source_text: Te souviens-tu du jour où nous nous sommes rencontrés ?
target_text: Je! Unakumbuka siku tuli kutananaka?
target_text_raw: Je! Unakumbuka siku tuli kutananaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas pu aller à l'école pendant trois semaines.
target_text: Tom hakuwai enda ku masomo kwa muda wa miezi tatu.
target_text_raw: Tom hakuwai enda ku masomo kwa muda wa miezi tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton pantalon est sale.
target_text: Pantalon yako inachafuka.
target_text_raw: Pantalon yako inachafuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais savoir ce que tu cherches.
target_text: Ningependa kujua chenye unatafuta.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kujua chenye unatafuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veux-tu que je dise à Tom que nous ne le ferons pas ?
target_text: Je! Unataka nimwambie Tom kama hatutaifanya?
target_text_raw: Je! Unataka nimwambie Tom kama hatutaifanya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a pris une semaine de congé.
target_text: Tom alikamata mapumuziko ya juma moya.
target_text_raw: Tom alikamata mapumuziko (congé) ya juma moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous étions assis sur un banc dans le parc.
target_text: Tulikuwa naikala ku kiti ndani ya bustani.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa naikala ku kiti (banc) ndani ya bustani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est revenue ici.
target_text: Alirudia hapa.
target_text_raw: Alirudia hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a abandonné ses fils.
target_text: Aliacha natupa batoto yake.
target_text_raw: Aliacha natupa batoto yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu jouais.
target_text: Ulikua nacheza.
target_text_raw: Ulikua nacheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'imagine une maison dans laquelle je serais heureux.
target_text: Minafikiria nyumba yenye nitaishi amo na furaha.
target_text_raw: Minafikiria nyumba yenye nitaishi amo na furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fais un petit somme presque tous les jours.
target_text: Nalalaka kidogo karibu kila siku.
target_text_raw: Nalalaka kidogo karibu kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'habite pas dans mon quartier.
target_text: Aishi mu mutaa yangu.
target_text_raw: Aishi mu mutaa (quartier) yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devez vous arrêter de boire.
target_text: Unapashwa acha kunywa pombe.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa acha kunywa pombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne nous mens pas.
target_text: Usitudanganye.
target_text_raw: Usitudanganye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je réponds de son honnêteté.
target_text: Minajibu kwa uaminifu wake.
target_text_raw: Minajibu kwa uaminifu wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le village où il est né.
target_text: Hii njo kijiji yenye alizaliwa amo.
target_text_raw: Hii njo kijiji yenye alizaliwa amo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Confirmez la commande.
target_text: Zibitisha agizo.
target_text_raw: Zibitisha agizo (commande).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois faire ça.
target_text: Lazima nifanye ivyo.
target_text_raw: Lazima nifanye ivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que c'est la bonne manière de le faire.
target_text: Nazani hiyo ndiyo njia ya muzuri yakuifanya.
target_text_raw: Nazani hiyo ndiyo njia ya muzuri yakuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci, j'ai tout compris.
target_text: Aksanti, nimeelewa kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Aksanti, nimeelewa kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne changerai pas d'idée, quoi qu'il se passe.
target_text: Sitabadilisha mawazo yangu hata ikuwe aje.
target_text_raw: Sitabadilisha mawazo yangu hata ikuwe aje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La société a été fondée en 1930.
target_text: Iyi kampuni ilianzishwa munamo mwaka wa 1930.
target_text_raw: Iyi kampuni ilianzishwa munamo mwaka wa 1930.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La télé ruine la vie de famille.
target_text: Télévision inaaribishaka tabia ya batu ndani ya familia.
target_text_raw: Télévision inaaribishaka tabia ya batu ndani ya familia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui d'autre est venu à la fête ?
target_text: Nani mwingine alikuya ku sherehe?
target_text_raw: Nani mwingine alikuya ku sherehe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était trop dur.
target_text: Ilikuwa vigumu sana.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa vigumu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allé en Italie pour la seconde fois en 1980.
target_text: Nilienda Italia kwa mara ya pili munamo mwaka wa 1980.
target_text_raw: Nilienda Italia kwa mara ya pili munamo mwaka wa 1980.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demandez au poste de police là-bas.
target_text: Uliza kituo cha polisi hapo.
target_text_raw: Uliza kituo cha polisi hapo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand ton anniversaire a-t-il lieu ?
target_text: Siku yako ya kuzaliwa inakuwaka siku gani ?
target_text_raw: Siku yako ya kuzaliwa inakuwaka siku gani ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes dents me font mal.
target_text: Meno yangu inanisumbua.
target_text_raw: Meno yangu inanisumbua (meno yangu iko naniluma).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a fermé la porte à clé.
target_text: Alifunga mulango na fungulo.
target_text_raw: Alifunga mulango na fungulo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Miracle ! Le lien fonctionne !
target_text: Muujiza! Kiunganishio kinatumika!
target_text_raw: Muujiza! Kiunganishio kinatumika!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me fais plus vieux et je ne veux plus travailler de nuit.
target_text: Minaendelea kuzeeka na sitaki kufanya kazi busiku tena.
target_text_raw: Minaendelea kuzeeka na sitaki kufanya kazi busiku tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une énorme responsabilité.
target_text: Ni jukumu kubwa.
target_text_raw: Ni jukumu kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas un secret que l'opinion de Tom est différente de la tienne.
target_text: Aiko siri kwamba maoni ya Tom ni tafauti na maoni yako.
target_text_raw: Aiko siri kwamba maoni ya Tom ni tafauti na maoni yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis votre voisin.
target_text: Niko jirani yako.
target_text_raw: Niko jirani yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'essayez pas de faire deux choses à la fois.
target_text: Usijaribu kufanya bitu mbili kwa wakati moja.
target_text_raw: Usijaribu kufanya bitu mbili kwa wakati moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aimerais pas vivre là-bas.
target_text: Singependa kuishi huko.
target_text_raw: Singependa kuishi huko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un peu injuste.
target_text: Iyo sio haki.
target_text_raw: Iyo sio haki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils finirent leur repas.
target_text: Balimaliza chakula yabo.
target_text_raw: Balimaliza chakula yabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est venu vers quatre heures.
target_text: Alifika karibu saa ine za asubui.
target_text_raw: Alifika karibu saa ine za asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut un miracle.
target_text: Minahitaji muujiza.
target_text_raw: Minahitaji muujiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me rappelle l'année où il a eu un travail.
target_text: Nakumbuka mwaka yenye alipata kazi.
target_text_raw: Nakumbuka mwaka yenye alipata kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est souvent en voyage.
target_text: Mara mingi Tom anazowea kuwa mu safari.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi Tom anazowea kuwa mu safari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sans mon conseil, tu aurais échoué.
target_text: Bila mashauri yangu, ungeshindwa.
target_text_raw: Bila mashauri yangu, ungeshindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as une bonne réputation.
target_text: Uko na tabia ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Uko na tabia ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois à mon oncle ce que je suis aujourd'hui.
target_text: Vile niko leo ni juu ya muyomba yangu.
target_text_raw: Vile niko leo ni juu ya muyomba yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se dressa pour ce qui était juste.
target_text: Alisimama kwa haki.
target_text_raw: Alisimama kwa (kupigania) haki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux même pas que tu sois là.
target_text: Sitaki ata ukuwe pale.
target_text_raw: Sitaki ata ukuwe pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je déteste ma voix.
target_text: Nachukia sauti yangu.
target_text_raw: Nachukia sauti yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a beaucoup trop de monde dans cette pièce.
target_text: Piko batu mingi mwa iyi chumba.
target_text_raw: Piko batu mingi mwa iyi chumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Savez-vous comment vous rendre chez nous ?
target_text: Unajua ginsi ya kwenda kwetu?
target_text_raw: Unajua ginsi ya kwenda kwetu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-moi la raison pour laquelle tu étais en retard à l'école.
target_text: Niambie sababu yenye ilifanya ufike ku masomo nyuma leo.
target_text_raw: Niambie sababu yenye ilifanya ufike ku masomo nyuma leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En raison d'une grave maladie, il ne peut pas mouvoir son corps comme la plupart des gens le peuvent.
target_text: Hawezi kusonga mwili wake kama watu wengi wanavyoweza kwa sababu ya ugonjwa mubaya.
target_text_raw: Hawezi kusonga (tingiza) mwili wake kama watu wengi wanavyoweza kwa sababu ya ugonjwa mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'as-tu embrassée ?
target_text: Ulimukumbatia?
target_text_raw: Ulimukumbatia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est maintenant à court d'argent.
target_text: Hana tena pesa.
target_text_raw: Hana tena pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette salle est pleine de soleil.
target_text: Piko jua mingi mwa iyi ukumbi.
target_text_raw: Piko jua mingi mwa iyi ukumbi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est dangereux de passer par le pont.
target_text: Ni hatari kupitia ku kilalo.
target_text_raw: Ni hatari kupitia ku kilalo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laissez-moi regarder !
target_text: Niache niangalie!
target_text_raw: Niache niangalie!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est plus dangereux que je ne le pensais.
target_text: Ni hatari sana kuliko ginsi nilikuwa nafikiria.
target_text_raw: Ni hatari sana kuliko ginsi nilikuwa nafikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai laissé mon parapluie ici la semaine dernière.
target_text: Niliacha mwamvuli yangu hapa juma yenye ilipita.
target_text_raw: Niliacha mwamvuli yangu hapa juma yenye ilipita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux vraiment vous embrasser.
target_text: Nataka ku kukumbatia.
target_text_raw: Nataka ku kukumbatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu cuisines vraiment bien.
target_text: Unajua kupiga muzuri.
target_text_raw: Unajua kupiga muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas Tom qui a emprunté ma voiture.
target_text: Aiko Tom njo alihazima gari yangu.
target_text_raw: Aiko Tom njo alihazima gari yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le pape visita le Brésil.
target_text: Papa alitembelea Brazil.
target_text_raw: Papa alitembelea Brazil.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'imagine que j'aurais dû le lire plus attentivement.
target_text: Nazani ningepashwa kuisoma kwa uangalifu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Nazani ningepashwa kuisoma kwa uangalifu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Permettez-moi de me présenter.
target_text: Niruhusu nijitambulishe.
target_text_raw: Niruhusu nijitambulishe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils se sont mariés quand ils étaient encore jeunes.
target_text: Walioana wakati walikua bado vijana.
target_text_raw: Walioana wakati walikua bado vijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sage.
target_text: Niko na hekima.
target_text_raw: Niko na hekima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça goûte le poulet.
target_text: Iko na onjo sawa ya nyama ya kuku.
target_text_raw: Iko na onjo sawa ya nyama ya kuku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me réjouis de vous revoir bientôt.
target_text: Natarajia kukuona tena mu siku kidogo zenye ziko mbele.
target_text_raw: Natarajia kukuona tena mu siku kidogo zenye ziko mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas le choix. Je dois le faire.
target_text: Sina chaguo. Lazima niifanye.
target_text_raw: Sina chaguo (sina ginsi ingine ya kufanya). Lazima niifanye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux les voir.
target_text: Napenda kuwa ona.
target_text_raw: Napenda kuwa ona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une heure de plus et la dinde sera prête.
target_text: Nyama ya dinde itakuwa tayari mu saa moya.
target_text_raw: Nyama ya dinde itakuwa tayari mu saa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils sont vraiment grands.
target_text: Ni ya mukubwa kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ni ya mukubwa kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chien qui aboie ne mord pas.
target_text: Imbwa yenye inafoka ailumake.
target_text_raw: Imbwa yenye inafoka ailumake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était l'heure du déjeuner.
target_text: Ilikua wakati wa chakula ya muchana.
target_text_raw: Ilikua wakati wa chakula ya muchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est gentil plutôt que doux.
target_text: Yeye ni mtu muzuri kuliko mupole.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mtu muzuri kuliko mupole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous composer le numéro pour moi ? Le téléphone est placé trop haut.
target_text: Je, unaweza kunipigia iyi numéro ya téléphone? Téléphone inawekwa yulu sana.
target_text_raw: Je, unaweza kunipigia iyi numéro (namba) ya téléphone? Téléphone (simu) inawekwa yulu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'excuse pour hier.
target_text: Naomba musamaha kuhusu jana.
target_text_raw: Naomba musamaha kuhusu jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne capte simplement pas.
target_text: Haelewi kitu kabisa.
target_text_raw: Haelewi kitu kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu aurais dû me dire ça avant.
target_text: Ungepashwa niambie tangu mbele.
target_text_raw: Ungepashwa niambie tangu mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La boîte est presque vide.
target_text: Sanduku iko karibu wazi.
target_text_raw: Sanduku iko karibu wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est élégant.
target_text: Tom anapendeza sana.
target_text_raw: Tom anapendeza sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La synchronisation est horrible.
target_text: Mabadadiliko ni ya mubaya sana.
target_text_raw: Mabadadiliko (marekebisho) ni ya mubaya sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allons-y !
target_text: Twende!
target_text_raw: Twende!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyages-tu seul ?
target_text: Unasafiri wepeke ?
target_text_raw: Unasafiri wepeke ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a demandé à Marie de ne pas discuter de ce sujet avec quelqu'un d'autre.
target_text: Tom alimwambia Maria asizungumuzie iyi habari na mutu mwingine.
target_text_raw: Tom alimwambia Maria asizungumuzie iyi habari na mutu mwingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a descendu les escaliers.
target_text: Tom alishuka escaliers.
target_text_raw: Tom alishuka escaliers.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai des devoirs à terminer.
target_text: Niko na kazi zakumalizia.
target_text_raw: Niko na kazi zakumalizia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne m'y connais peut-être pas beaucoup, mais je sais que Tom ne sait pas de quoi il parle.
target_text: Sijui mingi zaidi, alakini minajua kama Tom hajui byenye iko nazungumuza.
target_text_raw: Sijui mingi zaidi, alakini minajua kama Tom hajui byenye iko nazungumuza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne faisons pas confiance à Tom.
target_text: Hatumwamini Tom.
target_text_raw: Hatumwamini Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a une roche sur le plancher.
target_text: Piko lijiwe ya mkubwa yulu ya mbao.
target_text_raw: Piko lijiwe ya mkubwa yulu ya mbao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'allez pas le dire à mes parents, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Hautaambia wazazi wangu, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Hautaambia wazazi wangu, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu déjà porté des sous-vêtements longs ?
target_text: Je, ulishaka vala calecons ya murefu?
target_text_raw: Je, ulishaka vala calecons (chupi) ya murefu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Par ici !
target_text: Pitia hapa!
target_text_raw: Pitia hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demain, c'est dimanche.
target_text: Kesho ni siku ya Mungu.
target_text_raw: Kesho ni siku ya Mungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon s'est presque noyé.
target_text: Kijana alikaribia kuzama.
target_text_raw: Kijana alikaribia kuzama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime ce chien.
target_text: Minapenda iyi imbwa.
target_text_raw: Minapenda iyi imbwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il chante très bien.
target_text: Anaimba muzuri.
target_text_raw: Anaimba muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne peut pas vivre avec dix mille yens par mois.
target_text: Hauwezi ishi na yen elfu kumi ku mwezi.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi ishi na (franga za) yen elfu kumi ku mwezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est sans domicile fixe.
target_text: Tom hana makao kamili.
target_text_raw: Tom hana makao kamili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceux qui habitent des maisons de verre ne devraient pas lancer de pierres.
target_text: Wale ambao wanaishi katika nyumba za bio hawapashwi tupa majiwe.
target_text_raw: Wale ambao wanaishi katika nyumba za bio hawapashwi tupa majiwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dormi deux heures dans l'avion.
target_text: Nililala ma saa mbili mu avion.
target_text_raw: Nililala ma saa mbili mu avion (ndege).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allons continuer à le faire jusqu'à ce que quelqu'un nous dise que nous ne le pouvons pas.
target_text: Tutaendelea nafanya hivi mpaka mtu atuambie hatuwezi.
target_text_raw: Tutaendelea nafanya hivi mpaka mtu atuambie hatuwezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien t'en reste-t-il ?
target_text: Inakubakia na ngapi?
target_text_raw: Inakubakia na ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ignorais ça jusqu'à ce matin.
target_text: Leo asubuhi njo nilijua hivo.
target_text_raw: Leo asubuhi njo nilijua hivo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prenez rendez-vous.
target_text: Fanya mupango naye.
target_text_raw: Fanya mupango naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête d'aller là-bas.
target_text: Acha kwenda kule.
target_text_raw: Acha kwenda kule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ouvrit la porte.
target_text: Alifungula mulango.
target_text_raw: Alifungula mulango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'as-tu pensé de Tom ?
target_text: Uliwaza nini kuhusu Tom?
target_text_raw: Uliwaza nini kuhusu Tom?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son mari est sur son lit de mort.
target_text: Bwana yake iko ku kitanda ya mauti.
target_text_raw: Bwana yake iko ku kitanda ya mauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons deux filles.
target_text: Tuko na babinti bawili.
target_text_raw: Tuko na babinti bawili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne parle que le français.
target_text: Naongea tu Kifaransa.
target_text_raw: Naongea tu Kifaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je connais les conséquences potentielles.
target_text: Najua hatari zenye zinaweza kutokea.
target_text_raw: Najua hatari zenye zinaweza kutokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me douche quotidiennement.
target_text: Minakogaka kila siku.
target_text_raw: Minakogaka kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faudrait que tu ailles jusqu'au bout de ton premier plan.
target_text: Ungepashwa endelea na mpango yako ya kwanza mpaka mwisho.
target_text_raw: Ungepashwa endelea na mpango yako ya kwanza mpaka mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se met à neiger.
target_text: Neiges zinaanza mwangika.
target_text_raw: Neiges zinaanza mwangika (shuka).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vos parents parlent-ils le français ?
target_text: Wazazi wako wanasemaka Kifaransa?
target_text_raw: Wazazi wako wanasemaka Kifaransa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les nuits, elle reste éveillée jusqu'à ce que son mari rentre à la maison.
target_text: Kila busiku anabakiaka anakesha mpaka saa bwana yake anarudia kunyumba.
target_text_raw: Kila busiku anabakiaka anakesha mpaka saa bwana yake anarudia kunyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se mit à faire courir ses doigts dans ses cheveux.
target_text: Alianza pitisha bidole yake mu nywele zake.
target_text_raw: Alianza pitisha bidole yake mu nywele zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'allemand est la meilleure langue du monde.
target_text: Kijerumani njo lugha bora ya kwanza duniani.
target_text_raw: Kijerumani njo lugha bora ya kwanza duniani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom choisit la solution de facilité.
target_text: Tom anachagula njia rahisi.
target_text_raw: Tom anachagula njia (suluhisho) rahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette boîte est d'une autre couleur que celle-là.
target_text: Rangi ya iyi sanduku iko tafauti na ya ile ingine.
target_text_raw: Rangi ya iyi sanduku iko tafauti na ya ile ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est arrivée là-bas avant Tom.
target_text: Alifika pale mbele ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Alifika pale mbele ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il sera en train de dormir.
target_text: Itakuwa analala.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa analala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vous a tout sacrifié.
target_text: Alikupatia kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Alikupatia kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous parlez en anglais ?
target_text: Unasema mu Kingereza?
target_text_raw: Unasema mu Kingereza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allons nous marier en octobre.
target_text: Tutaoana mwezi wa kumi.
target_text_raw: Tutaoana mwezi wa kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Va-t-il bien ?
target_text: Anaendelea muzuri?
target_text_raw: Anaendelea muzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Te faut-il un chauffeur pour rentrer chez toi ?
target_text: Je, unahitaji dereva kwa kurudi kwako?
target_text_raw: Je, unahitaji dereva (chauffeur) kwa kurudi kwako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas encore décidé quoi faire.
target_text: Sijahamua chakufanya.
target_text_raw: Sijahamua chakufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les vaches vivent sur l'herbe.
target_text: Ngombe zinaishiki ku nyasi.
target_text_raw: Ngombe zinaishiki ku nyasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est un gosse de riche.
target_text: Tom ni mutoto wa tajiri.
target_text_raw: Tom ni mutoto wa tajiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tiens ta langue ou tu seras puni.
target_text: Shika ulimi yako kama aiko ivo utaazibiwa.
target_text_raw: Shika ulimi yako kama aiko ivo utaazibiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux plus supporter ce froid.
target_text: Siwezi vumilia tena iyi baridi.
target_text_raw: Siwezi vumilia tena iyi baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soyons simplement amis !
target_text: Tubakie tu marafiki!
target_text_raw: Tubakie tu marafiki!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux ce boulot.
target_text: Nataka iyi kazi.
target_text_raw: Nataka iyi kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne lui dis pas.
target_text: Usimwambie.
target_text_raw: Usimwambie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais ouvrir la boîte et regarder ce qu'il y a à l'intérieur.
target_text: Ndafungula sanduku na niangalie nini njo iko ndani.
target_text_raw: Ndafungula sanduku na niangalie nini njo iko ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lave-toi le visage.
target_text: Nawa sura yako.
target_text_raw: Nawa sura yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La conquête normande de l'Angleterre eut beaucoup d'influence sur la langue anglaise.
target_text: Ushindi wa Norman wa Uingereza ulikuwa na ushawishi mkubwa kwa lugha ya Kiingereza.
target_text_raw: Ushindi wa Norman wa Uingereza ulikuwa na ushawishi mkubwa kwa lugha ya Kiingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle lui a transmis des signaux contradictoires.
target_text: Alimupa signal zaku tofautiyana.
target_text_raw: Alimupa signal (ishara) zaku tofautiyana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il avait marché durant des heures.
target_text: Alitembeaka kwa masaa mingi.
target_text_raw: Alitembeaka kwa masaa mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Depuis combien de temps habites-tu ici ?
target_text: Unaishi hapa kwa muda gani?
target_text_raw: Unaishi hapa kwa muda gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon frère aîné a décroché un poste dans une grosse boîte.
target_text: Kaka yangu mukubwa alipata kazi kwenye shirika kubwa.
target_text_raw: Kaka yangu mukubwa alipata kazi kwenye shirika kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas besoin de préparer une allocution formelle.
target_text: Hauna haja ya kuandaa hotuba rasmi.
target_text_raw: Hauna haja ya kuandaa hotuba (discours) rasmi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'a pas d'égale pour ce qui est de cuisiner chinois.
target_text: Hana mupinzani kwa kupiga chakula ya Kichina.
target_text_raw: Hana mupinzani kwa kupiga chakula ya Kichina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout s'est passé d'un coup.
target_text: Yote ilipitika mara moja.
target_text_raw: Yote ilipitika mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quels sont vos véritables sentiments ?
target_text: Hisia zako za kweli ni gani?
target_text_raw: Hisia zako za kweli ni gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La prochaine fois que je serai à la plage, j'enverrai un message dans une bouteille.
target_text: Siku ndakuwaka tena ku plage, ndatumaka ujumbe kupitia chupa.
target_text_raw: Siku ndakuwaka tena ku plage, ndatumaka ujumbe kupitia chupa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qu'un dieu ?
target_text: Miungu ni nani ?
target_text_raw: Miungu ni nani ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom va perdre.
target_text: Tom atapoteza.
target_text_raw: Tom atapoteza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que nous nous sommes égarés.
target_text: Minawaza kama tulisha potea.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama tulisha potea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela est d'aspect ordinaire.
target_text: Iyi ni kitu ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Iyi ni kitu ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne faites pas de bruit.
target_text: Usifanye fujo.
target_text_raw: Usifanye fujo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux participer.
target_text: Minataka kushiriki.
target_text_raw: Minataka kushiriki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon appartement est proche d'ici.
target_text: Nyumba yangu iko karibu ya hapa.
target_text_raw: Nyumba yangu iko karibu ya hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Réfléchis-y encore une fois.
target_text: Ifikirie tena.
target_text_raw: Ifikirie tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais vous y trouver.
target_text: Nilizani nitakukuta huko.
target_text_raw: Nilizani nitakukuta huko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pierre le Cruel est également connu comme Pierre le Justicier.
target_text: Petro mufanya maovu anajulikana pia kama Petro mupiganiaji wa haki.
target_text_raw: Petro mufanya maovu (Pierre le cruel) anajulikana pia kama Petro mupiganiaji wa haki (Pierre le Justicier).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est difficile d'oublier ce qui s'est passé.
target_text: Ni nguvu sana kusahau byenye bilipita.
target_text_raw: Ni nguvu sana kusahau byenye bilipita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'est levé et est parti au milieu de la discussion.
target_text: Akashimama na kuondoka katikati ya mazungumzo.
target_text_raw: Akashimama na kuondoka katikati ya mazungumzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux entrer.
target_text: Unaweza ingia.
target_text_raw: Unaweza ingia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je croyais que Tom était mort.
target_text: Nilizani kama Tom alikua amekufa.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama Tom alikua amekufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est très ouvert.
target_text: Yeye ni muwazi sana.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni muwazi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jour se divise en matin, matinée, midi, après-midi, soir et nuit.
target_text: Siku inagawanyika kati ya asubuhi, ma asubuhi, muchana, kisha saa sita ya muchana, jioni na usiku.
target_text_raw: Siku inagawanyika kati ya asubuhi, ma asubuhi, muchana, kisha saa sita ya muchana, jioni na usiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai tellement ri que mon estomac me fait mal.
target_text: Nilicheka sana mpaka tumbu inaanza niluma.
target_text_raw: Nilicheka sana mpaka tumbu inaanza niluma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas un sujet de plaisanterie.
target_text: Haiko kitu ya kuchekesha.
target_text_raw: Haiko kitu ya kuchekesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a retrouvé le porte-monnaie qu'il croyait avoir perdu après avoir fouillé la maison de tous bords tous côtés.
target_text: Tom alipata mkoba yake ya kuwekea amo pesa yenye alikuwa nazania alipoteza kisha kupekua fasi zote mu nyumba.
target_text_raw: Tom alipata mkoba yake ya kuwekea amo pesa (porte-monnaie) yenye alikuwa nazania alipoteza kisha kupekua fasi zote mu nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a essayé fort mais il a échoué.
target_text: Alijaribu sana lakini alishindwa.
target_text_raw: Alijaribu sana lakini alishindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas eu beaucoup de sommeil.
target_text: Sikupata busingizi mingi.
target_text_raw: Sikupata busingizi mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime ta manière de parler.
target_text: Minapenda namna yako yakuongea.
target_text_raw: Minapenda namna yako yakuongea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas qu'on puisse lui faire confiance.
target_text: Sizani kama ni mutu wakuaminika.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama ni mutu wakuaminika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je le fais pour eux.
target_text: Naifanya juu yabo.
target_text_raw: Naifanya juu yabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne reste pas de nourriture.
target_text: Hakuna tena chakula.
target_text_raw: Hakuna tena chakula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils s'aimaient.
target_text: Walikua wanapendana.
target_text_raw: Walikua wanapendana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vous dois rien !
target_text: Sina deni yako!
target_text_raw: Sina deni yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis trop fatigué pour conduire. Pourriez-vous conduire ?
target_text: Siwezi tembeza gari juu minachoka. Unaweza tembeza gari?
target_text_raw: Siwezi tembeza gari juu minachoka. Unaweza tembeza gari?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous traverser la rivière à la nage ?
target_text: Je, unaweza kuvuka mutoni kwa kuogelea?
target_text_raw: Je, unaweza kuvuka mutoni kwa kuogelea?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avant demain matin cette fille l'aura fini.
target_text: Kabla ya kesho asubuhi huyu musichana atakuwa alisha maliza.
target_text_raw: Kabla ya kesho asubuhi huyu musichana atakuwa alisha maliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas exactement ce que je voulais, mais je l'ai acheté malgré tout.
target_text: Aiko njo kyenye nilikuwa alakini niliuza tu vile.
target_text_raw: Aiko njo kyenye nilikuwa alakini niliuza tu vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un chat est sous la table.
target_text: Pusi iko chini ya meza.
target_text_raw: Pusi iko chini ya meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi me faites-vous ça ?
target_text: Juu ya nini unanifanyia hivi?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini unanifanyia hivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous apprécie en tant qu'ami.
target_text: Minakupenda kama rafiki.
target_text_raw: Minakupenda kama rafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne me souviens pas quand et où je t'ai rencontré.
target_text: Sikumbuki nilikutana na weye wapi na wakati gani.
target_text_raw: Sikumbuki nilikutana na weye wapi na wakati gani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a une voiture japonaise.
target_text: Iko na gari ya Kijapani.
target_text_raw: Iko na gari ya Kijapani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je savais que c'était ce que tu voulais.
target_text: Nilijua kama iyi njo ulikuwa nataka.
target_text_raw: Nilijua kama iyi njo ulikuwa nataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devrions attendre.
target_text: Tunapashwa chunga.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa chunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est dommage que le professeur quitte notre école.
target_text: Ni huzuni kuona mwalimu anatoka ku masomo yetu.
target_text_raw: Ni huzuni kuona mwalimu anatoka ku masomo yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre vol part à 14 h 30.
target_text: Avion yetu itaondoka saa 7 na dakika makumi tatu za muchana.
target_text_raw: Avion (ndege) yetu itaondoka saa 7 na dakika makumi tatu za muchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nuit dernière, quelqu'un a cambriolé une boutique près de chez moi.
target_text: Jana busiku, mtu aliiba mu duka ya karibu ya kwenye minaishi.
target_text_raw: Jana busiku, mtu aliiba mu duka ya karibu ya kwenye minaishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'avais eu le temps, je l'aurais fait.
target_text: Ningekuwaka na wakati, ningefanya hivyo.
target_text_raw: Ningekuwaka na wakati, ningefanya hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'as-tu dans ton sac ?
target_text: Nini njo unako nayo mu mukoba yako?
target_text_raw: Nini njo unako nayo mu mukoba yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et Marie ont étudié ensemble.
target_text: Tom na Maria balisomaka pamoja.
target_text_raw: Tom na Maria balisomaka pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il travaillait dur, il pourrait avoir son examen.
target_text: Ingekuwa alifanya kazi kwa bidii, angeweza kufanya mtihani wake.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa alifanya kazi kwa bidii, angeweza kufanya (pitisha) mtihani wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne compare jamais ta femme à une autre femme.
target_text: Usijaribu linganisha bibi yako na mwanamuke mwingine.
target_text_raw: Usijaribu linganisha bibi yako na mwanamuke mwingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne retire pas toutes les pierres du chemin de tes enfants, sans quoi ils se heurteront un jour, en courant, la tête dans un mur.
target_text: Usitoe majiwe yote kutoka mu njia kwenye batoto yako banapita, bila ivyo siku moya watakimbiaka na haraka nakujigonga kwenye ukuta.
target_text_raw: Usitoe majiwe yote kutoka mu njia kwenye batoto yako banapita, bila ivyo siku moya watakimbiaka na haraka nakujigonga kwenye ukuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes restés silencieux.
target_text: Tulibakia kimya.
target_text_raw: Tulibakia kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a dit que Mary était morte lundi.
target_text: Tom aliniambia kama Maria alikufa siku ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Tom aliniambia kama Maria alikufa siku ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne pouvait pas s'empêcher de le tripoter.
target_text: Akuweza kujizuia kuigusa gusa.
target_text_raw: Akuweza kujizuia kuigusa gusa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu une solution ?
target_text: Uko na suluhisho?
target_text_raw: Uko na suluhisho?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a écrit ce poème la nuit dernière.
target_text: Aliandika hii poème jana busiku.
target_text_raw: Aliandika hii poème jana busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Reste près.
target_text: Bakia karibu.
target_text_raw: Bakia karibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne parlez pas de ça.
target_text: Usiongelee iyo.
target_text_raw: Usiongelee iyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui que ce soit qui dit cela est un menteur.
target_text: Mutu yeyote mwenye anasema vile ni muongo.
target_text_raw: Mutu yeyote mwenye anasema vile ni muongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que veux-tu de moi ?
target_text: Unataka nini kwangu?
target_text_raw: Unataka nini kwangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas encore désespérés.
target_text: Hatuya poteza matumaini bado.
target_text_raw: Hatuya poteza matumaini bado.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va probablement neiger demain.
target_text: Iko saa kesho kutakua neige.
target_text_raw: Iko saa kesho kutakua neige.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vérifié deux fois pour m'assurer que nous n'avions fait aucune erreur.
target_text: Niliangalia mara mbili juu ya kuhakikisha kama hatukufanya makosa yoyote.
target_text_raw: Niliangalia mara mbili juu ya kuhakikisha kama hatukufanya makosa yoyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est le numéro de ma chambre ?
target_text: Numéro ya chumba yangu ni gani?
target_text_raw: Numéro (namba) ya chumba yangu ni gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a pris très peu de poissons dans cette rivière.
target_text: Tulipata samaki za kidogo sana mwa iyi mutoni.
target_text_raw: Tulipata samaki za kidogo sana mwa iyi mutoni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous lui rendons visite de temps en temps.
target_text: Tuna mutembeleaka mara kwa mara.
target_text_raw: Tuna mutembeleaka mara kwa mara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois plus au régime qu'aux médicaments.
target_text: Minaamini zaidi malisho kuliko madawa.
target_text_raw: Minaamini zaidi malisho kuliko madawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça fonctionne.
target_text: Inatumika.
target_text_raw: Inatumika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et les voilà !
target_text: Njo hizi!
target_text_raw: Njo hizi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant, pourquoi irais-tu commettre une telle bêtise ?
target_text: Sasa juu ya nini unaweza enda fanya mambo ya kijinga?
target_text_raw: Sasa juu ya nini unaweza enda fanya mambo ya kijinga?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ignore si je devrais rire ou pleurer.
target_text: Sijui kama nicheke ao nilie.
target_text_raw: Sijui kama nicheke ao nilie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux rien promettre, mais je vais faire de mon mieux.
target_text: Siwezi kukuahidi chochote, lakini nitajitahidi.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kukuahidi chochote, lakini nitajitahidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas bu cette eau, hein ?
target_text: Haukukunywa iyi mayi eh?
target_text_raw: Haukukunywa iyi mayi eh?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom s'est fait mal.
target_text: Tom alijilumiza.
target_text_raw: Tom alijilumiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous répétons beaucoup.
target_text: Tunarudialia mara mingi.
target_text_raw: Tunarudialia mara mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de fois devriez-vous exercer ?
target_text: Mungefanya mazoezi mara ngapi?
target_text_raw: Mungefanya mazoezi mara ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allons manger ensemble.
target_text: Twende kula pamoja.
target_text_raw: Twende kula pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui penses-tu qu'est cet homme ?
target_text: Unafikiri huyu mutu ni nani?
target_text_raw: Unafikiri huyu mutu ni nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été promu il y a trois mois.
target_text: Nilipandishwa cheo miezi tatu yenye ilipita.
target_text_raw: Nilipandishwa cheo miezi tatu yenye ilipita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet enfant est mince.
target_text: Uyu mutoto ni mwembamba.
target_text_raw: Uyu mutoto ni mwembamba (anagonda).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Entends-tu quelque chose ?
target_text: Unasikia kitu?
target_text_raw: Unasikia kitu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me sens beaucoup mieux maintenant.
target_text: Najisikia muzuri zidi sasa.
target_text_raw: Najisikia muzuri zidi sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dépêche-toi et tu seras à l'heure à l'école.
target_text: Harakisha na utafika mapema ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Harakisha na utafika mapema ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que peux-tu m'enseigner ?
target_text: Unaweza nifundisha nini?
target_text_raw: Unaweza nifundisha nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devrions y parvenir si la circulation n'est pas trop encombrée.
target_text: Tutafika kama embouteillage mu balabala aiko mingi.
target_text_raw: Tutafika kama embouteillage mu balabala aiko mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veux-tu manger ça ?
target_text: Unataka kula iyi?
target_text_raw: Unataka kula iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'y prête pas attention.
target_text: Usiijali.
target_text_raw: Usiijali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « D'où Tom tient-il cette facilité pour le français ? Il n'a jamais mis les pieds dans un pays francophone et n'a pas non plus d'amis francophones. » « Je crois qu'il regarde beaucoup de films français sur Internet. »
target_text: «Nini njo inatuma Tom anaongea Kifaransa kwa urahisi?» Hajawahi kufika mu nchi inayozungumuza Kifaransa na hana marafiki wenye wanazungumuza Kifaransa. «Nazani anaangalia films mingi za Kifaransa kwenye internet». »
target_text_raw: «Nini njo inatuma Tom anaongea Kifaransa kwa urahisi?» Hajawahi kufika mu nchi inayozungumuza Kifaransa na hana marafiki wenye wanazungumuza Kifaransa. «Nazani anaangalia films (filamu) mingi za Kifaransa kwenye internet». »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux être cosmonaute.
target_text: Nataka kuwa cosmonaute.
target_text_raw: Nataka kuwa cosmonaute (dereva wa kutembeza chombo ya kwenda angani).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne permettrais jamais cela.
target_text: Sitaruhusu ile ata siku moya.
target_text_raw: Sitaruhusu ile ata siku moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel jour es-tu libre habituellement ?
target_text: Unazowea kuwa huru siku gani?
target_text_raw: Unazowea kuwa huru siku gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle perte !
target_text: Iyi ni hasara!
target_text_raw: Iyi ni hasara!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que Thomas a un vélo ?
target_text: Je! Thomas iko na kinga?
target_text_raw: Je! Thomas iko na kinga?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'argent n'est pas tout.
target_text: Pesa siyo kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Pesa siyo kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'opération a eu lieu hier.
target_text: Shughuli ilifanyika jana.
target_text_raw: Shughuli (opération) ilifanyika jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu as bu beaucoup ?
target_text: Je! Ulikunywa pombe sana?
target_text_raw: Je! Ulikunywa pombe sana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est le monsieur auquel il parle ?
target_text: Ni bwana gani njo iko naongea?
target_text_raw: Ni bwana gani njo iko naongea?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis plus jeune, mais je peux encore mordre.
target_text: Miye siko tena mtoto mdogo alakini minaweza luma.
target_text_raw: Miye siko tena mtoto mdogo alakini minaweza luma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas être ami avec Tom.
target_text: Siwezi kua rafiki ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kua rafiki ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'es sérieux, non ?
target_text: Uko sérieux, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Uko sérieux, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un oiseau de nuit.
target_text: Ni ndege ya busiku.
target_text_raw: Ni ndege ya busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Parles-tu le grec ? » - « Pas encore, c'est ma première leçon ! »
target_text: "Unaongea Kigiriki?" - "Bado, ni somo yangu ya kwanza!" »
target_text_raw: "Unaongea Kigiriki?" - "Bado, ni somo yangu ya kwanza!" »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voulais savoir d'où la voix provenait.
target_text: Nilikuwa nataka kujua sauti ilikua natoka wapi.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nataka kujua sauti ilikua natoka wapi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux plus causer de souci à personne.
target_text: Sitaki kusumbua mutu tena.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kusumbua mutu tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a une rumeur selon laquelle Tom est gay.
target_text: Kuna habari isiyo kuwa na uhakikisho yenye kusema kama Tom ni shoga.
target_text_raw: Kuna habari isiyo kuwa na uhakikisho yenye kusema kama Tom ni shoga (homosexuel).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Communiquer des nouvelles à la télévision et à la radio est très courant de nos jours.
target_text: Kupitisha habari ku télévision na ku redio ni jambo ya kawaida siku hizi.
target_text_raw: Kupitisha habari ku télévision na ku redio ni jambo ya kawaida siku hizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan semblait être un suspect probable.
target_text: Dan alionekana kuwa mtuhumiwa.
target_text_raw: Dan alionekana kuwa mtuhumiwa (suspect).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas beaucoup aimé le concert.
target_text: Tom hakupenda sana ile concert.
target_text_raw: Tom hakupenda sana ile concert.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il va pleuvoir bientôt.
target_text: Minawaza kama mvula itanyesha mu saa zenye zinakuya.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama mvula itanyesha mu saa zenye zinakuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'achetais beaucoup de choses.
target_text: Nilikua nauza bitu mingi.
target_text_raw: Nilikua nauza bitu mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a quelques bons films cette semaine?
target_text: Je! Kuna sinema za muzuri iyi juma?
target_text_raw: Je! Kuna sinema za muzuri iyi juma?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle tenait un parapluie.
target_text: Alikua nakamata mwamvuli.
target_text_raw: Alikua nakamata mwamvuli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est difficile à croire.
target_text: Ni bigumu kuamini.
target_text_raw: Ni bigumu kuamini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une douleur à la poitrine.
target_text: Kifua iko naniluma.
target_text_raw: Kifua iko naniluma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai déjà lu tous les livres d'Harry Potter.
target_text: Nilisha soma bitabu yote ya Harry Potter.
target_text_raw: Nilisha soma bitabu yote ya Harry Potter.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Venez avec moi, je vous prie.
target_text: Nifuate, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Nifuate, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez-vous en ! Je ne veux pas vous parler !
target_text: Wende huko! Sitaki kukuongelesha!
target_text_raw: Wende huko (Toka hapo)! Sitaki kukuongelesha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le problème est qu'elles ne pensent qu'à elles.
target_text: Shida ni kwamba wanajipendelea tu.
target_text_raw: Shida ni kwamba wanajipendelea tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa théorie est difficile à comprendre.
target_text: Mtazamo yake iko nguvu kuelewa.
target_text_raw: Mtazamo (wazo) yake iko nguvu kuelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as rien à craindre.
target_text: Usiogope kitu.
target_text_raw: Usiogope kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous reste-t-il de la bière ?
target_text: Kungali pombe bado ?
target_text_raw: Kungali pombe bado ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père ne dit rien.
target_text: Baba yangu hasemi kitu.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu hasemi kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a montré sa chambre.
target_text: Tom alinionesha chumba yake.
target_text_raw: Tom alinionesha chumba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses cheveux cachaient son visage.
target_text: Nywele zake zilikua naficha sura yake.
target_text_raw: Nywele zake zilikua naficha sura yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette salle peut accueillir deux mille personnes.
target_text: Watu elfu mbili wanawaza enea mwa iyi ukumbi.
target_text_raw: Watu elfu mbili wanawaza enea mwa iyi ukumbi (salle).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vous faudra le faire par vous-même.
target_text: Itabidi uifanye wepeke.
target_text_raw: Itabidi uifanye wepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne crois pas que les choses changent.
target_text: Sizani kama mambo itabadilika.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama mambo itabadilika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela fait longtemps que j'attends.
target_text: Nilishafanya muda murefu minangoa.
target_text_raw: Nilishafanya muda murefu minangoa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon conseil n'a pas été suivi.
target_text: Shauri yangu haikufuatwa.
target_text_raw: Shauri yangu haikufuatwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’ai tendance à regarder les images avant de lire le texte.
target_text: Miye naangaliaka picha mbele ya kusoma maandishi.
target_text_raw: Miye naangaliaka picha mbele ya kusoma maandishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où cette pièce va-t-elle ?
target_text: Upana ya iyi nyumba inaishia wapi?
target_text_raw: Upana ya iyi nyumba inaishia wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux tous vous remercier d'être venus ici aujourd'hui.
target_text: Nataka kuwashukuru nyiye bote kwa kufika hapa leo.
target_text_raw: Nataka kuwashukuru nyiye bote kwa kufika hapa leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allons essuyer une tempête.
target_text: Tutapambana na zoruba.
target_text_raw: Tutapambana na zoruba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il demanda de l'aide à ses amis.
target_text: Akalomba musaada ku barafiki yake.
target_text_raw: Akalomba musaada ku barafiki yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai déjà fait.
target_text: Nilisha ifanya.
target_text_raw: Nilisha ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce que tu ignores ne peut te faire de mal.
target_text: Kyenye haujui hakiwezi kukusumbua.
target_text_raw: Kyenye haujui hakiwezi kukusumbua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants doivent obéir à leurs parents.
target_text: Watoto wanapashwa heshimu wazazi wao.
target_text_raw: Watoto wanapashwa heshimu wazazi wao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel gros gâteau !
target_text: Ni keki ya mukubwa sana!
target_text_raw: Ni keki ya mukubwa sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a gagné le concours.
target_text: Tom alishinda shindano.
target_text_raw: Tom alishinda shindano (concours).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut que cela soit corrigé.
target_text: Ile inapashwa kosolewa.
target_text_raw: Ile inapashwa kosolewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Accepteriez-vous ces conditions ?
target_text: Utakubali iyi masharti?
target_text_raw: Utakubali iyi masharti?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous fermer la porte, s'il vous plaît ?
target_text: Unaweza funga mulango, tafazali?
target_text_raw: Unaweza funga mulango, tafazali?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens qui jouent dans la boue auront leurs mains sales.
target_text: Batu benye banacheza mu matope mikono yabo ita chafuka.
target_text_raw: Batu benye banacheza mu matope mikono yabo ita chafuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'essaye pas de jouer le héros maintenant.
target_text: Usijaribu kuwa shujaa sasa.
target_text_raw: Usijaribu kuwa shujaa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout espoir a disparu.
target_text: Matumaini yote ilipotea.
target_text_raw: Matumaini yote ilipotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous oublié votre argent ?
target_text: Ulisahabu pesa yako?
target_text_raw: Ulisahabu pesa (franga) yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle me demanda d'aller la chercher à la gare.
target_text: Aliniambia niende mukamata ku kituo ya.
target_text_raw: Aliniambia niende mukamata ku kituo ya (gari, train, etc).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis resté alité toute la journée d'hier.
target_text: Jana nilishinda mu kitanda siku mzima.
target_text_raw: Jana nilishinda mu kitanda siku mzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Garde un œil sur Tom.
target_text: Muchunge Tom muzuri.
target_text_raw: Muchunge Tom muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas encore !
target_text: Bado!
target_text_raw: Bado!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous viendrons te chercher.
target_text: Tutakuya kutafuta.
target_text_raw: Tutakuya kutafuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es trop jeune encore pour obtenir un permis de conduire.
target_text: Umri yako aiya kuruhusu kupata kitambulisho ya kutembeza gari.
target_text_raw: Umri yako aiya kuruhusu kupata kitambulisho ya kutembeza gari (permis de conduire).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre père est-il médecin ?
target_text: Baba yako ni muganga?
target_text_raw: Baba yako ni muganga (daktari)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a mangé du riz deux fois par jour pendant de nombreuses années.
target_text: Alikula wali mara mbili kwa siku mu kipindi ya miaka mingi.
target_text_raw: Alikula wali mara mbili kwa siku mu kipindi ya miaka mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devez arrêter de faire ça sur-le-champ.
target_text: Unapashwa acha kufanya hivi sasa.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa acha kufanya hivi sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'après ce que je sais, ils n'ont pas d'enfants.
target_text: Kwa ginsi minajua, habana batoto.
target_text_raw: Kwa ginsi minajua, habana batoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a fait des erreurs graves.
target_text: Tom alifanya makosa kubwa sana.
target_text_raw: Tom alifanya makosa kubwa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'as de jolies jambes.
target_text: Uko na migulu ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Uko na migulu ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas un problème.
target_text: Hakuna shida.
target_text_raw: Hakuna shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis le seul à ne pas être tombé dans le piège.
target_text: Miye tu njo sikuanguka mu mutego.
target_text_raw: Miye tu njo sikuanguka mu mutego.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous demande pardon ?
target_text: Minakulomba musamaha.
target_text_raw: Minakulomba musamaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu en train de tomber amoureux de moi ?
target_text: Je! Unaanza nipenda ?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaanza nipenda ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une table.
target_text: Ni meza.
target_text_raw: Ni meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi avez-vous écrit ce livre ?
target_text: Kwa nini uliandika iyi kitabu?
target_text_raw: Kwa nini uliandika iyi kitabu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais toujours différent.
target_text: Nilikua tafauti kila mara.
target_text_raw: Nilikua tafauti kila mara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le monsieur sait mieux lui-même la valeur de sa propre vie.
target_text: Huyu bwana anajua yepeke samani ya maisha yake.
target_text_raw: Huyu bwana anajua yepeke samani ya maisha yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attends ici. Je reviendrai bientôt.
target_text: Chungia hapa. Ndarudia mu saa kidogo.
target_text_raw: Chungia hapa. Ndarudia mu saa kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai rencontrée il y a une heure.
target_text: Nilikutana naye saa kunapita saa moya.
target_text_raw: Nilikutana naye saa kunapita saa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est soit fou, soit drogué.
target_text: Yeye ni mwendabazimu ao alitumia madawa ya kulevya.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mwendabazimu ao alitumia madawa ya kulevya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma famille a vécu ici pendant vingt ans.
target_text: Familia yangu iliishi apa miaka makumi mbili.
target_text_raw: Familia yangu iliishi apa miaka makumi mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis beaucoup plus jeune que Tom.
target_text: Niko mdogo sana kushinda Tom.
target_text_raw: Niko mdogo sana kushinda Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette femme sait précisément qu'elle ne sait pas ce qu'elle veut.
target_text: Huyu mwanamuke anajua kabisa kama hajui kyenye anataka.
target_text_raw: Huyu mwanamuke anajua kabisa kama hajui kyenye anataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voudrais boire quelque chose de chaud.
target_text: Nataka kunywa kitu ya moto.
target_text_raw: Nataka kunywa kitu ya moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était presque noyé.
target_text: Alikuwa karibu ya kuzama.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa karibu ya kuzama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis bonjour à ta femme de ma part, s'il te plaît.
target_text: Salimia muke wako kwa niaba yangu, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Salimia muke wako kwa niaba yangu, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que Tom va bien ?
target_text: Tom iko sawa ?
target_text_raw: Tom iko sawa ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne lui parle pas comme ça.
target_text: Usimuongeleshe vile.
target_text_raw: Usimuongeleshe vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas bien réveillé ce matin.
target_text: Sikulamuka muzuri leo.
target_text_raw: Sikulamuka muzuri leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle en a une : dans le cœur du peuple chinois.
target_text: Iko na moya : katika roho ya wachina.
target_text_raw: Iko na moya : katika roho ya wachina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vas le casser si tu ne fais pas attention.
target_text: Usipokuwa mwangalifu utaivunja.
target_text_raw: Usipokuwa mwangalifu utaivunja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serais malheureux, mais je ne me suiciderais pas.
target_text: Ningekuwa munyonge, alakini nisingejiua.
target_text_raw: Ningekuwa munyonge, alakini nisingejiua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se fait une règle d'écrire dans son journal tous les jours.
target_text: Alijiwekea kanuni ya kuandika mu journal yake kila siku.
target_text_raw: Alijiwekea kanuni ya kuandika mu journal yake kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il te plaît, dis-moi que c'est dingue !
target_text: Tafazali, niambie kama hiyi haiko kitu ya kawaida !
target_text_raw: Tafazali, niambie kama hiyi haiko kitu ya kawaida !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'agent de service m'a aidé à résoudre mon problème.
target_text: Ule mfanyakazi alinisaidia kutatua shida yangu.
target_text_raw: Ule mfanyakazi alinisaidia kutatua shida yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Excusez-moi, combien cela coûte ?
target_text: Samahani, inauzishwa ngapi ?
target_text_raw: Samahani, inauzishwa ngapi ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dois-tu faire ça à chaque fois ?
target_text: Ni lazima ufanye ivyo kila mara ?
target_text_raw: Ni lazima ufanye ivyo kila mara ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle parle bien.
target_text: Anaongea vizuri.
target_text_raw: Anaongea vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me manques beaucoup.
target_text: Minakukumbuka sana.
target_text_raw: Minakukumbuka sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je travaille de nuit.
target_text: Minatumika busiku.
target_text_raw: Minatumika busiku.
