notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai repris l'entreprise de Père.
target_text: Nilianza shimamia biashara ya Baba.
target_text_raw: Nilianza shimamia biashara (entreprise) ya Baba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vraiment passé du bon temps.
target_text: Nilipitisha wakati muzuri sana kabisa.
target_text_raw: Nilipitisha wakati muzuri sana kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme c'est dégueulasse !
target_text: Inachukiza sana!
target_text_raw: Inachukiza sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n’ai rien entendu.
target_text: Sikusikia chochote.
target_text_raw: Sikusikia chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle bonne idée !
target_text: Ni wazo nzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Ni wazo nzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne ferais jamais quelque chose comme ça.
target_text: Siwezi kufanya kitu ya vile ata siku moja.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kufanya kitu ya vile ata siku moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom regrette de ne pas être allé au théâtre hier.
target_text: Tom anajuta kustokwenda kwenye salle ya michezo ya kuigiza jana.
target_text_raw: Tom anajuta kustokwenda kwenye salle ya michezo ya kuigiza jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vient d'arriver.
target_text: Anafika sai.
target_text_raw: Anafika sai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'attends qu'il m'aide.
target_text: Minachunga anisaidie.
target_text_raw: Minachunga anisaidie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie est parfois étrange.
target_text: Wakati mwingine maisha haieleweki.
target_text_raw: Wakati mwingine maisha haieleweki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelqu'un a-t-il eu mal ?
target_text: Kuna mtu aliumia?
target_text_raw: Kuna mtu aliumia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Connais-tu quelqu'un sachant parler français ?
target_text: Je, unajua mtu mwenye anaweza zungumza Kifaransa ?
target_text_raw: Je, unajua mtu mwenye anaweza zungumza Kifaransa ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a marché dans le parc hier.
target_text: Alitembea mu jardin public jana.
target_text_raw: Alitembea mu jardin public (parc) jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ressentis une douleur soudaine au côté.
target_text: Nilisikia maumivu ya ghafla mu mbavu.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia maumivu ya ghafla mu mbavu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À cause de la pluie, nous n'avons pas pu jouer au tennis à l'extérieur.
target_text: Hatukuweza kucheza tenisi inje juu ya mvula.
target_text_raw: Hatukuweza kucheza tenisi inje juu ya mvula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai perdu mon inspiration.
target_text: Nilipoteza wazo yenye nilitaka toa.
target_text_raw: Nilipoteza wazo yenye nilitaka toa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était parfaitement détendu et n'opposa aucune résistance mais me lança un regard si hideux que cela me fit transpirer à grosses gouttes.
target_text: Alikuwa amerizika kabisa na hakupinga hata kitu alakini aliniangalia na licho ya mubaya mpaka nikasikia boga sana.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa amerizika kabisa na hakupinga hata kitu alakini aliniangalia na licho ya mubaya mpaka nikasikia boga sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais que tu n'aies pas à y aller.
target_text: Ningependa usilazamishwe kwenda eko.
target_text_raw: Ningependa usilazamishwe kwenda eko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons embarqué dans l'avion.
target_text: Tulipanda mu avion.
target_text_raw: Tulipanda mu avion.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est important que j'entende cela.
target_text: Ni muhimu nisikie iyi.
target_text_raw: Ni muhimu nisikie iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que Tom l'ait fait exprès.
target_text: Sizani kama Tom alifanya hivyo kwa makusudi.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama Tom alifanya hivyo kwa makusudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas en parler avec Tom.
target_text: Sitaki niuzungumzie na Tom.
target_text_raw: Sitaki niuzungumzie na Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dirait que tu as pleuré.
target_text: Iko saa ulilia.
target_text_raw: Iko saa ulilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand bien même il n'a que seize ans, il ne dépend pas de ses parents.
target_text: Japokuwa iko miaka kumi na sita tu, hategemei wazazi wake.
target_text_raw: Japokuwa iko miaka kumi na sita tu, hategemei wazazi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tes chemises doivent être lavées.
target_text: Mashati zako zinahitaji kufuliwa.
target_text_raw: Mashati zako zinahitaji kufuliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vu comment Tom conduit, il finira par avoir un accident.
target_text: Ukiangalia ginsi Tom anatembeza, mwisho na mwisho atapata ajali.
target_text_raw: Ukiangalia ginsi Tom anatembeza, mwisho na mwisho atapata ajali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nourriture refroidit.
target_text: Chakula iko napata baridi.
target_text_raw: Chakula iko napata baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa lettre me mit en colère.
target_text: Barua yake ilinisirikisha.
target_text_raw: Barua yake ilinisirikisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais essayer.
target_text: Ndajaribu.
target_text_raw: Ndajaribu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un petit problème.
target_text: Ni shida kidogo.
target_text_raw: Ni shida kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie était blessée.
target_text: Maria alilumia.
target_text_raw: Maria alilumia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon frère n'est pas à la maison.
target_text: Kaka yangu aiko nyumbani.
target_text_raw: Kaka yangu aiko nyumbani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous qui entrez, abandonnez toute espérance.
target_text: Nyiye benye munaingia, mukate matumaini yote.
target_text_raw: Nyiye benye munaingia, mukate matumaini yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel genre de musiques est en vogue ces temps-ci ?
target_text: Je, ni aina gani ya muziki inavuma sana siku hizi ?
target_text_raw: Je, ni aina gani ya muziki inavuma sana siku hizi ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Finalement Jeanne n'a pas acheté ça.
target_text: Jeanne akuiuza tena.
target_text_raw: Jeanne akuiuza tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a surpris.
target_text: Alinishangaza.
target_text_raw: Alinishangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi as-tu dit quelque chose d'aussi bête ?
target_text: Juu ya nini ulisema kitu kijinga sana?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini ulisema kitu kijinga sana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère ne sait pas du tout rouler en voiture.
target_text: Mama yangu hawezi tembeza gari hata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu hawezi tembeza gari hata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle heure est ton premier cours ?
target_text: Darasa yako ya kwanza ni saa ngapi ?
target_text_raw: Darasa (cours) yako ya kwanza ni saa ngapi ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette règle ne souffre pas d'exceptions.
target_text: Piko hiyi sheria haifati masharti ya kipee.
target_text_raw: Piko hiyi sheria haifati masharti ya kipee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère ne peut pas lire sans ses lunettes.
target_text: Mama yangu hawezi kusoma bila kuvala matalatala zake.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu hawezi kusoma bila kuvala matalatala (lunettes) zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viendrai.
target_text: Nitakuya.
target_text_raw: Nitakuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu as un problème, j'aimerais savoir ce que c'est.
target_text: Kama uko na shida, ningependa kujua ni nini.
target_text_raw: Kama uko na shida, ningependa kujua ni nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle parle de tout avec ses parents.
target_text: Anazungumzia kila kitu na wazazi wake.
target_text_raw: Anazungumzia kila kitu na wazazi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne dois rien dire à Tom.
target_text: Sina deni ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Sina deni ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est trop compliqué pour moi.
target_text: Ni bigumu sana kwangu.
target_text_raw: Ni bigumu sana kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas vraiment ce qui se passait.
target_text: Sijui nini njo ilikuwa naendelea.
target_text_raw: Sijui nini njo ilikuwa naendelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me contredis pas ! Je sais ce qui est le mieux pour toi.
target_text: Usinipinge! Najua kile kinachofaa kwako.
target_text_raw: Usinipinge! Najua kile kinachofaa kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourrais-tu cesser, je te prie ?
target_text: Je, unaweza kusimama, tafazali?
target_text_raw: Je, unaweza kusimama, tafazali?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le problème est que cela coûte trop cher.
target_text: Shida ni kwamba iko beyi sana.
target_text_raw: Shida ni kwamba iko beyi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce pont n'est pas long.
target_text: Iyi kilalo aiko ya murefu.
target_text_raw: Iyi kilalo aiko ya murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que vais-je ressentir ?
target_text: Nitasikia nini?
target_text_raw: Nitasikia nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet hôtel est à mon beau-frère.
target_text: Iyi hoteli ni ya shemeki yangu.
target_text_raw: Iyi hoteli ni ya shemeki yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela appartient à Tom.
target_text: Ni ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Ni ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils se sont tous arrêtés.
target_text: Wote walisimama.
target_text_raw: Wote walisimama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chien est dans la maison.
target_text: Imbwa iko ndani ya nyumba.
target_text_raw: Imbwa iko ndani ya nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aimes-tu cette musique?
target_text: Je, unapenda iyi muziki?
target_text_raw: Je, unapenda iyi muziki (nyimbo) ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais qu'il serait fâché.
target_text: Nilizani kama atasirika.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama atasirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux dormir avec tout ce bruit.
target_text: Siwezi kulala mwa iyi fujo yote.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kulala mwa iyi fujo yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup d'étrangers parlent bien japonais.
target_text: Bageni bengi banazungumza Kijapani vizuri.
target_text_raw: Bageni bengi banazungumza Kijapani vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'est pas encore levé.
target_text: Tom bado hayalamuka.
target_text_raw: Tom bado hayalamuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas tel qu'il paraît.
target_text: Aiko kama vile inaonekana.
target_text_raw: Aiko kama vile inaonekana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle disposait d'une radio.
target_text: Alikuwa na redio.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa na redio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a demandé à la personne à la réception de lui passer ce numéro.
target_text: Aliomba mtu wa ku réception iyi numéro.
target_text_raw: Aliomba mtu wa ku réception iyi numéro.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous nous montrer la maison ?
target_text: Je, unaweza kutuonesha nyumba?
target_text_raw: Je, unaweza kutuonesha nyumba?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais une chose, c'est que je ne sais rien.
target_text: Kitu moya yenye minajua ni kwamba sijui kitu.
target_text_raw: Kitu moya yenye minajua ni kwamba sijui kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se comporte comme s'il savait tout.
target_text: Anajifanya saa mwenye anajua kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Anajifanya saa mwenye anajua kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûr que nous fassions ce qu'il convient ?
target_text: Je, uko na uhakika kama tuko nafanya kitu sahihi?
target_text_raw: Je, uko na uhakika kama tuko nafanya kitu sahihi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils vont préparer une fête pour Sam.
target_text: Watapanga sherehe ya Sam.
target_text_raw: Watapanga sherehe ya Sam.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai besoin d'une paire de ciseaux.
target_text: Minahitaji ciseaux.
target_text_raw: Minahitaji ciseaux.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je faisais juste l'imbécile.
target_text: Nilikuwa najifanya sawa vile mpumbavu.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa najifanya sawa vile mpumbavu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devrais réfléchir avant de parler.
target_text: Unapashwa kufikiria mbele ya kusema.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kufikiria mbele ya kusema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais dû voir ça venir.
target_text: Nilipashwa kuiona inakuya.
target_text_raw: Nilipashwa kuiona inakuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom portait des gants.
target_text: Tom alikuwa anavala kinga ya mikono.
target_text_raw: Tom alikuwa anavala kinga ya mikono (gants).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup d'étudiants vont en Europe pour étudier la musique.
target_text: Wanafunzi wengi wanaendaka Ulaya kusoma muziki.
target_text_raw: Wanafunzi wengi wanaendaka Ulaya kusoma muziki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'avais d'autre choix que de le prendre au mot.
target_text: Sikuwa na namna ingine isopokuwa kukamata maneno yake kama vile mtani.
target_text_raw: Sikuwa na namna ingine isopokuwa kukamata maneno yake kama vile mtani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il est l'heure de manger.
target_text: Nazani ni wakati wa kula.
target_text_raw: Nazani ni wakati wa kula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que pensez-vous de l'avenir ?
target_text: Je, unafikiria nini kuhusu maisha ya baadae ?
target_text_raw: Je, unafikiria nini kuhusu maisha ya baadae ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il le méritait.
target_text: Alihistahili.
target_text_raw: Alihistahili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être devriez-vous faire ceci ensemble.
target_text: Labda mungepashwa kufanya hivyo pamoja.
target_text_raw: Labda mungepashwa kufanya hivyo pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec un peu de chance, il n'y aura pas d'école demain.
target_text: Tunawaza kama hakutakuwa masomo kesho.
target_text_raw: Tunawaza kama hakutakuwa masomo kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Désolé de ma réponse tardive.
target_text: Samahani kwa kukujibia nyuma.
target_text_raw: Samahani kwa kukujibia nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C’est bon.
target_text: Ni muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est sérieux.
target_text: Ni muhimu.
target_text_raw: Ni muhimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps n'aurait pu être meilleur.
target_text: Hali ya hewa haingekuwa muzuri.
target_text_raw: Hali ya hewa haingekuwa muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La bibliothèque est en train de fermer.
target_text: Bibliothèque inaanza fungwa.
target_text_raw: Bibliothèque inaanza fungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu faisais seulement ton devoir.
target_text: Ulikuwa nafanya tu kazi yako.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa nafanya tu kazi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je préfèrerais mourir que de me rendre.
target_text: Afazali nikufe kuliko kujisalimisha.
target_text_raw: Afazali nikufe kuliko kujisalimisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a annulé le rendez-vous.
target_text: Alibalisha mkutano.
target_text_raw: Alibalisha mkutano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Carol regarde souvent des films d'horreur.
target_text: Mara nyingi Carol anaangaliaka sinema za boga.
target_text_raw: Mara nyingi Carol anaangaliaka sinema (films) za boga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se moquait de son mari.
target_text: Alikuwa anamucheka bwana yake.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anamucheka bwana yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En été, il fait chaud.
target_text: Mu kipwa, kifukutu inakuwaka mingi.
target_text_raw: Mu kipwa, kifukutu inakuwaka mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom acheta quelque chose pour Marie.
target_text: Tom aliuzia Maria kitu fulani.
target_text_raw: Tom aliuzia Maria kitu fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ne put résister.
target_text: Hakuweza kupinga.
target_text_raw: Hakuweza kupinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te prie de te conformer aux règles de l'école.
target_text: Tafazali fuata sheria za shule.
target_text_raw: Tafazali fuata sheria za shule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu aurais dû arriver plus tôt à la réception pour mon mariage.
target_text: Ungepashwa fika mapema kwenye sherehe yangu ya harusi.
target_text_raw: Ungepashwa fika mapema kwenye sherehe yangu ya harusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dansera ce vendredi.
target_text: Iyi siku ya tano yenye inakuya tutacheza.
target_text_raw: Iyi siku ya tano yenye inakuya tutacheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'université est une perte de temps.
target_text: Kusoma ku chuo Kikuu ni kupoteza muda.
target_text_raw: Kusoma ku chuo Kikuu (université) ni kupoteza muda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une mouche est tout aussi susceptible d'atterrir sur une merde qu'elle le fera sur une tarte.
target_text: Inzi inaweza ingia kwenye mavi kama vile inaweza ingia kwenye tarte.
target_text_raw: Inzi inaweza ingia kwenye mavi kama vile inaweza ingia kwenye tarte (mkate).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui se soucie de ce qu'ils pensent?
target_text: Nani anajali kile wanachofikiria?
target_text_raw: Nani anajali kile wanachofikiria?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom savait où il avait mis ses clés.
target_text: Tom alikuwa najua kwenye aliweka fungulo zake.
target_text_raw: Tom alikuwa najua kwenye aliweka fungulo zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a été trois mois au front.
target_text: Alikuwa kwenye shamba la mapambano kwa miezi tatu.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa kwenye shamba la mapambano (ku vita) kwa miezi tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne dis pas que ce n'est pas possible.
target_text: Sisemi kama haiwezekani.
target_text_raw: Sisemi kama haiwezekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A-t-elle un piano ?
target_text: Iko na piano?
target_text_raw: Iko na piano?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis seulement moi.
target_text: Miye ni miye tu.
target_text_raw: Miye ni miye tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons beaucoup d'amis.
target_text: Tuko na barafiki bengi.
target_text_raw: Tuko na barafiki bengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons partir !
target_text: Lazima tuondoke!
target_text_raw: Lazima tuondoke!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Y a pas comme une odeur bizarre ?
target_text: Je! Hausikie harufu yenye haiko ya kawaida ?
target_text_raw: Je! Hausikie harufu yenye haiko ya kawaida ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas vivre comme ça.
target_text: Sitaki kuishi hivi.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kuishi hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouvez m'excuser une minute ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza nipatia dakika moya ?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza nipatia dakika moya ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'aime pas la manière dont Marie traite Jean.
target_text: Tom hapendi gisi Marie anakamata Jean.
target_text_raw: Tom hapendi gisi Marie anakamata Jean.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ferai tout ce qui est en mon possible.
target_text: Nitafanya kila kitu yenye ndaweza.
target_text_raw: Nitafanya kila kitu yenye ndaweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants jouent dehors.
target_text: Batoto biko nacheza inje.
target_text_raw: Batoto biko nacheza inje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime vos souliers.
target_text: Napenda biato yako.
target_text_raw: Napenda biato yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ferais mieux de t'en occuper.
target_text: Ni muzuri ujishugulishe nayo.
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri ujishugulishe nayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûr que votre fils reviendra sain et sauf.
target_text: Nina hakika mtoto wako atarudi salama na mzima.
target_text_raw: Nina hakika mtoto wako atarudi salama na mzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Excusez-moi, mais je n'ai pas la monnaie.
target_text: Samahani, alakini sina franga ya kukurudishia.
target_text_raw: Samahani, alakini sina franga ya kukurudishia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne mets pas tous tes œufs dans le même panier.
target_text: Usiweke mayai yako yote kwenye kikapu kimoja.
target_text_raw: Usiweke mayai yako yote kwenye kikapu kimoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La ville se dresse au pied de la montagne.
target_text: Mji itapatikana chini ya mlima.
target_text_raw: Mji itapatikana chini ya mlima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais qu'elle ignore qui je suis.
target_text: Najua hajui mimi ni nani.
target_text_raw: Najua hajui mimi ni nani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que j'irai aujourd'hui.
target_text: Sizani kama ndaenda leo.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama ndaenda leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne dois pas t'en aller, à moins que tu ne le veuilles.
target_text: Haupashwi kuondoka, isipokuwa unataka wepeke.
target_text_raw: Haupashwi kuondoka, isipokuwa unataka wepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu empruntes un livre.
target_text: Unakopesha kitabu.
target_text_raw: Unakopesha kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle portait un chapeau étrange.
target_text: Alikuwa amevaa kofia isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa amevaa kofia (chapeau) isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que tu sais que la dernière chose que je veuille faire est de te blesser.
target_text: Nazani kama unajua jambo ya mwisho yenye nataka kufanya ni kukulumiza.
target_text_raw: Nazani kama unajua jambo ya mwisho yenye nataka kufanya ni kukulumiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon copain est journaliste.
target_text: Mpenzi wangu ni mwandishi wa habari.
target_text_raw: Mpenzi wangu ni mwandishi wa habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La date limite s'approche.
target_text: Siku ya mwisho inakaribia.
target_text_raw: Siku ya mwisho inakaribia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment puis-je vous joindre ?
target_text: Aye njo naweza kuwasiliana na weye ?
target_text_raw: Aye njo naweza kuwasiliana na weye ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un magnifique dessin.
target_text: Ni mchoro mzuri.
target_text_raw: Ni mchoro (dessin) mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je resterai à la maison.
target_text: Nitabakia ku nyumba.
target_text_raw: Nitabakia ku nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu le moindre liquide ?
target_text: Je! Una kitu ya maji maji yoyote ?
target_text_raw: Je! Una kitu ya maji maji yoyote ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça ne me surprendrait pas.
target_text: Haitanishangaza.
target_text_raw: Haitanishangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as un brillant avenir.
target_text: Maisha yako ya badae itakuwa muzuri saana.
target_text_raw: Maisha yako ya badae (avenir) itakuwa muzuri saana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attention ! Quelqu'un pourrait nous entendre !
target_text: Angalisho! Mtu anaweza kutusikia!
target_text_raw: Angalisho! Mtu anaweza kutusikia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui se perd dans sa passion perd moins que celui qui perd sa passion.
target_text: Heri ule mwenye anapotelea mu kitu yenye anapendaka fanya kuliko ule mwenye anapoteza kitu yenye anapendaka fanya.
target_text_raw: Heri ule mwenye anapotelea mu kitu yenye anapendaka fanya (passion) kuliko ule mwenye anapoteza kitu yenye anapendaka fanya (passion).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu m'en veux.
target_text: Najua umenisirikia.
target_text_raw: Najua umenisirikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu me pardonner ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza nisamehe ?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza nisamehe ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jane est très contente de son travail et n'a aucune envie de le quitter.
target_text: Jane anarizika sana na kazi yake na hataki kuiacha.
target_text_raw: Jane anarizika sana na kazi yake na hataki kuiacha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faire ça est illégal ici.
target_text: Kufanya hivyo hapa ni kinyume cha sheria.
target_text_raw: Kufanya hivyo hapa ni kinyume cha sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a averti l'enfant de ne pas jouer dans la rue.
target_text: Alimuonya huyo mototo asichezee barabarani.
target_text_raw: Alimuonya huyo mototo asichezee barabarani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom fait du bon travail.
target_text: Tom anafanya kazi muzuri.
target_text_raw: Tom anafanya kazi muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vite, sors d'ici !
target_text: Toka hapa, haraka !
target_text_raw: Toka hapa, haraka !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce mot lui est sorti de la bouche.
target_text: Iyi neno ilitoka mu kinywa yake.
target_text_raw: Iyi neno ilitoka mu kinywa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quoi qu'il arrive, je veux que tu saches que je t'aime.
target_text: Ata kukitokeya nini, nataka ujue kama ninakupenda.
target_text_raw: Ata kukitokeya nini, nataka ujue kama ninakupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour dire la vérité, j'ai perdu ton stylo.
target_text: Kusema kweli, nilipoteza kalamu yako.
target_text_raw: Kusema kweli, nilipoteza kalamu (bic, stylo) yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ne revit jamais sa sœur.
target_text: Hakumuonaka tena dada yake.
target_text_raw: Hakumuonaka tena dada yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après qu'il eut entendu la tragique nouvelle, il sortit dehors pour être seul.
target_text: Baada ya kusikia habari hiyo ya mubaya, alitoka inje na kubaki yepeke.
target_text_raw: Baada ya kusikia habari hiyo ya mubaya, alitoka inje na kubaki yepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pourrais pas être plus heureux pour vous deux.
target_text: Singekuwa na furaha zaidi juu ya nyiye bawili.
target_text_raw: Singekuwa na furaha zaidi juu ya nyiye bawili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que María est plus belle que moi.
target_text: Najua kama Maria ni mrembo kuliko miye.
target_text_raw: Najua kama Maria ni mrembo kuliko miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom veut vendre la ferme.
target_text: Tom anataka uzisha shamba.
target_text_raw: Tom anataka uzisha shamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que ce n'est pas le cas.
target_text: Minazani kama haiko njo hivyo.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama haiko njo hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ferme cette porte !
target_text: Funga iyo mulango!
target_text_raw: Funga iyo mulango!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi êtes-vous tous si contents ?
target_text: Juu ya nini nyiye bote munafurahi?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini nyiye bote munafurahi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai décidé de ne rien boire.
target_text: Niliamua nisikunywe kitu yoyote ile.
target_text_raw: Niliamua nisikunywe kitu yoyote ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon copain aime les pâtes comme moi.
target_text: Mpenzi wangu anapenda pâtes kama mimi.
target_text_raw: Mpenzi wangu anapenda pâtes (chakula yenye banatengeza na farine) kama mimi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai quelque chose à manger.
target_text: Niko na kitu ya kukula.
target_text_raw: Niko na kitu ya kukula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas besoin de ta pitié.
target_text: Sihitaji huruma yako.
target_text_raw: Sihitaji huruma yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui possède ce bateau ?
target_text: Iyi mashua ni ya nani?
target_text_raw: Iyi mashua ni ya nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est resté assis là pendant deux heures.
target_text: Aliikala pale kwa masaa mbili.
target_text_raw: Aliikala pale kwa masaa mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'adore cette phrase.
target_text: Napenda sana iyo musemo.
target_text_raw: Napenda sana iyo musemo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens d'avoir une conversation avec ton médecin.
target_text: Nimeongea na muganga wako.
target_text_raw: Nimeongea na muganga wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vas rire.
target_text: Utacheka.
target_text_raw: Utacheka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis levé à onze heures.
target_text: Nililamuka saa tano za asubui.
target_text_raw: Nililamuka saa tano za asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où est Boston ?
target_text: Boston iko wapi?
target_text_raw: Boston iko wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous échouerons.
target_text: Tutashindwa.
target_text_raw: Tutashindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai besoin de peinture.
target_text: Ninahitaji rangi.
target_text_raw: Ninahitaji rangi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens de dépenser plus de trois mille dollars.
target_text: Nimetumia zaidi ya dola elfu tatu.
target_text_raw: Nimetumia zaidi ya dola elfu tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais à bout de souffle.
target_text: Pumzi iliniishia.
target_text_raw: Pumzi iliniishia (nilifika mwisho).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma valise est pleine de papiers.
target_text: Shakoshi yangu inayala makartasi.
target_text_raw: Shakoshi (valise) yangu inayala makartasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fiche-nous la paix !
target_text: Tuachie fujo.
target_text_raw: Tuachie (tutoshee) fujo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Suis-je sur la bonne voie ?
target_text: Niko ku njia ya muzuri kweli?
target_text_raw: Niko ku njia ya muzuri kweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous l'apprécions.
target_text: Tuna munapendaka.
target_text_raw: Tuna munapendaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous trouver comment se rendre là-bas ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza jua gisi ya kwenda kule?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza jua gisi ya kwenda kule?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom cuisine.
target_text: Tom anapiga chakula.
target_text_raw: Tom anapiga chakula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça n'a rien à voir avec lui.
target_text: Habimuhusu!
target_text_raw: Habimuhusu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque question a une réponse.
target_text: Kila swali iko na jibu.
target_text_raw: Kila swali iko na jibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sais-tu ce que c'est ?
target_text: Unajua ni nini?
target_text_raw: Unajua ni nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'arriverons en aucun cas à Londres avant la tombée de la nuit.
target_text: Haiwezekani tufike Londres mbele ya busiku kuingia.
target_text_raw: Haiwezekani tufike Londres mbele ya busiku kuingia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il voudrait devenir médecin.
target_text: Alitaka kukuwa muganga.
target_text_raw: Alitaka kukuwa muganga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux trouver pour Tom quelque chose de joli pour son anniversaire.
target_text: Nitamutafutia Tom zawadi kwa siku yake ya kuzaliwa.
target_text_raw: Nitamutafutia Tom zawadi kwa siku yake ya kuzaliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a perdu ses clés de voiture.
target_text: Alipoteza fungulo zake za gari.
target_text_raw: Alipoteza fungulo zake za gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas faim ?
target_text: Hauna njala ?
target_text_raw: Hauna njala ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Meurtrier !
target_text: Muuwaji!
target_text_raw: Muuwaji!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous méritez une augmentation.
target_text: Unastahili nyongezo.
target_text_raw: Unastahili nyongezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je préférerais que vous veniez demain plutôt qu'aujourd'hui.
target_text: Ningependa ukuye kesho asubui kuliko leo.
target_text_raw: Ningependa ukuye kesho asubui kuliko leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un écran séparait la pièce en deux.
target_text: Kio ilikua inatenganisha chumba mara mbili.
target_text_raw: Kio ilikua inatenganisha chumba mara mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il travaille toute la nuit.
target_text: Alitumika busiko yote.
target_text_raw: Alitumika busiko yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela ne m'est pas venu à l'esprit.
target_text: Haikunitokea mu mawazo.
target_text_raw: Haikunitokea mu mawazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet arbre a une circonférence de trois mètres.
target_text: Iyi muti iko na mzunguko ya mita tatu.
target_text_raw: Iyi muti iko na mzunguko ya mita (mètres) tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom croit qu'il sait tout.
target_text: Tom anawaza anajua kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Tom anawaza anajua kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'habite plus ici.
target_text: Haishi tena apa.
target_text_raw: Haishi tena apa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donnez-moi de l'eau !
target_text: Nipatie maji!
target_text_raw: Nipatie maji!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aime pas que tu sois si occupé.
target_text: Sipendake ukuwe na shughuli mingi vile.
target_text_raw: Sipendake ukuwe na shughuli (activités) mingi vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prends des notes.
target_text: Andika.
target_text_raw: Andika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurai trente ans dans deux semaines.
target_text: Ndaeneza miaka makumi tatu mu juma mbili zijazo.
target_text_raw: Ndaeneza miaka makumi tatu mu juma mbili zijazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne lui fais rien de mal !
target_text: Usimufanyie bya mubaya!
target_text_raw: Usimufanyie bya mubaya!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est tout ce qu'il a à faire.
target_text: Iyo tu njo yenye atafanya.
target_text_raw: Iyo tu njo yenye atafanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oscar était le chien de ma mère.
target_text: Imbwa ya mama ilikua inaitwa Oscar.
target_text_raw: Imbwa ya mama ilikua inaitwa Oscar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est vrai qu'il eut tout bon à l'examen.
target_text: Ni kweli alikuwa na kila kitu kizuri kwenye mtihani.
target_text_raw: Ni kweli alikuwa na kila kitu kizuri kwenye mtihani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C’est difficile d'avoir des idées géniales.
target_text: Ni vigumu kukuwa na maoni ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ni vigumu kukuwa na maoni ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne pas fumer.
target_text: Usivute.
target_text_raw: Usivute.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La terre est bleue comme une orange.
target_text: Dunia iko bleu kama rangi ya machungwa.
target_text_raw: Dunia iko bleu kama rangi ya machungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il gara sa voiture devant le bâtiment.
target_text: Aliweka gari yake mbele ya jengo.
target_text_raw: Aliweka gari yake mbele ya jengo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est hors de question.
target_text: Iyo aiko njo swali.
target_text_raw: Iyo aiko njo swali (mada).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle semble être en difficulté, dites-lui ce qu'il faut faire.
target_text: Anaonekana kuwa na shida, mwambie chakufanya.
target_text_raw: Anaonekana kuwa na shida, mwambie chakufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'oublie pas d'apporter un parapluie.
target_text: Usisahabu kubeba mumvuli.
target_text_raw: Usisahabu kubeba mumvuli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un piège !
target_text: Ni mutego.
target_text_raw: Ni mutego.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne bouge pas !
target_text: Usitingizike!
target_text_raw: Usitingizike!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je déteste les flics tels que lui.
target_text: Nachukia polisi kama yeye.
target_text_raw: Nachukia polisi (ba policiers) kama yeye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai reçu votre lettre hier.
target_text: Nilipokea barua yako jana.
target_text_raw: Nilipokea barua yako jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand s'est-elle mariée ?
target_text: Aliolewa wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Aliolewa wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aime pas les gens.
target_text: Sipendake watu.
target_text_raw: Sipendake watu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas pu répondre à mes questions.
target_text: Tom hakujibia maswali zangu.
target_text_raw: Tom hakujibia maswali zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu trouves ta propre piaule.
target_text: Nataka utafute nyumba yako ya wepeke.
target_text_raw: Nataka utafute nyumba yako ya wepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas bon de manger entre les repas.
target_text: Siyo muzuri kula kati kati ya mulo.
target_text_raw: Siyo muzuri kula kati kati ya mulo (repas).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que cette chemise ne va pas bien avec une cravate rouge.
target_text: Nazani iyi shati haipendezi ku cravate nyekundu.
target_text_raw: Nazani iyi shati haipendezi ku cravate nyekundu (ya rouge).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais qu'il est très improbable que j'arrive à te convaincre que tu as tort.
target_text: Najua ni uwezekano mkubwa kuwa nitaweza kukuelewesha kama umekosea.
target_text_raw: Najua ni uwezekano mkubwa kuwa nitaweza kukuelewesha kama umekosea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je mets un pull-over.
target_text: Minavala mupira ya baridi.
target_text_raw: Minavala mupira ya baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous en sommes tous certains.
target_text: Siye bote tuko na uhakika.
target_text_raw: Siye bote tuko na uhakika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prends-en deux.
target_text: Kamata amo mbili.
target_text_raw: Kamata amo mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marchez un peu tous les jours.
target_text: Tembea kidogo kila siku.
target_text_raw: Tembea kidogo kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'entends souvent mes voisins se disputer.
target_text: Kila mara nasikiaka majiani wangu wanazozana.
target_text_raw: Kila mara nasikiaka majiani wangu wanazozana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre anniversaire arrive bientôt.
target_text: Siku yako ya kuzaliwa inakaribia.
target_text_raw: Siku yako ya kuzaliwa inakaribia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est facile de se perdre.
target_text: Ni rahisi sana kupotea.
target_text_raw: Ni rahisi sana kupotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne m'aviez pas dit que vous étiez docteur.
target_text: Haukuniambia kama uko muganga.
target_text_raw: Haukuniambia kama uko muganga (daktari).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que ça a sonné ?
target_text: Je! Ililia?
target_text_raw: Je! Ililia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne le découvrira pas.
target_text: Hatutaigundua.
target_text_raw: Hatutaigundua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me sentais seul.
target_text: Nilikua najisikia kuwa peke yangu.
target_text_raw: Nilikua najisikia kuwa peke yangu (mupweke).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils n'ont pas remarqué l'augmentation du bruit.
target_text: Hawakusikia muongezeko ya kelele.
target_text_raw: Hawakusikia muongezeko ya kelele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le français de Tom s'améliore.
target_text: Kifaransa ya Tom inaboreka.
target_text_raw: Kifaransa ya Tom inaboreka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devez prendre la deuxième rue à droite.
target_text: Lazima ufate barabara ya pili ngambo ya kuume.
target_text_raw: Lazima ufate barabara ya pili ngambo ya kuume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons nous débrouiller avec ce que nous avons.
target_text: Tunapashwa kufanya na kile kyenye tuko nakyo .
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa kufanya na kile kyenye tuko nakyo .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes ses enfants.
target_text: Tuko batoto yake.
target_text_raw: Tuko batoto yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que ces médicaments agissent sur l'estomac ?
target_text: Je! Iyo dawa inasaidia ku tatizo ya tumbu kweli?
target_text_raw: Je! Iyo dawa inasaidia ku tatizo ya tumbu (estomac) kweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rends-moi mon stylo.
target_text: Nirudushie kalamu yangu.
target_text_raw: Nirudushie kalamu (bic) yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux ce fruit.
target_text: Nataka iyi tunda.
target_text_raw: Nataka iyi tunda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment va tout le monde ?
target_text: Habari ya kila mtu ?
target_text_raw: Habari ya kila mtu ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai rencontré une vieille femme.
target_text: Nilikutana na mwanamuke muzee.
target_text_raw: Nilikutana na mwanamuke muzee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une fourchette.
target_text: Ni kanya.
target_text_raw: Ni kanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonjour, chérie ! Pourquoi es-tu encore au lit ? Es-tu malade ?
target_text: Jambo, mupenzi ! Juu ya nini ungali mu kitanda? Uko mugonjwa?
target_text_raw: Jambo, mupenzi ! Juu ya nini ungali mu kitanda? Uko mugonjwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une autre guerre et nous serons tous morts.
target_text: Vita ingine ikitokea, siye bote tutakufa.
target_text_raw: Vita ingine ikitokea, siye bote tutakufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom vit-il ici avec vous ?
target_text: Tom anaishi hapa na weye?
target_text_raw: Tom anaishi hapa na weye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une histoire raconte que si la pièce de monnaie est ronde c'est pour lui permettre de rouler d'un endroit à l'autre.
target_text: Hadisi inasema kama kikoroti ya franga iko muviringo ni kusudi itembee kutoka sehemu moja hadi ingine.
target_text_raw: Hadisi inasema kama kikoroti ya franga iko muviringo ni kusudi itembee kutoka sehemu moja hadi ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est désormais une femme.
target_text: Yeye ni mwanamuke sasa.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mwanamuke sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me souviendrai de vous pour toujours.
target_text: Nita ku kumbukaka kila siku.
target_text_raw: Nita ku kumbukaka kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai beaucoup mangé ce matin.
target_text: Nilikula sana asubui.
target_text_raw: Nilikula sana asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce ta fille ?
target_text: Ni binti yako?
target_text_raw: Ni binti yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas ne vit jamais quelque loup que ce fût, mais il put les entendre.
target_text: Thomas hakuwahi kuona mbwa mwitu, alakini alizisikia.
target_text_raw: Thomas hakuwahi kuona mbwa mwitu, alakini alizisikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laissez-moi appeler mon avocat !
target_text: Ngoya nimupigie mwanasheria wangu!
target_text_raw: Ngoya nimupigie mwanasheria (avocat) wangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas l'appeler.
target_text: Siwezi muita.
target_text_raw: Siwezi muita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais nager environ deux fois par semaine.
target_text: Nitaogelea mara mbili kwa juma.
target_text_raw: Nitaogelea mara mbili kwa juma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vois un garçon.
target_text: Naona kijana umoya.
target_text_raw: Naona kijana umoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom sera jaloux.
target_text: Tom atakuwa na wivu.
target_text_raw: Tom atakuwa na wivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un peu froid.
target_text: Nasikia baridi kidogo.
target_text_raw: Nasikia baridi kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand l'as-tu découvert ?
target_text: Uliigundua wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Uliigundua wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas ce qu'il essaye de dire.
target_text: Sijui anajaribu kusema nini.
target_text_raw: Sijui anajaribu kusema nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne fait rien de mal.
target_text: Tom hafanyi kitu ya mubaya.
target_text_raw: Tom hafanyi kitu ya mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui t'a dit de m'emmener ici ?
target_text: Nani alikuambia unilete hapa?
target_text_raw: Nani alikuambia unilete hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas pu emprunter autant d'argent qu'il le fallait.
target_text: Tom hakuweza kukopesha pesa mingi kama gisi alihitaji.
target_text_raw: Tom hakuweza kukopesha pesa mingi kama gisi alihitaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'alcool et le tabac sont tous deux mauvais pour la santé.
target_text: Pombe na tumbaku vyote ni vibaya kwa afya yako.
target_text_raw: Pombe na tumbaku vyote ni vibaya kwa afya yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle en sait davantage qu'elle admet.
target_text: Anajua zaidi ya vile anakubali.
target_text_raw: Anajua zaidi ya vile anakubali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regrette de ne pouvoir t'aider.
target_text: Natamani ningekusaidia.
target_text_raw: Natamani ningekusaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chapeau est-il à la bonne taille ?
target_text: Je! Kofia ni saizi sahihi?
target_text_raw: Je! Kofia (chapeau) ni saizi (numéro) sahihi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais à la piscine.
target_text: Minaenda ku piscine.
target_text_raw: Minaenda ku piscine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est bien pourquoi tu m'en diras tant.
target_text: Ndio maana utanifasiria zaidi.
target_text_raw: Ndio maana utanifasiria zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attention ! Voici un camion qui arrive !
target_text: Angalisho! Lori inakuya!
target_text_raw: Angalisho! Lori inakuya!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas comme ça.
target_text: Siye hatuko vile.
target_text_raw: Siye hatuko vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'apprécie vos efforts pour m'aider.
target_text: Nashukuru juhudi zako za kunisaidia.
target_text_raw: Nashukuru juhudi zako za kunisaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devrais travailler dans l'intérêt de l'humanité.
target_text: Unapashwa kufanya kazi kwa ajili ya ubinadamu.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kufanya kazi kwa ajili ya ubinadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout a été volé.
target_text: Kila kitu kiliibiwa.
target_text_raw: Kila kitu kiliibiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci pour les belles fleurs.
target_text: Asante kwa maua mazuri.
target_text_raw: Asante kwa maua mazuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils se sont tous moqués de son erreur.
target_text: Wote walicheka kwa kosa yake.
target_text_raw: Wote walicheka kwa kosa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une vieille dame traverse la route.
target_text: Mama moja muzee anavuka barabara.
target_text_raw: Mama moja muzee anavuka barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas beaucoup d'argent.
target_text: Sina pesa mingi.
target_text_raw: Sina pesa mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi te sens-tu ainsi ?
target_text: Juu ya nini unajihisi ivo?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini unajihisi ivo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À part son caractère, elle est très bien.
target_text: Mbali na tabia yake, yeye ni mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Mbali na tabia yake, yeye ni mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère qu'il va arrêter de pleuvoir.
target_text: Natumaini kama mvula itaacha kunyesha.
target_text_raw: Natumaini kama mvula itaacha kunyesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que tous vos rêves s'incarneront.
target_text: Natumani kama ndoto zako zote zitatimia.
target_text_raw: Natumani kama ndoto zako zote zitatimia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'assis à côté de Tom.
target_text: Naikala karibu na Tom.
target_text_raw: Naikala karibu na Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne t'assieds-tu pas ici, un moment ?
target_text: Juu ya nini usikae hapa kwa muda?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini usikae hapa kwa muda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pleurer est normal.
target_text: Kulia ni kawaida.
target_text_raw: Kulia ni kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a eu une grippe.
target_text: Maria alipatwa na mafuwa.
target_text_raw: Maria alipatwa na mafuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dois-je aller avec toi ?
target_text: Lazima niende na weye?
target_text_raw: Lazima niende na weye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'es pas un lâche.
target_text: Weye sio muwoga.
target_text_raw: Weye sio muwoga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout commentaire est superflu.
target_text: Maoni yoyote hayafai.
target_text_raw: Maoni yoyote hayafai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle m'apprécie et je l'apprécie également.
target_text: Ananipenda na miye namupenda pia.
target_text_raw: Ananipenda na miye namupenda pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom pense qu'il est plus fort que moi.
target_text: Tom anawaza kama iko na nguvu mingi kunishinda.
target_text_raw: Tom anawaza kama iko na nguvu mingi kunishinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis en rien comme vous.
target_text: Miye siyo kitu kama wewe.
target_text_raw: Miye siyo kitu kama wewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu nous as dit qu'elle était gentille et elle l'est vraiment.
target_text: Ulituambia alikuwa ni mtu muzuri tena mupole, na ni kweli kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ulituambia alikuwa ni mtu muzuri tena mupole, na ni kweli kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai assez d'attendre.
target_text: Nimechoka kungojea.
target_text_raw: Nimechoka kungojea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été très chanceux dans ma vie pour avoir rencontré plusieurs de mes acteurs préférés.
target_text: Nilikuwa na bahati sana katika maisha yangu ya kukutanana na waigizaji wengi ninaowapenda.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa na bahati sana katika maisha yangu ya kukutanana na waigizaji wengi ninaowapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis une femme.
target_text: Niko mwanamuke.
target_text_raw: Niko mwanamuke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que Tom a été très chanceux.
target_text: Minawaza kama Tom alikua na bahati sana.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama Tom alikua na bahati sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui, laissons les ouvriers finir plus tôt.
target_text: Leo, tuache wafanyakazi wamalize mapema.
target_text_raw: Leo, tuache wafanyakazi wamalize mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pratique pas la divination.
target_text: Sifanyi kazi ya kifumu.
target_text_raw: Sifanyi kazi ya kifumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous fîmes une promenade sur les berges du lac.
target_text: Tulijitembeza pembeni ya lac.
target_text_raw: Tulijitembeza pembeni ya lac.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon oncle a vécu à Washington pendant deux ans.
target_text: Mujomba yangu aliishi Washington miaka mbili.
target_text_raw: Mujomba yangu aliishi Washington miaka mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis un être humain.
target_text: Miye ni binadamu.
target_text_raw: Miye ni binadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis coupé la main droite sur un bout de verre.
target_text: Nilijikata mkono wa kuume kwenye kipande ya kio.
target_text_raw: Nilijikata mkono wa kuume kwenye kipande ya kio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu nous as manqué hier soir.
target_text: Tulikukumbuka sana jana usiku.
target_text_raw: Tulikukumbuka sana jana usiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai peur de mon patron.
target_text: Naogopa mukubwa yangu wa kazi.
target_text_raw: Naogopa mukubwa yangu wa kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est convaincu que tout le monde le déteste.
target_text: Tom anaamini kama kila mutu hamupendi.
target_text_raw: Tom anaamini kama kila mutu hamupendi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Élever un enfant demande de la patience.
target_text: Kulea mutoto inalomba uvumilivu.
target_text_raw: Kulea mutoto inalomba uvumilivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui, le ciel est bleu et sans nuages.
target_text: Leo anga iko bleu na haina mawingu.
target_text_raw: Leo anga iko bleu na haina mawingu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas aimé la façon dont le film s'est terminé.
target_text: Sikupenda gisi sinema ilimalizika.
target_text_raw: Sikupenda gisi sinema ilimalizika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne m'a pas dit ça.
target_text: Hawakuniambia ivo.
target_text_raw: Hawakuniambia ivo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les ressources de la Terre sont limitées.
target_text: Utajiri wa mu budongo uko kidogo.
target_text_raw: Utajiri wa mu budongo uko kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez, essayons !
target_text: Acha tujaribu!
target_text_raw: Acha tujaribu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'épée peut être employée pour protéger le corps.
target_text: Mpanga inaweza kutumika kulinda mwili.
target_text_raw: Mpanga (épée) inaweza kutumika kulinda mwili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je craignais de prendre froid.
target_text: Niliogopa kupata baridi.
target_text_raw: Niliogopa kupata baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde ne peut pas être artiste.
target_text: Siyo kila mutu anaweza kuwa musanii.
target_text_raw: Siyo kila mutu anaweza kuwa musanii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est comme ça qu'on fait.
target_text: Hivi njo gisi banafanyaka.
target_text_raw: Hivi njo gisi banafanyaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle levait les bras.
target_text: Aliinua mikono yake.
target_text_raw: Aliinua mikono yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourvu qu'il pleuve demain.
target_text: Bora tu mvula inyeshe kesho.
target_text_raw: Bora tu mvula inyeshe kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom peut skier aussi bien que son frère.
target_text: Tom anaweza fanya muchezo wa ski kama vile kaka yake.
target_text_raw: Tom anaweza fanya muchezo wa ski kama vile kaka yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est bon cuisinier.
target_text: Ni mpishi muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Ni mpishi muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y fait vraiment chaud.
target_text: Kunakuwaka kifukutu sana.
target_text_raw: Kunakuwaka kifukutu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu sûr que tes parents te laisseront aller ?
target_text: Una uhakika kama wazazi wako watakuitikia uende?
target_text_raw: Una uhakika kama wazazi wako watakuitikia uende?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Commençons la leçon d'aujourd'hui en ouvrant le livre à la page 156", dit le professeur.
target_text: "Tuanze mafundisho ya leo kwa kufungua kitabu kwenye ukurasa wa 156," mwalimu alisema.
target_text_raw: "Tuanze mafundisho (somo) ya leo kwa kufungua kitabu kwenye ukurasa (page) wa 156," mwalimu alisema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le verre est propre.
target_text: Kilahuli kina takata.
target_text_raw: Kilahuli kina takata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon adresse électronique a changé.
target_text: Adresse email yangu ilibadilika.
target_text_raw: Adresse email (barua pepe) yangu ilibadilika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les étudiants étudient l'anglais.
target_text: Wanafunzi wote wanajifunza Kiingereza.
target_text_raw: Wanafunzi wote wanajifunza Kiingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'élevez pas la voix !
target_text: Usipandishe sauti.
target_text_raw: Usipandishe sauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es la femme parfaite pour moi.
target_text: Weye ni mwanamuke kamili kwangu.
target_text_raw: Weye ni mwanamuke kamili kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom travaille toujours dans le même restaurant où travaille Mary.
target_text: Tom bado anafanyia kazi mu restraurant moya na Mary.
target_text_raw: Tom bado anafanyia kazi mu restraurant moya na Mary.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce qu'il faut que je te suive?
target_text: Lazima nikufuate ?
target_text_raw: Lazima nikufuate ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux partir à l'étranger.
target_text: Natamani niende mu inchi ya kigeni.
target_text_raw: Natamani niende mu inchi ya kigeni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Au feu ! », Cria-t-il.
target_text: Alipiga kelele akisema :" Kwenye moto".
target_text_raw: Alipiga kelele akisema :" Kwenye moto".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les cloches de l'église tintent.
target_text: Kengele za kanisa zinalia.
target_text_raw: Kengele za kanisa zinalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne triche pas.
target_text: Usiibie.
target_text_raw: Usiibie (usi tricher).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes en train d'y pénétrer.
target_text: Tuko naingia amo.
target_text_raw: Tuko naingia amo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa santé évolue en s'améliorant.
target_text: Hali yake ya afya inaendelea najiboresha.
target_text_raw: Hali yake ya afya inaendelea najiboresha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'a qu'un seul serviteur à son service.
target_text: Iko na mutumishi umoja tu.
target_text_raw: Iko na mutumishi umoja tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'actrice a un très beau nom.
target_text: Muigizaji iko na jina ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Muigizaji iko na jina ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lis ton livre.
target_text: Nasoma kitabu yako.
target_text_raw: Nasoma kitabu yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce dont j'ai besoin, c'est d'une bière.
target_text: Kyenye nahitaji ni chupa ya pombe.
target_text_raw: Kyenye nahitaji ni chupa ya pombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les étudiants aiment les vacances.
target_text: Wanafunzi wote wanapendaka likizo.
target_text_raw: Wanafunzi wote wanapendaka likizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne perdez pas courage.
target_text: Usivunjike moyo.
target_text_raw: Usivunjike moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que la phrase sonnerait plus naturelle comme ça.
target_text: Nazani kama hiyo musemwa ingesikilina ya kawaida namna iyi.
target_text_raw: Nazani kama hiyo musemwa (phrase) ingesikilina ya kawaida namna iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a refusé de nous croire.
target_text: Alikatala kutuamini.
target_text_raw: Alikatala kutuamini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu es plus intelligent que ça.
target_text: Najua una akili kuliko hiyo.
target_text_raw: Najua una akili kuliko hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que Tom a sauvé la vie de Mary.
target_text: Najua Tom aliokoa maisha ya Maria.
target_text_raw: Najua Tom aliokoa maisha ya Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils skiaient.
target_text: Walikua wanacheza muchezo ya ski.
target_text_raw: Walikua wanacheza muchezo ya ski.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.
