source_text: Nous sommes désormais responsables de votre protection.
target_text: Tangu leo siye njo tutashimamia ulinzi wako.
target_text_raw: Tangu leo siye njo tutashimamia ulinzi wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'économie ne s'est pas encore complètement remise de la crise financière.
target_text: Uchumi bado hauyakuwa muzuri kabisa kutokana na tatizo ya kifedha.
target_text_raw: Uchumi bado hauyakuwa muzuri kabisa kutokana na tatizo ya kifedha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis surpris que Tom ne m'ait jamais parlé de vous.
target_text: Ninashangala kuona Tom hakuwahi kuniambia juu yako.
target_text_raw: Ninashangala kuona Tom hakuwahi kuniambia juu yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle dit qu'elle viendra demain.
target_text: Alisema kama atakuya kesho.
target_text_raw: Alisema kama atakuya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Appelez une ambulance.
target_text: Pigia simu gari ya kubeba wagonjwa.
target_text_raw: Pigia simu gari ya kubeba wagonjwa (ambulense).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a élevé tout seul son fils.
target_text: Tom alilea mutoto wake yepeke.
target_text_raw: Tom alilea mutoto wake yepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Y a-t-il une station-service dans les environs ?
target_text: Je! Kuna kituo cha mafuta karibu ?
target_text_raw: Je! Kuna kituo cha mafuta (station ya essence) karibu ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela prit exactement une heure.
target_text: Ilikamata saa moya.
target_text_raw: Ilikamata saa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce tapis est beau.
target_text: Iyi tapis inapendeza sana.
target_text_raw: Iyi tapis inapendeza sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas mon cousin.
target_text: Yeye aiko binamu yangu.
target_text_raw: Yeye aiko binamu yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais vendre ma voiture.
target_text: Nataka kuuzisha gari.
target_text_raw: Nataka kuuzisha gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est trop tôt.
target_text: Ingali mapema sana.
target_text_raw: Ingali mapema sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'a répondu Tom ?
target_text: Tom alijibu nini?
target_text_raw: Tom alijibu nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une autre sœur.
target_text: Niko na dada mwingine.
target_text_raw: Niko na dada mwingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À chaque fois qu'il vient, il fait toute une histoire.
target_text: Kila anapokuja anafanya fujo kabisa.
target_text_raw: Kila anapokuja anafanya fujo kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle dort sur le ventre.
target_text: Analalia tumbo.
target_text_raw: Analalia tumbo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laisseras-tu le poulet frit comme ça ?
target_text: Je! Utaacha nyama ya kuku ya kukalangiwa sawa iyi?
target_text_raw: Je! Utaacha nyama ya kuku ya kukalangiwa sawa iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime voyager et rencontrer de nouvelles personnes.
target_text: Napenda kusafiri na kukutana na watu wa mpya.
target_text_raw: Napenda kusafiri na kukutana na watu wa mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était content de sa nouvelle voiture.
target_text: Alifurahia gari yake ya mpya.
target_text_raw: Alifurahia gari yake ya mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'étais riche, je le ferais. Au point où j'en suis, je ne peux rien faire.
target_text: Ningekua tajiri, ningeifanya. Kwa kiwango minafikia, siwezi kufanya chochote.
target_text_raw: Ningekua tajiri, ningeifanya. Kwa kiwango minafikia, siwezi kufanya chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je cherchais une paire de ciseaux.
target_text: Nilikuwa natafuta ciseaux.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa natafuta ciseaux (mikasi).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un problème cardiaque.
target_text: Niko na matatizo ya moyo.
target_text_raw: Niko na matatizo ya moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous l'aidez ?
target_text: Je! Unamusaidia?
target_text_raw: Je! Unamusaidia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai essayé de le faire.
target_text: Nilijaribu kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Nilijaribu kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'appellerai.
target_text: Nitakuita.
target_text_raw: Nitakuita.

source_text: Tout le monde buvait du vin, à la fête.
target_text: Kila mutu alikuwa nakunywa divai kwenye sherehe.
target_text_raw: Kila mutu alikuwa nakunywa divai kwenye sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai toujours pas assez d'argent pour acheter ça.
target_text: Siyakuwa na pesa za kutosha juu ya kuuza iyo.
target_text_raw: Siyakuwa na pesa za kutosha juu ya kuuza iyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus je réfléchissais à ce problème, plus il paraissait difficile.
target_text: Kila nikifikiria zaidi juu ya iyi shida, ilionekana kuwa ngumu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Kila nikifikiria zaidi juu ya iyi shida, ilionekana kuwa ngumu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous suggérer une autre date ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza chagua tarehe ingine?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza chagua tarehe ingine?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je garantis que cette information est correcte.
target_text: Ninahakikisha kama iyi habari ni ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Ninahakikisha kama iyi habari ni ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il lui a offert une poupée.
target_text: Alimupatia poupée.
target_text_raw: Alimupatia poupée.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vit en marge de la société.
target_text: Anaishi pembeni ya jamii.
target_text_raw: Anaishi pembeni ya jamii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus on vieillit, plus on entend dire des choses.
target_text: Kadiri umri inaongezeka njo gisi utazidi kusikia maneno mengi tafauti.
target_text_raw: Kadiri umri inaongezeka njo gisi utazidi kusikia maneno mengi tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Japon est ici !
target_text: Japani iko hapa.
target_text_raw: Japani iko hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles lisent son livre.
target_text: Wanasoma kitabu yake.
target_text_raw: Wanasoma kitabu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es étudiant en quoi ?
target_text: Unasomea nini?
target_text_raw: Unasomea nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu ne parles pas français.
target_text: Najua kama hausemaki Kifaransa.
target_text_raw: Najua kama hausemaki Kifaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'êtes pas vieux.
target_text: Hauko mzee.
target_text_raw: Hauko mzee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je compte sur votre aide.
target_text: Nategemea musaada wako.
target_text_raw: Nategemea musaada wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me fiche de la mode.
target_text: Sijali mitindo.
target_text_raw: Sijali mitindo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai peur également, donc je ne vais pas m'y rendre.
target_text: Minaogopa pia, kwa hivyo sitaenda huko.
target_text_raw: Minaogopa pia, kwa hivyo sitaenda huko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce serait mieux de rester à la maison avec le temps qu'il fait.
target_text: Ingekuwa muzuri kuikala nyumbani juu ya iyi hali ya hewa.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa muzuri kuikala nyumbani juu ya iyi hali ya hewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'a presque rien mangé.
target_text: Hakukula kitu.
target_text_raw: Hakukula kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je marcherais volontiers mais il fait trop chaud.
target_text: Ningependa kutembea alakini piko kifukutu sana.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kutembea alakini piko kifukutu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment subvient-il à ses besoins ?
target_text: Aye njoo anakuwaka najibia ku mahitaji yake?
target_text_raw: Aye njoo anakuwaka najibia ku mahitaji yake?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce fut un hiver terriblement froid.
target_text: Ilikuwa kipindi ya baridi kali sana.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa kipindi ya baridi kali sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sois ouvert d'esprit.
target_text: Kuwa muvumilivu.
target_text_raw: Kuwa muvumilivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas sûr que ça soit une bonne idée.
target_text: Sina uhakika kama iyi ni wazo muzuri.
target_text_raw: Sina uhakika kama iyi ni wazo muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que je t'avais compris.
target_text: Nilizani kama minakuelewa.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama minakuelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gardez vos papiers dans votre poche intérieure.
target_text: Weka kartasi zako mu mfuko yako ya ndani.
target_text_raw: Weka kartasi zako mu mfuko yako ya ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu m'empoisonnes.
target_text: Uliniwekea sumu.
target_text_raw: Uliniwekea sumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me force pas à aller te chercher !
target_text: Usinilazimishe kwenda kukutafuta!
target_text_raw: Usinilazimishe kwenda kukutafuta!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n’ai jamais dit que tu étais ennuyeux.
target_text: Sikuwahi kusema kama ulikuwa unachosha.
target_text_raw: Sikuwahi kusema kama ulikuwa unachosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois également écouter l'autre partie.
target_text: Unapshwa sikiliza pia neno kutoka upande ingine.
target_text_raw: Unapshwa sikiliza pia neno kutoka upande ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne pouvons pas tout le temps raconter le même mensonge aux gens. Des fois nous devons en imaginer un nouveau.
target_text: Hatuwezi kuendelea nadanganya watu kila mara. Wakati mwingine tunapashwa kufikiria kitu ya mpya.
target_text_raw: Hatuwezi kuendelea nadanganya watu kila mara. Wakati mwingine tunapashwa kufikiria kitu ya mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'important n'est pas combien de livres, mais quels livres vous lisez.
target_text: Jambo muhimu aiko idadi ya vitabu, alakini ni vitabu ya aina gani njo unasoma.
target_text_raw: Jambo muhimu aiko idadi ya vitabu, alakini ni vitabu ya aina gani njo unasoma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un chauffeur expérimenté.
target_text: Ni dereva muzoefu.
target_text_raw: Ni dereva muzoefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est illégal dans l'Union Européenne.
target_text: Ni kinyume cha sheria katika Umoja wa Ulaya.
target_text_raw: Ni kinyume cha sheria katika Umoja wa Ulaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que John a déjà décidé son plan de carrière ?
target_text: Je! John tayari ameamua mpango wake wa kazi?
target_text_raw: Je! John tayari ameamua mpango wake wa kazi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Flanque juste ton vélo à l'arrière du camion et je te conduirai à la maison.
target_text: Weka basikeli yako tu nyuma ya camion na nitakubeba nyumbani.
target_text_raw: Weka basikeli (kinga) yako tu nyuma ya camion na nitakubeba nyumbani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas jouer aux échecs.
target_text: Sijui kucheza mchezo wa échecs.
target_text_raw: Sijui kucheza mchezo wa échecs.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai déjà vu le film.
target_text: Nilishaona filamu.
target_text_raw: Nilishaona filamu (film).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ravi d'être ici.
target_text: Nafurahi kuwa hapa.
target_text_raw: Nafurahi kuwa hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il vous plait laissez un message sur mon répondeur.
target_text: Tafazali acha ujumbe kwenye simu yangu, nitajibia badae.
target_text_raw: Tafazali acha ujumbe kwenye simu yangu, nitajibia badae.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui mange des abeilles ?
target_text: Nani anakula nyuki?
target_text_raw: Nani anakula nyuki?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un excellent argument.
target_text: Ni wazo muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Ni wazo muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a fait cela pour l'argent.
target_text: Alifanya ivo sababu ya pesa.
target_text_raw: Alifanya ivo sababu ya pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serai toujours amoureux de Mary.
target_text: Nitazidi kumupenda Maria.
target_text_raw: Nitazidi kumupenda Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une personne brillante.
target_text: Yeye ni mutu mwenye akili sana.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mutu mwenye akili sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas demandé tes conseils.
target_text: Siyaomba ushauri wako.
target_text_raw: Siyaomba ushauri wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta réponse est juste.
target_text: Jibu yako ni ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Jibu yako ni ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je connais quelqu'un qui peut nous aider.
target_text: Minajua mtu mwenye anaweza kutusaidia.
target_text_raw: Minajua mtu mwenye anaweza kutusaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un aigle vole dans le ciel.
target_text: Aigle inarukaka angani.
target_text_raw: Aigle (aina ya ndege) inarukaka angani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom va aller à Boston le week-end prochain.
target_text: Tom ataenda Boston wikendi ijayo.
target_text_raw: Tom ataenda Boston wikendi ijayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me prends pas au sérieux. Je ne fais que blaguer.
target_text: Usinikamate byenye minasema bya maana. Natania tu.
target_text_raw: Usinikamate byenye minasema bya maana. Natania tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En faisant un peu plus d'effort, il aurait réussi.
target_text: Kwa juhudi kidogo zaidi angefanikiwa.
target_text_raw: Kwa juhudi kidogo zaidi angefanikiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant je te reconnais !
target_text: Sasa minakujua!
target_text_raw: Sasa minakujua!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il le fit entièrement par gentillesse.
target_text: Alifanya ile yote kwa roho muzuri.
target_text_raw: Alifanya ile yote kwa roho muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est d'une humeur massacrante.
target_text: Anasirika sana.
target_text_raw: Anasirika sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon resta tranquille.
target_text: Kijana aliikala kimya.
target_text_raw: Kijana aliikala kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui, de vos amis, viendra ?
target_text: Ni nani kati ya barafiki yako njo atakuya?
target_text_raw: Ni nani kati ya barafiki yako njo atakuya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis intelligente.
target_text: Miye ni mwerevu.
target_text_raw: Miye ni mwerevu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'avion est-il à l'heure ?
target_text: Ndege inaeshimia muda ?
target_text_raw: Ndege inaeshimia muda ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était une fois un grand roi.
target_text: Hapo zamani za kale kulikuwa mfalme mkubwa.
target_text_raw: Hapo zamani za kale kulikuwa mfalme mkubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous mangez ça, vous allez mourir.
target_text: Ukikula iyi, utakufa.
target_text_raw: Ukikula iyi, utakufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as raison.
target_text: Uko na sheria.
target_text_raw: Uko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis intelligent.
target_text: Niko mwerevu.
target_text_raw: Niko mwerevu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dit à Tom d'enlever ses chaussures.
target_text: Niliambia Tom avue biato.
target_text_raw: Niliambia Tom avue biato.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est temps que quelqu'un fasse quelque chose à propos de cette porte cassée.
target_text: Ni wakati ya kufanya jambo fulani juu ya iyi mlango yenye ulivunjika.
target_text_raw: Ni wakati ya kufanya jambo fulani juu ya iyi mlango yenye ulivunjika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a dit à Mary qu'elle ne devrait pas y aller seule.
target_text: Tom aliambia Maria kama hapashwi kwenda peke yake.
target_text_raw: Tom aliambia Maria kama hapashwi kwenda peke yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonjour Ô toi le ciel bleu !
target_text: Jambo ewe anga ya bleu !
target_text_raw: Jambo ewe anga ya bleu !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons jamais été à Boston.
target_text: Hatujawai kwenda Boston.
target_text_raw: Hatujawai kwenda Boston.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On rentre à la maison.
target_text: Turudie ku nyumba.
target_text_raw: Turudie ku nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de temps ça prend de marcher d'ici jusqu'à la gare ?
target_text: Inakamata saa ngapi kutembea kutoka hapa kwenda kituo ?
target_text_raw: Inakamata saa ngapi kutembea kutoka hapa kwenda kituo (ya gari) ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle désespérait qu'on s'intéresse à elle.
target_text: Alikata tamaa ya kuonekana mwenye kufaa mbele yabo.
target_text_raw: Alikata tamaa ya kuonekana mwenye kufaa mbele yabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donne-moi mon verre !
target_text: Nipe kilahuli yangu.
target_text_raw: Nipe kilahuli yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci. Que Dieu vous bénisse. Et que Dieu bénisse les États-Unis d'Amérique.
target_text: Aksanti. Mungu akubariki. Na Mungu ibariki Amerika.
target_text_raw: Aksanti. Mungu akubariki. Na Mungu ibariki Amerika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et moi n'avons pas d'enfants.
target_text: Miye na Tom hatuna batoto.
target_text_raw: Miye na Tom hatuna batoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regarde toujours du bon côté de la vie.
target_text: Kila mara angalia tu upande muzuri wa maisha.
target_text_raw: Kila mara angalia tu upande muzuri wa maisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aime pas vivre ici.
target_text: Sitaki kuishi hapa.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kuishi hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père est, chaque jour, affairé comme une abeille.
target_text: Kila siku baba yangu anafanya ma shughuli kama nyuki.
target_text_raw: Kila siku baba yangu anafanya ma shughuli (activités) kama nyuki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce fruit n'a pas bon goût.
target_text: Iyi tunda haina onjo ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Iyi tunda haina onjo ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle continuait à m'interrompre.
target_text: Aliendelea kunikata kauli.
target_text_raw: Aliendelea kunikata kauli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je le savais, je vous le dirais.
target_text: Kama ningekuwa najua, ningekuambia.
target_text_raw: Kama ningekuwa najua, ningekuambia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas pu réveiller Mary.
target_text: Tom hakulamusha Maria.
target_text_raw: Tom hakulamusha Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça veut rien dire !
target_text: Haimanishi kitu!
target_text_raw: Haimanishi kitu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a regardé autour de la maison.
target_text: Aliangalia kando ya nyumba.
target_text_raw: Aliangalia kando ya nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On peut répondre très simplement à ces questions.
target_text: Iyi maswali inaweza kujibiwa kwa urahisi sana.
target_text_raw: Iyi maswali inaweza kujibiwa kwa urahisi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle lui a volé beaucoup d'argent, donc maintenant, elle est en prison.
target_text: Alimuibia pesa mingi, kwa hivyo sasa iko gerezani.
target_text_raw: Alimuibia pesa mingi, kwa hivyo sasa iko gerezani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te détestais.
target_text: Nilikua nakuchukia.
target_text_raw: Nilikua nakuchukia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai quelque chose qui t'appartient. Pourquoi ne viens-tu pas ici le récupérer ?
target_text: Niko na kitu yako. Juu ya nini aukuyi hapa kuikamata?
target_text_raw: Niko na kitu yako. Juu ya nini aukuyi hapa kuikamata?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce vieux poisson a un goût étrange.
target_text: Iyi samaki iko na onjo yenye haiko ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Iyi samaki iko na onjo yenye haiko ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Excusez-moi, Monsieur, auriez-vous une petite pièce ?
target_text: Samahani, Papa, unaweza kuwa na chumba kidogo?
target_text_raw: Samahani, Papa (Monsieur), unaweza kuwa na chumba kidogo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trouvé la photo que vous cherchiez.
target_text: Nimepata picha yenye ulikuwa natafuta.
target_text_raw: Nimepata picha (photo) yenye ulikuwa natafuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais être seul, si tu n'y vois pas d'inconvénient.
target_text: Ningependa kuwa peke yangu, kama haujali.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kuwa peke yangu, kama haujali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suppose qu'elle a raison.
target_text: Minawaza kama iko na sheria.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama iko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où as-tu eu ces informations ?
target_text: Ulitoa wapi izo habari ?
target_text_raw: Ulitoa wapi izo habari ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je jouerai avec toi.
target_text: Nitachezeka na weye.
target_text_raw: Nitachezeka na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A quelle heure est servi le petit déjeuner?
target_text: Saa ngapi njo banapanaka chai ya asubui?
target_text_raw: Saa ngapi njo banapanaka chai (chakula) ya asubui (petit déjeuner)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je perds ton amour, je perds tout.
target_text: Nikipoteza upendo wako, nitapoteza kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Nikipoteza upendo wako, nitapoteza kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle m'a demandé qui était arrivé en premier.
target_text: Aliniuliza ni nani njo alikuya wa kwanza.
target_text_raw: Aliniuliza ni nani njo alikuya wa kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Apparemment, tout ceci ne fonctionne pas encore à la perfection, mais le système ne manque pas d'intérêt.
target_text: Inaonekana kama kitu hakianza tumika muzuri alakini iyi mfumo ni ya lazima.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana kama kitu hakianza tumika muzuri alakini iyi mfumo (système) ni ya lazima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est contraire aux règles.

source_text: Ils ne seront pas à temps.
target_text: Hawatafika kwa wakati.
target_text_raw: Hawatafika kwa wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas une erreur.
target_text: Haiko makosa.
target_text_raw: Haiko makosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas te causer d'ennuis.
target_text: Sitaki kukutia shida.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kukutia shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis heureux d'aider.
target_text: Minafurahi kusaidia.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi kusaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il passa l'examen avec succès.
target_text: Aliweza mutihani.
target_text_raw: Aliweza mutihani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne n'est autorisé à faire cela.
target_text: Hakuna mwenye anaruhusiwa kufanya vile.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwenye anaruhusiwa kufanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'en as pas fini avec ça?
target_text: Je! Hauyamaliza iyi?
target_text_raw: Je! Hauyamaliza iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si seulement je pouvais bien chanter.
target_text: Ingekuwa ata minajuwa kuimba muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa ata minajuwa kuimba muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un biscuit se trouve sous la table.
target_text: Kiskwiti kimoja kiko chini ya meza.
target_text_raw: Kiskwiti kimoja kiko chini ya meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fais partie de l'équipe ?
target_text: Niko mwanatimu ?
target_text_raw: Niko mwanatimu ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Finir le rapport pour demain est à peu près impossible.
target_text: Iko saa haitawezekana kumaliza ripoti ya kesho.
target_text_raw: Iko saa haitawezekana kumaliza ripoti ya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je prévois de dormir à l'hôtel.
target_text: Minapanga kulala ku hoteli.
target_text_raw: Minapanga kulala ku hoteli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se tenait derrière la chaise.
target_text: Alikuwa nasimama nyuma ya kiti.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nasimama nyuma ya kiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aussi vite que tu coures, tu ne le rattraperas pas.
target_text: Hata ukimbie aye, hauwezi mufikilia.
target_text_raw: Hata ukimbie aye, hauwezi mufikilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Visiblement, Tom et Mary sont très riches.
target_text: Ni wazi, Tom na Mary ni watajiri sana.
target_text_raw: Ni wazi, Tom na Mary ni watajiri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut attaquer l'opinion avec ses armes : on ne tire pas des coups de fusil aux idées.
target_text: Lazima tupiganishe maoni ya wanaichi kwa namna yetu: maoni haipigwi masasi.
target_text_raw: Lazima tupiganishe maoni ya wanaichi kwa namna yetu: maoni haipigwi masasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lève ta main si tu veux parler.
target_text: Pandisha mkono yako kama unataka ongea.
target_text_raw: Pandisha mkono yako kama unataka ongea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai oublié de fermer le tiroir à clé.
target_text: Nilisahabu kufunga kabati na fungulo.
target_text_raw: Nilisahabu kufunga kabati na fungulo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es mignon.
target_text: Uko wa kiyana.
target_text_raw: Uko wa kiyana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle distance est-ce du musée ?
target_text: Musée iko kwa umbali gani ?
target_text_raw: Musée (nyumba ya kumbukumbu) iko kwa umbali (distance) gani ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde sait que Tom aime Mary.
target_text: Kila mutu anajua kama Tom anapenda Maria.
target_text_raw: Kila mutu anajua kama Tom anapenda Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne nous laissez-vous pas y aller avec vous ?
target_text: Juu ya nini hauturuhusu twende nawe?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini hauturuhusu twende nawe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta sœur ne sait pas bien nager, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Dada yako hajui kuogelea muzuri, haiko hivyo?
target_text_raw: Dada yako hajui kuogelea muzuri, haiko hivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est difficile de croire que c'est effectivement arrivé.
target_text: Ni vigumu kuamini kama kweli ilitokea.
target_text_raw: Ni vigumu kuamini kama kweli ilitokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que tu comprends ?
target_text: Unaelewa nini?
target_text_raw: Unaelewa nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'importe quelle montre fera l'affaire pourvu qu'elle ne soit pas chère.
target_text: Saa yoyote itaisaidia lakini isikuwe tu beyi.
target_text_raw: Saa yoyote itaisaidia lakini isikuwe tu beyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Buvons à son succès.
target_text: Tukunywe kwa mafanyikio yake.
target_text_raw: Tukunywe kwa mafanyikio yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est tombé amoureux avec l'un de ses élèves.
target_text: Alipenda umoja wa wanafunzi wake.
target_text_raw: Alipenda umoja wa wanafunzi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je avoir un autre verre maintenant ?
target_text: Je! Minaweza pata kingine kilahuli ya kinywaji sasa?
target_text_raw: Je! Minaweza pata kingine kilahuli ya kinywaji sasa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'alcool au volant peut être dangereux.
target_text: Kutembeza gari na ukiwa mlevi inawezakuwa hatari.
target_text_raw: Kutembeza gari na ukiwa mlevi inawezakuwa hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je prends mon travail au sérieux.
target_text: Nakamata kazi yangu kwa umakini.
target_text_raw: Nakamata kazi yangu kwa umakini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet idiot de Tom aurait dû se douter que le dernier mot de cette phrase serait évidemment pour Mary.
target_text: Huyo Tom mjinga angepashwa jua kama Mariamu angeelewa neno ya mwisho mwa iyi msemo.
target_text_raw: Huyo Tom mjinga angepashwa jua kama Mariamu angeelewa neno ya mwisho mwa iyi msemo (phrase).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voulais pas ça.
target_text: Sikukuwa nataka hiyi.
target_text_raw: Sikukuwa nataka hiyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me rappelle de votre visage mais pas de votre nom.
target_text: Nakumbuka sura yako alakini hapana jina yako.
target_text_raw: Nakumbuka sura yako alakini hapana jina yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu sûr que tu n'as pas froid?
target_text: Je! Uko na uhakika kama hausikii baridi?
target_text_raw: Je! Uko na uhakika kama hausikii baridi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demande à Tom où il est.
target_text: Muulize Tom iko wapi.
target_text_raw: Muulize Tom iko wapi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est trop jeune pour connaître la vérité.
target_text: Angali mtoto mudogo sana kujuaukweli.
target_text_raw: Angali mtoto mudogo sana kujuaukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ok, Tom, ça suffit !
target_text: Sawa, Tom, inatosha!
target_text_raw: Sawa, Tom, inatosha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut celui-ci.
target_text: Minahitaji hiyi.
target_text_raw: Minahitaji hiyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce cinéma a deux étages.
target_text: Iyi ukumbi sinema iko na étages mbili.
target_text_raw: Iyi ukumbi (salle) sinema iko na étages mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le roi se présentera en personne demain soir.
target_text: Mufalme atajitambulisha yepeke kesho magaribi.
target_text_raw: Mufalme atajitambulisha yepeke kesho magaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom t’a répondu ?
target_text: Tom alikujibia?
target_text_raw: Tom alikujibia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a perdu son sang-froid à ce moment là.
target_text: Alipoteza uvumilivu ile wakati.
target_text_raw: Alipoteza uvumilivu ile wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis à Tom que j'ai besoin de son aide.
target_text: Mwambie Tom kama minahitaji msaada wake.
target_text_raw: Mwambie Tom kama minahitaji msaada wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie ne perdait pas de temps.
target_text: Maria hakuwa napoteza muda.
target_text_raw: Maria hakuwa napoteza muda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Selon moi, elle a raison.
target_text: Kwa mtazamo wangu, iko na sheria.
target_text_raw: Kwa mtazamo wangu, iko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu le film.
target_text: Niliangalia film.
target_text_raw: Niliangalia film.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi est-ce que tu ne viens pas avec nous ?
target_text: Juu ya nini haukuyi twende pamoya?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini haukuyi twende pamoya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est fier de ce que son père était un grand scientifique.
target_text: Anajivunia kuwa baba yake alikuwa mwanasayansi mukubwa.
target_text_raw: Anajivunia kuwa baba yake alikuwa mwanasayansi mukubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À demain matin !
target_text: Tuonane kesho asubui.
target_text_raw: Tuonane kesho asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que quelque chose de bien va se produire avant que la journée soit finie.
target_text: Natumaini kama kitu kizuri kinatokea kabla ya mwisho ya siku.
target_text_raw: Natumaini kama kitu kizuri kinatokea kabla ya mwisho ya siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis né sur un bateau.
target_text: Nilizaliwa kwenye mashua.
target_text_raw: Nilizaliwa kwenye mashua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne viendrais-tu pas en parler autour d'une tasse de café ?
target_text: Juu ya nini hauwezi kuya tuzuingumzie na tukikunywa kahawa?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini hauwezi kuya tuzuingumzie na tukikunywa kahawa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette vidéo a déjà plus de un million de vues.
target_text: Iyi video ilishaangaliwa na zaidi ya watu milioni moja
target_text_raw: Iyi video ilishaangaliwa na zaidi ya watu milioni moja
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où sont les chaussures ?
target_text: Biato biko wapi?
target_text_raw: Biato biko wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut perdre un peu de poids.
target_text: Minahitaji kupoteza bilo.
target_text_raw: Minahitaji kupoteza bilo (bunene).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi tu souris ?
target_text: Juu ya nini unacheka?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini unacheka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai senti quelque chose toucher mes pieds.
target_text: Nilisikia kitu kinanigusa ku migulu.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia kitu kinanigusa ku migulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas d'autre choix.
target_text: Hakuna chaguo ingine.
target_text_raw: Hakuna chaguo ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne chante vraiment pas.
target_text: Siimbaki kabisa.
target_text_raw: Siimbaki kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que cela serait très utile.
target_text: Nazani hiyo itasaidia sana.
target_text_raw: Nazani hiyo itasaidia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Levez la main.
target_text: Nawa mikono.
target_text_raw: Nawa mikono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette peinture devrait rapporter pas mal d'argent aux enchères.
target_text: Iyi uchoraji inapashwa kupata pesa nyingi kwenye enchères.
target_text_raw: Iyi uchoraji inapashwa kupata pesa nyingi kwenye enchères (fasi kwenye wa franga mingi njo banauzishiaka biashara).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce travail exige un haut degré de compétence.
target_text: Iyi kazi inahitaji ujuzi mkubwa.
target_text_raw: Iyi kazi inahitaji ujuzi mkubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons pensé que ça ne t'a pas plu.
target_text: Tulizani kama haukuipenda.
target_text_raw: Tulizani kama haukuipenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dit que je ne m'en souvenais pas.
target_text: Nilisema kama sikumbuki.
target_text_raw: Nilisema kama sikumbuki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laisse tomber.
target_text: Achana nayo.
target_text_raw: Achana nayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as peut-être raison.
target_text: Unaweza kuwa na sheria.
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuwa na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'honneur existe même parmi les voleurs.
target_text: Heshima inakuwaka hata mu kundi ya bamwizi.
target_text_raw: Heshima inakuwaka hata mu kundi ya bamwizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est là pour te protéger.
target_text: Iko pale kwa kukulinda.
target_text_raw: Iko pale kwa kukulinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une belle histoire.
target_text: Ni adisi ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ni adisi (histoire) ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a jamais entendu Mary mentir.
target_text: Tom hayawahi kusikia Maria anadanganya.
target_text_raw: Tom hayawahi kusikia Maria anadanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon épouse suit un régime sévère.
target_text: Mke wangu iko kwenye malishi yenye inaomba uangalifu sana.
target_text_raw: Mke wangu iko kwenye malishi yenye inaomba uangalifu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suppose que c'est une blague.
target_text: Nazani iyi ni utani.
target_text_raw: Nazani iyi ni utani (muzaa).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attention de ne pas tomber.
target_text: Kuwa mwangalifu usianguke.
target_text_raw: Kuwa mwangalifu usianguke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me rases.
target_text: Unaninyoa.
target_text_raw: Unaninyoa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il devrait arriver chez toi dans une heure.
target_text: Angepashwa fika kwako mu saa moya.
target_text_raw: Angepashwa fika kwako mu saa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne va pas dans un endroit pareil en pleine nuit.
target_text: Usiende mahali kama iyi busiku.
target_text_raw: Usiende mahali kama iyi busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais te surveiller.
target_text: Nitakuchunguza.
target_text_raw: Nitakuchunguza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a terminé son travail.
target_text: Alimaliza kazi yake.
target_text_raw: Alimaliza kazi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père et moi allons à la pèche de temps en temps.
target_text: Miye na baba yangu tunaendaka kuvua samaki mara kwa mara.
target_text_raw: Miye na baba yangu tunaendaka kuvua samaki mara kwa mara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a un fils.
target_text: Iko na mutoto wa kijana.
target_text_raw: Iko na mutoto wa kijana (garcon).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ici avec un ami.
target_text: Niko hapa na rafiki yangu umoya.
target_text_raw: Niko hapa na rafiki yangu umoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux inviter qui tu veux.
target_text: Unaweza kukaribisha yeyote mwenye unataka.
target_text_raw: Unaweza kukaribisha yeyote mwenye unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis bonjour à Jimmy.
target_text: Salimia Jimmy.
target_text_raw: Salimia Jimmy.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au revoir, monde cruel !
target_text: Kwaheri, dunia bila huruma!
target_text_raw: Kwaheri, dunia bila huruma!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom arrêtait de pleurer.
target_text: Tom aliacha kulia.
target_text_raw: Tom aliacha kulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a accepté un cadeau coûteux de Mary.
target_text: Tom alikubali zawadi ya beyi kutoka kwa Maria.
target_text_raw: Tom alikubali zawadi ya beyi kutoka kwa Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai l'habitude d'aller au lit avant 10 heures.
target_text: Kawaida minaendeaka lala mbele ya saa 10 ya asubuhi.
target_text_raw: Kawaida minaendeaka lala mbele ya saa 10 ya asubuhi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "J'ai vu Tom, aujourd'hui." "Qui ?!"
target_text: "Niliona Tom leo." "Nani?!
target_text_raw: "Niliona Tom leo." "Nani?!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux voyager sur la Lune.
target_text: Nataka niende ku mwezi.
target_text_raw: Nataka niende ku mwezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux manger un truc bon.
target_text: Natamani kula chakula nzuri.
target_text_raw: Natamani kula chakula nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai lu ton livre, il est très intéressant.
target_text: Nilisoma kitabu yako, inavutia sana.
target_text_raw: Nilisoma kitabu yako, inavutia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y avait un vent frais.
target_text: Kulikuwa mupepeo ya baridi.
target_text_raw: Kulikuwa mupepeo ya baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le crois pas, quoi qu'il dise.
target_text: Hata anasema nini, usimwamini.
target_text_raw: Hata anasema nini, usimwamini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: M.Smith se présente pour être maire.
target_text: Bwana Smith anagombea kwa uchaguzi wa Meya.
target_text_raw: Bwana Smith anagombea kwa uchaguzi wa Meya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom avoua qu'il avait tué Mary.
target_text: Tom aliitika kama aliua Maria.
target_text_raw: Tom aliitika kama aliua Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vais pas aller là-dedans.
target_text: Sitaenda kule ndani.
target_text_raw: Sitaenda kule ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils n'ont jamais admis qu'ils avaient tort.
target_text: Hawayawahi kuitika kama walikosea.
target_text_raw: Hawayawahi kuitika kama walikosea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est cher.
target_text: Ni beyi kali.
target_text_raw: Ni beyi kali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pensons tous qu'il est malsain de tricher aux examens.

source_text: Les oiseaux sont rouges.
target_text: Ndege ziko nyekundu.
target_text_raw: Ndege ziko nyekundu (rouge).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où est-ce qu'il va s'installer ?
target_text: Ataikala wapi?
target_text_raw: Ataikala wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour Noël, nous envoyons des cartes de vœux à nos amis.
target_text: Juu ya Noeli, tunatumiaka barafiki yetu kadi za salamu.
target_text_raw: Juu ya Noeli, tunatumiaka barafiki yetu kadi za salamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des milliers de familles sont restées sans abri.
target_text: Familia za mingi zilibaki bila makao.
target_text_raw: Familia za mingi zilibaki bila makao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des milliers de personnes ont péri au Japon.
target_text: Maelfu ya watu walifariki pale Japani.
target_text_raw: Maelfu ya watu walifariki pale Japani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On saura une fois pour toute qui est le meilleur.
target_text: Tutajua mara moja nani njo bora.
target_text_raw: Tutajua mara moja nani njo bora.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous jouons aux cartes pour tuer le temps.
target_text: Tunacheza karata juu ya kupitisha wakati.
target_text_raw: Tunacheza karata juu ya kupitisha wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est mal de tricher aux jeux de cartes.
target_text: Ni mubaya kuiba mu michezo ya karata.
target_text_raw: Ni mubaya kuiba mu michezo ya karata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Calme-toi !
target_text: Tulia!
target_text_raw: Tulia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Seriez-vous intéressé par un jeu de cartes ?
target_text: Je! Ungependa kucheza mchezo wa karata?
target_text_raw: Je! Ungependa kucheza mchezo wa karata?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pas envie de jouer au cartes.
target_text: Sina hamu ya kucheza karata.
target_text_raw: Sina hamu ya kucheza karata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom refusa de se calmer.
target_text: Tom alikatala kunyamanza.
target_text_raw: Tom alikatala kunyamanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Distribue-nous les cartes.
target_text: Tugabulie ma karata.
target_text_raw: Tugabulie ma karata (cartes).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne faut pas miser aux cartes.
target_text: Husipinganishie kwenye mchezo ya karata.
target_text_raw: Husipinganishie kwenye mchezo ya karata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Se battre ne résoudra rien.
target_text: Kupigana haitatua shida yoyote.
target_text_raw: Kupigana haitatua shida yoyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux me calmer.
target_text: Nataka kutulia.
target_text_raw: Nataka kutulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle veut s'installer et avoir des enfants.
target_text: Anataka kujipanga na kupata batoto.
target_text_raw: Anataka kujipanga na kupata batoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais comment régler ça.
target_text: Najua kutatua iyo mambo.
target_text_raw: Najua kutatua iyo mambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jouons un peu aux cartes !
target_text: Tucheze karata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Tucheze karata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'avais encore jamais vu autant d'oiseaux en même temps auparavant.
target_text: Sikuwahi kuona ndege mingi kwa limoja hapo zamani.
target_text_raw: Sikuwahi kuona ndege mingi kwa limoja hapo zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai obligée à faire mes devoirs.
target_text: Nilimushurtisha afanye kazi zangu.
target_text_raw: Nilimushurtisha afanye kazi zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne ne vous a forcé à le faire.
target_text: Hakuna mutu aliyekulazimisha kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mutu aliyekulazimisha kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils passèrent le temps en jouant aux cartes.
target_text: Walipitisha wakati wakicheza karata.
target_text_raw: Walipitisha wakati wakicheza karata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a forcé à le faire.
target_text: Alimulazimisha kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Alimulazimisha kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui t'a forcé à faire ça ?
target_text: Ni nani aliyekulazimisha kufanya hivi?
target_text_raw: Ni nani aliyekulazimisha kufanya hivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis contraint à le faire.
target_text: Nimelazimishwa kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Nimelazimishwa kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a forcé à y aller.
target_text: Tom alinilazimisha niende kule.
target_text_raw: Tom alinilazimisha niende kule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était un sourire emprunté.
target_text: Ilikuwa tabasamu ya kukopesha.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa tabasamu ya kukopesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont été obligés de battre en retraite.
target_text: Walilazimika kurudia.
target_text_raw: Walilazimika kurudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ne jouait pas aux cartes, parce qu'elle n'aimait pas ça.
target_text: Hakucheza karata kwa sababu hakupenda iyi mchezo.
target_text_raw: Hakucheza karata kwa sababu hakupenda iyi mchezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux jouer aux cartes.
target_text: Nataka kucheza karata.
target_text_raw: Nataka kucheza karata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils étaient assis autour de la table, jouant aux cartes.
target_text: Balikuwa nacheza karata ku meza.
target_text_raw: Balikuwa nacheza karata ku meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque j'étais à l'école, les enfants gauchers étaient forcés d'écrire de la main droite.
target_text: Nilipokuwa ku masomo, batoto benye kutumia mukono ya kushoto balikuwa nalazimishwa kuandika na mikono ya kuume.
target_text_raw: Nilipokuwa ku masomo, batoto benye kutumia mukono ya kushoto balikuwa nalazimishwa kuandika na mikono ya kuume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a forcé à y aller.
target_text: Alinilazimisha niende kule.
target_text_raw: Alinilazimisha niende kule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas pu résister à la pression qu'ils ont exercée sur moi.
target_text: Sikuweza kuziwiya mashurti zenye walinitilia.
target_text_raw: Sikuweza kuziwiya mashurti zenye walinitilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux de nouvelles cartes de visite.
target_text: Nataka cartes de visite mupya .
target_text_raw: Nataka cartes de visite mupya .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été contraint de démissionner.
target_text: Nililazimishwa kujiuzulu.
target_text_raw: Nililazimishwa kujiuzulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut quinze minutes pour marcher d'ici jusqu'au campus.
target_text: Inakamata dakika kumi na tano kutoka hapa kwenda chuo kikuu.
target_text_raw: Inakamata dakika kumi na tano kutoka hapa kwenda chuo kikuu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle le força à manger ses légumes.
target_text: Alimulazimisha kukula mboga zake.
target_text_raw: Alimulazimisha kukula mboga zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai forcé à porter la mallette.
target_text: Nilimlazimisha kubeba sakoshi.
target_text_raw: Nilimlazimisha kubeba sakoshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été forcée à le faire.
target_text: Nililazimishwa kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Nililazimishwa kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a été finalement forcé de démissionner.
target_text: Alilazimika kujiuzulu.
target_text_raw: Alilazimika kujiuzulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a distribué les cartes.
target_text: Tom aligabula karata.
target_text_raw: Tom aligabula karata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et Mary jouent souvent aux cartes ensemble.
target_text: Tom na Mary banazoweya cheza karata pamoja.
target_text_raw: Tom na Mary banazoweya cheza karata pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vide ton sac.
target_text: Tonya kila kitu mu sac yako.
target_text_raw: Tonya kila kitu mu sac yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom se força à parler.
target_text: Tom alijikaza kuongea.
target_text_raw: Tom alijikaza kuongea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolé de t'avoir forcé à faire ça.
target_text: Utanisamehe kwa kukulazimisha kufanya hivi.
target_text_raw: Utanisamehe kwa kukulazimisha kufanya hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous déjà écrit toutes les cartes de Nouvel An ?
target_text: Je! Ulishawahi kuandika kadi zote za Mwaka Mpya?
target_text_raw: Je! Ulishawahi kuandika kadi zote za Mwaka Mpya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils sont heureux, parce qu'ils voient les oiseaux dans l'arbre près de la fenêtre.
target_text: Wanafurahi juu wanaona ndege kwenye mti karibu na dirisha.
target_text_raw: Wanafurahi juu wanaona ndege kwenye mti karibu na dirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les oiseaux ne peuvent pas voler.
target_text: Siyo ndege zote njo zinaweza ruka.
target_text_raw: Siyo ndege zote njo zinaweza ruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tous les oiseaux peuvent voler ?
target_text: Je! Ndege zote zinaweza ruka?
target_text_raw: Je! Ndege zote zinaweza ruka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux chantaient.
target_text: Ndege zlikuwa naimba.
target_text_raw: Ndege zlikuwa naimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux chantent.
target_text: Ndege zinaimba.
target_text_raw: Ndege zinaimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Je voudrais bien jouer aux cartes. » - « Moi aussi. »
target_text: "Ningependa kucheza karata. " - " Miye pia. »
target_text_raw: "Ningependa kucheza karata. " - " Miye pia. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plupart des oiseaux ont deux pattes et deux ailes.
target_text: Ndege mingi zinakuwaka na migulu mbili na mabawa mbili.
target_text_raw: Ndege mingi zinakuwaka na migulu mbili na mabawa mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Distribuez les cartes, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Gabula karata, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Gabula karata, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux chantent dans les arbres.
target_text: Ndege ziko naimba ku miti.
target_text_raw: Ndege ziko naimba ku miti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aime jouer aux cartes.
target_text: Anapenda kucheza karata.
target_text_raw: Anapenda kucheza karata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regarde les oiseaux sauvages.
target_text: Niko naangalia ndege za mu pori.
target_text_raw: Niko naangalia ndege za mu pori.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce sont des oiseaux.
target_text: Ni ndege.
target_text_raw: Ni ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La forêt est pleine d'animaux en tout genre.
target_text: Pori inayala manyama za kila aina.
target_text_raw: Pori inayala manyama za kila aina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime observer les oiseaux.
target_text: Napenda kuangalia ndege.
target_text_raw: Napenda kuangalia ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons passé un moment agréable en jouant aux cartes.
target_text: Tulipitisha wakati muzuri tukicheza kadi.
target_text_raw: Tulipitisha wakati muzuri tukicheza kadi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regarde les oiseaux.
target_text: Niko naangalia ndege.
target_text_raw: Niko naangalia ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a beaucoup d'oiseaux dans ce parc.
target_text: Piko ndege mengi kwenye ndani ya iyi parc.
target_text_raw: Piko ndege mengi kwenye ndani ya iyi parc.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux chantèrent comme seuls les oiseaux le peuvent par un matin clair de printemps.
target_text: Ndege ziliimba kama gisi ndege zopeke zinaweza asubuhi safi wakati ya printemps.
target_text_raw: Ndege ziliimba kama gisi ndege zopeke zinaweza asubuhi safi wakati ya printemps.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette petite fille a fait s'enfuir l'oiseau.
target_text: Huyu binti mudogo alishitula ndege na zikakimbia.
target_text_raw: Huyu binti mudogo alishitula ndege na zikakimbia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des oiseaux chantent tout autour du parc.
target_text: Ndege zinaimba ngambo zote za parc.
target_text_raw: Ndege zinaimba ngambo zote za parc.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux se réveillent d'habitude tôt le matin.
target_text: Kawaida ndege zinalamukaka asubui sana.
target_text_raw: Kawaida ndege zinalamukaka asubui sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Heureux au jeu, malheureux en amour.
target_text: Mwenye furaha kwenye mchezo, mwenye uzuni kwenye mapenzi.
target_text_raw: Mwenye furaha kwenye mchezo, mwenye uzuni kwenye mapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Imaginez juste que l'on puisse voler comme des oiseaux.
target_text: Fikiria tu kama tungekuwa naruka kama ndege.
target_text_raw: Fikiria tu kama tungekuwa naruka kama ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps de me rendre compte, je ne pouvais plus voir les oiseaux.
target_text: Wakati nilijuwa, sikuweza tena kuona ndege.
target_text_raw: Wakati nilijuwa, sikuweza tena kuona ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Observer les oiseaux sauvages est vraiment intéressant.
target_text: Kuangalia ndege za mu pori inavutia sana.
target_text_raw: Kuangalia ndege za mu pori inavutia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux s'envolèrent à cause du bruit.
target_text: Ndege ziliruka kwa sababu ya fujo.
target_text_raw: Ndege ziliruka kwa sababu ya fujo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu beaucoup d'oiseaux hier matin.
target_text: Niliona ndege mingi jana asubuhi.
target_text_raw: Niliona ndege mingi jana asubuhi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'aigle est le roi des oiseaux.
target_text: Aigle ni mufalme wa ndege.
target_text_raw: Aigle ni mufalme wa ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce peuple n'aime pas les oiseaux.
target_text: Aba batu habapendaki ndege.
target_text_raw: Aba batu habapendaki ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les arbres étaient emplis d'oiseaux.
target_text: Miti ilikuwa nayala ndege.
target_text_raw: Miti ilikuwa nayala ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux volent au moyen de leurs ailes.
target_text: Ndege zinarukaka kwa kutumia mabawa yazo.
target_text_raw: Ndege zinarukaka kwa kutumia mabawa yazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux pondent des œufs.
target_text: Ndege zinataga mayayi.
target_text_raw: Ndege zinataga mayayi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu un groupe d'oiseaux s'envoler.
target_text: Niliona kundi ya ma ndege zikiruka.
target_text_raw: Niliona kundi ya ma ndege zikiruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les hommes, les chiens, les poissons et les oiseaux sont tous des animaux.
target_text: Watu, imbwa, samaki na ndege wote ni manyama.
target_text_raw: Watu, imbwa, samaki na ndege wote ni manyama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vit des oiseaux, des fleurs et des feuilles, tous de vives couleurs.
target_text: Aliona ndege, maua na mayani zenye kuwa rangi ya kuangara.
target_text_raw: Aliona ndege, maua na mayani zenye kuwa rangi ya kuangara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux chantent çà et là dans le parc.
target_text: Ndege zinaimba hapa na pale ndani ya bustani.
target_text_raw: Ndege zinaimba hapa na pale ndani ya bustani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as attrapé trois oiseaux.
target_text: Ulikamata ndege tatu.
target_text_raw: Ulikamata ndege tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Certaines espèces d'oiseaux ne peuvent pas voler.
target_text: Piko aina ya ndege zenye haziwezi ruka.
target_text_raw: Piko aina ya ndege zenye haziwezi ruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous vu des oiseaux?
target_text: Uliona ndege?
target_text_raw: Uliona ndege?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant, calme-toi.
target_text: Sasa, tulia.
target_text_raw: Sasa, tulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a des dettes de jeu.
target_text: Tom iko na deni za mchezo.
target_text_raw: Tom iko na deni za mchezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Eric est dans notre équipe de football.
target_text: Eric iko mu timu yetu ya mpira wa miguu.
target_text_raw: Eric iko mu timu yetu ya mpira wa miguu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces ordinateurs sont de types différents.
target_text: Hizi ordinateurs ni za aina tafauti.
target_text_raw: Hizi ordinateurs ni za aina tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est russe de naissance.
target_text: Yeye ni Mrusi wa kizalikilio.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni Mrusi wa kizalikilio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez patienter dans la salle d'attente jusqu'à ce que les résultats de l'inspection soient prêts.
target_text: Tafazali subiri kwenye chumba cha kusubiri mpaka saa matokeo ya ukaguzi itakuwa tayari.
target_text_raw: Tafazali subiri kwenye chumba cha kusubiri mpaka saa matokeo ya ukaguzi itakuwa tayari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les paysans se plaignent toujours du temps.
target_text: Kila wakati wakulima wanalalamika juu ya hali ya hewa.
target_text_raw: Kila wakati wakulima wanalalamika juu ya hali ya hewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est aveugle depuis la naissance.
target_text: Ni kipofu tangu azaliwe.
target_text_raw: Ni kipofu tangu azaliwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est Allemand de naissance.
target_text: Yeye ni Mjerumani wa kizalikio.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni Mjerumani wa kizalikio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi tu n'es pas venu samedi ?
