notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai la mienne alors va te faire foutre.
target_text: Niko na yangu sasa wende fanya chenye unataka.
target_text_raw: Niko na yangu sasa wende fanya chenye unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous organisons une fête samedi prochain.
target_text: Tunaandaa sherehe siku ya posho ijayo.
target_text_raw: Tunaandaa sherehe siku ya posho ijayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui c'est samedi, le vingt et un octobre.
target_text: Leo ni siku ya posho, tarehe kumi na moya mwezi wa kumi.
target_text_raw: Leo ni siku ya posho, tarehe kumi na moya mwezi wa kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime la soupe aigre-douce.
target_text: Napenda supu tamu.
target_text_raw: Napenda supu tamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'a pas cessé de pleuvoir depuis samedi.
target_text: Mvula inanyesha tangu siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Mvula inanyesha tangu siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a joué aux cartes hier soir.
target_text: Tulicheza karata jana mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Tulicheza karata jana mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demain, c'est samedi.
target_text: Kesho ni siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Kesho ni siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous jouions au tennis tous les samedis après les cours.
target_text: Tunachezaka tennis kila siku ya posho baada ya masomo.
target_text_raw: Tunachezaka tennis kila siku ya posho baada ya masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le fous pas en l'air !
target_text: Usi muzungurushe!
target_text_raw: Usi muzungurushe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je foire, quel est le pire qui puisse advenir ?
target_text: Nikishindwa, nini ya mubaya zaidi inaweza tokea?
target_text_raw: Nikishindwa, nini ya mubaya zaidi inaweza tokea?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La dose fait le poison.
target_text: Kiwango kinafanyaka kuwa sumu.
target_text_raw: Kiwango kinafanyaka kuwa sumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On se mettra d'accord.
target_text: Tutaelewana.
target_text_raw: Tutaelewana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom joue aux cartes avec Marie.
target_text: Tom anacheza karata na Maria.
target_text_raw: Tom anacheza karata na Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux me résoudre à cette vie ennuyeuse.
target_text: Siwezi ishi kwenye iyi maisha ya kuchosha.
target_text_raw: Siwezi ishi kwenye iyi maisha ya kuchosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu réglé la note ?
target_text: Ulisha lipa ile facture?
target_text_raw: Ulisha lipa ile facture?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jouons aux cartes plutôt que d'écouter la télévision.
target_text: Tucheze karata kuliko kusikiliza télévision.
target_text_raw: Tucheze karata kuliko kusikiliza télévision.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a été poignardé à mort par quelqu'un dans le métro.
target_text: Tom alichomekwa na mutu kwenye metro na akakufa.
target_text_raw: Tom alichomekwa na mutu kwenye metro na akakufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il n'y a probablement pas une personne dans ce pays qui n'ait pas vissé de vis.
target_text: Nazani pengine hakuna mtu mwa iyi nchi mwenye hayawahi kufunga visi.
target_text_raw: Nazani pengine hakuna mtu mwa iyi nchi mwenye hayawahi kufunga visi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne fiche rien en l'air.
target_text: Hasumbuwake watu.
target_text_raw: Hasumbuwake watu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai oublié d'envoyer des cartes postales du nouvel an à mes amis.
target_text: Nilisahau kutuma kadi za posta za Mwaka Mpya kwa marafiki zangu.
target_text_raw: Nilisahau kutuma kadi za posta za Mwaka Mpya kwa marafiki zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il manque une vis.
target_text: Kunakosa visi moya.
target_text_raw: Kunakosa visi moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien à foutre des règles ; j'ai du fric !
target_text: Sijali sheria, niko na pesa!
target_text_raw: Sijali sheria, niko na pesa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne m'arnaque pas !
target_text: Usiniibe!
target_text_raw: Usiniibe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un chat apparut de derrière le rideau.
target_text: Pusi alitokea nyuma ya rido.
target_text_raw: Pusi alitokea nyuma ya rido.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le franc-tireur abattait ses victimes une par une.
target_text: Franc-tireur alikuwaka naua wahanga wake kwa lisasi umoya baada ya mwingine.
target_text_raw: Franc-tireur alikuwaka naua wahanga wake kwa lisasi umoya baada ya mwingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque membre de la famille est à la maison le samedi matin.
target_text: Kila mwanamemba wa familia iko ku nyumba kila siku ya posho asubui.
target_text_raw: Kila mwanamemba wa familia iko ku nyumba kila siku ya posho asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu allé à la fête de Tom samedi dernier ?
target_text: Ulienda ku sikukuu ya Tom siku ya posho iliyopita?
target_text_raw: Ulienda ku sikukuu ya Tom siku ya posho iliyopita?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sors avec Mary presque tous les samedis.
target_text: Natokaka na Maria kila siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Natokaka na Maria kila siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est sorti avec sa petite amie samedi soir.
target_text: Tom alitoka na mupenzi wake siku ya sposho mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Tom alitoka na mupenzi wake siku ya sposho mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle donna naissance à un garçon.
target_text: Alizalaka mutoto mwanaume.
target_text_raw: Alizalaka mutoto mwanaume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'y es samedi ?
target_text: Utakua siku ya posho?
target_text_raw: Utakua siku ya posho?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Même si tout va bien, nous ne pouvons finir avant samedi.
target_text: Hata kama mambo yote ni sawa, hatuwezi maliza siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Hata kama mambo yote ni sawa, hatuwezi maliza siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne pouvais-tu pas venir samedi ?
target_text: Juu ya nini haungeweza kuya siku ya posho?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini haungeweza kuya siku ya posho?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est française de naissance.
target_text: Yeye ni Mfaransa wa kizalikio.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni Mfaransa wa kizalikio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle accouchera bientôt.
target_text: Atazala mu siku zenye zinakuya.
target_text_raw: Atazala mu siku zenye zinakuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais à l'école le samedi.
target_text: Naendaka ku masomo siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Naendaka ku masomo siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne va pas au bureau le samedi.
target_text: Haendaki ku kazi siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Haendaki ku kazi siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a mis au monde un bébé bien portant.
target_text: Alizala mutoto mwenye afya nzuri kabisa.
target_text_raw: Alizala mutoto mwenye afya nzuri kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le samedi est son jour de liberté.
target_text: Siku ya posho njo siku anakuwaka huru.
target_text_raw: Siku ya posho njo siku anakuwaka huru.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lundi elle a accouché de son premier fils.
target_text: Alizala mutoto wake wa kwanza siku ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Alizala mutoto wake wa kwanza siku ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle passe tous ses samedis soirs à jouer au tennis.
target_text: Kila siku ya posho mangaribi anachezaka tennis.
target_text_raw: Kila siku ya posho mangaribi anachezaka tennis.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a aucun rendez-vous amoureux pour samedi soir.
target_text: Tom hana rendez-vous yoyote ya kimapenzi siku ya posho mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Tom hana rendez-vous yoyote ya kimapenzi siku ya posho mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je joue de la guitare dans un groupe, tous les samedis soir.
target_text: Nachezaka kitari ndani ya kundi kila siku ya posho mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Nachezaka kitari ndani ya kundi kila siku ya posho mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après le samedi vient le dimanche.
target_text: Kisha siku ya posho ni siku ya Mungu.
target_text_raw: Kisha siku ya posho ni siku ya Mungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais à la fête samedi soir.
target_text: Naenda ku sikukuu siku ya posho mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Naenda ku sikukuu siku ya posho mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle va avoir un bébé le mois prochain.
target_text: Atapata mutoto mwezi ujao.
target_text_raw: Atapata mutoto mwezi ujao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle heure vas-tu te coucher, le samedi soir ?
target_text: Siku ya posho utalala saa ngapi?
target_text_raw: Siku ya posho utalala saa ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous jouons au football chaque samedi.
target_text: Kila siku ya posho tunachezaka mpira.
target_text_raw: Kila siku ya posho tunachezaka mpira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je travaille du lundi au samedi.
target_text: Natumikaka kutoka siku ya kwanza mpaka siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Natumikaka kutoka siku ya kwanza mpaka siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens tous les jours sauf le samedi et le dimanche.
target_text: Nakuyaka kila siku kutosha tu siku ya posho na siku ya Mungu.
target_text_raw: Nakuyaka kila siku kutosha tu siku ya posho na siku ya Mungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’ai oublié qu’on était samedi, aujourd’hui.
target_text: Nilisahabu kama leo ni siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Nilisahabu kama leo ni siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allé au parc samedi dernier.
target_text: Nilienda kwenye bustani siku ya posho iliyopita.
target_text_raw: Nilienda kwenye bustani siku ya posho iliyopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La mort est-elle la seule délivrance ?
target_text: Je! Kifo ndio ukombozi pekee?
target_text_raw: Je! Kifo ndio ukombozi pekee?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui, c'est samedi, et demain, ce sera dimanche.
target_text: Leo ni siku ya posho, na kesho ni siku ya Mungu.
target_text_raw: Leo ni siku ya posho, na kesho ni siku ya Mungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Et si on allait au cinéma samedi ? » « Oui, j'aimerais bien. »
target_text: « Na kama tunaenda ku sinema siku ya posho? » « Ndio, ningefurahia sana. »
target_text_raw: « Na kama tunaenda ku sinema siku ya posho? » « Ndio, ningefurahia sana. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier c'était dimanche, pas samedi.
target_text: Jana ilikua siku ya Mungu, hapana siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Jana ilikua siku ya Mungu, hapana siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avions l'habitude d'aller au cinéma le samedi soir.
target_text: Tunazoweyaka enda ku sinema siku ya posho mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Tunazoweyaka enda ku sinema siku ya posho mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai passé mon samedi après-midi à regarder la télévision.
target_text: Nilipitisha siku yangu ya posho niko naangalia télévision.
target_text_raw: Nilipitisha siku yangu ya posho niko naangalia télévision.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nettoyons entièrement le bureau samedi prochain.
target_text: Tusafishe ofisi yote siku ya posho ijayo.
target_text_raw: Tusafishe ofisi yote siku ya posho ijayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et si on jouait au tennis samedi prochain ?
target_text: Na kama tunacheza tennis siku ya posho ijayo?
target_text_raw: Na kama tunacheza tennis siku ya posho ijayo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Samedi, Tom donne une fête dans son jardin.
target_text: Siku ya posho, Tom anaandaka sherehe ndani ya bustani yake.
target_text_raw: Siku ya posho, Tom anaandaka sherehe ndani ya bustani yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous jouons toujours au tennis le samedi matin.
target_text: Tunachezaka tenisi kila siku ya posho asubuhi.
target_text_raw: Tunachezaka tenisi kila siku ya posho asubuhi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais incapable de quitter la maison samedi dernier, ma mère étant malade.
target_text: Sikuweza kutoka nyumbani siku ya posho iliyopita sababu mama yangu alikuwa mgonjwa.
target_text_raw: Sikuweza kutoka nyumbani siku ya posho iliyopita sababu mama yangu alikuwa mgonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne lâche pas le chien.
target_text: Usiachilie imbwa.
target_text_raw: Usiachilie imbwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laissez-le partir !
target_text: Iache iende!
target_text_raw: Iache iende!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ici depuis samedi.
target_text: Niko hapa tangu siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Niko hapa tangu siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'a pas besoin d'aller à l'école le samedi.
target_text: Hana haja yakwenda ku masomo siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Hana haja yakwenda ku masomo siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle peut vous prendre un rendez-vous pour samedi.
target_text: Anaweza kukuandalia mukutano siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Anaweza kukuandalia mukutano siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais te laisser partir.

target_text_raw: Nitakuacha uende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Libérez Tom.
target_text: Achilia Tom.
target_text_raw: Achilia Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Relâche-le !
target_text: Mwachilie!
target_text_raw: Mwachilie!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allons faire une fête samedi soir.
target_text: Tutakua na siku kuu siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Tutakua na siku kuu siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te libèrerai.
target_text: Nitakuachilia.
target_text_raw: Nitakuachilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voudrais prendre cette cravate marron.
target_text: Ningependa kukamata iyi cravate ya rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kukamata iyi cravate ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle coupa tous ses longs et beaux cheveux bruns et s'habilla avec des vêtements de garçon.
target_text: Alikata nywele zake zote za muzuri na murefu na akavala nguo za vijana wanaume.
target_text_raw: Alikata nywele zake zote za muzuri na murefu na akavala nguo za vijana wanaume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mr Brown est notre professeur d'anglais.
target_text: Bwana Brown njo mwalimu wetu wa kingereza.
target_text_raw: Bwana Brown njo mwalimu wetu wa kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a de beaux yeux marron.

target_text_raw: Maria iko na macho mazuri ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le pain est brun.
target_text: Mukate iko na rangi ya brun.
target_text_raw: Mukate iko na rangi ya brun.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma bicyclette a un pneu à plat.
target_text: Kinga yangu iko na pneu ya kuharibika.
target_text_raw: Kinga yangu iko na pneu (piné) ya kuharibika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le temps, les gens croyaient que le monde était plat.
target_text: Hapo zamani, watu walifikiri ulimwengu ulikuwa plat.
target_text_raw: Hapo zamani, watu walifikiri ulimwengu ulikuwa plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses chaussures sont marron.
target_text: Biato yake ni ya rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Biato yake ni ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est l'appartement de Tom.
target_text: Iyi ni nyumba ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Iyi ni nyumba ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Terre est plate.
target_text: Dunia iko plat.
target_text_raw: Dunia iko plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie est monotone dans un petit village.

target_text_raw: Maisha inafanana ndani ya kijiji kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses cheveux étaient bruns.

target_text_raw: Nywele zake zilikuwa na rangi ya brun.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet enfant pense que la Terre est plate.
target_text: Huyu mutoto anazani kama dunia iko plat.
target_text_raw: Huyu mutoto anazani kama dunia iko plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je parler à Mlle Brown ?
target_text: Naweza ongea na dada Brown?
target_text_raw: Naweza ongea na dada Brown?

source_text: Elle portait des chaussures brun foncé.
target_text: Alikuwa navala biato ya rangi ya brun foncé.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa navala biato ya rangi ya brun foncé.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu le garçon en chaussures marron.
target_text: Niliona uule kijana anavala biato ya marron.
target_text_raw: Niliona uule kijana anavala biato ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont la peau marron et les cheveux noirs.
target_text: Biko na ngozi ya marron na nywele nyeusi.
target_text_raw: Biko na ngozi ya marron na nywele nyeusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous ai prise pour Mme Brun.
target_text: Nilizani kama weye ni Bibi Brun.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama weye ni Bibi Brun.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chien est brun, petit et mince.
target_text: Imbwa iko na rangi ya brun, na ni ya kidogo na mwembamba.
target_text_raw: Imbwa iko na rangi ya brun, na ni ya kidogo na mwembamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela va requérir un énorme investissement en temps et en argent.

target_text_raw: Iyi itahitaji uwekezaji mkubwa wa wakati na pesa.

source_text: Marie a de grands yeux marron.

target_text_raw: Maria iko na macho ya mkubwa ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que M. Brown est médecin ?
target_text: Je, Bwana Brown ni muganga?
target_text_raw: Je, Bwana Brown ni muganga?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai juste proposé une nouvelle version.
target_text: Nilipendekeza tu version mupya.
target_text_raw: Nilipendekeza tu version mupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas aussi jeune que Mademoiselle Brown.
target_text: Miye siko mdogo sana kuliko dada Brown.
target_text_raw: Miye siko mdogo sana kuliko dada Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est précis en calcul.
target_text: Tom akoseaki kwenye mambo ya hesabu.
target_text_raw: Tom akoseaki kwenye mambo ya hesabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce chat est brun.
target_text: Iyi pusi iko na rangi ya brun.
target_text_raw: Iyi pusi iko na rangi ya brun.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que par hasard tu connais le professeur Brown ?
target_text: Unaweza kuwa unamufahamia Mwalimu Brown?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuwa unamufahamia Mwalimu Brown?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est cette femme qui porte un manteau brun ?
target_text: Huyu mwanamuke mwenye anavala kanzu ya marron ni nani ?
target_text_raw: Huyu mwanamuke mwenye anavala kanzu ya marron ni nani ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la lettre écrite par M. Brown.
target_text: Ni barua yenye imeandikwa na bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Ni barua yenye imeandikwa na bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai entendu John parler à M. Brown.
target_text: Nilisikia John anaongea na bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia John anaongea na bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai les cheveux châtains.
target_text: Niko na nywele ya rangi ya brun ya kuangara.
target_text_raw: Niko na nywele ya rangi ya brun ya kuangara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon appartement est au troisième étage.
target_text: Nyumba yangu iko ku gorofa ya tatu.
target_text_raw: Nyumba yangu iko ku gorofa ya tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses cheveux sont châtains.
target_text: Nywele zake ni za rangi ya brun ya kuangara.
target_text_raw: Nywele zake ni za rangi ya brun ya kuangara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Permettez-moi de vous présenter M. Brown.
target_text: Niruhusu nikutambulishe bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Niruhusu nikutambulishe bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Autrefois, on pensait que la Terre était plate.
target_text: Ile wakati, tuliwaza kama dunia ilikua iko plat.
target_text_raw: Ile wakati, tuliwaza kama dunia ilikua iko plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le sommet de la colline est plat.
target_text: Chongo ya kilima iko plat.
target_text_raw: Chongo ya kilima iko plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux avoir l'estomac plat.
target_text: Ninataka kuwa na tumbu ya plat.
target_text_raw: Ninataka kuwa na tumbu ya plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le passé, on pensait que la Terre était un disque.
target_text: Hapo zamani, inazaniwaka kuwa dunia ilikuwa disque.
target_text_raw: Hapo zamani, inazaniwaka kuwa dunia ilikuwa disque.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chat est marron.
target_text: Pusi iko na rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Pusi iko na rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai crevé un pneu.
target_text: Nilitobola pneu.
target_text_raw: Nilitobola pneu (piné).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Monsieur Braun m'a donné votre nom.
target_text: Bwana Braun alinipa jina yako.
target_text_raw: Bwana Braun alinipa jina yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment est ton nouvel appartement ?
target_text: Nyumba yako mupya iko namna gani?
target_text_raw: Nyumba yako mupya iko namna gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que la Terre n'est pas plate.
target_text: Najua kama dunia haiko plat.
target_text_raw: Najua kama dunia haiko plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est tombé à plat sur le sol.
target_text: Tom aliangukia tumbu.
target_text_raw: Tom aliangukia tumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en préférerais un marron.
target_text: Ningependelea ya rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Ningependelea ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vit tout seul dans son appartement.
target_text: Anaishi yepeke mu nyumba yake.
target_text_raw: Anaishi yepeke mu nyumba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vit dans un appartement.
target_text: Anaishi ndani ya nyumba.
target_text_raw: Anaishi ndani ya nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regarde ce chat. C'est celui de M.Brown.
target_text: Angalia iyi pusi. Ni ile ya bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Angalia iyi pusi. Ni ile ya bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été terrassé par un terrible rhume durant une semaine.
target_text: Nilipigwa na mafua kali juma iliopita.
target_text_raw: Nilipigwa na mafua kali juma iliopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton pneu est crevé.
target_text: Pneu yako inatoboka.
target_text_raw: Pneu (piné) yako inatoboka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bureau de poste est ce bâtiment marron.
target_text: Ofisi ya posta ni iyi nyumba ya rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Ofisi ya posta ni iyi nyumba ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu me faire une petite faveur ?
target_text: Unaweza nisaidia kidogo?
target_text_raw: Unaweza nisaidia kidogo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom vit dans une toute petite maison.
target_text: Tom anaishi mu kanyumba kadogo.
target_text_raw: Tom anaishi mu kanyumba kadogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma maison est minuscule.
target_text: Nyumba yangu ni ya kidogo sana.
target_text_raw: Nyumba yangu ni ya kidogo sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La chambre de Tom est petite.
target_text: Chumba ya Tom ni ya kidogo.
target_text_raw: Chumba ya Tom ni ya kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous disposons juste d'un minuscule bout de jardin.
target_text: Tuko na ka bustani kadogo sana.
target_text_raw: Tuko na ka bustani kadogo sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cinquante familles vivent dans ce petit village.
target_text: Familia makumi tano zinaishi mwa iyi kijiji ndogo.
target_text_raw: Familia makumi tano zinaishi mwa iyi kijiji ndogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a les cheveux bruns.
target_text: Tom iko na nywele za marron.
target_text_raw: Tom iko na nywele za marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un petit pays dont la plupart des gens n'ont jamais entendu parler.
target_text: Nika inchi kadogo kenye batu bengi habayawayi sikia banakaongelea.
target_text_raw: Nika inchi kadogo kenye batu bengi habayawayi sikia banakaongelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce chapeau marron est vieux.
target_text: Iyi kofia ya rangi ya marron inazeeka.
target_text_raw: Iyi kofia ya rangi ya marron inazeeka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un certain M. Brown est passé vous voir en votre absence.
target_text: Bwana anaye itwa Brown alipita kukuona saa ulikuwa hauko.
target_text_raw: Bwana anaye itwa Brown alipita kukuona saa ulikuwa hauko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous faut nous focaliser.
target_text: Lazima tuzingatie.
target_text_raw: Lazima tuzingatie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Concentre-toi !
target_text: Jikaze!
target_text_raw: Jikaze!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On m'a dit que j'étais un cochon.
target_text: Waliniambia kama niko nguruwe.
target_text_raw: Waliniambia kama niko nguruwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom portait un manteau marron.
target_text: Tom alikuwa anavala kanzu ya rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Tom alikuwa anavala kanzu ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce chapeau est bien assorti aux vêtements marron.
target_text: Iyi kofia inapendeza ku nguo za rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Iyi kofia inapendeza ku nguo za rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan a accepté un poste à un cabinet d'avocats respectable.
target_text: Dan alikubali kazi ku kampuni ya sheria yenye kueshimia sana.
target_text_raw: Dan alikubali kazi ku kampuni ya sheria yenye kueshimia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous vu un portefeuille marron dans les alentours ?
target_text: Uliona portefeuille ya rangi ya marron hapa karibu karibu?
target_text_raw: Uliona portefeuille ya rangi ya marron hapa karibu karibu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bureau de poste est le bâtiment marron.
target_text: Ofisi ya posta ni nyumba ya rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Ofisi ya posta ni nyumba ya rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a de petits pieds.
target_text: Iko na migulu ya kidogo.
target_text_raw: Iko na migulu ya kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce chat est marron.
target_text: Iyi pusi iko na rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Iyi pusi iko na rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis encore en train de faire cuire le riz brun.
target_text: Ningali napiga muchele ya marron.
target_text_raw: Ningali napiga muchele ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mary a déjà vingt-cinq ans, mais elle a une voix fluette.
target_text: Mary alisha eneza miaka makumi mbili na tano, alakini iko na kasauti kakidogo sana.
target_text_raw: Mary alisha eneza miaka makumi mbili na tano, alakini iko na kasauti kakidogo sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a arrêté la course à pied pour se concentrer sur le saut en longueur.
target_text: Aliacha mchezo ya kukimbia juu azingatie kufanya mchezo ya kuruka mu burefu.
target_text_raw: Aliacha mchezo ya kukimbia juu azingatie kufanya mchezo ya kuruka mu burefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le brun n'est pas sa couleur de cheveux naturelle.
target_text: Nywele yake halisi hazina rangi ya marron.
target_text_raw: Nywele yake halisi hazina rangi ya marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La photo de la tour était floutée.
target_text: Picha ya mnara haikuwa naonekana muzuri.
target_text_raw: Picha ya mnara haikuwa naonekana muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons nous concentrer.
target_text: Lazima tuzingatie.
target_text_raw: Lazima tuzingatie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il vous plaît penser à l'environnement - Avez-vous vraiment besoin d'imprimer ce courriel?
target_text: Tafazali fikiria juu ya mazingira - unahitaji kweli kuchapisha iyi barua pepe?
target_text_raw: Tafazali fikiria juu ya mazingira - unahitaji kweli kuchapisha iyi barua pepe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu te concentres sur ici et maintenant.
target_text: Nataka uzingatie hapa na sasa.
target_text_raw: Nataka uzingatie hapa na sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut me concentrer.
target_text: Lazima nizingatie.
target_text_raw: Lazima nizingatie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: M. Brown cherche ses lunettes.
target_text: Bwana Brown anatafuta lunette yake.
target_text_raw: Bwana Brown anatafuta lunette yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai besoin que tu te concentres et que tu m'écoutes.
target_text: Nahitaji uzingatie na unisikilize.
target_text_raw: Nahitaji uzingatie na unisikilize.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à me concentrer sur deux choses à la fois.
target_text: Sifikie kufanya mambo mbili ku limoya.
target_text_raw: Sifikie kufanya mambo mbili ku limoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Préférez-vous le riz blanc ou le riz brun ?
target_text: Unapendelea mchele mweupe au mchele wa rangi ya kufifia?
target_text_raw: Unapendelea mchele mweupe au mchele wa rangi ya kufifia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Concentre-toi.
target_text: Zingatia!
target_text_raw: Zingatia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma couleur préférée est le marron.
target_text: Rangi ninayopenda zaidi ni marron.
target_text_raw: Rangi ninayopenda zaidi ni marron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme que tu as rencontré hier était Monsieur Brown.
target_text: Mutu mwenye ulikutana naye jana alikua bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Mutu mwenye ulikutana naye jana alikua bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que je préfère manger du riz blanc que du riz complet.
target_text: Minazani kama napendelea kula wali ya mweupe kuliko wali ya kuenea.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama napendelea kula wali ya mweupe kuliko wali ya kuenea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a un petit chien marron sous cette table.
target_text: Piko ka imbwa ka rangi ya marron chini ya iyi meza.
target_text_raw: Piko ka imbwa ka rangi ya marron chini ya iyi meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle est la chose dans laquelle vous avez investi le plus d’énergie quand vous étiez étudiant ?
target_text: Ni jambo gani njo uliwekeza zaidi wakati ulikuwa mwanafunzi?
target_text_raw: Ni jambo gani njo uliwekeza zaidi wakati ulikuwa mwanafunzi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est en bons termes avec M. Brown.
target_text: Iko na uhusiano muzuri na bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Iko na uhusiano muzuri na bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux me concentrer sur ça.
target_text: Nataka zingatia iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Nataka zingatia iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Concentrons-nous là-dessus.
target_text: Tuzingatie iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Tuzingatie iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux me concentrer sur l'avenir.
target_text: Nataka zingatia ku maisha ya kesho.
target_text_raw: Nataka zingatia ku maisha ya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois vraiment me concentrer sur ceci.
target_text: Napashwa zingatia iyi jambo kabisa.
target_text_raw: Napashwa zingatia iyi jambo kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Y a-t-il un endroit dans les environs qui répare un pneu à plat ?
target_text: Piko fasi ya karibu kwenye wanatangenezaka pneu ya kupasuka?
target_text_raw: Piko fasi ya karibu kwenye wanatangenezaka pneu ya kupasuka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme que tu as vu ici hier était M. Brown.
target_text: Mutu mwenye uliona hapa jana alikua bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Mutu mwenye uliona hapa jana alikua bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais être votre correspondant.
target_text: Ningependa nikuye mtu mwenye ndakuwa nawasiliana na weye kwa mbali.
target_text_raw: Ningependa nikuye mtu mwenye ndakuwa nawasiliana na weye kwa mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je rendrai visite à Monsieur Brown demain.
target_text: Kesho nitamtembelea Bwana Brown.
target_text_raw: Kesho nitamtembelea Bwana Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit qu'il y a des Anglais qui aiment le style japonais de chambres.
target_text: Inasemekana kuwa piko Wangereza wenye wanapenda majengeo ya vyumba vya Kijapani.
target_text_raw: Inasemekana kuwa piko Wangereza wenye wanapenda majengeo ya vyumba vya Kijapani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La grande femme écoute le cheval brun.
target_text: Mwanamke mrefu anasikiliza farasi ya rangi ya kufifia.
target_text_raw: Mwanamke mrefu anasikiliza farasi ya rangi ya kufifia (brun).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'apporterai mon repas cette semaine.
target_text: Nitaleta chakuna yangu iyi juma.
target_text_raw: Nitaleta chakuna yangu iyi juma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le gouvernement anglais est contre ce projet.
target_text: Serikali ya Uingereza inapinga iyi mradi.
target_text_raw: Serikali ya Uingereza inapinga iyi mradi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis britannique.
target_text: Miye ni Muwingereza.
target_text_raw: Miye ni Muwingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous nous déposer au British Museum?
target_text: Unaweza kutuacha kwenye Jumba la kumbukumbu ya Uwingereza?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kutuacha kwenye Jumba la kumbukumbu (musée) ya Uwingereza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis malade en déplacement.
target_text: Niko mugonjwa mwenye kupita tu.
target_text_raw: Niko mugonjwa mwenye kupita tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un correspondant en Australie.
target_text: Niko na mtu tunaye wasiliana naye huko Australia.
target_text_raw: Niko na mtu tunaye wasiliana naye huko Australia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son salaire a augmenté de dix pour cent.
target_text: Mushahara yake uliongezeka kwa asilimia kumi.
target_text_raw: Mushahara yake uliongezeka kwa asilimia kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il avait les cheveux brun foncé.
target_text: Alikuwa na nywele za rangi ya kufifia.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa na nywele za rangi ya kufifia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hé mon ami, je veux juste t'aider.
target_text: Hé, Rafiki yangu, nataka tu kukusaidia.
target_text_raw: Hé, Rafiki yangu, nataka tu kukusaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son salaire a été augmenté de 10%.
target_text: Mushahara yake uliongezeka kwa asilimia kumi.
target_text_raw: Mushahara yake uliongezeka kwa asilimia kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux un correspondant.
target_text: Nataka mtu mwenye tutakuwa nawasiliana kwa mbali.
target_text_raw: Nataka mtu mwenye tutakuwa nawasiliana kwa mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux des chaussures marron, pas des noires.
target_text: Nataka baito ya rangi ya marron, hapana bya mweusi.
target_text_raw: Nataka baito ya rangi ya marron, hapana bya mweusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Britanniques et les Français ont débarqué dans le coin, pris une carte et dessiné quelques lignes ici et là.
target_text: Waingereza na Wafaransa walifika mwa iyi eneo, wakamata carte na kuchora mistari hapa na pale.
target_text_raw: Waingereza na Wafaransa walifika mwa iyi eneo, wakamata carte na kuchora mistari hapa na pale.

source_text: Elle est Britannique.

source_text: Elle, à la figure tellement douce et pure, s'est sabordée en écorchant nos deux noms.
target_text: Yeye, mwenye sura ya tegetege na ya kutakata, alijigamba kuharibu majina yetu mbili.

target_text: Kulishapita muda mrefu sana tangu nikuone: Mara ya mwisho "Star Wars" ilikuwa naitwa "Vita ya nyota" na kulikuwa na episodes tatu tu, tena zote za muzuri.

source_text: N'attendez ni droit ni justice de l'empereur ! Aidez-vous vous-mêmes !

target_text_raw: Usitegemee sheria ao haki kutoka kwa mufalme mukubwa! Jisaidie wepeke!

target_text_raw: Karibu kwa wapenzi wanaotaka kuoana: Jules na Marie.

target_text_raw: Mapato yake ilipunguka kwa nusu kisha kuacha kazi na kwenda mu mapumuziko.

source_text: Malheur aux faiseurs de traductions littérales, qui en traduisant chaque parole énervent le sens! C'est bien là qu'on peu dire que la lettre tue, et que l'esprit vivifie.
target_text: Ole kwa wale wanaotafsiri neno kwa neno, tafsiri ya kila neno inakera maana. Hapa njo tunaweza sema kama erufi inaua na kama roho inatoa uhai.

source_text: Tiens, quelle coïncidence incroyable ! Hugo a les mêmes empreintes digitales que moi.

target_text_raw: Ona, aye njo inafikia hivi ! Hugo iko na alama za bidole sawa zangu.

source_text: Quant à l'Afrique du nord, les Amazighs, sont une cible facile, quiconque leur tombe dessus, ils en sont arrivés au point de sous-estimer leur langue leur civilisation, leur traditions et leur lois.
target_text: Kwa upande ya Afrika Kaskazini, Amazigh ni kabila ya batu benye abaheshimiwe kabisa, kila mwenye anakutananaka nabo anakuwaka nazarau luga yabo, mila na desturi zabo na sheria zabo.
target_text_raw: Kwa upande ya Afrika Kaskazini, Amazigh ni kabila ya batu benye abaheshimiwe kabisa, kila mwenye anakutananaka nabo anakuwaka nazarau luga yabo, mila na desturi zabo na sheria zabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais vu une bande de désert aussi désolée.
target_text: Sijawahi ona kipande ya jangwa ukiwa yenye kuwa na sura mubaya kama hiyi.
target_text_raw: Sijawahi ona kipande ya jangwa ukiwa yenye kuwa na sura mubaya kama hiyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas cru nécessaire de t'appeler immédiatement.
target_text: Sikuzani kama ni ya maana kukuita mara moya.
target_text_raw: Sikuzani kama ni ya maana kukuita mara moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donnez à ceux que vous aimez des raisons de rester.
target_text: Patia bale benye unapenda sababu za kubakia.
target_text_raw: Patia bale benye unapenda sababu za kubakia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu aimes le miel, ne crains pas les abeilles.
target_text: Kama unapenda asali, usiogope nyuki.
target_text_raw: Kama unapenda asali, usiogope nyuki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez près de moi, messieurs dames.
target_text: Bakia karibu yangu, ba papa na ba mamans.
target_text_raw: Bakia karibu yangu, ba papa na ba mamans.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les suspects répondront des faits d'importation et de possession de drogues dans une cour de Sydney.
target_text: Katika mahakama ya Sydney, washtumia watajibu ukweli kuhusu kuingiza na kukutwa na dawa za kulevya.
target_text_raw: Katika mahakama ya Sydney, washtumia watajibu ukweli kuhusu kuingiza na kukutwa na dawa za kulevya (drogues).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les bonnes choses viennent en petites quantités.
target_text: Bitu bizuri binakuyaka mu kiwango ya kidogo.
target_text_raw: Bitu bizuri binakuyaka mu kiwango ya kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis a désobéi à un ordre direct d'un officier supérieur.
target_text: Yanis akutii amri ya moja kwa moja kutoka kwa officier mukubwa.
target_text_raw: Yanis akutii amri ya moja kwa moja kutoka kwa officier mukubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Théo connaissait la vérité, mais il a fait en sorte que personne ne le sache.

target_text_raw: Theo alikua anajua ukweli, lakini alifanya yote juu mutu mwingine asijue.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui, les automobiles suivent le comportement des conducteurs : ils collectent des données personnelles telles que la vitesse, l'itinéraire et le style de conduite, puis rapportent cette information aux constructeurs automobiles ou compagnies d'assurance.
target_text: Leo, magari zinafata tabia ya ma dereva: zinakusanya habari za kibinafsi kama vitesse, njia, na style ya kutembeza, na kisha zinapana hizi habari ku makampuni zinazo tengeneza gari au kampuni za assurance.

source_text: Vénus est pareille à l'enfer. Sa température de surface, telle une fournaise, s'élève à plus de quatre-cent-cinquante degrés Celsius.
target_text: Venus inafanana kuzimu. Hii kifukutu ya budongo, yenye kuwa moto ya mingi na yenye kuchoma sana, inapandaka mpaka zaidi ya degré mia ine na makumi tano.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: David a tellement de petites copines qu'il n'arrive pas à retenir tous leurs noms.
target_text: David iko na barafiki mingi mpaka hakumbuki tena majina zabo.
target_text_raw: David iko na barafiki mingi mpaka hakumbuki tena majina zabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Chine a fait se poser son premier avion de combat sur un porte-avions.
target_text: Uchina imedemesha ndege yake ya kwanza ya kivita kwenye mashua ya kubeba ndehe.
target_text_raw: Uchina imedemesha ndege yake ya kwanza ya kivita kwenye mashua ya kubeba ndehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle compare l'effet de son entraînement à un élève de piano qui progresse dans sa capacité de jouer un air simple à exécuter un concerto.
target_text: Analinganisha mafunzo yake na mwanafunzi wa piano ambaye anaendelea katika uwezo wake wa kucheza mtindo rahisi kwenye tamasha.
target_text_raw: Analinganisha mafunzo yake na mwanafunzi wa piano ambaye anaendelea katika uwezo wake wa kucheza mtindo rahisi kwenye tamasha.

source_text: Tard dans la soirée nous trouvâmes enfin notre chemin jusqu'au pied de la montagne.
target_text: Mangaribu ya zaidi tulipata njia yetu ya kwenda chini ya mulima.
target_text_raw: Mangaribu ya zaidi tulipata njia yetu ya kwenda chini ya mulima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pourriez me ramener une autre serviette chaude?

target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza kunipatia kitambala ingine ya moto?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jean-Claude se flatte d'être parmi les meilleurs, sinon le meilleur dans son domaine.

target_text_raw: Jean-Claude anajivunia kuwa kati ya watu bora, kama sio bora katika domaine yake.

target_text_raw: Uamuzi wa meneja ulikuwa mugumu kwa wafanyikazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle était en costume de bal, laissant admirer des épaules magnifiques et fascinantes, sa taille de jeune fille, et des bras de statue antique.

target_text_raw: Alikuwa navala nguo ya sikukuu ya bal (sikukuu ya kumaliza mwaka ya masomo), akiacha mabega mazuri na ya kupendeza wazi, burefu yake ya binti, na mikono yenye kufanana sanamu ya zamani.

source_text: Parfois, un simple acquiescement de la tête est suffisant pour faire comprendre à une personne que vous l'écoutez attentivement.

target_text: Hukumu hiyo inawaalika walio kopesha kupeleka mashtaki mbele ya mwanasheria juu ya kuadai ma deni zabo zilipiwe mu siku zenye azizidi makumi tatu kuanzia siku ya hukumu lakini deni inaweza hakikishiwa tu ndani ya miaka 3.

target_text_raw: Ku mwisho bwana pepo alipoteza fahamu na kuanguka chini kwa kishindo.

target_text: Tunaposema kuwa lugha hupitishwa kitamaduni - ambayo ni kwamba inajifunza badala ya kurithi - tunamaanisha kuwa ni sehemu ya ugumu wote wa tabia iliyojifunza na ya pamoja ambayo wananthropolojia wanaiita " utamaduni ".

target_text_raw: Anna ni rafiki mwenye naweza kutegemea musaada wake.

target_text: Iran ni nchi huru yenye kuwa na haki ya kujitetea, kutetea faida zake, kupambana na kikundi yoyote ya kigaidi yenye kuitisha na kutisha serikali yoyote inayotishia kuiangamiza.

source_text: Savoir, c'est savoir que vous ne savez rien, c'est le sens de la vraie connaissance.
target_text: Kujua ni kujua kwamba haujui kitu, iyi njo maana ya ujuzi ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Kujua ni kujua kwamba haujui kitu, iyi njo maana ya ujuzi ya kweli.

target_text_raw: Kwenye shule ya sekondari, nilikuwa na uwezo ya kuchagua somo ya Kilatini .

source_text: Il a promis d'apporter de nouvelles industries à la région, mais les politiciens tiennent rarement leur parole.

target_text_raw: Alijua kama alisha shindwa na alipendelea kukimbia kuliko kupambana na adui.

target_text_raw: Ku mwisho, alifanya maamuzi wa kutengeneza pua yake.

source_text: Vous devriez jeter un coup d'œil à votre garde-robe et ajouter un peu de couleur à vos vêtements.
target_text: Unapashwa kuangalia kabati yako ya nguo na kuongeza rangi ku manguo yako.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kuangalia kabati yako ya nguo na kuongeza rangi ku manguo yako.

target_text_raw: Nilikuta virusi mingi mu ordinateur ya shangazi yangu.

target_text_raw: Alikuwa nafika kutoka Uchina.

source_text: Les deux premiers ours blancs à mettre le pied en Islande ont été tués après avoir parcouru cinq cents kilomètres à la nage... Bizarre récompense !
target_text: Ours mbili za kwanza kuweka mugulu huko Irlande ziliuawa baada ya kuogelea kilomita mia tano... Zawaida ya kushangaza!
target_text_raw: Ours (minyama ) mbili za kwanza kuweka mugulu huko Irlande ziliuawa baada ya kuogelea kilomita mia tano... Zawaida ya kushangaza!

source_text: Louis accusa finalement Germaine de s'être mise, métaphoriquement parlant, dans le rôle de l'éternel objet.
target_text: Ku mwisho Louis alimushutumu Germaine kwa kujiweka yepeke, akiongea kwa fumbo, katika jukumu ya kitu ya milele.
target_text_raw: Ku mwisho Louis alimushutumu Germaine kwa kujiweka yepeke, akiongea kwa fumbo, katika jukumu ya kitu ya milele.

source_text: Si vous ne voulez pas manquer le train, vous feriez mieux de vous dépêcher !

target_text_raw: Kama hautaki kukosa gari moshi (train), ufanye haraka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été battu par une bande de criminels en retournant du travail.
target_text: Nilipigwa na kundi ya waalifu wakati nilikuwa narudia kutoka mu kazi.
target_text_raw: Nilipigwa na kundi ya waalifu wakati nilikuwa narudia kutoka mu kazi.

target_text_raw: Minajua kama ba garçons (vinaja) bengi banatakaka kutoka na weye.

source_text: Je n'ai pas les bonnes réponses. C'est sans doute que je ne me pose pas les bonnes questions.
