target_text_raw: Tulikamata asansere (ascenseur) kwa kupanda na kushuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puisque vous êtes fatiguée, vous devriez vous reposer.
target_text: Kwa kuwa unachoka, unapashwa pumuzika.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa unachoka, unapashwa pumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez tout droit !
target_text: Endelea moja kwa moja!
target_text_raw: Endelea moja kwa moja!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont examiné si, au sujet des traces qui avaient été trouvées sur la porte, il s'agissait d'empreintes digitales du voleur.
target_text: Walichunguza kugunguwa kama, zile alama zenye zilionekana ku mulango zilikuwa alama za bidole ya mwizi.
target_text_raw: Walichunguza kugunguwa kama, zile alama zenye zilionekana ku mulango zilikuwa alama za bidole ya mwizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je donnai dix balles de pourboire au taxi pour m'avoir emmené à l'heure à l'aéroport.
target_text: Nilipatia chofere wa taxi pesa elfu kumi ya zawadi kwa kunipeleka kwenye uwanja wa ndege kwa wakati.
target_text_raw: Nilipatia chofere wa taxi pesa elfu kumi ya zawadi kwa kunipeleka kwenye uwanja wa ndege (ku aéroprt) kwa wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Or du duc ou de moi souffrez qu’on vous délivre, il faut choisir des deux, l’épouser, ou me suivre.
target_text: Ikiwa ya duc ao yangu vumilia tukuletee, unapashwa chagula kati ya siye bawili, umuoe ao unifuate.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa ya duc ao yangu vumilia tukuletee, unapashwa chagula kati ya siye bawili, umuoe ao unifuate.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, je veux que tu le fasses.
target_text: Ndio, nataka uifanye.
target_text_raw: Ndio, nataka uifanye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien que le poste soit déjà occupé, le directeur du personnel aimerait vous rencontrer pour un entretien.
target_text: Hata kama poste ilisha kamatiwa, kiongozi wa wafanyikazi angependa kukutana na weye kwa mahoji.
target_text_raw: Hata kama poste ilisha kamatiwa, kiongozi wa wafanyikazi angependa kukutana na weye kwa mahoji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan a tiré sur Matt en état de légitime défense.
target_text: Dan alifyatulia Matt lisasi katika lengo ya kujilinda.
target_text_raw: Dan alifyatulia Matt lisasi katika lengo ya kujilinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûre que vous voulez quitter votre emploi ?
target_text: Una uhakika ya kutaka kuacha kazi?
target_text_raw: Una uhakika ya kutaka kuacha kazi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégage de là en vitesse !
target_text: Toka hapo haraka!
target_text_raw: Toka hapo haraka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Steve monte dans le bus.
target_text: Steve anapanda mu bisi.
target_text_raw: Steve anapanda mu bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'incendie, qui sévit depuis plus d'une semaine dans l'est de la Californie, continue de s'étendre.
target_text: Moto yenye inaendelea nawaka kwa zaidi ya juma moja mashariki mwa California, inaendelea nasambarana fasi za mingi.
target_text_raw: Moto yenye inaendelea nawaka kwa zaidi ya juma moja mashariki mwa California, inaendelea nasambarana fasi za mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle sentit une boule au fond de sa gorge et les larmes se mirent à lui monter aux yeux.
target_text: Alisikia kitu saa vile kivimba mu shingo yake na machozi ikaanza mutoka mu macho.
target_text_raw: Alisikia kitu saa vile kivimba mu shingo yake na machozi ikaanza mutoka mu macho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dispose enfin du temps pour répondre à la correspondance que j'ai reçue ces trois dernières semaines.
target_text: Kwa sasa niko na wakati ya kujibia barua ambazo nimepokea mu juma tatu zilizopita.
target_text_raw: Kwa sasa niko na wakati ya kujibia barua ambazo nimepokea mu juma tatu zilizopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez clairement du talent, c'est vraiment dommage que vous n'ayez pas étudié plus!
target_text: Uko na kipaji kabisa, inasikitisha kuona gisi haukusoma zaidi!
target_text_raw: Uko na kipaji kabisa, inasikitisha kuona gisi haukusoma zaidi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous serez tuée !
target_text: Utauawa!
target_text_raw: Utauawa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous pouviez seulement parler l'anglais, vous seriez parfait.
target_text: Ikiwa ungeweza kuzungumza Kiingereza tu ungekuwa unajieneza.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa ungeweza kuzungumza Kiingereza tu ungekuwa unajieneza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils marchèrent sur 16 km, se reposèrent pendant 10 minutes et ensuite reprirent la route.
target_text: Walitembea urefu wa kilometa 16, wakapumzika kwa dakika 10, kisha wakaendelea na safari.
target_text_raw: Walitembea urefu wa kilometa 16, wakapumzika kwa dakika 10, kisha wakaendelea na safari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le pilote craint que le départ de l'avion, prévu pour dans une heure, ne soit retardé par le brouillard.
target_text: Rubani alikuwa na hofu kuwa kuondoka kwa ndege, iliyopangwa kwa saa moja, itacheleweshwa na ukungu.
target_text_raw: Rubani (pilote) alikuwa na hofu kuwa kuondoka kwa ndege, iliyopangwa kwa saa moja, itacheleweshwa na ukungu (brouillard).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai longuement réfléchi à si je devais m'établir à Rome ou à Paris et je me suis finalement décidé à rester à Berlin.
target_text: Nilifikiria sana juu ya kusema niikale Rome ao Paris na ku mwisho niliamua kuikala Berlin.
target_text_raw: Nilifikiria sana juu ya kusema niikale Rome ao Paris na ku mwisho niliamua kuikala Berlin.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a été trop sympa de nous amener sur l'île avec son bateau.
target_text: Alifanya muzuri sana kutuleta kwenye kisanga na mashua yake.
target_text_raw: Alifanya muzuri sana kutuleta kwenye kisanga na mashua yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Réaliser des esquisses revient à planter des graines pour faire pousser des tableaux.
target_text: Kutengeneza michoro ya kwanza ni kama kupanda mbegu juu ya kuotesha michoro.
target_text_raw: Kutengeneza michoro ya kwanza ni kama kupanda mbegu juu ya kuotesha michoro.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta caméra n'a que la moitié de la taille de la mienne.
target_text: Kamera yako ni nusu ya bunene ya yangu.
target_text_raw: Kamera yako ni nusu ya bunene ya yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous présenta ses excuses pour n'avoir pas tenu sa promesse.
target_text: Alituomba musamaha kwa kutotimiza ahadi yake.
target_text_raw: Alituomba musamaha kwa kutotimiza ahadi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne dispose pas du droit de vote, celui que le tribunal a exclu du corps électoral pour avoir commis un crime ou en vertu de sa capacité de compréhension limitée.
target_text: Mtu asiye kuwa na haki ya kupiga kura ni yoyote ule mwenye mahakama ilikatalia kushiriki kwenye uchaguzi kwa sababu ya makosa ya uhalifu ao kwa sababu ya uwezo yake mdogo ya kuelewa.
target_text_raw: Mtu asiye kuwa na haki ya kupiga kura ni yoyote ule mwenye mahakama ilikatalia kushiriki kwenye uchaguzi kwa sababu ya makosa ya uhalifu ao kwa sababu ya uwezo yake mdogo ya kuelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a de quoi s'amuser : luge, skis, raquettes, c'est comme vous voulez.
target_text: kuko bitu mingi ya kujifurahisha amo: mchezo ya luge, ya ski, yaraquette, ni gisi unapenda.
target_text_raw: kuko bitu mingi ya kujifurahisha amo: mchezo ya luge, ya ski, yaraquette, ni gisi unapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y avait qu'une simple croix blanche pour marquer la tombe du soldat.
target_text: Kulikuwa tu msalaba mweupe ya kawaida juu kuweka alama ku kaburi ya ule askari.
target_text_raw: Kulikuwa tu msalaba mweupe ya kawaida juu kuweka alama ku kaburi ya ule askari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne tire pas dans le dos du diable. Tu pourrais le rater.
target_text: Usipige lisasi mu mugongo ya shetani. Unaweza kukosea.
target_text_raw: Usipige lisasi mu mugongo ya shetani. Unaweza kukosea (rater).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Certainement, monsieur. Le bar à salade est par là bas.
target_text: Kweli, bwana. Bar ya salade iko pale.
target_text_raw: Kweli, bwana. Bar ya salade iko pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se disait à la vue de Sonia : « J’en trouverai beaucoup comme elle, beaucoup qui me sont encore inconnues ! Il sera toujours temps d’aimer et de m’en occuper plus tard. »
target_text: Alikuwa najiambia akiangalia Sonia: "Nitapata bengi kama yeye, bengi benye sijui! Kutakuwa wakati ya kupenda na kushughulika nayo baadae. »
target_text_raw: Alikuwa najiambia akiangalia Sonia: "Nitapata bengi kama yeye, bengi benye sijui! Kutakuwa wakati ya kupenda na kushughulika nayo baadae. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Johnny Depp est mon acteur préféré.
target_text: Johnny Depp njo muigizaji mwenye napendaka zaidi.
target_text_raw: Johnny Depp njo muigizaji mwenye napendaka zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que ferait Jésus ?
target_text: Yesu angefanya nini?
target_text_raw: Yesu angefanya nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une faible estime de soi résulte d'un désaccord entre le moi réel et le moi idéal.
target_text: Kutokujikubali inatokana na kutokubaliana kati ya umutu wa kweli na umutu bora.
target_text_raw: Kutokujikubali inatokana na kutokubaliana kati ya umutu wa kweli na umutu bora.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Billy se cogne souvent la tête contre la vitre.
target_text: Billy anagongaka mara mingi kichwa yake ku kio.
target_text_raw: Billy anagongaka mara mingi kichwa yake ku kio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous faites partie de ceux qui essaient de se débarrasser de leur addiction, s'engager dans la campagne est un bon choix.
target_text: Kama weye ni mumoja wa watu wenye wanajaribu kuacha tabia yabo, kushiriki kwenye kampeni ni chaguo muzuri.
target_text_raw: Kama weye ni mumoja wa watu wenye wanajaribu kuacha tabia yabo, kushiriki kwenye kampeni ni chaguo muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chefs de projets emploient l'idée de la technique du saucissonnage pour dissiper les craintes que peut soulever une tâche importante. Ils précisent les éléments unitaires de la tâche, qui peuvent être exécutés « tranche par tranche ».
target_text: Wasimamizi wa mradi wanatumia mbinu ya kugawa bipande bipande juu ya kupunguza hofu yenye inaweza tokana na kazi kubwa. Wanataja bitu yenye inaunda kazi, ambayo binaweza kufanywa "kipande kwa kipande".
target_text_raw: Wasimamizi wa mradi wanatumia mbinu ya kugawa bipande bipande juu ya kupunguza hofu yenye inaweza tokana na kazi kubwa. Wanataja bitu yenye inaunda kazi, ambayo binaweza kufanywa "kipande kwa kipande".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'accord, le lérot est une petite bête bien mignonne, mais le tapage nocturne qu'il entreprend même et surtout quand nous avons besoin de dormir nous donne parfois des envies de le supprimer plutôt que de l'éloigner !
target_text: Sawa, lerot ni mnyama mzuri sana, lakini kelele ba busiku zenye inafanyaka hata na sana sana wakati tunahitaji kulala piko saa inatumaka tunataka kuikandamiza kuliko kuimbiza mbali!
target_text_raw: Sawa, lerot ni mnyama mzuri sana, lakini kelele ba busiku zenye inafanyaka hata na sana sana wakati tunahitaji kulala piko saa inatumaka tunataka kuikandamiza kuliko kuimbiza mbali!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Durant la saison chaude, les matières périssables se gâtent facilement.
target_text: Wakati ya joto, vifaa ya kuharibika inaharibikaka kwa urahisi.
target_text_raw: Wakati ya joto, vifaa ya kuharibika inaharibikaka kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lors de mon adolescence, je détestais la vie et j'étais continuellement au bord du suicide, mais j'en étais écarté par le désir de connaître plus de mathématiques.
target_text: Wakati nilikuwa adolensa, nilikuwa nachukia maisha na nilikuwaka karibu ya kujiua, lakini nilisaidiwaka na hamu ya kujifunza zaidi hesabu.
target_text_raw: Wakati nilikuwa adolensa, nilikuwa nachukia maisha na nilikuwaka karibu ya kujiua, lakini nilisaidiwaka na hamu ya kujifunza zaidi hesabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous avaient anxieusement attendu la nouvelle qui fit l'effet d'une bombe.
target_text: Bote balikuwa nangojea kwa hamu habari yenye ilianguka kama bombe.
target_text_raw: Bote balikuwa nangojea kwa hamu habari yenye ilianguka kama bombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai le sentiment que vous ne voulez pas vraiment que je parte.
target_text: Niko nasikia sawa vile hautaki niende.
target_text_raw: Niko nasikia sawa vile hautaki niende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et l'on savait, qu'en ces lieux prospères, hommes et chevaux gisaient, enterrés en tas désordonné et bonifiaient la terre.
target_text: Na tulijua kuwa mwa iyi maeneo ya mafanyikio, wanaume na farasi wamelala, wamezikwa mu bu ma lundo lundo bya kusambarana na kuboresha udongo.
target_text_raw: Na tulijua kuwa mwa iyi maeneo ya mafanyikio, wanaume na farasi wamelala, wamezikwa mu bu ma lundo lundo bya kusambarana na kuboresha udongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi, Diable, l'as-tu amené à la gare ?
target_text: Juu ya nini shetani ulimuleta ku kituo?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini shetani ulimuleta ku kituo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette route vous amène au bord du lac Biwa.
target_text: Hii barabara inakupeleka kando ya ziwa Biwa.
target_text_raw: Hii barabara inakupeleka kando ya ziwa Biwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bougez vos fesses, les filles !
target_text: Mufanye haraka, wa dada!
target_text_raw: Mufanye haraka, wa dada!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je connaissais déjà le résultat final.
target_text: Nilikua najua matokeo ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Nilikua najua matokeo ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que, dans un futur lointain, vous ne serez pas capable de vous pardonner.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kuwa, mu siku za mbele, hautaweza kujisamehe mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kuwa, mu siku za mbele, hautaweza kujisamehe mwenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fit un bref discours.
target_text: Alitoa hotuba ya mufupi.
target_text_raw: Alitoa hotuba ya mufupi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La moindre chose qui se forme au monde est toujours le produit d'une formidable coïncidence.
target_text: Kitu kidogo yenye inajiunda duniani kila wakati inakuwaka ni matokeo ya kitu ya kushitukia ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Kitu kidogo yenye inajiunda duniani kila wakati inakuwaka ni matokeo ya kitu ya kushitukia ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quiconque devine le nombre, gagne.
target_text: Yeyote mwenye atatombolesha numero, atashinda.
target_text_raw: Yeyote mwenye atatombolesha numero, atashinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas. Timéo ne nous laissera pas tomber.
target_text: Usikuwe na hofu. Timeo hatatuachilia.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na hofu. Timeo hatatuachilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Respire à fond et ensuite relâche-toi.
target_text: Vuta pumuzi kwa ndani kisha ujiachilie.
target_text_raw: Vuta pumuzi kwa ndani kisha ujiachilie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu sembles parfait pour le job.
target_text: Unaonekana kama hii kazi inakufaa.
target_text_raw: Unaonekana kama hii kazi inakufaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a exprimé très clairement qu'il aimerait sortir avec toi.
target_text: Alisema wazi kabisa kwamba angependa kutoka na wewe.
target_text_raw: Alisema wazi kabisa kwamba angependa kutoka na wewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le voleur a été appréhendé par des agents de sécurité qui ont découvert plusieurs cravates dans ses poches.
target_text: Mwizi alikamatwa na walinda usalama ambao walikuta cravates za mingi mu mifuko yake.
target_text_raw: Mwizi alikamatwa na walinda usalama ambao walikuta cravates za mingi mu mifuko yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fièvre fait monter le pouls.
target_text: Homa inatoshanaka ma tundu ya baridi ku mwili.
target_text_raw: Homa inatoshanaka ma tundu ya baridi ku mwili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Tu dessines ? » « Ouais, je caricature. » « Qui ça, le prof ? » « Nan, j'ai essayé, ça m'irrite les yeux. »
target_text: « Uko nachapa ? » « Ndio, niko nachapa. » « Nani, mwalimu? » « Hapana, nilijaribu, inanilumisha macho. »
target_text_raw: « Uko nachapa (nachora) ? » « Ndio, niko nachapa. » « Nani, mwalimu? » « Hapana, nilijaribu, inanilumisha macho. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa Majesté a-t-elle bien dormie ?
target_text: Mufalme alilala muzuri?
target_text_raw: Mufalme alilala muzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On représente assez souvent le titan Atlas à genoux, soutenant sur son dos la voûte céleste.
target_text: Mara mingi titan Atlas inaoneshwaka ikipiga magoti, ikibeba ki lijiwe ya mbinguni kwenye mugongo yake.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi titan Atlas inaoneshwaka ikipiga magoti, ikibeba ki lijiwe ya mbinguni (voûte céleste) kwenye mugongo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une porte était entr’ouverte ; une jeune fille agenouillée dans un oratoire gothique, au pied d’un simple autel, récitait à demi-voix les litanies de la Vierge.
target_text: Mlango ilikuwa wazi; binti mdogo akipiga magoti ndani ya chumba ya sala yenye majengo ya gothique, chini ya mazabahu ya kawaida, alisoma kwa sauti ya chini sala za Bikira.
target_text_raw: Mlango ilikuwa wazi; binti mdogo akipiga magoti ndani ya chumba ya sala yenye majengo ya gothique, chini ya mazabahu ya kawaida, alisoma kwa sauti ya chini sala za Bikira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se rappelait son dernier baiser avec Nathalie à Vierzon, trois heures plus tôt, le côté haletant, éperdu de leur adieu et il se sentait rempli d'une vague superstition.
target_text: Alikumbuka bizu yake ya mwisho na Nathalie huko Vierzon, saa tatu mapema, upande ya kupumulia,akisikitishwa na kulagana kwabo na alisikiwa kujazwa na upendo usiyo kuwa wa kawaida.
target_text_raw: Alikumbuka bizu yake ya mwisho na Nathalie huko Vierzon, saa tatu mapema, upande ya kupumulia,akisikitishwa na kulagana kwabo na alisikiwa kujazwa na upendo usiyo kuwa wa kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La guerre, c'est simple : c'est faire entrer un morceau de fer dans un morceau de chair.
target_text: Vita ni rahisi: ni kuingiza kipande ya chuma ndani ya kipande ya nyama.
target_text_raw: Vita ni rahisi: ni kuingiza kipande ya chuma ndani ya kipande ya nyama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Japon produit beaucoup de bonnes caméras.
target_text: Japani inatengezaka kamera mingi za muzuri.
target_text_raw: Japani inatengezaka kamera mingi za muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûre de pouvoir gérer ceci ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kama unaweza shughulikia iyi?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kama unaweza shughulikia iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En échange, je l'ai regardée avec surprise.
target_text: Na miye pia, nilimwangalia kwa mushangao.
target_text_raw: Na miye pia, nilimwangalia kwa mushangao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que fout ce conteneur dans notre port de Hambourg ?
target_text: Hii kontenere iko nafanya nini mu port yetu ya Hambourg ?
target_text_raw: Hii kontenere iko nafanya nini mu port yetu ya Hambourg ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez les gars, va falloir passer à la vitesse supérieure maintenant.
target_text: Musonge mbele vijana, itabidi kuongeza vitesse sasa.
target_text_raw: Musonge mbele vijana, itabidi kuongeza vitesse sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s’est caché, il a peur qu’on le voit.
target_text: Anajificha, anaogopa tusimuone.
target_text_raw: Anajificha, anaogopa tusimuone.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une tentative d'anéantissement de l'Iran signifierait un premier pas vers l'anéantissement de la Russie elle-même, c'est ce qui explique le soutien stratégique de Moscou pour Téhéran.
target_text: Jaribio ya kuangamiza Iran ingekuwa hatua ya kwanza katika uangamizaji ya Urusi yenyewe, na hii njo inaonesha msaada ya Moscou kwa Téhéran.
target_text_raw: Jaribio ya kuangamiza Iran ingekuwa hatua ya kwanza katika uangamizaji ya Urusi yenyewe, na hii njo inaonesha msaada ya Moscou kwa Téhéran.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie est un si bon prof que si tu n'apprends pas ta leçon, elle te la répète volontiers.
target_text: Maisha ni mwalimu mzuri na usipojifunza somo yako, inakufasiria ayo tena kwa furaha.
target_text_raw: Maisha ni mwalimu mzuri na usipojifunza somo yako, inakufasiria ayo tena kwa furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pars maintenant et ne reviens jamais.
target_text: Wende sai na usirudiake tena.
target_text_raw: Wende sai na usirudiake tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je retourne à la fac.
target_text: Minatoka ku université.
target_text_raw: Minatoka ku université.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où que vous alliez, vous serez bienvenue.
target_text: Hata ukienda wapi, utakaribishwa.
target_text_raw: Hata ukienda wapi, utakaribishwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je savais qu'in fine, la faute m'en serait attribuée.
target_text: Nilijua kama ku mwisho, hiyo kosa batani vika ayo.
target_text_raw: Nilijua kama ku mwisho, hiyo kosa batani vika ayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai cru sur parole lorsqu'il a déclaré qu'il ne l'avait jamais vue auparavant.
target_text: Nilimuamini kwa maneno wakati alisema kama hakuwahi kumuona hapo mbele.
target_text_raw: Nilimuamini kwa maneno wakati alisema kama hakuwahi kumuona hapo mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce qu'au bar, il assure ?
target_text: Je, ku bar anafanyaka muzuri?
target_text_raw: Je, ku bar anafanyaka muzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que Jules serait parfait pour Emma.
target_text: Nilizani kama Jules atakuwa mtu muzuri kwa Emma.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama Jules atakuwa mtu muzuri kwa Emma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les deux points sont utilisés soit pour annoncer une citation, soit pour expliquer une conséquence, soit pour expliquer une cause, soit pour faire une liste.
target_text: Alama mbili inatumikishwa kwa kutangaza msemo, ao kuelezea matokeo, ao kuelezea sababu, ao kwa kufanya liste.
target_text_raw: Alama mbili inatumikishwa kwa kutangaza msemo, ao kuelezea matokeo, ao kuelezea sababu, ao kwa kufanya liste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une faute cache souvent l'autre.
target_text: Mara mingi kosa moya inafichaka ingine.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi kosa moya inafichaka ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est tard. Thomas va s'inquiéter.
target_text: Inakuwa nyuma. Thomas atakuwa na wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Inakuwa nyuma. Thomas atakuwa na wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La femme est l'être le plus parfait entre les créatures ; elle est une créature transitoire entre l'homme et l'ange.
target_text: Mwanamuke ndiye kiumbe kizuri zaidi kati ya viumbe vyote; yeye ni kiumbe cha mpito kati ya mwanamume na malaika.
target_text_raw: Mwanamuke ndiye kiumbe kizuri zaidi kati ya viumbe vyote; yeye ni kiumbe cha mpito kati ya mwanamume na malaika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Assurez-vous d'éteindre toutes les lumières avant de sortir.
target_text: Hakikisha unazimisha tala zote mbele utoke.
target_text_raw: Hakikisha unazimisha tala zote mbele utoke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons détruit le paradis et l'enfer.
target_text: Tulivunja paradizo na kuzimu.
target_text_raw: Tulivunja paradizo na kuzimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis enchanté d'avoir fait votre connaissance.
target_text: Nafurahi kujuana na weye.
target_text_raw: Nafurahi kujuana na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gosses sont enfin endormis.
target_text: Batoto banalala sasa.
target_text_raw: Batoto banalala sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les étrangers, dans ce pays, sont l'objet d'un traitement particulier.
target_text: Wageni ndani ya hii inchi banatunziwaka kiupekee.
target_text_raw: Wageni ndani ya hii inchi banatunziwaka kiupekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voyez ou entendez quelque chose, prévenez-moi.
target_text: Ukisikia ao kuona kitu chochote, niambie mapema.
target_text_raw: Ukisikia ao kuona kitu chochote, niambie mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ressens une sorte de crampe dans la jambe gauche.
target_text: Niko nasikia kitu saa crampe mugulu yangu ya kushoto.
target_text_raw: Niko nasikia kitu saa crampe mugulu yangu ya kushoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sais-tu si Grace est chez elle ?
target_text: Unajua kama Grace iko kwake?
target_text_raw: Unajua kama Grace iko kwake?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a eu comme l'impression d'avoir vu un fantôme.
target_text: Aliwaza kama anaona muzimu.
target_text_raw: Aliwaza kama anaona muzimu (mzuka).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu regardes là-bas, tu peux apercevoir les fumées de l'usine.
target_text: Ukiangalia kule, unaweza ona moshi kutoka mu kiwanda.
target_text_raw: Ukiangalia kule, unaweza ona moshi kutoka mu kiwanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Est-ce que cette soirée vous a plu ? » « Oui, c'était fantastique. »
target_text: "Ulifurahia iyi fete ya mangaribi ?" » « Ndio, ilikua muzuri sana. »
target_text_raw: "Ulifurahia iyi fete ya mangaribi (soirée) ?" » « Ndio, ilikua muzuri sana. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nul n'a jamais vu Dieu; le Fils unique, qui est tourné vers le sein du Père, lui l'a fait connaître.
target_text: Hakuna mutu mwenye alisha ona Mungu; mutoto yake wa pekee, ambaye amegeukia kifua cha Baba, alimujulisha.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mutu mwenye alisha ona Mungu; mutoto yake wa pekee, ambaye amegeukia kifua cha Baba, alimujulisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est mon amie Rachel. Nous allons à l'école ensemble.
target_text: Ni rafiki yangu Rachel. Tunaendaka ku masomo pamoya.
target_text_raw: Ni rafiki yangu Rachel. Tunaendaka ku masomo pamoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant il est trop tard : Vienne est occupée par les troupes françaises !
target_text: Sasa ilishakuwa nyuma sana: Vienne inatekwa na vikosi vya Ufaransa!
target_text_raw: Sasa ilishakuwa nyuma sana: Vienne inatekwa na vikosi vya Ufaransa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lance la balle.
target_text: Tupa mupira.
target_text_raw: Tupa mupira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne crois pas nécessaire de nettoyer les fenêtres.
target_text: Sizani kama ni muhimu kupanguzamadirisha.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama ni muhimu kupanguzamadirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Descends au prochain arrêt et prends un bus à destination de l'aéroport.
target_text: Shuka ku kituo kifuatacho na ukamate bisi kwenda kwenye kiwanja ya ndege.
target_text_raw: Shuka ku kituo kifuatacho na ukamate bisi kwenda kwenye kiwanja ya ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouah, quel gros coucou ! Oui, c'est un coucou de grand-père.
target_text: Oh, ni coucou kubwa! Ndio, ni coucou ya tate mwanaume.
target_text_raw: Oh, ni coucou (ndege) kubwa! Ndio, ni coucou (ndege) ya tate mwanaume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si cela va sans dire, cela ira encore mieux en le disant.
target_text: Kama itakuwa muzuri bila kusema, itakuwa bora hata kwa kusema.
target_text_raw: Kama itakuwa muzuri bila kusema, itakuwa bora hata kwa kusema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’espérais vous faire une surprise.
target_text: Nilikuwa nataka kukufanyia surprise.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nataka kukufanyia surprise.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceci n’est pas ma faute mais la vôtre.
target_text: Hii haiko kosa yangu lakini ni kosa yako.
target_text_raw: Hii haiko kosa yangu lakini ni kosa yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Partons, dans un baiser, pour un monde inconnu.
target_text: Twende, ndani ya bizu, mu dunia isiojulikana.
target_text_raw: Twende, ndani ya bizu, mu dunia isiojulikana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a quelque chose de très étrange qui se cache derrière ça, Scott !
target_text: Piko kitu yenye haiko ya kawaida nyuma ya hii, Scott!
target_text_raw: Piko kitu yenye haiko ya kawaida nyuma ya hii, Scott!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si seulement j'avais vendu cette propriété avant l'explosion de la bulle économique, je n'aurais pas perdu tout cet argent.
target_text: Kama ningeuzisha iyi lupango mbele ya muripuko ya kiuchumi, singepoteza hizi pesa zote.
target_text_raw: Kama ningeuzisha iyi lupango mbele ya muripuko ya kiuchumi, singepoteza hizi pesa zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens des territoires occupés ont-ils le droit de visiter leurs proches dans les autres pays et territoires ?
target_text: Je! Wapalestina wenye kuwa katika maeneo yanayotawaliwa biko na haki ya kutembelea wandugu yabo mu nchi na wilaya zingine?
target_text_raw: Je! Wapalestina wenye kuwa katika maeneo yanayotawaliwa biko na haki ya kutembelea wandugu yabo mu nchi na wilaya zingine?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a des moments où une rose est plus importante qu'un morceau de pain.
target_text: Piko wakati liuwa ya rose ni maana zaidi kuliko kipande ya mkate.
target_text_raw: Piko wakati liuwa ya rose ni maana zaidi kuliko kipande ya mkate.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une liste des demandes en souffrance.
target_text: Niko na liste ya maombi ya mateso.
target_text_raw: Niko na liste ya maombi ya mateso.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un flingue serait bien utile.
target_text: Bunduki itakuwa muhimu sana.
target_text_raw: Bunduki itakuwa muhimu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut que je parte, mes collègues m'attendent.
target_text: Lazima niende, benzangu biko nanichunga.
target_text_raw: Lazima niende, benzangu biko nanichunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez toujours tout contrôler.
target_text: Unataka uendelee naongoza byote.
target_text_raw: Unataka uendelee naongoza byote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La phrase d'exemple no. 354618 a créé beaucoup de confusion sur le site web de Tatoeba.
target_text: Musemo ya mufano no. 354618 ilichanganya sana ku site internet ya Tatoeba.
target_text_raw: Musemo ya mufano no. 354618 ilichanganya sana ku site internet ya Tatoeba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au lieu d'écrire à la main puis de taper ton texte, saisis-le directement à l'ordinateur.
target_text: Kuliko kuandika na mkono na kisha kuandika texte yako ku ordinateur, iandike mara moja ku ordinateur.
target_text_raw: Kuliko kuandika na mkono na kisha kuandika texte yako ku ordinateur, iandike mara moja ku ordinateur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trois jours après la mort, les cheveux et les ongles continuent à pousser mais les appels téléphoniques se font plus rares.
target_text: Siku tatu kisha kifo, nywele na makucha zinaendelea kuota, lakini appel za telephone zinakuwa chache sana.
target_text_raw: Siku tatu kisha kifo, nywele na makucha zinaendelea kuota, lakini appel za telephone zinakuwa chache sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la mesure où vous serez à proximité, passez nous rendre visite !
target_text: Wakati utakuwa mwa iyi eneo, unaweza pita kututembelea!
target_text_raw: Wakati utakuwa mwa iyi eneo, unaweza pita kututembelea!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me rappelles un garçon que je connaissais.
target_text: Unanikumbusha kijana mwenye nilukuwa nafaamihi.
target_text_raw: Unanikumbusha kijana mwenye nilukuwa nafaamihi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois supprimer de nombreux dossiers de mon ordinateur.
target_text: Napashwa vuta dossiers za mingi mu ordinateur yangu.
target_text_raw: Napashwa vuta dossiers za mingi mu ordinateur yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le croissant n'est pas français mais autrichien. Il a été créé par un pâtissier viennois pour célébrer la levée du siège de Vienne par les Ottomans.
target_text: Croissant haiko ya Ufaransa lakini ni ya Kiaustralia. Iliundwa na mpiga mikate kutoka Vienne kwa kusherehekea ukombozi wa makao ya Vienne na wa Ottomans.
target_text_raw: Croissant haiko ya Ufaransa lakini ni ya Kiaustralia. Iliundwa na mpiga mikate kutoka Vienne kwa kusherehekea ukombozi wa makao ya Vienne na wa Ottomans.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont demandé à Kate de prendre soin de son enfant.
target_text: Waliambia Kate ashughulikie mtoto wake.
target_text_raw: Waliambia Kate ashughulikie mtoto wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Mais où vas-tu comme ça ?" "Je pars chez ma mère et je te laisserai avec tes charmantes araignées."
target_text: "Lakini unaenda wapi hivi?" "Minaenda kwa mama yangu na nitakuacha na buibui zako za kupendeza."
target_text_raw: "Lakini unaenda wapi hivi?" "Minaenda kwa mama yangu na nitakuacha na buibui zako za kupendeza."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'adhère totalement à cette vision du futur.
target_text: Minakubaliana kabisa ya iyi maoni ya maisha ya kesho.
target_text_raw: Minakubaliana kabisa ya iyi maoni ya maisha ya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jamais, au dire de ceux qui l’ont ensevelie, une créature vivante n’avait atteint à sa maigreur sans mourir.
target_text: Kwa misemo benye waliozika, hakuna kiumbe yenye kuishi ilishawahi kuwa mwembamba kama ile bila kufa.
target_text_raw: Kwa misemo benye waliozika, hakuna kiumbe yenye kuishi ilishawahi kuwa mwembamba kama ile bila kufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce piano sonne faux.
target_text: Iyi piano iko na sauti ya mubaya.
target_text_raw: Iyi piano iko na sauti ya mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La bombe atomique est une sérieuse menace pour l'humanité.
target_text: Bombe atomique ni tishio kubwa kwa bindadamu.
target_text_raw: Bombe atomique ni tishio kubwa kwa bindadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tôt ou tard il me dira tout.
target_text: Leo ao siku ingine ataniambia kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Leo ao siku ingine ataniambia kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand Marie était assise au bord de la mer, lisant le journal et mangeant une glace, elle se sentait comme au paradis.
target_text: Wakati Marie alikuwa naikala kando ya bahari, akisoma gazeti na kula barafu, alijisikia saa iko paradizo.
target_text_raw: Wakati Marie alikuwa naikala kando ya bahari, akisoma gazeti na kula barafu, alijisikia saa iko paradizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cesse de me pousser dans le dos !
target_text: Acha kunisukumia nyuma ya mgongo!
target_text_raw: Acha kunisukumia nyuma ya mgongo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme disent les bonnes vieilles femmes quand elles conseillent un remède de leur façon, si cela ne fait pas de bien, cela ne peut pas faire de mal.
target_text: Kama vile bazee ya banamuke banasemaka wakati bako nashauria mu namna yabo kuhusu dawa, kama haitumike muzuri, haiwezi luma.
target_text_raw: Kama vile bazee ya banamuke banasemaka wakati bako nashauria mu namna yabo kuhusu dawa, kama haitumike muzuri, haiwezi luma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon lit est grand, et les fantômes viennent dormir dedans durant la journée.
target_text: Kitanda yangu ni ya mukubwa, na mizimu inakuyaka lala amo muchana.
target_text_raw: Kitanda yangu ni ya mukubwa, na mizimu inakuyaka lala amo muchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon revenu couvre à peine de quoi survivre.
target_text: Pato yangu inagharamia tu mu bitu kidogo mu maisha.
target_text_raw: Pato yangu inagharamia tu mu bitu kidogo mu maisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ayons du vin et des femmes, du plaisir et des rires, Des sermons et du soda le lendemain.
target_text: Tukuwe divai na wanawake, raha na kicheko, mahubiri na soda siku inayofuata.
target_text_raw: Tukuwe divai na wanawake, raha na kicheko, mahubiri na soda siku inayofuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prêtre n'est tenu de dire la messe qu'autant qu'il est en état de le faire; si cette condition manque, il ne pèche pas par omission.
target_text: Padiri anapashwa fanyisha misa wakati iko na uwezo ya kuifanya; kama haiwezekani, hatendi zambi kwa kuacha.
target_text_raw: Padiri anapashwa fanyisha misa wakati iko na uwezo ya kuifanya; kama haiwezekani, hatendi zambi kwa kuacha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ne prennent aucune décision importante.
target_text: Hawakamati mauzi yeyote ya muhimu.
target_text_raw: Hawakamati mauzi yeyote ya muhimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Par une journée aussi froide, je n'aime pas sortir sans une veste.
target_text: Siku ya baridi, sipendaki kutoka inje bila koti.
target_text_raw: Siku ya baridi, sipendaki kutoka inje bila koti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous saviez où ils étaient, comment se fait-il que vous n'ayez rien dit ?
target_text: Kama ulikuwa najua kwenye balikuwa, aye njo haukusema chochote?
target_text_raw: Kama ulikuwa najua kwenye balikuwa, aye njo haukusema chochote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Al Capone fut finalement jeté en prison pour évasion fiscale.
target_text: Ku mwisho Al Capone alitupwa jela kwa kutolipa ushuru.
target_text_raw: Ku mwisho Al Capone alitupwa jela kwa kutolipa ushuru.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lisa ne dit absolument rien.
target_text: Lisa hasemi hata kitu kimoja.
target_text_raw: Lisa hasemi hata kitu kimoja.

source_text: Le sort a été brisé et le cochon est devenu un homme.
target_text: Laana ilivunjika na nguruwe iligeuka mtu.
target_text_raw: Laana ilivunjika na nguruwe iligeuka mtu.

source_text: Suite à une chute, une bosse est apparue sur mon genou droit.
target_text: Kutokana na kuanguka, ka kivimba kalionekana ku ligoti yangu ya kuume.
target_text_raw: Kutokana na kuanguka, ka kivimba kalionekana ku ligoti yangu ya kuume.

source_text: La police a découvert l'héroïne lors d'un contrôle de routine sous le faux plancher de la cale d'un poids lourd.
target_text: Polisi iligundua bangi wakati ya controle ya kawaida chini ya mbao ya camion.
target_text_raw: Polisi iligundua bangi wakati ya controle ya kawaida chini ya mbao ya camion.

source_text: Je n'ai pas de langage de programmation préféré, mais j'avoue aimer les langages orientés objet.
target_text: Hukuna langage ya programmation yenye minapendelea, lakini minapendaka langages orientés objets.
target_text_raw: Hukuna langage ya programmation yenye minapendelea, lakini minapendaka langages orientés objets.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est top secret.
target_text: Ni siri kubwa.
target_text_raw: Ni siri kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le fameux scientifique Isaac Newton s'est comparé un jour à un enfant jouant au bord d'un océan; il trouve des cailloux d'une merveilleuse beauté, mais devant lui s'étend un océan de mystères inexplorés.
target_text: Mwanasayansi maarufu Isaac Newton aliwahi kujilinganisha na mtoto anayecheza kando ya bahari; anapataka bu majiwe bya kupendeza sana, lakini mbele yake piko bahari ya siri zisizojulikana.
target_text_raw: Mwanasayansi maarufu Isaac Newton aliwahi kujilinganisha na mtoto anayecheza kando ya bahari; anapataka bu majiwe bya kupendeza sana, lakini mbele yake piko bahari ya siri zisizojulikana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je savais que Mathéo ferait quelque chose de romantique.
target_text: Nilijua Mathéo angefanya jambo la kimapenzi.
target_text_raw: Nilijua Mathéo angefanya jambo la kimapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces jours-ci, je fais en sorte que le chauffage s’allume automatiquement une demi-heure avant que je me réveille.
target_text: Hizi siku, najitahidi chombo ya kuongeza kifukutu ijiwashe yopeke nusu saa kabla nilamuke.
target_text_raw: Hizi siku, najitahidi chombo ya kuongeza kifukutu ijiwashe yopeke nusu saa kabla nilamuke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le diable transparaît sous le masque du bonhomme.
target_text: Ibilisi anaonekana mu masque ya uyu mwanaume.
target_text_raw: Ibilisi anaonekana mu masque ya uyu mwanaume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Oui, c'est vrai, " glissa Susan, "Justement je voulais appeler..."
target_text: "Ndio, ni kweli," Susan alisema, "Nilikuwa nataka kukuita ku telefone ..."
target_text_raw: "Ndio, ni kweli," Susan alisema, "Nilikuwa nataka kukuita ku telefone ..."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il semble que Jeff sache qui elle est.
target_text: Iko sawa Jeff anajua uyu binti ni nani.
target_text_raw: Iko sawa Jeff anajua uyu binti ni nani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pensez que je plaisante ?
target_text: Je! Unafikiri niko natania?
target_text_raw: Je! Unafikiri niko natania?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont sûrement perdu leur chemin, autrement ils seraient déjà arrivés depuis longtemps.
target_text: Inapashwa kuwa walipotea jana, kama sivyo wangekuwa wamishafika tangu zamani sana.
target_text_raw: Inapashwa kuwa walipotea jana, kama sivyo wangekuwa wamishafika tangu zamani sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un expert est une personne qui évite les petites erreurs tout en dérapant dans les plus grandes illusions.
target_text: Mtaalamu ni mtu anayeepuka makosa ya kidogo na kuigia kwenye uongo mkubwa.
target_text_raw: Mtaalamu ni mtu anayeepuka makosa ya kidogo na kuigia kwenye uongo mkubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette blessure ressemble à une morsure d'araignée.
target_text: Iyi kidonda inaonekana kama kulumiwa na buibui.
target_text_raw: Iyi kidonda inaonekana kama kulumiwa na buibui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne pense jamais qu'on ira à la guerre et qu'on finira par tomber sous un tir ami.
target_text: Mtu anajuwake kama anaweza enda ku vita na kukufa kwa kupigwa lisasi na adui.
target_text_raw: Mtu anajuwake kama anaweza enda ku vita na kukufa kwa kupigwa lisasi na adui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Travaillez avec davantage d'application, si vous voulez réussir !
target_text: Fanya kazi kwa bidii zaidi kama unataka kufaulu!
target_text_raw: Fanya kazi kwa bidii zaidi kama unataka kufaulu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous vous souvenez d'avoir entendu des cris cette nuit-là ?
target_text: Je! Unakumbuka kusikia zile fujo mwa ile busiku?
target_text_raw: Je! Unakumbuka kusikia zile fujo mwa ile busiku?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais en vain il veut fuir : sur sa troupe tremblante / les armes à la main nous fondons en fureur ; / l'ignorance des lieux, leur ténébreuse horreur, / la surprise, l'effroi, tout enfin nous les livre.
target_text: Lakini anataka kukimbia bure: kwa kikosi yake yenye kutetemeka na boga / silaha mu mikono tulipatwa na hasira; / kutojuwa mahali, hofu yabo ya giza, / mshangao, hofu, walitupatia kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Lakini anataka kukimbia bure: kwa kikosi yake yenye kutetemeka na boga / silaha mu mikono tulipatwa na hasira; / kutojuwa mahali, hofu yabo ya giza, / mshangao, hofu, walitupatia kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez savoir qu'on ne répond pas à son employeur.
target_text: Unapashwa jua kama abajibiyake mukobwa yako wa kazi.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa jua kama abajibiyake mukobwa yako wa kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hmm, c'est une bonne idée. Allons-y.
target_text: Hmm, iyo ni wazo ya muzuri. Twende.
target_text_raw: Hmm, iyo ni wazo ya muzuri. Twende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Reculez un peu.
target_text: Rudia nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Rudia nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez avancer au fond du bus.
target_text: Tafazali songa ndani ya bisi.
target_text_raw: Tafazali songa ndani ya bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une personne bilingue est en mesure de passer d'une langue à l'autre au milieu d'une phrase et ce changement de code est un sujet d'étude pour les linguistes.
target_text: Mtu anayezungumza luga mbili anaweza kubadilisha luga moya kwenda ingine mu phase moya na iyi mabadiliko ya kanuni ni mada ya utafiti ya wataalumu wa luga.
target_text_raw: Mtu anayezungumza luga mbili anaweza kubadilisha luga moya kwenda ingine mu phase moya na iyi mabadiliko ya kanuni ni mada ya utafiti ya wataalumu wa luga (linguistes).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis rentrée un peu tard, cette nuit.
target_text: Nilifika ku nyumba nyuma kidogo, ile busiku.
target_text_raw: Nilifika ku nyumba nyuma kidogo, ile busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'information présentée dans l'article de Kelly sur la coordination des couleurs est considérée comme étant utile dans l'élaboration d'une théorie alternative.
target_text: Habari yenye ilitangazwa ndani ya article ya Kelly juu ya kuchanga ma rangi ilionekana kuwa muhimu kuunda wazo mupya ya kusaidia.
target_text_raw: Habari yenye ilitangazwa ndani ya article ya Kelly juu ya kuchanga ma rangi ilionekana kuwa muhimu kuunda wazo mupya ya kusaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne jouez pas l'innocente !
target_text: Usijifanye haujui!
target_text_raw: Usijifanye haujui!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez, ne partez pas.
target_text: Ngojea, usiende.
target_text_raw: Ngojea, usiende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a fallu un bon moment pour construire ce garage.
target_text: Iliomba muda mrefu kwa kujenga iyi garage.
target_text_raw: Iliomba muda mrefu kwa kujenga iyi garage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun dispose du droit, seul ou avec d'autres, de s'exprimer par écrit au moyen d'une pétition, d'une réclamation ou d'une proposition à n'importe quel organe assurant les pouvoirs publics.
target_text: Kila mtu iko na haki, peke yake ao na bengine, ya kujitetea kwa kuandika ao kwa kupitia ombi ya batu bengi, ya malalamiko ao pendekezo kwa chombo yoyote yenye kuwa na mamlaka ya kiserkali.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu iko na haki, peke yake ao na bengine, ya kujitetea kwa kuandika ao kwa kupitia ombi ya batu bengi, ya malalamiko ao pendekezo kwa chombo yoyote yenye kuwa na mamlaka ya kiserkali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des gamins qui volaient des pêches dans le jardin s’étaient enfuis silencieusement par les trous de la haie.
target_text: Batoto benye balikuwa naiba tunda ya peches mu bustani balikimbia kwa ufichi kupitia tundu ya lupango.
target_text_raw: Batoto benye balikuwa naiba tunda ya peches mu bustani balikimbia kwa ufichi kupitia tundu ya lupango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez être fière de ce que vous avez accompli.
target_text: Unapashwa kujivunia kile chenye unatimiza.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kujivunia kile chenye unatimiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aura sûrement la puce à l'oreille si je suis avec toi.
target_text: Atashakiwa kitu kama niko pamoja na weye.
target_text_raw: Atashakiwa kitu kama niko pamoja na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est dur de faire des prédictions, surtout concernant le futur !
target_text: Ni vigumu kutabiri, sana sana juu ya siku zijazo!
target_text_raw: Ni vigumu kutabiri, sana sana juu ya siku zijazo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah, l'argent ! Il me procure un plaisir divin, plonger dedans comme un phoque et m'y enfouir comme une taupe, et le balancer en l'air pour qu'il me crépite sur le crâne !
target_text: Ah, pesa! Inanipa raha ya kimungu, kuzama ndani kama vile mnyama phoque na kujizika ndani yake kama vile mnyama taupe, na kuirusha yulu juu ipasukie yulu ya kichwa yangu!
target_text_raw: Ah, pesa! Inanipa raha ya kimungu, kuzama ndani kama vile mnyama phoque na kujizika ndani yake kama vile mnyama taupe, na kuirusha yulu juu ipasukie yulu ya kichwa yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son revenu fut diminué de moitié après sa mise à la retraite.
target_text: Pato yake ulipunguzwa nusu kisha kuacha kazi na kwenda kupumuzika.
target_text_raw: Pato yake ulipunguzwa nusu kisha kuacha kazi na kwenda kupumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce bus est-il à destination de Park Ridge?
target_text: Iyi bisi hii inaenda Park Ridge?
target_text_raw: Iyi bisi hii inaenda Park Ridge?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’hôtel était sympa, mais bonjour l’accueil ! Le personnel était exécrable.
target_text: Hoteli ilikuwa muzuri, lakini jambo wa kukaribisha! Wafanyakazi walikuwa wabaya.
target_text_raw: Hoteli ilikuwa muzuri, lakini jambo wa kukaribisha (accueil)! Wafanyakazi walikuwa wabaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’aurais dû bosser mon français plus sérieusement.
target_text: Nilipashwa kuboresha luga ya Kifaransa zaidi.
target_text_raw: Nilipashwa kuboresha luga ya Kifaransa zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chut ! Marie dort !
target_text: Nyamanza! Maria analala!
target_text_raw: Nyamanza! Maria analala!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se bat le dos au mur dans cette élection.
target_text: Anagonga mgongo ku kibambazi mwa iyi uchaguzi.
target_text_raw: Anagonga mgongo ku kibambazi mwa iyi uchaguzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Mais vous ne pourrez pas vous fixer sur ses bords, / que, pressés par la faim, dans votre rage extrême / vous n'ayez dévoré jusqu'à vos tables même. "
target_text: "Lakini hauwezi weza kujitengeneza karibu yake, / kwamba, kukimbizwa juu ya njala, kwa hasira yako kali / hauyakula mpaka meza zako pia. "
target_text_raw: "Lakini hauwezi weza kujitengeneza karibu yake, / kwamba, kukimbizwa juu ya njala, kwa hasira yako kali / hauyakula mpaka meza zako pia. "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le lait, c'est de la nourriture pour bébés.
target_text: Maziwa ni chakula ya watoto.
target_text_raw: Maziwa ni chakula ya watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu donnes l'impression d'être heureux.
target_text: Unaonesha sawa vile uko furaha.
target_text_raw: Unaonesha sawa vile uko furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La caractéristique la plus significative de la civilisation moderne est le sacrifice de l'avenir au présent, et toute la puissance de la science a été prostituée à cet effet.
target_text: Kitu muhimu zaidi ya usirimi ya kisasa ni kujitowa ya siku zijazo kwa siku za leo, na nguvu zote za sayansi ziliharibika juu ya iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Kitu muhimu zaidi ya usirimi ya kisasa ni kujitowa ya siku zijazo kwa siku za leo, na nguvu zote za sayansi ziliharibika juu ya iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous faites pas de soucis ! Tout ira bien.
target_text: Usijali! Kila kitu itakua muzuri.
target_text_raw: Usijali! Kila kitu itakua muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Occupons Wall Street est en train de faire évoluer le discours de Barack Obama.
target_text: Wall Street iko nabadilisha hotuba ya Barack Obama.
target_text_raw: Wall Street iko nabadilisha hotuba ya Barack Obama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On devrait toujours se voir comme des gens qui vont mourir le lendemain. C'est ce temps qu'on croit avoir devant soi qui vous tue.
target_text: Tunapashwa kujiona kila mara kama watu ambao watakufa siku ya kufuata. Iyi njo wakati ambao unafikiria kuwa mbele yako njo inakuuwaka.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa kujiona kila mara kama watu ambao watakufa siku ya kufuata. Iyi njo wakati ambao unafikiria kuwa mbele yako njo inakuuwaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous entendez l'alarme, marchez, ne courez pas.
target_text: Ukisikia alarme, tembea, usikimbie.
target_text_raw: Ukisikia alarme, tembea, usikimbie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'a pas envie que tu lui racontes votre vie sexuelle.
target_text: Hataki umwambie kuhusu maisha yako ya ngono.
target_text_raw: Hataki umwambie kuhusu maisha yako ya ngono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Eau froide, savon, air pur sont les meilleurs médecins.
target_text: Maji ya baridi, sabuni, hewa safi ni waganga bora.
target_text_raw: Maji ya baridi, sabuni, hewa safi ni waganga bora.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu aimes les histoires de fantômes ?
target_text: Unapendeka hadisi za mizimu?
target_text_raw: Unapendeka hadisi za mizimu (mizuka)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu le chien de mon voisin tourner en rond dans la cour.
target_text: Niliona imbwa ya jirani yangu iko nazunguruka zunguruka mu kiwanja.
target_text_raw: Niliona imbwa ya jirani yangu iko nazunguruka zunguruka mu kiwanja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bâtiment que vous voyez actuellement devant vous est supposé être le plus grand bureau de poste du monde.
target_text: Iyi jengo yenye uko naona hivi mbele yako njo inapshwa kuwa biro ya posta kubwa zaidi mu dunia.
target_text_raw: Iyi jengo yenye uko naona hivi mbele yako njo inapshwa kuwa biro ya posta kubwa zaidi mu dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous en supplie. Je ferai tout ce que vous voulez !
target_text: Minakuomba. Nitafanya kila kitu yenye unataka!
target_text_raw: Minakuomba. Nitafanya kila kitu yenye unataka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Adam doit s'inquiéter pour lui-même.
target_text: Lazima Adamu iko na wasiwasi juu yake mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Lazima Adamu iko na wasiwasi juu yake mwenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ma tournée !
target_text: Ni turu yangu!
target_text_raw: Ni turu yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la continuité de la grande logique des services publics, le secrétariat du lycée est fermé pendant midi, seul moment où les élèves ont du temps de libre.
target_text: Ndani ya mtazamo kubwa ya huduma ya serkali, sekreteria ya shule ya segondari inafungwaka midi, wakati pekee yenye wanafunzi wanakuwaka na temps libre.
target_text_raw: Ndani ya mtazamo kubwa ya huduma ya serkali, sekreteria ya shule ya segondari (lycée) inafungwaka midi, wakati pekee yenye wanafunzi wanakuwaka na temps libre.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'aimez pas les chats et c'est faux.
target_text: Haupendaki pusi na ni bongo.
target_text_raw: Haupendaki pusi na ni bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégagez d'ici, il n'y a rien à voir !
target_text: Mutoke hapa, hakuna bya kuona!
target_text_raw: Mutoke hapa, hakuna bya kuona!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cornique ressemble au gallois et encore plus au breton, qui provient en fait de la langue des anciens britanniques, lesquels, au haut Moyen Âge, fuirent vers le territoire français de l'actuelle Bretagne.
target_text: Luga ya cornique inafanana na luga ya Gallois na pia zaidi luga ya Breton, yenye inatokea mu luga ya Waingereza wa zamani, ambao zama za kale, walikimbilia eneo ya Ufaransa kutoka eneo ambao sasa ni Bretagne.
target_text_raw: Luga ya cornique inafanana na luga ya Gallois na pia zaidi luga ya Breton, yenye inatokea mu luga ya Waingereza wa zamani, ambao zama za kale, walikimbilia eneo ya Ufaransa kutoka eneo ambao sasa ni Bretagne.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soleil se voila.
target_text: Jua inalala.
target_text_raw: Jua inalala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est occupée à taper des rapports.
target_text: Anapitisha mdaa yake kwa kuandika ma rapports kwenye ordinateur.
target_text_raw: Anapitisha mdaa yake kwa kuandika ma rapports kwenye ordinateur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela représente une sacrée tâche que d'enlever cette tache.
target_text: Ni kazi kubwa kabisa kuondoa iyi tache.
target_text_raw: Ni kazi kubwa kabisa kuondoa iyi tache (doa).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La liste des endroits que j'aimerais visiter au Venezuela est simplement sans fin.
target_text: Liste ya ma eneo yenye ningependa kutembelea huko Venezuela haina mwisho.
target_text_raw: Liste ya ma eneo yenye ningependa kutembelea huko Venezuela haina mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette barre de fer est devenu complètement rouillée.
target_text: Iyi chuma ilishaingiaka ako kutu kabisa.
target_text_raw: Iyi chuma ilishaingiaka ako kutu kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La parole ne représente parfois qu'une manière, plus adroite que le silence, de se taire.
target_text: Wakati mwingine neno inamaanishaka kitu moya, yenye kuzidi ukimya, ya kuikala kimya.
