source_text: La soirée d'hier était géniale, pas vrai ?
target_text: Mangaribi ya jana ilikuwa ya muzuri sana, haiko ivyo?
target_text_raw: Mangaribi ya jana ilikuwa ya muzuri sana, haiko ivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie est en train de vérifier ses messages sur son téléphone.
target_text: Marie iko naangalia ujumbe wake kwenye téléphone yake.
target_text_raw: Marie iko naangalia ujumbe wake kwenye téléphone yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je retourne avec mon ex petite amie.
target_text: Minarudiana na mpenzi wangu wa zamani.
target_text_raw: Minarudiana na mpenzi wangu wa zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La direction a menacé de mettre les employés en lock-out s'ils n'acceptaient pas les changements.
target_text: Uongozi ilitishia kusimamisha kazi kama wanafanyakazi hawatakubali mabadiliko.
target_text_raw: Uongozi ilitishia kusimamisha kazi kama wanafanyakazi hawatakubali mabadiliko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu veux que je recommence ?
target_text: Unataka nianze bupya?
target_text_raw: Unataka nianze bupya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est en effet curieux.
target_text: Kwa kweli ni ya kuchunguza.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli ni ya kuchunguza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lucy est sûre de venir.
target_text: Lucy iko na uhakika ya kukuya.
target_text_raw: Lucy iko na uhakika ya kukuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que Mathéo était impliqué.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama Mathéo aliusika.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama Mathéo aliusika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le parking ne coûte absolument rien.
target_text: Parking haina gharama yoyote.
target_text_raw: Parking haina gharama yoyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme je venais leur rendre visite à leur domicile, le couple était au milieu d'une dispute.
target_text: Nilipokuya kuwatembelea kwabo ku nyumba, bibi na bwana balikuwa mu mabishano.
target_text_raw: Nilipokuya kuwatembelea kwabo ku nyumba, bibi na bwana balikuwa mu mabishano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À mon chef de campagne, David Plouffe ! Le héros méconnu de cette campagne, qui a construit la meilleure, la meilleure campagne politique, je pense, dans l'histoire des États-Unis d'Amérique.
target_text: Kwa kiongozi wangu wa kampeni, David Plouffe! Shujaa asiyejulikana mwa iyi kampeni, ambaye aliunda kampeni bora zaidi, kampeni bora ya kisiasa, nazani, katika historia ya Marekani.
target_text_raw: Kwa kiongozi wangu wa kampeni, David Plouffe! Shujaa asiyejulikana mwa iyi kampeni, ambaye aliunda kampeni bora zaidi, kampeni bora ya kisiasa, nazani, katika historia ya Marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai eu une soirée absolument merveilleuse. Mais pas celle-ci.
target_text: Nilipitisha mangaribi ya muzuri kabisa. Lakini haiko iyi.
target_text_raw: Nilipitisha mangaribi ya muzuri kabisa. Lakini haiko iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu plaisantes ou tu es sérieuse ?
target_text: Unatania ao uko serieux ?
target_text_raw: Unatania ao uko serieux ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne hais personne, pas même le méchant. Plains-le, car il ne connaîtra jamais la seule jouissance qui console de vivre : faire le bien.
target_text: Usichukie mtu yeyote, hata mtu mbaya. Umufanyie mema, juu hatajuaka ata siku moya raha moya inayofariji maisha: kufanya mema.
target_text_raw: Usichukie mtu yeyote, hata mtu mbaya. Umufanyie mema, juu hatajuaka ata siku moya raha moya inayofariji maisha: kufanya mema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le contraste saute immédiatement aux yeux.
target_text: Tafauti inaonekana ku macho mara moja.
target_text_raw: Tafauti inaonekana ku macho mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai toujours voulu le tenter.
target_text: Siku zote nilitaka kuijaribu.
target_text_raw: Siku zote nilitaka kuijaribu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La femme de Sami a su pour la liaison.
target_text: Muke wa Sami alijua jkuhusu iyo jambo.
target_text_raw: Muke wa Sami alijua jkuhusu iyo jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ta chambre est-elle rose, Hugo? - Ho! Avant c'était la chambre de ma sœur.
target_text: Juu ya nini chumba chako iko rangi ya rose, Hugo? - Ho! Ilikuwaka chumba ya dada yangu.
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini chumba chako iko rangi ya rose, Hugo? - Ho! Ilikuwaka chumba ya dada yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûrs que vous ne vouliez pas que je vienne avec vous ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kama haukutaka niende nawe?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kama haukutaka niende nawe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas la moindre connaissance en matière de pêche.
target_text: Sina hata ujuzi kidogo mu uvuvi.
target_text_raw: Sina hata ujuzi kidogo mu uvuvi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsqu'enfin les barrières linguistiques tomberont, il ne restera plus que les barrières économiques et politiques. C'est encore plus atroce.
target_text: Wakati mipaka ya luga itaanguka, kutakuwaka tu mipaka ya kiuchumi na kisiasa. Ni ya mubaya zaidi.
target_text_raw: Wakati mipaka ya luga itaanguka, kutakuwaka tu mipaka ya kiuchumi na kisiasa. Ni ya mubaya zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce seigneur avait une fierté convenable à un homme qui portait tant de noms.
target_text: Bwana huyu alikuwa na kiburi kinachostahili mtu aliye kuwa na majina mingi.
target_text_raw: Bwana huyu alikuwa na kiburi kinachostahili mtu aliye kuwa na majina mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ben si, la preuve.
target_text: Ben ndio, ushahidi.
target_text_raw: Ben ndio, ushahidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous acceptons de réaliser une baisse de prix de 5% à condition que cela vous aide à développer un nouveau marché pour nos produits.
target_text: Tunaitika kupunguza bei mpaka 5% lakini kwa sharti ya kusema ikusaidie kuendelesha soko mpya ya biashara yetu.
target_text_raw: Tunaitika kupunguza bei mpaka 5% lakini kwa sharti ya kusema ikusaidie kuendelesha soko mpya ya biashara yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus tu travailles, plus ton patron gagne.
target_text: Zaidi unafanya kazi, zaidi patron wako anafaidika.
target_text_raw: Zaidi unafanya kazi, zaidi patron wako anafaidika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis à la moitié de ce roman policier.
target_text: Niko katikati ya iyi roman ya kipolisi.
target_text_raw: Niko katikati ya iyi roman ya kipolisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il laissa filer la corde.
target_text: Aliachilia ile kamba.
target_text_raw: Aliachilia ile kamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous vous en sortir saine et sauve ?
target_text: Unaweza toka amo bila shida yeyote?
target_text_raw: Unaweza toka amo bila shida yeyote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Selon les définitions de la loi, chacun dispose du droit à la compensation des dommages qui lui sont illégalement causés par les instances au cours de l'exercice de leur tâche.
target_text: Kulingana na ufafanuzi wa sheria, kila mutu iko na haki ya kulipwa kutokana na uharibifu yenye kusababishwa na kinyume ya sheria na wafanya sheria wanapokuwa nafanya kazi yabo.
target_text_raw: Kulingana na ufafanuzi wa sheria, kila mutu iko na haki ya kulipwa kutokana na uharibifu yenye kusababishwa na kinyume ya sheria na wafanya sheria wanapokuwa nafanya kazi yabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hey, que penses-tu être en train de faire ?
target_text: Hee, unawaza uko nafanya nini?
target_text_raw: Hee, unawaza uko nafanya nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoutez, messieurs.
target_text: Musikilie, banaume.
target_text_raw: Musikilie, banaume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est plus tard que tu ne penses.
target_text: Ilishakuwa nyuma kuliko gisi unafikiria.
target_text_raw: Ilishakuwa nyuma kuliko gisi unafikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai rencontré un type génial.
target_text: Nilikutanana na mutu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Nilikutanana na mutu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chou blanc, le chou-fleur, le brocoli et le chou de Bruxelles sont tous des variétés de la même sorte de plante.
target_text: Chou ya mweupe, chou-fleur, brocoli, na chou ya Bruxelles zote ni aina moya ya mumea.
target_text_raw: Chou ya mweupe, chou-fleur, brocoli, na chou ya Bruxelles zote ni aina moya ya mumea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le son d'un baiser n'est pas aussi fort que celui d'un canon, mais son écho dure beaucoup plus longtemps.
target_text: Sauti ya bizu haikuwaki ya mkubwa kama ya bunduki, lakini sauti yake inadumu sana.
target_text_raw: Sauti ya bizu haikuwaki ya mkubwa kama ya bunduki, lakini sauti yake inadumu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chien s'est libéré très facilement du collier.
target_text: Imbwa ilijifungula kwa urahisi mwa ile collier.
target_text_raw: Imbwa ilijifungula kwa urahisi mwa ile collier.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a du sable au fond de l'océan.
target_text: Piko muchanga chini ya bahari.
target_text_raw: Piko muchanga chini ya bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que vous seriez partis et m'auriez quitté.
target_text: Niliwaza kama ungeenda kisha uniache.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza kama ungeenda kisha uniache.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il insiste pour se souvenir de chacun de nos anniversaires.
target_text: Anasisitiza kukumbuka kila siku zetu za kuzaliwa.
target_text_raw: Anasisitiza kukumbuka kila siku zetu za kuzaliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne touchez pas à l'ordinateur.
target_text: Usiguse ku ordinateur.
target_text_raw: Usiguse ku ordinateur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon essayait de bouger le lourd canapé.
target_text: Ule kijana alikuwa najaribu kusogeza ile kiti ya diva.
target_text_raw: Ule kijana alikuwa najaribu kusogeza ile kiti ya diva.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'appelle Maria Sara.
target_text: Jina yangu ni Maria Sara.
target_text_raw: Jina yangu ni Maria Sara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais, si son cerveau est brûlé, il ne pensera plus, ne parlera plus et n'entendra plus jamais.
target_text: Lakini, kama kichwa yake inalungula, hatawazaka tena, hataongeaka tena na hatasikiaka tena.
target_text_raw: Lakini, kama kichwa yake inalungula, hatawazaka tena, hataongeaka tena na hatasikiaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai simplement supposé que tout irait bien.
target_text: Niliwaza kama kila kitu kitakuwa sawa.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza kama kila kitu kitakuwa sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous m'en voyez navré.
target_text: Unaniona gisi minasikitika.
target_text_raw: Unaniona gisi minasikitika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne pensez jamais que vous savez tout.
target_text: Usiwaze kama unajua kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Usiwaze kama unajua kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Engagé contre l'apartheid, « le Zoulou blanc » s'est fait connaître grâce à ses airs universels de partage, des chansons soutenant la solidarité entre les hommes et entre les peuples.
target_text: Alijitolea kugombanisha apartheid, "Mzungu wa Kizulu" alijulikana kwa tabia yake ya kuchangiya, nyimbo zinazounga mukono mshikamano kati ya watu na kati ya jamii.
target_text_raw: Alijitolea kugombanisha apartheid, "Mzungu wa Kizulu" alijulikana kwa tabia yake ya kuchangiya, nyimbo zinazounga mukono mshikamano kati ya watu na kati ya jamii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as gagné son coeur.
target_text: Ulishinda roho yake.
target_text_raw: Ulishinda roho yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu arrêtes ça immédiatement.
target_text: Nataka uachana na iyo mara moja.
target_text_raw: Nataka uachana na iyo mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous venons de nettoyer les toilettes.
target_text: Tunatoka kusukula ma toillettes.
target_text_raw: Tunatoka kusukula ma toillettes.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Surtout pas de panique, Jules ! Après tout, nous ne sommes pas des débutants !
target_text: Na sana sana, usiogope, Jules! Baada ya yote, hatuko ba débutants!
target_text_raw: Na sana sana, usiogope, Jules! Baada ya yote, hatuko ba débutants (baanzamwaka)!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les données citées dans l'enquête de King proviennent du livre blanc de l'UNESCO de 1970 sur la population mondiale.
target_text: Habari zenye zilitajwa katika uchunguzi ya King zinatoka mu kitabu mweupe ya UNESCO ya mwaka 1970 kuhusu ya idadi ya batu mu dunia.
target_text_raw: Habari zenye zilitajwa katika uchunguzi ya King zinatoka mu kitabu mweupe ya UNESCO ya mwaka 1970 kuhusu ya idadi ya batu mu dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia fut triste lorsqu'il découvrit que Marie était une croqueuse de diamants et Marie fut triste lorsqu'elle découvrit que Kylia était pauvre.
target_text: Kylia alihuzunika alipogundua kama Marie alikuwaka natafuta diamants na Marie alihuzunika alipogundua kama Kylia alikuwa maskini.
target_text_raw: Kylia alihuzunika alipogundua kama Marie alikuwaka natafuta diamants na Marie alihuzunika alipogundua kama Kylia alikuwa maskini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Depuis hier, mon ordinateur se conduit comme s'il était devenu cinglé.
target_text: Tangu jana, ordinateur yangu iko nafanya sawa yenye ilisha pata bwendabazimu.
target_text_raw: Tangu jana, ordinateur yangu iko nafanya sawa yenye ilisha pata bwendabazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les parents de Bernadette ont immédiatement téléphoné à leurs deux autres enfants pour leur annoncer la triste nouvelle.
target_text: Mara moja bazazi ya Bernadette bali telephoner bengine batoto yabo bawili kwa kuwapatia iyo habari ya kusikitisha.
target_text_raw: Mara moja bazazi ya Bernadette bali telephoner bengine batoto yabo bawili kwa kuwapatia iyo habari ya kusikitisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La seule vraie science est la connaissance des faits.
target_text: Sayansi ya kweli ni kujuwa ukweli.
target_text_raw: Sayansi ya kweli ni kujuwa ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu aimes le miel, ne crains pas les abeilles.
target_text: Ukipenda asali, usiogope nyuki.
target_text_raw: Ukipenda asali, usiogope nyuki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a un casier aussi long que mon bras.
target_text: Iko na kesi ya murefu kuzidi mukono yangu.
target_text_raw: Iko na kesi ya murefu kuzidi mukono yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez un sandwich, levez la main.
target_text: Kama unataka sandwich, nyorosha mukono.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka sandwich, nyorosha mukono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu arrives trop tard pour le cours.
target_text: Unafika ku masomo unachelewa.
target_text_raw: Unafika ku masomo unachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous retournez surtout pas !
target_text: Usiangalie nyuma!
target_text_raw: Usiangalie nyuma!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Désolée, je ne le fais pas sans tes potes.
target_text: Samahani, siwezi fanya hivi bila barafiki yako.
target_text_raw: Samahani, siwezi fanya hivi bila barafiki yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais si une femme éprouve un sentiment particulier pour un homme et ne cherche pas à le cacher, c’est à lui à le découvrir.
target_text: Lakini kama mwanamuke anavutia na mwanamume na hajaribu kuficha, ni mwanaume njo anapashwa gundua.
target_text_raw: Lakini kama mwanamuke anavutia na mwanamume na hajaribu kuficha, ni mwanaume njo anapashwa gundua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chéri, je peux te l'expliquer !
target_text: Mpenzi, naweza kukuelezea!
target_text_raw: Mpenzi, naweza kukuelezea!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les planètes sont faciles à identifier parce qu'elles ne scintillent pas comme le font les étoiles.
target_text: Ni rahisi kutambua planètes kwa sababu haziangari kama nyota.
target_text_raw: Ni rahisi kutambua planètes kwa sababu haziangari kama nyota.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour autant que je sache, elle est encore célibataire.
target_text: Kwa gisi minajua, angali celibataire.
target_text_raw: Kwa gisi minajua, angali celibataire.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce type de livre devrait être à sa portée.
target_text: Angepashwa kuwa na iyi aina ya kitabu.
target_text_raw: Angepashwa kuwa na iyi aina ya kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voyez ma fleur ?
target_text: Unaona liua yangu?
target_text_raw: Unaona liua yangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout homme a le droit de se tromper. Cependant, n'importe quelle erreur n'est pas pardonnable.
target_text: Kila mutu iko na haki ya kufanya makosa. Lakini, hakuna kosa yenye inaweza samehewa.
target_text_raw: Kila mutu iko na haki ya kufanya makosa. Lakini, hakuna kosa yenye inaweza samehewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que vous me disiez tout ce que vous savez à ce sujet.
target_text: Nataka uniambie kila kitu chenye unajua kuhusu iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Nataka uniambie kila kitu chenye unajua kuhusu iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans certains pays, les victimes de viol sont contraintes d'épouser leur agresseurs, ce qui les mène fréquemment au suicide.
target_text: Mu nchi zingine, wahanga wa ubakaji wanalazimishwa kuoa washambuliaji wao, na mara mingi hii inatuma wanajinyonga.
target_text_raw: Mu nchi zingine, wahanga wa ubakaji wanalazimishwa kuoa washambuliaji wao, na mara mingi hii inatuma wanajinyonga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous permettez, nous allons fouiller vos bagages.
target_text: Kama unaniruhusu, tunataka controle muzigo yako.
target_text_raw: Kama unaniruhusu, tunataka controle muzigo yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la famille d’Alceste, on respecte les bonnes manières à table.
target_text: Katika familia ya Alceste, tunaheshimia tabia muzuri wakati ya kula ku meza.
target_text_raw: Katika familia ya Alceste, tunaheshimia tabia muzuri wakati ya kula ku meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui connait ce type ?
target_text: Nani mwenye anajua huyu mutu?
target_text_raw: Nani mwenye anajua huyu mutu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Envoyez vos bagages en avance.
target_text: Tuma mizigo yako mapema.
target_text_raw: Tuma mizigo yako mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es venue trop tard.
target_text: Ulifika unachelewa sana.
target_text_raw: Ulifika unachelewa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Les policiers parisiens, dit-il, sont extrêmement habiles à leur façon. Ils sont persévérants, ingénieux, rusés et très savants du type de connaissance que semble principalement requérir leurs fonctions."
target_text: "Ba polisi ba Paris, alisema, wana ujuzi mingi mu namna yabo. Banavumilia, bako na busara, ujanja, na banajua sana aina ya ujuzi yenye kazi yabo kubwa inahitaji. "
target_text_raw: "Ba polisi ba Paris, alisema, wana ujuzi mingi mu namna yabo. Banavumilia, bako na busara, ujanja, na banajua sana aina ya ujuzi yenye kazi yabo kubwa inahitaji. "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais organiser une réunion du personnel demain en début d'après-midi, donc pourriez-vous réserver la salle de conférence ?
target_text: Ningependa kutayarisha mkutano wa wafanyikazi kesho mwanzo ya après-midi, kwa hivyo unaweza ku reserver chumba ya mkutano?
target_text_raw: Ningependa kutayarisha mkutano wa wafanyikazi kesho mwanzo ya après-midi, kwa hivyo unaweza ku reserver chumba ya mkutano?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas de condition humaine, pour humble ou misérable qu'elle soit, qui n'ait quotidiennement la proposition du bonheur : pour l'atteindre, rien n'est nécessaire que soi-même.
target_text: Haiko hali ya kibinadamu, kwa unyenyekevu ao ya kusikitisha, ambayo haina kila siku maoni ya furaha: kuifikilia, hakuna kitu ya lazima isipokuwa weye mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Haiko hali ya kibinadamu, kwa unyenyekevu ao ya kusikitisha, ambayo haina kila siku maoni ya furaha: kuifikilia, hakuna kitu ya lazima isipokuwa weye mwenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il réfléchissait si profondément qu’il ne pensait pas à mordre dans une tartine de pain et de lait caillé que sa mère lui avait donnée pour son déjeuner.
target_text: Alikuwa nafikiria sana kama hakufikiria kuluma kipande ya mkate na maziwa ya kugandana yenye mama yake alimupatia juu ya dejeuner.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nafikiria sana kama hakufikiria kuluma kipande ya mkate na maziwa ya kugandana yenye mama yake alimupatia juu ya dejeuner.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne m'appelle pas M. Ricardo mais simplement Ricardo ou Rick.
target_text: Jina yangu siyo Bwana Ricardo lakini Ricardo tu ao Rick.
target_text_raw: Jina yangu siyo Bwana Ricardo lakini Ricardo tu ao Rick.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ennemi a largué beaucoup de bombes sur l'usine.
target_text: Adui alitupa ma bombe ya mingi ku kiwanda.
target_text_raw: Adui alitupa ma bombe ya mingi ku kiwanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous me répéter quand la réunion est censée démarrer ?
target_text: Unaweza kuniambia tena wakati mkutano inatakiwa kuanza?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuniambia tena wakati mkutano inatakiwa kuanza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pose ton chapeau et ton pardessus dans le hall.
target_text: Tiya shapo yako na koti yako mu salle.
target_text_raw: Tiya shapo yako na koti yako mu salle.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne devriez pas vous approcher de mon chien pendant qu'il mange.
target_text: Haupashwi kukaribia mbwa yangu wakati iko nakula.
target_text_raw: Haupashwi kukaribia mbwa yangu wakati iko nakula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut que tu sois à la gare à minuit pile.
target_text: Unapashwa fika ku kituo saa sita usiku kamili ya busiku.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa fika ku kituo saa sita usiku kamili ya busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont-ils le droit à se faire soigner dans des hôpitaux ?
target_text: Wapalestina wako na haki ya kupata matibabu mu ma hopital?
target_text_raw: Wapalestina wako na haki ya kupata matibabu mu ma hopital?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami est entré aux urgences avec un homme qui avait été poignardé.
target_text: Sami aliingia mu chumba ya matunzo ya haraka haraka na mwanaume mwenye alikuwa nachomwa kisu.
target_text_raw: Sami aliingia mu chumba ya matunzo ya haraka haraka na mwanaume mwenye alikuwa nachomwa kisu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela pourrait nous mener à croire qu'une culture simple ferait l'usage d'un langage simple, et qu'une culture compliquée utiliserait un langage compliqué, c'est comme ça.
target_text: Hii inaweza tuma tunaamini kama utamaduni ya kawaida itatumia luga rahisi, na utamaduni ya nguvu itatumia luga ya nguvu, njo ivo.
target_text_raw: Hii inaweza tuma tunaamini kama utamaduni ya kawaida itatumia luga rahisi, na utamaduni ya nguvu itatumia luga ya nguvu, njo ivo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui regarde du dehors à travers une fenêtre ouverte, ne voit jamais autant de choses que celui qui regarde une fenêtre fermée.
target_text: Kila mwenye anaangalia inje kupitia dirisha yenye inafunguliwa, haonaki bitu mingi kama ule mwenye anaangalia kupitia dirisha inayo fungiwa.
target_text_raw: Kila mwenye anaangalia inje kupitia dirisha yenye inafunguliwa, haonaki bitu mingi kama ule mwenye anaangalia kupitia dirisha inayo fungiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai le sentiment que c'est un peu risqué de faire ça.
target_text: Niko nasikia sawa piko hatari kidogo kwa kufanya hivyo.
target_text_raw: Niko nasikia sawa piko hatari kidogo kwa kufanya hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'abord je vous rends l'argent que vous m'avez prêté; deuxièmement je vous remercie pour ce prêt; troisièmement je vous prie de m'en prêter encore ensuite quand j'en aurai besoin.
target_text: Kwanza nitakurudishia pesa zenye ulinikopesha; kisha, minakushukuru kwa iyi mkopo; na kwa mwisho, naomba unikopeshe tena wakati nitakuwa nahitaji.
target_text_raw: Kwanza nitakurudishia pesa zenye ulinikopesha; kisha, minakushukuru kwa iyi mkopo; na kwa mwisho, naomba unikopeshe tena wakati nitakuwa nahitaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vite soufflons la lampe, afin de nous cacher dans les ténèbres!
target_text: Tuzimishe tala haraka juu tujifiche mu giza!
target_text_raw: Tuzimishe tala haraka juu tujifiche mu giza!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enfin, le jour suivant, le noir horizon s'ouvre ; / des monts dans le lointain le sommet se découvre, / et leur vapeur s'élève en tourbillons fumeux.
target_text: Ku mwisho, siku ya kufuata, upeo ya giza inafunguka; / milima inaonekana kwa mbali, / na hewa inapanda yulu mu muzunguko ya moshi.
target_text_raw: Ku mwisho, siku ya kufuata, upeo ya giza inafunguka; / milima inaonekana kwa mbali, / na hewa inapanda yulu mu muzunguko ya moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il préconisait un capitalisme d'Etat aux dépens d'un capitalisme de marché.
target_text: Alikuwa nashauri capitalisme ya serkali kuliko capitalisme ya soko.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nashauri capitalisme ya serkali kuliko capitalisme ya soko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne pointe pas ton arme en direction de quiconque !
target_text: Usielekeze bunduki yako kwa mtu yeyote!
target_text_raw: Usielekeze bunduki yako kwa mtu yeyote!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous en prie, ayez pitié de mon fourreau : si vous continuez, il va rendre sa lame !
target_text: Tafazali, sikilia huruma ya chombo yangu ya kuwekea amo silaha: ukiendelea, atarudisha lame yake!
target_text_raw: Tafazali, sikilia huruma ya chombo yangu ya kuwekea amo silaha: ukiendelea, atarudisha lame yake!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après quelques verres le type n'avait plus mal.
target_text: Baada ya kutumia binywaji kidogo ule mtu hakukuwa na maumivu tena.
target_text_raw: Baada ya kutumia binywaji kidogo ule mtu hakukuwa na maumivu tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon seigneur, qui a tué le dragon, est ici. Je vais commander du vin comme le roi en boit.
target_text: Bwana wangu, mwenye aliuwa dragon, yuko hapa. Nitaagiza divai gisi mfalme anaikunywaka.
target_text_raw: Bwana wangu, mwenye aliuwa dragon, yuko hapa. Nitaagiza divai gisi mfalme anaikunywaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Eh bien, il rêve d'un boulot bien payé dans la capitale, mais je crains qu'il ne revienne vite tout penaud.
target_text: Kweli, analota kazi ya kulipa muzuri ndani ya muji mkuu, lakini niko na wasiwasi asirudie na anasikitika.
target_text_raw: Kweli, analota kazi ya kulipa muzuri ndani ya muji mkuu, lakini niko na wasiwasi asirudie na anasikitika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dû annuler la soirée.
target_text: Nililazimika kuvunja hiyo sherehe.
target_text_raw: Nililazimika kuvunja hiyo sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Catherine y est-elle également allée ?
target_text: Catherine naye alienda kule?
target_text_raw: Catherine naye alienda kule?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Helen est très inquiète pour sa fille.
target_text: Helen iko na wasiwasi sana juu ya binti yake.
target_text_raw: Helen iko na wasiwasi sana juu ya binti yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien que des progrès ont été faits, la plupart des organismes de presse ont informé que les négociations n'ont pas porté leurs fruits, faute de temps.
target_text: Hata kama maendeleo ilifayika, mashirika mingi ya habari ziliambiwa kama mazungumzo haikuzala matunda kwa sababu ya kukosa muda.
target_text_raw: Hata kama maendeleo ilifayika, mashirika mingi ya habari ziliambiwa kama mazungumzo haikuzala matunda kwa sababu ya kukosa muda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un vampire a-t-il un groupe sanguin ?
target_text: Vampire inakuwaka na groupe sanguin?
target_text_raw: Vampire inakuwaka na groupe sanguin?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon oncle est parti au Mexique en 1983 pour n'en jamais revenir.
target_text: Muyomba angu alienda Mexique mnamo mwaka 1983 na hakurudiaka tena.
target_text_raw: Muyomba angu alienda Mexique mnamo mwaka 1983 na hakurudiaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Commencez à amasser du bois de chauffage immédiatement, car nous attendons un hiver très rigoureux !
target_text: Anza kulogota makuni ya kupiga mara moja, sababu tuko nachung hiver kali sana!
target_text_raw: Anza kulogota makuni ya kupiga mara moja, sababu tuko nachung hiver (saison ya baridi) kali sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai de bonnes raisons de ne pas apprécier Jules.
target_text: Niko na sababu muzuri za kutokupenda Jules.
target_text_raw: Niko na sababu muzuri za kutokupenda Jules.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le secret de la dialectique d'Hegel repose ultimement uniquement dans ceci, qu'elle nie la théologie par la philosophie pour ensuite nier la philosophie par la théologie.
target_text: Siri ya kusadikisha ya Hegel inaundwa tu katika hii, inakana teolojia kupitia filozofi na kisha inakana filozofi kupitia teolojia.
target_text_raw: Siri ya kusadikisha ya Hegel inaundwa tu katika hii, inakana teolojia kupitia filozofi na kisha inakana filozofi kupitia teolojia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reviens juste de ma séance de natation du matin.
target_text: Minatoka kwenye somo yangu ya kuogelea ya asubui.
target_text_raw: Minatoka kwenye somo yangu ya kuogelea ya asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Servir chaude ou froide avec de la crème, de la crème glacée, ou de la sauce à la vanille.
target_text: Kupana ya moto ao baridi na crème, crème ya baridi, ao supu ya vanille.
target_text_raw: Kupana ya moto ao baridi na crème, crème ya baridi, ao supu ya vanille.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils donnent un grand bal à l'ambassade américaine ce soir.
target_text: Watafanya fete ya mukubwa kwenye Ubalozi wa Marekani mangaribi ya leo.
target_text_raw: Watafanya fete (bal) ya mukubwa kwenye Ubalozi wa Marekani mangaribi ya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Is sentaient qu’ils avaient beaucoup de choses à se dire en secret.
target_text: Balikuwa nasikia sawa biko na bitu mingi ya kuambiana kwa siri.
target_text_raw: Balikuwa nasikia sawa biko na bitu mingi ya kuambiana kwa siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vous interroger au sujet d'une de vos étudiantes.
target_text: Ningependa kukuuliza kuhusu umoja mu banafunzi yako.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kukuuliza kuhusu umoja mu banafunzi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Deux promeneurs se sont perdus dans la forêt. Quand les sauveteurs les ont retrouvés quelques semaines plus tard, ils n'avaient que la peau sur les os.
target_text: Watembeaji wawili walipotea ndani ya msitu. Wakati waokoaji waliwapata juma chache baadaye, walikuwa nabakia na ngozi ku mufupa.
target_text_raw: Watembeaji wawili walipotea ndani ya msitu. Wakati waokoaji waliwapata juma chache baadaye, walikuwa nabakia na ngozi ku mufupa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les USA veulent sauver l'euro, maintenant. C'est d'autant plus bizarre qu'on l'avait créé justement pour concurrencer le dollar. Il faut croire qu'il est pas trop concurrencé.
target_text: Marekani inataka kuokoa euro sasa. Ni kitu isiyo elewaka zaidi ya gisi ilitengenezwa juu ya kushindana na dollar. Tunapashwa amini kama haina ushindani mingi.
target_text_raw: Marekani inataka kuokoa euro sasa. Ni kitu isiyo elewaka zaidi ya gisi ilitengenezwa juu ya kushindana na dollar. Tunapashwa amini kama haina ushindani mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prince portait un uniforme de cour brodé d’or, chamarré de décorations, des bas de soie et des souliers à boucles.
target_text: Mtoto wa mufalme alikuwa anavala nguo iliyopambwa na zahabu, ya kuyala mapambo, shoksi za soie na biatu bya kufunga.
target_text_raw: Mtoto wa mufalme alikuwa anavala nguo iliyopambwa na zahabu, ya kuyala mapambo, shoksi za soie na biatu bya kufunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas du tout. C'est parfaitement convenable. S'adresser les uns les autres par nos prénoms est une bonne chose ; cela produit une impression de camaraderie.
target_text: Hapana kabisa. Ni sawa kabisa. Kuitana mu ma prénoms ni kitu kizuri; inajenga hali ya burafiki.
target_text_raw: Hapana kabisa. Ni sawa kabisa. Kuitana mu ma prénoms (jina ya kwanza) ni kitu kizuri; inajenga hali ya burafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'aimerai toujours, quoi que tu fasses.
target_text: Nitaendelea kukupenda, hata ufanye nini.
target_text_raw: Nitaendelea kukupenda, hata ufanye nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le dernier groupe a fait un spectacle d’enfer avec lasers, effets pyrotechniques et tout le tremblement.
target_text: Kundi ya mwisho ilifanya spectacle ya kuvutia sana kwa kutumia lasers, mapambo ya mwangaza ya rangi tafauti na mutetemeko ya kutosha.
target_text_raw: Kundi ya mwisho ilifanya spectacle ya kuvutia sana kwa kutumia lasers, mapambo ya mwangaza ya rangi tafauti na mutetemeko ya kutosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je savais que je ne devais pas lui rendre visite, je suis pourtant allée la voir.
target_text: Nilijua sipashwi kumutembelea, lakini nilienda kumuona.
target_text_raw: Nilijua sipashwi kumutembelea, lakini nilienda kumuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons attendu le bus, mais il avait plus de trente minutes de retard, donc nous avons pris un taxi.
target_text: Tulingojea bisi, lakini ilikuya inachelewa kwa dakika makumi tatu, kwa hivyo tukakamata taksi.
target_text_raw: Tulingojea bisi, lakini ilikuya inachelewa kwa dakika makumi tatu, kwa hivyo tukakamata taksi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceux qui ne connaissent que la campagne ne savent pas ce qu’est la campagne, et ceux qui n’ont jamais mis les pieds en dehors d’une ville ne savent pas ce qu’est la ville.
target_text: Bale benye banajua tu kijiji habajui kijiji ni nini, na bale benye habajawahi kukanyanga inje ya muji habajui muji ni nini.
target_text_raw: Bale benye banajua tu kijiji habajui kijiji ni nini, na bale benye habajawahi kukanyanga inje ya muji habajui muji ni nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les hommes sont fuyants comme du sable, comme de l'eau. Ménagez-leur une ouverture ils ne demandent qu'à s'échapper.
target_text: Banaume banapitaka kama muchanga, kama maji. Wapatie fursa, wanataka tu kutoroka.
target_text_raw: Banaume banapitaka kama muchanga, kama maji. Wapatie fursa, wanataka tu kutoroka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faites comme vous voulez, ça m'est égal !
target_text: Fanya byenye unataka, sijali!
target_text_raw: Fanya byenye unataka, sijali!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En tant qu'officier public, vous avez prêté serment de soutenir et défendre la constitution.
target_text: Kama officier wa serkali, ulipanaka kiapo ya kuunga mukono na kutetea katiba.
target_text_raw: Kama officier wa serkali, ulipanaka kiapo ya kuunga mukono na kutetea katiba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu aimes ma moto ?
target_text: Je! Unapenda moto yangu?
target_text_raw: Je! Unapenda moto yangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis enchantée de faire votre connaissance.
target_text: Minafurahi kukutanana na weye.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi kukutanana na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle coïncidence ! On parlait justement de toi.
target_text: Iyi inatokea aye ! Tulikuwa tunasema juu yako.
target_text_raw: Iyi inatokea aye ! Tulikuwa tunasema juu yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie sauvage est si simple, et nos sociétés sont des machines si compliquées !
target_text: Maisha ya mupori ni rahisi sana, na jamii zetu ni mashine za nguvu kuelewa!
target_text_raw: Maisha ya mupori ni rahisi sana, na jamii zetu ni mashine za nguvu kuelewa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le directeur d'école était aussi brut qu'une brosse à poil de fer.
target_text: Directeur wa masomo alikuwa muchafu kama brosse ya chuma.
target_text_raw: Directeur wa masomo alikuwa muchafu kama brosse ya chuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La sorcière maudit la pauvre petite enfant.
target_text: Muchawi anamulaani mutoto mudogo.
target_text_raw: Muchawi anamulaani mutoto mudogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Leurs pommes ne sont pas aussi bonnes que les nôtres.
target_text: Pommes zabo haziko muzuri kushinda zetu.
target_text_raw: Pommes zabo haziko muzuri kushinda zetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le monde du sport devrait, à ce stade, éliminer la collusion avec les organisations criminelles.
target_text: Ulimwengu wa michezo unapashwa, mwa iyi hatua, kuacha ushirikiano na mashirika ya watenda mabaya.
target_text_raw: Ulimwengu wa michezo unapashwa, mwa iyi hatua, kuacha ushirikiano na mashirika ya watenda mabaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un rat a traversé la route.
target_text: Panya ilivuka barabara.
target_text_raw: Panya ilivuka barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne pouvez pas forcer un crabe à marcher droit.
target_text: Hauwezi lazimisha lipondo kutembea na inanyoroka.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi lazimisha lipondo (crabe) kutembea na inanyoroka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme vous êtes adultes, à présent, vous devriez bien mieux le savoir.
target_text: Kama weye ni mtu mzima, kwa sasa unapashwa kuijua muzuri.
target_text_raw: Kama weye ni mtu mzima, kwa sasa unapashwa kuijua muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mobile de son comportement n'est pas évident.
target_text: Sababu ya tabia yake haijulikani.
