notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nouvelle piste d'atterrissage a été mise en service il y a juste une semaine.
target_text: Piste mupya kwenye uwanja ya ndege ilianza tumika tangu juma moja tu iliyopita.
target_text_raw: Piste mupya kwenye uwanja ya ndege ilianza tumika tangu juma moja tu iliyopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au cours de ces trois dernières années, il a repeint sa maison successivement en bleu, puis en vert et enfin en jaune canari.
target_text: Mu miaka mitatu iliyopita, alipakala nyumba yake rangi mfululizo kwa rangi ya bleu, kisha ya kijani kibichi na mwisho rangi ya manjano ya kanari.
target_text_raw: Mu miaka mitatu iliyopita, alipakala nyumba yake rangi mfululizo kwa rangi ya bleu, kisha ya kijani kibichi (vert) na mwisho rangi ya manjano (jaune) ya kanari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'es un mec marrant.
target_text: Weye ni mutu wakuchekesha.
target_text_raw: Weye ni mutu wakuchekesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne refuse pas un bienfait à qui y a droit quand il est en ton pouvoir de le faire.
target_text: Usikatale kupokea kitendo ya mzuri kwa mutu aliye na haki ya kuipata wakati uko na uwezo ya kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Usikatale kupokea kitendo ya mzuri kwa mutu aliye na haki ya kuipata wakati uko na uwezo ya kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allâmes tôt au théâtre, de sorte que nous puissions être assurés que chacun puisse disposer d'un fauteuil.
target_text: Tulienda ku salle ya theatre mapema, juu tuhakikishe kwamba kila mtu anaweza kuwa na kiti.
target_text_raw: Tulienda ku salle ya theatre mapema, juu tuhakikishe kwamba kila mtu anaweza kuwa na kiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le présentateur, après de long roulements de tambours, dévoila enfin le nom du gagnant.
target_text: Mtangazaji, kisha kupigwa kwa ngoma mudaa murefu, alitangaza jina ya mshindi.
target_text_raw: Mtangazaji, kisha kupigwa kwa ngoma mudaa murefu, alitangaza jina ya mshindi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que vous devriez vous faire pousser la barbe.
target_text: Nazani unapashwa kukomalisha mandevu.
target_text_raw: Nazani unapashwa kukomalisha mandevu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le captif bien décidé à manquer à sa parole pense aussi mettre sa conscience au repos.
target_text: Aliyetekwa aliamua kutotimiza ahadi yake anafikiria pia kutuliza zamiri yake.
target_text_raw: Aliyetekwa aliamua kutotimiza ahadi yake anafikiria pia kutuliza zamiri yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo habite à 16 km de la frontière canadienne.
target_text: Enzo anaishi kwenye kilometa 16 kutoka ku mupaka ya Canada.
target_text_raw: Enzo anaishi kwenye kilometa 16 kutoka ku mupaka ya Canada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout à coup d'Apollon je vois le saint-ministre, / tout pâle des horreurs de cette nuit sinistre, / portant ses dieux vaincus, traînant son petit-fils, / échapper à grands pas au fer des ennemis.
target_text: Ghafla kutoka kwa Apollo namuona waziri mtakatifu, / wote wakionekana kuwa na boga kubwa ya ile busiku mubaya, / wakibeba miungu yabo iliyoshindwa, akinyangula mjukuu yake, / akakwepa chuma kubwa za maadui.
target_text_raw: Ghafla kutoka kwa Apollo namuona waziri mtakatifu, / wote wakionekana kuwa na boga kubwa ya ile busiku mubaya, / wakibeba miungu yabo iliyoshindwa, akinyangula mjukuu yake, / akakwepa chuma kubwa za maadui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Disons simplement que je n'ai pas été surprise.
target_text: Naweza sema tu kama sikushangaa.
target_text_raw: Naweza sema tu kama sikushangaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo me tuera.
target_text: Enzo ataniua.
target_text_raw: Enzo ataniua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tommy n'est pas du tout d'accord avec Lucie.
target_text: Tommy hakubaliani na Lucie hata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Tommy hakubaliani na Lucie hata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Grant demanda au Sénat d'approuver le traité.
target_text: Grant aliuliza Seneti kupitisha mkataba.
target_text_raw: Grant aliuliza Seneti kupitisha mkataba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma tante m'a donné une caméra.
target_text: Shangazi yangu alinipa kamera.
target_text_raw: Shangazi yangu alinipa kamera.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mesdames et messieurs, en face voici la gare, et à droite, vous voyez la cathédrale de Cologne.
target_text: Wa mama na wa baba, kituo iki mbele yenu, na kushoto, munaona cathedrale ya Cologne.
target_text_raw: Wa mama na wa baba, kituo iki mbele yenu, na kushoto, munaona cathedrale ya Cologne.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quoique vous fassiez, ne lâchez pas la corde.
target_text: Hata ufanye aye, usiachilie kamba.
target_text_raw: Hata ufanye aye, usiachilie kamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devrais sortir et t'amuser.
target_text: Unapashwa enda inje na kujifurahisha.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa enda inje na kujifurahisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait un cauchemar à propos de vampires.
target_text: Nililota ndoto ya mubaya kuhusu vampires.
target_text_raw: Nililota ndoto ya mubaya kuhusu vampires.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La liste des élèves du quatrième niveau est un peu longue.
target_text: Liste ya wanafunzi wa kiwango ya ine iko murefu kidogo.
target_text_raw: Liste ya wanafunzi wa kiwango ya ine iko murefu kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le noble jeune homme eût voulu mourir dans ce fatal moment ; il lui semblait que toute la félicité de sa vie lui échappait.
target_text: Kijana tajiri angependa kufa iyi wakati mubaya; ilikuwa naona sawa maisha ya raha na furaha ilikuwa namuponyoka.
target_text_raw: Kijana tajiri angependa kufa iyi wakati mubaya; ilikuwa naona sawa maisha ya raha na furaha ilikuwa namuponyoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Akiji est un soldat devenu professeur.
target_text: Akiji ni askari aliyegeuka mwalimu.
target_text_raw: Akiji ni askari aliyegeuka mwalimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne croyez pas tout ce que vous entendez.
target_text: Usiamini kila kitu chenye unasikia.
target_text_raw: Usiamini kila kitu chenye unasikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons vu monsieur Sato qui venait de sortir de la chambre.
target_text: Tuliona Monsieur Sato mwenye alikuwa natoka mu chumba.
target_text_raw: Tuliona Monsieur Sato mwenye alikuwa natoka mu chumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enfin nous faisons connaissance ! J'ai longtemps attendu ce moment.
target_text: Maraba ku mwisho tunafamiana! Nilisubiri iyi wakati muda murefu.
target_text_raw: Maraba ku mwisho tunafamiana! Nilisubiri iyi wakati muda murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez où vous êtes ou je vous tuerai !
target_text: Bakia kwenye uko kama sivyo nitakuua!
target_text_raw: Bakia kwenye uko kama sivyo nitakuua!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se nommait Johnny.
target_text: Alikuwa naitwa Johnny.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa naitwa Johnny.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai eu le sentiment que ça valait le risque.
target_text: Nilihisikia sawa vile ilikuwa na hatari.
target_text_raw: Nilihisikia sawa vile ilikuwa na hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se coucha à ses genoux et lui roucoula sa romance favorite, à savoir: qu'elle était charmante, pâle comme la lune, douce comme un mouton.
target_text: Alilala ku magoti yake na akumutamukia maneno ya mapenzi anayo penda zaidi, na ambayo ni : kwamba alikuwa navutia, mwenye rangi kama mwezi, mpole kama kondolo.
target_text_raw: Alilala ku magoti yake na akumutamukia maneno ya mapenzi anayo penda zaidi, na ambayo ni : kwamba alikuwa navutia, mwenye rangi kama mwezi, mpole kama kondolo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se tient droit dans ses bottes.
target_text: Anasimama akivala boti.
target_text_raw: Anasimama akivala boti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai la sensation que Tatoeba est devenu un endroit très agréable pour nous les amateurs de langues, et en particulier pour ceux d'entre nous qui sont capables d'apprendre des langues relativement facilement et rapidement.
target_text: Niko nasikia sawa Tatoeba ilishakuwa mahali bora sana kwetu wapenzi wa luga, na sana sana kwa siye benye tunaweza kujifunza luga za rahisi na haraka kujua.
target_text_raw: Niko nasikia sawa Tatoeba ilishakuwa mahali bora sana kwetu wapenzi wa luga, na sana sana kwa siye benye tunaweza kujifunza luga za rahisi na haraka kujua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'élève, comme la rivière, aimerait suivre son cours tout en restant dans son lit...
target_text: Mwanafunzi, kama mtoni, angependa kufuata somo yake akiwa analala mu kitanda...
target_text_raw: Mwanafunzi, kama mtoni, angependa kufuata somo yake akiwa analala mu kitanda...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand mes amis auront vendu leur commerce, ils se retireront à la campagne.
target_text: Wakati barafiki yangu batauzisha biashara yabo, bataenda bakia mu kijiji.
target_text_raw: Wakati barafiki yangu batauzisha biashara yabo, bataenda bakia mu kijiji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez, vous pouvez prendre les miens.
target_text: Ukitaka, unaweza kukamata yangu.
target_text_raw: Ukitaka, unaweza kukamata yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est pas mal foutue.
target_text: Iko na sura na muonekano ya mubaya.
target_text_raw: Iko na sura na muonekano ya mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le procureur me posa une question insidieuse.
target_text: Mwendesha mashtaka aliniuliza swali ya mutego.
target_text_raw: Mwendesha mashtaka aliniuliza swali ya mutego.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne traduis plus tes phrases depuis un certain temps, et j'ai décidé de ne plus le faire. J'en ai marre de travailler avec un type arrogant comme toi.
target_text: Nakuwa na siku mingi sitafsiri phrases zako, na nimeamua kutofanya hivyo tena. Minachoga kutumika na mtu wa kiburi kama weye.
target_text_raw: Nakuwa na siku mingi sitafsiri phrases zako, na nimeamua kutofanya hivyo tena. Minachoga kutumika na mtu wa kiburi kama weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Je sais quand même bien ce que j'ai à faire ! Je n'ai nul besoin de tes conseils. » - « Comme tu voudras. À toi de voir. »
target_text: “Minajua cha kufanya! Sihitaji ushauri wako. » - « Sawa basi. Weye njo utaona. »
target_text_raw: “Minajua cha kufanya! Sihitaji ushauri wako. » - « Sawa basi. Weye njo utaona. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Daniel remercia le policier.
target_text: Daniel alishukuru hule polisi.
target_text_raw: Daniel alishukuru hule polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour changer les unités du système métrique au système de mesures anglo-saxonnes et inversement, il faut cliquer sur le bouton « Menu ».
target_text: Kwa kubadilisha byenye kuunda mfumo wa système métrique na mfumo wa vipimo ya Kiingereza na upande mwingine, fyonda ku bouton "Menu".
target_text_raw: Kwa kubadilisha byenye kuunda mfumo wa système métrique na mfumo wa vipimo ya Kiingereza na upande mwingine, fyonda ku bouton "Menu".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dévouée aux horreurs de ses funestes feux, / Didon surtout, Didon le dévore des yeux ; / et, le cœur agité d'un trouble qui l'étonne, / admire et les présents et celui qui les donne.
target_text: Kwa kujitolea mu vitisho ya moto yenye kutangaza tabu, / Dido sana sana, Dido anamwangalia kwa macho makali; / na, roho ya kuangaika na musukosuko ambao inamushangaza, / anafurahia na zawadi na ule anaye zipana.
target_text_raw: Kwa kujitolea mu vitisho ya moto yenye kutangaza tabu, / Dido sana sana, Dido anamwangalia kwa macho makali; / na, roho ya kuangaika na musukosuko ambao inamushangaza, / anafurahia na zawadi na ule anaye zipana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme ce n'est pas une zone très sure, j'ai envie de rentrer avant qu'il soit tard.
target_text: Kwa kuwa siyo eneo ya usalama sana, minataka kwenda ku nyumba kabla siachelewa.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa siyo eneo ya usalama sana, minataka kwenda ku nyumba kabla siachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons amené l'ordinateur jusqu'au bureau.
target_text: Tulipeleka ordinateur mpaka ku bureau.
target_text_raw: Tulipeleka ordinateur mpaka ku bureau.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pardonne à tes ennemis mais n'oublie jamais leurs noms !
target_text: Wasamehe maadui zako lakini usisahabu majina yao hata siku moya!
target_text_raw: Wasamehe maadui zako lakini usisahabu majina yao hata siku moya!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a plus de filles que de garçons dans cette division.
target_text: Piko mabinti wengi kuliko wavulana mwa iyi division.
target_text_raw: Piko mabinti wengi kuliko wavulana mwa iyi division.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et surtout, ne racontez pas de mensonges à votre mère, car les mères sont encore plus fines que leurs enfants, et, tôt ou tard elles finissent toujours par connaître la vérité !
target_text: Na kwanza, usiambie mama yako bongo, kwa sababu wa mama ni watu bora zaidi kuliko watoto wao, na kuko siku wanaishia kujua ukweli!
target_text_raw: Na kwanza, usiambie mama yako bongo, kwa sababu wa mama ni watu bora zaidi kuliko watoto wao, na kuko siku wanaishia kujua ukweli!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que chacun amène ses enfants.
target_text: Nataka kila mtu alete watoto wake.
target_text_raw: Nataka kila mtu alete watoto wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pardon ! J'ai oublié ton prénom. Ah non, j'y suis ! Tu t'appelles Marie.
target_text: Samahani! Nilisahabu jina prénom yako. Hapana, niko ako! Jina yako ni Maria.
target_text_raw: Samahani! Nilisahabu jina prénom yako. Hapana, niko ako! Jina yako ni Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Russie est garante de la souveraineté de l'Ukraine, et donc de ses frontières, depuis le traité de mille-neuf-cent-quatre-vingt-quatorze, par lequel l'Ukraine renonçait, en échange, à son arsenal nucléaire.
target_text: Urusi njo inashimamia uhuru wa Ukraine, na kwa hivyo ya mipaka yake, tangu mkataba wa elfu moja mia kenda makumi kenda na ine, ambao Ukraine iliacha, kwa kubadilisha na, silaha zake za nucléaire.
target_text_raw: Urusi njo inashimamia uhuru wa Ukraine, na kwa hivyo ya mipaka yake, tangu mkataba wa elfu moja mia kenda makumi kenda na ine, ambao Ukraine iliacha, kwa kubadilisha na, silaha zake za nucléaire.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un bref exposé vaut mieux qu'un long discours.
target_text: Exposé fupi ni bora kuliko hotuba murefu.
target_text_raw: Exposé fupi ni bora kuliko hotuba murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Passe une superbe soirée.
target_text: Mangaribi nzuri kwako.
target_text_raw: Mangaribi nzuri kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pourrai revenir ?
target_text: Naweza rudia?
target_text_raw: Naweza rudia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Un homme peut-il épouser la sœur de sa veuve ? » « Il en a le droit mais pas la capacité. »
target_text: « Je! Mwanauma anaweza kuoa dada ya muke wake mwenya anakufa? » « Iko na haki lakini siyo uwezo. »
target_text_raw: « Je! Mwanauma anaweza kuoa dada ya muke wake mwenya anakufa? » « Iko na haki lakini siyo uwezo. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soit ce projet sera un succès formidable, soit un coup d'épée dans l'eau, sûrement rien entre les deux.
target_text: Hii muradi itakuwa na mafanikio makubwa, ao mupanga mu mayi, hakika hakuna kitu kati ya iyo.
target_text_raw: Hii muradi itakuwa na mafanikio makubwa, ao mupanga mu mayi, hakika hakuna kitu kati ya iyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mec, t'as l'air crevé. Tu devrais arrêter d'écrire pour faire une pause.
target_text: Jamaa, unaonekana unachoka. Unapashwa kuacha kuandika juu upumuzike.
target_text_raw: Jamaa, unaonekana unachoka. Unapashwa kuacha kuandika juu upumuzike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a rejoint l'entreprise juste après le lycée.
target_text: Alijiunga na kampuni kisha tu kumaliza shule ya sekondari.
target_text_raw: Alijiunga na kampuni kisha tu kumaliza shule ya sekondari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne pouvait pas expliquer ses erreurs stupides.
target_text: Hakuweza kuelezea makosa yake ya kijinga.
target_text_raw: Hakuweza kuelezea makosa yake ya kijinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûre de ne pas vouloir considérer une autre option ?
target_text: Una uhakika kama hautaki kufanya chaguo ingine?
target_text_raw: Una uhakika kama hautaki kufanya chaguo ingine?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je connais quelqu'un qui est parfait pour le job.
target_text: Najua mutu mwenye anafaa kwa iyi kazi.
target_text_raw: Najua mutu mwenye anafaa kwa iyi kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo était extrêmement timide. Ça donnait souvent lieu à des moments bizarres.
target_text: Hugo alikuwa na haya sana. Mara mingi ilileta wakati wa kushangaza.
target_text_raw: Hugo alikuwa na haya sana. Mara mingi ilileta wakati wa kushangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je rigole !
target_text: Nacheka!
target_text_raw: Nacheka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un kangourou a surpris des agents de sécurité à l'aéroport de Melbourne, alors qu'il a été découvert en train de bondir autour de l'un des parkings !
target_text: Kanguru aliwashangaza walinzi wa uwanja wa ndege ya Melbourne, ilipo onekana ikiruka ruka kwenye parking moja hapo!
target_text_raw: Kanguru aliwashangaza walinzi wa uwanja wa ndege ya Melbourne, ilipo onekana ikiruka ruka kwenye parking moja hapo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dit au roi : Votre Majesté, veuillez me pardonner !
target_text: Nilimwambia mfalme: Mfalme, naomba unisamehe!
target_text_raw: Nilimwambia mfalme: Mfalme, naomba unisamehe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fermez-la. Sinon, vous serez virée.
target_text: Nyamanza. Kama sio ivo, utafukuzwa mu kazi.
target_text_raw: Nyamanza. Kama sio ivo, utafukuzwa mu kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses revenus ont baissé de moitié après sa mise à la retraite.
target_text: Mapato yake ilipunguka nusu kisha kuacha kazi na kwenda mu mapumuziko.
target_text_raw: Mapato yake ilipunguka nusu kisha kuacha kazi na kwenda mu mapumuziko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon a promis qu'il ne sera plus méchant.
target_text: Kijana aliahidi kama hatakuwa tena mtu mubaya.
target_text_raw: Kijana aliahidi kama hatakuwa tena mtu mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Achète bas, vends haut !
target_text: Uza chini, uzisha yulu!
target_text_raw: Uza chini, uzisha yulu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un animal, le rat ou le kangourou, sert de totem à tout un clan.
target_text: Munyama, panya ao kanguru, inachukuliwa kama moja ya wanamemba ndani ya ukoo muzima.
target_text_raw: Munyama, panya ao kanguru, inachukuliwa kama moja ya wanamemba ndani ya ukoo muzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pensez-vous qu'elle puisse gérer son personnel ?
target_text: Unazani kama anaweza kusimamia wafanyikazi wake?
target_text_raw: Unazani kama anaweza kusimamia wafanyikazi wake?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'entreprise a rapidement aiguillé son activité hors de son cœur de métier dans les dernières années.
target_text: Hiyo kampuni ilibadilisha kwa haraka shughuli yake ya musingi mu miaka ya nyuma nyuma.
target_text_raw: Hiyo kampuni ilibadilisha kwa haraka shughuli yake ya musingi mu miaka ya nyuma nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne bougez pas jusqu'à ce que je revienne.
target_text: Usitoke mpaka nirudie.
target_text_raw: Usitoke mpaka nirudie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les langages interprétés comme Ruby ou Lua ne sont pas compilés et nécessitent par conséquent une sorte de moteur d'exécution.
target_text: Luga zilizotafsiriwa kama Ruby au Lua hazijakusanywa na kwa hivyo zinahitaji aina ya ufundi ya kuzifanya zitumike.
target_text_raw: Luga zilizotafsiriwa kama Ruby au Lua hazijakusanywa na kwa hivyo zinahitaji aina ya ufundi ya kuzifanya zitumike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton nom a été retiré de la liste.
target_text: Jina yako iliondolewa ku liste.
target_text_raw: Jina yako iliondolewa ku liste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que fout ce conteneur dans notre port de Hambourg ?
target_text: Hii kontenere inafanya nini ndani ya bandari yetu ya Hambourg?
target_text_raw: Hii kontenere inafanya nini ndani ya bandari yetu ya Hambourg?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Certaines odeurs peuvent facilement évoquer des souvenirs d'enfance.
target_text: Kuna harufu fulani zenye zinaweza kuleta kumbukumbu za mu butoto.
target_text_raw: Kuna harufu fulani zenye zinaweza kuleta kumbukumbu za mu butoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis retrouvé piégé dans un cercle vicieux.
target_text: Nilijikuta minanaswa mu muzunguko isiyo kuwa na mwanzo ao mwisho.
target_text_raw: Nilijikuta minanaswa mu muzunguko isiyo kuwa na mwanzo ao mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir qu'il les achète.
target_text: Itabidi aziuze tu.
target_text_raw: Itabidi aziuze tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Montrez-moi ce que vous avez caché derrière votre dos !
target_text: Nioneshe ulichoficha nyuma ya mgongo wako!
target_text_raw: Nioneshe ulichoficha nyuma ya mgongo wako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La guerre du Vietnam, est très justement connue au Vietnam sous le nom de "Guerre Américaine".
target_text: Vita vya Vietnam vinajulikana sana nchini Vietnam kama "Vita vya Amerika".
target_text_raw: Vita vya Vietnam vinajulikana sana nchini Vietnam kama "Vita vya Amerika".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tenez, buvez ça.
target_text: Kamata, kunywa iyi.
target_text_raw: Kamata, kunywa iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trop tard ! Elle nous a déjà vus.
target_text: Ulisha chelewa! Alisha tuona.
target_text_raw: Ulisha chelewa! Alisha tuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aucune preuve n'a jamais été trouvée.
target_text: Hakuna ushahidi umewahi kupatikana.
target_text_raw: Hakuna ushahidi umewahi kupatikana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez ça dans votre coffre à jouets.
target_text: Weka hii kwenye sanduku yako ya kuchezea.
target_text_raw: Weka hii kwenye sanduku yako ya kuchezea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au fond, voyez-vous, le chagrin, c'est comme le ver solitaire : le tout, c'est de le faire sortir.
target_text: Kiundani, unaona, huzuni, ni kama minyoo: yote, ni kuitosha.
target_text_raw: Kiundani, unaona, huzuni, ni kama minyoo: yote, ni kuitosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande combien de temps nous avons gâché jusqu'à présent.
target_text: Minajiuliza ni muda gani tulipoteza mpaka sasa.
target_text_raw: Minajiuliza ni muda gani tulipoteza mpaka sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il sera éduqué et prendra le droit chemin.
target_text: Ataadibishiwa na kukamata njia inayofaa.
target_text_raw: Ataadibishiwa na kukamata njia inayofaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La guerre a atteint sa phase finale.
target_text: Vita imefikia hatua yake ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Vita imefikia hatua yake ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que la fac, c'était plus marrant.
target_text: Nilizani chuo kikuu kilikuwa cha kufurahisha zaidi.
target_text_raw: Nilizani chuo kikuu kilikuwa cha kufurahisha zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'idée de Dieu serait plus intéressante si au lieu d'avoir créé les humains, il les avait trouvés.
target_text: Wazo ya Mungu itapendeza zaidi kama kuliko kuumba wanadamu, angewapata.
target_text_raw: Wazo ya Mungu itapendeza zaidi kama kuliko kuumba wanadamu, angewapata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous enregistré votre produit ?
target_text: Uliandikisha biashara yako?
target_text_raw: Uliandikisha biashara yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Du wirst sehen, wir werden in Top-Form ins neue Jahr rutschen!
target_text: Du wirst sehen, wir werden in Top-Form ins neue Jahr rutschen!
target_text_raw: Du wirst sehen, wir werden in Top-Form ins neue Jahr rutschen!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a, au fond, de réel que l'humanité.
target_text: Hakuna, moyoni, kitu ya kweli isipokuwa ubinadamu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna, moyoni, kitu ya kweli isipokuwa ubinadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont une plus grande puissance de feu que nous, mais nous bénéficierons de l'effet de surprise.
target_text: Wako na nguvu zaidi kuliko sisi, lakini tutafaidika kwa kuwashitukia.
target_text_raw: Wako na nguvu zaidi kuliko sisi, lakini tutafaidika kwa kuwashitukia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous vous inquiétez trop pour Ethan.
target_text: Uko na wasiwasi sana juu ya Ethan.
target_text_raw: Uko na wasiwasi sana juu ya Ethan.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce cheval peut être un bon pari.
target_text: Inaweza kuwa muzuri kupingia kwa iyi farasi.
target_text_raw: Inaweza kuwa muzuri kupingia kwa iyi farasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai l'honneur de porter à votre connaissance que notre affaire sera entendue à l'audience de la troisième chambre du Tribunal du Travail de Charleroi, le <date>.
target_text: Ni kwa heshima njo nakujulisha kwamba kesi yetu itasikilizwa na chumba ya tatu ya mahakama ya kazi ya Charleroi, tarehe <date>.
target_text_raw: Ni kwa heshima njo nakujulisha kwamba kesi yetu itasikilizwa na chumba ya tatu ya mahakama ya kazi ya Charleroi, tarehe <date>.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ramène Sami à l'arrêt de bus.
target_text: Mulete Sam kwenye kituo cha bisi.
target_text_raw: Mulete Sam kwenye kituo cha bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'incendie fut immédiatement éteint.
target_text: Moto ilizimwa mara moja.
target_text_raw: Moto ilizimwa mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai l'impression qu'elle cache quelque chose.
target_text: Niko naona kwamba anaficha kitu.
target_text_raw: Niko naona kwamba anaficha kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez bien partir ? J'aimerais m'habiller.
target_text: Unaweza enda? Ningependa kuvala.
target_text_raw: Unaweza enda? Ningependa kuvala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Heureusement que la main connaît la bouche ! Autrement, c'est fichu !
target_text: Kwa bahati nzuri, mkono inajua kinywa! Vinginevyo, imeharibiwa!
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati nzuri, mkono inajua kinywa! Vinginevyo, imeharibiwa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Surtout, pas de bêtises !
target_text: Zaidi ya yote, hakuna mambo ya ujinga!
target_text_raw: Zaidi ya yote, hakuna mambo ya ujinga!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le désert, une roue de secours ne sert à rien. Encore faudrait-il pouvoir soulever la voiture sur du sable.
target_text: Mu jangwa, pneu ya kusaidia haina maana. Na tena itabidi kuweza kuinua gari kwenye mchanga.
target_text_raw: Mu jangwa, pneu ya kusaidia haina maana. Na tena itabidi kuweza kuinua gari kwenye mchanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La maladie est facilement curable avec une transfusion sanguine d'un parent, surtout un frère.
target_text: Ugonjwa huo unatibika kwa urahisi na damu kutoka kwa mwanamemba wa jamaa, sana sana kaka.
target_text_raw: Ugonjwa huo unatibika kwa urahisi na damu kutoka kwa mwanamemba wa jamaa, sana sana kaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis enchanté de faire votre connaissance.
target_text: Nimefurahi kukutana na weye.
target_text_raw: Nimefurahi kukutana na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les pauvres gosses tremblaient de peur.
target_text: Batoto balikuwa natetemeka kwa woga.
target_text_raw: Batoto balikuwa natetemeka kwa woga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonjour, je m'appelle Tina.
target_text: Jambo, naitwa Tina.
target_text_raw: Jambo, naitwa Tina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Assure un bon départ en observant soigneusement.
target_text: Hakikisha mwanzo mzuri kwa kuchunguza kwa uangalifu.
target_text_raw: Hakikisha mwanzo mzuri kwa kuchunguza kwa uangalifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis au commissariat.
target_text: Niko ku kituo cha polisi.
target_text_raw: Niko ku kituo cha polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'eau s'est arrêtée de couler car le tuyau s'est entortillé.
target_text: Maji aliacha kutiririka kwa sababu tuyau ilitoboka.
target_text_raw: Maji aliacha kutiririka kwa sababu tuyau ilitoboka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sur eux, le fer en main, nous fondons avec joie, / et nos dieux sont admis à cette riche proie. / Une table, dressée au bord courbé des mers, / se couvre de ces mets par le hasard offerts.
target_text: Yulu yabo, chuma mu mikono, tunajazwa na furaha, / na miungu yetu inakubaliwa kwa iyi mawindo nzuri. / Meza, ilipangwa pembezoni mwa bahari, / inayala hizi chakula zenye zilitolewa kwa bahati.
target_text_raw: Yulu yabo, chuma mu mikono, tunajazwa na furaha, / na miungu yetu inakubaliwa kwa iyi mawindo nzuri. / Meza, ilipangwa pembezoni mwa bahari, / inayala hizi chakula zenye zilitolewa kwa bahati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Presque tous les hommes, frappés par l'attrait d'un faux bien ou d'une vaine gloire, se laissent séduire, volontairement ou par ignorance, à l'éclat trompeur de ceux qui méritent le mépris plutôt que la louange.
target_text: Karibu watu wote, waliopigwa na muvuto ya uzuri ya uongo ao utukufu wa bure, wanaruhusu kuitika, kwa mapenzi yao ao kwa kutokujuwa, kwa mwangaza wa udanganyifu wa wale ambao wanastahili zarau kuliko sifa.
target_text_raw: Karibu watu wote, waliopigwa na muvuto ya uzuri ya uongo ao utukufu wa bure, wanaruhusu kuitika, kwa mapenzi yao ao kwa kutokujuwa, kwa mwangaza wa udanganyifu wa wale ambao wanastahili zarau kuliko sifa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maxime a versé du lait dans un bol pour ses chats.
target_text: Maxime alimwanga maziwa ndani ya bakuli kwa ajili ya pusi zake.
target_text_raw: Maxime alimwanga maziwa ndani ya bakuli kwa ajili ya pusi zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai adoré le lycée.
target_text: Nilipenda sana shule ya sekondari.
target_text_raw: Nilipenda sana shule ya sekondari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au secours ! au secours ! cria Pierrette, on me tue !
target_text: Naomba munisaidie! munisaidie! Pierrette alilalamika , bananiua!
target_text_raw: Naomba munisaidie! munisaidie! Pierrette alilalamika , bananiua!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu commences sérieusement à me taper sur les nerfs.
target_text: Unaanza niuzi sana.
target_text_raw: Unaanza niuzi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sur le quai, il lut un panneau d'avertissement : « Attention ! Un train peut en cacher un autre. »
target_text: Kwenye panneau alisoma onyo yenye kusema: « Angalisho! Treni moja inaweza kujificha ingine. »
target_text_raw: Kwenye panneau alisoma onyo yenye kusema: « Angalisho! Treni moja inaweza kujificha ingine. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nancy est allée à Londres de même qu'à Paris.
target_text: Nancy alienda Londres na Paris pia.
target_text_raw: Nancy alienda Londres na Paris pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je déteste le défilement infini parce que je crois fermement que les utilisateurs ont le droit de choisir s'ils veulent charger la page suivante ou pas.
target_text: Minachukiaka kufanya défilement isiyo kuwa na mwisho kwa sababu minazani kama watumiaji wana haki ya kuchagua kama wanataka kuingia ku page ya kufata ao hapana.
target_text_raw: Minachukiaka kufanya défilement isiyo kuwa na mwisho kwa sababu minazani kama watumiaji wana haki ya kuchagua kama wanataka kuingia ku page ya kufata ao hapana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Veux-tu aller au bal avec moi ? » « Je suis vraiment désolée, mais je ne peux pas. »
target_text: « Unataka enda na miye kwenye sherehe? » « Samahani sana, lakini siwezi. »
target_text_raw: « Unataka enda na miye kwenye sherehe? » « Samahani sana, lakini siwezi. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez à l'écart.
target_text: Ikala mbali.
target_text_raw: Ikala mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu m'aimes, mais tout ce que je ressens pour toi, c'est de l'amitié.
target_text: Najua unanipenda, lakini chenye minasikia juu yako, ni urafiki.
target_text_raw: Najua unanipenda, lakini chenye minasikia juu yako, ni urafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Grace à un besoin urgent il n'a pas pu venir.
target_text: Kutokana na hitaji ya haraka hakuweza kuya.
target_text_raw: Kutokana na hitaji ya haraka hakuweza kuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le comté de Galles a certainement plus de fraîcheur que notre Bretagne. Mais sur la lande pierreuse, c'est bien la même végétation mélancolique: bruyères, fougères, et l'ajonc épineux.
target_text: Kata ya Wales hakika ni safi kuliko Bretagne yetu. Lakini kwenye budongo ya mawe, ni mimea ile ile ya kusikitisha: mumea ya maua, mimea isiyo kuwa na maua ao mbegu na ajonc ya miba.
target_text_raw: Kata ya Wales hakika ni safi kuliko Bretagne yetu. Lakini kwenye budongo ya mawe, ni mimea ile ile ya kusikitisha: mumea ya maua (bruyère), mimea isiyo kuwa na maua ao mbegu (fougère) na ajonc ya miba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathis ne voulait pas suivre les traces de son père.
target_text: Mathis hakutaka kufuata nyayo za baba yake.
target_text_raw: Mathis hakutaka kufuata nyayo za baba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous savez qui est ce mec ?
target_text: Unajua huyu jamaa ni nani?
target_text_raw: Unajua huyu jamaa ni nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-il nécessaire que je lui en explique la raison ?
target_text: Je! Ni muhimu nimuelezee sababu?
target_text_raw: Je! Ni muhimu nimuelezee sababu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle portait une robe décolletée dans le dos jusqu'à la naissance des fesses.
target_text: Alikuwa navala robe ya mufupi kutoka mu mugongo mpaka sehemu ya mwanzo ya matako.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa navala robe ya mufupi kutoka mu mugongo mpaka sehemu ya mwanzo ya matako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est comme un zéro, il n'a en lui-même aucune importance, seule sa position dans la société est importante.
target_text: Ni kama sifuri, hana ata faida ndani yake mwenyewe, cheo yake ndani ya jamii njo tu ya muhimu.
target_text_raw: Ni kama sifuri, hana ata faida ndani yake mwenyewe, cheo yake ndani ya jamii njo tu ya muhimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque John est revenu, il semblait pâle, comme s'il avait vu un fantôme.
target_text: Wakati John alirudia, alionekana hana furaha, kama vile alikuwa naona muzimu.
target_text_raw: Wakati John alirudia, alionekana hana furaha, kama vile alikuwa naona muzimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pointe de la lance était trempée dans un poison mortel.
target_text: Chongo ya mukuki ilikuwa natiwa mu sumu ya kuua.
target_text_raw: Chongo ya mukuki ilikuwa natiwa mu sumu ya kuua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu regardes une belle fleur.
target_text: Unaangalia liua nzuri.
target_text_raw: Unaangalia liua nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fille a le droit de rêver, non ?
target_text: Binti iko na haki ya kulota, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Binti iko na haki ya kulota, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'orateur couvrit le micro de sa main et chuchota quelque chose à la femme assise à son côté.
target_text: Musemaji alifunika micro na mukono yake na kuambia kitu fulani mwanamuke mwenye alikua anaikala karibu nayeye kwa sauti ya chini.
target_text_raw: Musemaji alifunika micro na mukono yake na kuambia kitu fulani mwanamuke mwenye alikua anaikala karibu nayeye kwa sauti ya chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève son nom de la liste des candidats.
target_text: Toa jina yake ku liste ya wagombeaji.
target_text_raw: Toa jina yake ku liste ya wagombeaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce baiser était fantastique.
target_text: Hii bizu ilikuwa ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Hii bizu ilikuwa ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous étiez vivant lorsque vous êtes né et vous êtes vivant en ce moment, donc vous deviez être vivant à n'importe quel instant entre les deux. Cela implique que la vie de tout un chacun est convexe.
target_text: Ulikuwa hai wakati ulizaliwa na uko hai sasa, kwa hivyo unapashwa kuwa hai wakati wowote katikati ya hizi mbili. Hii inamaanisha kuwa maisha ya kila mtu iko muviringo.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa hai wakati ulizaliwa na uko hai sasa, kwa hivyo unapashwa kuwa hai wakati wowote katikati ya hizi mbili. Hii inamaanisha kuwa maisha ya kila mtu iko muviringo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La modification du programme a eu un léger effet de bord.
target_text: Marekebisho ya programme ilileta mabadiliko kidogo.
target_text_raw: Marekebisho ya programme ilileta mabadiliko kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne devriez pas faire à cet enfant ses quatre volontés. Ça va le rendre très égoïste.
target_text: Haupashwi kumutimizia huyu mutoto mahitaji yake ine. Itamufanya akuwe mtu wa kujipendelea sana.
target_text_raw: Haupashwi kumutimizia huyu mutoto mahitaji yake ine. Itamufanya akuwe mtu wa kujipendelea sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai connu un mec qui s'appelait Tom.
target_text: Nilikuwa najua jamaa mumoja mwenye anaitwa Tom.

source_text: La Russie et la Chine feront tout pour défendre leurs intérêts géostratégiques et les organisations terroristes soutenues par le plus grand État voyou au monde n'arriveront jamais à faire tomber ces deux superpuissances.

source_text: On ne visite pas les gens, à moins d'être médecin légiste : on leur rend visite...
target_text: Habatembeleaki batu, isipokuwa kuwa muganga wa uchunguzi: banaendaka kubatembelea ..
target_text_raw: Habatembeleaki batu, isipokuwa kuwa muganga wa uchunguzi: banaendaka kubatembelea ..
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La presse n'a eu de cesse de pourchasser le Président au sujet de son renoncement à sa promesse de ne pas augmenter les impôts.
target_text: Vyombo vya habari vilifuatilia Raisi bila kuchoka kuhusu ahadi ya kutopandisha impots.
target_text_raw: Vyombo vya habari vilifuatilia Raisi bila kuchoka kuhusu ahadi ya kutopandisha impots.

source_text: Sami, un adolescent homosexuel, a fait son coming out à sa mère.
target_text: Sami, kijana homosexuel, alijulisha mama yake kuhusu iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Sami, kijana homosexuel, alijulisha mama yake kuhusu iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où que vous alliez, vous serez bienvenu.
target_text: Popote kwenye utaenda, utakaribishwa.
target_text_raw: Popote kwenye utaenda, utakaribishwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Muse, raconte-moi ces grands évènements ; / dis pourquoi de Junon les fiers ressentiments, / poursuivant en tous lieux le malheureux Énée, / troublèrent si longtemps la haute destinée / d'un prince magnanime, humain, religieux. / Tant de fiel entre-t-il dans les âmes des dieux !
target_text: Muse, niambie kuhusu hizo matukio; / sema kwa nini Junon majivuno, / kufuata Énée asiye kuwa na furaha kila mahali, / kuangaisha kwa muda mrefu destin kubwa/ ya mtoto wa mwami wa roho muzuri, wa moyo ya kibinadamu, wa kidini. / Uchungu mingi inaingia mu roho za miungu!
target_text_raw: Muse, niambie kuhusu hizo matukio; / sema kwa nini Junon majivuno, / kufuata Énée asiye kuwa na furaha kila mahali, / kuangaisha kwa muda mrefu destin kubwa/ ya mtoto wa mwami wa roho muzuri, wa moyo ya kibinadamu, wa kidini. / Uchungu mingi inaingia mu roho za miungu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quels horribles événements se sont donc passés ? Où sont vos parents ? Qu'est devenu votre mari ?
target_text: Ni mambo gani ya mubaya ilitokea? Bazazi yenu bako wapi? Bwana yako alishaka kuwa nani?
target_text_raw: Ni mambo gani ya mubaya ilitokea? Bazazi yenu bako wapi? Bwana yako alishaka kuwa nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas Joan. Tu t'es trompé.
target_text: Haiko Joan. Ulijikoroga.
target_text_raw: Haiko Joan. Ulijikoroga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a plein de bordel à ranger.
target_text: Piko bitu mingi ya kupanga.
target_text_raw: Piko bitu mingi ya kupanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils s'efforcent de proposer quelque chose pour chacun.
target_text: Wanajitahidi kutoa kitu kwa kila mtu.
target_text_raw: Wanajitahidi kutoa kitu kwa kila mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lincoln était triste de ne pas avoir gagné.
target_text: Lincoln alihuzunika juu hakushinda.
target_text_raw: Lincoln alihuzunika juu hakushinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils avaient beaucoup de bagages et voulaient un taxi.
target_text: Walikuwa na mizigo mingi na walitaka taxi.
target_text_raw: Walikuwa na mizigo mingi na walitaka taxi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortez d'ici et ne revenez jamais !
target_text: Toka hapa na usirudiake tena!
target_text_raw: Toka hapa na usirudiake tena!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est nécessaire que tu commences immédiatement.
target_text: Ni muhimu uanze mara moja.
target_text_raw: Ni muhimu uanze mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Théo disait apprécier tout ce qu'elle avait préparé pour le dîner, mais ce n'était que par politesse.
target_text: Theo kama alifurahia kila kitu kuhusu chakula ya muchana yenye alitayarisha lakini ilikuwa tu kwa adabu.
target_text_raw: Theo kama alifurahia kila kitu kuhusu chakula ya muchana yenye alitayarisha lakini ilikuwa tu kwa adabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce chapitre introduit trop de nouveaux concepts, il est totalement indigeste pour les étudiants. Je pense qu'on devrait le remanier.
target_text: Hii chapitre inaongeza bitu mingi ya mupya, inasumbua wanafunzi kuelewa. Nazani tunapashwa ibadirisha.
target_text_raw: Hii chapitre inaongeza bitu mingi ya mupya, inasumbua wanafunzi kuelewa. Nazani tunapashwa ibadirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aimerait être policier plus tard.
target_text: Angependa kuwa polisi baadaye.
target_text_raw: Angependa kuwa polisi baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas surprise que vous ne connaissiez pas la réponse.
target_text: Sishangali kuona haujui jibu.
target_text_raw: Sishangali kuona haujui jibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'entrée ou le séjour irrégulier sont un motif d'expulsion au même titre que la menace pour l'ordre public.
target_text: Kuingia au kuikala bila ruhusa ni sababu ya kufukuzwa kama vile ku atarisha utaratibu wa inchi.
target_text_raw: Kuingia au kuikala bila ruhusa ni sababu ya kufukuzwa kama vile ku atarisha utaratibu wa inchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons assemblé ici les seuls athlètes qui sont passés en dessous de la barre des dix minutes, mais comme vous le constatez, la performance de Hirayama est la plus basse des cinq.
target_text: Tulikusanya tu bachezaji benye balifikia kuvuka barre ya dakika kumi, lakini kwa gisi unaweza ona, uwezo ya Hiramaya iko chini sana kati ya aba batano.
target_text_raw: Tulikusanya tu bachezaji benye balifikia kuvuka barre ya dakika kumi, lakini kwa gisi unaweza ona, uwezo ya Hiramaya iko chini sana kati ya aba batano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dieu, dans sa divine prévoyance, n'a pas donné de barbe aux femmes, parce qu'elles n'auraient pas su se taire pendant qu'on les eût rasées.
target_text: Mungu, kwa mtazamo wake wa kimungu, hakuwapa wanamuke ndevu, kwa sababu hawangejua kunyamanza wakati bangekuwa nabanyola.
target_text_raw: Mungu, kwa mtazamo wake wa kimungu, hakuwapa wanamuke ndevu, kwa sababu hawangejua kunyamanza wakati bangekuwa nabanyola.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pensez-vous que vous pourriez être flic ?
target_text: Unawaza kama unaweza kuwa polisi?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kama unaweza kuwa polisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La moitié de la ville et donc la totalité des écoles ont été réduites en cendres.
target_text: Kipande ya mji na kwa hivyo shule zote zimepunguzwa kuwa majivu.
target_text_raw: Kipande ya mji na kwa hivyo shule zote zimepunguzwa kuwa majivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais qu'une poignée de gens serait venue faire du ski-nautique avec nous, mais absolument personne ne se manifesta.
target_text: Nilizani kama watu wachache wangekuya kucheza ski ya maji na siye, lakini hakuna mtu mwenye alijitokeza.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama watu wachache wangekuya kucheza ski ya maji na siye, lakini hakuna mtu mwenye alijitokeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le procès se tenait au tribunal de Grenoble.
target_text: Kesi ilifanyika katika tribunal ya Grenoble.
target_text_raw: Kesi ilifanyika katika tribunal ya Grenoble.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La famille de la victime estimait que certains journalistes avaient un peu trop rapidement parlé de suicide alors que la police n'avait encore donné aucune information.
target_text: Familia ya muhanga ilidai kama piko waandishi wa habari wenye waliongelea kuhusu suicide ijapokuwa polisi ilikuwa haipana habari yoyote.
target_text_raw: Familia ya muhanga ilidai kama piko waandishi wa habari wenye waliongelea kuhusu suicide (kuiuwa mwenyewe) ijapokuwa polisi ilikuwa haipana habari yoyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est captivé par l'idée de devenir une star du rock.
target_text: Anapendelea sana kuwa muimbaji wa rock kujulikana.
target_text_raw: Anapendelea sana kuwa muimbaji wa rock kujulikana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On se retrouve au bar de l'hôtel !
target_text: Tunakutanana ku bar ya hotel!
target_text_raw: Tunakutanana ku bar ya hotel!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le couple s'est embrouillé à propos du programme TV à regarder il y a plus d'une semaine.
target_text: Couple balichanganyikiwa kuhusu kipindi gani cha TV ya kuangalia tangu juma moya iliyopita.
target_text_raw: Couple (bibi na bwana) balichanganyikiwa kuhusu kipindi gani cha TV ya kuangalia tangu juma moya iliyopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'as certainement pas le cran de traduire cette phrase.
target_text: Kwa kweli hauna uwezo ya kutafsiri hii maneno.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli hauna uwezo ya kutafsiri hii maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tel, enfin triomphant de sa digue impuissante, / un fier torrent s'échappe, et l'onde mugissante / traîne, en précipitant ses flots amoncelés, / pâtre, étable et troupeau, confusément roulés.
target_text: Ku mwisho aliweza kuzibia mayi kuingia kwenye jengo yake isiyokuwa nguvu, / mufereji ya kiburi inapasula, nawimbi ya kunguruma / inabakia, ikitingiza fasi za kuyala mayi / mchungaji, nyumba ya minyama na minyama, inageuka muviringo.
target_text_raw: Ku mwisho aliweza kuzibia mayi kuingia kwenye jengo yake isiyokuwa nguvu, / mufereji ya kiburi inapasula, nawimbi ya kunguruma / inabakia, ikitingiza fasi za kuyala mayi / mchungaji, nyumba ya minyama na minyama, inageuka muviringo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'avez pas le droit de me donner des ordres.
target_text: Hauna haki ya kunipa mashurti.
target_text_raw: Hauna haki ya kunipa mashurti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quoi ressemble la vie où vous vivez ?
target_text: Maisha yako ya zamani ilikuwa nafanana aye?
target_text_raw: Maisha yako ya zamani ilikuwa nafanana aye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quittez la pièce immédiatement.
target_text: Toka mu chumba mara moja.
target_text_raw: Toka mu chumba mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortons d'ici avant que les policiers n'arrivent.
target_text: Tutoke hapa kabla ba polisi habayafika.
target_text_raw: Tutoke hapa kabla ba polisi habayafika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton avenir est devant toi, surtout ne te retourne pas.
target_text: Maisha yako ya kesho iko mbele yako, usiangalie nyuma ata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Maisha yako ya kesho iko mbele yako, usiangalie nyuma ata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Déjà Peter se sentait las des gamines infantiles et voulait faire la connaissance d'une femme vraiment mûre.
target_text: Tayari Peter alikuwa anajisikia kuchoka na ba binti ya akili ya kitoto na alitaka kukutanana na mwanamuke wakukomala.
target_text_raw: Tayari Peter alikuwa anajisikia kuchoka na ba binti ya akili ya kitoto na alitaka kukutanana na mwanamuke wakukomala.

source_text: Alpha du Centaure est un système de trois étoiles. On ne sait pas encore s'il a des planètes.
target_text: Alpha du Centaure ni mfumo wa nyota tatu. Hatuyajuwa kama iko na ma planètes.
target_text_raw: Alpha du Centaure ni mfumo wa nyota tatu. Hatuyajuwa kama iko na ma planètes.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai rencontré un mec super.
target_text: Nilikutanana na mtu mzuri.
target_text_raw: Nilikutanana na mtu mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le commandant refusa de négocier.
target_text: Kamanda alikatala kuongea.
target_text_raw: Kamanda alikatala kuongea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un gentleman ne ferait pas une chose pareille.
target_text: Mwanaume musirimu hangefanya jambo kama hiyo.
target_text_raw: Mwanaume musirimu hangefanya jambo kama hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu penses que Théo nous a menti?
target_text: Unawaza kamaTheo alitudanganya?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kamaTheo alitudanganya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jeune promis au mariage, cherche contact avec monsieur expérimenté, pour qu'il le convainque de ne pas le faire.
target_text: Kijana mwenye anakaribia kuoa, anatafuta kuonana na mtu mzoefu, juu amushaurie kutofanya hivyo.
target_text_raw: Kijana mwenye anakaribia kuoa, anatafuta kuonana na mtu mzoefu, juu amushaurie kutofanya hivyo.

source_text: Marie sent super bon.
target_text: Marie anatosha harufu ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Marie anatosha harufu ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants de Max sont adorables. Les enfants d'Alain sont bien plus pénibles.
target_text: Watoto wa Max wako na tabiya muzuri. Watoto wa Alain wanasumbua sana.
target_text_raw: Watoto wa Max wako na tabiya muzuri. Watoto wa Alain wanasumbua sana.

source_text: Vous pourriez au moins tâcher d'être un peu plus poli, même si ça ne vous ressemble pas.

target_text_raw: Unaweza jaribu basi kuwa ata adabu kidogo, hata kama haufanani kuwa nayo.

source_text: De nuit, Yanis a été menacé d'un couteau, dans la rue, par un inconnu qui lui a dérobé son argent.
target_text: Usiku, Yanis alitishiwa na kisu barabarani na mtu asiyejulikana na kumuiba pesa.
target_text_raw: Usiku, Yanis alitishiwa na kisu barabarani na mtu asiyejulikana na kumuiba pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un régime démocratique, raciste et colonialiste c'est une chose rare dans le monde, mais c'est également une anomalie absurde qui devrait absolument changer.
target_text: Utawala wa kidemokrasia, wa kibaguzi na wa kikoloni ni kitu yenye haikuwaki sana mu dunia, lakini pia ni shida ya kijinga yenye inapashwa badilika kabisa.
target_text_raw: Utawala wa kidemokrasia, wa kibaguzi na wa kikoloni ni kitu yenye haikuwaki sana mu dunia, lakini pia ni shida ya kijinga yenye inapashwa badilika kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu aimes les boules.
target_text: Unapenda bitu ya muviringo.
target_text_raw: Unapenda bitu ya muviringo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu sûre de vouloir jeter cela ?

target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kama unataka kuitupa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'obscurité ne peut pas chasser l'obscurité, seule la lumière le peut. (Martin Luther King Jr.)
target_text: Giza haiwezi kufukuza giza, mwangaza tu njo inaweza.
target_text_raw: Giza haiwezi kufukuza giza, mwangaza tu njo inaweza. (Martin Luther King Jr.)
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes félicitations du fond du cœur !
target_text: Hongera zangu za zati!
target_text_raw: Hongera zangu za zati!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La première fois que vous rencontrez une personne, vous devriez être attentive à la proximité avec laquelle vous vous tenez par rapport à elle.
target_text: Unapokutanana na mtu kwa mara ya kwanza, unapashwa kuwa muangalifu kuhusu umbali kati yako na yeye.
target_text_raw: Unapokutanana na mtu kwa mara ya kwanza, unapashwa kuwa muangalifu kuhusu umbali kati yako na yeye.

target_text_raw: Mwizi alijaribu kuchomeka kisu mu mwili ya kijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Consolons-nous de ne pas savoir les rapports qui peuvent être entre une araignée et l'anneau de Saturne, et continuons à examiner ce qui est à notre portée.
target_text: Tufarijiwe kwa kutokujua mahusiano yenye inaweza kuwa kati ya buibui na pete ya Saturne, na tuendelee kuchunguza kile kyenye kiko mbele yetu.

source_text: C'est lui qu'on a promu colonel.
target_text: Yeye njo alipandishwa cheo ya kanali.
target_text_raw: Yeye njo alipandishwa cheo ya kanali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Unahitaji dereva juu ya kukurudisha ku nyumbani baadaye?

target_text_raw: Thomas iko na FBI.

target_text_raw: Uliniahidi kama utawashughulikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Unajua kama miye sijachezaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Unajua, hauwezi kutakutana watu wazuri kuliko siye..

target_text_raw: Kila mtu alikuwa naniita Tony ile wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mec, sérieusement.

target_text_raw: Jamaa, bila muza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j’avais su qu’on prenait une photo, je me serais mieux habillé que ça.
target_text: Ingekuwa nilikuwa najua kama tutakamatiwa foto, ningekuya navala muzuri kuliko hivi.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa nilikuwa najua kama tutakamatiwa foto, ningekuya navala muzuri kuliko hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au lycée, il se mettait à dos tous ses amis avec ses moqueries continuelles.
target_text: Kwenye shule ya sekondari, alikuwaka nasumbua barafiki yake kwa kubachokoza kila mara.
target_text_raw: Kwenye shule ya sekondari, alikuwaka nasumbua barafiki yake kwa kubachokoza kila mara.

source_text: Les policiers ont battu la campagne toute la journée pour trouver un enfant disparu.

source_text: La pauvre femme pleura son mari pendant quelque temps, mais, à vrai dire l'argent que je lui apportais fut pour elle une puissante consolation; huit semaines plus tard elle épousait un planteur du voisinage. Ainsi va le monde !
target_text: Mwanamuke munyonge alimlilia bwana yake kwa muda fulani, lakini, kusema kweli, pesa nilizo mupelekea zilikuwa faraja kubwa kwake; kisha juma munane aliolewa na muliwayi wa karibu. Njo gisi dunia inakuwaka.

target_text_raw: Sababu, hukumu, binakuyaka polepole, kusema bitu bila musingi inakuyaka mu kikundi.

source_text: Il paraît tendre en surface, mais au fond, il a une volonté de fer qui fait de lui un négociateur extrêmement coriace.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des agents de renfort, tels que le sable, sont ajoutés à l'eau, pour élargir les fissures nouvellement créées.

target_text_raw: Mwalimu wetu wa hesabu hajui kufundisha hata kidogo.

source_text: On peut facilement dire que les deux balles ont le même poids.
target_text: Inaweza semwa kwa urahisi kama mipira mbili ziko na buzito ya sawa.
target_text_raw: Inaweza semwa kwa urahisi kama mipira mbili ziko na buzito ya sawa.

source_text: Il voit flotter épars les débris d'Ilion, / en devine la cause, et reconnaît Junon.
target_text: Anaona mabaki ya kusambarana ya Ilion inazunguruka, / anawaza sababu, na anamutambua Juno.
target_text_raw: Anaona mabaki ya kusambarana ya Ilion inazunguruka, / anawaza sababu, na anamutambua Juno.
