source_text: J'ai dit au roi : « Votre majesté, pardonnez-moi ! »
target_text: Nilimwambia mfalme: “Kwa heshima na uwezo wako, nisamehe! »
target_text_raw: Nilimwambia mfalme: “Kwa heshima na uwezo wako, nisamehe! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était absolument incroyable.
target_text: Ilikuwa ya kushangaza kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa ya kushangaza kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ne prennent pas conscience qu'ils sont utilisés comme des pions pour atteindre un objectif politique plus large.
target_text: Hawajui kama wanatumikiswha kama wa pelelezi kama kwa kufikia lengo kubwa ya kisiasa.
target_text_raw: Hawajui kama wanatumikiswha kama wa pelelezi kama kwa kufikia lengo kubwa ya kisiasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demandais juste quel type de chien tu as à la maison.
target_text: Nilikuwa najiuliza tu ni aina gani ya imbwa uko nayo ku nyumba.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa najiuliza tu ni aina gani ya imbwa uko nayo ku nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que c'est que ce grand drôle de Yankee qui ose dicter des lois aux honnêtes citoyens de l'Arkansas ? Incendions sa maison et faisons-le rôtir avec sa femme et ses domestiques !
target_text: Huyu Yankee wa kuchekesha ni nanin juu asubutu kuumrisha sheria kwa raia waaminifu wa Arkansas? Tulunguze nyumba yake na tumuchome na muke wake na watumishi wake!
target_text_raw: Huyu Yankee wa kuchekesha ni nanin juu asubutu kuumrisha sheria kwa raia waaminifu wa Arkansas? Tulunguze nyumba yake na tumuchome na muke wake na watumishi wake!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Adam purgea trois ans pour possession de drogues.
target_text: Adam alimaliza miaka tatu mu jela kwa kumiliki dawa za kulevya.
target_text_raw: Adam alimaliza miaka tatu mu jela kwa kumiliki dawa za kulevya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez rester ici, vous êtes bienvenue.
target_text: Kama unataka kubakia hapa, unakaribishwa.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka kubakia hapa, unakaribishwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui va doucement, va sûrement.
target_text: Mwenye anatembea polepole anatembea na uhakika.
target_text_raw: Mwenye anatembea polepole anatembea na uhakika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le héros est devenu le méchant.
target_text: Shujaa anageuka muovu.
target_text_raw: Shujaa anageuka muovu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo est un mec sympa. Tout le monde l'aime.
target_text: Enzo ni mutu muzuri. Kila mutu anamupenda.
target_text_raw: Enzo ni mutu muzuri. Kila mutu anamupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les idéologies et les révolutions, ça prend surtout parce qu'il y a toujours des masses de nazes incultes prêtes à gober les discours fumeux d'illuminés.
target_text: Idéologies na mapinduzi, zinakuwa zinashinda sana sana kwa sababu kila mara kunakuwaka raia wa pumbafu ambao wanaitikaka bila kuwaza hotuba za watu wenye kudai kuwa na akili zaidi na kujua ukweli
target_text_raw: Idéologies na mapinduzi, zinakuwa zinashinda sana sana kwa sababu kila mara kunakuwaka raia wa pumbafu ambao wanaitikaka bila kuwaza hotuba za watu wenye kudai kuwa na akili zaidi na kujua ukweli
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a trois actes de gouvernement : éclairer, soutenir, combattre : éclairer les aveugles, soutenir les faibles, combattre les ennemis.
target_text: Kuna matendo tatu ya serkali: kuangaza, kusaidia, kupambana: kuangazia vipofu, kuanga mkono wazaifu, kupambana na maadui.
target_text_raw: Kuna matendo tatu ya serkali: kuangaza, kusaidia, kupambana: kuangazia vipofu, kuanga mkono wazaifu, kupambana na maadui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu faire tourner un ballon de basket sur le bout de ton doigt ?
target_text: Unaweza kuzungurusha mupira ya basket ku kidole yako?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuzungurusha mupira ya basket ku kidole yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment est-ce que les bébés font pour respirer lorsqu'ils sont dans l'utérus ?
target_text: Watoto wanapumua namna gani wakati wako ndani ya tumbo?
target_text_raw: Watoto wanapumua namna gani wakati wako ndani ya tumbo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chut ! Elle dort !
target_text: Nyamanza! Analala!
target_text_raw: Nyamanza! Analala!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se bat le dos au mur.
target_text: Anapiga mgongo ku kibambazi.
target_text_raw: Anapiga mgongo ku kibambazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La dispute de Dan avec le policier a été capturée sur la vidéo de surveillance.
target_text: Muzozano ya Dan na polisi ilikamatwa ku video ya surveillance.
target_text_raw: Muzozano ya Dan na polisi ilikamatwa ku video ya surveillance.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me donnes un verre de lait?
target_text: Unaweza kunipa verre ya maziwa?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kunipa verre ya maziwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À la sortie de l'école, le dealer est toujours là.
target_text: Mwisho ya masomo, muuzishaji bado iko.
target_text_raw: Mwisho ya masomo, muuzishaji bado iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le futur est voilé par les soucis, l’horizon invisible aux yeux.
target_text: Maisha ya kesho inafunikwa na wasiwasi, ya kutokea inaonekana kwa macho.
target_text_raw: Maisha ya kesho inafunikwa na wasiwasi, ya kutokea inaonekana kwa macho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a suffisamment de talent pour gérer une affaire.
target_text: Iko na kipaji ya kutosha kwa kufanya shughuli ya biashara.
target_text_raw: Iko na kipaji ya kutosha kwa kufanya shughuli ya biashara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lors de sa déposition, il était au bord des larmes.
target_text: Wakati wa ushuhuda yake, alikaribia kulia.
target_text_raw: Wakati wa ushuhuda yake, alikaribia kulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fille me donna une orange en échange d'un morceau de gâteau.
target_text: Binti alinipa orange kwa kubadilisha na kipande ya keki.
target_text_raw: Binti alinipa orange kwa kubadilisha na kipande ya keki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouvez rester ici si vous voulez, aussi longtemps que vous restez tranquilles.
target_text: Unaweza bakia hapa ukitaka, kwa muda yote ile unapojisikia uko mu ukimya.
target_text_raw: Unaweza bakia hapa ukitaka, kwa muda yote ile unapojisikia uko mu ukimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne bougez pas jusqu'à ce que je vous le dise !
target_text: Usitingizike mpaka saa nitakwambia!
target_text_raw: Usitingizike mpaka saa nitakwambia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: — Pourquoi as-tu menti ? dit-il à voix basse. C’est ton amoureux. — Mais non, je te jure ! cria-t-elle.
target_text: — Juu ya nini ulidanganya? alisema kwa sauti ya chini. Yeye ni mupenzi wako. — Hapana, minakulapia ! alisema kwa sauti kubwa.
target_text_raw: — Juu ya nini ulidanganya? alisema kwa sauti ya chini. Yeye ni mupenzi wako. — Hapana, minakulapia ! alisema kwa sauti kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La semaine dernière, je lui ai envoyé quelques souvenirs des USA.
target_text: Juma iliyopita nilimutumia zawadi za ukumbusho kutoka USA.
target_text_raw: Juma iliyopita nilimutumia zawadi za ukumbusho kutoka USA.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça me fout les boules.
target_text: Inanisirikisha.
target_text_raw: Inanisirikisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allé à la gare Victoria où j'ai rencontré un vieil ami.
target_text: Nilienda ku kituo cha Victoria ambapo nilikutana na rafiki yangu wa zamani.
target_text_raw: Nilienda ku kituo cha Victoria ambapo nilikutana na rafiki yangu wa zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous comprendrez qu'il ne me soit pas possible de faire des commentaires sur des détails. L'enquête continue.
target_text: Utaelewa kuwa haiwezekani kwangu kutoa commentaires ya maelezo zaidi. Uchunguzi unaendelea.
target_text_raw: Utaelewa kuwa haiwezekani kwangu kutoa commentaires ya maelezo zaidi. Uchunguzi unaendelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir changer de comportement.
target_text: Tunapashwa badilisha tabia.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa badilisha tabia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Montre-moi ce que tu as caché derrière ton dos !
target_text: Nionyeshe beynye unaficha nyuma ya mgongo yako!
target_text_raw: Nionyeshe beynye unaficha nyuma ya mgongo yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu reviens avant dix heures, tu peux aller au bal.
target_text: Ukirudi kabla ya saa kumi, unaweza enda ku sherehe.
target_text_raw: Ukirudi kabla ya saa kumi, unaweza enda ku sherehe (bal).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'avais su que tu étais là, je ne serais pas venue.
target_text: Ningejuwa kama ulikuwa pale, singekuya.
target_text_raw: Ningejuwa kama ulikuwa pale, singekuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me croyez pas juste sur parole.
target_text: Usiniaminie tu kwa maneno.
target_text_raw: Usiniaminie tu kwa maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trop tard ! Louis nous a déjà vus.
target_text: Unachelewa ! Louis alishatuona.
target_text_raw: Unachelewa ! Louis alishatuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'était-il pas supposé neiger, la nuit passée ?
target_text: Si neige ingepashwa shuka, busiku iliyopita?
target_text_raw: Si neige ingepashwa shuka, busiku iliyopita?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut que j'y retourne et que je vérifie.
target_text: Minapashwa nirudia ako na nichunguze.
target_text_raw: Minapashwa nirudia ako na nichunguze.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous supplie de me donner un peu d'eau.
target_text: Minaomba unipe maji kidogo.
target_text_raw: Minaomba unipe maji kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aucune preuve ADN n'a été trouvée.
target_text: Hakuna ushahidi wa ADN uliopatikana.
target_text_raw: Hakuna ushahidi wa ADN uliopatikana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette tournée est pour moi. Que voudriez-vous ?
target_text: Iyi tour ni yangu. Ungependa nini?
target_text_raw: Iyi tour ni yangu. Ungependa nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée, je suis occupée maintenant.
target_text: Samahani, niko na bitu yakufanya sai.
target_text_raw: Samahani, niko na bitu yakufanya sai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela révèle l'ambition des dirigeants locaux de redonner à la région son niveau d'excellence.
target_text: Hii inaonekana kuwa lengo ya viongozi wa eneo ya kurudisha jimbo katika kiwango chake cha ubora.
target_text_raw: Hii inaonekana kuwa lengo ya viongozi wa eneo ya kurudisha jimbo katika kiwango chake cha ubora.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces vêtements sales pourraient constituer une nouvelle preuve de son innocence.
target_text: Hizi nguo ya buchafu zinaweza kuwa ushahidi zaidi wake wa kutokuwa na hatia.
target_text_raw: Hizi nguo ya buchafu zinaweza kuwa ushahidi zaidi wake wa kutokuwa na hatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prends du temps pour tes amis, sinon le temps te les prendra.
target_text: Kamata muda juu ya marafiki wako, kama haiko ivyo wakati itakunyanganya abo.
target_text_raw: Kamata muda juu ya marafiki wako, kama haiko ivyo wakati itakunyanganya abo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée de vous déranger si souvent.
target_text: Samahani kukusumbua mara mingi.
target_text_raw: Samahani kukusumbua mara mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous verrai plus tard, d'accord ?
target_text: Nitakuona baadaye, sawa?
target_text_raw: Nitakuona baadaye, sawa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a fait clairement comprendre qu'elle voulait aller à la fac.
target_text: Alionesha wazi kuwa anataka kwenda chuo kikuu.
target_text_raw: Alionesha wazi kuwa anataka kwenda chuo kikuu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégagez simplement d'ici !
target_text: Toka tu hapa!
target_text_raw: Toka tu hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez visiter Kyoto, qui est célèbre pour ses anciens temples et ses sanctuaires.
target_text: Unapashwa kutembelea Kyoto, ambayo ni maarufu kwa mahekalu na eneo zake takatifu za zamani.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kutembelea Kyoto, ambayo ni maarufu kwa mahekalu na eneo zake takatifu za zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette nana est comme une Birkenstock : t'es super bien dedans mais t'as l'air ridicule.
target_text: Uyu binti ni kama Birkenstock: unajisikia muzuri ndani yake lakini unaonekana mujinga.
target_text_raw: Uyu binti ni kama Birkenstock: unajisikia muzuri ndani yake lakini unaonekana mujinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je désire parler à une avocate.
target_text: Nataka kuongea na avocat.
target_text_raw: Nataka kuongea na avocat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton coup de fil m’a donné un bon prétexte pour m’échapper de cette soirée morose.
target_text: Appel yako ya simu ilinipa kisingizio muzuri ya kutokwenda kwa ile sherehe ya kusikitisha.
target_text_raw: Appel yako ya simu ilinipa kisingizio muzuri ya kutokwenda kwa ile sherehe ya kusikitisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et j'ajouterais, dans le prolongement de ce que tu disais, que non seulement c'est ennuyeux, mais ça va coûter fort cher.
target_text: Na ningeongeza, kutoka kwa ile yenye ulikuwa nasema, kwamba siyo tu inachosha, lakini itakuwa beyi sana.
target_text_raw: Na ningeongeza, kutoka kwa ile yenye ulikuwa nasema, kwamba siyo tu inachosha, lakini itakuwa beyi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le médecin arriva in extremis.
target_text: Daktari alifika ku dakika ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Daktari alifika ku dakika ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout un chacun peut se rendre compte que votre intérêt est réel.
target_text: Mtu yoyote anaweza ona kama lengo yenu ni ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Mtu yoyote anaweza ona kama lengo yenu ni ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas sûre de suivre ce que tu dis.
target_text: Sizani kama minasikie chenye unasema.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama minasikie chenye unasema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En quelque sorte, il est une encyclopédie vivante.
target_text: Ni kama vile, ni encyclopédie hai.
target_text_raw: Ni kama vile, ni encyclopédie hai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Désolé, je ne le fais pas sans ta pote.
target_text: Samahani, siifanyi bila rafiki yako.
target_text_raw: Samahani, siifanyi bila rafiki yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus tard, quand ils sortirent, il n’y avait pas âme qui vive sur les quais. La ville, avec ses cyprès avait un air sinistre, mais la mer était encore agitée, et se fracassait sur le rivage.
target_text: Walipotoka baadaye, hakuna mtu mwenye aliishi kwenye bandari. Muji, na miti yake ya cypres ilionekana kuwa na uzuni, lakini bahari haikukuwa natulia, na ilikuwa nagonga kwenye kando.
target_text_raw: Walipotoka baadaye, hakuna mtu mwenye aliishi kwenye bandari. Muji, na miti yake ya cypres ilionekana kuwa na uzuni, lakini bahari haikukuwa natulia, na ilikuwa nagonga kwenye kando.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était une sacrée surprise.
target_text: Ilikuwa suprise kubwa sana.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa suprise kubwa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas trop.
target_text: Usiwe na mashaka.
target_text_raw: Usiwe na mashaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La balle est dans votre camp.
target_text: Mupira iko mu kambi yako.
target_text_raw: Mupira iko mu kambi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: « Weye ni Marie Poppins, si ndiyo? » « Ndio, kwa kweli, prénom yangu ni Marie na nom de jeune fille yangu ni Poppins. Lakini unajua aye hiyo? »
target_text_raw: « Weye ni Marie Poppins, si ndiyo? » « Ndio, kwa kweli, prénom yangu ni Marie na nom de jeune fille yangu ni Poppins. Lakini unajua aye hiyo? »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vais pas tenter le Diable.
target_text: Sitajaribu shetani.
target_text_raw: Sitajaribu shetani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tandis que toutes sortes de moyens de communication se multiplient, les relations humaines s'affaiblissent. Un parfait cas de confusion entre les moyens et les fins.
target_text: Kadari njia za mawasiliano zinazidi kuongezeka, uhusiano wa kibinadamu unazoofika. Mufano muzuri ya kuchanganyikiwa kati ya uwezo na malengo.
target_text_raw: Kadari njia za mawasiliano zinazidi kuongezeka, uhusiano wa kibinadamu unazoofika. Mufano muzuri ya kuchanganyikiwa kati ya uwezo na malengo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mille diables ! Ma liaison réseau est interrompue.
target_text: Mashetani elfu moya! Liaison yangu ya mtandao anajikata.
target_text_raw: Mashetani elfu moya! Liaison yangu ya mtandao anajikata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crains de paraître vêtue avec trop de cérémonie.
target_text: Ninaogopa kuonekana minavala manguo kama vile za sherehe.
target_text_raw: Ninaogopa kuonekana minavala manguo kama vile za sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne m'attendais pas à ce que tu fasses ça.
target_text: Sikutegemea kama ungefanya hivi.
target_text_raw: Sikutegemea kama ungefanya hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ho, Tom, emmène-moi avec toi !
target_text: Ho, Tom, nipeleke na weye!
target_text_raw: Ho, Tom, nipeleke na weye!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons mesurer votre tension oculaire, - veuillez ouvrir grand vos yeux et regarder fixement en direction de cet objet.
target_text: Tunahitaji kukupima tatizo ya macho, - tafazali fungula macho yako sana na uangalie hii kitu.
target_text_raw: Tunahitaji kukupima tatizo ya macho, - tafazali fungula macho yako sana na uangalie hii kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tant que notre relation est définie par nos différences, nous renforcerons ceux qui sèment la haine plutôt que la paix, et qui promeuvent le conflit plutôt que la coopération qui peut aider tout notre peuple à atteindre justice et prospérité.
target_text: Wakati uhusiano yetu inatembelea ku tafauti zetu, tutaimarisha wale wenye kupanda chuki kuliko amani, na kuhimiza mizozo kuliko ushirikiano ambao inaweza kusaidia raia wetu wote kufikia haki na matumaini.
target_text_raw: Wakati uhusiano yetu inatembelea ku tafauti zetu, tutaimarisha wale wenye kupanda chuki kuliko amani, na kuhimiza mizozo kuliko ushirikiano ambao inaweza kusaidia raia wetu wote kufikia haki na matumaini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cependant, ô délire ! on poursuit sans alarmes, / et dans nos murs enfin, par un zèle insensé, / l'auteur de leur ruine en triomphe est placé.
target_text: Lakini, we shida! Tunaendelea bila kengele, / na kwa mwisho ndani ya kibambazi yetu, kwa bidii yenye haina maana, / muanzilishi wa uharibifu kwa ushindi amewekwa.
target_text_raw: Lakini, we shida! Tunaendelea bila kengele, / na kwa mwisho ndani ya kibambazi yetu, kwa bidii yenye haina maana, / muanzilishi wa uharibifu kwa ushindi amewekwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a quitté sa femme et s'est mis en ménage avec une femme moitié plus jeune.
target_text: Aliache bibi yake na kuishi na mwanamuke wa nusu ya miaka yake.
target_text_raw: Aliache bibi yake na kuishi na mwanamuke wa nusu ya miaka yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons installé notre tente et avons construit un feu de camp.
target_text: Tulijenga hema yetu na tukawasha moto.
target_text_raw: Tulijenga hema yetu na tukawasha moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les traducteurs professionnels se spécialisent souvent dans un seul domaine, par exemple le droit ou la médecine.
target_text: Mara mingi "watafsiri professionnels" banasomeaka kitu moya tu, kwa mfano sheria ao buganga.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi "watafsiri professionnels" banasomeaka kitu (domaine) moya tu, kwa mfano sheria ao buganga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un « resto U » est une sorte de restaurant où l'on peut manger quelque chose pour vraiment pas cher lorsqu'on est étudiant, et où, lorsqu'on a de la chance, on n'est pas malade.
target_text: "Resto U" ni aina ya restaurant ambako unaweza kula kitu ya bei chini wakati uko mwanafunzi, na ambako, wakati uko na bahati, hauko mgonjwa.
target_text_raw: "Resto U" ni aina ya restaurant ambako unaweza kula kitu ya bei chini wakati uko mwanafunzi, na ambako, wakati uko na bahati, hauko mgonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aurais pas voulu rater ce voyage, pour rien au monde, pas même pour tout le thé de Chine.
target_text: Singependa kukosa hii safari, hakuna kwa sababu gani, hata kwa sababu ya chai yote ya China.
target_text_raw: Singependa kukosa hii safari, hakuna kwa sababu gani, hata kwa sababu ya chai yote ya China.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia est notre ennemi juré.
target_text: Kylia ni adui yetu mukubwa.
target_text_raw: Kylia ni adui yetu mukubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la vie, rien ne se résout, tout continue. On demeure dans l'incertitude, et on restera jusqu'à la fin sans savoir à quoi s'en tenir.
target_text: Mu maisha, hakuna kitu kinacho tatuliwa, kila kitu kinaendelea. Tunabakia mu hali ya sintofahamu, na tutakaa mpaka mwisho bila kujua nini njo itatokea.
target_text_raw: Mu maisha, hakuna kitu kinacho tatuliwa, kila kitu kinaendelea. Tunabakia mu hali ya sintofahamu, na tutakaa mpaka mwisho bila kujua nini njo itatokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est lourd, mais je peux m'en sortir.
target_text: Iko buzito, lakini ninaweza weza.
target_text_raw: Iko buzito, lakini ninaweza weza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il doit être condamné pour avoir rompu sa promesse.
target_text: Anapashwa hukumiwa kwa kuvunja ahadi yake.
target_text_raw: Anapashwa hukumiwa kwa kuvunja ahadi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En ce temps-là, je me voyais plutôt comme un beau mec.
target_text: Wakati huo, nilijiona kama mtu mzuri.
target_text_raw: Wakati huo, nilijiona kama mtu mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu travailles trop. Fais une pause!
target_text: Unatumika sana. Pumzika!
target_text_raw: Unatumika sana. Pumzika!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Baisse le niveau, s'il te plait.
target_text: Punguza kiwango, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Punguza kiwango, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te laisse filer pour cette fois, mais je ne veux plus jamais t'attraper en train de voler.
target_text: Nitakuacha uende leo, lakini sitaki tena nikukamate uko naiba.
target_text_raw: Nitakuacha uende leo, lakini sitaki tena nikukamate uko naiba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'après une estimation, la production d'acier devrait atteindre les 100 millions de tonnes cette année.
target_text: Hii mwaka, production ya acier inakadiriwa kufikia toni milioni 100.
target_text_raw: Hii mwaka, production ya acier (chuma) inakadiriwa kufikia toni milioni 100.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu t'en sortir saine et sauve ?
target_text: Unaweza maliza ukiwa salama?
target_text_raw: Unaweza maliza ukiwa salama?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me tins assis dans une antichambre pendant une heure et finalement, une demoiselle me fit comprendre en allemand, que je devrais revenir à deux heures de l'après-midi.
target_text: Niliikala mu salle ya mapokezi kwa saa moja na ku mwisho binti mchanga alinielewesha mu Kijerumani kama ningepashwa kurudia saa munane ya muchana.
target_text_raw: Niliikala mu salle ya mapokezi (salle d'atteinte) kwa saa moja na ku mwisho binti mchanga alinielewesha mu Kijerumani kama ningepashwa kurudia saa munane ya muchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On peut manger le chou, cru.
target_text: Tunaweza kula choux mubichi.
target_text_raw: Tunaweza kula choux mubichi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Comme vous fugitive, / comme vous exilée, enfin sur cette rive / j'ai trouvé le repos ; partagez sa douceur : / malheureuse, j'appris à plaindre le malheur. "
target_text: "Unapo toroka na kutafutiwa, / kama vile mukimbiza, kwenye hii kando ya bahari / nilipata mapumuziko; kugabula upole wake: / bila furaha, nilijifunza kusikitika na mateso. "
target_text_raw: "Unapo toroka na kutafutiwa, / kama vile mukimbiza, kwenye hii kando ya bahari / nilipata mapumuziko; kugabula upole wake: / bila furaha, nilijifunza kusikitika na mateso. "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est tard et demain on se réveille tôt.
target_text: Ilishakuwa nyuma na kesho tutalamuka mapema.
target_text_raw: Ilishakuwa nyuma na kesho tutalamuka mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Greenwich Village est un endroit qui attire surtout les jeunes.
target_text: Kijiji cha Greenwich ni mahali yenye inavutia zaidi vijana.
target_text_raw: Kijiji cha Greenwich ni mahali yenye inavutia zaidi vijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sympa, la bagnole !
target_text: Gari ya muzuri!
target_text_raw: Gari ya muzuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serais reconnaissante si vous pouviez jeter un œil lorsque vous avez du temps un de ces quatre.
target_text: Nitashukuru kama unaweza kupiga licho kwa iyi wakati utapata muda mwa hizi siku ine zenye zinakuya.
target_text_raw: Nitashukuru kama unaweza kupiga licho kwa iyi wakati utapata muda mwa hizi siku ine zenye zinakuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Serveuse, que fait cette mouche dans ma soupe ? » - « Je dirais du dos crawlé, monsieur ! »
target_text: « Mhudumu, nini njo hii inzi iko nafanya mu supu yangu? » - « Naweza sema ni dos crawlé, bwana! »
target_text_raw: « Mhudumu, nini njo hii inzi iko nafanya mu supu yangu? » - « Naweza sema ni dos crawlé (kunawa na mugongo), bwana! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous feriez tout aussi bien de jeter votre argent par les fenêtres que de le dépenser au jeu.
target_text: Ungefanya pia kutupa pesa ku dirisha zako kuliko kuzitumiakisha ku mchezo.
target_text_raw: Ungefanya pia kutupa pesa ku dirisha zako kuliko kuzitumiakisha ku mchezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai enfin contacté par téléphone.
target_text: Nilifikia kuwasiliana naye ku telephone.
target_text_raw: Nilifikia kuwasiliana naye ku telephone.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'y touchez pas, ça se cassera facilement.
target_text: Usiguse, itavunjika.
target_text_raw: Usiguse, itavunjika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le lait était vendu dans des bouteilles de verre.
target_text: Maziwa yaliuzishwa mu ma chupa za verre.
target_text_raw: Maziwa yaliuzishwa mu ma chupa za verre.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a des gens qui tiennent dix fois plus facilement un discours qu'une seule fois leur parole.
target_text: Piko watu wanaongeaka mara kumi kwa urahisi zaidi kuliko kutumiza ahadi yabo ata limoya.
target_text_raw: Piko watu wanaongeaka mara kumi kwa urahisi zaidi kuliko kutumiza ahadi yabo ata limoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La prévention des feux de forêt relève de la responsabilité de chacun.
target_text: Kuzuwia moto ya misitu ni jukumu ya kila mtu.
target_text_raw: Kuzuwia moto ya misitu ni jukumu ya kila mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'assisterai sans faute à ton enterrement.
target_text: Nitahuzuria ku mazishi yako bila shaka.
target_text_raw: Nitahuzuria ku mazishi yako bila shaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reprends tout.
target_text: Nitakamate yote.
target_text_raw: Nitakamate yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon nom est Maria Sara.
target_text: Naitwa Maria Sara.
target_text_raw: Naitwa Maria Sara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux qu'on prenne immédiatement soin de cette affaire.
target_text: Nataka hii jambo ishughulikiwe mara moja.
target_text_raw: Nataka hii jambo ishughulikiwe mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus on l'explique, moins c'est impressionnant.
target_text: Inapoelezea zaidi, haivutii.
target_text_raw: Inapoelezea zaidi, haivutii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon a essayé de déplacer le canapé lourd.
target_text: Kijana alijaribu kusogeza kiti ya diva ya buzito.
target_text_raw: Kijana alijaribu kusogeza kiti ya diva ya buzito.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas qu'un jour la majorité de la population mondiale parlera Espéranto.
target_text: Sizani kama siku moja idadi kubwa ya watu ulimwenguni watazungumza Kiesperanto.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama siku moja idadi kubwa ya watu ulimwenguni watazungumza Kiesperanto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le médecin a dit qu'il irait mieux s'il prenait son médicament.
target_text: Muganga alisema atakuwa muzuri kama atakuwa nakunywa madawa.
target_text_raw: Muganga alisema atakuwa muzuri kama atakuwa nakunywa madawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se sentit mal à l'aise en pensant à son futur.
target_text: Alijisikia mubaya kufikiria juu ya maisha yake yakesho.
target_text_raw: Alijisikia mubaya kufikiria juu ya maisha yake yakesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sincèrement navré.
target_text: Samahani sana.
target_text_raw: Samahani sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prince Guillaume est le second en ligne de succession au trône d'Angleterre.
target_text: Prince Guillaume ndiye wa pili kwenye katika ukoo ya kiti cha enzi cha Uingereza.
target_text_raw: Prince Guillaume ndiye wa pili kwenye katika ukoo ya kiti cha enzi cha Uingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un pessimiste voit la difficulté dans chaque opportunité, un optimiste voit l'opportunité dans chaque difficulté.
target_text: Mtu mwenye kukiri kushindwa anaonakana shida fasi yote, mwenye matumaini anaonaka fursa mu kila shida.
target_text_raw: Mtu mwenye kukiri kushindwa anaonakana shida fasi yote, mwenye matumaini anaonaka fursa mu kila shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les progrès fulgurants de la technologie sont la preuve de l'ingéniosité humaine.
target_text: Maendeleo ya haraka ya teknolojia ni uzibitisho ya akili na ujuzi wa kibinadamu.
target_text_raw: Maendeleo ya haraka ya teknolojia ni uzibitisho ya akili na ujuzi wa kibinadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'arrêtes pas de répéter la même chose.
target_text: Unaendelea kurudiliana kitu kimoya.
target_text_raw: Unaendelea kurudiliana kitu kimoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Ici, c'est un parking payant." "Ah oui ? Alors montrez-moi votre badge de gardien."
target_text: "Hii ni parking ya kulipa." "Ah ndio? Sasa nioneshe kitambulisho yako ya mulinzi. "
target_text_raw: "Hii ni parking ya kulipa." "Ah ndio? Sasa nioneshe kitambulisho (badge) yako ya mulinzi. "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Surtout pas de panique, Enzo !
target_text: Usiogope ata kidogo, Enzo!
target_text_raw: Usiogope ata kidogo, Enzo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des erreurs de cette sorte passent facilement inaperçues.
target_text: Makosa ya aina hii inapita bila kujua.
target_text_raw: Makosa ya aina hii inapita bila kujua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au niveau local, il est nécessaire d'agir.
target_text: Katika kiwango cha mitaa, ni muhimu kutenda.
target_text_raw: Katika kiwango cha mitaa, ni muhimu kutenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous partons à la pension.
target_text: Tunaenda mu internat ya masomo.
target_text_raw: Tunaenda mu internat ya masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai déposé une copie du contrat d'assurance à la banque.
target_text: Nili déposer copie ya contrat ya assurance ku banki.
target_text_raw: Nili déposer copie ya contrat ya assurance ku banki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo fit une liste des chansons qu'il n'aimait pas.
target_text: Hugo alifanya liste ya nyimbo zenye hakukuwa napenda.
target_text_raw: Hugo alifanya liste ya nyimbo zenye hakukuwa napenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se sentait prise d'un profond respect pour ce qu'on appelle le faubourg Saint-Germain, c'est-à-dire pour cette aristocratie incomparable qui se croit supérieure à tout le genre humain par droit de naissance.
target_text: Alisikia sawa kuheshimia sana kitu yenye inaitwa Faubourg Saint-Germain, inamaanisha kwamba kwa hiyi utawala ya watu wa ukoo moja isiyo na mufano ambayo inaamini kuwa bora kuliko binadamu yoyote kutokana na haki ya kuzaliwa.
target_text_raw: Alisikia sawa kuheshimia sana kitu yenye inaitwa Faubourg Saint-Germain, inamaanisha kwamba kwa hiyi utawala ya watu wa ukoo moja isiyo na mufano ambayo inaamini kuwa bora kuliko binadamu yoyote kutokana na haki ya kuzaliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas étonnant que vous n'ayez pas trouvé ces mots.
target_text: Haishangazi kuona haukupata iyi maneno.
target_text_raw: Haishangazi kuona haukupata iyi maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a perdu la clé de son casier pendant qu'elle nageait dans la piscine.
target_text: Alipoteza fungulo ya kabati yake wakati alikuwa naogelea mu piscine.
target_text_raw: Alipoteza fungulo ya kabati yake wakati alikuwa naogelea mu piscine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne la jouez pas fine avec moi.
target_text: Usiniletee bujanja yako.
target_text_raw: Usiniletee bujanja yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Donne-moi un sandwich à la choucroute ! » disait Cicéron.
target_text: « Nipe sandwich ya choucroute! » alisema Cicéron.
target_text_raw: « Nipe sandwich ya choucroute! » alisema Cicéron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo se crève à la tâche.
target_text: Enzo anajiuwa na kazi.
target_text_raw: Enzo anajiuwa na kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu arrives trop tard.
target_text: Unafika unachelewa sana.
target_text_raw: Unafika unachelewa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te remercie pour cette charmante soirée.
target_text: Ninakushukuru kwa iyi mangaribi ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ninakushukuru kwa iyi mangaribi ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Retournez d'où vous venez.
target_text: Rudia kwenye unatoka.
target_text_raw: Rudia kwenye unatoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De nombreuses fois, mes potes étaient si avides de longues histoires, qu'ils m'ont fait m'endormir au milieu d'un récit, à mi-chemin d'une phrase, entre des syllabes.
target_text: Mara nyingi barafiki yangu balikuwaka na hamu ya adisi za murefu mpaka bakafanyaka niachie adisi mu katikati juu ya busingizi, katikati ya musemo, katikati ya herufi.

source_text: « Dis-moi, est-ce ton estomac ou le mien qui fait ces bruits ? » « C'est le tien, déjà autrefois il gargouillait toujours quand tu avais faim. »

source_text: Et lorsque vous m'adressez la parole, enlevez votre chapeau.

target_text_raw: Wakati unaongea na miye, vua kofia yako.

source_text: Il est nécessaire de trouver un compromis raisonnable.

source_text: Quand les bombes sont tombées sur notre port et la tyrannie menaçait le monde, elle était là pour témoigner l'ascension d'une génération à la grandeur et une démocratie était sauvée. Oui, nous pouvons.
target_text: Wakati bombe zilianguka kwenye bandari yetu na udikteta ilikuwa natishia dunia, alikuwa apo kushuhudia kuongezeka kwa kizazi kubwa na demokrasia iliokolewa. Ndio, tunaweza.

source_text: Dans la rêverie, nous réfléchissons, nous cherchons, pour revenir sur le passé, à ralentir, à suspendre le mouvement perpétuel où nous sommes entraînés.
target_text: Wakati ya kufikiria bya zamani, tunatafakari, tunatafuta, juu ya kurudia mu siku zilizo pita, kupunguza mwendo, kusimamisha mouvement ya kudumu yenye tunazoweya fata.

source_text: Je le jure devant Dieu, si quelqu'un de plus ici dit "robot géant", vous êtes tous aussi bien que mort.

target_text_raw: Unaweza kujivunia binti yako, alipata pongezi za jury jury.

target_text_raw: Nilikuona, ee murembo, na nikapita naanza kupenda!

target_text_raw: Gari iliharibika na nikaipeleka ku garage kuitengeneza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La rencontre des bouches est la plus parfaite, la plus divine sensation qui soit donnée aux humains, la dernière, la suprême limite du bonheur.
target_text: Mukutano ya binywa ni kamilifu zaidi, sentiment ya kimungu yenye ilipewa kwa binadamu, ya mwisho, hatua ya mwisho ya furaha.

source_text: Un gars a failli nous rentrer dedans.

target_text_raw: Kijana alikaribia kutuingia amo.

source_text: Louis Blériot a traversé la Manche en 1909, de Sangatte à Douvres.

target_text_raw: Louis Blériot alivuka bahari mnamo mwaka 1909, kutoka Sangatte kwenda Dover.

target_text_raw: Ukosefu wa ajira inchini Ufaransa inafikia mu niveau yenye haiwayi fikia.

target_text_raw: Ijapokuwa vita kali, uyu shujaa alianguka chini akiwa anakufa.

source_text: Je l’ai trouvée entrain de jouer au ballon.

target_text_raw: Nilimkuta iko nacheza mupira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il disait que, quand il était jeune, on pouvait voir sur la promenade du bord de la mer des dames en chapeau.
target_text: Alikuwa nasema kama, wakati alikuwa mudogo, wakati ya matembezi kando ya bahari palikuwa wamamuke wenye kuvala kofia.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nasema kama, wakati alikuwa mudogo, wakati ya matembezi kando ya bahari palikuwa wamamuke wenye kuvala kofia.

source_text: Bienvenue, Mesdames, Mesdemoiselles, Messieurs !

target_text_raw: Karibu, wa mama na wa baba!

source_text: Il y a des paroles qui tuent mieux qu'une balle.

target_text_raw: Piko maneno yenye inauwaka muzuri kuliko lisasi.

target_text_raw: Mbele ya yote batman ni shujaa.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont le droit de retourner dans leur pays et aucun argument historique, politique, légal, sécuritaire, religieux, moral, philosophique ou mythologique n'est valable pour les priver de ce droit.
target_text: Wapalestina biko na haki ya kurudia mu inchi yabo na hakuna mutazomo ya kihistoria, kisiasa, kisheria, kiusalama, kidini, kitabia, kifikra ao hadisi za bongo zenye zinaweza waima hii haki.

target_text_raw: Kile chenye unaona, pembeni ya muti, siyo hema lakini ni lundo ya nyasi.

target_text_raw: Miye ni Mupalestina, nilizaliwa na kukomalia Palestina na minaamini kama niko na haki ya kurudia mu inchi yangu.

source_text: Cette fête était super, mec !

target_text_raw: Hii sherehe ilikuwa muzuri sana, jamaa!

source_text: Ne sois pas fâchée ! J'ai seulement raconté aux gens comme je suis heureux avec toi.

target_text_raw: Usisirike! Niliambia tu batu gisi niko na furaha ya kuwa naye.

target_text_raw: Meli tatu zilileta wanahaki kutoka Sicile, na ilikuwa natokea jangwani.

target_text_raw: Mwanamuke anadai kuwa na haki ya kuchagua na heshima ya kuchaguliwa.

target_text_raw: Nilijitahidi sana, lakini sikupata matokeo yenye nilikuwa natarajia.

target_text_raw: Tumefika mahali kwenye barabara inajigabula mara pili.

target_text_raw: Nilishangala kuona, huyu psycholgue wa kuheshimia alishtakiwa kwa kuteka nyara.

target_text_raw: Kama angekuwa napenda kutupigia simu, tungeongeaka nae kwa furaha.

target_text_raw: Kama singeitiakaka mu imbwa, singekimbiaka.

target_text_raw: Minakushukuru kwa kunikaribisha na furaha.

target_text_raw: Uko naona kila kitu kinajirudia amo?

target_text_raw: Samahani kwa kukupigia simu nyuma sana. Nilikuwa nataka tu nisikie sauti yako.

target_text: Wasomi wengi katika iyi jimbo ya kibaguzi na kikoloni wanataka wazaliwa wa iyi eneo wenye kuishi mu wilaya zenye zilisha chukuliwa wapotee kabisa. Kama sivyo, aye njo wanaweza kuhakikisha kuendelea kuzingatia kitambulisho cha ukabila na kidini juu ya jimbo yenye wanatetea?
target_text_raw: Wasomi wengi katika iyi jimbo ya kibaguzi na kikoloni wanataka wazaliwa wa iyi eneo wenye kuishi mu wilaya zenye zilisha chukuliwa wapotee kabisa. Kama sivyo, aye njo wanaweza kuhakikisha kuendelea kuzingatia kitambulisho cha ukabila na kidini juu ya jimbo yenye wanatetea?
