target_text_raw: Usitarajie mtu yyote kukusaidia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La littérature kabyle est née de rien. Elle avance, elle se développe d'elle même, elle progresse doucement, elle cherche son chemin.
target_text: Littérature ya Kabyle iliundwa bila kitu. Inasonga mbele, inajiendelesha yepeke, inaendelea polepole, inatafuta njia yake.
target_text_raw: Littérature (masomo kuhusu maandishi) ya Kabyle iliundwa bila kitu. Inasonga mbele, inajiendelesha yepeke, inaendelea polepole, inatafuta njia yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fait super froid dehors. Il vaudrait mieux sortir avec des vêtements plus chauds.
target_text: Piko baridi mingi inje. Itakuwa bora kwenda inje na nguo za baridi.
target_text_raw: Piko baridi mingi inje. Itakuwa bora kwenda inje na nguo za baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis Anthony.
target_text: Miye ni Anthony.
target_text_raw: Miye ni Anthony.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as le droit de dire tout ce que tu penses... si tu penses comme moi.
target_text: Unaweza sema kila kitu yenye unawaza... kama unawaza kama miye.
target_text_raw: Unaweza sema kila kitu yenye unawaza... kama unawaza kama miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je soulevai ma fille de telle sorte qu'elle puisse placer l'étoile au haut de l'arbre de Noël.
target_text: Nilinyangula binti yangu juu aweze kumweka nyota julu ya muti ya Noeli.
target_text_raw: Nilinyangula binti yangu juu aweze kumweka nyota julu ya muti ya Noeli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne change surtout rien, c'est parfait comme ça !
target_text: Usibadilishe chochote, ni muzuri sana hivo!
target_text_raw: Usibadilishe chochote, ni muzuri sana hivo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que ça ira bien pour moi.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama itakuwa sawa kwangu.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama itakuwa sawa kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un cercle illustre d'invités triés sur le volet offre l'occasion unique de passer une soirée de légende.
target_text: Mzunguko muzuri ya wageni iliyo chaguliwa kwa makini inapanaka fursa ya kipekee ya kupitisha sherehe mu hali nzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Mzunguko muzuri ya wageni iliyo chaguliwa kwa makini inapanaka fursa ya kipekee ya kupitisha sherehe mu hali nzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne jetez pas la balle près des fenêtres.
target_text: Usitupe mupira karibu na madirisha.
target_text_raw: Usitupe mupira karibu na madirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Penses-tu que tu puisses faire en sorte que les choses continuent à fonctionner jusqu'à ce que je revienne ?
target_text: Unazani kama unaweza kuendelesha bitu mpaka wakati nitarudia?
target_text_raw: Unazani kama unaweza kuendelesha bitu mpaka wakati nitarudia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " O fureur ! Quoi ! Pallas, une simple déesse, / a bien pu foudroyer les vaisseaux de la Grèce ; / soldats, chefs, matelots, tout périt sous ses yeux : / Pourquoi ? pour quelques torts d'un jeune furieux. "
target_text: "O Hasira ! Nini! Pallas, mungu wa kike wa kawaida, / alipiga radi meli za kijeshi za Ugiriki; / ma askari, viongozi, waendesha mashua, kila kitu kiliangamia mbele ya macho yake: / Juu ya nini? kwa makosa fulani ya kijana wa hasira kali. "
target_text_raw: "O Hasira ! Nini! Pallas, mungu wa kike wa kawaida, / alipiga radi meli za kijeshi za Ugiriki; / ma askari, viongozi, waendesha mashua, kila kitu kiliangamia mbele ya macho yake: / Juu ya nini? kwa makosa fulani ya kijana wa hasira kali. "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: He ! Allez, vite ! Il est déjà tard !
target_text: He ! Wende haraka! Ilishakuwa nyuma!
target_text_raw: He ! Wende haraka! Ilishakuwa nyuma!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas sûre à cent pour cent de ce que vous voulez dire.
target_text: Sina uhakika kwa asilimia mia moja na yenye unataka sema.
target_text_raw: Sina uhakika kwa asilimia mia moja na yenye unataka sema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand j'ai dit que le travail était devenu plus prenant et que nous pourrions partager les tâches domestiques, mon époux a fait la tête.
target_text: Niliposema kwamba kazi ilisha kuwa nguvu na kwamba tunaweza gabula kazi za mu nyumba, bwana yangu alisirika.
target_text_raw: Niliposema kwamba kazi ilisha kuwa nguvu na kwamba tunaweza gabula kazi za mu nyumba, bwana yangu alisirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis un traducteur engagé, pas un tube digestif qui mange et chie.
target_text: Miye ni mtafsiri aliye jitolea, siyo njia ya butumbutumbu yenye inakulaka na kunyamba.
target_text_raw: Miye ni mtafsiri aliye jitolea, siyo njia ya butumbutumbu yenye inakulaka na kunyamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle comprendra peut-être plus tard ce que j'ai voulu dire.
target_text: Labda atakuwa elewa nyumba kitu yenye nilikuwa namaanisha.
target_text_raw: Labda atakuwa elewa nyumba kitu yenye nilikuwa namaanisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un angle droit mesure 90 degrés.
target_text: Pembe ya kulia inapimaka 90 degrés.
target_text_raw: Pembe ya kulia inapimaka 90 degrés.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le quatrième document est un extrait d’un décret qui propose la confiscation des biens du clergé, en revendiquant la souveraineté de la nation au-dessus de toute autre souveraineté en matière de propriété territoriale.
target_text: Document ya nne ni sehemu ya sheria yenye inashauri kunyanganya wa padiri mali yabo, na inadai kujitegemea kwa taifa mbele ya kujitegemea katika swala ya mali ya wilaya.
target_text_raw: Document ya nne ni sehemu ya sheria yenye inashauri kunyanganya wa padiri mali yabo, na inadai kujitegemea kwa taifa mbele ya kujitegemea katika swala ya mali ya wilaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-lui que tu l'aimes avant qu'il ne soit trop tard.
target_text: Mwambie unamupenda ingali mbele.
target_text_raw: Mwambie unamupenda ingali mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis est allergique aux poils de chien.
target_text: Yanis apendaki ata kidogo manyoa ya imbwa.
target_text_raw: Yanis apendaki ata kidogo manyoa ya imbwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque Seigneur est Empereur de sa terre.
target_text: Kila Bwana ni Mfalme wa eneo yake.
target_text_raw: Kila Bwana ni Mfalme wa eneo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'inspecteur fut accusé d'avoir dissimulé des preuves sur la scène du crime.
target_text: Inspektere alishtakiwa kwa kuficha ushahidi kwenye eneo ya mauaji.
target_text_raw: Inspektere alishtakiwa kwa kuficha ushahidi kwenye eneo ya mauaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chéri, il y a un petit robot à la porte d'entrée et il souhaite te parler.
target_text: Mpenzi, piko ka robot ka kidogo kwenye mlango ya kuingililia na kangetaka kuongea na weye.
target_text_raw: Mpenzi, piko ka robot ka kidogo kwenye mlango ya kuingililia na kangetaka kuongea na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai tendu des cordes de clocher à clocher ; des guirlandes de fenêtre à fenêtre ; des chaînes d'or d'étoile à étoile et je danse.
target_text: Nilinyorosha kamba kutoka kati ya munara ya kengele na munara ya kengele; maua dirisha kwa dirisha; chainettes ya zahabu nyota kwa nyota, na minacheza.
target_text_raw: Nilinyorosha kamba kutoka kati ya munara ya kengele na munara ya kengele; maua dirisha kwa dirisha; chainettes ya zahabu nyota kwa nyota, na minacheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tâche de ne pas traîner la nuit sur les routes.
target_text: Jaribu kutotembelea mu ma barabara wakati ya busiku.
target_text_raw: Jaribu kutotembelea mu ma barabara wakati ya busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Professeur Hiroshi Ishiguro de l'université d'Osaka a inventé un télénoïde qui pourrait remplacer les téléphones portables dans le futur.
target_text: Mwalimu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Osaka Hiroshi Ishiguro aliunda telenoide ambayo inaweza kukamata fasi ya simu za mukonooni mu siku zijazo.
target_text_raw: Mwalimu wa Chuo Kikuu cha Osaka Hiroshi Ishiguro aliunda telenoide ambayo inaweza kukamata fasi ya simu za mukonooni mu siku zijazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que c'est faux.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama haiko kweli.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama haiko kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dépêche-toi, sinon nous arriverons trop tard.
target_text: Fanya haraka, kama sivyo tutachelewa.
target_text_raw: Fanya haraka, kama sivyo tutachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle doit revenir à la maison au plus tard à 9 heures.
target_text: Anapashwa rudia nyumbani mbele ya saa tatu ya asubui.
target_text_raw: Anapashwa rudia nyumbani mbele ya saa tatu ya asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « J'adorerais aller au bal avec vous. » « Vraiment ? Vous le voudriez ? »
target_text: « Ningependa kwenda ku sherehe na weye. » « Kweli ? Ungependa? »
target_text_raw: « Ningependa kwenda ku sherehe na weye. » « Kweli ? Ungependa? »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoutez, je suis un peu occupée.
target_text: Sikia, niko na kazi ya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Sikia, niko na kazi ya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son rêve s'est enfin réalisé.
target_text: Ndoto yake ilitimia.
target_text_raw: Ndoto yake ilitimia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Oh, Nathan ! Pourquoi devons-nous impérativement être un couple dans la vie? Nous le sommes sur scène et c'est suffisant !"-" Si tes admirateurs savaient qui tu étais vraiment !"
target_text: "Oh, Nathan! Juu ya nini tunapshwa kuwa wanandoa mu maisha? Tuko pamoja kwenye scène na inatosha! "-" Ingekuwa ata mashabiki wako wanajua uko nani kweli! "
target_text_raw: "Oh, Nathan! Juu ya nini tunapshwa kuwa wanandoa mu maisha? Tuko pamoja kwenye scène na inatosha! "-" Ingekuwa ata mashabiki wako wanajua uko nani kweli! "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des dizaines d'étudiants mâles et femelles dessinaient un unique modèle mâle - complètement nu - se tenant debout sur une estrade.
target_text: Makumi ya wanafunzi wa kiume na wa kike walikuwa nachapa mfano moja ya kiume - bila kuvala manguo - akiwa anashimama wima kwenye podium.
target_text_raw: Makumi ya wanafunzi wa kiume na wa kike walikuwa nachapa mfano moja ya kiume - bila kuvala manguo - akiwa anashimama wima kwenye podium.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie est venue trop tard.
target_text: Marie alikuya anachelewa
target_text_raw: Marie alikuya anachelewa
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il continue de boire trop, il tombera malade tôt ou tard.
target_text: Kama ataendelea nakunywa pombe kupita kiasi, atafikia kuanguka tu.
target_text_raw: Kama ataendelea nakunywa pombe kupita kiasi, atafikia kuanguka tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'imaginais que mon premier baiser serait plus romantique.
target_text: Nilikuwa nazani kama bizu yangu ya kwanza itakuwa ya kimapenzi zaidi.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nazani kama bizu yangu ya kwanza itakuwa ya kimapenzi zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a promis de ne pas sortir seule.
target_text: Aliahidi kama atatoka pekeyake.
target_text_raw: Aliahidi kama atatoka pekeyake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette histoire est trop incroyable pour être vraie.
target_text: Iyi hadisi ni ya kushangaza sana kusema ikuwe ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Iyi hadisi ni ya kushangaza sana kusema ikuwe ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bats les blancs en neige.
target_text: Achananisha blanc d'oeuf na jaune d'oeuf.
target_text_raw: Achananisha blanc d'oeuf na jaune d'oeuf.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a cru le pauvre, que tout le monde est comme lui.
target_text: Yoo na aliamini, kama kila mtu iko sawa yeye.
target_text_raw: Yoo na aliamini, kama kila mtu iko sawa yeye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela lui ressemble en effet beaucoup de dire cela.
target_text: Inamuonekana ako sana.
target_text_raw: Inamuonekana ako sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas est un mec sympa au grand cœur.
target_text: Thomas ni mtu muzuri na mwenye moyo mwema.
target_text_raw: Thomas ni mtu muzuri na mwenye moyo mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons minimiser le risque d'infection.
target_text: Tunapapashwa punguza hatari ya kuambukizwa.
target_text_raw: Tunapapashwa punguza hatari ya kuambukizwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouvez rester ici si vous voulez, aussi longtemps que vous restez tranquille.
target_text: Unaweza kubakia hapa ukitaka, ukijisikia uko mu ukimwa.
target_text_raw: Unaweza kubakia hapa ukitaka, ukijisikia uko mu ukimwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a menti au flic.
target_text: Tom alidanganya polisi.
target_text_raw: Tom alidanganya polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jamais je n'avais vu un tel bordel.
target_text: Siyawahi kuona bitu ya desordre kama iyi.
target_text_raw: Siyawahi kuona bitu ya desordre kama iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le berceau est aussi neuf que le nouveau-né couché dedans.
target_text: Berceau nayo iko mupya sawa vile mtoto wa kuzaliwa mwenye analazwa amo.
target_text_raw: Berceau nayo iko mupya sawa vile mtoto wa kuzaliwa mwenye analazwa amo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'avais su que vous étiez là, je ne serais pas venue.
target_text: Ingekuwa nilikuwa najua kama uko pale, singekuya.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa nilikuwa najua kama uko pale, singekuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne nous croyez pas sur parole.
target_text: Usiniamie ku maneno.
target_text_raw: Usiniamie ku maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il jure de s'amuser.
target_text: Analapa kujifurahisha.
target_text_raw: Analapa kujifurahisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je lui disais la vérité, il serait en colère.
target_text: Ningemwambia kweli, angesirika.
target_text_raw: Ningemwambia kweli, angesirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La carte de métro est simple à suivre.
target_text: Carte ya metro iko rahisi kufuata.
target_text_raw: Carte ya metro iko rahisi kufuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce soir on va manger un bœuf bourguignon chez un pote, on va se faire péter la panse !
target_text: Mangaribi ya leo tutakula nyama ya ngombe "bourguignon" kwa rafiki, tutapasuka tumbu!
target_text_raw: Mangaribi ya leo tutakula nyama ya ngombe "bourguignon" kwa rafiki, tutapasuka tumbu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce mec est une vraie girouette: il change constamment d'avis.
target_text: Uyu mtu ni girouette wa kuenea: anabadilishaka msimamo kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Uyu mtu ni girouette wa kuenea: anabadilishaka msimamo kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant la balle est dans votre camp !
target_text: Sasa uamuzi ni kwako!
target_text_raw: Sasa uamuzi ni kwako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Devinez combien de litres de bière ont été bus pendant la dernière fête de la bière.
target_text: Tombolesha ni litres ngapi za pombe njo zilikunywa wakati ya sherehe ya pombe iliyo pita.
target_text_raw: Tombolesha ni litres ngapi za pombe njo zilikunywa wakati ya sherehe ya pombe iliyo pita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allô, y a quelqu'un?
target_text: Allo, piko mtu?
target_text_raw: Allo, piko mtu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son nom est Michael.
target_text: Anaitwa Michael.
target_text_raw: Anaitwa Michael.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus on avance dans la soirée, plus les invités sont de choix.
target_text: Gisi sherehe inaendelea, wageni wanazidi kuwa chaguo.
target_text_raw: Gisi sherehe inaendelea, wageni wanazidi kuwa chaguo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est exact qu'elle enseigne le français à l'école.
target_text: Ni kweli kwamba anafundisha Kifaransa ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Ni kweli kwamba anafundisha Kifaransa ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vitesse tue.
target_text: Haraka inaua.
target_text_raw: Haraka inaua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le lac Biwa était visible de l'endroit, où je me tenais debout.
target_text: Ziwa Biwa ilionekana kutoka kwenye nilikuwa nashimama.
target_text_raw: Ziwa Biwa ilionekana kutoka kwenye nilikuwa nashimama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: David a tellement d'amies, qu'il ne peut même pas se rappeler de tous leurs noms.
target_text: David iko na barafiki bengi ba kike kwa gisi anaweza kumbuka majina yabo yote.
target_text_raw: David iko na barafiki bengi ba kike kwa gisi anaweza kumbuka majina yabo yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami était un tueur à gages professionnel.
target_text: Sami alikuwaka na kazi ya kuuwa batu kisha analipwa.
target_text_raw: Sami alikuwaka na kazi ya kuuwa batu kisha analipwa (tueur à gages).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De quel droit nous donnez-vous des ordres ?
target_text: Uko na uwezo gani juu utupatie masharti?
target_text_raw: Uko na uwezo gani juu utupatie masharti?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Souviens toi que nul ne peut me vaincre au combat, ni me corrompre avec de l'argent.
target_text: Kumbuka kwamba hakuna mtu mwenye anaweza kunishinda ku vita, wala kunipatia rushwa ya pesa.
target_text_raw: Kumbuka kwamba hakuna mtu mwenye anaweza kunishinda ku vita, wala kunipatia rushwa ya pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ennemi larguait des bombes sur l'usine.
target_text: Adui alikuwa napiga ma bombes ku kiwanda.
target_text_raw: Adui alikuwa napiga ma bombes ku kiwanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortez de mon siège !
target_text: Toka ku kiti yangu!
target_text_raw: Toka ku kiti yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est allée en Allemagne pour étudier la médecine.
target_text: Alienda Ujerumani kusoma udaktari.
target_text_raw: Alienda Ujerumani kusoma udaktari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai essayé de lui expliquer que l'on n'était pas responsable de ses erreurs mais il ne voulait rien entendre.
target_text: Nilijaribu kumwelezea kama hatukukuwa tunahusika na makosa yake lakini hakutaka kusikia chochote.
target_text_raw: Nilijaribu kumwelezea kama hatukukuwa tunahusika na makosa yake lakini hakutaka kusikia chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as travaillé dur depuis des mois et tu as certainement mérité des vacances.
target_text: Ulitumika sana tangu miezi mingi na ulistahili kupata likizo.
target_text_raw: Ulitumika sana tangu miezi mingi na ulistahili kupata likizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle travaille beaucoup: elle enseigne dans une école et a également un emploi dans un bar.
target_text: Anatumika sana: anafundisha katika shule na pia iko na kazi mu bar.
target_text_raw: Anatumika sana: anafundisha katika shule na pia iko na kazi mu bar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous remercie de m'offrir un si beau moment. Ces travaux, en fait, sont d'une beauté unique.
target_text: Asanti kwa kunipa wakati mzuri sana kama iyi. Hizi kazi, kwa kweli, ziko na uzuri ya kipekee.
target_text_raw: Asanti kwa kunipa wakati mzuri sana kama iyi. Hizi kazi, kwa kweli, ziko na uzuri ya kipekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai tenté de l'avertir à son sujet mais elle refuse de m'écouter.
target_text: Nilijaribu kumuonya kumuhusu lakini anakatala kunisikiliza.
target_text_raw: Nilijaribu kumuonya kumuhusu lakini anakatala kunisikiliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez monter prendre un verre ?
target_text: Ungependa kupanda kukamata verre?
target_text_raw: Ungependa kupanda kukamata verre?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es le prof de mon gamin.
target_text: Weye ni mwalimu wa mtoto wangu.
target_text_raw: Weye ni mwalimu wa mtoto wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je comprends que M. Collins vous ait fait une demande en mariage.
target_text: Ninaelewa kama Bwana Collins aliomba akuoe.
target_text_raw: Ninaelewa kama Bwana Collins aliomba akuoe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mike sait comment se défendre.
target_text: Mike anajua gisi ya kujitetea.
target_text_raw: Mike anajua gisi ya kujitetea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soyez prudente en lisant des ouvrages sur la santé. Vous pourriez mourir d'une erreur d'impression.
target_text: Kuwa mwangalifu unaposoma bitabu vinavyo husiana na afya. Unaweza kufa kutokana na erreur ya impression.
target_text_raw: Kuwa mwangalifu unaposoma bitabu vinavyo husiana na afya. Unaweza kufa kutokana na erreur ya impression.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voilà les faits qui nous amènent à la position que je viens d'exprimer.
target_text: Iyi njo ukweli yenye inapelekea kuchukua iyi msimamo ambao namaliza elezea.
target_text_raw: Iyi njo ukweli yenye inapelekea kuchukua iyi msimamo ambao namaliza elezea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te retourne surtout pas !
target_text: Usiangalie nyuma kabisa!
target_text_raw: Usiangalie nyuma kabisa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En voici quelques-unes : la question sociale, la libération de la femme, les questions d'éducation et de pédagogie, de droit, d'hygiène etc.
target_text: Izi ni baadhi yazo: swali ya kijamii, ukombozi ya wanawake, maswali ya elimu na ufundishaji, sheria, usafi , na kazalika.
target_text_raw: Izi ni baadhi yazo: swali ya kijamii, ukombozi ya wanawake, maswali ya elimu na ufundishaji, sheria, usafi , na kazalika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca avait l'air si pauvre et si triste.
target_text: Luca alikuwa naonekana munyonge na mwenye huzuni.
target_text_raw: Luca alikuwa naonekana munyonge na mwenye huzuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voudrions inviter Peter au Japon dans un futur proche.
target_text: Tungependa kumwalika Peter inchini Japani mu siku zijazo.
target_text_raw: Tungependa kumwalika Peter inchini Japani mu siku zijazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme vous êtes adulte, à présent, vous devriez bien mieux le savoir.
target_text: Kama weye ni mtu mzima, kwa sasa, ungepashwa kuijua muzuri zaidi.
target_text_raw: Kama weye ni mtu mzima, kwa sasa, ungepashwa kuijua muzuri zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez en contact avec moi.
target_text: Endelea kuwasiliana na miye.
target_text_raw: Endelea kuwasiliana na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le commandant Joki a une famille.
target_text: Komanda Joki iko na jamaa.
target_text_raw: Komanda Joki iko na jamaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le conflit commença sur un simple malentendu.
target_text: Muzozo inaanziaka mu ukosefu ya maelewano ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Muzozo inaanziaka mu ukosefu ya maelewano ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maxime sent super bon.
target_text: Maxime ananuka muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Maxime ananuka muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La religion, fût-elle fausse, est un élément nécessaire à la vie d'un peuple.
target_text: Dini, ata kama ni ya uongo, ni kitu ya lazima katika maisha ya watu.
target_text_raw: Dini, ata kama ni ya uongo, ni kitu ya lazima katika maisha ya watu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Relaxe, Max !
target_text: Pumuzika, Max!
target_text_raw: Pumuzika, Max!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous promets que j'expliquerai tout plus tard.
target_text: Minakuahidi kama nitaeleza kila kitu baadaye.
target_text_raw: Minakuahidi kama nitaeleza kila kitu baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas a été licencié pour faute grave pour avoir menti sur son CV.
target_text: Thomas alifukuzwa mu kazi juu ya kosa mkubwa ya kusema uongo ku CV yake.
target_text_raw: Thomas alifukuzwa mu kazi juu ya kosa mkubwa ya kusema uongo ku CV yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûre de vouloir jeter ça ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kama unataka kutupa iyi?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kama unataka kutupa iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La première fois que vous rencontrez une personne, vous devriez être attentif à la proximité avec laquelle vous vous tenez par rapport à elle.
target_text: Unapo kutanana na mtu mara ya kwanza, unapashwa kuwa muangalifu kuhusu umbali kati yako na yeye.
target_text_raw: Unapo kutanana na mtu mara ya kwanza, unapashwa kuwa muangalifu kuhusu umbali kati yako na yeye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu te moques de moi ou tu le penses sérieusement ?
target_text: Unanitania ao unasema kweli kabisa?
target_text_raw: Unanitania ao unasema kweli kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que vous auriez voulu que je fasse ?
target_text: Ungetaka nifanye nini?
target_text_raw: Ungetaka nifanye nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a été promu colonel.
target_text: Alipandishwa cheo kuwa kanali.
target_text_raw: Alipandishwa cheo kuwa kanali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous faut-il un conducteur pour vous ramener chez vous plus tard ?
target_text: Unahitaji dereva wa kukupeleka ku nyumba baadaye?
target_text_raw: Unahitaji dereva wa kukupeleka ku nyumba baadaye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le FBI a secrètement truffé de micros le repaire du bandit.
target_text: FBI iliweka kwa siri micro mahali jambazi alikuwa najificha.
target_text_raw: FBI iliweka kwa siri micro mahali jambazi alikuwa najificha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n’avons moralement aucunement le droit de nous mêler de cette affaire.
target_text: Hatuna haki ya kuingililia kati iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Hatuna haki ya kuingililia kati iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête de bouffer dans le lit, j'en ai marre de nettoyer après toi.
target_text: Acha kuwa nakulia mu kitanda, minachoka kukuwa napanguza.
target_text_raw: Acha kuwa nakulia mu kitanda, minachoka kukuwa napanguza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit que la soupe aux orties est très savoureuse, mais je ne veux surtout pas le vérifier.
target_text: Wanasemaka kama supu ya ortie inakuwaka butamu sana, lakini sitaki kuhakikisha kama ni kweli.
target_text_raw: Wanasemaka kama supu ya ortie inakuwaka butamu sana, lakini sitaki kuhakikisha kama ni kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont déterré une boite qui contenait des restes humains.
target_text: Walitosha sanduku mu budongo yenye lilikuwa na mabaki ya mtu.
target_text_raw: Walitosha sanduku mu budongo yenye lilikuwa na mabaki ya mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel est devenu anorexique lorsqu'il était étudiant au lycée.
target_text: Gabriel alikuwa anorexique wakati alikuwa mwanafunzi kwenye shule ya sekondari.
target_text_raw: Gabriel alikuwa anorexique (mtu mwenye kugonjwa bugonjwa ya kukosa appetit) wakati alikuwa mwanafunzi kwenye shule ya sekondari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'avocat revêtit sa toge avant d'aller défendre son client au procès.
target_text: Avocat alivala toge yake mbele ya kwenda kumtetea mteja wake mbele ya mahakama.
target_text_raw: Avocat alivala toge (kanzu) yake mbele ya kwenda kumtetea mteja (client) wake mbele ya mahakama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous partez maintenant, vous serez assurément à l'heure pour l'avion.
target_text: Ukienda sai, utafika kwa wakati juu ya kukamata ndege.
target_text_raw: Ukienda sai, utafika kwa wakati juu ya kukamata ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai utilisé Twitter, mais j'ai ensuite trouvé ça ennuyeux alors j'ai arrêté de l'utiliser.
target_text: Nilitumikisha Twitter, lakini nikaiona kama inachosha kwa hivyo niliacha kuitumikisha.
target_text_raw: Nilitumikisha Twitter, lakini nikaiona kama inachosha kwa hivyo niliacha kuitumikisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne pose pas de questions ! Contente-toi de me suivre !
target_text: Usiulize maswali! Nifuate tu!
target_text_raw: Usiulize maswali! Nifuate tu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Debout, bande de fainéants !
target_text: Shimama, kundi ya watu wavivu!
target_text_raw: Shimama, kundi ya watu wavivu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il voit sa petite copine tous les samedis.
target_text: Anaonanaka na mpenzi yake wa kike kila siku ya posho.
target_text_raw: Anaonanaka na mpenzi yake wa kike kila siku ya posho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Désolée, mais je dois me rendre d'urgence aux toilettes.
target_text: Samahani, lakini lazima niende ku toilettes haraka.
target_text_raw: Samahani, lakini lazima niende ku toilettes (wc) haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le débat a été organisé de telle sorte que chaque participant intervienne dix minutes.
target_text: Maongezi iliandaliwa kwa gisi kila mshiriki aliongea dakika kumi.
target_text_raw: Maongezi iliandaliwa kwa gisi kila mshiriki aliongea dakika kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les passagers chargent leurs valises et bagages dans le coffre.
target_text: Wasafiri wanapakia ma valises na mizigo zabo mu coffre.
target_text_raw: Wasafiri wanapakia ma valises na mizigo zabo mu coffre.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'élève a obtenu de meilleurs résultats que l'enseignant.
target_text: Mwanafunzi alipata alama za muzuri kuliko mwalimu.
target_text_raw: Mwanafunzi alipata alama za muzuri kuliko mwalimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne comprenez absolument rien.
target_text: Haulewi ata kitu.
target_text_raw: Haulewi ata kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne t'accuse pas pour l'accident. Ça n'a pas été ta faute.
target_text: Sikulaumu juu ya ajali. Haikukuwa kosa yako.
target_text_raw: Sikulaumu juu ya ajali. Haikukuwa kosa yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon nom est Alex, mais je préfèrerais que vous m'appeliez Augusto.
target_text: Naitwa Alex, lakini ningependa uniite Augusto.
target_text_raw: Naitwa Alex, lakini ningependa uniite Augusto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est venue vivre avec sa tante.
target_text: Alikuya kuishi na shangazi yake.
target_text_raw: Alikuya kuishi na shangazi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marika n'est pas un simple souvenir, un simple nom avec un simple visage dans ma mémoire. Marika fait partie de ma vie. C'est une partie de moi que je n'arriverai jamais à oublier.
target_text: Marika siyo kumbukumbu ya kawaida, jina ya kawaida na sura ya kawaida mu kichwa yangu. Marika ni sehemu ya maisha yangu. Ni sehemu yangu ambayo siwezi sahabu ata siku moya.
target_text_raw: Marika siyo kumbukumbu ya kawaida, jina ya kawaida na sura ya kawaida mu kichwa yangu. Marika ni sehemu ya maisha yangu. Ni sehemu yangu ambayo siwezi sahabu ata siku moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Portez ce que vous voulez.
target_text: Vala byenye unapenda.
target_text_raw: Vala byenye unapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son père revient toujours tard à la maison.
target_text: Baba yake anarudiaka kila siku ku nyumba anachelewa.
target_text_raw: Baba yake anarudiaka kila siku ku nyumba anachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous arriverez à 2h30 et Marie arrivera un peu plus tard.
target_text: Utafika saa munane na nusu na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Utafika saa munane na nusu na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton porte-monnaie ressemble au mien.
target_text: Porte-monnaie yako inafanana yangu.
target_text_raw: Porte-monnaie yako inafanana yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne leur tourne pas le dos.
target_text: Siwapi mugongo.
target_text_raw: Siwapi mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est dur d'aimer quelqu'un quand vous ne savez pas s'il vous aime autant que vous l'aimez.
target_text: Ni vigumu kumpenda mtu wakati haujui kama anakupenda kama unavyo mupenda.
target_text_raw: Ni vigumu kumpenda mtu wakati haujui kama anakupenda kama unavyo mupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai songé que tu n'aurais pas voulu que le professeur sache que tu n'avais pas encore fait tes devoirs.
target_text: Nilizani kama haukutaka mwalimu ajue kama haukufanya devoirs zako.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama haukutaka mwalimu ajue kama haukufanya devoirs zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils m'ont remis une copie du contrat d'assurance.
target_text: Walinipa copie ya mkataba ya assurance.
target_text_raw: Walinipa copie ya mkataba ya assurance.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande s'il arrivera à l'heure demain. On parie une cannette ?
target_text: Niko najiuliza kama batafika kwa wakati kesho. Tupingie cannette.
target_text_raw: Niko najiuliza kama batafika kwa wakati kesho. Tupingie cannette.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La mort tragique de la princesse Diana a choqué le monde.
target_text: Kifo ya gafla ya Princesse Diana kilishtua ulimwengu.
target_text_raw: Kifo ya gafla ya Princesse Diana kilishtua ulimwengu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le fantôme revêtait l'apparence d'une fée superbe.
target_text: Muzimu ilikuwa nafanana mwanamuke wa magie.
target_text_raw: Muzimu ilikuwa nafanana mwanamuke wa magie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne savons pas ce que nous devons faire ensuite.
target_text: Hatujui cha kufanya baadaye.
target_text_raw: Hatujui cha kufanya baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fausse annonce d'une explosion a fait paniquer les gens.
target_text: Tangazo ya bongo ya muripuko iliogopesha batu.
target_text_raw: Tangazo ya bongo ya muripuko iliogopesha batu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Ha, ha!", dit-il en espagnol.
target_text: "Ha, ha!" anasema mu Kihispania.
target_text_raw: "Ha, ha!" anasema mu Kihispania.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À trente-sept piges c'est encore un vrai gamin, qui achète des coussins-péteurs et trouve cela poilant, mon dieu ...
target_text: Ku piges makumi tatu na saba angali mudogo sana, ambaye anauza coussins-péteurs na anaona sawa ni kitu ya kuchekesha, mungu wangu ...
target_text_raw: Ku piges makumi tatu na saba angali mudogo sana, ambaye anauza coussins-péteurs na anaona sawa ni kitu ya kuchekesha, mungu wangu ...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jeune officier était attablé dans la chambre du fond devant un plat de saucisses et une bouteille de vin.
target_text: Officeir kijana alikuwa naikala ku meza mu chumba mbele ya saani ya saucisses na chupa ya muvinyo.
target_text_raw: Officeir kijana alikuwa naikala ku meza mu chumba mbele ya saani ya saucisses na chupa ya muvinyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où est caché le trésor reste un mystère.
target_text: Kwenye hazina inafichwa ni siri.
target_text_raw: Kwenye hazina inafichwa ni siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'attendais à ce que ça se produise, en quelque sorte.
target_text: Nilitarajia hiyo kutokea, kwa namna fulani.
target_text_raw: Nilitarajia hiyo kutokea, kwa namna fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans un costume de Saint-Nicolas, il y a toujours une fausse barbe touffue.
target_text: Mu constume ya Saint Nicholas, kunakuwaka ndevu ya munene ya bongo.
target_text_raw: Mu constume ya Saint Nicholas, kunakuwaka ndevu ya munene ya bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fais quatre fois plus par moi-même que quand j'ai engagé Tony pour la première fois.
target_text: Minafanya mara ine kuzidia miepeke kuliko wakati nilipatia Tony kazi kwa mara ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Minafanya mara ine kuzidia miepeke kuliko wakati nilipatia Tony kazi kwa mara ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sarah exigea d'être remboursée.
target_text: Sarah alidai alipwe.
target_text_raw: Sarah alidai alipwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est des musiciens qui savent créer une atmosphère en quelques notes.
target_text: Piko na wanamuziki wenye wanajua gisi ya ku créer ambiance kwa kutumia notes chaches tu.
target_text_raw: Piko na wanamuziki wenye wanajua gisi ya ku créer ambiance kwa kutumia notes chaches tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai marre de cette bande de tarés.
target_text: Minachoka na iyi kundi ya wajinga.
target_text_raw: Minachoka na iyi kundi ya wajinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nick n'a pas besoin de venir à mon bureau.
target_text: Nick haitaji kuya ku ofisi yangu.
target_text_raw: Nick haitaji kuya ku ofisi yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles arrivent à 2h30 et Marie arrive un peu plus tard.
target_text: Wanafika saa saba na nusu ya muchana na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Wanafika saa saba na nusu ya muchana na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son objectif est de réussir le test.
target_text: Lengo yake ni kufaulu mutihani.
target_text_raw: Lengo yake ni kufaulu mutihani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le plus tard on me contacte, le mieux, parce que je gagne ainsi du temps.
target_text: Ni muzuri kuwasiliana na miye nyuma kwa sababu naokoa wakati.
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri kuwasiliana na miye nyuma kwa sababu naokoa wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'équipe de tournage en est à sa cinquième prise parce que l'actrice n'arrête pas de foirer son texte.
target_text: Equipe ya tournage iko ku scène ya tano kwa sababu mwigizaji anaendelea kuharibisha script yake.
target_text_raw: Equipe ya tournage iko ku scène ya tano kwa sababu mwigizaji anaendelea kuharibisha script yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au régal des vermines, on retrouve toujours les mêmes à table.
target_text: Kwenye sikukuu ya bidudu, kunakuwaka za kufanana ku meza kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Kwenye sikukuu ya bidudu, kunakuwaka za kufanana ku meza kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai enfin trouvé la femme que je veux épouser.
target_text: Maraba nilipata mwanamuke wa kuoa.
target_text_raw: Maraba nilipata mwanamuke wa kuoa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous auriez pu me donner plus de temps pour arranger les choses.
target_text: Ungenipatia muda zaidi juu ya kutatua mambo.
target_text_raw: Ungenipatia muda zaidi juu ya kutatua mambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Stop au harcèlement des plus faibles.
target_text: Tunapinga unyanyasaji ya wanyonge.
target_text_raw: Tunapinga unyanyasaji ya wanyonge.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'avait encor grossie une foule nouvelle, / femmes, enfants, vieillards, restes infortunés / chargés de leurs débris, à l'exil condamnés.
target_text: Watu waliendelea kuongezeka, / wanawake, watoto, wazee, na wengine wasiyo kuwa na bakati / wakielemewa na mizigo yabo ya buchafu, walihukumia kwenda ukumbizini.
target_text_raw: Watu waliendelea kuongezeka, / wanawake, watoto, wazee, na wengine wasiyo kuwa na bakati / wakielemewa na mizigo yabo ya buchafu, walihukumia kwenda ukumbizini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sauter à la corde est ce que ma fille préfère.
target_text: Binti yangu anapendaka kuruka kumba.
target_text_raw: Binti yangu anapendaka kuruka kumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cambrioleur est rentré par effraction chez lui.
target_text: Mwizi aliingia mu nyumba kwa makosa.
target_text_raw: Mwizi aliingia mu nyumba kwa makosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On n'a pas le droit de tourner à gauche dans cette rue.
target_text: Haturuhusiwi kugeuka kushoto mwa iyi barabara.
target_text_raw: Haturuhusiwi kugeuka kushoto mwa iyi barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas le temps de le répéter alors écoutez avec attention !
target_text: Sina muda wa kuirudilia kwa hivyo musikilize kwa makini!
target_text_raw: Sina muda wa kuirudilia kwa hivyo musikilize kwa makini!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous continuez à enfreindre les règles du club, vous en serez exclu.
target_text: Ukiendelea kuvunja sheria za club, utafukuzwa.
target_text_raw: Ukiendelea kuvunja sheria za club, utafukuzwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est l'âge ? D'abord on oublie les noms, et puis on oublie les visages, puis on oublie de remonter sa braguette, et puis on oublie de la descendre.
target_text: Uko na miaka ngapi? Kwanza tunasahabu majina, na kisha tunasahabu ma sura, kisha tunasahabu kupandisha étirette ya pantalon yetu, na kisha tunasahabu kuishusha.
target_text_raw: Uko na miaka ngapi? Kwanza tunasahabu majina, na kisha tunasahabu ma sura, kisha tunasahabu kupandisha étirette ya pantalon yetu, na kisha tunasahabu kuishusha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est sur la piste de danse.
target_text: Iko ku piste de danse
target_text_raw: Iko ku piste de danse
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est trop tard pour voter maintenant. Les bureaux de vote sont fermés.
target_text: Sasa ilishakuwa nyuma sana kwa kupiga kura. Vituo ya kupigia kura bilisha fungwa.
target_text_raw: Sasa ilishakuwa nyuma sana kwa kupiga kura. Vituo ya kupigia kura bilisha fungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous commettez un délit, vous serez puni.
target_text: Ukifanya kosa, utaazibiwa.
target_text_raw: Ukifanya kosa, utaazibiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jeune couple voit la vie en rose.
target_text: Vijana walio owana wanaona maisha nzuri.
target_text_raw: Vijana walio owana wanaona maisha nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégage !
target_text: Toka!
target_text_raw: Toka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui veut déambuler sur le sentier de la sagesse, ne doit avoir aucune crainte de l'échec, car pour autant qu'il progresse, sa cible reste pourtant à une distance inaccessible.
target_text: Mwenye anapenda tembea ku njia ya hekima, hawezi kuogopa kushindwa, kwa sababu kwa gisi anaendelea, lakini lengo yake inabakia mbali.
target_text_raw: Mwenye anapenda tembea ku njia ya hekima, hawezi kuogopa kushindwa, kwa sababu kwa gisi anaendelea, lakini lengo yake inabakia mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle chérit les souvenirs précieux de son enfance.
target_text: Anapenda makumbusho nzuri ya mu butoto yake.
target_text_raw: Anapenda makumbusho nzuri ya mu butoto yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le voleur a fui avec l'argent.
target_text: Mwizi alikimbiya na pesa.
target_text_raw: Mwizi alikimbiya na pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Steve était aimé de tout le monde.
target_text: Steve alikuwa napendwa na watu wote
target_text_raw: Steve alikuwa napendwa na watu wote
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pensé que vous vouliez sortir d'ici.
target_text: Niliwaza ulikuwa nataka toka umu.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza ulikuwa nataka toka umu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « La fête est super, vous ne trouvez pas ? » « C'est vrai, mais quelle chaleur ! »
target_text: « Sherehe iko muzuri, hauone ivyo? » « Ni kweli, lakini kifukutu iko mingi! »
target_text_raw: « Sherehe iko muzuri, hauone ivyo? » « Ni kweli, lakini kifukutu iko mingi! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À peu près la moitié des banquises du Canada a disparu durant les six dernières années.
target_text: Karibu nusu ya mito ya barafu ya Canada imepotea mu miaka sita iliyopita.
target_text_raw: Karibu nusu ya mito ya barafu ya Canada imepotea mu miaka sita iliyopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le policier mit le voleur à terre et lui passa les menottes.
target_text: Polisi alimutiya mwizi chini na kumufunga.
target_text_raw: Polisi alimutiya mwizi chini na kumufunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C’est super marrant.
target_text: Ni ya kuchekesha sana.
target_text_raw: Ni ya kuchekesha sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est probable qu'elle refuse de suivre ses conseils, car elle ne l'apprécie pas.
target_text: Inawezekana kwamba anakatala kufwata ushauri yake kwa sababu hampendi.
target_text_raw: Inawezekana kwamba anakatala kufwata ushauri yake kwa sababu hampendi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez ceci dans votre sac à dos.
target_text: Weka iyi mu sac yako ya kumugongo.
target_text_raw: Weka iyi mu sac yako ya kumugongo (sac à dos).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vendons pas mémé dans les orties avant de l'avoir tuée.
target_text: Tusiuzishe mémé ndani ya orties kabla hatuyaiuwa
target_text_raw: Tusiuzishe mémé ndani ya orties kabla hatuyaiuwa
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après dix ans comme partenaires en affaires, ils ont décidé de cheminer chacun de leur côté.
target_text: Baada ya miaka kumi kama washirika kwenye biashara, waliamua kila mtu anafate njia yake.
target_text_raw: Baada ya miaka kumi kama washirika kwenye biashara, waliamua kila mtu anafate njia yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je présenterai plus tard mes excuses.
target_text: Nitaomba msamaha baadaye.
target_text_raw: Nitaomba msamaha baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a donc 10 km de bouchons.
target_text: Kwa hivyo kuko kilomita 10 ya embouteillage.
target_text_raw: Kwa hivyo kuko kilomita 10 ya embouteillage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Comment est-ce que je me rends d'ici à la gare ? » « Toujours tout droit. »
target_text: « Minaweza jielekeza aye ku kitu kwa kutokea apa? » « Siku zote mu njia ya sawa. »
target_text_raw: « Minaweza jielekeza aye ku kitu kwa kutokea apa? » « Siku zote mu njia ya sawa. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trop dormi parce que je me suis couché tard.
target_text: Nililala sana sababu nililala nyuma.
target_text_raw: Nililala sana sababu nililala nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne dois jamais révéler ce que nous nous disons entre nous.
target_text: Haupashwe sema mambo ambayo tunaongeya kati yetu.
target_text_raw: Haupashwe sema mambo ambayo tunaongeya kati yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous êtes aussi courageux que vous le prétendez, eh ben venez vous battre !
target_text: Kama wewe ni jasiri kama unavyodai, kuya upigane!
target_text_raw: Kama wewe ni jasiri kama unavyodai, kuya upigane!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia a pris une photo de son ancienne caméra avec sa nouvelle caméra.
target_text: Kylia alikama picha ya kamera yake ya zamani na kamera yake mpya.
target_text_raw: Kylia alikama picha ya kamera yake ya zamani na kamera yake mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi donc avez-vous de la lumière à minuit ? Ouvrez. Je dois savoir ce que vous faites.
target_text: Juu ya nini uko na mwangaza katikati ya busiku? Fungula. Minapashwa juwa yale ambayo uko nafanya.
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini uko na mwangaza katikati ya busiku? Fungula. Minapashwa juwa yale ambayo uko nafanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Outre qu’il est trop tard pour faire les arrangements que tu me proposes je n’aurai jamais, au grand jamais, consenti à ce que l’on vienne solliciter pareille chose.
target_text: Hata kama ni nyuma sana kufanya mipango yenye unanishauri, sitawahi, kuwahi ata siku moya, kukubaliana tukuye uliza kitu kama hicho.
target_text_raw: Hata kama ni nyuma sana kufanya mipango yenye unanishauri, sitawahi, kuwahi ata siku moya, kukubaliana tukuye uliza kitu kama hicho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne penses qu'à t'amuser.
target_text: Unawaza tu kujifuraisha.
target_text_raw: Unawaza tu kujifuraisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le savant n’est pas l’homme qui fournit les vraies réponses, c’est celui qui pose les vraies questions.
target_text: Mwanasayansi siyo mtu anayepana majibu nzuri, yeye njo anaulizaka maswali ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Mwanasayansi siyo mtu anayepana majibu nzuri, yeye njo anaulizaka maswali ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si un problème a une solution, alors il est inutile de s'en inquiéter ; s'il n'en a pas, s'inquiéter n'y changera rien.
target_text: Kama shida iko na suluhisho, basi hakuna haja ya kuwa na wasiwasi; kama haiko hivyo, wasiwasi haita badilisha kitu.
target_text_raw: Kama shida iko na suluhisho, basi hakuna haja ya kuwa na wasiwasi; kama haiko hivyo, wasiwasi haita badilisha kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soldat disait qu'on ne devait pas redouter la mort.
target_text: Askari alisema kama hatupashwe ogopa kifo.
target_text_raw: Askari alisema kama hatupashwe ogopa kifo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a frappé une balle avec une batte.
target_text: Aligonga mupira na batte.
target_text_raw: Aligonga mupira na batte.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les musulmans appellent Jésus « Issa ».
target_text: Waislamu wanaitaka Yesu « Issa».
target_text_raw: Waislamu wanaitaka Yesu « Issa».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a un incendie dans l'immeuble. Nous devons évacuer immédiatement.
target_text: Nyumba inakamatiwa na moto. Tunapashwa toka sasa ivi.
target_text_raw: Nyumba inakamatiwa na moto. Tunapashwa toka sasa ivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis est arrivé à la gare trop tard donc il a raté le train.
target_text: Yanis alifika ku kituo na alishachelewa sana na hivyo akakosa gari moshi.
target_text_raw: Yanis alifika ku kituo na alishachelewa sana na hivyo akakosa gari moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C’est dans le malheur qu’on découvre ses vrais amis.
target_text: Ni ndani ya shida ndipo unatambua marafili wa kweli.
target_text_raw: Ni ndani ya shida ndipo unatambua marafili wa kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En sortant de la maison, Mariette remarque le superbe temps printanier.
target_text: Anapoondoka nyumbani, Mariette anagundua hali ya hewa nzuri ya printemps.
target_text_raw: Anapoondoka nyumbani, Mariette anagundua hali ya hewa nzuri ya printemps.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le caractère du Brésilien, il y a l'aménité de l'Indien, la douceur de l'ancien esclave noir et la mélancolie du Portugais.
target_text: Katika tabia ya Mbrazili, kuna tabiza nzuri ya Kihindi, upole wa mtumwa wa zamani mweusi na uchungu ya zamani ya Mureno.
target_text_raw: Katika tabia ya Mbrazili, kuna tabiza nzuri ya Kihindi, upole wa mtumwa wa zamani mweusi na uchungu ya zamani ya Mureno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En bref, j'ai été viré.
target_text: Kwa kifupi, nilifukuziwa mu kazi.
target_text_raw: Kwa kifupi, nilifukuziwa mu kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis Braille, qui était aveugle depuis l'âge de quatre ans, a inventé une méthode qui permet aux aveugles de lire.
target_text: Louis Braille, ambaye alikuwa kipofu tangu umri wa miaka minne, aligundua njia inayowaruhusu vipofu kusoma.
target_text_raw: Louis Braille, ambaye alikuwa kipofu tangu umri wa miaka minne, aligundua njia inayowaruhusu vipofu kusoma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne pouvons être les deux seules personnes qui aient oublié de payer leurs factures à temps.
target_text: Hatuwezi kuwa watu wawili tu ambao walisahau kulipa factures zabo kwa wakati.
target_text_raw: Hatuwezi kuwa watu wawili tu ambao walisahau kulipa factures zabo kwa wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un procureur arrive.
target_text: Mwendesha mashtaka anafika.
target_text_raw: Mwendesha mashtaka anafika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si quelqu'un me parlait de la sorte, j’appellerais la police.
target_text: Mutu akinisemesha kwa namna hiyo, nita ita polisi.
target_text_raw: Mutu akinisemesha kwa namna hiyo, nita ita polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De nombreuses personnes qui sont aveugles utilisent une forme d'écho-localisation, et ce que Daniel Kish fait, c'est qu'il se sert de cette capacité et l'affûte.
target_text: Watu wengi ambao ni vipofu wanatumia aina fulani ya kutambulishana kupitiya echo, na anachofanya Daniel Kish ni kutumia uwezo iyo na kuiboresha.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi ambao ni vipofu wanatumia aina fulani ya kutambulishana kupitiya echo, na anachofanya Daniel Kish ni kutumia uwezo iyo na kuiboresha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis venue simplement pour dire adieu.
target_text: Minakuya tu kusema kwaheri.
target_text_raw: Minakuya tu kusema kwaheri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez amener l'un de nous à le faire.
target_text: Ungelipashwa leta mutu mumoja mu siye kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Ungelipashwa leta mutu mumoja mu siye kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bus vous amène dans le centre-ville.
target_text: Bisi itakubeba mpaka mjini.
target_text_raw: Bisi itakubeba mpaka mjini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Y a-t-il quelque chose de particulier que tu recherches ?
target_text: Kuko kitu ya kipekee unatafuta?
target_text_raw: Kuko kitu ya kipekee unatafuta?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pardon, tu t’appelles comment, déjà ?
target_text: Samahani, unaitwa nani tena?
target_text_raw: Samahani, unaitwa nani tena?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée, mais l'heure d'aller te coucher est passée.
target_text: Samahani, lakini wakati ya kwenda kulala ilishapita.
target_text_raw: Samahani, lakini wakati ya kwenda kulala ilishapita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demain, je pourrai me reposer.
target_text: Kesho, minaweza kupumuzika.
target_text_raw: Kesho, minaweza kupumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton discours était superbe.
target_text: Hotuba yako ilikuwa muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Hotuba yako ilikuwa muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet athlète a fait preuve d'un formidable esprit sportif.
target_text: Uyu muchezaji alionesha kuwa na akili kijapi ya muchezo.
target_text_raw: Uyu muchezaji alionesha kuwa na akili kijapi ya muchezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis dit qu'une pause te ferait du bien.
target_text: Nilizani mapumziko itakufanya ujisikiye vizuri.
target_text_raw: Nilizani mapumziko itakufanya ujisikiye vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous savons tous que les chiens aiment grignoter des os.
target_text: Siye bote tunajua kama imbwa zinapenda kukula mifupa.
target_text_raw: Siye bote tunajua kama imbwa zinapenda kukula mifupa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu voyages à l'étranger, il est nécessaire que tu échanges ta monnaie par celle du pays que tu visites, pour payer un taxi, une tasse de café ou pour un pourboire.
target_text: Unaposafiri inje ya inchi, inahitajika ubadilishe makuta yako mwa ile ya inchi unayotembelea, kwa kulipa taksi, ama kikombe ya kahawa.
target_text_raw: Unaposafiri inje ya inchi, inahitajika ubadilishe makuta yako mwa ile ya inchi unayotembelea, kwa kulipa taksi, ama kikombe ya kahawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est pauvre comme Job.
target_text: Ni masikini kama Ayubu.
target_text_raw: Ni masikini kama Ayubu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-on se faire un masque au concombre tueur ?
target_text: Tunaweza fanya mask ya concombre tueur?
target_text_raw: Tunaweza fanya mask ya concombre tueur?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand le beurre est allé dans le cou du chien il est trop tard.
target_text: Wakati beurre inaingia mu shingo ya imbwa inakuwa nyuma sana.
target_text_raw: Wakati beurre inaingia mu shingo ya imbwa inakuwa nyuma sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les agents de sécurité ont déjoué la tentative de braquage.
target_text: Maaskari wa usalama walinguwa jaribio ya bwizi.
target_text_raw: Maaskari wa usalama walinguwa jaribio ya bwizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et, aux lueurs de la lampe rougeâtre, il présentait aux lèvres pâles de la mère le crâne nu et desséché de son fils.
target_text: Na, kwa mwangaza wa tala mwekundu, alikuwa na midomo ya rangi ya mweupe ya mama kichwa ya waz na ya mwembamba ya mtoto yake.
target_text_raw: Na, kwa mwangaza wa tala mwekundu, alikuwa na midomo ya rangi ya mweupe ya mama kichwa ya waz na ya mwembamba ya mtoto yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les détracteurs de la star américaine considèrent que cette chanson est blasphématoire.
target_text: Wakosoaji wa star wa Marekani wanadai kama iyi nyimbo inakufuru.
target_text_raw: Wakosoaji wa star wa Marekani wanadai kama iyi nyimbo inakufuru.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre silence est à mes yeux la preuve éclatante que vous êtes conscient de ne pas avoir agi correctement.

target_text: Ukifanya haraka, unaweza kumukuta.
