notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vu que dans cette organisation, il n'y a que des chefs et pas d'indiens, c'est un miracle que quelque décision soit effectuée.
target_text: Kwa kuwa mwa iyi shirika, kuko tu bakubwa na hakuna Bahindi, ni muujiza kuona uamuzi yoyote ikamatwe.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa mwa iyi shirika, kuko tu bakubwa na hakuna Bahindi, ni muujiza kuona uamuzi yoyote ikamatwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tôt ou tard, les hommes qui pensent et qui écrivent gouvernent l’opinion ; et l’opinion, comme vous le savez, gouverne le monde.
target_text: Piko tu siku, wanaume wanaofikiria na kuandika wanaongoza raia; na raia, kama unavyojua, inatawala dunia.
target_text_raw: Piko tu siku, wanaume wanaofikiria na kuandika wanaongoza raia; na raia, kama unavyojua, inatawala dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui fait attention au centime le voit se transformer en euro.
target_text: Yeyote anayezingatia senti aniona inageuka kuwa euro.
target_text_raw: Yeyote anayezingatia senti aniona inageuka kuwa euro.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux seulement que vous sachiez que je suis désolée.
target_text: Nataka tu ujue kwamba naomba musamaha.
target_text_raw: Nataka tu ujue kwamba naomba musamaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le responsable vanta ses mérites.
target_text: Musimamizi alisifu sifa zake.
target_text_raw: Musimamizi alisifu sifa zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mike a un ami qui habite à Chicago.
target_text: Mike iko narafiki mwenye anaishi Chicago.
target_text_raw: Mike iko narafiki mwenye anaishi Chicago.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sure qu'il y a une connexion.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama connexion iko.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama connexion iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez à respirer.
target_text: Endelea kupumua.
target_text_raw: Endelea kupumua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne voyez dans chaque affaire que le côté négatif.
target_text: Unaangaliaka kila kesi ku ngambo yake ya mubaya tu.
target_text_raw: Unaangaliaka kila kesi ku ngambo yake ya mubaya tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Certains jours semblent se traîner et durer éternellement.
target_text: Piko ma siku yenye inaendaka pole pole na kudumu milele.
target_text_raw: Piko ma siku yenye inaendaka pole pole na kudumu milele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée mais j'ai déjà un mec.
target_text: Samahani lakini niko na mupenzi tayari.
target_text_raw: Samahani lakini niko na mupenzi tayari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le vieil homme a été renversé et immédiatement transporté à l'hôpital.
target_text: Mzee aligongwa na mara moja akapelekwa kwa hopital.
target_text_raw: Mzee aligongwa na mara moja akapelekwa kwa hopital.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je souhaite faire usage de mon droit à ne pas témoigner.
target_text: Ninataka kutumikisha haki yangu kutokushuhudia.
target_text_raw: Ninataka kutumikisha haki yangu kutokushuhudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah bah, comment ça ?
target_text: Ah, aye tu?
target_text_raw: Ah, aye tu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée de vous appeler si tard dans la nuit.
target_text: Samahani kukuita usiku sana.
target_text_raw: Samahani kukuita usiku sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'arrive enfin à voir la lumière au bout du tunnel.
target_text: Minaona sasa mwangaza mwisho ya tunnel.
target_text_raw: Minaona sasa mwangaza mwisho ya tunnel.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chats sont comme les filles. S'ils vous parlent, c'est super, mais si vous essayez de leur parler, ça ne se passe pas si bien.
target_text: Pusi ziko kama mabinti. Zikizungumuza na weye ni muzuri sana, lakini ukijaribu kuzungumuza nazo, babiendekaki muzuri.
target_text_raw: Pusi ziko kama mabinti. Zikizungumuza na weye ni muzuri sana, lakini ukijaribu kuzungumuza nazo, babiendekaki muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous nous rendîmes tôt au théâtre, de sorte que nous puissions être assurés que chacun pourrait avoir un fauteuil.
target_text: Tulienda kwenye fasi ya michezo ya kuigiza mapema, juu tuweze kuhakikishiwa kama kila mtu ataweza kuwa na kiti.
target_text_raw: Tulienda kwenye fasi ya michezo ya kuigiza mapema, juu tuweze kuhakikishiwa kama kila mtu ataweza kuwa na kiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens l'appellent David.
target_text: Watu wanamuita David.
target_text_raw: Watu wanamuita David.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle hauteur pouvez-vous sauter ?
target_text: Unaweza ruka saa gani?
target_text_raw: Unaweza ruka saa gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis heureux de vous annoncer que j'ai bien récupéré.
target_text: Niko na furaha ya kukufaamisha kwamba nimepona muzuri.
target_text_raw: Niko na furaha ya kukufaamisha kwamba nimepona muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a quelques restes dans le frigo.
target_text: Piko byenye bilibakia mu frigo.
target_text_raw: Piko byenye bilibakia mu frigo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai gâché quatre heures de ma vie à l'écouter débiter ses conneries.
target_text: Nilipoteza saa ine ya maisha yangu kumsikiliza akiongea maneno ya kijinga.
target_text_raw: Nilipoteza saa ine ya maisha yangu kumsikiliza akiongea maneno ya kijinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le communisme, les moyens de production sont propriété de l'État.
target_text: Katika ukomunisti, njia za uzalishaji ni mali ya serikali.
target_text_raw: Katika ukomunisti, njia za uzalishaji ni mali ya serikali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peu importe ce que nous dirons, la décision finale lui reviendra toujours.
target_text: Haijalishi byenye tutasema, uamuzi wa mwisho inakuwaka yake kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Haijalishi byenye tutasema, uamuzi wa mwisho inakuwaka yake kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pensiez à quoi en laissant les loyalistes dans le château ?
target_text: Ulikuwa unafikiria nini kusema uache kundi ya wa "loyalistes" ndani nyumba?
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa unafikiria nini kusema uache kundi ya wa "loyalistes" ndani nyumba?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avance doucement !
target_text: Tembea polepole!
target_text_raw: Tembea polepole!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Madame Takeda avait l'oreille pour les dernières rumeurs du voisinage.
target_text: Madame Takeda alikuwaka najua habari zisizohakikishwa za kwa majirani.
target_text_raw: Madame Takeda alikuwaka najua habari zisizohakikishwa za kwa majirani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regardais la télévision à moitié endormi.
target_text: Niliangalia télévision nikiwa nalala nusu.
target_text_raw: Niliangalia télévision nikiwa nalala nusu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A-t-il donné quelque indice concernant son activité professionnelle ?
target_text: Alitoa maelezo yoyote kuhsu shuruli yake ya kazi?
target_text_raw: Alitoa maelezo yoyote kuhsu shuruli yake ya kazi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avant de partir nous nous fîmes une franche accolade en témoignage de notre amitié retrouvée.
target_text: Mbele ya kuondoka tulikumbatiana kwa uaminifu kama ishara ya urafiki wetu mupya.
target_text_raw: Mbele ya kuondoka tulikumbatiana kwa uaminifu kama ishara ya urafiki wetu mupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le vent produit un son effrayant, comme des fantômes hurlants.
target_text: Upepo unatoa sauti ya kutisha, kama mizimu yenye iko nalalamika.
target_text_raw: Upepo unatoa sauti ya kutisha, kama mizimu yenye iko nalalamika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as le droit de dire ce que tu penses... si tu penses comme moi.
target_text: Uko na haki ya kusema chochote unataka... kama unawaza kama miye.
target_text_raw: Uko na haki ya kusema chochote unataka... kama unawaza kama miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis réconcilié avec ma tante avant qu'elle meure.
target_text: Nilipatanishwa na shangazi yangu mbele akufe.
target_text_raw: Nilipatanishwa na shangazi yangu mbele akufe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais sortir le chien pour le faire pisser.
target_text: Nitatosha imbwa inje kwa kuikoyolesha.
target_text_raw: Nitatosha imbwa inje kwa kuikoyolesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jour viendra sûrement où ton rêve se réalisera.
target_text: Piko siku ndoto yako itatimia.
target_text_raw: Piko siku ndoto yako itatimia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'oubli est le meilleur remède pour soigner un cœur brisé.
target_text: Kusahabu ni dawa bora juu ya kutunza moyo uliyovunjika.
target_text_raw: Kusahabu ni dawa bora juu ya kutunza moyo uliyovunjika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fois finis, les produits étaient ramenés de l'industrie à l'entrepôt pour y être conservés.
target_text: Kisha kumaliza, vifaa vilirudishwa kutoka kwenye kiwanda mpaka ku nyumba ya kuwekeya.
target_text_raw: Kisha kumaliza, vifaa vilirudishwa kutoka kwenye kiwanda mpaka ku nyumba ya kuwekeya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les êtres vivants ont besoin d'oxygène.
target_text: Viumbe vyote vinahitaji hewa.
target_text_raw: Viumbe vyote vinahitaji hewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment en es-tu venue à t'intéresser à l'étude des langues ?
target_text: Bilikufikiya aye kusema uanze penda kusoma luga?
target_text_raw: Bilikufikiya aye kusema uanze penda kusoma luga?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour accomplir un voyage en avion, il convient tout d'abord de s'enregistrer à l'aéroport. On y reçoit une carte d'embarquement qui stipule qu'on est admis sur un vol donné et indique le numéro de siège.
target_text: Kwa kukamilisha safari ya ndege, ni muhimu kwanza kukjiandikisha kwenye uwanja ya ndege. Unapokeaka cheti ya kukuruhusu uafiri na ambayo inasema kuwa unakubaliwa kuingia mu ndege uliyopewa na inaonesha namba ya kiti.
target_text_raw: Kwa kukamilisha safari ya ndege, ni muhimu kwanza kukjiandikisha kwenye uwanja ya ndege. Unapokeaka cheti ya kukuruhusu uafiri na ambayo inasema kuwa unakubaliwa kuingia mu ndege uliyopewa na inaonesha namba ya kiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu t'inquiètes trop pour Thomas.
target_text: Uko na wasiwasi sana kuhusu Thomas.
target_text_raw: Uko na wasiwasi sana kuhusu Thomas.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devras assumer ta faute comme les autres.
target_text: Itakuombwa kuitika makosa yako kama wengine.
target_text_raw: Itakuombwa kuitika makosa yako kama wengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère met un fond de Morgon dans sa salade de fraises. C'est à se damner !
target_text: Mama yangu anaweka kipande ya Morgon mu salade yake ya matunda ya fraises. Ni ya kukata matumaini!
target_text_raw: Mama yangu anaweka kipande ya Morgon mu salade yake ya matunda ya fraises. Ni ya kukata matumaini!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est incroyable de pouvoir tendre un gant et voir un faucon se poser sur sa main.
target_text: Ni jambo ya kushangaza kuweza kutia gant na kuona ndege ya faucon inakuya dema ku mikono.
target_text_raw: Ni jambo ya kushangaza kuweza kutia gant na kuona ndege ya faucon inakuya dema ku mikono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les uns sur la cime des flots / demeurent suspendus ; d'autres au fond des eaux / roulent, épouvantés de découvrir la terre : / aux sables bouillonnants l'onde livre la guerre.
target_text: Wengine yulu ya mawimbi / wanabakia wanasimamishwa; wengine chini ya maji / wanaendelea, wanaogopa kugundua udongo: / katika mchanga inayo tokota wimbi inafanya vita.
target_text_raw: Wengine yulu ya mawimbi / wanabakia wanasimamishwa; wengine chini ya maji / wanaendelea, wanaogopa kugundua udongo: / katika mchanga inayo tokota wimbi inafanya vita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'agence de sûreté nucléaire et industrielle a élevé le niveau de l'incident à la centrale nucléaire de Fukushima Daiichi du niveau cinq au niveau sept.
target_text: Kituo cha usalama ya nucléaire na viwanda uliinua kiwango ya tukio katika kiwanda cha nucléaire cha Fukushima Daiichi kutoka kiwango cha tano hadi kiwango cha saba.
target_text_raw: Kituo cha usalama ya nucléaire na viwanda uliinua kiwango ya tukio katika kiwanda cha nucléaire cha Fukushima Daiichi kutoka kiwango cha tano hadi kiwango cha saba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amiral n'est jamais satisfait.
target_text: Amiral harizikake.
target_text_raw: Amiral harizikake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pensez être drôle ?
target_text: Unazani inachekesha?
target_text_raw: Unazani inachekesha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le comte, surpris en robe de chambre, ce qui du reste lui arrivait tous les jours, se confondit en excuses.
target_text: Mueshimiwa, alikutwa anavala nguo yake ya chumba, ambayo zaidi ya hayo ilikuwa namutokea kila siku, aliomba musamaha.
target_text_raw: Mueshimiwa, alikutwa anavala nguo yake ya chumba, ambayo zaidi ya hayo ilikuwa namutokea kila siku, aliomba musamaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ayez pitié. Voyez des âmes dans les choses.
target_text: Kuwa na huruma. Tazama nafsi katika vitu.
target_text_raw: Kuwa na huruma. Tazama nafsi katika vitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les amis que nous avons perdus ne reposent pas dans la terre, ils sont ensevelis dans notre cœur, et c'est Dieu qui l'a voulu ainsi pour que nous en fussions toujours accompagnés.
target_text: Marafiki ambao tumepoteza hawapumzikake mu budongo, wamezikwa ndani ya mioyo yetu, na ni Mungu ambaye aliamua ikuwe hivyo juu tusindikizwe nabo kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Marafiki ambao tumepoteza hawapumzikake mu budongo, wamezikwa ndani ya mioyo yetu, na ni Mungu ambaye aliamua ikuwe hivyo juu tusindikizwe nabo kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça va être dur de choisir un gagnant.
target_text: Itakuwa vigumu kuchagua mushindi.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa vigumu kuchagua mushindi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Amazigh ont commencé à compter les jours à partir de 950 avant la naissance du christ.
target_text: Wa Amazigh walilianza kuhesabu siku kuanziya 950 kabla ya kuzaliwa kwa Kristo.
target_text_raw: Wa Amazigh walilianza kuhesabu siku kuanziya 950 kabla ya kuzaliwa kwa Kristo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quiconque a-t-il ici réalisé des profits dans les opérations à terme ?
target_text: Kuko na mtu yeyote hapa aliyepata faida katika biashara mpaka mwisho?
target_text_raw: Kuko na mtu yeyote hapa aliyepata faida katika biashara mpaka mwisho?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On se voit toujours plus tard ?
target_text: Tutaonanaka baadaye?
target_text_raw: Tutaonanaka baadaye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceci tuera cela.
target_text: Iyi itauwa ile.
target_text_raw: Iyi itauwa ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est drôle de sortir avec lui.
target_text: Inachekesha kutoka naye.
target_text_raw: Inachekesha kutoka naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûre que c'est ce que vous voulez ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kama njo byenye unapenda?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kama njo byenye unapenda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lâchez la corde !
target_text: Achilia kamba!
target_text_raw: Achilia kamba!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous aurez beau vivre dans une communauté civilisée ou densément peuplée, vous devrez tout de même comprendre votre propre nature et celle des autres.
target_text: Unaweza kuishi katika jamii yenye inasirimuka ao yenye watu wengi, lakini bado utahitaji kuelewa asili yako na ya wengine.
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuishi katika jamii yenye inasirimuka ao yenye watu wengi, lakini bado utahitaji kuelewa asili yako na ya wengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo voulu sortir du lit, mais il n'a pas pu.
target_text: Enzo alipenda atoke ku kitanda, lakini hakuweza.
target_text_raw: Enzo alipenda atoke ku kitanda, lakini hakuweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Reviens immédiatement, s'il te plait.
target_text: Rudia sasa ivi, nakuomba.
target_text_raw: Rudia sasa ivi, nakuomba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle écrivit un roman sur des vampires.
target_text: Aliandika kitabu juu ya mizumu.
target_text_raw: Aliandika kitabu juu ya mizumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es si noble et si jeune pour monter sur un échafaud !
target_text: Weye ni mzuri sana na mudogo sana kwa kupanda yulu ya jukwaa!
target_text_raw: Weye ni mzuri sana na mudogo sana kwa kupanda yulu ya jukwaa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis aussi souvent que tu le peux à quelqu'un que tu l'aimes, car le jour viendra où il sera trop tard.
target_text: Mwambie mtu unamupenda mara nyingi uwezavyo, kwa sababu itafika wakati itakuwa nyuma.
target_text_raw: Mwambie mtu unamupenda mara nyingi uwezavyo, kwa sababu itafika wakati itakuwa nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je le tuerai.
target_text: Nda muuwaka.
target_text_raw: Nda muuwaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis droit dans mes bottes et je crois en la France.
target_text: Niko mwaminifu na minaamini Ufaransa.
target_text_raw: Niko mwaminifu na minaamini Ufaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette maison et ce terrain sont les miens.
target_text: Iyi nyumba na iyi budongo ni byangu.
target_text_raw: Iyi nyumba na iyi budongo ni byangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est bien foutue.
target_text: Anaishiwa kabisa.
target_text_raw: Anaishiwa kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les médecins hospitaliers ne sortent pas souvent car leur travail leur prend tout leur temps.
target_text: Madaktari wa hospitali habatoki inje mara nyingi kwa sababu kazi yabo inachukuaka muda yabo wote.
target_text_raw: Madaktari wa hospitali habatoki inje mara nyingi kwa sababu kazi yabo inachukuaka muda yabo wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Incroyable ! L'espéranto a atteint le deuxième rang !
target_text: Haiwezekani! Esperanto ilifikia nafasi ya pili!
target_text_raw: Haiwezekani! Esperanto ilifikia nafasi ya pili!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'article « la » est employé chaque fois que nous parlons au sujet de personnes ou d'objets connus.
target_text: Article « ki » inatumiwa kila tunapozungumza juu ya watu wanaojulikana ao vitu.
target_text_raw: Article « ki » inatumiwa kila tunapozungumza juu ya watu wanaojulikana ao vitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyant le fils d'une catin jeter des pierres à la foule : "Fais attention, lui dit-il, tu pourrais blesser ton père."
target_text: Kuona mtoto wa kahaba anatupia kundi ya watu majiwe: "Angalisho, akamwambia, unaweza kulumiza baba yako."
target_text_raw: Kuona mtoto wa kahaba anatupia kundi ya watu majiwe: "Angalisho, akamwambia, unaweza kulumiza baba yako."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Viens quand tu voudras. Tu es attendu.
target_text: Kuya saa unapenda. Unachungiwa.
target_text_raw: Kuya saa unapenda. Unachungiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rhipée à ses côtés tombe égorgé de même, / Rhipée, hélas ! si juste et si chéri des siens ! / Mais le ciel le confond dans l'arrêt des troyens.
target_text: Rhipée akiwa kando yake anaanguka kuuwawa sawa, / Rhipée, ole! mwenye haki na anayependwa sana wandugu yake! / Lakini mbigu linamchanganya katika kukamatwa kwa wa Troyens.
target_text_raw: Rhipée akiwa kando yake anaanguka kuuwawa sawa, / Rhipée, ole! mwenye haki na anayependwa sana wandugu yake! / Lakini mbigu linamchanganya katika kukamatwa kwa wa Troyens.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il continue comme ça, il va sûrement nous péter une durite !
target_text: Ukiendelea hivi, kweli atatupiga bombe!
target_text_raw: Ukiendelea hivi, kweli atatupiga bombe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était une conclusion évidente, mais c'était absolument faux.
target_text: Ilikuwa kauli ya mwisho ya kweli, lakini ilikuwa ya bongo.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa kauli ya mwisho ya kweli, lakini ilikuwa ya bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Anglo-saxons utilisent des unités différentes de celle du système métrique.
target_text: Wa Anglo-Saxons wanatumia ma unités tafauti kuliko système métrique.
target_text_raw: Wa Anglo-Saxons wanatumia ma unités tafauti kuliko système métrique.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donne-toi du mal maintenant, sinon tu vas t'en repentir plus tard.
target_text: Ujisumbue kwa sasa, kama sivyo utatubu baadaye.
target_text_raw: Ujisumbue kwa sasa, kama sivyo utatubu baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les parents de Norman Finkelstein étaient des survivants de l'Holocauste.
target_text: Wazazi wa Norman Finkelstein walikuwa watu waliopona mu Holocauste.
target_text_raw: Wazazi wa Norman Finkelstein walikuwa watu waliopona mu Holocauste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te pardonne, à condition que tu ne fasses plus rien de tel.
target_text: Nimekusamehe, lakini usifanye tena kitu kama icho.
target_text_raw: Nimekusamehe, lakini usifanye tena kitu kama icho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortez du parking ou j'appelle la police pour vous.
target_text: Toka mu parking ao nitakuitiya polisi.
target_text_raw: Toka mu parking ao nitakuitiya polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sure que vos intentions étaient bonnes.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama ulikuwa na nia nzuri.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama ulikuwa na nia nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourrais-tu revenir un peu plus tard ?
target_text: Unaweza rudia nyuma kidogo?
target_text_raw: Unaweza rudia nyuma kidogo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les projets de coopération entre les peuples sont les bienvenus, et tous les projets de division doivent être combattus.
target_text: Miradi yote ya ushirikiano kati ya watu inakaribishwa, na miradi yote ya kugawanyisha inapashwa pigwa vita.
target_text_raw: Miradi yote ya ushirikiano kati ya watu inakaribishwa, na miradi yote ya kugawanyisha inapashwa pigwa vita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nathan respire normalement.
target_text: Nathan anapumua kawaida.
target_text_raw: Nathan anapumua kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre rêve s'est réalisé, enfin !
target_text: Ndoto yetu imetimia, maraba!
target_text_raw: Ndoto yetu imetimia, maraba!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le cadeau parfait pour la fête des Mères.
target_text: Ni zawadi bora kwa siku ya wa mama.
target_text_raw: Ni zawadi bora kwa siku ya wa mama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes heureux que vous ayez rejoint notre équipe.
target_text: Tunafurahi kuwa umejiunga na timu yetu.
target_text_raw: Tunafurahi kuwa umejiunga na timu yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son discours était particulièrement attendu.
target_text: Neno yake ilikua na chungwa sana.
target_text_raw: Neno yake ilikua na chungwa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continue d'aller tout droit.
target_text: Endelea mbele bila kukunja.
target_text_raw: Endelea mbele bila kukunja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une commission de trois pour cent sur tout ce que je vends.
target_text: Niko na faida ya asilimia tatu kwa kila kitu yenye minauzisha.
target_text_raw: Niko na faida ya asilimia tatu kwa kila kitu yenye minauzisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regardez cette collection, on voit bien qu’il ne s’agit pas de livres ordinaires.
target_text: Angalia iyi mukusanyiko, unaonekana kama siyo bitabu ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Angalia iyi mukusanyiko, unaonekana kama siyo bitabu ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les garçons sont stupides.
target_text: Wavulana ni wajinga.
target_text_raw: Wavulana ni wajinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont-ils le droit de défendre leurs lieux saints ?
target_text: Wapalestina wana haki ya kutetea ma eneo yao takatifu?
target_text_raw: Wapalestina wana haki ya kutetea ma eneo yao takatifu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous nous sommes habitués à entendre toutes sortes de noms bizarres.
target_text: Tulizoea kusikia kila aina ya majina ya kushangaza.
target_text_raw: Tulizoea kusikia kila aina ya majina ya kushangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rigole !
target_text: Cheka!
target_text_raw: Cheka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pars, et cette fois, c'est pour ne plus revenir.
target_text: Minaondoka, na iyi wakati, sitarudiaka tena.
target_text_raw: Minaondoka, na iyi wakati, sitarudiaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y avait chez moi le vague regret d'une soirée trop courte.
target_text: Nilikuwa nasikitika kwa sababu sherehe ya mangaribi ilikuwa mufupi sana.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nasikitika kwa sababu sherehe ya mangaribi ilikuwa mufupi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai cru en effet que Nathan gagnerait peut-être.
target_text: Niliwaza kama Nathan angeshinda labda.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza kama Nathan angeshinda labda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sois la bienvenue dans la vraie vie !
target_text: Karibu mu maisha ya kweli!
target_text_raw: Karibu mu maisha ya kweli!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas que le suicide soit toujours de la folie. Mais en général, ce n'est pas dans un accès de raison que l'on se tue.
target_text: Kujiuuwa haikuwake bazimu kila mara. Lakini kwa ujumla, siyo kwa sababu inayofaa njo mtu anajiuaka yepeke.
target_text_raw: Kujiuuwa haikuwake bazimu kila mara. Lakini kwa ujumla, siyo kwa sababu inayofaa njo mtu anajiuaka yepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela ressemble en effet à un plan excellent.
target_text: Inaonekana kama ni mpango bora kabisa.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana kama ni mpango bora kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela doit être une faute d'impression.
target_text: Lazima iwe kosa ya impression.
target_text_raw: Lazima iwe kosa ya impression.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai rencontré un mec plutôt sympa.
target_text: Nilikutana na mtu muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Nilikutana na mtu muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la cour du palais, de ses rameaux antiques / un laurier embrassant ses autels domestiques / les couvrait de son ombre.
target_text: Mu kiwanja ya ikulu, na matawi yake ya zamani / mti ya laurier ikitambala ku mazabahu zake za nyumbani / ilikuwa nazifunika na kivuli chake.
target_text_raw: Mu kiwanja ya ikulu, na matawi yake ya zamani / mti ya laurier ikitambala ku mazabahu zake za nyumbani / ilikuwa nazifunika na kivuli chake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai hâte que les vacances d'été arrivent.
target_text: Niko na hamu likizo ya kipwa ifike.
target_text_raw: Niko na hamu likizo ya kipwa ifike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils se sont partagé le pays, chaque clan a pris la part qui lui revenait, restait un champ qui est 'amagour'.
target_text: Wakagawana inchi kati yao, kila ukoo ukachukua sehemu yake yenye ilitakiwa kukamata, kulibakia shamba ambao ni 'amagour'.
target_text_raw: Wakagawana inchi kati yao, kila ukoo ukachukua sehemu yake yenye ilitakiwa kukamata, kulibakia shamba ambao ni 'amagour'.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'inspecteur Dan Anderson n'a pas trouvé d'empreintes digitales sur le marteau.
target_text: Inspekta Dan Anderson hakuweza kupata alama za vidole kwenye hama.
target_text_raw: Inspekta Dan Anderson hakuweza kupata alama za vidole kwenye hama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'en avez pas marre de vos conneries ?
target_text: Je! Hamuyachoka na upumbavu wenyu?
target_text_raw: Je! Hamuyachoka na upumbavu wenyu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Seul un fou croirait ça.
target_text: Mwendabazimu tu njo angeamini hivyo.
target_text_raw: Mwendabazimu tu njo angeamini hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas tard. Je vous en prie, restez donc encore un peu.
target_text: Haiyakuwa nyuma. Nakuomba, bakia kidogo.
target_text_raw: Haiyakuwa nyuma. Nakuomba, bakia kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les clameurs venimeuses d'une femme jalouse empoisonnent plus sûrement que la dent du chien enragé.
target_text: Kelele za sumu za mwanamuke mwenye wivu ni sumu zaidi kuliko lino ya imbwa yenye kuwa na ugonjwa ya rage.
target_text_raw: Kelele za sumu za mwanamuke mwenye wivu ni sumu zaidi kuliko lino ya imbwa yenye kuwa na ugonjwa ya rage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi m'as-tu retiré de ta liste d'amis ?
target_text: Juu ya nini ulinitosha ku liste ya barafiki yako?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini ulinitosha ku liste ya barafiki yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie croyait avoir trouvé son prince charmant.
target_text: Marie alizani anapata mupendwa wake.
target_text_raw: Marie alizani anapata mupendwa wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils semblèrent vraiment découragés de s'apercevoir que leur projet ne stimulait pas les revenus comme ils pensaient qu'il le ferait.
target_text: Walionekana kukatishwa tamaa kweli kugundua kuwa mradi yao haikuongeza mapato gisi walikuwa nafikiria.
target_text_raw: Walionekana kukatishwa tamaa kweli kugundua kuwa mradi yao haikuongeza mapato gisi walikuwa nafikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel bordel !
target_text: Ni fujo gani!
target_text_raw: Ni fujo gani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été piégé.
target_text: Balinitega.
target_text_raw: Balinitega.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois être en mesure de facilement vous expliquer cette circonstance.
target_text: Minaamini kama minaweza kukuelezea iyi hali kwa urahisi.
target_text_raw: Minaamini kama minaweza kukuelezea iyi hali kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous buvez du lait, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Unakunywaka maziwa, si vile?
target_text_raw: Unakunywaka maziwa, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En remettant à plus tard ce qu'on a à faire, on court le risque de ne jamais pouvoir le faire.
target_text: Kwa kuweka mbali kile chenye unapashwa fanya, kuko hatari ya kutoweza kukifanya kamwe.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuweka mbali kile chenye unapashwa fanya, kuko hatari ya kutoweza kukifanya kamwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai toujours su que tu étais un gars sympa.
target_text: Siku zote nilijua kama uko mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Siku zote nilijua kama uko mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces histoires de cubes et de boîtes me font tourner la tête.
target_text: Izi hadisi za cubes na masanduku zinani zungurusha kichwa.
target_text_raw: Izi hadisi za cubes na masanduku zinani zungurusha kichwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous faites pas couper les cheveux pendant la phase croissante de la lune.
target_text: Usikatwe nywele zako wakati mwezi iko naonekana sana.
target_text_raw: Usikatwe nywele zako wakati mwezi iko naonekana sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai gardé les 20 $ que j'ai trouvés dans la rue.
target_text: Niliweka zile $ 20 zenye nililogota mu barabara.
target_text_raw: Niliweka zile $ 20 zenye nililogota mu barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps est tel qu'on ne ferait pas même sortir un chien.
target_text: Hali ya hewa hairuhusu hata kutosha imbwa inje.
target_text_raw: Hali ya hewa hairuhusu hata kutosha imbwa inje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu enregistré ton produit ?
target_text: Umeandikisha kifaa chako?
target_text_raw: Umeandikisha kifaa chako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu disais que je deviendrais meilleur.
target_text: Ulisema kama nitakuwa muzuri zaidi.
target_text_raw: Ulisema kama nitakuwa muzuri zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne comprends pas que les enfants veuillent grandir immédiatement et puis qu'ils désirent ensuite être à nouveau des enfants.
target_text: Sielewi kwamba watoto wanataka kukomala mara moja na kisha wanataka kuwa watoto tena.
target_text_raw: Sielewi kwamba watoto wanataka kukomala mara moja na kisha wanataka kuwa watoto tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme tous les enfants libres de leurs amusements et habitués à suivre les inspirations de leur fantaisie, elle usait effroyablement vite ses souliers, ses brodequins, ses robes, et surtout ses pantalons à manchettes.
target_text: Kama watoto wote wasio chungiziwa katika kujifurahisha kwao na waliyo zowea kufuata hisia zao, alikuwa nazehekesha biato yake, baito yake ya talon, nguo zake, na hasa pantalons zake za kufungwa.
target_text_raw: Kama watoto wote wasio chungiziwa katika kujifurahisha kwao na waliyo zowea kufuata hisia zao, alikuwa nazehekesha biato yake, baito yake ya talon, nguo zake, na hasa pantalons zake za kufungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À ma connaissance, Nathan aura déménagé à Dunkerque avant deux ans.
target_text: Kwa gisi minajua, Nathan alihamiaka Dunkerque kunapita miaka mbili.
target_text_raw: Kwa gisi minajua, Nathan alihamiaka Dunkerque kunapita miaka mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La guerre du Viêt Nam est connue au Vietnam, et à juste titre, sous le nom de « guerre américaine ».
target_text: Vita ya Vietnam inajulikana Vietnam, kwa jina ya "Vita ya Marekani".
target_text_raw: Vita ya Vietnam inajulikana Vietnam, kwa jina ya "Vita ya Marekani".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pointe de la lance avait été trempée dans un poison mortel.
target_text: Chongo ya mkuki ilikuwa imelowekwa kwenye sumu mbaya.
target_text_raw: Chongo ya mkuki ilikuwa imelowekwa kwenye sumu mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton pote me met mal à l'aise.
target_text: Rafiki yako ananitia wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yako ananitia wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une vraie totoche, ce mec !
target_text: Mujinga sana, huyu jamaa!
target_text_raw: Mujinga sana, huyu jamaa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Coupez l'alimentation du tuyau !
target_text: Zima fasi ambayo tiyo inafunguliwa.
target_text_raw: Zima fasi ambayo tiyo inafunguliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je perdis le pari.
target_text: Nilipoteza kwa kupinga.
target_text_raw: Nilipoteza kwa kupinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allô ! Qui est au téléphone ?
target_text: Allo! Nani njo iko ku telefone?
target_text_raw: Allo! Nani njo iko ku telefone?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le stade fut submergé par les fans de baseball.
target_text: Uwanja uliyala mashabiki wa baseball.
target_text_raw: Uwanja uliyala mashabiki wa baseball.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Michael Jackson est mort.
target_text: Michael Jackson alikufa.
target_text_raw: Michael Jackson alikufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arthur ne saigne pas encore.
target_text: Arthur havuye damu tena.
target_text_raw: Arthur havuye damu tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est drôle de penser à tous ces gens habillés pareils, tous bien convaincus de s'habiller selon leur fantaisie propre.
target_text: Inachekesha kufikiria aba batu bote bamevala bya kufanana, bote banaamini kuvala kulingana na hisia zabo.
target_text_raw: Inachekesha kufikiria aba batu bote bamevala bya kufanana, bote banaamini kuvala kulingana na hisia zabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fichu temps pour une balade !
target_text: Wakati mubaya ya kujitembeza!
target_text_raw: Wakati mubaya ya kujitembeza!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez commander à l'avance.
target_text: Unapashwa kuagiza mapema.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kuagiza mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a donné tous les renseignements que j'ai voulu.
target_text: Alinipa habari muhimu zenye nilikuwa nahitaji.
target_text_raw: Alinipa habari muhimu zenye nilikuwa nahitaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que c'est exact.
target_text: Minaamini kama iyi kweli.
target_text_raw: Minaamini kama iyi kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après toutes ses bêtises, il s'est fait passer un savon par le directeur.
target_text: Kisha ujinga yake yote, alitombokewa na kiongozi.
target_text_raw: Kisha ujinga yake yote, alitombokewa na kiongozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux vous poser une simple question.
target_text: Nataka nikuulize swali moja tu.
target_text_raw: Nataka nikuulize swali moja tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'a aucun ami ou parent pour prendre soin d'elle.
target_text: Hana rafiki ao mzazi wa kumushurulikia.
target_text_raw: Hana rafiki ao mzazi wa kumushurulikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Salut, je m'appelle Tina.
target_text: Jambo, naitwa Tina.
target_text_raw: Jambo, naitwa Tina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment puis-je me rendre au commissariat de police ?
target_text: Aye njo naweza fika ku kituo cha polisi?
target_text_raw: Aye njo naweza fika ku kituo cha polisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je jure que rien ne s'est produit.
target_text: Minalapa kama hakuna yenye ilitokea.
target_text_raw: Minalapa kama hakuna yenye ilitokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai toujours adoré les plantes.
target_text: Minapendaka mimea.
target_text_raw: Minapendaka mimea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne veut plus revenir là où il a connu un dénuement total.
target_text: Hataki kurudia mahali kwenye alishi mu bumaskini kabisa.
target_text_raw: Hataki kurudia mahali kwenye alishi mu bumaskini kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le feu de camp s'est éteint.
target_text: Moto wa kambi ilizimika.
target_text_raw: Moto wa kambi ilizimika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce sont elles qui ont survécu, même si l'immeuble a été détruit.
target_text: Hao njo walibakia wazima, kama kama nyumba liliharibiwa.
target_text_raw: Hao njo walibakia wazima, kama kama nyumba liliharibiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas l'habitude de rester debout tard.
target_text: Siwezi kubakia nashimama hadi busiku.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kubakia nashimama hadi busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez à l'écart de mon chemin.
target_text: Bakia mbali na njia yangu.
target_text_raw: Bakia mbali na njia yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis commença à charger le pistolet.
target_text: Louis alianza kutia masasi mu bunduki.
target_text_raw: Louis alianza kutia masasi mu bunduki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme Porto Rico est une colonie étasunienne, le chef de l'État de Porto Rico est le Président des USA, mais les habitants de Porto Rico n'ont pas le droit de voter aux élections présidentielles étasuniennes.
target_text: Kwa kuwa Puerto Rico ni inchi iliyokoloniwa na Marekani, Rais wa inchi ya Puerto Rico ni Rais wa Marekani, lakini wakaaji wa Puerto Rico hawana ruhusa ya kupiga kura katika uchaguzi wa Rais wa Marekani.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa Puerto Rico ni inchi iliyokoloniwa na Marekani, Rais wa inchi ya Puerto Rico ni Rais wa Marekani, lakini wakaaji wa Puerto Rico hawana ruhusa ya kupiga kura katika uchaguzi wa Rais wa Marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ceci était bien triste pour le pauvre petit caneton.
target_text: Yote ilikuwa ya kusikitisha sana kwa kitoto ya bata munyonge.
target_text_raw: Yote ilikuwa ya kusikitisha sana kwa kitoto ya bata munyonge.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a rencontré un garçon à la foire du comté.
target_text: Alikutanana na kijana kwenye maonyesho ya mtaa.
target_text_raw: Alikutanana na kijana kwenye maonyesho ya mtaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait hier l'acquisition d'un canapé vert, mais il ne passe pas la porte, je dois donc le ramener.
target_text: Jana niliuza kiti ya rangi ya vert, lakini haitapita mu mulango, itaniomba niirudishe.
target_text_raw: Jana niliuza kiti ya rangi ya vert (kimajani), lakini haitapita mu mulango, itaniomba niirudishe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ensuite, tu arroseras ce bol de farine d'un peu d'eau.
target_text: Kisha, utamwanga maji kidogo mwa iyi bakuli ya bunga.
target_text_raw: Kisha, utamwanga maji kidogo mwa iyi bakuli ya bunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo a préparé lui-même le diner.
target_text: Hugo alitayarisha chakula cha mangaribi yepeke.
target_text_raw: Hugo alitayarisha chakula cha mangaribi yepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans mon rêve, j'ai rêvé que j'étais en train de rêver.
target_text: Mu ndoto yangu, nililota kwamba nilikua nalota.
target_text_raw: Mu ndoto yangu, nililota kwamba nilikua nalota.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est facile d'oublier que le micro est branché.
target_text: Ni rahisi kusahabu kuwa mikrofone inachomekwa.
target_text_raw: Ni rahisi kusahabu kuwa mikrofone inachomekwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une super idée ! On pourrait communiquer sur irc exclusivement en s'envoyant des liens de phrases Tatoeba !
target_text: Niko na wazo nzuri! Tungeweza kuwasiliana kwenye irc kwa kutumiana liens ya misemo ya Tatoeba!
target_text_raw: Niko na wazo nzuri! Tungeweza kuwasiliana kwenye irc kwa kutumiana liens ya misemo ya Tatoeba!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre chant ferait pâlir un chanteur professionnel.
target_text: Nyimbo yako inaweza fanya mwimbaji mukubwa aburudike sana.
target_text_raw: Nyimbo yako inaweza fanya mwimbaji mukubwa aburudike sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo est dégoûtant.
target_text: Timéo anachukiza.
target_text_raw: Timéo anachukiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous deviez partir de bonne heure ?
target_text: Mungepashwa ondoka mapema?
target_text_raw: Mungepashwa ondoka mapema?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dès l'aurore, dis-toi d'avance : je rencontrerai un indiscret, un ingrat, un insolent, un fourbe, un envieux, un égoïste.
target_text: Alfajiri, jiambie mapema: Nitakutana na mtu asiye na siri, asiye na shukrani, mwenye kiburi, mdanganyifu, mwenye wivu, mwenye kujipendeleya.
target_text_raw: Alfajiri, jiambie mapema: Nitakutana na mtu asiye na siri, asiye na shukrani, mwenye kiburi, mdanganyifu, mwenye wivu, mwenye kujipendeleya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas que vous parliez de moi toutes les deux.
target_text: Sitaki nyiye bawili muzungumze juu yangu.
target_text_raw: Sitaki nyiye bawili muzungumze juu yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les massacres que veulent perpétrer les colons extrémistes semblent arranger tous ceux qui veulent se débarrasser des Palestiniens autochtones de la Cisjordanie.
target_text: Mauaji ambayo wakoloni wanapenda kuanza yanaonekana kuwapendeza wale wote ambao wanataka kuwaondoa Wapalestina asilia wa Ukunda ya Mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Mauaji ambayo wakoloni wanapenda kuanza yanaonekana kuwapendeza wale wote ambao wanataka kuwaondoa Wapalestina asilia wa Ukunda ya Mangaribi (Cisjordanie).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'or est plus lourd que le fer, plus léger que l'air.
target_text: Zahabu ni nzito kuliko chuma, nyepesi kuliko hewa.
target_text_raw: Zahabu ni nzito kuliko chuma, nyepesi kuliko hewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les garçons ont tendance à mépriser leurs jeunes sœurs.
target_text: Ba garçons wanakuwa kama vile wanazarau ba dada yabo badogo.
target_text_raw: Ba garçons wanakuwa kama vile wanazarau ba dada yabo badogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis souvent qu'à moitié réveillée.
target_text: Mara nyingi minakuwa nalamuka nusu tu.
target_text_raw: Mara nyingi minakuwa nalamuka nusu tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien d'épisodes de One Piece avez-vous regardé?
target_text: Umeangalia épisodes ngapi vya One peace?
target_text_raw: Umeangalia épisodes (vipindi) ngapi vya One peace?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo a acquis droit de cité.
target_text: Timéo alipata uraia.
target_text_raw: Timéo alipata uraia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jour est sans soleil, et la nuit sans étoiles ; / l'onde brise la rame, et le vent rompt les voiles ; / et la troisième aurore a revu nos vaisseaux / abandonnés, sans guide, à la merci des eaux.
target_text: Mchana haina jua, na usiku haina nyota; / wimbi linavunja mti ya kusoza, na upepo unavunja ma voiles; / na alfajiri ya tatu iliona mashua zetu / zilizo achiliwa tena, bila mwongozo, kuelekea kumezwa na maji.
target_text_raw: Mchana haina jua, na usiku haina nyota; / wimbi linavunja mti ya kusoza, na upepo unavunja ma voiles (matanga); / na alfajiri ya tatu iliona mashua zetu / zilizo achiliwa tena, bila mwongozo, kuelekea kumezwa na maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vas-y. Je te rejoins dans 10 minutes.
target_text: Endelea. Nitakukutana mu dakika 10.
target_text_raw: Endelea. Nitakukutana mu dakika 10.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne l'ai pas volée. Tu peux vérifier mes poches.
target_text: Sikuiiba Ukipenda uangaliye ndani ya mifuko yangu.
target_text_raw: Sikuiiba Ukipenda uangaliye ndani ya mifuko yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon plus grand objectif est de partager avec les gens les meilleurs moments de ma vie.
target_text: Lengo yangu kubwa ni kushiriki wakati bora za maisha yangu na watu.
target_text_raw: Lengo yangu kubwa ni kushiriki wakati bora za maisha yangu na watu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que tu laisses pousser ta barbe quatre ou sept ans, elle tombe dans le même temps sous le rasoir du barbier.
target_text: Hata ukiache ndevu zako zikomale kwa miaka ine ao saba, wakati huo huo zitaanguka chini ya wembe wa kinyozi.
target_text_raw: Hata ukiache ndevu zako zikomale kwa miaka ine ao saba, wakati huo huo zitaanguka chini ya wembe wa kinyozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai oublié de prendre les pilules contre la perte de la mémoire.
target_text: Nilisahabu kunywa dawa ya kuni kinga na kupoteza ufahamu.
target_text_raw: Nilisahabu kunywa dawa ya kuni kinga na kupoteza ufahamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bus a tourné à l'angle.
target_text: Bisi iligeuza mwelekeo.
target_text_raw: Bisi iligeuza mwelekeo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous trouvâmes une grande empreinte de pas et quelques unes plus petites, de différentes tailles.
target_text: Tulipata alama kubwa ya migulu na ndogo ndogo za bunene tafauti.
target_text_raw: Tulipata alama kubwa ya migulu na ndogo ndogo za bunene tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est comme vous disiez : c'est génial !
target_text: Ni kama ulivyosema: ni muzuri!
target_text_raw: Ni kama ulivyosema: ni muzuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec ce vent d'automne frais, on ressent vraiment le changement de saison.
target_text: Pamoja na iyi upepo muzuri ya musimu ya automne, tunasikia kabisa mabadiliko ya msimu.
target_text_raw: Pamoja na iyi upepo muzuri ya musimu ya automne, tunasikia kabisa mabadiliko ya msimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En 1632, Galilée a publié un livre qui disait que la Terre tourne autour du Soleil. Il a été arrêté et jugé par l'Église Catholique.
target_text: Mnamo mwaka 1632, Galilée alitangaza kitabu ambacho kilisema Dunia inazunguka kando ya jua. Alikamatwa na kushtakiwa na Kanisa Katoliki.
target_text_raw: Mnamo mwaka 1632, Galilée alitangaza kitabu ambacho kilisema Dunia inazunguka kando ya jua. Alikamatwa na kushtakiwa na Kanisa Katoliki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis identifié à la bande de malfaiteurs de ce film.
target_text: Nilijikituta mwenyewe mu kundi ya majambazi mwa iyi film.
target_text_raw: Nilijikituta mwenyewe mu kundi ya majambazi mwa iyi film.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, le plein emploi n'est plus une évidence.
target_text: Kwa bahati mubaya, kazi ya saa yote haipaniwake tena.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati mubaya, kazi ya saa yote haipaniwake tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu penses que tu trouveras que tout est fin prêt.
target_text: Unawaza utakuta kila kitu kiko tayari.
target_text_raw: Unawaza utakuta kila kitu kiko tayari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils vont se la couler douce cet après-midi.
target_text: Watapata raha iyi muchana.
target_text_raw: Watapata raha iyi muchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a traité de tous les noms qu'elle connaissait.
target_text: Alimutukana mu jina zote zenye anajua.
target_text_raw: Alimutukana mu jina zote zenye anajua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faire la lessive ou écrire un roman, bien souvent le romancier sera moins grand et méritant que la femme qui bat son linge.
target_text: Kufula ao kuandika kitabu ya roman, mara nyingi mwandishi wa roman atakuwa mudogo na asiye stahili kuliko mwanamke anaye fula nguo.
target_text_raw: Kufula ao kuandika kitabu ya roman, mara nyingi mwandishi wa roman atakuwa mudogo na asiye stahili kuliko mwanamke anaye fula nguo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hélas, je meurs au-dessus de mes moyens.
target_text: Ole, nakufa zaidi ya uwezo wangu.
target_text_raw: Ole, nakufa zaidi ya uwezo wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous en laisserai la décision.
target_text: Nitakuachia uamuzi.
target_text_raw: Nitakuachia uamuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Evidemment.
target_text: Ndio.
target_text_raw: Ndio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il gardait le silence, n'osant parler devant le groupe de témoins présent.
target_text: Aliikala kimya, hakusubutu kuongea mbele ya kundi ya mashahidi wenye walikuwa pale.
target_text_raw: Aliikala kimya, hakusubutu kuongea mbele ya kundi ya mashahidi wenye walikuwa pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vienne la nuit sonne l'heure Les jours s'en vont je demeure.
target_text: Vienne busiku inapiga saa Siku zinaenda na minabakia.
target_text_raw: Vienne busiku inapiga saa Siku zinaenda na minabakia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nos cellules de base agissent au niveau local dans les villes et les villages.
target_text: Vikundi yetu za msingi zinafanya kazi kwenye ngazi ya mitaa ndani ya miji na vijiji.
target_text_raw: Vikundi yetu za msingi zinafanya kazi kwenye ngazi ya mitaa ndani ya miji na vijiji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peu importe ce qu'il dira, j'ai pris ma décision.
target_text: Ata aseme nini, nilishaamua.
target_text_raw: Ata aseme nini, nilishaamua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus loin, dans le troisième salon, au milieu du tohu-bohu général des rires et des cris, le grognement d'un ours se faisait entendre.
target_text: Mbali zaidi, katika baraza ya tatu, katikati ya musukosuko ya jumla ya vicheko na kelele, mulio ya munyama ours ilisikika.
target_text_raw: Mbali zaidi, katika baraza ya tatu, katikati ya musukosuko ya jumla ya vicheko na kelele, mulio ya munyama ours ilisikika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas quel métier exercer plus tard.
target_text: Sijue nitafanya kazi gani baadaye.
target_text_raw: Sijue nitafanya kazi gani baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vérifiez vos poches !
target_text: Muchunguze mifuko yenu!
target_text_raw: Muchunguze mifuko yenu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'important dans la vie, ce n'est point le triomphe, mais le combat. L'essentiel n'est pas d'avoir vaincu, mais de s'être bien battu.
target_text: Jambo muhimu mu maisha, siyo ushindi, lakini vita. Jambo muhimu siyo kushinda, lakini kupambana muzuri.
target_text_raw: Jambo muhimu mu maisha, siyo ushindi, lakini vita. Jambo muhimu siyo kushinda, lakini kupambana muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est très important d'expliquer les risques.
target_text: Ni ya maana kutoa mafasirio juu ya hatari.
target_text_raw: Ni ya maana kutoa mafasirio juu ya hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis pratiquement sûre que c'est le parapluie de Gabriel.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama ni mumvili ya Gabriel.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama ni mumvili ya Gabriel.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'un air triste, mon chat s'est enfui quelque part.
target_text: Mu hali ya kusirika, pusi yangu ilikimbia mahali fulani.
target_text_raw: Mu hali ya kusirika, pusi yangu ilikimbia mahali fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais non, ma jeunesse est finie… Adieu, doux rayon qui m’as lui.
target_text: Lakini hapana, ujana wangu unaisha... Kwaheri, mwangaza nzuri ya juwa iliyo niangarisha.
target_text_raw: Lakini hapana, ujana wangu unaisha... Kwaheri, mwangaza nzuri ya juwa iliyo niangarisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces diamants viennent d'Afrique du Sud.
target_text: Hizi almasi zinatoka Afrika Kusini.
target_text_raw: Hizi almasi zinatoka Afrika Kusini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui, jusque dans ces lieux la gloire a ses honneurs, L’humanité ses droits, et la pitié ses pleurs.
target_text: Ndio, hata katika iyi maeneo utukufu unakuwaka na heshima zake, Ubinadamu haki zake, na huruma machozi yake.
target_text_raw: Ndio, hata katika iyi maeneo utukufu unakuwaka na heshima zake, Ubinadamu haki zake, na huruma machozi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'inspecteur était vraiment sûr qu'elle ne s'était pas suicidée parce que certains indices lui prouvaient la participation d'une autre personne.
target_text: Inspektere alikuwa na uhakika kabisa kwamba hakujiua kwa sababu kulikuwa alama wa kuhakikisha kama mtu mwengine alishiriki.
target_text_raw: Inspektere alikuwa na uhakika kabisa kwamba hakujiua kwa sababu kulikuwa alama wa kuhakikisha kama mtu mwengine alishiriki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vous faut prendre soin de ma veste.
target_text: Unahitaji kutunza koti yangu.
target_text_raw: Unahitaji kutunza koti yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un câlin de vous me ferait plaisir.
target_text: Ukinikumbatia itanifurahisha.
target_text_raw: Ukinikumbatia itanifurahisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es Simon, fils de Jean.
target_text: Weye ni Simon, mtoto wa Jean.
target_text_raw: Weye ni Simon, mtoto wa Jean.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous saviez à quel point j'ai attendu ce moment!
target_text: Ungelijua gisi nilikuwa nachunga iyi muda!
target_text_raw: Ungelijua gisi nilikuwa nachunga iyi muda!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont-ils le droit de remettre en cause un processus de paix qui n'était qu'un leurre ?
target_text: Je! Wapalestina wako na haki ya kutoamini njia ya kutafuta amani ambao ilikuwa ni udanganyifu tu?
target_text_raw: Je! Wapalestina wako na haki ya kutoamini njia ya kutafuta amani ambao ilikuwa ni udanganyifu tu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Al Qaïda, c'est une franchise comme Manpower.
target_text: Al-Qaida, ni ukweli kama Manpower.
target_text_raw: Al-Qaida, ni ukweli kama Manpower.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a versé une caution de 900 euros pour l'appartement.
target_text: Alilipa amande ya ma euro 900 juu ya nyumba.
target_text_raw: Alilipa amande ya ma euro 900 juu ya nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En appuyant sur ce bouton, tu feras apparaître une porte qui te permettra d'accéder à un niveau secret.
target_text: Kwa kuponda iyi bouton, kutajitokeza mlango ambao itakuruhusu kufikia kiwango ya siri.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuponda iyi bouton, kutajitokeza mlango ambao itakuruhusu kufikia kiwango ya siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le commentaire que vous avez fait à la fête sur le poids de Lisa était totalement inutile.
target_text: Maoni uliyotoa kwenye sherehe juu ya kilo ya Lisa haikukuwa ya maana ata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Maoni uliyotoa kwenye sherehe juu ya kilo ya Lisa haikukuwa ya maana ata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que dire de ces villageois qui suspendent une oie vivante pour la décoller de loin au tranchant du bâton? Leur maladresse prolonge son martyre, et ils s'amusent pendant plus de deux heures, de la Passion de cette pauvre bête.
target_text: Ni nini juu ya wale wanakijiji ambao wana tundika kanga yenye ingali ya muzima juu ya kuiepusha na fimbo ya makali. Ukorofi yao inaongeza kuuawa kwake, na wanajifurahisha kwa zaidi ya masaa mbili, na Mateso ya uyu munyama munyonge.

target_text_raw: Haujawahi kupanda ku mgongo ya ngamia?

target_text_raw: Jana mangaribi, nilimaliza kusoma roman iitwayo « Mulima ya uchawi ».

target_text_raw: Niko polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Judy fait preuve envers tous de bon cœur.

target_text_raw: Judy anaonesha mbele ya watu wote roho yake muzuri.

target_text_raw: Chagua zawadi kwa uangalifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'industrie alimentaire est tellement carrément criminelle en Chine que les BCBG des villes deviennent fermiers à temps partiel.

source_text: Dieu et le diable sont vraiment super.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est souvent facile de voir quelque chose qu'on ne peut expliquer et d'en rendre responsable quelque chose qu'on ne peut voir.

target_text_raw: Usiachie kati kati ya njia!
