source_text: Mathéo s'est promis de ne plus jamais refaire cela.
target_text: Mathéo aliahidi kutofanya hivyo tena.
target_text_raw: Mathéo aliahidi kutofanya hivyo tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Félicitations, jeune homme ! Voulez-vous un ballon ?
target_text: Hongera, kijana! Unataka kabumbu?
target_text_raw: Hongera, kijana! Unataka kabumbu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la jungle de la solitude, un beau geste d'éventail est un paradis.
target_text: Katika msitu wa upweke, ishara nzuri ya chombo ya kujipepea ni paradiso.
target_text_raw: Katika msitu wa upweke, ishara nzuri ya chombo ya kujipepea ni paradiso.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faites gaffe ou vous allez abîmer la boîte de vitesse !
target_text: Fanya angalisho, kama sivyo utaharibu boite ya vitesse!
target_text_raw: Fanya angalisho, kama sivyo utaharibu boite ya vitesse!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce là sérieusement ce que tu penses ?
target_text: Ni iyi njo unawaza kweli?
target_text_raw: Ni iyi njo unawaza kweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La première fois que vous rencontrez une personne, vous devriez être attentifs à la proximité avec laquelle vous vous tenez par rapport à elle.
target_text: Mara ya kwanza kukutana na mtu, unapashwa kuwa mwangalifu kuhusu gisi unajikamata karibu naye.
target_text_raw: Mara ya kwanza kukutana na mtu, unapashwa kuwa mwangalifu kuhusu gisi unajikamata karibu naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas fan du postmodernisme.
target_text: Miye siyo shabiki wa postmodernisme.
target_text_raw: Miye siyo shabiki wa postmodernisme.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les médecins ont extrait la balle.
target_text: Madaktari walitoa lisasi.
target_text_raw: Madaktari walitoa lisasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous jamais tellement voulu quelque chose que vous auriez fait n'importe quoi pour l'avoir ?
target_text: Hauyawahi kutaka kitu sana yenye ungefanya chochote juu ya kukipata?
target_text_raw: Hauyawahi kutaka kitu sana yenye ungefanya chochote juu ya kukipata?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quand remonte la dernière fois que vous avez regardé les étoiles dans ciel ?
target_text: Mara yako ya mwisho kuangalia nyota angani ilikuwa wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Mara yako ya mwisho kuangalia nyota angani ilikuwa wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle aime ce petit colonel de cavalerie, parce qu’il monte bien à cheval...
target_text: Anamupenda uyu kanali mdogo wa wapanda farasi, kwa sababu ananjua panda muzuri ku farasi...
target_text_raw: Anamupenda uyu kanali mdogo wa wapanda farasi, kwa sababu ananjua panda muzuri ku farasi...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous avec le FBI ?
target_text: Uko na FBI?
target_text_raw: Uko na FBI?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez peut-être vérifier ceci.
target_text: Labda ungepashwa kuchunguza iyi.
target_text_raw: Labda ungepashwa kuchunguza iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a agit dans le dos du directeur.
target_text: Anafanya mambo yako bila kumushirikisha kiongozi.
target_text_raw: Anafanya mambo yako bila kumushirikisha kiongozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Russie a envoyé des soldats qui ont commencé à occuper d'importantes positions dans la péninsule de Crimée. Ces jeunes hommes silencieux portent un uniforme vert sans épaulettes.
target_text: Rusia ilituma wanajeshi ambao walianza kukamata fasi muhimu kwenye kisanga kubwa ya Crimée. Hawa vijana wakimya wanavala nguo za vert bila pete.
target_text_raw: Rusia ilituma wanajeshi ambao walianza kukamata fasi muhimu kwenye kisanga kubwa ya Crimée. Hawa vijana wakimya wanavala nguo za vert bila pete.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cauchemar est enfin terminé.
target_text: Ndoto mubaya lnaisha.
target_text_raw: Ndoto mubaya lnaisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noah et Marie donne une soirée. On boit, on danse et on rit beaucoup.
target_text: Noah na Marie wanafanya sherehe. Tunakunya, tunacheza na tunacheka sana.
target_text_raw: Noah na Marie wanafanya sherehe. Tunakunya, tunacheza na tunacheka sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon frère est devenu prêtre.
target_text: Kaka yangu alishakuwa padiri.
target_text_raw: Kaka yangu alishakuwa padiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ramenez le dos vers la position initiale.
target_text: Rudisha mugongo mu position ya mwanzo.
target_text_raw: Rudisha mugongo mu position ya mwanzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a trompé sa pauvre femme.
target_text: Alidanganya bibi yake munyonge.
target_text_raw: Alidanganya bibi yake munyonge.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me tins fermement à la corde de sorte que je ne tombe pas.
target_text: Nilikamata ile kamba muzuri juu nisianguke.
target_text_raw: Nilikamata ile kamba muzuri juu nisianguke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais dû étudier le français plus sérieusement quand j'étais au lycée.
target_text: Nilipashwa kusoma Kifaransa kwa uangalifu zaidi nilipokuwa kwenye shule ya kiskondari.
target_text_raw: Nilipashwa kusoma Kifaransa kwa uangalifu zaidi nilipokuwa kwenye shule ya kiskondari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu racontes des bêtises !
target_text: Unaongea upuuzi!
target_text_raw: Unaongea upuuzi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est point par la rigueur des supplices qu'on prévient le plus sûrement les crimes, c'est par la certitude de la punition.
target_text: Siyo kwa ukali wa azabu ambayo hakika mtu anaweza kuzuia uhalifu, ni kwa uhakika wa azabu.
target_text_raw: Siyo kwa ukali wa azabu ambayo hakika mtu anaweza kuzuia uhalifu, ni kwa uhakika wa azabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour réaliser ce projet, la famille tout entière a rassemblé ses forces. C’est une façon d’adapter les moyens à la situation et d’avoir toutes les chances de réussir.
target_text: Kwa kufanya iyi mradi, familia nzima ilikusanya nguvu zabo. Iyi ni njia ya kurekebisha njia kwa hali yenye iko na kuwa na bahati ya kufanikiwa.
target_text_raw: Kwa kufanya iyi mradi, familia nzima ilikusanya nguvu zabo. Iyi ni njia ya kurekebisha njia kwa hali yenye iko na kuwa na bahati ya kufanikiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce procès ne décrit pas un fonctionnement idéal de la justice.
target_text: Iyi mashtaka haioneshi kazi bora ya haki.
target_text_raw: Iyi mashtaka haioneshi kazi bora ya haki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu me mettre de la crème solaire dans le dos ?
target_text: Unaweza kunipakala mafuta ya jua ku mugongo?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kunipakala mafuta ya jua (crème solaire) ku mugongo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Partez immédiatement !
target_text: Sema sai sai!
target_text_raw: Sema sai sai!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Excusez ma rudesse, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Usamehe ukali wangu, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Usamehe ukali wangu, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est venu tard à l'entraînement.
target_text: Alichelewa kwenye mazowezi.
target_text_raw: Alichelewa kwenye mazowezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est revenu à la maison trois jours plus tard.
target_text: Alirudia ku nyumba siku tatu baadaye.
target_text_raw: Alirudia ku nyumba siku tatu baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’ambiance était à son comble, quand nous sommes arrivés à la soirée.
target_text: Ambiance ilikuwa mingi, wakati tulifika ku sherehe.
target_text_raw: Ambiance (furaha) ilikuwa mingi, wakati tulifika ku sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon rêve est de devenir un jour joueur de base-ball.
target_text: Ndoto yangu ni kuwa siku moja muchezaji wa baseball.
target_text_raw: Ndoto yangu ni kuwa siku moja muchezaji wa baseball.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne devez surtout pas parler de ça à ma petite copine.
target_text: Usipime ata kuiongelea na mpenzi wangu.
target_text_raw: Usipime ata kuiongelea na mpenzi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le droit de l'eau est le champ du droit traitant de la propriété, du contrôle et de l'utilisation de l'eau en tant que ressource.
target_text: Sheria ya maji ni uwanja wa sheria inayohusu umiliki, uchunguzi na matumizi ya maji kama mali.
target_text_raw: Sheria ya maji ni uwanja wa sheria inayohusu umiliki, uchunguzi na matumizi ya maji kama mali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que toi et Mathis avez plus en commun que vous ne voulez bien l'admettre.
target_text: Minazani kama weye na Mathis mnafanana mu bitu mingi hata kama haukubali.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama weye na Mathis mnafanana mu bitu mingi hata kama haukubali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est douteux que ce matériel soit digne de confiance.
target_text: Iyi kifaa haiko ya kuaminika.
target_text_raw: Iyi kifaa haiko ya kuaminika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez tout droit et vous verrez la banque.
target_text: Enda moja kwa moja mbele na utaona benki.
target_text_raw: Enda moja kwa moja mbele na utaona benki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'hésitez pas à poser une question si vous ne comprenez pas.
target_text: Usisite kuuliza swali kama hauelewi.
target_text_raw: Usisite kuuliza swali kama hauelewi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: M. Kato qui habite en ce moment Paris, s'ennuie de sa famille qu'il a laissée chez lui.
target_text: Bwana Kato ambaye kwa sasa anaishi Paris, anakumbuka familia yenye aliiacha nyumbani.
target_text_raw: Bwana Kato ambaye kwa sasa anaishi Paris, anakumbuka familia yenye aliiacha nyumbani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laura dansait avec grâce.
target_text: Laura alikuwa akicheza kwa kupendeza.
target_text_raw: Laura alikuwa akicheza kwa kupendeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pourrions nous donner rendez-vous au pub irlandais au bout de la rue… Qu'en penses-tu ?
target_text: Tunaweza kukutana ku bar ya wa kiirlandais chini ya barabara. Unafikiria nini juu ya iyi?
target_text_raw: Tunaweza kukutana ku bar ya wa kiirlandais chini ya barabara. Unafikiria nini juu ya iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tant pis pour toi, on vous a assez prévenus, alors maintenant tu assumes.
target_text: Binakuona, tulikuonya bya kutosha, sasa unajuta.
target_text_raw: Binakuona, tulikuonya bya kutosha, sasa unajuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Durant des circonstances extraordinaires ou si le parlement en décide en situation de défense préventive, les hommes hongrois majeurs, ayant leur lieu de résidence en Hongrie et la citoyenneté hongroise, accomplissent un service militaire.
target_text: Wakati wa hali isiyo ya kawaida ao kama bunge itaamua mu hali ya ukingo ya kuzuia, banaume ya uraia ya Hongrie wenye umri kamili, na wenye kuwa na makao huko Hongrie na uraia wa Hongrie, wanafanya huduma ya jeshi.
target_text_raw: Wakati wa hali isiyo ya kawaida ao kama bunge itaamua mu hali ya ukingo ya kuzuia, banaume ya uraia ya Hongrie wenye umri kamili, na wenye kuwa na makao huko Hongrie na uraia wa Hongrie, wanafanya huduma ya jeshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu abandonnes ce plan débile.
target_text: Nataka uachane na iyi mpango ya kijinga.
target_text_raw: Nataka uachane na iyi mpango ya kijinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne t'inquiète pas pour moi. Je trouverai un moyen de m'en sortir.
target_text: Usijali kuhusu miye. Ndaweza.
target_text_raw: Usijali kuhusu miye. Ndaweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux commencer à apprendre le français. Pourrais-tu me conseiller une méthode d'apprentissage ?
target_text: Nataka anza kujifunza Kifaransa. Unaweza kunishauri juu ya namna ya kujifunza?
target_text_raw: Nataka anza kujifunza Kifaransa. Unaweza kunishauri juu ya namna ya kujifunza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez mettre votre bannière sur mon site, envoyez-moi juste le code.
target_text: Kama unataka kuweka tangazo yako ku site internet yangu, nitumie tu code.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka kuweka tangazo yako ku site internet yangu, nitumie tu code.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ressemble à sa tante.
target_text: Anafanana shangazi yake.
target_text_raw: Anafanana shangazi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La théorie du Big Bang a été proposée en 1927 et développée en 1929.
target_text: Wazo ya Big Bang ilipewa mnamo mwaka 1927 na ikaendeleshwa mnamo mwaka 1929.
target_text_raw: Wazo ya Big Bang ilipewa mnamo mwaka 1927 na ikaendeleshwa mnamo mwaka 1929.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'appelle Alex.
target_text: Minaitwa Alex.
target_text_raw: Minaitwa Alex.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Julie nous tient constamment au courant de sa grossesse.
target_text: Julie anatupa habari kila wakati kuhusu ujauzito wake.
target_text_raw: Julie anatupa habari kila wakati kuhusu ujauzito wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Saïd m'a ramené un livre très ancien.
target_text: Saïd aliniletea kitabu ya zamani sana.
target_text_raw: Saïd aliniletea kitabu ya zamani sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il déclare qu'il n'a aucun souvenir de la soirée.
target_text: Anasema kwamba hakumbuki kitu yoyote kuhusu sherehe.
target_text_raw: Anasema kwamba hakumbuki kitu yoyote kuhusu sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce que je veux est ce qui me revient de droit.
target_text: Chenye minataka ni kile kyenye niko na haki yakuwa nayo.
target_text_raw: Chenye minataka ni kile kyenye niko na haki yakuwa nayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a présenté sa fiancée.
target_text: Alitambulisha mchumba wake.
target_text_raw: Alitambulisha mchumba wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il arrivera pour huit heures au plus tard.
target_text: Atafika saa munane kamili.
target_text_raw: Atafika saa munane kamili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parce qu'elle est une prof géniale.
target_text: Kwa sababu yeye ni mwalimu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Kwa sababu yeye ni mwalimu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reçois sans cesse des messages électroniques indésirables.
target_text: Minaendelea kupata messages za kielektoniki za wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Minaendelea kupata messages za kielektoniki za wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce parapluie ressemble au mien.
target_text: Iyi mumvuli inafanana yangu.
target_text_raw: Iyi mumvuli inafanana yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si seulement j'avais eu quelques années de plus, ils m'auraient laissée rentrer dans le bar.
target_text: Ningekuwa na miaka michache ya zaidi, wangeniruhusu niingie mu bar.
target_text_raw: Ningekuwa na miaka michache ya zaidi, wangeniruhusu niingie mu bar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est dotée d'un sens pratique très aigu : elle a un ex dans chaque corps de métier.
target_text: Alipewa akili mingi sana ya kutendo : iko na mupenzi wa zamani mu kila kazi.
target_text_raw: Alipewa akili mingi sana ya kutendo : iko na mupenzi wa zamani mu kila kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous savez comment elles s'appellent?
target_text: Unajua gisi banaitwa?
target_text_raw: Unajua gisi banaitwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as échoué ! Recommence !
target_text: Ulishindwa! Anzilia!
target_text_raw: Ulishindwa! Anzilia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ressembles à quelqu'un avec qui j'ai été au lycée.
target_text: Unafanana mutu mwenye nilisoma naye kwenye shule ya sekondari.
target_text_raw: Unafanana mutu mwenye nilisoma naye kwenye shule ya sekondari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lucy s'est occupée de mon chien.
target_text: Lucy alishurulikia imbwa yangu.
target_text_raw: Lucy alishurulikia imbwa yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a des hauts et des bas dans la vie, comme disait le groom de l'ascenseur.
target_text: Mu maisha kuna kupanda na kushuka, kama alivyosema muhudumu wa ascenseur.
target_text_raw: Mu maisha kuna kupanda na kushuka, kama alivyosema muhudumu wa ascenseur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie nous tourne le dos.
target_text: Marie anatuachililia.
target_text_raw: Marie anatuachililia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que vous devriez dire à Noah que vous l'aimez.
target_text: Nawaza kama unapashwa ambia noah kama unamupenda.
target_text_raw: Nawaza kama unapashwa ambia noah kama unamupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père est vraiment très impliqué dans la bourse à présent.
target_text: Baba yangu anahusika sana kwenye bourse sasa.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu anahusika sana kwenye bourse (soko) sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis surprise que Noah ne sache pas parler français.
target_text: Minashangala kuona Noah hawezi zungumza Kifaransa.
target_text_raw: Minashangala kuona Noah hawezi zungumza Kifaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous n'en voulez pas, je la donnerai à quelqu'un d'autre.
target_text: Kama hautaki, nitapatia mtu mwengine.
target_text_raw: Kama hautaki, nitapatia mtu mwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un fonds a été créé pour préserver la vie marine.
target_text: Mfuko umeundwa juu ya kukinga bahari na yaliomo.
target_text_raw: Mfuko umeundwa juu ya kukinga bahari na yaliomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oublie ce type. Il y a plein d'hommes meilleurs que lui en ce monde.
target_text: Achana na uyu jamaa. Kuko wanaume wengi bora zaidi yake katika iyi dunia.
target_text_raw: Achana na uyu jamaa. Kuko wanaume wengi bora zaidi yake katika iyi dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les partis politiques reçoivent une aide de l'État, calculée en fonction du nombre de parlementaires de chaque formation au Sénat et à l’Assemblée nationale.
target_text: Vyama vya siasa vinapokea misaada ya serikali, iliyohesabiwa kulingana na idadi ya wabunge kutoka kila chama katika Seneti na Bunge la Kitaifa.
target_text_raw: Vyama vya siasa vinapokea misaada ya serikali, iliyohesabiwa kulingana na idadi ya wabunge kutoka kila chama katika Seneti na Bunge la Kitaifa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons pas le droit de traîner par ici.
target_text: Haturuhusiwi kubakia hapa.
target_text_raw: Haturuhusiwi kubakia hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cabaret est une sorte de spectacle.
target_text: Cabaret ni aina ya tamasha.
target_text_raw: Cabaret ni aina ya tamasha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son faible revenu l'empêche d'acquérir la maison.
target_text: Pato yake ndogo inamuzuia kuuza nyumba.
target_text_raw: Pato yake ndogo inamuzuia kuuza nyumba.

source_text: Elle n'est pas venue à la rencontre de peur de croiser son ex-mari.
target_text: Hakukuya ku mkutano kwa kuogopa kukutana na mupenzi wake wa zamani.
target_text_raw: Hakukuya ku mkutano kwa kuogopa kukutana na mupenzi wake wa zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je n'avais rien dit, vous auriez traversé la rue.
target_text: Ingekuwa sikusema chochote, ungevuka barabara.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa sikusema chochote, ungevuka barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous savons quoi faire ensuite.
target_text: Tunajua nini cha kufanya baadaye.
target_text_raw: Tunajua nini cha kufanya baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peu de gens savent à quel point je suis doué pour ce genre de choses.
target_text: Siyo batu bengi njo banajua kama niko na kipaji mwa iyi mambo.
target_text_raw: Siyo batu bengi njo banajua kama niko na kipaji mwa iyi mambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Christophe Colomb a exigé qu'une "semaine Colomb" soit dédiée à sa gloire, mais il n'a finalement eu droit qu'à un seul jour, et uniquement en Amérique.
target_text: Christophe Colomb aliamuru kwamba "juma ya Colomb" itolewe kwa utukufu yake, lakini ku mwisho alikuwa na haki ya siku moja tu, na ni Marekani tu.
target_text_raw: Christophe Colomb aliamuru kwamba "juma ya Colomb" itolewe kwa utukufu yake, lakini ku mwisho alikuwa na haki ya siku moja tu, na ni Marekani tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ha! tu partiras demain !
target_text: Ha! Utaenda kesho!
target_text_raw: Ha! Utaenda kesho!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Tu plaisantes. » « Non. »
target_text: « Unatania. » « Apana. »
target_text_raw: « Unatania. » « Apana. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre déclaration d'amour me va droit au cœur.
target_text: Tamko yako ya upendo inaniingia ku roho.
target_text_raw: Tamko yako ya upendo inaniingia ku roho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où le trésor est caché reste un mystère.
target_text: Kwenye hazina imefichwa inabaki kuwa siri.
target_text_raw: Kwenye hazina imefichwa inabaki kuwa siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez laisser ce paquet chez les Jones quand vous irez travailler.
target_text: Tafazali acha iyi kifurushi kwa Jones wakati utaenda ku kazi.
target_text_raw: Tafazali acha iyi kifurushi kwa Jones wakati utaenda ku kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'attendais à ce qu'il soit présent à la réunion.
target_text: Nilitarajia akuwe ku mkutano.
target_text_raw: Nilitarajia akuwe ku mkutano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle saute à la corde.
target_text: Anaruka kamba.
target_text_raw: Anaruka kamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je hais les organisations terroristes.
target_text: Minachukiaka mashirika ya kigaidi.
target_text_raw: Minachukiaka mashirika ya kigaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Vous êtes Hugo, n'est-ce pas ? » « Oui, en effet, mon prénom est Hugo. »
target_text: « Weye ni Hugo, si ndiyo? » « Ndio, kweli, jina yangu ya kwanza ni Hugo. »
target_text_raw: « Weye ni Hugo, si ndiyo? » « Ndio, kweli, jina yangu ya kwanza ni Hugo. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Diable nous apparaît constamment sous une forme séduisante pour nous tenter.
target_text: Shetani anaonekana kila wakati kwetu kwa njia ya kuvutia juu atujaribie.
target_text_raw: Shetani anaonekana kila wakati kwetu kwa njia ya kuvutia juu atujaribie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La liaison de Sami avec Layla est connue du public.
target_text: Mapenzi ya Sami na Layla inajulikana na batu bengi.
target_text_raw: Mapenzi ya Sami na Layla inajulikana na batu bengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les jeunes compagnes de Sarah commençaient à s'apeurer. Elle seule conservait son sang-froid et rassurait ses amies.
target_text: Vijana wenzake na Sarah walianza ogopa. Yepeke alikuwa navumilia na aliwahakikishia marafiki zake.
target_text_raw: Vijana wenzake na Sarah walianza ogopa. Yepeke alikuwa navumilia na aliwahakikishia marafiki zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Tout-Paris était présent à la cérémonie.
target_text: Paris yote ilikuwa kwenye sherehe.
target_text_raw: Paris yote ilikuwa kwenye sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voulais pas que tu fasses d'histoires.
target_text: Sikutaka ufanye fujo.
target_text_raw: Sikutaka ufanye fujo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La course principale d'hier fut sans surprise. C'est le genre de courses sur lesquelles on peut ramasser gros.
target_text: Mbio kuu ya jana haikushangaza. Ni aina ya mbio ambazo unaweza kupata ushindi mukubwa.
target_text_raw: Mbio kuu ya jana haikushangaza. Ni aina ya mbio ambazo unaweza kupata ushindi mukubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ho, mon Dieu, quel désordre !
target_text: Oh, Mungu wangu, ni virugu gani!
target_text_raw: Oh, Mungu wangu, ni virugu gani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez vous rendre à l'océan.
target_text: Unataka enda ku bahari.
target_text_raw: Unataka enda ku bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Par une chaude après-midi d'été, Tony, John et Pip coupaient les hautes herbes.
target_text: Katika mchana ya majira ya kifukutu, Tony, John na Pip walikuwa nakata nyasi ya murefu.
target_text_raw: Katika mchana ya majira ya kifukutu, Tony, John na Pip walikuwa nakata nyasi ya murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle lui donna un baiser d'adieu.
target_text: Akampa bizu ya kwaheri.
target_text_raw: Akampa bizu ya kwaheri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils arrivent à 2h30 et Marie arrive un peu plus tard.
target_text: Wanafika saa 2:30 za muchana na Marie anafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Wanafika saa 2:30 za muchana na Marie anafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De temps en temps, faire du ménage est nécessaire !
target_text: Mara kwa mara, kusafisha ni muhimu!
target_text_raw: Mara kwa mara, kusafisha ni muhimu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce matin, j'ai été convoqué au tribunal, et j'ai eu à traiter une affaire en tant que juré.
target_text: Iyi asubuhi, niliitwa kwenye nyumba ya mashtaka, na ilibidi nishurulikie kesi kama mwendesha mashtaka.
target_text_raw: Iyi asubuhi, niliitwa kwenye nyumba ya mashtaka, na ilibidi nishurulikie kesi kama mwendesha mashtaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le test d'aptitude en japonais, ou "JLPT", est divisé en 5 niveaux. Le niveau 5 est le plus facile et le niveau 1 le plus dur.
target_text: Mutihani ya aptitude wa Kijapani, ao "JLPT", umegawanywa mu viwango 5. Kiwango cha 5 ni rahisi na kiwango cha 1 ni kigumu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Mutihani ya aptitude wa Kijapani, ao "JLPT", umegawanywa mu viwango 5. Kiwango cha 5 ni rahisi na kiwango cha 1 ni kigumu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle gagne moitié moins que son mari.
target_text: Anapokeaka nusu ya mushahara ya bwana yake.
target_text_raw: Anapokeaka nusu ya mushahara ya bwana yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De plus, il retrouve son partenaire préféré : Diego Costa.
target_text: Na tena, anakutanana tena na mupenzi wake mupendwa: Diego Costa.
target_text_raw: Na tena, anakutanana tena na mupenzi wake mupendwa: Diego Costa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le Massachusetts, un homme n'a pas le droit d'épouser la grand-mère de sa femme.
target_text: Huko Massachusetts, mwanamume haruhusiwi kuoa tate yake ya bibi yake.
target_text_raw: Huko Massachusetts, mwanamume haruhusiwi kuoa tate yake ya bibi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il restera toute la soirée.
target_text: Atabakia mangaribi yote.
target_text_raw: Atabakia mangaribi yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Très craintive, la jument levait la patte dès que Meaulnes voulait la toucher et grattait le sol de son sabot lourd et maladroit. Il comprit enfin qu’elle avait tout simplement un caillou dans le sabot.
target_text: Muoga sana, cheval ya kike ilinyanyua mgulu yake wakati tu Meaulnes alipotaka kumugusa na kukwaruza udongo na kiato yake ya buzito na isiyotumia inavyofaa. Aligundua kuwa alikuwa ka lijiwe mu kiato yake.
target_text_raw: Muoga sana, cheval ya kike ilinyanyua mgulu yake wakati tu Meaulnes alipotaka kumugusa na kukwaruza udongo na kiato yake ya buzito na isiyotumia inavyofaa. Aligundua kuwa alikuwa ka lijiwe mu kiato yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Conseil de sécurité des Nations Unis n'est pas gouverné par l'Ancien Testament, et les Palestiniens ont le droit de vivre dans leur pays ancestral.
target_text: Baraza la Usalama la Umoja wa Mataifa haiongozwi na Agano la Kale, na Wapalestina wako na haki ya kuishi katika inchi ya mababu zao.
target_text_raw: Baraza la Usalama la Umoja wa Mataifa haiongozwi na Agano la Kale, na Wapalestina wako na haki ya kuishi katika inchi ya mababu zao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il paraît qu'il lisait des livres tout en marchant le dos chargé de fagots.
target_text: Inaonekana alisoma bitabu wakati anatembea na kubeba muzigo ya kuni ku mugongo.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana alisoma bitabu wakati anatembea na kubeba muzigo ya kuni ku mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque Théo s'est arrêté au stop, son engin a calé.
target_text: Wakati Theo alishimama kwenye ishara ya kusimama, mashine yake ilikwama.
target_text_raw: Wakati Theo alishimama kwenye ishara ya kusimama, mashine yake ilikwama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux une corde à sauter avec des poignées en bois.
target_text: Minataka kamba ya kuruka yenye poignées ya mbao.
target_text_raw: Minataka kamba ya kuruka yenye poignées ya mbao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je voyais un garçon en train de voler dans un supermarché, je le dénoncerais au directeur.
target_text: Kama minaona kijana akiwa naiba mu duka kubwa, minaweza muchongea kwa kiongozi.
target_text_raw: Kama minaona kijana akiwa naiba mu duka kubwa (supermarché), minaweza muchongea kwa kiongozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu travailles plus dur que quiconque ici.
target_text: Unatumika sana kushinda kila mutu umu.
target_text_raw: Unatumika sana kushinda kila mutu umu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête de tourner autour du pot et dis-nous ce que tu penses réellement.
target_text: Acha kupita pita pembeni na utuambie unawaza nini kabisa.
target_text_raw: Acha kupita pita pembeni na utuambie unawaza nini kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On espère que la baisse des taux bancaires soulagera le sévère resserrement financier qui a frappé l'industrie.
target_text: Tunazani kama kushuka kwa taux bancaire itapunguza tatizo kubwa ya kifeza iliyo kumba kiwanda.
target_text_raw: Tunazani kama kushuka kwa taux bancaire itapunguza tatizo kubwa ya kifeza iliyo kumba kiwanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout à l'heure, j'ai vu Nathan filer à l'anglaise.
target_text: Kwa sasa, nimeona Nathan anakimbia kwa kujificha.
target_text_raw: Kwa sasa, nimeona Nathan anakimbia kwa kujificha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai rompu avec ma copine.
target_text: Niliachana na mpenzi wangu.
target_text_raw: Niliachana na mpenzi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es sauve.
target_text: Uko salama.
target_text_raw: Uko salama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de gens pensent que nous n'avons pas seulement grand besoin de lait durant l'enfance et l'adolescence, c'est-à-dire au cours de la croissance, mais également à l'âge adulte.
target_text: Watu wengi wanafikiria kama hatuhitaji tu sana maziwa katika utoto na ujana wetu, inamaanisha, wakati wa kukomala, lakini pia wakati ya umri ya watu wazima.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wanafikiria kama hatuhitaji tu sana maziwa katika utoto na ujana (adolescence) wetu, inamaanisha, wakati wa kukomala, lakini pia wakati ya umri ya watu wazima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il risque de rater son train.
target_text: Anaweza kukosa gari ya moshi.
target_text_raw: Anaweza kukosa gari ya moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pars souvent en vacances au Brésil et rends visite à des connaissances.
target_text: Mara nyingi minaendala mu likizo Brazil na kutembelea marafiki.
target_text_raw: Mara nyingi minaendala mu likizo Brazil na kutembelea marafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez à monter.
target_text: Endelea kupanda.
target_text_raw: Endelea kupanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amitié double les joies et réduit de moitié les peines.
target_text: Urafiki unazidisha furaha kwa mara mbili na kupunguza huzuni kwa nusu.
target_text_raw: Urafiki unazidisha furaha kwa mara mbili na kupunguza huzuni kwa nusu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne devriez pas être si dure avec vous-même.
target_text: Haupashwi kujilaumu sana.
target_text_raw: Haupashwi kujilaumu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le signe distinctif du Prince Charles, ce sont ses oreilles en feuille de chou.
target_text: Alama ya kutafautisha Prince Charles ni masikio yake ya majani ya chou.
target_text_raw: Alama ya kutafautisha Prince Charles ni masikio yake ya majani ya chou.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qu'est l'âge ? D'abord on oublie les noms, et puis on oublie les visages, puis on oublie de remonter sa braguette, et puis on oublie de la descendre.
target_text: Ni miaka ngapi? Kwanza tunasahabu majina, na kisha tunasahau ma sura, kisha tunasahabu kupandisha étirettes yetu, na kisha tunasahau kuishusha.
target_text_raw: Ni miaka ngapi? Kwanza tunasahabu majina, na kisha tunasahau ma sura, kisha tunasahabu kupandisha étirettes yetu, na kisha tunasahau kuishusha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maman se réveille directement quand on la chatouille sous les pieds.
target_text: Mama analamukaka mara moja wakati unamutekenya chini ya migulu.
target_text_raw: Mama analamukaka mara moja wakati unamutekenya chini ya migulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La piste de danse était pleine à craquer, difficile de se frayer un chemin pour aller de l'autre côté.
target_text: Piste ya danse ilikuwa inayala sana, ilikuwa bigumu kupata njia ya kwenda upande mwengine.
target_text_raw: Piste ya danse ilikuwa inayala sana, ilikuwa bigumu kupata njia ya kwenda upande mwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serais reconnaissant si vous pouviez jeter un œil lorsque vous avez du temps un de ces quatre.
target_text: Nitashukuru kama ungeweza kutupa licho wakati utakuwa na wakati siku moja.
target_text_raw: Nitashukuru kama ungeweza kutupa licho wakati utakuwa na wakati siku moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne pouvons poursuivre notre conversation en présence de ces personnes.
target_text: Hatuwezi kuendelea na mazungumzo yetu mbele ya aba batu.
target_text_raw: Hatuwezi kuendelea na mazungumzo yetu mbele ya aba batu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégage de mon lit !
target_text: Toka mu kitanda yangu!
target_text_raw: Toka mu kitanda yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne touchez pas la blessure.
target_text: Usiguse kidonda.
target_text_raw: Usiguse kidonda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons tous raté la cible.
target_text: Siye hatukufikia lengo.
target_text_raw: Siye hatukufikia lengo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Passez un joyeux Noël !
target_text: Nakutakia noeli njema!
target_text_raw: Nakutakia noeli njema!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Steve, tu es le benjamin de la famille, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Steve, uko mtoto wa mwisho mu jamaa, si ivo?
target_text_raw: Steve, uko mtoto wa mwisho (muzibo) mu jamaa, si ivo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cependant Ilion au carnage est livré ; / déjà le bruit affreux (quoique, loin de la ville, / mon père eût sa demeure au fond d'un bois tranquille) / de moment en moment me frappe de plus près.
target_text: Lakini simba kwenye mauaji inatolewaka; / tayari kelele ya kutisha / piko wakati anaipiga kwa karibu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Lakini simba kwenye mauaji inatolewaka; / tayari kelele ya kutisha (ata kama ilikuwa mbali ya mji / baba yangu alikuwa na nyumba yake chini ya kuni ya kutulia) / piko wakati anaipiga kwa karibu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûre que vous vouliez partir sans dire au revoir ?
target_text: Je! Uko na uhakika kama ulitaka kuondoka bila kulaga?
target_text_raw: Je! Uko na uhakika kama ulitaka kuondoka bila kulaga?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous vous trouvez sur la liste.
target_text: Uko ku liste.
target_text_raw: Uko ku liste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Théo était présent à l'enterrement de Marguerite.
target_text: Theo alikuwa kwenye mazishi ya Marguerite.
target_text_raw: Theo alikuwa kwenye mazishi ya Marguerite.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était un parfait inconnu pour nous.
target_text: Alikuwa mgeni kabisa kwetu.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa mgeni kabisa kwetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous ne voulez pas louper le train, vous feriez mieux de vous grouiller !
target_text: Kama hautaki kukosa gari la moshi itaomba uharikishe.
target_text_raw: Kama hautaki kukosa gari la moshi itaomba uharikishe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sara est une citoyenne tunisienne.
target_text: Sara ni raia wa Tunisia.
target_text_raw: Sara ni raia wa Tunisia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu penses que tu es assez marrant, non ?
target_text: Unazani unachekesha vya kutosha, si ivo?
target_text_raw: Unazani unachekesha vya kutosha, si ivo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Par hasard, il a trouvé la caméra qu'il avait perdue.
target_text: Kwa bahati, alipata kamera yenye alikuwa napoteza.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati, alipata kamera yenye alikuwa napoteza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a pris sa décision et refuse d'en être dissuadée.
target_text: Alikamata uamuzi wake na anakatala kuibadilisha
target_text_raw: Alikamata uamuzi wake na anakatala kuibadilisha
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fille d'un diplomate chilien a été tuée au Venezuela.
target_text: Binti wa mwanadiplomasia wa Chilie aliuawa huko Venezuela.
target_text_raw: Binti wa mwanadiplomasia wa Chilie aliuawa huko Venezuela.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est rentré à la maison très tard.
target_text: Alirudia nyumbani nyuma sana.
target_text_raw: Alirudia nyumbani nyuma sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De la Lune, la Terre ressemble à un ballon.
target_text: Kutoka ku mwezi, Dunia inaonekana kama kabumbu.
target_text_raw: Kutoka ku mwezi, Dunia inaonekana kama kabumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est parfois trop tard pour présenter ses excuses.
target_text: Wakati mwengine ni nyuma sana kwa kuomba musamaha.
target_text_raw: Wakati mwengine ni nyuma sana kwa kuomba musamaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pradelle est une commune située à 25 km au nord de la Motte-Chalancon.
target_text: Pradelle ni mtaa inayopatikana kilomita 25 kaskazini mwa La Motte-Chalancon.
target_text_raw: Pradelle ni mtaa inayopatikana kilomita 25 kaskazini mwa La Motte-Chalancon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Judy parlera du Japon demain.
target_text: Judy ataongea kuhusu Japani kesho.
target_text_raw: Judy ataongea kuhusu Japani kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis couché très tard.
target_text: Nililala nyuma.
target_text_raw: Nililala nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est passée devant moi en faisant mine de ne pas me connaitre.
target_text: Alipita mbele yangu akijifanya kama hanijui.
target_text_raw: Alipita mbele yangu akijifanya kama hanijui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De nombreux enseignants des langues recommandent d'apprendre de nouveaux mots, non à part, mais dans leur contexte. Donc disons : au minimum dans des phrases complètes.
target_text: Waalimu wengi wa luga wanashauriaka kujifunza maneno mapya, siyo pembeni, lakini ndani ya fasi ya matumizi yake. Basi acha tuseme: angalau katika misemo ya kuenea.
target_text_raw: Waalimu wengi wa luga wanashauriaka kujifunza maneno mapya, siyo pembeni, lakini ndani ya fasi ya matumizi yake (contexte). Basi acha tuseme: angalau katika misemo ya kuenea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La récompense devrait m'en revenir !
target_text: Matabishi inapashwa kunirudilia.
target_text_raw: Matabishi inapashwa kunirudilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelques années plus tard, ceci m'avait totalement quitté l'esprit.
target_text: Miaka michache baadaye,iyi nilikuwa nilisha isahabu kabisa.
target_text_raw: Miaka michache baadaye,iyi nilikuwa nilisha isahabu kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment pensais-tu qu'il en irait ?
target_text: Ulikuwa nawaza itaenda aye?
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa nawaza itaenda aye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes partis quatre jours plus tard.
target_text: Tulitoka siku ine baadaye.
target_text_raw: Tulitoka siku ine baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis navré d'avoir crié sur vous.
target_text: Samahani kukutombokea.
target_text_raw: Samahani kukutombokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La presse ne peut pas nous ignorer éternellement. Tôt ou tard, ils feront un article à notre sujet.
target_text: Vyombo vya habari habiwezi kutupuuza siku zote. Piko tu siku wataandika juu yetu.
target_text_raw: Vyombo vya habari habiwezi kutupuuza siku zote. Piko tu siku wataandika juu yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'ouvrez la porte à quiconque.
target_text: Usifungulie mtu yeyote mulango.
target_text_raw: Usifungulie mtu yeyote mulango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La confrontation des témoins l'ayant rencontrée le jour de sa mort devait aider l'inspecteur.
target_text: Makabiliano ya washahidi waliokutanana naye siku ya kifo chake itasaidia inspecteur.
target_text_raw: Makabiliano ya washahidi waliokutanana naye siku ya kifo chake itasaidia inspecteur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La lutte continue !
target_text: Mapambano inaendelea!
target_text_raw: Mapambano inaendelea!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez le voir comme une opportunité.
target_text: Unapashwa kuiona kama fursa.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kuiona kama fursa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai remarqué que t'amuser n'interférait absolument pas avec ton apprentissage. Moi, je ne peux juste pas.
target_text: Niligundua kama kujifurahisha haiambatane na masomo yako hata kidogo. Miye, siwezi tu.
target_text_raw: Niligundua kama kujifurahisha haiambatane na masomo yako hata kidogo. Miye, siwezi tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dieux ! qu'il m'attendrissait ! qu'Hector ressemblait peu / à ce terrible Hector qui dans leur flotte en feu / poussait des ennemis les cohortes tremblantes, / ou d'Achille emportait les dépouilles fumantes !
target_text: Miungu! gisi alikuwa naniangalia na huruma! Hector alionekana kidogo kama / Uyo Hector mubaya ambaye katika meli yabo yenye iko nawaka moto / alisukuma vikundi vya maadui wanaotetemeka, / ao Achille alikuwa nabeba maiti zaku toka moshi!
target_text_raw: Miungu! gisi alikuwa naniangalia na huruma! Hector alionekana kidogo kama / Uyo Hector mubaya ambaye katika meli yabo yenye iko nawaka moto / alisukuma vikundi vya maadui wanaotetemeka, / ao Achille alikuwa nabeba maiti zaku toka moshi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soldat refusa le combat.
target_text: Uyo Askari alikatala pambano.
target_text_raw: Uyo Askari alikatala pambano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a frappé une balle avec la batte.
target_text: Alipiga mupira na batte.
target_text_raw: Alipiga mupira na batte.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un ami musicien à moi donnait une représentation impromptue d'un morceau qu'il venait de finir de composer.
target_text: Rafiki yangu mwanamuziki alikuwa naimba muziki isiyo ya kawaida ambayo alikuwa anamaliza kutunga.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yangu mwanamuziki alikuwa naimba muziki isiyo ya kawaida ambayo alikuwa anamaliza kutunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez calmes, s'il vous plaît ! Pas de panique !
target_text: Bakia kimya, tafazali! Usikuwe na wasiwasi!
target_text_raw: Bakia kimya, tafazali! Usikuwe na wasiwasi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'arrivais trop tard et j'ai raté le train.
target_text: Nilifika nyuma na nilikosa gari la moshi.
target_text_raw: Nilifika nyuma na nilikosa gari la moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Stephen King est un de mes auteurs préférés.
target_text: Stephen King ni mumoja wa waandishi ninaowapenda.
target_text_raw: Stephen King ni mumoja wa waandishi ninaowapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il prit ses jambes à son cou en voyant le policier.
target_text: Alikimbi mbio sana wakati aliona polisi.
target_text_raw: Alikimbi mbio sana wakati aliona polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyant Nathanaël venir à lui, Jésus dit de lui : « Voici un véritable fils d'Israël, un homme sans détour. »
target_text: Alipomwona Nathanaeli akija kwake, Yesu alisema juu yake : « Uyu hapa ni mwana wa kweli wa Israeli, mtu muwazi. »
target_text_raw: Alipomwona Nathanaeli akija kwake, Yesu alisema juu yake : « Uyu hapa ni mwana wa kweli wa Israeli, mtu muwazi. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'avais jamais voulu que les choses se passent de cette manière.
target_text: Sikupendaka mambo ipite ivi.
target_text_raw: Sikupendaka mambo ipite ivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo a failli épouser Gabrielle.
target_text: Timéo alitafutaka owa Gabrielle.
target_text_raw: Timéo alitafutaka owa Gabrielle.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pourrai pas terminer à moins que tu ne m'aides.
target_text: Siwezi maliza, labda kama unanisaidia.
target_text_raw: Siwezi maliza, labda kama unanisaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia a fait une liste des chansons qu'il n'aimait pas.
target_text: Kylia alifanya liste ya nyimbo ambazo hapendaki.
target_text_raw: Kylia alifanya liste ya nyimbo ambazo hapendaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aucune parole ne peut soulager son profond chagrin.
target_text: Hakuna neno inayoweza kupunguza huzuni yake kubwa.
target_text_raw: Hakuna neno inayoweza kupunguza huzuni yake kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis enfin capable de comprendre ce qui est intéressant dans le shōgi professionnel.
target_text: Ku mwisho minaweza elewa ni nini njo inafurahisha ndani ya muchezo ya shogi ya kitaalamu.
target_text_raw: Ku mwisho minaweza elewa ni nini njo inafurahisha ndani ya muchezo ya shogi ya kitaalamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est très étonnant qu'un homme comme lui soit policier.
target_text: Inashangaza kuona mwanaume kama yeye akuwe polisi.
target_text_raw: Inashangaza kuona mwanaume kama yeye akuwe polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que Timéo t'a dit que je venais.
target_text: Niko na uhakika Timéo alikuambia kama niko nakuya.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika Timéo alikuambia kama niko nakuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous un casier judiciaire ?
target_text: Ulishawahi kushitakiwa.
target_text_raw: Ulishawahi kushitakiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jouez le tout pour le tout !
target_text: Cheza bila kujali matokeo!
target_text_raw: Cheza bila kujali matokeo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est ton sandwich préféré ?
target_text: Sandwich gani njo unapendaka?
target_text_raw: Sandwich gani njo unapendaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu arrives à 2h30 et Marie arrive un peu plus tard.
target_text: Unafika saa saba na nusu na Marie anafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Unafika saa saba na nusu na Marie anafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant retournez d'où vous êtes venus.
target_text: Sasa rudia kwenye ulitoka.
target_text_raw: Sasa rudia kwenye ulitoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On pense aller au cinoche voir un nanar avec des potes, tu veux squatter ?
target_text: Tuko nawazia kwenda na barafiki ku sinema kuangalia film ya zamani! Utakuya?
target_text_raw: Tuko nawazia kwenda na barafiki ku sinema kuangalia film ya zamani! Utakuya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demandais si vous aimeriez aller au bal avec moi.
target_text: Nilikuwa najiuliza kama ungependa kwenda na miye ku sherehe.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa najiuliza kama ungependa kwenda na miye ku sherehe (bal).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée si ma présence vous embarrasse.
target_text: Samahani kama kuwa kwangu apa inakusumbua.
target_text_raw: Samahani kama kuwa kwangu apa inakusumbua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Tu m'as frappé par haine. » « Non, je l'ai fait par amour », a répondu la fille.
target_text: « Ulinipiga kwa chuki. » « Hapana, nilifanya hivyo kwa upendo », binti alijibia.
target_text_raw: « Ulinipiga kwa chuki. » « Hapana, nilifanya hivyo kwa upendo », binti alijibia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le locuteur donne au co-locuteur les instructions pour identifier le référent.
target_text: Musemaji anapatiaka mwenzake musemaji maagizo juu ya kugunduwa chanzo.
target_text_raw: Musemaji anapatiaka mwenzake musemaji maagizo juu ya kugunduwa chanzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Daniel remercia la police.
target_text: Daniel alishukuru polisi.
target_text_raw: Daniel alishukuru polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortir avec elle et manger à notre restaurant préféré m'a manqué.
target_text: Nakumbuka kutoka naye na kukula mwa ile restaurant yenye tulikuwa napenda kulia amo.
target_text_raw: Nakumbuka kutoka naye na kukula mwa ile restaurant yenye tulikuwa napenda kulia amo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsqu'il est revenu de chez le teinturier, mon costume était abîmé.
target_text: Aliporudia kutoka kwa mupakala rangi, koti yangu ilikuwa naharibika.
target_text_raw: Aliporudia kutoka kwa mupakala rangi, koti yangu ilikuwa naharibika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma tante me donna une fleur.
target_text: Shangazi yangu alinipa liua.
target_text_raw: Shangazi yangu alinipa liua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa voiture roule vraiment bien, même si c'est une voiture ancienne.
target_text: Gari yake ilitembeaka muzuri kabisa, ata kama ni gari ya zamani.
target_text_raw: Gari yake ilitembeaka muzuri kabisa, ata kama ni gari ya zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est double plaisir de tromper le trompeur.
target_text: Ni raha kubwa kumudanganya mudanganyifu.
target_text_raw: Ni raha kubwa kumudanganya mudanganyifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as amené le tien, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Ulileta yako, si hivyo?
target_text_raw: Ulileta yako, si hivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand la bombe explosa, je me trouvais justement là.
target_text: Wakati bombe iliripuka, nilikuwa pale pale.
target_text_raw: Wakati bombe iliripuka, nilikuwa pale pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il élargit l'objet de ses recherches.
target_text: Anapanua mada ya utafiti yake.
target_text_raw: Anapanua mada ya utafiti yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui ai promis que je viendrais aujourd'hui.
target_text: Nilimuahidi kama nitakuya leo.
target_text_raw: Nilimuahidi kama nitakuya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Normalement, je prends le bus pour aller à l'école.
target_text: Kwa kawaida minakamataka bisi kwa kwenda ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Kwa kawaida minakamataka bisi kwa kwenda ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu t'appelles Layla ?
target_text: Unaitwa Layla?
target_text_raw: Unaitwa Layla?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La danseuse étoile a dansé dans le "lac des cygnes", le public l'a trouvée excellente dans son rôle.
target_text: Mchezaji nyota alicheza katika "ziwa la cygnes", watazamaji walifurahiswha sana na iyo role yake.
target_text_raw: Mchezaji nyota alicheza katika "ziwa la cygnes", watazamaji walifurahiswha sana na iyo role (jukumu) yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La décision du tribunal est définitive.
target_text: Uamuzi yenye ilitolewa na korti njo ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Uamuzi yenye ilitolewa na korti njo ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La mort ne connait ni riche ni pauvre.
target_text: Kifo hakijui tajiri wala masikini.
target_text_raw: Kifo hakijui tajiri wala masikini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée de ne pas avoir été chez moi alors que tu es passée exprès.
target_text: Samahani kwa kutokuwa nyumbani kwangu wakati ulikua unataka.
target_text_raw: Samahani kwa kutokuwa nyumbani kwangu wakati ulikua unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien ne paraît. Soudain s'offrent à ses regards / trois cerfs au front superbe, errant dans la campagne ; / un jeune et long troupeau de loin les accompagne.
target_text: Hakuna kyenye kinaonekana. Ghafla aliona / cerfs tatu za sura ya kuvutia, wakitangatanga mashambani; / kundi ya kijana na mrefu kutoka mbali ilikuwa nazisindikiza.
target_text_raw: Hakuna kyenye kinaonekana. Ghafla aliona / cerfs tatu za sura ya kuvutia, wakitangatanga mashambani; / kundi ya kijana na mrefu kutoka mbali ilikuwa nazisindikiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un pêcheur pêchait sous un pêcher. Il vola une pêche, et il est devenu pécheur.
target_text: Mvuvi alikuwa navua samaki chini ya mti wa pêcher. Aliiba samaki, na akakuwa mvuvi.
target_text_raw: Mvuvi alikuwa navua samaki chini ya mti wa pêcher. Aliiba samaki, na akakuwa mvuvi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « J'ai acheté une nouvelle voiture. » « Formidable ! Et l'ancienne, tu vas la vendre ? »
target_text: « Niliuza gari mupya. » « Muzuri sana. Na ya zamani, utaiuzisha? »
target_text_raw: « Niliuza gari mupya. » « Muzuri sana. Na ya zamani, utaiuzisha? »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'artiste qui vient ensuite est extraordinaire.
target_text: Msanii wa kufata iko na kipaji sana.
target_text_raw: Msanii wa kufata iko na kipaji sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait la moitié du travail, maintenant je peux faire une pause.
target_text: Nilifanya nusu ya kazi, sasa minaweza pumuzika.
target_text_raw: Nilifanya nusu ya kazi, sasa minaweza pumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La sorcière a jeté un sort sur le méchant garçon.
target_text: Muchawi aliloga kijana mubaya.
target_text_raw: Muchawi aliloga kijana mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle voulait se faire couper les cheveux, mais sa mère n'a pas voulu.
target_text: Alitaka kunyolewa nywele, lakini mama yake hakutaka.
target_text_raw: Alitaka kunyolewa nywele, lakini mama yake hakutaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le sort fut rompu et le porc se transforma en homme.
target_text: Laana ilivunjika na nguruwe ikageuka kuwa mtu.
target_text_raw: Laana ilivunjika na nguruwe ikageuka kuwa mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fus frappé d'horreur, car j'avais déjà tranché les muscles et j'allais scier l'os; jugez de ma consternation lorsque je m'aperçus qu'il avait raison !
target_text: Niliogopa sana, sababu nilikuwa nilisha kata minyofu na nilikuwa nataka kuranda mufupa; kulaumu maumivu yangu wakati niligundua kama alikuwa na sheria!
target_text_raw: Niliogopa sana, sababu nilikuwa nilisha kata minyofu na nilikuwa nataka kuranda mufupa; kulaumu maumivu yangu wakati niligundua kama alikuwa na sheria!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il vous plait, envoyez ce formulaire par la poste à votre compagnie d'assurance.
target_text: Tatazali tumia kampuni yako ya assurance ile kartasi ya kujaza kwa njia ya poste.
target_text_raw: Tatazali tumia kampuni yako ya assurance ile kartasi ya kujaza (formulaire) kwa njia ya poste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo ne convient absolument pas pour le job.
target_text: Enzo hafai kabisa kwa iyi kazi.
target_text_raw: Enzo hafai kabisa kwa iyi kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te gêne surtout pas.
target_text: Usijisumbue ata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Usijisumbue ata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un bloc de roche s'est détaché de la paroi.
target_text: Kipande ya lijuwe ilitoka ku kilima ya majiwe.
target_text_raw: Kipande ya lijuwe ilitoka ku kilima ya majiwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au final, son rêve de devenir un médecin se réalisa.
target_text: Ku mwisho, ndoto yake ya kuwa daktari ilitimia.
target_text_raw: Ku mwisho, ndoto yake ya kuwa daktari ilitimia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le criminel a été arrêté par deux agents de police.
target_text: Muuaji alikamatwa na ba polisi bawili.
target_text_raw: Muuaji alikamatwa na ba polisi bawili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo était la star de l'équipe de football américaine.
target_text: Timéo alikuwaka mchezaji bora kwenye timu ya mpira wa miguu ya Marekani.
target_text_raw: Timéo alikuwaka mchezaji bora kwenye timu ya mpira wa miguu ya Marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.
