source_text: "As-tu un surnom ?" "Oui, c'est Rick."
target_text: "Uko na jina ya utani?" "Ndio, ni Rick."
target_text_raw: "Uko na jina ya utani?" "Ndio, ni Rick."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne trouve pas le mot pour exprimer ce que je ressens.
target_text: Siwezi kupata neno ya kuelezea kitu yenye minasikia.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kupata neno ya kuelezea kitu yenye minasikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça explique pourquoi la porte était ouverte.
target_text: Inaelezea juu ya nini mulango ilikuwa wazi.
target_text_raw: Inaelezea juu ya nini mulango ilikuwa wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons trouvé des traces de pas dans le sable.
target_text: Tulipata alama za migulu ndani ya muchanga.
target_text_raw: Tulipata alama za migulu ndani ya muchanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nouvelle loi est censée réduire la pollution de l'air de soixante pour cent.
target_text: Sheria mupya inatarajia kupunguza uharibifu ya hewa kwa asilimia makumi sita.
target_text_raw: Sheria mupya inatarajia kupunguza uharibifu ya hewa kwa asilimia makumi sita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Permettez !
target_text: Niruhusu!
target_text_raw: Niruhusu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de policiers gardaient le hall.
target_text: Ba polisi mingi walikuwa nalinda salle.
target_text_raw: Ba polisi mingi walikuwa nalinda salle.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans cette ville fantôme, il n'y a pas âme qui vive.
target_text: Ndani ya iyi mji ya mizumu, hakuna nafsi hai.
target_text_raw: Ndani ya iyi mji ya mizumu, hakuna nafsi hai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ennemi ne peut pas s'approcher.
target_text: Adui hawezi kukaribia.
target_text_raw: Adui hawezi kukaribia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu regardes mes belles tulipes.
target_text: Unaangalia tulipes zangu nzuri.
target_text_raw: Unaangalia tulipes zangu nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez vous débarrasser de ceci.
target_text: Unapashwa kuachana na iyi.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kuachana na iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'enlève ma veste parce qu'il fait chaud.
target_text: Navua koti yangu kwa sababu piko kifukutu.
target_text_raw: Navua koti yangu kwa sababu piko kifukutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le film est fantastique, c'est un vrai chef-d'œuvre.
target_text: Iyi film ni ya muzuri, ni kazi nzuri kabisa.
target_text_raw: Iyi film ni ya muzuri, ni kazi nzuri kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À ma grande surprise, la porte était ouverte.
target_text: Kwa mushangao wangu, mulango ulikuwa wazi.
target_text_raw: Kwa mushangao wangu, mulango ulikuwa wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo se vante de n'avoir jamais été battu dans une course de chevaux.
target_text: Timéo anajivunia kuwa hayawahi kushindwa kwenye course za farasi.
target_text_raw: Timéo anajivunia kuwa hayawahi kushindwa kwenye course (mbio) za farasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regarde ! Nous venons de manquer le bus.
target_text: Angalia! Tunakosa bisi.
target_text_raw: Angalia! Tunakosa bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme en train de se noyer appelait au secours.
target_text: Mtu aliyezama alikuwa naomba msaada.
target_text_raw: Mtu aliyezama alikuwa naomba msaada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vas-y doucement, c'est la vaisselle en faïence de ma grande tante.
target_text: Wende polepole, ni saani za budongo za shangazi yangu mkubwa.
target_text_raw: Wende polepole, ni saani za budongo za shangazi yangu mkubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le paradis et l'enfer existent dans le cœur des hommes.
target_text: Mbingu na kuzimu ziko ndani ya roho ya wanadamu.
target_text_raw: Mbingu na kuzimu ziko ndani ya roho ya wanadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas besoin d'une cravate pour présenter cette émission. Les gens sont habitués à me voir en tenue sport.
target_text: Sihitaji kravate kwaku pitisha iki kipindi. Watu wanazoea kuniona navala nguo za sport.
target_text_raw: Sihitaji kravate kwaku pitisha iki kipindi. Watu wanazoea kuniona navala nguo za sport.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne restez pas plantées là ! Aidez-moi à le nettoyer !
target_text: Usibakiye nashimama hapo. Nisaidie kuisukula!
target_text_raw: Usibakiye nashimama hapo. Nisaidie kuisukula!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il jeta une lance sur l'ennemi.
target_text: Alitupia adui mkuki.
target_text_raw: Alitupia adui mkuki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les entreprises qui réussissent font de bonnes analyses, de bonnes prévisions et de bons plans, mais elles ne s'y sentent pas enchaînées.
target_text: Kampuni zinazofanikiwa zinafanyaka uchambuzi muzuri, maandalizi muzuri na mipango mizuri, lakini haijisikiake inafungwa.
target_text_raw: Kampuni zinazofanikiwa zinafanyaka uchambuzi muzuri, maandalizi muzuri na mipango mizuri, lakini haijisikiake inafungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il sortit précipitamment du taxi, en disant "gardez la monnaie".
target_text: Alitoka haraka mu taxi, akisema "weka makuta ya kurudia".
target_text_raw: Alitoka haraka mu taxi, akisema "weka makuta ya kurudia".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’ai vu plus d’une fois, du fond d’une caverne noire, les jeunes filles de Kole ou d’Oëlmoe laver leurs pieds nus dans l’eau des torrents, en chantant d’une voix douce.
target_text: Niliona mara mingi, kutoka mu nyumba ndogo yenye giza, mabinti wadogo wa Kole ao wa Oëlmoe wakisukula migulu yabo wazi katika maji ya mito, wakiimba kwa sauti nyororo.
target_text_raw: Niliona mara mingi, kutoka mu nyumba ndogo yenye giza, mabinti wadogo wa Kole ao wa Oëlmoe wakisukula migulu yabo wazi katika maji ya mito, wakiimba kwa sauti nyororo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis vôtre et vous êtes mien.
target_text: Miye ni wako na weye ni wangu.
target_text_raw: Miye ni wako na weye ni wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pourrez le contacter chez lui ce soir.
target_text: Unaweza kuwasiliana naye kwake kunyumba leo mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuwasiliana naye kwake kunyumba leo mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espérais que vous seriez là aujourd'hui.
target_text: Nilitumaini utakuwa hapa leo.
target_text_raw: Nilitumaini utakuwa hapa leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un verbe transitif est un verbe qui peut avoir une complément direct (objet direct).
target_text: Verbe transitif ni verbe ambao inaweza kuwa na complément direct.
target_text_raw: Verbe transitif ni verbe ambao inaweza kuwa na complément direct (objet direct).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je rends souvent visite à mes proches.
target_text: Minazoweaka tembelea wandugu yangu wa karibu.
target_text_raw: Minazoweaka tembelea wandugu yangu wa karibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Brian fait faire ses devoirs par sa mère.
target_text: Brian anafanyizikiwa devoirs zake na mama yake.
target_text_raw: Brian anafanyizikiwa devoirs zake na mama yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je descends du bus ici.
target_text: Ninashukia mu bisi hapa.
target_text_raw: Ninashukia mu bisi hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as appelé tes chats Noah et Jerry.
target_text: Uliita pusi zako Noah na Jerry.
target_text_raw: Uliita pusi zako Noah na Jerry.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En règle générale, l'histoire se répète.
target_text: Kwa kawaida, historia inajirudilia.
target_text_raw: Kwa kawaida, historia inajirudilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que vous devriez vous reposer un moment.
target_text: Minawaza kama minapashwa pumzika kidogo.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama minapashwa pumzika kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crains qu'il ne soit trop tard.
target_text: Minawaza kama ilisha kuwa nyuma.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama ilisha kuwa nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À mon avis, face à la tomate vénéneuse et la salade infectieuse, le concombre tueur ne fait pas le poids.
target_text: Kwa maoni yangu, mbele ya tomati yenye sumu na salade ya kuambukiza, concombre muuaji hailinganishwe.
target_text_raw: Kwa maoni yangu, mbele ya tomati yenye sumu na salade ya kuambukiza, concombre muuaji hailinganishwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme l'avait noté Scott Fitzgerald, les riches sont différents de vous et moi.
target_text: Kama alivyo sema Scott Fitzgerald, watajiri ni tafauti na miye na weye.
target_text_raw: Kama alivyo sema Scott Fitzgerald, watajiri ni tafauti na miye na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun devrait pouvoir contrôler son destin.
target_text: Kila mtu anapashwa kuwa na uwezo wakufatilia destin yake.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu anapashwa kuwa na uwezo wakufatilia destin (alichoandaliwa) yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les appels des scientifiques pour que soient introduits des quotas de pêche ont été ignorés pendant trop longtemps.
target_text: Uwito ya wanasayansi juu ya kuanzishwa migawanyo kwenye mambo ya uvuvi ulipuuzwa toka zamani sana.
target_text_raw: Uwito ya wanasayansi juu ya kuanzishwa migawanyo (pourcentage) kwenye mambo ya uvuvi ulipuuzwa toka zamani sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne te rappelles pas ; je ne l'oublierai jamais.
target_text: Haukumbuki; sitakusahabu ata siku moja.
target_text_raw: Haukumbuki; sitakusahabu ata siku moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la plupart des hôpitaux, les dossiers patients sont conservés par ordre alphabétique.
target_text: Mu hospitali mingi, dossiers za wagonjwa zinawekewa kwa kufwatana na herufi.
target_text_raw: Mu hospitali mingi, dossiers (habari zinahusiana) za wagonjwa zinawekewa kwa kufwatana na herufi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ravie que vous ayez pu venir.
target_text: Minafurahi kwa kuwa umeweza kurudia.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi kwa kuwa umeweza kurudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne faisons pas semblant qu'il en va autrement.
target_text: Tusijifanye kama ni vinginevyo.
target_text_raw: Tusijifanye kama ni vinginevyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kate boit chaque jour beaucoup de lait.
target_text: Kila siku Kate anakunywaka maziwa mingi.
target_text_raw: Kila siku Kate anakunywaka maziwa mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Désolée de ne pas vous avoir envoyé de courriel plus tôt.
target_text: Samahani kwa kutokutumia barua pepe mbele ya wakati.
target_text_raw: Samahani kwa kutokutumia barua pepe mbele ya wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vaisseau spatial a effectué un atterrissage parfait.
target_text: Chombo cha angani kilitua muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Chombo cha angani kilitua muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah ouais. Brillante ton idée...
target_text: Oh ndio. Wazo yako ni nzuri...
target_text_raw: Oh ndio. Wazo yako ni nzuri...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu penses être drôle ?
target_text: Unawaza unachekesha?
target_text_raw: Unawaza unachekesha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel drôle de type !
target_text: Ni mtu wakuchekesha!
target_text_raw: Ni mtu wakuchekesha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est super ! Je regarderai ça plus tard.
target_text: Ni muzuri sana! Nitaiangalia baadaye.
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri sana! Nitaiangalia baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une noria de véhicules du SAMU, des pompiers, et des ambulances sont arrivés pour porter secours aux nombreuses victimes de l'attentat.
target_text: Mustari ya ma gari za kwenda na kurudia za SAMU, wazimamoto, na magari ya wagonjwa ilifika kuwasaidia wahanga wengi wa shambulio.
target_text_raw: Mustari ya ma gari za kwenda na kurudia za SAMU, wazimamoto, na magari ya wagonjwa ilifika kuwasaidia wahanga wengi wa shambulio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sinon, tout est parfait.
target_text: Lakini, kila kitu ni sawa.
target_text_raw: Lakini, kila kitu ni sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La chose la plus incroyable avec les miracles, c'est qu'ils arrivent.
target_text: Jambo la kushangaza juu ya miujiza ni kwamba inafanyikaka.
target_text_raw: Jambo la kushangaza juu ya miujiza ni kwamba inafanyikaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La femme n'est victime d'aucune mystérieuse fatalité : il ne faut pas conclure que ses ovaires la condamnent à vivre éternellement à genoux.
target_text: Mwanamuke siyo muhanga wa kifo chochote cha kushangaza: haipashwi kuhakikishwa kuwa mbegu zake za uzazi zinamuhukumu kuishi milele akipiga magoti .
target_text_raw: Mwanamuke siyo muhanga wa kifo chochote cha kushangaza: haipashwi kuhakikishwa kuwa mbegu zake za uzazi zinamuhukumu kuishi milele akipiga magoti .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tiens, quelle coïncidence rarissime ! Kylia a les mêmes empreintes digitales que moi.
target_text: Ona, iyi ni jambo isiyo ya kawaida! Kylia iko na alama za vidole kama zangu.
target_text_raw: Ona, iyi ni jambo isiyo ya kawaida! Kylia iko na alama za vidole kama zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne fais que dire que ce que les autres ont toujours voulu te dire : t'es un type arrogant et chiant.
target_text: Minasema tu kile wengine walikuwa nataka kukuambia: weye ni mtu mwenye kiburi na wa kuchosha.
target_text_raw: Minasema tu kile wengine walikuwa nataka kukuambia: weye ni mtu mwenye kiburi na wa kuchosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On se voit plus tard.
target_text: Tutaonana baadaye.
target_text_raw: Tutaonana baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je comprends ce que vous voulez dire, mais je ne suis pas sûre de la façon de le traduire.
target_text: Minasikia kile ulitaka kusema, lakini sina uhakika na namna ya kukitafsiri.
target_text_raw: Minasikia kile ulitaka kusema, lakini sina uhakika na namna ya kukitafsiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pensez que tout ça est une sorte de blague ?
target_text: Unawaza kama iyi ni aina ya utani?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kama iyi ni aina ya utani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reviens immédiatement.
target_text: Ndarudia mara moja.
target_text_raw: Ndarudia mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-lui que tu l'aimes avant qu'il ne soit trop tard !
target_text: Mwambie kama unamupenda na haiyakuwa nyuma!
target_text_raw: Mwambie kama unamupenda na haiyakuwa nyuma!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi avez-vous voulu revenir ici ?
target_text: Juu ya nini ulitaka kurudia hapa?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini ulitaka kurudia hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu trouveras la liste des leçons sur la page des leçons en ligne.
target_text: Utapata liste ya masomo kwenye page ya masomo kwenye mtandao.
target_text_raw: Utapata liste ya masomo kwenye page ya masomo kwenye mtandao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonjour, chéri.
target_text: Jambo, mpenzi.
target_text_raw: Jambo, mpenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons agir, sinon il sera trop tard.
target_text: Tunapashwa kamata hatua, kama sivyo itakuwa nyuma.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa kamata hatua, kama sivyo itakuwa nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les faux amis sont bien plus sympa à traduire !
target_text: Marafiki wa baya ndiyo wazuri zaidi kuelewa!
target_text_raw: Marafiki wa baya ndiyo wazuri zaidi kuelewa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Comment se passe l'enquête ? » « Ça avance. »
target_text: « Uchunguzi inaendelea aye? » « Inaendelea muzuri. »
target_text_raw: « Uchunguzi inaendelea aye? » « Inaendelea muzuri. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie est enfin venue.
target_text: Marie anarudia sasa.
target_text_raw: Marie anarudia sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu m'as promis que tu prendrais soin de Luca.
target_text: Uliniahidi kama utachunga Muca muzuri.
target_text_raw: Uliniahidi kama utachunga Muca muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après avoir cru que je ne savais pas grand-chose, j'ai à présent la déprimante conviction que je ne comprends rien.
target_text: Baada ya kuamini kama sijuwe mengi, sasa niko na sikitiko ya kuamini kwamba sielewi chochote.
target_text_raw: Baada ya kuamini kama sijuwe mengi, sasa niko na sikitiko ya kuamini kwamba sielewi chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bienvenue dans la vraie vie !
target_text: Karibu kwenye maisha ya kweli!
target_text_raw: Karibu kwenye maisha ya kweli!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un mec sympa.
target_text: Yeye ni mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En relisant — et souvent en corrigeant — mes phrases dans Tatoeba, j'ai parfois l'impression d'écrire le journal que j'ai toujours voulu écrire.
target_text: En relisant — na mara mingi kwa kukosoa — wakati mwengine minaonaka sawa vile minaandika kitabu cha habari ambacho nilikuwa nikitaka kuandika tangu zamani.
target_text_raw: En relisant — na mara mingi kwa kukosoa — wakati mwengine minaonaka sawa vile minaandika kitabu cha habari ambacho nilikuwa nikitaka kuandika tangu zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vu de loin, ça ressemble à une balle.
target_text: Ukionea kwa mbali, inaonekana kama lisasi.
target_text_raw: Ukionea kwa mbali, inaonekana kama lisasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous en prie, restez donc encore un peu ! Il n'est pas tard.
target_text: Tafazali bakia tena kidogo! Haiyakuwa nyuma.
target_text_raw: Tafazali bakia tena kidogo! Haiyakuwa nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie, voici David, frère de Joseph.
target_text: Marie, uyu ni David, kaka yake ya Joseph.
target_text_raw: Marie, uyu ni David, kaka yake ya Joseph.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ai-je encore foutu le bordel ?
target_text: Nilifanya tena bitu yenye haina maana?
target_text_raw: Nilifanya tena bitu yenye haina maana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que je suis en mesure de facilement vous expliquer cette circonstance.
target_text: Minaamini kama minaweza kuelezea kwa urahisi iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Minaamini kama minaweza kuelezea kwa urahisi iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes toujours exposés à un type quelconque de risque.
target_text: Tunaendelea kuwa mu aina fulani ya hatari.
target_text_raw: Tunaendelea kuwa mu aina fulani ya hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne peux plus séparer le lait du café une fois que tu l'as versé dedans.

target_text: Hawa mabinti, walevi wa raha na uvivu, ambao wanavunja mali kupitia vidole yao vya uharibifu, wanatarajia mbele ya wakati siku zijazo mbele na kupoteza wakati wa sasa.

source_text: Luca était parmi mes meilleurs amis au lycée.

target_text_raw: Luca alikuwaka mumoja ya marafiki zangu wazuri kwenye shule ya sekondari.

target_text_raw: Heather ananiamini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me semblait que la beauté était pareille à un sommet de pic de montagne ; une fois atteint il ne reste plus qu'à descendre.
target_text: Ilionekana kwangu kuwa uzuri ilikuwa kama chongo ya mulima; ukisha ifikia inabakiaka tu kushuka.
target_text_raw: Ilionekana kwangu kuwa uzuri ilikuwa kama chongo ya mulima; ukisha ifikia inabakiaka tu kushuka.

target_text_raw: kama hauondoki sasa ivi, initabidi niite walinda usalama.

target_text_raw: Nilitumia picha ya imbwa yangu kama fond d'écran.

source_text: Il est parti aux toilettes, il va revenir.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'hésitez pas à poser des questions si vous ne comprenez pas.

target_text_raw: Usisite kuuliza maswali kama hauelewi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai assez de tes conneries stupides.

target_text_raw: Minachoka na bujinga yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La prise de poids est la méthode de développement personnel la plus simple.
target_text: Kuongeza kilo njo njia rahisi ya maendeleo ya kibinafsi.
target_text_raw: Kuongeza kilo njo njia rahisi ya maendeleo ya kibinafsi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ressemble à sa tante.
target_text: Anafanana shangazi yake.
target_text_raw: Anafanana shangazi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Cinq ! " A dit Alex.
target_text: " Tano! "Alex alisema.
target_text_raw: " Tano! "Alex alisema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le risque de confusion est trop élevé, je ne dois sûrement pas être la seule, à ne pas piger ça.
target_text: Hatari ya kuchanganyikiwa ni kubwa sana, niko na ukika kama siyo miepeke njo sielewi.
target_text_raw: Hatari ya kuchanganyikiwa ni kubwa sana, niko na ukika kama siyo miepeke njo sielewi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit n'avoir aucun souvenir de la soirée.
target_text: Anasema hakumbuki hata kitu moya kuhusu mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Anasema hakumbuki hata kitu moya kuhusu mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous trouvez ça marrant ?
target_text: Unawaza inachekesha?
target_text_raw: Unawaza inachekesha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas à qui en revient la faute.
target_text: Sijuwi kosa ni ya nani.
target_text_raw: Sijuwi kosa ni ya nani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous arriverons à 2h30 et Marie arrivera un peu plus tard.
target_text: Tutafika 2:30 na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Tutafika 2:30 na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi t'es-tu mise de son côté plutôt que du mien ?
target_text: Juu ya nini ulijitia ngambo yake pahali ya ngambo yangu?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini ulijitia ngambo yake pahali ya ngambo yangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée de ne pas t'avoir envoyé un courriel plus tôt.
target_text: Samahani kwa kutokutumia barua mapema.
target_text_raw: Samahani kwa kutokutumia barua mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne tourne jamais le dos à Louis.
target_text: Usimugeuzie Louis mugongo ata siku moja.
target_text_raw: Usimugeuzie Louis mugongo ata siku moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que Timéo sache pourquoi Alice est allée à l'hôpital.
target_text: Sizani kama Timéo anajua juu ya nini Alice alienda ku hospitali.
target_text_raw: Sizani kama Timéo anajua juu ya nini Alice alienda ku hospitali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour être heureux, vous devriez passer du temps avec quelqu'un que vous aimez.
target_text: Juu ukuwe na furaha, unapashwa pitisha wakati na mtu unaye mupenda.
target_text_raw: Juu ukuwe na furaha, unapashwa pitisha wakati na mtu unaye mupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, c'est ce que j'ai dit.
target_text: Ndio, njo gisi nilisema.
target_text_raw: Ndio, njo gisi nilisema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce spectacle de Carthage irritait les Barbares. Ils l’admiraient, ils l’exécraient, ils auraient voulu tout à la fois l’anéantir et l’habiter.
target_text: Iyi onyesho ya Carthage iliwasirikisha wa Barbares. Waliifurahia, waliichukia, walitaka kuiteketeza na kuikala ndani yake.
target_text_raw: Iyi onyesho (spectacle) ya Carthage iliwasirikisha wa Barbares. Waliifurahia, waliichukia, walitaka kuiteketeza na kuikala ndani yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsqu'une femme reste trop longtemps esseulée, tôt ou tard elle commence à penser; et nul homme ne sait ce qu'elle pourrait découvrir.
target_text: Wakati mwanamuke anabakia mupweke kwa muda mrefu sana, anafikiaka tu kuanza fikiria; na hakuna mwanamume anaye jua chenye anaweza gunduwa.
target_text_raw: Wakati mwanamuke anabakia mupweke kwa muda mrefu sana, anafikiaka tu kuanza fikiria; na hakuna mwanamume anaye jua chenye anaweza gunduwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles se sont rencontrées à une rencontre surprise.
target_text: Walikutana kwenye mkutano wa kushtukia.
target_text_raw: Walikutana kwenye mkutano wa kushtukia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'officier encouragea ses hommes à faire preuve de bravoure.
target_text: Uyo afisa aliwahimiza watu wake kuonesha uhodari.
target_text_raw: Uyo afisa (officier) aliwahimiza watu wake kuonesha uhodari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans l'enquête d'opinion, les deux partis sont à égalité.
target_text: Katika utafiti ya maoni, pande mbili ziko sawa sawa.
target_text_raw: Katika utafiti ya maoni, pande mbili ziko sawa sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne dirai jamais à personne où j'ai caché le trésor.
target_text: Sitamwambia mtu yoyote mahali ambapo nilificha hazina.
target_text_raw: Sitamwambia mtu yoyote mahali ambapo nilificha hazina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'aimes pas les histoires d'amour.
target_text: Hupendi hadisi za mapenzi.
target_text_raw: Hupendi hadisi za mapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'attendais à moitié à ce que ça arrive.
target_text: Nilikuwa nangoya nusu itokee.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nangoya nusu itokee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai mal au dos du fait que je sois assis de longues heures devant l'ordinateur.
target_text: Mugongo yangu inaluma kwa sababu ya kuikala muda murefu mbele ya ordinateur.
target_text_raw: Mugongo yangu inaluma kwa sababu ya kuikala muda murefu mbele ya ordinateur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sarah, peux-tu fermer les volets ?
target_text: Sarah, unaeza funga madirisha?
target_text_raw: Sarah, unaeza funga madirisha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voulez-vous absolument mener votre grossesse à terme ?
target_text: Unataka kabisa kubakia na ujauzito wako mpaka mwisho ?
target_text_raw: Unataka kabisa kubakia na ujauzito wako mpaka mwisho ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je trouve que Tatoeba, pour nous amoureux des langues, est devenu un lieu très chaleureux et intime, en particulier pour tous ceux d'entre nous qui peuvent comprendre et apprendre des langues relativement rapidement et facilement.
target_text: Minaona kama Tatoeba, kwetu sisi wapenzi wa luga, ilishakuwa mahali pazuri sana na ya kibinafsi, hasa kwa sisi wote ambao tunaweza kuelewa na kujifunza luga mbio na kwa urahisi.
target_text_raw: Minaona kama Tatoeba, kwetu sisi wapenzi wa luga, ilishakuwa mahali pazuri sana na ya kibinafsi, hasa kwa sisi wote ambao tunaweza kuelewa na kujifunza luga mbio na kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tony se trouvait à l'entrée.
target_text: Tony alikuwa ku mulango.
target_text_raw: Tony alikuwa ku mulango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au tribunal, ils ont nié avoir forcé le jeune et se sont justifiés en disant qu'il n'avait jamais réagi ou protesté.
target_text: Kwenye korti, walikatala kama hawakumukaza kijana na kujifasiria kwa kusema kwamba hajawahi kujibu ao kupinga.
target_text_raw: Kwenye korti, walikatala kama hawakumukaza kijana na kujifasiria kwa kusema kwamba hajawahi kujibu ao kupinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La confrontation des témoins qui l'avaient rencontrée le jour de sa mort devait aider l'inspecteur.
target_text: Makabiliano ya mashahidi ambao walikunana naye siku ya kifo chake ingesaidia muchunguzi.
target_text_raw: Makabiliano ya mashahidi ambao walikunana naye siku ya kifo chake ingesaidia (inspecteur) muchunguzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se retrouve sur la corde raide.
target_text: Anajikutana iko ku kamba ya nguvu.
target_text_raw: Anajikutana iko ku kamba ya nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que le dernier test de bombe atomique signifie la guerre ?

target_text_raw: Jaribio ya mwisho ya bombeatomique inamaanisha vita?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon frère gagne moitié moins d'argent que mon père.
target_text: Kaka yangu anapataka nusu ya mushahara ya baba yangu.
target_text_raw: Kaka yangu anapataka nusu ya mushahara ya baba yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez ici, je vais revenir.
target_text: Bakia hapa,ndarudia.
target_text_raw: Bakia hapa,ndarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes un drôle de type.
target_text: Weye ni mtu wakuchekesha.
target_text_raw: Weye ni mtu wakuchekesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il refuse de croire que l'un de mes frères est responsable de la mort de mon père.
target_text: Anakatala kuamini kwamba umoya mu ba kaka yangu njo alisababisha kifo cha baba yangu.
target_text_raw: Anakatala kuamini kwamba umoya mu ba kaka yangu njo alisababisha kifo cha baba yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le pain est l'aliment le plus simple et le plus ancien du monde.
target_text: Mukate njo chakula rahisi na ya zamani zaidi duniani.
target_text_raw: Mukate njo chakula rahisi na ya zamani zaidi duniani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Nilisema: « Acha! »
target_text_raw: Nilisema: « Acha! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au paresseux donnez un œuf, il vous dira de l'écaler.

target_text_raw: Mupatie muvivu liyayi, atakuambia uimenye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu restes ici jusqu'à ce que je revienne.
target_text: Nataka ubakie hapa mpaka nirudie.
target_text_raw: Nataka ubakie hapa mpaka nirudie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma sœur adore la corde à sauter.
target_text: Dada yangu anapendaka kamba ya kuruka.
target_text_raw: Dada yangu anapendaka kamba ya kuruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un combat dure à peu près cinq minutes.
target_text: Mapigano inadumu kama dakika tano.
target_text_raw: Mapigano inadumu kama dakika tano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ben a adjoint Ken à Théo.

target_text_raw: Ben alikutanisha Ken na Theo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si l'œil ne voit pas parfaitement, un couteau aiguisé est inutile.

target_text_raw: Kama licho haione muzuri, kisu ya makali hahitajike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En veux-tu un simple ou un double ?
target_text: Unataka ya kawaida ao ya double?
target_text_raw: Unataka ya kawaida ao ya double?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le personnage principal de cette émission est un écureuil parlant.
target_text: Muhusika mkuu wa iki kipindi ni munyama ecureuil anaye ongea.
target_text_raw: Muhusika mkuu wa iki kipindi ni munyama ecureuil anaye ongea.

source_text: Officiellement, on ne dénomme « miel en rayon » que les morceaux de nids d'abeilles avec du miel de bruyère.

target_text_raw: Rasmi inaitwa « asali mu rayon » vipande vya chicha ya nyuki na asali ya mumea bruyère.
