source_text: Plusieurs danseurs se déhanchaient sur la grande piste de danse.
target_text: Wacheza danse wengi walikuwa wakicheza ku piste ya danse kubwa.
target_text_raw: Wacheza danse wengi walikuwa wakicheza ku piste ya danse kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vécu notre vie de couple comme un enfer.
target_text: Niliishi maisha yetu ya ndoa kama kuzimu.
target_text_raw: Niliishi maisha yetu ya ndoa kama kuzimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque camp devra se composer d'au moins quinze personnes.
target_text: Kila kundi inapashwa kuwa na watu kumi na tano.
target_text_raw: Kila kundi inapashwa kuwa na watu kumi na tano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu n'es pas ici pour m'aider, dégage !
target_text: Kama hauko hapa kwa kunisaidia, toka!
target_text_raw: Kama hauko hapa kwa kunisaidia, toka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu penses que tout ça est une sorte de canular ?
target_text: Unawaza kama iyi yote ni aina ya uongo?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kama iyi yote ni aina ya uongo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La flèche est passée loin de la cible.
target_text: Mushale umepita mbali ya mahali ilitakiwa kufika.
target_text_raw: Mushale umepita mbali ya mahali ilitakiwa kufika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne l'en rends pas responsable.
target_text: Usimulaumu.
target_text_raw: Usimulaumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est d'un naturel joyeux.
target_text: Anakuwaka mtu wa furaha.
target_text_raw: Anakuwaka mtu wa furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il y a quoi que ce soit que vous vouliez faire, vous devriez le faire.
target_text: Kama piko jambo yoyote unayotaka fanya, unapashwa kulifanya.
target_text_raw: Kama piko jambo yoyote unayotaka fanya, unapashwa kulifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pensez que vous êtes assez marrant, non ?
target_text: Unawaza unachekesha ya kutosha, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Unawaza unachekesha ya kutosha, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez un taxi ?
target_text: Unataka taxi?
target_text_raw: Unataka taxi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’ai besoin d’aide pour mettre à niveau le système d’exploitation de mon appareil afin de me protéger des dernières cybermenaces.
target_text: Minahitaji msaada kwa kuboresha mfumo wa uendeshaji ya kifaa changu juu ya kujikinga na bitisho ya izi siku ku mutandao wa internet.
target_text_raw: Minahitaji msaada kwa kuboresha mfumo wa uendeshaji (exploitation) ya kifaa changu juu ya kujikinga na bitisho ya izi siku ku mutandao wa internet.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parfait. Je vous remercie.
target_text: Muzuri sana. Aksanti.
target_text_raw: Muzuri sana. Aksanti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez vos bonnes chaussures.
target_text: Vala biato yako muzuri.
target_text_raw: Vala biato yako muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette souris a été tuée par mon chat.
target_text: Iyi panya iliuawa na pusi yangu.
target_text_raw: Iyi panya iliuawa na pusi yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est rentré tard hier.
target_text: Alirudia nyuma jana.
target_text_raw: Alirudia nyuma jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous allez présenter vos excuses, vous devriez le faire sans délai.
target_text: Kama utaomba musamaha, unapashwa kufanya hivyo bila kuchelewesha.
target_text_raw: Kama utaomba musamaha, unapashwa kufanya hivyo bila kuchelewesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'est couché sur le dos.
target_text: Alilalia mugongo.
target_text_raw: Alilalia mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Disons simplement que je suis là pour rester.
target_text: Tuseme tu kama niko hapa kwa kubakia.
target_text_raw: Tuseme tu kama niko hapa kwa kubakia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La soutane du prêtre gonflait doucement au vent.
target_text: Kaneu ya padiri ilikuwa navimba pole pole mu mupepeo.
target_text_raw: Kaneu ya padiri ilikuwa navimba pole pole mu mupepeo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'ouvrez jamais la porte d'un véhicule en marche.
target_text: Usifungulake mulango ya gari yenye iko natembea.
target_text_raw: Usifungulake mulango ya gari yenye iko natembea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon maître de conférences a dit qu'une bonne connaissance de l'analyse numérique, du calcul stochastique et de la programmation en C++ est importante pour un emploi dans la banque.
target_text: Maître de conférence wangu alisema kama kujua muzuri analyse numérique, hesabu ya stochastique na programmation mu C++ ni ya muhimu kwa kazi ndani ya banki.
target_text_raw: Maître de conférence wangu alisema kama kujua muzuri analyse numérique, hesabu ya stochastique na programmation mu C++ ni ya muhimu kwa kazi ndani ya banki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'essayais de faire semblant d'être quelque chose que je n'étais pas.
target_text: Nilikuwa najaribu kujifanya kuwa gisi sikukuwa.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa najaribu kujifanya kuwa gisi sikukuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai bien l'impression qu'on va s'amuser ce soir.
target_text: Minaona kama tutaburudika mangaribi ya leo.
target_text_raw: Minaona kama tutaburudika mangaribi ya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soldat a été tué au combat.
target_text: Askari aliuawa mu vita.
target_text_raw: Askari aliuawa mu vita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a frappé la balle avec la batte.
target_text: Alipiga mupira na batte.
target_text_raw: Alipiga mupira na batte.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand Nathan arriva à la gare, Marie venait déjà à sa rencontre.
target_text: Wakati Nathan alifika kituoni, Marie alikuya tayari kumukutana.
target_text_raw: Wakati Nathan alifika kituoni, Marie alikuya tayari kumukutana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce type est un raté.
target_text: Uyu jamaa hana akili sawa.
target_text_raw: Uyu jamaa hana akili sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mariage royal était un grand spectacle.
target_text: Ndoa ya kifalme ilikuwa tamasha kubwa.
target_text_raw: Ndoa ya kifalme ilikuwa tamasha kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne paraissez pas si surprise ! Vous savez que je peux faire tout ce que je veux.
target_text: Usifanane mwenye kushangala sana! Unajua kama minaweza fanya byote byenye minataka.
target_text_raw: Usifanane mwenye kushangala sana! Unajua kama minaweza fanya byote byenye minataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'avantage que tu peux trouver à un emploi au bas de l'échelle, c'est qu'il laisse largement la place à l'amélioration.
target_text: Faida ambayo unaweza pata katika kazi ya chini ni kwamba inapanaka fursa mingi ya kujiboresha.
target_text_raw: Faida ambayo unaweza pata katika kazi ya chini ni kwamba inapanaka fursa mingi ya kujiboresha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça ira tant que je reste debout, non ?
target_text: Itaendeka sawa kabla ningali nashimama, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Itaendeka sawa kabla ningali nashimama, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Marie, le café est trop fort pour moi. » – « Oh, je suis désolée. Prends peut-être un peu de lait. »
target_text: « Marie, kahawa ni ya mingi sana kwangu. » – « Ah, samahani. Kamata labda maziwa kidogo. »
target_text_raw: « Marie, kahawa ni ya mingi sana kwangu. » – « Ah, samahani. Kamata labda maziwa kidogo. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon rêve parlait d'aquariums et d'armes sous-marines.
target_text: Ndoto yangu ilikuwa juu ya Aquarium na silaha za chini ya maji.
target_text_raw: Ndoto yangu ilikuwa juu ya Aquarium na silaha za chini ya maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous confions le méchant à Dieu, afin qu’Il le dirige ou le châtie.
target_text: Tunamkabizi Mungu waovu, juu aweze kuiongoza ao kuiazibu.
target_text_raw: Tunamkabizi Mungu waovu, juu aweze kuiongoza ao kuiazibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il refuse de porter ce costume sans une cravate bleue.
target_text: Anakatala kuvala yi koti bila Kravate ya bleu.
target_text_raw: Anakatala kuvala yi koti bila Kravate ya bleu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son carnet d'adresses ne comportant pas beaucoup de noms, il serait facile pour la police d'établir la liste des suspects.
target_text: Carnet d'adresse yake haina majina mingi, itakuwa rahisi kwa polisi kuanda liste ya washutumiwa.
target_text_raw: Carnet d'adresse yake haina majina mingi, itakuwa rahisi kwa polisi kuanda liste ya washutumiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demandais si tu aimerais aller au bal avec moi.
target_text: Nilikua najiuliza kama ungependa kuenda ku shereke na miye.
target_text_raw: Nilikua najiuliza kama ungependa kuenda ku shereke na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée si ma présence t'embarrasse.
target_text: Samahani kama kukuwa yangu hapa inakusumbua.
target_text_raw: Samahani kama kukuwa yangu hapa inakusumbua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais en retard, car j'étais sûre que les cours commençaient plus tard.
target_text: Nilichelewa kwa sababu nilikuwa na uhakika kuwa masomo itaanza baadaye.
target_text_raw: Nilichelewa kwa sababu nilikuwa na uhakika kuwa masomo itaanza baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle est votre type d'art préféré ?
target_text: Ni aina gani ya sanaa njo unapendaka?
target_text_raw: Ni aina gani ya sanaa njo unapendaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être que toi ou moi pouvons amener du changement à ce monde si froid.
target_text: Labda weye ao miye njo tunaweza leta mabadiliko katika iyi dunia isiyo kuwa na zamiri.
target_text_raw: Labda weye ao miye njo tunaweza leta mabadiliko katika iyi dunia isiyo kuwa na zamiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le professeur a écrit un bref commentaire sur l'épreuve de chaque étudiant.
target_text: Mwalimu aliandika maelezo mufupi juu ya mutihani ya kila mwanafunzi.
target_text_raw: Mwalimu aliandika maelezo mufupi juu ya mutihani ya kila mwanafunzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que Thomas pourrait être amené à proposer son aide.
target_text: Nazani kama Thomas anaweza ombwa kutoa msaada wake.
target_text_raw: Nazani kama Thomas anaweza ombwa kutoa msaada wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Reviens immédiatement !
target_text: Rudia mara moja!
target_text_raw: Rudia mara moja!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceci est le résultat de toute une vie de recherches.
target_text: Iyi ni matokeo ya utafiti ya muda murefu.
target_text_raw: Iyi ni matokeo ya utafiti ya muda murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis arrivé trop tard pour entendre son discours.
target_text: Nilifika minachelewa sana, sikusikia hotuba yake.
target_text_raw: Nilifika minachelewa sana, sikusikia hotuba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce couple ne se dispute pas souvent maintenant, mais auparavant ça arrivait souvent.
target_text: Hawa wanandoa hawapiganake tena mara mingi kwa sasa, lakini zamani ilikuwa natokea sana.
target_text_raw: Hawa wanandoa hawapiganake tena mara mingi kwa sasa, lakini zamani ilikuwa natokea sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu l'appelles "Louis."
target_text: Unamuita "Louis."
target_text_raw: Unamuita "Louis."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoute encore une fois le disque et dis-moi plus tard si tu l'aimes.
target_text: Sikiliza tena iyi muziko na uniambie baadaye kama unaipenda.
target_text_raw: Sikiliza tena iyi muziko na uniambie baadaye kama unaipenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'aiderai de toutes les manières que je pourrai.
target_text: Nitakusaidia kwa namna yoyote nitakayo weza.
target_text_raw: Nitakusaidia kwa namna yoyote nitakayo weza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi as-tu voulu revenir ici ?
target_text: Juu ya nini ulipenda kurudia hapa?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini ulipenda kurudia hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes une très bonne secrétaire. Si vous ne vous étiez pas occupée de tout, je n'aurais rien pu faire. Vous êtes formidable.
target_text: Weye ni katibu muzuri sana. Ikiwa haukushurulikia kila kitu, singeweza fanya chochote. Uko mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Weye ni katibu muzuri sana. Ikiwa haukushurulikia kila kitu, singeweza fanya chochote. Uko mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a frappé doucement à la porte.
target_text: Aligonga mulango polepole.
target_text_raw: Aligonga mulango polepole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les plantes que nous utilisons pour notre production, la communauté des médecins la connaît et l'utilise déjà depuis des centaines d'années.
target_text: Mimea tunayotumia kwa uzalishaji yetu, inajulikana na kutumiwa na jamii ya wanganga tangu mamia ya miaka.
target_text_raw: Mimea tunayotumia kwa uzalishaji (production) yetu, inajulikana na kutumiwa na jamii ya wanganga tangu mamia ya miaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez vraiment vous faire couper les cheveux.
target_text: Kwa kweli ungepashwa kutoshesha nywele zako.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli ungepashwa kutoshesha nywele zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La viande est facilement séparée des os.
target_text: Nyama inatenganishwa na mifupa kwa urahisi.
target_text_raw: Nyama inatenganishwa na mifupa kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous trouve bien à la coule dans ce job.
target_text: Minaona sawa unaweza iyi kazi.
target_text_raw: Minaona sawa unaweza iyi kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un type sur qui on peut compter.
target_text: Yeye ni mtu ambaye anaweza tegemewa.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mtu ambaye anaweza tegemewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son long cou ressemble à celui d'un cheval.
target_text: Shingo yake murefu inafanana na ya farasi.
target_text_raw: Shingo yake murefu inafanana na ya farasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel a été escorté hors du bâtiment par des agents de sécurité.
target_text: Gabriel alitolewa inje ya jengo na walinda usalama.
target_text_raw: Gabriel alitolewa inje ya jengo na walinda usalama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo était la star de l'équipe de basket.
target_text: Mathéo alikuwa muchezaji bora kwenye timu ya basketball.
target_text_raw: Mathéo alikuwa muchezaji bora kwenye timu ya basketball.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Selon Arte, « à l'épreuve des balles » se dit en anglais « belette-prouf ». Selon moi, c'est « boulette-prouf ».
target_text: Kulingana na Arte, « kuzuia lisasi » inaitwa « belette-prouf » mu Kiingereza. Kwa maoni yangu, ni « boulette-prouf ».
target_text_raw: Kulingana na Arte, « kuzuia lisasi » inaitwa « belette-prouf » mu Kiingereza. Kwa maoni yangu, ni « boulette-prouf ».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet homme a vendu son âme au diable.
target_text: Uyu mtu aliuzisha roho yake kwa shetani.
target_text_raw: Uyu mtu aliuzisha roho yake kwa shetani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ici, les soldats, aussi bien que les colons, ont le droit de tirer sur n'importe quel autochtone qu'ils jugent être une "menace" pour leur sécurité.
target_text: Hapa, waaskari, na vile vile wakoloni, wako na haki ya kupiga lisasi mtu yeyote wanaye muona kuwa "kitisho" kwa usalama yao.
target_text_raw: Hapa, waaskari, na vile vile wakoloni, wako na haki ya kupiga lisasi mtu yeyote wanaye muona kuwa "kitisho" kwa usalama yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le vaisseau spatial a fait un atterrissage parfait.
target_text: Chombo cha angani kilishuka muzuri.
target_text_raw: Chombo cha angani kilishuka muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Alors chéri, tu montes ?
target_text: Sasa mupenzi, utapanda?
target_text_raw: Sasa mupenzi, utapanda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Essaye maintenant, sinon tu le regretteras plus tard.
target_text: Ujaribu sasa ivi, kama sivyo utakuja juta.
target_text_raw: Ujaribu sasa ivi, kama sivyo utakuja juta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment cela t'arrangerait-il d'organiser notre échange ?
target_text: Namna gani njo ingekupendeza kupangilia ubadilishaji yetu?
target_text_raw: Namna gani njo ingekupendeza kupangilia ubadilishaji yetu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais cru qu'il me ferait ça.
target_text: Sikuamini ata kidogo kama atanifanyia hivi.
target_text_raw: Sikuamini ata kidogo kama atanifanyia hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parfois un hochement de tête est suffisant pour montrer à quelqu'un que vous écoutez attentivement.
target_text: Wakati ingine ku tingiza kichwa inatosha kuonesha mtu kwamba unasikiliza kwa makini.
target_text_raw: Wakati ingine ku tingiza kichwa inatosha kuonesha mtu kwamba unasikiliza kwa makini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au Japon, il pleut pas mal pendant notre saison des pluies, qui dure de mi-juin à mi-juillet.
target_text: Huko Japani, mvula inanyeshaka kidogo wakati wa msimu wetu wa mvula, ambayo inaanzaka katikati ya mwezi wa sita mpaka katikati ya mwezi wa saba.
target_text_raw: Huko Japani, mvula inanyeshaka kidogo wakati wa msimu wetu wa mvula, ambayo inaanzaka katikati ya mwezi wa sita mpaka katikati ya mwezi wa saba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir que tu m'aides.
target_text: Itabidi unisaidie.
target_text_raw: Itabidi unisaidie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne seriez pas capable de gérer la pression.
target_text: Haungeweza kukabiziana na pression.
target_text_raw: Haungeweza kukabiziana na pression.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bougez.
target_text: Sogea.
target_text_raw: Sogea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va sans dire qu'Edmée n'en fout pas une.
target_text: Anaenda bila kusema kama Edmée hayafanya ata kitu moja.
target_text_raw: Anaenda bila kusema kama Edmée hayafanya ata kitu moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À présent, Hugo ne vit plus que de souvenirs.
target_text: kwa sasa Hugo anaishi tu kwa kumbukumbu.
target_text_raw: kwa sasa Hugo anaishi tu kwa kumbukumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es enfin venue.
target_text: Unafika maraba.
target_text_raw: Unafika maraba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il continue à vous menacer, vous devriez aller à la police.
target_text: Akiendelea kukutisha, unapashwa enda ku polisi.
target_text_raw: Akiendelea kukutisha, unapashwa enda ku polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que tu penses des films que nous avons vus hier ?
target_text: Unawaza nini juu ya films zenye tuliangalia jana?
target_text_raw: Unawaza nini juu ya films zenye tuliangalia jana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis acheté un logiciel de traitement de texte pour écrire un livre de mon cru.
target_text: Niliuza logiciel ya kusaidia kuandika juu niandike kitabu yangu miepeke.
target_text_raw: Niliuza logiciel ya kusaidia kuandika (traitement de texte) juu niandike kitabu yangu miepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais aimé que vous ne m'ayez pas trouvée.
target_text: Ningependa usijue kwenye niko.
target_text_raw: Ningependa usijue kwenye niko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sans l'eau, les humains ne pourraient pas survivre.
target_text: Bila maji, wanadamu hawawezi ishi.
target_text_raw: Bila maji, wanadamu hawawezi ishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est moi qui ai jeté un sac par-dessus bord.
target_text: Ni miye njo nilitupa sakoshi mu bahari.
target_text_raw: Ni miye njo nilitupa sakoshi mu bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie casse souvent nos fenêtres avec une balle.
target_text: Mara mingi Marie anavunjaka madirisha yetu na kabumbu.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi Marie anavunjaka madirisha yetu na kabumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre nouveau prof sort juste de la fac.
target_text: Mwalimu wetu wa mupya anatoka kumaliza masomo ya chuo kikuu.
target_text_raw: Mwalimu wetu wa mupya anatoka kumaliza masomo ya chuo kikuu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes plus beaux, mes plus doux voyages, je les ai faits au coin de mon feu, les pieds dans la cendre chaude et les coudes appuyés sur les bras râpés du fauteuil de ma grand’mère.
target_text: Safari zangu nzuri na za kuvutia zaidi, nilizifanya kando ya moto yangu, migulu ndani ya majifu ya moto na konongo yangu inasegemea ku mikono ya kukunjama ya kiti ya tate yangu .
target_text_raw: Safari zangu nzuri na za kuvutia zaidi, nilizifanya kando ya moto yangu, migulu ndani ya majifu ya moto na konongo yangu inasegemea ku mikono ya kukunjama ya kiti ya tate yangu .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il chercha tous les moyens possibles pour s'échapper.
target_text: Alitafuta njia zote zinazowezekana juu atoroke.
target_text_raw: Alitafuta njia zote zinazowezekana juu atoroke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bienvenue à bord !
target_text: Karibu ndani!
target_text_raw: Karibu ndani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: ℝ est archimédien : pour tout réel x, il existe un entier naturel n strictement plus grand que x.
target_text: ℝ ni Archimédien : kwa X réel yoyote, kuko entier naturel N ambayo ni kubwa zaidi kuliko X.
target_text_raw: ℝ ni Archimédien : kwa X réel yoyote, kuko entier naturel N ambayo ni kubwa zaidi kuliko X.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon camarade est cinglé.
target_text: Rafiki yangu hana akili sawa.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yangu hana akili sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après la mort d'Hérode, un ange du Seigneur apparut en songe à Joseph.
target_text: Kisha kifo cha Herode malaika wa bwana alimutokea Yosefu kwenye ndoto.
target_text_raw: Kisha kifo cha Herode malaika wa bwana alimutokea Yosefu kwenye ndoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est trop sympa, ce mec !
target_text: Yeye ni mkarimu, uyu jamaa!
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mkarimu, uyu jamaa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai l'impression d'être dans un rêve.
target_text: Minawazia kama niko nalota.
target_text_raw: Minawazia kama niko nalota.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais te poser une question mais si le moment n'est pas propice, je peux revenir à un autre moment.
target_text: Ningependa kukuuliza swali lakini kama siyo wakati muzuri kwako, minaweza rudia wakati ingine.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kukuuliza swali lakini kama siyo wakati muzuri kwako, minaweza rudia wakati ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne vous inquiétez pas pour Luca.
target_text: Hauna wasiwasi juu ya Luca.
target_text_raw: Hauna wasiwasi juu ya Luca.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enfin nous nous rencontrons ! J'ai longtemps attendu ce moment.
target_text: Tunakutanana maraba! Nilichunga iyi wakati kwa muda murefu.
target_text_raw: Tunakutanana maraba! Nilichunga iyi wakati kwa muda murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette route ramène au théâtre.
target_text: Iyi barabara inaelekea kwenye salle ya michezo ya kuigiza.
target_text_raw: Iyi barabara inaelekea kwenye salle ya michezo ya kuigiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est quelque chose qui ressemble à une balle.
target_text: Ni kitu yenye inafanana lisasi.
target_text_raw: Ni kitu yenye inafanana lisasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je devrais rentrer à la maison avant que mes parents ne commencent à s'inquiéter.
target_text: Ningelipashwa rudia ku nyumba kabla wazazi wangu hawakuwa na wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Ningelipashwa rudia ku nyumba kabla wazazi wangu hawakuwa na wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La marée ne laissait aux gens se promenant sur la plage qu’une étroite bande de sable sur laquelle ils pouvaient marcher sans se mouiller les pieds.
target_text: Wimbi iliruhusu batu benye balikuwa najitembeze ku plage lungu ya mchanga tu kidogo ambayo wangeweza tembelea ako bila kulowana migulu.
target_text_raw: Wimbi iliruhusu batu benye balikuwa najitembeze ku plage lungu ya mchanga tu kidogo ambayo wangeweza tembelea ako bila kulowana migulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police a facilement découvert le corps de la victime sur la plage.
target_text: Polisi ilivumbuwa mwili ya mtu ya muhanga ku plage.
target_text_raw: Polisi ilivumbuwa mwili ya mtu ya muhanga ku plage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut réaliser plus de travaux de recherche pour savoir si ces services sont accessibles à la majorité et de quelle manière.
target_text: Inafaa kutimiza kazi miingi zaidi za utafiti juu ya kujua kama idadi kubwa ya batu inapataka izi huduma na kwa njia gani.
target_text_raw: Inafaa kutimiza kazi miingi zaidi za utafiti juu ya kujua kama idadi kubwa ya batu inapataka izi huduma na kwa njia gani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu pars maintenant, tu vas certainement te retrouver dans les embouteillages.
target_text: Ukiondoka sasa, hakika utajikutana mu embouteillage ya ma gari.
target_text_raw: Ukiondoka sasa, hakika utajikutana mu embouteillage ya ma gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aurais pas chanté cette chanson si j'avais su que cela ferait pleurer Noah.
target_text: Singeimba ile nyimbo ningejua kama ingelimlilisha Noah.
target_text_raw: Singeimba ile nyimbo ningejua kama ingelimlilisha Noah.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parlons sérieusement.
target_text: Tuzungumuze kwa makini.
target_text_raw: Tuzungumuze kwa makini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est quoi tout ce bordel ?
target_text: Ni nini iyi virugu?
target_text_raw: Ni nini iyi virugu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enchanté.
target_text: Minafurahi kukutanana na weye.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi kukutanana na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne suffit pas de vaincre les ennemis du dehors, il faut encore exterminer les ennemis du dedans.
target_text: Haitoshi kushinda maadui kutoka inje, inafaa pia kumaliza maadui wa ndani.
target_text_raw: Haitoshi kushinda maadui kutoka inje, inafaa pia kumaliza maadui wa ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les bobos ne sont tolérables que lorsqu'ils sont stériles : leurs gosses sont trop pourris.
target_text: Matajari wanavumiliaka tu wakati hanana uzazi: watoto wao wanakuwaka na tabia mbaya sana.
target_text_raw: Matajari wanavumiliaka tu wakati hanana uzazi: watoto wao wanakuwaka na tabia mbaya sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ethan a volé le téléphone de Marie et a pris un tas de selfies avant de le remettre en douce dans son sac à main.
target_text: Ethan aliiba telefone ya Marie na kukamata ma selfies mbele ya kuirudisha kisirisiri mu sac à main yake.
target_text_raw: Ethan aliiba telefone ya Marie na kukamata ma selfies mbele ya kuirudisha kisirisiri mu sac à main yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous croyez aux fantômes ?
target_text: Unaamini kama mizumu inakuwaka?
target_text_raw: Unaamini kama mizumu inakuwaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez ici jusqu'à ce qu'il revienne.
target_text: Chunga hapa mpaka saa anarudia.
target_text_raw: Chunga hapa mpaka saa anarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai su directement que mon entêtement n'était pas près de s'achever.
target_text: Nilipita naanza jua kama bukaramusi yangu haikukuwa karibu ya kuisha.
target_text_raw: Nilipita naanza jua kama bukaramusi yangu haikukuwa karibu ya kuisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voyez un paquet abandonné, n'hésitez pas à nous le signaler.
target_text: Ukiona fulushi iliyo achwa, usisite kutujulisha.
target_text_raw: Ukiona fulushi iliyo achwa, usisite kutujulisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un dieu tout puissant pourrait-il créer une pierre qu'il ne pourrait pas lui-même soulever ensuite ?
target_text: Je! Mungu mwenye nguvu anaweza kuumba jiwe ambalo yepeke hangeweza kunyangula?
target_text_raw: Je! Mungu mwenye nguvu anaweza kuumba jiwe ambalo yepeke hangeweza kunyangula?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une enquête de police a été ouverte.
target_text: Uchunguzi ya polisi inafunguliwa.
target_text_raw: Uchunguzi ya polisi inafunguliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prédire, c'est dire ce qui va se passer, puis plus tard, expliquer pourquoi cela ne s'est pas passé.
target_text: Kutabiri ni kusema nini njo itatokea, kisha baadaye, kueleza ni sababu gani haikutokea.
target_text_raw: Kutabiri ni kusema nini njo itatokea, kisha baadaye, kueleza ni sababu gani haikutokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle sorte de personne ferait cette sorte de chose ?
target_text: Ni mtu wa aina gani njo anaweza fanya kitu kama iki?
target_text_raw: Ni mtu wa aina gani njo anaweza fanya kitu kama iki?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu retrouvé le parapluie que tu disais avoir perdu l'autre jour ?
target_text: Ulipata munvuli yenye ulikuwa nasema ulipoteza ile siku?
target_text_raw: Ulipata munvuli yenye ulikuwa nasema ulipoteza ile siku?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui paie le bal conduit la danse.
target_text: Mwenye analipa sherehe njo anaongozaka danse.
target_text_raw: Mwenye analipa sherehe njo anaongozaka danse.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voulons faire un simple changement.
target_text: Tunataka fanya mabadiliko kidogo.
target_text_raw: Tunataka fanya mabadiliko kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez suivre son conseil.
target_text: Unapashwa fata ushauri wake.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa fata ushauri wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai prêté de l'argent à mon pote.
target_text: Nilikopesha rafiki yangu pesa.
target_text_raw: Nilikopesha rafiki yangu pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne parviens pas à exprimer ce que je ressens.
target_text: Siwezi kuelezea kile ninacho sikia.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kuelezea kile ninacho sikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a enfin montré sa vraie nature.
target_text: Alionesha sasa sura yake ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Alionesha sasa sura yake ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans ma hâte de quitter le bureau, j'ai oublié d'éteindre les lumières.
target_text: Nilipokuwa natoka mu bureau kwa haraka, nilisahabu kuzimisha matala.
target_text_raw: Nilipokuwa natoka mu bureau kwa haraka, nilisahabu kuzimisha matala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allô ?
target_text: Allo?
target_text_raw: Allo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne donnez pas plus d'argent à un enfant qu'il ne lui est nécessaire.
target_text: Usimupe mtoto pesa zaidi ya zile anazohitaji.
target_text_raw: Usimupe mtoto pesa zaidi ya zile anazohitaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons trouvé des traces de pas sur le sable.
target_text: Tulipata alama za migulu ku muchanga.
target_text_raw: Tulipata alama za migulu ku muchanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amour donne de l'esprit aux gens bêtes. C'est sans doute celui qu'il enlève aux gens d'esprit.
target_text: Upendo inapatiaka watu wajinga roho Bila shaka ni ule anaye tiya watu mu wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Upendo inapatiaka watu wajinga roho Bila shaka ni ule anaye tiya watu mu wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu regardes une belle rose.
target_text: Unaangalia liua nzuri.
target_text_raw: Unaangalia liua nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonjour. C'est Joe Carlton. Puis-je parler à Michael ?
target_text: Jambo. Ni Joe Carlton. Naweza ongea na Michael, tafazali?
target_text_raw: Jambo. Ni Joe Carlton. Naweza ongea na Michael, tafazali?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce sont eux qui ont survécu, même si l'immeuble a été détruit.
target_text: Ni hao njo waliyo pona, ingawa nyumba iliharibika.
target_text_raw: Ni hao njo waliyo pona, ingawa nyumba iliharibika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dirige bien les chevaux.
target_text: Anaongoza farasi muzuri.
target_text_raw: Anaongoza farasi muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Deux et deux font toujours quatre ? » « Exact ! »
target_text: « Mbili na mbili ni ine siku zote? » « Ni kweli! »
target_text_raw: « Mbili na mbili ni ine siku zote? » « Ni kweli! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il disait que je n'avais pas le droit de nager là-bas.
target_text: Alikuwa nasema kama siruhusiwi kuogelea pale.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nasema kama siruhusiwi kuogelea pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Boston est une ville fantastique.
target_text: Boston ni mji muzuri.
target_text_raw: Boston ni mji muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est triste que tu ne sois pas venue.
target_text: Inasikitisha kuona haukukuya.
target_text_raw: Inasikitisha kuona haukukuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si un homme tue un tigre, on dit que c'est du sport. Si un tigre tue un homme, on dit que c'est de la sauvagerie.
target_text: Kama mtu anauwa tigre, wanasemeka ni sport. Kama tigre inauwa mtu, wanasemaka ni ukali wa kinyama.
target_text_raw: Kama mtu anauwa tigre, wanasemeka ni sport. Kama tigre inauwa mtu, wanasemaka ni ukali wa kinyama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jim et David appartiennent à cette association.
target_text: Jim na David ni wanamemba wa iyi chama.
target_text_raw: Jim na David ni wanamemba wa iyi chama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un robot tueur est une arme autonome.
target_text: Robot muaji ni silaha yenye kujitegemea.
target_text_raw: Robot muaji ni silaha yenye kujitegemea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu viens de me faire manquer le coup parfait quand tu as crié.
target_text: Unatuma minakosa bahati ya muzuri wakati ulilalamika.
target_text_raw: Unatuma minakosa bahati ya muzuri wakati ulilalamika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Roger Duflair faisait sérieusement son enquête.
target_text: Roger Duflair alikuwa nafanya uchunguzi wake vizuri.
target_text_raw: Roger Duflair alikuwa nafanya uchunguzi wake vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Paradis et l’Enfer n’existent que dans le cœur des gens.
target_text: Mbingu na Kuzimu zinapatikana tu katika roho za watu.
target_text_raw: Mbingu na Kuzimu zinapatikana tu katika roho za watu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne restez pas planté là ! Aidez-moi à le nettoyer !
target_text: Usibakie nashimama pale! Nisaidie kuisukula!
target_text_raw: Usibakie nashimama pale! Nisaidie kuisukula!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme les avis sont partagés, Tom lance l’idée d’un référendum sur le projet d’aéroport.
target_text: Kwa kuwa maoni iligawanyika, Tom alileta wazo ya kupiga kura kuhusu muradi wa uwanja ya ndege.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa maoni iligawanyika, Tom alileta wazo ya kupiga kura kuhusu muradi wa uwanja ya ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Douce poésie ! Le plus beau des arts ! Toi qui, suscitant en nous le pouvoir créateur, nous met tout proches de la divinité.
target_text: Poésie nzuri!. Sanaa za muzuri zaidi! Weye ambaye, unalamusha ndani yetu nguvu ya uumbaji, unatuweka karibu sana na umungu.
target_text_raw: Poésie nzuri!. Sanaa za muzuri zaidi! Weye ambaye, unalamusha ndani yetu nguvu ya uumbaji, unatuweka karibu sana na umungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous faisons justement des plans pour les vacances.
target_text: Tuko napanga tu kuhusu likizo.
target_text_raw: Tuko napanga tu kuhusu likizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À la plage, le gamin aime jouer avec le sable.
target_text: Ku plage, mtoto anapendaka kucheza na muchanga.
target_text_raw: Ku plage, mtoto anapendaka kucheza na muchanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que Mike appartient au cercle des nageurs ?
target_text: Mike anapatikana kwenye kundi ya waogeleaji?
target_text_raw: Mike anapatikana kwenye kundi ya waogeleaji?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous citer les situations dans lesquelles un supérieur doit donner un ordre direct ?
target_text: Unaweza taja hali ambazo mkubwa kicheo anapashwa toa agizo ya moja kwa moja?
target_text_raw: Unaweza taja hali ambazo mkubwa kicheo anapashwa toa agizo ya moja kwa moja?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis resté debout jusqu'à tard hier soir.
target_text: Nilibakia nashimama mpaka nyuma mangaribi ya jana.
target_text_raw: Nilibakia nashimama mpaka nyuma mangaribi ya jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne pourrez pas passer en revue le livre aussi vite.
target_text: Hautaweza kusoma iyi kitabu kwa haraka sana .
target_text_raw: Hautaweza kusoma iyi kitabu kwa haraka sana .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon opinion est totalement différente de la vôtre.
target_text: Maoni yangu ni tafauti kabisa na yako.
target_text_raw: Maoni yangu ni tafauti kabisa na yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus tard, son humeur s'est pourtant visiblement détendue.
target_text: Baadaye , hali yake ilionekana kuwa sawa.
target_text_raw: Baadaye , hali yake ilionekana kuwa sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette voiture est celle de Brian.
target_text: Iyi gari ni ya Brian.
target_text_raw: Iyi gari ni ya Brian.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les secouristes sont arrivés deux heures trop tard.
target_text: Waokoaji walifika muda ya saa mbili walisha chelewa.
target_text_raw: Waokoaji walifika muda ya saa mbili walisha chelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Assure-toi de prendre le bus nº2, et descends à la 21e rue.
target_text: Hakikisha ku kamata bus n°2, na ushukie ku barabara ya 21.
target_text_raw: Hakikisha ku kamata bus n°2, na ushukie ku barabara ya 21.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai appelé mes chats Mathéo et Jerry.
target_text: Niliita pusi zangu Mathéo na Jerry.
target_text_raw: Niliita pusi zangu Mathéo na Jerry.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je répète, n'arrivez pas en retard !
target_text: Narudilia, usifike nyuma!
target_text_raw: Narudilia, usifike nyuma!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puisque vous êtes fatigué, vous devriez vous reposer.
target_text: Kwa kuwa unachoka, unapashwa pumuzika.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa unachoka, unapashwa pumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Scott était contemporain de Byron.
target_text: Scott alikuwa wa wakati mmoja na Byron.
target_text_raw: Scott alikuwa wa wakati mmoja na Byron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui lit ce rapport obtient toutes les affirmations nécessaires pour pouvoir contrôler les faits lui-même.
target_text: Yeyote anayesoma iyi ripoti anapata madai yote ya muhimu kwa kuweza kuchunguza ukweli yepeke.
target_text_raw: Yeyote anayesoma iyi ripoti anapata madai yote ya muhimu kwa kuweza kuchunguza ukweli yepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les mathématiciens sont des artistes créatifs, leurs œuvres étant des échafaudages élaborés d'idées et des preuves esthétiques.
target_text: Wa mathématiciens ni wasanii wabunifu, kazi zao zikiwa ni njia zenye kuyala mawazo na uzibitisho wa kupendeza.
target_text_raw: Wa mathématiciens (wataalamu wa hesabu) ni wasanii wabunifu, kazi zao zikiwa ni njia zenye kuyala mawazo na uzibitisho wa kupendeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'était pas nécessaire que tu demandes.
target_text: Haikukuwa muhimu uulize.
target_text_raw: Haikukuwa muhimu uulize.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon contrat couvre les appels illimités vers les lignes fixes, mais pas vers les mobiles.
target_text: Mkataba yangu inagaramia appels za telefone zisizo kuwa na mwisho kwenda lignes fixe, lakini hapana kwenda simu za mkono.
target_text_raw: Mkataba yangu inagaramia appels za telefone zisizo kuwa na mwisho kwenda lignes fixe, lakini hapana kwenda simu za mkono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me rappelles ton père.
target_text: Unanikumbusha baba yako.
target_text_raw: Unanikumbusha baba yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En fouillant précipitamment, il a bouleversé tous mes dossiers.
target_text: Kwa tafutisha haraka haraka, alisambaraza dossiers zangu zote.
target_text_raw: Kwa tafutisha haraka haraka, alisambaraza dossiers zangu zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ravie que vous ayez soulevé cela.
target_text: Minafurahi kuona ulinyangula hiyo.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi kuona ulinyangula hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'officiel prussien veut des rapports avec Boule de Suif, mais elle ne veut pas coucher avec lui et les personnes avec elle ne partent pas.
target_text: Afisa wa Prusse anataka uhusiano na Boule de Suif, lakini hataki kulala naye na watu wenye wako naye hawaondoke.
target_text_raw: Afisa wa Prusse anataka uhusiano na Boule de Suif, lakini hataki kulala naye na watu wenye wako naye hawaondoke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans quelle sorte de ranch as-tu grandi ?
target_text: Ulikomaliaka mu haina gani ya shamba?
target_text_raw: Ulikomaliaka mu haina gani ya shamba?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fille du nom de Kate est passée pour te voir.
target_text: Binti anayeitwa Kate alikuya kukuona.
target_text_raw: Binti anayeitwa Kate alikuya kukuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il prenait soin de ne rien laisser paraître.
target_text: Alikuwa nafanya gisi yote chochote kisionekane.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nafanya gisi yote chochote kisionekane.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que chacun de vous prenne un morceau de papier et écrive ce qui s'est passé.
target_text: Nataka kila mumoja wenu akamate kipande ya kartasi na aandike kile kilichotokea.
target_text_raw: Nataka kila mumoja wenu akamate kipande ya kartasi na aandike kile kilichotokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un guépard qui est pressé peut atteindre une vitesse de cent-vingt kilomètres heure.
target_text: Munyama guépard ambayo iko mu haraka inaweza kufikia mbio ya kilomita 120 kwa saa.
target_text_raw: Munyama guépard ambayo iko mu haraka inaweza kufikia mbio (vitesse) ya kilomita 120 kwa saa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’équipe retourne aux vestiaires pour les quinze minutes de pause réglementaire.
target_text: Timu inarudia kwenye chumba cha kubadilishia manguo kwa mapumuziko ya dakika 15.
target_text_raw: Timu inarudia kwenye chumba cha kubadilishia manguo kwa mapumuziko ya dakika 15.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La folie est quelque chose de rare chez les individus, mais dans les groupes, les partis, les peuples, les âges, c'est la norme.
target_text: Wazimu ni kitu isiyo ya kawaida kwa watu binafsi, lakini kwa vikundi, vyama vya kisiasa, watu, umri ni kawaida.
target_text_raw: Wazimu ni kitu isiyo ya kawaida kwa watu binafsi, lakini kwa vikundi, vyama vya kisiasa, watu, umri ni kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a merdé.
target_text: Aliaribisha.
target_text_raw: Aliaribisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Prince fut enlevé.
target_text: Mtoto wa mfalme alitekwa nyara.
target_text_raw: Mtoto wa mfalme alitekwa nyara.

target_text_raw: Waroma, murudie kwenyu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo est monté à bord.
target_text: Hugo alipanda ndani.
target_text_raw: Hugo alipanda ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne nous fourvoyons pas dans la pensée magique en supposant que ça produit des licornes.
target_text: Tusipoteze muda kwa kuingia ndani yamawazo ya maggie na kuwazia kama inazalaka ma cheval.
target_text_raw: Tusipoteze muda kwa kuingia ndani yamawazo ya maggie na kuwazia kama inazalaka ma cheval.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu t’es trompé sur la date quand tu as rempli le chèque.
target_text: Ulijikoroga ku tarehe wakati ulijaza chèque.
target_text_raw: Ulijikoroga ku tarehe wakati ulijaza chèque.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pourrions sortir ensemble.
target_text: Tunaweza toka pamoja.
target_text_raw: Tunaweza toka pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Choisis un livre avec soin.
target_text: Chagua kitabu kwa uangalifu.
target_text_raw: Chagua kitabu kwa uangalifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'avait pas le droit de se taire.
target_text: Hakukuwa na haki ya kuikala kimya.
target_text_raw: Hakukuwa na haki ya kuikala kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me sens beaucoup mieux à présent, mais je sais que papa va être encore inquiet.
target_text: Minajisikia muzuri zaidi sasa, lakini najua Baba atakuwa na wasiwasi tena.
target_text_raw: Minajisikia muzuri zaidi sasa, lakini najua Baba atakuwa na wasiwasi tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Bonjour, je voudrais un, euh...billet, c'est ça ?» « C'est exactement comme ça que ça s'appelle ! » « Je dois l'enfoncer dans le trou ? » « Oui, vous devez l'insérer dans l'appareil. » « Ah, super, merci ! »
target_text: « Jambo, ningependa nini moya, uh ... billet, njo hiyo?» « Ni ivo njoo inaitwa kweli! » « Minapashwa isindiria mu tundu?" » « Ndio, unapashwa iingiza ndani ya appareil. « Ah, ni muzuri, aksanti! »
target_text_raw: « Jambo, ningependa nini moya, uh ... billet, njo hiyo?» « Ni ivo njoo inaitwa kweli! » « Minapashwa isindiria mu tundu?" » « Ndio, unapashwa iingiza ndani ya appareil. « Ah, ni muzuri, aksanti! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je saute à la pire case de scénario.
target_text: Minaruka kwa hali mbaya zaidi.
target_text_raw: Minaruka kwa hali mbaya zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Même s'il a réussi son examen, son niveau de chinois oral n'est pas forcément aussi bon que le tien.
target_text: Hatakama aliweza mashindano yake, kiwango chake cha ki chinois ya kuongea haiko muzuri kuliko yako.
target_text_raw: Hatakama aliweza mashindano yake, kiwango chake cha ki chinois ya kuongea haiko muzuri kuliko yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es à Paris chez le juge d'instruction, comme un criminel on te met en état d'arrestation.
target_text: Huko Paris kwa jaji, kama muuaji wanakukamata.
target_text_raw: Huko Paris kwa jaji, kama muuaji wanakukamata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était totalement indifférent à nos cris pendant qu'il battait notre mère.
target_text: Alikuwa kabisa haangaiki na kelele zetu wakati alikuwa napiga mama yetu.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa kabisa haangaiki na kelele zetu wakati alikuwa napiga mama yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a de ces malades, je te jure !
target_text: Piko bagonjwa, minakwambia!
target_text_raw: Piko bagonjwa, minakwambia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Montez à bord s'il vous plait.
target_text: Ingia ndani tafazali.
target_text_raw: Ingia ndani tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a fait la promesse de rendre l'argent sans faute.
target_text: Alitoa ahadi ya kurudisha pesa bila shida.
target_text_raw: Alitoa ahadi ya kurudisha pesa bila shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Emma louche.
target_text: Emma siyo wa kuaminia.
target_text_raw: Emma siyo wa kuaminia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux m'empêcher d'avoir le sentiment que quelque chose cloche.
target_text: Minaendelea kusikia sawa piko kitu yenye haiendeki.
target_text_raw: Minaendelea kusikia sawa piko kitu yenye haiendeki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois remplir la pile de formulaires.
target_text: Ninapashwa kuyalisha lundo ya ma kartasi za kujaza.
target_text_raw: Ninapashwa kuyalisha lundo ya ma kartasi za kujaza (formulaires).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle fréquence le bus vient-il ?
target_text: Bisi inakuyaka mara ngapi?
target_text_raw: Bisi inakuyaka mara ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous aurons un test demain.
target_text: Tutakuwa na mutihani kesho.
target_text_raw: Tutakuwa na mutihani kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils emmènent Marie à la salle des urgences.
target_text: Wanapeleka Marie kwenye chumba cha kutunzia wagonjwa wanao tabanika sana.
target_text_raw: Wanapeleka Marie kwenye chumba cha kutunzia wagonjwa wanao tabanika sana (urgences).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils font pousser des oranges en Californie.
target_text: Wanaoteshaka ma oranges huko California.
target_text_raw: Wanaoteshaka ma oranges huko California.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous passé une chouette soirée ?
target_text: Ulipitisha mangaribi nzuri?
target_text_raw: Ulipitisha mangaribi nzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons filmé cette scène dans un camp d'entraînement des forces spéciales.
target_text: Tulipiga picha ya iyi onyesho ndani ya kambi ya mazoezi ya vikosi ya jeshi ya kipekee.
target_text_raw: Tulipiga picha ya iyi onyesho (scène) ndani ya kambi ya mazoezi ya vikosi ya jeshi ya kipekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortez de ce véhicule.
target_text: Toka mwa iyi gari.
target_text_raw: Toka mwa iyi gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le train voyage à la vitesse de 50 miles par heure.
target_text: Gari la moshi inasafiri kwa mwendo wa 50 miles kwa saa.
target_text_raw: Gari la moshi inasafiri kwa mwendo wa 50 miles kwa saa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo se sent triste.
target_text: Enzo anajisikia kuwa na huzuni.
target_text_raw: Enzo anajisikia kuwa na huzuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Surveille ta vitesse.
target_text: Chunguza vitesi yako.
target_text_raw: Chunguza vitesi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je déposai un baiser sur le front pâle de Marie, que les soins de sa nourrice commençaient à ranimer, et je m’enfuis précipitamment, de peur que son premier regard, sa première plainte, ne m’enlevassent toute ma force.
target_text: Niliweka bizu kwenye sura yenye uzuni ya Marie, ambayo utunzaji ya yaya wake ilianza kupatia nguvu, na nikakimbia haraka, kwa uoga kwamba kuniangalia kwake kwa mara ya kwanza, malalamiko yake ya kwanza, isinivunje nguvu zangu zote.
target_text_raw: Niliweka bizu kwenye sura yenye uzuni ya Marie, ambayo utunzaji ya yaya wake ilianza kupatia nguvu, na nikakimbia haraka, kwa uoga kwamba kuniangalia kwake kwa mara ya kwanza, malalamiko yake ya kwanza, isinivunje nguvu zangu zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'abandonne pas le combat !
target_text: Usikate tamaa!
target_text_raw: Usikate tamaa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux rien faire de risqué.
target_text: Sitaki kufanya chochote cha hatari.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kufanya chochote cha hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Seuls les gens qui ont raté leur vie connaissent les clés pour la réussir.
target_text: Watu walioharibisha maisha yao wenyewe wanajua fungulo yakuiboresha.
target_text_raw: Watu walioharibisha maisha yao wenyewe wanajua fungulo yakuiboresha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont remporté l'épreuve de quatre de couple sans barreur.
target_text: Walishinda mashindamano ya quatre couple bila barreur.
target_text_raw: Walishinda mashindamano ya quatre couple (kundi ya wasozaji wa ine wa ine) bila barreur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a joint le geste à la parole.
target_text: Aliambatisha vitendo na maneno.
target_text_raw: Aliambatisha vitendo na maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À peu près quatorze pour cent de tous les êtres humains ayant jusqu'à présent existé sont vivants aujourd'hui.
target_text: Karibu asilimia kumi na ine ya wanadamu wote ambao walishawahi kuishi wako wazima leo.
target_text_raw: Karibu asilimia kumi na ine ya wanadamu wote ambao walishawahi kuishi wako wazima leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fais gaffe ou tu vas abîmer la boîte de vitesse !
target_text: Fanya angalisho ao utaharibisha boite ya vtesse!
target_text_raw: Fanya angalisho ao utaharibisha boite ya vtesse!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée que les choses n'aient pas fonctionné.
target_text: Samahani kuona mambo haikuendeka.
target_text_raw: Samahani kuona mambo haikuendeka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'amuse en jouant aux jeux vidéos.
target_text: Anajifuraisha kwa kucheza michezo ya video.
target_text_raw: Anajifuraisha kwa kucheza michezo ya video.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que Ton est un fan de hockey.
target_text: Minajua kama Ton ni shabaki wa Hockey.
target_text_raw: Minajua kama Ton ni shabaki wa Hockey.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai cru que le cauchemar était fini.
target_text: Nilizani kama ndoto mbaya iliisha.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama ndoto mbaya iliisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tenez la barre au cas où.
target_text: Kamata barre ikiwa labda.
target_text_raw: Kamata barre ikiwa labda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment dis-tu « love » en français ?
target_text: Unasemaka aye « mapenzi » mu Kifaransa?
target_text_raw: Unasemaka aye « mapenzi » mu Kifaransa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a coiffé sainte Catherine.
target_text: Marie alitengeneza nywele za mtakatifu Catherine.
target_text_raw: Marie alitengeneza nywele za mtakatifu Catherine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quand remonte la dernière explosion ?
target_text: Muripuko ya mwisho ilikuwa wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Muripuko ya mwisho ilikuwa wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'Etat algérien est dictatorial.
target_text: Serkali ya Algeria ni ya kidikteta.
target_text_raw: Serkali ya Algeria ni ya kidikteta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun a ses lunettes ; mais personne ne sait au juste de quelle couleur en son les verres.
target_text: Kila mtu iko na lineti zake; lakini hakuna mwenye anajua rangi ya kio.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu iko na lineti zake; lakini hakuna mwenye anajua rangi ya kio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont un droit absolu d'avoir leur foyer national.
target_text: Wapalestina biko na haki kamili ya kuwa na nyumba yao ya kitaifa.
target_text_raw: Wapalestina biko na haki kamili ya kuwa na nyumba yao ya kitaifa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun de nous porte un uniforme scolaire.
target_text: Kila mumoja wetu anavala nguo zaku masomo.
target_text_raw: Kila mumoja wetu anavala nguo zaku masomo (uniforme).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si le colis n'arrive pas d'ici trois jours, je me verrai forcé d'annuler ma commande.
target_text: Kama ile fulushi haifike mwa iyi siku tatu, nitaniomba ni annuler byenye nilitumanisha.
target_text_raw: Kama ile fulushi haifike mwa iyi siku tatu, nitaniomba ni annuler byenye nilitumanisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'existe aucune raison pour que je continue une conversation dans laquelle je me sens trompé.
target_text: Sina ata sababu moya ya kuendelea na mazungumzo ambamo minajisikia kudanganyiwa.
target_text_raw: Sina ata sababu moya ya kuendelea na mazungumzo ambamo minajisikia kudanganyiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est descendu à l’aide d’une corde jusqu’au fond du puits.
target_text: Alitumikisha kamba kwa kushuka ndani ya kisima.
target_text_raw: Alitumikisha kamba kwa kushuka ndani ya kisima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon mari est à une conférence. Vous voulez prendre un café ?
target_text: Mume wangu iko kwenye mkutano. Ungependa kunywa kahawa?
target_text_raw: Mume wangu iko kwenye mkutano. Ungependa kunywa kahawa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Répondez tout de suite, lui reconnut cette façon de faire quand il sera bon de connaître et, même dans ces moments de silence, me font moins mal.
target_text: Jibia sai sai, yeye alitambua iyi namna ya kufanya wakati itakuwa vizuri kujua na, hata katika iyi wakati ya ukimya, haitaniumiza sana.
target_text_raw: Jibia sai sai, yeye alitambua iyi namna ya kufanya wakati itakuwa vizuri kujua na, hata katika iyi wakati ya ukimya, haitaniumiza sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que tu racontes comme bêtises ?
target_text: Unaongea upuuzi?
target_text_raw: Unaongea upuuzi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Helen, lui c'est mon cousin.
target_text: Helen, ni binamu yangu.
target_text_raw: Helen, ni binamu yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que c'est ce que Ethan aurait voulu.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama iyo njo yenye Ethan angetaka.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama iyo njo yenye Ethan angetaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une des habitudes des employés est de se retrouver presque chaque jour dans un bar ou un restaurant, à la fin de la journée de travail, pour se saouler et oublier leur vie misérable jusqu'au jour suivant.
target_text: Moja ya tabia ya wafanyikazi ni kukutanana kila siku mu bar ao mu restaurant, ku mwisho ya siku ya kazi, kulewa na kusahau maisha yao ya ukosefu mpaka siku inayofuata.
target_text_raw: Moja ya tabia ya wafanyikazi ni kukutanana kila siku mu bar (kilabu ya pombe) ao mu restaurant, ku mwisho ya siku ya kazi, kulewa na kusahau maisha yao ya ukosefu mpaka siku inayofuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le faux dieu auquel croient les colons est un dieu tribal et raciste qui n'existe que pour que ces colons justifient leurs crimes contre les autochtones.
target_text: Mungu wa bongo mwenye wakoloni wanaamini ni mungu wa ukabila na wa ubaguzi ya rangi ambaye anasaidia tu hawa wakoloni kutetea mauwaji yao ndani ya jamii za wakaaji wa kwanza.
target_text_raw: Mungu wa bongo mwenye wakoloni wanaamini ni mungu wa ukabila na wa ubaguzi ya rangi ambaye anasaidia tu hawa wakoloni kutetea mauwaji yao ndani ya jamii za wakaaji wa kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reçois des mails de publicité pour de la crème solaire, ça sent les vacances !
target_text: Niko napokea barua za kielektroniki za matangazo juu ya mafuta ya kujipakala kwa kujikinga na mishale ya jua, inanuka kama likizo!
target_text_raw: Niko napokea barua za kielektroniki za matangazo juu ya mafuta ya kujipakala kwa kujikinga na mishale ya jua, inanuka kama likizo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon oncle est parti au Mexique en 1983 et n'est jamais revenu.
target_text: Muyomba yangu aliendaka Mexique mnamo mwaka 1983 na hakurudiaka tena.
target_text_raw: Muyomba yangu aliendaka Mexique mnamo mwaka 1983 na hakurudiaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Excusez moi.
target_text: Samahani.
target_text_raw: Samahani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle sorte d'entraînement as-tu reçu ?
target_text: Ulipokea mafunzo ya aina gani?
target_text_raw: Ulipokea mafunzo ya aina gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le même principe ! Cela repose sur les mêmes lois physiques.
target_text: Ni ile ile kanuni! Iyo inategemea na sheria zile za asili.
target_text_raw: Ni ile ile kanuni! Iyo inategemea na sheria zile za asili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon rêve est de devenir un très bon joueur de mahjong.
target_text: Ndoto yangu ni kuwa mchezaji muzuri sana wa mahjong.
target_text_raw: Ndoto yangu ni kuwa mchezaji muzuri sana wa mahjong.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se plaint toujours de son traitement médical.
target_text: Analalamika kila mara kuhusu matibabu yake.
target_text_raw: Analalamika kila mara kuhusu matibabu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a un droit sur la propriété de son défunt mari.
target_text: Iko na haki ku mali ya mume wake marehemu.
target_text_raw: Iko na haki ku mali ya mume wake marehemu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est carrément de la balle !
target_text: Ni lisasi kabisa!
target_text_raw: Ni lisasi kabisa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois admettre que c'était de ma faute.
target_text: Minapashwa kubali kama ilikuwa kosa yangu.
target_text_raw: Minapashwa kubali kama ilikuwa kosa yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le progrès matériel ne satisfait aucun des besoins que l'homme a vraiment.
target_text: Kwa kweli maendeleo ya vifaa haitosheleyi mahitaji yoyote ya mwanadamu.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli maendeleo ya vifaa haitosheleyi mahitaji yoyote ya mwanadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Ils sont partis, sans doute ; et, sous d'autres auspices, / bientôt accompagnés de leurs dieux plus propices, / vous les verrez soudain reparaître à vos yeux ; / ainsi s'est expliqué l'interprète des dieux. "
target_text: "Walishaenda, bila shaka; na, kwa alama zingine, / mu siku zijazo wakisindikizwa na miungu yao inayo wasaidia zaidi, / ghafla utawaona wanatokea mbele ya macho yako; / ivi njo mutafsiri wa miungu ilieleza. "
target_text_raw: "Walishaenda, bila shaka; na, kwa alama zingine, / mu siku zijazo wakisindikizwa na miungu yao inayo wasaidia zaidi, / ghafla utawaona wanatokea mbele ya macho yako; / ivi njo mutafsiri wa miungu ilieleza. "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vous interroger au sujet d'un de vos étudiants.
target_text: Ningependa kukuuliza kuhusu mumoja wa wanafunzi wako.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kukuuliza kuhusu mumoja wa wanafunzi wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez la sauce séparément s'il vous plait.
target_text: Weka supu pembeni, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Weka supu pembeni, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de minutes dure la séance de massage ?
target_text: Kikao ya massage inafanyaka dakika ngapi?
target_text_raw: Kikao ya massage inafanyaka dakika ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce roman m'ennuie.
target_text: Iyi roman inaniletea uvivu.
target_text_raw: Iyi roman inaniletea uvivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laura dansait gracieusement.
target_text: Laura alikuwa nacheza muzuri na kwa adabu.
target_text_raw: Laura alikuwa nacheza muzuri na kwa adabu.
