source_text: Quel drôle de type que ton copain !
target_text: Rafiki yako ni mtu wakuchekesha!
target_text_raw: Rafiki yako ni mtu wakuchekesha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis profondément désolée si je vous ai méjugée.
target_text: Samahani sana kama nilikuwazia mubaya.
target_text_raw: Samahani sana kama nilikuwazia mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu m'aides à choisir un livre.
target_text: Minataka unisaidie kuchagua kitabu.
target_text_raw: Minataka unisaidie kuchagua kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le coup fût si grand que j'aurais juré avoir vu des étoiles.
target_text: Pigo ilikuwa kubwa sanakwa gisi ningeweza hakikisha kama niliona nyota.
target_text_raw: Pigo ilikuwa kubwa sanakwa gisi ningeweza hakikisha kama niliona nyota.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami a dépensé l'argent de son bus pour des bonbons.
target_text: Sami alitumikisha pesa zake za bisi kwa kuuza bonbon.
target_text_raw: Sami alitumikisha pesa zake za bisi kwa kuuza bonbon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai étudié la philosophie, le droit et la médecine.
target_text: Nilisoma filosofia, sheria na kinganga.
target_text_raw: Nilisoma filosofia, sheria na kinganga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles ont chargé Thomas de suivre l'affaire.
target_text: Walipatia Thomas jukumu ya kufuatilia kesi.
target_text_raw: Walipatia Thomas jukumu ya kufuatilia kesi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au Vietnam, le français est carrément en voie de disparition.
target_text: Huko Vietnam, Kifaransa iko mu njia ya kupotea kabisa.
target_text_raw: Huko Vietnam, Kifaransa iko mu njia ya kupotea kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Commencez à compter.
target_text: Anza kuhesabia.
target_text_raw: Anza kuhesabia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne semblez pas trop surprise.
target_text: Hauonekani kushangala sana.
target_text_raw: Hauonekani kushangala sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vos raisons sont meilleures que les miennes, c'est pourquoi je cède et je baisse pavillon.
target_text: Sababu zako ni bora kuliko zangu, ndio sababu minaacha na minakupatia sheria.
target_text_raw: Sababu zako ni bora kuliko zangu, ndio sababu minaacha na minakupatia sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère est restée éveillée très tard hier.
target_text: Mama yangu alilala nyuma sana jana.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu alilala nyuma sana jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourtant, lorsque je vis la situation à la gare, je commençai à regretter cette décision.
target_text: Ijapokuwa, wakati niliona hali ku kituo, nilianza kujutia iyi uamuzi.
target_text_raw: Ijapokuwa, wakati niliona hali ku kituo, nilianza kujutia iyi uamuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils sont en train de filer la laine.
target_text: Biko nasuka manyoa.
target_text_raw: Biko nasuka manyoa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après avoir rompu avec sa copine, il traîna en broyant du noir autour de la maison pendant tout un mois.
target_text: Kisha kuachana na rafiki yake wa kike, alibakia inje ya nyumba na manunguniko kwa mwezi muzima.
target_text_raw: Kisha kuachana na rafiki yake wa kike, alibakia inje ya nyumba na manunguniko kwa mwezi muzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le policier releva le numéro de la plaque minéralogique.
target_text: Polisi alikamata numero ya plaque ya gari.
target_text_raw: Polisi alikamata numero ya plaque ya gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On suppose que la personne qui conduisait la voiture en a perdu le contrôle ; le véhicule est passé par-dessus le bord de la falaise, est tombé dans l'abîme et a explosé.
target_text: Inasemekana kuwa mtu mwenye alikuwa natembeza gari alipoteza controle; gari ilipita yulu ya mulima, ikaanguka mu shimu na kuripuka.
target_text_raw: Inasemekana kuwa mtu mwenye alikuwa natembeza gari alipoteza controle; gari ilipita yulu ya mulima, ikaanguka mu shimu na kuripuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Contentez-vous juste d'être saine et sauve.
target_text: Rizika tu kuwa salama na mzima.
target_text_raw: Rizika tu kuwa salama na mzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parler avec un téléphone mobile dans un ascenseur bondé est le summum de la grossièreté.
target_text: Kuzungumuza kwenye simu ya mkono kwenye lifti iliyojaa watu ni urefu wa ukali.
target_text_raw: Kuzungumuza kwenye simu ya mkono kwenye lifti iliyojaa watu ni urefu wa ukali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas rater le bus.
target_text: Sitaki kukosa bisi.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kukosa bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quand remonte la dernière fois où vous êtes allés chasser ?
target_text: Mara yako ya mwisho kwenda kuwinda ilikuwa siku gani?
target_text_raw: Mara yako ya mwisho kwenda kuwinda ilikuwa siku gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'invite à m'accompagner dans cette aventure incroyable.
target_text: Nakualika unisindikize mwa iyi aventure isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Nakualika unisindikize mwa iyi aventure (safari) isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi quiconque voudrait manger du chou mariné ?
target_text: Juu ya nini hakuna mwenye anapenda kula chou ya kuchomewa?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini hakuna mwenye anapenda kula chou ya kuchomewa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce fracas me réveille : au faîte du palais / je cours, vole, et de loin prête une oreille avide.
target_text: Iyi fujo inanilamusha: yulu ya hekalu / minakimbia, minaruka, na kwa mbali minasikiliza kwa makini.
target_text_raw: Iyi fujo inanilamusha: yulu ya hekalu / minakimbia, minaruka, na kwa mbali minasikiliza kwa makini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dirait que tu essaies de te laisser pousser la barbe.
target_text: Iko sawa uko najaribu kukomalisha ndevu.
target_text_raw: Iko sawa uko najaribu kukomalisha ndevu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous pouviez choisir les gènes de votre enfant, le feriez-vous ?
target_text: Kama ungeweza chagula gènes za mtoto wako, ungefanya hivo!
target_text_raw: Kama ungeweza chagula gènes (chembe za urizi) za mtoto wako, ungefanya hivo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Ce serait lâche de faire demi-tour maintenant », dit le chef rebelle épuisé, en se grattant le menton, « nous devons poursuivre notre route jusqu'à son funeste terme. »
target_text: « Itakuwa haya kurudia nyuma kwa sasa », anasema kiongozi wa waasi aliyechoka, akiparua kindevu chake, « tunapashwa endelesha njia yetu mpaka mwisho wake mbaya. »
target_text_raw: « Itakuwa haya kurudia nyuma kwa sasa », anasema kiongozi wa waasi aliyechoka, akiparua kindevu chake, « tunapashwa endelesha njia yetu mpaka mwisho wake mbaya. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le combat était perdu d'avance.
target_text: Walikuwa walisha poteza mapambano.
target_text_raw: Walikuwa walisha poteza mapambano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plupart des jeunes adultes aiment sortir la nuit.
target_text: Vijana wengi wakubwa wanapendaka kutoka busiku.
target_text_raw: Vijana wengi wakubwa wanapendaka kutoka busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Élégant comme Céladon, agile comme Scaramouche, je vous préviens, cher Myrmidon, qu’à la fin de l’envoi, je touche !
target_text: Mwenye kupendeza kama Celadon, mwepesi kama Scaramouche, nakuonya, ndugu mpendwa Myrmidon, kwamba kisha kutuma, nitakugusa!
target_text_raw: Mwenye kupendeza kama Celadon, mwepesi kama Scaramouche, nakuonya, ndugu mpendwa Myrmidon, kwamba kisha kutuma, nitakugusa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les nations sont pareilles à une goutte d'eau qui tombe d'un seau, elles sont comme de la poussière sur une balance, et les îles comme une fine poussière qui s'envole.
target_text: Mataifa ni kama toni ya maji inayo mwangika kutoka mu mbegeti, zinakuwaka kama vumbi kwenye kipimo, na visiwa kama vumbi inayo ruka.
target_text_raw: Mataifa ni kama toni ya maji inayo mwangika kutoka mu mbegeti, zinakuwaka kama vumbi kwenye kipimo, na visiwa kama vumbi inayo ruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne touchez pas à ces verres.
target_text: Usiguse hizi verres.
target_text_raw: Usiguse hizi verres (bilauli).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une heure plus tard, sa fièvre était encore plus grande.
target_text: Saa moja baadaye, homa yake ilizidi kupanda sana.
target_text_raw: Saa moja baadaye, homa yake ilizidi kupanda sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'irais pas jusque là.
target_text: Sitaenda mpaka kule.
target_text_raw: Sitaenda mpaka kule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À cette époque il reprenait la moindre faute de prononciation que je faisais, ce qui était agaçant, surtout en public.
target_text: Wakati huo alikuwa narudilia makosa kidogo ya matamshi yenye nilikuwa nafanya, iyi ilikuwa nanikasirisha, hasa katikati ya wetu wengi.
target_text_raw: Wakati huo alikuwa narudilia makosa kidogo ya matamshi yenye nilikuwa nafanya, iyi ilikuwa nanikasirisha, hasa katikati ya wetu wengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis responsable de ce que je dis, non de ce que vous comprenez.
target_text: Minahusika na kile nilichosema na siyo kile unachoelewa.
target_text_raw: Minahusika na kile nilichosema na siyo kile unachoelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas allée à l'enterrement.
target_text: Sikuenda ku maziko.
target_text_raw: Sikuenda ku maziko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Angela n'est pas un ange.
target_text: Angela haiko malaika.
target_text_raw: Angela haiko malaika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca est un parfait inconnu pour moi.
target_text: Luca ni mgeni kabisa kwangu.
target_text_raw: Luca ni mgeni kabisa kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La discussion réveille l'objection et tout fini par le doute.
target_text: Majadiliano yanalamusha mapingano na yote yanaishia mashakani.
target_text_raw: Majadiliano yanalamusha mapingano na yote yanaishia mashakani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous feriez mieux d'y aller. Il se fait tard.
target_text: Ingekuwa muzuri uende. Ilishakuwa nyuma.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa muzuri uende. Ilishakuwa nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suggère que tu partes immédiatement.
target_text: Naomba uende sasa ivi.
target_text_raw: Naomba uende sasa ivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo ne voudra probablement pas le refaire.
target_text: Matheo hatapenda irudilia tena.
target_text_raw: Matheo hatapenda irudilia tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne partira pas avant que vous lui ayez fait une proposition raisonnable !
target_text: Hataondoka kabla hauyamupatia proposition inayofaa!
target_text_raw: Hataondoka kabla hauyamupatia proposition inayofaa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je rêve de revenir !
target_text: Minalota kurudia!
target_text_raw: Minalota kurudia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il prend la plupart des décisions importantes, sinon toutes, pour sa société.
target_text: Yeye anakamaka baazi ya uamuzi muhimu, kama sivyo, maamuzi yote ndani ya kampuni yake.
target_text_raw: Yeye anakamaka baazi ya uamuzi muhimu, kama sivyo, maamuzi yote ndani ya kampuni yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Travaillez à loisir, quelque ordre qui vous presse, et ne vous piquez point d'une folle vitesse.
target_text: Fanya kazi kwa raha yako, agizo yoyote inayo kuweka mu haraka, na usifanya kwa haraka mingi.
target_text_raw: Fanya kazi kwa raha yako, agizo yoyote inayo kuweka mu haraka, na usifanya kwa haraka mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sensible à ta présence ici.
target_text: Nashukuru kwa uwepo wako hapa.
target_text_raw: Nashukuru kwa uwepo wako hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les aléas de l'Histoire font que la langue des signes nord-américaine ressemble davantage à la langue des signes française qu'à la britannique.
target_text: Mabadiliko ya historia inafanya luga ya ishara ya Amerika Kaskazini kufafana kama luga ya ishara ya Ufaransa kuliko ya Uingereza.
target_text_raw: Mabadiliko ya historia inafanya luga ya ishara ya Amerika Kaskazini kufafana kama luga ya ishara ya Ufaransa kuliko ya Uingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne m'envoyez plus de messages.
target_text: Usinitumie tena ujumbe.
target_text_raw: Usinitumie tena ujumbe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo n'en parlera pas.
target_text: Enzo hatasema.
target_text_raw: Enzo hatasema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La récompense devrait me revenir !
target_text: Matabishi ingenirudilia.
target_text_raw: Matabishi ingenirudilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La chirurgie plastique seule ne vous rendra pas moins laid.
target_text: Chirurgie plastique peke yake haitakufanya usikuwe mubaya.
target_text_raw: Chirurgie plastique peke yake haitakufanya usikuwe mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demain soir à neuf heures, ça t’irait ?
target_text: Kesho saa tatu ya busiku, ni sawa kwako?
target_text_raw: Kesho saa tatu ya busiku, ni sawa kwako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est l'enfant terrible d'Hollywood.
target_text: Yeye ni mtoto mubaya wa Hollywood.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mtoto mubaya wa Hollywood.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis navré, je n'ai pas pu t'écrire plus tôt.
target_text: Samahani, sikuweza kukuandikia mapema.
target_text_raw: Samahani, sikuweza kukuandikia mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que pensez vous qu'elles feront ?
target_text: Unawaza watafanya nini ?
target_text_raw: Unawaza watafanya nini ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand est-ce que tu rentres à la maison ?
target_text: Utarudia sangapi nyumbani.
target_text_raw: Utarudia sangapi nyumbani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle vend un ancien chapeau.
target_text: Anauzisha kofia ya zamani.
target_text_raw: Anauzisha kofia ya zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne gaspille pas ta jeunesse, autrement tu le regretteras plus tard.
target_text: Usipoteze ujana wako, kama sivyo utajuta baadaye.
target_text_raw: Usipoteze ujana wako, kama sivyo utajuta baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'Office européen de lutte antifraude, connu sous l'acronyme français de l'OLAF, est responsable de la lutte contre la fraude contre l'UE.
target_text: Shirika ya umoja ya ulaya ya kupambana na fraude, inayojulikana kwa kifupi mu Kifaransa kama OLAF, inahusika kupambana.
target_text_raw: Shirika ya umoja ya ulaya ya kupambana na fraude, inayojulikana kwa kifupi mu Kifaransa kama OLAF, inahusika kupambana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un collier charmant.
target_text: Ni sheneti ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ni sheneti ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas d'opportunité en enfer.
target_text: Hakuna fursa kuzimu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna fursa kuzimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a été libéré sur parole après avoir servi onze années de sa peine.
target_text: Alifunguliwa ku neno baada ya kutumikia kifungo cha miaka kumi na moja cha hukumu yake.
target_text_raw: Alifunguliwa ku neno baada ya kutumikia kifungo cha miaka kumi na moja cha hukumu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ben j'ai pas grand-chose à me mettre sous la dent en allemand en ce moment.
target_text: Ok, sina chakula mingi ya kukula kwa sasa mu Kijeremani.
target_text_raw: Ok, sina chakula mingi ya kukula kwa sasa mu Kijeremani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'arrêtes pas de te tromper, bien sûr que tu peux être puni.
target_text: Hauchi kujidanganya, kwa kweli unaweza kuazibiwa.
target_text_raw: Hauchi kujidanganya, kwa kweli unaweza kuazibiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans une relation sexuelle, tromper quelqu'un consiste à avoir une relation sexuelle avec quelqu'un d'autre.
target_text: Katika uhusiano wa kimapenzi ya ngono, kudanganya mtu ni kufanya tendo la ndoa na mtu mwengine.
target_text_raw: Katika uhusiano wa kimapenzi ya ngono, kudanganya mtu ni kufanya tendo la ndoa na mtu mwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne posez aucun objet sur la console.
target_text: Usiweke kitu chochote ku console.
target_text_raw: Usiweke kitu chochote ku console.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu la bagarre.
target_text: Niliona mangonvi.
target_text_raw: Niliona mangonvi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La batte de baseball a été volée hier, tout comme les balles.
target_text: Batte ya baseball iliibwa jana, na mipira vile vile.
target_text_raw: Batte ya baseball iliibwa jana, na mipira vile vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voudrais m'être lié d'amitié avec eux.
target_text: Nilipenda nikuwe na burafiki nabo.
target_text_raw: Nilipenda nikuwe na burafiki nabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cuire par induction est simplement bien plus génial !
target_text: Kupiga par induction ni kitu kizuri sana!
target_text_raw: Kupiga par induction ni kitu kizuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des marques bleues et rouges sillonnaient la figure de la jeune fille.
target_text: Alama za bleu na mwekundu zilikuwa nayala sura ya ule binti.
target_text_raw: Alama za bleu na mwekundu zilikuwa nayala sura ya ule binti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce fut la panique totale.
target_text: Ilikuwa hofu kubwa kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa hofu kubwa kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes absolument sûrs ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kabisa?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je souhaiterais prendre rendez-vous avec le docteur King.
target_text: Ningependa nikamate rendez-vous na Dakitari King.
target_text_raw: Ningependa nikamate rendez-vous na Dakitari King.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bientôt sortira un nouveau film sur l'Inde dans les cinémas.
target_text: Mu siku zijazo filamu mpya kuhusu India itatoka ndani ya ma salles za sinema.
target_text_raw: Mu siku zijazo filamu mpya kuhusu India itatoka ndani ya ma salles za sinema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Personne peut croire un truc pareil. » « Hugo m’a bien cru, pourtant. »
target_text: « Hakuna mtu anaye weza kuamini jambo kama iyi. » « Hugo aliniamini, hata kama. »
target_text_raw: « Hakuna mtu anaye weza kuamini jambo kama iyi. » « Hugo aliniamini, hata kama. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Te voilà enfin promu à un poste digne de toi.
target_text: Sasa unapandishwa ku fasi yenye inakustahili.

source_text: Donald Trump, un homme politique de second plan, a gagné la présidence dans un étonnant renversement.

target_text_raw: Donald Trump, mwanasiasa wa mahali ya pili, alishinda uraisi katika mapinduzi ya kushangaza.

source_text: Je suis sûre que Louis vous a dit que je venais.

target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kuwa Louis alikuambia kama minakuya.

source_text: C'est quoi cette photo dans ton casier ?

target_text_raw: Picha gani hiyo ku kabati yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette soirée fut riche en émotions.
target_text: Iyi mangaribi ilikuwa muzuri sana ku ngambo ya hisia.
target_text_raw: Iyi mangaribi ilikuwa muzuri sana ku ngambo ya hisia.

source_text: Vous jouez très bien de la guitare.
target_text: Unapiga kitari vizuri sana.
target_text_raw: Unapiga kitari vizuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne voit jamais un seau d'eau sortir de cette maison.
target_text: Mbegeti ya maji haitokake mwa iyi nyumba ata siku moja.
target_text_raw: Mbegeti ya maji haitokake mwa iyi nyumba ata siku moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On peut facilement distinguer l'original de la copie.

target_text_raw: Mtu anaweza kutofautisha original na copie kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gœthe dit quelque part, dans son roman de Wilhelm Meister, «qu'un ouvrage d'imagination doit être parfait, ou ne doit pas exister». Si cette maxime sévère était suivie, combien peu d'ouvrages existeraient, à commencer par Wilhelm Meister lui-même.
target_text: Mu kitabu yake ya Wilhelm Meister, piko fasi kwenye Goethe anasema "kwamba kazi ya imagination inapashwa fanyika muzuri sana, ao haipashwi kuwa". Kama iyi shauri inafuatiliwa, ni bitabu ngapi bingekuwa, kuanzia ku Wilhelm Meister mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Mu kitabu yake ya Wilhelm Meister, piko fasi kwenye Goethe anasema "kwamba kazi ya imagination inapashwa fanyika muzuri sana, ao haipashwi kuwa". Kama iyi shauri inafuatiliwa, ni bitabu ngapi bingekuwa, kuanzia ku Wilhelm Meister mwenyewe.

source_text: Quel est votre sandwich préféré ?
target_text: Unapendaka aina gani ya Sandwich?
target_text_raw: Unapendaka aina gani ya Sandwich?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enfin tu arrives !
target_text: Unafika sasa!
target_text_raw: Unafika sasa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un élève a menacé un autre élève avec un couteau.
target_text: Mwanafunzi alitishia mwanafunzi mwengine kwa kisu.
target_text_raw: Mwanafunzi alitishia (menacer) mwanafunzi mwengine kwa kisu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est allée au stade.
target_text: Alienda uwanjani.
target_text_raw: Alienda uwanjani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continue de t'entraîner, Maxime.
target_text: Endelea kufanya mazoezi, Maxime.
target_text_raw: Endelea kufanya mazoezi, Maxime.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous retournez pas.
target_text: Usigeuke.
target_text_raw: Usigeuke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes potes.
target_text: Tuko marafiki.
target_text_raw: Tuko marafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après quelques brasses, je sortis de l'eau et m'assis sur le bord de la piscine.
target_text: Baada ya kuogelea na tumbu kwa muda fulani, nilitoka mu mayi na kuikala pembeni ya piscine.
target_text_raw: Baada ya kuogelea na tumbu kwa muda fulani, nilitoka mu mayi na kuikala pembeni ya piscine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous identifier l'homme qui utilise cette photo ?
target_text: Unaweza kutambua mtu anayetumia iyi picha?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kutambua mtu anayetumia iyi picha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toute personne a droit à la liberté personnelle.
target_text: Kila mtu iko na haki ya uhuru wa kibinafsi.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu iko na haki ya uhuru wa kibinafsi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous mariée ou célibataire ? Vivez-vous seule ou en couple ?
target_text: Ulisha owa ao hauyaowa? Unaishi peke yako ao en couple?
target_text_raw: Ulisha owa ao hauyaowa? Unaishi peke yako ao en couple?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo a fait un drôle de rêve la nuit dernière.

target_text_raw: Hugo alilota bya kuchekesha jana busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec son épaule il danse
target_text: Iko nacheza na libega.
target_text_raw: Iko nacheza na libega.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez ça hors de portée des enfants, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Weka iyi mbali na watoto, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Weka iyi mbali na watoto, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La petite fille fit un bisou au garçon qui venait de lui offrir une fleur.
target_text: Binti mdogo alibusu kijana mwanaume ambaye alikuwa namupatia maua .
target_text_raw: Binti mdogo alibusu kijana mwanaume (garçon) ambaye alikuwa namupatia maua .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le train roule à vingt miles à l'heure.
target_text: Gari la moshi inatembeaka ku miles makumi mbili kwa saa.
target_text_raw: Gari la moshi inatembeaka ku miles makumi mbili kwa saa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'accord, je pense que j'ai pigé.
target_text: Sawa, minawaza kama minaelewa.
target_text_raw: Sawa, minawaza kama minaelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne fus pas invitée à la cérémonie d'ouverture.
target_text: Sikualikwa kwenye sherehe ya ufunguzi.
target_text_raw: Sikualikwa kwenye sherehe ya ufunguzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour tromper un rival l'artifice est permis ; on peut tout employer contre ses ennemis.
target_text: Kwa kudanganya mpinzani, ufundi unaruhusiwa; unaweza kutumia kila kitu zidi ya adui zako.
target_text_raw: Kwa kudanganya mpinzani, ufundi unaruhusiwa; unaweza kutumia kila kitu zidi ya adui zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le tireur se révéla être fou.
target_text: Mupiga lisasi alihakikishiwa kuwa na bazimu.
target_text_raw: Mupiga lisasi alihakikishiwa kuwa na bazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux juste que vous me disiez pourquoi vous avez menti.
target_text: Nataka tu uniambie juu ya nini ulisema bongo.
target_text_raw: Nataka tu uniambie juu ya nini ulisema bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais ma pauvre, vous n'y pensez pas !
target_text: Lakini masikini mupendwa, hauifikirii!
target_text_raw: Lakini masikini mupendwa, hauifikirii!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mamie comprit comment utiliser la télécommande, mais oublia le lendemain.
target_text: Mamie alisikia gisi ya kutumikisha télécommande, lakini alisahabu siku iliyofuata.
target_text_raw: Mamie alisikia gisi ya kutumikisha télécommande, lakini alisahabu siku iliyofuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne supporte pas le lait.
target_text: Sipendaki maziwa ata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Sipendaki maziwa ata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te prie de descendre du canapé !
target_text: Nakuomba shuka ku kitanda!
target_text_raw: Nakuomba shuka ku kitanda!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu aimes vraiment Jeanne, tu devrais l'inviter à sortir.
target_text: Kama unapenda Jeanne kwa kweli, unapashwa kumwalika mutoke.
target_text_raw: Kama unapenda Jeanne kwa kweli, unapashwa kumwalika mutoke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez affronter la réalité.
target_text: Unapashwa kukabili mambo gisi iko.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kukabili mambo gisi iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun de nous acceptait le fait que le professeur connait l'anglais.
target_text: Kila mumoja wetu aliitika kama mwalimu anajua Kiingereza.
target_text_raw: Kila mumoja wetu aliitika kama mwalimu anajua Kiingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'auriez pas dû aller à la pêche aujourd'hui.

target_text_raw: Haupashwi kwenda kuvua leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez votre masque.
target_text: Weka mask yako.
target_text_raw: Weka mask yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'est pas aussi patiente que toi.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait un rêve extraordinaire.

target_text_raw: Nililota ndoto isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es à la fois très mignonne et très sympa.

target_text_raw: Uko murembo sana na muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le sort fut rompu et le porc se transforma de nouveau en homme.
target_text: Bulozi iliharibishwa na nguruwe ikageuka tena kuwa mtu.
target_text_raw: Bulozi iliharibishwa na nguruwe ikageuka tena kuwa mtu.

source_text: L'ennemi nous a retourné notre feu.

target_text_raw: Adui alirudisha moto yetu.

source_text: Allons chercher du champagne, il faut fêter ça !
target_text: Twende tutafute pombe ya champagne, lazima tusherehekee!
target_text_raw: Twende tutafute pombe ya champagne, lazima tusherehekee!

source_text: Son appréhension gêne considérablement son progrès.

target_text_raw: Hofu yake inazuia sana maendeleo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Uko mu shida wewote.

source_text: Elle a été la seule à ne pas être invitée à la soirée.

target_text_raw: Yepeke tu njo hakualikwa kwenye sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous dans le bloc d'appartements partagent la cuisine.

target_text_raw: Wote wenye kuishi mwa iyi gorofa wanapigiaka mu mafiga moya.

target_text: Kiwango ya juu ya petrole, jambo inayotokea kwenye théorie Hubbert, ndio wakati ambapo kiwango ya juu cha uchimbaji wa pétrole, kisha hapo, wanachunga kiwango ya uzalishaji ipunguke.
target_text_raw: Kiwango ya juu ya petrole, jambo inayotokea kwenye théorie Hubbert, ndio wakati ambapo kiwango ya juu cha uchimbaji wa pétrole, kisha hapo, wanachunga kiwango ya uzalishaji (production) ipunguke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Unaficha nini nyuma ya mugongo?

target_text_raw: Ukitaka kujua luga, kusoma luga kwa undani ni njia bora kwa kufikia iyi lengo.

target_text_raw: Plan wa kanisa kuu la Mtakatifu Marie de la Fleur ilifanywa na Filippo Brunelleschi.

target_text_raw: Jua ilimuchoma mugongo.

target_text_raw: Kamera yangu inaweza kamata za qualité ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un DJ de renom. Le milieu de la nuit, c'est son business.

target_text_raw: Yeye ni DJ anaye julikana sana. Katikati ya usiku, njoo shuruli yake.

target_text_raw: Inchi mingi zimesaini mkataba ya kusisitiza armes nucléaires.

target_text_raw: Utalala mchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Ilikuwa alarme ya bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien sûr, chéri !
target_text: Kweli, mpenzi!
target_text_raw: Kweli, mpenzi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ici que j'ai emmené ma petite amie lors de notre premier rencard.
target_text: Hapa njo kwenye nililetaka rafiki yangu wa kike ku rendez-vous yetu ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Hapa njo kwenye nililetaka rafiki yangu wa kike ku rendez-vous yetu ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'expliquerai plus en détail plus tard.

target_text_raw: Nitamupa mafasirio zaidi baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand nous avons démarré, notre groupe ne pouvait trouver que des petites salles dans de petites villes pour nous engager.
target_text: Wakati tulianza, kikundi yetu haingewezaka kupata salles za kidogo kidogo ndani ya miji midogo midogo ili tuanze kazi.
target_text_raw: Wakati tulianza, kikundi yetu haingewezaka kupata salles za kidogo kidogo ndani ya miji midogo midogo ili tuanze kazi.

source_text: Sinon va ouvrir les flancs du cheval, et en fait sortir les guerriers qu'il recelait.
target_text: Lakini wende ufungule kamba ya farasi, na utoshe inje wapiganaji wenye ilikuwa inafunga.
target_text_raw: Lakini wende ufungule kamba ya farasi, na utoshe inje wapiganaji wenye ilikuwa inafunga.

source_text: Je ne crois pas à la thérapie de groupe.
target_text: Siaminiaki uponyaji ya kikundi.
target_text_raw: Siaminiaki uponyaji ya kikundi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a fallu sortir de là.
target_text: Iliniomba nitoke pale.
target_text_raw: Iliniomba nitoke pale.

source_text: Une cérémonie a été organisée à l'hôtel pour la signature du contrat.
target_text: Karamu ilifanyika ku hotel kwa kusaini contrat.
target_text_raw: Karamu ilifanyika ku hotel kwa kusaini (ku signer) contrat.

source_text: Les soldats ont aligné les prisonniers ennemis contre le mur avant de les exécuter sommairement.
target_text: Maaskari walipanga wafungwa maadui ku kibambazi mbele ya kuwauwa wote pamoja.
target_text_raw: Maaskari walipanga wafungwa maadui ku kibambazi mbele ya kuwauwa wote pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est devenu naturel pour lui de parler français.
target_text: Ilishakuwa kawaida kwake kuongea Kifaransa.
target_text_raw: Ilishakuwa kawaida kwake kuongea Kifaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca essayait d'être drôle.

target_text_raw: Luca alikuwa anajaribu kuchekesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'assistante de direction, c'est elle.

target_text_raw: Musaidizi wa uongozi, ni yeye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne peut s'éloigner consciemment de quelque objet sans retourner la tête pour s'assurer que l'on s'éloigne.
target_text: Mutu hawezi enda mbali na kitu fulani bila kugeuza kichwa juu ahakikishe kama anaenda mbali kabisa.
target_text_raw: Mutu hawezi enda mbali na kitu fulani bila kugeuza kichwa juu ahakikishe kama anaenda mbali kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mesdames, Messieurs, je vous soutiens. Nous ferons certainement de cet événement un succès !
target_text: Wandugu wapenzi, minawaunga mkono. Tutafanya bila shaka iyi tukio ipate kufaulu!
target_text_raw: Wandugu wapenzi, minawaunga mkono. Tutafanya bila shaka iyi tukio ipate kufaulu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se repentait d'avoir trahi son pays au profit de l'ennemi.
target_text: Alikuwa anaungama kwa kusaliti inchi yake kwa faida ya adui.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anaungama kwa kusaliti inchi yake kwa faida ya adui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un courriel de confirmation sera ensuite envoyé.
target_text: Barua ya kuhakikisha itatumiwa.
target_text_raw: Barua ya kuhakikisha itatumiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il revient au juge de décider si un rapport demande une enquête de police.
target_text: Ni kazi ya jaji kuamua kama ripoti inaomba uchunguzi ya polisi.
target_text_raw: Ni kazi ya jaji (juge) kuamua kama ripoti inaomba uchunguzi ya polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'évolution, c'est de l'adaptation.
target_text: Maendeleo, ni kuzowea.
target_text_raw: Maendeleo, ni kuzowea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es un brave type.
target_text: Uko mutu wa juhudi.
target_text_raw: Uko mutu wa juhudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce là sérieusement ce que vous pensez ?
target_text: Ni kweli kabisa njo vile unawaza?
target_text_raw: Ni kweli kabisa njo vile unawaza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un traitement permettra de guérir la maladie.
target_text: Matunzo italeta uponyaji ya ugonjwa.
target_text_raw: Matunzo italeta uponyaji ya ugonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La route descend doucement.
target_text: Barabara inashuka pole pole.
target_text_raw: Barabara inashuka pole pole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça serait gâcher son talent.
target_text: Ingelikuwa kuharibu kipaji yake.
target_text_raw: Ingelikuwa kuharibu kipaji yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les officiers étaient suivis de nombreuses chanteuses et danseuses avec un orchestre.
target_text: Waongozi wa ibada walikuwa wanafuatiwa na waimbaji na wachezaji wengi na bendi moya ya wanamuziki.
target_text_raw: Waongozi wa ibada walikuwa wanafuatiwa na waimbaji na wachezaji wengi na bendi moya ya wanamuziki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne respecte pas toujours le code de la route.
target_text: Siheshimiaki sheria ya barabara.
target_text_raw: Siheshimiaki sheria ya barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit : de nos guerriers la réponse incertaine / aussitôt nous décèle. Instruit de son erreur, / il se tait et recule.
target_text: Alisema: wapinaganaji wetu jibu ya masito/ mara moja wanatuvumbua. Alifundishwa na kosa lake, / ananyamanza na anarudia nyuma.
target_text_raw: Alisema: wapinaganaji wetu jibu ya masito/ mara moja wanatuvumbua. Alifundishwa na kosa lake, / ananyamanza na anarudia nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est enfin venue.
target_text: Alifika maraba.
target_text_raw: Alifika maraba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Par ce comportement, elle s'est offerte à la critique, et s'expose à un terrible soupçon : pouvait-elle avoir assassiné son propre enfant ?
target_text: Kwa iyi tabia, alisababisha wamutete, na kufanya akuwe mutu wakushakia : angeweza kumuuwa mtoto wake?
target_text_raw: Kwa iyi tabia, alisababisha wamutete, na kufanya akuwe mutu wakushakia : angeweza kumuuwa mtoto wake?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les garçons ont soif.
target_text: Vijana wako na kiu.
target_text_raw: Vijana wako na kiu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton baiser est plus doux que le miel.
target_text: Bizu yako ni tamu kushindia asali.
target_text_raw: Bizu yako ni tamu kushindia asali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prêtre fit un sermon impressionnant. Il parla avec vigueur et enthousiasme. Il ne lui fallut guère de temps pour attirer la sympathie de sa paroisse.
target_text: Padiri alihubiri muzuri sana. Aliongea na nguvu na furaha. Haikumulomba muda murefu kwa kupendewa na wakristu wa parokya yake.
target_text_raw: Padiri alihubiri muzuri sana. Aliongea na nguvu na furaha. Haikumulomba muda murefu kwa kupendewa na wakristu wa parokya yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pars souvent en voyage organisé.
target_text: Minaendaka mara mingi mu safiri iliyo pangwa.
target_text_raw: Minaendaka mara mingi mu safiri iliyo pangwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je rassurai la pauvre Marie, et je me promis de veiller sans relâche sur elle, jusqu’au moment prochain où il me serait permis de la protéger encore de plus près.
target_text: Nilikuwa namutuliza Maria, na nilimuahidia kama nitamushurulikia bila kuchoka, mpaka siku zijazo amabazo nitaruhusiwa kumulinda tena kwa namna ya karibu.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa namutuliza Maria, na nilimuahidia kama nitamushurulikia bila kuchoka, mpaka siku zijazo amabazo nitaruhusiwa kumulinda tena kwa namna ya karibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce que tu passes ton temps à faire durant ton enfance, affecte le reste de ta vie.
target_text: Byenye unapitishaka muda uko nafanya mu utoto wako binakufuataka maisha yako yote.
target_text_raw: Byenye unapitishaka muda uko nafanya mu utoto wako binakufuataka maisha yako yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme est la seule créature qui refuse d'être ce qu'elle est.
target_text: Mwanadamu ni kiumbe pekee inayo katala kukuwa gisi iko.
target_text_raw: Mwanadamu ni kiumbe pekee inayo katala kukuwa gisi iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut remercier Tom : c’est lui qui a lancé l’idée, au départ.
target_text: Inaomba kumushukuru Tom : yeye njo alileta wazo, ku mwanzo.
target_text_raw: Inaomba kumushukuru Tom : yeye njo alileta wazo, ku mwanzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est marrant, l'élite nationale ne sort pas de la mixité sociale.
target_text: Ni huzuni, wasomi wa inchi wako wanazidi kuchangana na watu wengine ndani ya jamii.
target_text_raw: Ni huzuni, wasomi wa inchi wako wanazidi kuchangana na watu wengine ndani ya jamii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez simplement dans les environs quelques jours et vous en viendrez à adorer cet endroit.
target_text: Ubakie tu ndani ya iyi eneo kwa siku chache na mwisho utapapenda.
target_text_raw: Ubakie tu ndani ya iyi eneo kwa siku chache na mwisho utapapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne m'en sers pratiquement jamais.
target_text: Kwanza siitumikishaki hata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Kwanza siitumikishaki hata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez vraiment que je parte ?
target_text: Unapenda niende kabisa?
target_text_raw: Unapenda niende kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon est vraiment rompu à tous les tours.
target_text: Kijana anachoka mu ngambo zote kabisa.
target_text_raw: Kijana anachoka mu ngambo zote kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu faisais confiance à ton associé.
target_text: Ulikuwa unaaminia mushirika wako.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa unaaminia mushirika wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais tous vous souhaiter la bienvenue à bord.
target_text: Ningependa kuwatakia nyiyi wote ujio mwema.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kuwatakia nyiyi wote ujio mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan avait un parfait alibi.
target_text: Dan alikuwa na sababu ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Dan alikuwa na sababu ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me moque que notre équipe gagne ou pas.
target_text: Siangaike kama timu yetu inashinda ao hapana.
target_text_raw: Siangaike kama timu yetu inashinda ao hapana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a utilisé un langage qui représente la réalité.
target_text: Tulitumia masemi yenye inamaanisha ukweli.
target_text_raw: Tulitumia masemi yenye inamaanisha ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça ne marchera pas !
target_text: Habitaendeka!
target_text_raw: Habitaendeka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soleil tape et il n'y a pas d'ombre en vue.
target_text: Jua iko inapiga na hakuna hata kivuli.
target_text_raw: Jua iko inapiga na hakuna hata kivuli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vous poser une question mais si le moment n'est pas propice, je peux revenir à un autre moment.
target_text: Nilitaka niwaulize lakini kama wakati hairuhusu, ndaweza rudia saa ingine.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka niwaulize lakini kama wakati hairuhusu, ndaweza rudia saa ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous me rappelez votre père.
target_text: Unanikumbusha baba yako.
target_text_raw: Unanikumbusha baba yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyez avec joie, le roi des Anges qui vient de naître né de la Vierge Marie.
target_text: Angalia na furaha, mwami wa wamalaika ambaye anamaliza zaliwa na Bikira Maria.
target_text_raw: Angalia na furaha, mwami wa wamalaika ambaye anamaliza zaliwa na Bikira Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'hésite pas à se livrer à de nombreuses agaceries auprès des dames.
target_text: Haachake kujitia mu mauzi mingi ya wanawake.
target_text_raw: Haachake kujitia mu mauzi mingi ya wanawake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les femmes plus âgées donnent naissance plus tard.
target_text: Wanawake wenye miaka mingi wanazalaka nyuma.
target_text_raw: Wanawake wenye miaka mingi wanazalaka nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est souvent à ce moment de la soirée que les fêtes battaient son plein.
target_text: Mara mingi ni wakati ya mangaribi kama iyi njo sherehe zilikuwaka nayala batu.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi ni wakati ya mangaribi kama iyi njo sherehe zilikuwaka nayala batu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le discours de l'érudit vaut bien la peine d'être écouté.
target_text: Kauli ya mwenye hekima na busara ni muzuri isikiliwe.
target_text_raw: Kauli ya mwenye hekima na busara ni muzuri isikiliwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un nombre entier est naturel ssi il est supérieur ou égal à 0.
target_text: Numba isiyo kuwa na mkato ni ya kawadia kama iko juu ao sawa na 0.
target_text_raw: Numba isiyo kuwa na mkato ni ya kawadia kama iko juu ao sawa na 0.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a promis qu'il le ferait demain.
target_text: Alihadia kama ataifanya kesho.
target_text_raw: Alihadia kama ataifanya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle bande d'idiots !
target_text: Iyi ni kikundi ya watu wajinga?
target_text_raw: Iyi ni kikundi ya watu wajinga?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un jour il reçut une lettre anonyme, qui lui disait qu'Odette avait été la maîtresse d'innombrables hommes, de femmes, et qu'elle fréquentait les maisons de passe.
target_text: Siku moya alipata barua ya mtu asiye julikana, yenye ilikuwa inasema kama Odette alikuwa bibi ya wanaume wengi, ya wanawake, na alikuwaka anazowea kuingia mu ma nyumba za mbaraga.
target_text_raw: Siku moya alipata barua ya mtu asiye julikana, yenye ilikuwa inasema kama Odette alikuwa bibi (habala) ya wanaume wengi, ya wanawake, na alikuwaka anazowea kuingia mu ma nyumba za mbaraga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans ce genre de petits villages, tu deviens facilement victime des commérages des voisins.
target_text: Katika vijiji vidogo vya aina iyi, ni raisi ukuwe muhanga wa utetaji ya majirani.
target_text_raw: Katika vijiji vidogo vya aina iyi, ni raisi ukuwe muhanga wa utetaji ya majirani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon ordinateur fonctionne au poil, maintenant.
target_text: Ordinateur yangu inatumika muzuri kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Ordinateur (kompyuta) yangu inatumika muzuri kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai simplement voulu prendre aucun risque.
target_text: Sikupenda tu kujiweka mu hatari.
target_text_raw: Sikupenda tu kujiweka mu hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Par votre faute, j'ai des problèmes de tension.
target_text: Kwa kosa yako, minapata ugonjwa ya moyo.
target_text_raw: Kwa kosa yako, minapata ugonjwa ya moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pars immédiatement !
target_text: Wende sasa ivi!
target_text_raw: Wende sasa ivi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais qu'est-ce que c'est que ce bordel ?
target_text: Ni désordre gani iyi lakini?
target_text_raw: Ni désordre (vurugu) gani iyi lakini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le flic est dans une voiture.
target_text: Polisi iko ndani ya gari.
target_text_raw: Polisi iko ndani ya gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Seul celui qui est capable d'obéir pourra ensuite donner des ordres.
target_text: Ni mwenye anaweza kutii ndiye anaye weza kupana masharti baadaye.
target_text_raw: Ni mwenye anaweza kutii ndiye anaye weza kupana masharti baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'entreprise a répondu que les primes de départ des directeurs étaient en ligne avec les normes du secteur.
target_text: Kampuni ilijibia kama malipo za kwanza za viongozi zikuwa nalingana na kanuni za aina ya kazi.
target_text_raw: Kampuni ilijibia kama malipo (primes) za kwanza za viongozi zikuwa nalingana na kanuni za aina ya kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle fut surprise qu'il fût déjà si tard.
target_text: Alishituka kuona ilishakuwa nyuma kama ivi.
target_text_raw: Alishituka kuona ilishakuwa nyuma kama ivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fois, Christophe Colomb a combattu Cerbère, le chien à trois têtes gardien des enfers, armé de son seul chapeau.
target_text: Wakati moja, Christophe Colomb alipiganisha Cerbere, imbwa ya bichwa tatu mlinzi wa kuzimu, yenyi kuwa tu na silaha yake moja ya kofia.
target_text_raw: Wakati moja, Christophe Colomb alipiganisha Cerbere, imbwa ya bichwa tatu mlinzi wa kuzimu, yenyi kuwa tu na silaha yake moja ya kofia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme Tom avait une panne d'essence, il est arrivé trop tard à la réunion.
target_text: Kwa kuwa Tom alipata shida ya kukosa essence, alifika kwenye mkutano anachelewa.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa Tom alipata shida ya kukosa essence, alifika kwenye mkutano anachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun de nous est responsable de sa propre conduite.
target_text: Kila mumoja wetu ni kiongozi wa mwenendo yake.
target_text_raw: Kila mumoja wetu ni kiongozi wa mwenendo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous savez comment nous contacter ?
target_text: Munajuwa gisi ya kuasiliana na siye?
target_text_raw: Munajuwa gisi ya kuasiliana na siye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après cela tu iras t'exercer quotidiennement, j'ai acheté des fortifiants pour que tu essaies d'en prendre.
target_text: Kisha ile uatenda unajizowelesha kila siku, niliuza madawa za kukuleta nguvu kusudi ujaribu kuzitumia.
target_text_raw: Kisha ile uatenda unajizowelesha kila siku, niliuza madawa za kukuleta nguvu kusudi ujaribu kuzitumia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette année, la saison des bains de mer est tombée à l'eau.
target_text: Iyi mwaka, watu wengi hawaendi kuogelea ndani ya ziwa.
target_text_raw: Iyi mwaka, watu wengi hawaendi kuogelea ndani ya ziwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À notre surprise, elle est allée seule au Brésil.
target_text: Kwa mushangao wetu, aliende yepeke Brésil.
target_text_raw: Kwa mushangao wetu, aliende yepeke Brésil.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles viennent tard.
target_text: Banafika banachelewa.
target_text_raw: Banafika banachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et si on se faisait une petite bouffe ?
target_text: Tunaweza kupiga chakula kidogo?
target_text_raw: Tunaweza kupiga chakula kidogo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon ami s'est fait renvoyer du lycée.
target_text: Rafiki yangu alijifukuzisha yepeke ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yangu alijifukuzisha yepeke ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit, et d'une main embrasse Ilionée, / tend l'autre vers Sergeste, ensuite ouvre les bras / au courageux Cloanthe, au valeureux Gyas.
target_text: Anasema, na mkono moya inamukumbatia Ilionée, / akanyorosha ingine kwa Sergeste, kisha akafungula mikono / kwa Cloanthe mwenye juhudi, na kwa Gyas mwenye samani.
target_text_raw: Anasema, na mkono moya inamukumbatia Ilionée, / akanyorosha ingine kwa Sergeste, kisha akafungula mikono / kwa Cloanthe mwenye juhudi, na kwa Gyas mwenye samani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais t'expliquer tout cela plus tard.
target_text: Nitakufasiria ile yote baadaye.
target_text_raw: Nitakufasiria ile yote baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce petit monsieur de Soulas n'aime que ma fortune; si j'étais pauvre, il ne ferait seulement pas attention à moi.
target_text: Ule mwanaume mdogo wa Soulas anapenda tu utajiri yangu, ningelikuwa maskini hangeniangaikia hata.
target_text_raw: Ule mwanaume mdogo wa Soulas anapenda tu utajiri yangu, ningelikuwa maskini hangeniangaikia hata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On m'a donné la permission d'y aller à condition que je sois de retour au plus tard à cinq heures.
target_text: Balinipatia ruhusa ya kwenda ako lakini nirudie mbele ya saa kumi ya moja.
target_text_raw: Balinipatia ruhusa ya kwenda ako lakini nirudie mbele ya saa kumi ya moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et si je te disais que je ne peux pas faire ça?
target_text: Na nikikwambia kama siwezi fanya ivi?
target_text_raw: Na nikikwambia kama siwezi fanya ivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'ai envoyé un courrier électronique.
target_text: Nilikutumia barua ku internet.
target_text_raw: Nilikutumia barua ku internet.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous souhaite une merveilleuse soirée.
target_text: Minawatakia mangaribi njema.
target_text_raw: Minawatakia mangaribi njema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La sauvegarde est endommagée et ne peut pas être utilisée. Veuillez sortir du jeu et le relancer une fois que vous aurez effacé la sauvegarde.
target_text: Sauvegarde inaharibika na haiwezi tena kutumikishwa. Tafazali utoke mu mchezo na kuianzilia tena kisha kuvuta kila kitu mu sauvegarde.
target_text_raw: Sauvegarde inaharibika na haiwezi tena kutumikishwa. Tafazali utoke mu mchezo na kuianzilia tena kisha kuvuta kila kitu mu sauvegarde.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez suivre le conseil de votre professeur.
target_text: Mulipashwa fuata shauri ya mwalimu wenu.
target_text_raw: Mulipashwa fuata shauri ya mwalimu wenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que cela sent la fumée.
target_text: Minawaza ile kitu inanuka moshi.
target_text_raw: Minawaza ile kitu inanuka moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ironie est surtout un jeu de l'esprit. L'humour serait plutôt un jeu du cœur, un jeu de sensibilité.
target_text: Kuchekeana ni tabia ya kucheza na akili mbele ya yote. Lakini kuchekesha ni kama kucheza na roho, kucheza na hisia.
target_text_raw: Kuchekeana ni tabia ya kucheza na akili mbele ya yote. Lakini kuchekesha ni kama kucheza na roho, kucheza na hisia.

target_text_raw: Ni mtaalamu wa uvuvi.

source_text: J'ai prêté deux trois bouquins à mon pote pour les vacances.

target_text_raw: Nilipatia rafiki yangu bitabu mbili ao bitatu bya kurudisha mu likizo.

source_text: Le génie, cela ne s'explique pas, cela se respecte.

target_text_raw: Mwenye akili sana, ile haifasiriwe, ile inaheshimika.

source_text: Fais chacun de tes actes comme si c'était le dernier de ta vie.
target_text: Tendea kila mumoja kadiri ya matendo yake sawa vile njo mara ya mwisho mu maisha yako.
target_text_raw: Tendea kila mumoja kadiri ya matendo yake sawa vile njo mara ya mwisho mu maisha yako.

source_text: Oh Peter, ton ombre s'est échappée !
target_text: O Petro, kivuli yako ilisha potea !
target_text_raw: O Petro, kivuli yako ilisha potea !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec ce masque, je suis moche.
target_text: Na iyi mask, minaonekana wa mubaya.
target_text_raw: Na iyi mask, minaonekana wa mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Allô, c'est qui ?"

target_text_raw: "Allo, ni nani?"
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au fond, il y a cette pluie battante que la musique peine à cacher, et qui resurgit lorsque le calme se fait.
target_text: Kwa ndani, kuna ile nvula kali yenye kupiga sana kuliko muziki inashindwa kuficha, na yenye iko inasikilika wakati kimya inarudia.
target_text_raw: Kwa ndani, kuna ile nvula kali yenye kupiga sana kuliko muziki inashindwa kuficha, na yenye iko inasikilika wakati kimya inarudia.

source_text: Est-ce que tu penses que c'est suffisant ?
target_text: Unawaza kama inatosha ?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kama inatosha ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle était censée l'appeler à quatorze heures trente.
target_text: Alipashwa muita na saa munane na nusu.
target_text_raw: Alipashwa muita na saa munane na nusu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Permettez, Monsieur, vous faites erreur.
target_text: Samahani, Bwana, unadanganyika.
target_text_raw: Samahani, Bwana, unadanganyika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes très douée.
target_text: Uko na akili ya mingi sana.
target_text_raw: Uko na akili ya mingi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Commandant, l'avion est prêt à atterrir.
target_text: Kamanda, ndege iko tayari kudema.
target_text_raw: Kamanda, ndege (avion) iko tayari kudema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De nombreux policiers gardaient le hall.
target_text: Bapolisi bamingi balikuwa banalinda hangar.
target_text_raw: Bapolisi bamingi balikuwa banalinda hangar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortir avec des garçons est épuisant.
target_text: Kutoka na vijana inachokesha.
target_text_raw: Kutoka na vijana (garçons) inachokesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne laisse pas l'ennemi l'approcher.
target_text: Usiache adui asogee.
target_text_raw: Usiache adui asogee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'animal même sauvage, quand on le tient enfermé, oublie son courage.
target_text: Mnyama hata ikiwa wa pori, ukibakia unaifunga, inaanzaka poteza juhudi yake.
target_text_raw: Mnyama hata ikiwa wa pori, ukibakia unaifunga, inaanzaka poteza juhudi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Michael Jackson est populaire aux États-Unis.
target_text: Michael Jackson iko mashuhuru Marekani.
target_text_raw: Michael Jackson iko mashuhuru Marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y avait des juifs dans les pays arabes avant le partage de la Palestine.
target_text: Kulikuwa Wayahudi mu inchi za kiarabu mbele ya kugawanya Palestina.
target_text_raw: Kulikuwa Wayahudi mu inchi za kiarabu mbele ya kugawanya Palestina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit, que l'amour et la haine sont très proches l'un de l'autre.
target_text: Wanasema, upendo na chuki binakaribiana.
target_text_raw: Wanasema, upendo na chuki binakaribiana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui était ton enseignant préféré quand tu étais au lycée ?
target_text: Nani njo mwalimu ulikuwa unamupenda wakati ulikuwaka kwenye shule ya sekondari.
target_text_raw: Nani njo mwalimu ulikuwa unamupenda wakati ulikuwaka kwenye shule ya sekondari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Félicitations pour ton diplôme !
target_text: Hongera kwa cheti chako cha kumaliza masomo!
target_text_raw: Hongera kwa cheti chako cha kumaliza masomo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je promets que je ne commettrai jamais une telle faute.
target_text: Minaahidi kama sitafanyaka kosa ya vile.
target_text_raw: Minaahidi kama sitafanyaka kosa ya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça semble exact.
target_text: Inafanana kweli.
target_text_raw: Inafanana kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Approchez.
target_text: Karibia.
target_text_raw: Karibia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il disait qu'il était pauvre.
target_text: Alikuwa anasema kama ni maskini.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anasema kama ni maskini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne me tue pas si facilement.
target_text: Habaniuwaki mbio mbio hivi.
target_text_raw: Habaniuwaki mbio mbio hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police verrouilla les rues environnantes de l'hôtel, tandis qu'elle cherchait la bombe.
target_text: Polisi ilifunga barabara za kando kando ya hotel, ilipokuwa natafuta bombe.
target_text_raw: Polisi ilifunga barabara za kando kando ya hotel, ilipokuwa natafuta bombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: David me dit que vous vous en allez.
target_text: Daudi ananiambia kama munaenda.
target_text_raw: Daudi ananiambia kama munaenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous vous rendez à la bibliothèque cette après-midi, voudriez-vous alors, je vous prie, ramener deux livres pour moi, tant que vous y êtes ?
target_text: Mukienda ku bibliothèque iyi muchana, munaweza niletea vitabu viwili tafazali, wakati mutakua ako?
target_text_raw: Mukienda ku bibliothèque iyi muchana, munaweza niletea vitabu viwili tafazali, wakati mutakua ako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait une réservation dans un bar près de la gare de Shinjuku. C'est boisson à volonté pendant deux heures pour 2 500 yens.
target_text: Niliwekesha fasi ndani ya kilabo cha pombe karibu na fasi ya kuchungia bisi ya Shinjuku. Ni kukunywa gisi kila mtu anataka muda wa saa mbili kwa beyi ya yens 2.500.
target_text_raw: Niliwekesha fasi ndani ya kilabo cha pombe (bar) karibu na fasi ya kuchungia bisi ya Shinjuku. Ni kukunywa gisi kila mtu anataka muda wa saa mbili kwa beyi ya yens 2.500.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons élu M. Jordan à la place de président.
target_text: Tulimchagua Bwana Jordan ku fasi ya Rais.
target_text_raw: Tulimchagua Bwana Jordan ku fasi ya Rais.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis essayait de contrôler son propre tempérament violent.
target_text: Louis alijaribu kucunguza hali yake ya kusirika.
target_text_raw: Louis alijaribu kucunguza hali yake ya kusirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qu'un « robot tueur » ?
target_text: « Robot ya kuuwa » njo nini?
target_text_raw: « Robot ya kuuwa » njo nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun sait ce qu'il veut, mais pas tous savent ce qu'ils peuvent.
target_text: Kila mumoja anajua anataka nini, lakini siyo wote njo wanajua wanaweza nini.
target_text_raw: Kila mumoja anajua anataka nini, lakini siyo wote njo wanajua wanaweza nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est jeter des perles aux pourceaux que d'acheter un ordinateur aussi cher alors qu'il ne sait pas s'en servir.
target_text: Nikupoteza makuta bure kuuza ordinateur ya bei sana hivi na japo hajuwi kuitumikisha.
target_text_raw: Nikupoteza makuta bure kuuza ordinateur ya bei sana hivi na japo hajuwi kuitumikisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le trafic est chargé par ici.
target_text: Piko embouteillage ya mingi hapa.
target_text_raw: Piko embouteillage ya mingi hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je jure que je n'ai jamais montré ce document à quiconque.
target_text: Ninalapa kama siyawahi onyesha hata mtu mumoja iyi document.
target_text_raw: Ninalapa kama siyawahi onyesha hata mtu mumoja iyi document.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es la plus chouette petite amie que j'ai jamais eue.
target_text: Uko rafiki yangu wa kike mrembo sana kuliko bote benye nilishaka toka nabo.
target_text_raw: Uko rafiki yangu wa kike (copine) mrembo sana kuliko bote benye nilishaka toka nabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y en a qui travaillent juste parce qu'ils sont assez hypocrites pour cacher leur paresse.
target_text: Kuko benye banatumikaka juu tu ya kuficha uvivu yabo.
target_text_raw: Kuko benye banatumikaka juu tu ya kuficha uvivu yabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un gamin peut rêver, non?
target_text: Mtoto anaweza lota, si vile?
target_text_raw: Mtoto anaweza lota, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas assez forts pour suivre toute notre raison.
target_text: Hatuna nguvu za kutosha kwa kuweza kufuatana na byenye akili yetu inatuambia.
target_text_raw: Hatuna nguvu za kutosha kwa kuweza kufuatana na byenye akili yetu inatuambia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'avais su que tu étais comme ça, je ne t'aurais pas épousé.
target_text: Ningejuwaka kama unakuwaka ivi, singekuowaka!
target_text_raw: Ningejuwaka kama unakuwaka ivi, singekuowaka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mike aime les chats.
target_text: Mike anapendaka pusi.
target_text_raw: Mike anapendaka pusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La cabine sentait le moisi.
target_text: Kabine ilikuwa inanuka bitu ya baridi baridi.
target_text_raw: Kabine ilikuwa inanuka bitu ya baridi baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous auriez dû prendre davantage de soin de votre santé.
target_text: Ulipashwa shurulikia zaidi afya yako.
target_text_raw: Ulipashwa shurulikia zaidi afya yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a été promu au grade de colonel.
target_text: Aliinuliwa ku cheo ya colonel.
target_text_raw: Aliinuliwa ku cheo ya colonel.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De fait, je baise votre antithèse.
target_text: Minaelewa wazo yako ya tafauti.
target_text_raw: Minaelewa wazo yako ya tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous resterons debout tard ce soir.
target_text: Tutalala nyuma leo busiku.
target_text_raw: Tutalala nyuma leo busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est surveillé par le FBI.
target_text: Anachunguzwa na FBI.
target_text_raw: Anachunguzwa na FBI.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit : les Phrygiens, qu'enchante son discours, / d'un murmure flatteur lui prêtent le secours.
target_text: Anasema : raia wa Phrygie, ata kama maneno yake inafurahisha, / wanamuteta mu roho bila yeye kujua.
target_text_raw: Anasema : raia wa Phrygie, ata kama maneno yake inafurahisha, / wanamuteta mu roho bila yeye kujua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez vérifier votre pression sanguine.

target_text_raw: Unapashwa chunguza gisi damu yako inatumika mu mwili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Nilisha kuwa kiongozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas a assisté à un spectacle de danse contemporaine.
target_text: Thomas alihuzuria kwenye danse yakisasa.
target_text_raw: Thomas alihuzuria kwenye danse yakisasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était si triste qu'il est presque devenu fou.
target_text: Alikuwa mwenye hasira mno mpaka akakaribia kupata bazimu.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa mwenye hasira mno mpaka akakaribia kupata bazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.
