target_text: Mushimame.
target_text_raw: Mushimame.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois adapter tes plans aux miens.
target_text: Unapashwa patanisha mipango yako na yangu.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa patanisha mipango yako na yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le problème se situe au bas de mon dos, au niveau des lombaires.
target_text: Shida iko chini ya mugongo yangu, ngambo ya kiuno.
target_text_raw: Shida iko chini ya mugongo yangu, ngambo ya kiuno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est devenu un traître.
target_text: Alishakuwa musaliti.
target_text_raw: Alishakuwa musaliti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouah, c'était rapide !
target_text: Ah, ilikuwa mbio!
target_text_raw: Ah, ilikuwa mbio!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après avoir perdu son procès, certains des biens incriminés lui ont été confisqués.
target_text: Aliposhindwa kwenye mashtaka, vitu vyake vimoja vilivyo tajwa vilinyanganywa.
target_text_raw: Aliposhindwa kwenye mashtaka, vitu vyake vimoja vilivyo tajwa vilinyanganywa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle accélérait la cassette.
target_text: Alikuwa anapiga cassette mbio mbio.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anapiga cassette mbio mbio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande si vous pourriez porter plainte contre quelqu'un du même sexe que vous pour harcèlement sexuel.
target_text: Minajiuliza kama mtu anaweza shitaki mtu wa jinsia yake kwa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.
target_text_raw: Minajiuliza kama mtu anaweza shitaki mtu wa jinsia yake kwa unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pauvreté n'est pas péché, mais mieux vaut cependant la cacher.
target_text: Umaskini haiko zambi, lakini ni vizuri kuificha.
target_text_raw: Umaskini haiko zambi, lakini ni vizuri kuificha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens juste de revenir des toilettes.
target_text: Ninatoka ku toilettes saa iyi.
target_text_raw: Ninatoka ku toilettes (wc) saa iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pose un couteau sur la table.
target_text: Minatia kisu ku meza.
target_text_raw: Minatia kisu ku meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bob est revenu à la maison tard.
target_text: Bob alirudia ku nyumba nyuma.
target_text_raw: Bob alirudia ku nyumba nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa copine est une vraie planche à pain.
target_text: Rafiki yake wa kike ni mwembamba sana.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yake wa kike ni mwembamba sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le foutez pas en l'air !
target_text: Usiiharibishe!
target_text_raw: Usiiharibishe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a arrangé le garage en bureau.
target_text: Aligeuza garage amo bureau.
target_text_raw: Aligeuza garage amo bureau.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous serez épargnés si vous vous rendez.
target_text: Utaepushwa ukiitika kujileta wepeke.
target_text_raw: Utaepushwa ukiitika kujileta wepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens du RIET cherchent une vie intelligente dans l'univers parce qu'ils ne l'ont pas trouvée ici sur Terre !
target_text: Watu wa RIET wanatafuta maisha inayotumika na teknolojia ndani ya ulimwengu sababu hawakuipata hapa ku dunia.
target_text_raw: Watu wa RIET wanatafuta maisha inayotumika na teknolojia ndani ya ulimwengu sababu hawakuipata hapa ku dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis un simple employé de bureau.
target_text: Niko tu mufanyakazi wa ofisi.
target_text_raw: Niko tu mufanyakazi wa ofisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le monde d'aujourd'hui, nous devons doter tous nos enfants d'une éducation qui les prépare au succès, quelle que soit leur apparence, ou le revenu de leurs parents, ou le code postal où ils vivent.
target_text: Mu dunia ya leo tunapashwa patia watoto wetu maadibisho yenye itawatayarisha kufaulu, haizuru namna wanaonekana kwa inje, ao pato ya wazazi yao, ao kwenye wanaishi.
target_text_raw: Mu dunia ya leo tunapashwa patia watoto wetu maadibisho yenye itawatayarisha kufaulu, haizuru namna wanaonekana kwa inje, ao pato ya wazazi yao, ao kwenye wanaishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où est-ce que tu as caché la boite ?
target_text: Ulificha boite wapi ?
target_text_raw: Ulificha boite wapi ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Coupez votre moteur, je vous prie.
target_text: Kata moteur yako, nakusii.
target_text_raw: Kata moteur yako, nakusii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de voitures a Alex ?
target_text: Gari ngapi za Alex?
target_text_raw: Gari ngapi za Alex?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Apprend-il à marcher sur les pas de son père ? / Vers ses hautes vertus prend-il déjà l'essor ? / Promet-il d'être un jour digne neveu d'Hector ? "
target_text: "Anajifunza kufuata mwenendo ya baba yake? / Je! tabia yake nzuri ilishaanza onekanana? / Anahaidia atakuwa mupwa muzuri wa Hector? "
target_text_raw: "Anajifunza kufuata mwenendo ya baba yake? / Je! tabia yake nzuri ilishaanza onekanana? / Anahaidia atakuwa mupwa muzuri wa Hector? "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Seul le coucou tient de son père.
target_text: Anafanana baba yake tu ku shingo.
target_text_raw: Anafanana baba yake tu ku shingo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit qu'il n'a aucun souvenir de la soirée.
target_text: Anasema hakumbuke hata kitu moja kuhusu mangaribi ya jana.
target_text_raw: Anasema hakumbuke hata kitu moja kuhusu mangaribi ya jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais à qui en revient la faute.
target_text: Minajuwa kosa ni ya nani.
target_text_raw: Minajuwa kosa ni ya nani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dieu n'a pas fait d'aliments bleus. Il a voulu réserver l'azur pour le firmament et les yeux de certaines femmes.
target_text: Mungu hakuumbaka chakula ya bleu. Alitaka kuweka rangi ya bleu juu ya kuipakala ku mawingu na ndani ya macho ya wanawake.
target_text_raw: Mungu hakuumbaka chakula ya bleu. Alitaka kuweka rangi ya bleu juu ya kuipakala ku mawingu na ndani ya macho ya wanawake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça arrivera tôt ou tard.
target_text: Mwisho na mwisho itafika tu.
target_text_raw: Mwisho na mwisho itafika tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son revenu est trois fois plus élevé que le mien.
target_text: Pato yake iko yulu mara tatu zaidi ya yangu.
target_text_raw: Pato yake iko yulu mara tatu zaidi ya yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui a vu le présent a vu tout ce qui a été de toute éternité et tout ce qui sera à l'infini ; car tout a la même origine et le même aspect.
target_text: Mwenye aliona Rais aliona kila kitu yenye ilishaka kuwa na kila yenye itakuwa milele na milele, kwa sababu kila kitu iko na asili moja na muonekano moja.
target_text_raw: Mwenye aliona Rais aliona kila kitu yenye ilishaka kuwa na kila yenye itakuwa milele na milele, kwa sababu kila kitu iko na asili moja na muonekano moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Voie Lactée se compose d'environ cent milliards d'étoiles.
target_text: Anga inaundwa na nyota bilioni moja.
target_text_raw: Anga inaundwa na nyota bilioni (millliards) moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai raté la compétition.
target_text: Nilishindwa mashindano.
target_text_raw: Nilishindwa mashindano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle me tourne le dos.
target_text: Ananigeuzia mugongo.
target_text_raw: Ananigeuzia mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le krav-maga qui, au milieu du vingtième siècle, a permis à des communautés de se protéger contre l'antisémitisme, permet actuellement à des Indiennes de lutter contre le viol, fléau national trop souvent impuni.
target_text: Krav-maga, ambayo katikati ya karne ya makumi mbili, iliwezesha jamii kujikinga na chuki zidi ya Wayahudi, leo inawezesha Wahindi kupiganisha ubakaji, shida ya kitaifa yenye mara mingi haiazibiwaki.
target_text_raw: Krav-maga, ambayo katikati ya karne (siècle) ya makumi mbili, iliwezesha jamii kujikinga na chuki zidi ya Wayahudi, leo inawezesha Wahindi kupiganisha ubakaji, shida ya kitaifa yenye mara mingi haiazibiwaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans les petites villes, chacun sait tout sur tout le monde.
target_text: Ndani ya miji midogo, kila mtu anajua kila kitu juu ya kila mtu.
target_text_raw: Ndani ya miji midogo, kila mtu anajua kila kitu juu ya kila mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez faire quelque chose que vous aimez faire.
target_text: Ulipashwa fanya kitu ambacho unapendaka fanya.
target_text_raw: Ulipashwa fanya kitu ambacho unapendaka fanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le titre a pu légèrement se rétablir hier et il était coté à la clôture en hausse de trois virgule quarante-et-un pour cent.
target_text: Titre ilirudishwa kidogo nafasi yake jana na ilipanda mpaka kwenye asilimia tatu na mukato makumi ine na moja.
target_text_raw: Titre ilirudishwa kidogo nafasi yake jana na ilipanda mpaka kwenye asilimia tatu na mukato makumi ine na moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le médecin mesura le pouls et la tension artérielle du patient.
target_text: Mganga alipima vipimo vya njia ya damu na vya mapigo ya moyo ya mgonjwa.
target_text_raw: Mganga alipima vipimo vya njia ya damu na vya mapigo ya moyo ya mgonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand je pars m'amuser, c'est toujours à Nankin que je prends l'avion, je ne suis jamais allé à Shanghai.
target_text: Wakati ninaendaka kujifurahisha, siku zote minakamatiaka ndege Nankin, siyawahi kuenda Shanghai.
target_text_raw: Wakati ninaendaka kujifurahisha, siku zote minakamatiaka ndege (avion) Nankin, siyawahi kuenda Shanghai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime les histoires ayant une fin triste.
target_text: Minapendaka hadisi zenye zinaishaka na uzuni.
target_text_raw: Minapendaka hadisi zenye zinaishaka na uzuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais que ce combat se termine.
target_text: Ningependa iyi vita iishe.
target_text_raw: Ningependa iyi vita iishe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'avais pourtant dit de ranger ta chambre.
target_text: Na japo nilikwambiaka upange chumba yako vizuri.
target_text_raw: Na japo nilikwambiaka upange chumba yako vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez vous enrichir, ayez une pizzeria plutôt qu'un restaurant étoilé.
target_text: Kama unapenda kuwina, ufanye restaurant ya pizza kuliko restaurant ya kisasa sana.
target_text_raw: Kama unapenda kuwina, ufanye restaurant ya pizza kuliko restaurant ya kisasa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux y arriver tôt afin que nous obtenions de bonnes places.
target_text: Minapenda tufike ako mapema juu tupate fasi za muzuri.
target_text_raw: Minapenda tufike ako mapema juu tupate fasi za muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce mec est nul.
target_text: Uyu mtu hajui kitu.
target_text_raw: Uyu mtu hajui kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne dispose pas de l'autorité nécessaire pour ordonner cela.
target_text: Sina mamlaka ya kutosha juu ya kuamuru ile.
target_text_raw: Sina mamlaka ya kutosha juu ya kuamuru ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À combien s’élève la commission ?
target_text: Commission ni ngapi?
target_text_raw: Commission ni ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous nous sommes rencontrés à une rencontre surprise.
target_text: Tulikutanana bila ata kupanga.
target_text_raw: Tulikutanana bila ata kupanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis crut qu’elle jouait la comédie.
target_text: Louis aliwaza kama ule binti alikuwa natania.
target_text_raw: Louis aliwaza kama ule binti alikuwa natania.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais nous savons que ses intentions sont bonnes.
target_text: Lakini tunajua kama iko na nia nzuri.
target_text_raw: Lakini tunajua kama iko na nia nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que vous voulez probablement vous retrouver seules alors je vais partir.
target_text: Minajua kama mungependa mubakie peke yenu, kwa hivyo minataka enda.
target_text_raw: Minajua kama mungependa mubakie peke yenu, kwa hivyo minataka enda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je commencer par remercier chacun de vous pour votre chaleureux accueil ?
target_text: Muniruhusu nipigie kila mumoya wenu aksanti kwa kunikaribisha muzuri?
target_text_raw: Muniruhusu nipigie kila mumoya wenu aksanti kwa kunikaribisha muzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le voleur a braqué son arme à feu sur l'officier de police.
target_text: Mwizi alinyoroshea bunduki yake ku afisa wa polisi.
target_text_raw: Mwizi alinyoroshea bunduki yake ku afisa wa polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On croyait que le trésor était resté caché quelque part dans la montagne.
target_text: Tulizani kama hazina ilikuwa nafichwa fasi moja ndani ya kilima.
target_text_raw: Tulizani kama hazina ilikuwa nafichwa fasi moja ndani ya kilima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est en taule.
target_text: Iko ndani ya jela.
target_text_raw: Iko ndani ya jela.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le directeur a donné la réponse précise que j'attendais.
target_text: Kiongozi alipana jibu yenye uhakika yenye nilikuwa nangoja.
target_text_raw: Kiongozi alipana jibu yenye uhakika yenye nilikuwa nangoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Expliquer des figures planes comme les triangles, cercles, ellipses ou hyperboles et tridimensionnelles comme les sphères, tétraèdres, cylindres ou prismes serait absurde si elles n'étaient auparavant représentées graphiquement sur une feuille de papier.
target_text: Kufasiria ma figures sawa vile triangles, cercles, ellipses ao hyperboles na zenye pembe nyingi sawa vile spheres, tétraèdres, cylindres ao prismes itakuwa upuuzi kama mbele haikuchapwa ku kartasi.
target_text_raw: Kufasiria ma figures sawa vile triangles, cercles, ellipses ao hyperboles na zenye pembe nyingi sawa vile spheres, tétraèdres, cylindres ao prismes itakuwa upuuzi kama mbele haikuchapwa ku kartasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si ça continue comme ça, nous ne pourrons jamais rattraper le temps perdu.
target_text: Kama inaendelea hivi, hatutarudishaka tena muda yenye ilipotea.
target_text_raw: Kama inaendelea hivi, hatutarudishaka tena muda yenye ilipotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces hommes viennent d'Asie, mais je ne sais pas s'ils sont des Indiens, des Pakistanais, des Sri-lankais ou des Bangladais.
target_text: Hawa watu wanatokea Asia, lakini sijuwi kama ni Wahindi, wa Pakistani, raia wa Srilanka ao wa Bangladesh.
target_text_raw: Hawa watu wanatokea Asia, lakini sijuwi kama ni Wahindi, wa Pakistani, raia wa Srilanka ao wa Bangladesh.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Che Guevara a beaucoup fait pour transformer la société...surtout les tee-shirts, en fait.
target_text: Che Guevara alifanya kazi kubwa kuhusu maendeleo ya jamii... hasa ma T-Shirts, kweli.
target_text_raw: Che Guevara alifanya kazi kubwa kuhusu maendeleo ya jamii... hasa ma T-Shirts, kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il courut jusqu’à la grande porte fermée. Elle était très haute, tout en cœur de chêne, avec des clous de fer et doublée d’airain.
target_text: Alikimbilia mpaka ku mulango ya kabambi ya kufungiwa. Ilikuwa ya murefu, katikakati ya mti, na misumari ya chuma na kuzungukwa na cuivre.
target_text_raw: Alikimbilia mpaka ku mulango ya kabambi ya kufungiwa. Ilikuwa ya murefu, katikakati ya mti, na misumari ya chuma na kuzungukwa na cuivre.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des politiciens éminents de trois nations ont exprimé leur vive inquiétude concernant les conséquences des opérations militaires dans le sud-est de l'Ukraine.
target_text: Wanasiasa kutokea mu inchi tatu walionesha shaka yao kufuatana na vinyume ya shuruli za vikosi vya kijeshi kusini mwa Ukraine.
target_text_raw: Wanasiasa kutokea mu inchi tatu walionesha shaka yao kufuatana na vinyume ya shuruli za vikosi vya kijeshi kusini mwa Ukraine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle hauteur peux-tu sauter ?
target_text: Unaweza ruka mpaka kwa urefu gani?
target_text_raw: Unaweza ruka mpaka kwa urefu gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui court le plus vite, de Ken ou de Tony ?
target_text: Nani anakimbia mbio zaidi ya mwengine, Ken ao Tony?
target_text_raw: Nani anakimbia mbio zaidi ya mwengine, Ken ao Tony?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le président s'est réservé le droit de décider.
target_text: Rais alijipatia haki ya kukamata uamuzi.
target_text_raw: Rais alijipatia haki ya kukamata uamuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si le cours de ces actions continue à monter, nous les vendrons à la fin du mois.
target_text: Kama bei ya michango inazidi kupanda, tutaziuzisha mwisho ya mwezi.
target_text_raw: Kama bei ya michango (parts) inazidi kupanda, tutaziuzisha mwisho ya mwezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai raté le test écrit.
target_text: Nilishindwa kwenye mtihani ya kuandika.
target_text_raw: Nilishindwa kwenye mtihani ya kuandika (test écrit).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le gel eut un effet négatif sur la récolte.
target_text: Baridi kali ilikuwa na kinyume ku mavuno.
target_text_raw: Baridi kali ilikuwa na kinyume ku mavuno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les travaux devraient durer quatre jours.
target_text: Kazi zilipashwa fanya siku ine.
target_text_raw: Kazi zilipashwa fanya siku ine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais voulu l'épouser.
target_text: Nilikuwa napenda nimuowe.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa napenda nimuowe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les partisans de cette idéologie raciste et colonialiste pensent qu'ils représentent la civilisation occidentale dans un Moyen-Orient qui n'attend que leurs bombes et leur épuration ethnique pour sortir de l'"âge de la pierre."
target_text: Wafuasi wa iyi ideolojia ya ubaguzi wa rangi na ukoloni wanawaza kama wanaonesha usirimi wa Magharibi katika Mashariki ya Kati yenye inangoja tu ma bombes yao na utakaso wa kikabila ili kutoka mu "enzi za mawe."
target_text_raw: Wafuasi wa iyi ideolojia ya ubaguzi wa rangi na ukoloni wanawaza kama wanaonesha usirimi wa Magharibi katika Mashariki ya Kati yenye inangoja tu ma bombes yao na utakaso wa kikabila ili kutoka mu "enzi za mawe."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je peux arranger ça.
target_text: Ndaweza itengeneza.
target_text_raw: Ndaweza itengeneza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un conducteur ivre a été responsable de l'accident de voiture.
target_text: Dereva mulevi njo aaliye sababisha ajali ya gari.
target_text_raw: Dereva mulevi njo aaliye sababisha ajali ya gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ange et démon, vous l'avez connu, le pauvre ancien curé était plus tranquille.
target_text: Malaika na shetani, mulimujua, padiri mukubwa wa zamani alikuwa kimya zaidi.
target_text_raw: Malaika na shetani, mulimujua, padiri mukubwa wa zamani alikuwa kimya zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aime pas faire du stop.
target_text: Sipendaki kushimama.
target_text_raw: Sipendaki kushimama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bah, ces gens ne m'intéressent pas!
target_text: Kweli, sifurahiake aba batu!
target_text_raw: Kweli, sifurahiake aba batu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu sauter à la corde ?
target_text: Unaweza ruka kamba?
target_text_raw: Unaweza ruka kamba?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'arrive enfin à percevoir la lumière au bout du tunnel.
target_text: Minafikia sasa kuona mwangaza mwisho ya tunnel.
target_text_raw: Minafikia sasa kuona mwangaza mwisho ya tunnel.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il l'a vu tourner le dos et a crié : "Bonjour."
target_text: Alimuona anageuza mugongo na akalalamika: "Jambo."
target_text_raw: Alimuona anageuza mugongo na akalalamika: "Jambo."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez à avancer !
target_text: Endelea kusonga mbele!
target_text_raw: Endelea kusonga mbele!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez vous acheter un nouveau couteau.
target_text: Ingekuwa muzuri muuze kisu ya mpya.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa muzuri muuze kisu ya mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Simple ou double ?
target_text: Ya kawaida ao yenye iko amo mbili?
target_text_raw: Ya kawaida ao yenye iko amo mbili?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où vais-je lorsque j'ai récupéré mes bagages ?
target_text: Ndaenda wapi nikisha kamata mizigo yangu?
target_text_raw: Ndaenda wapi nikisha kamata mizigo yangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La parole vous est-elle dure ?
target_text: Neno ni ya nguvu kwako?
target_text_raw: Neno ni ya nguvu kwako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vérité est rarement pure, et jamais simple.
target_text: Ukweli haizoweyi kuwa safi, haiyakuwaka rahisi.
target_text_raw: Ukweli haizoweyi kuwa safi, haiyakuwaka rahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai senti que je devais simplement descendre du bateau.
target_text: Nilisikia sawa tu nitoke mu mashua.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia sawa tu nitoke mu mashua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La jeune fille prit Thomas par la main pour l'attirer sur la piste de danse.
target_text: Kijana bintu alimukamata Thomas mukono kwa kumubeba kwenye piste ya danse.
target_text_raw: Kijana bintu alimukamata Thomas mukono kwa kumubeba kwenye piste ya danse.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous lui avons laissé la décision finale.
target_text: Tulimuachia uamuzi ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Tulimuachia uamuzi ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous pensiez vraiment que c'était mon anniversaire aujourd'hui ?
target_text: Ulikuwa unawaza kabisa kama leo ilikuwa anniversaire yangu ?
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa unawaza kabisa kama leo ilikuwa anniversaire yangu ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fus très déçu de voir notre équipe nationale de foot encaisser une défaite historique.
target_text: Nilisikia mubaya sana kuona timu yetu ya taifa ya mupira wa miguu inashindwa gisi haiwayi shindwa.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia mubaya sana kuona timu yetu ya taifa ya mupira wa miguu inashindwa gisi haiwayi shindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégage.
target_text: Toka.
target_text_raw: Toka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'enfant marche joyeux, sans songer au chemin ; il le croit infini, n'en voyant pas la fin.
target_text: Mtoto anatembea akiwa anafurahi, bila kuwaza njia, anawaza haina mwisho, haoni mwisho ya njia.
target_text_raw: Mtoto anatembea akiwa anafurahi, bila kuwaza njia, anawaza haina mwisho, haoni mwisho ya njia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez toujours dit que vous vouliez devenir scientifique. Pourquoi ne l'êtes-vous pas devenu ?
target_text: Kila wakati unasemaka kama ulikuwa napenda kuwa mwanasayansi. Juu ya nini hauyakuwaka aye?
target_text_raw: Kila wakati unasemaka kama ulikuwa napenda kuwa mwanasayansi. Juu ya nini hauyakuwaka aye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trouvez un emploi, de façon à pouvoir subvenir aux besoins de votre femme et de vos enfants !
target_text: Tafuta kazi, kwa gisi uweze kuragamia muke na watoto wako.
target_text_raw: Tafuta kazi, kwa gisi uweze kuragamia muke na watoto wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est comme vous disiez : c'est formidable !
target_text: Ni kama gisi ungesema : ni muzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Ni kama gisi ungesema : ni muzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La consommation de ce produit a augmenté au cours des deux dernières années.
target_text: Matumizi ya iyi produit iliongeza katika saa mbili iliyopita.
target_text_raw: Matumizi ya iyi produit iliongeza katika saa mbili iliyopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'autre refuse de se cacher.
target_text: Ule mwengine anakatala kujificha.
target_text_raw: Ule mwengine anakatala kujificha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça à en effet l'air très marrant.
target_text: Inaonekana kabisa ya kuchekesha.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana kabisa ya kuchekesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu entendu les dernières rumeurs ?
target_text: Umesikia habari zisizokuwa na uhakika izi siku?
target_text_raw: Umesikia habari zisizokuwa na uhakika (rumeurs) izi siku?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pourriez au moins me donner un indice.
target_text: Ungenipatia hata basi alama ya kuniongoza.
target_text_raw: Ungenipatia hata basi alama ya kuniongoza (indice).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme je ne regardais pas où j'allais je me suis heurté à lui. Ce n'était pas sa faute.
target_text: Kwa kuwa sikukuwa naangalia mwelekeo yangu niligongana naye. Haikukuwa kosa yake.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa sikukuwa naangalia mwelekeo yangu niligongana naye. Haikukuwa kosa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Madame Tulipe a été tuée dans l'abri de jardin avec un sécateur.
target_text: Madame Tulipe aliuawa ndani ya bustani na chombo ya kukata mayani.
target_text_raw: Madame Tulipe aliuawa ndani ya bustani na chombo ya kukata mayani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est rentré tard hier soir.
target_text: Alirudia jana nyuma mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Alirudia jana nyuma mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si Tom avait eu quelque chose à jeter, il l'aurait jeté.
target_text: Ingekuwa Tom alikuwaka na kitu ya kutupa, angeikitupaka.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa Tom alikuwaka na kitu ya kutupa, angeikitupaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez lui présenter des excuses pour être arrivée en retard.
target_text: Mungepashwa kumuomba musamaha kwa sababu mulifika munachelewa.
target_text_raw: Mungepashwa kumuomba musamaha kwa sababu mulifika munachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le détective recueillit son témoignage sur place.
target_text: Polisi alichukua ushahidi pale pale.
target_text_raw: Polisi alichukua ushahidi pale pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me rends à la mansuétude de la cour.
target_text: Minaomba korti inionee huruma.
target_text_raw: Minaomba korti inionee huruma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est parfois surprenant que d'autres langues ne distinguent absolument pas des plantes que l'on considère soi-même comme totalement différentes.
target_text: Inakuwaka nashangaza wakati mwengine kuona kuko luga zenye hazina ata tafauti kidogo na mimea yenye mtu yepeke anaonaka kama ziko tafauti kabisa.
target_text_raw: Inakuwaka nashangaza wakati mwengine kuona kuko luga zenye hazina ata tafauti kidogo na mimea yenye mtu yepeke anaonaka kama ziko tafauti kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca dort couché sur le dos.
target_text: Luca analalia mugongo.
target_text_raw: Luca analalia mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C’est effrayant ce qu’on vieillit entre deux Expositions Universelles, surtout lorsqu’elles sont séparées par un laps considérable.
target_text: Inaleta boga kuona mtu anazeeka kati ya maonyesho mbili ya duniani, hasa wakati yanaachana na muda murefu.
target_text_raw: Inaleta boga kuona mtu anazeeka kati ya maonyesho mbili ya duniani, hasa wakati yanaachana na muda murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le disons à personne !
target_text: Tusiiambie mutu!
target_text_raw: Tusiiambie mutu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan a autorisé les policiers à fouiller son domicile.
target_text: Dan aliruhusu wapolisi wachunguze nyumba yake.
target_text_raw: Dan aliruhusu wapolisi wachunguze nyumba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils sont partis chacun de leur côté.
target_text: Walienda wote kila mtu ngambo yake.
target_text_raw: Walienda wote kila mtu ngambo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et ne me remercie pas, surtout.
target_text: Na usinishukuru, hasa.
target_text_raw: Na usinishukuru, hasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te donnerai cette caméra.
target_text: Nitakupatia iyi camera.
target_text_raw: Nitakupatia iyi camera.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est allé aux toilettes pour pisser.
target_text: Alienda ku toilette kukoyola.
target_text_raw: Alienda ku toilette (wc) kukoyola.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouvrez les fenêtres !
target_text: Fungula madirisha.
target_text_raw: Fungula madirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Va à l'entrepôt !
target_text: Wende ku entrepot!
target_text_raw: Wende ku entrepot!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La température du corps augmente, la pulsation également... Il manque d'oxygène.
target_text: Temperature ya mwili inaongezeka, mapigo pia... Anakosa hewa.
target_text_raw: Temperature ya mwili inaongezeka, mapigo pia... Anakosa hewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu t'inquiètes de tout.
target_text: Uko na wasiwasi juu ya kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Uko na wasiwasi juu ya kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca était un soldat courageux.
target_text: Luca alikuwa askari mwenye juhudi.
target_text_raw: Luca alikuwa askari mwenye juhudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il lui expliqua qu'il venait du futur.
target_text: Alimuelezea kama anatokea siku zijazo.
target_text_raw: Alimuelezea kama anatokea siku zijazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À la manière des fats, il larde ses phrases de mots anglais mal digérés. Une sorte de dandy raté, auquel il manquerait la classe.
target_text: Kama batu ya kujisifu, anayaza misemwa yake na maneno ya nguvu kuelewa ya kiingereza yenye kusikilikana mubaya. Aina ya mtu wa kujipendeza na hapendezeki, ajawahi kusirimuka.
target_text_raw: Kama batu ya kujisifu, anayaza misemwa yake na maneno ya nguvu kuelewa ya kiingereza yenye kusikilikana mubaya. Aina ya mtu wa kujipendeza na hapendezeki, ajawahi kusirimuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devras étudier plus sérieusement à partir de maintenant.
target_text: Inakuomba ujifunze sana zaidi kuanzia leo.
target_text_raw: Inakuomba ujifunze sana zaidi kuanzia leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La flèche indique la voie à suivre.
target_text: Mshale inaonyesha njia ya kufuata.
target_text_raw: Mshale inaonyesha njia ya kufuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fillette a failli se perdre dans la foule.
target_text: Ule binti mdogo alikuwa karibu ya kupotea mu kundi ya batu.
target_text_raw: Ule binti mdogo alikuwa karibu ya kupotea mu kundi ya batu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le fond des êtres? Mais il n'y a ni fond ni tréfonds. Ce que nous cachons aux uns, nous le montrons aux autres et le fond devient la surface.
target_text: Ndani ya roho za watu? Lakini hakuna ndani ao ndani sana. Tunacho ficha wamoja, tunakionesha wengine na siri inakuwa wazi.
target_text_raw: Ndani ya roho za watu? Lakini hakuna ndani ao ndani sana. Tunacho ficha wamoja, tunakionesha wengine na siri inakuwa wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand je lui pose une question, elle me regarde avec rage.
target_text: Wakati minauliza swali, ananiangalia kwa hasira.
target_text_raw: Wakati minauliza swali, ananiangalia kwa hasira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La prêtresse vaudou ricana quand Mathéo et Jeanne, perdus dans cette phrase, se demandèrent qui donc, sinon l’auteur, maîtrisait en fait leur destin.
target_text: Mchungaji mu dini ya vodu alicheka kwa zarau wakati Mathéo na Jeanne, walipotea katika iyi msemwa, wakajiuliza sasa ni nani, kama labda mwandishi, alikuwa najua kitakacho watokea.
target_text_raw: Mchungaji mu dini ya vodu alicheka kwa zarau wakati Mathéo na Jeanne, walipotea katika iyi msemwa, wakajiuliza sasa ni nani, kama labda mwandishi, alikuwa najua kitakacho watokea (destin yao).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Raphaël a failli se faire écraser.
target_text: Raphael alitaka kugongwa na gari kwa kosa yake.
target_text_raw: Raphael alitaka kugongwa na gari kwa kosa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que j'ai le billet gagnant.
target_text: Minawaza niko na ticket ya ushindi.
target_text_raw: Minawaza niko na ticket ya ushindi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai marre de tes histoires !
target_text: Minachoka na maneno yako!
target_text_raw: Minachoka na maneno yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le lait est dans le frigo.
target_text: Maziwa iko mu frigo.
target_text_raw: Maziwa iko mu frigo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a aimé l’humanité, comme le Christ l’aima, d’un amour infini.
target_text: Alipenda binadamu, kama vile Kristu aliwapenda, kwa upendo isiyo kuwa na mwisho.
target_text_raw: Alipenda binadamu, kama vile Kristu aliwapenda, kwa upendo isiyo kuwa na mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathis versa du lait dans le verre et ensuite le donna à Renee.
target_text: Mathis alimwangia maziwa mu verre kisha akaipatia Renee.
target_text_raw: Mathis alimwangia maziwa mu verre kisha akaipatia Renee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais gêné quand quelqu'un me parlait en anglais, mais à présent, je n'ai plus peur et je le parle très bien.
target_text: Nilisikia mubaya wakati mutu aliniongelesha mu Kingereza, lakini kwa sasa, siogopi tena na ninaongea muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia mubaya wakati mutu aliniongelesha mu Kingereza, lakini kwa sasa, siogopi tena na ninaongea muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On te tuera !
target_text: Batakuuwa!
target_text_raw: Batakuuwa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un salarié est en droit de demander le versement de la treizième partie du salaire annuel calculée au prorata de son temps de présence.
target_text: Mfanyakazi iko na haki ya kuomba malipo ya sehemu ya kumi na tatu ya mshahara wa mwaka uliohesabiwa kutokana na wakati alifanya ku kazi.
target_text_raw: Mfanyakazi iko na haki ya kuomba malipo ya sehemu ya kumi na tatu ya mshahara wa mwaka uliohesabiwa kutokana na wakati alifanya ku kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lâchez la poignée !
target_text: Achilia poignée!
target_text_raw: Achilia poignée!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voudrais faire nettoyer ce costume.
target_text: Minataka kufulisha iyi veste.
target_text_raw: Minataka kufulisha iyi veste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce que je sais, c'est que ce jeune homme, que nous connaissions tous sous le nom de M. Pierre tout court, est devenu comte Besoukhow et possesseur de l'une des plus grandes fortunes de Russie.
target_text: Chenye minajuwa, ni kwamba uyu kijana, mwenye siye bote tulikuwa najua kwa jina ya Bwana Petro kwa kifupi, alishakuwa tajiri Besoukhow na mwenye kuwa na moja ya utajiri mkubwa nchini Urusi.
target_text_raw: Chenye minajuwa, ni kwamba uyu kijana, mwenye siye bote tulikuwa najua kwa jina ya Bwana Petro kwa kifupi, alishakuwa tajiri Besoukhow na mwenye kuwa na moja ya utajiri mkubwa nchini Urusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai amené ici que mon linge et mon cheval.
target_text: Nilileta tu hapa kitambala na farasi yangu.
target_text_raw: Nilileta tu hapa kitambala na farasi yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va amener ces vins rouges en Chine pour offrir.
target_text: Ataleta iyi mivinyo mwekundu kutoka Uchina kukupatia.
target_text_raw: Ataleta iyi mivinyo mwekundu kutoka Uchina kukupatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le rire profond amène les larmes.
target_text: Cheko ya mingi sana inaletaka machozi.
target_text_raw: Cheko ya mingi sana inaletaka machozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le principal résultat des récentes recherches de la théorie d'Emmet a été qu'elle peut aussi bien s'appliquer à la biochimie.
target_text: Matokeo kubwa ya utafiti wa siku zilizopita ya ile theorie ya Emmet ni kama inaweza pia tumikishwa mu biochimie.
target_text_raw: Matokeo kubwa ya utafiti wa siku zilizopita ya ile theorie ya Emmet ni kama inaweza pia tumikishwa mu biochimie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Ton discours était super. » « Ah oui ? Merci ! »
target_text: « Hotuba yako ilikuwa nzuri sana. » « Ndio ? Aksanti! »
target_text_raw: « Hotuba yako ilikuwa nzuri sana. » « Ndio ? Aksanti! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un cœur noble ne peut soupçonner en autrui la bassesse et la malice qu'il ne sent point en lui.
target_text: Roho muzuri haiwezi shakia mwengine ubaya na ujanja yenye mtu yepeke hasikii ndani yake.
target_text_raw: Roho muzuri haiwezi shakia mwengine ubaya na ujanja yenye mtu yepeke hasikii ndani yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-moi, je te prie, comment tu t'appelles !
target_text: Niambie, tafazali, unaitwa nani?
target_text_raw: Niambie, tafazali, unaitwa nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est justement cette sorte d'enseignante que nous admirons tous.
target_text: Yeye kwa kweli ni aina ya mwalimu mwenye sis wote tunafurahiaka.
target_text_raw: Yeye kwa kweli ni aina ya mwalimu mwenye sis wote tunafurahiaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si jamais tu me touches encore, je te tuerai.
target_text: Ukipima tena kunigusa, ndakuuwa.
target_text_raw: Ukipima tena kunigusa, ndakuuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pendant près d'une semaine, chaque jour, en fin d'après-midi, un orage violent mais bref éclatait.
target_text: Karibu juma moya, kila siku, mwisho ya mchana, mupepeo mkali lakini ya mufupi ilikuwa napita.
target_text_raw: Karibu juma moya, kila siku, mwisho ya mchana, mupepeo mkali lakini ya mufupi ilikuwa napita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a une superbe vue depuis le toit de cet immeuble. Tu veux aller voir ?
target_text: Kutokea ku manjanja ya iyi nyuma, mutu anaona fasi ingine muzuri. Unataka enda kuona?
target_text_raw: Kutokea ku manjanja ya iyi nyuma, mutu anaona fasi ingine muzuri. Unataka enda kuona?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui craint le grand méchant loup ?
target_text: Nani njo anaogopa imbwa mwitu ya makali?
target_text_raw: Nani njo anaogopa imbwa mwitu ya makali?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous aiderai de toutes les manières que je pourrai.
target_text: Nitakusaidia mu namna yote yenye ndaweza.
target_text_raw: Nitakusaidia mu namna yote yenye ndaweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si on pouvait, par une formule, exprimer les raisons exactes pour lesquelles on aime une personne ou pas, la vie semblerait différente.
target_text: Kungekuwa gisi, mutu aeleze kwa nini anapenda ao kutopenda mwengine, maisha ingekuwa tafauti.
target_text_raw: Kungekuwa gisi, mutu aeleze kwa nini anapenda ao kutopenda mwengine, maisha ingekuwa tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est resté droit dans ses bottes.
target_text: Akubarisha musimamo ata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Akubarisha musimamo ata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Non mais regarde ma frange, elle est toute droite. J’avais pourtant demandé au coiffeur de me la couper qu’un tout petit peu.
target_text: Hapana lakini angalia coiffe yangu, inashimama wima. Ijapokuwa niliambia kinyozi azipunguze kidogo tu.
target_text_raw: Hapana lakini angalia coiffe (mutindo ya nywele) yangu, inashimama wima. Ijapokuwa niliambia kinyozi azipunguze kidogo tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa bouche resta ouverte, comme si elle ne croyait pas ce qu'elle venait d'entendre.
target_text: Kinywa yake ikabakia wazi, sawa vile hakukuwa anawazia chenye alikuwa namaliza sikia.
target_text_raw: Kinywa yake ikabakia wazi, sawa vile hakukuwa anawazia chenye alikuwa namaliza sikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une chute de douze étages, quelques os cassés, une bonne période de repos, et le revoilà reparti à l'aventure.
target_text: Kuanguka kwa gorofa kumi na mbili, piko mifupa yenye ilivunjika, wakati ya kupumuzika ya kutosha, njo huyu tena anaendelea na mabo yake.
target_text_raw: Kuanguka kwa gorofa (étages) kumi na mbili, piko mifupa yenye ilivunjika, wakati ya kupumuzika ya kutosha, njo huyu tena anaendelea na mabo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle s'est foutue de moi.
target_text: Alinidanganya.
target_text_raw: Alinidanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les grands cygnes nagèrent autour du nouveau venu, et lui caressèrent le cou de leurs becs, en guise de bienvenue.
target_text: Aina ya ndege cygnes kubwa ziliogelea karibu na mgeni, na zikamuvunja shingo yake kwa midomo yazo, mu namna ya kumukaribisha.
target_text_raw: Aina ya ndege cygnes kubwa ziliogelea karibu na mgeni, na zikamuvunja shingo yake kwa midomo yazo, mu namna ya kumukaribisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ré-écoutez l'album et dites-moi ensuite s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Sikiliza albamu tena kisha uniambie tafazali.
target_text_raw: Sikiliza albamu tena kisha uniambie tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde a fait un job fabuleux.
target_text: Kila mutu alifanya kazi nzuri.
target_text_raw: Kila mutu alifanya kazi nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qui est tordu ne peut être droit, ce qui manque ne peut se compter.
target_text: Kile kyenye kiliharibika hakiwezi kuwa sana tena, kile kyenye kinakosa hakiwezi kuhesabiwa.
target_text_raw: Kile kyenye kiliharibika hakiwezi kuwa sana tena, kile kyenye kinakosa hakiwezi kuhesabiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand entre le vin, sortent d'étranges choses.
target_text: Wakati muvinyo inaingia, kunatokeaka bitu ya ajabu ajabu.
target_text_raw: Wakati muvinyo inaingia, kunatokeaka bitu ya ajabu ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les voyageurs montrent leur passeport aux agents de l'immigration.
target_text: Wasafiri wanaonyesha passeports zabo kwa watumishi kwenye mipaka.
target_text_raw: Wasafiri wanaonyesha passeports zabo kwa watumishi kwenye mipaka (ba agents ya immigration).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le typhon était vraiment violent hier, non ? Les fenêtres ont claqué toute la soirée.
target_text: Mupepeo mkali ilikuwa ya nguvu sana jana, si vile? Madirisha zilijigonga mangaribi yote.
target_text_raw: Mupepeo mkali ilikuwa ya nguvu sana jana, si vile? Madirisha zilijigonga mangaribi yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les exploits infinis de Christophe Colomb sont une menace pour Google. Ils ne savent pas indexer l'infini, quand quelqu'un cherche "Christophe Colomb".
target_text: Safari siziko kuwa na mwisho za Christophe Colomb ni kitisho kwa Google. Hawajui gisi ya kuoesha mwisho wakati mtu anatafuta "Christophe Colomb".
target_text_raw: Safari siziko kuwa na mwisho za Christophe Colomb ni kitisho kwa Google. Hawajui gisi ya kuoesha mwisho wakati mtu anatafuta "Christophe Colomb".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu un amateur de la série Star Trek ?
target_text: Unapendaka serie ya Star Trek?
target_text_raw: Unapendaka serie ya Star Trek?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette fenêtre est à l'épreuve des balles.
target_text: Iyi dirisha iko mu hatari ya masasi.
target_text_raw: Iyi dirisha iko mu hatari ya masasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes revenus au camp avant la nuit.
target_text: Tulirudia mu kambi mbele ya busiku.
target_text_raw: Tulirudia mu kambi mbele ya busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu voudras avoir l'air à ton maximum, demain.
target_text: Utapenda kuvuta hewa gisi unataka, kesho.
target_text_raw: Utapenda kuvuta hewa gisi unataka, kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La maîtrise des compétences de communication en plusieurs langues est essentielle à toute entreprise qui fournit des biens et des services sur le marché mondial.
target_text: Kujuwa muzuri kuongea mu luga za mingi ni ya maana sana kwa kila kampuni ambayo inauzisha biashara ao kutoa huduma kwenye soko la dunia.

source_text: Ça sera l'un des meilleurs souvenirs de ma vie.

source_text: Il va falloir se serrer, car elle est minuscule.

target_text_raw: Nilijuwa kama nilikuwa nakuhitaji wakati tu yenye nilikuona.

target_text_raw: Sikuweza pata option ya kweli ya menu ku distributeur ya banki.

target_text_raw: Tuliwahi kutoka pamoja wakati yote tulikuwa nasoma pamoja kwenye chuo kikuu.

target_text_raw: Baridi mingi iliyotokea Siberia ilipiga sehemu kubwa inchini Ufaransa.

target_text_raw: Baba anahakikisha kama matala yote inazimwa mbele ya kwenda kulala.

source_text: Le déséquilibre actuel de l'offre et de la demande ne doit pas être considéré comme un phénomène cyclique, mais comme un effet du changement structurel du côté de la demande.
target_text: Ukosefu wa usawa wa sasa wa coffre na mahitaji haipashwi kuonekana kama hali ya mzunguko, lakini kama tokeo ya mabadiliko ku ngambo ya mahitaji.

source_text: Mon père a offert ses services à une compagnie de négoce bien connue.
target_text: Baba yangu alitumikia kampuni ya uchuruzi yenye kujulikana sana.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu alitumikia kampuni ya uchuruzi yenye kujulikana sana.

target_text: « Mushangao ya maisha ya kibinafsi » ni tafauti kati ya maana ambayo watumiaji wanadai kupatia maisha yao ya kibinafsi na kupuuza kwamba wanatangaza habari kuhusu maisha yao ya kibinafsi kwenye mitandao.

source_text: Quatrième donne et personne ne prend. Des bétonneurs, je te jure !
target_text: Ya ine inapana na hakuna mwenye anakamata. Ni wafanya biashara wasiyo heshimia mazingira, minakulapia!
target_text_raw: Ya ine inapana na hakuna mwenye anakamata. Ni wafanya biashara wasiyo heshimia mazingira, minakulapia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas pourquoi, mais dès la première rencontre, je n'ai pas ressenti qu'il était un étranger.
target_text: Sijuwe ni juu ya nini, lakini wakati tunakutanana kwa mara ya kwanza, sikusikiaka kama alikuwa mugeni.
target_text_raw: Sijuwe ni juu ya nini, lakini wakati tunakutanana kwa mara ya kwanza, sikusikiaka kama alikuwa mugeni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as juste à suivre les instructions.
target_text: Unapashwa tu kufuata maagizo.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa tu kufuata maagizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voudrez peut-être vérifier que ces prises électriques sont sécurisées pour les enfants.
target_text: Munaweza labda angalia tena kama zile ma prises za courant hazitii watoto mu hatari.
target_text_raw: Munaweza labda angalia tena kama zile ma prises za courant hazitii watoto mu hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre diplomatie et notre stratégie militaire étaient à l'évidence en contradiction.
target_text: Diplomasia yetu na mbinu yetu ya kijeshi havikupatana.
target_text_raw: Diplomasia yetu na mbinu yetu ya kijeshi havikupatana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa propre survie est désormais plus importante.
target_text: Kuendelea kuishi kwake njo ya lazima zaidi kuanzia leo.
target_text_raw: Kuendelea kuishi kwake njo ya lazima zaidi kuanzia leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de fausses couches avez-vous faites ?
target_text: Ulishaka pata mimba ngapi ya kuharibika?
target_text_raw: Ulishaka pata mimba ngapi ya kuharibika?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je refuse que tu me traites comme une esclave.
target_text: Usinikamate sawa vile mtumwa.
target_text_raw: Usinikamate sawa vile mtumwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les filles commencent leur puberté aux environs de dix ou onze ans et les garçons autour de onze ou douze.
target_text: Mabinti wanaanzaka kipindi yabo ya puberté mu miaka kumi ao kumi na moja na wavulana mu miaka kumi na moja ao kumi na mbili.
target_text_raw: Mabinti wanaanzaka kipindi yabo ya puberté mu miaka kumi ao kumi na moja na wavulana mu miaka kumi na moja ao kumi na mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas de moyen d'atteindre l'île autrement qu'en bateau.
target_text: Hakuna namna ingine ya kufika kwenye kisanga isipokuwa kwenda na mashua.
target_text_raw: Hakuna namna ingine ya kufika kwenye kisanga isipokuwa kwenda na mashua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est comme combattre quelqu'un avec un bras attaché dans le dos.
target_text: Ni kama kupiganisha mtu na mkono inafungwa mu mugongo.
target_text_raw: Ni kama kupiganisha mtu na mkono inafungwa mu mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a couru dehors, à moitié nue.
target_text: Alikimbilia inje, akiwa nusu uchi.
target_text_raw: Alikimbilia inje, akiwa nusu uchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais faire mes études en Chine pour améliorer mon niveau de chinois.
target_text: Ningependa nisomee Uchina ili niboreshe kiwango yangu ya luga ya Kichina.
target_text_raw: Ningependa nisomee Uchina ili niboreshe kiwango yangu ya luga ya Kichina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel âge ont vos frères et soeurs ?
target_text: Ba kaka yako na ba dada yako biko na miaka ngapi?
target_text_raw: Ba kaka yako na ba dada yako biko na miaka ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les personnes qui ne sont pas pressées sont placées du côté droit de l'escalier.
target_text: Watu wenye hawako mu haraka wanatiwa ngambo ya kuume ya escalier.
target_text_raw: Watu wenye hawako mu haraka wanatiwa ngambo ya kuume ya escalier.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi les garçons sont-ils si bêtes ?
target_text: Juu ya nini ba garcons banakuwa baduru hivi?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini ba garcons banakuwa baduru hivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi êtes-vous si gentils avec moi ?
target_text: Juu ya nini uko mwema kwangu?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini uko mwema kwangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Finissons-en et rentrons à la maison.
target_text: Tumalize na turudie ku nyumba.
target_text_raw: Tumalize na turudie ku nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les êtres humains sont les seules créatures vivantes qui emploient le feu.
target_text: Wanadamu ndiyo viumbe tu vinavyo tumikisha moto.
target_text_raw: Wanadamu ndiyo viumbe tu vinavyo tumikisha moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a eu la nuit dernière une explosion dans une usine de feux d'artifice.
target_text: Usiku wa jana kulikuwa muripuko ndani ya kiwanda ya kutengeneza ma feux d'artifice.
target_text_raw: Usiku wa jana kulikuwa muripuko ndani ya kiwanda ya kutengeneza ma feux d'artifice.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a une chose que nous faisons chaque fois que nous lisons, que nous en soyons conscients ou non ; nous entrons en contact avec la personnalité de l'écrivain.
target_text: Kuko kitu tunafanyaka kila mara tuko nasoma, tutambue ao hapana, tunaingia ndani ya akili ya mwandishi.
target_text_raw: Kuko kitu tunafanyaka kila mara tuko nasoma, tutambue ao hapana, tunaingia ndani ya akili ya mwandishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça doit être chouette d'avoir quelqu'un qui reste même lorsque les temps sont durs.
target_text: Inapashwa kuwa muzuri kupata mtu wakubakia pembeni yako hata kama maisha iko mubaya.
target_text_raw: Inapashwa kuwa muzuri kupata mtu wakubakia pembeni yako hata kama maisha iko mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tiens, quelle coïncidence, Luca a les mêmes empreintes digitales que moi !
target_text: Aye tu, surprise gani iyi, Luca iko alama za bidole kama zangu!
target_text_raw: Aye tu, surprise gani iyi, Luca iko alama za bidole kama zangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trouvé une très belle lampe de chevet qui ira parfaitement dans ta chambre.
target_text: Nilipata tala ya muzuri ya kutikia pembeni ya kitanda ngambo ya kichwa mu chumba yako.
target_text_raw: Nilipata tala ya muzuri ya kutikia pembeni ya kitanda ngambo ya kichwa mu chumba yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Impossible de s'abstenir de manger pendant une semaine, sans avoir la sensation de crever la dalle!
target_text: Haiwezekani kufanya juma moya bila kukula, bila kusikia sawa unataka kufa na njala.
target_text_raw: Haiwezekani kufanya juma moya bila kukula, bila kusikia sawa unataka kufa na njala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La trahison de Ken fut pour Arthur comme un coup de poignard dans le dos.
target_text: Usaliti ya Ken ilikuwa sawa kuchomekwa kisu mu mugongo.
target_text_raw: Usaliti ya Ken ilikuwa sawa kuchomekwa kisu mu mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants prennent le goûter après l'école.
target_text: Batoto banaonja chakula kidogo kisha kutoka ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Batoto banaonja chakula kidogo kisha kutoka ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un esprit vide est l'atelier du diable.
target_text: Nafsi yenye kuwa wazi ni nyumba ya shetani.
target_text_raw: Nafsi yenye kuwa wazi ni nyumba ya shetani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie est au bord de la crise de nerfs.
target_text: Marie anataka gonjwa malali ya kichwa.
target_text_raw: Marie anataka gonjwa malali ya kichwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'élève a dépassé le maître.
target_text: Mwanafunzi alisha shinda mwalimu.
target_text_raw: Mwanafunzi alisha shinda mwalimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tuez !
target_text: Uwa!
target_text_raw: Uwa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est généreux envers ses ennemis.
target_text: Iko na roho muzuri kwa maadui zake.
target_text_raw: Iko na roho muzuri kwa maadui zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous attendons la fin du d'abord pour procéder à l'ensuite.
target_text: Tunangoja mwisho ya kwanza juu tuendelee na ya kufuata.
target_text_raw: Tunangoja mwisho ya kwanza juu tuendelee na ya kufuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était bourré.
target_text: Alikuwa nalewa.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nalewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te prêterai mon manuel si tu promets de ne rien écrire dessus.
target_text: Nitakukopesha kitabu yangu kama unaniahidia kama hautakiandika ako.
target_text_raw: Nitakukopesha kitabu yangu kama unaniahidia kama hautakiandika ako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « C'est pas ma faute. c'est à cause de mon petit frère si je suis en retard. » « Il a bon dos ton petit frère. »
target_text: « Haiko kosa yangu. Kama minachelewa ni juu ya muloko yangu. » « Muloko yako anavumiliaka makosa yenye hakufanya. »
target_text_raw: « Haiko kosa yangu. Kama minachelewa ni juu ya muloko yangu. » « Muloko yako anavumiliaka makosa yenye hakufanya. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voici un présent pour vous, comme marque de notre reconnaissance.
target_text: Matabishi yako iyi, kama ishara ya shukurani ku byenye ulifanya.
target_text_raw: Matabishi yako iyi, kama ishara ya shukurani ku byenye ulifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous déjà embrassé un autre type ?
target_text: Ulishaka embrassé mwengine mwanaume?
target_text_raw: Ulishaka embrassé mwengine mwanaume?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie ne prononça pas un mot, mais on pouvait lire sur son visage que grand-père avait réussi à lui couper l'appétit avec ses récits sur les années de disette passées.
target_text: Marie hakuongea neno, lakini ku sura yake ilionekana kama tate yake mwanaume alimuuzi na hadisi zake za miaka ya njala iliyopita.
target_text_raw: Marie hakuongea neno, lakini ku sura yake ilionekana kama tate yake mwanaume alimuuzi na hadisi zake za miaka ya njala iliyopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est meilleur marché si tu les commandes à la douzaine.
target_text: Ni bei ya muzuri kama unauza bitu kumi na mbili.
target_text_raw: Ni bei ya muzuri kama unauza bitu kumi na mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police a établi une liste des personnes présentant un intérêt après la découverte du corps de Marie.
target_text: Polisi ilifanya liste ya batu benye biko na faida kisha kugundua mwili ya Marie.
target_text_raw: Polisi ilifanya liste ya batu benye biko na faida kisha kugundua mwili ya Marie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne n'osait se risquer dans la chambre, parce qu'on connaissait Bijard, une bête brute quand il était soûl.
target_text: Hakuna yeyote alikuwa naingia mu chambre, ju Bijard alikuwa najulikana, mtu wa fujo sana wakati analewa.
target_text_raw: Hakuna yeyote alikuwa naingia mu chambre, ju Bijard alikuwa najulikana, mtu wa fujo sana wakati analewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Désolée, je ne vous ai pas entendue.
target_text: Samahani, sikukusikia.
target_text_raw: Samahani, sikukusikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis excité si je dois parler devant une grande foule.
target_text: Minakuwaka na furaha sana wakati nataka kuongea mbele ya watu wengi.
target_text_raw: Minakuwaka na furaha sana wakati nataka kuongea mbele ya watu wengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le câble électrique était rompu.
target_text: Singa ya moto ilikatika.
target_text_raw: Singa ya moto ilikatika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma recherche d'emploi s'avère plutôt rude. Je n'ai aucune relation.
target_text: Kutafuta kazi kwangu inakuwa nguvu sana. Sina hata mtu mwenye ananijua.
target_text_raw: Kutafuta kazi kwangu inakuwa nguvu sana. Sina hata mtu mwenye ananijua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette décision dépend de la place et du temps disponible.
target_text: Iyi uamuzi inafuatana na fasi na wakati yenye iko.
target_text_raw: Iyi uamuzi inafuatana na fasi na wakati yenye iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette jolie veste lui a été envoyée par son frère qui vit en Suède.
target_text: Ndugu yake mwenyi anaishi Suede njo alimutia iyi veste ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ndugu yake mwenyi anaishi Suede njo alimutia iyi veste (koti) ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On se dépêche, les filles !
target_text: Tufanye haraka, mabinti !
target_text_raw: Tufanye haraka, mabinti !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le niveau de ségrégation sociale atteint des sommets inacceptables.
target_text: Hali ya ubaguzi ya kijamii kati ya watu ilishafikia hatua yenye haikubaliwe.
target_text_raw: Hali ya ubaguzi ya kijamii kati ya watu ilishafikia hatua yenye haikubaliwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie, quoique fille d'un simple fermier, a des manières qui trahissent une éducation distinguée.
target_text: Marie, hata kama ni binti wa mukulima wa kawaida, iko na tabia yenye kuonesha kama aliadibishwa muzuri.
target_text_raw: Marie, hata kama ni binti wa mukulima wa kawaida, iko na tabia yenye kuonesha kama aliadibishwa muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père gère un restaurant.
target_text: Baba yangu anashimamia restaurant.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu anashimamia restaurant.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le simple mortel ne comprend pas la physique quantique, parce qu'elle est trop compliquée.
target_text: Mwanadamu wa kawaida hasikiake physique quantique, kwa sababu ni ya nguvu sana kuelewa.
target_text_raw: Mwanadamu wa kawaida hasikiake physique quantique, kwa sababu ni ya nguvu sana kuelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez, jusqu'à ce que je revienne.
target_text: Mungoye, mpaka wakati ndarudia.
target_text_raw: Mungoye, mpaka wakati ndarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il est nécessaire que tu le voies.
target_text: Minawaza ni ya lazima umuone.
target_text_raw: Minawaza ni ya lazima umuone.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dick me transmit la photo.
target_text: Dick alinitumia picha.
target_text_raw: Dick alinitumia picha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une raison profonde se dévoile souvent dans ce que les hommes nomment hasard. Il y a dans les événements comme une main mystérieuse qui leur marque, en quelque sorte, la voie et le but.
target_text: Sababu ya ndani inaonekana mara mingi mu vitu yenye wanadamu wanaitaka kitu ya kushitukiwa. Kuko matukio kama vile mukono ya kushangaza inayo watia alama, kwa namna fulani, njia na lengo.
target_text_raw: Sababu ya ndani inaonekana mara mingi mu vitu yenye wanadamu wanaitaka kitu ya kushitukiwa (hasard). Kuko matukio kama vile mukono ya kushangaza inayo watia alama, kwa namna fulani, njia na lengo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Paname pendant l'été indien, c'est un paradis terrestre.
target_text: Wakati wa kipwa huko Paname, ni paradiso chini ya jua.
target_text_raw: Wakati wa kipwa huko Paname, ni paradiso chini ya jua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne peux pas enterrer ta tête dans le sable.
target_text: Hauwezi zika kichwa yako ndani ya muchanga.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi zika kichwa yako ndani ya muchanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les mathématiciens sont des poètes, avec la différence qu'ils doivent prouver ce que leur imagination crée.
target_text: Watalaamu wa hesabu ni kama waandishi wa poeme, wanapashwa onesha kile ambacho mawazo yao inatunga.
target_text_raw: Watalaamu wa hesabu ni kama waandishi wa poeme, wanapashwa onesha kile ambacho mawazo yao inatunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme cette gamine est mignonne !
target_text: Uyu binti mudogo ni murembo!
target_text_raw: Uyu binti mudogo ni murembo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan était un détective homicide.
target_text: Dan alikuwa mpelelezi wa mauaji.
target_text_raw: Dan alikuwa mpelelezi wa mauaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sue s'est enregistrée au Royal Hotel.
target_text: Sue alijiandikisha ku Hotel Royal.
target_text_raw: Sue alijiandikisha ku Hotel Royal.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après le ski, se détendre dans un bain de source chaude, permet de complètement se réchauffer.
target_text: Kisha mchezo wa ski, kunawa mayi ya moto, inaletaka kifukutu mu mwili yote.
target_text_raw: Kisha mchezo wa ski, kunawa mayi ya moto, inaletaka kifukutu mu mwili yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En regardant simplement ton visage, je sais que tu apportes de bonnes nouvelles.
target_text: Kwa kuangalia tu sura yako, minajuwa kama unaleta habari ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuangalia tu sura yako, minajuwa kama unaleta habari ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est l'archétype du bourreau de travail, tel que tu te l'imagines.
target_text: Ni mufanyakazi anayefaa, gisi unawazia.
target_text_raw: Ni mufanyakazi anayefaa, gisi unawazia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et ta fonction de transfert, est-elle stable ?
target_text: Na fonction ya kutuma, inatumika muzuri?
target_text_raw: Na fonction ya kutuma, inatumika muzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Zut ! J'ai oublié mon appareil photo !
target_text: Ha! Nilisahabu appareil photo yangu.
target_text_raw: Ha! Nilisahabu appareil photo yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aucune accusation criminelle n'a été enregistrée.
target_text: Hakuna mashtaka ya mauaji yenye iliandikwa.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mashtaka ya mauaji yenye iliandikwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux me rendre dans plusieurs pays quand je serai plus âgé et l'Amérique est définitivement sur la liste.
target_text: Nitaenda mu inchi za mingi wakati nitakuwa mkubwa na Marekani iko ku liste.
target_text_raw: Nitaenda mu inchi za mingi wakati nitakuwa mkubwa na Marekani iko ku liste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas présenté tes excuses une seule fois !
target_text: Haukulomba musamaha hata mara moja.
target_text_raw: Haukulomba musamaha hata mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les choses qu'on voit avec les yeux ne sont pas nécessairement vraies.
target_text: Siyo kila kitu yenye tunaonaka na macho ni ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Siyo kila kitu yenye tunaonaka na macho ni ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous jamais été coincée dans un ascenseur ?
target_text: Ulishaka bana mu ascenceur?
target_text_raw: Ulishaka bana mu ascenceur?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au cours des années passées, le moteur de la croissance mondiale, c'était la Chine.
target_text: Mu miaka iliyopita, yenye ilikuwa nasababisha watu kuongezeka mu dunia, ilikuwa China.
target_text_raw: Mu miaka iliyopita, yenye ilikuwa nasababisha watu kuongezeka mu dunia, ilikuwa China.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu aimes ce que tu fais, ça se voit.
target_text: Wakati unapenda unacho fanya, inaonekanaka.
target_text_raw: Wakati unapenda unacho fanya, inaonekanaka.

source_text: On ne peut l'amener à s'engager qu'avec difficulté.

target_text_raw: Inakuwaka nguvu sana kumuitikisha.

target_text_raw: Alicheza guitare pekeyake na haikuvutia ata kidogo.

source_text: Ben c'est très surprenant pour moi étant donné que je l'ai appris différemment.
target_text: Kwa kweli, ni mushangao sana kwangu kabisa kuona niliisikia mu njia tafauti.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli, ni mushangao sana kwangu kabisa kuona niliisikia mu njia tafauti.

source_text: Le camp de migrants a été ravagé par un incendie.
target_text: Kambi ya wahamiaji ililungula na moto.
target_text_raw: Kambi ya wahamiaji ililungula na moto.
