source_text: Messieurs, au commencement de ce siècle, la France était pour les nations un magnifique spectacle.
target_text: Ndugu wapendwa, mwanzo ya iyi karne, Ufaransa ilikuwa fasi nzuri yenye ilikuwa navutia inchi zote.

source_text: Plus haut, dans le versant, on voit trois petits écaillements naissants au droit des fixations des clous de plaques de plâtre, vraisemblablement.
target_text: Yulu, kwenye muteremuko, inaonekana kama fasi ya kupigia misuri mu kibambazi iliyo pakalia chokaa.
target_text_raw: Yulu, kwenye muteremuko, inaonekana kama fasi ya kupigia misuri mu kibambazi iliyo pakalia chokaa.

source_text: Il se pourrait que vous vouliez jeter un œil à ceci.
target_text: Ni kama vile ungependa tupa licho ya iyi.
target_text_raw: Ni kama vile ungependa tupa licho ya iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait un drôle de rêve.
target_text: Nililota ndoto ya mubaya sana.
target_text_raw: Nililota ndoto ya mubaya sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ira dès qu'il arrivera.
target_text: Tutaenda saa atafika.
target_text_raw: Tutaenda saa atafika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme c'est un homme de parole, il te paiera sûrement ce qu'il te doit.
target_text: Kwa kuwa ni mtu anaye heshimia ahadi, atakulipa deni yako bila shaka.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa ni mtu anaye heshimia ahadi, atakulipa deni yako bila shaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu sais à quoi l'enfer ressemble.
target_text: Unajua gisi jehenama inafanana.
target_text_raw: Unajua gisi jehenama inafanana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les habitants se rebellèrent contre le seigneur.
target_text: Wakaaji walimwasi Bwana.
target_text_raw: Wakaaji walimwasi Bwana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'est pas venue à la soirée et personne ne sait pourquoi.
target_text: Hakufika ku sherehe na hakuna anaye jua ni kwa sasa gani?
target_text_raw: Hakufika ku sherehe na hakuna anaye jua ni kwa sasa gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jules demanda à Marie où elle sera plus tard dans la soirée.
target_text: Jules akauliza Maria mahali kwenye atakuwa mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Jules akauliza Maria mahali kwenye atakuwa mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a chéri ses parents.
target_text: Alikuwa napenda sana wazazi wake.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa napenda sana wazazi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre saxophone n'est pas aussi ancien que le mien.
target_text: Saxophone yako shaiko ya zamani sawa yangu.
target_text_raw: Saxophone yako shaiko ya zamani sawa yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est justement la question que je me pose.
target_text: Njo ulizo yenye niko najiuliza ile.
target_text_raw: Njo ulizo yenye niko najiuliza ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'aimez pas les histoires d'amour.
target_text: Haupendaki maongezi kuhusu mapenzi.
target_text_raw: Haupendaki maongezi kuhusu mapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoutez ce qu'il dit attentivement.
target_text: Sikiliza muzuri byenye anasema.
target_text_raw: Sikiliza muzuri byenye anasema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez absolument immobile !
target_text: Usitingizike ata kidogo!
target_text_raw: Usitingizike ata kidogo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pourriez le faire si vous le vouliez vraiment.
target_text: Ungeifanya kama ungependa.
target_text_raw: Ungeifanya kama ungependa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais toutes vous souhaiter la bienvenue à bord.
target_text: Ningependa kuwatakia nyinyi wote ujio mwema.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kuwatakia nyinyi wote ujio mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce type a encore parlé sur le dos de Théo ?
target_text: Uyu jamaa aliongelea tena mu mugongo ya Théo?
target_text_raw: Uyu jamaa aliongelea tena mu mugongo ya Théo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux examiner le corps de la victime.
target_text: Nitachunguza mwili ya muhanga.
target_text_raw: Nitachunguza mwili ya muhanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel a promis qu'il ne ferait pas ça.
target_text: Gabriel alihaidi kama hangefanyaka vile.
target_text_raw: Gabriel alihaidi kama hangefanyaka vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai l'impression que tout le monde parle de moi dans mon dos.
target_text: Minawaza batu yote bananisemeaka mu mugongo.
target_text_raw: Minawaza batu yote bananisemeaka mu mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai simplement voulu ne prendre aucun risque.
target_text: Sikutaka nijitie mu hatari!
target_text_raw: Sikutaka nijitie mu hatari!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je ne pars pas immédiatement, je vais être en retard à mon rendez-vous.
target_text: Kama siende sasa ivi, nitachelewa rendez-vous yangu.
target_text_raw: Kama siende sasa ivi, nitachelewa rendez-vous yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est pas bientôt fini, ce bordel !
target_text: Iyi virugu haitaisha sasa ivi!
target_text_raw: Iyi virugu (désordre) haitaisha sasa ivi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qu'il fit ensuite fut déjà une surprise pour moi.
target_text: Alichofanya baadaye ilinishangaza sana
target_text_raw: Alichofanya baadaye ilinishangaza sana
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous croyez que vous apprendrez l'anglais juste en vous rendant aux USA, vous vous fourrez vraiment le doigt dans l'œil.
target_text: Kama unawaza kama utajifunza Kingereza kwa kwenda tu Marekani, unajidanganya sana.
target_text_raw: Kama unawaza kama utajifunza Kingereza kwa kwenda tu Marekani, unajidanganya sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voulais pas travailler tard mais le patron m'a dit que je le devais.
target_text: Sikukuwa nataka nimalize kazi nyuma lakini patron wangu alinilazimisha.
target_text_raw: Sikukuwa nataka nimalize kazi nyuma lakini patron wangu alinilazimisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prédire, c'est dire ce qui va arriver et ensuite expliquer pourquoi ça n'est pas arrivé.
target_text: Kutabiri , nikusema kitakacho fika na kisha kufasiria kwa nini hakikutimia.
target_text_raw: Kutabiri , nikusema kitakacho fika na kisha kufasiria kwa nini hakikutimia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je disais qu'il n'y avait rien que nous puissions faire.
target_text: Nilikuwa nasema kama hatukukuwa na uwezo ya kufanya chochote.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nasema kama hatukukuwa na uwezo ya kufanya chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez suivre mon conseil.
target_text: Ungepashwa fuata shauri yangu.
target_text_raw: Ungepashwa fuata shauri yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jeanne se demandait si elle comptait pour Mathéo comme un simple mot ou comme une vraie personne.
target_text: Jeanne alikuwa anajiuliza kama alikuwa wa maana mbele ya Matheo sawa vile neno ya kawaida ao sawa mtu wa kweli.
target_text_raw: Jeanne alikuwa anajiuliza kama alikuwa wa maana mbele ya Matheo sawa vile neno ya kawaida ao sawa mtu wa kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mike mange dehors pratiquement tous les soirs.

target_text_raw: Mike anakuliaka inje karibu kila mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Hawa vijana wanaonekana kuwa na uzuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Minamukumbuka Michael Jackson.
target_text_raw: Minamukumbuka Michael Jackson.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Ni siku ya muzuri, si vile? Juu ya nini hatuwezi enda kujitembeza?

target_text_raw: Inataka kuwa kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel disait qu'il avait fait un rêve merveilleux.

target_text_raw: Gabriel alikuwa anasema kama alilota ndoto ya muzuri sana.

target_text_raw: David iko na bidii sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Uko muuaji kabisa.

target_text_raw: Mu miezi mbili, nitaongea Kiespania muzuri. Minakulapia!

target_text_raw: Patron wa bar, ule mwizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'apprécie que vous ayez aussi promptement répondu à mon enquête.

target_text_raw: Minazowea kubakia nashimama busiku yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pris soin de ne laisser aucune preuve.

target_text_raw: Nilijikaza kusikuwe hata ushaidi moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Unawaza utakuwaka baba wa aina gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trouvé sa prestation un peu molle. On était pourtant en droit d'attendre quelque chose de plus énergique.
target_text: Miye niliona sawa spectacle yake ilikuwa ya uvivu. Ijapokuwa tulikuwa na haki ya kusikia kitu moya ya kuchangamusha.
target_text_raw: Miye niliona sawa spectacle (prestation) yake ilikuwa ya uvivu. Ijapokuwa tulikuwa na haki ya kusikia kitu moya ya kuchangamusha.

source_text: Nous ne faisions que suivre les ordres.
target_text: Tulikuwa tu tunafuata maagizo.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa tu tunafuata maagizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les rames en éclats échappent au rameur ; / le vaisseau tourne au gré des vagues en fureur, / et présente le flanc au flot qui le tourmente. / Soudain, amoncelée en montagne écumante, / l'onde bondit.
target_text: Chombo za kusoza za kuvunjika zilikuwa zinaponyoka mwenye alikuwa naendesha mashua; / mashua ilipinduka kwa sababu ya zoruba kali, / na inaonekana kutingizwa na mawimbi kali. / Mara moja, ilijigonga ku mlima ya povu, / zoruba iliendelea napinda.
target_text_raw: Chombo za kusoza za kuvunjika zilikuwa zinaponyoka mwenye alikuwa naendesha mashua; / mashua ilipinduka kwa sababu ya zoruba kali, / na inaonekana kutingizwa na mawimbi kali. / Mara moja, ilijigonga ku mlima ya povu, / zoruba iliendelea napinda.

source_text: Le personnel de ce restaurant nous a fait une très bonne impression.

target_text_raw: Watumishi wa mwa iyi restaurant walitufuhaisha sana.

target_text: Unapendaka tamasha?
target_text_raw: Unapendaka tamasha (spectacle)?

source_text: Je me rappelais les jours sereins et toujours les mêmes que, peu de semaines auparavant, je passais encore près de Marie, sans même entrevoir dans l’avenir une autre possibilité que celle d’un bonheur éternel.
target_text: Minakumbuka siku zenye utulivu na siku zile zile ambazo, juma kidogo mbele, nilikuwa napita pembeni ya Maria, bila hata kuwazia kama kuko kitu ingine inaweza tokea siku zijazo isipokuwa raha ya kudumu milele.
target_text_raw: Minakumbuka siku zenye utulivu na siku zile zile ambazo, juma kidogo mbele, nilikuwa napita pembeni ya Maria, bila hata kuwazia kama kuko kitu ingine inaweza tokea siku zijazo isipokuwa raha ya kudumu milele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un guépard qui est pressé peut atteindre une vitesse de cent-vingt kilomètres à l'heure.
target_text: Chui yenye iko mu haraka inaweza kimbia kilomita miya moja makumi mbili kwa saa.
target_text_raw: Chui yenye iko mu haraka inaweza kimbia kilomita miya moja makumi mbili kwa saa.

source_text: Il a vendu tout son terrain.
target_text: Aliuzisha kiwanja yake yote.
target_text_raw: Aliuzisha kiwanja yake yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Prince a été enlevé.

target_text_raw: Mtoto wa mwami alitekwa nyara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'absence de preuves n'est pas la preuve de l'absence.
target_text: Ukosefu ya ushahidi haimaanishi kama ushahidi haiko.
target_text_raw: Ukosefu ya ushahidi haimaanishi kama ushahidi haiko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles arrivent à Rome.
target_text: Wanafikia Roma.
target_text_raw: Wanafikia Roma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous le pensez sérieusement ?
target_text: Munafikiria hivyo kabisa?
target_text_raw: Munafikiria hivyo kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continue à monter.

target_text_raw: Endelea kupanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Claude, voyant un homme puissant devant lui, vit que les choses semblaient sérieuses et comprit qu'il n'avait pas ici tout à fait la même pré-éminence qu'à Rome, où personne n'était son égal.
target_text: Wakati Claude aliona mwanaume wa nguvu mbele yake, akaona kama mambo inaanza badilika na akaelewa kwamba hapa hakukuwa na mamlaka yenye alikuwa nayo Roma, kwenye hakukuwa na mtu wakulinganana naye.
target_text_raw: Wakati Claude aliona mwanaume wa nguvu mbele yake, akaona kama mambo inaanza badilika na akaelewa kwamba hapa hakukuwa na mamlaka yenye alikuwa nayo Roma, kwenye hakukuwa na mtu wakulinganana naye.
