source_text: Le lait bout à plus haute température que l'eau.
target_text: Maziwa inatokotaka sana kuliko maji.
target_text_raw: Maziwa inatokotaka sana kuliko maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment savais-tu que cet homme était flic ?
target_text: Ulijuwa aye kama uyu mwanaume ni polisi?
target_text_raw: Ulijuwa aye kama uyu mwanaume ni polisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il devait déjà se repentir de cette décision une semaine plus tard.
target_text: Alipashwa kuomba musamaha kutokana na iyi uamuzi juma moja baadaye..
target_text_raw: Alipashwa kuomba musamaha kutokana na iyi uamuzi juma moja baadaye..
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortez les mains de vos poches !
target_text: Mutoshe mikono yenu mu mifuko!
target_text_raw: Mutoshe mikono yenu mu mifuko!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À notre grande surprise, elle est allée seule au Brésil.
target_text: Kwa mushangao wetu mkubwa, alienda yepeke Brésil.
target_text_raw: Kwa mushangao wetu mkubwa, alienda yepeke Brésil.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun est responsable de sa propre stupidité.
target_text: Kila mumoja iko na jukumu yakuita ujinga wake.
target_text_raw: Kila mumoja iko na jukumu yakuita ujinga wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier, je suis devenu un dieu, mais j'ai trouvé ça un peu ennuyeux, alors aujourd'hui je suis devenu un diable.
target_text: Jana, nilikuwa muungu, lakini niliona kama inauzi kidogo, kwa hivyo leo minageuka shetani.
target_text_raw: Jana, nilikuwa muungu, lakini niliona kama inauzi kidogo, kwa hivyo leo minageuka shetani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu joues avec le feu à rouler constamment à moto sans casque.
target_text: Unacheza na moto kwa kuendelea unatembeza pikipiki bila kuvala casque.
target_text_raw: Unacheza na moto kwa kuendelea unatembeza pikipiki bila kuvala casque.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sérieusement, reste en contact.
target_text: Kweli, ubakie hewani.
target_text_raw: Kweli, ubakie hewani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous achetez un cercueil aujourd'hui, vous aurez droit à une réduction de vingt pour cent.
target_text: Ukiuza sanduku leo, batakupunguzia bei mpaka asilimia makumbi mbili.
target_text_raw: Ukiuza sanduku leo, batakupunguzia bei mpaka asilimia makumbi mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je compte sur toi pour ramener une salade.
target_text: Minatumainia kama utaleta salade.
target_text_raw: Minatumainia kama utaleta salade.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce soir, c'est ma fête de départ, et demain ce sera ma fête de bienvenue.
target_text: Mangaribi ya leo, itakuwa sherehe yangu ya kulaga, na kesho itakuwa sherehe ya kunitakia ujio mwema.
target_text_raw: Mangaribi ya leo, itakuwa sherehe yangu ya kulaga, na kesho itakuwa sherehe ya kunitakia ujio mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peter boit beaucoup trop de café.
target_text: Peter anakunywaka kahawa mingi.
target_text_raw: Peter anakunywaka kahawa mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les soldats doivent obéir à leur commandant.
target_text: Waaskari wanapashwa kutii commandant wabo.
target_text_raw: Waaskari wanapashwa kutii commandant wabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes parents ne me laissaient pas sortir avec les garçons.
target_text: Wazazi wangu hawakukuwaka naniruhusu nitoke na ba garcons.
target_text_raw: Wazazi wangu hawakukuwaka naniruhusu nitoke na ba garcons.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ici, chacun se sent respecté et aimé.
target_text: Hapa, kila mtu anajisikia kuheshimiwa na kupendwa.
target_text_raw: Hapa, kila mtu anajisikia kuheshimiwa na kupendwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Excusez-moi, pourriez vous m'indiquer le chemin vers l'arrêt du bus ?
target_text: Samahani, unaweza nionesha njia ya kwenda fasi ya kungojelea bisi?
target_text_raw: Samahani, unaweza nionesha njia ya kwenda fasi ya kungojelea bisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Félicitations pour votre diplôme !
target_text: Hongera kwa cheti chako cha masomo.
target_text_raw: Hongera kwa cheti (diplome) chako cha masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tenez fermement cette échelle.
target_text: Mukamate iyi ngazi nguvu sana.
target_text_raw: Mukamate iyi ngazi nguvu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'auriez pas pu choisir un meilleur moment.
target_text: Hamungeweza chagula muda muzuri zaidi.
target_text_raw: Hamungeweza chagula muda muzuri zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu m'expliquer pourquoi tu ne l'aimes pas ?
target_text: Unaweza niambia juu ya nini haumupendaki?
target_text_raw: Unaweza niambia juu ya nini haumupendaki?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le colonel avait le défaut de ne jamais croire un seul mot de ce que disaient les femmes.
target_text: Kanali alikuwa na ulema ya kutoamini hata neno moja katika yale wanamuke walikuwa nasema.
target_text_raw: Kanali alikuwa na ulema ya kutoamini hata neno moja katika yale wanamuke walikuwa nasema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est quelqu'un au FBI.
target_text: Ni mtu mkubwa mu FBI.
target_text_raw: Ni mtu mkubwa mu FBI.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'énergie et le dynamisme sont des qualités des hommes que l'on voit souvent célébrer pour la première fois lors de leur mise à la retraite.
target_text: Juhudi na nguvu ni sifa za wananaume zenye mara mingi zinasherekewa kwa mara ya kwanza wakati wanaacha kazi.
target_text_raw: Juhudi na nguvu ni sifa za wananaume zenye mara mingi zinasherekewa kwa mara ya kwanza wakati wanaacha kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, je pense que je ne pourrais pas être d'un grand secours.
target_text: Kwa bahati mubaya, minawaza kama sitakuwa msaada ya kutosha kwako.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati mubaya, minawaza kama sitakuwa msaada ya kutosha kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le directeur serra la main à chacun des diplômés.
target_text: Kiongozi alipatia mukono kila mwenye alipata cheti.
target_text_raw: Kiongozi alipatia mukono kila mwenye alipata cheti (diplome).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On peut sûrement trouver un taxi à la gare.
target_text: Ni sherti taxi ipatikane ku fasi ya kungojelea ma gari.
target_text_raw: Ni sherti taxi ipatikane ku fasi ya kungojelea ma gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun se mit en position.
target_text: Kila mtu alijitayarisha.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu alijitayarisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne te laisserai pas t'échapper.
target_text: Sitakuacha utoroke.
target_text_raw: Sitakuacha utoroke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec la venue du printemps, tout revient progressivement à la vie.
target_text: Wakati musimu ya printemps inarudia, maisha inarudia pole pole.
target_text_raw: Wakati musimu (saison) ya printemps inarudia, maisha inarudia pole pole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'hydroxyde de sodium est utilisé dans la fabrication des savons.
target_text: Hidroxyde ya sodium inatumiwa kwa kutengeneza sabuni.
target_text_raw: Hidroxyde ya sodium inatumiwa kwa kutengeneza sabuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec deux lignes d'écriture d'un homme, on peut faire le procès du plus innocent.
target_text: Na mistari miwili ya mwandiko kutoka kwa mtu, tunaweza kufanya kesi ya mtu asiye kuwa na hatia.
target_text_raw: Na mistari miwili ya mwandiko kutoka kwa mtu, tunaweza kufanya kesi ya mtu asiye kuwa na hatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à me souvenir du code secret.
target_text: Sikumbuki hata mot de passe.
target_text_raw: Sikumbuki hata mot de passe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il effaça son discours de la bande.
target_text: Alivuta hotuba yake mu bande.
target_text_raw: Alivuta hotuba yake mu bande.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis vraiment désolé d'être revenu si tard à la maison.
target_text: Samahani kabisa kuona nimerudia ku nyumba nyuma hivi.
target_text_raw: Samahani kabisa kuona nimerudia ku nyumba nyuma hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez une fille, faites la cour à la mère.
target_text: Kama unataka kuwa kwenye uhusiano wa kimapenzi na binti, utongoze mama yake.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka kuwa kwenye uhusiano wa kimapenzi na binti, utongoze mama yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne comprenez pas ce qui se produit.
target_text: Hausikie kitu kinacho endelea.
target_text_raw: Hausikie kitu kinacho endelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Cinq ! " Dit Alex.
target_text: " Tano! "Anasema Alex.
target_text_raw: " Tano! "Anasema Alex.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il déclare n'avoir aucun souvenir de la soirée.
target_text: Anasema hakumbuki ata kitu moja iliyo tokea jana mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Anasema hakumbuki ata kitu moja iliyo tokea jana mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle arrivera à 2h30 et Marie arrivera un peu plus tard.
target_text: Atafika na saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Maria atafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Atafika na saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Maria atafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle m'a envoyé une carte postale qui disait qu'elle détestait l'odeur des animaux.
target_text: Alinitumana carte postale yenye ilikuwa nasema kama anachukiaka harufu ya minyama.
target_text_raw: Alinitumana carte postale yenye ilikuwa nasema kama anachukiaka harufu ya minyama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour autant que je sache, ils tiennent toujours leur parole.
target_text: Ninacho juwa ni kwamba, wanazingatia neno lao siku zote.
target_text_raw: Ninacho juwa ni kwamba, wanazingatia neno lao siku zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne savez pas, jusqu'à ce que vous ayez un enfant, quelle douleur vous pouvez ressentir lorsque quelque chose leur arrive.
target_text: Haujui, mpaka wakati utakuwa na mtoto, maumivu gani unaweza sikia wakati kitu inawafikia.
target_text_raw: Haujui, mpaka wakati utakuwa na mtoto, maumivu gani unaweza sikia wakati kitu inawafikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parie que tu es occupée.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama hauna muda juu ya kazi mingi.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama hauna muda juu ya kazi mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'as le droit de dire que c'est nul.
target_text: Uko na haki ya kusema kama ni kitu yenye haina maana.
target_text_raw: Uko na haki ya kusema kama ni kitu yenye haina maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils se sont rencontrés à une rencontre surprise.
target_text: Walikutananaka mu hali ya kushitukia.
target_text_raw: Walikutananaka mu hali ya kushitukia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais nous savons qu'il a de bonnes intentions.
target_text: Lakini tunajua kama wako na nia nzuri.
target_text_raw: Lakini tunajua kama wako na nia nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un brave officier n’est jamais de trop.
target_text: Kukuwa askari mkubwa shujaa haiyakuwaka mubaya.
target_text_raw: Kukuwa askari mkubwa shujaa haiyakuwaka mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui court le plus vite, Ken ou Tony ?
target_text: Nani njo anakimbiaka mbio, Ken ao Tony?
target_text_raw: Nani njo anakimbiaka mbio, Ken ao Tony?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devrais épouser quelqu'un que tu aimes.
target_text: Unapashwa kuowa mwenye unapenda.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kuowa mwenye unapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut faire attention lorsque l'on écrit les réponses lors d'un test.
target_text: Unapashwa fanya angalisho wakati uko unaandika majibu ya mashindano.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa fanya angalisho wakati uko unaandika majibu ya mashindano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'aristocratie se retrouve également dans le monde moral. Les roturiers paient avec ce qu'ils font, les nobles avec ce qu'ils sont.
target_text: Mfumo wa kitwala ya aristocratie inapatikana pia katika ulimwengu wa tabia na roho nzuri. Raia wa kawaida wanalipaka kutokana na kazi yao, matajiri wanalipaka kutokana na gisi wako.
target_text_raw: Mfumo wa kitwala ya aristocratie inapatikana pia katika ulimwengu wa tabia na roho nzuri. Raia wa kawaida wanalipaka kutokana na kazi yao, matajiri wanalipaka kutokana na gisi wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont fait arranger la voiture.
target_text: Walitengenezesha gari.
target_text_raw: Walitengenezesha gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ancien directeur est en disgrâce.
target_text: Kiongozi wa zamani iko mu hali ya aibu.
target_text_raw: Kiongozi wa zamani iko mu hali ya aibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais que cette rencontre ne dure pas plus de vingt minutes.
target_text: Ningependa iyi mkutano isifanye zaidi ya dakika makumi mbili.
target_text_raw: Ningependa iyi mkutano isifanye zaidi ya dakika makumi mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Stop !
target_text: Acha!
target_text_raw: Acha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Autrefois, les enfants jouaient encore à la corde à sauter.
target_text: Zamani, batoto balikuwa banacheza muchezo ya kuruka kamba.
target_text_raw: Zamani, batoto balikuwa banacheza muchezo ya kuruka kamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a des fois où ce garnement me ferait tourner en bourrique !
target_text: Piko wakati huyu bukaramusi itanifanyaka kuwa duru!
target_text_raw: Piko wakati huyu bukaramusi itanifanyaka kuwa duru!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait contrôler ma vision.
target_text: Nilipimisha macho yangu.
target_text_raw: Nilipimisha macho yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez d'avancer.
target_text: Muendelee.
target_text_raw: Muendelee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jules est mort avec un couteau dans le dos.
target_text: Jules alikufa kwa kupigwa kisu mu mugongo.
target_text_raw: Jules alikufa kwa kupigwa kisu mu mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En voulez-vous un simple ou un double ?
target_text: Unataka ya kawaida ao ya mbili?
target_text_raw: Unataka ya kawaida ao ya mbili?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sentis que je devais simplement descendre du bateau.
target_text: Nilisikia kama nilipashwa tu kushuka mu mashua.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia kama nilipashwa tu kushuka mu mashua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'avais l'habitude de jouer avec un couple de garçons.
target_text: Nilikuwa na tabia ya kucheza na ba garcons bawili bawili.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa na tabia ya kucheza na ba garcons bawili bawili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Madame Grégoire venait de descendre à la cuisine, en pantoufles et en peignoir de flanelle.
target_text: Bibi ya Gregoire alishuka mu mafiga, anavala biato ya pantoufles na kitambala mu kichwa.
target_text_raw: Bibi ya Gregoire alishuka mu mafiga, anavala biato ya pantoufles na kitambala mu kichwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a atteint la cible.
target_text: Aligusa kitu yenye alikuwa na vizia.
target_text_raw: Aligusa kitu yenye alikuwa na vizia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet album me rappelle mes joyeux jours d'école.
target_text: Iyi album inanikumbusha wakati muzuri ya zamani tulipokuwa ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Iyi album inanikumbusha wakati muzuri ya zamani tulipokuwa ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trouvez un emploi !
target_text: Tafuta kazi!
target_text_raw: Tafuta kazi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut dégager immédiatement la piste d'atterrissage.
target_text: Inaomba kutoka haraka fasi kwenye ndege inashukiaka.
target_text_raw: Inaomba kutoka haraka fasi kwenye ndege inashukiaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Monter à cheval est très marrant.
target_text: Kupanda ku farasi ni kitu ya kufurahisha.
target_text_raw: Kupanda ku farasi ni kitu ya kufurahisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a un bon nombre de raisons pour lesquelles vous ne devriez pas le faire.
target_text: Kuko sababu mingi zenye zinaweza tuma usiifanye.
target_text_raw: Kuko sababu mingi zenye zinaweza tuma usiifanye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je refuse de t'adresser la parole !
target_text: Minakatala kukusemesha.
target_text_raw: Minakatala kukusemesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand vous aurez écrit votre nom, mettez aussi la date.
target_text: Ukimaliza andika jina yako, utie na tarehe.
target_text_raw: Ukimaliza andika jina yako, utie na tarehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'as-tu tuée ?
target_text: Ulimuua?
target_text_raw: Ulimuua?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis rentré un peu tard, cette nuit.
target_text: Nilirudia nyuma kidogo, iyi busiku.
target_text_raw: Nilirudia nyuma kidogo, iyi busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez présenter vos excuses.
target_text: Ulipashwa kulomba musamaha.
target_text_raw: Ulipashwa kulomba musamaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-il vrai que l'amour et la haine sont très proches l'un de l'autre ?
target_text: Ni kweli upendo na chuki binakaribiana sana?
target_text_raw: Ni kweli upendo na chuki binakaribiana sana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu t'y rends par le bus, tu peux y être dans environ le tiers du temps.
target_text: Ukienda ako na bisi, unaweza fika ile wakati kugabula amo mara tatu.
target_text_raw: Ukienda ako na bisi, unaweza fika ile wakati kugabula amo mara tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était couché sur le dos.
target_text: Alikuwa analalia mugongo.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa analalia mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Apparemment, il comprend ce que nous disons en finnois.
target_text: Inaonekana kama iko nasikia tunayo ongea mu luga ya finnois.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana kama iko nasikia tunayo ongea mu luga ya finnois.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le vieillard est totalement aveugle d'un œil et voit très mal de l'autre.
target_text: Mzee ni kipofu wa licho moja kabisa na anaona na ile ingine licho kwa shida.
target_text_raw: Mzee ni kipofu wa licho moja kabisa na anaona na ile ingine licho kwa shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les garçons sont partis en courant.
target_text: Ba garcons yote balienda banakimbia.
target_text_raw: Ba garcons yote balienda banakimbia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous remercie, adieu !
target_text: Minakushukuru, kwa heri!
target_text_raw: Minakushukuru, kwa heri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te remercie du fond du cœur.
target_text: Minakushukuru kutoka ndani ya roho yangu.
target_text_raw: Minakushukuru kutoka ndani ya roho yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cessez de rêver et ouvrez les yeux.
target_text: Acha kulota na ufungule macho.
target_text_raw: Acha kulota na ufungule macho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier on a passé une soirée super avec mes frères et mes amis, et le barbeuc était trop bon aussi.
target_text: Jana tulipitisha mangaribi muzuri na wandugu na marafiki zangu, na barbecue ilikuwa ya muzuri sana pia.
target_text_raw: Jana tulipitisha mangaribi muzuri na wandugu na marafiki zangu, na barbecue (nyama za kuchomewa) ilikuwa ya muzuri sana pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des recherches ont montré que l'hygiène des mains est un moyen de lutte efficace contre les épidémies de gastro-entérite.
target_text: Utafiti ilionesha kama usafi wa mikono ni njia ya kupiganisha magonjwa za tumbu.
target_text_raw: Utafiti ilionesha kama usafi wa mikono ni njia ya kupiganisha magonjwa za tumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était un brave soldat.
target_text: Alikuwa askari shujaa.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa askari shujaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai eu de la chance que le train ait du retard. Sinon je l'aurais raté.
target_text: Nilipata bahati kuona gari la moshi ilichelewa. Bila vile singeipata.
target_text_raw: Nilipata bahati kuona gari la moshi ilichelewa. Bila vile singeipata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez le jeu en pause.
target_text: Mu stopper kwanza muchezo.
target_text_raw: Mu stopper kwanza muchezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On lui a poliment dit que sa présence n'était pas la bienvenue.
target_text: Walimuambia kwa adabu kama hawakuwa nataka afike.
target_text_raw: Walimuambia kwa adabu kama hawakuwa nataka afike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En bref, il s'est enfui sans payer ses dettes.
target_text: Kwa kifupi, alikimbia bila kulipa ma deni zake.
target_text_raw: Kwa kifupi, alikimbia bila kulipa ma deni zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pardon. J'ai failli ne pas réussir à venir ici.
target_text: Samahani. Nilitaka shindwa kufika hapa.
target_text_raw: Samahani. Nilitaka shindwa kufika hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai marre de tes excuses.
target_text: Nilishachoka na misamaha yako.
target_text_raw: Nilishachoka na misamaha yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Essaie d’expliquer en gros de quoi ça parlait.
target_text: Pima kufasiria kwa kirefu ilikuwa nahusu nini.
target_text_raw: Pima kufasiria kwa kirefu ilikuwa nahusu nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens de faire nettoyer ce costume.
target_text: Minaliza kusukulisha iyi koti.
target_text_raw: Minaliza kusukulisha iyi koti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'éléphant a été amené au zoo.
target_text: Balibeba tembo ku zoo.
target_text_raw: Balibeba tembo ku zoo (mahali minyama wanaishi).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Si l'argent n'amène pas la paix, rends-le.", a dit Jules Renard.
target_text: "Kama pesa hazilete amani, zirudishe." alisema Jules Renard.
target_text_raw: "Kama pesa hazilete amani, zirudishe." alisema Jules Renard.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi tu m'appelles comme ça ?
target_text: Juu ya nini unaniita hivi ?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini unaniita hivi ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être viendra-t-elle demain ; peut-être n'est elle pas venue hier justement car demain elle aura plus de temps libre.
target_text: Labda atakuya kesho, labda akukuya jana kwa sababu kesho atakuwa na wakati ya mingi zaidi.
target_text_raw: Labda atakuya kesho, labda akukuya jana kwa sababu kesho atakuwa na wakati ya mingi zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai décidé de me reposer un peu avant de reprendre le travail.
target_text: Niliamuwa kupumuzika kidogo mbele niendeleshe kazi.
target_text_raw: Niliamuwa kupumuzika kidogo mbele niendeleshe kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai à nouveau fait ce rêve étrange, la nuit passée.
target_text: Nililota tena ndoto ya ajabu, busiku ya jana.
target_text_raw: Nililota tena ndoto ya ajabu, busiku ya jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas quand je pourrai te rembourser l'argent que je te dois.
target_text: Sijui wakati ndakulipa pesa zako zenye niko nazo.
target_text_raw: Sijui wakati ndakulipa pesa zako zenye niko nazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle formidable coïncidence !
target_text: Ni suprise nzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Ni suprise nzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est allée se faire couper les cheveux.
target_text: Alienda kujinyolesha nywele.
target_text_raw: Alienda kujinyolesha nywele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est cet imbécile qui a jeté ses chaussettes dans les toilettes ?
target_text: Ni pumbavu gani njo alitupa chokse zake mu toilette?
target_text_raw: Ni pumbavu gani njo alitupa chokse (chaussettes) zake mu toilette (wc)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a accepté le job.
target_text: Aliitika ile kazi.
target_text_raw: Aliitika ile kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne devriez pas compter sur l'aide d'autres personnes.
target_text: Haungepashwa tumainia watu wengine.
target_text_raw: Haungepashwa tumainia watu wengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils attachèrent les mains de Pinocchio dans son dos et lui passèrent le nœud autour du cou.
target_text: Balifungia Pinocchio mikono mu mugongo yake na wakamuzungulusha kamba mu shingo.
target_text_raw: Balifungia Pinocchio mikono mu mugongo yake na wakamuzungulusha kamba mu shingo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu en train de suggérer que nous nous fassions passer pour des agents de police ?
target_text: Uko nashauri tujifanye kama watu wa polisi?
target_text_raw: Uko nashauri tujifanye kama watu wa polisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a fini par devenir une star du cinéma.
target_text: Alifikia kuwa muigizaji mukubwa wa filamu.
target_text_raw: Alifikia kuwa muigizaji mukubwa wa filamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te laisse pas tromper. Il fait seulement semblant d'être amoureux de toi.
target_text: Usidanganyike. Anajifanya kama anakupenda.
target_text_raw: Usidanganyike. Anajifanya kama anakupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas eu de tes nouvelles. Je me demandais si peut-être mon courrier électronique ne t'était jamais parvenu.
target_text: Sikupata habari zako. Nilikuwa najiuliza kama email yangu haikukufikiaka.
target_text_raw: Sikupata habari zako. Nilikuwa najiuliza kama email yangu haikukufikiaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Adam fut le premier brouillon pour Ève.
target_text: Adamu alikuwa brouillon ya kwanza ya Eva.
target_text_raw: Adamu alikuwa brouillon ya kwanza ya Eva.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La main faute, le dos paie.
target_text: Mkono inafanyaka kosa, mugongo inalipa.
target_text_raw: Mkono inafanyaka kosa, mugongo inalipa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, l'ambulance est arrivé trop tard.
target_text: Kwa bahati mubaya, ambulance ilikuya nyuma sana.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati mubaya, ambulance ilikuya nyuma sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez dit que vous alliez le gérer.
target_text: Ulisema utaishurulikia.
target_text_raw: Ulisema utaishurulikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été en Italie dans le cadre d'un programme d'échange.
target_text: Nilikuwa Italia ili kuhuzuria kwenye mpango ya kubadilisha mawazo.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa Italia ili kuhuzuria kwenye mpango ya kubadilisha mawazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce vaisseau spatial est propulsé par un moteur ionique.
target_text: Iyi chombo ya angani inatumia moteur ionique.
target_text_raw: Iyi chombo ya angani inatumia moteur ionique.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne bougez plus !
target_text: Usitingizike!
target_text_raw: Usitingizike!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qu'il fout ici ?
target_text: Iko nafanya nini hapa?
target_text_raw: Iko nafanya nini hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir se coucher de bonne heure et se lever tôt.
target_text: Inaombwa kulala mbele ya wakati kusudi ili kulamuka mapema.
target_text_raw: Inaombwa kulala mbele ya wakati kusudi ili kulamuka mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le point de fusion d'un alliage eutectique est atteint à plus faible température que la température de fusion respective de chacun des matériaux pris séparément.
target_text: Kiwango ya kuyeyuka ya muchanganyiko wa chini inafikiaka kwa température ya chini kuliko température ya muyayuko ya kila moja ya vifaa yenye ilikamatwa mu hali tafauti.
target_text_raw: Kiwango ya kuyeyuka ya muchanganyiko wa chini inafikiaka kwa température ya chini kuliko température ya muyayuko ya kila moja ya vifaa yenye ilikamatwa mu hali tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous l'avons trouvée vivante.
target_text: Tulimukutana ni mzima.
target_text_raw: Tulimukutana ni mzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vous ai pas vus jusqu'à présent.
target_text: Siyakuona mpaka hivi.
target_text_raw: Siyakuona mpaka hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sans air, les être vivants ne pourraient vivre.
target_text: Bila hewa, viumbe haviwezi ishi.
target_text_raw: Bila hewa, viumbe haviwezi ishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a personne qui prendra soin d'elle.
target_text: Hakuna mwenye atamushurulikia.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwenye atamushurulikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux aller à la fac.
target_text: Nitaenda ku chuo kikuu.
target_text_raw: Nitaenda ku chuo kikuu (université).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est votre réel objectif ?
target_text: Shaba kabisa ni nini?
target_text_raw: Shaba kabisa ni nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père a acheté du terrain avec l'intention de construire une maison.
target_text: Baba yangu aliuza kiwanja na nia ya kujenga nyumba.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu aliuza kiwanja na nia ya kujenga nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas, il est fiable.
target_text: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, ni mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, ni mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a posé un lapin; je l'ai attendu toute la soirée !
target_text: Alinialika na hakukuya, nilimungoya mangaribi yote!
target_text_raw: Alinialika na hakukuya, nilimungoya mangaribi yote!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une corde dans le coffre.
target_text: Niko na kamba mu coffre.
target_text_raw: Niko na kamba mu coffre.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le travail à temps partiel de ma femme ramène un peu d'argent supplémentaire.
target_text: Kazi ya muda kidogo ya mke wangu inaleta pesa kidogo za ziada.
target_text_raw: Kazi ya muda kidogo ya mke wangu inaleta pesa kidogo za ziada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas se cache dans le garage.
target_text: Thomas anajificha mu garage.
target_text_raw: Thomas anajificha mu garage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'avez pas à vous inquiéter.
target_text: Usikuwe na wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soyons raisonnables et ne parlons que des faits !
target_text: Tutumikishe akili na tuongelee mambo ya kweli!
target_text_raw: Tutumikishe akili na tuongelee mambo ya kweli!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bâtiment que vous voyez là est un usine automobile.
target_text: Ile nyumba unaona pale ni kiwanda ya kutengeneza ma gari.
target_text_raw: Ile nyumba unaona pale ni kiwanda ya kutengeneza ma gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas était enchanté.
target_text: Thomas alifurahi sana.
target_text_raw: Thomas alifurahi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous des gosses ?
target_text: Uko na watoto wadogo
target_text_raw: Uko na watoto wadogo
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous assure que j'ai pris cette possibilité en considération.
target_text: Minakuhakikishia kama nilifikiria iyi uwezekano.
target_text_raw: Minakuhakikishia kama nilifikiria iyi uwezekano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est allée directement au lit.
target_text: Alienda ku kitanda mara moja.
target_text_raw: Alienda ku kitanda mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je descends, je te mets un coup de boule !
target_text: Nikishuka, nitakupiga ngumi!
target_text_raw: Nikishuka, nitakupiga ngumi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que vous savez ce que vous devriez faire.
target_text: Minawaza kama unajua kitu yenye ulipashwa fanya.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama unajua kitu yenye ulipashwa fanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils explorèrent le désert à la recherche du trésor enfoui.
target_text: Walichunguza ndani ya jangwa kwa kutafuta kwenye hazina ilifichwa.
target_text_raw: Walichunguza ndani ya jangwa kwa kutafuta kwenye hazina ilifichwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un changement de décor ne me ferait vraiment pas de mal !
target_text: Kama rangi ya nyumba inabadirishwa haitanichukiza kabisa.
target_text_raw: Kama rangi ya nyumba inabadirishwa haitanichukiza kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux exprimer ce que je ressens.
target_text: Siwezi kuelezea gisi minajisikia.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kuelezea gisi minajisikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense pouvoir atteindre la branche si vous me donnez une impulsion.
target_text: Minawaza kama ndaweza fikia kamaba kama unaniambia namna ya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama ndaweza fikia kamaba kama unaniambia namna ya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses chaussures blanches laissent des traces de couleur rouge foncé.
target_text: Biato yake ya mweupe binaacha alama za rangi mwekundu.
target_text_raw: Biato yake ya mweupe binaacha alama za rangi mwekundu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les passagers prièrent qu'elle appelle le capitaine et que celui-ci explique les conséquences de l'avarie.
target_text: Wasafiri waliomba amuite capitaine kusudi afasirie vinyume ya uharibifu.
target_text_raw: Wasafiri waliomba amuite capitaine kusudi afasirie vinyume ya uharibifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens de m'acheter une voiture qui m'a coûté la peau des fesses.
target_text: Natoka uza gari ya bei sana.
target_text_raw: Natoka uza gari ya bei sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est restée figée comme si elle avait vu un fantôme.
target_text: Alibakia kimya sawa vile aliona muzimu.
target_text_raw: Alibakia kimya sawa vile aliona muzimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut juste que tu regardes ce que je fais.
target_text: Inaombwa tu uangalie byenye niko nfanya.
target_text_raw: Inaombwa tu uangalie byenye niko nfanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons débarrasser le pays des drogues.
target_text: Tunapashwa ondoa madwa ya kulevya mu inchi.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa ondoa madwa ya kulevya mu inchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève les bicyclettes du trottoir !
target_text: Tosha kinga mu njia!
target_text_raw: Tosha kinga mu njia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louise a un corps fantastique.
target_text: Louise iko na mwili ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Louise iko na mwili ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le son que vous entendez quand tout est silencieux.
target_text: Njo sauti yenye unasikiaka wakati kila kitu kiko kimya.
target_text_raw: Njo sauti yenye unasikiaka wakati kila kitu kiko kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cours plus vite, sinon tu vas manquer le train.
target_text: Kimbia tena zaidi, kama sivyo utakosa gari la moshi.
target_text_raw: Kimbia tena zaidi, kama sivyo utakosa gari la moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre misère comme la mienne vous aura donné sans doute la mesure de ce que valent les hommes : il faut se servir d’eux comme on se sert des chevaux de poste.
target_text: Umaskini yako kawa vile yangu itakusaidia kujua watu ni nini : inaomba kuwatumia kawa bile farasi za ku poste zinatumikishiwaka.
target_text_raw: Umaskini yako kawa vile yangu itakusaidia kujua watu ni nini : inaomba kuwatumia kawa bile farasi za ku poste zinatumikishiwaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à croire que je regardais cette émission.
target_text: Siamini kama nilikuwaka naangalia iki kipindi.
target_text_raw: Siamini kama nilikuwaka naangalia iki kipindi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ken appelait Tom "la souris".
target_text: Ken alikuwa anaita Tom "panya".
target_text_raw: Ken alikuwa anaita Tom "panya".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est promis au musulman qui accomplit toutes les prières obligatoires le bien-être en ce monde éphémère et dans l'au-delà, le séjour au paradis.
target_text: Muislamu mwenyi kufanya sala zote zinazo lazimishwa anaahidiwa maisha mema katika iyi dunia ya kupita na katika maisha ya milele, kuingia paradiso.
target_text_raw: Muislamu mwenyi kufanya sala zote zinazo lazimishwa anaahidiwa maisha mema katika iyi dunia ya kupita na katika maisha ya milele, kuingia paradiso.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne restez pas plantés là ! Aidez-moi à le nettoyer !
target_text: Musibakie munashimama pale. Nisaidie kuisukula!
target_text_raw: Musibakie munashimama pale. Nisaidie kuisukula!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chromosomes de nos cellules contiennent l'ensemble de notre matériel génétique.
target_text: Chembe chembe ya cellules zetu zinakuwa na kila kitu kinacho unda matériel génétique yetu.
target_text_raw: Chembe chembe ya cellules zetu zinakuwa na kila kitu kinacho unda matériel génétique yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie c'est ce qui se passe pendant que tu es occupée à faire d'autres plans.
target_text: Maisha ni kile kinacho fanyika wakati uko na tayarisha mipango ingine.
target_text_raw: Maisha ni kile kinacho fanyika wakati uko na tayarisha mipango ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il croit en la superstition disant que 13 est un nombre qui porte malheur.
target_text: Anaaminia ile inayosemwa kwamba 13 ni namba inayo leta mikoshi.
target_text_raw: Anaaminia ile inayosemwa kwamba 13 ni namba inayo leta mikoshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me souviens encore — et plus rien ne m'importe — de ces jours à la lumière si douce, qui me laissaient toujours, comme souvenir, quelque nouveau jouet à la porte.
target_text: Ningali nakumbuka - na hakuna kinacho nisumbua tena - hizi siku za mwangaza muzuri, zenye zilikuwa zinaniachia siku zote, kama vile ukumbusho, vifaa ya mupya ya kuchezesha ku mlango.
target_text_raw: Ningali nakumbuka - na hakuna kinacho nisumbua tena - hizi siku za mwangaza muzuri, zenye zilikuwa zinaniachia siku zote, kama vile ukumbusho, vifaa ya mupya ya kuchezesha ku mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai le sentiment que vous ne voulez pas vraiment que je conduise.
target_text: Niko nasikia sawa hautaki kabisa nitembeze.
target_text_raw: Niko nasikia sawa hautaki kabisa nitembeze.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne pourrez probablement pas faire cela.
target_text: Haungefanya hata vile.
target_text_raw: Haungefanya hata vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espérais un peu que tu viennes seule.
target_text: Minatumaini kidogo kama utakuya wepeke.
target_text_raw: Minatumaini kidogo kama utakuya wepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous l'avez fait au vu et au su du personnel.
target_text: Iliifanya mbele na wafanyakazi.
target_text_raw: Iliifanya mbele na wafanyakazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre foyer est aussi le vôtre.
target_text: Jamaa yetu ni yako pia.
target_text_raw: Jamaa yetu ni yako pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas de train direct. Vous devez changer à Paris.
target_text: Hakuna gari la moshi ya kwenda moja kwa moja. Unapashwa badilishia Paris.
target_text_raw: Hakuna gari la moshi ya kwenda moja kwa moja. Unapashwa badilishia Paris.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes arrivés à 2h30 et Marie est arrivée un peu plus tard.
target_text: Tulifika na saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie alifika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Tulifika na saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie alifika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au lieu que chacun utilise un système de traitement de texte différent, tout le monde devrait utiliser le même.
target_text: Kuliko kila mtu atumikishe namna tafauti ya kuandika ku ordinateur, watu wote wanapashwa tumikisha namna iyo iyo namna.
target_text_raw: Kuliko kila mtu atumikishe namna tafauti ya kuandika ku ordinateur, watu wote wanapashwa tumikisha namna iyo iyo namna.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles ont appelé leurs chats Jules et Jerry.
target_text: Waliita pusi zao Jules na Jerry.
target_text_raw: Waliita pusi zao Jules na Jerry.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qu'on répète le plus, ce ne sont pas les vérités, mais les mensonges.
target_text: Mara mingi kinacho ruduliwa sana, hakizoweyi kuwa cha kweli, lakini ni uongo.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi kinacho ruduliwa sana, hakizoweyi kuwa cha kweli, lakini ni uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi perdre la moitié de sa vie à dormir pendant la nuit alors qu'on pourrait utiliser tout ce temps à se reposer ?
target_text: Kwa nini mtu kupoteza nusu ya maisha mtu analala busiku ijapokuwa iyi muda inaweza tumikishwa kwa kupumuzika.
target_text_raw: Kwa nini mtu kupoteza nusu ya maisha mtu analala busiku ijapokuwa iyi muda inaweza tumikishwa kwa kupumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ainsi disait l'âne: laisse-moi seulement poser mes lèvres sur l'orge.
target_text: "Uniache tu nitie midomo yangu ku mayani", alisema punda.
target_text_raw: "Uniache tu nitie midomo yangu ku mayani", alisema punda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu te rends compte de ce que tu me demandes de faire?
target_text: Unaelewa chenye uko naniomba nifanye?
target_text_raw: Unaelewa chenye uko naniomba nifanye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai cru entendre une explosion.
target_text: Niliwaza minasikia muripuko.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza minasikia muripuko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'en dois une, Scott.
target_text: Minabakia mu deni yako, Scott.
target_text_raw: Minabakia mu deni yako, Scott.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vous laisserai plus me donner des ordres.
target_text: Sitakuruhusu unipatie maagizo.
target_text_raw: Sitakuruhusu unipatie maagizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je déteste que tu fasses semblant de ne pas me connaître.
target_text: Minachukiaka wakati unajifanyaka sawa vile mwenye haunijui.
target_text_raw: Minachukiaka wakati unajifanyaka sawa vile mwenye haunijui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour l'un de nos clients, une entreprise internationale de production de haute technologie, je suis à la recherche d'un spécialiste en applications expérimenté.
target_text: Kwa mumoja wa wateja wetu, kampuni ya kimataifa ya kiteknolojia ya yulu, niko natafuta mutaalaamu mwenye kuwa na uzoefu wa ku créer ma applications.
target_text_raw: Kwa mumoja wa wateja wetu, kampuni ya kimataifa ya kiteknolojia ya yulu, niko natafuta mutaalaamu mwenye kuwa na uzoefu wa ku créer ma applications.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez sortir d'ici, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Unataka toka hapa, si vile?
target_text_raw: Unataka toka hapa, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La réception reçoit les appels téléphoniques.
target_text: Huduma ya réception inapokeaka mwenye kuita ku simu.
target_text_raw: Huduma ya réception inapokeaka mwenye kuita ku simu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me rappelles quelqu'un.
target_text: Unanikumbusha mtu umoja ivi.
target_text_raw: Unanikumbusha mtu umoja ivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les dossiers sont manquants.
target_text: Piko ma dossiers zenye zinakosa.
target_text_raw: Piko ma dossiers zenye zinakosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serais ravie s'ils me demandaient de prononcer un discours.
target_text: Ndafurahi wakiniambia nitoe hotuba.
target_text_raw: Ndafurahi wakiniambia nitoe hotuba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kate est plus maligne que n'importe quel autre élève de notre classe.
target_text: Kate ni mwerevu kuliko mwanafunzi wote mu darasa yetu.
target_text_raw: Kate ni mwerevu kuliko mwanafunzi wote mu darasa yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce serait un péché que de le gâcher.
target_text: Inaweza kuwa zambi kama unaiharibisha.
target_text_raw: Inaweza kuwa zambi kama unaiharibisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je trouve que Tatoeba, pour nous amis des langues, est devenu un lieu très agréable, en particulier pour tous ceux d'entre nous qui peuvent comprendre et apprendre des langues relativement rapidement et facilement.
target_text: Minaona kama Tatoeba, kwa sisi wapenzi wa luga, ilishakuwa fasi nzuri sana, hasa kwa wamoja kati yetu ambao wanaweza kuelewa na kujifunza luga kwa haraka kwa urahisi.
target_text_raw: Minaona kama Tatoeba, kwa sisi wapenzi wa luga, ilishakuwa fasi nzuri sana, hasa kwa wamoja kati yetu ambao wanaweza kuelewa na kujifunza luga kwa haraka kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est open bar pour les filles jusqu'à minuit le mardi soir.
target_text: Mabinti watatumia pombe kwa bure mpaka saa sita za usiku siku ya pili mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Mabinti watatumia pombe kwa bure mpaka saa sita za usiku siku ya pili mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah ! je meurs, dit Pierrette en tombant sur ses genoux. Qui me sauvera ?
target_text: Ha! Minakufa, Pierrette alisema akiangukia magoti yake. Nani ataniokowa?
target_text_raw: Ha! Minakufa, Pierrette alisema akiangukia magoti yake. Nani ataniokowa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le téléphone sonne. Mais personne ne répond.
target_text: Simu iko inalia. Lakini hakuna mwenye anajibia.
target_text_raw: Simu iko inalia. Lakini hakuna mwenye anajibia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Depuis quand vous êtes en couple, avec ta copine ?
target_text: Muko mu couple tangu wakati gana, weye na rafiki yako wa kike?
target_text_raw: Muko mu couple tangu wakati gana, weye na rafiki yako wa kike?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui sait quel type de métier Enzo souhaiterait exercer quand il sera grand?
target_text: Nani mwenye anajuwa aina gani ya kazi yenye Enzo anapendelea kufanya wakati atakuwa mkubwa?
target_text_raw: Nani mwenye anajuwa aina gani ya kazi yenye Enzo anapendelea kufanya wakati atakuwa mkubwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne laissez pas vos effets personnels sans surveillance.
target_text: Usiache bitu yako binafsi bila kubichunga.
target_text_raw: Usiache bitu yako binafsi bila kubichunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La majorité des algériens soutiennent le régime militaire algérien faute d'avoir un régime islamiste.
target_text: Baazi ya Waaljeria wanaunga mkono utawala wa kialjeria ya kijeshi kwa sababu hakuna serkali ya Kiislamu.
target_text_raw: Baazi ya Waaljeria wanaunga mkono utawala wa kialjeria ya kijeshi kwa sababu hakuna serkali ya Kiislamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il abandonna son rêve de devenir pilote.
target_text: Aliacha ndoto yake ya kukuwa rubani.
target_text_raw: Aliacha ndoto yake ya kukuwa rubani (pilote).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un jour sans rires est un jour perdu.
target_text: Siku bila cheko ni siku ya kukufa bure.
target_text_raw: Siku bila cheko ni siku ya kukufa bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a envoyé le paquet par avion.
target_text: Alitumana ile mzigo kwa ndege.
target_text_raw: Alitumana ile mzigo (colis) kwa ndege (avion).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En raison des risques croissants de complication, le médecin prit la décision de provoquer l'accouchement.
target_text: Kwa sababu ya kuongezeka kwa mataizo ya kiafya, dakatri alikamata uamuzi wa ku poromosha mimba.
target_text_raw: Kwa sababu ya kuongezeka kwa mataizo ya kiafya, dakatri alikamata uamuzi wa ku poromosha mimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si quelqu'un vous dit : "Je me tue à vous le répéter", laissez-le mourir.
target_text: Kama mtu anakwambia: "minajisumbua kuwafasiria mara mingi", umuache akufe.
target_text_raw: Kama mtu anakwambia: "minajisumbua kuwafasiria mara mingi", umuache akufe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, on sait déjà que tu es un gros malin !
target_text: Ndio, tulisha jua kama uko mujanja!
target_text_raw: Ndio, tulisha jua kama uko mujanja!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jour où les extrémistes seront en mesure de détruire la mosquée d'al-Aqsa, les autorités d'occupation ne feront rien pour les empêcher.
target_text: Siku yenye vikundi vyenye kuwa na musimamo mkali wataweza kuharibu msikiti wa al-Aqsa, wakubwa wa inchi hawatafanya kitu chochote kwa kuwazuia.
target_text_raw: Siku yenye vikundi vyenye kuwa na musimamo mkali (wa extrémistes) wataweza kuharibu msikiti wa al-Aqsa, wakubwa wa inchi hawatafanya kitu chochote kwa kuwazuia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est fou comme la Nouvelle Russie ressemble à l'ancienne !
target_text: Ni kitu ya kushangaza kuona Rusia Mpya inafanana na ile ya zamani!
target_text_raw: Ni kitu ya kushangaza kuona Rusia Mpya (Nouvelle Russie) inafanana na ile ya zamani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les filles étaient pavoisées de rubans et de dentelles, les garçons en belle veste propre avaient arboré les chapeaux ronds en soie bleue.
target_text: Mabinti walikuwa napambwa kwa rubans na dentelles, wa garçons walikuwa navala koti nzuri safi na kofia za muviringo za soie ya rangi ya bleu.
target_text_raw: Mabinti walikuwa napambwa kwa rubans na dentelles, wa garçons walikuwa navala koti nzuri safi na kofia za muviringo za soie ya rangi ya bleu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Anna, n'as-tu pas un frère ?
target_text: Anna, hauna kaka?
target_text_raw: Anna, hauna kaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous saviez la vérité, vous seriez surpris.
target_text: Ungekuwa najua ukweli, ungeshangala.
target_text_raw: Ungekuwa najua ukweli, ungeshangala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu le feras à la dure ou à la bonne manière.
target_text: Utaifanya kwa namna ya nguvu ao ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Utaifanya kwa namna ya nguvu ao ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne tirez pas sur ma manche.
target_text: Usikogote mukono ya shati yangu.
target_text_raw: Usikogote mukono ya shati (chemise) yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Montre-moi ton visage, fais-moi entendre ta voix ; car ta voix est douce et charmant ton visage.
target_text: Nioneshe sura yako, nisikilizishe sauti yako, kwa sababu sauti yako ni nyororo na sura yako ni ya kupendeza.
target_text_raw: Nioneshe sura yako, nisikilizishe sauti yako, kwa sababu sauti yako ni nyororo na sura yako ni ya kupendeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mona Lisa a été peinte par Léonard de Vinci.
target_text: Mona Lisa alichorwa na Léonard de Vinci.
target_text_raw: Mona Lisa alichorwa na Léonard de Vinci.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suppose que c'est différent quand vous y pensez à long terme.
target_text: Minazani ni tafauti ukiifiiria kwa muda mrefu.
target_text_raw: Minazani ni tafauti ukiifiiria kwa muda mrefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça ressemble a une blague qui serait devenue réalité.
target_text: Inafanana utani yenye inaweza kuwa kweli.
target_text_raw: Inafanana utani yenye inaweza kuwa kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Respire le bonheur.
target_text: Pumua raha.
target_text_raw: Pumua raha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y avait trois ans que je le connaissais quand il est devenu mon beau-frère.
target_text: Inapita miaka tatu sasa tangu nilimujua wakati aligeuka shemeki yangu.
target_text_raw: Inapita miaka tatu sasa tangu nilimujua wakati aligeuka shemeki yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Emily a un grand sens de l'humour.
target_text: Emily ni mtu wa kuchekesha sana.
target_text_raw: Emily ni mtu wa kuchekesha sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez dû laisser tomber votre téléphone dans votre hâte pour attraper le bus.
target_text: Inawezekana uliangusha telefone yako wakati ulikuwa mu haraka ya kukamata bisi.
target_text_raw: Inawezekana uliangusha telefone yako wakati ulikuwa mu haraka ya kukamata bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous partons immédiatement.
target_text: Tunaenda moja kwa moja
target_text_raw: Tunaenda moja kwa moja
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne te rends compte de la valeur d'une chose qu'après l'avoir perdue.
target_text: Mtu anajuwaka umuhimu ya kitu kisha kukipoteza.
target_text_raw: Mtu anajuwaka umuhimu ya kitu kisha kukipoteza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La femme se dirige vers une rencontre de sorcières.
target_text: Mwanamuke anaelekea kwenye mkutano ya wachawi.
target_text_raw: Mwanamuke anaelekea kwenye mkutano ya wachawi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est le sport que tu aimes le plus regarder ?
target_text: Ni sport gani njo unapendaka angalia zaidi?
target_text_raw: Ni sport (mchezo) gani njo unapendaka angalia zaidi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est doté d'un talent incroyable.
target_text: Iko na kipaji ya ajabu.
target_text_raw: Iko na kipaji ya ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez qu'il revienne.
target_text: Ngoya arudie.
target_text_raw: Ngoya arudie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes un enfant de l'univers, tout autant que les arbres et les étoiles ; vous avez le droit de vous trouver ici.
target_text: Uko mtoto wa ulimwengu, kama vile miti na nyota, uko na haki ya kukuwa hapa.
target_text_raw: Uko mtoto wa ulimwengu, kama vile miti na nyota, uko na haki ya kukuwa hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu te laisses trop dominer par tes émotions.
target_text: Unajiacha kutawaliwa sana na hisia zako.
target_text_raw: Unajiacha kutawaliwa sana na hisia (ma émotions) zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment oses-tu virer un de mes chauffeurs?
target_text: Aye unasubutu kufukuza mumoja ya wa dereva wangu?
target_text_raw: Aye unasubutu kufukuza mumoja ya wa dereva wangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes absolument sûre ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kabisa?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne passez jamais devant un Ecclésiastique que vous ne lui fassiez la révérence, si pauvre et si mal vêtu qu'il puisse être.
target_text: Usijaribu ata siku moja kupita mbele ya mchungaji bila kumupatia heshima zake, hata kama anavala mubaya.
target_text_raw: Usijaribu ata siku moja kupita mbele ya mchungaji bila kumupatia heshima zake, hata kama anavala mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez passer les moindres moments qu'il vous reste avec vos amis.
target_text: Muda kidogo yenye unabakia nayo unapashwa ipitisha na marafiki zako.
target_text_raw: Muda kidogo yenye unabakia nayo unapashwa ipitisha na marafiki zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous serez toujours la bienvenue.
target_text: Utakaribishwa siku zote.
target_text_raw: Utakaribishwa siku zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À présent l'ombre d'un doute lui assombrissait le visage.
target_text: Kwa sasa mashaka inaonekana ku sura yake.
target_text_raw: Kwa sasa mashaka inaonekana ku sura yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’amour est l’histoire de la vie des femmes, c’est un épisode dans la vie des hommes.
target_text: Mapenzi ni hadisi ya maisha ya wanawake, ni kipindi mu maisha ya wanaume.
target_text_raw: Mapenzi ni hadisi ya maisha ya wanawake, ni kipindi mu maisha ya wanaume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le directeur a signé et cacheté votre contrat d'assurance.
target_text: Kiongozi alisaini na kutia muhuri ku contrat yako ya assurance.
target_text_raw: Kiongozi alisaini na kutia muhuri (cachet) ku contrat yako ya assurance.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, la recette du pain « Susie » est un secret bien gardé par Susanne.
target_text: Kwa bahati mubaya, mapishi ya mkate « Susie » ni siri inayo fichwa na Susanne.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati mubaya, mapishi ya mkate « Susie » ni siri inayo fichwa na Susanne.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils voulaient juste me poser quelques questions.
target_text: Alikuwa nataka tu kuniuliza maswali kidogo.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nataka tu kuniuliza maswali kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai longuement réfléchi si je devais réagir, et j'ai finalement décidé de faire quelque chose.
target_text: Nilifikiria kwa muda mrefu kama ningepashwa fanya kitu yoyote, na nikaamua nifanye kitu fulani.
target_text_raw: Nilifikiria kwa muda mrefu kama ningepashwa fanya kitu yoyote, na nikaamua nifanye kitu fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.
