source_text: Si Thomas a besoin d'un coup de main, nous pouvons lui en filer.
target_text: Kama Thomas iko na lazima ya msaada, tunaweza mupatia.
target_text_raw: Kama Thomas iko na lazima ya msaada, tunaweza mupatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a rompu sa parole.
target_text: Alivunja ahadi yake.
target_text_raw: Alivunja ahadi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère qu'elle est saine et sauve.
target_text: Minatumaini kama iko salama.
target_text_raw: Minatumaini kama iko salama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'était pas particulièrement bon élève au lycée.
target_text: Tom hakukuwaka mwanafunzi muzuri kwenye shule ya sekondari.
target_text_raw: Tom hakukuwaka mwanafunzi muzuri kwenye shule ya sekondari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cours vite, ou tu vas rater ton bus.
target_text: Kimbia mbio, kama sivyo utakosa bisi.
target_text_raw: Kimbia mbio, kama sivyo utakosa bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me réserve avec fermeté le droit de me contredire.
target_text: Niko na haki kabisa ya kujipinga.
target_text_raw: Niko na haki kabisa ya kujipinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bienvenue en enfer, Mouammar !
target_text: Karibu kuzimu, Mouammar!
target_text_raw: Karibu kuzimu, Mouammar!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une feuille de chou, pourquoi perds-tu ton temps à lire une cochonnerie pareille ?
target_text: Ni liyani ya chou, kwa nini unapoteza muda wako kusoma kitu ya kijinga kama iyi?
target_text_raw: Ni liyani ya chou, kwa nini unapoteza muda wako kusoma kitu ya kijinga kama iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand je me réveille, j'ai toujours soif.
target_text: Kila nikilamuka, minasikiaka kiu.
target_text_raw: Kila nikilamuka, minasikiaka kiu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouviez compter jusqu'à dix lorsque vous étiez deux.
target_text: Mungeweza kuhesabu mpaka ku kumi wakati mulikuwa wawili.
target_text_raw: Mungeweza kuhesabu mpaka ku kumi wakati mulikuwa wawili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a recouvré la santé : il est donc en mesure de poursuivre ses études.
target_text: Alishapona : kwa hivyo anaweza endelesha masomo yake.
target_text_raw: Alishapona : kwa hivyo anaweza endelesha masomo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avant le mariage, les demoiselles d'honneur sont censées organiser un enterrement de vie de jeune fille pour la mariée.
target_text: Kabla ya ndoa, wadada wasimamizi wanapashwa kuandaa sherehe ya kuzika ujana kwa ajili ya bibi arusi.
target_text_raw: Kabla ya ndoa, wadada wasimamizi (filles d'honneur) wanapashwa kuandaa sherehe ya kuzika ujana (enterrement de vie de jeune fille) kwa ajili ya bibi arusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet homme était un parfait inconnu.
target_text: Uyu mtu alikuwa ajulikani kabisa.
target_text_raw: Uyu mtu alikuwa ajulikani kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous feriez mieux de ne pas veiller trop tard.
target_text: Ungekuwa muzuri musikeshe mpaka nyuma sana.
target_text_raw: Ungekuwa muzuri musikeshe mpaka nyuma sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’ennui fait le fond de la vie, c’est l’ennui qui a inventé les jeux, les distractions, les romans et l’amour.
target_text: Uvuvi ni msingi wa maisha, ni uvuvi njo iliyo unda michezo, burudani, hadisi na mapenzi.
target_text_raw: Uvuvi ni msingi wa maisha, ni uvuvi njo iliyo unda michezo, burudani, hadisi na mapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces Messieurs ont-ils réservé ?
target_text: Hawa wa baba waliwekesha?
target_text_raw: Hawa wa baba waliwekesha (waliagiza)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voilà, ô moines, ceci est mon dernier conseil pour vous, tout dans ce monde est voué au changement ; travaillez avec diligence à votre propre salut.
target_text: Angalia, ooh watawa, iyi ni shauri yangu ya mwisho kwenu, kila kitu hapa chini ya jua kinapashwa badilika; mtumike bidii kwa ajili ya wokovu wenyu wenyewe.
target_text_raw: Angalia, ooh watawa, iyi ni shauri yangu ya mwisho kwenu, kila kitu hapa chini ya jua kinapashwa badilika; mtumike bidii kwa ajili ya wokovu wenyu wenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jusqu'à présent on n'avait trouvé que des fragments, à chaque fois comprenant à peine plus que deux douzaines de signes et souvent davantage gribouillés qu'écrits.
target_text: Mpaka sasa ni vipande tu njo vilikuwa vinapatikana, kila wakati inakuwa na ishara zaidi ya mbili na mara nyingi maandashi haionekani muzuri gisi inatakiwa kuandikwa
target_text_raw: Mpaka sasa ni vipande tu njo vilikuwa vinapatikana, kila wakati inakuwa na ishara zaidi ya mbili na mara nyingi maandashi haionekani muzuri gisi inatakiwa kuandikwa
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jean parlera avec le voisin.
target_text: Jean ataongea na jirani.
target_text_raw: Jean ataongea na jirani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sans risque, pas de récompense.
target_text: Bila kupima, hakuna malipo.
target_text_raw: Bila kupima, hakuna malipo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle m'a dit qu'elle irait à Paris en août.
target_text: Aliniambia kama ataenda Paris mwezi wa munane.
target_text_raw: Aliniambia kama ataenda Paris mwezi wa munane.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom était navré.
target_text: Tom alijuta.
target_text_raw: Tom alijuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le rat, jusqu'à maintenant il était mon copain et maintenant il est parti et il m'a trahi.
target_text: Panya, mpaka leo alikuwa rafiki yangu na sasa anaenda na ananisaliti.
target_text_raw: Panya, mpaka leo alikuwa rafiki yangu na sasa anaenda na ananisaliti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma tante se sent malade.
target_text: Shangazi yangu anajisikia mgonjwa.
target_text_raw: Shangazi yangu anajisikia mgonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu ne t'arrêtes pas, je vais le dire à papa.
target_text: Kama haushimami, nitakuchongea kwa baba.
target_text_raw: Kama haushimami, nitakuchongea kwa baba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas de panique, Dan.
target_text: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, Dan.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, Dan.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rev. King et ses partisans étaient menacés.
target_text: Mch. King na wafuasi wake walitishiwa.
target_text_raw: Mch. King na wafuasi wake walitishiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit que les filles passent plus de temps à se préoccuper de leur apparence que les garçons.
target_text: Inasemekana kwamba mabinti wanapitishaka wakati mingi kushurulikia muonekano yao kuliko wa garçons.
target_text_raw: Inasemekana kwamba mabinti wanapitishaka wakati mingi kushurulikia muonekano yao kuliko wa garçons.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se peut que mon explication soit absolument erronée. Je pense cependant qu'elle est la plus plausible.
target_text: Inawezekana kuwa maelezo yangu siyo ya kweli. Lakini minazani kama njo yenye kuwa na uhakika.
target_text_raw: Inawezekana kuwa maelezo yangu siyo ya kweli. Lakini minazani kama njo yenye kuwa na uhakika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand vous êtes-vous mise à écrire des chansons ?
target_text: Ni tangu wakati gani njo ulianzaka andika ma nyimbo.
target_text_raw: Ni tangu wakati gani njo ulianzaka andika ma nyimbo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre façon de chanter ferait pâlir plus d'un chanteur professionnel.
target_text: Namna yako ya kuimba inafanana ya mwimbaji mkubwa.
target_text_raw: Namna yako ya kuimba inafanana ya mwimbaji mkubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas étonnant qu'ils l'aient élu président.
target_text: Haishangazi kuona walimuchaguwa kuwa prezidenti.
target_text_raw: Haishangazi kuona walimuchaguwa kuwa prezidenti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a semblé que je venais tout juste d'entendre le bruit sourd d'une explosion.
target_text: Nilionekana sawa vile kusikia muripuko kwa mbali.
target_text_raw: Nilionekana sawa vile kusikia muripuko kwa mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce votre casier ?
target_text: Iyi ni kabati yako ?
target_text_raw: Iyi ni kabati yako ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne jouez pas avec moi !
target_text: Usicheze na miye.
target_text_raw: Usicheze na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était mon rêve de traduire ce roman.
target_text: Ilikuwa ndoto yangu kutafsiri iyi kitabu ya roman.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa ndoto yangu kutafsiri iyi kitabu ya roman.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est mon sandwich préféré.
target_text: Iyi njo sandwich yenye minapendaka.
target_text_raw: Iyi njo sandwich yenye minapendaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Mon pauvre ami, tu arrives après la soupe ! »
target_text: « Oh rafiki yangu, unakuja kisha chakula! »
target_text_raw: « Oh rafiki yangu, unakuja kisha chakula! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée de cet incident.
target_text: Samahani kwa iyi tukio.
target_text_raw: Samahani kwa iyi tukio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Retournez dans la maison.
target_text: Murudie mu nyumba.
target_text_raw: Murudie mu nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On est potes hein ?
target_text: Siye ni marafiki, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Siye ni marafiki, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous identifier l'homme à l'aide de cette photo ?
target_text: Unaweza kumtambua ule mtu kwa iyi picha?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kumtambua ule mtu kwa iyi picha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous marié ou célibataire ? Vivez-vous seul ou en couple ?
target_text: Ulishaowa ao ungali célibataire. Unaishi peke yako ao mu couple?
target_text_raw: Ulishaowa ao ungali célibataire. Unaishi peke yako ao mu couple?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donne un masque à un homme et il dira la vérité.
target_text: Upatie mtu mask na atasema ukweli.
target_text_raw: Upatie mtu mask na atasema ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons le plaisir de vous annoncer que Timéo vous a envoyé une carte de vœux.
target_text: Tunafuraha ya kukujulisha kwamba Timéo alikutumia kadi ya salamu.
target_text_raw: Tunafuraha ya kukujulisha kwamba Timéo alikutumia kadi ya salamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Réussir une belle soudure n'est pas à la portée de tout le monde !
target_text: Kuunganisha muzuri siyo kitu yenye kila mtu anaweza fanya!
target_text_raw: Kuunganisha muzuri siyo kitu yenye kila mtu anaweza fanya!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le conducteur roule trop vite.
target_text: Dereva anakimbiza sana.
target_text_raw: Dereva anakimbiza sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo regarde la télévision couché sur le canapé.
target_text: Enzo anaangalia télévision akilala ku kiti.
target_text_raw: Enzo anaangalia télévision akilala ku kiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous disiez que vous vouliez la vérité.
target_text: Ulikuwa nasema kama unataka kujua ukweli?
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa nasema kama unataka kujua ukweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'achète normalement mes fringues au grand magasin.
target_text: Kawaida minauziaka nguo zangu ku magasin.
target_text_raw: Kawaida minauziaka nguo zangu ku magasin (duka kubwa).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prier peut être une façon de ne pas affronter la dure réalité.
target_text: Kuomba inaweza kuwa njia ya kuepuka kupambana na ukweli ya kutisha.
target_text_raw: Kuomba inaweza kuwa njia ya kuepuka kupambana na ukweli ya kutisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette histoire est très célèbre, chacun la connait.
target_text: Iyi historia inajulikana sana, kila mtu anaijuwa.
target_text_raw: Iyi historia inajulikana sana, kila mtu anaijuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a appris tout ceci très vite, comme nul autre, car son goût extraordinaire d'apprendre et de travailler avait accru ses facultés d'apprentissage.
target_text: Alijifunza haya yote haraka sana, kama hakuna mwengine, kwa sababu hamu yake kubwa ya kujifunza na kufanya kazi iliongeza uwezo wake wa kujifunza.
target_text_raw: Alijifunza haya yote haraka sana, kama hakuna mwengine, kwa sababu hamu yake kubwa ya kujifunza na kufanya kazi iliongeza uwezo wake wa kujifunza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne voulez pas faire mon malheur, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Hautaki kuniingiza mu shida, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Hautaki kuniingiza mu shida, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai détruit toutes les preuves.
target_text: Nimevuta ushahidi yote.
target_text_raw: Nimevuta ushahidi yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le sort s'est rompu et le porc est redevenu un homme.
target_text: Uchawi ulivunjika na nguruwe ikageuka mtu tena.
target_text_raw: Uchawi ulivunjika na nguruwe ikageuka mtu tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Envoyez ceci par courrier recommandé, s'il vous plait.
target_text: Tuma iyi kupitia njia yenye inashauriwa, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Tuma iyi kupitia njia yenye inashauriwa, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se peut que la Chine soit la grande puissance du futur.
target_text: China inaweza kuwa inchi yenye nguvu kubwa mu siku zijazo.
target_text_raw: China inaweza kuwa inchi yenye nguvu kubwa mu siku zijazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il restait appuyé sur son bâton, à regarder le hobbit sans rien dire, jusqu'à ce que Bilbo en ressentît une certaine gêne et même quelque irritation.
target_text: Alibakia nakamatia ku fimbo yake, akiangalia hobbit bila kusema chochote, mpaka Bilbo akaanza sikia haya na hata hasira.
target_text_raw: Alibakia nakamatia ku fimbo yake, akiangalia hobbit bila kusema chochote, mpaka Bilbo akaanza sikia haya na hata hasira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bloc soviétique s’est effondré dans les années quatre-vingt-dix.
target_text: Umoja wa inchi zilizounda kambi ya kisovetiki ulianguka mnamo miaka ya 1990.
target_text_raw: Umoja wa inchi zilizounda kambi ya kisovetiki (bloc soviétique) ulianguka mnamo miaka ya 1990.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'idée est intéressante, mais le produit final coûtera trop cher.
target_text: Ni wazo nzuri, lakini matokeo ya mwisho itakuwa bei sana.
target_text_raw: Ni wazo nzuri, lakini matokeo ya mwisho itakuwa bei sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça sent le brûlé.
target_text: Inanuka bya kulungula.
target_text_raw: Inanuka bya kulungula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Passez une excellente fin de semaine.
target_text: Mupitishe mwisho mzuri wa juma.
target_text_raw: Mupitishe mwisho mzuri wa juma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le business absorbe tout son temps.
target_text: Biashara inakamataka wakati yake yote.
target_text_raw: Biashara inakamataka wakati yake yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous vous y ferez.
target_text: Utaizoea.
target_text_raw: Utaizoea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'alarme incendie se mit à sonner.
target_text: Kengele ya incendie ilianza lia.
target_text_raw: Kengele ya incendie ilianza lia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami avait un rencard.
target_text: Sami alikuwa na rendez-vous ya kimapenzi.
target_text_raw: Sami alikuwa na rendez-vous (mpango) ya kimapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton saxophone n'est pas aussi ancien que le mien.
target_text: Saxophone yako siyo ya zamani kuliko yangu.
target_text_raw: Saxophone yako siyo ya zamani kuliko yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a fallu sortir de la maison.
target_text: Nililazimika kutoka mu nyumba.
target_text_raw: Nililazimika kutoka mu nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chasse le naturel par la porte, il revient par la fenêtre.
target_text: Fukuza kitu kupitia mulango, itarudia kupitia dirisha.
target_text_raw: Fukuza kitu kupitia mulango, itarudia kupitia dirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a pu le reconnaître à son manteau rouge et à son collier en or.
target_text: Tuliweza kumutambua ku kanzu yake mwekundu na shenete yake ya zahabu.
target_text_raw: Tuliweza kumutambua ku kanzu yake mwekundu na shenete yake ya zahabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un unique rayon de lumière brillait à travers une fissure de la fenêtre aux volets fermés.
target_text: Mushale moya ya mwangaza ilikuwa naangaza kupitia mstari ya dirisha mu ma rideaux zakufungiwa.
target_text_raw: Mushale moya ya mwangaza ilikuwa naangaza kupitia mstari ya dirisha mu ma rideaux zakufungiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le grand héros romain, Jules César, fut assassiné.
target_text: Shujaa mkubwa wa Kiroma, Julius César, aliuawa.
target_text_raw: Shujaa mkubwa wa Kiroma, Julius César, aliuawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis mise à avoir soif.
target_text: Nilianza kusikia kiu.
target_text_raw: Nilianza kusikia kiu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maxime a réécrit son essai et l'a remis un jour trop tard.
target_text: Maxime aliandika tena maandishi yake na akaipana siku moja baadaye akiwa alishachelewa.
target_text_raw: Maxime aliandika tena maandishi (dissertation) yake na akaipana siku moja baadaye akiwa alishachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est plutôt impressionnant.
target_text: Ni ya kuvutia sana.
target_text_raw: Ni ya kuvutia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu passes trop de temps au soleil sans mettre de crème solaire, il est probable que tu attrapes un coup de soleil.
target_text: Ukipitisha muda mingi ku jua bila kuweka mafuta ya kujikinga na mishale ya jua, unawezwa chomwa na jua.
target_text_raw: Ukipitisha muda mingi ku jua bila kuweka mafuta ya kujikinga na mishale ya jua, unawezwa chomwa na jua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ennemi a lancé une attaque contre nous.
target_text: Adui alianza kutushambulia.
target_text_raw: Adui alianza kutushambulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prends-le. Je ne m'en sers pratiquement jamais.
target_text: Ikamate. Siitumukishaki kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ikamate. Siitumukishaki kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suppose que vous voulez que je parte.
target_text: Minazani kama unapenda niende.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama unapenda niende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami était le nouvel associé de Farid.
target_text: Sami alikuwa mshirika mupya wa Farid.
target_text_raw: Sami alikuwa mshirika mupya wa Farid.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bande d'idiots !
target_text: Kundi ya wapumbafu.
target_text_raw: Kundi ya wapumbafu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te moque pas des pauvres.
target_text: Usichekee wa maskini.
target_text_raw: Usichekee wa maskini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas lui donna une tape sur l'épaule.
target_text: Thomas alimupiga ka kofi ku libega.
target_text_raw: Thomas alimupiga ka kofi ku libega.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous allez tourner bien des têtes avec cette robe.
target_text: Utageuza kichwa muzuri mwa iyi kanzu.
target_text_raw: Utageuza kichwa muzuri mwa iyi kanzu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai écouté que la fin du discours de Jules.
target_text: Nilisikiliza tu mwisho ya hotuba ya Jules.
target_text_raw: Nilisikiliza tu mwisho ya hotuba ya Jules.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va de soi que le commerce du riz est un secteur en déclin.
target_text: Inaonekana kwamba biashara ya mchele ni sekta iko napotea.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana kwamba biashara ya mchele ni sekta iko napotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La maîtresse de maison s'est mise en frais pour recevoir ses convives.
target_text: Bibi wa nyumba alifanya gharama mingi kwa kupokea wageni wake.
target_text_raw: Bibi wa nyumba alifanya gharama mingi kwa kupokea wageni wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'aspirine n'a aucun effet sur la tension artérielle.
target_text: Aspirine haina kinyume chochote kwa ongezeko ya damu.
target_text_raw: Aspirine haina kinyume chochote kwa ongezeko ya damu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si à 20 ans tu n'es pas encore directeur, ne serait-ce que d'une école, alors ce n'est pas la peine d'aller plus loin, tu as raté ta vie professionnelle.
target_text: Kama mu miaka makumi mbili hauyakuwa kiongozi, hata wa shule moja tu, kwa hivyo usijisumbue kwenda mbali zaidi, ulishindwa katika maisha yako ya kizazi.
target_text_raw: Kama mu miaka makumi mbili hauyakuwa kiongozi, hata wa shule moja tu, kwa hivyo usijisumbue kwenda mbali zaidi, ulishindwa katika maisha yako ya kizazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette longue dispute est enfin terminée.
target_text: Iyi mafarakano ya murefu inaisha sasa.
target_text_raw: Iyi mafarakano ya murefu inaisha sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci pour la bouffe.
target_text: Aksanti kwa chakula.
target_text_raw: Aksanti kwa chakula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'avez aucun droit de porter un jugement sur ces gens.
target_text: Hauna ruhusa yoyote ya kuhukumu aba batu.
target_text_raw: Hauna ruhusa yoyote ya kuhukumu aba batu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme il a été courageux de se jeter à l'eau pour secourir la petite fille.
target_text: Kwa gisi alikuwa na bidii ya kujitupa mu maji majini kwa kusaidia binti mdogo.
target_text_raw: Kwa gisi alikuwa na bidii ya kujitupa mu maji majini kwa kusaidia binti mdogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'adversaire d'une vraie liberté est un désir excessif de sécurité.
target_text: Adui wa uhuru wa kweli ni hamu ya kupitiliza ya usalama.
target_text_raw: Adui wa uhuru wa kweli ni hamu ya kupitiliza ya usalama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez faire suivre mon courrier à cette adresse.
target_text: Tafazali peleka barua yangu kwa iyi adresse.
target_text_raw: Tafazali peleka barua yangu kwa iyi adresse.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était une merveilleuse surprise.
target_text: Ilikuwa mushangao ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa mushangao ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous ses espoirs sont partis en fumée quand il a perdu son fils pendant la guerre.
target_text: Matumaini yake yote iliruka wakati alipoteza mtoto wake mu vita.
target_text_raw: Matumaini yake yote iliruka wakati alipoteza mtoto wake mu vita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un expert en la matière, c'est certain.
target_text: Anaujuzi katika ile mambo, ni kweli.
target_text_raw: Anaujuzi katika ile mambo, ni kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que suis-je censée en faire ?
target_text: Minapashwa ifanyisha nini?
target_text_raw: Minapashwa ifanyisha nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Père, je sortirai aujourd'hui avec quelques amis. Bien sûr, c'est si vous me le permettez.
target_text: Baba, leo ndatoka na ba rafiki. Kwa kweli, kama munaniruhusu.
target_text_raw: Baba, leo ndatoka na ba rafiki. Kwa kweli, kama munaniruhusu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a seulement deux choses pour lesquelles nous devrions nous battre. L'une est la défense de nos foyers et l'autre est la Déclaration des Droits du Citoyen.
target_text: Kuko mambo mbili tu yenye tunapashwa kupigania. Moja ni ulinzi wa nyumba zetu na ingine ni azimio wa Haki za Raia.
target_text_raw: Kuko mambo mbili tu yenye tunapashwa kupigania. Moja ni ulinzi wa nyumba zetu na ingine ni azimio wa Haki za Raia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la bagnole la plus rapide de notre hall d'exposition.
target_text: Ni gari ya kukimbia sana kwenye salle yetu ya maonyesho.
target_text_raw: Ni gari ya kukimbia sana kwenye salle yetu ya maonyesho (exposition).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne laissez pas l'ennemi s'approcher.
target_text: Usiache adui asogee.
target_text_raw: Usiache adui asogee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'êtes pas aussi bonnes que vous pensez l'être.
target_text: Hauko muzuri kama unavyo fikiria.
target_text_raw: Hauko muzuri kama unavyo fikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plusieurs soldats ont refusé de suivre les ordres.
target_text: Maaskari wengi walikatala kufuata maagizo.
target_text_raw: Maaskari wengi walikatala kufuata maagizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle prenait soin de ne rien laisser paraître.
target_text: Alifanya kila kitu kutoonyesha chochote.
target_text_raw: Alifanya kila kitu kutoonyesha chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le sauvage m'a dérobé mes précieux bijoux et s'est enfui.
target_text: Ule mshenzi aliniiba biato ya bei na kukimbia.
target_text_raw: Ule mshenzi aliniiba biato ya bei na kukimbia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque fois que je commets une erreur, j'apprends quelque chose. Le défi est de ne pas continuer à toujours commettre les mêmes erreurs.
target_text: Kila nikifanya kosa, minajifunzaka kitu ya mupya. Changamoto ni kutoendelea nafanya ile ile makosa.
target_text_raw: Kila nikifanya kosa, minajifunzaka kitu ya mupya. Changamoto ni kutoendelea nafanya ile ile makosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les révolutions, jusqu'à présent, n'ont prouvé qu'une chose, à savoir que beaucoup de choses peuvent changer, mais que seuls les hommes ne le peuvent pas.
target_text: Mapinduzi yote, mpaka sasa, ilihakikisha kitu moja tu, ambayo ni kwamba bitu mingi inaweza badilika, isipokuwa tu wanadamu.
target_text_raw: Mapinduzi yote, mpaka sasa, ilihakikisha kitu moja tu, ambayo ni kwamba bitu mingi inaweza badilika, isipokuwa tu wanadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce nest pas avec des os que l'on attrape des renards.
target_text: Mbweha hainaswi na mifupa.
target_text_raw: Mbweha hainaswi na mifupa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans ce restaurant, le personnel nous a fait très bonne impression.
target_text: Mwa iyi restaurant, wafanyakazi walitufurahisha sana.
target_text_raw: Mwa iyi restaurant, wafanyakazi walitufurahisha sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me réjouis par avance de notre nouvelle rencontre.
target_text: Kwanza minafurahi kwa ajili ya mukutano wetu mupya.
target_text_raw: Kwanza minafurahi kwa ajili ya mukutano wetu mupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment vais-je m'y prendre pour engager la conversation avec cette superbe jeune femme ?
target_text: Nitajikamata namna gani kwa kuanzisha mazungumuzo na uyu binti mrembo?
target_text_raw: Nitajikamata namna gani kwa kuanzisha mazungumuzo na uyu binti mrembo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je promets de revenir tôt.
target_text: Minaahidi kurudia mapema.
target_text_raw: Minaahidi kurudia mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne le pensez pas sérieusement, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Hauiwazie kweli, si vile?
target_text_raw: Hauiwazie kweli, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne mets pas la faute sur le dos de la conductrice.
target_text: Usilaumu dereva.
target_text_raw: Usilaumu dereva.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jeune couple est allé à Kyoto pour s'amuser.
target_text: Wanandoa wapya walienda Kyoto kujifurahisha.
target_text_raw: Wanandoa wapya walienda Kyoto kujifurahisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il doit payer pour faire refaire sa plaque d'immatriculation.
target_text: Inapashwa lipa juu afanyishe tena plaque yake ya immatriculation.
target_text_raw: Inapashwa lipa juu afanyishe tena plaque yake ya immatriculation.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Commencez votre entraînement !
target_text: Muanze mazoezi yenu.
target_text_raw: Muanze mazoezi yenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Penses-tu que tu pourrais être flic ?
target_text: Unazani kama unaweza kuwa polisi.
target_text_raw: Unazani kama unaweza kuwa polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Sortez du cadre ! » « Quel cadre ? »
target_text: « Toka mu cadre! » « Cadre gani? »
target_text_raw: « Toka mu cadre! » « Cadre gani? »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a un combat de coq dans la cour.
target_text: Jogoo ziko napigana mu kiwanja.
target_text_raw: Jogoo ziko napigana mu kiwanja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fis en sorte que les enfants qui avaient oublié leur crayon rouge viennent en emprunter un.
target_text: Nilifanya watoto ambao walisahabu crayon zao za mwekundu wakuye lazima moja.
target_text_raw: Nilifanya watoto ambao walisahabu crayon zao za mwekundu wakuye lazima moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne mangez pas trop avant le repas, sinon vous n'aurez plus faim.
target_text: Usikule sana mbele ya kwenda ku meza, kama sivyo hautakuwa na njala.
target_text_raw: Usikule sana mbele ya kwenda ku meza, kama sivyo hautakuwa na njala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le vélo équipé de petites roues à l’arrière stabilise la position des enfants qui en font.
target_text: Kinga ya ma piné kidogo nyuma inasaidiaka batoto benye biko najifunza ayo.
target_text_raw: Kinga ya ma piné (pneus) kidogo nyuma inasaidiaka batoto benye biko najifunza ayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois couper le courant avant de vérifier le circuit.
target_text: Unapashwa kata umeme mbele ya ku vérifier circuit.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kata umeme mbele ya ku vérifier (kuchunguza) circuit.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À présent que Marie s'en est allée, Ethan est beaucoup plus heureux.
target_text: Kwa kuwa Marie alishaenda, Ethan anajazwa na furaha.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa Marie alishaenda, Ethan anajazwa na furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peter et Carol se sont disputés pour savoir où ils passeraient leurs vacances.
target_text: Peter na Carol walibishana kwa kujuwa niwapi watapitisha mafungo yao.
target_text_raw: Peter na Carol walibishana kwa kujuwa niwapi watapitisha mafungo yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Deux larmes perlaient au bord de ses cils, et elle se détourna avec l'intention de les cacher.
target_text: Machozi ilionekana ku makiki yake na akageuka na nia ya kuificha.
target_text_raw: Machozi ilionekana ku makiki yake na akageuka na nia ya kuificha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'un des meilleurs usages d'Internet est d'apprendre l'espéranto et de prendre contact avec les représentants d'autres peuples.
target_text: Mojawapo ya matumizi bora ya internet ni kujifunza Kiesperanto na kuwasiliana na wawakilishi ya jamii zingine.
target_text_raw: Mojawapo ya matumizi bora ya internet ni kujifunza Kiesperanto na kuwasiliana na wawakilishi ya jamii zingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui mon commandant !
target_text: Ndiyo kamanda wangu.
target_text_raw: Ndiyo kamanda wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes parents ne me laisseraient pas sortir avec des garçons.
target_text: Wazazi wangu hawawezi niruhusu kutoka na wa garçons.
target_text_raw: Wazazi wangu hawawezi niruhusu kutoka na wa garçons.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils arrivent à Rome.
target_text: Wanafika Roma.
target_text_raw: Wanafika Roma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a vraiment aucune honte à ne plus pouvoir courir aussi loin ?! Tu en as certainement mis plein la vue aux gens de ton âge qui ne savent plus courir du tout.
target_text: Hakuna haya ingine kama vile kutoweza kukimbia mbali? Umevutia watu wa umri wako ambao hawawezi kukimbia hata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Hakuna haya ingine kama vile kutoweza kukimbia mbali? Umevutia watu wa umri wako ambao hawawezi kukimbia hata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le test du nouveau moteur a lieu aujourd'hui.
target_text: Moteur ya mpya itapimwa leo.
target_text_raw: Moteur ya mpya itapimwa leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pars jamais en vacances sans nettoyer mon appartement.
target_text: Siwezi enda mu mafungo bila kusafisha nyumba yangu.
target_text_raw: Siwezi enda mu mafungo bila kusafisha nyumba yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Très bon travail ! Félicitations !
target_text: Kazi nzuri sana. Hongera.
target_text_raw: Kazi nzuri sana. Hongera.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'auriez pas pu choisir de meilleur endroit.
target_text: Hamungeweza chagula fasi nzuri.
target_text_raw: Hamungeweza chagula fasi nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu me ramener à la maison ?
target_text: Unaweza nirudisha nyumbani?
target_text_raw: Unaweza nirudisha nyumbani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois toujours vérifier dans ma cour pour voir s'il n'y a pas des mares d'eau stagnantes, afin que des moustiques ne se s'y reproduisent pas.
target_text: Minapashwa chunguza ndani ya kiwanja changu kila mara juu ya kuona kama hakuna tingitingi ya maji, ili imbu zisizalike ndani yake.
target_text_raw: Minapashwa chunguza ndani ya kiwanja changu kila mara juu ya kuona kama hakuna tingitingi ya maji, ili imbu zisizalike ndani yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande ce qu'il est devenu après son départ vers les États-Unis.
target_text: Minajiuliza alishaka kuwa nani kisha kwenda Marekani.
target_text_raw: Minajiuliza alishaka kuwa nani kisha kwenda Marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il déposa un baiser sur son cou.
target_text: Akaweka bizu ku shingo yake.
target_text_raw: Akaweka bizu ku shingo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des tas de gens dépassent la limite de vitesse donc ça doit être autorisé.
target_text: Watu wengi wanatembezaka na vitesse mingi, kwa hivyo inapashwa kuwa inaruhusiwa.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wanatembezaka na vitesse mingi, kwa hivyo inapashwa kuwa inaruhusiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que vous comprenez par le mot talent?
target_text: Unaelewa nini katika neno kipaji?
target_text_raw: Unaelewa nini katika neno kipaji?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun sait à un niveau ou un autre, ce que sont le bien et le mal ; certains feignent de l'ignorer.
target_text: Katika njia moja ao nyingine kila mtu anajua maana ya kizuri na kibaya; wengine wanajifanya kupuuza.
target_text_raw: Katika njia moja ao nyingine kila mtu anajua maana ya kizuri na kibaya; wengine wanajifanya kupuuza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un dragon est une créature imaginaire.
target_text: Dragon ni kiumbe kilicho fikiriwa.
target_text_raw: Dragon ni kiumbe kilicho fikiriwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de journalistes assistèrent au procès.
target_text: Waandishi wa habari wengi walihuzuria masambo.
target_text_raw: Waandishi wa habari wengi walihuzuria masambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous apprenons que cette année vous ne partez pas en vacances à cause de ces travaux que vous avez entrepris.
target_text: Tunafaamishwa kama iyi mwaka hautaenda mu mafungo juu ya kazi zenye ulianzisha.
target_text_raw: Tunafaamishwa kama iyi mwaka hautaenda mu mafungo juu ya kazi zenye ulianzisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons utilisé l'ordinateur pour gagner du temps.
target_text: Tulitumikisha ordinateur juu ya kukomboa muda.
target_text_raw: Tulitumikisha ordinateur juu ya kukomboa muda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis revenu deux ans plus tard dans mon village natal.
target_text: Nilirudia mu kijiji yangu ya mazalikio kisha miaka mbili.
target_text_raw: Nilirudia mu kijiji yangu ya mazalikio kisha miaka mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez sortir d'ici, non ?
target_text: Unapenda utoke hapa, si vile?
target_text_raw: Unapenda utoke hapa, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'avantage d'être dans son propre bar, c'est qu'on peut boire à l'œil.
target_text: Faida ya kukuwa mu bar yako ni kwamba unaweza kunywa pombe bila kulipa.
target_text_raw: Faida ya kukuwa mu bar yako ni kwamba unaweza kunywa pombe bila kulipa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'évite de parler avec lui afin de ne pas entendre ces conneries arrogantes.
target_text: Minakatala kuongea nae juu ya kuepuka utani yake ya kiburi.
target_text_raw: Minakatala kuongea nae juu ya kuepuka utani yake ya kiburi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime Alex Marcelo.
target_text: Namupenda Alex Marcelo.
target_text_raw: Namupenda Alex Marcelo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il annonça une nouvelle qui fit l'effet d'une bombe.
target_text: Alieleza habari yenye ilileta mshituko.
target_text_raw: Alieleza habari yenye ilileta mshituko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon oncle et ma tante aiment passer leurs vacances d’été dans des stations au bord de la mer. Ils profitent de ce séjour pour se baigner quotidiennement.
target_text: Muyomba yangu na shangazi yangu wanapendaka kupitisha mafungo ya kipwa katika maeneo ya kando kando ya bahari. Wanatumiaka iyi matembezi kwa kuoga kila siku ndani ya bahari.
target_text_raw: Muyomba yangu na shangazi yangu wanapendaka kupitisha mafungo ya kipwa katika maeneo ya kando kando ya bahari. Wanatumiaka iyi matembezi kwa kuoga kila siku ndani ya bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle vous a envoyé ses meilleurs vœux.
target_text: Alikutumia heri ya mwaka mupya.
target_text_raw: Alikutumia heri ya mwaka mupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez le contact !
target_text: Weka mawasiliano.
target_text_raw: Weka mawasiliano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée que vous n'ayez pas bien dormi.
target_text: Samahani kwa kuwa haukulala muzuri.
target_text_raw: Samahani kwa kuwa haukulala muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonheur partagé revient multiplié, peine partagée revient à moitié.
target_text: Furaha ya pamoja inaongezekaka, huzuni ya pamoja inakuwaka nusu.
target_text_raw: Furaha ya pamoja inaongezekaka, huzuni ya pamoja inakuwaka nusu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il arrivera à 2h30 et Marie arrivera un peu plus tard.
target_text: Atafika saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Atafika saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et pourtant, elle tourne !
target_text: Ijapokuwa, anazuguruka.
target_text_raw: Ijapokuwa, anazuguruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous recherchons quelqu'un qui sache se servir d'un ordinateur.
target_text: Tuko natafuta mtu ambaye anajua kutumikisha ordinateur.
target_text_raw: Tuko natafuta mtu ambaye anajua kutumikisha ordinateur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il le fit au vu et au su du personnel.
target_text: Aliifanya mbele ya macho ya wafanyakazi.
target_text_raw: Aliifanya mbele ya macho ya wafanyakazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parie que vous êtes occupée.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama hauna muda.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama hauna muda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nul n'a le droit d'échanger la souveraineté contre une amitié illusoire.
target_text: Hakuna mwenye iko na haki ya kubadilisha mamlaka na urafiki ya uongo.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwenye iko na haki ya kubadilisha mamlaka na urafiki ya uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne savons absolument rien sur la vie de cet oiseau.
target_text: Hatujui chochote kuhusu maisha ya iyi ndege.
target_text_raw: Hatujui chochote kuhusu maisha ya iyi ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'officier de haut rang s'approchait à grands pas.
target_text: Afisa wa cheo cha juu alikuwa anakaribia kwa hatua kubwa.
target_text_raw: Afisa wa cheo cha juu alikuwa anakaribia kwa hatua kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'es pas revenu ! Et moi, je t'attendais tellement...
target_text: Haukurudia tena! Na miye, nilikuwa nakuchunga sana...
target_text_raw: Haukurudia tena! Na miye, nilikuwa nakuchunga sana...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si l'on en croit les histoires, nul n'est prophète ni en sa maison, ni en son pays.
target_text: Tukiamini maneno inayo semwa, mtu hakukuwaki nabii nyumbani kwao, wala mu inchi yake.
target_text_raw: Tukiamini maneno inayo semwa, mtu hakukuwaki nabii nyumbani kwao, wala mu inchi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tony peut courir rapidement.
target_text: Tony anaweza kimbia mbio sana.
target_text_raw: Tony anaweza kimbia mbio sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'obsédé est le vrai ennemi des femmes. Jamais je ne le laisserais s'en sortir sans problème.
target_text: Anaye penda mambo ya ngono sana ni adui mkubwa ya wanamuke. Siwezi muacha ata siku moja ashinde bila shida.
target_text_raw: Anaye penda mambo ya ngono sana ni adui mkubwa ya wanamuke. Siwezi muacha ata siku moja ashinde bila shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, tu as raison.
target_text: Ndio, uko na sheria.
target_text_raw: Ndio, uko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce lait une drôle d'odeur.
target_text: Iyi maziwa iko na harufu isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Iyi maziwa iko na harufu isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvons-nous arranger ça ?
target_text: Tunaweza rekebisha iyi?
target_text_raw: Tunaweza rekebisha iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais quand dire stop.
target_text: Minajua wakati ya kusema "stop".
target_text_raw: Minajua wakati ya kusema "stop".
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Allemands ont fait sauter le pont.
target_text: Wajerumani walibomoa kilalo.
target_text_raw: Wajerumani walibomoa kilalo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu restes où tu es.
target_text: Minapenda ubakie kwenye uko.
target_text_raw: Minapenda ubakie kwenye uko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonne sainte Vierge, soyez-moi une bonne mère, protégez-moi.
target_text: Bikira mtakatifu mwema, uwe mama mwema kwangu, unilinde.
target_text_raw: Bikira mtakatifu mwema, uwe mama mwema kwangu, unilinde.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous auriez dû tourner à gauche.
target_text: Ulipashwa geuka kushoto.
target_text_raw: Ulipashwa geuka kushoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez à vous entraîner.
target_text: Uendelee kufanya mazoezi.
target_text_raw: Uendelee kufanya mazoezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est venue au musée en taxi.
target_text: Alikuya ku musée mu taxi.
target_text_raw: Alikuya ku musée mu taxi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pouvais rien sentir d'autre que le couteau, tandis qu'il s'enfonçait dans mon dos.
target_text: Sikusikia kitu ingine isipokuwa kisu, wakati ilikuwa naniingia mu mugongo.
target_text_raw: Sikusikia kitu ingine isipokuwa kisu, wakati ilikuwa naniingia mu mugongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne peut descendre deux fois sans monter une fois.
target_text: Hauwezi enda chini mara mbili bila kwenda yulu limoya.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi enda chini mara mbili bila kwenda yulu limoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voudriez-vous une simple ou une double ?
target_text: Ungependa ya kawaida ao ya mbili?
target_text_raw: Ungependa ya kawaida ao ya mbili?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La batterie de mon ordinateur portable ne dure plus aussi longtemps qu'elle en avait l'habitude.
target_text: Batterie ya ordinateur yangu haichungaki tena moto sawa vile zamani.
target_text_raw: Batterie ya ordinateur yangu haichungaki tena moto sawa vile zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en suis absolument sûre.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kabisa.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous serez toujours bienvenue.
target_text: Unakaribishwa siku ingine.
target_text_raw: Unakaribishwa siku ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne leur dégage pas le chemin.
target_text: Sitawaachia njia.
target_text_raw: Sitawaachia njia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le son venait de cette direction.
target_text: Sauti ilitokea iyi ngambo.
target_text_raw: Sauti ilitokea iyi ngambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La flèche a atteint la cible.
target_text: Mshale iligusa kwenye ilikuwa nalenga.
target_text_raw: Mshale iligusa kwenye ilikuwa nalenga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette île ne dispose d'aucune piste d'atterrissage.
target_text: Hiki kisiwa hakina uwanja wa ndege.
target_text_raw: Hiki kisiwa hakina uwanja wa ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que Nathan avait ses raisons.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama Nathan alikuwa na sheria.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama Nathan alikuwa na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle s'est tuée hier.
target_text: Alijiuwa jana.
target_text_raw: Alijiuwa jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était tard, donc je suis rentré chez moi.
target_text: Ilikuashakuwa nyuma, kwa hivyo nilirudia kwangu.
target_text_raw: Ilikuashakuwa nyuma, kwa hivyo nilirudia kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez lui présenter des excuses pour être arrivées en retard.
target_text: Ulipashwa muomba musamaha kwa kurudia nyuma.
target_text_raw: Ulipashwa muomba musamaha kwa kurudia nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne me rends pas à l'école en bus.
target_text: Siendaki ku masomo na bisi.
target_text_raw: Siendaki ku masomo na bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas nous qui disons les mots, ce sont les mots qui nous disent.
target_text: Siyo siye njo tunasema maneno, ni maneno njo inatusema.
target_text_raw: Siyo siye njo tunasema maneno, ni maneno njo inatusema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas totalement sûre.
target_text: Sina uhakika sana.
target_text_raw: Sina uhakika sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les garçons sont partis voir le match.
target_text: Ba garçons yote balienda kuangalia match.
target_text_raw: Ba garçons yote balienda kuangalia match.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La direction a promis de garantir une meilleure information à tous les salariés.
target_text: Uongozi uliahidi kuhakikisha habari bora kwa wafanyakazi wote.
target_text_raw: Uongozi uliahidi kuhakikisha habari bora kwa wafanyakazi wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te remercie, adieu !
target_text: Nakushukuru, Kwa heri.
target_text_raw: Nakushukuru, Kwa heri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous remercie du fond du cœur.
target_text: Nakushukuru kwa moyo wangu wote.
target_text_raw: Nakushukuru kwa moyo wangu wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mois dernier, Théo a acheté une nouvelle caméra.
target_text: Mwezi iliopita, Theo aliuzan kamera ya mupya.
target_text_raw: Mwezi iliopita, Theo aliuzan kamera ya mupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tournez la poignée et ouvrez la porte.
target_text: Zungurusha poignet na ufungule mlango.
target_text_raw: Zungurusha poignet na ufungule mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez jusqu'à ce que je revienne.
target_text: Uchunge mpaka saa minarudia.
target_text_raw: Uchunge mpaka saa minarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fut un brave soldat.
target_text: Alikuwa askari shujaa.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa askari shujaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crains qu'il ne se produise une catastrophe si tu pars déjà maintenant.
target_text: Niko na mashaka kwamba kitu ya mubaya inaweza jitokeza ukienda sasa ivi.
target_text_raw: Niko na mashaka kwamba kitu ya mubaya inaweza jitokeza ukienda sasa ivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si la vie et la mort de Socrate sont d'un sage, la vie et la mort de Jésus sont d'un Dieu.
target_text: Kama maisha na kifo ya Socrate ni ya mujuzi wa mambo, maisha na kifo ya Yesu ni ya umungu.
target_text_raw: Kama maisha na kifo ya Socrate ni ya mujuzi wa mambo, maisha na kifo ya Yesu ni ya umungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Monsieur Serrurier parlait si vite, que je ne pouvais pas comprendre ce qu'il disait.
target_text: Ule bwana wa kutengeneza ma serrures alikuwa naongea mbio mbio, kwa gisi sikukuwa naelewa aliyo kuwa nasema.
target_text_raw: Ule bwana wa kutengeneza ma serrures alikuwa naongea mbio mbio, kwa gisi sikukuwa naelewa aliyo kuwa nasema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai marre de ses longs discours.
target_text: Minachoka na hotuba zake za murefu.
target_text_raw: Minachoka na hotuba zake za murefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai senti ta présence dans mon dos. Tu étais proche, constamment, calme comme un soir d'été.
target_text: Nilisikia présence yako mu mugongo yangu. Ulikuwa karibu, kila wakati, mtulivu kama mangaribi ya kipwa
target_text_raw: Nilisikia présence yako mu mugongo yangu. Ulikuwa karibu, kila wakati, mtulivu kama mangaribi ya kipwa
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous auriez préféré traduire des phrases plutôt que de bavarder avec moi.
target_text: Ungependelea kutafsiri maneno kuliko kuzungumuza na miye.
target_text_raw: Ungependelea kutafsiri maneno kuliko kuzungumuza na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis fait faire ce costume sur mesure.
target_text: Nilishonesha iyi veste ku taille yangu.
target_text_raw: Nilishonesha iyi veste ku taille yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Et si tu prenais un peu de vacances ? » « Ah ben ça, c’est pas l’envie qui me manque. » « C’est quoi, alors ? » « L’argent. »
target_text: « Na kama unafanya mafungo kidogo? » « Ah sawa, siyo hamu njo minakosa. » « Ni nini, sasa? » « Pesa. »
target_text_raw: « Na kama unafanya mafungo kidogo? » « Ah sawa, siyo hamu njo minakosa. » « Ni nini, sasa? » « Pesa. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bill a amené son petit frère au zoo.
target_text: Bill alibeba kaka yake mdogo ku zoo.
target_text_raw: Bill alibeba kaka yake mdogo ku zoo (bustani ya minyama).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas l'amener dans ton bureau, parce qu'il est allergique à la poussière.
target_text: Siwezi muleta mu ofisi yako, kwa sababu hapendaki vumbi.
target_text_raw: Siwezi muleta mu ofisi (bureau) yako, kwa sababu hapendaki vumbi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que chacune amène ses enfants.
target_text: Minataka kila mumoja alete watoto wake.
target_text_raw: Minataka kila mumoja alete watoto wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vitesse à laquelle on oublie est tout simplement incroyable.
target_text: Ku vitesse yenye tunasahabu ni ya kushangaza kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ku vitesse yenye tunasahabu ni ya kushangaza kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il serait très intéressant que, le plus tôt possible, il y ait la possibilité d'effectuer des recherches avancées dans la base de données de Tatoeba.
target_text: Itakuwa ya maana sana kama, haraka iwezekanavyo, kutakuwa uwezekano ya kufanya uchunguzi wa kindani kuhusu ufundi ya kukusanya habari mingi ya Tatoeba.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa ya maana sana kama, haraka iwezekanavyo, kutakuwa uwezekano ya kufanya uchunguzi wa kindani kuhusu ufundi ya kukusanya habari mingi (base des données) ya Tatoeba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce serait vraiment génial.
target_text: Inweza kuwa muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Inweza kuwa muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si les Palestiniens de la Cisjordanie refusent de quitter leurs terres ancestrales, les colons les feront partir par des "négociations de paix", avec des bombes incendiaires et des armes automatiques.
target_text: Kama Wapalestina wa Ukingo wa Magharibi wanakatala kuondoka kwenye udongo ya mababu zao, wakoloni watawalazimisha kuondoka kupitia "mazungumzo ya amani", na bombes za kufanya maangamizi na silaha za kupiga masasi moja kwa moja.
target_text_raw: Kama Wapalestina wa Ukingo wa Magharibi (Cisjordanie) wanakatala kuondoka kwenye udongo ya mababu zao, wakoloni watawalazimisha kuondoka kupitia "mazungumzo ya amani", na bombes za kufanya maangamizi na silaha za kupiga masasi moja kwa moja (armes automatiques).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il viendra si tu l'appelles.
target_text: Atakuya ukimuita.
target_text_raw: Atakuya ukimuita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces chevaux de bois sont anciens.
target_text: Farasi za mbao ni za zamani.
target_text_raw: Farasi za mbao ni za zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il jeta un regard bref aux passants.
target_text: Akatazama wapita njia kwa muda mrefu.
target_text_raw: Akatazama wapita njia kwa muda mrefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toute personne qui mesure plus d'un mille doit quitter le tribunal.
target_text: Mtu yeyote anaye pima zaidi ya elfu moja anapashwa toka kortini.
target_text_raw: Mtu yeyote anaye pima zaidi ya elfu moja anapashwa toka kortini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait un rêve bizarre, la nuit passée.
target_text: Nililota ndoto ya kushangaza, usiku iliyo pita.
target_text_raw: Nililota ndoto ya kushangaza, usiku iliyo pita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toute idée traverse trois stades : d'abord, elle est ridiculisée. Ensuite, on s'y oppose violemment. Enfin, elle est acceptée comme étant évidente.
target_text: Kila wazo inapitia hatua tatu: kwanza, inazarauliwa. Kisha, inapingwa vikali. Na mwisho, inakubaliwa kuwa ukweli.
target_text_raw: Kila wazo inapitia hatua tatu: kwanza, inazarauliwa. Kisha, inapingwa vikali. Na mwisho, inakubaliwa kuwa ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas quand je pourrai vous rembourser l'argent que je vous dois.
target_text: Sijui wakati gani ndakulipa deni yako ya pesa.
target_text_raw: Sijui wakati gani ndakulipa deni yako ya pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo a un formidable sens de l'humour.
target_text: Mathéo anajuwaka chekesha sana.
target_text_raw: Mathéo anajuwaka chekesha sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On prendra contact avec toi.
target_text: Tutakamata contact na weye.
target_text_raw: Tutakamata contact na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vous draguait carrément, au bar.
target_text: Alikuwa nakutongoza kabisa ku bar.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nakutongoza kabisa ku bar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai toujours voulu me faire sucer sur ce morceau.
target_text: Tangu zamani nilitamani kupapaswa ku sehemu yangu ya siri wakati nasikiliza iyi nyimbo.
target_text_raw: Tangu zamani nilitamani kupapaswa ku sehemu yangu ya siri wakati nasikiliza iyi nyimbo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo est blessé d'une balle dans le cou.
target_text: Hugo analumizwa na lisasi ku shingo.
target_text_raw: Hugo analumizwa na lisasi ku shingo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le lait était vendu dans des bouteilles en verre.
target_text: Maziwa iliuzishwa ndani ya chupa za kio.
target_text_raw: Maziwa iliuzishwa ndani ya chupa za kio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia ne peut pas faire le job.
target_text: Kylia hawezi fanya kazi.
target_text_raw: Kylia hawezi fanya kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit que son fils sait à présent compter jusqu'à cent.
target_text: Anasema kwamba mtoto wake anaweza sasa hesabu mpaka ku mia moja.
target_text_raw: Anasema kwamba mtoto wake anaweza sasa hesabu mpaka ku mia moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Afin de l'isoler d'éventuels agents pathogènes, aucune visite ne lui est autorisée.
target_text: Kwa kumuepusha na maambukizi ya magonjwa, hairuhusiwi kumutembelea.
target_text_raw: Kwa kumuepusha na maambukizi ya magonjwa, hairuhusiwi kumutembelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois ajuster tes plans aux miens.
target_text: Unapashwa rekebisha mipango yako juu ifanane yangu.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa rekebisha mipango yako juu ifanane yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu veux devenir une star ? Commence par te déshabiller !

target_text_raw: Unapenda ukuwe mtu wa kujulikana? Anza kwanza tosha manguo.

source_text: Je peux désormais jongler à quatre balles.

target_text_raw: Naweza sasa kuchezesha mchezo ya ku jongler quatre balles.
