source_text: Un sentiment centriste croissant menace de bouleverser le système bipartisan traditionnel des États-Unis d'Amérique.
target_text: Mtazamo ya wanasiasa wa siasa ya kadiri inaonekana kutishia kupinduwa mfumo wa siasa ya pande mbili ya Marekani.
target_text_raw: Mtazamo ya wanasiasa wa siasa ya kadiri (partisans centristes) inaonekana kutishia kupinduwa mfumo (système) wa siasa ya pande mbili ya Marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie c'est des étapes... La plus douce c'est l'amour... La plus dure c'est la séparation... La plus pénible c'est les adieux... La plus belle c'est les retrouvailles.
target_text: Maisha ni hatua... Ya utamu zaidi ni upendo... Ya nguvu zaidi ni utengano... Ya uchungu sana ni kulaga... Ya muzuri sana ni kuonana tena.
target_text_raw: Maisha ni hatua... Ya utamu zaidi ni upendo... Ya nguvu zaidi ni utengano... Ya uchungu sana ni kulaga... Ya muzuri sana ni kuonana tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demandais quand vous alliez me le dire.
target_text: Nilikuwa najiuliza wakati gani utaniambiya iyo.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa najiuliza wakati gani utaniambiya iyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi Adam a-t-il mangé le fruit défendu ?
target_text: Kwa nini Adamu alikula tunda iliyo katazwa?
target_text_raw: Kwa nini Adamu alikula tunda iliyo katazwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, Thomas a laissé le chat sortir du sac.
target_text: Kwa bahati mubaya, Thomas aliacha pusi itoke mu saki.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati mubaya, Thomas aliacha pusi itoke mu saki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme cela nous semblerait flou, inconsistant et inquiétant une tête de vivant s'il n'y avait pas une tête de mort dedans.
target_text: kwa kuwa kwetu itaonekana kama vile isiyo eleweka, isiyo kuwa na uhakika na ya wasiwasi kwa kichwa ya aliye kuwa muzima kama hapangekuwa kichwa ya mufu ndani yake.
target_text_raw: kwa kuwa kwetu itaonekana kama vile isiyo eleweka, isiyo kuwa na uhakika na ya wasiwasi kwa kichwa ya aliye kuwa muzima kama hapangekuwa kichwa ya mufu ndani yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre ami pensait et se sentait sûrement autrement alors qu'aujourd'hui.
target_text: Rafiki yako alikuwa nawaza na kujisikia kuwa tafauti kabisa kwa siku ya leo.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yako alikuwa nawaza na kujisikia kuwa tafauti kabisa kwa siku ya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un seul mensonge détruit cette confiance absolue qui, pour certaines âmes, est le fond même de l’amour.
target_text: Uongo moja inaharibu huo uaminifu ambao, kwa watu wengine, njo msingi ya upendo.
target_text_raw: Uongo moja inaharibu huo uaminifu ambao, kwa watu wengine, njo msingi ya upendo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme l'échange culturel entre les deux pays progressait, la compréhension mutuelle s'approfondit.
target_text: Kwani maongezi ya kitamaduni kati ya hizi nchi mbili inaendelea, maelewano wa pande zote uliongezeka.
target_text_raw: Kwani maongezi ya kitamaduni kati ya hizi nchi mbili inaendelea, maelewano wa pande zote uliongezeka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne bougez pas, s'il vous plait.
target_text: Usitingizike, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Usitingizike, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « On s’en fout, de ça ! » « Mais non, on s’en fout pas ! »
target_text: « Hatujali, na iyo! » « Lakini hapana, tunajali! »
target_text_raw: « Hatujali, na iyo! » « Lakini hapana, tunajali! »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma sœur s'est habillée en vitesse pour la soirée.
target_text: Dada yangu alivala mbio mbio juu ya kwenda ku sherehe.
target_text_raw: Dada yangu alivala mbio mbio juu ya kwenda ku sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Syrie gagnera la guerre contre le terrorisme et démontrera aux parrains de ce fléau que même des armées de terroristes et de mercenaires sanguinaires ne pourraient pas suffire à détruire des États civilisés.
target_text: Syria itashinda vita ya kigaidi na kuonesha kwa wanayo unga mukono iyi janga kwamba ata makundi ya kigaidi na zenye kumwanga damu haziwezi tosha kuangamiza inchi za kusirimuka.
target_text_raw: Syria itashinda vita ya kigaidi na kuonesha kwa wanayo unga mukono iyi janga kwamba ata makundi ya kigaidi na zenye kumwanga damu haziwezi tosha kuangamiza inchi za kusirimuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir larguer du lest, on est trop nombreux.
target_text: Tutalazimika kutupa last, tuko wengi.
target_text_raw: Tutalazimika kutupa last, tuko wengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était l'un des meilleurs films que Maxime ait jamais vus.
target_text: Ilikuwa moja ya filamu ambazo Maxime hajawahi angalia.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa moja ya filamu ambazo Maxime hajawahi angalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai jeté une pierre en direction de l'oiseau.
target_text: Nilitupa lijiwe kuelekea kwenye ndege iko.
target_text_raw: Nilitupa lijiwe kuelekea kwenye ndege iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je rêve de me rendre dans ce pays et surtout de voir le monde.
target_text: Niko na hamu ya kwenda mwa iyi inchi na hasa kuona dunia.
target_text_raw: Niko na hamu ya kwenda mwa iyi inchi na hasa kuona dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces employés de banque semblent ces derniers temps si courtoisement irrespectueux : je me demande ce que cela cache.
target_text: Hizi siku hawa wafanyakazi wa banki wanaonekana kutokuwa na heshima: niko najiuliza inasababishwa na nani.
target_text_raw: Hizi siku hawa wafanyakazi wa banki wanaonekana kutokuwa na heshima: niko najiuliza inasababishwa na nani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme il est doux de se tenir devant le Crucifix, et rester simplement sous le regard plein d’amour du Seigneur.
target_text: Ni vizuri sana kushimama mbele ya Msalaba, na kubakia mbele ya macho ya Bwana.
target_text_raw: Ni vizuri sana kushimama mbele ya Msalaba, na kubakia mbele ya macho ya Bwana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est maintenant étudiante à la fac.
target_text: Kwa sasa ni mwanafunzi wa chuo kikuu.
target_text_raw: Kwa sasa ni mwanafunzi wa chuo kikuu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous souhaite à tous une bonne soirée et plus tard des rêves colorés.
target_text: Nawatakia usiku mwema na pia ndoto nzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Nawatakia usiku mwema na pia ndoto nzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fois de plus, je fus en mesure d'échapper à la mort.
target_text: Kwa mara nyingine, niliweza kuepuka kifo.
target_text_raw: Kwa mara nyingine, niliweza kuepuka kifo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qu'il y a, chéri ?
target_text: Uko na shida gani, mupenzi?
target_text_raw: Uko na shida gani, mupenzi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'Allemagne du Sud fait partie du monde réel et on y dit « molsch » pour « mulsch ».
target_text: Ujerumani ya kusini inapatikana mu dunia ya kweli na uko wanasemaka « molsch » kwa kumaanisha « mulsch ».
target_text_raw: Ujerumani ya kusini inapatikana mu dunia ya kweli na uko wanasemaka « molsch » kwa kumaanisha « mulsch ».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans ce jeu, tu as le droit de tricher. Il faut juste ne pas te faire prendre, sinon tu prends quatre cartes de pénalité.
target_text: Katika iyi muchezo, unaruhusiwa kuibia. Ni kufanya namna yote usikamatwe tu, kama sivyo unapewa malipizi ya cartes ine.
target_text_raw: Katika iyi muchezo, unaruhusiwa kuibia (ku tricher). Ni kufanya namna yote usikamatwe tu, kama sivyo unapewa malipizi ya cartes ine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne restez pas debout toute la nuit !
target_text: Usibakie unashimama busiku yote.
target_text_raw: Usibakie unashimama busiku yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'avais su que vous viendriez, j'aurais attendu.
target_text: Ningejua kama utakuya, ningechunga.
target_text_raw: Ningejua kama utakuya, ningechunga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas, il est fiable, il vient toujours à l'heure.
target_text: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, ni mwaminifu, anakuyaka kwa wakati siku zote.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, ni mwaminifu, anakuyaka kwa wakati siku zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une corde dans mon coffre.
target_text: Niko na kamba mu coffre yangu.
target_text_raw: Niko na kamba mu coffre yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit, et d'un seul mot il calme les orages, / ramène le soleil, dissipe les nuages.
target_text: Anasema, na kwa neno moja anatuliza zoruba, / analeta jua, anaondoa mawingu.
target_text_raw: Anasema, na kwa neno moja anatuliza zoruba, / analeta jua, anaondoa mawingu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suppose que c'est un peu ridicule pour moi de m'inquiéter de quelque chose comme ça.
target_text: Minazani kama ni ujinga kwangu kukuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kitu kama iki.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama ni ujinga kwangu kukuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kitu kama iki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un changement climatique global pourrait avoir été responsable de l'extinction des dinosaures.
target_text: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa ulimwenguni njo inaweza kuwa ilisababishaka minyama dinosaures kupotea.
target_text_raw: Mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa ulimwenguni njo inaweza kuwa ilisababishaka minyama dinosaures kupotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Venons-en aux faits et parlons affaires.
target_text: Tuchunguze yaliyo tokea na tuongelee biashara.
target_text_raw: Tuchunguze yaliyo tokea na tuongelee biashara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Hamusikie, si vile?
target_text_raw: Hamusikie, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel sera enchanté de vous voir.
target_text: Gabriel atafurahi kukuona.
target_text_raw: Gabriel atafurahi kukuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses enfants sont tous des gosses mal élevés.
target_text: Watoto wake wote ni watoto walilelewa mubaya.
target_text_raw: Watoto wake wote ni watoto walilelewa mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'assure de ne pas traverser cette rue, même si je suis pressé.
target_text: Minahakikisha kutokuvuka iyi barabara, ata kama niko mu haraka.
target_text_raw: Minahakikisha kutokuvuka iyi barabara, ata kama niko mu haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jules ferait bien de suivre nos recommandations.

target_text_raw: Jules angejikaza afuate mashauri yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allée directement au lit.
target_text: Nilipita naanza enda ku kitanda.
target_text_raw: Nilipita naanza enda ku kitanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les neuf mots en question, il est conseillé de les apprendre par cœur, car à partir d'eux chacun peut déjà se créer toute une série d'autres pronoms et adverbes.
target_text: Maneno kenda yanayoulizwa, inashauriwa kujifunza ayo kwa moyo, kwa sababu inaweza ruhusu kila mumoja kuunda ma prénoms na adverbes.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai failli me faire écraser.

target_text_raw: Nilikuwa karibu kugongwa.

source_text: Lorsqu’un travailleur se connecte à son tableau de bord Turc M., il visualise une liste de tâches possibles, par qui elles sont proposées, leur délai et leur rémunération.
target_text: Wakati mfanyakazi anaingia ku tableau de bord yake ya Kituruki M., anaona liste ya kazi zinazo wezekana, na jina ya mwenye alizipana, tarehe ya mwisho ya kuzimaliza na malipo.

source_text: Je ne ressens pas particulièrement la faim.
target_text: Ku ngambo yangu, sisikii njala.
target_text_raw: Ku ngambo yangu, sisikii njala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donnez aux hommes de quoi jouer et ils deviendront adultes.
target_text: Upatie wanaume bitu ya kuchezesha na watageuka watu wazima.
target_text_raw: Upatie wanaume bitu ya kuchezesha na watageuka watu wazima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est mort l’artiste ; même s’il nous a quitté, il a laissé des traces indélébiles.
target_text: Uyo msanii alikufa; ata kama alituacha, aliacha alama zisizo vutikana.
target_text_raw: Uyo msanii alikufa; ata kama alituacha, aliacha alama zisizo vutikana.

source_text: Le malheur est un marche-pied pour le génie, une piscine pour le chrétien, un trésor pour l’homme habile, pour les faibles un abîme.
target_text: Bahati mubaya ni njia ya kutimiza kufikia malengo kwa mtu aliye kuwa na ujuzi wa hali ya juu, kisima ya kuogelea kwa mkristo, hazina kwa mtu mwenye uzoefu, shimo kwa wazaifu.
target_text_raw: Bahati mubaya ni njia ya kutimiza kufikia malengo kwa mtu aliye kuwa na ujuzi wa hali ya juu, kisima ya kuogelea kwa mkristo, hazina kwa mtu mwenye uzoefu, shimo kwa wazaifu.

source_text: Elle m'explique toujours les leçons de mathématiques.
target_text: Kila wakati anaifasiriaka leçons za hesabu.
target_text_raw: Kila wakati anaifasiriaka leçons za hesabu (mathématiques).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai mal aux fesses.
target_text: Niko nasikia maumivu ku matako.
target_text_raw: Niko nasikia maumivu ku matako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas prendre le risque de manquer le dernier train.
target_text: Sitaki nikose gari la moshi ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Sitaki nikose gari la moshi ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses cheveux se dressèrent sur sa tête en voyant le fantôme.
target_text: Nywele zake zilimushimama ku kichwa alio ona muzimu.
target_text_raw: Nywele zake zilimushimama ku kichwa alio ona muzimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu regardes tes belles tulipes.
target_text: Unaangalia mimea yako ya tulipes za kupendeza.
target_text_raw: Unaangalia mimea yako ya tulipes za kupendeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel s'est promis qu'il ne ferait plus jamais la même erreur.

target_text_raw: Gabriel alijiahidi kutofanya tena ile ile kosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons nous débarrasser de ces vieilles règles.
target_text: Tunapashwa achana na izi kanuni za zamani.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa achana na izi kanuni za zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève ton manteau.
target_text: Tosha koti yako ya manteau.
target_text_raw: Tosha koti yako ya manteau.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un type sympa.
target_text: Yeye ni mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es fantastique !
target_text: Weye ni mzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Weye ni mzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que c'est que ce bordel ?
target_text: Ni vurugu gani iyi?
target_text_raw: Ni vurugu (désodre) gani iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous effrayez pas de ce que vous entendez avant de l'avoir vu.
target_text: Usiogope unacho sikia mbele ya kukiona.
target_text_raw: Usiogope unacho sikia mbele ya kukiona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Était-ce vous qui avez laissé la porte ouverte la nuit passée ?
target_text: Weye njo uliiacha mulango wazi usiku uliyo pita?
target_text_raw: Weye njo uliiacha mulango wazi usiku uliyo pita?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En effet, c'est une belle surprise de vous voir ici.
target_text: Kwa kweli, ni mushangao kukuona hapa.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli, ni mushangao (surprise) kukuona hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Croyez en la chance !

target_text_raw: Usadikie bahati.

source_text: Un docteur tenta d'extraire une balle de son dos.
target_text: Daktari alijaribu kutosha lisasi ²ndani ya mugongo yake.
target_text_raw: Daktari alijaribu kutosha lisasi ²ndani ya mugongo yake.

source_text: Je ne voulais pas travailler tard mais la patronne m'a dit que je le devais.

target_text_raw: Sikutaka kutumika mpaka usiku, lakini patron alinilazimisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À Sao Paulo en 58, le candidat avec le plus de voix fut un rhinocéros qui s’appelait Cacareco.
target_text: Huko Sao Paulo mnamo mwaka wa 1958, kandidenti aliyepata kura nyingi alikuwa kifaru iliyoitwa Cacareco.
target_text_raw: Huko Sao Paulo mnamo mwaka wa 1958, kandidenti aliyepata kura nyingi alikuwa kifaru ( rhinocéros) iliyoitwa Cacareco.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regardais une émission sur la télévision.
target_text: Nilikuwa naangalia kipindi ku télévision.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa naangalia kipindi ku télévision.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est plus facile à l'imagination de se composer un enfer avec la douleur qu'un paradis avec le plaisir.
target_text: Ni rahisi kwa mawazo kutunga kuzimu yenye maumivu kuliko paradiso yenye raha.
target_text_raw: Ni rahisi kwa mawazo kutunga kuzimu yenye maumivu kuliko paradiso yenye raha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le flux impétueux de ces chocs meurtriers / avec moi de la foule emporte deux guerriers, / Iphite, de qui l'âge enchaîne la vaillance, / et Pélias, qu'Ulysse a blessé de sa lance.
target_text: Ongezeko kubwa ya iyi mauaji ya kushitukia / pamoja na miye kundi kubwa ilichukua maisha ya washujaa mbili, / Iphite, ambaye alikuwa shujaa maisha yake yote, / na Pelias, ambaye Ulysses alilumiza na mukiki yake.
target_text_raw: Ongezeko kubwa ya iyi mauaji ya kushitukia / pamoja na miye kundi kubwa ilichukua maisha ya washujaa mbili, / Iphite, ambaye alikuwa shujaa maisha yake yote, / na Pelias, ambaye Ulysses alilumiza na mukiki yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami était riche en terres et pauvre en argent.

target_text_raw: Sami alikuwa tajiri kwa udongo na maskini kwa pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment le serpent à sonnette peut-il localiser sa proie et la suivre à travers herbes et buissons, après qu'il l'a blessée, s'il est complètement sourd ?
target_text: Namna gani nyoka ya kupinga kengele inaweza gundua mawindo yake, ndani ya majani na maji, kisha kuilumiza, ijapokuwa ni kiziwi kabisa?
target_text_raw: Namna gani nyoka ya kupinga kengele (sonnette) inaweza gundua mawindo yake, ndani ya majani na maji, kisha kuilumiza, ijapokuwa ni kiziwi kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maudit ordinateur !
target_text: Ordinateur gani iyi, Mungu wangu!
target_text_raw: Ordinateur gani iyi, Mungu wangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'art de reconnaître les champignons matsutake est devenu ma passion, culminant par l'écriture d'un livre sur le sujet.
target_text: Nilisha penda sana sanaa ya kutambua buyoga ya matsutake, nitafikia kuandika kitabu juu ya iyi mada.
target_text_raw: Nilisha penda sana sanaa ya kutambua buyoga ya matsutake, nitafikia kuandika kitabu juu ya iyi mada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est devenu accro aux drogues à un jeune âge.
target_text: Alianzaka kutumia sana dawa za kulevya akiwa na miaka kidogo.
target_text_raw: Alianzaka kutumia sana dawa za kulevya akiwa na miaka kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es certainement allergique au pollen et à la poussière.
target_text: Wewe hauvumiliaki na pollen ya maua na vumbi.
target_text_raw: Wewe hauvumiliaki na pollen ya maua na vumbi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'agit de l'un des nôtres.
target_text: Ni mumoja wetu.
target_text_raw: Ni mumoja wetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez le droit de consulter un avocat avant de parler aux policiers.
target_text: Uko na haki ya kukamata avocat mbele ya kuzungumuza na polisi.
target_text_raw: Uko na haki ya kukamata avocat (mtetezi) mbele ya kuzungumuza na polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouvez ajouter des phrases que vous ne savez pas traduire. Peut-être quelqu'un d'autre le saura-t-il !
target_text: Unaweza kuongeza misemwa ambazo hauwezi kutafsiri. Labda mtu mwengine ataijua.
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuongeza misemwa (phrases) ambazo hauwezi kutafsiri. Labda mtu mwengine ataijua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le type idéal pour toi.
target_text: Ni kijana anayefaa kwangu.
target_text_raw: Ni kijana anayefaa kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le but des sanctions collectives contre les populations des territoires occupés n'est pas de punir ces populations mais de les forcer à quitter leurs territoires ancestraux.
target_text: Lengo ya vikwazo vya pamoja kwa wakaaji ndani ya eneo zilizo tawaliwa na kundi za kigaidi siyo kuazibu aba watu bali kuwalazimisha udongo ya mababu zao.
target_text_raw: Lengo ya vikwazo vya pamoja kwa wakaaji ndani ya eneo zilizo tawaliwa na kundi za kigaidi siyo kuazibu aba watu bali kuwalazimisha udongo ya mababu zao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un homme est bien fort quand il s'avoue sa faiblesse.
target_text: Mwanaume anakuwaka na nguvu wakati anaitika uzaifu wake.
target_text_raw: Mwanaume anakuwaka na nguvu wakati anaitika uzaifu wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oliver est un amateur de sensations fortes.
target_text: Olivier ni mwenye kupenda ya hisia kali.
target_text_raw: Olivier ni mwenye kupenda ya hisia (sensations) kali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en suis profondément désolée.
target_text: Samahani sana.
target_text_raw: Samahani sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me casse pas les bonbons !
target_text: Usivunje bonbons zangu!
target_text_raw: Usivunje bonbons zangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai libéré cette phrase et t'invite à l'adopter.
target_text: Nilisema msemwa iyi na minakualika kuitumikisha.
target_text_raw: Nilisema msemwa iyi (phrase) na minakualika kuitumikisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas que les colons extrémistes qui veulent la disparition totale de tous les autochtones. Beaucoup d'intellectuels modérés de cet État raciste et colonialiste le veulent, mais hypocrisie politique oblige, ils ne le déclarent pas publiquement.
target_text: Siyo tu wakoloni wenye msimamo mkali njo wanataka wakaaji wenye udongo wapotee kabisa. Wasomi wengi wa kadiri katika iyi inchi ya ubaguzi wa rangi na ukoloni wanaitaka, lakini unafiki wa kisiasa inalazimisha, hawaitangazi hazarani.
target_text_raw: Siyo tu wakoloni wenye msimamo mkali njo wanataka wakaaji wenye udongo wapotee kabisa. Wasomi wengi wa kadiri katika iyi inchi ya ubaguzi wa rangi na ukoloni wanaitaka, lakini unafiki wa kisiasa inalazimisha, hawaitangazi hazarani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous semblez triste aujourd'hui.
target_text: Unaonekana mwenye uzuni leo.
target_text_raw: Unaonekana mwenye uzuni leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de temps êtes-vous restée à la soirée ?
target_text: Ni wakati gani njo ulifanya kwenye sherehe?
target_text_raw: Ni wakati gani njo ulifanya kwenye sherehe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qui ne nous tue pas nous rend plus forts.
target_text: Yenye haituuwi inatupatia nguvu tele.
target_text_raw: Yenye haituuwi inatupatia nguvu tele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Penses-y, j'ai vraiment besoin d'un téléphone mobile.
target_text: Ifikirie, minahitaji kabisa simu ya mkononi.
target_text_raw: Ifikirie, minahitaji kabisa simu ya mkononi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit que vous auriez été malades.
target_text: Wanasema kama ulikuwa mgonjwa.
target_text_raw: Wanasema kama ulikuwa mgonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceux qui me connaissent savent que je suis plutôt bon aux échecs.
target_text: Wenye wananijua wanaelewa gisi minajua sana mchezo ya échecs.
target_text_raw: Wenye wananijua wanaelewa gisi minajua sana mchezo ya échecs.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne saurais assez vous dire ma reconnaissance.
target_text: Siwezi weza kuonesha shukrani yangu kwako.
target_text_raw: Siwezi weza kuonesha shukrani yangu kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant que vous êtes adultes, vous devriez le savoir.
target_text: Kwa kuwa ulisha kuwa mtu mkubwa sasa, unapashwa ijua.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa ulisha kuwa mtu mkubwa sasa, unapashwa ijua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Préviens Timéo.
target_text: Mupatie Timéo angalisho.
target_text_raw: Mupatie Timéo angalisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les prétextes sont bons pour démolir les maisons des Palestiniens. L'essentiel c'est d'en chasser le maximum de leur propre pays.
target_text: Kisingizio yoyote ni nzuri ili kubomoa nyumba za Wapalestina. Ya maana ni kuwafukuza wengi iwezekanavyo kutoka mu inchi yao.
target_text_raw: Kisingizio yoyote ni nzuri ili kubomoa nyumba za Wapalestina. Ya maana ni kuwafukuza wengi iwezekanavyo kutoka mu inchi yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez placer vos bagages sur cette balance.
target_text: Tafazali mutie mizigo yenu kwa iyi kilo.
target_text_raw: Tafazali mutie mizigo yenu kwa iyi kilo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier, j'ai eu un peu de fièvre, c'est pourquoi je préfère ne pas sortir.
target_text: Jana, nilikuwa na homa, ndiyo maana sijisikie kutoka.
target_text_raw: Jana, nilikuwa na homa, ndiyo maana sijisikie kutoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande si je n'irais pas quelque part pour changer d'air, puisque mon médecin me le conseille.
target_text: Minajiuliza kama singeenda fasi moja nivute hewa, kwa sababu muganga wangu ananishauri hivo.
target_text_raw: Minajiuliza kama singeenda fasi moja nivute hewa, kwa sababu muganga wangu ananishauri hivo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il te plaît, appelle-moi Angela.
target_text: Tafazali, uniite Angela.
target_text_raw: Tafazali, uniite Angela.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aussi dur que tu essaies, le résultat sera le même.
target_text: Hata uifanye kwa nguvu, matokeo itakuwa ile ile.
target_text_raw: Hata uifanye kwa nguvu, matokeo itakuwa ile ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien ne transforme une maison comme la présence d'une femme charmante.
target_text: Hakuna kitu kinacho badilisha nyumba kama uwepo ya mwanamuke muzuri.
target_text_raw: Hakuna kitu kinacho badilisha nyumba kama uwepo (présence) ya mwanamuke muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suggère que vous partiez immédiatement.
target_text: Nashauri uende sai sai.
target_text_raw: Nashauri uende sai sai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est peut-être pas raisonnable de faire savoir votre présence.
target_text: Labda siyo busara kwako ujulishe kama uko présent.
target_text_raw: Labda siyo busara kwako ujulishe kama uko présent.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il prend la plupart des décisions importantes, sinon toutes, pour son entreprise.
target_text: Anakamataka karibu maamuzi yote ya maana, kama sivyo, kwa kampuni yake.
target_text_raw: Anakamataka karibu maamuzi yote ya maana, kama sivyo, kwa kampuni yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sensible à votre présence ici.
target_text: Naguswa na kuwa kwako hapa.
target_text_raw: Naguswa na kuwa kwako hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons pas la moindre objection à ce que tu adhères à notre cercle.
target_text: Hatuna pingamizi hata kidogo kuhusu weye kujiunga na kundi yetu.
target_text_raw: Hatuna pingamizi hata kidogo kuhusu weye kujiunga na kundi yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai subi une chirurgie de remplacement du genou il y a trois mois.
target_text: Nilifanyiwa upasuaji wa kubadilisha ligoti kunapita miezi tatu.
target_text_raw: Nilifanyiwa upasuaji wa kubadilisha ligoti kunapita miezi tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Travaille en toute saison, dépense selon la raison et tu feras bonne maison.
target_text: Tumika mu misimu yote, tumia kulingana na sababu, na utajenga bunyumba ya kukamilika.
target_text_raw: Tumika mu misimu (saisons) yote, tumia kulingana na sababu, na utajenga bunyumba ya kukamilika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Comité voudra peut-être prendre note des renseignements fournis.
target_text: Kamati inaweza labda kamata maelezo iliyotolewa.
target_text_raw: Kamati inaweza labda kamata maelezo iliyotolewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Désolée, mais tu as tort en la matière.
target_text: Samahani, lakini haina sheria kuhusu iyi jambo.
target_text_raw: Samahani, lakini haina sheria kuhusu iyi jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soit tu rentres, soit tu sors.
target_text: Wala unarudia, wala unatoka.
target_text_raw: Wala unarudia, wala unatoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca achète et vend des voitures.
target_text: Luca anauzaka na anauzishaka ma gari.
target_text_raw: Luca anauzaka na anauzishaka ma gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Sénat ordonna qu'un nouveau Consul soit choisi et que le pays soit libéré de ses ennemis.
target_text: Seneti iliamuru Balozi mupya achaguliwe na kwamba nchi ipate uhuru kutoka kwa maadui zake.
target_text_raw: Seneti iliamuru Balozi mupya achaguliwe na kwamba nchi ipate uhuru kutoka kwa maadui zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que le port de crocs roses est une forme d'affirmation publique d'abstinence sexuelle.
target_text: Minazani kama kuvala biato ya bodaboda ni namna ya kuhakikisha kwamba unaepuka kufanya tendo ya ndoa.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama kuvala biato ya bodaboda (crocs roses) ni namna ya kuhakikisha kwamba unaepuka kufanya tendo ya ndoa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me posez pas de questions si difficiles.
target_text: Musiniulize maulizo ya ngufu.
target_text_raw: Musiniulize maulizo ya ngufu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il avait le corps couvert de contusions après la bagarre.
target_text: Mwili yake ilichubuka chubuka kisha kupigana.
target_text_raw: Mwili yake ilichubuka chubuka kisha kupigana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis lié à lui par une étroite amitié.
target_text: Niko na uhusiano wa urafiki wa karibu naye.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhusiano wa urafiki wa karibu naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des chercheurs ont découvert que des sujets pouvaient collecter deux fois plus de dons pour les œuvres lorsqu'ils portaient des vêtements de marques.
target_text: Watafiti waligundua kuwa watu wanaweza kusanya misaada mara pili ya kazi wakati navala nguo zenye kuwa griffe.
target_text_raw: Watafiti waligundua kuwa watu wanaweza kusanya misaada mara pili ya kazi wakati navala nguo zenye kuwa griffe (alama).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quel point sommes-nous sûrs qu'il ne nous a pas menti ?
target_text: Ni kwa kiasi gani tuko na uhakika kama hakutudanganya.
target_text_raw: Ni kwa kiasi gani tuko na uhakika kama hakutudanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jette un chançard à la mer et il en sortira avec un poisson dans la bouche.
target_text: Tupa mtu wa bahati ndani ya bahari na atatoka na samaki mu kinywa yake.
target_text_raw: Tupa mtu wa bahati ndani ya bahari na atatoka na samaki mu kinywa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont-ils le droit de mener une vie digne sur leur propre terre ?
target_text: Wapalestina wako na haki ya kuishi maisha mazuri ku udongo yao?
target_text_raw: Wapalestina wako na haki ya kuishi maisha mazuri ku udongo yao?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maxime se demandait comment il était supposé se déplacer sans voiture.
target_text: Maxime alikuwa najiuliza atatembea aye bila gari.
target_text_raw: Maxime alikuwa najiuliza atatembea aye bila gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Carlos Morel fut le premier peintre argentin.
target_text: Carlos Morel alikuwa mupaka rangi wa kwanza huko Arjantina.
target_text_raw: Carlos Morel alikuwa mupaka rangi wa kwanza huko Arjantina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous laissez pas dominer par vos émotions. Restez calme !
target_text: Usiruhusu hisia zako zikutawale. Bakia kimya.
target_text_raw: Usiruhusu hisia (émotions) zako zikutawale. Bakia kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Défense de fumer dans l’ascenseur.
target_text: Inakataziwa kuvuta ndani ya ascenseur.
target_text_raw: Inakataziwa kuvuta ndani ya ascenseur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas été invitée à la cérémonie d'ouverture.
target_text: Sikualikwa kwenye sherehe ya ufunguzi.
target_text_raw: Sikualikwa kwenye sherehe ya ufunguzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous allée au stade ?
target_text: Ulienda ku kiwanja ya mupira?
target_text_raw: Ulienda ku kiwanja ya mupira (stade)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La première copine de Mathéo était blonde.
target_text: Mpenzi wa kwanza wa Mathéo alikuwaka na nywele za blonde.
target_text_raw: Mpenzi wa kwanza wa Mathéo alikuwaka na nywele za blonde.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dis : et tout à coup je sens de l'immortel / s'agiter le laurier, et le temple, et l'autel. / Le mont tremble ; chacun vers la terre s'incline, / et ces mots sont sortis de l'enceinte divine :
target_text: Minasema: na ghafla minasikia kutokufa / mti wa laurier unatingizika tingizika, na hekalu, na mazabahu. / Mlima inatetemeka; kila mumoja anainama kuelekea chini, / na iyi maneno inatokea mu nyumba ya Mungu :
target_text_raw: Minasema: na ghafla minasikia kutokufa / mti wa laurier unatingizika tingizika, na hekalu, na mazabahu. / Mlima inatetemeka; kila mumoja anainama kuelekea chini, / na iyi maneno inatokea mu nyumba ya Mungu :
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été estomaquée par l'audace de l'étudiant de poser à l'orateur une question aussi personnelle.
target_text: Nilishangazwa na ujasiri wa mwanafunzi kwa kuuliza muzungumuzaji swali kama iyo ya kibinafsi.
target_text_raw: Nilishangazwa na ujasiri wa mwanafunzi kwa kuuliza muzungumuzaji swali kama iyo ya kibinafsi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pose la main sur son épaule.
target_text: Minatia mkono ku libega yake.
target_text_raw: Minatia mkono ku libega yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'avez-vous pigé ?
target_text: Uliisikia?
target_text_raw: Uliisikia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas est un excellent tireur.
target_text: Thomas ni mpiga lisasi muzuri.
target_text_raw: Thomas ni mpiga lisasi muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis soulagée d’apprendre que mamie va mieux, même si les médecins affirment que ce n’est qu’un sursis.
target_text: Minafurahi kusikia kwamba tate wa mwanamuke inaendelea muzuri, hata kama waganga wanasema kama ni kwa muda tu.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi kusikia kwamba tate wa mwanamuke inaendelea muzuri, hata kama waganga wanasema kama ni kwa muda tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet unique ressort supporte tout le poids de la voiture.
target_text: Iyi ressort inabeba uzito yote ya gari.
target_text_raw: Iyi ressort inabeba uzito yote ya gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez vous faire examiner par un docteur.
target_text: Ulipashwa fanyisha vipomo kwa daktari.
target_text_raw: Ulipashwa fanyisha vipomo kwa daktari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'aime parce qu'elle est patiente.
target_text: Minamupendaka kwa sababu ni mvumilivu.
target_text_raw: Minamupendaka kwa sababu ni mvumilivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est cette mignonne fille avec laquelle je vous ai vus à la galerie commerciale ?
target_text: Ule binti murembo mwenye mulikuwa naye mu gallerie ni nani?
target_text_raw: Ule binti murembo mwenye mulikuwa naye mu gallerie (duka kubwa) ni nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a retourné sa veste.
target_text: Alipita naanza badilisha msimamo yake.
target_text_raw: Alipita naanza badilisha msimamo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devrions fêter ça.
target_text: Tunapashwa kuisherehekea.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa kuisherehekea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis invitée à une soirée ce soir.
target_text: Minaalikwa kwenye sherehe mangaribi ya leo.
target_text_raw: Minaalikwa kwenye sherehe mangaribi ya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde s'en bat les couilles.
target_text: Hakuna mwenye anajali.

source_text: C'est dans une des impressionnantes salles que le studio d'enregistrement a été installé.
target_text: Ni ndani ya moja ya salles za kupendeza sana njo studio ya kurikodi sauti iliwekwa.
target_text_raw: Ni ndani ya moja ya salles za kupendeza sana njo studio ya kurikodi sauti iliwekwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que vous foutez là?
target_text: Muko nafanya nini hapo?
target_text_raw: Muko nafanya nini hapo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles ont arrangé le garage en bureau.
target_text: Waligeuza garage kuwa ofisi.
target_text_raw: Waligeuza garage kuwa ofisi (bureau).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est exactement comme l'original, une copie parfaite.
target_text: Inafanana na original kabisa, copie ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Inafanana na original kabisa, copie ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous serez épargnées si vous vous rendez.
target_text: Utapona kama unaitika kujitoa wepeke.
target_text_raw: Utapona kama unaitika kujitoa wepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Remets tes jouets dans la boite et range la boite sur l'étagère.
target_text: Rudisha bitu yako ya kuchezesha mu boite na utie boite ku étagère.
target_text_raw: Rudisha bitu yako ya kuchezesha mu boite na utie boite ku étagère.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les deux lignes se croisent en angle droit.
target_text: Iyo mistari mbili inakutanana ku pembe ya kuume.
target_text_raw: Iyo mistari mbili inakutanana ku pembe ya kuume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Coucou, y a-t-il quelqu'un ?
target_text: Hodi, piko mtu hapa?
target_text_raw: Hodi, piko mtu hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les États-Unis cherchent à détruire plus de pays que n'importe quelle autre puissance dans le monde.
target_text: Marekani inataka kuharibu inchi mingi kuliko inchi zote zenye kuwa na uwezo duniani.
target_text_raw: Marekani inataka kuharibu inchi mingi kuliko inchi zote zenye kuwa na uwezo duniani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le présent : tout cela que le temps autour de nous est en train d’introduire dans l’éternité.
target_text: Wakati ya sasa: yote yenye wakati inayo tuzunguruka iko naingiza katika umilele.
target_text_raw: Wakati ya sasa: yote yenye wakati inayo tuzunguruka iko naingiza katika umilele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Terre et le Soleil ne sont que des points minuscules parmi les milliards d'étoiles dans la galaxie de la Voie Lactée.
target_text: Dunia na Jua ni nukta ndogo tu kati ya mabilioni ya nyota kwenye galaksi ya anga.
target_text_raw: Dunia na Jua ni nukta ndogo tu kati ya mabilioni (milliards) ya nyota kwenye galaksi ya anga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Traiter avec succès les situations de compétition - voilà une partie importante de la vie.
target_text: Kufikia kuitika bila shaka hali za ushindani - iyi ni sehemu muhimu ya maisha.
target_text_raw: Kufikia kuitika bila shaka hali za ushindani - iyi ni sehemu muhimu ya maisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'ailleurs il y a une blague sur les photos d'identité : si on ressemble vraiment à la photo sur son passeport, c'est qu'on a sérieusement besoin de vacances !
target_text: Na kwanza, kuko utani mizaa ku ma foto passeport : kama unajifanana ku photo passeport yako, manaake unahitaji kupata mafungo!
target_text_raw: Na kwanza, kuko utani mizaa ku ma foto passeport : kama unajifanana ku photo passeport yako, manaake unahitaji kupata mafungo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Décider unilatéralement d'altérer la création d'autrui est un viol.
target_text: Kuamua kwa upande moja kubadilisha kazi ya mwengine ni ubakaji.
target_text_raw: Kuamua kwa upande moja kubadilisha kazi ya mwengine ni ubakaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Du coté positif, au moins de plus en plus de filles en Afghanistan se rendent-elles à l'école.
target_text: Jambo mzuri, mabinti inchini Afghanistan wazidi kwenda ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Jambo mzuri, mabinti inchini Afghanistan wazidi kwenda ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un détecteur de mensonges fonctionne en détectant les modifications du pouls et de la respiration.
target_text: Chombo inayo gundua uongo inatumikaka kwa kugundua mabadiliko katika mapigo ya moyo na kupumua.
target_text_raw: Chombo inayo gundua uongo (détecteur de mensoge) inatumikaka kwa kugundua mabadiliko katika mapigo ya moyo na kupumua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vogue des petites voitures se termine.
target_text: Gari za kidogo kidogo hazivumi tena.
target_text_raw: Gari za kidogo kidogo hazivumi tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allons au théâtre de bonne heure pour avoir de bonnes places.
target_text: Twende angalia mchezo ya kuigiza mapema juu tupate fasi za muzuri.
target_text_raw: Twende angalia mchezo ya kuigiza mapema juu tupate fasi za muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne dispose pas de l'autorité nécessaire pour passer commande de ça.
target_text: Sina mamlaka ya kuagiza iyi.
target_text_raw: Sina mamlaka ya kuagiza (ku commander) iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens utilisent une échelle pour entrer et sortir.
target_text: Watu wanatumikishaka ngazi kwa kuingia na kutoka.
target_text_raw: Watu wanatumikishaka ngazi kwa kuingia na kutoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La comédie inclut toujours une petite tragédie. C'est pour ça qu'il y a de tristes clowns.
target_text: Vichekesho daima inapitishaka matukio ya kusikitisha. Ndiyo maana kunakuwaka watu wa kuchekeshe wenye kuhuzunika.
target_text_raw: Vichekesho daima inapitishaka matukio ya kusikitisha. Ndiyo maana kunakuwaka watu wa kuchekeshe wenye kuhuzunika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est parce que vous ne voulez pas être seules.
target_text: Ni kwa sababu hamutaki mubakie peke yenu.
target_text_raw: Ni kwa sababu hamutaki mubakie peke yenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous remercie de votre accueil chaleureux.
target_text: Nawashukuru kwa mapokezi yenu mazuri.
target_text_raw: Nawashukuru kwa mapokezi yenu mazuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nouvelle venue, habillée de noir des pieds à la tête, était jeune et jolie; mais sa pâleur et sa maigreur contrastaient avec la distinction de ses traits sur lesquels on lisait une expression de souffrance indicible.
target_text: Mugeni, aliye vala nguo mweusi kutoka ku kichwa mpaka ku migulu, alikuwa kijana na murembo; lakini sura yake ya kuhuzunika na bwembamba yake ilikuwa tafauti ya muonekano yake ambako mtu alikuwa nagundua ku sura yake mateso yenye haiwezi semewa.
target_text_raw: Mugeni, aliye vala nguo mweusi kutoka ku kichwa mpaka ku migulu, alikuwa kijana na murembo; lakini sura yake ya kuhuzunika na bwembamba yake ilikuwa tafauti ya muonekano yake ambako mtu alikuwa nagundua ku sura yake mateso yenye haiwezi semewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je travaille dur afin de rattraper le niveau de la classe.
target_text: Minafanya kazi kwa bidii ili nikuwe ku niveau moya na batu yote mu masomo.
target_text_raw: Minafanya kazi kwa bidii ili nikuwe ku niveau (kiwango) moya na batu yote mu masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a enseigné au groupe de garçons indiens.
target_text: Alifundisha kikundi cha wa gaçons wa Kihindi.
target_text_raw: Alifundisha kikundi cha wa gaçons wa Kihindi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était possible de transformer l'eau de mer en eau douce grâce à cette installation.
target_text: Iliwezekana kubadilisha maji ya bahari kuwa maji matulivu kupitia iyi installation.
target_text_raw: Iliwezekana kubadilisha maji ya bahari kuwa maji matulivu kupitia iyi installation (ufundi).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que tu mérites ça.
target_text: Minazani kwamba unastahili iyi.
target_text_raw: Minazani kwamba unastahili iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a frappé à la porte fermée.
target_text: Alipiga hodi ku mulango iliyofungwa.
target_text_raw: Alipiga hodi ku mulango iliyofungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nul n'est parfait.
target_text: Hakuna mtu aliye kamilika.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mtu aliye kamilika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait un test de grossesse, mais il était négatif.
target_text: Nilifanya kipimo ya mimba, lakini sikukuwa na mimba.
target_text_raw: Nilifanya kipimo ya mimba, lakini sikukuwa na mimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela va durer une éternité.
target_text: Iyo itadumu kwa milele na milele.
target_text_raw: Iyo itadumu kwa milele na milele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il danse aussi gracieusement qu'un ours ivre.
target_text: Anacheza muzuri kama vile ours yenye inalewa.
target_text_raw: Anacheza muzuri kama vile ours yenye inalewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est par mon empressement à leur rendre service, c'est par ma gentillesse, par mon bon cœur que je peux dès maintenant témoigner ma reconnaissance à mes parents.
target_text: Ni kwa hamu yangu ya kuwahudumia, ni kwa upole wangu, kwa roho yangu muzuri njo minaweza sasa toa shukrani kwa wazazi wangu.
target_text_raw: Ni kwa hamu yangu ya kuwahudumia, ni kwa upole wangu, kwa roho yangu muzuri njo minaweza sasa toa shukrani kwa wazazi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bah ! A-t-il vraiment dit ça ? Impossible !
target_text: Bah! Alisema ivyo kweli? Haiwezekani!
target_text_raw: Bah! Alisema ivyo kweli? Haiwezekani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parviens enfin à voir la lumière au bout du tunnel.
target_text: Minaona sasa mwangaza ku mwisho ya njia.
target_text_raw: Minaona sasa mwangaza ku mwisho ya njia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chats sont plus malins que vous ne pensez.
target_text: Pusi zinakuwaka mayele kuliko gisi munafikiri.
target_text_raw: Pusi zinakuwaka mayele kuliko gisi munafikiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'accord monsieur. Le bar à salade est là-bas.
target_text: Sawa Bwana. Restaurant ya salade iko pale.
target_text_raw: Sawa Bwana. Restaurant ya salade iko pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est de l'opportunisme pur et simple.
target_text: Ni fursa ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Ni fursa ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En l'absence du chef de rayon, Monsieur Brun surveille le magasin.
target_text: Kama musimamizi wa rayon haiko, Bwana Brun njo anashimamiaka duka.
target_text_raw: Kama musimamizi wa rayon haiko, Bwana Brun njo anashimamiaka duka (magasin).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où as-tu récupéré toutes ces plantes ?
target_text: Wapi njo ulitosha iyi mimea yote?
target_text_raw: Wapi njo ulitosha iyi mimea yote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une invention pure et simple.
target_text: Iyi yote ni jambo yenye bali inventer.
target_text_raw: Iyi yote ni jambo yenye bali inventer (unda).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont le droit de vivre libres, de récupérer tous leurs biens et de circuler librement dans leur propre pays qui est également le pays de leurs ancêtres.
target_text: Wapalestini wako na haki ya kuishi huru, na kukamata tena bitu yabo yote na kutembea kwa uhuru mu inchi yao yenye kuwa pia inchi ya mababu yao.
target_text_raw: Wapalestini wako na haki ya kuishi huru, na kukamata tena bitu yabo yote na kutembea kwa uhuru mu inchi yao yenye kuwa pia inchi ya mababu yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous lui laissâmes la décision finale.
target_text: Tulimuachia uamuzi ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Tulimuachia uamuzi ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas que vous pensiez que je suis dingue.
target_text: Sitaki muwaze kama niko na bazimu.
target_text_raw: Sitaki muwaze kama niko na bazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que vous ne serez pas déçu.
target_text: Minazani kama hauta sikitika.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama hauta sikitika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des rumeurs circulent selon lesquelles elle aurait trouvé un nouvel emploi.
target_text: Maneno isiyo kuwa na uhakika inasema kwamba inawezekana alisha pata kazi.
target_text_raw: Maneno isiyo kuwa na uhakika inasema kwamba inawezekana alisha pata kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand papa est revenu, je regardais la télé.
target_text: Wakati baba alirudia, nilikuwa naangalia télévision.
target_text_raw: Wakati baba alirudia, nilikuwa naangalia télévision.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne peux pas sérieusement escompter qu'ils ne te reconnaîtront pas avec ce déguisement. Cette moustache de travers à deux sous est un indice révélateur instantané !
target_text: Hauwezi tumainia kama hawatakutambua ata kama unabadilisha muonekano. Iyi mustache yenye haina maana inafanya wakutambue mara moja.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi tumainia kama hawatakutambua ata kama unabadilisha muonekano. Iyi mustache yenye haina maana inafanya wakutambue mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le témoignage n'était pas crédible.
target_text: Ushaidi haikukuwa ya kuaminika.
target_text_raw: Ushaidi haikukuwa ya kuaminika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait un rêve effrayant.
target_text: Nililota ndoto ya kuogopesha.
target_text_raw: Nililota ndoto ya kuogopesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est en train de fouiller dans une poubelle parce qu'il a faim.
target_text: Iko natafutisha tafutisha ndani ya yalala juu anasikia njala.
target_text_raw: Iko natafutisha tafutisha ndani ya yalala juu anasikia njala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chiens aiment pisser sur les bouches à incendie.
target_text: Imbwa zina pendaka koyola yulu ya borne ya kuzimisha moto.
target_text_raw: Imbwa zina pendaka koyola yulu ya borne ya kuzimisha moto (bouche à incendie).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les surplus de marchandises ont été transférés dans un autre entrepôt.
target_text: Biashara ya kuzidisha ilibebwamu mu nyumba ingine ya kuwekea amo biashara.
target_text_raw: Biashara ya kuzidisha (ya yulu) ilibebwamu mu nyumba ingine ya kuwekea amo biashara (entrepôt).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En raison du pourcentage élevé d'oxygène, les gens se sentent pleins de vigueur et d'énergie.
target_text: Kwa sababu ya pourcentage mingi ya hewa, watu walijisikia kuwa na bidii sana na nguvu.
target_text_raw: Kwa sababu ya pourcentage (asilimia) mingi ya hewa, watu walijisikia kuwa na bidii sana na nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes inquiètes, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Munaogopa, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Munaogopa, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu veux que ce mariage marche, tu devras choisir entre passer du temps avec moi et travailler tout le temps.
target_text: Ukitaka iyi ndoa idumu, unapashwa chagua kati yangu na kutumika wakati yote.
target_text_raw: Ukitaka iyi ndoa idumu, unapashwa chagua kati yangu na kutumika wakati yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La flèche indique le chemin à suivre.
target_text: Mushali inaonyesha njia ya kufuata.
target_text_raw: Mushali inaonyesha njia ya kufuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce monde est un grand banquet où la nature convie tous les êtres vivants, à condition que les convives se mangent les uns les autres.
target_text: Ulimwengu hii ni karamu kubwa ambapo mazingira inaalika viumbe vyote vilivyo hai, kwa shurti moja tu wageni wakulane.
target_text_raw: Ulimwengu hii ni karamu kubwa ambapo mazingira inaalika viumbe vyote vilivyo hai, kwa shurti moja tu wageni wakulane.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peu de choses me mettent autant en rage que la vue d'un animal en train d'être battu.
target_text: Ni kitu kidogo njo inanisirikishaka sana kuliko kuona munyama iko napigwa.
target_text_raw: Ni kitu kidogo njo inanisirikishaka sana kuliko kuona munyama iko napigwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aimait à lui faire plaisir, et parfois il suivait le bord de la rivière, jambes nues, pendant des kilomètres, pour lui rapporter des œufs de poules d’eau, de canards sauvages, perdus dans les ajoncs.
target_text: Alikuwaka napenda kumufurahisha, na piko wakati alikuwa natembea pembeni pembeni ya mtoni, migulu wazi, kwa kilometa za kutosha, kumletea mayayi kuku za mu mayi, bata za pori, zenye zilipotelea mu mayani ya miba miba.
target_text_raw: Alikuwaka napenda kumufurahisha, na piko wakati alikuwa natembea pembeni pembeni ya mtoni, migulu wazi, kwa kilometa za kutosha, kumletea mayayi kuku za mu mayi, bata za pori, zenye zilipotelea mu mayani ya miba miba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui fut le gagnant ?
target_text: Nani njo alishinda?
target_text_raw: Nani njo alishinda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A-t-on du lait dans le frigo ?
target_text: Tuko na maziwa mu frigo?
target_text_raw: Tuko na maziwa mu frigo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Christ est ressuscité.
target_text: Kristu amefufuka.
target_text_raw: Kristu amefufuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous essayez de parler figurativement aux robots J-14, ils vous piqueront avec un petit projectile barbelé, mais le plus récent J-37 tuera aléatoirement des humains non coopératifs.
target_text: Ukijaribu kuongea kwa mfano na robots za J-14, zitakuchomeka chomeka na kashindano ka kidogo ka singa, lakini aina ya J-37 yenye ilitoka siku ziliso pita itakuwa nauwa mtu asiye kuwa na ushirikiano.
target_text_raw: Ukijaribu kuongea kwa mfano na robots za J-14, zitakuchomeka chomeka na kashindano ka kidogo ka singa, lakini aina ya J-37 yenye ilitoka siku ziliso pita itakuwa nauwa mtu asiye kuwa na ushirikiano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que vous pourriez apprécier de savoir qui vient déjeuner.
target_text: Nilizani kama ungefurahia kujua nani njo atakuya kula chakula ya mchana.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama ungefurahia kujua nani njo atakuya kula chakula ya mchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Courez aussi vite que vous pouvez et ne me lâchez pas la main !
target_text: Kimbiya mbio iwezekanavyo na usiniachilie mukono.
target_text_raw: Kimbiya mbio iwezekanavyo na usiniachilie mukono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun veut savoir à qui le comte léguera sa fortune.
target_text: Kila mtu anataka kujua nani njo yule tajari ataachia utajiri wake.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu anataka kujua nani njo yule tajari ataachia utajiri wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vois pas le plaisir que l'on peut trouver à soumettre ainsi un noble animal à sa volonté.
target_text: Sioni raha yenye mtu anaweza sikia kwa kutendea munyama mzuri kinyume na mapenzi yake.
target_text_raw: Sioni raha yenye mtu anaweza sikia kwa kutendea munyama mzuri kinyume na mapenzi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je les tuerai toutes.
target_text: Nitawa uwaka wote.
target_text_raw: Nitawa uwaka wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reste droit dans mes bottes et je ferai mon travail.
target_text: Sitabadilisha musimamo yangu na nitaendelea nafanya kazi yangu.
