notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pensé que vous deviez avoir faim, à l'heure qu'il est.
target_text: Nilikuwa nawaza kama unasikia njala, saa iyi.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nawaza kama unasikia njala, saa iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si l'enfant est égoïste, c'est parce qu'il ne connaît des choses que les rapports qu'elles ont avec lui.
target_text: Kama mtoto ni wa kujipendelea, ni kwa sababu mambo yenye anajua ni yenyi kuwa na mahusiano naye.
target_text_raw: Kama mtoto ni wa kujipendelea, ni kwa sababu mambo yenye anajua ni yenyi kuwa na mahusiano naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un grand frère et deux petites sœurs.
target_text: Niko na kaka umoya na ba dada ya kidogo bawili.
target_text_raw: Niko na kaka umoya na ba dada ya kidogo bawili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand on chatouille les pieds de maman, elle est immédiatement bien réveillée.
target_text: Wakati bananyota migulu ya mama, anapitaka naanza lamuka.
target_text_raw: Wakati bananyota migulu ya mama, anapitaka naanza lamuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a cité entre autres, lors de son discours, Kant et Heidegger.
target_text: Wakati ya hotuba yake, alitaja majina ikiwemo Kant na Heidegger.
target_text_raw: Wakati ya hotuba yake, alitaja majina ikiwemo Kant na Heidegger.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'adorerais aller au bal avec vous.
target_text: Ningependa kwenda kwenye sherehe pamoja na weye.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kwenda kwenye sherehe pamoja na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soit tous les pays ont droit à l'arme nucléaire, soit aucun.
target_text: Wala nchi zote zikuwe na haki ya kuwa na silaha za nyuklia, ao pasikuwe ata moya .
target_text_raw: Wala nchi zote zikuwe na haki ya kuwa na silaha za nyuklia (nucléaire), ao pasikuwe ata moya .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons toute la vie pour nous amuser. Nous avons toute la mort pour nous reposer.
target_text: Tungali na muda mingi ya kujifurahisha mu maisha Tuko na kifo kwa kupumuzika.
target_text_raw: Tungali na muda mingi ya kujifurahisha mu maisha Tuko na kifo kwa kupumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Garde-moi une place ! Je te rejoins dans dix minutes.
target_text: Nikamatie fasi moja. Nitakukutana mu dakika kumi.
target_text_raw: Nikamatie fasi moja. Nitakukutana mu dakika kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne descendez pas pendant que le véhicule est en marche !
target_text: Musishuke wakati gari iko natembeya.
target_text_raw: Musishuke wakati gari iko natembeya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pris trois pilules contre le rhume avant d'aller me coucher.
target_text: Nilikunywa bdonge tatu ya dawa ya mafua kabla ya kwenda kulala.
target_text_raw: Nilikunywa bdonge (binini) tatu ya dawa ya mafua kabla ya kwenda kulala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu l'empreinte du chagrin qui était restée gravée sur son visage.
target_text: Niliona alama ya huzuni iliyobakia ku sura yake.
target_text_raw: Niliona alama ya huzuni iliyobakia ku sura yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me réjouis par avance de notre prochaine rencontre.
target_text: Minaanza furahii kwa ajili ya kukutanana yetu.
target_text_raw: Minaanza furahii kwa ajili ya kukutanana yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis identifié aux bandits de ce film.
target_text: Nilijifananisha na majambazi mwa iyi film.
target_text_raw: Nilijifananisha na majambazi mwa iyi film.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est de toute évidence faux.
target_text: Kwa kweli yote ni uongo.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli yote ni uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À un âge avancé, même le diable entrerait dans les ordres.
target_text: Kwa miaka ya mingi sana, ata shetani anaweza nyenyekea.
target_text_raw: Kwa miaka ya mingi sana, ata shetani anaweza nyenyekea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûre que tu trouveras un moyen.
target_text: Niko na imani kama utapa njia ya suluhisho.
target_text_raw: Niko na imani kama utapa njia ya suluhisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le remède n'a pas eu d'effet.
target_text: Dawa haikukuwa na matokeo.
target_text_raw: Dawa haikukuwa na matokeo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sens couler des pleurs que je veux retenir ; le passé me tourmente, et je crains l'avenir.
target_text: Niko nasikia machozi inatiririka ambayo minataka kuzuia; ziku zilizo pita zinani zungurusha kichwa, na minaogopa siku zijazo.
target_text_raw: Niko nasikia machozi inatiririka ambayo minataka kuzuia; ziku zilizo pita zinani zungurusha kichwa, na minaogopa siku zijazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le sous-estime pas. Crois-moi, il mettra sa menace à exécution.
target_text: Usimuzarau. Niaminie, atakukutishia mwisho na mwisho.
target_text_raw: Usimuzarau. Niaminie, atakukutishia mwisho na mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est tellement évident que nous n'avons pas besoin de preuves.
target_text: Ni kweli sana kuwa hatuna lazima ya ushaidi.
target_text_raw: Ni kweli sana kuwa hatuna lazima ya ushaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dressé une liste des choses qu'il me fallait emporter.
target_text: Niliandika liste ya bitu yenye nilipashwa beba.
target_text_raw: Niliandika liste ya bitu yenye nilipashwa beba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Evidemment Timéo sera en retard.
target_text: Kwa kweli, Timéo atachelewa.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli, Timéo atachelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avant de pouvoir embarquer dans l'avion, vous devrez vous soumettre aux contrôles de sécurité de l'aéroport.
target_text: Mbele ya kupanda ndani ya ndege, unapashwa chunguzwa na kamati ya usalama ya uwanja wa ndege.
target_text_raw: Mbele ya kupanda ndani ya ndege, unapashwa chunguzwa na kamati ya usalama ya uwanja wa ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La défense suisse est pleine de trous.
target_text: Ulinzi ya Uswisi iko na mapungufu mingi.
target_text_raw: Ulinzi ya Uswisi iko na mapungufu mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Énée et les Troyens déjà sont rassemblés ; / sur des tapis de pourpre avec pompe étalés / chacun a pris sa place, et leur rang la décide.
target_text: Énée na raia wa Troie walisha kusanyika tayari; / kwenye tapis za rouge za kitajiri / kila mtu alikamata fasi yake, na kiwango yao inaamua.
target_text_raw: Énée na raia wa Troie (Troyens) walisha kusanyika tayari; / kwenye tapis za rouge za kitajiri / kila mtu alikamata fasi yake, na kiwango yao inaamua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne t'inquiète pas. Louis ne nous laissera pas tomber.
target_text: Usiofu. Louis hata tuachilia.
target_text_raw: Usiofu. Louis hata tuachilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vérifiez celle-là !
target_text: Muchunguze uyo.
target_text_raw: Muchunguze uyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Madison a fait un discours émouvant au Congrès.
target_text: Madison alitoa hotuba nzuri mbele ya bunge.
target_text_raw: Madison alitoa hotuba nzuri mbele ya bunge.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis pratiquement sûre que Arthur n'était pas là-bas.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kwamba Arthur hakukuwa huko.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kwamba Arthur hakukuwa huko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Ouais, tout était mieux autrefois ! » « Non, pas tout, mais ça oui. »
target_text: « Ndiyo, yote yalikuwa sawa zamani! » « Hapana, hapana yote, lakini iyi ndio. »
target_text_raw: « Ndiyo, yote yalikuwa sawa zamani! » « Hapana, hapana yote, lakini iyi ndio. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai déjà caché les diamants.
target_text: Nilisha fichika almasi.
target_text_raw: Nilisha fichika almasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu demandes à un mathématicien s'il est majeur ou mineur, ne sois pas surpris s'il répond « oui ».
target_text: Unapomuuliza mtaalam wa hesabu kama ni mkubwa ao mdogo, usishangale kama anajibu « oui ».
target_text_raw: Unapomuuliza mtaalam wa hesabu (mathématicien) kama ni mkubwa ao mdogo, usishangale kama anajibu « oui ».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est impératif pour nous d'encourager les processus collaboratifs de prise de décision.
target_text: Ni shurti kwetu kuhimiza tabia ya ushirikiano kwa kufanya uamuzi.
target_text_raw: Ni shurti kwetu kuhimiza tabia ya ushirikiano kwa kufanya uamuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas perdre ma caution.
target_text: Sitaki poteza caution yangu.
target_text_raw: Sitaki poteza caution yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que nous savons tous les deux comment Louis se sent.
target_text: Minazani siye bote bawaili tunajua namna gani Louis anajisikia.
target_text_raw: Minazani siye bote bawaili tunajua namna gani Louis anajisikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est absorbé dans la lecture d'un roman policier.
target_text: Anafurahia sana kusoma kitabu ya roman ya upelelezi.
target_text_raw: Anafurahia sana kusoma kitabu ya roman ya upelelezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chat a fait le dos rond.
target_text: Pusi haikuangaika na kitu.
target_text_raw: Pusi haikuangaika na kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quoi ressemblait l'autre type ?
target_text: Ule mtu mwengine alikuwa nafanana aye
target_text_raw: Ule mtu mwengine alikuwa nafanana aye
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a fait au vu et au su du personnel.
target_text: Aliifanya mbele ya wafanyikazi wote.
target_text_raw: Aliifanya mbele ya wafanyikazi wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez le droit de faire ce que vous voulez.
target_text: Muko na haki ya kufanya byenye munapenda.
target_text_raw: Muko na haki ya kufanya byenye munapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont finalement ressenti la joie de vaincre.
target_text: Kwa mwisho walisikia furaha ya kushinda.
target_text_raw: Kwa mwisho walisikia furaha ya kushinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai fait que suivre vos instructions.
target_text: Nilifuata tu maagizo yako.
target_text_raw: Nilifuata tu maagizo yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Euh, vous voudrez bien m'excuser ?
target_text: Euh, unaweza ni ruhusu?
target_text_raw: Euh, unaweza ni ruhusu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu arrives chez toi, téléphone à Ali.
target_text: Uki fika kwako, ita Ali ku telefone.
target_text_raw: Uki fika kwako, ita Ali ku telefone.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lave-toi les mains après être allée aux toilettes.
target_text: Nawa mikono kisha kutoka ku toilette.
target_text_raw: Nawa mikono kisha kutoka ku toilette (wc).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous aurez beau essayer, vous ne serez pas capables de finir ça en un jour.
target_text: Ungepima tu, haungeimaliza mu siku moja.
target_text_raw: Ungepima tu, haungeimaliza mu siku moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui, nous allons étudier la grande puissance du futur : la Chine.
target_text: Leo, tutajifunza inchi yenye uwezo kubwa mu siku zijazo: China.
target_text_raw: Leo, tutajifunza inchi yenye uwezo kubwa mu siku zijazo: China.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons une meilleure chance de survie si nous restons calmes.
target_text: Tuko na bahati kubwa ya kuishi kama tunabakia tu kimya.
target_text_raw: Tuko na bahati kubwa ya kuishi kama tunabakia tu kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les couches de glace fondent.
target_text: Lundo za glaces zinayeyuka.
target_text_raw: Lundo za glaces zinayeyuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je refuse que tu me traites comme un esclave.
target_text: Sitaki unikamate sawa vile mtumwa.
target_text_raw: Sitaki unikamate sawa vile mtumwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis affairé jusque tard dans la nuit à mettre diverses choses en ordre.
target_text: Nilipitisha busiku yote niko napanga bitu.
target_text_raw: Nilipitisha busiku yote niko napanga bitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En anglais tout au moins, les noms de tous les continents se terminent par la même lettre avec laquelle ils commencent.
target_text: Kwa Kiingereza, ma jina ya mabara yote inaisha na ile ile herufi yenye ilianza nayo.
target_text_raw: Kwa Kiingereza, ma jina ya mabara yote inaisha na ile ile herufi yenye ilianza nayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La stratégie qu'ils avaient mise au point était très ingénieuse.
target_text: Mfumo yenye walikuwa nakamata ilikuwa ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Mfumo (stratégie) yenye walikuwa nakamata ilikuwa ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment les jeux vidéos nous inspirent-ils pour créer de meilleures applications de e-learning ?
target_text: Michezo ya video inatuhamasisha ku créer applications bora za uvunzaji wa ku mtandao?
target_text_raw: Michezo ya video inatuhamasisha ku créer applications bora za uvunzaji wa ku mtandao (e-learning)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Alain désire toujours rester dans sa maison natale, attaché à son enfance.
target_text: Alain anataka tu bakia ndani ya nyumba yenye alizaliwa amo, akikumbuka utoto wake.
target_text_raw: Alain anataka tu bakia ndani ya nyumba yenye alizaliwa amo, akikumbuka utoto wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle courut dehors, à moitié nue.
target_text: Alikimbia inje, akiwa nusu uchi.
target_text_raw: Alikimbia inje, akiwa nusu uchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais aller en Chine pour étudier afin d'améliorer mon niveau de chinois.
target_text: Ningependa enda somea Uchina juu ya ku boresha namna yangu ya kuongea Kichina.
target_text_raw: Ningependa enda somea Uchina juu ya ku boresha namna yangu ya kuongea Kichina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez ici jusqu'à ce que je revienne.
target_text: Mchunge hapa mpaka saa minarudia.
target_text_raw: Mchunge hapa mpaka saa minarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens qui ne sont pas pressés se mettent du côté droit de l'escalier.
target_text: Watu wenye hawana haraka wanashimamaka upande ya kuume wa escalier.
target_text_raw: Watu wenye hawana haraka wanashimamaka upande ya kuume wa escalier.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La chambre était pleine de petites bestioles, des millions, des petites bêtes grouillantes avec une multitude de petites pattes.
target_text: Chumba ilikuwa nayala bu manyama budogo budogo, mamilioni, bu manyama budogo budogo bwa kurukaruka bwa migulu mifupi.
target_text_raw: Chumba ilikuwa nayala bu manyama budogo budogo, mamilioni, bu manyama budogo budogo bwa kurukaruka bwa migulu mifupi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle le laissa tomber parce qu'elle pensait qu'il était un pauvre type.
target_text: Akamuacha kwa sababu alikuwa nazani kama ni mwanaume maskini.
target_text_raw: Akamuacha kwa sababu alikuwa nazani kama ni mwanaume maskini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cessez d'être aussi gentils avec moi !
target_text: Acha kuwa mtu muzuri kwangu!
target_text_raw: Acha kuwa mtu muzuri kwangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rentrons au motel.
target_text: Turudie ku motel.
target_text_raw: Turudie ku motel.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chats sont des créatures inconstantes.
target_text: Pusi ni viumbe vya kubadilika badilika.
target_text_raw: Pusi ni viumbe vya kubadilika badilika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a deux docteurs dans son cercle d'amis, un chirurgien et un ophtalmologiste.
target_text: Piko ba daktari bawili mu barafiki yake, muganga mwenyi kufanya upasuaji na mwenyi kutunza macho.
target_text_raw: Piko ba daktari bawili mu barafiki yake, muganga mwenyi kufanya upasuaji na mwenyi kutunza macho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Grandir dans un foyer violent est l'une des pires choses qui puissent arriver à un enfant.
target_text: Kukomala katika nyumba yenye kuwa na vurugu ni moja ya mambo mabaya sana yenye yanaweza kumufikia mtoto.
target_text_raw: Kukomala katika nyumba yenye kuwa na vurugu ni moja ya mambo mabaya sana yenye yanaweza kumufikia mtoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le dollar et l'euro ont atteint un maximum historique.
target_text: Dola za kimarekani na ma Euro zilifikia kiwango ya juu ya historia.
target_text_raw: Dola za kimarekani na ma Euro zilifikia kiwango ya juu ya historia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La seule et unique période où j’ai été populaire, c’était en quatrième.
target_text: Wakati moja na ambayo nilijulikana sana, ilikuwa mu somo la ine.
target_text_raw: Wakati moja na ambayo nilijulikana sana, ilikuwa mu somo la ine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a une double personnalité.
target_text: Iko na umutu mbili.
target_text_raw: Iko na umutu (personnalités) mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous verrons qui restera quand les temps seront durs.
target_text: Tutaona nani mwenye atabakia kwenye wakati mugumu.
target_text_raw: Tutaona nani mwenye atabakia kwenye wakati mugumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous aurez besoin d'une lampe torche.
target_text: Utakuwa na lazima ya tala ya kuangazia.
target_text_raw: Utakuwa na lazima ya tala ya kuangazia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais crever la dalle encore longtemps ?
target_text: Nitabakia na njala kwa muda murefu?
target_text_raw: Nitabakia na njala kwa muda murefu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ben mon cochon !
target_text: Oh nguruwe yangu.
target_text_raw: Oh nguruwe yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne vous reste plus rien sinon à espérer.
target_text: Hauna kitu tena unabakiana isipokuwa matumaini tu.
target_text_raw: Hauna kitu tena unabakiana isipokuwa matumaini tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne fourre jamais la tête dans une ruche pour goûter le miel.
target_text: Usisubutu ata siku moja kutia kichwa yako mu mzinga wa nyuki juu ya kuonja asali.
target_text_raw: Usisubutu ata siku moja kutia kichwa yako mu mzinga wa nyuki juu ya kuonja asali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est génial !
target_text: Ni muzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme qui attend le bus a perdu ses nerfs.
target_text: Mtu anayesubiri bisi anapoteza mishipa yake.
target_text_raw: Mtu anayesubiri bisi anapoteza mishipa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez être sûre qu'il est chez lui avant de lui rendre visite.
target_text: Munapashwa kuwa na uhakika kama iko nyumbani kwake mbele ya kumutembelea.
target_text_raw: Munapashwa kuwa na uhakika kama iko nyumbani kwake mbele ya kumutembelea.

source_text: On n'a pas le droit de traverser la rue aux feux rouges.
target_text: Hatuna ruhusa yoyote ya kuvuka barabara wakati feu rouge inaonesha alama mwekundu.
target_text_raw: Hatuna ruhusa yoyote ya kuvuka barabara wakati feu rouge inaonesha alama mwekundu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'abord ils vous ignorent, ensuite ils se moquent de vous, puis ils vous combattent. Et enfin vous gagnez.
target_text: Kwanza wanakupuuza, kisha wanakucheka, wanakupiganisha pia. Maraba unashinda.
target_text_raw: Kwanza wanakupuuza, kisha wanakucheka, wanakupiganisha pia. Maraba unashinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La quasi-totalité des langues du monde n'a pas dépassé le stade de l'oralité.
target_text: Karibu luga zote za dunia haziyavuka hatua ya usemi.
target_text_raw: Karibu luga zote za dunia haziyavuka hatua ya usemi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne tuez pas le messager !
target_text: Usimuuwe mujumbe.
target_text_raw: Usimuuwe mujumbe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je meurs de soif !
target_text: Minakufa na kiu.
target_text_raw: Minakufa na kiu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez mon avis, c'est une totale perte de temps.
target_text: Ukitaka maoni yangu, iyi ni kupoteza muda bure.
target_text_raw: Ukitaka maoni yangu, iyi ni kupoteza muda bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pouvons voyager dans le temps. Et nous le faisons à la vitesse incroyable d’une seconde par seconde.
target_text: Tunaweza safiri kurudia mu siku zilizo pita. Na tunaifanya kwa mbio kubwa sana ya sekunde moja kwa sekunde.
target_text_raw: Tunaweza safiri kurudia mu siku zilizo pita. Na tunaifanya kwa mbio (vitesse) kubwa sana ya sekunde moja kwa sekunde.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que tenteriez-vous si vous saviez que vous ne pouviez pas échouer ?
target_text: Nini njo ungejaribu fanya kama ungejua ya kwamba utashindwa?
target_text_raw: Nini njo ungejaribu fanya kama ungejua ya kwamba utashindwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les femmes mènent bien loin parfois un homme généreux avec leur douce voix.
target_text: Piko wakati wanawake wanafikishaka mbali mwanaume mkarimu na sauti yao tamu.
target_text_raw: Piko wakati wanawake wanafikishaka mbali mwanaume mkarimu na sauti yao tamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous attendons de la visite dans la soirée.
target_text: Tunachunga kupokea wageni mangaribi ya leo.
target_text_raw: Tunachunga kupokea wageni mangaribi ya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout est bourré d'idioties.
target_text: Kila kitu kinayala ujinga.
target_text_raw: Kila kitu kinayala ujinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te prêterai mon manuel si tu promets de ne rien y écrire.
target_text: Nitaku lazima kitabu changu, ukiniahidi kama hautakiandika ako.
target_text_raw: Nitaku lazima kitabu changu, ukiniahidi kama hautakiandika ako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une vraie surprise.
target_text: Ni mushangao ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Ni mushangao (surprise) ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais un guide officiel qui sache parler anglais.
target_text: Ningependa musindikizaji rasmi mwenye anajua zungumuza Kiingereza.
target_text_raw: Ningependa musindikizaji rasmi mwenye anajua zungumuza Kiingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'entreprise lui donna une montre en or en reconnaissance de ses services.
target_text: Kampuni ilimuzawadia saha ya zahabu kwa kumushukuru kwa huduma zake.
target_text_raw: Kampuni ilimuzawadia saha ya zahabu kwa kumushukuru kwa huduma zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas simple d'expliquer comment on doit le prononcer pour que ce soit univoque.
target_text: Siyo vyepesi kuelezea gisi ya kuitamka juu ieleweke muzuri.
target_text_raw: Siyo vyepesi kuelezea gisi ya kuitamka juu ieleweke muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reviens à l'essentiel.
target_text: Narudia ku ya na maana.
target_text_raw: Narudia ku ya na maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à croire que vous ayez embrassé Mathéo.
target_text: Siamini kama ulipatia Mathéo bizu.
target_text_raw: Siamini kama ulipatia Mathéo bizu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles savaient exactement quel risque ils prendraient.
target_text: Walikuwa najua muzuri hatari yenye walijitia amo.
target_text_raw: Walikuwa najua muzuri hatari yenye walijitia amo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton ami pensait et se sentait sûrement alors autrement qu'aujourd'hui.
target_text: Rafiki yako labda alikuwa na waza na kujiskia tafauti kuliko leo.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yako labda alikuwa na waza na kujiskia tafauti kuliko leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quels sont les aliments naturels qui aident à couper l'appétit ?
target_text: Ni chakula gani za asili ambazo zinasaidia kuzuia hamu ya kula?
target_text_raw: Ni chakula gani za asili ambazo zinasaidia kuzuia hamu ya kula?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette découverte a changé toute la donne de l'enquête.
target_text: Iyi ugunduzi ilibadilisha matokeo yote ya uchunguzi.
target_text_raw: Iyi ugunduzi ilibadilisha matokeo yote ya uchunguzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est moins cher si tu les commandes à la douzaine.
target_text: Ni ku bei chini kama unaiuza ku duzene.
target_text_raw: Ni ku bei chini kama unaiuza ku duzene.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On doit risquer gros pour gagner gros.
target_text: Tunapashwa jaribu kitu kikubwa juu tushinde kitu kikubwa.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa jaribu kitu kikubwa juu tushinde kitu kikubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans le jargon de l'immobilier, un « rêve pour bricoleur » signifie généralement que l'endroit est une vraie décharge.
target_text: Mu jargon ya biashara ya ma nyumba, « ndoto kwa mtu wakuungaunga » kwa kawaida inamaanisha iyo mahali ni yalala.
target_text_raw: Mu jargon (misemo) ya biashara ya ma nyumba, « ndoto kwa mtu wakuungaunga » kwa kawaida inamaanisha iyo mahali ni yalala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée, je ne t'ai pas entendue.
target_text: Unisamehe, sikukusikia.
target_text_raw: Unisamehe, sikukusikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Transmets-le à la direction des ressources humaines et au responsable financier.
target_text: Uitumane ku ofisi inayo husika na wafanyakazi ama kwa musimamizi anaye husika na mabo ya pesa.
target_text_raw: Uitumane ku ofisi inayo husika na wafanyakazi ama kwa musimamizi anaye husika na mabo ya pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bob semble excité à l'idée de regarder le match de foot.
target_text: Bob anaonekana kufurahia kuangalia muchezo ya soka.
target_text_raw: Bob anaonekana kufurahia kuangalia muchezo ya soka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez-vous en position de départ.
target_text: Ingia mu position ya kuondoka.
target_text_raw: Ingia mu position ya kuondoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le câble d'alimentation était rompu.
target_text: Singa ya kuleta moto ilichomolewa.
target_text_raw: Singa ya kuleta moto ilichomolewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qu'elle nous a raconté s'avère être vrai.
target_text: Yale ambayo alituelezea inawezekana ikuwe kweli.
target_text_raw: Yale ambayo alituelezea inawezekana ikuwe kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La moustache d'un grand seigneur mais le cœur d'un lièvre !
target_text: Ndevu ya bwana mkubwa lakini moyo wa sungura!
target_text_raw: Ndevu ya bwana mkubwa lakini moyo wa sungura!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vous causer, lorsque vous aurez du temps disponible.
target_text: Ningependa kusimilia na weye, wakati utakuwa na muda.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kusimilia na weye, wakati utakuwa na muda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci, mon chéri.
target_text: Aksanti, mpenzi wangu.
target_text_raw: Aksanti, mpenzi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est malheureusement à la fois vrai et faux.
target_text: Kwa bahati mubaya, ni kweli na ni uongo.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati mubaya, ni kweli na ni uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les extrémistes par parole ne tarderont pas à devenir des groupes armés.
target_text: Makundi za watu wenye msimo mkali hazikawiyaki kugeuka makundi yenye silaha.
target_text_raw: Makundi za watu wenye msimo mkali hazikawiyaki kugeuka makundi yenye silaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La lettre sera envoyée par courrier demain.
target_text: Barua itatumwa na mjumbe kesho.
target_text_raw: Barua itatumwa na mjumbe kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La dépêche n'est pas encore tombée.
target_text: Habari kamili rasmi haiyatolewa.
target_text_raw: Habari kamili rasmi haiyatolewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je continue à dire « chez nous », bien que la maison ne nous appartienne plus. Nous avons quitté le pays depuis bientôt quinze ans et nous n’y reviendrons certainement jamais.
target_text: Minaendelea kusema « kwetu », hata kama nyumba haiko tena yetu. Tulitokaka mu inchi karibu miaka kumi na tano sasa na inawezekana hatuta rudiaka tena.
target_text_raw: Minaendelea kusema « kwetu », hata kama nyumba haiko tena yetu. Tulitokaka mu inchi karibu miaka kumi na tano sasa na inawezekana hatuta rudiaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les langues naturelles sont également complexes — mais de manières différentes. La grammaire du malais est simple, mais le choix entre de nombreux mots apparemment équivalents est dicté par le statut social du locuteur et de l'auditeur.
target_text: Luga zote za asili zinakuwaka nguvu sana - lakini mu namna tafauti. Sarufi ya Kimalesia ni rahisi, lakini kuchagua maneno ya kutumikisha yenye inataka kuwa na maana moya inatokanaka na hali ya kijamii ya musemaji na msikilizaji.
target_text_raw: Luga zote za asili zinakuwaka nguvu sana - lakini mu namna tafauti. Sarufi ya Kimalesia ni rahisi, lakini kuchagua maneno ya kutumikisha yenye inataka kuwa na maana moya inatokanaka na hali ya kijamii ya musemaji na msikilizaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les articles pour messieurs sont vendus au premier étage.
target_text: Bitu ya banaume binauzishwa ku étage ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Bitu ya banaume binauzishwa ku étage ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les deux équipes s'affronteront une autre fois dans la prochaine saison. En attendant, le Real Madrid s'en va avec un arrière-goût amer pour avoir perdu dans leur pays.
target_text: Hizo timu mbili zitapambana tena mu msimu ijao. Lakini kwa sasa, Real Madrid inaondoka na uchungu kubwa ya kupoteza mechi mu nchi yao.
target_text_raw: Hizo timu mbili zitapambana tena mu msimu ijao. Lakini kwa sasa, Real Madrid inaondoka na uchungu kubwa ya kupoteza mechi mu nchi yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle gère une franchise d'une chaîne de restaurants à la mode.
target_text: Anashimamia restaurants mingi za kisasa.
target_text_raw: Anashimamia restaurants mingi za kisasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mieux est le mortel ennemi du bien.
target_text: Ubora ni adui wa mema.
target_text_raw: Ubora ni adui wa mema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Finalement est-ce que vous m'écoutez ?
target_text: Je! Unanisikia sasa?
target_text_raw: Je! Unanisikia sasa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment saviez-vous que cet homme était flic ?
target_text: Aye njo unajua kama uyu mwanaume alikuwaka polisi?
target_text_raw: Aye njo unajua kama uyu mwanaume alikuwaka polisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai enfin pris une décision.
target_text: Maraba nilikamata maamuzi.
target_text_raw: Maraba nilikamata maamuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On peut atteindre ce but par deux voies différentes.
target_text: Tunaweza fikia iyi lengo kwa kutumia njia mbili tafauti.
target_text_raw: Tunaweza fikia iyi lengo kwa kutumia njia mbili tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à me souvenir à quoi ressemble Mathéo.
target_text: Sikumbuke tena gisi Mathéo anafanana.
target_text_raw: Sikumbuke tena gisi Mathéo anafanana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dick est mort à dix ans.
target_text: Disk alifariki na miaka kumi.
target_text_raw: Disk alifariki na miaka kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police poursuit son enquête sur le braquage de l'année passée.
target_text: Polisi inaendelesha uchunguzi kuhusu ya wizi wa pesa ndani ya benki wa mwaka jana.
target_text_raw: Polisi inaendelesha uchunguzi kuhusu ya wizi wa pesa ndani ya benki wa mwaka jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La situation prend une autre tournure s'il existe une relation de cause à effet entre les deux événements.
target_text: Hali inabadilika na kutaka kujua kama kuko uhusiano kati ya kinyume na izi matukio mbili.
target_text_raw: Hali inabadilika na kutaka kujua kama kuko uhusiano kati ya kinyume na izi matukio mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortez du cadre !
target_text: Fanya kitu ya mupya!
target_text_raw: Fanya kitu ya mupya!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'allons plus manger au restaurant indien.
target_text: Hatuta kulia tena mu restaurant ya Wahindi.
target_text_raw: Hatuta kulia tena mu restaurant ya Wahindi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les bonnes choses viennent par trois.
target_text: Bitu ya muzuri binakuyaka bitatu bitatu.
target_text_raw: Bitu ya muzuri binakuyaka bitatu bitatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne pouvez enterrer votre tête dans le sable.
target_text: Hauwezi zika kichwa yako mu muchanga.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi zika kichwa yako mu muchanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que cette gamine est mignonne !
target_text: Uyu binti mdogo ni murembo.
target_text_raw: Uyu binti mdogo ni murembo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce chameau est si apprivoisé que chacun peut le monter.
target_text: Iyi ngamia inazowea watu sana kwamba mtu yeyote anaweza kuipanda ako.
target_text_raw: Iyi ngamia inazowea watu sana kwamba mtu yeyote anaweza kuipanda ako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'inculpation pour assassinat a été reclassée en homicide.
target_text: Mashtaka ya mauaji ilitajwa kuwa mauaji ya binadamu.
target_text_raw: Mashtaka ya mauaji ilitajwa kuwa mauaji ya binadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est mort et son âme est allée en enfer.
target_text: Alikufa na roho yake ilienda jehenamu.
target_text_raw: Alikufa na roho yake ilienda jehenamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sue.
target_text: Minatoka jasho.
target_text_raw: Minatoka jasho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez vous détendre un peu.
target_text: Unapashwa kupumzika kidogo.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kupumzika kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voulez que quelque chose soit bien fait, vous devriez le faire vous-même.
target_text: Kama unapenda kitu kifanywe muzuri, unapashwa kifanya wepeke.
target_text_raw: Kama unapenda kitu kifanywe muzuri, unapashwa kifanya wepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien qu'en regardant votre visage, je sais que vous avez de bonnes nouvelles.
target_text: Kwa kuona tu sura yako, minajua kama uko na habari ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuona tu sura yako, minajua kama uko na habari ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Madame Hughes, voici Peter Brown.
target_text: Madame Hughes, uyu njo Peter Brown.
target_text_raw: Madame Hughes, uyu njo Peter Brown.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous promets que vous ne serez pas déçus.
target_text: Minakuahidi kama hautavunjika moyo.
target_text_raw: Minakuahidi kama hautavunjika moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si nous avions voulu visiter la ville, nous aurions laissé nos valises à l'hôtel.
target_text: Tungetaka kufanya matembezi ndani ya mji, tungeacha mizigo yetu ku hotel.
target_text_raw: Tungetaka kufanya matembezi ndani ya mji, tungeacha mizigo yetu ku hotel.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous prendrons contact avec vous dans les meilleurs délais.
target_text: Tutawasiliana nawe haraka iwezekanavyo.
target_text_raw: Tutawasiliana nawe haraka iwezekanavyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le commandant Joki.
target_text: Ni kamanda Joki.
target_text_raw: Ni kamanda (commandant) Joki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les mots me font l'effet d'un pensionnat de petits garçons que la phrase mène en promenade.
target_text: Maneno inanifanya kujisikia sawa internat ya shule ya sekondari yenye msemi inapeleka kutembea.
target_text_raw: Maneno inanifanya kujisikia sawa internat ya shule ya sekondari yenye msemi (phrase) inapeleka kutembea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amitié que le vin crée ne dure, comme le vin, qu'une nuit.
target_text: Urafiki yenye divai inaudwa inafanyaka, kama divai, usiku moja tu.
target_text_raw: Urafiki yenye divai inaudwa inafanyaka, kama divai, usiku moja tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu t'imagines ?
target_text: Unaona?
target_text_raw: Unaona?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathis ouvrait l'écrin, trouvait la bague dedans et la mettait à son doigt.
target_text: Mathis alifungua sanduku, akakuta pete ndani na kuiweka kwenye kidole chake.
target_text_raw: Mathis alifungua sanduku, akakuta pete ndani na kuiweka kwenye kidole chake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce type est vraiment sympa.
target_text: Uyu mtu mwema kabisa.
target_text_raw: Uyu mtu mwema kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est pas bientôt fini, ce bordel ! On ne s'entend plus.
target_text: Haitaisha sasa ivi, iyi virugu! Hatusikilizani tena.
target_text_raw: Haitaisha sasa ivi, iyi virugu! Hatusikilizani tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oh, zut ! J'ai oublié d'appeler oncle Thomas.
target_text: Oh, zut! Nilisahabu kuita muyomba Thomas.
target_text_raw: Oh, zut! Nilisahabu kuita muyomba Thomas.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça peut être utilisé comme un couteau.
target_text: Inaweza tumikishwa kama kisu.
target_text_raw: Inaweza tumikishwa kama kisu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai demandé à mon institutrice ce que je devais faire ensuite.
target_text: Nilimuuliza mwalimu wangu nini cha kufanya baadaye.
target_text_raw: Nilimuuliza mwalimu wangu nini cha kufanya baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est de la folie de votre part de penser que vous pourriez faire une pareille chose !
target_text: Ni wazimu kwako kuwaza unaweza fanya kitu kam iki.
target_text_raw: Ni wazimu kwako kuwaza unaweza fanya kitu kam iki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peu de gens savent comment retourner l'arme d'un ennemi contre celui-ci.
target_text: Watu wachache ndiyo wanaitikaka kushindwa.
target_text_raw: Watu wachache ndiyo wanaitikaka kushindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le croyez pas !
target_text: Usimuamini.
target_text_raw: Usimuamini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à croire que vous m'ayez menti.
target_text: Siamini kama ulinidanganya.
target_text_raw: Siamini kama ulinidanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Suis-je donc une criminelle pour que vous m’interrogiez ainsi ?
target_text: Maana yake niko muuaji juu muniulize hivyo?
target_text_raw: Maana yake niko muuaji juu muniulize hivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous rappelle que si vous perdez, vous devez vous retirer définitivement.
target_text: Minakukumbusha kama ukishindwa, unapashwa toka na hautarudiaka tena.
target_text_raw: Minakukumbusha kama ukishindwa, unapashwa toka na hautarudiaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Félicitations pour ta victoire!
target_text: Hongera kwa ushindi.
target_text_raw: Hongera kwa ushindi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai déjà présenté mes excuses pour cela.
target_text: Nilishalomba msamaha juu ya iyo.
target_text_raw: Nilishalomba msamaha juu ya iyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'est-il pas un homme totalement vertueux qui ne se chagrine pas qu'on ne le remarque pas ?
target_text: Yeye siyo mtu mwema kabisa ambaye hajuti kwamba hajulikani?
target_text_raw: Yeye siyo mtu mwema kabisa ambaye hajuti kwamba hajulikani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nul ne peut troubler les vraies amitiés.
target_text: Hakuna kitu yenye inaweza vuruga urafiki wa kweli.
target_text_raw: Hakuna kitu yenye inaweza vuruga urafiki wa kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'auriez pas pu choisir pire endroit.
target_text: Haungepashwa chagula fasi ya mubaya.
target_text_raw: Haungepashwa chagula fasi ya mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui gagne, c'est celui qui prend des risques.
target_text: Mwenye anashinda, njo mwenye anasubutu.
target_text_raw: Mwenye anashinda, njo mwenye anasubutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu vas à la bibliothèque cette après-midi, voudrais-tu alors, s'il te plait, ramener deux livres pour moi, tant que tu y es ?
target_text: Ukienda ku biblioteke mchana ya leo, basi tafazali uniletee vitabu mbili ukiwa hapo?
target_text_raw: Ukienda ku biblioteke mchana ya leo, basi tafazali uniletee vitabu mbili ukiwa hapo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas te le dire. C'est un secret et si je te le disais, ce ne serait plus un secret.
target_text: Siwezi kuambia ayo. Ni siri na nikikwambia, haitakuwa tena siri.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kuambia ayo. Ni siri na nikikwambia, haitakuwa tena siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après son départ à la retraite, Teresa se consacra au soin des orphelins.
target_text: Kisha kucha kazi na kupumuzika, Teresa alijishurulisha na matunzo ya yatima.
target_text_raw: Kisha kucha kazi na kupumuzika, Teresa alijishurulisha na matunzo ya yatima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous vérifier que votre ordinateur est bien branché ?
target_text: Unaweza chunguza kama ordinateur yako inachomekewa muzuri?
target_text_raw: Unaweza chunguza kama ordinateur yako inachomekewa muzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis est un inspecteur.
target_text: Yanis ni inspekta.
target_text_raw: Yanis ni inspekta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il gagne le double de moi.
target_text: Anapokeaka mara mbili kunizidi.
target_text_raw: Anapokeaka mara mbili kunizidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a un copain avec qui elle sort depuis le lycée, mais elle a le sentiment que leur relation stagne, alors elle est mécontente.
target_text: Iko na garçon mwenye anapendaka naye tangu shule la segondari, lakini iko naona sawa uhusiano yabo haindeleyi tena muzuri, kwa hiyo hana furaha.
target_text_raw: Iko na garçon mwenye anapendaka naye tangu shule la segondari, lakini iko naona sawa uhusiano yabo haindeleyi tena muzuri, kwa hiyo hana furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fichez le camp, les chats !
target_text: Mutoke, mapusi!
target_text_raw: Mutoke, mapusi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu étais coincée.
target_text: Ulikuwa nakwama.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa nakwama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La professeure s'est mise à nous poser des questions.
target_text: Mwalimu aliaanza kutuuliza ma swali.
target_text_raw: Mwalimu aliaanza kutuuliza ma swali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien sûr, chacun de nous a déjà rencontré des difficultés au niveau de la langue, par exemple lors d'un séjour à l'étranger.
target_text: Kwa kweli, kila mumoja wetu alishawahi kutanana na tatizo ya luga, kwa mfano wakati ya matembezi mu inchi ya mbali.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli, kila mumoja wetu alishawahi kutanana na tatizo ya luga, kwa mfano wakati ya matembezi mu inchi ya mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mien est totalement différent.
target_text: Yangu ni tafauti kabisa.
target_text_raw: Yangu ni tafauti kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fermez-la. Sinon, vous serez virés.
target_text: Funga kinywa. Kama sivyo, utafukuzwa mu kazi.
target_text_raw: Funga kinywa. Kama sivyo, utafukuzwa mu kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te tue pas à la tâche !
target_text: Usijiue na kazi!
target_text_raw: Usijiue na kazi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qu'il dit n'est pas exact.
target_text: Anayo sema siyo kweli.
target_text_raw: Anayo sema siyo kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vérité finit par éclater à son procès.
target_text: Ukweli inauonekna ku masambo yake.
target_text_raw: Ukweli inauonekna ku masambo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La cloche sonne à huit heures.
target_text: Kengele inalia pa saa munane.
target_text_raw: Kengele inalia pa saa munane.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: David tua Goliath avec une fronde.
target_text: Daudi aliuwa Goliati na topito.
target_text_raw: Daudi aliuwa Goliati na topito (mujareti).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je partirai si vous partez.
target_text: Nitaenda ukienda.
target_text_raw: Nitaenda ukienda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Or la question se pose tout autrement.
target_text: Ijapokuwa ulizo inaulizwa kitafauti.
target_text_raw: Ijapokuwa ulizo inaulizwa kitafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est revenu que quand il était déjà trop tard.
target_text: Alirudia tu wakati ilikuwa ilisha kuwa nyuma.
target_text_raw: Alirudia tu wakati ilikuwa ilisha kuwa nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police est à la recherche du tueur.
target_text: Polisi iko natafuta muuaji.
target_text_raw: Polisi iko natafuta muuaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je le jure par la barbe du prophète !
target_text: Minalapa kwa mandevu ya nabii.
target_text_raw: Minalapa kwa mandevu ya nabii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis plus un gamin.
target_text: Siko tena mtoto mudogo.
target_text_raw: Siko tena mtoto mudogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui dira la vérité devra être puni.
target_text: Mwenye atasema kweli ataazibiwa.
target_text_raw: Mwenye atasema kweli ataazibiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolé, Monsieur. Vous n'avez pas le droit de fumer dans la cour.
target_text: Samahani, bwana. Hauruhusiwi kuvuta sigara mu kiwanja.
target_text_raw: Samahani, bwana. Hauruhusiwi kuvuta sigara mu kiwanja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais dû téléphoner à Mike.
target_text: Nilipashwa pigia Mike simu.
target_text_raw: Nilipashwa pigia Mike simu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a eu déjà des types qui t'ont cloué le bec pour tes commentaires arrogants. Alors, pourquoi continues-tu toujours à débiter de telles conneries ?
target_text: Piko wa jamaa wenye walishaka kufungisha mdomo juu ya mameno yako ya kiburi. Sasa, juu ya nini unaendelea kufanya tena buwerewere?
target_text_raw: Piko wa jamaa wenye walishaka kufungisha mdomo juu ya mameno yako ya kiburi. Sasa, juu ya nini unaendelea kufanya tena buwerewere?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On présente un code culturel partagé qui forme l'identité culturelle de la communauté.
target_text: Kanuni ya kitamaduni iliyochangwa njo inayo unda kitambulisho cha kitamaduni cha jamii.
target_text_raw: Kanuni ya kitamaduni iliyochangwa njo inayo unda kitambulisho cha kitamaduni cha jamii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas bon de rester debout si tard la nuit, partenaire.
target_text: Siyo vizuri kuchelewa kulala, rafiki yangu.
target_text_raw: Siyo vizuri kuchelewa kulala, rafiki yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle t'a envoyé ses meilleurs vœux.
target_text: Alikutumia hezi zake za mwaka mwema.
target_text_raw: Alikutumia hezi zake za mwaka mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ce que vous ne comprenez pas.
target_text: Ile njo hamusikii.
target_text_raw: Ile njo hamusikii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée que vous n'ayez pu venir avec nous.
target_text: Samahani kuona hamukuweza kwenda na siye kwetu.
target_text_raw: Samahani kuona hamukuweza kwenda na siye kwetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous attendaient anxieusement la nouvelle qui fit l'effet d'une bombe.
target_text: Kila mtu alikuwa nangojea habari kwa wasiwasi, yenye ilishituwa watu sana.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu alikuwa nangojea habari kwa wasiwasi, yenye ilishituwa watu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fait un test du moteur chaque jour.
target_text: Anapimaka moteur kila siku.
target_text_raw: Anapimaka moteur kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est le film le plus triste que vous ayez jamais vu ?
target_text: Film gani yenye kusikitisha hauyaonaka?
target_text_raw: Film gani yenye kusikitisha hauyaonaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous mettez pas en position délicate.
target_text: Usijitie mu hali mubaya.
target_text_raw: Usijitie mu hali mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vous rends pas de services.
target_text: Sitawasaidia na lolote.
target_text_raw: Sitawasaidia na lolote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia a grandi en parlant et Français et Anglais.
target_text: Kylia alikomala anaongea kifransa na kingereza.
target_text_raw: Kylia alikomala anaongea kifransa na kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu arriveras à 2h30 et Marie arrivera un peu plus tard.
target_text: Utafika saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Utafika saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie atafika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il avait entendu des histoires à propos d'un ancien dieu qui avait quitté son pays plusieurs siècles auparavant par bateau.
target_text: Alikuwa nasikia hadisi juu ya muungu ya zamani ambayo ilikuwaka natoka na mashua mu inchi yayo pilishaka pita karne nyingi.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nasikia hadisi juu ya muungu ya zamani ambayo ilikuwaka natoka na mashua mu inchi yayo pilishaka pita karne (siècles) nyingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans les petites fermes d'antan, trois à quatre ruches complétaient toujours la basse cour et le jardin.
target_text: Ndani ya ma lupango za kidogo kidogo za Antan, mizinga tatu hadi ine ya nyuki ilikuwa naendelesha kiwanja ya minyama na bustani.
target_text_raw: Ndani ya ma lupango za kidogo kidogo za Antan, mizinga tatu hadi ine ya nyuki ilikuwa naendelesha kiwanja ya minyama na bustani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas nécessaire qu'elle sache.
target_text: Siyo lazima ajue.
target_text_raw: Siyo lazima ajue.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-on prouver l'existence d'éboueurs ?
target_text: Tunaweza hakikisha kama wazola yalala wako?
target_text_raw: Tunaweza hakikisha kama wazola yalala wako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parie que vous feriez un bon père.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama utakuwaka baba muzuri.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama utakuwaka baba muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais nous ne savons vraiment rien ; car la vérité se trouve tout au fond.
target_text: Lakini hatujui kitu kabisa; kwa sababu ukweli uko ndani sana.
target_text_raw: Lakini hatujui kitu kabisa; kwa sababu ukweli uko ndani sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'officier de haut rang gardait son calme.
target_text: Afisa wa cheo ya yulu alibakia kuwa mutulivu.
target_text_raw: Afisa (officier) wa cheo ya yulu alibakia kuwa mutulivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des témoins ont rapporté avoir vu Dan presque partout dans la ville.
target_text: Mashahidi walisema kwamba waliona Dan karibu fasi yote ndani ya muji.
target_text_raw: Mashahidi walisema kwamba waliona Dan karibu fasi yote ndani ya muji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce lait a un drôle goût.
target_text: Iyi maziwa iko onjo isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Iyi maziwa iko onjo isiyo kuwa ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils étaient meilleurs que ce à quoi je m'attendais.
target_text: Walikuwa bora kuliko gisi nilikuwa nafikiria.
target_text_raw: Walikuwa bora kuliko gisi nilikuwa nafikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant nous avons peur du paradis que nous avons créé.
target_text: Sasa tunaogopa paradizo yenye tuliumba.
target_text_raw: Sasa tunaogopa paradizo yenye tuliumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet ordinateur est puissant, efficace et simple à utiliser.
target_text: Iyi ordinateur iko uwezo mukubwa, inatumika vizuri zaidi na ni nyepesi kutumikisha.
target_text_raw: Iyi ordinateur iko uwezo mukubwa, inatumika vizuri zaidi na ni nyepesi kutumikisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne peut pas faire ce type de métier et elle non plus.
target_text: Hawezi fanya iyi aina ya kazi na yeye pia.
target_text_raw: Hawezi fanya iyi aina ya kazi na yeye pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants, laissés sans surveillance, firent toutes sortes de farces.
target_text: Watoto walioachwa bila kuchungwa, walifanya kila aina ya vichekesho.
target_text_raw: Watoto walioachwa bila kuchungwa, walifanya kila aina ya vichekesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est devenue folle à lier après avoir appris le suicide de son frère.
target_text: Aligeuka mwendawazimu kisha kusikia kama kaka yake alijiuwa.
target_text_raw: Aligeuka mwendawazimu kisha kusikia kama kaka yake alijiuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai acheté un sac à dos au surplus militaire.
target_text: Niliuza sakoshi ya ku mugongo ya kisoda.
target_text_raw: Niliuza sakoshi ya ku mugongo ya kisoda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu veux vraiment que je te dise ce que je pense de toi, alors voilà : t'es un type arrogant qui casse les pieds à tout le monde.
target_text: Ukitaka nikuambie nini njo minawaza juu yako, sikia sasa : uko kijana wa kiburi ambaya anasumbuwaka kila mtu.
target_text_raw: Ukitaka nikuambie nini njo minawaza juu yako, sikia sasa : uko kijana wa kiburi ambaya anasumbuwaka kila mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons envoyé le paquet par avion.
target_text: Tulituma fulushi kwa ndege.
target_text_raw: Tulituma fulushi kwa ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tony parle anglais mieux que moi.
target_text: Tony anaongeaka kingereza muzuri kunishinda.
target_text_raw: Tony anaongeaka kingereza muzuri kunishinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Théo a pris la décision de devenir pilote d'hélicoptère.
target_text: Théo alifanya uamuzi ya kuwa pilote wa helikopta.
target_text_raw: Théo alifanya uamuzi ya kuwa pilote wa helikopta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les rires des enfants résonnèrent à travers tout le bois.
target_text: Vicheko ya watoto bilisikilikana ndani ya msitu yote.
target_text_raw: Vicheko ya watoto bilisikilikana ndani ya msitu yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce que l'on conçoit bien s'énonce clairement, et les mots pour le dire arrivent aisément.
target_text: Kinacho pangwa muzuri kinaelezewaka waziwazi, na maneno ya kukisema inakuyaka kwa urahisi.
target_text_raw: Kinacho pangwa muzuri kinaelezewaka waziwazi, na maneno ya kukisema inakuyaka kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons sortir d'ici immédiatement.
target_text: Tunapashwa toka hapa sasa ivi.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa toka hapa sasa ivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fois, mon père m'a sauvagement battu dans un arrêt de bus, devant le regard choqué de plusieurs personnes.
target_text: Piko siku baba yangu alinipigaka sana kwenye kituo cha bisi, mbele ya macho ya watu wengi waliyo sikitishwa.
target_text_raw: Piko siku baba yangu alinipigaka sana kwenye kituo cha bisi, mbele ya macho ya watu wengi waliyo sikitishwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est allée au musée en taxi.
target_text: Alienda ku nyumba ya makumbusho na taxi.
target_text_raw: Alienda ku nyumba ya makumbusho (musée) na taxi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle posa un faitout de soupe composée de bouillie d'avoine et de morceaux de lard sur le bord de l'ancienne table creuse.
target_text: Aliweka chungu ya supu iliyotengenezewa na buyi ya bunga ya avoine na bipande ya mafuta ya ngombe ya kugandana pembeni ya meza ya zamani ya kukuliaka.
target_text_raw: Aliweka chungu ya supu iliyotengenezewa na buyi ya bunga ya avoine na bipande ya mafuta ya ngombe ya kugandana (lard) pembeni ya meza ya zamani ya kukuliaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La sœur d'Anna est plus belle que ma meilleure amie Agata.
target_text: Dada yake na Anna ni muzuri sana kushinda rafiki yangu mpenzi Agata.
target_text_raw: Dada yake na Anna ni muzuri sana kushinda rafiki yangu mpenzi Agata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui, naguère encore, croyait gouverner, se retrouve allongé, raide, dans une boîte en bois, et son entourage, comprenant qu’on ne peut plus rien faire de lui, le réduit en cendres.
