source_text: Un virus a infecté l'ordinateur de Mathéo.
target_text: Piko virusi moya yenye ili infecter ordinateur ya Mathéo.
target_text_raw: Piko virusi moya yenye ili infecter ordinateur ya Mathéo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment se fait-il que vous les ayez vus en train de le faire ?
target_text: Namna gani tu njo uliwaona wako wanaifanya?
target_text_raw: Namna gani tu njo uliwaona wako wanaifanya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'étais pas sûr, si je devais avancer ou me retirer.
target_text: Sikukuwa na uhakika, kama niendelee ao niache.
target_text_raw: Sikukuwa na uhakika, kama niendelee ao niache.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre association est fière de compter cinq cents adhérents.
target_text: Shirika yetu inafurahia kuwa na wanamemba mia tano wa mupya.
target_text_raw: Shirika yetu inafurahia kuwa na wanamemba mia tano wa mupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toute une ribambelle de gamins se tenaient là.
target_text: Kikundi kubwa ya watoto ilikuwa hapo.
target_text_raw: Kikundi kubwa ya watoto ilikuwa hapo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une bonne théorie se caractérise par le fait de faire une série de prédictions qui, en principe, pourraient être réfutées ou mises en défaut par l'observation.
target_text: Maelezo mazuri inajulikana kwa kutoa mfululizo wa utabiri yenye, kwa kawaida, inaweza kataliwa ao kuwekwa pembeni na wauzuriaji.
target_text_raw: Maelezo mazuri inajulikana kwa kutoa mfululizo wa utabiri yenye, kwa kawaida, inaweza kataliwa ao kuwekwa pembeni na wauzuriaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que la puce est un insecte ?
target_text: Je! Funza ni kidudu?
target_text_raw: Je! Funza ni kidudu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faites jouer du canon à l'approche de l'ennemi.
target_text: Piga masasi wakati adui anakaribia.
target_text_raw: Piga masasi wakati adui anakaribia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a étudié l'économie à la fac.
target_text: Alisoma mambo ya uchumi kwenye chuo kikuu.
target_text_raw: Alisoma mambo ya uchumi kwenye chuo kikuu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Devine combien j'ai d'employés.
target_text: Tombolesha niko na wafanyakazi wa ngapi.
target_text_raw: Tombolesha niko na wafanyakazi wa ngapi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ses quelques tantes prennent très bien soin de lui.
target_text: Washangazi wake fulani wanamushurulikiaka muzuri.
target_text_raw: Washangazi wake fulani wanamushurulikiaka muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il est hautement improbable que nous serons en mesure de nous échapper de cette prison.
target_text: Minawaza kama ni bigumu sana kwetu kutoroka mwa iyi jela.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama ni bigumu sana kwetu kutoroka mwa iyi jela (prison).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais aller à ce nouveau lieu sur la rue Park.
target_text: Nilikuwa nataka enda ku fasi mupya ku barabara ya Park.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nataka enda ku fasi mupya ku barabara ya Park.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vraiment trop la flemme d'aller bosser.
target_text: Niko na hamu sana ya kwenda kutumika.
target_text_raw: Niko na hamu sana ya kwenda kutumika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu fais trop de bruit ! Chut !
target_text: Unafanya fujo sana! Nyamanza!
target_text_raw: Unafanya fujo sana! Nyamanza!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas.
target_text: Usikuwe na wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a attendu, attendu, mais il n'est jamais revenu.
target_text: Alingoya, akangoya, lakini hakurudiaka tena.
target_text_raw: Alingoya, akangoya, lakini hakurudiaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le coffre est lourd. Je ne peux pas le porter.
target_text: Coffre iko buzito. Siwezi ibeba.
target_text_raw: Coffre iko buzito. Siwezi ibeba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces de Pershing ne furent pas directement envoyées au combat.
target_text: Vikosi vya Persing havikutumwa ku vita mara moja.
target_text_raw: Vikosi vya Persing havikutumwa ku vita mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne savais pas que les bébés pouvaient avoir des opinions politiques.
target_text: Sikukuwaka najua kama watoto wachanga wanaweza kuwa na maoni ya kisiasa.
target_text_raw: Sikukuwaka najua kama watoto wachanga wanaweza kuwa na maoni ya kisiasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu veux que je te ramène quelque chose?
target_text: Unapenda nikuletee kitu fulani.
target_text_raw: Unapenda nikuletee kitu fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas l'intention de divorcer d'avec toi à moins que tu ne me donnes une raison valable.
target_text: Sina nia ya ku divorcer na weye labda kama utanipatia sababu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Sina nia ya ku divorcer na weye labda kama utanipatia sababu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allé me coucher après avoir tout préparé à l'avance.
target_text: Nilienda kulala kisha kutayarisha kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Nilienda kulala kisha kutayarisha kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous faites pas de soucis, on peut compter sur lui.
target_text: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, tunaweza mutumainia.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na wasiwasi, tunaweza mutumainia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je verrai ce que je peux faire, mais je ne vous promets rien.
target_text: Nitaangalia nini ya kufanya, lakini sikuahidi kitu.
target_text_raw: Nitaangalia nini ya kufanya, lakini sikuahidi kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un étudiant a été écrasé par une voiture sur Basin street.
target_text: Mwanafunzi aligongwa na gari kwenye barabara ya Basin Street.
target_text_raw: Mwanafunzi aligongwa na gari kwenye barabara ya Basin Street.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne fallait pas t'inquiéter autant pour elle.
target_text: Usikuwe na wasiwasi sana juu yake.
target_text_raw: Usikuwe na wasiwasi sana juu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne parlons que de faits.
target_text: Tunasema kuhusu mambo ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Tunasema kuhusu mambo ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mien est meilleur que le tien.
target_text: Yangu ni ya muzuri kuliko yako.
target_text_raw: Yangu ni ya muzuri kuliko yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les soldats étaient debout côte à côte.
target_text: Waaskari wote walikuwa nashimama umoja karibu na mwengine.
target_text_raw: Waaskari wote walikuwa nashimama umoja karibu na mwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous tenté de redémarrer l'ordinateur ?
target_text: Ulijaribu ku redémarrer ordinateur ?
target_text_raw: Ulijaribu ku redémarrer ordinateur ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis enchanté de te rencontrer.
target_text: Minafurahi kukutanana na weye.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi kukutanana na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de gosses avez-vous ?
target_text: Uko na watoto ngapi?
target_text_raw: Uko na watoto ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nommer un objet, c'est supprimer les trois quarts de la jouissance du poème qui est faite du bonheur de deviner peu à peu ; le suggérer, voilà le rêve.
target_text: Kutaja kitu fulani, ni kumaliza robo tatu ya utamu ya poème yenye kupendeza kutokana na kutombolesha polepole, kuipendekeza, hiyo njo shaba kubwa.
target_text_raw: Kutaja kitu fulani, ni kumaliza robo tatu (trois quart) ya utamu ya poème (shairi) yenye kupendeza kutokana na kutombolesha polepole, kuipendekeza, hiyo njo shaba kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous assure que je peux faire ça.
target_text: Minakuhakikishia kwamba minaweza ifanya.
target_text_raw: Minakuhakikishia kwamba minaweza ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'en supplie. Je ferai tout ce que tu veux !
target_text: Nakuomba. Nitafanya kila kyenye unataka!
target_text_raw: Nakuomba. Nitafanya kila kyenye unataka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que dites-vous de payer une tournée à tout le monde ?
target_text: Munasema aye kuhusu kulipia kila mtu kinywaji moya moya.
target_text_raw: Munasema aye kuhusu kulipia kila mtu kinywaji moya moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nos anciens ont dit: Si une discussion est brève, elle sert; si elle dure, elle dégénère.
target_text: Wazee walisema: kama mazungumuzo ni ya mufupi, inasaidia, kama ni ya murefu, inaletaka ubishi sana.
target_text_raw: Wazee walisema: kama mazungumuzo ni ya mufupi, inasaidia, kama ni ya murefu, inaletaka ubishi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Concernant ceci, je suis responsable.
target_text: Minahusika na iyi.
target_text_raw: Minahusika na iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que certains en prennent ombrage, mais c'est plus fort que moi, il faut que je vérifie toutes les phrases.
target_text: Minajua kama wengine wako na mashaka nayo, lakini niko na hamu sana, inanibidi kuchunguza misemo yote.
target_text_raw: Minajua kama wengine wako na mashaka nayo, lakini niko na hamu sana, inanibidi kuchunguza misemo (phrases) yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le directeur de l'école veut fermer la cantine et créer une nouvelle salle récréative pour les élèves.
target_text: Kiongozi wa masomo anataka funga cantine na kuigeuza chumba ya wanafunzi kuchezea amo.
target_text_raw: Kiongozi wa masomo anataka funga cantine (duka ya masomo ya chakula ) na kuigeuza chumba ya wanafunzi kuchezea amo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolée de vous déranger.
target_text: Samahani kwa kukusumbua.
target_text_raw: Samahani kwa kukusumbua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous savez bien que l'Autriche n'a pas de bord de mer.
target_text: Unajua muzuri sana kama Autriche haina mipaka ya maji.
target_text_raw: Unajua muzuri sana kama Autriche haina mipaka ya maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu sûre que tu n'es pas fatiguée ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kama hauyachoka?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kama hauyachoka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégagez de mon lit !
target_text: Toka kukitanda yangu!
target_text_raw: Toka kukitanda yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'ayez pas peur du changement.
target_text: Usiogope mabadiliko.
target_text_raw: Usiogope mabadiliko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis la preuve vivante que la mort peut être surmontée.
target_text: Miye ni ushahidi yenye kuwa hai kuwa kifo inaweza shindwa.
target_text_raw: Miye ni ushahidi yenye kuwa hai kuwa kifo inaweza shindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux poursuivre mon travail jusqu'à son succès final.
target_text: Nataka endelea na kazi yangu mpaka ku mafanyikio yake ya mwisho wake.
target_text_raw: Nataka endelea na kazi yangu mpaka ku mafanyikio yake ya mwisho wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sacrée voiture !
target_text: Gari ya mubaya sana iyi!
target_text_raw: Gari ya mubaya sana iyi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Contente-toi de lui dire ce que tu ressens.
target_text: Umwambie tu gisi uko najisikia.
target_text_raw: Umwambie tu gisi uko najisikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un vent fort a rompu les câbles électriques dans plusieurs endroits.
target_text: Upepo mukali ilikata kamba za umeme fasi za mingi.
target_text_raw: Upepo mukali ilikata kamba za umeme fasi za mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce ballon est le trésor de ce garçon.
target_text: Iyi kabumbu ni hazina ya uyu kijana.
target_text_raw: Iyi kabumbu ni hazina ya uyu kijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'écris à présent une lettre à Gabriel.
target_text: Niko naandikia Gabriel barua.
target_text_raw: Niko naandikia Gabriel barua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quoi sert, après tout, de laisser des traces ? Les dinosaures sont-ils plus heureux parce que nous retrouvons leurs fossiles ?
target_text: Inasaidia nini, na kwanza, kuacha alama? Je! Minyama dinausores zinafurahi sana juu tunagundua kwenye zilikuwaka naishi?
target_text_raw: Inasaidia nini, na kwanza, kuacha alama? Je! Minyama dinausores zinafurahi sana juu tunagundua kwenye zilikuwaka naishi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une période de sécheresse explique la maigre récolte.
target_text: Ukame inasababisha na mavuno mabaya.
target_text_raw: Ukame (sécheresse) inasababisha na mavuno mabaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rentrez à la maison.
target_text: Rudia ku nyumba.
target_text_raw: Rudia ku nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle m'a empoigné les fesses !
target_text: Alinigonga ku makalio!
target_text_raw: Alinigonga ku makalio!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le lendemain, il se réveilla tard.
target_text: Kesho kutwa, alilamuka nyuma.
target_text_raw: Kesho kutwa, alilamuka nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'avenir, fantôme aux mains vides, qui promet tout et qui n'a rien !
target_text: Siku zijazo, muzimu yenye kuwa mikono wazi, anayo ahidi kila kitu na haina chochote!
target_text_raw: Siku zijazo, muzimu yenye kuwa mikono wazi, anayo ahidi kila kitu na haina chochote!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu regardes bien autour.
target_text: Nataka uangalie muzuri kandokando.
target_text_raw: Nataka uangalie muzuri kandokando.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est monté à bord de l'avion.
target_text: Alipanda mu ndege.
target_text_raw: Alipanda mu ndege (avion).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela importe peu qu'il vienne tard ou non.
target_text: Haina shida akuye anachelewa ao hapana.
target_text_raw: Haina shida akuye anachelewa ao hapana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas que tu aies une fausse impression.
target_text: Sipendi ukuwe na mawazo mabaya.
target_text_raw: Sipendi ukuwe na mawazo mabaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La jument alezane qui caracolait, hennit en essayant de se débarrasser de son cavalier.
target_text: Farasi ya rangi ya alezane yenye ilikuwa natingizika tingizika, ililalamika na kujaribu kuangusha mupandaji wake.
target_text_raw: Farasi ya rangi ya alezane yenye ilikuwa natingizika tingizika, ililalamika na kujaribu kuangusha mupandaji (cavalier) wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève ton chapeau !
target_text: Tosha kofia yako!
target_text_raw: Tosha kofia yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier au soir, j'ai terminé de lire le roman « La Montagne magique ».
target_text: Jana mangaribi, nilimaliza kusoma kitabu cha hadisi « Mlima wa ajabu ».
target_text_raw: Jana mangaribi, nilimaliza kusoma kitabu cha hadisi (roman) « Mlima wa ajabu ».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que c'est fantastique.
target_text: Minawaza kama ni muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama ni muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te fais un chèque et tu quittes le pays.
target_text: Nitakupatia chèque na upite naanza toka mu ichi.
target_text_raw: Nitakupatia chèque na upite naanza toka mu ichi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne m'entendez pas me plaindre, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Haunisikii nalalamika, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Haunisikii nalalamika, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’usage hésite clairement sur le genre du mot Wi-Fi. Une recherche avec Google montre un ratio d’usage d’environ 71 % pour le masculin et de 29 % pour le féminin. Alors, pourquoi ne pas utiliser tout simplement le réseau sans fil ?
target_text: Utumiaji unasita kabisa kuhusu genre ya neno Wi-Fi. Utafiti wa Google unaonesha asilimia ya 71% ya matumizi ya wanaume na 29% ya wanawake. Sasa, kwa nini kusitumikishwe tu réseau sans fil?
target_text_raw: Utumiaji unasita kabisa kuhusu genre ya neno Wi-Fi. Utafiti wa Google unaonesha asilimia ya 71% ya matumizi ya wanaume na 29% ya wanawake. Sasa, kwa nini kusitumikishwe tu réseau sans fil?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Était-ce toi qui as laissé la porte ouverte la nuit passée ?
target_text: Ni weye njo uliacha mulango wazi jana usiku?
target_text_raw: Ni weye njo uliacha mulango wazi jana usiku?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pourrions passer la soirée ensemble.
target_text: Tungepitisha mangaribi pamoya?
target_text_raw: Tungepitisha mangaribi pamoya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je contrôle mes pensées dans la direction que je choisis.
target_text: Minachunguzaka mawazo yangu mu njia yenye minataka.
target_text_raw: Minachunguzaka mawazo yangu mu njia yenye minataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avons-nous le droit de nous taire face une telle situation ?
target_text: Tuko na haki ya kunyamaza mbele ya hali kama iyi?
target_text_raw: Tuko na haki ya kunyamaza mbele ya hali kama iyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils vont très certainement me manquer.
target_text: Watanikumbuka sana kabisa.
target_text_raw: Watanikumbuka sana kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père a une ferme et il élève des bœufs et des chevaux.
target_text: Baba yangu iko na lupango ya kufugia minyama, anavuga ngombe na farasi.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu iko na lupango ya kufugia minyama, anavuga ngombe na farasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est encore ici, si vous voulez profiter de le voir.
target_text: Angali hapa, kama munataka kumuona.
target_text_raw: Angali hapa, kama munataka kumuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce billet de transport est-il valide dans ce bus ?
target_text: Iyi billet ya safiri ingali inaweza tumika kwa kukamata iyi bisi?
target_text_raw: Iyi billet ya safiri ingali inaweza tumika kwa kukamata iyi bisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un examen plus attentif montre que le crâne a été défoncé par un coup violent.
target_text: Uchunguzi ya kindanindani inaonesha kama kichwa ilipasuliwa na kitu ya nguvu sana.
target_text_raw: Uchunguzi ya kindanindani inaonesha kama kichwa ilipasuliwa na kitu ya nguvu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il appelait sa sœur.
target_text: Alikuwa naita dada yake.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa naita dada yake.

source_text: Nous sommes ici-bas pour rire. Nous ne le pourrons plus au purgatoire ou en enfer. Et, au paradis, ce ne serait pas convenable.

target_text_raw: Ajali iliyo tokea mu barabara ya Hang Tuah ilikuwa nahusu gari tatu ya voiture na moya ya camion.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne faut pas que nous prenions le moindre risque. Je donnerai l'ordre de réexaminer le tout.
target_text: Hatupashwi kujiingiza mu hatari. Nitapana ruhusa ya kuchunguza kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Hatupashwi kujiingiza mu hatari. Nitapana ruhusa ya kuchunguza kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est rare que les trois sommets d'un même triangle se rencontrent dans la vraie vie.
target_text: Siyo rahisi kuona chongo tatu za triangle zinakutanana mu maisha ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Siyo rahisi kuona chongo tatu za triangle zinakutanana mu maisha ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La venue des salons de bronzage intérieurs permet maintenant aux Canadiens d'afficher un bronzage toute l'année.
target_text: Ujio wa salons za kufanyia amo bronzage inaruhusu sasa raia wa Canada kufanya bronzage kila mwaka.
target_text_raw: Ujio wa salons za kufanyia amo bronzage inaruhusu sasa raia wa Canada kufanya bronzage kila mwaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Où as-tu donc mis la voiture ? » « J'ai tourné dix minutes pour trouver une place de parking. »
target_text: « Uliweka gari wapi? » « Nilizunguruka dakika kumi mbele nipate fasi ya kutia gari. »
target_text_raw: « Uliweka gari wapi? » « Nilizunguruka dakika kumi mbele nipate fasi ya kutia gari. »
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa blessure l'empêche de travailler.
target_text: Kidonda yake inamuzuwia kutumika.
target_text_raw: Kidonda yake inamuzuwia kutumika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un mécanicien doué ne gagne pas mal sa vie.
target_text: Fundi mwenye anajua kazi hakuwaki naishi mubaya.
target_text_raw: Fundi mwenye anajua kazi hakuwaki naishi mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a traversé l'océan Pacifique en 30 jours.
target_text: Alivuka bahari ya Pasifike mu siku 30.
target_text_raw: Alivuka bahari ya Pasifike mu siku 30.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le droit communautaire doit préalablement être transcrit dans la législation des états membres de la communauté.
target_text: Haki ya kijamii inapashwa wekwa mu sheria za inchi wanachama za jumuia.
target_text_raw: Haki ya kijamii inapashwa wekwa mu sheria za inchi wanachama za jumuia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la réalité ? Ou tu plaisantes ?
target_text: Ni ukweli? Wala unatania?
target_text_raw: Ni ukweli? Wala unatania?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour les questions financières, M. Jones en sait plus que quiconque dans notre entreprise.
target_text: Kuhusu maswali ya kipesa, Bwana Jones anajua zaidi kuliko mtu yoyote mu kampuni.
target_text_raw: Kuhusu maswali ya kipesa, Bwana Jones anajua zaidi kuliko mtu yoyote mu kampuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Venez tôt, de sorte que nous puissions discuter des projets.
target_text: Kuya mapema, juu tuongee kuhusu miradi.
target_text_raw: Kuya mapema, juu tuongee kuhusu miradi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La grenouille verte saute dans la mare.
target_text: Chura ya kijani inaruka mu tingitingi.
target_text_raw: Chura ya kijani inaruka mu tingitingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je les hais toutes.
target_text: Nawachukia wote.
target_text_raw: Nawachukia wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils m'ont laissée choisir un cadeau.
target_text: Waliniacha nichagule zawadi.
target_text_raw: Waliniacha nichagule zawadi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prénom de Arthur est-il sur la liste?
target_text: Jina ya Arthur iko ku liste?
target_text_raw: Jina ya Arthur iko ku liste?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous une liaison ?
target_text: Muko na uhusiano?
target_text_raw: Muko na uhusiano?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce lac ressemble à un océan.
target_text: Iyi ziwa ifanana na bahari.
target_text_raw: Iyi ziwa ifanana na bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis aimerait savoir ce qui va se passer ensuite.
target_text: Yanis anataka kujua nini njo itafuata baadaye.
target_text_raw: Yanis anataka kujua nini njo itafuata baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La prophétie de sa mère qu'il deviendrait un grand musicien devait se réaliser plus tard.
target_text: Utabiri wa mama yake ya kusema kama atakuwa kuwa mwanamuziki mukubwa itatimia baadaye.
target_text_raw: Utabiri wa mama yake ya kusema kama atakuwa kuwa mwanamuziki mukubwa itatimia baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un ménage est un groupe de personnes qui ont en commun un logement et des moyens de subsistance.
target_text: Jamaa ni kundi ya watu wenye kuchangiya nyumba moja na mahitaji ya maisha.
target_text_raw: Jamaa ni kundi ya watu wenye kuchangiya nyumba moja na mahitaji ya maisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plupart des employés sont partis.
target_text: Wafanyakazi wengi walienda.
target_text_raw: Wafanyakazi wengi walienda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai juré que je ne lui parlerai plus jamais.
target_text: Nililapa kama sitamuongeleshaka tena.
target_text_raw: Nililapa kama sitamuongeleshaka tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelles sont vos raisons de pratiquer la médecine chinoise au Royaume-Uni ?
target_text: Kwa nini unatumia madawa ya wa chinois ukiwa Uingereza?
target_text_raw: Kwa nini unatumia madawa ya wa chinois ukiwa Uingereza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'armoire restera là où je l'ai mise, il n'y a là-dessus aucun doute.
target_text: Kabati itaikala pale niliitia, hakuna shaka.
target_text_raw: Kabati itaikala pale niliitia, hakuna shaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce sac à dos bleu est lourd.
target_text: Sac ya ku mugongo ya rangi ya bleu iko buzito.
target_text_raw: Sac ya ku mugongo ya rangi ya bleu iko buzito.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a chargé Louis de suivre l'affaire.
target_text: Aliacha Louis afatililie ile maneno.
target_text_raw: Aliacha Louis afatililie ile maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lui et moi, on a survécu à l'enfer.
target_text: Miye na yeye, tulipitia shida kubwa.
target_text_raw: Miye na yeye, tulipitia shida kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était la première fois que je voyais Mathéo danser avec Marie.
target_text: Ilikuwa mara yangu ya kwanza kuona Matheo anacheza na Marie.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa mara yangu ya kwanza kuona Matheo anacheza na Marie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu travailles aussi bien que lui quand il avait ton âge.
target_text: Unafanya kazi muzuri kama wakati yeye alikuwaka na umri yako.
target_text_raw: Unafanya kazi muzuri kama wakati yeye alikuwaka na umri yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne baisse pas facilement les bras.
target_text: Sikataki tamaa haraka.
target_text_raw: Sikataki tamaa haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais te filer l'adresse d'un ami.
target_text: Nitakupatia adresse ya rafiki yangu.
target_text_raw: Nitakupatia adresse ya rafiki yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le couple a rompu leurs fiançailles.
target_text: Wanapendanao wawili walivunja uchumba.
target_text_raw: Wanapendanao wawili walivunja uchumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De quelle marque et de quelle couleur est le véhicule du directeur ?
target_text: Gari ya kiongozi ni ya aina gani na rangi gani?
target_text_raw: Gari ya kiongozi ni ya aina gani na rangi gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui sauve une vie sauve le monde entier.
target_text: Anaye okowa maisha ya mutu umoya anaokowa dunia muzima.
target_text_raw: Anaye okowa maisha ya mutu umoya anaokowa dunia muzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En résumé, les éthiques ne sont aussi qu'un langage des signes pour les émotions.
target_text: Kwa kifupi, tabia ni luga ya alama ya hisia.
target_text_raw: Kwa kifupi, tabia ni luga ya alama ya hisia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez, dépêche-toi. Tu vas rater le bus.
target_text: Fanya haraka. Bisi itakuacha.
target_text_raw: Fanya haraka. Bisi itakuacha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme a inventé le langage pour satisfaire son besoin profond de se plaindre.
target_text: Binadamu aliunda luga kwa ajili ya kurizisha hitaji yake kubwa ya kutoa malalamiko.
target_text_raw: Binadamu aliunda luga kwa ajili ya kurizisha hitaji yake kubwa ya kutoa malalamiko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il apprécie les légumes, tout particulièrement le chou.
target_text: Anapendaka mboga ya mayani, hasa chou.
target_text_raw: Anapendaka mboga ya mayani, hasa chou.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand Mathis se réveille, il a toujours soif.
target_text: Wakati Mathis analamuka, anasikiaka kiu.
target_text_raw: Wakati Mathis analamuka, anasikiaka kiu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouviez compter jusqu'à dix lorsque vous aviez deux ans.
target_text: Ulikuwa naweza hesabia mpaka kumi ulipokuwa na miaka mbili.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa naweza hesabia mpaka kumi ulipokuwa na miaka mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si le nombre de lits de soins de longue durée est réduit, alors il ne sera pas possible de poursuivre et cela affectera aussi les lits d'hôpital de jour.
target_text: Kama hesabu ya bitanda ya wagonjwa bya muda murefu inapunguzwa, manake haitawezekana kuendelea na asiri pia bitanda za hospitali.
target_text_raw: Kama hesabu ya bitanda ya wagonjwa bya muda murefu inapunguzwa, manake haitawezekana kuendelea na asiri pia bitanda za hospitali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne touchez pas la vitre.
target_text: Usiguse kioo.
target_text_raw: Usiguse kioo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout est préférable à ces affreux guillemets informatiques qui viennent se coller aux mots de la langue française et les enlaidir à ce point !
target_text: Yote inafaa kwa hizi guillemets informatiques za kutisha ambazo zinakuya kujiweka ku maneno ya luga ya kifaransa na kuzifananisha mubaya sana.
target_text_raw: Yote inafaa kwa hizi guillemets informatiques za kutisha ambazo zinakuya kujiweka ku maneno ya luga ya kifaransa na kuzifananisha mubaya sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ment comme un sermon d'enterrement.
target_text: Anadanganya sawa vile hotuba ya ku mazishi.
target_text_raw: Anadanganya sawa vile hotuba ya ku mazishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous êtes fatigué de débattre avec un inconnu sur Internet, essayez de parler à l'un d'entre eux dans la vraie vie.
target_text: Ukichoka kuzungumuza na mtu mwenye haujui ku mtandao, jaribu kuongea na umoya kati yabo mu maisha ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Ukichoka kuzungumuza na mtu mwenye haujui ku mtandao, jaribu kuongea na umoya kati yabo mu maisha ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous feriez mieux de sortir de là-bas.
target_text: Itakuwa muzuri kama unatoka pale.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa muzuri kama unatoka pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce sont purement des constatations, n'y voyez aucun jugement de valeurs de sa part.
target_text: Ni maoni tu ya kawaida, usiikamate sawa vile mazarau kutoka kwake.
target_text_raw: Ni maoni tu ya kawaida, usiikamate sawa vile mazarau kutoka kwake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous travaillez plus dur que quiconque ici.
target_text: Unatumika sana kuliko mtu wowote hapa.
target_text_raw: Unatumika sana kuliko mtu wowote hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les poupées aux filles et le ballon aux garçons.
target_text: Ma poupées ku wa binti na kabumbu ku wa garçons.
target_text_raw: Ma poupées ku wa binti na kabumbu ku wa garçons.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On en parlera à personne.
target_text: Tutaiongelea uso kwa uso.
target_text_raw: Tutaiongelea uso kwa uso.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pourrais certainement faire usage de cette récompense.
target_text: Minaweza kutumia iyi malipo muzuri.
target_text_raw: Minaweza kutumia iyi malipo muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attends, tu te moques de moi ? Pourquoi on irait si loin ?
target_text: Ngoya, unanicheka? Juu ya nini tutaenda mbali hivi?
target_text_raw: Ngoya, unanicheka? Juu ya nini tutaenda mbali hivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu m'en vois navré.
target_text: Nasikitika kusema hivi.
target_text_raw: Nasikitika kusema hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ancien dictateur égyptien lutte contre la mort.
target_text: Dikteta wa zamani wa Misri iko napigana na kifo.
target_text_raw: Dikteta wa zamani wa Misri iko napigana na kifo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais que tu arrêtes de dire ça.
target_text: Ningependa uache kusema vile.
target_text_raw: Ningependa uache kusema vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la panique, j'ai fait n'importe quoi.
target_text: Mu boga, nilifanya bitu isiyo kuwa na maana.
target_text_raw: Mu boga, nilifanya bitu isiyo kuwa na maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette technologie est une chose incroyable !
target_text: Iyi teknologia ni kitu ya muzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Iyi teknologia ni kitu ya muzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après son coup d’éclat, il est devenu une personne célèbre dans la région.
target_text: Kisha kuaminiwa, alijulikana sana ndani ya jimbo yake.
target_text_raw: Kisha kuaminiwa, alijulikana sana ndani ya jimbo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se peut que mon explication soit absolument erronée. Je la tiens cependant pour la plus plausible.
target_text: Inawezekana kuwa maelezo yangu haiko ya kweli. Lakini minaikamata kuwa uwezekano kubwa.
target_text_raw: Inawezekana kuwa maelezo yangu haiko ya kweli. Lakini minaikamata kuwa uwezekano kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand t'es-tu mise à écrire des chansons ?
target_text: Ulianzaka tunga nyimbo tangu wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Ulianzaka tunga nyimbo tangu wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien d'étonnant à ce qu'elles aient refusé sa proposition.
target_text: Haishangazi kuona walikatala pendekezo yake.
target_text_raw: Haishangazi kuona walikatala pendekezo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fois, je suis allé à l'atelier d'un peintre que je venais de rencontrer au milieu de la nuit. C'était une pièce sombre dans un grenier.
target_text: Piko siku, niliendaka ku duka ya mchoraji mwenye nilikutananaka naye katikati ya busiku. Ilikuwa chumba ya giza ndani ya grenier.
target_text_raw: Piko siku, niliendaka ku duka ya mchoraji mwenye nilikutananaka naye katikati ya busiku. Ilikuwa chumba ya giza ndani ya grenier.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a une photo de lui dans son casier.
target_text: Iko na picha yake mu kabati yake.
target_text_raw: Iko na picha yake mu kabati yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne jouez pas avec les allumettes.
target_text: Usicheze na vibiriti.
target_text_raw: Usicheze na vibiriti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Traduire ce roman était mon rêve.
target_text: Kutafasiri hiki kitabu kya roman ilikuwa ndoto yangu.
target_text_raw: Kutafasiri hiki kitabu kya roman ilikuwa ndoto yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "As-tu déjà mangé un insecte ?" "Une seule fois et c'était dans un sandwich que tu m'avais préparé."
target_text: "Ulishaka kula kidudu?" "Mara moja tu na ilikuwa sandwish njo ulinitayarishiaka ."
target_text_raw: "Ulishaka kula kidudu?" "Mara moja tu na ilikuwa sandwish njo ulinitayarishiaka ."
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais que s'est-il donc passé ? On ne peut pas compter sur toi. Nous avions rendez-vous à huit heures moins le quart, et toi tu arrives à huit heures cinq.
target_text: Lakini nini njo ilitokea? Hatuwezi kukutumainia. Tulikuwa na mpango ya kukutanana saa mbili kasorobo za asubui, na weye unafika saa mbili na dakika tano.
target_text_raw: Lakini nini njo ilitokea? Hatuwezi kukutumainia. Tulikuwa na mpango ya kukutanana saa mbili kasorobo za asubui, na weye unafika saa mbili na dakika tano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te moque pas de moi ! Je suis sérieuse.
target_text: Usinicheke! Siko natania.
target_text_raw: Usinicheke! Siko natania.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas le droit de vous parler de l'incident.
target_text: Sina haki ya kukuelezea kuhusu tokeo.
target_text_raw: Sina haki ya kukuelezea kuhusu tokeo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son cœur bat normalement.
target_text: Mapigo ya roho yake ni ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Mapigo ya roho yake ni ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Retournez dans votre chambre.
target_text: Rudia mu chumba yako.
target_text_raw: Rudia mu chumba yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami était avec ses potes.
target_text: Sami alikuwa na mafiki wake.
target_text_raw: Sami alikuwa na mafiki wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux identifier la voix des enfants sans le moindre problème.
target_text: Unaweza tambua sauti ya watoto bila tatizo yoyote.
target_text_raw: Unaweza tambua sauti ya watoto bila tatizo yoyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette mère célibataire a deux emplois juste pour être en mesure de payer le loyer et nourrir ses enfants.
target_text: Uyu mama aisiye kuwa na bwana iko na kazi mbili juu aweze kulipa nyumba na kukulisha batoto yake.
target_text_raw: Uyu mama aisiye kuwa na bwana iko na kazi mbili juu aweze kulipa nyumba na kukulisha batoto yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plupart des gens craignent plus d'affronter leurs erreurs que de se tromper.
target_text: Watu wengi wanaogopaka kuitika makosa yabo kuliko kujidanganya.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wanaogopaka kuitika makosa yabo kuliko kujidanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Réaliser une belle soudure n'est pas à la portée de tout le monde !
target_text: Siyo kila mtu njo anaweza fanya soudure ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Siyo kila mtu njo anaweza fanya soudure ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fleur de l'illusion produit le fruit de la réalité.
target_text: Mauwa ya wazo isiyo kuwa na kweli inatoshaka matunda ya ukweli.
target_text_raw: Mauwa ya wazo isiyo kuwa na kweli inatoshaka matunda ya ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'auto roule rapidement.
target_text: Gari inatembea mbio.
target_text_raw: Gari inatembea mbio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quiconque parle de lui-même veut, en règle générale, nous tromper sur lui.
target_text: Yeyote anaye ongea kuhusu yepeke anatakaka, mara mingi, kutudanganya kuhusu yeye.
target_text_raw: Yeyote anaye ongea kuhusu yepeke anatakaka, mara mingi, kutudanganya kuhusu yeye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui revient bredouille de la pêche ne contracte rien.
target_text: Mwenye anatoka kurowa mikono wazi hapati chochote.
target_text_raw: Mwenye anatoka kurowa mikono wazi hapati chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chat a détruit mon canapé.
target_text: Pusi iliharibisha kiti yangu ya diva.
target_text_raw: Pusi iliharibisha kiti yangu ya diva.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux manger des spécialités locales, de la poitrine de porc caramélisée aux châtaignes et à la sauce nengyouchijiang.
target_text: Nataka kula chakula ya nyumbani, nyama ya ku kifua ya nguruwe ya kukalangiwa légumes ya châtaignes pembeni na supu nengyouchijiang.
target_text_raw: Nataka kula chakula ya nyumbani, nyama ya ku kifua ya nguruwe ya kukalangiwa légumes ya châtaignes pembeni na supu nengyouchijiang.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le policier porte un masque à gaz.
target_text: Polisi anavala mask ya kujikinga na gaz.
target_text_raw: Polisi anavala mask ya kujikinga na gaz.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien d'extraordinaire ne s'est produit.
target_text: Hakuna kitu ya special yenye ilitokea.
target_text_raw: Hakuna kitu ya special yenye ilitokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas d'autre façon de me sortir de ce malheur.
target_text: Sina njia ingine ya kujitoa mwa iyi tatizo.
target_text_raw: Sina njia ingine ya kujitoa mwa iyi tatizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voudrais qu’on me coupât la tête, elle me gêne par sa masse, elle ne me sert à rien…
target_text: Nilikuwa nataka unikatie kichwa, bunene yayo inaniuzi, hainisaidii kitu...
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nataka unikatie kichwa, bunene yayo inaniuzi, hainisaidii kitu...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans l'un de mes rêves enfiévrés que je déteste le plus, j'ai dû démêler, de tête, un bloc de nouilles japonaises sèches.
target_text: Mu ndoto zangu zenye minachukiaka sana, niliachanisha kichwa na lundo ya spaghetti ya kukauka ya Kijapani.
target_text_raw: Mu ndoto zangu zenye minachukiaka sana, niliachanisha kichwa na lundo ya spaghetti (nouilles) ya kukauka ya Kijapani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelque chose sent le brûlé.
target_text: Piko harufu ya kitu ya kulungula.
target_text_raw: Piko harufu ya kitu ya kulungula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle apporta sur la table un pain tout chaud et un grand vase plein d’une crème épaisse excellente.
target_text: Akabeba mukate ya moto na kikombe ya maziwa ya buzito ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Akabeba mukate ya moto na kikombe ya maziwa ya buzito ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous vous y ferez des amis.
target_text: Utapata barafiki kule.
target_text_raw: Utapata barafiki kule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre alarme incendie se déclenche parfois lorsque ma mère prépare quelque chose dans la cuisine.
target_text: Piko wakati alarme incendie yetu inaliaka kama mama yangu iko napiga chakula mu mafiga.
target_text_raw: Piko wakati alarme incendie yetu inaliaka kama mama yangu iko napiga chakula mu mafiga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un rencard ce soir.
target_text: Niko na rendez-vous ya kimapenzi leo mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Niko na rendez-vous ya kimapenzi (rencard) leo mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bienvenue en enfer !
target_text: Karibu kuzimu!
target_text_raw: Karibu kuzimu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a fallu sortir d'ici.
target_text: Ilinibidi nitoke hapa.
target_text_raw: Ilinibidi nitoke hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les fumeurs sont une bande d'idiots.
target_text: Wavutaji ni kikundi ya wajinga.
target_text_raw: Wavutaji ni kikundi ya wajinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chassez le naturel, il revient en courant.
target_text: Ukifukuza asili, inarudiaka inakimbia.
target_text_raw: Ukifukuza asili, inarudiaka inakimbia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il essayait de cacher sa honte.
target_text: Alikuwa najaribu kufichika haya yake.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa najaribu kufichika haya yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On la voit marcher de dos.
target_text: Anaonekana anatembea kwa nyuma.
target_text_raw: Anaonekana anatembea kwa nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il rejoignit ses collègues dans le bureau du directeur.
target_text: Alijiunga na wenzake mu ofisi ya kiongozi.
target_text_raw: Alijiunga na wenzake mu ofisi ya kiongozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Suzanne a retiré son collier.
target_text: Suzanne alitoa chainette yake.
target_text_raw: Suzanne alitoa chainette yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça serait gâcher leurs talents.
target_text: Itakuwa kuaribisha kipaji yabo.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa kuaribisha kipaji yabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jules César, ce grand héros Romain, fut assassiné.
target_text: Jules César, shujaa mukubwa wa Kiroma, aliuawa.
target_text_raw: Jules César, shujaa mukubwa wa Kiroma, aliuawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces derniers temps avez-vous un sentiment de soif plus prononcé ?
target_text: Je! Hizi siku uko nasikia kama vile uko hamu sana ya kitu fulani?
target_text_raw: Je! Hizi siku uko nasikia kama vile uko hamu sana ya kitu fulani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous serez tout à fait remis dans quelques jours.
target_text: Utajisikia muzuri mu siku kidogo.
target_text_raw: Utajisikia muzuri mu siku kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous savons tous que les ours aiment le miel.
target_text: Siye bote tunajua kama minyama ours zinapendaka asali.
target_text_raw: Siye bote tunajua kama minyama ours zinapendaka asali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est assez impressionnant.
target_text: Inavutia sana.
target_text_raw: Inavutia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu passes à côté.
target_text: Unapoteza bahati.
target_text_raw: Unapoteza bahati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le garçon qui a lancé un avion de papier en direction de l'instituteur.
target_text: Ni garçon aliye tupia mwalimu ndege ya ma kartasi.
target_text_raw: Ni garçon aliye tupia mwalimu ndege ya ma kartasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sers le plat dans une assiette.
target_text: Pakulia chakula mu sahani.
target_text_raw: Pakulia chakula mu sahani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Garçons et filles devraient suivre des cours de cuisine à l'école.
target_text: Wa garçons na mabinti wanapashwa fata mafunzo ya kupiga chakula ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Wa garçons na mabinti wanapashwa fata mafunzo ya kupiga chakula ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dépêchez-vous ! Il faut que je parte au plus tard à sept heures dix.
target_text: Fanya haraka! Napashwa enda saa moya na dakika kumi nikichelewa.
target_text_raw: Fanya haraka! Napashwa enda saa moya na dakika kumi nikichelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est juste associé d'affaires.
target_text: Ni mwenzangu mwenye tunafanya nae tu biashara.
target_text_raw: Ni mwenzangu mwenye tunafanya nae tu biashara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne rajoute surtout pas des figues de Barbarie aux figues fraîches ! Sinon, tu t'en repentiras !
target_text: Usichange matunda ya figues de Barbarie na figues za mubichi. Kama sivyo, utakuyaka tubu iyo kosa!
target_text_raw: Usichange matunda ya figues de Barbarie na figues za mubichi. Kama sivyo, utakuyaka tubu iyo kosa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La façon de parler de Sakura me tape sur les nerfs.
target_text: Namna Sakura iko naongea inani sirikisha sana.
target_text_raw: Namna Sakura iko naongea inani sirikisha sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle fait tourner les têtes.
target_text: Anazungurusha kichwa.
target_text_raw: Anazungurusha kichwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On attendait qu'il prenne une décision.
target_text: Tulikuwa nangoya akamate uamuzi.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa nangoya akamate uamuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ayant écouté son discours, je cherche à comprendre ce qu'il tait.
target_text: Kisha kusikia hotuba yake, nataka kuelewa byenye anaficha.
target_text_raw: Kisha kusikia hotuba yake, nataka kuelewa byenye anaficha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vérifier votre tension.
target_text: Nataka kuchunguza tension yako.
target_text_raw: Nataka kuchunguza tension (mapigo yako ya moyo) yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'espéranto n'est la langue nationale de personne : il peut être la deuxième langue de chacun.
target_text: Esperanto haiko luga ya taifa ya mtu yoyote: Inaweza kuwa luga ya pili ya kila mtu.
target_text_raw: Esperanto haiko luga ya taifa ya mtu yoyote: Inaweza kuwa luga ya pili ya kila mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je respecte ton talent.
target_text: Minaheshimia kipaji chako.
target_text_raw: Minaheshimia kipaji chako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est difficile de trouver un emploi dans un secteur aussi bouché.
target_text: Ni vigumu kupata kazi mu mwa iyi sekta ya ovyo ovyo.
target_text_raw: Ni vigumu kupata kazi mu mwa iyi sekta (domaine) ya ovyo ovyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne disposais pas d'autre moyen de vous contacter alors je suis venue ici en personne.
target_text: Sikukuwa na namna ingine ya kuasiliana na weye njo maana nilikuya hapa miepeke.
target_text_raw: Sikukuwa na namna ingine ya kuasiliana na weye njo maana nilikuya hapa miepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lors d'une dispute, la différence entre un homme et une femme ressemble à celle entre un fusil et une mitrailleuse.
target_text: Wakati ya ugomvi, tafauti kati ya mwanaume na mwanamuke ni kama tafauti kati ya bunduki na bunduki ya mitrailleuse.
target_text_raw: Wakati ya ugomvi, tafauti kati ya mwanaume na mwanamuke ni kama tafauti kati ya bunduki na bunduki ya mitrailleuse.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je bouffe du néophyte.
target_text: Minakula géophyte.
target_text_raw: Minakula géophyte.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le courageux gardien trouve amusant qu'avec la plupart des phrases à la troisième personne en espagnol, vous ayez six possibilités de les traduire en allemand.
target_text: Mchugaji wa bidii anafurahia kuona misemo mingi mu Kihispania ku troisième personne, uko na njia sita yakuzitafsuri mu Kijeremani.
target_text_raw: Mchugaji wa bidii anafurahia kuona misemo mingi mu Kihispania ku troisième personne, uko na njia sita yakuzitafsuri mu Kijeremani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le désir contribue de moitié au plaisir.
target_text: Tamaa inaongezaka nusu ya furaha.
target_text_raw: Tamaa inaongezaka nusu ya furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je peux y aller à la condition de revenir avant 5 heures.
target_text: Minaweza enda kule lakini nirudie mbele ya saa 5.
target_text_raw: Minaweza enda kule lakini nirudie mbele ya saa 5.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À l'heure du courrier électronique, je suis tellement heureux quand un ami m'envoie une vraie lettre.
target_text: Nyakati ya kutuma barua mtandaoni, nakuwaka nafurahi sana wakati rafiki ananitumia barua ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Nyakati ya kutuma barua mtandaoni, nakuwaka nafurahi sana wakati rafiki ananitumia barua ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une merveilleuse opportunité.
target_text: Ni fursa ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Ni fursa ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amour est un feu qui, au cours des années, produit davantage de fumée que de chaleur.
target_text: Mapenzi ni moto ambao, gisi miaka inaendelea, unatoa moshi mingi kuliko kifukutu.
target_text_raw: Mapenzi ni moto ambao, gisi miaka inaendelea, unatoa moshi mingi kuliko kifukutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'êtes pas censée être là-dedans.
target_text: Haungepashwa kuwa mule ndani.
target_text_raw: Haungepashwa kuwa mule ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Permettez, Monsieur ?
target_text: Tafazali, Bwana?
target_text_raw: Tafazali, Bwana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la voiture la plus rapide de notre hall d'exposition.
target_text: Njo gari yenye inakimbia mbio sana mu hall yetu ya exposition.
target_text_raw: Njo gari yenye inakimbia mbio sana mu hall yetu ya exposition.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il tenta de s'approcher d'elle en utilisant tous les moyens possibles.
target_text: Alijaribu kumukaribia kwa kutumia njia zote.
target_text_raw: Alijaribu kumukaribia kwa kutumia njia zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps est un grand maître ; le malheur, c'est qu'il tue ses élèves.
target_text: Wakati ni mwalimu mukubwa; lakini, inauwaka wanafunzi wake.
target_text_raw: Wakati ni mwalimu mukubwa; lakini, inauwaka wanafunzi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, montre-nous tes f... phrases...
target_text: Ndio, tuoneshe misemo m... misemo yako...
target_text_raw: Ndio, tuoneshe misemo m... misemo yako...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui ai envoyé une lettre pour lui faire savoir ma décision.
target_text: Nilimuandikia barua juu ya kumujulisha uamuzi wangu.
target_text_raw: Nilimuandikia barua juu ya kumujulisha uamuzi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que le spectacle continue !
target_text: Sherehe iendelee!
target_text_raw: Sherehe iendelee!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu l'as fait au vu et au su du personnel.
target_text: Uliifanya mbele ya macho ya wanafanya kazi.
target_text_raw: Uliifanya mbele ya macho ya wanafanya kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez ici jusqu'à ce que je revienne !
target_text: Ngoya hapa mpaka nirudie!
target_text_raw: Ngoya hapa mpaka nirudie!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un tel pauvre type !
target_text: Ni mtu mwenye hana akili!
target_text_raw: Ni mtu mwenye hana akili!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux choisir n'importe quel livre que tu aimes.
target_text: Unaweza chagula kitabu yoyote ile unapenda.
target_text_raw: Unaweza chagula kitabu yoyote ile unapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je savais que je ne devais pas lui rendre visite, j'allai pourtant la voir.
target_text: Nilijua kama siwezi mutembelea, lakini nilienda kumuona.
target_text_raw: Nilijua kama siwezi mutembelea, lakini nilienda kumuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ben, tu sais, cette histoire, j'en n'ai rien à secouer.
target_text: Sasa, unajua, juu iyi mambo, siangaiki hata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Sasa, unajua, juu iyi mambo, siangaiki hata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami n'a pas pu prouver son alibi.
target_text: Sami hakuhakikisha sababu yake.
target_text_raw: Sami hakuhakikisha sababu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça va être génial.
target_text: Itakuwa muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'abord ils vous ignorent, ensuite ils vous raillent, ensuite ils vous combattent et enfin, vous gagnez.
target_text: Kwanza hababajali, banabazarau, kisha banapiganisha, na ku mwisho banabashinda.
target_text_raw: Kwanza hababajali, banabazarau, kisha banapiganisha, na ku mwisho banabashinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A présent, j'en sais plus sur Arthur que ce que j'aurais réellement voulu savoir.
target_text: Kwa sasa, minajua bya mingi kuhusu Arthur kuliko gisi ningependa kujua.
target_text_raw: Kwa sasa, minajua bya mingi kuhusu Arthur kuliko gisi ningependa kujua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cynthia peut calculer à une vitesse incroyable.
target_text: Cynthia anaweza kuhesabau mbio mbio sana.
target_text_raw: Cynthia anaweza kuhesabau mbio mbio sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette petite histoire est trop simple pour tout expliquer.
target_text: Iyi historia fupi iko rahisi sana kwa kusema ifasirie kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Iyi historia fupi iko rahisi sana kwa kusema ifasirie kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n’en reviens toujours pas que nous ayons gagné.
target_text: Mpaka hivi siamini kama tulishinda.
target_text_raw: Mpaka hivi siamini kama tulishinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon bouclier et defence c'est toy, mon Seigneur Dieu, sur toy i'ay esperance, conduis moy en ce lieu.
target_text: Ngome yangu ni weye, Mungu wangu, kwako naweka matumaini, niongeze mahali hapa.
target_text_raw: Ngome yangu ni weye, Mungu wangu, kwako naweka matumaini, niongeze mahali hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maxime, chéri, j'ai peur !
target_text: Mpenzi, Maxime, minaogopa!
target_text_raw: Mpenzi, Maxime, minaogopa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les articles pour messieurs sont vendus à l'étage.
target_text: Vitu ya wanaume vinauzishwa ku étage.
target_text_raw: Vitu ya wanaume vinauzishwa ku étage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le pays était en effervescence au sujet de la question de la défense nationale.
target_text: Habari kuhusu ulinzi wa kitaifa ilisisimua wanainchi wote.
target_text_raw: Habari kuhusu ulinzi wa kitaifa ilisisimua wanainchi wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous m'avez promis que vous prendriez soin de Enzo.
target_text: Uliniahidia kama utashurulikia Enzo.
target_text_raw: Uliniahidia kama utashurulikia Enzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoutez, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Sikiliza, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Sikiliza, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un cessez-le-feu prit effet quelques heures plus tard.
target_text: Kusisitiza mapigano ilianza ma saa chache baadaye.
target_text_raw: Kusisitiza mapigano ilianza ma saa chache baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami a caché le pistolet.
target_text: Sami alifichika bunduki ya pistolet.
target_text_raw: Sami alifichika bunduki ya pistolet.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa décision de rester fût une surprise pour nous tous.
target_text: Uamuzi yake ya kubakia ilikuwa mushtuko kwetu siye bote.
target_text_raw: Uamuzi yake ya kubakia ilikuwa mushtuko kwetu siye bote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Calchas se tait dix jours, sa pitié ne veut pas / révéler la victime et dicter son trépas. "
target_text: " Calchas alibakia kimya muda wa siku kumi, huruma yake haitaki / inaonesha muhanga na inaongoza kifo yake. "
target_text_raw: " Calchas alibakia kimya muda wa siku kumi, huruma yake haitaki / inaonesha muhanga na inaongoza kifo yake. "
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo n'est pas un type sympa.
target_text: Mathéo siyo mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Mathéo siyo mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceci est un hôtel, pas un bordel.
target_text: Iyi ni hoteli, na siyo fasi ya kufanyia vurugu.
target_text_raw: Iyi ni hoteli, na siyo fasi ya kufanyia vurugu (désordre).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai demandé à mon instituteur ce que je devais faire ensuite.
target_text: Niliuliza mwalimu wangu nini ya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Niliuliza mwalimu wangu nini ya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voici que s'avance l'immobilisme et, nous ne savons pas comment l'arrêter.
target_text: Angalia gisi asiye penda mabadiliko anaendelea na, hatujui gisi ya kumuzuia.
target_text_raw: Angalia gisi asiye penda mabadiliko anaendelea na, hatujui gisi ya kumuzuia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette décision politique risque de plomber notre économie.
target_text: Iyi uamuzi wa kisiasa inaweza kuwa na matokeo ya mubaya ku uchumi yetu.
target_text_raw: Iyi uamuzi wa kisiasa inaweza kuwa na matokeo ya mubaya ku uchumi yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous croyez que ça en vaut la peine ? Je ne crois pas.
target_text: Unazani kama ni ya maana? Sizani.
target_text_raw: Unazani kama ni ya maana? Sizani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je te disais la vérité, tu serais surpris.
target_text: Ningekuambia ukweli, ungeshangala.
target_text_raw: Ningekuambia ukweli, ungeshangala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre salut et notre perte sont en dedans de nous-mêmes.
target_text: Wokovu wetu na kupotoshwa kwetu uko ndani yetu.
target_text_raw: Wokovu wetu na kupotoshwa kwetu uko ndani yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est inspecteur.
target_text: Ni muchunguzi.
target_text_raw: Ni muchunguzi (Inspecteur).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les vérités seraient bonnes à dire si on les disait ensemble.
target_text: Kila ukweli ingekuwa muzuri kusema kama tungeisema pamoja.
target_text_raw: Kila ukweli ingekuwa muzuri kusema kama tungeisema pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne penses-tu pas que tu devrais doucement cesser cette activité à la limite de la criminalité ?
target_text: Hauoni kama ingekuwa muzuri uache iyi shuruli ya kihalifu.
target_text_raw: Hauoni kama ingekuwa muzuri uache iyi shuruli ya kihalifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est exact !
target_text: Ni kweli!
target_text_raw: Ni kweli!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: David est à la maison.
target_text: David iko kunyumba.
target_text_raw: David iko kunyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te souhaite de bonnes vacances, pleines de bonnes choses et surtout le soleil !
target_text: Minakutakia mapumuziko njema, yenye kujaa mambo mazuri na hasa jua!
target_text_raw: Minakutakia mapumuziko njema, yenye kujaa mambo mazuri na hasa jua!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a vu le tueur.
target_text: Aliona muuwaji.
target_text_raw: Aliona muuwaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit que dans ces parages est enterré un trésor.
target_text: Wanasemaka kama utajiri inazikwa iyi fasi.
target_text_raw: Wanasemaka kama utajiri (hazina) inazikwa iyi fasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un jour, quand j'étais à l'école primaire, un gamin était harcelé, et ça me chamboulait tellement que j'ai explosé de colère.
target_text: Siku moja, wakati ningali kwenye shule ya musingi, mtoto umoja alinyanyaswa, na ilinisirikishaka sana mpaka nikakamatia na hasira sana.
target_text_raw: Siku moja, wakati ningali kwenye shule ya musingi, mtoto umoja alinyanyaswa, na ilinisirikishaka sana mpaka nikakamatia na hasira sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme à son habitude, Mike était en retard à la réunion cet après-midi.
target_text: Kama kawaida yake, Mike alichelewa ku mukutano leo muchana.
target_text_raw: Kama kawaida yake, Mike alichelewa ku mukutano leo muchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était droit debout.
target_text: Alikuwa anashimama wima.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anashimama wima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'ayez pas l'air si triste !
target_text: Usisirike!
target_text_raw: Usisirike!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ambulance a perdu le contrôle et a failli écraser un piéton.
target_text: Gari ya kubeba wagonjwa ilipoteza controle na ikataka gonga mtu mwenye alikuwa natembea na migulu.
target_text_raw: Gari ya kubeba wagonjwa ilipoteza controle na ikataka gonga mtu mwenye alikuwa natembea na migulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous aurez beau essayer, vous ne serez pas capables de finir cela en un jour.
target_text: Uta ujaribu namna gani, hauwezi imaliza mu siku moya.
target_text_raw: Uta ujaribu namna gani, hauwezi imaliza mu siku moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous savons que tu as menti à Enzo.
target_text: Tunajua kama ulidanganya Enzo.
target_text_raw: Tunajua kama ulidanganya Enzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'individu terrien se sent totalement impuissant face à de tels problèmes de dimension planétaire.
target_text: Mtu anaye ishi duniani anajisikiaka kutokuwa kabisa na uwezo mbele ya shida za dunia kama hizi.
target_text_raw: Mtu anaye ishi duniani anajisikiaka kutokuwa kabisa na uwezo mbele ya shida za dunia kama hizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu sûre d'avoir pris la bonne décision ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika kama ulikamata uamuzi muzuri?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika kama ulikamata uamuzi muzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est si évident que l'on n'a pas besoin de preuves.
target_text: Inaonekana kama ni kweli hatuhitaji ushaidi.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana kama ni kweli hatuhitaji ushaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demain je vais jeter un melon d'eau du toit d'un immeuble de cinq étages, juste pour le plaisir.
target_text: Kesho ndatupa mayi ya pasteke kutoka ku manjanja ya nyumba ya étages tano kwa kujifurahisha tu.
target_text_raw: Kesho ndatupa mayi ya pasteke kutoka ku manjanja ya nyumba ya étages tano kwa kujifurahisha tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a promis de l'épouser.
target_text: Aliahidi kama ataolewa naye.
target_text_raw: Aliahidi kama ataolewa naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai raconté à Guillaume, mais il ne m'a pas cru.
target_text: Niliiambia Guillaume, lakini hakuniaminia.
target_text_raw: Niliiambia Guillaume, lakini hakuniaminia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne changerai pas la date de départ en retraite, mais pour partir, vous n'aurez votre taux plein qu'à 63 ans, de quoi vous plaigniez-vous?
target_text: Sitabadilisha terehe ya kuenda kupumuzika, lakini mbele uende, utapataka decompte final yako mpaka ueneze miaka 63, nini njo sababu ya malalamiko yako?
target_text_raw: Sitabadilisha terehe ya kuenda kupumuzika (retraite), lakini mbele uende, utapataka decompte final yako mpaka ueneze miaka 63, nini njo sababu ya malalamiko yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez l'air d'un flic.
target_text: Unafanana polisi.
target_text_raw: Unafanana polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Transmettez mon meilleur souvenir à votre tante et à votre oncle.
target_text: Mufikishie shangazi yako na muyomba yako salamu zangu.
target_text_raw: Mufikishie shangazi yako na muyomba yako salamu zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sortez les détritus.
target_text: Mutoshe buchafu.
target_text_raw: Mutoshe buchafu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les bonnes choses viennent d'en haut.
