target_text: Bitu yote ya muzuri binatokaka kwa Mungu.
target_text_raw: Bitu yote ya muzuri binatokaka kwa Mungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma belle-mère ne manque jamais une occasion de me reprocher ma décision de monter ma propre boîte.
target_text: Mama yangu mukwe hawezi kosa sababu ya kupinga uamuzi yangu ya kufungulisha kampuni yangu binafsi.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu mukwe hawezi kosa sababu ya kupinga uamuzi yangu ya kufungulisha kampuni yangu binafsi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup d'entre eux ont fini par épouser leurs petites amies russes.
target_text: Wengi wao waliowa wapenzi wao wa kike wa Kirusia.
target_text_raw: Wengi wao waliowa wapenzi wao wa kike wa Kirusia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps venait à manquer pour les Terriens tandis que leur environnement planétaire était en décomposition. Le voyage spatial devint une nécessité.
target_text: Wanayo ishi duniani walikosa muda ijapokuwa mazingira ya dunia yao iliendelea naaribika. Safari ya kwenda angani ilikuwa muhimu.
target_text_raw: Wanayo ishi duniani walikosa muda ijapokuwa mazingira ya dunia yao iliendelea naaribika. Safari ya kwenda angani ilikuwa muhimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous promets que vous ne serez pas déçue.
target_text: Minakuahidi kama hautasikitika.
target_text_raw: Minakuahidi kama hautasikitika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peter boit, et c'est la raison pour laquelle son nez est rouge.
target_text: Peter anakunywa, na njo maana lipua yake iko mwekundu.
target_text_raw: Peter anakunywa, na njo maana lipua yake iko mwekundu (rouge).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est le commandant de ce navire ?
target_text: Nani njo anaongoza iyi mashua.
target_text_raw: Nani njo anaongoza iyi mashua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'espion prit contact avec l'ennemi.
target_text: Mupelelezi aliwasiliana na adui.
target_text_raw: Mupelelezi aliwasiliana na adui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas tourner le cou parce que c'est très douloureux.
target_text: Siwezi zungurusha shingo juu inaluma.
target_text_raw: Siwezi zungurusha shingo juu inaluma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous pourriez m'ajouter ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza niongeza?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza niongeza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On continue à faire les mêmes choses.
target_text: Tunaendelea kufanya ile ile bitu.
target_text_raw: Tunaendelea kufanya ile ile bitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que cela mérite des félicitations.
target_text: Minazani kama iyo inastahili kupongezewa.
target_text_raw: Minazani kama iyo inastahili kupongezewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tenez les enfants éloignés des couteaux.
target_text: Weka watoto mbali na bisu.
target_text_raw: Weka watoto mbali na bisu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils continuèrent à chanter jusqu'à ce que vienne une équipe de secours.
target_text: Waliendelea naimba mpaka gisi kikundi ya wasaidizi ilifika.
target_text_raw: Waliendelea naimba mpaka gisi kikundi ya wasaidizi ilifika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous auriez pu choisir celui-ci.
target_text: Ungechagula iyi.
target_text_raw: Ungechagula iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je vous ramener quelque chose ?
target_text: Nikuletee kitu fulani?
target_text_raw: Nikuletee kitu fulani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le directeur a convoqué une réunion d'urgence du personnel.
target_text: Kiongozi aliitisha mukutano ya zarura ya wafanayakazi.
target_text_raw: Kiongozi aliitisha mukutano ya zarura ya wafanayakazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans ma mise en œuvre, la position de ce répertoire est relative au répertoire de travail, mais cela pourrait-être n'importe où, vraiment.
target_text: Kwa mutazamo wangu, position ya iyi répertoire inatokana na répertoire ya kazi, lakini inaweza kuwa fasi yoyote ile, kweli.
target_text_raw: Kwa mutazamo wangu, position ya iyi répertoire inatokana na répertoire ya kazi, lakini inaweza kuwa fasi yoyote ile, kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pire chose que l'on puisse faire est de ne faire quelque chose qu'à moitié sérieusement.
target_text: Kitu mubaya yenye inaweza tokea ni kufanya kitu kipande kipande bila utani.
target_text_raw: Kitu mubaya yenye inaweza tokea ni kufanya kitu kipande kipande bila utani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles nous ont vus alors qu'elles étaient en train de descendre du train.
target_text: Walituona walipo kuwa nashuka mu gari la moshi.
target_text_raw: Walituona walipo kuwa nashuka mu gari la moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les claviers d'ordinateurs, surtout ceux au-dessus desquels les gens déjeunent, sont un des premiers foyers d'infections bactériennes. Les doigts servent ensuite de vecteur.
target_text: Claviers za ordinateur, hasa zile watu wanakuliaka ako chakula ya muchana, ni moja ya chanzo ya maambukizi ya mikrobe. Kisha vidole zinakuwa njia ya kusambaraza.
target_text_raw: Claviers za ordinateur, hasa zile watu wanakuliaka ako chakula ya muchana, ni moja ya chanzo ya maambukizi ya mikrobe. Kisha vidole zinakuwa njia ya kusambaraza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un esprit universel est quelqu'un qui en connaît un paquet sur un tas de trucs.
target_text: Moyo mkunjufu ni ule anaye jua mingi kuhusu mambo mingi.
target_text_raw: Moyo mkunjufu ni ule anaye jua mingi kuhusu mambo mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi intentez-vous un procès à Dan?
target_text: Juu ya nini unashtaki Dan?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini unashtaki Dan?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous partez ?
target_text: Unaenda?
target_text_raw: Unaenda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les toilettes étaient dehors dans la cour.
target_text: Toilettes zilikuwa inje ya lupango.
target_text_raw: Toilettes (wc) zilikuwa inje ya lupango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le voleur a utilisé un tournevis pour s'introduire dans la voiture.
target_text: Mwizi alitumia turnevisi kwa kuingia mu gari gari.
target_text_raw: Mwizi alitumia turnevisi kwa kuingia mu gari gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est revenu deux heures plus tard.
target_text: Alikuya ma saa mbili nyuma.
target_text_raw: Alikuya ma saa mbili nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa nouvelle copine a l'air très excitante, malheureusement elle est bête à manger du foin.
target_text: Rafiki yake wa kike wa mupya anafana kufurahi, bahati mubaya hajui kula foin.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yake wa kike wa mupya anafana kufurahi, bahati mubaya hajui kula foin.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons trouvé un pauvre petit chat dans la cour.
target_text: Tulikuta ka pusi ka kidogo mu kiwanja.
target_text_raw: Tulikuta ka pusi ka kidogo mu kiwanja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Ne racontez donc pas de conneries ! », cria l'agriculteur.
target_text: Usiongee mambo ya kijanga. », mukulima alisema kwa sauti kubwa.
target_text_raw: Usiongee mambo ya kijanga. », mukulima alisema kwa sauti kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous ne comprenez pas cela ?
target_text: Hausikii hiyo?
target_text_raw: Hausikii hiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aimez vos ennemis.
target_text: Mupende maadui wenu.
target_text_raw: Mupende maadui wenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça me revient, j'ai cette phrase sur le bord des lèvres.
target_text: Minaikumbuka, niko na iyo neno mu mawazo.
target_text_raw: Minaikumbuka, niko na iyo neno mu mawazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne leur rends pas de services.
target_text: Sitawasaidia.
target_text_raw: Sitawasaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans les rêves tourmentés de Marie, des Finlandais intrépides luttaient contre des ennemis fictifs et de faux amis imaginaires.
target_text: Kwenye ndoto ya ajabu ajabu ya Marie, raia wa Finlande walikuwa napambana na maadui wasiyo kuwa wa kweli na marafiki wa bongo.
target_text_raw: Kwenye ndoto ya ajabu ajabu ya Marie, raia wa Finlande walikuwa napambana na maadui wasiyo kuwa wa kweli na marafiki wa bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathis arrivera à 2h30 et Marie arrivera un peu plus tard.
target_text: Mathis alifika saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie alifika nyuma kidogo.
target_text_raw: Mathis alifika saa munane na nusu ya busiku na Marie alifika nyuma kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les meilleurs biscuits que j'ai mangés jusqu'à présent sont ceux que ta mère m'a confectionnés.
target_text: Biskuti ya muzuri zaidi yenye nilishaka kula sasa ni zile zenye mama yako alinitayarishiaka.
target_text_raw: Biskuti ya muzuri zaidi yenye nilishaka kula sasa ni zile zenye mama yako alinitayarishiaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas nécessaire qu'il sache.
target_text: Siyo lazima aijue.
target_text_raw: Siyo lazima aijue.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas d’accord avec ce que vous dites, mais je me battrai jusqu’à la mort pour que vous ayez le droit de le dire.
target_text: Sikubaliani na ile yenye unasema, lakini nitapiganisha hadi kufa mpaka ukuwe na haki ya kuisema.
target_text_raw: Sikubaliani na ile yenye unasema, lakini nitapiganisha hadi kufa mpaka ukuwe na haki ya kuisema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parie qu'il va s'énerver.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama atasirika.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama atasirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'arrivera pas à l'heure à la rencontre.
target_text: Hatafika kwa wakati ku mukutano.
target_text_raw: Hatafika kwa wakati ku mukutano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un officier de police a subi des blessures mineures.
target_text: Mkubwa mu kipolisi aliumia kidogo.
target_text_raw: Mkubwa mu kipolisi aliumia kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai rencontré une amie tandis que j'attendais un bus.
target_text: Nilikutanana na rafiki wakati nilikuwa nachunga bisi.
target_text_raw: Nilikutanana na rafiki wakati nilikuwa nachunga bisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me tourna le dos et se concentra sur son ordinateur.
target_text: Alinigeuzia mugongo na kutumika ku ordinateur yake.
target_text_raw: Alinigeuzia mugongo na kutumika ku ordinateur yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tony était à la porte.
target_text: Tony alikuwa ku mulango.
target_text_raw: Tony alikuwa ku mulango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faisait enfin face à son ennemi.
target_text: Alipambana na adui yake.
target_text_raw: Alipambana na adui yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo semble préoccupé du résultat du test d'anglais.
target_text: Enzo anaonekana kuwaza sana juu ya matokeo ya mashindano ya Kingereza.
target_text_raw: Enzo anaonekana kuwaza sana juu ya matokeo ya mashindano ya Kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement je ne gagne pas d'argent.
target_text: Bahati mubaya sipati franga.
target_text_raw: Bahati mubaya sipati franga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est allée au musée d'art en taxi.
target_text: Alienda kwenye nyumba ya makumbusho na taxi.
target_text_raw: Alienda kwenye nyumba ya makumbusho (musée) na taxi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un rêve est indispensable lorsqu'on veut concevoir le futur.
target_text: Ndoto ni kitu muhimu wakati tunafikiria juu ya maisha ya kesho.
target_text_raw: Ndoto ni kitu muhimu wakati tunafikiria juu ya maisha ya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui rate une occasion ne la retrouve jamais.
target_text: Mwenye anapoteza fursa haipataki tena.
target_text_raw: Mwenye anapoteza fursa haipataki tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo était devenu le centre de l’attention des médias, les journalistes passaient leur temps à décortiquer tous ses faits et gestes.
target_text: Vyombo vya habari vilianza fatilia Hugo kwa karibu, wapasha habari walikuwa napitisha muda wakiongelea kila kitu yenye alikuwa nafanya.
target_text_raw: Vyombo vya habari vilianza fatilia Hugo kwa karibu, wapasha habari walikuwa napitisha muda wakiongelea kila kitu yenye alikuwa nafanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère qu'on peut arranger ça.
target_text: Minawaza kama tunaweza tatua hiyo.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama tunaweza tatua hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu fais une émoticône juste avant une parenthèse fermante, on a l'impression qu'elle a un double menton.
target_text: Wakati unatia emoji mbele ya parenthèse ya kufungiwa, inaonekanaka sawa vile iko na menton mbili.
target_text_raw: Wakati unatia emoji mbele ya parenthèse ya kufungiwa, inaonekanaka sawa vile iko na menton mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet ordinateur est beaucoup plus rapide que mon ancien.
target_text: Iyi ordinateur inatumika mbio mbio kuliko yangu ya zamani.
target_text_raw: Iyi ordinateur inatumika mbio mbio kuliko yangu ya zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il vous plaît, stop.
target_text: Tafazali, stop.
target_text_raw: Tafazali, stop.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es en sécurité aussi longtemps que tu restes ici.
target_text: Kadiri unaendelea kubakia hapa uko mu usalama.
target_text_raw: Kadiri unaendelea kubakia hapa uko mu usalama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La magnificence et la galanterie n’ont jamais paru en France avec tant d’éclat que dans les dernières années du règne de Henri second.
target_text: Ustarabu na tabai za kimapenzi habiawayi kufika Ufaransa kwa hali ya yulu kama iyi isipokuwa miaka iliyo pita wakati ya utawala wa Henri wa pili.
target_text_raw: Ustarabu na tabai za kimapenzi habiawayi kufika Ufaransa kwa hali ya yulu kama iyi isipokuwa miaka iliyo pita wakati ya utawala wa Henri wa pili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma tête s'est tout à coup mise à me tourner.
target_text: Kichwa yangu ikaanza zunguruka.
target_text_raw: Kichwa yangu ikaanza zunguruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi voulez-vous que l'espéranto devienne une langue de communication alors que vous continuez à communiquer en anglais ?
target_text: Juu ya nini unataka Esperanto ikuwe luga ya mawasiliano ijapokuwa unaendelea kuzungumuza mu Kingereza?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini unataka Esperanto ikuwe luga ya mawasiliano ijapokuwa unaendelea kuzungumuza mu Kingereza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Penses-tu pouvoir descendre ici immédiatement ?
target_text: Unawaza kama unaweza shuka hapa sasa ivi?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kama unaweza shuka hapa sasa ivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le ciel se dégage.
target_text: Mawingu inakuwa mweupe.
target_text_raw: Mawingu inakuwa mweupe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as fait de douloureux et de joyeux voyages.
target_text: Ulifanya safari za shida na za furaha.
target_text_raw: Ulifanya safari za shida na za furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous vous trouvez dans un trou, cessez de creuser.
target_text: Ukijikuta mu shimu, usiendelee kuchimba.
target_text_raw: Ukijikuta mu shimu, usiendelee kuchimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dois-je lui expliquer les raisons ?
target_text: Minapashwa mufasiria sababu?
target_text_raw: Minapashwa mufasiria sababu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour faire atterrir de gros porteurs sur cet aéroport, nous avons besoin d'une nouvelle piste d'atterrissage spécialement aménagée pour ce genre d'avions.
target_text: Ili kushusha ndege kubwa kwenye iyi uwanja wa ndege, tunahitaji kuwa na piste ya atterissage ambao itatengenezewa tu juu ya iyi aina ya ndege.
target_text_raw: Ili kushusha ndege kubwa kwenye iyi uwanja wa ndege, tunahitaji kuwa na piste ya atterissage ambao itatengenezewa tu juu ya iyi aina ya ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous remercie d'avance pour votre aide.
target_text: Natanguliza kusema asante kwa msaada wako.
target_text_raw: Natanguliza kusema asante kwa msaada wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le comportement du Prince lui sembla indécent.
target_text: Tabia ya mtoto wa mufalme haikumupendeza.
target_text_raw: Tabia ya mtoto wa mufalme haikumupendeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il refuse le lait maternisé.
target_text: Anakatala maziwa ya mama.
target_text_raw: Anakatala maziwa ya mama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que tu serais tuée. Je me réjouis d'avoir eu tort.
target_text: Nilizani kama utauawa. Minafurahi kwa makosa yenye nilifanya.
target_text_raw: Nilizani kama utauawa. Minafurahi kwa makosa yenye nilifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nathan est rentré chez lui plus tard que d'habitude aujourd'hui.
target_text: Nathan alirudia kwake leo anachelewa kinyume ya kawaida yake.
target_text_raw: Nathan alirudia kwake leo anachelewa kinyume ya kawaida yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon fils est devenu assez bon à inventer des excuses pour ne pas aller à l'école.
target_text: Mtoto wangu alishaka jua gisi ya kupana ma sababu juu asiende tu ku masomo.
target_text_raw: Mtoto wangu alishaka jua gisi ya kupana ma sababu juu asiende tu ku masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie était totalement surprise.
target_text: Marie alishangala kabisa.
target_text_raw: Marie alishangala kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me rends juste compte d’avoir raté le coche.
target_text: Minajikuta nilisahabu kufanya coche.
target_text_raw: Minajikuta nilisahabu kufanya coche.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Disons juste que je n'étais pas surpris.
target_text: Tuseme tu kama sikushangala.
target_text_raw: Tuseme tu kama sikushangala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La loi ne donne pas les mêmes droits au pauvre qu'au riche.
target_text: Sheria haipatiaki maskini haki kama zile za tajiri.
target_text_raw: Sheria haipatiaki maskini haki kama zile za tajiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes immédiatement partis.
target_text: Tulianza enda moja kwa moja.
target_text_raw: Tulianza enda moja kwa moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette île isolée se réjouit d'avoir enfin de l'eau potable.
target_text: Hiki kisiwa kilicho tengwa kinafurahia kupata sasa na maji safi.
target_text_raw: Hiki kisiwa kilicho tengwa kinafurahia kupata sasa na maji safi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où as-tu fait réparer ta caméra ?
target_text: Wapi njo ulitengenezeshea kamera yako?
target_text_raw: Wapi njo ulitengenezeshea kamera yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouvrez la porte ou nous l'enfoncerons !
target_text: Fungua mulango ao tutaifungula kwa kinguvu!
target_text_raw: Fungua mulango ao tutaifungula kwa kinguvu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis fait soldat ; mais je n’étais pas assez brave. Je me suis fait moine ; mais je n’étais pas assez dévot.
target_text: Nilijifanya askari; ila sikukuwa jasiri. Nilijifanya mataawa; ila sikukuwa mwenye kujitolea sana.
target_text_raw: Nilijifanya askari; ila sikukuwa jasiri. Nilijifanya mataawa; ila sikukuwa mwenye kujitolea sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis surprise que tu aies raté ça.
target_text: Minashangala kuona ulipitiwa na hilo.
target_text_raw: Minashangala kuona ulipitiwa na hilo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nulle part dans la Bible il n'est précisé si Jésus n'était pas un vélociraptor.
target_text: Hakuna fasi ndani ya biblia kwenye banaonesha kama Yesu akukuwaka munyama vélociraptor.
target_text_raw: Hakuna fasi ndani ya biblia kwenye banaonesha kama Yesu akukuwaka munyama vélociraptor (dinausore).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a oublié qu'elle avait promis de l'appeler la nuit passée.
target_text: Alisahabu kama aliahidi kumuita jana busiku.
target_text_raw: Alisahabu kama aliahidi kumuita jana busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il revient directement d'Amérique du Sud.
target_text: Anakuya moja kwa moja kutoka Amerika ya kusini.
target_text_raw: Anakuya moja kwa moja kutoka Amerika ya kusini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il reste un fond de lait.
target_text: Kunabakia kiwango fulani ya maziwa.
target_text_raw: Kunabakia kiwango fulani ya maziwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête de manger au lit, j'en ai marre de nettoyer après toi.
target_text: Wacha kukulia kitandani, nilisha choka kupanguza kila ukimaliza kuchafua.
target_text_raw: Wacha kukulia kitandani, nilisha choka kupanguza kila ukimaliza kuchafua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils se sont battus au bureau même du directeur et en sa présence.
target_text: Walipigana mu ofisini ya kiongozi na mbele yake.
target_text_raw: Walipigana mu ofisini ya kiongozi na mbele yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après le discours d'adieu de Jane, nous devînmes très tristes.
target_text: Baada ya hotuba ya kulaga ya Jane, tulihuzunika.
target_text_raw: Baada ya hotuba ya kulaga ya Jane, tulihuzunika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo n'achète pas ce costume, parce qu'il est trop cher.
target_text: Enzon hakubali utamaduni, sababu ni bei kali.
target_text_raw: Enzon hakubali utamaduni, sababu ni bei kali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca m'a amené ici.
target_text: Luca alinileta hapa.
target_text_raw: Luca alinileta hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je vous amener ?
target_text: Naweza kukuletea?
target_text_raw: Naweza kukuletea?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fille insista pour qu'on l'amène au zoo.
target_text: Binti alisisitiza apelekwe kwenye lupango ya minyama.
target_text_raw: Binti alisisitiza apelekwe kwenye lupango ya minyama (zoo).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serais surprise qu'elles me demandent de prononcer un discours.
target_text: Nitashangala wakiniambia nitoe hotuba.
target_text_raw: Nitashangala wakiniambia nitoe hotuba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La grande question à laquelle on n'a jamais répondu, et à laquelle je n'ai pas réussi à répondre malgré trente années de recherches sur l'âme féminine, est:"Que désire une femme ?"
target_text: Swali kubwa yenye haiyawahi pata jibu, na ambayo sikuweza kujibia kipindi ya miaka makumi tatu ya utafiti kuhusu roho ya mwanamuke, ni : "Mwanamuke anapendaka nini?"
target_text_raw: Swali kubwa yenye haiyawahi pata jibu, na ambayo sikuweza kujibia kipindi ya miaka makumi tatu ya utafiti kuhusu roho ya mwanamuke, ni : "Mwanamuke anapendaka nini?"
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment tu t’appelles ?
target_text: Unaitwa nani?
target_text_raw: Unaitwa nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as réfléchi au problème toute la matinée, prends une pause et va déjeuner !
target_text: Ulifikiria juu ya tatizo asubui muzima, pumzika kidogo na uende kula chakula ya muchana!
target_text_raw: Ulifikiria juu ya tatizo asubui muzima, pumzika kidogo na uende kula chakula ya muchana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bus devait justement avoir du retard tandis que j'étais en retard.
target_text: Bisi ingepashwa fika inachelewa ijapokuwa nilikuasha chelewa.
target_text_raw: Bisi ingepashwa fika inachelewa ijapokuwa nilikuasha chelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bref, je me suis encore fait avoir.
target_text: Kwa ufupi, nilidanganyiwa tena.
target_text_raw: Kwa ufupi, nilidanganyiwa tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sûr que je pourrai la trouver.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama minaweza ipata.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama minaweza ipata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le fémur est l'os le plus lourd du corps humain.
target_text: Mufupa ya mugulu njo mufupa ya murefu zaidi mu mwili ya binadamu.
target_text_raw: Mufupa ya mugulu njo mufupa ya murefu zaidi mu mwili ya binadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes un très bon secrétaire. Si vous ne vous étiez pas occupé de tout, je n'aurais rien pu faire. Vous êtes formidable.
target_text: Wewe ni katibu muzuri sana. Kama haunge shurulikia kila kitu,singefanya chochote. Weye ni mtu muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Wewe ni katibu muzuri sana. Kama haunge shurulikia kila kitu,singefanya chochote. Weye ni mtu muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À moins que tu n'aies un meilleur plan pour le dégommer, arrête de me couper la parole !
target_text: Labda ukuwe na njia ya muzuri ya kumuzuia, usinikate kahuli!
target_text_raw: Labda ukuwe na njia ya muzuri ya kumuzuia, usinikate kahuli!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Est-ce que je te donne la moitié ?" Demanda Yanis, qui était sur le point de manger un morceau de gâteau. - "Oh, tu ferais ça ?" Répondit Marie, très émue.
target_text: "Nikupatie nusu?" Yanis aliuliza, ambaye alikuwa nataka kula kipande ya keki. - "Oh, utafanya hivyo?" Marie alijibia, kwa furaha sana.
target_text_raw: "Nikupatie nusu?" Yanis aliuliza, ambaye alikuwa nataka kula kipande ya keki. - "Oh, utafanya hivyo?" Marie alijibia, kwa furaha sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu sembles parfaite pour le job.
target_text: Unaonekana kama unastahili iyi kazi.
target_text_raw: Unaonekana kama unastahili iyi kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que je peux compter sur chacun de vous.
target_text: Minajua kwamba ndaweza tegemea kila mumoja wenu.
target_text_raw: Minajua kwamba ndaweza tegemea kila mumoja wenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces enfants ont jeté les miettes de pain aux canards, je les ai vus.
target_text: Haba batoto balitupia ma bata bipande ya mikate, nilibaona.
target_text_raw: Haba batoto balitupia ma bata bipande ya mikate, nilibaona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bâtiment fut totalement détruit.
target_text: Iyi jengo ilivunjwa yote.
target_text_raw: Iyi jengo ilivunjwa yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo était la star de l'équipe de football.
target_text: Matheo alikuwa mchezaji bora wa timu ya mupira ya miguu.
target_text_raw: Matheo alikuwa mchezaji bora wa timu ya mupira ya miguu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne peux pas esquiver les balles.
target_text: Hauwezi kwepa masasi.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi kwepa masasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vendu mon ordinateur.
target_text: Niliuzisha ordinateur yangu.
target_text_raw: Niliuzisha ordinateur yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À mesure qu’approche le soir, une inquiétude incompréhensible m’envahit, comme si la nuit cachait pour moi une menace terrible.
target_text: Kadiri mangaribi inakaribia, minashikwa wasiwasi isiyo eleweka, kama vile usiku ilikuwa nanificha kitu ya hatari sana.
target_text_raw: Kadiri mangaribi inakaribia, minashikwa wasiwasi isiyo eleweka, kama vile usiku ilikuwa nanificha kitu ya hatari sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous savez pourquoi cette date est importante ?
target_text: Unajua juu ya nini iyi tarehe ni muhimu sana?
target_text_raw: Unajua juu ya nini iyi tarehe ni muhimu sana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a appelé son fils « Adam », en mémoire de son père, qui vient de mourir.
target_text: Marie aliita mtoto wake mwanaume "Adam", kwa ukumbusho ya baba yake, ambaye alikufa hizi siku.
target_text_raw: Marie aliita mtoto wake mwanaume "Adam", kwa ukumbusho ya baba yake, ambaye alikufa hizi siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami est toujours le méchant dans le film.
target_text: Sami ni mtu mubaya mu film kila mara.
target_text_raw: Sami ni mtu mubaya mu film kila mara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y avait pas d'empreintes digitales sur le couteau.
target_text: Hapakuwa alama ya vidole ku kisu.
target_text_raw: Hapakuwa alama ya vidole ku kisu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis vraiment désolée. Monsieur Tanaka n'est malheureusement pas là en ce moment.
target_text: Nasikitika kabisa. Bahati mubaya Bwana Tanaka haiko hapa kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Nasikitika kabisa. Bahati mubaya Bwana Tanaka haiko hapa kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plupart du temps, les « héros du Jihad » se déguisent en femmes après leurs crimes, pour échapper à la répression.
target_text: Mara mingi, « mashujaa wa Jihad » wanajigeuzaka wanamuke kisha kufanya makosa, ili kuepuka kushambuliwa.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi, « mashujaa wa Jihad » wanajigeuzaka wanamuke kisha kufanya makosa, ili kuepuka kushambuliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ne sait pas gérer ses émotions.
target_text: Hajui kulinda asira yake.
target_text_raw: Hajui kulinda asira yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Suis-je assez dans l'échange avec les gens que j'aime ?
target_text: Je! Minaongeaka ya kutosha na watu ninao wapenda?
target_text_raw: Je! Minaongeaka ya kutosha na watu ninao wapenda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne bougez pas !
target_text: Usitingizike!
target_text_raw: Usitingizike!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que ça fout dehors ?
target_text: Iko nafanya nini inje?
target_text_raw: Iko nafanya nini inje?

target_text: Hapakuwaki ulizo ya kijinga, kunakuwaka tu watu wajinga.
target_text_raw: Hapakuwaki ulizo ya kijinga, kunakuwaka tu watu wajinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, vous avez raison.
target_text: Ndio, uko na sheria.
target_text_raw: Ndio, uko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dois-je être présent à la soirée de ce soir ?
target_text: Je! Napashwa kuwa kwenye sherehe mangaribi ya leo?
target_text_raw: Je! Napashwa kuwa kwenye sherehe mangaribi ya leo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce qui ne nous tue pas nous rend plus forts.
target_text: Kisicho tuuwa kinatufanya tuwe na nguvu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Kisicho tuuwa kinatufanya tuwe na nguvu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a laissé tomber parce qu'elle pensait qu'il était un pauvre type.
target_text: Aliachana naye kwa sababu aliwaza kama ni mtu mwenye hana maana.
target_text_raw: Aliachana naye kwa sababu aliwaza kama ni mtu mwenye hana maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles l'ont fait au vu et au su du personnel.
target_text: Waliifanya mbele ya macho ya wafanyakazi.
target_text_raw: Waliifanya mbele ya macho ya wafanyakazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux choisir n'importe quelle couleur que tu aimes.
target_text: Unaweza chagua rangi yote yenye unapenda.
target_text_raw: Unaweza chagua rangi yote yenye unapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je savais que je ne devais pas lui rendre visite, pourtant, je suis allé la voir.
target_text: Nilijua kama singepashwa mutembelea, lakini, nilienda kumuona.
target_text_raw: Nilijua kama singepashwa mutembelea, lakini, nilienda kumuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ben dis donc !
target_text: Ok sikiliza!
target_text_raw: Ok sikiliza!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'en pensez-vous ? Ce serait génial !
target_text: Unaiwazia aye? Itakuwa muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Unaiwazia aye? Itakuwa muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est simple : est-ce que vous le voulez complet, ou est-ce que vous le voulez maintenant ?
target_text: Ni rahisi : Je! unaitaka ya muzima, ao unaitaka sasa ivi?
target_text_raw: Ni rahisi : Je! unaitaka ya muzima, ao unaitaka sasa ivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me le mets donc pas ensuite sur le dos !
target_text: Usikuwe nizingishia !
target_text_raw: Usikuwe nizingishia !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jules a envoyé de l'argent pour aider Marie à prendre soin de ses enfants.
target_text: Jules alituma makuta juu ya kusaidia Marie kushurulikia watoto wake.
target_text_raw: Jules alituma makuta juu ya kusaidia Marie kushurulikia watoto wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reviens en ville !
target_text: Minarudia mjini!
target_text_raw: Minarudia mjini!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On sait voyager dans le temps. Et on le fait avec une vitesse incroyable de une seconde par seconde.
target_text: Tunajua kurudia mu wakati iliyo pita. Na tunaifanya haraka sana kwa sekundekisha sekunde.
target_text_raw: Tunajua kurudia mu wakati iliyo pita. Na tunaifanya haraka sana kwa sekundekisha sekunde.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ô Seigneur qui me prête vie, accorde-moi un cœur plein de gratitude.
target_text: Ee Bwana unaye toa uzima, nipe moyo wa huruma.
target_text_raw: Ee Bwana unaye toa uzima, nipe moyo wa huruma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci, chéri.
target_text: Aksanti, mupenzi.
target_text_raw: Aksanti, mupenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je devais être sûre.
target_text: Nilipashwa kuwa na uhakika.
target_text_raw: Nilipashwa kuwa na uhakika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne ne voulait offenser ces messieurs.
target_text: Hakuna mwenye alitaka kukosea hawa wanaume.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwenye alitaka kukosea hawa wanaume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoutez Hugo !
target_text: Sikiliza Hugo!
target_text_raw: Sikiliza Hugo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous m'avez promis que vous prendriez soin d'eux.
target_text: Uliniahidi kama utawashurulikia.
target_text_raw: Uliniahidi kama utawashurulikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom donne certainement l'impression qu'il ne sait pas ce qu'il est en train de faire.
target_text: Tom anaonekana sawa vile mwenye hajui byenye iko nafanya.
target_text_raw: Tom anaonekana sawa vile mwenye hajui byenye iko nafanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au début, la décision de l'auteur de publier le livre en deux langues, en allemand et espéranto, m'a quelque peu surprise.
target_text: Mbele, uamuzi wa mwandishi waku toa kitabu mu luga mbili, mu Kijeremani na Kiesperanto, ilinishangaza kidogo.
target_text_raw: Mbele, uamuzi wa mwandishi waku toa kitabu mu luga mbili, mu Kijeremani na Kiesperanto, ilinishangaza kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Leurs noms furent rayés de la liste.
target_text: Majina zabo zilitoshwa ku liste.
target_text_raw: Majina zabo zilitoshwa ku liste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne devriez pas veiller aussi tard.
target_text: Haungepashwa kukesha mpaka nyuma hivi.
target_text_raw: Haungepashwa kukesha mpaka nyuma hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'accuse pas la victime !
target_text: Usilaumu muhanga!
target_text_raw: Usilaumu muhanga!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis est vraiment un type sympa.
target_text: Yanis ni mtu muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Yanis ni mtu muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa chambre est en bordel.
target_text: Vitu vinasambarana mu chumba yake.
target_text_raw: Vitu vinasambarana mu chumba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai demandé à mon maître ce que je devais faire ensuite.
target_text: Niliuliza mwalimu wangu nini ya kufanya baadaye.
target_text_raw: Niliuliza mwalimu wangu nini ya kufanya baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Croyez, Monsieur, à ma cordialité.
target_text: Ndugu, kubali, urafiki wangu.
target_text_raw: Ndugu, kubali, urafiki wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a peu de temps, je vous disais que celui qui fait la guerre doit être attentif à tout.
target_text: Palisha pita muda kidogo, nilikuwa nawaambia kwamba anaye fanya vita anapashwa kuwa muangalifu sana.
target_text_raw: Palisha pita muda kidogo, nilikuwa nawaambia kwamba anaye fanya vita anapashwa kuwa muangalifu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne bois pas d'eau. On ne sait jamais, si des renards ont pissé dedans...
target_text: Sikunywi maji. Mtu hajuwaki, labda hizi mbweha zilikoyolea ndani...
target_text_raw: Sikunywi maji. Mtu hajuwaki, labda hizi mbweha zilikoyolea ndani...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'inspecteur l'obligea à vider le contenu de son sac sur le bureau.
target_text: Inspektere alimulazimisha kutoa kila kitu mu sakoshi yake na kutia ku meza.
target_text_raw: Inspektere alimulazimisha kutoa kila kitu mu sakoshi yake na kutia ku meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voulez la moitié d'un poulet ?
target_text: Unataka kipande ya kuku?
target_text_raw: Unataka kipande ya kuku?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il disait que, quand il était jeune, on pouvait voir sur la promenade du bord de la mer des femmes en chapeau.
target_text: Alikuwa nasema kwamba, alipokuwa kijana, wanamuke mwenye kuvala kofia walikuwa naonekana wakitembea kandokando ya bahari.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa nasema kwamba, alipokuwa kijana, wanamuke mwenye kuvala kofia walikuwa naonekana wakitembea kandokando ya bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme les eaux du Danube scintillaient au loin doucement agitées !
target_text: Kama maji ya Danube ilikuwa naonekana kuangara na kuvurugika kwa mbali.
target_text_raw: Kama maji ya Danube ilikuwa naonekana kuangara na kuvurugika kwa mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-il exact que tu saches écrire le chinois ?
target_text: Ni kweli unajua kuandika Kichina?
target_text_raw: Ni kweli unajua kuandika Kichina?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te souhaite une semaine pleine de bonnes choses et surtout du soleil !
target_text: Nakutakia juma yenye kuyala mambo mazuri na hasa jua!
target_text_raw: Nakutakia juma yenye kuyala mambo mazuri na hasa jua!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas exclu qu'une pratique zoophile inavouable soit à l'origine de l'épidémie de concombre tueur.
target_text: Haiwezi semwa kwamba tendo ya ngono kati ya mtu na nyama inayo fichwa njo sababu ya janga ya concombre muhalifu.
target_text_raw: Haiwezi semwa kwamba tendo ya ngono kati ya mtu na nyama inayo fichwa njo sababu ya janga ya concombre muhalifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amortisseur idéal devrait transmettre le moins possible les irrégularités du terrain à la carrosserie et en même temps maintenir toujours les roues en adhérence avec la route.
target_text: Amortisseur ya muzuri inapashwa kutatua matatizo ya gari inapokuwa ikitembea na vile vile kuimarisha ma piné kwenye barabara.
target_text_raw: Amortisseur ya muzuri inapashwa kutatua matatizo ya gari inapokuwa ikitembea na vile vile kuimarisha ma piné (pneus) kwenye barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est aimable, je vous jure !
target_text: Ni ya kupendeza, minakulapia!
target_text_raw: Ni ya kupendeza, minakulapia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais bien aimé savoir ça quand j'étais gamin.
target_text: Ningependa kujua hilo wakati nilipokuwa mtoto.
target_text_raw: Ningependa kujua hilo wakati nilipokuwa mtoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mike chante bien.
target_text: Mike anaimba muzuri.
target_text_raw: Mike anaimba muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle sorte d'image l'Europe nous évoque-t-elle ? Cette Europe où nous nous sentons, ensemble, les habitants et que nous voulons conserver et améliorer.
target_text: Anatupatia picha gani ya Ulaya? Iyi Ulaya ambapo tunajisikia, kuwa pamoja, kama waakaji na ambayo tunataka kuimarisha na kuboresha.
target_text_raw: Anatupatia picha gani ya Ulaya? Iyi Ulaya ambapo tunajisikia, kuwa pamoja, kama waakaji na ambayo tunataka kuimarisha na kuboresha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça sent le coup monté !
target_text: Inaonekana kuwa ni kitu yenye ilitayarishwa tangu mwanzo!
target_text_raw: Inaonekana kuwa ni kitu yenye ilitayarishwa tangu mwanzo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux un prêtre, et un crucifix à baiser !
target_text: Nahitaji padiri, na musalaba ya Yesu ya ku busu!
target_text_raw: Nahitaji padiri, na musalaba ya Yesu ya ku busu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son tragique suicide restera gravé dans nos mémoires.
target_text: Kujuuwaka kwake kutabakia ndani ya myoyo zetu siku zote.
target_text_raw: Kujuuwaka kwake kutabakia ndani ya myoyo zetu siku zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je meurs de soif. Donne-moi de l'eau !
target_text: Nasikia kiu sana. Niatie mayi!
target_text_raw: Nasikia kiu sana. Niatie mayi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a trois sortes de personnes : celles qui savent compter et celles qui ne savent pas.
target_text: Kuna aina tatu za binaadamu : wale wanao juwa kuhesabu na wale wasiyo jua.
target_text_raw: Kuna aina tatu za binaadamu : wale wanao juwa kuhesabu na wale wasiyo jua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet aéroport est facilement accessible par le bus.
target_text: Ni rahisi kwa gari ya busu kufika kwenye huu uwanja wa ndege.
target_text_raw: Ni rahisi kwa gari ya busu kufika kwenye huu uwanja wa ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je peux toujours compter sur elle parce qu'elle est responsable.
target_text: Naweza kumutegemea siku zote kwa sababu anajielewa.
target_text_raw: Naweza kumutegemea siku zote kwa sababu anajielewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la concurrence qui met un prix juste aux marchandises et qui établit les vrais rapports entre elles.
target_text: Ni mashindano njo inatiaka beyi ku biashara na kuweka uhusiano kati yazo.
target_text_raw: Ni mashindano njo inatiaka beyi ku biashara na kuweka uhusiano kati yazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a rien de caché qui ne se découvre.
target_text: Hakuna siri isiyo fichuka.
target_text_raw: Hakuna siri isiyo fichuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est responsable de la logistique de l'opération militaire.
target_text: Anashimamia vifaa vya operesheni ya kijeshi.
target_text_raw: Anashimamia vifaa vya operesheni ya kijeshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'horloge s'est arrêtée. Il y faut une nouvelle pile.
target_text: Saa ilishimama. Inahitaji pile ya mupya.
target_text_raw: Saa ilishimama. Inahitaji pile ya mupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas soigner un cœur brisé.
target_text: Siwezi kutunza roho iliyo vunjika.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kutunza roho iliyo vunjika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ancienne filature abrite de nos jours une école de danse.
target_text: Kiwanda ya zamani ilisha kuwa amo masomo ya danse.
target_text_raw: Kiwanda ya zamani ilisha kuwa amo masomo ya danse.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez remplir vos promesses.
target_text: Unapashwa kutimiza ahadi zako.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kutimiza ahadi zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La cloche sonne.
target_text: Kengele inalia.
target_text_raw: Kengele inalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour chaque dix miles à l'heure de vitesse, tu devrais laisser la longueur d'une voiture entre toi et la voiture de devant.
target_text: Kila bilometa elfu kumi kwa saa moya, unapashwa acha umbali kati ya gari yenye iko mbele na yenye iko nyuma yako.
target_text_raw: Kila bilometa elfu kumi kwa saa moya, unapashwa acha umbali (distance) kati ya gari yenye iko mbele na yenye iko nyuma yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a laissé son enfant aux bons soins de sa tante.
target_text: Aliacha mtoto wake kwa shangazi yake ili amuchunge.
target_text_raw: Aliacha mtoto wake kwa shangazi yake ili amuchunge.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça a l'air risqué.
target_text: Inafanana kuwa na hatari.
target_text_raw: Inafanana kuwa na hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Durant ses sept ans passés au Japon, il a sérieusement étudié le japonais.
target_text: Miaka saba iliyo pita huko Japani, alijifunza kijapani muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Miaka saba iliyo pita huko Japani, alijifunza kijapani muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que faut-il donc, en ces jours meilleurs, pour conserver vivants mot ou forme ? Il vous suffit de les employer là où les glaneurs peuvent les trouver.
target_text: Nini njo ya kufanya, mwa hizi siku nzuri, ili kuchunga maneno mu hali nzuri? Unahitaji tu kuzitumikisha kwenye walogota mayani wanaweza ikuta.
target_text_raw: Nini njo ya kufanya, mwa hizi siku nzuri, ili kuchunga maneno mu hali nzuri? Unahitaji tu kuzitumikisha kwenye walogota mayani wanaweza ikuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis aurait volontiers jeté la servante dans le grand chaudron qui se balançait au milieu de la cheminée.
target_text: Inawezekana Louis alitupa mufanyakazi wa kike ndani ya chombo kubwa yenye ilikuwa katikati ya chombo ya kutosha moshi.
target_text_raw: Inawezekana Louis alitupa mufanyakazi wa kike ndani ya chombo kubwa yenye ilikuwa katikati ya chombo ya kutosha moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu fais l'objet d'une enquête.
target_text: Unachunguzwa.
target_text_raw: Unachunguzwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils feront une pause de trente ou quarante minutes.
target_text: Watapumuzika kwa dakika makumi tatu ao makumi ine.
target_text_raw: Watapumuzika kwa dakika makumi tatu ao makumi ine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui dira la vérité devra aller attacher l'âne.
target_text: Mwenye atasema ukweli ataenda funga punda.
target_text_raw: Mwenye atasema ukweli ataenda funga punda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun doit avoir en vue l'avantage de tous et tous doivent chercher à faire le bonheur de chacun.
target_text: Kila mtu anastahili kupata faida kutoka kwa wengine na kila mtu anapashwa fanya furaha ya mtu mwengine.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu anastahili kupata faida kutoka kwa wengine na kila mtu anapashwa fanya furaha ya mtu mwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La minorité de kabyles qui soutiennent l'Etat algérien criminel et corrompu sont des kabyles islamistes.
target_text: Wakaaji wengi wa kabyle wanaounga mkono serkali ya Algeria ya kikatili na yenye kutawalia na rushwa ni wa raia wa Kabylie wa Kieslamu.
target_text_raw: Wakaaji wengi wa kabyle wanaounga mkono serkali ya Algeria ya kikatili na yenye kutawalia na rushwa ni wa raia wa Kabylie wa Kieslamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que sommes-nous, en effet, qu'est ce que notre caractère, sinon la condensation de l'histoire que nous avons vécue depuis notre naissance.
target_text: Siye ni nini, kusema kweli, nini njo tunaweza weza, kama siyo hatua za maisha tuliyo pitia tangu tuzaliwe.
target_text_raw: Siye ni nini, kusema kweli, nini njo tunaweza weza, kama siyo hatua za maisha tuliyo pitia tangu tuzaliwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelques verres de vin peuvent redonner parole à la langue.
target_text: Divai kidogo inaweza saidia kuongea.
target_text_raw: Divai kidogo inaweza saidia kuongea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que vous ayez une copie de ceci.
target_text: Minataka ukuwe na copie ya iyi.
target_text_raw: Minataka ukuwe na copie ya iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En raison de la pluie, nous dûmes annuler la compétition.
target_text: Juu ya mvula, ilitubidi kutofanya tena mashindano.
target_text_raw: Juu ya mvula, ilitubidi kutofanya tena mashindano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous aurez beau essayer, vous ne serez pas capable de finir ça en un jour.
target_text: Hata ufanye namna gani, hauwezi maliza mu siku moya.
target_text_raw: Hata ufanye namna gani, hauwezi maliza mu siku moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne faut pas faire attention, expliquait Catherine à Étienne. Ils gueulent toujours.
target_text: Usifanye kwa uangalifu, Catherine alikuwa na fasiria Etienne. Wanasemaka na makelele kila mara.
target_text_raw: Usifanye kwa uangalifu, Catherine alikuwa na fasiria Etienne. Wanasemaka na makelele kila mara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand je songe à tous les maux que j'ai vus et que j'ai soufferts, provenant des haines nationales, je me dis que tout cela repose sur un grossier mensonge : l'amour de la Patrie.

source_text: Il est toujours avantageux de porter un titre nobiliaire. Être "de quelque chose", ça pose un homme, comme être "de Garenne", ça pose un lapin.

source_text: Ça m'est égal, combien de fois tu dis que tu m'aimes. Je sais que tes sentiments pour elle n'ont pas changé.

source_text: Pourquoi avoir gardé un si bon vin en réserve jusque-là ?
