target_text_raw: Nataka maoni ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il part à huit heures.
target_text: Ana enda saa mbili ya asubui.
target_text_raw: Ana enda saa mbili ya asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons pas eu beaucoup de pluie cette année.
target_text: Hatukuwa na mvua mingi hii mwaka.
target_text_raw: Hatukuwa na mvua mingi hii mwaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais toujours bon en maths.
target_text: Nilikuwa najua hesabu.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa najua hesabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Moi aussi, j'ai été invité ici.
target_text: Hata mie, nili alikwa hapa.
target_text_raw: Hata mie, nili alikwa hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai rencontré en train d'étudier.
target_text: Nili mu kutana anasoma.
target_text_raw: Nili mu kutana anasoma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chien de Tom s'est fait renverser par un camion.
target_text: imbwa ya Tom ili angushwa na gari.
target_text_raw: imbwa ya Tom ili angushwa na gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a perdu trois fils à la guerre.
target_text: Tom ali poteza watoto tatu mu vita.
target_text_raw: Tom ali poteza watoto tatu mu vita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci pour le chocolat. Il était délicieux.
target_text: Asante ku chokoleti. Ilikuwa tamu.
target_text_raw: Asante ku chokoleti. Ilikuwa tamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te rendrai visite un jour dans le futur proche.
target_text: Nita kutembelea siku za karibu.
target_text_raw: Nita kutembelea siku za karibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle longueur fait ce pont ?
target_text: Kilalo hiki kiko na urefu gani?
target_text_raw: Kilalo hiki kiko na urefu gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a encore du travail à faire.
target_text: Bado kuna kazi ya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Bado kuna kazi ya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle travaille pour une grande compagnie américaine.
target_text: Anafanya kazi na shirika kubwa ya wa marekani.
target_text_raw: Anafanya kazi na shirika kubwa ya wa marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le scandale a nui au prestige de la compagnie.
target_text: Kasha ili haribu sifa ya shirika.
target_text_raw: Kasha ili haribu sifa ya shirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'était pas terrible.
target_text: hayuko wa ajabu.
target_text_raw: hayuko wa ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le futur est la conséquence du présent.
target_text: Itakayo kuja inatokana na ya sasa.
target_text_raw: Itakayo kuja inatokana na ya sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Viens t'endormir dans mes bras.
target_text: Kuja ulale mikononi yangu.
target_text_raw: Kuja ulale mikononi yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est trop facile, j'imagine.
target_text: Nafikiri, ni rahisi sana.
target_text_raw: Nafikiri, ni rahisi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est le fils de Mary.
target_text: Tom ni mutoto wa Maria.
target_text_raw: Tom ni mutoto wa Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les fleurs étaient très belles à regarder.
target_text: Mahuwa ilikuwa muzuri ku hangalia.
target_text_raw: Mahuwa ilikuwa muzuri ku hangalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ravi que nous nous comprenions.
target_text: Na furai sababu tuna elewana.
target_text_raw: Na furai sababu tuna elewana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'aime davantage que qui que ce soit d'autre.
target_text: Nakupenda kuliko wengine wote.
target_text_raw: Nakupenda kuliko wengine wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens ont peur de la guerre.
target_text: Watu wana ogopa vita.
target_text_raw: Watu wana ogopa vita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas en forme.
target_text: Siko sawa.
target_text_raw: Siko sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand et où as-tu reçu le cadeau ?
target_text: Ulipata zawadi wapi?
target_text_raw: Ulipata zawadi wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'attends depuis plus d'une semaine.
target_text: Na kungojea mu juma moja.
target_text_raw: Na kungojea mu juma moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu peur de Tom ?
target_text: Una ogopa Tom?
target_text_raw: Una ogopa Tom?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne sait pas quoi dire.
target_text: Tom hajuwi kitu ya kusema.
target_text_raw: Tom hajuwi kitu ya kusema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Paul a gagné beaucoup d'argent l'année dernière.
target_text: Paul ali pata pesa mingi mwaka jana.
target_text_raw: Paul ali pata pesa mingi mwaka jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a connu de meilleurs jours.
target_text: Alikuwa ni masiku muzuri.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa ni masiku muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette découverte s'inscrira dans l'histoire.
target_text: Ugunduzi huu uta andikwa mu historia.
target_text_raw: Ugunduzi huu uta andikwa mu historia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai deux ordinateurs, mais ils sont tous les deux cassés. Donc, maintenant, j'utilise celui de ma sœur pendant qu'elle est absente.
target_text: Niko na kompyuta mbili, lakini yote mbili ime haribika. Basi, sasa, natumia ile ya dada yangu wakati kama haiko.
target_text_raw: Niko na kompyuta mbili, lakini yote mbili ime haribika. Basi, sasa, natumia ile ya dada yangu wakati kama haiko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous étions tous présents à la fête.
target_text: Tulikuwa wote karibu siku ya sherehe.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa wote karibu siku ya sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne lui demandons-nous pas conseil ?
target_text: Sababu ya nini atu ombi ushauri?
target_text_raw: Sababu ya nini atu ombi ushauri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le riz manque de sel.
target_text: Wali haina chumvi.
target_text_raw: Wali haina chumvi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle lui promit de le rencontrer au café.
target_text: Ali mwambia wakutanane ku mugahawa.
target_text_raw: Ali mwambia wakutanane ku mugahawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Tu passes chez moi ?" "Je peux ?" "Mes parents rentrent tard tous les deux comme ils travaillent."
target_text: “Unapita kwangu ?” “naweza ?” “wazazi wangu wanafika nyuma sababu wote wanafanya kazi.”
target_text_raw: “Unapita kwangu ?” “naweza ?” “wazazi wangu wanafika nyuma sababu wote wanafanya kazi.”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ignore pourquoi tu l'écoutes.
target_text: Sijui kwanini una msikiliza.
target_text_raw: Sijui kwanini una msikiliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai l'intention de travailler l'anglais cet après-midi.
target_text: Nataka kufanya Kingereza leo mchana.
target_text_raw: Nataka kufanya Kingereza leo mchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-il y avoir un ordinateur assez intelligent pour raconter une blague ?
target_text: Anaweza kuwa na kompyuta yenye iko na uwezo wa kutangaza mizaa?
target_text_raw: Anaweza kuwa na kompyuta yenye iko na uwezo wa kutangaza mizaa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu d'accord ?
target_text: Una kubali?
target_text_raw: Una kubali?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Excusez-moi s'il vous plait, parlez-vous l'anglais?
target_text: Samahani tafadhali, unasema Kingereza?
target_text_raw: Samahani tafadhali, unasema Kingereza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous dois des excuses pour mon retard.
target_text: Nita kuomba msamaha kwa kuchelewa kwangu.
target_text_raw: Nita kuomba msamaha kwa kuchelewa kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu l'as tué ?
target_text: Uli mu-huwa?
target_text_raw: Uli mu-huwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fermez toutes les portes et fenêtres !
target_text: Funga milango yote na madirisha yote!
target_text_raw: Funga milango yote na madirisha yote!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que ce soit juste.
target_text: Sijui ni kwa nani sana.
target_text_raw: Sijui ni kwa nani sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il prit le coup sur la tête.
target_text: Alipigwa kichwani.
target_text_raw: Alipigwa kichwani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un membre du club de tennis de l'école.
target_text: Ni mwanachama wa timu ya tenisi ya masomo.
target_text_raw: Ni mwanachama wa timu ya tenisi ya masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas en sécurité.
target_text: Hatuko katika usalama.
target_text_raw: Hatuko katika usalama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À peu près tous les étudiants aiment l'anglais.
target_text: Labda wanafunzi wote wanapenda Kingereza.
target_text_raw: Labda wanafunzi wote wanapenda Kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jour prend fin.
target_text: Siku ime isha.
target_text_raw: Siku ime isha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette fleur a une odeur suave.
target_text: Mahuwa hii ina harufu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Mahuwa hii ina harufu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom sait que c'est la vérité.
target_text: Tom anajua kama ni ukweli.
target_text_raw: Tom anajua kama ni ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-lui de le leur donner.
target_text: Mwambie awape.
target_text_raw: Mwambie awape.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devrais vraiment dire à Tom de ne pas le faire.
target_text: Uta mwambia Tom ile ya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Uta mwambia Tom ile ya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que Tom te le dira.
target_text: Nafikiri Tom ata ku ambia.
target_text_raw: Nafikiri Tom ata ku ambia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es mon héros.
target_text: Weye ni shujaa wangu.
target_text_raw: Weye ni shujaa wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: 365 jours sont passés.
target_text: Siku 365 zime pita.
target_text_raw: Siku 365 zime pita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le problème nécessitait un gros effort pour être résolu.
target_text: Tatizo ina hitaji kazi ya mingi.
target_text_raw: Tatizo ina hitaji kazi ya mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle m'a servi un café.
target_text: Ali nipatia kahawa.
target_text_raw: Ali nipatia kahawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La population de Suède est en augmentation.
target_text: Raia wa Uswizi wana ongezeka.
target_text_raw: Raia wa Uswizi wana ongezeka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu veux pleurer, pleure.
target_text: Kama unataka kulia, lia.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka kulia, lia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui avez-vous invité à dîner ?
target_text: Uli halika nani ku chakula ya jioni?
target_text_raw: Uli halika nani ku chakula ya jioni?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux rien faire qui pourrait s'avérer dangereux.
target_text: Sita fanya kitu yoyote mbaya.
target_text_raw: Sita fanya kitu yoyote mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas beaucoup d'argent sur moi.
target_text: Sina pesa mingi.
target_text_raw: Sina pesa mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a une autre façon.
target_text: Kuna njia ingine.
target_text_raw: Kuna njia ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne fais pas de traductions gratuites.
target_text: Si fanyi ukalimani ku bure.
target_text_raw: Si fanyi ukalimani ku bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux dormir ! Dormir plutôt que vivre !
target_text: nataka kulala! Kulala kuliko kuishi!
target_text_raw: nataka kulala! Kulala kuliko kuishi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se tenait assis sur un banc.
target_text: Alikuwa anakaa chini kwenye kiti.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anakaa chini kwenye kiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un homme n'est pas toujours ce qu'il semble être.
target_text: Mtu haiko vile una m fananisha.
target_text_raw: Mtu haiko vile una m fananisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'aimait Marie que pour son argent.
target_text: Tom alikuwa anapenda Marie sababu ya pesa yake.
target_text_raw: Tom alikuwa anapenda Marie sababu ya pesa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Savez-vous à qui appartient cette voiture ?
target_text: Unajua hiyo gari ni ya nani?
target_text_raw: Unajua hiyo gari ni ya nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai peur de ne pas avoir le temps de les finir.
target_text: Nina ogopa sitakuwa na muda wa kumaliza.
target_text_raw: Nina ogopa sitakuwa na muda wa kumaliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le lion est le roi des animaux.
target_text: Simba ni mkuu wa wanyama.
target_text_raw: Simba ni mkuu wa wanyama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le four de ma maison ne fonctionne pas très bien aujourd'hui.
target_text: Tanuru ya nyumba yangu haifanyi kazi leo.
target_text_raw: Tanuru ya nyumba yangu haifanyi kazi leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas l'intention d'obéir à ces ordres.
target_text: Sina nia ya kuheshimu utaratibu huu.
target_text_raw: Sina nia ya kuheshimu utaratibu huu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'oubliez pas de prendre votre pilule !
target_text: Usi sahau kunywa dawa yako!
target_text_raw: Usi sahau kunywa dawa yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas germanophone, mais je suis germanophile.
target_text: Mimi si germanophone, lakini mimi ni germanophile.
target_text_raw: Mimi si germanophone, lakini mimi ni germanophile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai oublié de dire à Tom quand venir.
target_text: Nili sahau kuambia Tom siku ya-kuja.
target_text_raw: Nili sahau kuambia Tom siku ya-kuja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où se trouve le zoo ?
target_text: Wanyama wako wapi?
target_text_raw: Wanyama wako wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voudriez-vous fermer la fenêtre ?
target_text: Ulitaka kufuga dirisha?
target_text_raw: Ulitaka kufuga dirisha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux lui faire faire ce travail difficile.
target_text: Nita mfanya afanye hii kazi ngumu.
target_text_raw: Nita mfanya afanye hii kazi ngumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouvez rester ici si vous voulez.
target_text: Unaweza kubakia hapa ukitaka.
target_text_raw: Unaweza kubakia hapa ukitaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles doivent le confesser.
target_text: Anapaswa kutubu.
target_text_raw: Anapaswa kutubu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas censés boire de l'alcool dans ce théâtre.
target_text: Haiko lazima tunywe pombe mu hii mchezo.
target_text_raw: Haiko lazima tunywe pombe mu hii mchezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne savait pas ce que je ressentais.
target_text: Tom hajui vile nilikuwa nasikia.
target_text_raw: Tom hajui vile nilikuwa nasikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bouge de mon chemin s'il-te-plait.
target_text: Toka mu njia yangu tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Toka mu njia yangu tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est l'heure pour nous de partir.
target_text: Ni wakati wa sisi kuenda.
target_text_raw: Ni wakati wa sisi kuenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était déterminé à partir à l'étranger.
target_text: Alikuwa anataka kuenda mu inchi ya kigeni.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anataka kuenda mu inchi ya kigeni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous jugeons parfois les autres sur leurs actes.
target_text: Tuna hukumu wengine mu matendo yao.
target_text_raw: Tuna hukumu wengine mu matendo yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est arrivé en 2013.
target_text: Ilifika mu mwaka wa 2013.
target_text_raw: Ilifika mu mwaka wa 2013.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a dit que c'était Marie qui le lui avait dit.
target_text: Tom ali ni ambia aliambiwa na Maria.
target_text_raw: Tom ali ni ambia aliambiwa na Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il peut cuisiner aussi bien que sa femme.
target_text: Anaweza kupika chakula kuliko mke wake.
target_text_raw: Anaweza kupika chakula kuliko mke wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les deux nations entrèrent en guerre.
target_text: Inchi mbili zita ingia mu vita.
target_text_raw: Inchi mbili zita ingia mu vita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas le temps de me soucier de ce genre de futilités.
target_text: Sina wakati wa kufuatana na watu wajinga.
target_text_raw: Sina wakati wa kufuatana na watu wajinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il te plait ne me fais pas rire. J'ai fait trop d'abdominaux hier et mes muscles ventraux me font mal.
target_text: Naomba usi ni chekeshe. Nilifanya vitu mingi vibaya jana na mishipa yangu ya tumbu ina huma.
target_text_raw: Naomba usi ni chekeshe. Nilifanya vitu mingi vibaya jana na mishipa yangu ya tumbu ina huma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom s'engagea finalement dans la Marine.
target_text: Tom ali ingiza mu maneno ya maji.
target_text_raw: Tom ali ingiza mu maneno ya maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Environ deux semaines.
target_text: Karibu majuma mbili.
target_text_raw: Karibu majuma mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui n'était pas ici ?
target_text: Nani ahuko hapa?
target_text_raw: Nani ahuko hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom sera là.
target_text: Tom atakuwa hapo.
target_text_raw: Tom atakuwa hapo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'en veux.
target_text: Na i penda.
target_text_raw: Na i penda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu veux être heureux.
target_text: Sijui kama uta furahia.
target_text_raw: Sijui kama uta furahia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous nous faisions du souci.
target_text: Tuna shangaa.
target_text_raw: Tuna shangaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi n'y allons-nous pas ensemble ?
target_text: Kwanini hapendi huko pamoja?
target_text_raw: Kwanini hapendi huko pamoja?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as beaucoup d'idées bizarres.
target_text: Uko na mawazo mingi mabaya.
target_text_raw: Uko na mawazo mingi mabaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prenez garde !
target_text: Chunga!
target_text_raw: Chunga!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais parler avec Tom sur son frère John.
target_text: Napenda ni sema na Tom sababu ya kaka yake John.
target_text_raw: Napenda ni sema na Tom sababu ya kaka yake John.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous mes amis sont mariés.
target_text: Marafiki yangu wote wame olewa.
target_text_raw: Marafiki yangu wote wame olewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à comprendre la signification de ce mot.
target_text: Sielewi maana ya hii neno.
target_text_raw: Sielewi maana ya hii neno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous séjournâmes dans un chouette hôtel.
target_text: Tuta shinda mu chumba ya hoteli.
target_text_raw: Tuta shinda mu chumba ya hoteli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était en train de déjeuner quand je suis entré dans la pièce.
target_text: Alikuwa anakula wakati nili ingia.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anakula wakati nili ingia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas pu comprendre l'annonce qui vient d'être faite.
target_text: Siku sikia matangazo wame sema saa hii.
target_text_raw: Siku sikia matangazo wame sema saa hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voulais pas le croire.
target_text: sikutaka kumuamini.
target_text_raw: sikutaka kumuamini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il part pour New York la semaine prochaine.
target_text: anaenda New York juma ijayo.
target_text_raw: anaenda New York juma ijayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai aucune idée de pourquoi.
target_text: Sina mawazo yoyote ya-ku uliza kwanini.
target_text_raw: Sina mawazo yoyote ya-ku uliza kwanini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne t'aurais jamais tiré dessus.
target_text: Sita weza kuku kokota juu.
target_text_raw: Sita weza kuku kokota juu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu te fais de nouveaux amis, n'oublie pas les anciens.
target_text: Ukipata marafiki wa mapya, usi sahau marafiki ya zamani.
target_text_raw: Ukipata marafiki wa mapya, usi sahau marafiki ya zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'achète que des œufs de poules élevées en plein air.
target_text: Tom ana ni-uzia mayai ya kuku ya kufugwa mu kiwanja.
target_text_raw: Tom ana ni-uzia mayai ya kuku ya kufugwa mu kiwanja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la maison il n'y avait pas de signe de vie.
target_text: Katika nyumba hamuku kuwa dalili ya maisha.
target_text_raw: Katika nyumba hamuku kuwa dalili ya maisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veux-tu manger quelque chose ?
target_text: Unataka kula kito yoyote?
target_text_raw: Unataka kula kito yoyote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne s'agit pas de cela.
target_text: Si hiyo.
target_text_raw: Si hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je déteste ce jeu.
target_text: Sita huu mchezo.
target_text_raw: Sita huu mchezo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va faire chaud.
target_text: Itakuwa joto.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa joto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'approuve son projet.
target_text: Nakubali muradi yake.
target_text_raw: Nakubali muradi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que Tom a vu ça ?
target_text: Je Tom aliiona?
target_text_raw: Je Tom aliiona?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allons provoquer le débat sur le changement climatique.
target_text: Tuta hanza mjadala kuhusu mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
target_text_raw: Tuta hanza mjadala kuhusu mabadiliko ya hali ya hewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom parle parfaitement l'allemand.
target_text: Tom anasema ki Allemand.
target_text_raw: Tom anasema ki Allemand.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trouvé le lit très confortable.
target_text: Nilipata kitanda muzuri.
target_text_raw: Nilipata kitanda muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis déjà vieux et je ne peux guère gérer toutes les affaires.
target_text: nime zeeka na siwezi ku ongoza maneno yote.
target_text_raw: nime zeeka na siwezi ku ongoza maneno yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me sentais davantage en sécurité.
target_text: Najisikia kuwa na usalama.
target_text_raw: Najisikia kuwa na usalama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sait-il ce qu'elle éprouve à son égard ?
target_text: Unajua ana maanisha nini?
target_text_raw: Unajua ana maanisha nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça s'assombrissait.
target_text: Inakuwa giza.
target_text_raw: Inakuwa giza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'endroit était presque vide.
target_text: Nafasi ilikuwa bure.
target_text_raw: Nafasi ilikuwa bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis la vérité à Tom.
target_text: Sema ukweli Tom.
target_text_raw: Sema ukweli Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quant aux échecs, je ne connais que les règles.
target_text: Wakati waku kosa, sijuagi sheria.
target_text_raw: Wakati waku kosa, sijuagi sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne peux pas le gérer seul.
target_text: Hauwezi waongoza peke yako.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi waongoza peke yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que tout le monde ait renoncé.
target_text: Si kumbuki kama kila mtu anakataa.
target_text_raw: Si kumbuki kama kila mtu anakataa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas beaucoup d'argent à disposition.
target_text: Sina pesa nyingi sana.
target_text_raw: Sina pesa nyingi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voudrai pas être responsable de mes actes.
target_text: Sitakuwa na uhamzi kuhusu matendo yangu.
target_text_raw: Sitakuwa na uhamzi kuhusu matendo yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas l'air très fatigué.
target_text: Hauonekani kuchoka.
target_text_raw: Hauonekani kuchoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que vous seriez impressionnée.
target_text: Siku dhani kama uta furaiya.
target_text_raw: Siku dhani kama uta furaiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui ai dit que je n'étais pas intéressé.
target_text: Nili mwambia sitaki.
target_text_raw: Nili mwambia sitaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu trouveras quelque chose qui t'intéresse.
target_text: Ulipata kitu yoyote ya-ku kufu raisha.
target_text_raw: Ulipata kitu yoyote ya-ku kufu raisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oh, non ! vraiment ?
target_text: Oh, hapa! kabisa?
target_text_raw: Oh, hapa! kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il lui a écrit un message.
target_text: Ali mu-andikia ujumbe.
target_text_raw: Ali mu-andikia ujumbe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laisse-la partir !
target_text: Wacha apite!
target_text_raw: Wacha apite!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon oncle a une ferme dans le village.
target_text: Mjomba yangu ako na bibi ku kijiji.
target_text_raw: Mjomba yangu ako na bibi ku kijiji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de personnes pensent que je suis fou.
target_text: Watu mingi wali fikiria mimi ni mwenda wazimu.
target_text_raw: Watu mingi wali fikiria mimi ni mwenda wazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me parle pas d'elle.
target_text: Usi niambie ku husu yeye.
target_text_raw: Usi niambie ku husu yeye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet endroit est à côté de la mer.
target_text: Hii nafasi iko karibu ya bahari.
target_text_raw: Hii nafasi iko karibu ya bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a compris qu'il avait tort.
target_text: Alikubali alikuwa na makosa.
target_text_raw: Alikubali alikuwa na makosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'est pas moins belle que sa sœur.
target_text: Ni kiyana kama dada yake.
target_text_raw: Ni kiyana kama dada yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai faim !
target_text: Niko na njaa!
target_text_raw: Niko na njaa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fête t'a-t-elle plu ?
target_text: Sherehe ili ku fura-isha ?
target_text_raw: Sherehe ili ku fura-isha ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est trop âgée pour toi.
target_text: Alisha zeeka ku-kuliko.
target_text_raw: Alisha zeeka ku-kuliko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La physique ne m'intéresse pas le moins du monde.
target_text: Fizikia hai fura ishi hata kidogo duniani.
target_text_raw: Fizikia hai fura ishi hata kidogo duniani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis susceptible de pouvoir le faire.
target_text: Nafurahi sana kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Nafurahi sana kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'irai en Irlande cet été.
target_text: Nita enda Irland wakati wa jua.
target_text_raw: Nita enda Irland wakati wa jua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je verrai Tom demain.
target_text: Nitaona Tom kesho.
target_text_raw: Nitaona Tom kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas nécessaire que tu te presses. Prends ton temps.
target_text: Aina haja wewe kuji finya. Chukua muda wako.
target_text_raw: Aina haja wewe kuji finya. Chukua muda wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se peut qu'il ne soit pas un homme mauvais.
target_text: Inawezekana haiko mtu mbaya.
target_text_raw: Inawezekana haiko mtu mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fis une liste.
target_text: Nafanya orodha.
target_text_raw: Nafanya orodha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police enquête.
target_text: Polisi wana chunguza.
target_text_raw: Polisi wana chunguza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant, je te présenterai mes parents.
target_text: Sasa, Nita kuonyesha wazazi wangu.
target_text_raw: Sasa, Nita kuonyesha wazazi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la maison où je vivais quand j'étais petit.
target_text: Ni nyumba nili ishi nikiwa mdogo.
target_text_raw: Ni nyumba nili ishi nikiwa mdogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dites-moi quel pain vous désirez manger.
target_text: Unataka kula mkate gani, niambie.
target_text_raw: Unataka kula mkate gani, niambie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis prêt à aller avec vous.
target_text: Niko tayari kuenda nawe.
target_text_raw: Niko tayari kuenda nawe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai vu sauter.
target_text: Niliona aliruka.
target_text_raw: Niliona aliruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous fîmes l'ascension de la montagne en téléphérique.
target_text: Tuli teremka mlima.
target_text_raw: Tuli teremka mlima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aurais peut-être pas dû t'embrasser.
target_text: Sita kubali kuku kumbatia.
target_text_raw: Sita kubali kuku kumbatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom nous a dit de ne pas nager ici.
target_text: Tom alisema tusi ogelee hapa.
target_text_raw: Tom alisema tusi ogelee hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais au lit. Bonne nuit.
target_text: Na henda kulala. Usiku mwema.
target_text_raw: Na henda kulala. Usiku mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons pas pu obtenir beaucoup d'aide.
target_text: Hatukupata usaidizi mingi.
target_text_raw: Hatukupata usaidizi mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est présent à la réunion.
target_text: Ako ku mkutano.
target_text_raw: Ako ku mkutano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est de France.
target_text: Anatoka France.
target_text_raw: Anatoka France.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui écrit lit deux fois.
target_text: Nani ana handika.
target_text_raw: Nani ana handika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parle le russe.
target_text: Nasema Ki-rusia.
target_text_raw: Nasema Ki-rusia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai du travail par-dessus la tête.
target_text: Niko na kazi kichwani.
target_text_raw: Niko na kazi kichwani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce fut une chouette fête.
target_text: Ilikuwa sherehe muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa sherehe muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toute la maison a cramé.
target_text: Nyumba mzima ya kuteketezwa.
target_text_raw: Nyumba mzima ya kuteketezwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le français de Tom est presque parfait.
target_text: Kifaransa ya Tom ni mzuri kiasi.
target_text_raw: Kifaransa ya Tom ni mzuri kiasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La maison prit feu.
target_text: Nyumba ili lungula.
target_text_raw: Nyumba ili lungula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ôte ton manteau et fais comme chez toi.
target_text: Vua koti yako ukale kama kwako.
target_text_raw: Vua koti yako ukale kama kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a personne ici. Où sont-ils tous ?
target_text: Hakuna mtu hapa. Wote wako wapi?
target_text_raw: Hakuna mtu hapa. Wote wako wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais savoir ce que vous voulez dire.
target_text: Napenda kujua ila unataka.
target_text_raw: Napenda kujua ila unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a peu d'hommes qui sachent cela en leurs cœurs.
target_text: Kuna watu wadogo wanajua hiyo mu roho yao.
target_text_raw: Kuna watu wadogo wanajua hiyo mu roho yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La chance n'y avait rien à faire.
target_text: Bahati haina kitu yoyote ya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Bahati haina kitu yoyote ya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il porte une chemise rouge, c'est un signe !
target_text: Anavaa shati nyekundu, ni ishara!
target_text_raw: Anavaa shati nyekundu, ni ishara!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce CD coûte 10 dollars.
target_text: Hii CD bana i huzisha dola 10.
target_text_raw: Hii CD bana i huzisha dola 10.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ennemi ne peut pas s'approcher.
target_text: Adui hawezi karibia.
target_text_raw: Adui hawezi karibia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne devrais probablement pas être en train de faire ça.
target_text: Siwezi kuwa nafanya vile.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kuwa nafanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que l'entreprise avait envoyé Tom à Boston.
target_text: Nafikiri shirika ilituma Tom huko Boston.
target_text_raw: Nafikiri shirika ilituma Tom huko Boston.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a quelque chose qui ne va pas.
target_text: Kuna kitu ambayo si muzuri.
target_text_raw: Kuna kitu ambayo si muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a réussi l'examen.
target_text: Alipata mtiani.
target_text_raw: Alipata mtiani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je connais le garçon qui est assis le plus près de la porte.
target_text: Najua kijana yule amekaa chini karibu ya mlango.
target_text_raw: Najua kijana yule amekaa chini karibu ya mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas difficile de parler français.
target_text: Kuongea Kifaransa si ngumu.
target_text_raw: Kuongea Kifaransa si ngumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reste pour quelques autres semaines.
target_text: Nabaki ku juma zingine.
target_text_raw: Nabaki ku juma zingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous savions tous les deux que cela arriverait.
target_text: Tulijua sisi wote wawili kama hiyo itafika.
target_text_raw: Tulijua sisi wote wawili kama hiyo itafika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne n'est aux alentours.
target_text: Hakuna mtu ako pembeni.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mtu ako pembeni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne sait pas qui a construit ces maisons.
target_text: Hajui nani alijenga hii nyumba.
target_text_raw: Hajui nani alijenga hii nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était la fin de l'hiver et le temps était très froid.
target_text: Ilikuwa mwisho wa joto na ilikuwa baridi sana.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa mwisho wa joto na ilikuwa baridi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aurais jamais dû essayer de faire ça.
target_text: Sita weza kujaribu hiyo hata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Sita weza kujaribu hiyo hata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que faisiez-vous tous les deux ?
target_text: Mnafanya nini nyinyi wote wawili?
target_text_raw: Mnafanya nini nyinyi wote wawili?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons jusqu'à demain soir pour décider.
target_text: Tuna taki-kana kuamua hadi kesho jioni.
target_text_raw: Tuna taki-kana kuamua hadi kesho jioni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne l'avais pas encore compris.
target_text: Siku mu-elewa.
target_text_raw: Siku mu-elewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom pensait que Marie n'apprécierait pas sa fête, donc il ne l'invita pas.
target_text: Tom ali fikiri Maria hata furaiya sherehe yake, basi bila ku mu halika.
target_text_raw: Tom ali fikiri Maria hata furaiya sherehe yake, basi bila ku mu halika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous nous réjouîmes d'avance d'une soirée à passer à la maison et sans invités.
target_text: Tuta kutana ku nyumba bila ku halika wageni.
target_text_raw: Tuta kutana ku nyumba bila ku halika wageni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Tom hakukuwa na pesa mingi yaku lipa gari yaku rudi nayo nyumbani.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A-t-on le droit de prendre des photos dans ce bâtiment ?

source_text: Je me sentais mal, aussi je fus admis à l'hôpital. Cependant, il s'avéra qu'il n'y avait rien qui n'allait réellement pas chez moi.
target_text: Nilikuwa nasikia vibaya, na nilikuwa nili lazwa ku hospitali. Kwa sasa, hakuna kitu inaendelea kwake.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nasikia vibaya, na nilikuwa nili lazwa ku hospitali. Kwa sasa, hakuna kitu inaendelea kwake.

source_text: Nous l'avons attendu jusqu'à deux heures du matin et sommes finalement allés nous coucher.
target_text: Tuli mngoja mu saa mbili za asubui na tuli enda kulala.
target_text_raw: Tuli mngoja mu saa mbili za asubui na tuli enda kulala.

source_text: Quelle est cette chose dans ta main droite ?

target_text_raw: Nini iko mkononi mwako wa kuhume?

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne crois pas que Tom puisse parler français.

source_text: Ce n'est qu'après avoir quitté l'école que je me rendis compte de l'importance des études.

target_text_raw: Haku kuwa juu ya nini muzuri au mbaya, lakini muzuri zaidi na safi.

source_text: Vous êtes une personne très généreuse.
target_text: Uko mtu muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Uko mtu muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants les plus âgés aidaient les plus jeunes.
target_text: Watoto wakubwa wana saidia watoto wadogo.
target_text_raw: Watoto wakubwa wana saidia watoto wadogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vivez.
target_text: Kuishi.
target_text_raw: Kuishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'oubliera jamais tout le temps qu'il a passé avec Marie.
target_text: Tom hawezi ku sahau wakati yote alikuwa na Marie.
target_text_raw: Tom hawezi ku sahau wakati yote alikuwa na Marie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il faut dire à Tom de ne pas faire ça.
target_text: Nafikiri huwezi kuambia Tom asifanye ile.
target_text_raw: Nafikiri huwezi kuambia Tom asifanye ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Présente-moi à tes parents quand tu te sentiras prête.
target_text: Ni peleke ku wazazi wako ukiwa tayari.
target_text_raw: Ni peleke ku wazazi wako ukiwa tayari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous suggère de partir.
target_text: Naomba uende.
target_text_raw: Naomba uende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons que trois heures.
target_text: Tuko na masaa tatu tu.
target_text_raw: Tuko na masaa tatu tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le voyage dans le temps est impossible.
target_text: Safari ku hii muda ni ngumu.
target_text_raw: Safari ku hii muda ni ngumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme c'est spacieux!
target_text: Kama iko muimu sana!
target_text_raw: Kama iko muimu sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment commence votre lundi ?
target_text: Uta hanza siku yako ya kwanza aje?
target_text_raw: Uta hanza siku yako ya kwanza aje?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père m'a dit de ne pas lire de livres dans mon lit.
target_text: Baba yangu alisema nisi some vitabu mu kitanda yangu.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu alisema nisi some vitabu mu kitanda yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas ce qu'on appelle un gentleman.
target_text: Haiko mtu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Haiko mtu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom connaît beaucoup de chansons.
target_text: Tom ana jua nyimbo mingi.
target_text_raw: Tom ana jua nyimbo mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai acheté un système antivol pour ma moto.
target_text: Nili huza kitu yaku zuia kuiba pikipiki yangu.
target_text_raw: Nili huza kitu yaku zuia kuiba pikipiki yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas quoi répondre.
target_text: Sijui nini ya kusema.
target_text_raw: Sijui nini ya kusema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai tellement soif.
target_text: Niko na kiu.
target_text_raw: Niko na kiu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il sait que tu le sais.
target_text: Anajua kama unajua.
target_text_raw: Anajua kama unajua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma chambre est toujours bien rangée.
target_text: Chumba yangu ina pangwa vizuri.
target_text_raw: Chumba yangu ina pangwa vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jane est une fille incroyablement attirante.
target_text: Jane ni msichana mrembo sana.
target_text_raw: Jane ni msichana mrembo sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'est plus un enfant.
target_text: Tom si mutoto.
target_text_raw: Tom si mutoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ainsi qu'il l'apprécie.
target_text: Hivi ndio ninapenda.
target_text_raw: Hivi ndio ninapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dites-moi lequel des deux appareils photo est le meilleur.
target_text: Niambie ni gani mu hizi kamera mbili ndo muzuri.
target_text_raw: Niambie ni gani mu hizi kamera mbili ndo muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci pour ton aide.
target_text: Asante kwa usaidizi yako.
target_text_raw: Asante kwa usaidizi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sers-toi, mange ce que tu veux.
target_text: Kamata, kula ile unataka.
target_text_raw: Kamata, kula ile unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand je vis cela, j'en eus le souffle coupé.
target_text: Nilipo ona vile, nili ishiwa na uhamuzi.
target_text_raw: Nilipo ona vile, nili ishiwa na uhamuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que Tom dort encore.
target_text: Nafikiri Toma bado ana lala.
target_text_raw: Nafikiri Toma bado ana lala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le problème est en train d'être discuté par eux.
target_text: Tatizo ina ongelewa na habo.
target_text_raw: Tatizo ina ongelewa na habo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne laisserai pas ceci se produire.
target_text: Sita acha hii iji tokeleze.
target_text_raw: Sita acha hii iji tokeleze.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il conduit souvent la voiture de son père.
target_text: Ana tembeza gari ya baba yake.
target_text_raw: Ana tembeza gari ya baba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aime pas être traité de cette manière.
target_text: Sitaki kuchukuliwa kama na vile.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kuchukuliwa kama na vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas moi qui ai commencé la dispute.
target_text: Si mimi nili hanza kugombana.
target_text_raw: Si mimi nili hanza kugombana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est vraiment très ennuyeux.
target_text: Ni yaku kasirisha kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ni yaku kasirisha kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma montre doit retarder.
target_text: Saa yangu inapaswa kuchelewa.
target_text_raw: Saa yangu inapaswa kuchelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La mort est le moment durant lequel tu ne peux plus revivre. Tu ne peux pas mourir, ni retourner à la vie. Si tu penses que c'est arrivé, c'est que tu n'étais pas vraiment mort.
target_text: Kufa ndo wakati hauwezi kuishi tena. Hauwezi kufa, ama kurudi kuwa na uzima. Kama uli ona itafika, basi hakuwa ume kufa.
target_text_raw: Kufa ndo wakati hauwezi kuishi tena. Hauwezi kufa, ama kurudi kuwa na uzima. Kama uli ona itafika, basi hakuwa ume kufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne croyait pas Mary quand elle lui disait qu'elle était amoureuse de lui.
target_text: Tom haja amini Mary wakati alisema ana mpenda.
target_text_raw: Tom haja amini Mary wakati alisema ana mpenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans chaque vie, il faut que tombe un peu de pluie.
target_text: Katika maisha yote, inabidi mvua inyeshe.
target_text_raw: Katika maisha yote, inabidi mvua inyeshe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: George est d'une nature très honnête.
target_text: George ni mwaminifu sana.
target_text_raw: George ni mwaminifu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas savoir ce qu'il va se passer.
target_text: Sitaki kujua nini ita tokea.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kujua nini ita tokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a appris à nager.
target_text: Ali ni-fundisha ku ogelea.
target_text_raw: Ali ni-fundisha ku ogelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se rend souvent à l'école à pied.
target_text: Ana henda ku masomo lwa migulu.
target_text_raw: Ana henda ku masomo lwa migulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu nous dis la vérité ?
target_text: Una tu-ambia ukweli?
target_text_raw: Una tu-ambia ukweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aucun médicament ne peut guérir cette maladie.
target_text: Hakuna dawa inaweza ponya hii ugonjwa.
target_text_raw: Hakuna dawa inaweza ponya hii ugonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai pris plein la gueule.
target_text: Nili chukua mdomo mzima.
target_text_raw: Nili chukua mdomo mzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trouve-moi un verre.
target_text: Nitafutie kikombe.
target_text_raw: Nitafutie kikombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N’avez-vous rien d’autre à dire ?
target_text: Hauna kitu ya kusema?
target_text_raw: Hauna kitu ya kusema?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis désolé, mais vous n'avez pas le droit de téléphoner ici.
target_text: Na shangaa, Lakini hauna haki yaku piga simu hapa.
target_text_raw: Na shangaa, Lakini hauna haki yaku piga simu hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sors le vélo du chemin !
target_text: Toa kinga mu njia!
target_text_raw: Toa kinga mu njia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La parti a toujours raison.
target_text: Iko na sheria.
target_text_raw: Iko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est dommage, mais ton personnage se fait tuer au début de la pièce.
target_text: Pole, ila nafasi yako ina kufa mbele ya kuanza.
target_text_raw: Pole, ila nafasi yako ina kufa mbele ya kuanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne devrais pas te moquer de son erreur.
target_text: Hu staili kushangalia na makosa yake.
target_text_raw: Hu staili kushangalia na makosa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Même toi, tu es un type qui ne sait pas quand laisser tomber.
target_text: Hata weye, uko mtu haujui ku sahau.
target_text_raw: Hata weye, uko mtu haujui ku sahau.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est descendue à la station suivante.
target_text: Alishuka ku kituo kilicho fuata.
target_text_raw: Alishuka ku kituo kilicho fuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as des yeux mignons.
target_text: Uko na macho muzuri.
target_text_raw: Uko na macho muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet endroit est parfait.
target_text: Hii fasi ni muzuri.
target_text_raw: Hii fasi ni muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'attendrai dehors.
target_text: Nita ngoja inje.
target_text_raw: Nita ngoja inje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas trop fatigué.
target_text: Siku choka.
target_text_raw: Siku choka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je désire une chaise.
target_text: Natamani kiti moja.
target_text_raw: Natamani kiti moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom espère visiter Boston l'été prochain.
target_text: Tom anapenda kwenda Boston mwaka kesho.
target_text_raw: Tom anapenda kwenda Boston mwaka kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'y travaille plus.
target_text: Si tumiki huko tena.
target_text_raw: Si tumiki huko tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui appelez-vous maintenant ?
target_text: Una ita nani sasa?
target_text_raw: Una ita nani sasa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est allergique à l'alcool.
target_text: Tom hapendi pombe.
target_text_raw: Tom hapendi pombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne va pas là.
target_text: Usi ende pale.
target_text_raw: Usi ende pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la nuit, un coup de feu retentit.
target_text: Usiku, moto uli waka.
target_text_raw: Usiku, moto uli waka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est justement la raison pour laquelle je n'ai aucun intérêt pour l'art.
target_text: Ndio sababu si tamani ufundi.
target_text_raw: Ndio sababu si tamani ufundi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde avait peur.
target_text: Kila mtu ali ogopa.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu ali ogopa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas comment gérer ça.
target_text: Sijui vile kufanya hii.
target_text_raw: Sijui vile kufanya hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ma première fois alors je suis un peu nerveux.
target_text: Ni mara yangu ya kwanza lakini naogopa.
target_text_raw: Ni mara yangu ya kwanza lakini naogopa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi dois-tu le faire ?
target_text: Kwanini unapaswa kuifanya?
target_text_raw: Kwanini unapaswa kuifanya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela leur a pris un moment avant de s'habituer les uns aux autres.
target_text: Ili wachukua muda kabla waanze kuzoeana.
target_text_raw: Ili wachukua muda kabla waanze kuzoeana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'aiderai du mieux que je peux.
target_text: ita kusaidia vile naweza.
target_text_raw: ita kusaidia vile naweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne gère pas bien la solitude.
target_text: Sipendi upweke.
target_text_raw: Sipendi upweke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment veux-tu te concentrer sur tes devoirs avec la télé allumée ?
target_text: Unataka kufanya kazi na runinga umewasha?
target_text_raw: Unataka kufanya kazi na runinga umewasha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que Tom n'est qu'un enfant.
target_text: Najua Tom si mutoto.
target_text_raw: Najua Tom si mutoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque année, le printemps nous apporte de la douceur.
target_text: Kila mwaka, upepo una tu-tuliza.
target_text_raw: Kila mwaka, upepo una tu-tuliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donne-lui une bonne moitié.
target_text: Patia kiwango kidogo kizuri.
target_text_raw: Patia kiwango kidogo kizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne trouve pas le mot pour exprimer ce que je ressens.
target_text: Sina neno la kusema kuhusu vile na fikiria.
target_text_raw: Sina neno la kusema kuhusu vile na fikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ressens la conscience du devoir.
target_text: Nafikiria kuhusu kazi.
target_text_raw: Nafikiria kuhusu kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'étais pas en mesure de susciter le moindre changement dans sa façon de penser.
target_text: Sikuwa na weza kufanya mabadiliko hata kidogo ku vile ana fikiria.
target_text_raw: Sikuwa na weza kufanya mabadiliko hata kidogo ku vile ana fikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se sent chez soi.
target_text: Ana ji-sikia kwake.
target_text_raw: Ana ji-sikia kwake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en veux davantage.
target_text: Naipenda.
target_text_raw: Naipenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom aurait pu se blesser aujourd'hui.
target_text: Tom ange ji umiza leo.
target_text_raw: Tom ange ji umiza leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons arrangé les fleurs.
target_text: Tuli panga mauwa.
target_text_raw: Tuli panga mauwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est juste ce dont tu as besoin maintenant.
target_text: Una itaji usaidizi huu sasa.
target_text_raw: Una itaji usaidizi huu sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous savons que vous n'êtes pas stupides.
target_text: Tunajua hauko mjinga.
target_text_raw: Tunajua hauko mjinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es une bête ! Tu ne t'es pas trompé sur la moindre question !
target_text: Uko mjinga! Hawa kudanganyika ku swali kidogo!
target_text_raw: Uko mjinga! Hawa kudanganyika ku swali kidogo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rira bien qui rira le dernier.
target_text: Uta cheka vizuri uki cheka wa mwisho.
target_text_raw: Uta cheka vizuri uki cheka wa mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom dit qu'il pense que c'est une perte de temps de voter.
target_text: Tom ana ona kupiga kura ni kupoteza muda.
target_text_raw: Tom ana ona kupiga kura ni kupoteza muda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne l'ai pas acheté parce que c'était trop cher.
target_text: Siku huza sababu ilikuwa bei mingi.
target_text_raw: Siku huza sababu ilikuwa bei mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a des vertiges.
target_text: Ako na kizunguzungu.
target_text_raw: Ako na kizunguzungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a dit qu'il aimerait une autre tasse de café.
target_text: Tom amesema kwamba anapenda kikomba ingine ya kahawa.
target_text_raw: Tom amesema kwamba anapenda kikomba ingine ya kahawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est dans le service depuis cinquante ans.
target_text: Iko mu huduma ku miaka ma kumi tano.
target_text_raw: Iko mu huduma ku miaka ma kumi tano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux connaître le groupe sanguin de Tom.
target_text: Nataka kujua kikundi ya damu ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Nataka kujua kikundi ya damu ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est deux heures du matin.
target_text: NI saa nane za usiku.
target_text_raw: NI saa nane za usiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'était pas chez lui aujourd'hui.
target_text: Tom hakuwa kwake leo.
target_text_raw: Tom hakuwa kwake leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aida les pauvres durant toute sa vie.
target_text: Ali saidia maskini mu maisha yake yote.
target_text_raw: Ali saidia maskini mu maisha yake yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne veut pas parler avec toi.
target_text: Tom hataki kusema na weye.
target_text_raw: Tom hataki kusema na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que nous devrions faire ça.
target_text: Naona tuna paswa kufanya vile.
target_text_raw: Naona tuna paswa kufanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est parce qu'il m'aime.
target_text: NI sababu ana ni penda.
target_text_raw: NI sababu ana ni penda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est déjà dans l'avion.
target_text: Tom iko mu ndege tayari.
target_text_raw: Tom iko mu ndege tayari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-moi juste quand tu veux partir.
target_text: Niambie uki taka kuenda.
target_text_raw: Niambie uki taka kuenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es plus que bienvenu.
target_text: Una karibishwa sana.
target_text_raw: Una karibishwa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est complètement déconcerté.
target_text: Tom haiko maanani.
target_text_raw: Tom haiko maanani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mike ne peut pas avoir fait une chose pareille.
target_text: Mike hawezi fanya kitu kama hiki.

target_text_raw: Uko na nguo chafu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suppose que nous pourrions essayer de faire cela.
target_text: Na pendekeza tuna weza kuanza kufanya yale.
target_text_raw: Na pendekeza tuna weza kuanza kufanya yale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qui brûle ?
target_text: Nini ina ungua?
target_text_raw: Nini ina ungua?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serai le dernier à le faire.
target_text: Nita kuwa wa mwisho kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Nita kuwa wa mwisho kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'oncle Tom est assis dans le jardin avec le journal.
target_text: Mjomba Tom ameketi ndani ya bustani na gazeti mkononi.
target_text_raw: Mjomba Tom ameketi ndani ya bustani na gazeti mkononi.
