source_text: Aujourd'hui c'est lundi.
target_text: Leo ni juma tatu.
target_text_raw: Leo ni juma tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom était là aussi.
target_text: Tom alikuwa pale pia.
target_text_raw: Tom alikuwa pale pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que ce soit la solution.
target_text: Sioni kama ndio suluhisho.
target_text_raw: Sioni kama ndio suluhisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'achète que des légumes frais, jamais de légumes surgelés.
target_text: Na nunua tu mboga mbichi, sio mboga yaku ganda.
target_text_raw: Na nunua tu mboga mbichi, sio mboga yaku ganda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ressemble à son père.
target_text: Ana fanana baba yake.
target_text_raw: Ana fanana baba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il demanda un peu d'argent.
target_text: Ali omba pesa kidogo.
target_text_raw: Ali omba pesa kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom prend bien soin de Mary.
target_text: Tom ali chunga Mary.
target_text_raw: Tom ali chunga Mary.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allons nager à la rivière.
target_text: Twende kuogelea kwenye mto.
target_text_raw: Twende kuogelea kwenye mto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous désirons tous une nouvelle voiture ou un nouveau téléphone.
target_text: Tuna tamani wote gari mpya au simu mpya.
target_text_raw: Tuna tamani wote gari mpya au simu mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vient de finir mon dîner.
target_text: nime maliza chakula changu.
target_text_raw: nime maliza chakula changu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a beaucoup de meubles dans cette pièce.
target_text: Kuna vyombo vingi katika sehemu hii.
target_text_raw: Kuna vyombo vingi katika sehemu hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a accepté le poste sans trop y réfléchir.
target_text: Ali kubali kazi bila kufikiria.
target_text_raw: Ali kubali kazi bila kufikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous attendons un bébé.
target_text: Tuna ngojea mtoto.
target_text_raw: Tuna ngojea mtoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai rien du tout.
target_text: Sina chochote.
target_text_raw: Sina chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas pourquoi Tom a fait ça.
target_text: Sijui kwanini Tom alifanya vile.
target_text_raw: Sijui kwanini Tom alifanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a donné un bon conseil à Mary.
target_text: Tom ali toa ushauri mzuri kwa Mary.
target_text_raw: Tom ali toa ushauri mzuri kwa Mary.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devez les aider.
target_text: Una staili kuwa saidia.
target_text_raw: Una staili kuwa saidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens de le faire.
target_text: nime ifanya.
target_text_raw: nime ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est tout ce que je fais.
target_text: Ni ile nataka kufanya.
target_text_raw: Ni ile nataka kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es désormais un adulte.
target_text: Wewe ni ya watu wazima.
target_text_raw: Wewe ni ya watu wazima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le parking est gratuit.
target_text: Ku egesha gari ni bure.
target_text_raw: Ku egesha gari ni bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton petit ami a l'air mignon.
target_text: Mdogo wako ni mrembo.
target_text_raw: Mdogo wako ni mrembo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est précisément ce qu'il lui fallait.
target_text: Ni ile ilivyo faa.
target_text_raw: Ni ile ilivyo faa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À sa mort, tout le pays fut en deuil.
target_text: Kwa kifo, inchi nzima ilikuwa ndani ya kifo.
target_text_raw: Kwa kifo, inchi nzima ilikuwa ndani ya kifo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais solliciter une bourse.
target_text: Nita omba usaidizi wa masomo.
target_text_raw: Nita omba usaidizi wa masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On construit un nouveau pont au-dessus de la rivière.
target_text: Kuna jengwa daraja mpya juu ya mpya.
target_text_raw: Kuna jengwa daraja mpya juu ya mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai tout fait correctement.
target_text: Nili fanya kama ilivyo staili.
target_text_raw: Nili fanya kama ilivyo staili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as besoin de quelqu'un pour t'aider, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Unataka mtu waku kusaidia, sivyo?
target_text_raw: Unataka mtu waku kusaidia, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont marché.
target_text: wali tembea.
target_text_raw: wali tembea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui cherchez-vous ?
target_text: Una tafuta nani?
target_text_raw: Una tafuta nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne prend jamais ses médicaments pour son rhume.
target_text: Hau-chukui dawa za homa.
target_text_raw: Hau-chukui dawa za homa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fut surpris par la nouvelle.
target_text: Ali stuka na habari.
target_text_raw: Ali stuka na habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu seras tuée !
target_text: Uta kufa!
target_text_raw: Uta kufa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce que tu as dit s'applique également dans ce cas.
target_text: Ile ulisema ina onekana katika hali hii.
target_text_raw: Ile ulisema ina onekana katika hali hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plupart étaient incapables de lire ou d'écrire.
target_text: Wengi wanashindwa kusoma na kuandika.
target_text_raw: Wengi wanashindwa kusoma na kuandika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne m'as-tu pas appelé ?
target_text: Kwanini hau-ku ni-ita?
target_text_raw: Kwanini hau-ku ni-ita?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pris soin de tout.
target_text: Nili chunga yote.
target_text_raw: Nili chunga yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de temps durent tes vacances de printemps ?
target_text: Mapumziko yako ya wakati wa joto ita chukua mda gani?
target_text_raw: Mapumziko yako ya wakati wa joto ita chukua mda gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Venez nous aider.
target_text: Kuja kutu saidia.
target_text_raw: Kuja kutu saidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que tu avais dit que tu ne pouvais pas manger de poisson cru.
target_text: Nafikiri ulisema hauwezi kula samaki waku choma.
target_text_raw: Nafikiri ulisema hauwezi kula samaki waku choma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre professeur parle aussi bien français qu'anglais.
target_text: Mwalimu wetu ana ongea Kifaransa vyema kuliko Kingereza.
target_text_raw: Mwalimu wetu ana ongea Kifaransa vyema kuliko Kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce que tu dois faire, c'est apprendre cette phrase par cœur.
target_text: Yote utakayo fanya, niku nakili msemwa huu katika roho yako.
target_text_raw: Yote utakayo fanya, niku nakili msemwa huu katika roho yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a étudié le japonais après le dîner.
target_text: Alisoma Kijapani baada ya chakula cha jioni.
target_text_raw: Alisoma Kijapani baada ya chakula cha jioni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Réunissons-nous ici hebdomadairement.
target_text: Tu patane hapa kila mara.
target_text_raw: Tu patane hapa kila mara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom vit seul depuis que sa femme est morte.
target_text: Tom ali hishi mwenyewe tangu kifo ya mke wake.
target_text_raw: Tom ali hishi mwenyewe tangu kifo ya mke wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a mangé la totalité de son diner.
target_text: Ali kula chakula yake yote.
target_text_raw: Ali kula chakula yake yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il voulait en savoir davantage sur les fleurs.
target_text: Alitaka kujua zaidi kuhusu mauwa.
target_text_raw: Alitaka kujua zaidi kuhusu mauwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne dispose pas de suffisamment d'argent pour payer le produit en liquide.
target_text: Sina pesa ya kutosha kulipa bidhaa na pesa taslimu.
target_text_raw: Sina pesa ya kutosha kulipa bidhaa na pesa taslimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est l'heure de travailler. Mettons-nous au travail.
target_text: Ni wakati waku fanya kazi. Tu fanye kazi.
target_text_raw: Ni wakati waku fanya kazi. Tu fanye kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom pensait que tu l'aurais fait.
target_text: Tom ali-fikiria kwamba ili ifanya.
target_text_raw: Tom ali-fikiria kwamba ili ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que je peux le faire.
target_text: Natumai Nita ifanya.
target_text_raw: Natumai Nita ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu arrêter de crier ?
target_text: Unaweza kuwacha kupiga kelele?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuwacha kupiga kelele?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suppose que ce ne serait pas du luxe que je prenne une douche.
target_text: Sioni kama ni raha kama nita oga.
target_text_raw: Sioni kama ni raha kama nita oga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'est refusé à prendre le pot-de-vin.
target_text: Ali kataa ku chukua sufuria ya divai.
target_text_raw: Ali kataa ku chukua sufuria ya divai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ici pour affaires.
target_text: Niko hapa kwa ajili ya shuguli.
target_text_raw: Niko hapa kwa ajili ya shuguli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À la vue de son visage, elle se mit à pleurer.
target_text: Alipo ona kijiji chake, ali hanza kulia.
target_text_raw: Alipo ona kijiji chake, ali hanza kulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère n'est pas toujours à la maison.
target_text: Mama yangu hayuko nyumbani kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu hayuko nyumbani kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne voulions pas énerver Tom.
target_text: Hatutaki ku msumbua Tom.
target_text_raw: Hatutaki ku msumbua Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il attrapa la corde.
target_text: Ali shika kamba.
target_text_raw: Ali shika kamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous travaillons à la journée.
target_text: Tuna fanya kazi kwa siku.
target_text_raw: Tuna fanya kazi kwa siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ho, Tom, emmène-moi avec toi !
target_text: Tom, tafadhali chukua hii!
target_text_raw: Tom, tafadhali chukua hii!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est ravi.
target_text: Tom ana furai.
target_text_raw: Tom ana furai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'as-tu dit à quiconque ?
target_text: Ali sema chochote?
target_text_raw: Ali sema chochote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais qu'elle est belle.
target_text: Najua kama ni mrembo.
target_text_raw: Najua kama ni mrembo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous allumer la lumière s'il vous plaît !
target_text: Tafadhali, unaweza washa mwangaza!
target_text_raw: Tafadhali, unaweza washa mwangaza!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan voulait beaucoup d'enfants.
target_text: Dan alipenda watoto wengi.
target_text_raw: Dan alipenda watoto wengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois l'aider.
target_text: nastahili ku msaidia.
target_text_raw: nastahili ku msaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas un sport facile.
target_text: Si mchezo raisi.
target_text_raw: Si mchezo raisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vient ici presque tous les jours.
target_text: Anakuja hapa karibu kila siku.
target_text_raw: Anakuja hapa karibu kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu te sens bien ?
target_text: Una jihisi vyema?
target_text_raw: Una jihisi vyema?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu la silhouette d'un homme.
target_text: Nili ona kivuli ya binadamu.
target_text_raw: Nili ona kivuli ya binadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu te taire?
target_text: Unaweza nyamaza?
target_text_raw: Unaweza nyamaza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande pourquoi Tom n'est pas allé au concert.
target_text: Najiuliza kwanini Tom alikataa kwenda kwenye tamasha la muziki.
target_text_raw: Najiuliza kwanini Tom alikataa kwenda kwenye tamasha la muziki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête de faire comme si tu ne me connaissais pas !
target_text: Wacha ku fanya kama huni jui!
target_text_raw: Wacha ku fanya kama huni jui!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde m'appelait Tony à l'époque.
target_text: Mbeleni kila mtu alikuwa ana ni ita Tony.
target_text_raw: Mbeleni kila mtu alikuwa ana ni ita Tony.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as un grand nez.
target_text: Uko na pua kubwa.
target_text_raw: Uko na pua kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma télé est cassée.
target_text: Kichwa changu ime vunjika.
target_text_raw: Kichwa changu ime vunjika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y eut pas de conséquences.
target_text: Hakuna ubaya.
target_text_raw: Hakuna ubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas encore morts.
target_text: Hatuja-fariki bado.
target_text_raw: Hatuja-fariki bado.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est comme ce chien, il a trouvé son maître en Marie.
target_text: Tom yuko kama umbwa, ali chukua Marie kama mwalimu wake.
target_text_raw: Tom yuko kama umbwa, ali chukua Marie kama mwalimu wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pièce était bondée.
target_text: Kipande kili songamana.
target_text_raw: Kipande kili songamana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La conférence est déjà terminée, monsieur.
target_text: Bwana, mkutano ume-sha malizika.
target_text_raw: Bwana, mkutano ume-sha malizika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es pile à l'heure.
target_text: Wewe ni mawe kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Wewe ni mawe kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il essuya la sueur de son front.
target_text: Ali toa jasho kwenye uso wake.
target_text_raw: Ali toa jasho kwenye uso wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le tremblement de terre provoqua un grand désastre comme le pays n'en avait jusque-là pas connu.
target_text: Mtetemeko wa ardhi uli sababisha uharibifu kama vile inchi aija wai ona.
target_text_raw: Mtetemeko wa ardhi uli sababisha uharibifu kama vile inchi aija wai ona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que dit-il ?
target_text: Ana sema nini?
target_text_raw: Ana sema nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le changement est possible.
target_text: Mabadiliko ina wezekana.
target_text_raw: Mabadiliko ina wezekana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le président actuel a beaucoup d'ennemis.
target_text: Raisi wa sasa ana maadui wengi.
target_text_raw: Raisi wa sasa ana maadui wengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui demandais de faire du thé.
target_text: Nili mwomba kupika chai.
target_text_raw: Nili mwomba kupika chai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai assez.
target_text: Niko na nyingi.
target_text_raw: Niko na nyingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle nous dit de ne pas faire un bruit.
target_text: Ali tu-ambia tusi fanya fujo.
target_text_raw: Ali tu-ambia tusi fanya fujo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut que je te dise au revoir.
target_text: Inabidi ni ku-ambie kwaheri.
target_text_raw: Inabidi ni ku-ambie kwaheri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'est pas sûr que ce soit un bon plan.
target_text: Tom hana uhakika kama ni mpango mzuri.
target_text_raw: Tom hana uhakika kama ni mpango mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que tu étais déjà mort.
target_text: Nili fikiria ulisha fariki.
target_text_raw: Nili fikiria ulisha fariki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne voit presque rien.
target_text: Tom haoni chochote.
target_text_raw: Tom haoni chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ours avance vers nous.
target_text: Dubu inakuja upande wetu.
target_text_raw: Dubu inakuja upande wetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom avait l'air malade.
target_text: Toma alikuwa na sura ya ugonjwa.
target_text_raw: Toma alikuwa na sura ya ugonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu t'en remettras.
target_text: Uta ji rudishia.
target_text_raw: Uta ji rudishia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Français sont nos voisins de l'autre côté de la Manche.
target_text: Wafaransa ni majirani zetu kwa upande mwengine.
target_text_raw: Wafaransa ni majirani zetu kwa upande mwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois rencontrer Thomas au supermarché.
target_text: Nastahili ku mkuta Thomas kwenye Duka.
target_text_raw: Nastahili ku mkuta Thomas kwenye Duka.

source_text: Tu dois regarder le contrat avant de le signer.

target_text_raw: Una paswa ku hangalia mkataa kabla ya ku weka saini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma maison est près de l'école.
target_text: Nyumba yangu iko karibu na shule.
target_text_raw: Nyumba yangu iko karibu na shule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne peut pas avoir lu ce livre.

target_text_raw: Hawezi weza kusoma hiki kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Alitoka bila kusema kwaheri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu’est ce qu’une femme pourrait désirer de plus ?

target_text_raw: Mwana mke anaweza tamani nini haswa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Inakaa vizuri.
target_text_raw: Inakaa vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a-t-il mangé quelque chose ?

target_text_raw: Tom alikula chochote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que Thomas mangeait ?

target_text_raw: Thomas alikua anakula nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a seulement un enfant et en voudrait bien un deuxième.

target_text_raw: Marie ana mtoto mmoja tu na angetaka wa pili.

source_text: Apparemment, il n'y personne à la maison.

target_text_raw: Hakuna mtu kwa nyumba, kama ivyo onekana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si seulement la pluie pouvait s'arrêter !

target_text_raw: Kama mvua inge wacha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un dénommé Henri veut vous voir.

target_text_raw: Mtu anaye itwa Henri anataka kupona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jim a levé la main.
target_text: Jim ali inua mkono.
target_text_raw: Jim ali inua mkono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta conduite est trop extravagante.
target_text: Tabia yako ni yaku shangaza.
target_text_raw: Tabia yako ni yaku shangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu veux vivre, tu veux aussi mourir; ou bien tu ne conçois pas ce qu'est la vie.
target_text: Kama unataka kuishi, unataka pika kufa, ama huelewi maisha ni nini.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka kuishi, unataka pika kufa, ama huelewi maisha ni nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a l'air jeune.
target_text: Ana sura ya kijana.
target_text_raw: Ana sura ya kijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom t'attend.
target_text: Tom ana kungojea.
target_text_raw: Tom ana kungojea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est aussi grand que moi.
target_text: Ni mkubwa kama mimi.
target_text_raw: Ni mkubwa kama mimi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne veux pas gagner ?
target_text: Hutaki ku shinda?
target_text_raw: Hutaki ku shinda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est fils unique.
target_text: Tom ni mtoto pekee.
target_text_raw: Tom ni mtoto pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un homme est apparu derrière la porte.
target_text: Mtu alitoka nyuma ya mlango.
target_text_raw: Mtu alitoka nyuma ya mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'éducation représente plus que d'aller à l'école.
target_text: Masomo ni zaidi ya kwenda shuleni.
target_text_raw: Masomo ni zaidi ya kwenda shuleni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis inquiété pour toi.
target_text: Nili shangaa na wewe.
target_text_raw: Nili shangaa na wewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne sait pas ce que c'est.
target_text: Tom hajui nini.
target_text_raw: Tom hajui nini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: M'as-tu vraiment aimé ?
target_text: Uli ni penda?
target_text_raw: Uli ni penda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai d'affreuses douleurs.
target_text: Nina maumivu yaku tisha.
target_text_raw: Nina maumivu yaku tisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais bien.
target_text: Niko salama.
target_text_raw: Niko salama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous donna non seulement des habits, mais aussi un peu d'argent.
target_text: hawaku tu-patia tu mavazi, lakini na pesa pia.
target_text_raw: hawaku tu-patia tu mavazi, lakini na pesa pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parle français et anglais.
target_text: Naongea Kifaransa na Kingereza.
target_text_raw: Naongea Kifaransa na Kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je traverse la voie ferrée chaque matin.
target_text: Na vuka njia ya reli kila asubui.
target_text_raw: Na vuka njia ya reli kila asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il garde ce pistolet chargé.
target_text: Ali chunga bunduki ikiwa na risasi.
target_text_raw: Ali chunga bunduki ikiwa na risasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons beaucoup accompli.
target_text: Tume timiza mengi.
target_text_raw: Tume timiza mengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pouvais pas expliquer à Tom ce qui se passait.
target_text: Siwezi ku tafsiria Tom yanayo pita.
target_text_raw: Siwezi ku tafsiria Tom yanayo pita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Non, je n'irai pas à l'école aujourd'hui.
target_text: La, sita henda shuleni leo.
target_text_raw: La, sita henda shuleni leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'eus l'impression que c'était nécessaire alors je le fis.
target_text: Niko na hisia kwamba ilikuwa muimu lakini nime maliza.
target_text_raw: Niko na hisia kwamba ilikuwa muimu lakini nime maliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle versa des larmes amères.

target_text_raw: Ali toa machozi ya uchungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a dit qu'il était malchanceux.

target_text_raw: Tom ali sema kwamba ako na bahati mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère est à l'hôpital, en ce moment.
target_text: Mama yangu yuko hospitalini, kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu yuko hospitalini, kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux qu'on me laisse seule.
target_text: Napenda wani aache peke yangu.
target_text_raw: Napenda wani aache peke yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça sent comme si quelqu'un avait fumé ici.
target_text: Naisi kama kuna mtu amevuta sigara.
target_text_raw: Naisi kama kuna mtu amevuta sigara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle restitua le livre à la bibliothèque.
target_text: Ali rudisha kitabu kwenye maktaba.
target_text_raw: Ali rudisha kitabu kwenye maktaba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les films d'horreur font peur aux enfants.
target_text: Filamu ya kuogofya ina ogopesha watoto.
target_text_raw: Filamu ya kuogofya ina ogopesha watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dormait profondément.
target_text: Ali lala usingizi mnono.
target_text_raw: Ali lala usingizi mnono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a dit que la réunion s'était bien passée.
target_text: Tom alisema mkutano uli pita vyema.
target_text_raw: Tom alisema mkutano uli pita vyema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre budget est très limité.
target_text: Bajeti yetu haitoshi.
target_text_raw: Bajeti yetu haitoshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chez nous, il neige en janvier.
target_text: Kunakuwa barafu kwetu, mwezi wa januari.
target_text_raw: Kunakuwa barafu kwetu, mwezi wa januari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être que les gens comme nous ne devraient pas avoir d'enfants.
target_text: Labda watu kama sisi hawa staili kuwa na watoto.
target_text_raw: Labda watu kama sisi hawa staili kuwa na watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son fils a huit ans.
target_text: Mtoto wake ana miaka nane.
target_text_raw: Mtoto wake ana miaka nane.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne me souviens pas quand je l'ai rencontré pour la première fois.
target_text: Si kumbuki kama ni-lisha mu-ona safari ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Si kumbuki kama ni-lisha mu-ona safari ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai écouté aucune de ses chansons.
target_text: Sija wai sikia hata wimbo wake mmoja.
target_text_raw: Sija wai sikia hata wimbo wake mmoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a encore de la lumière, dehors.
target_text: Bado kuna mwangaza inje.
target_text_raw: Bado kuna mwangaza inje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas vient de partir.
target_text: Thoma ana ondoka.
target_text_raw: Thoma ana ondoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne songe même pas à manger mon chocolat !
target_text: Usi fikirie kula chokoleti yangu!
target_text_raw: Usi fikirie kula chokoleti yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne la paie pas au mois, mais chaque jour.
target_text: Halipwi kwa mwezi, bali kwa siku.
target_text_raw: Halipwi kwa mwezi, bali kwa siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peu importe qui je rencontre.
target_text: Sijali yule nataka ku-mpata.
target_text_raw: Sijali yule nataka ku-mpata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a un chat dans la cuisine.
target_text: Ndani ya mafiga mko paka.
target_text_raw: Ndani ya mafiga mko paka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son petit frère est un joueur de football célèbre.
target_text: Mdogo wake ni mchezaji wa kabumbu.
target_text_raw: Mdogo wake ni mchezaji wa kabumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle pensait qu'elle pouvait faire en sorte qu'il l'apprécie.

target_text_raw: Ali fikiria angeweza kufanya vile anapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Paul est une personne tellement plaisante que tout le monde l'aime de suite.
target_text: Paul ni mchangamfu sana hadi kila mtu ana mpenda.
target_text_raw: Paul ni mchangamfu sana hadi kila mtu ana mpenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne l'ai jamais fait.
target_text: Siku wai ifanya.
target_text_raw: Siku wai ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est tout ce que tu peux faire pour l'instant.
target_text: Ni hiyo tu unaweza fanya kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Ni hiyo tu unaweza fanya kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’avais honte de mon frère.

target_text_raw: Nina aibu na kaka yangu.

source_text: Je gagnerai.
target_text: Nita shinda.
target_text_raw: Nita shinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle s'est habillée comme un garçon.

target_text_raw: Alivaa kama mvulana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas jeune.
target_text: yeye si kijana.
target_text_raw: yeye si kijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Uli kuweko?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est de loin le meilleur garçon de la classe.

target_text_raw: Yeye ndio mvulana mwema wa darasa lao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta question n'a pas de rapport avec le sujet.

target_text_raw: swali lako hali ambatani na mjadala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce château est beau.

target_text_raw: Jumba hili ni bora.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A vrai dire, je n'aime pas ce que tu portes.
target_text: Kusema ukweli, sipendi vile ume vaa.
target_text_raw: Kusema ukweli, sipendi vile ume vaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a donné trois cents dollars.

target_text_raw: Tom ali nipatia dola mia tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aime courir.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux compter sur Tom.

source_text: Il raffole de toi.

target_text_raw: ana wazimu na wewe.

source_text: Tout le monde chanta.

target_text_raw: Wote wali imba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela vous arrivera à vous aussi.
target_text: Hilo lita kufikia na wewe pia.
target_text_raw: Hilo lita kufikia na wewe pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes restés debout toute la nuit.
target_text: Tuli simama usiku mzima.
target_text_raw: Tuli simama usiku mzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a beaucoup de gens dans la rue.
target_text: Kuna watu wengi barabarani.
target_text_raw: Kuna watu wengi barabarani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allé me promener avec mon fils.
target_text: Nilienda kutembea na mvulana wangu.
target_text_raw: Nilienda kutembea na mvulana wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et Marie sont en colère contre Jean.
target_text: Tom na Marie wana kasirikia Jean.
target_text_raw: Tom na Marie wana kasirikia Jean.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces fleurs sont belles, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Mauwa haya ni mazuri, au sivyo?
target_text_raw: Mauwa haya ni mazuri, au sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De quelle couleur est ta robe ?
target_text: Kanzu yako ni ya rangi gani?
target_text_raw: Kanzu yako ni ya rangi gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis venu jusqu'ici pour passer un peu de temps avec toi.
target_text: Nilikuja hadi hapa ili kupitisha mda na wewe.
target_text_raw: Nilikuja hadi hapa ili kupitisha mda na wewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il promit de fournir des informations.

target_text_raw: Ali ahidi kutoa habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom porte un manteau trop grand pour lui.
target_text: Tom ana vaa koti kubwa kuliko yeye.
target_text_raw: Tom ana vaa koti kubwa kuliko yeye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu faire ça pour moi ?
target_text: Una weza ni-fanyia hiyo?
target_text_raw: Una weza ni-fanyia hiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voudrais pas que quiconque nous voie.
target_text: Sipendi mtu yeyote atuone.
target_text_raw: Sipendi mtu yeyote atuone.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mien n'est pas aussi bien que le tien.
target_text: Yangu si njema kama yako.
target_text_raw: Yangu si njema kama yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais épargner plus d'argent.
target_text: Nataka ku weka akiba ya pesa nyingi.
target_text_raw: Nataka ku weka akiba ya pesa nyingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel beau vélo !
target_text: Baiskeli nzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Baiskeli nzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où se trouve la bibliothèque ?
target_text: Maktaba yako wapi?
target_text_raw: Maktaba yako wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela semble trop simple à croire.
target_text: Inaonekana raisi kuamini.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana raisi kuamini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a posé les mêmes questions que beaucoup d'autres gens.
target_text: Ali ni uliza maswali kama hayo kama watu wengine.
target_text_raw: Ali ni uliza maswali kama hayo kama watu wengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne restez-vous pas là ?

target_text_raw: kwanini hau kai hapo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une tasse de café coûtait deux cents yens à cette époque.
target_text: Kikombe ya kahawa ili uzwa yeni mia mbili wakati kama huu.
target_text_raw: Kikombe ya kahawa ili uzwa yeni mia mbili wakati kama huu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'écrirai ou t'appellerai la semaine prochaine.
target_text: Nita kuandikia au kuita juma ijayo.
target_text_raw: Nita kuandikia au kuita juma ijayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si c'est marrant, je resterai.
target_text: Kama ni yaku chekesha, nita baki.
target_text_raw: Kama ni yaku chekesha, nita baki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment est le temps aujourd'hui ?

target_text_raw: Mda uko aje leo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Apportez un stylo à votre examen, s'il vous plaît.

target_text_raw: Beba kalamu kwenye mtiani wako, tafadhali.

source_text: De quelle couleur est cette fleur ?

target_text_raw: haya mauwa ni ya rangi gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est heureux.
target_text: Yuko na furaha.
target_text_raw: Yuko na furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai toujours été fier de vous.
target_text: nina ku furahia kila wakati.
target_text_raw: nina ku furahia kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aime pas la pluie.
target_text: Sipendi mvua.
target_text_raw: Sipendi mvua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle raconta l'histoire avec des larmes dans les yeux.

target_text_raw: Alitoa habari na machozi machoni.

source_text: Les tickets de concert sont en vente à cet endroit.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces maisons étaient sombres et sales.

target_text_raw: Nyumba hizi zilikuwa chafu na giza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est à l'article de la mort.
target_text: Yuko kwenye kipengele cha mauti.
target_text_raw: Yuko kwenye kipengele cha mauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah, je suis déjà venu ici !
