target_text_raw: Ah, nisha wai fika hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut lui parler.
target_text: Inna ni bidi kumwambia.
target_text_raw: Inna ni bidi kumwambia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a un chat noir.
target_text: Tom ana paka mweusi.
target_text_raw: Tom ana paka mweusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On est sorti manger une pizza hier soir.
target_text: Tulitoka kula piza jana jioni.
target_text_raw: Tulitoka kula piza jana jioni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le train avait 10 minutes de retard à cause d'une grosse chute de neige.
target_text: Gari ya moshi ili chelewa dakika 10 sababu ya ukubwa wa barafu.
target_text_raw: Gari ya moshi ili chelewa dakika 10 sababu ya ukubwa wa barafu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me mis à avoir très sommeil.
target_text: Nasikia usingizi sana.
target_text_raw: Nasikia usingizi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le nouveau plan ne plaisait pas aux Étasuniens.
target_text: Mpango mpya hauku furahisha wa marekani.
target_text_raw: Mpango mpya hauku furahisha wa marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a dit que Mary jouait bien du piano, mais je ne l'ai pas vraiment cru jusqu'à ce que je l'entende jouer.
target_text: Tom ali ni ambia kuwa Mary alikuwa na cheza kinanda vizuri, lakini siku mwamini hadi nilipo sikia mwenyewe aki cheza.
target_text_raw: Tom ali ni ambia kuwa Mary alikuwa na cheza kinanda vizuri, lakini siku mwamini hadi nilipo sikia mwenyewe aki cheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que j'ai bien compris tes mots.
target_text: Nafikiri nime elewa maneno vyema.
target_text_raw: Nafikiri nime elewa maneno vyema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour nous, c'est pas facile de décider lequel acheter.
target_text: Upande wetu si raisi kuamua ipi yaku nunua.
target_text_raw: Upande wetu si raisi kuamua ipi yaku nunua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pris conscience que je n'étais pas prêt.
target_text: Niliona sikuwa tayari.
target_text_raw: Niliona sikuwa tayari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le poulet rôti est un de mes plats favoris.
target_text: Kuku yaku choma ndio chakula ninacho ki penda.
target_text_raw: Kuku yaku choma ndio chakula ninacho ki penda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas accepter ton cadeau.
target_text: Siwezi kubali zawadi yako.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kubali zawadi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'abusez pas de moi, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Tafadhali, usi ni sahau.
target_text_raw: Tafadhali, usi ni sahau.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu attendre une minute ?
target_text: Unaweza ngojea dakika moja?
target_text_raw: Unaweza ngojea dakika moja?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom peut chanter.
target_text: Tom anaweza kuimba.
target_text_raw: Tom anaweza kuimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi vendez-vous ce meuble ?
target_text: Kwanini una huzisha hii kabati?
target_text_raw: Kwanini una huzisha hii kabati?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi Tom s'est-il suicidé ?
target_text: Kwanini Tom ali ji uwa ?
target_text_raw: Kwanini Tom ali ji uwa ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le ciel s'éclaircira bientôt.
target_text: Anga lita kuwa na mwangaza hivi karibuni.
target_text_raw: Anga lita kuwa na mwangaza hivi karibuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le gros orteil de mon pied droit me fait mal.
target_text: Kidole kikubwa cha mguu wangu kina ni huma.
target_text_raw: Kidole kikubwa cha mguu wangu kina ni huma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie avait les nerfs à fleur de peau.
target_text: Marie alikuwa na neva ya ngozi ya mauwa.
target_text_raw: Marie alikuwa na neva ya ngozi ya mauwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle voulait qu'il reste plus longtemps.
target_text: Alitaka abaki mda mrefu.
target_text_raw: Alitaka abaki mda mrefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tes revenus sont le triple des miens.
target_text: Faida yako ni mara tatu kuliko yangu.
target_text_raw: Faida yako ni mara tatu kuliko yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais quoi attendre.
target_text: Najua nini yaku ngojea.
target_text_raw: Najua nini yaku ngojea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est extrêmement séduisante.
target_text: yaya ni mdanganyifu kabisa.
target_text_raw: yaya ni mdanganyifu kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vérité est rarement pure, et jamais simple.
target_text: Ukweli sio msafi kila mara, na sio raisi.
target_text_raw: Ukweli sio msafi kila mara, na sio raisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un des garçons s'est soudainement enfui.
target_text: Mvulana mmoja ali kimbia ghafla.
target_text_raw: Mvulana mmoja ali kimbia ghafla.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle relation y a-t-il entre la politique et la guerre ?
target_text: Kuna uhusiano gani kati ya siasa na vita?
target_text_raw: Kuna uhusiano gani kati ya siasa na vita?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes allés au parc pour prendre des photos.
target_text: Tuli henda kwenye mbuga ya wanyama ili kuchukuwa picha.
target_text_raw: Tuli henda kwenye mbuga ya wanyama ili kuchukuwa picha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On n'y peut rien.
target_text: Hatuwezi hata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Hatuwezi hata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il retourna aux États-Unis.
target_text: Alirudi Marekani.
target_text_raw: Alirudi Marekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devez faire ce travail, même si ça ne vous plaît pas.
target_text: Una stahili kufanya hii kazi, hata kama hai ku furaishi.
target_text_raw: Una stahili kufanya hii kazi, hata kama hai ku furaishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mary est belle, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Mary ni mrembo, au sivyo?
target_text_raw: Mary ni mrembo, au sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est déçu.
target_text: Tom ana fedheheka.
target_text_raw: Tom ana fedheheka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous savions qu'aujourd'hui est son anniversaire.
target_text: Tulijua kama leo ndio tarehe yake yaku zaliwa.
target_text_raw: Tulijua kama leo ndio tarehe yake yaku zaliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que tu as assez de jugeotte pour voir la différence.
target_text: Natumai una mimba kadhaa ili ujue utofauti.
target_text_raw: Natumai una mimba kadhaa ili ujue utofauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas encore vu Mary.
target_text: Toma haja ona Mary.
target_text_raw: Toma haja ona Mary.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui je n'ai pas d'argent.
target_text: Leo sina pesa.
target_text_raw: Leo sina pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chat a appuyé son nez contre la fenêtre.
target_text: Paka ili bonyeza pua yake kwenye dirisha.
target_text_raw: Paka ili bonyeza pua yake kwenye dirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu une grande famille?
target_text: Una familia kubwa?
target_text_raw: Una familia kubwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa voix tremblait de colère.
target_text: Sauti yake ili tetemeka kwa ajili ya asira.
target_text_raw: Sauti yake ili tetemeka kwa ajili ya asira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne savais pas où aller.
target_text: Sikujua wapi pa kwenda.
target_text_raw: Sikujua wapi pa kwenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre bus arrive en retard surtout quand nous sommes pressés.
target_text: Gari yetu ilifika kuchelewa tukiwa tume choka.
target_text_raw: Gari yetu ilifika kuchelewa tukiwa tume choka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allume la lumière. Je n'y vois rien.
target_text: washa mwangaza. Sioni chochote.
target_text_raw: washa mwangaza. Sioni chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai rien à voir avec ça.
target_text: Sina lolote yaku fanya na hilo.
target_text_raw: Sina lolote yaku fanya na hilo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'avais davantage déjeuné, je n'aurais pas faim maintenant.
target_text: Kama ningekuwa nimekula chakula cha asubui, singekuwa na njaa kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Kama ningekuwa nimekula chakula cha asubui, singekuwa na njaa kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai encore perdu ton briquet.
target_text: Nili poteza kiberiti chako.
target_text_raw: Nili poteza kiberiti chako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle faillit être renversée par une voiture.
target_text: Ili hitajika ku wekwa na gari.
target_text_raw: Ili hitajika ku wekwa na gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela ne sert à rien de faire cela.
target_text: Haina maana kufanya vile.
target_text_raw: Haina maana kufanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez, dis-moi !
target_text: Wende, niambie!
target_text_raw: Wende, niambie!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai plus besoin de toi.
target_text: Siku itaji.
target_text_raw: Siku itaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est ruiné.
target_text: ana haribika.
target_text_raw: ana haribika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle priait.
target_text: Alikuwa aki omba.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa aki omba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez mettre vos chaussures.
target_text: Wekeni viatu vyenu.
target_text_raw: Wekeni viatu vyenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À l'avenir, sois plus prudent avec ton argent.
target_text: Siku zi jazo, kuwa makini na pesa zako.
target_text_raw: Siku zi jazo, kuwa makini na pesa zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est parti.
target_text: Tom ali ondoka.
target_text_raw: Tom ali ondoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allo. Pourrais-je parler à Mr Jackson ?
target_text: Allo. Naweza ongea na Bwana Jackson?
target_text_raw: Allo. Naweza ongea na Bwana Jackson?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai rencontré en janvier.
target_text: Nili mpata januari.
target_text_raw: Nili mpata januari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il pensait que j'étais très fatigué.
target_text: Ali fikiria nime choka sana.
target_text_raw: Ali fikiria nime choka sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom, que fais-tu ici ?
target_text: Unafanya nini hapa, Tom?
target_text_raw: Unafanya nini hapa, Tom?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me caches quelque chose, toi.
target_text: Kuna jambo una ni ficha, weye.
target_text_raw: Kuna jambo una ni ficha, weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En Russie, tu ne t'en tirerais pas comme ça.
target_text: Huwezi kuvuta hivi, huko Rusia.
target_text_raw: Huwezi kuvuta hivi, huko Rusia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais où c'est.
target_text: Najua ni wapi.
target_text_raw: Najua ni wapi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une malédiction.
target_text: Ni laana.
target_text_raw: Ni laana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment Tom prévoit-il d'aider ?
target_text: Tom anaweza kukusaidia vipi?
target_text_raw: Tom anaweza kukusaidia vipi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne dites jamais de mensonges.
target_text: Usi danganye.
target_text_raw: Usi danganye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas fermé la porte.
target_text: Siku funga mlango.
target_text_raw: Siku funga mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dort le jour et travaille la nuit.
target_text: Ana lala mchana na kufanya kazi usiku.
target_text_raw: Ana lala mchana na kufanya kazi usiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il cueillit des fleurs pour elle.
target_text: Ali mpatia mauwa.
target_text_raw: Ali mpatia mauwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle est ton opinion ?
target_text: Mawazo yako ni gani?
target_text_raw: Mawazo yako ni gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas ce qui lui prend.
target_text: Sijui nini ali chukulia.
target_text_raw: Sijui nini ali chukulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me savais observé.
target_text: Nili ji chunga na kuji angalia.
target_text_raw: Nili ji chunga na kuji angalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Moi, je ne dirais jamais un truc comme ça.
target_text: Mimi, Siwezi sema jambo kama hilo.
target_text_raw: Mimi, Siwezi sema jambo kama hilo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La politique est une bataille d'idées.
target_text: Siasa ni vita vya sera.
target_text_raw: Siasa ni vita vya sera.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a apporté une couverture.
target_text: Tom ali beba Kifuniko.
target_text_raw: Tom ali beba Kifuniko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes parents étaient furieux.
target_text: Wazazi wangu wali kasirika.
target_text_raw: Wazazi wangu wali kasirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: M'espionniez-vous ?
target_text: Una ni chunguza ?
target_text_raw: Una ni chunguza ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci à tous d'être venus ! On se revoit au prochain cours !
target_text: Asante kwa ujio wenu! Tuta onana wakati ujao!
target_text_raw: Asante kwa ujio wenu! Tuta onana wakati ujao!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son mari vit maintenant à Tokyo.
target_text: Bwana yake anaishi Tokyo.
target_text_raw: Bwana yake anaishi Tokyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'instituteur est sévère avec ses élèves.
target_text: Mwalimu ako makini na wanafunzi wake.
target_text_raw: Mwalimu ako makini na wanafunzi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voulais des chaussures rouges.
target_text: Nilitaka viatu ya mwekundu.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka viatu ya mwekundu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est de mauvaise humeur.
target_text: Ako na hali mbaya.
target_text_raw: Ako na hali mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais été aussi gêné de toute ma vie.
target_text: Sija wai funga kula katika maisha yangu.
target_text_raw: Sija wai funga kula katika maisha yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Essaie d'apprendre un peu d'anglais.
target_text: Jaribu kujifunza Kingereza.
target_text_raw: Jaribu kujifunza Kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il fait beau demain, nous irons pique-niquer.
target_text: Kesho kukiwa vyema, tuta henda matembezi.
target_text_raw: Kesho kukiwa vyema, tuta henda matembezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu es très en colère.
target_text: Najua ume kasirika sana.
target_text_raw: Najua ume kasirika sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fata a sarit in sus şansa şansa plecării New York.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom réussit à s'enfuir par une fenêtre.
target_text: Tom aliweza kukimbia kupitia dirisha.
target_text_raw: Tom aliweza kukimbia kupitia dirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne sera pas à l'heure pour la réunion.
target_text: Tom hatakuwa tayari kwa mkutano.
target_text_raw: Tom hatakuwa tayari kwa mkutano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me donna tous les détails.
target_text: Ali ni patia maelezo yote.
target_text_raw: Ali ni patia maelezo yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vérifié.
target_text: Nili chunguza.
target_text_raw: Nili chunguza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La conduite inconsidérée provoquera un accident.
target_text: Tabia isiyo julikana inaweza sababisha ajali.
target_text_raw: Tabia isiyo julikana inaweza sababisha ajali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est allé à Paris, qui est la capitale de la France.
target_text: Ali enda Paris, ambayo ni mji mkuu wa Ufaransa.
target_text_raw: Ali enda Paris, ambayo ni mji mkuu wa Ufaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Divise ça par deux !
target_text: Gawanya sehemu mbili!
target_text_raw: Gawanya sehemu mbili!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une solution.
target_text: Niko na jawabu.
target_text_raw: Niko na jawabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom aime aller à la plage.
target_text: Toma anapenda kwenda kwenye ufuko wa bahari.
target_text_raw: Toma anapenda kwenda kwenye ufuko wa bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas envie de te voir aujourd'hui.
target_text: Sina nia yaku kuona leo.
target_text_raw: Sina nia yaku kuona leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où se situe la source de ce fleuve ?
target_text: Chanzo cha huu mto kiko wapi?
target_text_raw: Chanzo cha huu mto kiko wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De quoi allons-nous parler ?
target_text: Tuta ongea kuhusu nini?
target_text_raw: Tuta ongea kuhusu nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que Tom est au lit.
target_text: Najua Tom iko kitandani.
target_text_raw: Najua Tom iko kitandani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils pourraient être toujours ici.
target_text: Alikuwa hapa kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa hapa kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dois-je aller te chercher ?
target_text: Niende kuku tafuta?
target_text_raw: Niende kuku tafuta?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père est très gentil.
target_text: Baba yangu ni mpole sana.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu ni mpole sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta mère a dû être belle lorsqu'elle était jeune.
target_text: Mama yako alikuwa mrembo sana aliko kuwa kijana.
target_text_raw: Mama yako alikuwa mrembo sana aliko kuwa kijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne sais-tu pas qui je suis ?
target_text: Hujui mimi ni nani?
target_text_raw: Hujui mimi ni nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enfin, j'ai trouvé la réponse à la question.
target_text: Hatimaye, Nilipata jibu la swali yako.
target_text_raw: Hatimaye, Nilipata jibu la swali yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai entendu que tu avais fait une grosse erreur aujourd'hui.
target_text: Nili siki kuwa ulifanya kosa kubwa leo.
target_text_raw: Nili siki kuwa ulifanya kosa kubwa leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les cheveux de ce garçon sont noirs.
target_text: Nywele za mvulana huyu ni nyeusi.
target_text_raw: Nywele za mvulana huyu ni nyeusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Savez-vous où cette caméra a été fabriquée ? » « Je pense qu'elle a été fabriquée en Chine, mais je n'en suis pas sûr. »
target_text: «Unajua ni wapi kamera hiyo ili tengenezwa?» «nafikiria ili tengenezwa Uchina lakini sina uhakika.»
target_text_raw: «Unajua ni wapi kamera hiyo ili tengenezwa?» «nafikiria ili tengenezwa Uchina lakini sina uhakika.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cerf a été attrapé par un lion.
target_text: Pongo ili kamatwa na simba.
target_text_raw: Pongo ili kamatwa na simba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me souviens à peine de quoi que ce soit.
target_text: Nakumbuka kwa njia zote zile.
target_text_raw: Nakumbuka kwa njia zote zile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas gobé cette histoire, quand même?
target_text: Ulishindwa kuelewa historia hiyo?
target_text_raw: Ulishindwa kuelewa historia hiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été ému par ses larmes.
target_text: Nili guswa na machozi yake.
target_text_raw: Nili guswa na machozi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils n'aiment pas le chien de Tom.
target_text: Hapendi imbwa ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Hapendi imbwa ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle distance environ ?
target_text: Umbali wa kiasi gani?
target_text_raw: Umbali wa kiasi gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pouvez-vous me l'indiquer sur la carte?
target_text: Unaweza ni onyesha kwenye ramani hii?
target_text_raw: Unaweza ni onyesha kwenye ramani hii?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne chante pas très bien.
target_text: Si imbake vizuri.
target_text_raw: Si imbake vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme moi, il n'est pas grand non plus.
target_text: Si mkubwa kama mimi.
target_text_raw: Si mkubwa kama mimi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il semble que tout le monde soit américain.
target_text: Ina onekana kama wote ni wamarekani.
target_text_raw: Ina onekana kama wote ni wamarekani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout s'est passé là.
target_text: Yote ina wezekana pale.
target_text_raw: Yote ina wezekana pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais voir Mary cet après-midi.
target_text: Nataka kuona Mary leo mchana.
target_text_raw: Nataka kuona Mary leo mchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais faire quelque chose par moi-même, pendant un moment.
target_text: nata kufanya jambo moja kwa manufaa yangu, kwa mda fulani.
target_text_raw: nata kufanya jambo moja kwa manufaa yangu, kwa mda fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela pourrait être une bonne idée.
target_text: Hiyo inaweza kuwa mawazo mazuri.
target_text_raw: Hiyo inaweza kuwa mawazo mazuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut prendre ma journée de lundi.
target_text: Inabidi kujua siku yangu ku hanza juma tatu.
target_text_raw: Inabidi kujua siku yangu ku hanza juma tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'écrit de moins en moins souvent ces jours-ci.
target_text: Siku hizi ana ni andikia kila mara.
target_text_raw: Siku hizi ana ni andikia kila mara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons davantage de dettes sur notre maison qu'elle n'en vaut.
target_text: Tuna madeni mengi nyumbani kwetu ambazo hataki.
target_text_raw: Tuna madeni mengi nyumbani kwetu ambazo hataki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas de frères ou de sœurs.
target_text: Sina ndugu au dada.
target_text_raw: Sina ndugu au dada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Actuellement le pouvoir d'achat de dix dollars est inférieur à celui de cinq dollars il y a trois ans.
target_text: Kwa sasa kiwango cha mauzo cha dola 10 ni kidogo kuliko kile cha dola 5 ilivyo kuwa miaka tatu iliyo pita.
target_text_raw: Kwa sasa kiwango cha mauzo cha dola 10 ni kidogo kuliko kile cha dola 5 ilivyo kuwa miaka tatu iliyo pita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Y avais-tu pensé ?
target_text: Uli fikiria ?
target_text_raw: Uli fikiria ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que nous allons nous en sortir.
target_text: Nafikiria tuta weza.
target_text_raw: Nafikiria tuta weza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment est-ce arrivé ?
target_text: Ili fikia ki vipi?
target_text_raw: Ili fikia ki vipi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Alors que j'avais fait tout ce chemin sous la pluie pour la voir, elle n'était pas chez elle.
target_text: Wakati nime tembea kwenye mvua ili nipata kumuona, hakuwa kwake.
target_text_raw: Wakati nime tembea kwenye mvua ili nipata kumuona, hakuwa kwake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'ai dit la vérité quand je t'ai dit que je t'aimais.
target_text: Nili kuambia ukweli nilipo sema nakupenda.
target_text_raw: Nili kuambia ukweli nilipo sema nakupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est très populaire.
target_text: Tom ana julikana sana.
target_text_raw: Tom ana julikana sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui. Il est temps de rentrer.
target_text: Ndio. Ni wakati wa kurudi.
target_text_raw: Ndio. Ni wakati wa kurudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je déteste les femmes qui disent que tous les hommes sont les mêmes.
target_text: Nachukia wanawake wanao sema kuwa wanaume wote wako sawa.
target_text_raw: Nachukia wanawake wanao sema kuwa wanaume wote wako sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai des informations.
target_text: Niko na habari.
target_text_raw: Niko na habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom va répondre à vos questions.
target_text: Tom atajibu maswali yako.
target_text_raw: Tom atajibu maswali yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que vous vous y mettiez immédiatement.
target_text: Napenda mu shugulikie yao haraka.
target_text_raw: Napenda mu shugulikie yao haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom baisse le son de la radio.
target_text: Tom punguza sauti ta radio.
target_text_raw: Tom punguza sauti ta radio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu ne viens pas à ma fête mais j'aimerais que tu y viennes.
target_text: Najua hauwezi kuja kwenye sherehe yangu, lakini ninge penda uje.
target_text_raw: Najua hauwezi kuja kwenye sherehe yangu, lakini ninge penda uje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils manquent de fonds.
target_text: Alikosa uwezo wa pesa.
target_text_raw: Alikosa uwezo wa pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais te chercher une serviette de toilette.
target_text: Nita kutafutia karatasi za chooni.
target_text_raw: Nita kutafutia karatasi za chooni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il avait une grosse fièvre.
target_text: Alikuwa na homa kubwa.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa na homa kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Appelle un médecin !
target_text: ita mganga!
target_text_raw: ita mganga!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qui me préoccupe, c'est son attitude.
target_text: Inayo ni shangaza, ni tabia yake.
target_text_raw: Inayo ni shangaza, ni tabia yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dès qu'il s'est arrêté de pleuvoir, un bel arc-en-ciel est apparu.
target_text: Ilipo acha kunyesha , mara moja upinde wa mvua uli tokea.
target_text_raw: Ilipo acha kunyesha , mara moja upinde wa mvua uli tokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a l'air très heureux.
target_text: Toma ako mwenye furaha.
target_text_raw: Toma ako mwenye furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne m’appelez pas ainsi, dit-elle doucement.
target_text: Alisema polepole, usi ni ite hivyo.
target_text_raw: Alisema polepole, usi ni ite hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'imagination est plus importante que la connaissance.
target_text: Mafikira ni muimu sana kuliko ujuzi.
target_text_raw: Mafikira ni muimu sana kuliko ujuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est comme ça que cela fonctionne.
target_text: Hiyo inafanya kazi hivyo.
target_text_raw: Hiyo inafanya kazi hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les assiettes sont sales.
target_text: Vyombo ni vichafu.
target_text_raw: Vyombo ni vichafu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais là où on me dit d'aller.
target_text: nime enda pale wame ni kataza kwenda.
target_text_raw: nime enda pale wame ni kataza kwenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a demandé à ma mère.
target_text: Ali huliza mama yangu.
target_text_raw: Ali huliza mama yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand était la dernière fois que je t'ai rendu visite ?
target_text: Wakati wa mwisho kukutembelea ili kuwa lini?
target_text_raw: Wakati wa mwisho kukutembelea ili kuwa lini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne sait rien de cela.
target_text: Tom hajui chochote kuhusu hilo.
target_text_raw: Tom hajui chochote kuhusu hilo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que tu serais plus serviable.
target_text: Nili dhani utakuwa mwenye kusaidia.
target_text_raw: Nili dhani utakuwa mwenye kusaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laisse-moi essayer à nouveau !
target_text: Wacha nijaribu mara ingine!
target_text_raw: Wacha nijaribu mara ingine!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son courage m'a surprise.
target_text: Bidii yake ili ni shangaza.
target_text_raw: Bidii yake ili ni shangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois bientôt me faire couper les cheveux.
target_text: Nita kata nywele hivi karibuni.
target_text_raw: Nita kata nywele hivi karibuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parle plus fort, l'ouïe de ton grand-père n'est pas très bonne.
target_text: Hongea kwa sauti, babu yako hasikii vizuri.
target_text_raw: Hongea kwa sauti, babu yako hasikii vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je préférerais rester à la maison plutôt que de sortir sous la pluie.
target_text: Nita penda kubaki nyumbani kuliko kutembea kwenye mvua.
target_text_raw: Nita penda kubaki nyumbani kuliko kutembea kwenye mvua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il te faut juste t'asseoir là.
target_text: Itabidi kuketi hapo.
target_text_raw: Itabidi kuketi hapo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La mer a commencé à forcir, aussi nous avons dû arrêter de pêcher.
target_text: Bahari ili hanza ku chafuka, kisha tuli simamisha uvuvi.
target_text_raw: Bahari ili hanza ku chafuka, kisha tuli simamisha uvuvi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout est un malentendu.
target_text: Yote ni kuto elewana.
target_text_raw: Yote ni kuto elewana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas si j'ai bien fait d'accepter.
target_text: Sijui kama nili fanya vyema kuku bali.
target_text_raw: Sijui kama nili fanya vyema kuku bali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'es-tu blessé ?
target_text: Uli humia?
target_text_raw: Uli humia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est ton ami ?
target_text: Nani ndio rafiki yako?
target_text_raw: Nani ndio rafiki yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a maudit pour avoir causé l'accident.
target_text: ali mkasirikia kwa kusababisha ajali.
target_text_raw: ali mkasirikia kwa kusababisha ajali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es très intelligent.
target_text: Uko na akili sana.
target_text_raw: Uko na akili sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne m'a rien payé.
target_text: Tom alishindwa ku ni lipa chochote.
target_text_raw: Tom alishindwa ku ni lipa chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce vraiment approprié ?
target_text: Je ina faa?
target_text_raw: Je ina faa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui, je le jure !
target_text: Ndio, nime hapa!
target_text_raw: Ndio, nime hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que pensez-vous de Tom?
target_text: Una fikiria aje kuhusu Tom?
target_text_raw: Una fikiria aje kuhusu Tom?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que veux-tu dire par là ?
target_text: Unataka kusema nini hapo?
target_text_raw: Unataka kusema nini hapo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez écouter votre mère.
target_text: Una staili kusikia mama yako.
target_text_raw: Una staili kusikia mama yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuons le jeu après manger.
target_text: Tuendelee na mchezo baada ya kula.
target_text_raw: Tuendelee na mchezo baada ya kula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me brosse les cheveux tous les jours.
target_text: Na chanua nywele kila siku.
target_text_raw: Na chanua nywele kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette nouvelle la rendit heureuse.
target_text: Habari hiyo ili mfuraisha.
target_text_raw: Habari hiyo ili mfuraisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas loin de l'hôtel.
target_text: Si mbali na hoteli.
target_text_raw: Si mbali na hoteli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai presque fini.
target_text: Nili karibia kumaliza.
target_text_raw: Nili karibia kumaliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela ressemble à une vache.
target_text: Ile ina fanana ngombe.
target_text_raw: Ile ina fanana ngombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chapeau bas pour son effort !
target_text: Tume mtolea kofia kwa bidii yake!
target_text_raw: Tume mtolea kofia kwa bidii yake!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est bien de lire des livres quand on est jeune.
target_text: Ni vizuri kusoma vitabu kama tuko mu mafungo ya roho.
target_text_raw: Ni vizuri kusoma vitabu kama tuko mu mafungo ya roho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est exactement ce que je cherchais.
target_text: Ni ile nilikuwa na tafuta kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ni ile nilikuwa na tafuta kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est- ce que tu veux regarder un film ?
target_text: Je unataka kuona filamu?
target_text_raw: Je unataka kuona filamu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ignorais ce dont il s'agissait, à l'époque.
target_text: Siku-jali ile inafaa kwa wakati ule.
target_text_raw: Siku-jali ile inafaa kwa wakati ule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais confus de l'entendre ainsi parler de mort, alors que, selon toutes les apparences, elle semblait aussi bien portante qu'on ne l'ait jamais vue.
target_text: Nili changanyikiwa kusikia ana hongea kuhusu kifo, ilhali, kulingana na vile inaonekana, alionekana kuwa mwenye ku-wezwa kuliko vile tuli muona.
target_text_raw: Nili changanyikiwa kusikia ana hongea kuhusu kifo, ilhali, kulingana na vile inaonekana, alionekana kuwa mwenye ku-wezwa kuliko vile tuli muona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et Mary se rendirent compte qu'ils en avaient dit beaucoup trop.
target_text: Tom na Mary wali kumbuka kuwa alisema mengi sana.
target_text_raw: Tom na Mary wali kumbuka kuwa alisema mengi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est tout ce que je veux.
target_text: Ni hiyo tu ndio nataka.
target_text_raw: Ni hiyo tu ndio nataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu aurais dû le voir !
target_text: Uta weza kuyasema!
target_text_raw: Uta weza kuyasema!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Non pas «c'est mon fils» mais «je suis son père».
target_text: La «ni mtoto wangu» lakini«mimi ni baba yake».
target_text_raw: La «ni mtoto wangu» lakini«mimi ni baba yake».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le destin ne penche pas en notre faveur.
target_text: Matokeo hai hegamie upande wetu.
target_text_raw: Matokeo hai hegamie upande wetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela fera dix ans que j'habite ici le mois prochain.
target_text: Mwezi ujao nita funga miaka kumi tangu ni hanze kuishi hapa.
target_text_raw: Mwezi ujao nita funga miaka kumi tangu ni hanze kuishi hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a oublié de venir me voir hier.
target_text: Ali sahau kuja kuniona.
target_text_raw: Ali sahau kuja kuniona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas reçu de réponse.
target_text: Tom hakupata majibu.
target_text_raw: Tom hakupata majibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'achète du lait presque tous les jours.
target_text: Na nunua maziwa takriban kila siku.
target_text_raw: Na nunua maziwa takriban kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veux-tu aller faire une promenade, plus tard ?
target_text: Unataka kwenda kuni tembeza, baadaye?
target_text_raw: Unataka kwenda kuni tembeza, baadaye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quoi ! Est-ce vrai ?
target_text: Nini! Je ni kweli?
target_text_raw: Nini! Je ni kweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle seule sait m'aider.
target_text: Yeye mwenyewe anajua kuni saidia.
target_text_raw: Yeye mwenyewe anajua kuni saidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La musique n'a pas d'âge.
target_text: Muziki hauna umri.
target_text_raw: Muziki hauna umri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'aurais pas dû venir si tôt.
target_text: Hauta weza kuja mapema.
target_text_raw: Hauta weza kuja mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où vous êtes-vous rendu ?
target_text: Mulienda wapi?
target_text_raw: Mulienda wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai eu un accident.
target_text: Nilipata ajali.
target_text_raw: Nilipata ajali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'armée avançait lentement, de l'autre côté de la rivière.
target_text: Jeshi lili songa polepole, upande mwengine wa mto.
target_text_raw: Jeshi lili songa polepole, upande mwengine wa mto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants pleurent souvent juste pour attirer l'attention.
target_text: Mara nyingi watoto hulia ili wapate ku bembelezwa.
target_text_raw: Mara nyingi watoto hulia ili wapate ku bembelezwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne fais que mon devoir.
target_text: Si fanyi ma pashwa yangu.
target_text_raw: Si fanyi ma pashwa yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis certain que ça n'arrivera pas aujourd'hui.
target_text: niko na uhakika kwamba a ita tendeka leo.
target_text_raw: niko na uhakika kwamba a ita tendeka leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi en as-tu besoin ?
target_text: Kwanini una i hitaji ?
target_text_raw: Kwanini una i hitaji ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai compté.
target_text: Nili hesabu.
target_text_raw: Nili hesabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu ne veux pas y aller, tu n'y es pas obligé.
target_text: Si lazima , kama hutaki kwenda.
target_text_raw: Si lazima , kama hutaki kwenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel genre de pain est-ce que tu manges en général ?
target_text: Una kula aina gani ya mkate mara mingi?
target_text_raw: Una kula aina gani ya mkate mara mingi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais disposer d'un petit peu plus de temps pour finir ça.
target_text: Nita weka mda kidogo ili nipate kumaliza hili.
target_text_raw: Nita weka mda kidogo ili nipate kumaliza hili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un Moi 2 plus fort que mon Moi 1.
target_text: Niko na mimi 2 kuliko mimi 1.
target_text_raw: Niko na mimi 2 kuliko mimi 1.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'école m'ennuie.
target_text: Shule ina ni kasirisha.
target_text_raw: Shule ina ni kasirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce pain est sans gluten.
target_text: Mkate huu haina gluteni.
target_text_raw: Mkate huu haina gluteni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai eu le sentiment que vous seriez en retard.
target_text: Nili hisi kwamba uta chelewa.
target_text_raw: Nili hisi kwamba uta chelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle vitesse vole cet oiseau ?
target_text: Ndege hii ina ruka kwa kasi ya mwendo gani?
target_text_raw: Ndege hii ina ruka kwa kasi ya mwendo gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas être riche. Je ne veux juste pas être pauvre.
target_text: Siwezi kuwa tajiri. Sitaki kuwa maskini.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kuwa tajiri. Sitaki kuwa maskini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tes chaussures sont ici.
target_text: Viatu zako ziko hapa.
target_text_raw: Viatu zako ziko hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est son cheval.
target_text: NI farasi wake.
target_text_raw: NI farasi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis juste un simple instituteur.
target_text: Mimi ni mwalimu wa kawaida tu.
target_text_raw: Mimi ni mwalimu wa kawaida tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom savait que Mary avait embrassé John.
target_text: Tom ali jua kuwa Mary ali kumbatia John.
target_text_raw: Tom ali jua kuwa Mary ali kumbatia John.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est quelqu'un qui a du bon sens.
target_text: Ni mtu aliye na hisia nzuri.
target_text_raw: Ni mtu aliye na hisia nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça te dérange si j'allume une cigarette ?
target_text: Ina kusumbua kama na washa sigara?
target_text_raw: Ina kusumbua kama na washa sigara?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne ne me respecte.
target_text: Hakuna mtu anaye ni heshimu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mtu anaye ni heshimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a terminé son travail.
target_text: Ali maliza kazi yake.
target_text_raw: Ali maliza kazi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom vient de faire un coup de circuit.
target_text: Tom ali sababisha msukumo wa umeme.
target_text_raw: Tom ali sababisha msukumo wa umeme.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai des nouvelles de ma mère tous les mois.
target_text: Niko na habari za mama yangu kila mwezi.
target_text_raw: Niko na habari za mama yangu kila mwezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant c'est un problème.
target_text: Ni shida kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Ni shida kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne t'ai jamais vu cuisiner. Sais-tu vraiment cuisiner quelque chose ?
target_text: Siku tarajia utakuwa mpishi. Una jua kupika kitu chochote?
target_text_raw: Siku tarajia utakuwa mpishi. Una jua kupika kitu chochote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les informations l'ont anéanti.
target_text: Habari zili mchanganya.
target_text_raw: Habari zili mchanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que vous seriez heureuses.
target_text: siku dhani kama uta furaiya.
target_text_raw: siku dhani kama uta furaiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne connais aucun de ses frères.
target_text: Sijui hata ndugu yangu mmoja.
target_text_raw: Sijui hata ndugu yangu mmoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un problème de maths difficile.
target_text: Ni tatizo la ugumu wa hesabu.
target_text_raw: Ni tatizo la ugumu wa hesabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela, tu le regretteras.
target_text: Hilo, uta shangaa.
target_text_raw: Hilo, uta shangaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand a-t-elle cassé la fenêtre ?
target_text: Ali vunja dirisha lini?
target_text_raw: Ali vunja dirisha lini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vient seul.
target_text: Alikuja mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Alikuja mwenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas en colère.
target_text: Hatuko na asira.
target_text_raw: Hatuko na asira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je manque de temps.
target_text: Sina wakati.
target_text_raw: Sina wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a environ trente ans.
target_text: Tom ako na miaka makumi tatu.
target_text_raw: Tom ako na miaka makumi tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu regardais la télé hier soir à neuf heures ?
target_text: Je uli angalia runinga jana jioni saa tatu?
target_text_raw: Je uli angalia runinga jana jioni saa tatu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom sera là ce soir.
target_text: Tom ata kuweko leo jioni.
target_text_raw: Tom ata kuweko leo jioni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'étais pas préparée à cette surprise.
target_text: Siku tarajia hii itokee hivi.
target_text_raw: Siku tarajia hii itokee hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parlez plus fort, s'il vous plait.
target_text: Ongea kwa sauti, tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Ongea kwa sauti, tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donne-moi un exemplaire de ce livre.
target_text: Nipe nakala ya hiki kitabu.
target_text_raw: Nipe nakala ya hiki kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tirez un trait sur votre feuille de papier.
target_text: Piga kistari kwenye karatasi.
target_text_raw: Piga kistari kwenye karatasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais te voir avant de partir pour l'Europe.
target_text: Nita penda kukuona kabla niende Ulaya.
target_text_raw: Nita penda kukuona kabla niende Ulaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ton livre.
target_text: Ni kitabu chako.
target_text_raw: Ni kitabu chako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez reculer s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Naomba urudi nyuma tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Naomba urudi nyuma tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Impossible !
target_text: Hai wezekani!
target_text_raw: Hai wezekani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous le peindrons.
target_text: Tuta paka rangi.
target_text_raw: Tuta paka rangi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom en était sûr.
target_text: Tom alikuwa tayari.
target_text_raw: Tom alikuwa tayari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dit que tout allait bien.
target_text: Nili sema itakuwa muzuri.
target_text_raw: Nili sema itakuwa muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton sac à dos est sur mon bureau.
target_text: Mfuko wako wa mgongo uko ndani ya ofisi yangu.
target_text_raw: Mfuko wako wa mgongo uko ndani ya ofisi yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas te dire pendant combien de temps j'ai attendu ça.
target_text: Siwezi kusema nili mara ngapi nimesikia hiyo.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kusema nili mara ngapi nimesikia hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle pleure.
target_text: Ali lia.
target_text_raw: Ali lia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si pas maintenant, alors quand ?
target_text: Kama si sasa, ni lini basi?
target_text_raw: Kama si sasa, ni lini basi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai mal ici.
target_text: Na isi vibaya hapa.
target_text_raw: Na isi vibaya hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce que Jacques fait, c'est de dormir.
target_text: Anacho fanya tu Jacques, ni kulala tu.
target_text_raw: Anacho fanya tu Jacques, ni kulala tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça pourrait durer longtemps.
target_text: inge chukua mda mrefu.
target_text_raw: inge chukua mda mrefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne peut rien y faire.
target_text: Tom hawezi fanya lolote.
target_text_raw: Tom hawezi fanya lolote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne parle pas l'espagnol.
target_text: Si ongei Espanyole.
target_text_raw: Si ongei Espanyole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous faisons tout ce que nous pouvons pour retrouver votre fils.
target_text: Tuna fanya lolote liwezekanalo ili tupate mtoto wako.
target_text_raw: Tuna fanya lolote liwezekanalo ili tupate mtoto wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les jeunes gens ont tendance à aller trop loin.
target_text: Vijana wana tabia ya kwenda mbali.
target_text_raw: Vijana wana tabia ya kwenda mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fait vraiment froid, ce soir.
target_text: Leo jioni, kuna baridi sana.
target_text_raw: Leo jioni, kuna baridi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien d'années a cette télé ?
target_text: Hii runinga ina miaka mingapi?
target_text_raw: Hii runinga ina miaka mingapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère était souvent en colère contre nous.
target_text: Mama yangu alikuwa ana tu kasirikia kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu alikuwa ana tu kasirikia kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui a inventé cela ?
target_text: Nani ali buni ile?
target_text_raw: Nani ali buni ile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom sait comment gagner.
target_text: Tom anajua ku shinda.
target_text_raw: Tom anajua ku shinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce un vrai diamant ?
target_text: Je nia almasi nzuri i?
target_text_raw: Je nia almasi nzuri i?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jim ne viendra pas aujourd'hui.
target_text: Jim hata kuja leo.
target_text_raw: Jim hata kuja leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet arbre est haut.
target_text: Mti huu ni mrefu.
target_text_raw: Mti huu ni mrefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a de beaux yeux.
target_text: Ana macho mazuri.
target_text_raw: Ana macho mazuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce mot a un double sens.
target_text: Neno hili lina maana mbili.
target_text_raw: Neno hili lina maana mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aimes-tu ton chien chaud ?
target_text: Una penda imbwa wako mwenye joto ?
target_text_raw: Una penda imbwa wako mwenye joto ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va accepter votre offre.
target_text: Atakubali pendekezo lako.
target_text_raw: Atakubali pendekezo lako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom devrait vraiment étudier le français.
target_text: Tom ali staili kusoma Kifaransa.
target_text_raw: Tom ali staili kusoma Kifaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trouvé ce test difficile.
target_text: Niliona mtiani huu kuwa mgumu.
target_text_raw: Niliona mtiani huu kuwa mgumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il donnerait jusqu'à sa dernière chemise.
target_text: Ata peana hadi shati yake ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Ata peana hadi shati yake ya mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'en penses-tu ?
target_text: Una fikiria nini ?
target_text_raw: Una fikiria nini ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un paquet ici pour vous.
target_text: Nina paketi hapa kwa ajili yako.
target_text_raw: Nina paketi hapa kwa ajili yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que t'ai-je jamais fait ?
target_text: nime wai kukufanyia nini?
target_text_raw: nime wai kukufanyia nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un nouveau téléphone.
target_text: Nina simu mpya.
target_text_raw: Nina simu mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom s'est fatigué.
target_text: Tom ali choka.
target_text_raw: Tom ali choka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où est-ce que tu voudrais aller ?
target_text: Ulitaka kwenda wapi?
target_text_raw: Ulitaka kwenda wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est fort probable qu'il pleuve demain.
target_text: Kuna uwezekano kuna weza nyesha kesho.
target_text_raw: Kuna uwezekano kuna weza nyesha kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est allé pêcher au lieu de jouer au tennis.
target_text: Alienda kuvua samaki kuliko kucheza tenisi.
target_text_raw: Alienda kuvua samaki kuliko kucheza tenisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Là, il y avait un pont.
target_text: Palikuwepo na kilalo, pale.
target_text_raw: Palikuwepo na kilalo, pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a essayé de se suicider mais a échoué.
target_text: Alijaribu kuji huwa ila alishindwa.
target_text_raw: Alijaribu kuji huwa ila alishindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aime pas courir.
target_text: Sitaki ku kimbia.Sipendi kitabu hiki.
target_text_raw: Sitaki ku kimbia.Sipendi kitabu hiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tôt ou tard sa chance tournera.
target_text: Mapema au kuchelewa bahati yake ita timia tu.
target_text_raw: Mapema au kuchelewa bahati yake ita timia tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyons ce qui se passe cette fois-ci.
target_text: uone nini ina tendekea kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: uone nini ina tendekea kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas et Marie étaient occupés.
target_text: Thomas na Marie walikuwa na shuguli.
target_text_raw: Thomas na Marie walikuwa na shuguli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et moi ne sommes pas occupés.
target_text: Tom na mimi hatuna shuguli.
target_text_raw: Tom na mimi hatuna shuguli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où se trouve ton école ?
target_text: Shule yako iko wapi?
target_text_raw: Shule yako iko wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les amis font des choses ensemble.
target_text: Marafiki hufanya kazi kwa pamoja.
target_text_raw: Marafiki hufanya kazi kwa pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est assez difficile de maîtriser le français en 2, 3 ans.
target_text: Ni vigumu ku jua Kifaransa kwa mda wa miaka 2 au 3.
target_text_raw: Ni vigumu ku jua Kifaransa kwa mda wa miaka 2 au 3.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun sait ce qu'il veut, mais pas tous savent ce qu'ils peuvent.
target_text: Kila mtu anafanya ila anataka, lakini si wote wano jua nini wana ita jika kufanya.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu anafanya ila anataka, lakini si wote wano jua nini wana ita jika kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai entendu directement par mon voisin.
target_text: Nili i sikia kutoka kwa jirani yangu.
target_text_raw: Nili i sikia kutoka kwa jirani yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Presque toutes les feuilles sont tombées.
target_text: Takriban majani yote ili hanguka.
target_text_raw: Takriban majani yote ili hanguka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère est malade depuis le mois dernier.
target_text: Mama yangu ni mgonjwa tangu mwezi jana.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu ni mgonjwa tangu mwezi jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des miracles se sont produits.
target_text: Miujiza ili fanyika.
target_text_raw: Miujiza ili fanyika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es celui que j'attendais.
target_text: Wewe ni yule nili kuwa na ngojea.
target_text_raw: Wewe ni yule nili kuwa na ngojea.

source_text: Il y a de nombreuses choses urgentes à faire.
