target_text_raw: Kuna mambo mengi ya kufanya kwa dharura.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aurais pu résoudre cette affaire sans toi.
target_text: Siwezi tatua hili bila wewe.
target_text_raw: Siwezi tatua hili bila wewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlevez vos vêtements mouillés.
target_text: Vua nguo zako zenye kujaa maji.
target_text_raw: Vua nguo zako zenye kujaa maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'étudiant lit dans la bibliothèque.
target_text: Mwanafunzi ana soma katika maktaba.
target_text_raw: Mwanafunzi ana soma katika maktaba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils n'ont pas de remise.
target_text: Hawana punguzo.
target_text_raw: Hawana punguzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle pense être drôle ?
target_text: Ana-fikiria kuwa ni laku shangaza?
target_text_raw: Ana-fikiria kuwa ni laku shangaza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai continué à lire.
target_text: Nili endelea kusoma.
target_text_raw: Nili endelea kusoma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils semblent s'amuser.
target_text: Ana onekana kufurahi.
target_text_raw: Ana onekana kufurahi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'était pas le seul à s'être fait arrêter.
target_text: Tom si wa kwanza kuji fungisha.
target_text_raw: Tom si wa kwanza kuji fungisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu l'as vu aussi.
target_text: Uli muona pia.
target_text_raw: Uli muona pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'as-tu fait la nuit dernière ?
target_text: Ulifanya nini jana usiku?
target_text_raw: Ulifanya nini jana usiku?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle rit gaiement.
target_text: Alicheka kwa furaha.
target_text_raw: Alicheka kwa furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons attendu Hélène à la bibliothèque pendant une heure, mais elle n'est pas apparue.
target_text: Tuli ngojea Helena kwenye maktaba kwa mda wa saa moja, lakini ali shindwa ku tokea.
target_text_raw: Tuli ngojea Helena kwenye maktaba kwa mda wa saa moja, lakini ali shindwa ku tokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voudrais être avec Tom.
target_text: Nilitaka kuwa na Tom.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka kuwa na Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'est pas ici.
target_text: Haiko hapa.
target_text_raw: Haiko hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne sait jamais combien de temps dureront ces réunions.
target_text: Hatujui mkutano uta kaa kwa mda wa saa ngapi.
target_text_raw: Hatujui mkutano uta kaa kwa mda wa saa ngapi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne comprends absolument pas sa façon de penser.
target_text: Si elewi kabisa hali yake yaku fikiria.
target_text_raw: Si elewi kabisa hali yake yaku fikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sors la main de ta poche !
target_text: Toa mkono wako ndani ya mfuko!
target_text_raw: Toa mkono wako ndani ya mfuko!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de gens sont actuellement en train d'essayer de vendre leurs maisons.
target_text: Watu wengi wana jaribu ku huzisha nyumba zao.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wana jaribu ku huzisha nyumba zao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ici ?
target_text: ni hapa?
target_text_raw: ni hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vu Tom embrasser une autre fille.
target_text: Niliona Toma aki kumbatia mwanamke mwengine.
target_text_raw: Niliona Toma aki kumbatia mwanamke mwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dînais.
target_text: Nilikuwa na kula chakula ya jioni.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa na kula chakula ya jioni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La seule chose que tu dois faire c'est de travailler plus dur.
target_text: Jambo moja una staili kufanya, niku fanya kazi kwa bidii.
target_text_raw: Jambo moja una staili kufanya, niku fanya kazi kwa bidii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as l'air si pâle. Dois-je appeler un médecin ?
target_text: Una sura yaku shangaa. Naweza kuita mganga ?
target_text_raw: Una sura yaku shangaa. Naweza kuita mganga ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que vous disposez déjà de suffisamment d'argent pour acquérir ce dont vous avez besoin.
target_text: Natumaini uko na pesa yaku tosha ili upate kuuza ile unataka.
target_text_raw: Natumaini uko na pesa yaku tosha ili upate kuuza ile unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai plus besoin de l'aide de Tom.
target_text: Siku itaji msaada wa Tom.
target_text_raw: Siku itaji msaada wa Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que tu as tout trouvé.
target_text: Natumai ume pata yote.
target_text_raw: Natumai ume pata yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom veut comprendre le sens de la vie.
target_text: Tom anataka kuelewa hali ya maisha.
target_text_raw: Tom anataka kuelewa hali ya maisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que j'étais heureux.
target_text: Natumaini nilikuwa na furaha.
target_text_raw: Natumaini nilikuwa na furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'a pas besoin de compassion, mais de soutien.
target_text: Hahitaji huruma, bali msaada.
target_text_raw: Hahitaji huruma, bali msaada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espérais plus.
target_text: Nili tarajia mengi.
target_text_raw: Nili tarajia mengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était mal à l'aise après qu'elle l'a embrassé.
target_text: Ali ji sikia vibaya baada yaku kumbatia.
target_text_raw: Ali ji sikia vibaya baada yaku kumbatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Passons un bon moment !
target_text: Tufikirie wakati mzuri!
target_text_raw: Tufikirie wakati mzuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ramassent des noisettes.
target_text: Ana fanana.
target_text_raw: Ana fanana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom respire normalement.
target_text: Tom ana pumua kawaida.
target_text_raw: Tom ana pumua kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son frère était méchant avec moi.
target_text: Ndugu yake alikuwa mkali kwangu.
target_text_raw: Ndugu yake alikuwa mkali kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cinéma était vide.
target_text: chumba cha Sinema ilikuwa bure.
target_text_raw: chumba cha Sinema ilikuwa bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est en effet un garçon intelligent.
target_text: Ukweli ni kijana mwenye akili.
target_text_raw: Ukweli ni kijana mwenye akili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne permettrai pas que vous soyez maltraité.
target_text: Siwezi ruhusu uteseke.
target_text_raw: Siwezi ruhusu uteseke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dus changer le plan.
target_text: Nili badilisha mpango.
target_text_raw: Nili badilisha mpango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma femme est chinoise.
target_text: Mke wangu ni m-china.
target_text_raw: Mke wangu ni m-china.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me rappelle quand nous ne mangions jamais de légumes que nous n'avions pas cultivés nous-mêmes.
target_text: Nakumbuka wakati hatuku kula mboga ambazo hatuku lima wenyewe.
target_text_raw: Nakumbuka wakati hatuku kula mboga ambazo hatuku lima wenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas ce que j'ai écrit.
target_text: Si ile nilio handika.
target_text_raw: Si ile nilio handika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne devrais pas boire cette eau.
target_text: Hau staili kunywa haya maji.
target_text_raw: Hau staili kunywa haya maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes encore mariés.
target_text: Bado tume olewa.
target_text_raw: Bado tume olewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ça.
target_text: Ni hii.
target_text_raw: Ni hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être ne se rappelle-t-elle pas de mon anniversaire.
target_text: Labda hakumbuki siku yangu yaku zaliwa.
target_text_raw: Labda hakumbuki siku yangu yaku zaliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est juste.
target_text: Ni ukweli.
target_text_raw: Ni ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quels sont leurs noms ?
target_text: Majina yao ni gani?
target_text_raw: Majina yao ni gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne crains personne.
target_text: Si ogopa mtu.
target_text_raw: Si ogopa mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'argent, en soi, n'a pas de signification.
target_text: Pesa, zenyewe, hazina maana.
target_text_raw: Pesa, zenyewe, hazina maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’étais en train de penser exactement à la même chose.
target_text: Nilikuwa na fikiria kuhusu kitu hicho.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa na fikiria kuhusu kitu hicho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voilà ce que je suis en train de faire.
target_text: Angalia ile ninayo ifanya.
target_text_raw: Angalia ile ninayo ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est une mère très avisée.
target_text: Ni mama mwenye hekima.
target_text_raw: Ni mama mwenye hekima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'avais su que tu étais là je serais venu tout de suite.
target_text: ninge jua kama uko pale, ninge kuja haraka.
target_text_raw: ninge jua kama uko pale, ninge kuja haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais bien pouvoir faire ça, mais je ne peux pas.
target_text: Nita itaji kufanya hilo, lakini siwezi.
target_text_raw: Nita itaji kufanya hilo, lakini siwezi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette lettre ne porte aucune signature.
target_text: Barua hii haina saini yoyote.
target_text_raw: Barua hii haina saini yoyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis en train de manger une banane.
target_text: Na kula ndizi.
target_text_raw: Na kula ndizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marcher de la station à la maison ne prend que cinq minutes.
target_text: Kutembea kutoka kituo hadi nyumbani ni dakika tano.
target_text_raw: Kutembea kutoka kituo hadi nyumbani ni dakika tano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis à Tom que je suis trop fatigué pour l'aider.
target_text: Ambia Tom kama nimechoka sana siwezi msaidia.
target_text_raw: Ambia Tom kama nimechoka sana siwezi msaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi n'admets-tu pas ton erreur ?
target_text: Kwanini hukubali makosa yako?
target_text_raw: Kwanini hukubali makosa yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voici son opinion.
target_text: Angalia mawazo yake.
target_text_raw: Angalia mawazo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ignorais pourquoi je n'étais pas censé me rendre dans cette partie de la ville.
target_text: Nili dharau kwanini siwezi kwenda mu sehemu hiyo ya mjini.
target_text_raw: Nili dharau kwanini siwezi kwenda mu sehemu hiyo ya mjini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vas cruellement nous manquer.
target_text: Uta tu kosa sana.
target_text_raw: Uta tu kosa sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la vie, il y a des choses qui restent irréalisables, peut importe à quel point on les souhaite.
target_text: Katika maisha, kuna vitu zina bakia bila kutimia, hata kama tuna zii-taji aje.
target_text_raw: Katika maisha, kuna vitu zina bakia bila kutimia, hata kama tuna zii-taji aje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne fermez pas la porte. Attendez un peu.
target_text: Usi funge mlango. Ngoja kidogo.
target_text_raw: Usi funge mlango. Ngoja kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je connais la véritable raison de son absence.
target_text: Najua sababu kamili ya kuchelewa kwake.
target_text_raw: Najua sababu kamili ya kuchelewa kwake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle était si proche de moi que j'aurais pu la toucher.
target_text: Alikuwa karibu yangu hadi ningeweza ku mgusa.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa karibu yangu hadi ningeweza ku mgusa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet ordinateur portable m'appartient !
target_text: Kompyuta ya mkononi ni yangu!
target_text_raw: Kompyuta ya mkononi ni yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je peux me rendre où que tu le veuilles.
target_text: Naweza kwenda kula unataka.
target_text_raw: Naweza kwenda kula unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne remets pas à demain ce que tu peux faire aujourd’hui.
target_text: Usi peleke kesho ile unaweza fanya leo.
target_text_raw: Usi peleke kesho ile unaweza fanya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il devint célèbre dans le monde entier, pour sa découverte.
target_text: Amekuwa mashuhuri duniani sababu ya uvumbuzi wake.
target_text_raw: Amekuwa mashuhuri duniani sababu ya uvumbuzi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'avez pas le droit de téléphoner ici !
target_text: Hauna haki ya kuita ku simu hapa!
target_text_raw: Hauna haki ya kuita ku simu hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous peur de quelque chose ?
target_text: Una ogopa kitu chochote?
target_text_raw: Una ogopa kitu chochote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui ai demandé où je pourrais garer ma voiture.
target_text: Nili mu-uliza wapi naweza egesha gari yangu.
target_text_raw: Nili mu-uliza wapi naweza egesha gari yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que ça plaira à Tom.
target_text: Nafikiria ita furahisha Tom.
target_text_raw: Nafikiria ita furahisha Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne s'agit pas d'argent, au moins ?
target_text: Hahitaji pesa kila wakati ?
target_text_raw: Hahitaji pesa kila wakati ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qu'ils t'ont piqué ?
target_text: Nini ili kuuma?
target_text_raw: Nini ili kuuma?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas besoin de répondre si tu ne veux pas.
target_text: Hauna haki yaku jibu kama hutaki.
target_text_raw: Hauna haki yaku jibu kama hutaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai lu le livre jusqu'à la page 80 hier.
target_text: Nili i soma kitabu hadi ukurasa wa 80 hapo jana.
target_text_raw: Nili i soma kitabu hadi ukurasa wa 80 hapo jana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je compter sur vous ?
target_text: Naweza hukutumaini ?
target_text_raw: Naweza hukutumaini ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est vraiment intelligente, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: ni mwenye akili, sivyo?
target_text_raw: ni mwenye akili, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'où connaissais-tu mon nom ?
target_text: Ulijua jina langu wapi?
target_text_raw: Ulijua jina langu wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’ai alors commencé à comprendre.
target_text: Nili hanza kuelewa sasa.
target_text_raw: Nili hanza kuelewa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelque chose s'en vient.
target_text: Kitu fulani ime kuja.
target_text_raw: Kitu fulani ime kuja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une théorie.
target_text: Niko na maelezo fulani.
target_text_raw: Niko na maelezo fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a travaillé pendant cinq heures d'affilée.
target_text: Alifanya kazi kwa masaa tano mfululizo.
target_text_raw: Alifanya kazi kwa masaa tano mfululizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme est le seul animal à utiliser le feu.
target_text: Binadamu ndio mnyama pekee waku tumia moto.
target_text_raw: Binadamu ndio mnyama pekee waku tumia moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prix de ces souliers a été réduit.
target_text: Bei ya hizi viatu ili punguzwa.
target_text_raw: Bei ya hizi viatu ili punguzwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est assurément une possibilité.
target_text: Ukweli ina wezekana.
target_text_raw: Ukweli ina wezekana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De toute façon on va tous mourir.
target_text: Kwa njia yote ile tuta kufa wote.
target_text_raw: Kwa njia yote ile tuta kufa wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les mots ne peuvent le décrire.
target_text: Neno haliwezi kulieleza.
target_text_raw: Neno haliwezi kulieleza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a dit qu'il pensait que Mary aurait faim.
target_text: Tom ana sema ali fikiria Mary alikuwa na njaa.
target_text_raw: Tom ana sema ali fikiria Mary alikuwa na njaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceux-là ne sont pas à moi.
target_text: Hile hai ni-husu.
target_text_raw: Hile hai ni-husu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils attendent tous.
target_text: Wana ngojea yote.
target_text_raw: Wana ngojea yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui ai fait réparer ma montre.
target_text: Nili mtengenezee saa yangu.
target_text_raw: Nili mtengenezee saa yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux conduire une voiture, n'est-ce pas?
target_text: Naweza tembeza gari, sivyo?
target_text_raw: Naweza tembeza gari, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est maintenant étudiante à la fac.
target_text: Ni mwanafunzi wa chuo kikuu kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Ni mwanafunzi wa chuo kikuu kwa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne regardez pas trop la télé !
target_text: Usi angalie kichwa sana!
target_text_raw: Usi angalie kichwa sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dites-moi à quoi ressemble cet homme.
target_text: Niambie kama yule mtu ana fanana nani.
target_text_raw: Niambie kama yule mtu ana fanana nani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je donnerai une copie à qui veut.
target_text: Nita toa nakala kwa yule anaye itaji.
target_text_raw: Nita toa nakala kwa yule anaye itaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne peux pas apprendre ici ! C'est une école !

source_text: Toutes les lampes ne sont pas merveilleuses.
target_text: Tala zangu zote hasiko zamuzuri.
target_text_raw: Tala zangu zote hasiko zamuzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bonheur, c'est simplement une bonne santé et une mauvaise conscience.
target_text: Furaha ni afya njema tu na zamiri mbaya.
target_text_raw: Furaha ni afya njema tu na zamiri mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les lapsus donnent souvent des résultats inattendus.
target_text: Kutereza kwa lulimi inaleta mara mingi matokeo yasiyotarajiwa.
target_text_raw: Kutereza kwa lulimi inaleta mara mingi matokeo yasiyotarajiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ceci explique cela.
target_text: Iyi inaelezea ile.
target_text_raw: Iyi inaelezea ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand la bombe a été larguée, j'ai senti la maison vibrer dans tous les sens.
target_text: Wakati bomu lilirushwa, nilisikiya nyumba ikitetemeka ngambo zote.
target_text_raw: Wakati bomu lilirushwa, nilisikiya nyumba ikitetemeka ngambo zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que tu dis de cela ?
target_text: Unasema nini kuhusu hile?
target_text_raw: Unasema nini kuhusu hile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ennemi est tombé dans le piège.
target_text: Adui ameanguka ndani ya mtego.
target_text_raw: Adui ameanguka ndani ya mtego.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le commerce aide les pays à se développer.
target_text: Biashara ina saidiya inchi kuendeleza.
target_text_raw: Biashara ina saidiya inchi kuendeleza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous attendons du mauvais temps, aujourd'hui.
target_text: Tuna chunga hali ya hewa mbaya leo.
target_text_raw: Tuna chunga hali ya hewa mbaya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nouvelle route profitera aux gens qui vivent dans les collines.
target_text: Barabara ya mupya itawasaidiya batu benye banaishi mu milimani.
target_text_raw: Barabara ya mupya itawasaidiya batu benye banaishi mu milimani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas des êtres humains vivant une expérience spirituelle, nous sommes des êtres spirituels vivant une expérience humaine.
target_text: Chiye hatuko wanadamu benye banaishi experience ya kiroho, chiye tuko viumbe ya kiroho benye banaishi experience ya kibinadamu.
target_text_raw: Chiye hatuko wanadamu benye banaishi experience ya kiroho, chiye tuko viumbe ya kiroho benye banaishi experience ya kibinadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les cerisiers du parc sont en fleurs.
target_text: Miti yote ya cerise mu parc zina tosha mauwa.
target_text_raw: Miti yote ya cerise mu parc zina tosha mauwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chambres dans cet hôtel sont frustes.
target_text: Machumba katika hoteli hii ziko mbaya.
target_text_raw: Machumba katika hoteli hii ziko mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Repose en paix, ma chère maman. Je te regrette beaucoup.
target_text: Pumzika kwa amani, mama yangu mpendwa. Nina nungunika sana.
target_text_raw: Pumzika kwa amani, mama yangu mpendwa. Nina nungunika sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mr. Bingley plaisait dès l’abord par un extérieur agréable, une allure distinguée, un air avenant et des manières pleines d’aisance et de naturel.
target_text: Bwana. Bingley alikuwa akipendeza tangu mwanzo na inje ya kupendeza, tabia iliyojulikana, tabia nzuri, na tabia zilizo yala urahisi na kawaida.
target_text_raw: Bwana. Bingley alikuwa akipendeza tangu mwanzo na inje ya kupendeza, tabia iliyojulikana, tabia nzuri, na tabia zilizo yala urahisi na kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que vous aviez grandi à Los Angeles.
target_text: Nilizani umekomalia Los Angeles.
target_text_raw: Nilizani umekomalia Los Angeles.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est inutile d'essayer de garder des secrets pour les journalistes.
target_text: Haina maana kwa kujaribu kuweka siri za waandishi wa habari.
target_text_raw: Haina maana kwa kujaribu kuweka siri za waandishi wa habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pourrai aimer qu’un homme qui pourra me protéger.
target_text: Ninaweza tu kumpenda mtu mwenye anayeweza kunilinda.
target_text_raw: Ninaweza tu kumpenda mtu mwenye anayeweza kunilinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est mieux d'aller en enfer avec une personne sensée qu'au paradis avec un idiot.
target_text: Afazali kuenda kuzimu na mtu mwenye akili nzuri kuliko kwenda mbinguni na mjinga.
target_text_raw: Afazali kuenda kuzimu na mtu mwenye akili nzuri kuliko kwenda mbinguni na mjinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Heureusement, le ridicule ne tue pas !
target_text: Kwa bahati nzuri, mambo ya haya haziuwake!
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati nzuri, mambo ya haya haziuwake!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si elles avaient suivi les conseils de leurs médecins, elles ne seraient peut-être pas dans cet état.
target_text: Ingekuwa balisikiya mashauri ya baganga yabo,hawangeli kuwa mu hali ya hiyo.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa balisikiya mashauri ya baganga yabo,hawangeli kuwa mu hali ya hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes en comité ayant trait à la protection des droits de l'enfant.
target_text: Tuko katika kamati inayoshughulikia na ulinzi wa haki za watoto.
target_text_raw: Tuko katika kamati inayoshughulikia na ulinzi wa haki za watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fais gaffe ! Le patron t'a dans le nez. Tu as intérêt à te tenir à carreau.
target_text: Fanya hange! Bosi iko naweye usoni. Ni muzuri ukuwe makini.
target_text_raw: Fanya hange! Bosi iko naweye usoni. Ni muzuri ukuwe makini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a deux manières de combattre, l’une avec les lois, l’autre avec la force. La première est propre aux hommes, l’autre nous est commune avec les bêtes.
target_text: Kuna njia mbili za kupigana, moja na sheria, na yengine kwa nguvu. Ya kwanza niya watu, nyingine niya kawaida kwetu na wanyama.
target_text_raw: Kuna njia mbili za kupigana, moja na sheria, na yengine kwa nguvu. Ya kwanza niya watu, nyingine niya kawaida kwetu na wanyama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police compara les empreintes digitales sur l'arme avec celles sur la porte.
target_text: Polisi walilinganisha alama za vidole kwenye bunduki na zile zilizokuwa ku mulango.
target_text_raw: Polisi walilinganisha alama za vidole kwenye bunduki na zile zilizokuwa ku mulango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les journalistes du Figaro ont été privé d'accès aux projections presse organisées par Pathé et Gaumont à cause de leurs critiques trop négatives envers les films de ces distributeurs.
target_text: Waandishi wa habari kutoka Le Figaro baliwakataliya kuasili projection ya presse organisé ulioandaliwa na Pathé na Gaumont kwa sababu yama critiques negatif ya film zaba distributeurs hawa.
target_text_raw: Waandishi wa habari kutoka Le Figaro baliwakataliya kuasili projection ya presse organisé ulioandaliwa na Pathé na Gaumont kwa sababu yama critiques negatif ya film zaba distributeurs hawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'infirmière utilisa un tensiomètre pour vérifier ma pression sanguine.
target_text: Infirmier alitumia damu kuangalia pression ya damu yangu.
target_text_raw: Infirmier alitumia damu kuangalia pression ya damu yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu trouves que c'est normal de passer sa vie à bosser ?
target_text: Je! Unazani ni kawaida kutumia maisha yako kufanya kazi?
target_text_raw: Je! Unazani ni kawaida kutumia maisha yako kufanya kazi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La canne sert à annoncer le fait que les mains de celui qui la tient sont employées à autre chose qu'à un effort utile, et elle est donc utile comme preuve d'oisiveté.
target_text: Fimbo inatumiwa kutangaza kama mikono ya ule anayeikamata anatumiwa kwa kitu kyengine isipokuwa juhudi inayofaa, na kwa hivyo niya lazima kama preuve ya uvivu.
target_text_raw: Fimbo inatumiwa kutangaza kama mikono ya ule anayeikamata anatumiwa kwa kitu kyengine isipokuwa juhudi inayofaa, na kwa hivyo niya lazima kama preuve ya uvivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les images des objets viennent, comme dans un appareil photographique, se former sur la rétine que le nerf optique relie au cerveau.
target_text: Picha za vitu inakuyaka, kama ku kamera ya picha, kujiunda ku retina kwenye mshipa wa macho inaunganisha na bongo.
target_text_raw: Picha za vitu inakuyaka, kama ku kamera ya picha, kujiunda ku retina kwenye mshipa wa macho inaunganisha na bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous mangé quelque chose qui pourrait être à l'origine de ces symptômes : par exemple du poisson, de la conserve, de la viande avariée, de la saucisse, des champignons, des fruits inconnus ou de la glace ?
target_text: Je! Umekula kitu fulani ambacho kinaweza kusababisha dalili hizi: kwa mfano samaki, chakula cha makopo, nyama iliyooza, saucisse,buyoga, matunda usiyo julikana au glasse?
target_text_raw: Je! Umekula kitu fulani ambacho kinaweza kusababisha dalili hizi: kwa mfano samaki, chakula cha makopo, nyama iliyooza, saucisse,buyoga, matunda usiyo julikana au glasse?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'extérieur doux et auto-réparateur de ce robot lui permettra de prendre des dégâts, de battre en retraite, puis de retourner au combat.
target_text: Inje muzuri ya kujiponya roboti hii itairuhusu kufanya uharibifu, kurudi nyuma, na kisha kurudi kuvita.
target_text_raw: Inje muzuri ya kujiponya roboti hii itairuhusu kufanya uharibifu, kurudi nyuma, na kisha kurudi kuvita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le ventre est un vorace, qui l'écoute restera sans amis.
target_text: Tumbo ni mkali, ambaye anamusikiliza atabaki hana marafiki.
target_text_raw: Tumbo ni mkali, ambaye anamusikiliza atabaki hana marafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quoi bon prendre la vie au sérieux, puisque de toute façon nous n'en sortirons pas vivants ?
target_text: Je! Ni maana gani ya kuchukua maisha lazima sana, juu hatuwezi kujitosha wazima hata hivi?
target_text_raw: Je! Ni maana gani ya kuchukua maisha lazima sana, juu hatuwezi kujitosha wazima hata hivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme j'ai mal dormi ces derniers temps, ma peau est devenue toute ridée.
target_text: Ginsi nililala mubaya siku izi, ngozi yangu imekunja kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ginsi nililala mubaya siku izi, ngozi yangu imekunja kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour lui tous les moyens étaient bons pour réussir dans la vie.
target_text: Kwake njia zote zilikuwa nzuri kufanikiwa maishani.
target_text_raw: Kwake njia zote zilikuwa nzuri kufanikiwa maishani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis contente que vous m'ayez invitée à la fête.
target_text: Ninafurahi kuwa ulinialika ku sherehe.
target_text_raw: Ninafurahi kuwa ulinialika ku sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Je viens juste de te sauver de Ganon!" "Non, tu ne l'as pas fait." "Bon OK."
target_text: «Nime Kuikowa kutoka kwa Ganon!» «Apana, haukuniokowa.» Sawa sawa.»
target_text_raw: «Nime Kuikowa kutoka kwa Ganon!» «Apana, haukuniokowa.» Sawa sawa.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous remercie, Capitaine Évidence.
target_text: Nakushukuru, Capitaine Évidence.
target_text_raw: Nakushukuru, Capitaine Évidence.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation commettent toutes sortes de crimes de guerre dans la plus parfaite impunité.
target_text: Forces ya occupation binafanya kila aina ya crime ya vita bila bila kuazibiwa hata.
target_text_raw: Forces ya occupation binafanya kila aina ya crime ya vita bila bila kuazibiwa hata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne ne sera plus jamais capable de briser l'enceinte qui cache mon cœur.
target_text: Hakuna mtu amwenye ataweza kuvunja kizuizi kinachoficha moyo wangu tena.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mtu amwenye ataweza kuvunja kizuizi kinachoficha moyo wangu tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne voyez pas qu'elle est malheureuse ? Personne ne s'occupe d'elle.
target_text: Huoni kuwa hana furaha? Hakuna mtu anausika naye.
target_text_raw: Huoni kuwa hana furaha? Hakuna mtu anausika naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois tout d'abord obtenir la permission de mes parents, avant de pouvoir aller danser avec toi.
target_text: Lazima nipate ruhusa kutoka kwa wazazi yangu kwanza, mbele niende kucheza na weye.
target_text_raw: Lazima nipate ruhusa kutoka kwa wazazi yangu kwanza, mbele niende kucheza na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne connaissez pas Théo aussi bien que vous ne le pensez.
target_text: Haumjui Theo kama vile unafikiria.
target_text_raw: Haumjui Theo kama vile unafikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le dernier secrétaire de Sami a dit qu'il était un patron merveilleux.
target_text: Secrétaire wa mwisho wa Sami alisema alikuwa bosi mzuri.
target_text_raw: Secrétaire wa mwisho wa Sami alisema alikuwa bosi mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son regard était prompt, sa bouche un peu dédaigneuse, et son sourire singulièrement doux et spirituel.
target_text: Kuangaliya yake ilikuwa ya haraka, mdomo yake ilikuwa yakuzarau kidogo, na kucheka yake moja tamu na yenye ujinga.
target_text_raw: Kuangaliya yake ilikuwa ya haraka, mdomo yake ilikuwa yakuzarau kidogo, na kucheka yake moja tamu na yenye ujinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis également fier d'apporter avec moi la bonne volonté du peuple américain, et une salutation de paix de la part des communautés musulmanes dans mon pays : Assalaamu alaykum.
target_text: Ninajivunia pia kuleta nia njema ya watu wa Amerika, na salamu ya amani kutoka kwa jamii za Waislamu nchini mwangu: Assalaamu alaykum.
target_text_raw: Ninajivunia pia kuleta nia njema ya watu wa Amerika, na salamu ya amani kutoka kwa jamii za Waislamu nchini mwangu: Assalaamu alaykum.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le coup de boule de Zidane fut un des moments marquants de la coupe du monde de 2006.
target_text: Ma tir za kabumbu za Zidane zilikuwa moja ya wakati nzuri vya Kombe la Dunia la 2006.
target_text_raw: Ma tir za kabumbu za Zidane zilikuwa moja ya wakati nzuri vya Kombe la Dunia la 2006.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personnellement, je trouve que les fellations sont plus agréables que le sexe classique.
target_text: Binafsi, ninaona kama ngono vkupitiya kinywa ina furahisha zaidi kuliko ngono ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Binafsi, ninaona kama ngono vkupitiya kinywa ina furahisha zaidi kuliko ngono ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous partons : nous voyons la riche Oléaros, / Naxos chère à Bacchus, et la blanche Paros, / Donyse aux verts bosquets, tant d'îles renommées / qui sur les vastes mers en cercle sont semées.
target_text: Tunaondoka: tunaona Oléaros tajiri, / Naxos chère ku Bacchus, na Paros nyeupe, / Donyse na shamba za vert, ma îles zinazo julikana / ambazo zina pandwa ku bahari kubwa za muviringo.

source_text: Bonsoir, Mademoiselle.
target_text: Habari musichana.
target_text_raw: Habari musichana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était inutile de tenter de l'emmener à l'hôpital.
target_text: Hilikuwa haina maana kujaribu kumpeleka hospitalini.
target_text_raw: Hilikuwa haina maana kujaribu kumpeleka hospitalini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne commettez pas d'erreur : Nous ne voulons pas garder nos troupes en Afghanistan. Nous ne cherchons pas à y établir de bases militaires.
target_text: Usifanye makosa: Hatutaki kuweka askari wetu nchini Afghanistan. Hatujarajiye kutiya vituo vya kijeshi huko.
target_text_raw: Usifanye makosa: Hatutaki kuweka askari wetu nchini Afghanistan. Hatujarajiye kutiya vituo vya kijeshi huko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Alijua kila mtu katika salon hii. Wote walitiya ndani mwake kuchoka sana, na angelipa mingi kabisa kutowaona au kuwasikia tena, bila kumuacha pembeni bibi yake.

source_text: Il se tint pendant un moment à l'extérieur des murs de la prison, exultant de son évasion miraculeuse.

target_text_raw: Alishimama kwa muda inje ya kibambazi ya prison, akifurahi kwa kutoroka kwake kimiujiza.

source_text: La nécessité est, d’ailleurs, de tous les maîtres, celui qu’on écoute le plus et qui enseigne le mieux.

target_text_raw: Ya lazima zaidi ya hayo, ni kwa walimu wote, ule uzaidi na anayefundiza sana na mwenye ana fundisha bora zaidi.

target_text_raw: Ili kutuliza masoko, couple Merkozy sasa wanaonyesha kicheko ya kudumu kwenye picha zote za waandishi wa habari.

target_text_raw: Bongo haikuwake kweli kwa kuruirudilia.

source_text: Arthur nous a conseillé d'aller visiter les châteaux de Louis II.

target_text_raw: Arthur alitushauri twende tutembeleye manyumba ya kifalme ya Louis II.

source_text: Il faut être rameur avant de tenir le gouvernail, avoir gardé la proue et observé les vents avant de gouverner soi-même le navire.
target_text: Lazima uwe msafirishaji kabla ya kukamata gouvernail, uwe umeweka upinde na uangalie pepo mbele ya kuendesha meli mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Lazima uwe msafirishaji kabla ya kukamata gouvernail, uwe umeweka upinde na uangalie pepo mbele ya kuendesha meli mwenyewe.

source_text: Depuis son divorce, il est plus cool que jamais.
target_text: Tangu divorce yake, amekuwa baridi kuliko hapo zamani.
target_text_raw: Tangu divorce yake, amekuwa baridi kuliko hapo zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On verra le résultat.
target_text: Tutaona matokeo.
target_text_raw: Tutaona matokeo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les termes d'un jeu de mots ne sont ni anodins ni sans liens mais sont interconnectés dans un réseau si tortueux que seuls les détours en sont intelligibles.
target_text: Masharti ya mchezo hayana madhara wala hayahusiani lakini yameunganishwa kwenye mtandao ambao ni mbaya sana hivi kama njia zingine zinaeleweka.
target_text_raw: Masharti ya mchezo hayana madhara wala hayahusiani lakini yameunganishwa kwenye mtandao ambao ni mbaya sana hivi kama njia zingine zinaeleweka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyant ensuite qu'il n'y a plus aucune espérance, il se retire dans sa maison, pour sauver son père, sa femme et son fils.
target_text: Kuona basi kama hakuna tumaini tena, aliji retirer mu nyumba yake, kwa kuokoa baba yake, bibi yake na mtoto wake.
target_text_raw: Kuona basi kama hakuna tumaini tena, aliji retirer mu nyumba yake, kwa kuokoa baba yake, bibi yake na mtoto wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour éviter que son idée originale soit copiée, Henry se fit silencieux.
target_text: Ili kuzuia wazo yake ya original isikuwe copié, Henry alinyamanza.
target_text_raw: Ili kuzuia wazo yake ya original isikuwe copié, Henry alinyamanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande si ce restaurant accepte des clients qui viennent pour la première fois.
target_text: Nashangaa kama iyi restaurant inakubali ba clients benye banakuja kwa mara ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Nashangaa kama iyi restaurant inakubali ba clients benye banakuja kwa mara ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A quoi bon chaparder ce qui revient aux autres ? C'est du vol. A moins de rattraper au vol un oeuf dur comme ceux lancés dans une fête!
target_text: Je! Ni lazma gani kuiba kilicho cha wengine? Hii ni bwizi. Isipokuwa ukikamata liyayi iliyochemshwa sana kama ile iliyotupwa kwenye sherehe!
target_text_raw: Je! Ni lazma gani kuiba kilicho cha wengine? Hii ni bwizi. Isipokuwa ukikamata liyayi iliyochemshwa sana kama ile iliyotupwa kwenye sherehe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vas t’abîmer les yeux à force de passer ton temps sur les jeux vidéo.
target_text: Utaharibu macho yako kutumia wakati wako kwenye michezo ya video.
target_text_raw: Utaharibu macho yako kutumia wakati wako kwenye michezo ya video.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier soir, j'ai emmené les gosses au ciné.
target_text: Jana usiku, niliwabeba watoto ku sinema.
target_text_raw: Jana usiku, niliwabeba watoto ku sinema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle lui a recommandé de ne pas acheter de voiture d'occasion, mais il n'a pas suivi ses conseils.
target_text: Alimshauriya asiuze gari iliyotumika, lakini hakufuata shauri yake.
target_text_raw: Alimshauriya asiuze gari iliyotumika, lakini hakufuata shauri yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À malin, malin et demi !
target_text: Kwa mudjanja, kuwa mudjandja.
target_text_raw: Kwa mudjanja, kuwa mudjandja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Essayez ces souliers et voyez s'ils vous vont.
target_text: Upime biato hibi na uone binakueneya.
target_text_raw: Upime biato hibi na uone binakueneya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous recevons beaucoup d'appels venant de l'étranger.
target_text: Tunapokea simu nyingi kutoka inje ya nchi.
target_text_raw: Tunapokea simu nyingi kutoka inje ya nchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourrions-nous vous emmener ailleurs ?
target_text: Tuna weza kupeleka fasi yengine?
target_text_raw: Tuna weza kupeleka fasi yengine?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se tient toujours à l'écart de la foule.
target_text: Anabakiyaka kawaida mbali na umate ya watu.
target_text_raw: Anabakiyaka kawaida mbali na umate ya watu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Es-tu en capacité de prouver que ce que tu as dit est vrai ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza kuthibitisha kile ulichosema ni kweli?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza kuthibitisha kile ulichosema ni kweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police a persuadé le criminel de remettre son arme.
target_text: Polisi walimshawishi criminel arudishe bunduki yake.
target_text_raw: Polisi walimshawishi criminel arudishe bunduki yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo est l'officier le plus gradé.
target_text: Timéo ndiye afisa anaeye kuwa na cheo ya yulu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Timéo ndiye afisa anaeye kuwa na cheo ya yulu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bravo! C'était vraiment une excellente performance.
target_text: Umefanya muzuri!! Ilikuwa kabisa utendaji mzuri.
target_text_raw: Umefanya muzuri!! Ilikuwa kabisa utendaji mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle avait une voix douce et claire.
target_text: Alikuwa na sauti laini na wazi.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa na sauti laini na wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les services administratifs et les institutions devraient proposer aux Étasuniens des opportunités accrues de participer à l'élaboration de la politique et d'apporter à leur gouvernement les bienfaits de leur expertise et de leur information collective.
target_text: Services administratifs na institutions za serikali zinapashwa ku proposer Wamarekani ma opportnite zilizoongezeka za kushiriki katika utengenezaji wa siasa na kuiletea serikali yao faida ya utaalam wao na wa habari zao pamoja..
target_text_raw: Services administratifs na institutions za serikali zinapashwa ku proposer Wamarekani ma opportnite zilizoongezeka za kushiriki katika utengenezaji wa siasa na kuiletea serikali yao faida ya utaalam wao na wa habari zao pamoja..
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux : un foyer pour chaque famille, du pain pour chaque bouche, l'éducation pour les cœurs de tous, de la lumière pour l'intelligence de tous.
target_text: Nataka: nyumba kwa kila familia, mkate kwa kila kinywa, elimu kwa mioyo ya wote, mwangaza kwa akili ya wote.
target_text_raw: Nataka: nyumba kwa kila familia, mkate kwa kila kinywa, elimu kwa mioyo ya wote, mwangaza kwa akili ya wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils appellent Paris la ville-lumière, mais Las Vegas mérite davantage l'appellation.
target_text: Wanaiita Paris njini wa mwangaza, lakini Las Vegas inastahili jina hii zaidi.
target_text_raw: Wanaiita Paris njini wa mwangaza, lakini Las Vegas inastahili jina hii zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout finit toujours par s'arranger.
target_text: Yote inaisha tu kwa masikilizano.
target_text_raw: Yote inaisha tu kwa masikilizano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux rester ici si tu veux, aussi longtemps que tu restes tranquille.
target_text: Unaweza bakiya hapa kwa wakati ya murefu kama tu una ikala kimia.
target_text_raw: Unaweza bakiya hapa kwa wakati ya murefu kama tu una ikala kimia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez le bon boulot.
target_text: Endelia kazi nzuri.
target_text_raw: Endelia kazi nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voulons que tu sois le capitaine de l'équipe.
target_text: Tuna penda ukuwe kiongozi wa timu.
target_text_raw: Tuna penda ukuwe kiongozi wa timu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai remarqué que vous n'étiez pas chez vous hier soir.
target_text: Niligundua kuwa haukukuwa nyumbani jana usiku.
target_text_raw: Niligundua kuwa haukukuwa nyumbani jana usiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devrions au moins, par prudence, ne jamais parler de nous-mêmes, parce que c'est un sujet sur lequel nous pouvons être sûrs que les points de vue des autres gens ne sont jamais en accord avec le nôtre.
target_text: Tunge pashwa kufanya hange, kwa ku zungumzia kwa ajili yetu, kwa sababu ni mada ambayo tuna weza kuwa na uhakika yakwamba maoni ya wengine hai ambatane nayetu.
target_text_raw: Tunge pashwa kufanya hange, kwa ku zungumzia kwa ajili yetu, kwa sababu ni mada ambayo tuna weza kuwa na uhakika yakwamba maoni ya wengine hai ambatane nayetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous me trouvez idiot ? C’est parce que je suis en train d’échanger des idées avec vous.
target_text: Muna niona mujinga? Ni sababu niko mu maongezi na nyiye.
target_text_raw: Muna niona mujinga? Ni sababu niko mu maongezi na nyiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégage simplement d'ici !
target_text: Toka tu hapa!
target_text_raw: Toka tu hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle aime bien se faire prier. D'abord elle ne voulut pas; puis elle se fit prier moins fort, puis elle consentit entièrement.
target_text: Anapendaka kujiombeya. Kwanza haku kuwa napenda; sasa aka omba kwa sauti ya kidogo, basi aka jitolea kabisa.
target_text_raw: Anapendaka kujiombeya. Kwanza haku kuwa napenda; sasa aka omba kwa sauti ya kidogo, basi aka jitolea kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me mettez pas dans une camisole de force, parce que je ne suis pas fou.
target_text: Usiniweke mukakitu kaunibana, ju siko mwendawazimu.
target_text_raw: Usiniweke mukakitu kaunibana, ju siko mwendawazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a couché avec son patron.
target_text: Ali lalana na bosi wake.
target_text_raw: Ali lalana na bosi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui, à Osaka aussi nous disons "idiot" quand nous insultons quelqu’un.
target_text: Ndio, na Osaka nasiye tuna semaka “mpumbafu” kama tuna tukana mutu.
target_text_raw: Ndio, na Osaka nasiye tuna semaka “mpumbafu” kama tuna tukana mutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette mission comporte de grands risques.
target_text: Ujumbe hii ni ya na hatari sana.
target_text_raw: Ujumbe hii ni ya na hatari sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il est grand temps qu'on mette les points sur les i, car là, ça ne va plus du tout !
target_text: Na waza ni wakati sasa ya kuweka alama kwenye i, kwasababu habiendeke kabisa!
target_text_raw: Na waza ni wakati sasa ya kuweka alama kwenye i, kwasababu habiendeke kabisa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux tous vous remercier pour du bon boulot.
target_text: Nataka kuwa shukuru kwa kazi nzuri.
target_text_raw: Nataka kuwa shukuru kwa kazi nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'ouvrez pas la bouche !
target_text: Usi funguwe kinywa!
target_text_raw: Usi funguwe kinywa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'abord, il faut débarrasser ça du chemin pour que l'on puisse accéder à la table.
target_text: Kwanza, inapashwa kutosha ile munjia ju tuweze kufikiya ku meza.
target_text_raw: Kwanza, inapashwa kutosha ile munjia ju tuweze kufikiya ku meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Russes ne parachutent pas secrètement des armes pour les terroristes de l'organisation autoproclamée "État islamique". Ce sont les services secrets occidentaux avec leurs alliés corrompus du Moyen-Orient qui le faisaient.
target_text: Warusi hawafanyake parashuti ya silaha kwa uficho kwa kundi la magaidi wanao jiita “Kundi la Kiislamu’’. Ni huduma za siri za watu wa mangaribi na washiriki wao waku kula rushwa wa mashariki njo waliifanya.
target_text_raw: Warusi hawafanyake parashuti ya silaha kwa uficho kwa kundi la magaidi wanao jiita “Kundi la Kiislamu’’. Ni huduma za siri za watu wa mangaribi na washiriki wao waku kula rushwa wa mashariki njo waliifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous feriez mieux de tenir vos distances avec Tanaka. Demain comme il a un interview ou quelque chose comme ça, il est vraiment très tendu.
target_text: Ingekuwa mu zuri mu jiepushe na Tanaka. Kwasababu kesho kuko maongezi wala yenye kukuwa sawa vile ni maongezi, ina ngonjelewa kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa mu zuri mu jiepushe na Tanaka. Kwasababu kesho kuko maongezi wala yenye kukuwa sawa vile ni maongezi, ina ngonjelewa kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous aviez besoin de mes conseils, je serais ravi de vous les apporter.
target_text: Kama una niya ya mashauri kutoka kwangu, nita furahi kuikupatiya.
target_text_raw: Kama una niya ya mashauri kutoka kwangu, nita furahi kuikupatiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Doux Jésus !
target_text: Yesu wangu!
target_text_raw: Yesu wangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Retraduire est évidemment plus facile que traduire, avec l'original sous les yeux, forcément...
target_text: Kurulidiya ku tafsiri ni kwepesi sana kuliko ku tafisiri, ukiwa na maandishi ya awali mbeleyako, lakini...
target_text_raw: Kurulidiya ku tafsiri ni kwepesi sana kuliko ku tafisiri, ukiwa na maandishi ya awali mbeleyako, lakini...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Odette l'avait reçu en robe de chambre de soie rose, le cou et les bras nus.
target_text: Odette alimukaribisha na vala kanzu ya rose ya muchumba, shingo na mikono byote wazi.
target_text_raw: Odette alimukaribisha na vala kanzu ya rose ya muchumba, shingo na mikono byote wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plusieurs types traînaient devant le bar.
target_text: Watu wengi wana kawa mbele ya baa.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wana kawa mbele ya baa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trouvé la boucle d'oreille que vous aviez perdue.
target_text: Ni lipata pete ya kulisikiyo yenye ulipoteza.
target_text_raw: Ni lipata pete ya kulisikiyo yenye ulipoteza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le patron décrivit Laurent Dorty comme un employé modèle et apprécié de tous.
target_text: Bosi alivio zungumuziya Laurent Dorty sawa ile mfanya kazi wakuiga na anaye pendewa nakila mutu.
target_text_raw: Bosi alivio zungumuziya Laurent Dorty sawa ile mfanya kazi wakuiga na anaye pendewa nakila mutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ethan est considéré comme le candidat ayant le plus de chances de l'emporter.
target_text: Ethan ana chukuliwa kama vile candidati ambaye iko bahati mingi ya kushinda.
target_text_raw: Ethan ana chukuliwa kama vile candidati ambaye iko bahati mingi ya kushinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Keiko empile la coutellerie de manière efficace et l'amène au lavabo.
target_text: Keiko anapanga visu muzuri na ana zipeleka kwa kusukuliya.
target_text_raw: Keiko anapanga visu muzuri na ana zipeleka kwa kusukuliya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a aidé à s'échapper de la prison.
target_text: Ali musaidiya kutoroka jela.
target_text_raw: Ali musaidiya kutoroka jela.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux amener le livre chez toi tant que tu ne le salis pas.
target_text: Unaweza beba kitabu kwako kama hauta ki chafua.
target_text_raw: Unaweza beba kitabu kwako kama hauta ki chafua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les hommes ne connaissent pas leurs propres droits. Et même quand ils les connaissent, ils ne cherchent pas à les protéger.
target_text: Wana ume hawajuwe haki yao wenyewe. na hatakama wana juwana , hawa tafute kuwa linda.
target_text_raw: Wana ume hawajuwe haki yao wenyewe. na hatakama wana juwana , hawa tafute kuwa linda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des scientifiques polonais effectuent des recherches en Afrique.
target_text: Wa somi wa kipolishi wana fanya utafiti mu Africa.
target_text_raw: Wa somi wa kipolishi wana fanya utafiti mu Africa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu t'appelles Kylia, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Una itwa Kylia, sindio?
target_text_raw: Una itwa Kylia, sindio?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parce que Lee était blessé, le niveau des Stars était beaucoup moins élevé.
target_text: Kwasababu Lee ali umiya, kiwango ya wa sanii ilikuwa chini sana.
target_text_raw: Kwasababu Lee ali umiya, kiwango ya wa sanii ilikuwa chini sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon cœur balance entre la tarte aux myrtilles et la glace à la vanille.
target_text: Roho yangu ina usawa kati ya tarte na myrtilles na barafe ya vanilla.
target_text_raw: Roho yangu ina usawa kati ya tarte na myrtilles na barafe ya vanilla.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dois-je d'abord mettre les pièces ?
target_text: Naweza tiya kwanza hizi sehemu?
target_text_raw: Naweza tiya kwanza hizi sehemu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On doit parfois garder son sang-froid pour faire part de certaine nouvelle.
target_text: Saa zimoya ina takiwa kubakiya kimiya ili upate ku husishwa na habari zingine.
target_text_raw: Saa zimoya ina takiwa kubakiya kimiya ili upate ku husishwa na habari zingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'observation des oiseaux sauvages est un passe-temps formidable.
target_text: Ku angaliya ndege zapori ni kupitisha wakati muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ku angaliya ndege zapori ni kupitisha wakati muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'en est suivi une courte pause, au cours de laquelle on n'entendit que des mots chuchotés isolément.
target_text: Kulifuata mapumziko kidogo wakati yenye hatukusikiya maneno yakisemwa kujitenga.
target_text_raw: Kulifuata mapumziko kidogo wakati yenye hatukusikiya maneno yakisemwa kujitenga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrêtez d'être aussi gentille avec moi !
target_text: Acha kujifanya kuwa mupole kwangu!
target_text_raw: Acha kujifanya kuwa mupole kwangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce diplôme vous permet d'avoir accès à la carrière d'ingénieur.
target_text: Diploma hii inakuwezesha kupata kazi ya kiufundi.
target_text_raw: Diploma hii inakuwezesha kupata kazi ya kiufundi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais où tu gardes ton arme.
target_text: Minajuwa kwenye una weka silaha yako.
target_text_raw: Minajuwa kwenye una weka silaha yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une arme sans balles.
target_text: Ni bunduki ya bila masasi.
target_text_raw: Ni bunduki ya bila masasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nouvelle arme araignée détruit les robots en bondissant et en enveloppant rapidement le robot dans un cocon.
target_text: Silaha mupiya ya vidudu ina ina bomowa ma roboti kwa kupanda juu na kufunga mbiyo roboti ndani ya kifungo cha mauzi.
target_text_raw: Silaha mupiya ya vidudu ina ina bomowa ma roboti kwa kupanda juu na kufunga mbiyo roboti ndani ya kifungo cha mauzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est si doux de vivre ! On ne meurt qu'une fois et c'est pour si longtemps !...
target_text: Ni utamu sana kuishi! Wana kufaka tu limoya na ni kwa wakati murefu sana!...
target_text_raw: Ni utamu sana kuishi! Wana kufaka tu limoya na ni kwa wakati murefu sana!...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bougez votre vélo de là, s'il vous plaît !
target_text: Tafazali, sogeza kinga yako pale!
target_text_raw: Tafazali, sogeza kinga yako pale!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça fout !
target_text: Sibiangaikiye!
target_text_raw: Sibiangaikiye!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le peuple reçoit la religion, les lois, comme la monnaie, sans l'examiner.
target_text: Watu wana pokea dini, sheria, kama pesa, bila kuchunguza.
target_text_raw: Watu wana pokea dini, sheria, kama pesa, bila kuchunguza.
