target_text_raw: Ucheshi ni uwezo waku bakia mchangamushi wakati inakuwa vya maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-moi que tu plaisantes !
target_text: Niambiye kama uko nafanya muzaa!
target_text_raw: Niambiye kama uko nafanya muzaa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à me souvenir de son prénom.
target_text: Si kumbuke jina yake.
target_text_raw: Si kumbuke jina yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fille saute.
target_text: Binti ana ruka.
target_text_raw: Binti ana ruka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voici une recette de caramel de banane qui pourra remplacer avantageusement le Nutella.
target_text: Angalia mapishi ya caramel ya bitika yenye ina weza ondoa faida ya Nutella.
target_text_raw: Angalia mapishi ya caramel ya bitika yenye ina weza ondoa faida ya Nutella.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Y a-t-il une liaison directe entre Varsovie et Berlin ?
target_text: Kuko ambatanisho kati ya Varsovie na Berlin?
target_text_raw: Kuko ambatanisho kati ya Varsovie na Berlin?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme est le seul animal capable de rester en bons termes avec les victimes qu'il se propose de manger, jusqu'à ce qu'il les dévore.
target_text: Mutu ni mnyama pekee ambaye ana ichi kwa uzuri na watu ambao ni majehuri wenye ana pangia kula, mpaka afikiye kuwa luma.
target_text_raw: Mutu ni mnyama pekee ambaye ana ichi kwa uzuri na watu ambao ni majehuri wenye ana pangia kula, mpaka afikiye kuwa luma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel dommage que tu ne saches pas danser !
target_text: Huruma sana mbona haujuwe kucheza!
target_text_raw: Huruma sana mbona haujuwe kucheza!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est normal que ses enfants mettent la main à la pâte pour l'aider à faire le ménage.
target_text: Nikawaida kwa watoto hawa ku tiya mukono mu bunga ili kumusaidiya kufanya kazi za nyumbani.
target_text_raw: Nikawaida kwa watoto hawa ku tiya mukono mu bunga ili kumusaidiya kufanya kazi za nyumbani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et la fée des petits drapeaux s'en revint de sa mission couronnée de succès à son quartier général.
target_text: Na muonekano wa bendera ya kidogo ika toka mu niya yake ikifanyikiwa na mtaa yote.
target_text_raw: Na muonekano wa bendera ya kidogo ika toka mu niya yake ikifanyikiwa na mtaa yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai reçu d'elle ces vieilles pièces de monnaie.
target_text: Nilipata kutoka kwake ile kichele ya kuzeeka.
target_text_raw: Nilipata kutoka kwake ile kichele ya kuzeeka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsqu'ils se sont mariés, ils ont tous deux juré de ne plus jamais mentir.
target_text: Wakati wali owana, wali apa wote hawata danganyana.
target_text_raw: Wakati wali owana, wali apa wote hawata danganyana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'exercice le plus difficile de la médecine consiste à garder son calme et son sourire face aux excès et aux faiblesses des gens qui vous bombardent sans interruption de leurs plaintes et de leurs microbes.
target_text: Mazoezi ya nguvu mu kinganga ina husu ku bakiya kimia na kicheko mbele ya uhalifu na uzaifu wa watu ambao wana kushushia bizuizo ya malalamiko na uchafu yao.
target_text_raw: Mazoezi ya nguvu mu kinganga ina husu ku bakiya kimia na kicheko mbele ya uhalifu na uzaifu wa watu ambao wana kushushia bizuizo ya malalamiko na uchafu yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque votre estomac est occupé à digérer un lourd repas, votre cerveau est en vacances.
target_text: Wakati tumbu yako inafanya kazi ya kusaga chakula yanguvu, akili yako ina pumuzika.
target_text_raw: Wakati tumbu yako inafanya kazi ya kusaga chakula yanguvu, akili yako ina pumuzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était la première fois que je voyais Mathis et Marie danser ensemble.
target_text: Ilikuwa mara ya kwanza minaona Mathis na Marie wakicheza pamoja.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa mara ya kwanza minaona Mathis na Marie wakicheza pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu travailles avec Timéo ?
target_text: Uko natumika na Timeo?
target_text_raw: Uko natumika na Timeo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne manque jamais une occasion de lui faire une remarque sur sa façon de s'habiller.
target_text: Hakosake namna ya kumuonesha ngizi ya kuvala.
target_text_raw: Hakosake namna ya kumuonesha ngizi ya kuvala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Viens me filer un coup de main, s'il te plaît.
target_text: Kuya nisaidiya , Nakuomba.
target_text_raw: Kuya nisaidiya , Nakuomba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai tant de choses en tête que je n’écoute pas mon estomac.
target_text: Niko na mambo ya mingi mu kichwa sifikiye hata kusikiya tumbu yangu.
target_text_raw: Niko na mambo ya mingi mu kichwa sifikiye hata kusikiya tumbu yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon bonus ne permet même pas de couvrir tous les paiements d'emprunts que je dois effectuer.
target_text: Ya kuni ongeza haifikiye hata kulipa deni ambayo na pashwa kulipa.
target_text_raw: Ya kuni ongeza haifikiye hata kulipa deni ambayo na pashwa kulipa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas rater le vol.
target_text: Sitaki kukosa ndege.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kukosa ndege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'idée m'est venue que je ne devrais pas le garder secret.
target_text: Wazo ili nikuiya yakwamba singelipshwa kuiweka siri.
target_text_raw: Wazo ili nikuiya yakwamba singelipshwa kuiweka siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La tâche d'une bonne fée est de protéger quelqu'un durant sa vie.
target_text: Kazi ya muonekano muzuri ni kulinda mutu katika maisha yake.
target_text_raw: Kazi ya muonekano muzuri ni kulinda mutu katika maisha yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De nombreuses personnes ont été bien élevées à ne pas parler la bouche pleine, mais elles n'ont aucune réserve à le faire la tête vide.
target_text: Watu wengi wali fundishiwa muzuri ili wasiseme wakiwa nakitu mu kinywa, lakini hawa chokake nakusema ovio ovio kichwa wazi.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wali fundishiwa muzuri ili wasiseme wakiwa nakitu mu kinywa, lakini hawa chokake nakusema ovio ovio kichwa wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce que tu souhaites enflammer chez les autres doit d’abord brûler au fond de toi-même.
target_text: Ambayo una taka kuwakisha kwa wengine ina pashwa kwanza ku lunguza ndani yako.
target_text_raw: Ambayo una taka kuwakisha kwa wengine ina pashwa kwanza ku lunguza ndani yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Émincez le chou mariné.
target_text: Kata kata chou iliyo sukuliwa.
target_text_raw: Kata kata chou iliyo sukuliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'aurai plus d'amis, parce qu'on souffre trop quand on les perd.
target_text: Sita kuwa na rafiki tena, kwasababu una umiya sana wakati wakipoteya.
target_text_raw: Sita kuwa na rafiki tena, kwasababu una umiya sana wakati wakipoteya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se réveille à midi.
target_text: Ata lamuka mchana.
target_text_raw: Ata lamuka mchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis votre seul espoir, Capitaine. Si vous ne faites pas ce que je dis, vous et votre équipage périrez.
target_text: Niko tumaini yako ya mwisho, Kiongozi. Kama hamufanye ngizi mina wa ambiya, wewe na watu wako muta angamiya.
target_text_raw: Niko tumaini yako ya mwisho, Kiongozi. Kama hamufanye ngizi mina wa ambiya, wewe na watu wako muta angamiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous pouviez seulement parler l'anglais, vous seriez parfaite.
target_text: Ingelikuwa una weza kusema kingereza, ungelikuwa kamili.
target_text_raw: Ingelikuwa una weza kusema kingereza, ungelikuwa kamili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ayant recouvré la santé, il est à même de poursuivre ses études.
target_text: Kwa ali kuwa na afya njema, ali fwatiliya hata masomo yake.
target_text_raw: Kwa ali kuwa na afya njema, ali fwatiliya hata masomo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous naissons faibles, nous avons besoin de force ; nous naissons dépourvus de tout, nous avons besoin d'assistance ; nous naissons stupides, nous avons besoin de jugement.
target_text: Tunazaliwa tukiwa wazaifu, tunataka kupata nguvu ;tuna zaliwa na hatuna kitu, tuna hitaji msaada ; tuna zaliwa kama wajinga, tuna hitaji hukumu.
target_text_raw: Tunazaliwa tukiwa wazaifu, tunataka kupata nguvu ;tuna zaliwa na hatuna kitu, tuna hitaji msaada ; tuna zaliwa kama wajinga, tuna hitaji hukumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À force de le cuisiner, il a fini par lâcher le morceau.
target_text: Kwa kutaka kujikaza kupiga chakula, ali fikiya kupoteza akil.
target_text_raw: Kwa kutaka kujikaza kupiga chakula, ali fikiya kupoteza akil.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Touchez ça ! C'est vraiment doux.
target_text: Gusa hii! Ni kabisa ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Gusa hii! Ni kabisa ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce fut un moment affreux. Il ne dura heureusement pas longtemps.
target_text: Ilikuwa wakati ya kuogopesha. Haita kawa sana kwa bahati muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa wakati ya kuogopesha. Haita kawa sana kwa bahati muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oiseaux construisent un nid au printemps pour élever leurs petits dedans.
target_text: Ndege zina jenga chicha kwa wakati muzuri ili kuchungiya bitoto byayo ndani.
target_text_raw: Ndege zina jenga chicha kwa wakati muzuri ili kuchungiya bitoto byayo ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noah est très heureux maintenant que Marie est venue s'installer avec lui.
target_text: Noa iko na furaha kwa sababu Marie alikuya bakiya kwake sasa.
target_text_raw: Noa iko na furaha kwa sababu Marie alikuya bakiya kwake sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais les accompagner, si vous n'y voyez pas d'inconvénient.
target_text: Ningeli penda wasindikiza, kama hamuone ni mubaya.
target_text_raw: Ningeli penda wasindikiza, kama hamuone ni mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne voulez pas un whisky d'abord ?
target_text: Hautaki whisky kwanza?
target_text_raw: Hautaki whisky kwanza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La longue période de paix cachait les signes précurseurs d'une explosion.
target_text: Wakati mrefu ya amani ilikuwa naweka ishara ya utangulizi wa mlipuko.
target_text_raw: Wakati mrefu ya amani ilikuwa naweka ishara ya utangulizi wa mlipuko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Viens d'abord, on parlera après.
target_text: Kuya kwanza, tuta ongeya nyuma..
target_text_raw: Kuya kwanza, tuta ongeya nyuma..
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas simplement partir. Je dois dire au patron que je pars.
target_text: Siezi enda kwa urahisi. Mina pashwa kuambiya bosi kama mina enda.
target_text_raw: Siezi enda kwa urahisi. Mina pashwa kuambiya bosi kama mina enda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne l'ai pas reconnu, au premier abord.
target_text: Siku mu juwa, kwanza mbele.
target_text_raw: Siku mu juwa, kwanza mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que ça irait si je prenais un congé, la semaine prochaine ?
target_text: Bina eza endeka kama mina kamata siku ya kupumuzika, posho itakayo kuja?
target_text_raw: Bina eza endeka kama mina kamata siku ya kupumuzika, posho itakayo kuja?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Les travailleurs feront non seulement l'expérience de l'utilité de l'espéranto, mais ils percevront mieux que quiconque l'essence et l'idée de l'espérantisme. »
target_text: «Siyo mazoezi tu ambyo isiyo na maana njo wa fanyakazi wa esperanto watafanya, lakini wata gunduwa kama kila mutu hana mafikiri na mawazo ya ki esperantisma.»
target_text_raw: «Siyo mazoezi tu ambyo isiyo na maana njo wa fanyakazi wa esperanto watafanya, lakini wata gunduwa kama kila mutu hana mafikiri na mawazo ya ki esperantisma.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puisque tu le dis, je suis forcé de te croire.
target_text: Kwa sababu una sema , mina lazimika kuku amini.
target_text_raw: Kwa sababu una sema , mina lazimika kuku amini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devrais profiter de l'opportunité d'aller à l'étranger.
target_text: Ungeli pashwa furahiya bahati ya kwenda inje ya inchi.
target_text_raw: Ungeli pashwa furahiya bahati ya kwenda inje ya inchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le patron a une bonne opinion de ton boulot.
target_text: Bosi iko na maoni mazuri kuhusu kazi yako.
target_text_raw: Bosi iko na maoni mazuri kuhusu kazi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu arrêtes de mener.
target_text: Una acha kuongoza.
target_text_raw: Una acha kuongoza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrêtez de vous nourrir d'illusions !
target_text: Acha ku jiweka ndani ya udanganyifu!
target_text_raw: Acha ku jiweka ndani ya udanganyifu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être qu'il verra un jour Marika pendant son séjour en Finlande.
target_text: Wenda ata ona Marika siku ata tembelea Finlande.
target_text_raw: Wenda ata ona Marika siku ata tembelea Finlande.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne supporte pas cette nana qui se croit tout permis.
target_text: Si sikilizanake na u ule binti mwenye ana wazaka ana ruhusiwa kufanya kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Si sikilizanake na u ule binti mwenye ana wazaka ana ruhusiwa kufanya kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de choses se passent, de la coupe aux lèvres.
target_text: Mambo mengi ina pitikana, toka ku kikombe mpaka ku kitabu.
target_text_raw: Mambo mengi ina pitikana, toka ku kikombe mpaka ku kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un agent de voyage va vous organiser une excursion en Andalousie.
target_text: Mutu wa kupanga safari ata panga safari ya mu Andalousie.
target_text_raw: Mutu wa kupanga safari ata panga safari ya mu Andalousie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas étonnant que vous ne pouviez pas ouvrir la porte.
target_text: Hai shangaze kuona hauwezi fungula mlango.
target_text_raw: Hai shangaze kuona hauwezi fungula mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien ne prouve mieux la nécessité d’un mariage indissoluble que l’instabilité de la passion. Les deux sexes doivent être enchaînés, comme des bêtes féroces qu’ils sont, dans des lois fatales, sourdes et muettes.
target_text: Hakuna kitu ina onesha mahitaji ya ndoa isiyovutwa sawa ile kukosa msimamo ya mapendo. Jinsia zote mbili zina pashwa kufundishana, kama vile ni wanyama wa kali,ndani ya sharia za mubaya, viziwi na wa bubu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna kitu ina onesha mahitaji ya ndoa isiyovutwa sawa ile kukosa msimamo ya mapendo. Jinsia zote mbili zina pashwa kufundishana, kama vile ni wanyama wa kali,ndani ya sharia za mubaya, viziwi na wa bubu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puisque les femmes prennent plus de responsabilités au travail et dans la communauté, il est dit que le nombre de femmes souffrant de stress dû à la fois à l'éducation des enfants et au travail augmente.
target_text: Kwa sababu wanamuke wana kamata majukumu ya mingi ku kazi na mu jamaa, inasemeka kama namba ya wanamuke ambao wana sumbuliwa na mafazaiko ina tokana na kuelimisha wa toto na kazi inayo ongezeka.
target_text_raw: Kwa sababu wanamuke wana kamata majukumu ya mingi ku kazi na mu jamaa, inasemeka kama namba ya wanamuke ambao wana sumbuliwa na mafazaiko ina tokana na kuelimisha wa toto na kazi inayo ongezeka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je venais de recevoir votre lettre.
target_text: Nilikuwa nanjo mina toka pokeya barua yako.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nanjo mina toka pokeya barua yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nathan n'a pas de casier judiciaire.
target_text: Nathan hana rekodi ya polisi.
target_text_raw: Nathan hana rekodi ya polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Petit à petit le tas de bois devient cendres.
target_text: Pole pole lundo ya makuni ita geuka majifu.
target_text_raw: Pole pole lundo ya makuni ita geuka majifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous jouez bien au tennis ?
target_text: Una cheza muzuri tenisi?
target_text_raw: Una cheza muzuri tenisi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle prépare un sandwich pour son déjeuner.
target_text: Ana tengeneza mkate kwa chakula cha mchana.
target_text_raw: Ana tengeneza mkate kwa chakula cha mchana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À moins que vous n'aies des preuves, tu ne peux pas l'accuser de vol.
target_text: Akose kama uko na ushahidi, hauwezi ku mustakia wizi.
target_text_raw: Akose kama uko na ushahidi, hauwezi ku mustakia wizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À ce moment-là, l'incident ne semblait pas sérieux.
target_text: kwa wakati ule, tukio ilikuwa haionekane kubwa.
target_text_raw: kwa wakati ule, tukio ilikuwa haionekane kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Retournez dans votre chambre !
target_text: Rudia mu chumba yako!
target_text_raw: Rudia mu chumba yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo et moi sommes potes.
target_text: Enzo na mimi tuko barafiki.
target_text_raw: Enzo na mimi tuko barafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chéri, réveille-toi, il est sept heures.
target_text: Mpenzi, lamuka sasa, ni saa moya.
target_text_raw: Mpenzi, lamuka sasa, ni saa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont vraiment l'air de rats quittant un navire qui sombre.
target_text: Wana onekana kweli kama ma panya zina toka mu chombo cheusi.
target_text_raw: Wana onekana kweli kama ma panya zina toka mu chombo cheusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous étiez bons.
target_text: Mulikuwa muzuri.
target_text_raw: Mulikuwa muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une triste chose de penser que la nature parle et que le genre humain n'écoute pas.
target_text: Ina sikitisha kuwaza kama ulimwengu ina ongeya na kwamba aina ya mutu hai sikiyake.
target_text_raw: Ina sikitisha kuwaza kama ulimwengu ina ongeya na kwamba aina ya mutu hai sikiyake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De là je cours à Troie ; et, couvert de mes armes, / revole dans ses murs affronter les alarmes, / braver, percer encor les nombreux bataillons, / et des feux dévorants franchir les tourbillons.
target_text: Kutokeya pale na kimbia kwa Troie ; na, mina funika silaha zangu, / kurukiya ndani ya kibambazi hii na kupambana na kengele, / ujuzi, ku angusha tena vikosi mingi, / na moto mkali kupita mzunguko wa upepo.
target_text_raw: Kutokeya pale na kimbia kwa Troie ; na, mina funika silaha zangu, / kurukiya ndani ya kibambazi hii na kupambana na kengele, / ujuzi, ku angusha tena vikosi mingi, / na moto mkali kupita mzunguko wa upepo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir, comment allez-vous ?

source_text: L’envie de parler à la paysanne vint au jeune homme, qui trouva lui-même la chose extraordinaire puisque les femmes le gênaient et l’intimidaient extrêmement.
target_text: Nia ya kutaka ongeya na mwanamke masikini kwa kijana, ambaye ali pata mwenyewe mambo ya ajabu kwa sababu wanamuke walikuwa na musumbua na kumu ogopesha sana.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ayant découvert la disparition de nombre de petits objets de la maison, je commence à penser que ma femme de maison a tendance à piquer.
target_text: Kisha kutambua kupotea kwa vitu vidogo vidogo munyumba, na anza kuwaza kama mwanamuke wangu wa munyumba iko na nia ya kugusa gusa.

source_text: Après son diplôme, elle est devenue journaliste dans une agence de presse.

target_text_raw: Akisha kupata diplome, alikuwa mpasha habari mu shirika la habari.

source_text: "J’ai quelque chose dans les talons qui me gêne !" "Et quoi donc ?" " L’estomac !"
target_text: “Kuko kitu niko nayo mu suruali ina nisumbua!” “Nini sasa?” “Tumbu!”
target_text_raw: “Kuko kitu niko nayo mu suruali ina nisumbua!” “Nini sasa?” “Tumbu!”

source_text: Ces points de l'ordre du jour ont été acceptés en bloc pour la discussion.

target_text_raw: Pointi hizi za ajenda ya siku zilikubaliwa kwa sehemu kama maongezi.

source_text: Ça vous aidera à vous garder chaud.
target_text: Ita kusaidiya kukuwa na kifukutu.
target_text_raw: Ita kusaidiya kukuwa na kifukutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est sympa de votre part d'essayer de me protéger.

target_text_raw: Ni muzuri kutoka kwako kutaka kuni linda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ferait tout ce qu'il est possible pour satisfaire les désirs de celle qu'il aime. Mais rien n'était suffisant.
target_text: Ata weza kufanya yote itakayo wezekana kurizisha ule anaye penda. Lakini hakuna kilicho toshelea.
target_text_raw: Ata weza kufanya yote itakayo wezekana kurizisha ule anaye penda. Lakini hakuna kilicho toshelea.

source_text: Tenez votre livre à l’endroit, mademoiselle.
target_text: Kama kitabu chako katika eneo, dada.
target_text_raw: Kama kitabu chako katika eneo, dada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a sauté sur l'occasion.

target_text_raw: Ali rukia kufasi ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de nouvelles entreprises ne trouvent pas de bons spécialistes.
target_text: Campuni za mingi za mupya hazi patake ma bons za muzuri.
target_text_raw: Campuni za mingi za mupya hazi patake ma bons za muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je devais ne garder qu’un livre, ce serait le livre Kunstformen der Natur du biologiste Ernst Haeckel.
target_text: Kama ni ngelipashwa ku chunga kitabu ki moja, ingeli kuwa kitabu ya Kunstformen der Natur ya mubiologia Ernst Haeckel.
target_text_raw: Kama ni ngelipashwa ku chunga kitabu ki moja, ingeli kuwa kitabu ya Kunstformen der Natur ya mubiologia Ernst Haeckel.

source_text: Pouvez-vous me promettre que vous ne ferez pas cela ?

target_text_raw: Unaweza ni haidi kwamba hauta fanya ile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas a eu un rencard avec Marie.

target_text_raw: Thomas alitoka na Marie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'aimer, c'est lutter constamment contre des milliers de forces cachées qui viennent de nous ou du monde.
target_text: Kupendana, ni kupiganisha daima na ma elfu za nguvu zinazo fichwa ambazo zina toka kwetu sisi wala kwa dunia.
target_text_raw: Kupendana, ni kupiganisha daima na ma elfu za nguvu zinazo fichwa ambazo zina toka kwetu sisi wala kwa dunia.

source_text: Lyndon Johnson a succédé à la présidence après que John Kennedy fut assassiné.
target_text: Lyndon Johnson ali ingiya kwenye kiti ya urais baada ya John Kennedy ku uwawa.
target_text_raw: Lyndon Johnson ali ingiya kwenye kiti ya urais baada ya John Kennedy ku uwawa.

source_text: La discussion, mes bons amis, est une terre stérile, croyez-moi, c'est elle qui tue tout.
target_text: Maongezi, rafiki zangu wazuri, ni udongo usiyo zala matunda, muni aminiye, ndiyo ina uwa byote.
target_text_raw: Maongezi, rafiki zangu wazuri, ni udongo usiyo zala matunda, muni aminiye, ndiyo ina uwa byote.

source_text: Mettez le balai dans le placard.
target_text: Weka kifagiyo mu kabati.
target_text_raw: Weka kifagiyo mu kabati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On essayait de te protéger.
target_text: Tulikuwa na jitaidi ku kulinda.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa na jitaidi ku kulinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que feriez-vous si vous aviez, par exemple, dix mille dollars ?
target_text: Nini ungelifanya kama ungelikuwa, kwa mfano na, elfu kumi ya dola?
target_text_raw: Nini ungelifanya kama ungelikuwa, kwa mfano na, elfu kumi ya dola?

source_text: Il y a des fois où je deviens dingue !

target_text_raw: Paire moya ya gants ili bakiya mu taxi.

source_text: Je ne peux pas vérifier si votre courriel est correct ou pas parce qu'il est trop court.
target_text: Siwezi kuchunguza kama barua yako iko sahihi wala hapana kwa sababu ni fupi sana.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kuchunguza kama barua yako iko sahihi wala hapana kwa sababu ni fupi sana.

target_text_raw: Angaliya buwelewele yenye uli jitiya ndani.

source_text: Critiquer est facile, mais on devrait aussi pouvoir mieux le faire. Lessing a réfuté cette opinion universelle dans un essai sur la tâche de critique littéraire.
target_text: Ku kosoa ni kwepesi, lakini tunge pashwa fanya muzuri pia. Lessing alikataa hii maoni inayo julikana ulimwenguni mu kipimo kuhusu jukumu ya kukosoa ya barua.
target_text_raw: Ku kosoa ni kwepesi, lakini tunge pashwa fanya muzuri pia. Lessing alikataa hii maoni inayo julikana ulimwenguni mu kipimo kuhusu jukumu ya kukosoa ya barua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a réalisé qu'elle ferait mieux de dire la vérité.

target_text_raw: Ali tambua kama itakuwa muzuri kusema kweli.

source_text: C’est impressionnant.

target_text_raw: Ina shangaza.

source_text: Le monde change, et nous avons un grand rôle à tenir.

target_text_raw: Dunia ina badilika, na tuko najukumu kubwa ya kushikilia.

target_text_raw: Ali ni angalia kwa muonekano wa kushangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Na tumaini ile mapatano inaeza kuwa ya maana kwa kuleta amani mu dunia.

target_text_raw: Kanali yangu ya video ku YouTube iko na watu muhimu.

target_text_raw: Mbele ya yote, tuta anza kupima michoro yako.

target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nawaza uli lumia.

target_text_raw: Richard, mwenye hakuchoka na kumu sifia, ali uzunishwa kidogo kumuona ana toka wa kwanza.

source_text: L'ajout des différents réactifs doit se faire à un moment bien précis.

target_text_raw: Kuongeza matendo tofauti inapashwa kufanyika kwa wakati muhimu.

target_text_raw: Ni upumbafu kweli.

target_text: Tuliona walinzi wana elekeya kwenye uko, ndiomana tulijificha muka pori.
target_text_raw: Tuliona walinzi wana elekeya kwenye uko, ndiomana tulijificha muka pori.

source_text: Pouvez-vous tenir ces sacs jusqu'à quatre heures de l'après-midi ?

target_text_raw: Unaweza kuchunga mifuku hii mpaka saa kumi za mchana?

source_text: Je ne te parlerai plus de Marika. Je te le promets.

target_text_raw: Kama uko na haja yangu, Uta nipata kusimu yangu.

target_text_raw: Haukukuwa na gonjwa.

target_text_raw: Uta kuya ku sherehe yangu, kama mina kualika? Ndio nitakuya.

target_text: Kwa wakati ile alikuwa nani nyorosha kulibega. “Rafiki yangu”, alisema kwa ngufu, Mina juwa niwakati sasa wa ndoto kutimiya. Kamata ngunfu yako na mikono mbili!”

target_text: Hapo mwanzo ya siku za baridi mu 1805 mpaka 1806, pierre ali pokeya tukaratasi tudogo twa kawaida twa rose ambayo mulikuwa barua ya mualiko. Posta ya maadishi ilikuwa nasema: «Utakutana kwangu mrembo Helene mwenye haba chokake na kuona.»
target_text_raw: Hapo mwanzo ya siku za baridi mu 1805 mpaka 1806, pierre ali pokeya tukaratasi tudogo twa kawaida twa rose ambayo mulikuwa barua ya mualiko. Posta ya maadishi ilikuwa nasema: «Utakutana kwangu mrembo Helene mwenye haba chokake na kuona.»

source_text: "Oui je sais, mais tu devrais essayer celui-là, il est assez différent de celui qu'on trouve d'habitude dans le commerce." "Je te remercie, mais je ne bois pas de ce café non plus."
target_text: «Ndio mina juwa, lakini ungeli pashwa pima ile, iko tofutu na yenye tunapaka mu duka.» «Mina kushukuru, lakini siku nywake hata pia na iyi kahawa.»
target_text_raw: «Ndio mina juwa, lakini ungeli pashwa pima ile, iko tofutu na yenye tunapaka mu duka.» «Mina kushukuru, lakini siku nywake hata pia na iyi kahawa.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai cherché toute la matinée.
target_text: Nili mutafuta asubui yote.
target_text_raw: Nili mutafuta asubui yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De tout le disque, c'est ma piste préférée.
target_text: Mu nyimbo zote, iyi njo nyimbo mina pendaka.
target_text_raw: Mu nyimbo zote, iyi njo nyimbo mina pendaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment en êtes-vous venue à vous intéresser à l'étude des langues ?
target_text: Ulifikiya namna gani ku kuwa na umuhimu wa kusoma wa ma luga?
target_text_raw: Ulifikiya namna gani ku kuwa na umuhimu wa kusoma wa ma luga?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un homme a été grièvement blessé par arme blanche à Paris.
target_text: Mwanaune ali umiya sana na kisu pale Paris.
target_text_raw: Mwanaune ali umiya sana na kisu pale Paris.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un enfant ayant grandi dans plus d’une langue a un sens de la tolérance inné et naturellement un cœur ouvert.
target_text: Mtoto ambaye ali komaliya mu lugha yenye iko na huruma ya ndani na kawaida ya roho kuwa wazi.
target_text_raw: Mtoto ambaye ali komaliya mu lugha yenye iko na huruma ya ndani na kawaida ya roho kuwa wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez votre main devant la bouche, lorsque vous toussez, éternuez ou bâillez !
target_text: Tiya mkono yako ku kinywa, wakati una kohola, kupiga chafya wala kupiga miayo!
target_text_raw: Tiya mkono yako ku kinywa, wakati una kohola, kupiga chafya wala kupiga miayo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est mieux d'être un gagnant qu'un perdant.
target_text: Ni muzuri ku kuwa mshindi kuliko ku kuwa aliye poteza.
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri ku kuwa mshindi kuliko ku kuwa aliye poteza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai couché avec mon patron.
target_text: Nili lalana na bosi wangu.
target_text_raw: Nili lalana na bosi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette nuit, j’ai senti quelqu’un accroupi sur moi, et qui, sa bouche sur la mienne, buvait ma vie entre mes lèvres.
target_text: Usiku huu, nili sikiya mutu ana ni laliya, na ni nani, kinywa yake yulu ya kinywa yangu, akikunywa maisha yangu katikati ya kinywa yangu.
target_text_raw: Usiku huu, nili sikiya mutu ana ni laliya, na ni nani, kinywa yake yulu ya kinywa yangu, akikunywa maisha yangu katikati ya kinywa yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le texte de l'hymne national du Canada a d'abord été écrit en français.
target_text: Maneno ya wimbo ya taifa ya Canada ili andikiwa kwanza mu kifaransa.
target_text_raw: Maneno ya wimbo ya taifa ya Canada ili andikiwa kwanza mu kifaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au frigo il y a du jus d'orange.
target_text: Mu frigo muko juisi ya machungwa.
target_text_raw: Mu frigo muko juisi ya machungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Christ est ressuscité !
target_text: Kirsto ali fufuka!
target_text_raw: Kirsto ali fufuka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Passons en revue les éléments de preuve.
target_text: Acha tupite mukila kitu inayo unda ushahidi.
target_text_raw: Acha tupite mukila kitu inayo unda ushahidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le politiquement correct nous tuera !
target_text: Usahihi ya kisiyasa ita tu uwaka!
target_text_raw: Usahihi ya kisiyasa ita tu uwaka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation ont utilisé plusieurs personnes comme des boucliers humains lors de leurs opérations militaires.
target_text: Ngufu za jeshi zili tumikisha wanadamu kama vile ukuta wakati waki shugulika na mambo yao ya kijeshi.
target_text_raw: Ngufu za jeshi zili tumikisha wanadamu kama vile ukuta wakati waki shugulika na mambo yao ya kijeshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'étiez pas sérieux, si ?
target_text: Hamu ku kuwa nasema kweli , si ndio?
target_text_raw: Hamu ku kuwa nasema kweli , si ndio?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dit : lâchez votre arme !
target_text: Mina sema: achiliya silaha yako!
target_text_raw: Mina sema: achiliya silaha yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laissez-moi d'abord commander une autre bouteille de vin !
target_text: Niache kwanza nilombe ingine chupa ya divai!
target_text_raw: Niache kwanza nilombe ingine chupa ya divai!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouvrez la bouche, je vous prie !
target_text: Fungula kinywa, tafazali na kuomba!
target_text_raw: Fungula kinywa, tafazali na kuomba!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez dit que votre patron était un chic type.
target_text: Ulisema kama bosi wako ni mutu muzuri.
target_text_raw: Ulisema kama bosi wako ni mutu muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous écoute, monsieur le comte, murmura Salomée en rougissant.
target_text: Mina kusikiya, bwana comte, aka ongeya na Salomée kwa sauti kidogo lakini akinungunika.
target_text_raw: Mina kusikiya, bwana comte, aka ongeya na Salomée kwa sauti kidogo lakini akinungunika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que mes opinions ainsi que celles de beaucoup d'autres personnes devraient être prises en compte.
target_text: Mina waza maioni yangu na ya watu wengine ina pashwa ku zingatiwa.
target_text_raw: Mina waza maioni yangu na ya watu wengine ina pashwa ku zingatiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devrez pour cela obtenir l'autorisation de l'académie.
target_text: Kwa hiyo ungelipashwa kupewa ruhusa ya masomo.
target_text_raw: Kwa hiyo ungelipashwa kupewa ruhusa ya masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu sèches mes cours, je te tuerai.
target_text: Uka toroka somo zangu, nita kuuwa.
target_text_raw: Uka toroka somo zangu, nita kuuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sauver le monde demande de la foi et du courage : foi en la raison, et courage pour proclamer ce que la raison démontre être vrai.
target_text: Ku okowa dunia ina lomba imani na ngufu: imani ya sababu, na ngufu ya kutangaza kama sababu iliyo onyesha kama ni kweli.
target_text_raw: Ku okowa dunia ina lomba imani na ngufu: imani ya sababu, na ngufu ya kutangaza kama sababu iliyo onyesha kama ni kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La force imposante des circonstances nous a séparés.
target_text: Ngufu inayo kaza matokeo ili tuachanisha.
target_text_raw: Ngufu inayo kaza matokeo ili tuachanisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jésus a pleuré.
target_text: Jesu ali lia.
target_text_raw: Jesu ali lia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec un peu de chance tu pourras te reposer dans le vol de retour.
target_text: Kwa bahati kidogo uta ikala mu ndege ya kuridiya.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati kidogo uta ikala mu ndege ya kuridiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une belle preuve d'optimisme que de planter un arbre à son âge et d'espérer en manger les fruits !
target_text: Ni ushuhuda muzuri ya matumaini kupanda muti mwaile miaka yake na kutumainiya kukula matunda!
target_text_raw: Ni ushuhuda muzuri ya matumaini kupanda muti mwaile miaka yake na kutumainiya kukula matunda!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il vient, la fête est foutue.
target_text: Akakuya, sherehe ina haribika.
target_text_raw: Akakuya, sherehe ina haribika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense qu'il est hautement improbable que nous puissions nous échapper de cette prison.
target_text: Mina waza kuna uwezekano mukubwa tutoroke mu hii gereza.
target_text_raw: Mina waza kuna uwezekano mukubwa tutoroke mu hii gereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai vraiment marre de mentir.
target_text: Mina choka na kudaganya.
target_text_raw: Mina choka na kudaganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il sombra dans un violent accès de colère contre moi.
target_text: Alizima mu ongezeko ya kugeuka makali juu yangu.
target_text_raw: Alizima mu ongezeko ya kugeuka makali juu yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a un idiot à mon travail et ça m'énerve.
target_text: Kuko pumbafu ku kazi yangu na ina niuzi.
target_text_raw: Kuko pumbafu ku kazi yangu na ina niuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'assure que je suis en parfaite santé.
target_text: Mina ku haki kishiya niko na afya njema.
target_text_raw: Mina ku haki kishiya niko na afya njema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux m'appeler quand tu voudras.
target_text: Una weza kuni ita wakati una penda.
target_text_raw: Una weza kuni ita wakati una penda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais repartir avec vous.
target_text: Nita enda tena naweye.
target_text_raw: Nita enda tena naweye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après que j'en aurai fini, je viendrai à toi.
target_text: Wakati nita maliza, Nita kuya kwako.
target_text_raw: Wakati nita maliza, Nita kuya kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai amené plein de livres pour ne pas m'ennuyer pendant les vingt-quatre heures de vol.
target_text: Nilileta bitabu ya mingi ju nisichoke wakati ya safari ya saa makumi mbili na ine.
target_text_raw: Nilileta bitabu ya mingi ju nisichoke wakati ya safari ya saa makumi mbili na ine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si on t'offre une promotion ailleurs, refuse-la et reste ici !
target_text: Kama bana kupandishia cheo fasi yengine, uta ikatala na kubakiya hapa!
target_text_raw: Kama bana kupandishia cheo fasi yengine, uta ikatala na kubakiya hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sure que beaucoup de gens seraient d'accord avec toi.
target_text: Niko na uhakika kama watu mingi wange kubaliyana na weye.
target_text_raw: Niko na uhakika kama watu mingi wange kubaliyana na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ainsi dit Jupiter ; mais il craint que Didon, / ignorant les destins des enfants d'Ilion, / ne leur ferme les murs de sa cité nouvelle : / il lui députe alors son messager fidèle.
target_text: Na hivio aka sema Jupiter ; lakini ana ogopa kama Didon, / ali upuuza hatima ya watoto wa Ilioni, / aka wafungiya ukuta ya muji wake mupya: / basi aka mtumiya mujumbe wake muaminifu.
target_text_raw: Na hivio aka sema Jupiter ; lakini ana ogopa kama Didon, / ali upuuza hatima ya watoto wa Ilioni, / aka wafungiya ukuta ya muji wake mupya: / basi aka mtumiya mujumbe wake muaminifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je t'amener une boisson ?
target_text: Naweza ku kuleteya kinywaji?
target_text_raw: Naweza ku kuleteya kinywaji?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après dîner, amène ta guitare et nous chanterons.
target_text: Kisha chakula cha muchana, leta gitar yako na tuta imba.
target_text_raw: Kisha chakula cha muchana, leta gitar yako na tuta imba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On discute de manière controversée de Constantin le Grand dans les recherches historiques modernes.
target_text: Tuna ongeleya kwa njia ya ongezeko ya Constantini Mkubwa ndani ya utafiti wa historia za sasa.
target_text_raw: Tuna ongeleya kwa njia ya ongezeko ya Constantini Mkubwa ndani ya utafiti wa historia za sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime les boulettes de pomme de terre fourrées de pâté de foie.
target_text: Napendaka fundo za birayi byenye bina funikiwa mu pate ya maini.
target_text_raw: Napendaka fundo za birayi byenye bina funikiwa mu pate ya maini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je peux te donner deux pièces de deux euros en échange de quatre pièces d'un euro.
target_text: Naweza kutupatia bichele mbili za euros kwa ku badilishiyana na bichele ine ya euro.
target_text_raw: Naweza kutupatia bichele mbili za euros kwa ku badilishiyana na bichele ine ya euro.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'appelle ou c'est toi qui m'appelles ?
target_text: Nikuite wala weye njo uni ite?
target_text_raw: Nikuite wala weye njo uni ite?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un homme sain d'esprit ne ferait pas cela.
target_text: Mutu mwenye iko na akili sawa hafanyake ile.
target_text_raw: Mutu mwenye iko na akili sawa hafanyake ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que vous buvez, les mecs ?
target_text: Muna kunywaka nini, vijana?
target_text_raw: Muna kunywaka nini, vijana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le voyage était bref.
target_text: Safari ilikuwa mufupi.
target_text_raw: Safari ilikuwa mufupi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une paix certaine vaut mieux que l'espérance d'une victoire.
target_text: Bora amani fulani kuliko matumaini ya kushinda.
target_text_raw: Bora amani fulani kuliko matumaini ya kushinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En privé, il se lâche.
target_text: Fasi ambayo hakuna watu, bana ji gusa gusaka.
target_text_raw: Fasi ambayo hakuna watu, bana ji gusa gusaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es formidable !
target_text: Uko wa muzuri!
target_text_raw: Uko wa muzuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'équipe n'a que de bons joueurs.
target_text: Timu iko tu na wachezaji wa muzuri.
target_text_raw: Timu iko tu na wachezaji wa muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a rejoint l'association l'année dernière.
target_text: Ali jiunga na shirika mwaka yenye ili pita.
target_text_raw: Ali jiunga na shirika mwaka yenye ili pita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: «Oui, d'accord,» dit Mme Lee.
target_text: «Ndio, sawa,» ana sema bibi ya Lee.
target_text_raw: «Ndio, sawa,» ana sema bibi ya Lee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, elle n'est pas venue.
target_text: Kwa bahati mubaya, haku kuya.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati mubaya, haku kuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il portait une chemise blanche à col ouvert et une chaînette en or autour du cou.
target_text: Alikuwa na vala shati ya mweupe ya col ya wazi na chainette ya zahabu kushingo.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa na vala shati ya mweupe ya col ya wazi na chainette ya zahabu kushingo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec Gabriel, il faut se tenir sur ses gardes.
target_text: Na Gabriel, Ina faa tu fanye hange.
target_text_raw: Na Gabriel, Ina faa tu fanye hange.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je rigole.
target_text: Mina cheka.
target_text_raw: Mina cheka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demandez Louis. C'est un de mes bons amis.
target_text: Uliza Louis. Ni mu moja wa barafiki yangu.
target_text_raw: Uliza Louis. Ni mu moja wa barafiki yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a plus de balles dans mon arme.
target_text: Hakuna tena masasi mu silaha yangu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna tena masasi mu silaha yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont tué plus de 100 jeunes innocents.
target_text: Wali uwa zaidi ya vijana 100 ambao hawana hatiya.
target_text_raw: Wali uwa zaidi ya vijana 100 ambao hawana hatiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle lui a acheté un appareil photo qui est trop gros pour tenir dans sa poche de chemise.
target_text: Ali muuziya Kamera ya kabambi na haiwezi kubana mu mufuko ya shati yake.
target_text_raw: Ali muuziya Kamera ya kabambi na haiwezi kubana mu mufuko ya shati yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Essaie de le tenir serré de toutes tes forces !
target_text: Pima kuibana na ngufu zako zote!
target_text_raw: Pima kuibana na ngufu zako zote!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoute ! Elle va expliquer cette règle à nouveau.
target_text: Sikiya! Ata anziliya eleze tena kuhusu ile sheria.
target_text_raw: Sikiya! Ata anziliya eleze tena kuhusu ile sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vends pas la peau de l’ours avant de l’avoir tué.
target_text: Usi ujishe ngozi ya nyama mwitu kabla hauya iuwa.
target_text_raw: Usi ujishe ngozi ya nyama mwitu kabla hauya iuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami a déménagé du Connecticut vers la Floride.
target_text: Sami ali hama kutoka Connecticut kwenda Floride.
target_text_raw: Sami ali hama kutoka Connecticut kwenda Floride.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qui a exacerbé mon mécontentement, c'est que son adjoint a refusé de me recevoir.
target_text: Yenye ilifanya ni sirike sana, ni msaidizi wake alikatala kuni pokeya.
target_text_raw: Yenye ilifanya ni sirike sana, ni msaidizi wake alikatala kuni pokeya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation ont détruit tous les puits d'eau potable de ce village.
target_text: Majeshi wali bomola shimu zote za kutosheya ndani maji safi ndani ya iyi kijiji.
target_text_raw: Majeshi wali bomola shimu zote za kutosheya ndani maji safi ndani ya iyi kijiji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La langue italienne meurt un petit peu à chaque fois qu'un anglophone commande « un panini ».
target_text: Luga ya kiitaliano iko na zimika pole pole wakati yenye mungereza ana lomba «mkate moya ya panini».
target_text_raw: Luga ya kiitaliano iko na zimika pole pole wakati yenye mungereza ana lomba «mkate moya ya panini».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'appartiens à un clan.
target_text: Niko wa kabila moya.
target_text_raw: Niko wa kabila moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a encore neigé en Allemagne. Malheureusement, notre lièvre a eu un accident. La livraison aura donc un peu de retard. Néanmoins, Joyeuses Pâques!
target_text: Kulikuwa tena neige mu Ujerumani. Kwa bahati mubaya sungura yetu ili pata ajali. Ukopeyaji kwahiyo itachelewa kidogo. Hata vile, Pasaka Njema!
target_text_raw: Kulikuwa tena neige mu Ujerumani. Kwa bahati mubaya sungura yetu ili pata ajali. Ukopeyaji kwahiyo itachelewa kidogo. Hata vile, Pasaka Njema!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous étiez jalouse de moi.
target_text: Ulikuwa na Anisikiliya wivu.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa na Anisikiliya wivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prions pour une paix parfaite et éternelle.
target_text: Tuombe kwa ajili ya amani kamili na tena ya milele.
target_text_raw: Tuombe kwa ajili ya amani kamili na tena ya milele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça fout, ça !
target_text: Nani ana angaika, na ile!
target_text_raw: Nani ana angaika, na ile!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami semblait se sentir piégé.
target_text: Sami ali jisikiya sawa vile iko mu mutego.
target_text_raw: Sami ali jisikiya sawa vile iko mu mutego.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir se relever les manches si nous voulons terminer ce travail dans les temps !
target_text: Italomba kuacha ku pachika mikono kama tunataka kumaliza hii kazi ku wakati!
target_text_raw: Italomba kuacha ku pachika mikono kama tunataka kumaliza hii kazi ku wakati!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne parviens pas à me rappeler la dernière fois que je vous ai vus aussi excités à propos de quelque chose.
target_text: Si fikiye ku kumbuka siku ya mwisho nili kuona una furahi juya mambo fulani.
target_text_raw: Si fikiye ku kumbuka siku ya mwisho nili kuona una furahi juya mambo fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet appareil produit de l'électricité.
target_text: Iyi chombo ina tosha moto.
target_text_raw: Iyi chombo ina tosha moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aucune arme n'est trouvée.
target_text: Hakuna silaha ambayo ime patikana.
target_text_raw: Hakuna silaha ambayo ime patikana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que nous avions trouvé la cachette parfaite mais la police nous a trouvés.
target_text: Nili waza tume pata fasi ya muzuri ya kuji ficha lakini polisi ili tuona.
target_text_raw: Nili waza tume pata fasi ya muzuri ya kuji ficha lakini polisi ili tuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est difficile à vivre, ne pense qu'à ses besoins et n'écoute pas ce que je dis.
target_text: Ni ngufu kuishi, ana waza ju ya mahitaji yake na hasikiye byenye niko na sema.
target_text_raw: Ni ngufu kuishi, ana waza ju ya mahitaji yake na hasikiye byenye niko na sema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rendre difficile une tâche facile ne donne pas l'air malin.
target_text: Kufanya ngufu kazi ya mwepesi haiku fanye kuwa mwerevu.
target_text_raw: Kufanya ngufu kazi ya mwepesi haiku fanye kuwa mwerevu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça en valait chaque centime.
target_text: Ilikuwa na umuhimu wa kila senti.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa na umuhimu wa kila senti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est difficile de convaincre Jack.
target_text: Ni ngufu kushawishi Jack.
target_text_raw: Ni ngufu kushawishi Jack.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le patron ne veut pas me recevoir.
target_text: Bosi hataki kuni pokeya.
target_text_raw: Bosi hataki kuni pokeya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après une séance de yoga, je me sens tellement « cool ».
target_text: Kisha makao ya yoga, mina jisikiya kabisa «muzuri».
target_text_raw: Kisha makao ya yoga, mina jisikiya kabisa «muzuri».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne me soucie pas particulièrement de ce que vous pensez.
target_text: Siangaike sasa na byenye uko na waza.
target_text_raw: Siangaike sasa na byenye uko na waza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas, vous êtes en sécurité.
target_text: Usijali, uko na usalama.
target_text_raw: Usijali, uko na usalama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon pari a porté ses fruits.
target_text: Pinga yangu ili leta matunda.
target_text_raw: Pinga yangu ili leta matunda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie est venue le lundi et est repartie le jour suivant.
target_text: Marie alikuya siku ya kwanza na aka enda siku ya kufuata.
target_text_raw: Marie alikuya siku ya kwanza na aka enda siku ya kufuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie est une jolie fille, mais elle s'habille de manière ridicule.
target_text: Marie iko na binti muzuri, lakini ana valaka bya kupatisha haya.
target_text_raw: Marie iko na binti muzuri, lakini ana valaka bya kupatisha haya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous commenciez à m'inquiéter.
target_text: Ulikuwa na anza nitiya wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa na anza nitiya wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lucie est jolie, mais elle a un fichu caractère.
target_text: Lucie ni muzuri, lakini iko na tabia za kipumbafu.
target_text_raw: Lucie ni muzuri, lakini iko na tabia za kipumbafu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'abord, parlons de Mathéo.
target_text: Kwanza, tuseme juya Matheo.
target_text_raw: Kwanza, tuseme juya Matheo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrêtez avec vos bêtises !
target_text: Achana na ujinga yako!
target_text_raw: Achana na ujinga yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis enchanté d'être ici.
target_text: Minafurahi ku kuwa hapa.
target_text_raw: Minafurahi ku kuwa hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous quelque autre parent ?
target_text: Uko na muzazi mwengine?
target_text_raw: Uko na muzazi mwengine?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu des gosses ?
target_text: Uko na watoto?
target_text_raw: Uko na watoto?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais au commissariat.
target_text: Mina enda ku polisi.
target_text_raw: Mina enda ku polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était assis là avec un tuyau dans la bouche.
target_text: Alikuwa na ikala na iko na tuyo mu kinywa yake.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa na ikala na iko na tuyo mu kinywa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te couvre pas de ridicule !
target_text: Usi jiteteye na ujinga!
target_text_raw: Usi jiteteye na ujinga!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous vous tenir tranquille, tout le monde ?
target_text: Muna weza ku bakiya kimia, yiye wote?
target_text_raw: Muna weza ku bakiya kimia, yiye wote?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai adoré vous regarder danser.
target_text: Nili furahi ku kuona uko nacheza.
target_text_raw: Nili furahi ku kuona uko nacheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève tes pattes de moi !
target_text: Nyangula migulu yako pamoya na miye!
target_text_raw: Nyangula migulu yako pamoya na miye!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il saura garder son sang-froid.
target_text: Ata juwa kubakiya kimia.
target_text_raw: Ata juwa kubakiya kimia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas réalisé que vous étiez éveillés.
target_text: Sikujuwa kama uli kuwa macho.
target_text_raw: Sikujuwa kama uli kuwa macho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attention, le robot prend tout littéralement et peut être facilement provoqué à attaquer.
target_text: Fanya hange, roboti ina kamata kila kitu iko naona na ika chokozewa ina weza shambulia mbio.
target_text_raw: Fanya hange, roboti ina kamata kila kitu iko naona na ika chokozewa ina weza shambulia mbio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo a un boulot compliqué.
target_text: Matheo iko na kazi ya kusumbua.
target_text_raw: Matheo iko na kazi ya kusumbua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'accepte de mentir.
target_text: Mina itika ku danganya.
target_text_raw: Mina itika ku danganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sois-en bien tranquille ! Je ne veux te charger d'aucun reproche !
target_text: Tuliya sasa! Sita ku shitaki kwa lolote!
target_text_raw: Tuliya sasa! Sita ku shitaki kwa lolote!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon ambition est d'avoir un jour des prairies et des pâturages en abondance, pour pouvoir élever et entretenir un grand nombre de bestiaux et de chevaux.
target_text: Tamani yangu niku pata siku moya milima na mashamba za mingi, juya kuongeza na kutengeneza fasi kubw1 ta ngombe na farasi.
target_text_raw: Tamani yangu niku pata siku moya milima na mashamba za mingi, juya kuongeza na kutengeneza fasi kubw1 ta ngombe na farasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyez-vous ce qui arrive lorsque vous donnez des conseils aux gens ?
target_text: Una ona sasa byenye bina fikaka wakati una patiya watu mashauri?
target_text_raw: Una ona sasa byenye bina fikaka wakati una patiya watu mashauri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne mange pas les fruits qui sont dans le bol sur la table, ils sont en plastique.
target_text: Usikule matunda yenye iko mu bakuli yulu ya meza, niza plastiki.
target_text_raw: Usikule matunda yenye iko mu bakuli yulu ya meza, niza plastiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Occupe-toi de tes fesses.
target_text: Husika na byenye bina kuona.
target_text_raw: Husika na byenye bina kuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qu'il voyait n'était pas un fantôme mais juste le fruit de son imagination.
target_text: Yenye alikuwa naona haiku kuwa kizimu lakini matokeo ya mawazo yake.
target_text_raw: Yenye alikuwa naona haiku kuwa kizimu lakini matokeo ya mawazo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrêtez de rêver.
target_text: Acha kulota.
target_text_raw: Acha kulota.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faire ses cartons, c’est toujours l’occasion de se débarrasser des vieilleries qui nous encombrent.
target_text: Funga zile sanduku, ni wakati waku tupa bitu ya zamani byenye bina tukula fasi.
target_text_raw: Funga zile sanduku, ni wakati waku tupa bitu ya zamani byenye bina tukula fasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donnez-moi le micro !
target_text: Nipatiye chombo ya kutowa sauti!
target_text_raw: Nipatiye chombo ya kutowa sauti!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vérité, c'est que tu mens sans piquer ton fard.
target_text: Ukweli, ni kwamba una sema bongo bila kuji pamba.
target_text_raw: Ukweli, ni kwamba una sema bongo bila kuji pamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens de recevoir une lettre d'une amie disant qu'elle vient me voir la semaine prochaine.
target_text: Nime pata barua ya rafiki yangu ina sema kama ata kuya niona posho inayo fata.
target_text_raw: Nime pata barua ya rafiki yangu ina sema kama ata kuya niona posho inayo fata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous deviez être là à 14 h 30.
target_text: Ungeli pashwa kuwa pale 14h 30.
target_text_raw: Ungeli pashwa kuwa pale 14h 30.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui accepterait de faire ce genre de boulot pour un salaire aussi minable ?
target_text: Nani ana weza itika ku fanya kazi ya pata vile ku malipo ya chini?
target_text_raw: Nani ana weza itika ku fanya kazi ya pata vile ku malipo ya chini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Heureusement qu'elle n'est pas venue.
target_text: Kwa bahati muzuri, haku kuya.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati muzuri, haku kuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quiconque désire se marier doit d'abord convaincre son père.
target_text: Yeyote ana penda ku owa/kuolewa ana pashwa kwanza elewesha baba yake.
target_text_raw: Yeyote ana penda ku owa/kuolewa ana pashwa kwanza elewesha baba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le retour au paradis serait en même temps la fin de la mode vestimentaire, ce qui constituerait un sérieux dilemme pour les femmes.
target_text: Kurudiya muparadizo kwa wakati ile ita kuwa piya mwisho ya kuvala manguo ya sasa, ndio ita kuwa shida kubwa kuÙ banamuke.
target_text_raw: Kurudiya muparadizo kwa wakati ile ita kuwa piya mwisho ya kuvala manguo ya sasa, ndio ita kuwa shida kubwa kuÙ banamuke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un lance-flammes. Il lance des flammes.
target_text: Ni ya kutupa moto. Iko na tupa moto.
target_text_raw: Ni ya kutupa moto. Iko na tupa moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne me suis pas réveillée avant midi.
target_text: Siku lamuka asubui.
target_text_raw: Siku lamuka asubui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Protester sans avoir été questionné est souvent preuve de culpabilité.
target_text: Kudaiya bila kuulizwa swali mara mingi ina onesha kukuwa na boga.
target_text_raw: Kudaiya bila kuulizwa swali mara mingi ina onesha kukuwa na boga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Même en m'arrêtant, en me torturant et en m'assassinant, vous ne pourrez jamais effacer mes écrits.
target_text: Hata kwa kuni simamisha, kwa kunitesa na kuni uwa, hauta vuta kamwe maandiko yangu.
target_text_raw: Hata kwa kuni simamisha, kwa kunitesa na kuni uwa, hauta vuta kamwe maandiko yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu ne veux pas assister aux classes du séminaire sur « Combattre la corruption en entreprise », alors tu peux juste payer 200 hryvni et recevoir le certificat.
target_text: Kama haupendi ku kushiriki ku ma somo ya semina kuhusu «Kupiganisha rushwa mu ma campuni», kumbe sasa una weza lipa hryvni 200 juu upate cheti.
target_text_raw: Kama haupendi ku kushiriki ku ma somo ya semina kuhusu «Kupiganisha rushwa mu ma campuni», kumbe sasa una weza lipa hryvni 200 juu upate cheti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La volonté de Dieu d'abord.
target_text: Mapenzi ya Mungu kwanza.
target_text_raw: Mapenzi ya Mungu kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allé à Sapporo en mission et j'ai dépassé mon budget.
target_text: Nili enda Sapporo kwenye mu utume na bageti yangu ika zidisha.
target_text_raw: Nili enda Sapporo kwenye mu utume na bageti yangu ika zidisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est dommage que je n'ai pas pu le convaincre de se joindre à nous.
target_text: Inasikitisha kuona sikuweza mu shawishi a ungane na siye.
target_text_raw: Inasikitisha kuona sikuweza mu shawishi a ungane na siye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vas-y, je te rejoins bientôt.
target_text: Wende, Niko na kufata nyuma.
target_text_raw: Wende, Niko na kufata nyuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrêtez de faire semblant de ne pas comprendre.
target_text: Acha kufanya sawa ngizi hausikiye.
target_text_raw: Acha kufanya sawa ngizi hausikiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque ma mère exerçait encore, elle avait de nombreux patients germanophones, mais maintenant, elle n'a plus jamais l'occasion de pratiquer son allemand.
target_text: Wakati mama yangu alikuwa na tumika, alikuwa na wagonjwa wengi wa kuongeya kijerumani, lakini sasa, hana tena njia kufanya mazoezi ya kuji funza kijerumani.
target_text_raw: Wakati mama yangu alikuwa na tumika, alikuwa na wagonjwa wengi wa kuongeya kijerumani, lakini sasa, hana tena njia kufanya mazoezi ya kuji funza kijerumani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Descendez de cet arbre !
target_text: Shuka mwa ile muti!
target_text_raw: Shuka mwa ile muti!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne l'ai pas volée. Je l'ai simplement empruntée sans permission.
target_text: Sikuiba ayo. Nili jilazima ayo tu bila kulomba ruhusa.
target_text_raw: Sikuiba ayo. Nili jilazima ayo tu bila kulomba ruhusa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'Histoire se répète à nouveau.
target_text: Historia ina rudiliya tena bupya.
target_text_raw: Historia ina rudiliya tena bupya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regrette d'avoir manqué cette occasion.
target_text: Mina sikitika kukosa ile bahati.
target_text_raw: Mina sikitika kukosa ile bahati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami a avalé une bouteille entière de pilules.
target_text: Sami ali meza chupa muzima ya ma dawa.
target_text_raw: Sami ali meza chupa muzima ya ma dawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aïe ! Une abeille m’a piqué au cou !
target_text: Ayi! Nyuki ina ni luma ku chingo!
target_text_raw: Ayi! Nyuki ina ni luma ku chingo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce bâtiment a une faible empreinte écologique.
target_text: Hii jengo iko na muonekano wa chini wa kiikologia.
target_text_raw: Hii jengo iko na muonekano wa chini wa kiikologia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, j'ai demandé six fois.
target_text: Ndio, nili uliza mara sita.
target_text_raw: Ndio, nili uliza mara sita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a identifié l'enfant perdu par ses vêtements.
target_text: Bali tambua mutoto aliye poteya ku manguo yake.
target_text_raw: Bali tambua mutoto aliye poteya ku manguo yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Tu voudrais bien m'appeler un taxi s'il te plaît ?" "Ok, un taxi s'il te plaît."
target_text: «Una weza ni itiya taxi tafazali?» «Sawa, taxi moya tafazali.»
target_text_raw: «Una weza ni itiya taxi tafazali?» «Sawa, taxi moya tafazali.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je cherche Andy. Savez-vous où il est ?
target_text: Niko natafuta Andy. Una juwa kwenye iko?
target_text_raw: Niko natafuta Andy. Una juwa kwenye iko?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais d'abord finir avec le salon, et après je m'attaque à la cuisine.
target_text: Nita maliza kwanza mu salon, na kisha mina fuatana na mafiga.
target_text_raw: Nita maliza kwanza mu salon, na kisha mina fuatana na mafiga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu me promettre que tu ne diras rien à Gabriel ?
target_text: Una weza ni haidi hauta ambiya kitu Gabriel?
target_text_raw: Una weza ni haidi hauta ambiya kitu Gabriel?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu te rappelles mieux les choses que moi.
target_text: Una kumbuka bitu muzuri kuni shinda.
target_text_raw: Una kumbuka bitu muzuri kuni shinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le monde est un chaos, et son désordre excède tout ce qu'on y voudrait apporter de remède.
target_text: Dunia ina angamiya, na shida yake ina pita yote ambayo ingepashwa fanyika kama vile suluhisho.
target_text_raw: Dunia ina angamiya, na shida yake ina pita yote ambayo ingepashwa fanyika kama vile suluhisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Ça va ? Pas trop blessée ? » « Non non, ça va très bien. Je suis même ravie que ça l’ait fait me parler en toute franchise. » « Je vois. Tant mieux. »
target_text: «Ni sawa? Hauku umiya sana?» «Hapana, ni sawa kabisa. Mina furahi ju ilimufanya ani ongeleshe na ukweli yote.» «Mina ona. Ni muzuri.»
target_text_raw: «Ni sawa? Hauku umiya sana?» «Hapana, ni sawa kabisa. Mina furahi ju ilimufanya ani ongeleshe na ukweli yote.» «Mina ona. Ni muzuri.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kim et moi sommes du même âge.
target_text: Kim na miye tuko na miaka sawa.
target_text_raw: Kim na miye tuko na miaka sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On me dit qu'"idiot" est un gros mot, mais là où j'ai grandi ce n'était pas le cas.
target_text: Wana ni ambiya kama «mujinga» ni kutukana, lakini kwenye nili komaliya haiko vile.
target_text_raw: Wana ni ambiya kama «mujinga» ni kutukana, lakini kwenye nili komaliya haiko vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et d'abord, je ne disposais pas des moyens de le faire.
target_text: Na kwanza, siku kuwa na uwezo ya kuifanya.
target_text_raw: Na kwanza, siku kuwa na uwezo ya kuifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le patron est très fâché.
target_text: Bosi ana sirika.

target_text_raw: Kama una gusa ku buto, motere ita zimika.

source_text: Plus d'heures je travaille, plus faible est mon salaire horaire net.

target_text_raw: Ngizi saa zamingi niko na tumika, na njo ngizi mushahara iko chini sana kwa saa.

target_text_raw: Ali fuku ziwa kwa sababu ya wizi.

source_text: Je n'oublierai jamais cette femme gentille et aimante.

target_text_raw: Siwezi sahau siku zote ule mwanamuke mwema na tena mwenye upendo.

source_text: Les avions de combat décollèrent pour intercepter un avion de ligne qui déviait de sa trajectoire de vol.
target_text: Ndege za vita zika jitayarisha kuruka juu ya ku zuiya ndege ambayo ilitoka kumustari yake angani.

target_text_raw: Haku uliza kitu na aka bakiya na mashaka yake.

source_text: Qui rêve mal, ne récupère pas la nuit.

target_text_raw: Mwenye ali lota mubaya, hawezi ku sinzia tena usiku.

source_text: Tu commences sérieusement à me les briser.

source_text: Je promets de mener.

target_text_raw: Mina haidi ku tafuta.

source_text: À l'approche de l'automne, beaucoup de gens souffrent d'une légère forme de dépression, qu'on peut soigner par luminothérapie.
target_text: Karibu ya kivuli, watu wengi wali teseka na shida kidogo ya akili, ambayo ina weza tunziwa na utunzo ya kutunza matatizo yaku tokana na mwanagaza.

source_text: Louis Pasteur découvrit que les bactéries causent la plupart des maladies infectieuses.
