target_text_raw: Nilikuwa na fanya ulizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas mon objectif d'enquêter sur l'impact de la théorie d'Emmet sur la biologie.
target_text: Haiko niya yangu ya kufanya uchunguzi kuhusu hatari ya maelezo ya Emmet juu ya biologia.
target_text_raw: Haiko niya yangu ya kufanya uchunguzi kuhusu hatari ya maelezo ya Emmet juu ya biologia.

source_text: Mettez tout sur ma note. Je le réglerai en partant.

target_text_raw: Tiya yote ku karatasi. Nita itengeneza wakati ndaenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les atomes ne peuvent pas être vus à l'œil nu.
target_text: Ma atomu hazi pashwe kuonekana kwa macho wazi.
target_text_raw: Ma atomu hazi pashwe kuonekana kwa macho wazi.

source_text: Essayez-le et voyez ce qui se passera.

target_text_raw: Ipime na uone nini njo ita tokeya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a élu Jim capitaine de notre équipe de baseball.

target_text_raw: Tuli chaguwa Jim kaptene wa timu yetu ya baseball.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chances que les vrais conspirateurs soient découverts sont quasi-nulles.
target_text: Bahati ya kupata walio husika niza bure bure kabisa.
target_text_raw: Bahati ya kupata walio husika niza bure bure kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous vérifier la pression des pneus ?

target_text_raw: Unaweza angaliya pumuzi za pneus?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le travail, toujours plus précaire et incertain, ne parvient plus à créer une identité professionnelle stable.
target_text: Kazi, kilasiku ni ngufu sana na bila uhakika, sifikiye tena ku tengeza kitambulisho ya kiufundi kamili.

source_text: Retournons au motel.

target_text_raw: Turudiye ku motel.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous les jeudis soirs, ils se retrouvent autour d'une table pour jouer au tarot ou au poker.

target_text_raw: Kila siku ya ine mangaribi, wana kutanana ku meza moya juu ya kucheza tarot wala poker.

source_text: Il n'est pas facile d'abattre un oiseau en plein vol.

target_text_raw: Haiko kwepesi ku uwa ndege yenye iko na ruka angani.

target_text_raw: Chumba ya viongozi ili amua kwa umoja ku mchaguwa rais.

source_text: Raphaël était hier soir, seul au bar à bières.

target_text_raw: Raphael alikuwa jana mangaribi, yepeke ku baa ya pombe.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles regardent sa belle rose.

target_text_raw: Wana angalia rosi yao ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pensé que vous étiez sérieux.
target_text: Nilikuwa nawaza uli kuwa nasema kweli.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nawaza uli kuwa nasema kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'entreprise décida de rabioter sur la qualité de ses produits pour améliorer sa marge de profit.
target_text: Campuni ika amua ku chunguza sifa ya upato yake juu ya kuongeza kiwango ya faida.
target_text_raw: Campuni ika amua ku chunguza sifa ya upato yake juu ya kuongeza kiwango ya faida.

source_text: Arrêtez de vous mentir à vous-même !

target_text_raw: Mu ache ji dangaya nyiye peke!

source_text: Seigneur, écoute ma prière !

target_text_raw: Bwana, sikiya maombi yangu!

source_text: C'est bon de se souvenir de ceux qui vont au lit le ventre vide.

target_text_raw: Ni muzuri ku kumbuka wale ambao wana na lala bila ku kula.

source_text: Une personne qui propose une marchandise, est un vendeur.

target_text_raw: Mutu mwenye kueleza juya muzigo, ni mwenye kuuzisha.

target_text_raw: Pasula mayayi na achanisha ya mwekunda na ya mweupe.

target_text_raw: Niwale ndio wali okoka, hatakama nyumba ili bomoka.

source_text: Selon les Ehl Eltahik, l'univers se compose d'une seule substance, et tout ce qu'on appelle générations et corruptions, mort et vie, n'est qu'une certaine combinaison ou dissolution de modes.
target_text: Ku fuatana na Ehl Eltahik, ulimwengu ina tunga kitu moya, na kila wanayo ita vizazi na rushwa, kifo na maisha, ni mchanganyiko tu wala kondolewa ya njia.

source_text: « Aujourd'hui est une belle journée pour mourir, vous ne trouvez pas ? » dit le chevalier, soulevant la rapière en souriant, se préparant à attaquer les dix rivaux qui l'entouraient.
target_text: «Leo ni siku muzuri ya ku kufa, hau one?» aka sema askari, aki nyangula upanga akiwa na cheka, aki jitayarishha ku vaamiya wapinzani kumi ambao walikuwa na wa zunguluka.

target_text_raw: Watu wana angaliliya mambo kwa tofauti hata ikuwe tajiri wala wa maskini.

target_text_raw: Uta fanya nini kama haupate chakula ya kutosha ya kupatiya jamaa yako?

target_text_raw: Mina enda uza tiketi moya, sasa ni chungiye sakoshi zangu kwa dakika moya, tafazali.

target_text_raw: Usifanye kitu ambayo ina eza acha una shangala.

target_text_raw: Unawaza nilikuwa nataka kusikia?

target_text_raw: Haina maana kumu ambiya. Hasikiyake.

source_text: Ces derniers font pitié.

target_text_raw: Iyi ya mwisho ina leta huruma.

target_text_raw: Nili liya siku yote sa pumbafu sababu yako tu.

target_text_raw: Kuko mutu iko na silaha kumukono ana simama pale ku mulango.

target_text_raw: Juya nini hauku andika mambo ya maana?

source_text: Vous apprenez plus en essayant de réparer une TV qu'en la regardant.
target_text: Una jifunza mingi kwa kutaka ku tengeneza runinga kuliko kui angaliya.
target_text_raw: Una jifunza mingi kwa kutaka ku tengeneza runinga kuliko kui angaliya.

source_text: Cela ne vous fera pas de mal de vous trouver ridicule. Résignez-vous à être l'idiot que vous êtes.
target_text: Ile haita ku kwaza uka jikuta uko mujinga. Dumu kwa kukuwa mujinga kama vile uko.
target_text_raw: Ile haita ku kwaza uka jikuta uko mujinga. Dumu kwa kukuwa mujinga kama vile uko.

target_text_raw: Alikuwa kimia kidogo mwa hizi masiku.

target_text_raw: Tuna pashwa kurudiya kwenye chombo iko.

source_text: Tu devrais emmener ta voiture à Kylia's Garage. Il fait un plutôt bon travail.

source_text: Le gouvernement considère la travail constructif sur la paix comme un principe de base.

target_text_raw: Kama una sahau ku kunywa dawa siku moya, kunywa mbili mu siku ya kufata.

target_text_raw: Iko sawa vile wakati ya kurudiya kumasomo, hauone?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous assure que je suis en parfaite santé.

source_text: Une règle utile : Réfléchis avant de commencer.

target_text_raw: Sheria moya ya ovio: Waza mbele ya kuanza.

target_text_raw: Tuna jitesa sana kweli juya kuanisha ule pumbafu!

source_text: Mais trop d'information tue l'information.

target_text_raw: Lakini habari za mingi zina uwa habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veux-tu prendre le petit-déjeuner, chéri ?

target_text_raw: Una penda ukunywe chai, mpenzi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Inutile de la motiver, elle ne change pas.

target_text_raw: Nibure ku musaidiya, ha badilikake.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais vu pareil tir.
target_text: Siya onaka ku fiatura kama iyi.
target_text_raw: Siya onaka ku fiatura kama iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne vous souvenez de rien ?
target_text: Hau kumbuke kitu?
target_text_raw: Hau kumbuke kitu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle nous a préparé un merveilleux repas.
target_text: Ali tu tayarishia chakula ya butamu.
target_text_raw: Ali tu tayarishia chakula ya butamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce que vous direz pourra être utilisé contre vous.
target_text: Yote uta sema ina weza kugeukiya.
target_text_raw: Yote uta sema ina weza kugeukiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Monica n'étudie pas beaucoup.
target_text: Monica hasomake mingi.
target_text_raw: Monica hasomake mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ignorais que vous étiez aussi bons en français.
target_text: Nili kuwa sijuwa kama uko muzuri mu kuongeya kifaransa .
target_text_raw: Nili kuwa sijuwa kama uko muzuri mu kuongeya kifaransa .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment ? Tu fais déjà la pause de midi ?
target_text: Aye? Una chukuwa tayari mapumuziko ya muchana?
target_text_raw: Aye? Una chukuwa tayari mapumuziko ya muchana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je vous amener une boisson ?
target_text: Naweza ku kuleteya kinywaji?
target_text_raw: Naweza ku kuleteya kinywaji?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu as besoin que je t'amène ?
target_text: Unataka niku peleke?
target_text_raw: Unataka niku peleke?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est un démon du travail.
target_text: Iko pepo ya jazi.
target_text_raw: Iko pepo ya jazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette intéressante fonction est-elle précisément ce que tu recherches ? Alors réagis vite avec ton CV et ta lettre de motivation.
target_text: Iyi kazi yaku furahisha njo ile yenye ulikuwa na tafuta sasa? Sasa amua mbio na CV yako na barua ya kuomba kazi.
target_text_raw: Iyi kazi yaku furahisha njo ile yenye ulikuwa na tafuta sasa? Sasa amua mbio na CV yako na barua ya kuomba kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis Enzo, tu t'appelles comment?
target_text: Miye njo Enzo, una itwa nani?
target_text_raw: Miye njo Enzo, una itwa nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sois prudent en ouvrant la bouteille ! Chaque goutte de perdue serait dommage.
target_text: Fanya hange sauna fungula chupa! Kila toni ya kupoteza ita kuwa shida.
target_text_raw: Fanya hange sauna fungula chupa! Kila toni ya kupoteza ita kuwa shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'investis corps et âme dans ce nouveau projet. Je sais qu'à force d'y consacrer du temps et de l'énergie, cela payera. Cela finit toujours par payer.
target_text: Mina jitoa kwa roho na mwili ndani ya mpango hii. Mina juwa kwa kujikaza kutimia wakati na ngufu, ita lipa. Mwisho ina fikiyaka tu kulipa.
target_text_raw: Mina jitoa kwa roho na mwili ndani ya mpango hii. Mina juwa kwa kujikaza kutimia wakati na ngufu, ita lipa. Mwisho ina fikiyaka tu kulipa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne réalise pas ce qu'on rate tant qu'on ne l'a pas perdu.
target_text: Hauwezi tambua kyenye uko nakyo kabla hauya kipoteza.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi tambua kyenye uko nakyo kabla hauya kipoteza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serai bref.
target_text: Nita sema kwa kufupi.
target_text_raw: Nita sema kwa kufupi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est que le bonheur me rend triste ; il me force à penser au malheur qui le suit toujours de près.
target_text: Nikama furaha ina nifanya ni kuwe na uzuni ; ana nikaza kuwaza juya mateso ambayo ina mufata kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Nikama furaha ina nifanya ni kuwe na uzuni ; ana nikaza kuwaza juya mateso ambayo ina mufata kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viendrai vous voir aussitôt que je le pourrai.
target_text: Ndakuya haraka ngizi ndaweza.
target_text_raw: Ndakuya haraka ngizi ndaweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je profiterai de mon voyage d'affaire à Hong Kong pour passer te voir, histoire de lier l'utile à l'agréable.
target_text: Nda kamata nafasi mu safari yangu ya biashara kule Hong Kong ku kuya kuona, hadisi ya kuunganisha ya maana ku ya kupendeza.
target_text_raw: Nda kamata nafasi mu safari yangu ya biashara kule Hong Kong ku kuya kuona, hadisi ya kuunganisha ya maana ku ya kupendeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous possédez uniquement des antigènes B, votre groupe sanguin est B.
target_text: Kama uko tu na antigeni B, aina yako ya damu ni B.
target_text_raw: Kama uko tu na antigeni B, aina yako ya damu ni B.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir monsieur Müller, puis-je vous présenter ma femme ?
target_text: Mangaribi njema bwana Muller, naweza ku tembulusha bibi yangu mbele yako?
target_text_raw: Mangaribi njema bwana Muller, naweza ku tembulusha bibi yangu mbele yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle formidable machine !

target_text_raw: Mashine ya muzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On pouvait douter de ses appas, même après le deuxième verre de vin.

target_text_raw: Tulikuwa na shaka ya ku furahisha yake, hata kisha ku kunywa verre mbili ya divai.

target_text_raw: Lee Leffingwell ana shimania baraza ya mashauri ya muji ya Austin.

source_text: Ce mémorandum sera publié au Registre Fédéral.
target_text: Barua ya kumbukumbu ita tangazwa mu rekodi ya serikali.
target_text_raw: Barua ya kumbukumbu ita tangazwa mu rekodi ya serikali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette infirmière est très gentille et polie.
target_text: Huyu mganga ni mu pole tena iko na adabu.
target_text_raw: Huyu mganga ni mu pole tena iko na adabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ferais tout pour ces gamins.

target_text_raw: Ndaweza fanya yote juya hawa watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis très contente que l'école soit finie.
target_text: Mina furahi sana ju masomo ina isha.
target_text_raw: Mina furahi sana ju masomo ina isha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme quelqu'un qui cherche une puce sur la tête d'un chauve.

target_text_raw: Kama mutu mwenye alikuwa na tafuta kitu ku kichwa ya kipara.

source_text: Laisse mon appareil photo tranquille.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon approche est différente.
target_text: Maoni yangu iko tofauti.
target_text_raw: Maoni yangu iko tofauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ose me tenir tête encore une seule fois, et je te mets en service de nuit.

target_text_raw: Pima tena ni gangiya limoya, na mina kutiya lu kazi za usiku.

target_text_raw: Juya nini uko na nipatiya makuta? Haiko sawa.

target_text_raw: Ku kimbiya yangu, mina zungurukaka Central Park kila siku, saa kumi na mbili za asubui.

source_text: Ce n’est pas le paradis, mais ça va moins mal qu’ailleurs.

target_text_raw: Haiko paradizo, lakini binaendeka kidogo kushinda kule.

source_text: Les relations avec le Canada demeurent empreintes de justice et de paix.

target_text_raw: Nilisahau kufanya kazi!

target_text_raw: Alisha choka na «kazi» yake kama vile mwanamuke mu bunyumba.

target_text_raw: Kusema kweli, mpendwa, ile njo shida ya mwisho kwangu!

target_text_raw: Ni wakati muzuri!

target_text_raw: Na haiku angaishe, weye?

source_text: L'essence est un peu moins chère en libre service, maintenant que la dérégulation entre en vigueur.

target_text_raw: Iko mu gereza? Si shangale juya ile.

source_text: De quelque manière que tu le fasses, le résultat n'est pas différent.

target_text_raw: Ata munjia yenye uko una ifanya, matokeo haiko tofauti.

target_text_raw: Batu mingi bana si mama mu koridoro ya mauti izi siku, wana chunga miujiza ikuwe.

target_text_raw: Siku kuwa najuwa kama ulikuwa na choka.

target_text_raw: Ina wezekana ni ku chaguwe.

target_text_raw: Mina owa mwanamuke ambaye ali soma sheria.

target_text_raw: Sami ali kaza Layla afiche mwili ya Farid.

source_text: Elle n'était pas jolie, mais avait de grands et beaux yeux marrons et un doux sourire.

target_text_raw: Haku kuwa muzuri, lakini alikuwa na macho ya muzuri yaku angara na cheko ya muzuri.

source_text: La politesse est comme un coussin d'air : il peut bien ne rien y avoir dedans mais ça adoucit les à-coups de la vie.
target_text: Adabu nisawa na segamiyo ya hewa: ndani muna weza kuwa hamuna kitu lakini ina punguza shida za maisha.

target_text_raw: Neno taifa inatumiwa mubaya sana mpaka hatuwezi kusema yoyote ya kawaida wala ya kweli.

source_text: Tu ne dois pas acheter une chose aussi chère parce que tes parents sont riches.

target_text_raw: Hauwezi uza kitu ya beyi kali vile ju aseme wa zazi wako ni wa tajiri.

target_text_raw: Maneno «raha uwerevu» inakuwaka tu mu kifaransa.

target_text_raw: Mitandao ya Japani iko imara sana.

source_text: On appelle demi-frères et sœurs, deux enfants qui ont la même mère mais des pères différents.
target_text: Wana itaka kaka-mudogo na dada-mudogo, watoto wa wili benye biko na mama mu moja lakini wa baba tofauti.

source_text: Lorsque l'on ne trouve pas la satisfaction en nous, il est inutile de la chercher ailleurs.

target_text_raw: Wakati mutu hawezi kujitoshelea yepeke, haina maana kutafuta fasi yengine.

target_text_raw: Hugo alisha fika ku nyumba ina furahisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Watoto, ni wakati yangu ya kuenda!

source_text: D'abord, il fait ses exercices, et ensuite il va jouer au basket.
target_text: Kwanza, ili omba iyi mazoezi ikuwe, na kisha ata enda cheza mchezo ya kikapo.
target_text_raw: Kwanza, ili omba iyi mazoezi ikuwe, na kisha ata enda cheza mchezo ya kikapo.

source_text: Le concombre tueur est sexiste.

target_text_raw: Tango ya kuuwa iko na ubaguzi ya jinsia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu veux te laver, prépare d'abord la serviette pour t'essuyer.
target_text: Wakati una penda nawa, tayarisha kwanza esume zuya kuji panguza.
target_text_raw: Wakati una penda nawa, tayarisha kwanza esume zuya kuji panguza.

source_text: Théo est de toute évidence inquiet.

target_text_raw: Théo iko na wasiwasi kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En employant des mercenaires des sociétés privées américaines, le nouveau gouvernement ukrainien fera bien profiter ses amis américains en payant les services de sécurité que ces derniers lui fourniront avec l'argent du contribuable ukrainien.
target_text: Kwa kutumikisha wa mercenaires ba mu campuni ya kipee ya marekani, serikali ya mupya ya ukraine ika patiya wa rafiki yabo wa marekani faida ambayo ni makuta zenye ziko na lipiwa ku michango yawa ukraine.
target_text_raw: Kwa kutumikisha wa mercenaires ba mu campuni ya kipee ya marekani, serikali ya mupya ya ukraine ika patiya wa rafiki yabo wa marekani faida ambayo ni makuta zenye ziko na lipiwa ku michango yawa ukraine.

source_text: Je bois un whisky et elle boit un jus de pomme.
target_text: Niko na kunywa wiski naye iko na kunwya juisi ya pomme.
target_text_raw: Niko na kunywa wiski naye iko na kunwya juisi ya pomme.

source_text: Ce distributeur n'accepte que les pièces de 100 yen.

target_text_raw: Hii mashini ya bichele haitikake bichele ya 100 za yen.

source_text: Je veux que tu sois revenue.

target_text_raw: Mina penda urudiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous trois êtes en état d'arrestation.
target_text: Nyiye batatu muko chini ya ulinzi.
target_text_raw: Nyiye batatu muko chini ya ulinzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas réalisé que vous étiez éveillée.

target_text_raw: Sikujuwa kama uli kuwa macho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas qui est ce gamin.

target_text_raw: Sijuwe ni nani huyu mtoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne saura jamais la vérité.
target_text: Hata juwaka kamwe ukweli.
target_text_raw: Hata juwaka kamwe ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Montez au 3e étage s'il vous plait.
target_text: Panda ku etage ya tatu tafazali.
target_text_raw: Panda ku etage ya tatu tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sean Connery a commencé à devenir chauve à l'âge de vingt-et-un ans.
target_text: Sean Connery ali anza kukuwa na kipara mu miaka makumi mbili na moya.
target_text_raw: Sean Connery ali anza kukuwa na kipara mu miaka makumi mbili na moya.

source_text: Il lui a sous-tiré une promesse de force.

target_text_raw: Ali mupa ahadi kidogo kwa kingufu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce problème a l'air simple au premier abord, mais il est en fait assez compliqué.
target_text: Hii shida ina onekana kwanza niya mwepesi, lakini iko na infanya yangufu.
target_text_raw: Hii shida ina onekana kwanza niya mwepesi, lakini iko na infanya yangufu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je devais tout recommencer, je ne changerais rien.
target_text: Kama ninge anzilia, siwezi geuza kitu.
target_text_raw: Kama ninge anzilia, siwezi geuza kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voyez la maison blanche ?
target_text: Uko na ona nyumba ya mweupe?
target_text_raw: Uko na ona nyumba ya mweupe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma femme attrape facilement froid.
target_text: Bibi yangu anapataka baridi mbiyo.
target_text_raw: Bibi yangu anapataka baridi mbiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as déjà détruit ma carrière et ma réputation. Que veux-tu de plus?
target_text: Ulisha ni haribishiya kazi yangu na sifa yangu. Unataka nini tena zaidi?
target_text_raw: Ulisha ni haribishiya kazi yangu na sifa yangu. Unataka nini tena zaidi?

source_text: Un fantôme hante l'Europe: le fantôme du communisme.

target_text_raw: Kizimu moya iko na winda Bulaya: kizimu yenyewe ni ukomunisti.

target_text: Neno hii ika pendeza mtoto mudogo kuwaza kutiya mende mu kitanda ya wazazi yake iliyo tokeya niku shitaka mwenye ile neno ya ku aribisha upango ya maneno ya maana.

target_text: Ku kaburi yako hapa sasa hivi kuta anguka barafu ya mweupe na yenye haina shida.

target_text_raw: Watoto wako na byote, kutosha yenye wana banyanganya.

target_text_raw: Kwa kweli, nilikuwa siwaziye kama uli muniga ju upate kukuwa mwalimu.

target_text: Mu miaka mu nane tu, tuli punguza nusu ya kutegemeya petroli ya inje ya inchi; tuli ongeza mara mbili moto yetu yenye ina badilishiwaka; na tuli fikiya ku peleka dunia ku fanya mapatano yaku saidiya ulimwengu.

target_text: Mu matokeo ya hivi, mina itaka ba fanyakazi bote. Wa shimamiye kazi zabo, wa ende ku isune zabo, wa lete kimia na utulivu.

target_text_raw: Tuna wanza kifo ilikuwa saa munane na muniti makumi mbili.

target_text_raw: Niko fana wako wa sana.

target_text_raw: Wali nileteya jana habari ya muzuri kama ulisha kuya kutoka safari.

target_text_raw: Kwaku weza kusoma kijapani, Jenny hakukuwa na shida Japani kabisa.

target_text_raw: Binti ambaye ali poteya, alikuwa na liya sana akisema jina yake.

source_text: Si vous allez dans ce supermarché, vous pourrez acheter la plupart des objets que vous utilisez dans votre vie quotidienne.

target_text_raw: Kama una enda mwa ile soko, una weza uza bitu mingi bya kutumikisha mu maisha ya kila siku.

target_text_raw: Ulikuwa na jifanyisha, si ndio?

target_text: Watu ni kundi ya kipumbafu, saa zimoya wajinga ku subiriya na saa zingine wakali ku andamana. Bana mwambia: «Ji furahishe.» Ana jifurahisha. Bana mwambia: «wende pigana na jirani yako.» Ana enda enda pigana.

target_text_raw: Ndoto zangu ni kuishi maisha ya uhuru kijijini.

target_text_raw: Wagonjwa wa cancere mara mingi wana kuwa na nausee ya kusumbua.

target_text_raw: Siku za mwisho za maisha ya Sami ilikuwa ni kuzimu.

target_text_raw: Nani mwenye iko na niya, kwa ngufu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que Dieu bénisse le ventre qui donne naissances.
target_text: Mugu abariki tumbu zenye zina zalaka.
target_text_raw: Mugu abariki tumbu zenye zina zalaka.

source_text: Nous devons joindre l'utile à l’agréable.

target_text_raw: Lazima tu patanishe ya maana ku ya muzuri.

source_text: Garder des animaux sauvages comme animaux domestiques est illicite.

target_text_raw: Kuweka wanyama ya pori kama kipenzi ni kinyume cha sheria.

source_text: Lorsqu'il est triste, il se retire.

target_text_raw: Sa ana uzika, ana endaka kwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, ma femme et ma maîtresse ne s'entendent pas très bien.

source_text: Nous nous rencontrons à un moment de tension entre les États-Unis et les musulmans à travers le monde - tension enracinée dans des forces historiques qui dépassent tout débat politique actuel.
target_text: Tunakutana wakati wa mvutano kati ya Merika na Waislamu kote ulimwenguni - mvutano uliotokana na nguvu za kihistoria ambazo zinavuka mjadala wowote wa kisiasa wa sasa.

source_text: Le ministère de la Défense britannique a décidé de supprimer l'organe mis en place pour enquêter sur les accusations de violations des droits de l'homme par des soldats britanniques en Irak.
target_text: Wizara ya Ulinzi ya Uingereza imeamua kukomesha mwili uliowekwa kuchunguza tuhuma za ukiukaji wa haki za binadamu na wanajeshi wa Uingereza huko Iraq.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu nous manques et nous avons hâte que tu sois ici.

target_text_raw: Tunaku kumbuka sana na tuna ngoya sana kukuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça a bien meilleur goût que ce que je bouffe d'habitude.
target_text: Iko butamu sana ku shinda chakula minakulaka.
target_text_raw: Iko butamu sana ku shinda chakula minakulaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rien d'autre que la paix ne peut sauver le monde.
target_text: Hakuna kitu isipokuwa amani inaweza kuokoa ulimwengu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna kitu isipokuwa amani inaweza kuokoa ulimwengu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils n'ont tout bonnement pas l'occasion de reviser ce jugement préconçu.
target_text: Hawana nafasi ya kurekebisha uamuzi huu wa mapema.
target_text_raw: Hawana nafasi ya kurekebisha uamuzi huu wa mapema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils recherchèrent tous l'enfant disparue.
target_text: Biko na tafuta bote ule mutoto mwenye ali potea.
target_text_raw: Biko na tafuta bote ule mutoto mwenye ali potea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui ai conseillé de revenir sans tarder.
target_text: Alimushauria arudie bila kucelewa.
target_text_raw: Alimushauria arudie bila kucelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le conducteur doit toujours pouvoir garder au moins une main sur le volant.
target_text: Ni lazima chauffeur weke mukono moya ku volant.
target_text_raw: Ni lazima chauffeur weke mukono moya ku volant.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dorenda est vraiment une fille gentille, elle partage ses gâteaux avec moi.
target_text: Dorenda ni misjana muzuri, anapenda changiya cake zake na miye.
target_text_raw: Dorenda ni misjana muzuri, anapenda changiya cake zake na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fumée blanche s'élevait dans le ciel bleu.
target_text: Moshi ya mweupe ili panda angani ya bleu.
target_text_raw: Moshi ya mweupe ili panda angani ya bleu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous a fallu une semaine pour localiser leur planque.
target_text: Ilitubidi week moya juya kupata planque yabo.
target_text_raw: Ilitubidi week moya juya kupata planque yabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais louer votre voiture la moins chère, pour une semaine.
target_text: Ningependa ku kodesha gari yako ya beyi chini, week moya.
target_text_raw: Ningependa ku kodesha gari yako ya beyi chini, week moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne dis pas que tes réponses sont toujours fausses.

target_text_raw: Siseme kama jibu zako zinnakuwaka tu za bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La monnaie française était le franc, et son symbole "F". Bien qu'il ne soit plus en usage en France, le franc est encore utilisé dans les anciennes colonies françaises, comme la Guinée.
target_text: Franga française ilikuwa franc, na alama yayo “F”. Ingawa haitumiki tena Ufaransa, faranga hiyo bado inatumiwa katika makoloni ya zamani ya Ufaransa, kama vile Guinea.
target_text_raw: Franga française ilikuwa franc, na alama yayo “F”. Ingawa haitumiki tena Ufaransa, faranga hiyo bado inatumiwa katika makoloni ya zamani ya Ufaransa, kama vile Guinea.

source_text: La pression est mise sur l'administration afin qu'elle trouve une nouvelle politique.
target_text: Shinikizo linawekwa kwa watawala kupata sera mpya.
target_text_raw: Shinikizo linawekwa kwa watawala kupata sera mpya.

target_text_raw: Mpangilio wa maua ni kipengele cha utamaduni wa Kijapani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant qu'Horus est de retour, on peut écrire des phrases sans vérifier qu'elles existent déjà.

target_text_raw: Sasa ngisi Horus ana rudiya, tunaweza andika ma phrases bila ku angaliya kama zina kuwaka.

source_text: Mon vieil oncle m’a couché sur son testament.

target_text_raw: Muyomba wangu wa mzee alini andika ku testament yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez, hop, en voiture !
target_text: Twende, mu gari!
target_text_raw: Twende, mu gari!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aimez la vérité ; sachez la dire avec courage.
target_text: Mupende kweli; mujuwe isema na bidi.
target_text_raw: Mupende kweli; mujuwe isema na bidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous conseille de garder vos distances avec Nathan.
target_text: Minaba shauriya ku bakiya mbali ni Nathan.
target_text_raw: Minaba shauriya ku bakiya mbali ni Nathan.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma voiture est une Ford, comme la tienne.
target_text: Gari yangu ni Ford, sa yako.
target_text_raw: Gari yangu ni Ford, sa yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette usine fabrique des pièces de voiture.
target_text: Kiwanda hiki kinatengeneza sehemu za gari.
target_text_raw: Kiwanda hiki kinatengeneza sehemu za gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'ordinaire, nous parlons français entre nous.
target_text: Kawaida, tuna o ngeyaka Français kati yetu.
target_text_raw: Kawaida, tuna o ngeyaka Français kati yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je levai la tête. Le ciel était bleu, et les rayons chauds du soleil, découpés par les longues cheminées, traçaient de grands angles de lumière au faîte des murs hauts et sombres de la prison. Il faisait beau en effet.
target_text: Nili pandisha kitchwa. Anga lilikuwa la samawati, na miale ya joto ya jua, iliyokatwa na chimney ndefu, ilifuatilia pembe kubwa za mwangaza kwenye ukuta wa ukuta mrefu, mweusi wa gereza. Ilikuwa sawa.

source_text: Ce qu'il y a de certain, c'est qu'au milieu de la forêt il savait déployer des talents remarquables, tandis qu'une fois en présence des dames, il osait à peine ouvrir la bouche.
target_text: Kilicho hakika ni kwamba katikati ya msitu alijua jinsi ya kuonyesha talanta nzuri, wakati mara moja mbele ya wanawake, hakuthubutu kufungua kinywa chake.

source_text: Il est normal que vous vous sentiez triste à cause des nouvelles.

target_text_raw: Unaona jengo jeupe chini ya kilima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Nahodha hudhibiti meli nzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le trois octobre, dans la soirée d'après l'heure locale, le porte-parole de la Maison Blanche a déclaré que la visite présidentielle en Asie n'aurait pas lieu. La cause en est la situation financière difficile du gouvernement.
target_text: Mnamo Oktoba 3, jioni kulingana na saa za eneo hilo, msemaji wa Ikulu ya White House alisema ziara ya rais Asia haingefanyika. Sababu ni hali ngumu ya kifedha ya serikali.
target_text_raw: Mnamo Oktoba 3, jioni kulingana na saa za eneo hilo, msemaji wa Ikulu ya White House alisema ziara ya rais Asia haingefanyika. Sababu ni hali ngumu ya kifedha ya serikali.

source_text: Dès que j'aurai fini mon travail, vous irez manger.

target_text_raw: Wakati nita maliza kazi yangu, mutaenda kula.

target_text_raw: Ninapata katika furaha ya kupendwa nguvu ya kuteseka.

target_text_raw: Ili kushambulia na kuangamiza Iraq mnamo 2003, Merika iliunda umoja wa «kimataifa» unaoundwa na nchi ndogo kama Jamuhuri ya Palau au Iceland.

source_text: Thomas est l'un des types les plus gentils que je connaisse.

target_text_raw: Thomas ni moya mu batu bazuri benye minajuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Tuliona banabeba mwanamuke ku hospitali.

target_text_raw: Jaji kwanza ikiwa unajua upande wa pili wa sarafu.

source_text: Essayez de faire preuve de patience avec les autres.

target_text_raw: Jaribu kuwa mvumilivu kwa wengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment un homme peut traiter le monde sérieusement, quand le monde lui-même est si ridicule?

target_text_raw: Mutu anawezaje kuuchukulia ulimwengu kwa umakini, wakati ulimwengu wenyewe ni ujinga sana?

target_text_raw: Mukuwe na huruma kwa uyu mwanamuke masikini.

target_text_raw: Anasoma ju aweze ile mutihani.

source_text: Éteins les lumières quand tu quittes la pièce, s'il te plaît.

target_text_raw: Zimisha matali sa unatoka mu chumba, tafazira.

source_text: Si nous restons ici nous serons au casse-pipes.

target_text_raw: Ikiwa tutakaa hapa tutakuwa kwenye bomba la kuvunja bomba.

source_text: Mon patron m'a loué pour mon sérieux travail.

target_text_raw: Bosi wangu aliniajiri kwa kazi yangu nzito.

source_text: Désormais, ils bombardent les palettes de fruits et de légumes de rayons ionisants qui tuent toutes les bactéries en surface, si bien qu'ils pourrissent de l'intérieur...sans qu'on le voie.
target_text: Sasa wanapiga pallets za matunda na mboga na mionzi ya ioni ambayo huua bakteria yoyote juu ya uso, ili kuoza kutoka ndani ... bila kuonekana.
target_text_raw: Sasa wanapiga pallets za matunda na mboga na mionzi ya ioni ambayo huua bakteria yoyote juu ya uso, ili kuoza kutoka ndani ... bila kuonekana.

source_text: C'est comme si le monde était déjà fini et que nous étions tous en enfer mais ne l'avions pas encore remarqué.

target_text_raw: Secrétaire itaweka ile baruwa dani ya enveloppe.

target_text_raw: Mauwa ya rose ni arufu ya kwanza ili tumikishiwa juyaku tengeneza marashi.

source_text: Je ne suis pas idiot. Je suis juste différent.

target_text_raw: Misiko bumbafu. Nikotu tafauti.

source_text: « Je n'arrive pas à croire qu'ils dorment ensemble ! » « Pourquoi pas ? Il est parfaitement normal d'emmener un ours en peluche au lit avec soi. »
target_text: Siko naweza elewa kama bana lala pamoya! Kwa “”nini isiwe hivyo? Ni sawa kabisa kuchukua teddy kubeba kitandani na wewe.»
target_text_raw: Siko naweza elewa kama bana lala pamoya! Kwa “”nini isiwe hivyo? Ni sawa kabisa kuchukua teddy kubeba kitandani na wewe.»

source_text: « Es-tu fâchée après moi ? » « Comment quiconque pourrait jamais être fâché contre toi ? »
target_text: «Unani sirikiya?” «Mutu yoyote angewezaje kuwa na hasira kwako?»
target_text_raw: «Unani sirikiya?” «Mutu yoyote angewezaje kuwa na hasira kwako?»

source_text: Même sans maquillage, elle est très mignonne.

target_text_raw: Ata bila kuji podowa, niwa muzuri.

target_text_raw: Munataka pitisha siku zinaba bakiya mu cacho?

target_text: Miongoni mwa maoni yaliyotetewa na wanafalsafa wa Ufahamu, tunaweza kutaja uhuru wa mtu binafsi, mgawanyo wa nguvu na usawa mbele ya sheria.

source_text: Luca, Marie et toi vous conservez dans le cœur, malgré toutes les souffrances de la passion qui brûle, même lorsque, tout près, une virgule vous sépare. Comme c'est merveilleux !
target_text: Luca, Marie na mnahifadhiana moyoni mwenu, licha ya mateso yote ya shauku inayowaka, hata wakati, karibu, koma inakutenganisha. Ni ajabu sana!
target_text_raw: Luca, Marie na mnahifadhiana moyoni mwenu, licha ya mateso yote ya shauku inayowaka, hata wakati, karibu, koma inakutenganisha. Ni ajabu sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a préparé une sauce aux airelles pour accompagner le canard.
target_text: Aliandaa mchuzi wa cranberry yenye ita pigiwa na bata.
target_text_raw: Aliandaa mchuzi wa cranberry yenye ita pigiwa na bata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le magicien a demandé un volontaire dans le public.
target_text: Mchawi aliuliza wakujitolea kutoka kwa watazamaji.
target_text_raw: Mchawi aliuliza wakujitolea kutoka kwa watazamaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Y a du gâteau, t’en veux ? » « Ouais ! »
target_text: “Kuko cake, unataka?” “Ndiyo”
target_text_raw: “Kuko cake, unataka?” “Ndiyo”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout semblait OK.
target_text: Yote iko sawa.
target_text_raw: Yote iko sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puisque la femme revendique ses droits, ne lui en reconnaissons qu'un seul : le droit de plaire.
target_text: Kwa kuwa mwanamuke anadai haki zake, wacha tu tutambue moja yao: haki ya kupendeza.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa mwanamuke anadai haki zake, wacha tu tutambue moja yao: haki ya kupendeza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'écoute les sons de la nature, loin du bruit de la circulation.
target_text: Ninasikiliza sauti za maumbile, mbali na kelele za trafiki.
target_text_raw: Ninasikiliza sauti za maumbile, mbali na kelele za trafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'orateur ne connaissait pas bien son sujet, et ne parlais pas bien non plus ; pour faire court, il était affligeant.
target_text: Mzungumzaji hakujua mada yake vizuri, wala hakuongea vizuri; kwa kifupi, ilikuwa ya kusumbua.
target_text_raw: Mzungumzaji hakujua mada yake vizuri, wala hakuongea vizuri; kwa kifupi, ilikuwa ya kusumbua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Même si on n'a pas de chance au premier essai, on peut continuer à baiser jusqu'à ce que je tombe enceinte.
target_text: Atakama tuko na bahati ku essai ya kwanza, tunaweza kuendelea kimapenzi hadi nipate mimba.
target_text_raw: Atakama tuko na bahati ku essai ya kwanza, tunaweza kuendelea kimapenzi hadi nipate mimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sonia était une petite brune mignonne, avec des yeux doux, ombragés de longs cils.
target_text: Sonia alikuwa brunette mdogo mzuri, na macho laini, amevikwa na ma cils virefu.
target_text_raw: Sonia alikuwa brunette mdogo mzuri, na macho laini, amevikwa na ma cils virefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les fusées ont été mises à feu sur une rampe de lancement.
target_text: Makombora yalirushwa juu ya pedi ya uzinduzi.
target_text_raw: Makombora yalirushwa juu ya pedi ya uzinduzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez fait preuve d'insouciance, en laissant votre valise.
target_text: Haukukuwa na wasiwasi, ukiacha sanduku lako.
target_text_raw: Haukukuwa na wasiwasi, ukiacha sanduku lako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demandez et vous recevrez,votre joie sera parfaite.
target_text: Mulombe na mutapata, furaha yenu itakuwa safi sana.
target_text_raw: Mulombe na mutapata, furaha yenu itakuwa safi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est carrément dingue !
target_text: Ni wazimu kabisa!
target_text_raw: Ni wazimu kabisa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est pourquoi le gouvernement Étasunien s'est pourvu en justice pour protéger le droit des femmes et des filles de porter le hijab, et pour punir ceux qui voudraient l'interdire.
target_text: Hii ndio sababu serikali ya Merika imechukua hatua za kisheria kulinda haki ya wanawake na wasichana kuvaa hijabu, na kuwaadhibu wale ambao wangeipiga marufuku.
target_text_raw: Hii ndio sababu serikali ya Merika imechukua hatua za kisheria kulinda haki ya wanawake na wasichana kuvaa hijabu, na kuwaadhibu wale ambao wangeipiga marufuku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrêtez de vous mentir à vous-mêmes !
target_text: Muatche ji dangaya nyiye peke!
target_text_raw: Muatche ji dangaya nyiye peke!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas parce que je n'aime pas l'auto, mais que je ne peux pas me permettre la dépense.
target_text: Aiko ju misipendi auto, njo sitapenda kuyi uza.
target_text_raw: Aiko ju misipendi auto, njo sitapenda kuyi uza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma mère se mêle continuellement de ma vie privée.
target_text: Mama yangu ana endelea ku fatiliya maisha yaku.
target_text_raw: Mama yangu ana endelea ku fatiliya maisha yaku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils viennent d'acheter, près d'Aix-en-Provence, un agréable mas.
target_text: Banatoka uza, karibu na Aix-en-Provence, mas ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Banatoka uza, karibu na Aix-en-Provence, mas ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Moi, c'est Anthony.
target_text: Miye ni Anthony.
target_text_raw: Miye ni Anthony.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'inscris en faux contre ces bruits de couloir.
target_text: Mina chagua kelele hizi za barabara ya ukumbi.
target_text_raw: Mina chagua kelele hizi za barabara ya ukumbi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu vérifier la pression des pneus ?
target_text: Unaweza angaliya pepo za pneus?
target_text_raw: Unaweza angaliya pepo za pneus?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez vos lunettes de protection, je vous prie !
target_text: Muvale miwani yenu, tafadhali!
target_text_raw: Muvale miwani yenu, tafadhali!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On pense que la reine Élizabeth II est une descendante de Genghis Khan de par sa grand-mère.
target_text: Malkia Elizabeth II angeaminika kuwa mzao wa Genghis Khan kupitia bibi yake.
target_text_raw: Malkia Elizabeth II angeaminika kuwa mzao wa Genghis Khan kupitia bibi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'ils avaient suivi les conseils de leurs médecins, ils ne seraient peut-être pas dans cet état.
target_text: Ingekuwa walisikiya mashauri ya waganga wao,wenda hawangeli kufa.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa walisikiya mashauri ya waganga wao,wenda hawangeli kufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'objectif est de concevoir un modèle qui pourra être progressivement transféré aux autres pays.
target_text: Lengo ni kubuni mfano ambao unaweza kuhamishiwa hatua kwa hatua kwenda inchi zingine.
target_text_raw: Lengo ni kubuni mfano ambao unaweza kuhamishiwa hatua kwa hatua kwenda inchi zingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: He bien parlez-vous aussi en anglais ?
target_text: Muna ongeyaka vile ki ongereza?
target_text_raw: Muna ongeyaka vile ki ongereza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis tourné et retourné toute la nuit.
target_text: Nili zungiruka busiku muzima.
target_text_raw: Nili zungiruka busiku muzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom arrive à se rappeler des accords de la chanson, mais n'arrive pas à se souvenir de toutes les paroles.
target_text: Tom anaweza kukumbuka nyimbo katika wimbo, lakini hawezi kukumbuka maneno yote.
target_text_raw: Tom anaweza kukumbuka nyimbo katika wimbo, lakini hawezi kukumbuka maneno yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce trop compliqué pour vous d'éteindre vos téléphones ?
target_text: Ni nguvu sana kwenu ku zimisha ma simu zenu?
target_text_raw: Ni nguvu sana kwenu ku zimisha ma simu zenu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu trouves ça sexy, les poils sur la poitrine ?
target_text: Unaiona ni ya kupendeza, nywele kwenye kifua?
target_text_raw: Unaiona ni ya kupendeza, nywele kwenye kifua?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le feriez-vous, si vous en aviez l'occasion ?
target_text: Munaeza kubi fanya kama mungekuwa na uwezo?
target_text_raw: Munaeza kubi fanya kama mungekuwa na uwezo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est cool.
target_text: Ni sawa.
target_text_raw: Ni sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regrette de ne pas pouvoir me joindre à vous.
target_text: Niko na uzuni ngisi sikuwezu kuji ungana na nyiye.
target_text_raw: Niko na uzuni ngisi sikuwezu kuji ungana na nyiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma date de naissance remonte au milieu de la guerre de libération du pays.
target_text: Tarehe yangu ya kuzaliwa inarudi katikati ya vita vya ukombozi nchini.
target_text_raw: Tarehe yangu ya kuzaliwa inarudi katikati ya vita vya ukombozi nchini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dansons, chéri !
target_text: Tucheze, mupenzi!
target_text_raw: Tucheze, mupenzi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le destin, la mission et le désir d'améliorer le monde.
target_text: Ni hatima, dhamira na hamu ya kuboresha ulimwengu.
target_text_raw: Ni hatima, dhamira na hamu ya kuboresha ulimwengu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils sont juste comme des rats quittant un navire qui sombre.
target_text: Wao ni kama panya wanaacha meli inayozama.
target_text_raw: Wao ni kama panya wanaacha meli inayozama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tenez compte de l'opinion publique.
target_text: Zingatia maoni ya umma.
target_text_raw: Zingatia maoni ya umma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je promets de ne pas recommencer.
target_text: Ninaahidi kutokuanza upya.
target_text_raw: Ninaahidi kutokuanza upya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le plastique tue chaque année un nombre incalculable d'oiseaux marins et de tortues de mer.
target_text: Plastiki huua idadi isitoshe ya ndege wa baharini na kasa wa baharini kila mwaka.
target_text_raw: Plastiki huua idadi isitoshe ya ndege wa baharini na kasa wa baharini kila mwaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir ! Je suis Marie une amie de Luca.
target_text: Habari za jioni! Niko Marie rafiki wa Luca.
target_text_raw: Habari za jioni! Niko Marie rafiki wa Luca.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a lâché l'école secondaire à 17 ans.
target_text: Aliatcha masomo secondarina iko na mwaka 17
target_text_raw: Aliatcha masomo secondarina iko na mwaka 17
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les clients arrivent, portant un filet ou un panier.
target_text: Wateja wanafika, wakiwa wamebeba wavu au kikapu.
target_text_raw: Wateja wanafika, wakiwa wamebeba wavu au kikapu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parfois ce sont les détails dans la vie, un caillou brillant d'une beauté inédite dans la rivière par exemple, qui nous donnent la force de continuer.
target_text: Wakati mwingine ni maelezo maishani, kokoto inayoangaza ya uzuri ambao haujawahi kutokea katika mto kwa mfano, ambayo hutupatia nguvu ya kuendelea.
target_text_raw: Wakati mwingine ni maelezo maishani, kokoto inayoangaza ya uzuri ambao haujawahi kutokea katika mto kwa mfano, ambayo hutupatia nguvu ya kuendelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me bats pour garder mes biens.
target_text: Na piganisha ku weka vitu zangu.
target_text_raw: Na piganisha ku weka vitu zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Entretiens la force de ton esprit pour te protéger des soudains revers de fortune.
target_text: Dumisha nguvu ya akili yako kujikinga na vipingamizi vya ghafla.
target_text_raw: Dumisha nguvu ya akili yako kujikinga na vipingamizi vya ghafla.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que vous connaissez tout le monde, ici.
target_text: Minawaza munajuwa kila muta apa.
target_text_raw: Minawaza munajuwa kila muta apa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu veux rester en Finlande, il faudra que tu trouves un boulot.
target_text: Kama unataka bakiya Filande, unapashwa pata kazi.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka bakiya Filande, unapashwa pata kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont petit-déjeuné sur le pouce.
target_text: Walikuwa na kiamsha kinywa wakiwa njiani.
target_text_raw: Walikuwa na kiamsha kinywa wakiwa njiani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous attendre un moment, s'i vous plaît ?
target_text: Munaweza ngoya kidogo, tafazari?
target_text_raw: Munaweza ngoya kidogo, tafazari?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que vous pourriez apprécier de savoir qui vient dîner.
target_text: Minawaza kama munaweza furahiya ku juwa nani atakuya kula.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama munaweza furahiya ku juwa nani atakuya kula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta maison est très sympa.
target_text: Nyumba yako iko muzuri.
target_text_raw: Nyumba yako iko muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pars pas du principe qu'il pleuvra.
target_text: Misiwaze kama nvula ita nyesha.
target_text_raw: Misiwaze kama nvula ita nyesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui a laissé ce bordel dans les chiottes ?
target_text: Ni nani aliyeacha buchafu hii chooni?
target_text_raw: Ni nani aliyeacha buchafu hii chooni?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as mérité une pause.
target_text: Uko na lazima ya ku pumuzika.x
target_text_raw: Uko na lazima ya ku pumuzika.x
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'infirmière m'a dit par la suite qu'elle avait fait de son mieux pour me remettre sur pieds.
target_text: Muuguzi aliniambia baadaye kwamba alikuwa amejitahidi kadiri awezavyo kunirudisha kwa miguu yangu.
target_text_raw: Muuguzi aliniambia baadaye kwamba alikuwa amejitahidi kadiri awezavyo kunirudisha kwa miguu yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À peine était-elle montée dedans que le train quitta la gare.
target_text: Mara tu baada ya kuingia ndani yake gari moshi iliondoka kituoni.
target_text_raw: Mara tu baada ya kuingia ndani yake gari moshi iliondoka kituoni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mot patrie est tellement mésusé qu'on peut à peine en dire quelque chose de normal ou de sérieux.
target_text: Neno inchi linatumiwa vibaya sana hivi kwamba hatuwezi kusema chochote cha kawaida au mzito juu yake.
target_text_raw: Neno inchi linatumiwa vibaya sana hivi kwamba hatuwezi kusema chochote cha kawaida au mzito juu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne devrait pas tenir les gens responsables de choses qu'ils ne peuvent pas contrôler.
target_text: Hatupaswi kuwawajibisha watu kwa vitu ambavyo hawawezi kudhibiti.
target_text_raw: Hatupaswi kuwawajibisha watu kwa vitu ambavyo hawawezi kudhibiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Devinez qui vient déjeuner !
target_text: Ni nani anakuja kula?
target_text_raw: Ni nani anakuja kula?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vous remercier d'être venue aujourd'hui.
target_text: Minapenda wa shukuru kwa ku kuya yenu apa leo.
target_text_raw: Minapenda wa shukuru kwa ku kuya yenu apa leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Généralement, ce qu'elle dit est exact.
target_text: Kawaida, yenye anasema ni kweli.
target_text_raw: Kawaida, yenye anasema ni kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un flic a été tué.
target_text: Askari ali wawa.
target_text_raw: Askari ali wawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu te tenais à l’écart.
target_text: Ulikuwa pembeni
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa pembeni
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan était un tueur en série en cavale.
target_text: Dani alikuwa muuaji wa mfululizo.
target_text_raw: Dani alikuwa muuaji wa mfululizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vois mon vaisseau.
target_text: Ninaona meli yangu.
target_text_raw: Ninaona meli yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami est serveur dans un bar gay.
target_text: Sami ni serveur katika baa ya mashoga.
target_text_raw: Sami ni serveur katika baa ya mashoga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'ils avaient d'abord dû étudier le latin, les Romains n'auraient jamais eu l'occasion de conquérir le monde.
target_text: Ikiwa ilibidi wajifunze Kilatini kwanza, Warumi wasingepata fursa ya kuchukua ulimwengu.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa ilibidi wajifunze Kilatini kwanza, Warumi wasingepata fursa ya kuchukua ulimwengu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hors de mon chemin, gamin.
target_text: Toka ku njiya yangu, mutoto.
target_text_raw: Toka ku njiya yangu, mutoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Essayez de le tenir en échec.
target_text: Jaribu kumzuia.
target_text_raw: Jaribu kumzuia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le téléphone est un appareil merveilleux.
target_text: Simu iko chombo ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Simu iko chombo ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il m'a cherché, il m'a trouvé, et maintenant nous formons un couple.
target_text: Alini tafuta, akanipata kisha tukakuwa bapenzi.
target_text_raw: Alini tafuta, akanipata kisha tukakuwa bapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est inutile d'essayer de se rappeler de tous les mots du dictionnaire.
target_text: Aiko lazima ku kumbuka ma mots zamu dictionnaire.
target_text_raw: Aiko lazima ku kumbuka ma mots zamu dictionnaire.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Surveille mes valises.
target_text: Angaliya muzigo yangu.
target_text_raw: Angaliya muzigo yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'excuse si je t'ai blessée.
target_text: Uni urumiye kama niliku lumiza roho.
target_text_raw: Uni urumiye kama niliku lumiza roho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un bon sens de l'humour t'aidera à surmonter des lendemains difficiles.
target_text: Ucheshi mzuri itakusaidia kupitia kesho ngumu.
target_text_raw: Ucheshi mzuri itakusaidia kupitia kesho ngumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne voulons pas nous mêler de vos affaires.
target_text: Atutaki ingiya mu maneno yenu.
target_text_raw: Atutaki ingiya mu maneno yenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a épousé pour son fric.
target_text: Ali owa franga zake.
target_text_raw: Ali owa franga zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fais-y bouffer ses dents !
target_text: Mu kulishe meno zake!
target_text_raw: Mu kulishe meno zake!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bravo à eux.
target_text: Ongezakwenu.
target_text_raw: Ongeza (Félicitations) kwenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a encore un tas de choses à faire, je ne vais donc pas m'ennuyer.
target_text: Kungali bya mingi byakufanya, kwa hivyo sitaweza choka.

target_text: Ni wakati unagundua kuwa sehemu ya ziada inauzwa kwa karibu bei sawa na kifaa chote ambacho unajua kuwa umekwama katika jamii ya watumiaji hadi shingo yako.

target_text_raw: Otto alisimama kimya mwanzoni, akashangaa sana na kushangaa hata akafikiria kutoroka.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas. Nous trouverons Louis.

target_text_raw: Nina wafitsha siri tatu.

source_text: Tu es venue le lundi et es repartie le jour suivant.

target_text_raw: Ulikuya siku ya kwanza na kurudi siku yaku fwata.

target_text_raw: Nili anza ku sumbuka.

source_text: Rien d'extraordinaire n'a jamais été réussi sans prendre de risques.

target_text_raw: Hakuna kitu cha ajabu ambacho kimewahi kupatikana bila kuchukua hatari.

target_text_raw: Hatua nane zaidi kabla ya kufikia kilele.

target_text_raw: Ni vizuri kuku juwa!

target_text_raw: Watoto wako niwazuri!

source_text: Je t'assure que je ne l'ai pas vu arriver !

target_text_raw: Ninawahakikishia sikuiona ikija!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu veux la paix, prépare la guerre.
target_text: Kama unataka amani, ji tayarishe ku vita.
target_text_raw: Kama unataka amani, ji tayarishe ku vita.

target_text_raw: Musi ogope.

target_text_raw: Amani p ekee inlinda dunia.
