target_text: Karibu theluthi mbili ya wanasoka wanacheza kwenye Ligi ya Premia, wengine katika Idara ya Heshima.
target_text_raw: Karibu theluthi mbili ya wanasoka wanacheza kwenye Ligi ya Premia, wengine katika Idara ya Heshima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un cœur, des reins et un foie surmenés sont les conséquences inévitables d'une nourriture trop abondante.
target_text: Un cœur, des reins et un foie surmenés sont les conséquences inévitables d'une nourriture trop abondante.
target_text_raw: Un cœur, des reins et un foie surmenés sont les conséquences inévitables d'une nourriture trop abondante.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir, je suis Marie, une amie de Thomas.
target_text: Niko Marie rafiki wa Luca.
target_text_raw: Niko Marie rafiki wa Luca.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette équipe a de bons joueurs.
target_text: Timu hii ina wachezaji wazuri.
target_text_raw: Timu hii ina wachezaji wazuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de jeunes algériens ont rejoint les séparatistes afin qu'ils bénéficient d'un visa ou de l'asile politique en Europe.
target_text: Vijana wengi wa Algeria walijiunga na watenanishaji ili waweze kufaidika na visa au hifadhi ya kisiasa huko Uropa.
target_text_raw: Vijana wengi wa Algeria walijiunga na watenanishaji ili waweze kufaidika na visa au hifadhi ya kisiasa huko Uropa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nathan a une jolie collection de peintures modernes.
target_text: Nathan ana mkusanyiko mzuri wa picha za kisasa.
target_text_raw: Nathan ana mkusanyiko mzuri wa picha za kisasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi est-ce que tout le monde rigole ?
target_text: Juya nini kila mutu iko na cheka.
target_text_raw: Juya nini kila mutu iko na cheka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'écoute un bruit vague. J'essaye d'entendre, mais je ne perçois rien.
target_text: Ni sikiya fujo. Niko napima sikiya, alakini si sikiye kitu.
target_text_raw: Ni sikiya fujo. Niko napima sikiya, alakini si sikiye kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et quand des innocents en Bosnie et au Darfour sont massacrés, c'est une tache sur notre conscience collective.
target_text: Na wakati watu wasio na hatia huko Bosnia na Darfur wanachinjwa, hiyo ni doa kwa dhamiri yetu ya pamoja.
target_text_raw: Na wakati watu wasio na hatia huko Bosnia na Darfur wanachinjwa, hiyo ni doa kwa dhamiri yetu ya pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation arrêtent toute personne suspectée de soutenir la résistance.
target_text: Vikosi vya kazi hukamata mtu yeyote anayeshukiwa kuunga mkono upinzani.
target_text_raw: Vikosi vya kazi hukamata mtu yeyote anayeshukiwa kuunga mkono upinzani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis retrouvé impliqué dans un accident.
target_text: Nilijikuta katika ajali.
target_text_raw: Nilijikuta katika ajali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Pourrais-tu me donner s'il te plaît le couteau à viande et la fourchette à viande, cher Enzo ? » « Mais naturellement, chère Maria ! Je t'en prie ! »
target_text: «Tafadhali naomba unipe kisu cha nyama na uma wa nyama, Enzo mpendwa?» «Lakini kwa kweli, mpenzi Maria! Karibu!»
target_text_raw: «Tafadhali naomba unipe kisu cha nyama na uma wa nyama, Enzo mpendwa?» «Lakini kwa kweli, mpenzi Maria! Karibu!»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne connaissez pas tous les faits.
target_text: Amujuwe ukweli yote.
target_text_raw: Amujuwe ukweli yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vends des pommes au marché.
target_text: Una uzisha matunda ku soko.
target_text_raw: Una uzisha matunda ku soko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca et Marie ont une maison de vacances en Floride.
target_text: Luca na Maria wako nia nyumba ya ku pumuzika uko Floride.
target_text_raw: Luca na Maria wako nia nyumba ya ku pumuzika uko Floride.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gardez toujours la foi.
target_text: Weka tu imani.
target_text_raw: Weka tu imani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez adjoint les noms de vos maris aux vôtres.
target_text: Muli ongeza jina zawa bwana wenu ku zenu.
target_text_raw: Muli ongeza jina zawa bwana wenu ku zenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D tafugt i ttafgen wussan.
target_text: D tafugt i ttafgen wussan.
target_text_raw: D tafugt i ttafgen wussan.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a changé de clan, pour une bouchée de pain.
target_text: Aliba geuka juya chakula.
target_text_raw: Aliba geuka juya chakula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est insensé. Seul un idiot croirait cela.
target_text: Niyaku shangaza. Ni bumbafu tu njo anaweza itika iyo.
target_text_raw: Niyaku shangaza. Ni bumbafu tu njo anaweza itika iyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand le livreur aura fini de décharger les boîtes, il me remettra le bon de livraison.
target_text: Wakati mutu wa kujifungua amemaliza kupakua masanduku, atanipa hati ya kujifungua.
target_text_raw: Wakati mutu wa kujifungua amemaliza kupakua masanduku, atanipa hati ya kujifungua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous étiez jalouse, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Uko n a wivu, sivyo?
target_text_raw: Uko n a wivu, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous faut soit définir la norme soit perdre notre côté sympa.
target_text: Lazima tuweke kiwango au kupoteza upande wetu mzuri.
target_text_raw: Lazima tuweke kiwango au kupoteza upande wetu mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La patience est parfois l'arme la plus efficace.
target_text: Uvumilivu wakati mwingine ndio silaha inayofaa zaidi.
target_text_raw: Uvumilivu wakati mwingine ndio silaha inayofaa zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne pars pas les mains vides.
target_text: Usienda mikono waza.
target_text_raw: Usienda mikono waza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que se passe-t-il ici, bordel ?
target_text: Kulipita nini?
target_text_raw: Kulipita nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est piégé.
target_text: Imenaswa.
target_text_raw: Imenaswa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour la première fois de ma vie, je me suis trouvée toute seule dans une ville inconnue.
target_text: Kwa mara ya kwanza mu maisha yangu, najikuta mu mungini mupia.
target_text_raw: Kwa mara ya kwanza mu maisha yangu, najikuta mu mungini mupia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon appartement a été privé d'électricité pendant soixante douze heures.
target_text: Nyumba yangu alikatwa courant siku tatu.
target_text_raw: Nyumba yangu alikatwa courant siku tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mangez et buvez et faites bonne chère, mieux vaut cœur que richesse.
target_text: Mukule na mukunywe na mufurahi,ni bora roho,juhudi ku kazi, kuliko utajiri.
target_text_raw: Mukule na mukunywe na mufurahi,ni bora roho,juhudi ku kazi, kuliko utajiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a cherché ses enfants mais ne les a trouvés nulle part.
target_text: Alitafuta watoto yake alakini akuwapata.
target_text_raw: Alitafuta watoto yake alakini akuwapata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'attends ici dedans.
target_text: Naku ngoya apa ndani.
target_text_raw: Naku ngoya apa ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trouve un boulot, de façon à pouvoir subvenir aux besoins de ta femme et de tes enfants !
target_text: Pata kazi, uweze ku saidiya bibi na watoto wako!
target_text_raw: Pata kazi, uweze ku saidiya bibi na watoto wako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont tous déménagé ailleurs.
target_text: wali hama kwengine.
target_text_raw: wali hama kwengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela valait la peine d'essayer.
target_text: Ilikuwa lizama kupima.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa lizama kupima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le pari a porté ses fruits.
target_text: Pari yangu ili leta matunda.
target_text_raw: Pari yangu ili leta matunda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami devait en apporter la preuve.
target_text: Sami ilibidi athibitishe.
target_text_raw: Sami ilibidi athibitishe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ne pouvait pas se permettre les coûts élevés de la formation.
target_text: Hakuweza kumudu gharama kubwa za mafunzo.
target_text_raw: Hakuweza kumudu gharama kubwa za mafunzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Souvent chante la bouche, alors que le cœur saigne.
target_text: Kawaidi kinwa ina imba alakini roho ina vuya.
target_text_raw: Kawaidi kinwa ina imba alakini roho ina vuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas pour les autres qu'il nous faut être bons, mais pour être en paix avec nous-mêmes.
target_text: Aiko juya wengine njo lazima kukuwa muzuri alakini ju ya amani yetu pekee.
target_text_raw: Aiko juya wengine njo lazima kukuwa muzuri alakini ju ya amani yetu pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle aime s'habiller en sombre.
target_text: Anapenda vala nguo nyehusi.
target_text_raw: Anapenda vala nguo nyehusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous sentez pas gêné. Ces choses arrivent.
target_text: Mujisijisikie mbaya. Binafikaka.
target_text_raw: Mujisijisikie mbaya. Binafikaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a fichu son petit ami à la porte.
target_text: Ali tiya rafiki yangu kwa mulango.
target_text_raw: Ali tiya rafiki yangu kwa mulango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui ai donné de bons renseignements.
target_text: Nilikupatia renseignements za bien.
target_text_raw: Nilikupatia renseignements za bien.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dirait que c'est exact.
target_text: Ina wezekana kukuwa k weli.
target_text_raw: Ina wezekana kukuwa k weli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a commis trop de bêtises.
target_text: Alifanya ujinga nyingi.
target_text_raw: Alifanya ujinga nyingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un parent éloigné.
target_text: Ni muzazi wa mbali.
target_text_raw: Ni muzazi wa mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia est un tueur.
target_text: Kylia nimu uwaji.
target_text_raw: Kylia nimu uwaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je cherche le commissariat de police. Pouvez-vous m'aider ?
target_text: Na tafuta mukubwa wa police. Unaweza ni saiidiya?
target_text_raw: Na tafuta mukubwa wa police. Unaweza ni saiidiya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Coupe l'alimentation du tuyau !
target_text: Zima alimentation ya tuyau!
target_text_raw: Zima alimentation ya tuyau!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa nouvelle coupe de cheveux lui couvre les oreilles.
target_text: Kukata nywele kwake mupya ina funika masikio yake.
target_text_raw: Kukata nywele kwake mupya ina funika masikio yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a engagé un détective privé.
target_text: Aliajiri mpelelezi wa kibinafsi.
target_text_raw: Aliajiri mpelelezi wa kibinafsi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel habite un quartier tranquille.
target_text: Gabriel ana ishi eneo kimya.
target_text_raw: Gabriel ana ishi eneo kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai adoré te regarder danser.
target_text: Nili furahi kuona una cheza.
target_text_raw: Nili furahi kuona una cheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sur demande, l'appareil peut être équipé d'un réservoir de gaz étanche, et d'un disque dur à gaine plastique.
target_text: Kama una lomba, kifaa kinaweza kuwekwa na tanki la gesi lililofungwa na diski ngumu na ala ya plastiki.
target_text_raw: Kama una lomba, kifaa kinaweza kuwekwa na tanki la gesi lililofungwa na diski ngumu na ala ya plastiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce gamin est vraiment insolent, il m'a fait un pied de nez.
target_text: Mtoto huyu ni jeuri kweli.
target_text_raw: Mtoto huyu ni jeuri kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'entomologie n'est pas que l'étude du vol des mouches !
target_text: Entomolojia sio tu utafiti wa kuruka ya inzi!
target_text_raw: Entomolojia sio tu utafiti wa kuruka ya inzi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous ai dit de vous tenir à l'écart de ma fille.
target_text: Niliwa ambiya ku baki mbali na musichana wangu.
target_text_raw: Niliwa ambiya ku baki mbali na musichana wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laisse-moi m'en charger.
target_text: Ni atchiye iyo.
target_text_raw: Ni atchiye iyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne mangez pas les fruits qui sont dans le bol sur la table, ils sont en plastique.
target_text: Usikule matunda yenye iko mu bakuli yulu ya meza, niza plastiki.
target_text_raw: Usikule matunda yenye iko mu bakuli yulu ya meza, niza plastiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je propose que tu restes en dehors de ça.
target_text: NA shauri ubakiye inje ya iyo .
target_text_raw: NA shauri ubakiye inje ya iyo .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La mienne est mieux que la tienne.
target_text: Yangu niya muzuri kishanda yako.
target_text_raw: Yangu niya muzuri kishanda yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rodolphe aima comme toutes les femmes peuvent rêver d'être aimées, avec une force, une constance, une cohésion qui faisait de Francesca la substance même de son cœur.
target_text: Rodolphe alipenda kama wanawake wote wanaweza kuota kupendwa, kwa nguvu, uthabiti, mshikamano ambao ulimfanya Francesca kuwa dutu ya moyo wake.
target_text_raw: Rodolphe alipenda kama wanawake wote wanaweza kuota kupendwa, kwa nguvu, uthabiti, mshikamano ambao ulimfanya Francesca kuwa dutu ya moyo wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voilà qu'un convive non invité se rendit au micro.
target_text: Hapa mgeni asiyealikwa alikwenda kwenye kipaza sauti.
target_text_raw: Hapa mgeni asiyealikwa alikwenda kwenye kipaza sauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amour de la vérité est le plus rare des liens amoureux.
target_text: Upendo wa ukweli ni adimu ya uhusiano wa kimapenzi.
target_text_raw: Upendo wa ukweli ni adimu ya uhusiano wa kimapenzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et c'est reparti comme en quarante! Ils ne vont jamais s'arrêter, ces deux-là? À force de rompre et de se rabibocher, on ne sait plus où on en est.
target_text: Na imepita kama arubaini! Abata atcha bale bawili. Kwa sababu ya kuvunja na kutengeneza, hatujui tena tuko wapi.
target_text_raw: Na imepita kama arubaini! Abata atcha bale bawili. Kwa sababu ya kuvunja na kutengeneza, hatujui tena tuko wapi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous deviez partir tôt ?
target_text: Ni lazima kwende mbele?
target_text_raw: Ni lazima kwende mbele?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'es qu'un pauvre minable.
target_text: Uko masikini wa chini.
target_text_raw: Uko masikini wa chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est inconcevable que vous parliez au téléphone tandis que vous êtes derrière le volant.
target_text: Aiko muzuri kuongeya kwa siku kama una endesha gari.
target_text_raw: Aiko muzuri kuongeya kwa siku kama una endesha gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est le premier politicien d'envergure nationale à avoir été nommé dans un scandale de corruption qui s'avère grandissant.
target_text: Yeye njo mwanasiasa wa kwanza kitaifa kutajwa katika kashfa ya ufisadi inayokua.
target_text_raw: Yeye njo mwanasiasa wa kwanza kitaifa kutajwa katika kashfa ya ufisadi inayokua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu la trouves plus jolie que moi ?
target_text: Unawaza iko wa muzuri kunishinda?
target_text_raw: Unawaza iko wa muzuri kunishinda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il était presque midi lorsque Marie s'est réveillée.
target_text: Ilikuwa karibu midi saa Marie ali lamuka.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa karibu midi saa Marie ali lamuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Youba est cité comme exemple dans son école.
target_text: Youba anatajwa kama mfano katika shule yake.
target_text_raw: Youba anatajwa kama mfano katika shule yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas revu mes camarades de classe depuis que j'ai eu mon diplôme il y a 15 ans.
target_text: Siya ona wa rafiki zangu wa masomo kutoka nili pataka diploeme kunapita myaka 15
target_text_raw: Siya ona wa rafiki zangu wa masomo kutoka nili pataka diploeme kunapita myaka 15
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle éprouvait un vague sentiment de culpabilité.
target_text: Alihisi hisia isiyo wazi ya hatia.
target_text_raw: Alihisi hisia isiyo wazi ya hatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne devons pas nous permettre de laisser voir que nous n'avons pas de preuves.
target_text: Lazima tusi itike kuonekana kama hatuna uthibitisho.
target_text_raw: Lazima tusi itike kuonekana kama hatuna uthibitisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pourrons bientôt t'envoyer en prison.
target_text: Tunaweza kutuma karibu mu gereza.
target_text_raw: Tunaweza kutuma karibu mu gereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit que le temps change facilement en montagne.
target_text: Bana semaka kama wakati ina geuzaka mu milima.
target_text_raw: Bana semaka kama wakati ina geuzaka mu milima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Descendez ici et venez manger avec nous !
target_text: Mushuku uku, mukuye kula na siye!
target_text_raw: Mushuku uku, mukuye kula na siye!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que ma valise a été volée.
target_text: nNwaza kama valise yangu ili ibiwa.
target_text_raw: nNwaza kama valise yangu ili ibiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sur une feuille de papier, l'ingénieur réalise un dessin de l'appareil conçu par lui.
target_text: Ku karatasi moya, fundi ame chapa chombo yenye alifanya.
target_text_raw: Ku karatasi moya, fundi ame chapa chombo yenye alifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À l'abri des rochers, et sous de noirs ombrages, / il laisse ses vaisseaux ; et, deux traits à la main, / suivi du seul Achate, il se fraie un chemin.
target_text: Chini ya makazi ya miamba, na chini ya vivuli vyeusi, / anaacha vyombo vyake; na, viboko viwili mkononi mwake, / akifuatiwa na Achate peke yake, huenda.
target_text_raw: Chini ya makazi ya miamba, na chini ya vivuli vyeusi, / anaacha vyombo vyake; na, viboko viwili mkononi mwake, / akifuatiwa na Achate peke yake, huenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils avalaient des pilules.

source_text: Ou plutôt, puisque vous n'aimerez pas, puissé-je faire pousser une heureuse marguerite, dans le chemin du jardin qu'ainsi votre pied d'argent puisse m'encourager à aller, puisse m'encourager à aller, même jusqu'à la mort.
target_text: Au tuseme, kwa kuwa hautapenda, naomba nikue daisy yenye furaha, katika njia ya bustani ili mguu wako wa fedha univutie moyo niende, unitie moyo niende, hata kifo.

target_text_raw: Eveline ana tumika kama secretaire mu chumba yaba experts-comptables.

target_text_raw: Hali ya hewa ni ya moto, sitaki kutoka nje.

source_text: Si ces massacres et violations des droits de l'Homme étaient commis dans un autre pays, tout le monde dirait que c'est un pays barbare.

source_text: Peut-être que tout ce que l'on peut espérer est de finir avec les bons regrets.

target_text_raw: Labda yote ambayo mtu anaweza kutarajia ni kuishia na majuto mazuri.

target_text_raw: Sa alitoka ku kazi, alikula chakula yake magaribi.

target_text_raw: Mwenye anatoka ona directeurmu bureau yake, iko na lazima yaku pita kwa secretaire.

source_text: J'ai cherché un livre avec beaucoup d'images.

target_text_raw: Niko na tafuta kitabu yenye iko na picture mingi.

source_text: Une défaite offre toujours l'occasion de grandir.

target_text_raw: Kushindwa kila wakati hutoa fursa ya kukua.

target_text_raw: Nilimu lumiza roho, na nika mu lilisha.

target_text: Una ugonjwa wa moyo au unasumbuliwa na mzunguko wa damu uliofadhaika kwenda kwenye ubongo?

target_text: Chini ya mng'ao wa jua, majani ya mzabibu huchukua tani ambazo hutofautiana kutoka manjano kupitia vivuli vyote vya rangi nyekundu, hudhurungi, machungwa hadi kufikia zambarau.

target_text_raw: Niko nataka jifunza ku cheza go.

target_text: Tumaini ni wakati unapoingia jikoni ghafla kama kichaa ili kudhibitisha kuwa sanduku la mikate ya chokoleti uliyomaliza saa moja mapema imejazwa tena kichawi.

target_text: Lazima nimuone daktari wa magonjwa ya ngozi ili aondoe mishono yangu.
target_text_raw: Lazima nimuone daktari wa magonjwa ya ngozi ili aondoe mishono yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu parlais fort.
target_text: Uli ongeya na sauti ya yulu.
target_text_raw: Uli ongeya na sauti ya yulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit que le jus de betterave peut faire baisser la tension artérielle.
target_text: Wanasema kamajus ya betteraveinaweza shusha tension.
target_text_raw: Wanasema kamajus ya betteraveinaweza shusha tension.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous parlons de tuer le temps, comme si hélas ! ce n'était pas lui qui nous tuait !
target_text: Tuna ongeya juyaku poteza wakati na nikama ayo njo inatu uwa!
target_text_raw: Tuna ongeya juyaku poteza wakati na nikama ayo njo inatu uwa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enchanté de t'aider !
target_text: Na furahi ku kusaidiya!
target_text_raw: Na furahi ku kusaidiya!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont tous des gosses.
target_text: Abo bote biko na batoto .
target_text_raw: Abo bote biko na batoto .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous assure qu'il est là.
target_text: Ninawahakikishia kwamba iko.
target_text_raw: Ninawahakikishia kwamba iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça va être compliqué de convaincre Maxime de nous aider.
target_text: Itakuwa nguvu kumu akikisha Maxime atu saidiye.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa nguvu kumu akikisha Maxime atu saidiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me manques tellement. J'ai hâte de te voir.
target_text: Naku kumbuka sana. Nataka sana kukuona.
target_text_raw: Naku kumbuka sana. Nataka sana kukuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On s'est fait une petite bouffe.
target_text: Tukule pamoja.
target_text_raw: Tukule pamoja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle vient de s’asseoir quand quelques pigeons arrivent en volant.
target_text: Anatoka ikala sa ma ndege zinafika ku volant.
target_text_raw: Anatoka ikala sa ma ndege zinafika ku volant.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que le jugement de la foule vous fasse toujours réfléchir, mais qu'il ne vous décourage jamais !
target_text: Mei hukumu ya umati kila wakati ikufanye ufikirie, lakini usikate tamaa kamwe!
target_text_raw: Mei hukumu ya umati kila wakati ikufanye ufikirie, lakini usikate tamaa kamwe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il vit dans une résidence fermée.
target_text: Ana ishi mu nyumba ina fungiwa.
target_text_raw: Ana ishi mu nyumba ina fungiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'avais pas réalisé que vous étiez déjà là.
target_text: Sikuona kama mulisha fika.
target_text_raw: Sikuona kama mulisha fika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom le saura.
target_text: Tom atajuwa.
target_text_raw: Tom atajuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une colonne de fumée blanche s'éleva vers le ciel.
target_text: Safu ya moshi mweupe ilipanda angani.
target_text_raw: Safu ya moshi mweupe ilipanda angani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Heureusement, Théo est différent maintenant.
target_text: Ni muzuri ngisi Théoali badirika sasa.
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri ngisi Théoali badirika sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donnez l’idée générale du texte que vous avez lu.
target_text: Toa wazo la jumla la maandishi uliyosoma.
target_text_raw: Toa wazo la jumla la maandishi uliyosoma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Permettez que je vous présente Mayuko.
target_text: Niruhusu nimtambulishe Mayuko kwako.
target_text_raw: Niruhusu nimtambulishe Mayuko kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu m'as empoigné les fesses !
target_text: Aliniponda matako!
target_text_raw: Aliniponda matako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon est tombé de peur quand il a vu un fantôme.
target_text: Ule kijana alipata boga saa aliona fantôme.
target_text_raw: Ule kijana alipata boga saa aliona fantôme.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu jouais de la guitare.
target_text: Ulikuwa na cheza gitaa.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa na cheza gitaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu peux te débarrasser de ton rhume en prenant ce médicament.
target_text: Unaweza ponesha oma yako na iyi dawa.
target_text_raw: Unaweza ponesha oma yako na iyi dawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève ta jupe, s'il te plaît.
target_text: Tosha jupe yako tafazari.
target_text_raw: Tosha jupe yako tafazari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me mens toujours.
target_text: Unani danganyaka kila saa.
target_text_raw: Unani danganyaka kila saa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre maison comprend sept pièces, salon compris.
target_text: Nyumba yetu iko na chumba saba, na salon.
target_text_raw: Nyumba yetu iko na chumba saba, na salon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a employé tous les moyens de conviction, supplication... (Il se tient sur un pied suppliant).
target_text: Alitumia njia zote za kusadikika..
target_text_raw: Alitumia njia zote za kusadikika. (anasimama ku mugulu moya yaku tchoka).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aime tous les animaux à l'exception des chevaux.
target_text: Anapenda ma myama zote bila chevaux.
target_text_raw: Anapenda ma myama zote bila chevaux.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'île est un paradis pour les enfants.
target_text: Ile ile ni mbuguni ku batoto.
target_text_raw: Ile ile ni mbuguni ku batoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'importe qui lance, cette équipe perd toujours.
target_text: Haijalishi ni nani anayetupa, timu hii hupoteza kila wakati.
target_text_raw: Haijalishi ni nani anayetupa, timu hii hupoteza kila wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On m'a rapporté hier l'agréable nouvelle que vous étiez revenues de votre voyage.
target_text: Walini ambiya jana habari muzuri yako yakutoka safari.
target_text_raw: Walini ambiya jana habari muzuri yako yakutoka safari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il l'a interrompu en lui disant non.
target_text: Alimu simamisha akamwambiya apana.
target_text_raw: Alimu simamisha akamwambiya apana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pomme est douce.
target_text: Pomme iko tamu.
target_text_raw: Pomme iko tamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je le regrette mais ce tableau n'est pas à vendre.
target_text: Si uzike, iyi tableau aiko yaku uzisha.
target_text_raw: Si uzike, iyi tableau aiko yaku uzisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pourrez venir?
target_text: Munaweza kuya.
target_text_raw: Munaweza kuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devrions garder cette information sous le coude pour l'instant.
target_text: Tungeweza weka ile habari kwa iyi wakati.
target_text_raw: Tungeweza weka ile habari kwa iyi wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Allez dire à ceux qui vous envoient que nous sommes ici par la volonté du peuple et que nous ne quitterons nos places que par la force des baïonnettes !
target_text: Muenda uwaambie wale wanaokutuma kwamba tuko hapa kwa mapenzi ya watu na kwamba tutaacha tu maeneo yetu kwa nguvu ya bayonets!
target_text_raw: Muenda uwaambie wale wanaokutuma kwamba tuko hapa kwa mapenzi ya watu na kwamba tutaacha tu maeneo yetu kwa nguvu ya bayonets!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous serons pauvres et nous souffrirons la misère aussi longtemps qu’il le faut, comme une ville assiégée qui n’entend pas capituler, mais nous montrerons que nous sommes quelque chose.
target_text: Tutakuwa maskini na tutapata shida kwa muda mrefu kama inachukua, kama mji uliozingirwa ambao hautaki kujisalimisha, lakini tutaonyesha kuwa sisi ni kitu.
target_text_raw: Tutakuwa maskini na tutapata shida kwa muda mrefu kama inachukua, kama mji uliozingirwa ambao hautaki kujisalimisha, lakini tutaonyesha kuwa sisi ni kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le médecin reçoit ses patients de 15h à 18h.
target_text: Muganga ana pokea wagonjwa kutoka 15h mpaka 18h.
target_text_raw: Muganga ana pokea wagonjwa kutoka 15h mpaka 18h.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chacun peut apporter sa pierre à la protection de l'environnement.
target_text: Kila mtu anaweza kuchukua jukumu lake katika kulinda mazingira.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu anaweza kuchukua jukumu lake katika kulinda mazingira.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu descends en ville.
target_text: Unashuka mu ville.
target_text_raw: Unashuka mu ville.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'arriverai jamais à dormir.
target_text: Siwezake lala tena.
target_text_raw: Siwezake lala tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te répète que ta conduite laisse à désirer.
target_text: Na rudiliya, tabiya yake niya mubaya.
target_text_raw: Na rudiliya, tabiya yake niya mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan harcela Linda d'appels continus.
target_text: Dan alimu sumbuwa Linda ni simu za mingi.
target_text_raw: Dan alimu sumbuwa Linda ni simu za mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me rappelles moi lorsque j'avais ton âge.
target_text: Unani kumbusha miye sa nilikuwa na myaka yako.
target_text_raw: Unani kumbusha miye sa nilikuwa na myaka yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ravie, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Una furahi, sivyo?
target_text_raw: Una furahi, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se bouche les yeux et fait semblant de ne pas comprendre.
target_text: Anafunga matcho naku danganya kama asikiye.
target_text_raw: Anafunga matcho naku danganya kama asikiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kim sourit gentiment.
target_text: Kim anacheka.
target_text_raw: Kim anacheka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jeu est la seule chose que les hommes prennent au sérieux, c'est pourquoi les règles du jeu sont plus anciennes que toutes les lois du monde.
target_text: Kamari ndio kitu pekee ambacho wanaume huchukua kwa uzito, ndiyo sababu sheria za mchezo huo ni za zamani kuliko sheria yoyote ulimwenguni.
target_text_raw: Kamari ndio kitu pekee ambacho wanaume huchukua kwa uzito, ndiyo sababu sheria za mchezo huo ni za zamani kuliko sheria yoyote ulimwenguni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, j'irai.
target_text: Ndiyo nita enda.
target_text_raw: Ndiyo nita enda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "OK" se trouve-t-il dans le Littré ?
target_text: “sawa” ilikuwa ndani ya Littré?
target_text_raw: “sawa” ilikuwa ndani ya Littré?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Un bon capitaine quitte toujours son navire en premier, » dit Hugo « car seul un capitaine en vie est un bon capitaine. »
target_text: «Nahodha mzuri siku zote huiacha meli yake kwanza,» anasema Hugo, «kwa sababu tu nahodha aliye hai ndiye nahodha mzuri.»
target_text_raw: «Nahodha mzuri siku zote huiacha meli yake kwanza,» anasema Hugo, «kwa sababu tu nahodha aliye hai ndiye nahodha mzuri.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous aviez suivi mon conseil, vous ne seriez pas dans un tel embarras, maintenant.
target_text: Ikiwa ulifuata shauri wangu, usingekuwa katika aibu kama hiyo sasa.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa ulifuata shauri wangu, usingekuwa katika aibu kama hiyo sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les pétales de la rose sont très doux.
target_text: Maua ya rose ni laini sana.
target_text_raw: Maua ya rose ni laini sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le règne de Ramsès II dura 67 ans.
target_text: Utawala wa Ramses II ulidumu miaka 67.
target_text_raw: Utawala wa Ramses II ulidumu miaka 67.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un agent de la circulation fait arrêter les voitures.
target_text: Polisi wa trafiki anasimamisha magari.
target_text_raw: Polisi wa trafiki anasimamisha magari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Dis, comment ça se fait que t’es si cool ? » « C’est dans ma nature. »
target_text: «Haya, vipi mbona uko poa sana?» «Ni katika asili yangu.»
target_text_raw: «Haya, vipi mbona uko poa sana?» «Ni katika asili yangu.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je donne la pomme à Jack.
target_text: Mina patiya Jack pomme.
target_text_raw: Mina patiya Jack pomme.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Certaines personnes viennent au monde comme des bénédictions, d'autres comme des leçons.
target_text: Watu wengine huja ulimwenguni kama baraka, wengine kama masomo.
target_text_raw: Watu wengine huja ulimwenguni kama baraka, wengine kama masomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon chéri, peux-tu repasser ma robe, s'il te plait ?
target_text: Mpenzi, unawza pika pasi nguo yangu, tafazari?
target_text_raw: Mpenzi, unawza pika pasi nguo yangu, tafazari?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La jeunesse s'enfuit sans jamais revenir.
target_text: Vijana hukimbia bila kurudi tena.
target_text_raw: Vijana hukimbia bila kurudi tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir à tous.
target_text: Nawa salumu.
target_text_raw: Nawa salumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand j'aurai remboursé toutes mes dettes, il ne me restera plus d'argent.
target_text: Ninga maliza lipe deni zangu, sitabaki tena na pesa
target_text_raw: Ninga maliza lipe deni zangu, sitabaki tena na pesa
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne me connaissez pas du tout.
target_text: Hamunijuwe ata kidogo.
target_text_raw: Hamunijuwe ata kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se tenait droit comme un i.
target_text: Ali simama kama i.
target_text_raw: Ali simama kama i.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est pas sympa d'avoir mangé tout le grisbi.
target_text: Ni vizuri gisi tulikula ile gribsi yote.
target_text_raw: Ni vizuri gisi tulikula ile gribsi yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pars en avion à Paris.
target_text: Minaenda na ndege Paris.
target_text_raw: Minaenda na ndege Paris.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que tu fous bordel ?
target_text: Unasema nini kuhusu hile?
target_text_raw: Unasema nini kuhusu hile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les taux de change sont affichés quotidiennement à l'extérieur de la caisse.
target_text: Viwango vya ubadilishaji huwekwa kila siku nje ya mtunza fedha.
target_text_raw: Viwango vya ubadilishaji huwekwa kila siku nje ya mtunza fedha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Veux-tu une pomme ? » « Rien ne me ferait plus plaisir que ça. »
target_text: “Unataka Pomme?” “akuna kitu ingine itani furahisha.”
target_text_raw: “Unataka Pomme?” “akuna kitu ingine itani furahisha.”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Est-il à côté de la voiture ?» «Non, il est dedans.»
target_text: “Iko pembeni ya gari?” “apana, iko ndani.”
target_text_raw: “Iko pembeni ya gari?” “apana, iko ndani.”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est exact que les Étasuniens adorent la pizza.
target_text: Ni kweli wa Etasuniens wanapenda Pizza.
target_text_raw: Ni kweli wa Etasuniens wanapenda Pizza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qui ne vous tue pas vous renforce.
target_text: Amuta kufa kitu muka tiya bidii.
target_text_raw: Amuta kufa kitu muka tiya bidii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après avoir été innocenté, le concombre tueur prit une retraite bien méritée en Espagne.
target_text: Baada ya kusafishwa, tango muuaji alichukua kustaafu stahili huko Uhispania.
target_text_raw: Baada ya kusafishwa, tango muuaji alichukua kustaafu stahili huko Uhispania.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a dépensé soixante-dix mille yens dans un bar à hôtesses.
target_text: Alitumia yen elfu sabini katika baa ya mhudumu.
target_text_raw: Alitumia yen elfu sabini katika baa ya mhudumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'est conduit comme un gamin.
target_text: Anaji kamata kama mutoto.
target_text_raw: Anaji kamata kama mutoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous aurez beau essayer, vous ne réussirez pas aussi facilement.
target_text: Atakama munapima, amutaweza.
target_text_raw: Atakama munapima, amutaweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai amené au restaurant le plus cher du campus.
target_text: Nilimu beba ku restaurant ya beyi sana ya campus.
target_text_raw: Nilimu beba ku restaurant ya beyi sana ya campus.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un bracelet assez curieux que tu portes là.
target_text: Kikomo unavala sijawayi ona.
target_text_raw: Kikomo unavala sijawayi ona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le magazine Look a arrêté sa publication.
target_text: Jarida la Look limeacha kuchapishwa kwake.
target_text_raw: Jarida la Look limeacha kuchapishwa kwake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reviendrai. Je le promets.
target_text: Nda rudiya. Mina ku ahidi.
target_text_raw: Nda rudiya. Mina ku ahidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son souvenir vivra éternellement dans nos cœurs et dans nos esprits.
target_text: Kumbukumbu yake itaendelea kuishi milele katika mioyo na akili zetu.
target_text_raw: Kumbukumbu yake itaendelea kuishi milele katika mioyo na akili zetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La morale est la faiblesse de la cervelle.
target_text: Maadili ni udhaifu wa ubongo.
target_text_raw: Maadili ni udhaifu wa ubongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Y a-t-il des jolies filles qui viennent t'accoster en boîte ?
target_text: Kuna wasichana wazuri wanakutana na wewe kwenye kilabu?
target_text_raw: Kuna wasichana wazuri wanakutana na wewe kwenye kilabu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les mensonges grossiers que ce politicien nous sert font réfléchir le Baron Munchhausen.
target_text: Crass uongo kwamba mwanasiasa huyu anatuhudumia hufanya Baron Munchhausen afikirie.
target_text_raw: Crass uongo kwamba mwanasiasa huyu anatuhudumia hufanya Baron Munchhausen afikirie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pause est finie.
target_text: Mapumziko umekwisha.
target_text_raw: Mapumziko umekwisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien qu'ils soient jumeaux, ils ont peu d'intérêts en commun.
target_text: Ingawa wao ni mapacha, wana maslahi machache sawa.
target_text_raw: Ingawa wao ni mapacha, wana maslahi machache sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais dû amener un déjeuner.
target_text: Ningeleta chakula.
target_text_raw: Ningeleta chakula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un effort permanent amène à un succès certain.
target_text: Jitihada za kudumu husababisha mafanikio fulani.
target_text_raw: Jitihada za kudumu husababisha mafanikio fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai effectué des recherches.
target_text: Nilifanya utafiti.
target_text_raw: Nilifanya utafiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Croyez-vous que je me soucie de ce que vous pensez de moi ?
target_text: MMisi jali kujuwa kenye munani wanza ako.
target_text_raw: MMisi jali kujuwa kenye munani wanza ako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne perds pas ton temps à essayer de convaincre Kylia.
target_text: Uko na poteza wakati yako ku shawishi Kylia.
target_text_raw: Uko na poteza wakati yako ku shawishi Kylia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Est-ce que tu t'appelles Marie ? » « Oui, je m'appelle Marie. »
target_text: “Jina lako ni Marie?” “ndio, jina langu ni Marie.”
target_text_raw: “Jina lako ni Marie?” “ndio, jina langu ni Marie.”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pourrai pas assister à votre mariage.
target_text: Sitaweza kuwa ku harusi yenu.
target_text_raw: Sitaweza kuwa ku harusi yenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais essayer de rester bref.
target_text: Ndakuwa mufupi kwa maneno.
target_text_raw: Ndakuwa mufupi kwa maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons céder dans une certaine mesure si nous voulons arriver à un accord.
target_text: Tunapaswa kujitoa kwa kiwango fulani ikiwa tuafikia makubaliano.
target_text_raw: Tunapaswa kujitoa kwa kiwango fulani ikiwa tuafikia makubaliano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La Suisse est formidable !
target_text: Suisse napazuri!
target_text_raw: Suisse napazuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trop cool !
target_text: Ni safi!
target_text_raw: Ni safi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est inutile d'essayer de s'échapper.
target_text: Ni bure kupima ku kimbiya.
target_text_raw: Ni bure kupima ku kimbiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas la faute de Jack.
target_text: Aiko kosa ya Jack.
target_text_raw: Aiko kosa ya Jack.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons reprendre ce document avant que Kylia ne le montre à n’importe qui.
target_text: Tunahitaji kurudisha hati hii kabla ya Kylia kumwonyesha mtu yeyote.
target_text_raw: Tunahitaji kurudisha hati hii kabla ya Kylia kumwonyesha mtu yeyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demandez au bureau d'information.
target_text: Uliza kwenye dawati la habari.
target_text_raw: Uliza kwenye dawati la habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne me reste que quelques balles.
target_text: Nimebakiza mipira michache tu.
target_text_raw: Nimebakiza mipira michache tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chéri, iras-tu faire du shopping pour moi?
target_text: Mpenzi, utaninunulia?
target_text_raw: Mpenzi, utaninunulia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont vérifié si les empreintes digitales trouvées sur la porte sont celles du voleur.
target_text: Waliangalia ikiwa alama za vidole zilizopatikana mlangoni ni zile za mwizi.
target_text_raw: Waliangalia ikiwa alama za vidole zilizopatikana mlangoni ni zile za mwizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voulons simplement vivre en paix.
target_text: Tunataka ichi na amani.
target_text_raw: Tunataka ichi na amani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand pensais-tu revenir aux USA ?
target_text: Una weza rudiya wakati gani kule USA
target_text_raw: Una weza rudiya wakati gani kule USA
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que j'obtiens en échange ?
target_text: Ndapata nini?
target_text_raw: Ndapata nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Même en portant un complet Armani et en conduisant une Jaguar, à la fin on est pareils aux fourmis. On bouge, on bouge et on meurt sans raison.
target_text: Hata kuvaa suti ya Armani na kuendesha Jaguar, mwishowe wewe ni kama mchwa. Tunasonga, tunahama na tunakufa bila sababu.
target_text_raw: Hata kuvaa suti ya Armani na kuendesha Jaguar, mwishowe wewe ni kama mchwa. Tunasonga, tunahama na tunakufa bila sababu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a cherché après elle et il l’a trouvée.
target_text: Alimu tafuta, akamupata!
target_text_raw: Alimu tafuta, akamupata!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand on dit qu'on se fout de quelque chose, c'est qu'on ne s'en fout pas.
target_text: Tunaposema kwamba hatujali kitu, ni kwa sababu tujali.
target_text_raw: Tunaposema kwamba hatujali kitu, ni kwa sababu tujali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La loi constitue une attaque en règle contre les droits des consommateurs.
target_text: Sheria ni shambulio rasmi kwa haki za watumiaji.
target_text_raw: Sheria ni shambulio rasmi kwa haki za watumiaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir, tout le monde !
target_text: Habari za jioni kila mtu!
target_text_raw: Habari za jioni kila mtu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir travailler dur.
target_text: Ni lazima ku tumika sana.
target_text_raw: Ni lazima ku tumika sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est plus doux de donner que de recevoir.
target_text: NI vizuri sana kupana kuliko ku pokeya.
target_text_raw: NI vizuri sana kupana kuliko ku pokeya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je caresse le rêve suivant: aller vivre au soleil dans un pays tranquille.
target_text: Ninathamini ndoto ifuatayo: kwenda kuishi jua katika nchi tulivu.
target_text_raw: Ninathamini ndoto ifuatayo: kwenda kuishi jua katika nchi tulivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de personnes est-ce que vous connaissez bien ?
target_text: Ni watu wangapi uni faamu vizuri.
target_text_raw: Ni watu wangapi uni faamu vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous sentez pas gênés. Ces choses arrivent.
target_text: Musi uzike. Binafikaka.
target_text_raw: Musi uzike. Binafikaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo est fort malin.
target_text: Hugo iko na akili mingi.
target_text_raw: Hugo iko na akili mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas pour votre famille.
target_text: Musijali juya familia.
target_text_raw: Musijali juya familia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mačči yiwet n tugdi i d-yettlalen seg εeyyu meqqren d tasuft.
target_text: Mačči yiwet n tugdi i d-yettlalen seg εeyyu meqqren d tasuft.
target_text_raw: Mačči yiwet n tugdi i d-yettlalen seg εeyyu meqqren d tasuft.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas de quoi s'inquiéter.
target_text: Hakuna cha kuwa na wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Hakuna cha kuwa na wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’exemple n’est pas le meilleur moyen de convaincre, c’est le seul.
target_text: Mfano sio njia bora ya kushawishi, ndio pekee.
target_text_raw: Mfano sio njia bora ya kushawishi, ndio pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-il sympa avec elle ?
target_text: Iko vizuri na yeye?
target_text_raw: Iko vizuri na yeye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne parlais pas de toi.
target_text: Sikusema ju yako.
target_text_raw: Sikusema ju yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu pars demain ?
target_text: Unaenda kesho?
target_text_raw: Unaenda kesho?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les modifications sont en cours au moment où nous parlons.
target_text: Mabadiliko yanaendelea tunapozungumza.
target_text_raw: Mabadiliko yanaendelea tunapozungumza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'as-tu donc dit, bordel ?
target_text: Ulisema nini?
target_text_raw: Ulisema nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous descendîmes dans une petite vallée qui m’eût enchanté dans tout autre instant.
target_text: Tulishuka kwenye bonde dogo ambalo lingekuwa likiniloga wakati wowote mwingine.
target_text_raw: Tulishuka kwenye bonde dogo ambalo lingekuwa likiniloga wakati wowote mwingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'aime pas que j'appelle ses enfants "ses gosses".
target_text: Yeye hapendi niwaite watoto wake «watoto wake».
target_text_raw: Yeye hapendi niwaite watoto wake «watoto wake».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous assure que ce n'est pas qu'une question d'argent.
target_text: Aiko shida ya pesa.
target_text_raw: Aiko shida ya pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cuisinier prépare des plats différents tous les jours.
target_text: Mupishi anapika chakula tafauti kila siku.
target_text_raw: Mupishi anapika chakula tafauti kila siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'avais pas réalisé que vous étiez ici.
target_text: Sikujua ulikuwa hapa.
target_text_raw: Sikujua ulikuwa hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde le saura.
target_text: Kila mutu atajuwa.
target_text_raw: Kila mutu atajuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais imaginé qu'il me ferait ça.
target_text: Siku waziya kama anaweza fanya vile.
target_text_raw: Siku waziya kama anaweza fanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beurrer les moules à madeleines, et verser la préparation dedans (mais pas jusqu'en haut, les madeleines vont gonfler !).
target_text: Siagi ukungu wa madeleines, na mimina maandalizi ndani.
target_text_raw: Siagi ukungu wa madeleines, na mimina maandalizi ndani (lakini sio juu, madeleines watavimba!).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet enfant a résolu facilement ce problème mathématique compliqué.
target_text: Mutoto huyu alitatua shida hii ngumu ya hesabu.
target_text_raw: Mutoto huyu alitatua shida hii ngumu ya hesabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel âge vous me donnez ?
target_text: Munanipa mwaka ngapi?
target_text_raw: Munanipa mwaka ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces jeux de fesses m'ont épuisé.
target_text: Michezo hii ya kitako imenichosha.
target_text_raw: Michezo hii ya kitako imenichosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'essai en traction permet de mettre en évidence les caractéristiques principales d'un matériau.
target_text: Mtihani wa kuvuta hufanya iweze kuonyesha sifa kuu za nyenzo.
target_text_raw: Mtihani wa kuvuta hufanya iweze kuonyesha sifa kuu za nyenzo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle fut choquée à la vue d'un fantôme.
target_text: Alishtuka baada ya kuona mzuka.
target_text_raw: Alishtuka baada ya kuona mzuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a essayé de se débarrasser des fourmis.
target_text: Alijaribu kuondoa mchwa.
target_text_raw: Alijaribu kuondoa mchwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hé, toi, enlève tes lunettes et laisse-nous applaudir !
target_text: Haya, vua glasi yako na tupige makofi!
target_text_raw: Haya, vua glasi yako na tupige makofi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce exact ?
target_text: Ni kweli?
target_text_raw: Ni kweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me mens plus jamais.
target_text: Usini danganye tena.
target_text_raw: Usini danganye tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est moi qui ai dormi au salon.
target_text: Mimi njo nililala kwa salon.
target_text_raw: Mimi njo nililala kwa salon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui tue des enfants n’est pas humain.
target_text: Mwenye anauwa watoto sib inadamu.
target_text_raw: Mwenye anauwa watoto sib inadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan était un tueur impitoyable.
target_text: Dan alikuwa mu uwaji wa hatari.
target_text_raw: Dan alikuwa mu uwaji wa hatari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime les chevaux.
target_text: Napenda ma chevaux.
target_text_raw: Napenda ma chevaux.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis en train d'écluser le bar.
target_text: Ninafunga baa.
target_text_raw: Ninafunga baa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette île est un paradis pour les enfants.
target_text: Kisiwa hiki ni paradiso ya watoto.
target_text_raw: Kisiwa hiki ni paradiso ya watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne lance de pierres contre rien.
target_text: Situpi mawe kwa chochote.
target_text_raw: Situpi mawe kwa chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand j'étais gamin, j'étais bon à rien.
target_text: Wakati nilikuwa mutoto, sikufanya kitu.
target_text_raw: Wakati nilikuwa mutoto, sikufanya kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis contente que tu aies de bons amis.
target_text: Nafurahi uko na wa rafiki wazuri.
target_text_raw: Nafurahi uko na wa rafiki wazuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a décliné ma requête, en disant être occupé.
target_text: Alikataa ombi langu, akisema alikuwa na shughuli.
target_text_raw: Alikataa ombi langu, akisema alikuwa na shughuli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa voix était douce et tendre.
target_text: Sauti yake ilikuwa muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Sauti yake ilikuwa muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon petit frère courut complètement nu à travers le salon.
target_text: Muloko yangu ali kimbiya na anavala butchi mpaka ku salon.
target_text_raw: Muloko yangu ali kimbiya na anavala butchi mpaka ku salon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne pourrez pas vous lever de si bonne heure.
target_text: Amuwezi lamuka asubuyi?
target_text_raw: Amuwezi lamuka asubuyi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrêtez de faire celles qui ne sont pas intéressées !
target_text: Mu atcha onesha kama amutaki.
target_text_raw: Mu atcha onesha kama amutaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui a la volonté a la force.
target_text: Mwenye anataka iko na nguvu.
target_text_raw: Mwenye anataka iko na nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je descends au prochain arrêt.
target_text: Nda shuka ku arreêt yaku fwata.
target_text_raw: Nda shuka ku arreêt yaku fwata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je le répète, et dis, vaille que vaille, le monde n'est que franche moutonnaille.
target_text: Narudia, na kusema, haijalishi ni nini, ulimwengu si kitu isipokuwa kondoo mkweli.
target_text_raw: Narudia, na kusema, haijalishi ni nini, ulimwengu si kitu isipokuwa kondoo mkweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regrette beaucoup qu'étant à Pékin, je n'aie pas vu le Palais impérial. Je n'ai pas pu le visiter, n'ayant pas suffisamment de temps.
target_text: Ninajuta sana kuwa, nikiwa Pékin, sikuona Ikulu ya Kifalme. Siku weza enda mu salimiya, sikukuwa na wakati.
target_text_raw: Ninajuta sana kuwa, nikiwa Pékin, sikuona Ikulu ya Kifalme. Siku weza enda mu salimiya, sikukuwa na wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons rentrer vite parce que nous avons parié que nous serons les premiers à la maison.
target_text: Lazima tufike nyumbani haraka kwa sababu tunabeti tutakuwa nyumbani kwanza.
target_text_raw: Lazima tufike nyumbani haraka kwa sababu tunabeti tutakuwa nyumbani kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens ont besoin de protection contre les radiations à l'extérieur.
target_text: Watu wanahitaji ulinzi wa mnururisho nje.
target_text_raw: Watu wanahitaji ulinzi wa mnururisho nje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les photographies sont les seules preuves que nous ayons.
target_text: Picha ndio ushahidi pekee tulionao.
target_text_raw: Picha ndio ushahidi pekee tulionao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai grandi dans ce quartier.
target_text: Nili komala mu iyi quartier.
target_text_raw: Nili komala mu iyi quartier.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai deux ou trois appels à passer aujourd'hui.
target_text: Niko na simu mbili wala tatu yakupiga leo.
target_text_raw: Niko na simu mbili wala tatu yakupiga leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu te rappelles de la question ?
target_text: Ungali na kumbuka ile swali?
target_text_raw: Ungali na kumbuka ile swali?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serais ravie que vous puissiez venir avec nous.
target_text: Mani furahi kuona ngisi munakuja na sisi.
target_text_raw: Mani furahi kuona ngisi munakuja na sisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai même pas les moyens d'acheter une voiture d'occasion.
target_text: Sina ata uwezo naku uza gari yenye ilisha tumishiwa.
target_text_raw: Sina ata uwezo naku uza gari yenye ilisha tumishiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes certes des citoyens très respectueux de la loi, mais si, à l'occasion, des problèmes apparaissent, alors nous devrons simplement interpréter les lois avec souplesse.
target_text: Kwa kweli sisi ni raia wanaotii sheria, lakini ikiwa mara kwa mara shida zinaibuka, basi tutalazimika kuzitafsiri sheria kwa urahisi.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli sisi ni raia wanaotii sheria, lakini ikiwa mara kwa mara shida zinaibuka, basi tutalazimika kuzitafsiri sheria kwa urahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et après la débandade de tous mes compagnons devant le rugissement du lion, il ne restait que moi, votre oncle Louis, pour affronter cet animal qui atteignait presque la taille d'un éléphant.
target_text: Na baada ya kukanyagana kwa wenzangu wote mbele ya kishindo cha simba, kulikuwa na mimi tu, mjomba wako Louis, kumkabili mnyama huyu ambaye alifikia karibu saizi ya tembo.
target_text_raw: Na baada ya kukanyagana kwa wenzangu wote mbele ya kishindo cha simba, kulikuwa na mimi tu, mjomba wako Louis, kumkabili mnyama huyu ambaye alifikia karibu saizi ya tembo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette école ressemble de l'extérieur à une prison.
target_text: Iyi masomo inje ina fanana jela.
target_text_raw: Iyi masomo inje ina fanana jela.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous fûmes contraints de mentir pour nous protéger.
target_text: Tuli danganya juya kujilinda.
target_text_raw: Tuli danganya juya kujilinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De temps en temps, elle faisait une pause et regardait le sommet en soupirant.
target_text: Kila wakati alikuwa akisimama na kutazama juu kwa kuugua.

source_text: De quelque manière que vous le fassiez, le résultat n'est pas différent.

target_text_raw: Iliandikia Catherine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Dans quelles circonstances le corps a-t-il été découvert ?", demanda le commissaire.
target_text: «Ni mu hali gani njo mwili iligunduliwa» mkubwa wa polisi aliuliza.
target_text_raw: «Ni mu hali gani njo mwili iligunduliwa» mkubwa wa polisi aliuliza.

target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nawaza batazimisha mwangaza ile saa, lakini tala ilikuwa tu inawaka.

target_text_raw: Ni muzui zaidi kufundisha mutu kulowa samaki pahali ya kumupatia samaki.

target_text_raw: Uambia Bwana Tate kama Helena Cartwright iko hapa anapenda amuone.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation commettent toutes sortes de crimes au vu et au su de tout le monde.

target_text_raw: Majeshi ya wavamizi iko inafanya mauwaji na watu wote wanajuwa.

target_text_raw: Juu ya Kitaliano yake, Dan aliweza kujisikilisha na watu wa Mexico.

target_text_raw: Anza mazoezi yako!

target_text_raw: Sungura ilikuwa katikati ya barabara, ilicanganyikiwa na matala za camion yenyi ilikuwa inakuya.

target_text_raw: Uchunguzi wa kisasa ya ADN inawatesa batu mingi na kuwabeba mpaka kufa huko Amerika.

target_text_raw: Hasabu zangu hazifanane kuwa sawa sawa na zako.

target_text_raw: Haiko aina ya mutu wa kuitika makosa yake mbio mbio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'esprit est-il quelque chose matériel ? Et s'il en allait ainsi, où devrions-nous situer la conscience ? Et l'âme ?

target_text_raw: Akili ni kitu kyenyi kinaweza onekana na maco? Na kama anaenda vile, tunapashwa tia zamiri wapi? Na nafsi?

target_text_raw: Mutaona kama niko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Umate watu waliandamana juu ya haki za binadamu.

target_text_raw: Hakuna kuingia saa ya réunion.

source_text: La police ne peut l'interroger pour cette raison.

target_text_raw: Police haitamusambisha juu ya ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laura était peut-être malade.
target_text: Laura alikuwa mgonjwa labda.
target_text_raw: Laura alikuwa mgonjwa labda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va de mal en pis.
target_text: Anaendelea kuwa mbaya zaidi na zaidi.
target_text_raw: Anaendelea kuwa mbaya zaidi na zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je prévois d'y aller. Ça m'est égal que vous y alliez aussi ou pas.

target_text_raw: Ninapanga kwendako. Uende ao uaca yote ni sawa kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'aimerai jusqu'à ma mort.
target_text: Nitakupenda mpaka kufa.
target_text_raw: Nitakupenda mpaka kufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je trouverai des amis où que j'aille.
target_text: Nitapata warafiki kote kwenyi ndaenda.
target_text_raw: Nitapata warafiki kote kwenyi ndaenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous me conseiller un bon restaurant ?
target_text: Utaweza nishauria restaurant ya mzuri?
target_text_raw: Utaweza nishauria restaurant ya mzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être cela vaudrait-il mieux que je jette tous ces livres, que j'embrasse ton petit nez et que j'oublie tous ces soucis et tracas.

target_text_raw: Landa ingelikuwa mzuri nitupe bitabu byote, nikumbatie ka lipua kako nisahau zile soucis na magumu yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils combinèrent leurs forces pour combattre l'ennemi.
target_text: Balicanga nguvu zabo kwa kupihanisha adui.
target_text_raw: Balicanga nguvu zabo kwa kupihanisha adui.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les philosophes chinois voient dans ce livre une œuvre majeur de la philosophie classique dans laquelle ils peuvent puiser sans fin des connaissances.
target_text: Wafilosofia wachina wanaona kama ile kitabu ni kazi kubwabya filosofia ya kisasa yenyi wanaweza toshamo ujuzi.
target_text_raw: Wafilosofia wachina wanaona kama ile kitabu ni kazi kubwabya filosofia ya kisasa yenyi wanaweza toshamo ujuzi.

source_text: Le repas permet l'intégration de Boule de Suif.

target_text_raw: Cakula inaruhusu kuingiza Boule de Suif.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dès que je parlerai bien le néerlandais, j'irai causer avec des flamandes.

target_text_raw: Wakati nitaongea kiholanzi(Neerlandais) muzuri,nitaenda ongea na wa flamands.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Mufuate maco yangu!
target_text_raw: Mufuate maco yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Merci de m'avoir ramené.
target_text: Aksanti kuona ulinileta.
target_text_raw: Aksanti kuona ulinileta.

source_text: Il a clairement indiqué qu'il ne connaissait pas le thème.

target_text_raw: Alisema wazi kama hakukuwa anajuwa mada.

source_text: Ça nous est égal, si vous prenez une photo depuis l'extérieur.
target_text: Na siye ki vile, kama munakamatia foto inje.
target_text_raw: Na siye ki vile, kama munakamatia foto inje.

source_text: Il est impossible d'organiser un référendum national pour l'application d'une amnistie générale.

target_text_raw: Iko nguvu kufanya ucaguzi ya maoni(référendum) ya taifa kwa kufanyisha musamaha wa jumla.

target_text_raw: Tena leo ninakumbuka rafiki yangu wa zamani.

source_text: Mes nouvelles ne sont pas très importantes pour qui n'est pas curieux.

target_text_raw: Habari zangu haziko za lazima saana ku mwenyi hataki kuzijuwa.

source_text: Je n'ai pas l'intention de le répéter à nouveau, alors s'il te plaît, écoute bien.

target_text_raw: Sitaki kurudilia tena, sasa tafazali, sikia muzuri.

target_text_raw: Hauna masomo ya kuweza kuongoza kikundi.

target_text_raw: Yanis alisikia kama yeye pekee njo amepewa hukumu ya kifo mwa ile prison.

target_text_raw: Esk unaona hekalu?

target_text_raw: Sami alikuwa anajuwa kama bibi yake alikuwa na relation na mwanaume mwenyi iko bibi mwengine.

target_text_raw: Itakuuzi kama unaniwekea hii valise hata dakika moya?

target_text_raw: Unaonaka saa hausikie hata ginsi hii mambo iko nguvu.

target_text_raw: Serkali ilitangaza leo kama beyi ya carburant itapanda mwezi kesho.

source_text: La vie est courte, la science interminable, l'opportunité fugace, l'expérimentation faillible, le jugement difficile.

source_text: Quelques enfants ont emmené des sandwiches au beurre de cacahuètes, d'autres des sandwiches au jambon ou au fromage.

source_text: Déposez-les sur la plaque du four et badigeonnez-les de jaune d'œuf.

target_text_raw: Uitie ku plaque ya four na ucange ndani jaune d'oeuf.

source_text: Je dois malheureusement refuser.

source_text: Dieu sauve l'Ukraine !

target_text_raw: Mungu usaidie Ukreni!

source_text: Avec ce froid, il faut se couvrir chaudement.

target_text_raw: Yanis hataki akose avion yake.

target_text_raw: Ni Enzo njo mwenyi aliniambia kama uko mgonjwa.
