source_text: Je ne comprends pas pourquoi les adultes changent drastiquement de vocabulaire quand ils parlent à un enfant.
target_text: Sielewe juu ya nini watu wazima wanabadilisha luga hivi saa wanaongea na mtoto.
target_text_raw: Sielewe juu ya nini watu wazima wanabadilisha luga hivi saa wanaongea na mtoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous invite à assister à la fête de mariage de mon fils aîné.
target_text: Ninawaalika kuhuzuria ku fete ya ndoa ya gaarcon wangu .
target_text_raw: Ninawaalika kuhuzuria ku fete ya ndoa ya gaarcon wangu .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a pour tâche d'assurer le suivi de la performance des stations d'épuration.
target_text: Kazi yake ni kufuatilia kama ile kiwanda kya kutengeneza kinatumika mzuri.
target_text_raw: Kazi yake ni kufuatilia kama ile kiwanda kya kutengeneza kinatumika mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils connaissent l'importance de protéger la terre.
target_text: Wanajuwa maana ya kukinga arzi.
target_text_raw: Wanajuwa maana ya kukinga arzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je garde une bonne réserve de timbres pour m'économiser les visites au bureau de poste.
target_text: Ninaweka ma timbres za mingi juu ya kuepuka kwenda ku postes sana.
target_text_raw: Ninaweka ma timbres za mingi juu ya kuepuka kwenda ku postes sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils peuvent brûler plus facilement.
target_text: Zinaweza lungula mbio mbio.
target_text_raw: Zinaweza lungula mbio mbio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prix du chou chuta à cause de la surproduction.

target_text_raw: Beyi ya chou ilipunguka sana balizivuna za mingi sana.

source_text: Arthur se réveille.
target_text: Arthur analamuka.
target_text_raw: Arthur analamuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vérifier votre pression artérielle.
target_text: Ninataka niangalie ginsi moyo yako iko inapiga.
target_text_raw: Ninataka niangalie ginsi moyo yako iko inapiga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sho avait 12 ans, était de faible constitution et un peu idiot.
target_text: Sho alikuwa na myaka 12,alikuwa na mwili ya kidogo na upungufu wa akili kidogo.
target_text_raw: Sho alikuwa na myaka 12,alikuwa na mwili ya kidogo na upungufu wa akili kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne saurais assez le remercier.
target_text: Sijuwe ginsi ndaweza mupigia aksanti.
target_text_raw: Sijuwe ginsi ndaweza mupigia aksanti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voici de l'argent pour poursuivre votre voyage.
target_text: Makuta hizi za kuendelea safari yako.
target_text_raw: Makuta hizi za kuendelea safari yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vas nous les lâcher, oui ?
target_text: Utatufungulia aye, si ndio?
target_text_raw: Utatufungulia aye, si ndio?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils essaient de chasser les produits japonais hors du marché.
target_text: Mu soko biko banapima kufukuza biashara bya kutokea Japani.
target_text_raw: Mu soko biko banapima kufukuza biashara bya kutokea Japani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis certaine que Thomas souffre.
target_text: Niko sur kama Thomas anateseka.
target_text_raw: Niko sur kama Thomas anateseka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La monnaie commune européenne est sur la balance.
target_text: Makuta za pamoya za Ulaya ziko ku kipimo.
target_text_raw: Makuta za pamoya za Ulaya ziko ku kipimo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne touchez pas aux affaires des autres !
target_text: Usiguse ku bitu bya batu!
target_text_raw: Usiguse ku bitu bya batu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois t'endurcir afin de garder tout ton calme, y compris dans une situation critique.
target_text: Unapashwa kujikaza ukuwe na nguvu hata kama hali iko nguvu haupashwe babaika.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kujikaza ukuwe na nguvu hata kama hali iko nguvu haupashwe babaika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La ville, assez morne d’habitude, présentait donc une animation extraordinaire. Dix races différentes de négociants, européens ou asiatiques, y fraternisaient sous l’influence des transactions commerciales.
target_text: Mu ville hata kama munakuwaka kifukutu munavuma sana kushindia kawaida. Aina kumi tafauti za wauzaji, wa Ulaya wa Azia, wanazoweana ju ya mambo ya ucuruzi.
target_text_raw: Mu ville hata kama munakuwaka kifukutu munavuma sana kushindia kawaida. Aina kumi tafauti za wauzaji, wa Ulaya wa Azia, wanazoweana ju ya mambo ya ucuruzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si la météo est bonne, j'irais.
target_text: Kama hali ya hewa iko mzuri,ndaenda.
target_text_raw: Kama hali ya hewa iko mzuri,ndaenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'eus d'affreux maux d'estomac.
target_text: Nilipata maumivu ya tumbu ya sana.
target_text_raw: Nilipata maumivu ya tumbu ya sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel genre d'enterrement souhaitez-vous ?
target_text: Unapenda mazishi ya aina gani?
target_text_raw: Unapenda mazishi ya aina gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Souvent on viole la langue de son pays d'accueil, partie pour s'en venger de manière sourde, partie pour se prosterner devant la langue du maître du moment.
target_text: Mara mingi tunavunjaka kanunu ya luga ya inchi yenyi ilitukaribisha, bila hata kusikia ,kwa kutumikisha sasa luga ya bwana wa sasa.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi tunavunjaka kanunu ya luga ya inchi yenyi ilitukaribisha, bila hata kusikia ,kwa kutumikisha sasa luga ya bwana wa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te donnerai tout ce que tu veux dans les limites du raisonnable.
target_text: Nitakupatia byote byenyi unataka kadiri inawezekana.
target_text_raw: Nitakupatia byote byenyi unataka kadiri inawezekana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au lieu de s'accorder quelque repos, il travaillait avec encore plus de zèle qu'à l'ordinaire.
target_text: Pahali ya kupumuzika, alitumika tena na juhudi zaidi kushindia kawaida.
target_text_raw: Pahali ya kupumuzika, alitumika tena na juhudi zaidi kushindia kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Uko unapima kuandika.
target_text_raw: Uko unapima kuandika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que j'ai déterminé où il nous faut installer l'alarme incendie.
target_text: Ninawaza nilisha hakikisha kwenyi banapashwa tia ile kengele ya ku alerter kama nyumba inataka lungula.
target_text_raw: Ninawaza nilisha hakikisha kwenyi banapashwa tia ile kengele ya ku alerter kama nyumba inataka lungula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est née avec une cuillère en argent dans la bouche.
target_text: Alizaliwa na kijiko ya feza mu kinywa.
target_text_raw: Alizaliwa na kijiko ya feza mu kinywa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La théorie est assez inutile à moins qu'elle ne fonctionne en pratique.

target_text_raw: Kusema tu haina maana bila kutenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas cherche une voiture d'occasion à prix raisonnable.

target_text_raw: Thomas iko anatafuta mutugari ya occasion ku beyi ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'équipage s'apprêtait pour le vol spatial.
target_text: Watumishi wa mu avion balikuwa banatayarisha kuruka angani.
target_text_raw: Watumishi wa mu avion balikuwa banatayarisha kuruka angani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Maneno ni halama za luga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je soulève une objection !

target_text_raw: Niko na neno la kusema!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Haba ba filles bazuri hivi banakuya fanya nini hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Dawa inapashwa kwanza pita ku vipimo ya matunzo mbele iruhusiwe.
target_text_raw: Dawa inapashwa kwanza pita ku vipimo ya matunzo mbele iruhusiwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis ne m'en parlera pas.

target_text_raw: Louis hataniambia juu ya ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous essayons d'avoir une conversation sérieuse, là.

target_text_raw: Tuko tunajaribu kuongea mambo ya maana pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne t'en fais pas. Je vous ai dit que tout irait bien.

target_text_raw: Usijali. Niliwaambia kama kila kitu kitakuwa bien.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On sait rarement ce qu'on veut et jamais ce qu'on voudra.
target_text: Haiko kawaida kujuwa byenyi mutu anapenda na hakuna mutu anajuwa byenyi atapenda mu siku za kukuya.
target_text_raw: Haiko kawaida kujuwa byenyi mutu anapenda na hakuna mutu anajuwa byenyi atapenda mu siku za kukuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nathan collectionne des vieilles pièces.

target_text_raw: Nathan anakusanya makuta za zamani za bicele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À force d'envoyer des manuscrits les uns après les autres, ça a fini par payer, un magazine m'a finalement publié.
target_text: Kuendelea kutumana byenyi niliandika na mikono ilifika wakati ninalipiwa, na kuko gazeti yenyi ilinitangaza.

source_text: Elles ne feront pas de sieste.

target_text_raw: Habatalala hata mcana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est à cette heure-là que tu rentres ?
target_text: Njo saa ile yenyi unarudiaka?
target_text_raw: Njo saa ile yenyi unarudiaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour autant que je sache, il est digne de foi.
target_text: Kwa ginsi ninajuwa , ni mutu wa confiance.
target_text_raw: Kwa ginsi ninajuwa , ni mutu wa confiance.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne posez pas de questions, contentez-vous de venir avec moi !

target_text_raw: Musiulize kitu,munifuate tu basi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Sipendake kugombana.
target_text_raw: Sipendake kugombana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut que t'arrêtes.

target_text_raw: Inaomba uace.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas essaya de me convaincre de l'accompagner.
target_text: Thomas alini convaincre nimusindikize.
target_text_raw: Thomas alini convaincre nimusindikize.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout est lié au travail.
target_text: Yote inafuatana na kazi.
target_text_raw: Yote inafuatana na kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est à la limite de ses forces.
target_text: Amefika ku mwisho ya nguvu zake.
target_text_raw: Amefika ku mwisho ya nguvu zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Ma dasa za kawaida nazo ni za muzuri saa zenyi haziko za kawaida?
target_text_raw: Ma dasa za kawaida nazo ni za muzuri saa zenyi haziko za kawaida(ma spécialités)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit que Ramsès II avait six épouses et plus de cent enfants.
target_text: Inasemeka kama Ramses alikuwa na banamuke kumi na zaidi ya batoto miya moya.
target_text_raw: Inasemeka kama Ramses alikuwa na banamuke kumi na zaidi ya batoto miya moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous sûrs de ne pas vouloir le garder ?
target_text: Uko sur hamuna lazima ya kumubakiana?
target_text_raw: Uko sur hamuna lazima ya kumubakiana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas un mot ne sortira de ma bouche.
target_text: Hakuna neno yenyi itatoka mu kinywa yangu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna neno yenyi itatoka mu kinywa yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nature n'est pas assez féconde pour nourrir dix milliards d'êtres humains qui vont occuper tout l'espace et tout consommer, animaux et végétaux. Il ne restera rien.
target_text: Mazingira haina mazao ya kutosha kwa kulisha miliare kumi ya watu wenyi wataishi fasi yote, na kutumia kila kitu, na nyama na mimea. Hakuna kitu kyenyi kinabakie.
target_text_raw: Mazingira haina mazao ya kutosha kwa kulisha miliare kumi ya watu wenyi wataishi fasi yote, na kutumia kila kitu, na nyama na mimea. Hakuna kitu kyenyi kinabakie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie voulait aller au cirque pour voir les trapézistes qui semblaient danser en l'air.

target_text_raw: Maria alitaka enda ...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J’ai une triste nouvelle à vous annoncer.

target_text_raw: Niko na habari ya huzuni ya kuwaambia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les algériens passent leurs temps à voir des matchs de foot, à prier dans les mosquées et à roupiller dans les bars-cafés.
target_text: Wa aljeria wanapitisha wakati yao biko banaangalia mpira ya migulu, wanasali ndani ya muskitina kusinzilia mu fasi ya kuuzishia kahawa.
target_text_raw: Wa aljeria wanapitisha wakati yao biko banaangalia mpira ya migulu, wanasali ndani ya muskiti(mosquee) na kusinzilia mu fasi ya kuuzishia kahawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le premier homme à se suicider du Burj Khalifa l'a fait parce que son patron lui a refusé un jour de congé. Il devait pas baiser souvent.
target_text: Mutu wa kwanza aliye jiuwa Burj Khalifa,ni juu mkubwa wake wa kazi alimukatalia siku moya ya congé. Hangelipashwa coka.
target_text_raw: Mutu wa kwanza aliye jiuwa Burj Khalifa,ni juu mkubwa wake wa kazi alimukatalia siku moya ya congé. Hangelipashwa coka.

source_text: Il prenait Luca pour un idiot.
target_text: Alikuwa anaona Luca sawa pumbavu.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anaona Luca sawa pumbavu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et il se rendormit heureux, avec un sourire d’enfant, du profond sommeil de la jeunesse.
target_text: Alilala tena na furaha, na kiceko ya mtoto,kwa usingizi mzito ya ujana.
target_text_raw: Alilala tena na furaha, na kiceko ya mtoto,kwa usingizi mzito ya ujana.

source_text: Étonnant, non ?

target_text_raw: Ya kushangaza, si vile?

source_text: Quand vous jouez aux échecs, faites très attention à ne pas perdre la reine.

target_text_raw: Wakati uko unaceza cartes za kupoteza, fanya hange usipoteze mwamikazi.

source_text: La nana du bulletin météo a dit que ce soir, nous aurions au pire une fine pluie.

source_text: L'agent a proposé à l'aveugle de l'aider à traverser.

source_text: Le jugement de la foule nous rend toujours pensifs, mais jamais abattus.

source_text: Les couches de roches qui composent le sous-sol de ce plateau sont uniques par leurs dispositions successives.

target_text_raw: Kuko za bamingi inje kushindia ndani.

target_text_raw: Nitakutumana ku vita ya wadogo saa utapenda.

source_text: Vous permettez, Monsieur ?

target_text_raw: Bwana, unaruhusu?

target_text_raw: Hauko obligé kusema uongo.

source_text: Le cinéma américain, qui est le meilleur au monde est propulsé par les juifs.

target_text_raw: Cinema ya kiamerika,yenyi ni muzuri kushindia zingine zote mu dunia, inaendeleshwa na Wayahudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis enfermé à l'extérieur de mon appartement.
target_text: Ninajifungia inje ya nyumba yangu.
target_text_raw: Ninajifungia inje ya nyumba yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation ont tué plusieurs civils lors de leur dernière incursion dans ce quartier.
target_text: Majeshi ya uvamizi ziliuwa raia wengi wakati ya mashambulizi yao ya mwisho mwa hii mungini.
target_text_raw: Majeshi ya uvamizi ziliuwa raia wengi wakati ya mashambulizi yao ya mwisho mwa hii mungini.

source_text: Exact.
target_text: Njo kweli.
target_text_raw: Njo kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous approchez pas davantage.

source_text: Le bonheur tue, et le chagrin laisse vivre.

target_text_raw: Raha inauwaka, na magumu inaaca mutu anaishi.

source_text: Son regard plongea dans le lointain : on aurait dit qu’il cherchait à y découvrir quelque chose.

target_text_raw: Aliangalia mbali sana: inakuwa saa ginsi alikuwa anatafuta kugundua kitu fulani.

source_text: Tu n'es pas un tueur et moi non plus.

target_text_raw: Na weye na miye hatuko bauwaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce que vous pourriez faire à l'appui de leur effort serait très apprécié.

target_text_raw: Kila kitu yenyi utaweza fanya kwa kuunga juhudi yao mkono itakuwa ya mzuri sana.

target_text_raw: Kulikuwa mutu mwengine mu bar?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens de perdre la meilleure amie que j'aie jamais eue.

target_text_raw: Ninamupoteza rafiki yangu wa fille mwenyi siyaonaka mu maisha.

target_text_raw: Kamata hii!

target_text_raw: Nilikuwa mtoto mdogo ile wakati.

target_text_raw: Niko sûr kama ulifanya byenyi uliwaza ni bya muzuri kufanya.

target_text_raw: Lakini kupata habari haiko njo kusema unaisikia.

source_text: Le Ministère dut faire face à une montagne de questions de la presse.

target_text_raw: Toka, kiwelewele!

target_text_raw: Ninafurahi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Tafuta Nathan mbele hayaambia mutu ile maneno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Nilipata gants mbili cini ya kiti.

source_text: La non divulgation ne devrait jamais être basée sur un effort de protection des intérêts personnels des fonctionnaires du gouvernement, aux dépens de ceux qu'ils sont supposés servir.

source_text: Beth attendait avec impatience de le voir, mais il ne se montra jamais.

target_text_raw: Beth alikua anangoya sana amuone, makini hakujionyesha hata siku moya.

target_text_raw: Tunataka kukupigia aksanti kuona umekuya.

target_text_raw: Wametengeneza fasi ya avion kushukia pale.

target_text_raw: Inafanana ni kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Hauyalalaka na mwanamuke hata siku moya?
target_text_raw: Hauyalalaka na mwanamuke hata siku moya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était très effrayant.

target_text_raw: Ni bya kuogopesha.

source_text: Bonjour à tout le monde...sauf aux traducteurs allemands, qui ne sont évidemment pas levés à cette heure...

target_text_raw: Jambo kwenu nyi bote...sauf ku ba tafsiri wakijermani, benyi habayalamuka saa hii...

target_text_raw: Ulivuka mipaka.

source_text: Ces derniers temps, nous clavardions tous les soirs sur internet, et en plus nous discutions très tard la nuit, jusqu'à en perdre haleine.
target_text: Hizi siku, tulikuwa tunapitisha mangaribi yote ku internet, na tena tulikuwa tunaongea mpaka nyuma sana busiku, mpaka tunacoka.
target_text_raw: Hizi siku, tulikuwa tunapitisha mangaribi yote ku internet, na tena tulikuwa tunaongea mpaka nyuma sana busiku, mpaka tunacoka.

source_text: J'aurais dû recevoir cette promotion.

target_text_raw: Nilipashwa kupata ile kupandishiwa cheo.
