target_text: Kungali mambo fulani fulani napenda tuongeye na weye,lakini tuiace kwa wakati ingine.
target_text_raw: Kungali mambo fulani fulani napenda tuongeye na weye,lakini tuiace kwa wakati ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Moi et Sue sommes toujours d'accord.
target_text: Miye na Sue tunaitika.
target_text_raw: Miye na Sue tunaitika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai vraiment hâte de me détendre ce week-end.
target_text: Niko na hamu ya kuji nyorosha/ kupumuzika/kujitembeza hii week-end.
target_text_raw: Niko na hamu ya kuji nyorosha/ kupumuzika/kujitembeza hii week-end.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous aurions dû apporter une autre bouteille de vin.
target_text: Tulipashwa leta cupa ingine ya divai.
target_text_raw: Tulipashwa leta cupa ingine ya divai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est l'heure que tu ailles te coucher. Coupe la radio.
target_text: Saa yako ya kwenda kulala inaenea. Zilisha radio.
target_text_raw: Saa yako ya kwenda kulala inaenea. Zilisha radio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'imagines pas à quel point je m'en fiche.
target_text: Haujuwe ginsi sibiangaikie hata.
target_text_raw: Haujuwe ginsi sibiangaikie hata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Zut ! J'ai mal au cœur de voir mon identité s'effriter.
target_text: Shwi! Ninasikia roho inaniluma kuona identité yangu inaharibika.
target_text_raw: Shwi! Ninasikia roho inaniluma kuona identité yangu inaharibika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vous coupe pas les ongles.
target_text: Sikukate makuca.
target_text_raw: Sikukate makuca.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ethan n'aime définitivement pas Marie.
target_text: Kwa mwisho Ethan hamupendi Maria.
target_text_raw: Kwa mwisho Ethan hamupendi Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie est comme une habile extraction de dent : on pense qu'elle doit venir, jusqu'à ce qu'on remarque avec étonnement qu'elle est déjà partie.
target_text: Maisha ni sawa kutosha lino na mayele: unawaza itakuya mpaka unajikuta kwa mshangao ilisha enda zamani.
target_text_raw: Maisha ni sawa kutosha lino na mayele: unawaza itakuya mpaka unajikuta kwa mshangao ilisha enda zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les blagues sur les belles-mères sont amusantes, parce qu'elles sont vraies.
target_text: Mizaha juu ya ba mamukwe ni nzuri sababu zinakuwaka za kweli.
target_text_raw: Mizaha juu ya ba mamukwe ni nzuri sababu zinakuwaka za kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fait seulement 10 degrés dehors et il marche à l'extérieur avec un T-shirt. J'ai froid juste à le regarder.
target_text: Hali ya baridi inje ni degres 10, na iko anatembea inje na T-shirt. Ninasikia baridi kwa kumuangalia tu.
target_text_raw: Hali ya baridi inje ni degres 10, na iko anatembea inje na T-shirt. Ninasikia baridi kwa kumuangalia tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Se souvenir dans la sérénité de douleurs passées est un vrai bonheur.
target_text: Kukumbuka na kimiya maumivu iliyopita ni raha ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Kukumbuka na kimiya maumivu iliyopita ni raha ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois qu'un jour viendra où les gens se rendront compte que l'anglais est le symbole de l'empire anglo-américain qui a déjà détruit beaucoup de nations et de cultures avant de s'attaquer au reste du monde.
target_text: Naamini siku moya itafika wakati watu watatambua kama kingereza ni halama ya utawala wa Ungereza na Amerika yenyi ilisha bomola inchi nyingi na utamaduni mingi duniani mbele ya kufuatilia bingine bya mu dunia.
target_text_raw: Naamini siku moya itafika wakati watu watatambua kama kingereza ni halama ya utawala wa Ungereza na Amerika yenyi ilisha bomola inchi nyingi na utamaduni mingi duniani mbele ya kufuatilia bingine bya mu dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu viendras tu pourras mettre ta voiture dans le garage.
target_text: Saa utajuya utatia gari yako mu garage.
target_text_raw: Saa utajuya utatia gari yako mu garage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il proposa qu'un autre meeting se tienne le lundi suivant.
target_text: Alitekeleza.
target_text_raw: Alitekeleza (aliproposer) ingine reunion ifanyike siku ya kwanza (lundi).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous sentez pas gênée. Ces choses arrivent.
target_text: Mujisijisikie mbaya. Binafikaka.
target_text_raw: Mujisijisikie mbaya. Binafikaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah ouais, et alors ?
target_text: Ndio ,na kisha?
target_text_raw: Ndio ,na kisha?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "OK" est-il dans le Larousse ?
target_text: «OK» iko mu Larousse?
target_text_raw: «OK» iko mu Larousse (mu dictionnaire)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'agent de police l'autorisa à se garer là.
target_text: Mtumishi wa polisi alimuruhusu kusimamisha gari yake pale.
target_text_raw: Mtumishi wa polisi alimuruhusu kusimamisha gari yake pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon Dieu, s’écria-t-elle, ayez pitié de nous !
target_text: Mungu wangu, akalalamika, mutusikilie huruma!
target_text_raw: Mungu wangu, akalalamika, mutusikilie huruma!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai suivi l'exemple de ma mère.
target_text: Nilifuata mfano ya mamangu.
target_text_raw: Nilifuata mfano ya mamangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce là ce que vous pensez que je veuille entendre ?
target_text: Njo ile unawaza nilikuwa nataka kusikia?
target_text_raw: Njo ile unawaza nilikuwa nataka kusikia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que croyiez-vous que j'allais proposer ?
target_text: Uliwaza nini njo ninge proposer?
target_text_raw: Uliwaza nini njo ninge proposer?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de langues disparaissent chaque année parce qu'une autre langue semble plus « cool » à ses jeunes locuteurs ?
target_text: Luga ngapi zinapotea kila mwaka juu ingine luga inaonekana kuwa «nzuri» zaidi kwa hawa watu wapya wenyi wanaiongea?
target_text_raw: Luga ngapi zinapotea kila mwaka juu ingine luga inaonekana kuwa «nzuri» zaidi kwa hawa watu wapya wenyi wanaiongea?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De rien, Jack !
target_text: Ya bure, Jack!
target_text_raw: Ya bure, Jack!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regarde, mon chéri, ça ne va pas !
target_text: Ona, cheri wangu, habiendeke!
target_text_raw: Ona, cheri wangu, habiendeke!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir monsieur !
target_text: Jambo Bwana!
target_text_raw: Jambo (Bonsoir) Bwana (monsieur)!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une tante qui habite à Los Angeles.
target_text: Niko na shangazi yangu mwenyi anaishi Los Angeles.
target_text_raw: Niko na shangazi yangu mwenyi anaishi Los Angeles.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne me connaissez pas.
target_text: Haunijuwe.
target_text_raw: Haunijuwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En espéranto, les verbes à l'infinitif terminent toujours par « i ».
target_text: Mu luga ya espéranto,matendo inaisha na «i».
target_text_raw: Mu luga ya espéranto,matendo inaisha na «i».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est sympa de passer.
target_text: Ni mzuri kupita.
target_text_raw: Ni mzuri kupita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demain je pars. Qui viendra avec moi.
target_text: Kesho ninaenda. Nani ataenda na miye.
target_text_raw: Kesho ninaenda. Nani ataenda na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est le bordel dans ma chambre.
target_text: Ni kavuyomu chambre yangu.
target_text_raw: Ni kavuyo(désordre) mu chambre yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce sera une mission très dangereuse.
target_text: Itakuwa mission ya hatari sana.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa mission ya hatari sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le conseil d'école local ferait tout pour interdire ce livre.
target_text: Shauri ya nyumbani ya masomo inapiganisha kwa kukataza ile kitabu.
target_text_raw: Shauri ya nyumbani ya masomo inapiganisha kwa kukataza ile kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette chambre est si petite qu'on ne peut pas jouer dedans.
target_text: Hii chambre ni ya kidogo saba hatuwezi cezea ndani.
target_text_raw: Hii chambre ni ya kidogo saba hatuwezi cezea ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo sortit sa nouvelle voiture pour faire une balade.
target_text: Timeo alitosha gari yake ya mpya kusudi ajitembeze.
target_text_raw: Timeo alitosha gari yake ya mpya kusudi ajitembeze.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce mot est-il exact, dans ce contexte ?
target_text: Hii neno ni ya kweli? mu hii fasi?
target_text_raw: Hii neno ni ya kweli? mu hii fasi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce qui ne me tue pas me rend plus fort.
target_text: Kila kyenyi hakiniuwe kinanifanya nguvu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Kila kyenyi hakiniuwe kinanifanya nguvu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: «Aujourd'hui est un bon jour pour mourir», songea le concombre tueur.
target_text: «Leo ni siku ya mzuri ya kukufa» muuwaji akafikia.
target_text_raw: «Leo ni siku ya mzuri ya kukufa» muuwaji akafikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À mon avis, un musée est plus intéressant qu'un bar.
target_text: Kwangu, fasi ya kuwekea vyombo, ni ya maana zaidi ya bar.
target_text_raw: Kwangu, fasi ya kuwekea vyombo(musée) , ni ya maana zaidi ya bar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le paysan a surpris le gamin qui volait des pommes dans son verger.
target_text: Mkaaji wa kijijini alimukamata mtoto mwenyi alikuwa anaiba matunda mu shamba yake.
target_text_raw: Mkaaji wa kijijini alimukamata mtoto mwenyi alikuwa anaiba matunda (ma pommes) mu shamba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous promets que je viendrai tôt.
target_text: Ninawahaidiakama ndarudia mbele.
target_text_raw: Ninawahaidia(ninabapromettre) kama ndarudia mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous mettez trop de choses dans votre portefeuille.
target_text: Unatiaka bitu mingi mu porte monnaie yako.
target_text_raw: Unatiaka bitu mingi mu porte monnaie yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'idée me parut évidemment absurde.
target_text: Ile nia inaonekana giza kwangu.
target_text_raw: Ile nia inaonekana giza kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nathan n'avait aucun moyen de vérifier l'information.
target_text: Nathan hakukuwa na ginsi yoyote ya kucunguza ile habari.
target_text_raw: Nathan hakukuwa na ginsi yoyote ya kucunguza ile habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je passais dans le quartier. J'en ai profité pour te rendre visite.
target_text: Nilikuwa napita mu quartier. Niliprofiter kukuangalia.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa napita mu quartier. Niliprofiter kukuangalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas assister à la fête mais je vous remercie de m'y avoir convié.
target_text: Siwezi fika ku fête lakini ninakushukuru kuona ulinialika.
target_text_raw: Siwezi fika ku fête lakini ninakushukuru kuona ulinialika(ulini inviter).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes flic ou quoi ?
target_text: Uko polisi ao aye?
target_text_raw: Uko polisi ao aye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous donnons, dans le tableau suivant, l'ensemble des résultats obtenus.
target_text: Tunapana ,mu tableau ya kufuata, ma resultats zote.
target_text_raw: Tunapana ,mu tableau ya kufuata, ma resultats zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le vaisseau spatial atteindra bientôt la Lune.
target_text: Combo ca kwenda angani kitafika ku mwezi hapa karibuni.
target_text_raw: Combo ca kwenda angani kitafika ku mwezi hapa karibuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Reste en enfer.
target_text: Bakia jehenama.
target_text_raw: Bakia jehenama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je vous proposer de vous déposer, les mecs ?
target_text: Ndaweza baaca, rafiki?
target_text_raw: Ndaweza baaca (ba déposer), rafiki?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père avait l'habitude de m'emmener ici dans ma jeunesse.
target_text: Babangu alikuwaka anazowea nileta hapa saa nilikuwa kijana.
target_text_raw: Babangu alikuwaka anazowea nileta hapa saa nilikuwa kijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre conduite de vie est différente de la mienne.
target_text: Ginsi yako ya kuishi iko tafauti na yangu.
target_text_raw: Ginsi yako ya kuishi iko tafauti na yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans combien de situations de combat vous êtes-vous retrouvés ?
target_text: Hali ngapi za vita ulishaka jikutana ndani?
target_text_raw: Hali ngapi za vita ulishaka jikutana ndani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation ont démoli plusieurs maisons dans ce quartier.
target_text: Majeshi ya uvamizi ilibomola nyumba mingi mwa hii mgini.
target_text_raw: Majeshi ya uvamizi ilibomola nyumba mingi mwa hii mgini (quartier).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour être de vrais amis, il faut être sûrs l'un de l'autre.
target_text: Kwa kukuwa barafiki bazuri,inaomba kuaminiana .
target_text_raw: Kwa kukuwa barafiki bazuri,inaomba kuaminiana .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque vous rencontrez une personne pour la première fois, soyez attentive à la distance à laquelle vous vous tenez d'elle.
target_text: Wakati unakutanana mutu mara ya kwanza, fanya hange na distance yenyi iko katikati yenu.
target_text_raw: Wakati unakutanana mutu mara ya kwanza, fanya hange na distance yenyi iko katikati yenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est enceinte de jumeaux.
target_text: Iko mimba ya mapasa.
target_text_raw: Iko mimba ya mapasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes riches voisins appartiennent à un club de golf privé.
target_text: Bajirani yangu batajiri banakuwaka mu kikundiya mcezo ya golf ya kipekee.
target_text_raw: Bajirani yangu batajiri banakuwaka mu kikundi(club) ya mcezo ya golf ya kipekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle trouva une excuse pour être en retard.
target_text: Alipata motif ya kucelewa.
target_text_raw: Alipata motif ya kucelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bravo à vous !
target_text: Hongera kwenu!
target_text_raw: Hongera (Félicitations) kwenu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noah ne pense qu'au fric.
target_text: Noah anawaza tu makuta.
target_text_raw: Noah anawaza tu makuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est important d'obtenir le bon ratio carbone/azote dans un tas de compost.
target_text: Ni ya lazima kupata sehemu nzuri ya carbone/azote mu lundo ya mboleo.
target_text_raw: Ni ya lazima kupata sehemu nzuri ya carbone/azote mu lundo ya mboleo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: " Assis, après sa mort, sur le trône d'Énée, / Ascagne trente fois verra naître l'année, / et, de Lavinium aux remparts des Albains, / portera le premier le berceau des Romains. "
target_text: «Aliikala,kisha kufa kwake,ku kiti ca ufalme wa Énée,/Ascagne mara makumi tatu akaona mwaka inafika,/na, kutokea Lavinium mpaka ngambo ya Albains,/akakkuwa wa kwanza kubeba msinji ya Warumi.»
target_text_raw: «Aliikala,kisha kufa kwake,ku kiti ca ufalme wa Énée,/Ascagne mara makumi tatu akaona mwaka inafika,/na, kutokea Lavinium mpaka ngambo ya Albains,/akakkuwa wa kwanza kubeba msinji ya Warumi.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne partez pas tout de suite !
target_text: Musiende sasa hivi!
target_text_raw: Musiende sasa hivi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les oreilles d'un éléphant bleu sont aussi grandes que celles d'un éléphant rose.
target_text: Masikio ya tembo ya rangi ya samawi ni yakabambi sawa vile ya tembo ya rose.
target_text_raw: Masikio ya tembo ya rangi ya samawi (bleu) ni yakabambi sawa vile ya tembo ya rose.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne dis pas des conneries.
target_text: Usisema mambo ya upumbavu.
target_text_raw: Usisema mambo ya upumbavu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quels légumes faites-vous pousser, d'ordinaire ?
target_text: Ni mboga gani njo unakomalisha,ni za kawaida?
target_text_raw: Ni mboga (legumes) gani njo unakomalisha,ni za kawaida?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui-ci est spécial.
target_text: Hii ni ya kipekee.
target_text_raw: Hii ni ya kipekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis joue tout le temps aux jeux vidéo.
target_text: Saa zote Yanis iko anaceza micezo za vidéo.
target_text_raw: Saa zote Yanis iko anaceza micezo (ma jeux) za vidéo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En mentant, on peut parcourir le monde entier, mais on ne revient jamais.
target_text: Mu kusema uongo, mutu anaweza tembea dunia nzima, lakini hatarudiaka hata siku moya.
target_text_raw: Mu kusema uongo, mutu anaweza tembea dunia nzima, lakini hatarudiaka hata siku moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Autrefois je ne savais pas en quoi l'éternité pouvait être utile. Mais elle permet au moins d'offrir une chance d'apprendre l'allemand.
target_text: Mbele sikukuwaka najua nini njo milele inaweza maanisha. Lakini inaruhusu kupana bahati ya kujifunza ki allemand.
target_text_raw: Mbele sikukuwaka najua nini njo milele inaweza maanisha. Lakini inaruhusu kupana bahati ya kujifunza ki allemand.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne pouvons rien prouver.
target_text: Hatuwezi sibitisha kitu chochote.
target_text_raw: Hatuwezi sibitisha (prouver) kitu chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette glace à l'arachide se marie très bien avec les tartes aux fruits des bois.
target_text: Ile ice cream ya kalanga iko butamu sana kuikulishia na mkate wa beri.
target_text_raw: Ile ice cream ya kalanga iko butamu sana kuikulishia na mkate wa beri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est difficile de se rappeler comment parler une langue si vous n'avez pas d'occasion de la parler.
target_text: Ni kugumu kukumbuka ginsi ya kusema luga kama haupatake wakati ya kuongea.
target_text_raw: Ni kugumu kukumbuka ginsi ya kusema luga kama haupatake wakati ya kuongea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'officier insuffla du courage à ses hommes.
target_text: Ofisa aliwaambia majeshi yake maneno ya kuwapatia juhudi.
target_text_raw: Ofisa aliwaambia majeshi yake maneno ya kuwapatia juhudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai retrouvé la maison dans un drôle d'état.
target_text: Nilikutana nyumba iko mu hali mbaya sana.
target_text_raw: Nilikutana nyumba iko mu hali mbaya sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aussi mademoiselle de Watteville arriva-t-elle en quelques jours à une phase quasi morbide et très dangereuse de l'exaltation amoureuse.
target_text: Pia mu siku kidogo binti wa Watteville alifikia ku hali mbaya ya mapenzi na ya hatari sana.
target_text_raw: Pia mu siku kidogo binti wa Watteville alifikia ku hali mbaya ya mapenzi na ya hatari sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fut dans l'incapacité de l'épouser.
target_text: Alikuwa mu hali yenyi hangeweza kumuowa.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa mu hali yenyi hangeweza kumuowa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez fait arranger la voiture.
target_text: Ulitafutisha gari.
target_text_raw: Ulitafutisha gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que tu restes pour dîner.
target_text: Ninatumaini utabakia kusudi ukule cakula ca mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Ninatumaini utabakia kusudi ukule cakula ca mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez jusqu'à ce que je vous dise d'arrêter, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Endelesha mpaka saa ndakwambia uace, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Endelesha mpaka saa ndakwambia uace, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai toujours pensé que vous feriez un couple très mignon.
target_text: Kila siku ninawazaka tu kama mutaweza fanya couple ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Kila siku ninawazaka tu kama mutaweza fanya couple ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En dépit d'un extérieur sévère, elle avait une certaine vulnérabilité qui la rendait assez attachante.
target_text: Ijapokuwa hali yaka ya inje ya mubaya, alikuwa na hatari fulani yenyi ilituma akuwe mutu wa kuangaikia batu sana.
target_text_raw: Ijapokuwa hali yaka ya inje ya mubaya, alikuwa na hatari fulani yenyi ilituma akuwe mutu wa kuangaikia batu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Richard Dawkins est un célèbre athéiste.
target_text: Richard Dawkins ni mtu mwenyi anajulikana sana kama haamini kama Mungu iko.
target_text_raw: Richard Dawkins ni mtu mwenyi anajulikana sana kama haamini kama Mungu iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous serons bientôt à court d'essence.
target_text: Hapa karibuni essence itatuishia.
target_text_raw: Hapa karibuni essence itatuishia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gardez-vous de celui qui veut vous dénier l'accès à l'information car dans son cœur, il rêve d'être votre maître.
target_text: Ujihazari na mutu mwenyi hataki upate habari , analota akuwe mwalimu wako.
target_text_raw: Ujihazari na mutu mwenyi hataki upate habari , analota akuwe mwalimu wako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dégage ces gens !
target_text: Fukuza haba batu!
target_text_raw: Fukuza haba batu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Passe un joyeux Noël !
target_text: Noeli njema kwako!
target_text_raw: Noeli njema kwako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous vous trouvez avec des amis.
target_text: Munapata barafiki.
target_text_raw: Munapata barafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voulons remercier tout spécialement Thomas.
target_text: Tunataka kushukuru Thomas kwa namna ya upekee.
target_text_raw: Tunataka kushukuru Thomas kwa namna ya upekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons besoin d'une piste d'atterrissage bien construite et dotée de tous les équipements nécessaires.
target_text: Tuko na lazima ya fasi ya ndege kushukia yenyi inajengewa muzuri na yenyi iko na kila kitu ca lazima.
target_text_raw: Tuko na lazima ya fasi ya ndege kushukia yenyi inajengewa muzuri na yenyi iko na kila kitu ca lazima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne courtoise, il demanda qu'on inscrive sur sa pierre tombale : « Permettez-moi de rester couché. »
target_text: Mutu mwenyi adabu, aliomba baandike ku kaburi yake: «Muniruhusu nibakie ninalala.»
target_text_raw: Mutu mwenyi adabu, aliomba baandike ku kaburi yake: «Muniruhusu nibakie ninalala.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas non plus l'idée de comment nous le disons ici.
target_text: Na miye sijuwe hata ginsi tunaisemaka hapa.
target_text_raw: Na miye sijuwe hata ginsi tunaisemaka hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a tendance à ne pas être claire quand elle discute de ce sujet.
target_text: Saa iko anaongea ile sujet hakuwake wazi.
target_text_raw: Saa iko anaongea ile sujet hakuwake wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ouvrez la fenêtre.
target_text: Ufungule mlango.
target_text_raw: Ufungule mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie est devenue plus chère.
target_text: Maisha ilisha kuwa nguvu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Maisha ilisha kuwa nguvu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons des points de vue différents.
target_text: Tuko na mauni tafauti.
target_text_raw: Tuko na mauni tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis Jésus que tu persécutes.
target_text: Mimi ni Yesu mwenyi unatesa.
target_text_raw: Mimi ni Yesu mwenyi unatesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La manière de voir par la Foi est de fermer l’Œil de la Raison : la lumière du matin apparaît plus clairement quand on éteint sa bougie.
target_text: Namna ya kuamini ni kufunga lico ya akili: mwangaza ya asubui inakuwaka ya mzuri zaidi wakati mutu anazimisha mushuma.
target_text_raw: Namna ya kuamini ni kufunga lico ya akili: mwangaza ya asubui inakuwaka ya mzuri zaidi wakati mutu anazimisha mushuma(bougie).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle feuilleta un magazine en attendant que son rendez-vous se montre.
target_text: Alifungula gazetimbele saa ya rendez-vous yake ifike.
target_text_raw: Alifungula gazeti(journal) mbele saa ya rendez-vous yake ifike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L’ail est un remède médical extrêmement puissant, c’est aussi une denrée alimentaire largement utilisée.
target_text: Ailni dawa ya nguvu sana,na pia ni cakula yenyi watu wanatumia sana.
target_text_raw: Ail(tungulu sumu) ni dawa ya nguvu sana,na pia ni cakula yenyi watu wanatumia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle l'a amené au lac.
target_text: Alimubeba ku bahari.
target_text_raw: Alimubeba ku bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dépêche-toi de m'amener quelque chose à boire !
target_text: Fanya mbio unileteye kitu ya kukunywa!
target_text_raw: Fanya mbio unileteye kitu ya kukunywa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qui t'amène ici ?
target_text: Nini njo inakuleta hapa?
target_text_raw: Nini njo inakuleta hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Effectue des recherches afin de savoir si Hugo a de la parenté à Boston.
target_text: Fanya utafitikule Boston.
target_text_raw: Fanya utafiti(ma recherches) uangalie kama Hugo iko na jamaa(famille) kule Boston.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vas au téléphone et tu appelles le médecin !
target_text: Wende ku telephone uite docteur!
target_text_raw: Wende ku telephone uite docteur!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bref, la vie est brève !
target_text: Kwa kifupi, maisha iko mfupi!
target_text_raw: Kwa kifupi, maisha iko mfupi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai adopté cette phrase. Je pourrai en adopter d'autres, si vous le souhaitez ?
target_text: Nilikubali hii msemwa. Ndaweza kubali zingine, kama munapenda?
target_text_raw: Nilikubali hii msemwa. Ndaweza kubali zingine, kama munapenda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Votre pays est formidable !
target_text: Inchi yenu ni nzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Inchi yenu ni nzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ayant pris son pied chez elle, il prit ses jambes à son cou.
target_text: Alipomaliza fika kwabo, akakimbia!
target_text_raw: Alipomaliza fika kwabo, akakimbia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que dis-tu de reprendre depuis le tout début ?
target_text: Unasema nini juu ya kurudilia mwanzo kabisa?
target_text_raw: Unasema nini juu ya kurudilia mwanzo kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avance en étant sur tes gardes et emporte un long bâton !
target_text: Endela mbele na uko unafanya hange na ulete fimbo ya mrefu!
target_text_raw: Endela mbele na uko unafanya hange na ulete fimbo ya mrefu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marthe, ayant jeté un regard sur elle, reconnut en elle une jeune fille qu'elle avait rencontrée dans l'escalier.
target_text: Marthe, alipomuangalia ako, akakumbuka kama ni msika alikutananaka mu escalier.
target_text_raw: Marthe, alipomuangalia ako, akakumbuka kama ni msika alikutananaka mu escalier.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon gouvernement prendra les mesures appropriées, en accord avec la loi et la politique, pour dévoiler rapidement l'information sous des formes que le public peut aisément trouver et employer.
target_text: Serkali yangu itakamata hatua zenyi kufaa, kulingana na sheria na siasa, kwa kugundua mbio mbio habari yenyi watu wanaweza pata na kutumikisha bila shida.
target_text_raw: Serkali yangu itakamata hatua zenyi kufaa, kulingana na sheria na siasa, kwa kugundua mbio mbio habari yenyi watu wanaweza pata na kutumikisha bila shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as deux balles.
target_text: Uko na masasi mbili.
target_text_raw: Uko na masasi mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une personne vraiment gentille.
target_text: Ni mtu muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Ni mtu muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, l'information est exacte.
target_text: Kibaya,ile habari ni ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Kibaya,ile habari ni ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo sort avec une étudiante d'échange chinoise.
target_text: Mathéo anatokaka/anachumbiana na mwanafunzi wa kubadilisha Wachina.
target_text_raw: Mathéo anatokaka/anachumbiana na mwanafunzi (étudiante) wa kubadilisha Wachina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À ces mots ma voix meurt, mes sens sont oppressés, / et mes cheveux d'horreur sur mon front sont dressés.
target_text: Kwa maneno hii, sauti yangu inakufa,hisia zangu zinaonewa,/na nywele zangu za kutisha kwenye paji la uso zimechomwa.
target_text_raw: Kwa maneno hii, sauti yangu inakufa,hisia zangu zinaonewa,/na nywele zangu za kutisha kwenye paji la uso zimechomwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir se relever les manches si on veut terminer ce travail dans les temps !
target_text: Italomba kugombolana kama tunataka kumaliza hii kazi ku wakati!
target_text_raw: Italomba kugombolana kama tunataka kumaliza hii kazi ku wakati!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment les ont-ils vus ?
target_text: Aye njo balibaona?
target_text_raw: Aye njo balibaona?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais malin.
target_text: Nilikuwa mayele.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa mayele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas. Nous le trouverons.
target_text: Musiwe na wasi wasi. Tutamupata.
target_text_raw: Musiwe na wasi wasi. Tutamupata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu commençais à m'inquiéter.
target_text: Ulikuwa umeanza niletea wasi wasi.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa umeanza niletea wasi wasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un enfant brûlé craint le feu.
target_text: Mtoto mwenyi alishaka lungula anaogopaka moto.
target_text_raw: Mtoto mwenyi alishaka lungula anaogopaka moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne savais pas que tu parlais français.
target_text: Sikukuwa najuwa kama unaongeaka français.
target_text_raw: Sikukuwa najuwa kama unaongeaka français.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la classe, nous parlons allemand.
target_text: Mu masomo , tunaongeaka ki allemand.
target_text_raw: Mu masomo , tunaongeaka ki allemand.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en perds mes moyens tellement elle est exhaustive.
target_text: Ninapoteza uwezo wangu sababu iko mingi sana.
target_text_raw: Ninapoteza uwezo wangu sababu iko mingi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enchanté !
target_text: Na furahi!
target_text_raw: Na furahi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom assure.
target_text: Tom anaakikisha
target_text_raw: Tom anaakikisha
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chauffeur conduit la limousine au garage.
target_text: Chauffeur anabeba limousine mu garage.
target_text_raw: Chauffeur anabeba limousine mu garage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je doute, parce que je crois que l'avenir saura mieux.
target_text: Ninashakia,juu ninawaza kesho itajuwa muzuri zaidi.
target_text_raw: Ninashakia,juu ninawaza kesho itajuwa muzuri zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'accepte, reconnaissant, toutes les critiques car en m'indiquant mes erreurs, elles m'aident à m'améliorer.
target_text: Ninaitika ma critiques zote, na ninashukuru sababu kwa kuniambia makosa yangu, inanisaidia kuji corriger.
target_text_raw: Ninaitika ma critiques zote, na ninashukuru sababu kwa kuniambia makosa yangu, inanisaidia kuji corriger.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Donnez ces cookies à Arthur.
target_text: Mupatie Arthur hizi cookies.
target_text_raw: Mupatie Arthur hizi cookies.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bougez-vous les fesses, les filles !
target_text: Ba filles, mutingize matako!
target_text_raw: Ba filles, mutingize matako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mal avait si bien rongé cette femme qu’elle n’était plus qu’un fantôme.
target_text: Ubaya iligusa ile mwanamuke sana mpaka akabakia tu sawa kizimu.
target_text_raw: Ubaya iligusa ile mwanamuke sana mpaka akabakia tu sawa kizimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne pouvez pas vous débarrasser de moi.
target_text: Hauwezi hata kujitosha ku miye.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi hata kujitosha ku miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève ton manteau, veux-tu ?
target_text: Tosha koti yako, unataka?
target_text_raw: Tosha koti yako, unataka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne te mens pas à toi-même.
target_text: Usijidanganye we pekee.
target_text_raw: Usijidanganye we pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons abreuvé nos chevaux.
target_text: Tulinywesha farasi zetu.
target_text_raw: Tulinywesha farasi zetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plus grande défaite pour un athée est de se retrouver au paradis.
target_text: Kushindwa ya nguvu sana kwa mutu asiye amini Mungu ni kukutaniwa mbinguni.
target_text_raw: Kushindwa ya nguvu sana kwa mutu asiye amini Mungu ni kukutaniwa mbinguni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fit souffler sur les dés par sa petite amie, pour lui porter chance, avant qu'il les lance.
target_text: Aliambia rafiki yake mdogo wa fille apulize ku ma billes zake kwa kumuletea bahati mbele aanze ceza.
target_text_raw: Aliambia rafiki yake mdogo wa fille apulize ku ma billes zake kwa kumuletea bahati mbele aanze ceza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un grand écrivain est un homme qui sait nous surprendre en nous disant ce que nous savions depuis toujours.
target_text: Mwandishi mkubwa ni mutu anajuwa kushitula akituambia byenyi tunajuwa tangia zamani.
target_text_raw: Mwandishi mkubwa ni mutu anajuwa kushitula akituambia byenyi tunajuwa tangia zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Contrairement à son apparence effrayante, sa voix était douce et calme.
target_text: Tafauti na hali yake ya inje ya kuleta woga, sauti yake ilikuwa nzuri na yenyi kimya.
target_text_raw: Tafauti na hali yake ya inje ya kuleta woga, sauti yake ilikuwa nzuri na yenyi kimya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Approchez-vous et vous pourrez mieux voir.
target_text: Muzogeleane na mutaweza ona muzuri zaidi.
target_text_raw: Muzogeleane na mutaweza ona muzuri zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui peut se permettre d'acheter une maison aussi chère ?
target_text: Ni nani anaweza pima kuuza nyumba ya beyi kali hivi?
target_text_raw: Ni nani anaweza pima kuuza nyumba ya beyi kali hivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il gagna grâce à sa force de volonté.
target_text: Alishinda kupitia nguvu yake ya utashi.
target_text_raw: Alishinda kupitia nguvu yake ya utashi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De l'argile naissent les pots, mais le vide, en eux réalisé, forme l'essence du pot.
target_text: Ni udongo njo inatengeneza vyungu vya inchi, lakini ile bure ya ndani ya cungu kisha kuitengeneza, njo yenyi inapatia cungu valeur.
target_text_raw: Ni udongo njo inatengeneza vyungu vya inchi, lakini ile bure ya ndani ya cungu kisha kuitengeneza, njo yenyi inapatia cungu valeur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y aura aucune vraie paix si les droits des autochtones ne sont pas réhabilités aux dépens des principes injustes de cette idéologie raciste et colonialiste au nom de laquelle ce pays est dirigé.
target_text: Hakuna amani ya kweli kama haki za wazaliwa hazirudishiwa kwa ajili ya kanuni zenyi haziko sasa ya ideolojia ya ubaguzi ya rangi na ya ukoloni kwa jina yenyi inchi inaongozewa.
target_text_raw: Hakuna amani ya kweli kama haki za wazaliwa hazirudishiwa kwa ajili ya kanuni zenyi haziko sasa ya ideolojia ya ubaguzi ya rangi na ya ukoloni kwa jina yenyi inchi inaongozewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans la plupart des hôpitaux, l'historique des patients est conservé par ordre alphabétique.
target_text: Mu ma hopitali za mingi, hadisi ya wagonjwa inalindwa kufuatana na alphabet.
target_text_raw: Mu ma hopitali za mingi, hadisi ya wagonjwa inalindwa kufuatana na alphabet.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je descends du train à la prochaine station.
target_text: Nitashuka mu train ku station ya kufuata.
target_text_raw: Nitashuka mu train ku station ya kufuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Iopas prend alors sa harpe enchanteresse : / chantre inspiré du ciel, il commence, et sa voix / répète ce qu'Atlas enseignait autrefois.
target_text: Lopas anakamata combo yake ca kupiga muziki:/muimbaji mwenyi uwepo kutoka mbinguni, anaanza, na sauti yake/anarudilia byenyi Atlas alikuwa anafundisha hapa zamani.
target_text_raw: Lopas anakamata combo yake ca kupiga muziki:/muimbaji mwenyi uwepo kutoka mbinguni, anaanza, na sauti yake/anarudilia byenyi Atlas alikuwa anafundisha hapa zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voulais passer quelques appels.
target_text: Nilitaka niite kwanza.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka niite kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me rappelles ma fille.
target_text: Unanikumbusha fille wangu.
target_text_raw: Unanikumbusha fille wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie sera ravie.
target_text: Maria atafurahi.
target_text_raw: Maria atafurahi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et Marie faisaient semblant de ne pas remarquer que John les regardait.
target_text: Tom na Maria balikuwa banajifanyisha saa habaone kama Johane alikuwa anabaangalia.
target_text_raw: Tom na Maria balikuwa banajifanyisha saa habaone kama Johane alikuwa anabaangalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père ayant grandi en Amérique, il parle couramment l'anglais.
target_text: Baba yangu mwenyi alikomalia Amerika, anaongea Kingereza muzuri.
target_text_raw: Baba yangu mwenyi alikomalia Amerika, anaongea Kingereza muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelqu'un est clairement en train de mentir.
target_text: Kuko mutu mwenyi kwa wazi iko anasema uongo.
target_text_raw: Kuko mutu mwenyi kwa wazi iko anasema uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il avait dix-huit ans et demi et déjà eu trois relations auparavant, dans lesquelles il avait eu aussi des rapports sexuels.
target_text: Alikuwaka na myaka kumi na mnane na nusu na déjà alikuwa alisha kuwa na relations tatu, zenyi ndani alikuwa alisha fanya ngono.
target_text_raw: Alikuwaka na myaka kumi na mnane na nusu na déjà alikuwa alisha kuwa na relations tatu, zenyi ndani alikuwa alisha fanya ngono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela a certes une certaine logique, voire une logique certaine.
target_text: Kweli ile iko na logique fulani, na kwanza ni logique kamili.
target_text_raw: Kweli ile iko na logique fulani, na kwanza ni logique kamili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malheureusement, nous n'avons pas pu enregistrer votre participation. Peut-être avez-vous déjà participé, ou bien il est possible que nos conditions générales aient été enfreintes. Vous allez être redirigé vers la plate-forme de votre panel.
target_text: Kibaya, hakuluweza kuandika mcango yako. Labda ulishaka shiriki,ao saa moya shurti zetu za kijumla zilikuwa nguvu. Utaelekezwa tena kwenyi mutandao ya timu yenyi kuongoza mashindano yako.
target_text_raw: Kibaya, hakuluweza kuandika mcango yako. Labda ulishaka shiriki,ao saa moya shurti zetu za kijumla zilikuwa nguvu. Utaelekezwa tena kwenyi mutandao ya timu yenyi kuongoza mashindano yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une limousine noire a viré à l'angle dans un crissement de pneus.
target_text: Gari ya limousine ya mweusi ilitereza ikaenda ngambo ingine pembeni ya barabara.
target_text_raw: Gari ya limousine ya mweusi (noir) ilitereza ikaenda ngambo ingine pembeni ya barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y avait des témoins.
target_text: Kulikuwa washahidi.
target_text_raw: Kulikuwa washahidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une excellente méthode pour soulager le stress.
target_text: Ni namna nzuri sana ya kupunguza stress.
target_text_raw: Ni namna nzuri sana ya kupunguza stress.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chances que nous avons de réussir sont minces.
target_text: Bahati zenyi tuko nazo za kuweza ziko kidogo sana.
target_text_raw: Bahati zenyi tuko nazo za kuweza ziko kidogo sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Saint Louis ne dédaignait pas d'admettre des ménétriers ou poètes ambulants à sa table.
target_text: Mtakatifu Louis hakukuwaka anazarau kuitika waandishi wakwenda enda ku meza yake.
target_text_raw: Mtakatifu Louis hakukuwaka anazarau kuitika waandishi wakwenda enda ku meza yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À certains animaux, la nature impose de fuir. Aux autres, de foncer. En d'autres, tels périls ou émois font naître le courage.
target_text: Kwa wanyama fulani fulani , hali ya kuzaliwa inawakimbiza. Kwa wengine, kuendelea. Kwa wengine, kuangamia ao magumu inawaletea juhudi.
target_text_raw: Kwa wanyama fulani fulani , hali ya kuzaliwa inawakimbiza. Kwa wengine, kuendelea. Kwa wengine, kuangamia ao magumu inawaletea juhudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Considère soigneusement ce que tu es sur le point de dire. Tu risques gros là-dessus.
target_text: Waza kwanza muzuri byenyi unataka sema. Una risquer bya mingi kwa ile.
target_text_raw: Waza kwanza muzuri byenyi unataka sema. Una risquer bya mingi kwa ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louer un bureau dans cette immeuble est très cher.
target_text: Kupanga bureau mwa ile batiment iko beyi sana.
target_text_raw: Kupanga bureau mwa ile batiment iko beyi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah, OK!
target_text: Ah, Ok!
target_text_raw: Ah, Ok!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces temps derniers, Israël et l'Iran ont vraiment très peu de choses en commun, mais l'espéranto en fait partie.
target_text: Hizi siku, Israel na Iran biko mambo kidogo ya pamoya, lakini Esperanto iko ndani.
target_text_raw: Hizi siku, Israel na Iran biko mambo kidogo ya pamoya, lakini Esperanto iko ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voulons atteindre un public plus large.
target_text: Tunataka kufikia watu wengi zaidi.
target_text_raw: Tunataka kufikia watu wengi zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les policiers lui ont demandé de retirer ses lunettes, sa montre, sa ceinture et sa cravate, puis ils l'ont mis dans une cellule.
target_text: Wa polisi walimwambia atoshe ma lunettes zake, montre yake, ceinture yake, cravate kisha wakamutia mu cachot.
target_text_raw: Wa polisi walimwambia atoshe ma lunettes zake, montre yake, ceinture yake, cravate kisha wakamutia mu cachot.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne ne chante aussi bien sous la douche qu'Anna !
target_text: Hakuna mutu mwenyi anaimbaka muzuri saa iko mu douche saa vile Anna!
target_text_raw: Hakuna mutu mwenyi anaimbaka muzuri saa iko mu douche saa vile Anna!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous saviez probablement déjà cela.
target_text: Iko saa ulikuwa déjà unajuwa vile.
target_text_raw: Iko saa ulikuwa déjà unajuwa vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gardez la monnaie !
target_text: Weka makuta!
target_text_raw: Weka makuta!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie doit répondre à la lettre de Lisa.
target_text: Maria anapashwa jibia ku barua ya Liza.
target_text_raw: Maria anapashwa jibia ku barua ya Liza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu sembles avoir un faible pour la bonne chère, non ?
target_text: Iko saa uko mzaifu mbele ya mutu wa mwili mzuri,sivyo?
target_text_raw: Iko saa uko mzaifu mbele ya mutu wa mwili mzuri,sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut parfois déclarer une guerre pour réaliser qu'on l'a déjà perdue.
target_text: Inaombaka saa moya kutangaza vita kwa kujuwa kama ulisha ishindwa.
target_text_raw: Inaombaka saa moya kutangaza vita kwa kujuwa kama ulisha ishindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Moi j'ai pas envie d'avoir un ventre tout distendu. S'il veut un chiard, on recourra à la GPA, un point c'est tout, il n'a qu'à avoir les moyens !
target_text: Miye sitaki hata kukuwa na tumbu ya kwenda ku mgongo. Kama anataka katoto ka garcon kadogo, GPA itatusaidia, na basi, atayarishe tu makuta!
target_text_raw: Miye sitaki hata kukuwa na tumbu ya kwenda ku mgongo. Kama anataka katoto ka garcon kadogo, GPA itatusaidia, na basi, atayarishe tu makuta!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le carter s'est ouvert sous le choc.
target_text: Carter ya gari ilijifungula kwa gafla.
target_text_raw: Carter ya gari ilijifungula kwa gafla.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est Emily ?
target_text: Emile ni nani?
target_text_raw: Emile ni nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aux échecs, ce sont les blancs qui commencent.
target_text: Bazungu njo bakwanza kushindwa.
target_text_raw: Bazungu njo bakwanza kushindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces devoirs accomplis, le signal est donné ; / et les voiles, des vents appelant les haleines, / tournent sur les longs bras de leurs longues antennes. / Nous partons, nous fuyons d'un cours précipité / ce rivage suspect, par les Grecs habité.
target_text: Mapashwa tumemaliza, signal imepaniwa,;/na vitambala, mpepeo ikaleta harufu,/ikageuka ku mikono mrefu ya ma antennes zabo zirefu./Tunaenda, tunakimbia kwa haraka yote/hii mtoni ya kushakia, kwenyi Wagriki walikuwa wanaishi.
target_text_raw: Mapashwa tumemaliza, signal imepaniwa,;/na vitambala, mpepeo ikaleta harufu,/ikageuka ku mikono mrefu ya ma antennes zabo zirefu./Tunaenda, tunakimbia kwa haraka yote/hii mtoni ya kushakia, kwenyi Wagriki walikuwa wanaishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu verras la maison aujourd'hui.
target_text: Utaona nyumba leo.
target_text_raw: Utaona nyumba leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne me laisses pas le choix.
target_text: Hauniacie chaguo.
target_text_raw: Hauniacie chaguo(choix).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais eu à virer quelqu'un avant.
target_text: Habiyanifikiaka hata siku moya kufukuza mutu mbele.
target_text_raw: Habiyanifikiaka hata siku moya kufukuza mutu mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La crainte de quelques pouvoirs suprêmes et divins conservent les hommes dans l'obéissance.
target_text: Boga ya mamlaka zikubwa zimoya na za mbinguni zinatuma watu wanakuwa na utii.
target_text_raw: Boga ya mamlaka zikubwa zimoya na za mbinguni zinatuma watu wanakuwa na utii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque vous pénétrez sur l'autoroute, passez en cinquième !
target_text: Wakati unaingia ndani ya barabara kubwa, upite wa tano!
target_text_raw: Wakati unaingia ndani ya barabara kubwa, upite wa tano!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les bons moments sont terminés.
target_text: Wakati nzuri zimeisha.
target_text_raw: Wakati nzuri zimeisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai gardé la meilleure pour la fin.
target_text: Nimibaki mzuri sana zaidi mpaka mwisho.
target_text_raw: Nimibaki mzuri sana zaidi mpaka mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noah a demandé à Marie de surveiller les enfants.
target_text: Noah aliomba Maria aangalie batoto.
target_text_raw: Noah aliomba Maria aangalie batoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce une société publique ou privée ?
target_text: Ni kampuni ya kipekee ao ya serkali?
target_text_raw: Ni kampuni ya kipekee ao ya serkali?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces derniers temps, il se met facilement en colère.
target_text: Hizi siku, iko anasirika mbio mbio.
target_text_raw: Hizi siku, iko anasirika mbio mbio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une langue est comme une espèce ; pour survivre, elle doit s'améliorer et non se dégrader.
target_text: Luga ni sawa ukoo, kwa kuishi , inapashwa kuwa bora hapana kuharibika.
target_text_raw: Luga ni sawa ukoo, kwa kuishi , inapashwa kuwa bora hapana kuharibika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tes "O" ressemblent à des "A".
target_text: Ma «O» zako zinafanana na ma «A».
target_text_raw: Ma «O» zako zinafanana na ma «A».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a engagé une nouvelle secrétaire.
target_text: Ali engager katibuwa mpya.
target_text_raw: Ali engager katibu(secretaire) wa mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est évident que tu ne peux pas faire tes devoirs en regardant la télé.
target_text: Ni wazi kama hauweai fanya ma devoirs zako na uko unaangalia télévision.
target_text_raw: Ni wazi kama hauweai fanya ma devoirs zako na uko unaangalia télévision.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À l'âge de six ans, j'ai été emmené au cirque pour la première fois.
target_text: Ku myaka 6, balinibebaka ku fasi ya mcezo ya wacoraji wa nyama mara ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Ku myaka 6, balinibebaka ku fasi ya mcezo ya wacoraji wa nyama mara ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous revenez à Kyoto.
target_text: Munarudia Kyoto.
target_text_raw: Munarudia Kyoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu te trouves dans un groupe indécis, propose, avec un air confiant, quelque chose que personne n'accepterait.
target_text: Wakati unajikutana mu kundi ya watu wa mashaka,elekeza,ukiwa na hali ya kujiaminia,kitu yenyi mutu hawezi itika.
target_text_raw: Wakati unajikutana mu kundi ya watu wa mashaka,elekeza,ukiwa na hali ya kujiaminia,kitu yenyi mutu hawezi itika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Prendre un apéritif avant le repas, c'est s'ouvrir l'estomac avec une fausse clé.
target_text: Kutumia kitu ya kuleta appetit mbele ya kula, ni kufungula tumbu na fungulo ya mbaya.
target_text_raw: Kutumia kitu ya kuleta appetit mbele ya kula, ni kufungula tumbu na fungulo ya mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les premiers seront souvent les derniers.
target_text: Mara mingi ba kwanza batakuwa ba mwisho.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi ba kwanza batakuwa ba mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voulons toutes des réponses.
target_text: Tunataka majibu zote.
target_text_raw: Tunataka majibu zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand reviendra enfin le printemps ?
target_text: Majira mazuri itafika wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Majira mazuri itafika wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soyez en alerte. L'ordre d'évacuation peut intervenir à tout moment.
target_text: Baki chonjo. Maagizo ya kutosha batu inaweza tokea wakati wowote.
target_text_raw: Baki chonjo(makini). Maagizo ya kutosha batu inaweza tokea wakati wowote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne pouvons pas libérer les prisonniers aujourd'hui.
target_text: Hatuwezi acilia wafungwa leo.
target_text_raw: Hatuwezi acilia wafungwa (ba prisoniers) leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'étiez pas sérieuse, si ?
target_text: Hamukukuwa sérieuses,ndio?
target_text_raw: Hamukukuwa sérieuses,ndio?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je deviens nerveuse lorsque je parle devant une foule nombreuse.
target_text: Ninasikia siko bien saa ninaongea mbele watu wengi.
target_text_raw: Ninasikia siko bien saa ninaongea mbele watu wengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand le patron est revenu, la secrétaire avait déjà tapé toutes les lettres !
target_text: Wakati boss alirudia, secretaire alikuwa ameandika barua zote!
target_text_raw: Wakati boss alirudia, secretaire alikuwa ameandika barua zote!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regarder de jolies images lui procure beaucoup de plaisir.
target_text: Kuangalia ma picainamuleteyaka raha.
target_text_raw: Kuangalia ma pica(ma images) inamuleteyaka raha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai brisé mes lunettes.
target_text: Nilivunja ma lunettes zangu.
target_text_raw: Nilivunja ma lunettes zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous voyez un temple ?
target_text: Unaona hekalu?
target_text_raw: Unaona hekalu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Connaissez-vous le massage cardiaque ?
target_text: Unajuwa ginsi ya kunyorosha roho?
target_text_raw: Unajuwa ginsi ya kunyorosha roho?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jeu de Go est mon seul passe-temps.
target_text: Mcezo ya Go tu njo ninapitishaka nayo wakati.
target_text_raw: Mcezo ya Go tu njo ninapitishaka nayo wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arthur est un agent des services correctionnels.
target_text: Arthur ni mtumishi wa kazi ya ukosowaji.
target_text_raw: Arthur ni mtumishi wa kazi ya ukosowaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Réfléchis bien à ce sujet, s'il te plaît ! » - « Mais au sujet de quoi ? »
target_text: «Waza bien kwanza juu ya sujet, tafazali!» «Lakini juu ya nini?»
target_text_raw: «Waza bien kwanza juu ya sujet, tafazali!» «Lakini juu ya nini?»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans l'après-midi, nous avons fait du tir avec ma carabine à air comprimé.
target_text: Mu apres midi, tulifanya ma tirs na bunduki yangu ya hewa.
target_text_raw: Mu apres midi, tulifanya ma tirs na bunduki yangu ya hewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Suis-je supposé vous remercier ?
target_text: Ninapashwa kukupigia aksanti?
target_text_raw: Ninapashwa kukupigia aksanti?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis ni démon, ni ange.
target_text: Siko shetani na siko malaika.
target_text_raw: Siko shetani na siko malaika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes probablement fatiguée après un vol aussi long.
target_text: Iko saa unacoka kisha ile safari ya mrefu vile ya mu avion.
target_text_raw: Iko saa unacoka kisha ile safari ya mrefu vile ya mu avion.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne pensez pas à de tels trucs !
target_text: Musiwaze ju ya bitu bya hivi!
target_text_raw: Musiwaze ju ya bitu bya hivi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Disiez-vous : « Elle pousse toujours ses partenaires de jeu au tennis. » ou « Elle touche toujours ses partenaires de jeu au pénis » ?
target_text: Ulisema: «Yeye huwa anasukuma wenzi wake wa kucheza tenisi.» Au «Yeye huwagusa wachezaji wenzake katika uume?»
target_text_raw: Ulisema: «Yeye huwa anasukuma wenzi wake wa kucheza tenisi.» Au «Yeye huwagusa wachezaji wenzake katika uume?»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La rentrée des classes ne va pas tarder.
target_text: Masomo haitakawia tena kufunguliwa.
target_text_raw: Masomo haitakawia tena kufunguliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'en bats les couilles !
target_text: Hanijali hata!
target_text_raw: Hanijali hata!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'allais proposer la possibilité suivante.
target_text: Nilitaka proposer ufuatayo.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka proposer ufuatayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cool, Raoul !
target_text: Sawa , Raoul!
target_text_raw: Sawa , Raoul!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a tourné à gauche à l'angle.
target_text: Aligeukia kushoto ya congo.
target_text_raw: Aligeukia kushoto ya congo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jack n'aime pas du tout le Camembert.
target_text: Jack hapendake Camembert sana.
target_text_raw: Jack hapendake Camembert (fromage) sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai remarqué qu'elle était assise au premier rang.
target_text: Niliona kama alikuwa anaikala ku mustari ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Niliona kama alikuwa anaikala ku mustari ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma jeunesse est finie.
target_text: Ujana wangu imeisha.
target_text_raw: Ujana wangu imeisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca offrit à Marie une coupe de champagne.
target_text: Luca alitolea Maria kikombe ya champagne.
target_text_raw: Luca alitolea Maria kikombe ya champagne.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne pratiquons pas la polygamie au Japon, chéri.
target_text: Huku Japani mwanaume haruhusiwe kuowa banamuke bawili, cheri.
target_text_raw: Huku Japani mwanaume haruhusiwe kuowa banamuke bawili, cheri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Être une femme n'est pas chose aisée. On doit penser comme un homme, agir comme une dame, avoir l'air d'une jeune fille et bosser comme un cheval.

target_text_raw: Hata siku moya hauwezi juwa kama utaweza ao hapana kama haupime.

target_text: Mwanamuke anakuwaka na mapua ya muzuri sana, anasoma kila siku kitabu ca sala, ananusa kila mbao, kitu ikuwe kitakatifu ao kibaya.

source_text: C'est sympa de siroter et de savourer d'autres boissons que de la bière de temps en temps.

source_text: Mastodon est un réseau social libre décentralisé et Open Source.

target_text_raw: Kati ya caguo ya matunda, ninacagulaka tu ma pommes.

target_text_raw: Juu ya nini uko na wasiwasi hivi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux profiter de l'occasion pour vous souhaiter d'ores et déjà un bon dimanche.

target_text_raw: Ninaprofiter hii muda(occasion) ili niwatakie déjà siku ya Mungu njema.

target_text_raw: Maria alirudia hapa.

target_text_raw: Unafungiwa.

source_text: Vous êtes la seule personne que je connaisse qui soit qualifiée pour cette mission.
target_text: Uko we pekee mutu moya mwenyi ninajuwa mwenyi iko na masomo juu ya hii kazi.
target_text_raw: Uko we pekee mutu moya mwenyi ninajuwa mwenyi iko na masomo juu ya hii kazi(mission).

source_text: Une sieste ferait du bien.

target_text_raw: Kulala kidogo mcana ingelikusaidia.

target_text_raw: Upande mu bateau!

source_text: " Cette plaintive voix, ces accents de douleurs / étonnent les esprits, amollissent les cœurs ; / on demande son nom, son état, sa naissance, / et quels droits il apporte à notre confiance. "
target_text: «Hii sauti ya kulialia,hibi bilio bya maumivu/zinashangaza akili,zinaregeza ma roho;/banauliza jina yake,hali yake,kuzaliwa kwake,/na haki gani analeta kujiaminia kwetu.»

source_text: Ils s'emparent de Troie ; et les vapeurs du vin / et la paix du sommeil secondant leur dessein, / ils massacrent la garde, ouvrent toutes les portes, / et la mort dans nos murs entre avec leurs cohortes.
target_text: Wanavamia Troie; na mivuke ya divai/na amani ya usingizi yenyi kufuata mipango ya maisha yao,/ wanauwa walinzi,banafungula milango,/na kifo mu bibambazi yetu katikati na fujo zao.

source_text: Elle ne voulait pas qu’il parte.
target_text: Hakukuwa anapenda aende.
target_text_raw: Hakukuwa anapenda aende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le grand nombre de traductions amateur de mangas japonais sur Internet, prouve combien ils sont populaires.
target_text: Idadi kuwa ya tafsiri ya amateurs za mangas ya kijapani ku internet inasibitisha ginsi zinajulikana.
target_text_raw: Idadi kuwa ya tafsiri ya amateurs za mangas ya kijapani ku internet inasibitisha ginsi zinajulikana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le président est associé à l'organisation depuis dix ans.
target_text: Raisni mmoja wa ile shirika tangu myaka kumi.
target_text_raw: Rais(Président) ni mmoja wa ile shirika tangu myaka kumi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est l'hôpital qui se moque de la Charité.
target_text: Ni hopitali njo inacekelea Upendo.
target_text_raw: Ni hopitali njo inacekelea Upendo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soleil brille au-dessus de nos têtes.
target_text: Jua inawaka julu ya bicwa byetu.
target_text_raw: Jua inawaka julu ya bicwa byetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avoir des enfants te donne de la vitalité, mais les élever te la retire.
target_text: Kukuwa na batoto inakupatia nguvu ya kuishi lakini kuwakomalisha inakunyanganya nayo.
target_text_raw: Kukuwa na batoto inakupatia nguvu ya kuishi lakini kuwakomalisha inakunyanganya nayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À cause de toi, j'ai des problèmes de tension.
target_text: Juu yako, niko na problemes ya tension.
target_text_raw: Juu yako, niko na problemes ya tension.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu veux dire que tu manques de partenaires sexuels réguliers ?
target_text: Unataka sema kama unakosa wenzako wakufanya nao ngono mara kwa mara?
target_text_raw: Unataka sema kama unakosa wenzako wakufanya nao ngono mara kwa mara?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un problème avec mon colocataire. Il me bouffe tout.
target_text: Niko na shida na mwenzangu mwenyi tunapanga naye. Ananikula byote.
target_text_raw: Niko na shida na mwenzangu mwenyi tunapanga naye. Ananikula byote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Très noble ! Si vous vous laissez ainsi guider en pratique, je ne veux pas porter de jugement.
target_text: Muzuri sana! Kama unajiacilia kuongozwa vile mu pratique , sitaitika bibebe hukumu.
target_text_raw: Muzuri sana! Kama unajiacilia kuongozwa vile mu pratique , sitaitika bibebe hukumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La cheminée conduit la fumée de l'âtre à l'extérieur.
target_text: Njia ya moshiinabeba moshi inje.
target_text_raw: Njia ya moshi (cheminée)inabeba moshi inje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne permettez à personne de parler !
target_text: Usiruhusu mutu aseme!
target_text_raw: Usiruhusu mutu aseme!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Asseyez-vous sur cette chaise et essayez de vous calmer.
target_text: Uikale kwa hii kiti na ujikaze kupima kutulia.
target_text_raw: Uikale kwa hii kiti na ujikaze kupima kutulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous sentez pas gênées. Ces choses arrivent.
target_text: Musijisikie muko gênées. Binafikaka.
target_text_raw: Musijisikie muko gênées. Binafikaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un bon massage vous ferait du bien.
target_text: Message ya bien inakusikilisha bien.
target_text_raw: Message ya bien inakusikilisha bien.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour réussir, il faut avoir foi en l'avenir.
target_text: Kwa kuweza, inaomba kuwa na imani ya byenyi bitakuya kesho.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuweza, inaomba kuwa na imani ya byenyi bitakuya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au cours de ses cent premiers jours, le président n'a pas réalisé grand-chose.
target_text: Wakati ya siku zake miya moya za kwanza, Raishakufanya hata bya maana.
target_text_raw: Wakati ya siku zake miya moya za kwanza, Rais(President) hakufanya hata bya maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton temps est limité, ne le perds donc pas en menant une vie qui n'est pas la tienne.
target_text: Wakati yako iko kidogo, usiipoteze sasa ukitafuta kuishi maisha yenyi haikustahili.
target_text_raw: Wakati yako iko kidogo, usiipoteze sasa ukitafuta kuishi maisha yenyi haikustahili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On voyait la mer reflétée dans la glace du restaurant.
target_text: Bahari ilikuwa inaonekana mu kiyo ya restaurant.
target_text_raw: Bahari ilikuwa inaonekana mu kiyo ya restaurant.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me suivez pas, je suis également perdue !
target_text: Usinifuate, na miye nimepotea.
target_text_raw: Usinifuate, na miye nimepotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regrette d'avoir accepté cette tâche.
target_text: Nina regretter kyenyi niliitikia hii kazi.
target_text_raw: Nina regretter kyenyi niliitikia hii kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te promets que je viendrai tôt.
target_text: Ninawahaidia kama ndarudia mbele.
target_text_raw: Ninawahaidia (ninabapromettre) kama ndarudia mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voilà un flic.
target_text: Ona polisi.
target_text_raw: Ona polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La glace est trop dure à briser.
target_text: Kio iko nguvu sana kupasula.
target_text_raw: Kio iko nguvu sana kupasula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si on la regarde depuis un vaisseau spatial, la Terre a l'air bleue.
target_text: Ukiangalia kutokea ngambo ya angani, arzi inafanana bleu.
target_text_raw: Ukiangalia kutokea ngambo ya angani, arzi inafanana bleu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La guerre, c'est l'enfer.
target_text: Vita, ni jehenama.
target_text_raw: Vita, ni jehenama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Eh les mecs, pouvez-vous nous dire où nous nous trouvons ?
target_text: Rafiki,mutaweza tuambia tuko wapi?
target_text_raw: Rafiki,mutaweza tuambia tuko wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.
