source_text: Elle a pris la peine de m'emmener jusqu'à la maison que je cherchais.
target_text: Alijikaza akanibeba mpaka ku nyumba nilikwa natafuta.
target_text_raw: Alijikaza akanibeba mpaka ku nyumba nilikwa natafuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'Algérie combat la laïcité et la démocratie.
target_text: Aljeria inapiganisha kuto kuwa na dini na demokrasia.
target_text_raw: Aljeria inapiganisha kuto kuwa na dini na demokrasia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chez nous, tout est dingue, sans exception.
target_text: Kwetu,kila kitu ni umbavu,kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Kwetu,kila kitu ni umbavu,kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les forces d'occupation ont incendié plusieurs maisons dans ce quartier.
target_text: Majeshi ya uvamizi zililunguza nyumba mingi mwa hii mgini.
target_text_raw: Majeshi ya uvamizi zililunguza nyumba mingi mwa hii mgini (quartier).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai des preuves.
target_text: Niko na ma preuves.
target_text_raw: Niko na ma preuves.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voulais pas remettre en cause votre autorité.
target_text: Sikukukuwa nataka nishakie mamlaka yako.
target_text_raw: Sikukukuwa nataka nishakie mamlaka yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis imaginé que vous pourriez vouloir ceci.
target_text: Niliwaza kama utaweza kutaka hii.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza kama utaweza kutaka hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque vous rencontrez une personne pour la première fois, soyez attentives à la distance à laquelle vous vous en tenez.
target_text: Wakati unakutana na mutu mara ya kwanza, fanya hange na distance yenyi iko katikati yenu.
target_text_raw: Wakati unakutana na mutu mara ya kwanza, fanya hange na distance yenyi iko katikati yenu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marguerite était enceinte de jumeaux.
target_text: Marguerite iko na mimba ya mapasa.
target_text_raw: Marguerite iko na mimba ya mapasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ne crut pas un mot de ce que sa fille lui donna comme excuse.
target_text: Hakuamini hata neno moya mu mafasirio yenyi fille wake alimupatia.
target_text_raw: Hakuamini hata neno moya mu mafasirio yenyi fille wake alimupatia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bravo !
target_text: Hongera!
target_text_raw: Hongera!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marc ne travaille que pour le fric.
target_text: Marco hatumike juu ya makuta!
target_text_raw: Marco hatumike juu ya makuta!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un tas de logos d'entreprise ornaient l'entrée menant au match de football.
target_text: Logos za mingi za kampuni zilikuwa zinapamba njia ya kuingilia ku match ya foot.
target_text_raw: Logos za mingi za kampuni zilikuwa zinapamba njia ya kuingilia ku match ya foot.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit : on applaudit, on dépose au rivage / tous ceux que retenait ou leur sexe ou leur âge. / Le vent gonfle la voile ; et, sur les vastes eaux, / nous cherchons des périls et des climats nouveaux.
target_text: Anasema: Anashangilia,tunaweka/bote benyi balikuwa banafungwa na buci yao ao myaka yao./mpepeo inavimbisha kitambala;na,ku mayi mengi,/tunatafuta kupotea na hali ya hewa mpya.
target_text_raw: Anasema: Anashangilia,tunaweka/bote benyi balikuwa banafungwa na buci yao ao myaka yao./mpepeo inavimbisha kitambala;na,ku mayi mengi,/tunatafuta kupotea na hali ya hewa mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère qu'il verra cela.
target_text: Natumaini kama ataiona.
target_text_raw: Natumaini kama ataiona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Partez !
target_text: Wende!
target_text_raw: Wende!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me saoules avec tes conneries.
target_text: Unalewesha na mizaha yako.
target_text_raw: Unalewesha na mizaha yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La conscience est à l'âme ce que l'instinct est au corps ; qui la suit obéit à la nature et ne craint point de s'égarer.
target_text: Zamiri ni kwa nafsi sasa kile kyenyi mwili inafanya bila kujuwa, mwenyi anafuata hali ya kizalikio anaitii na haogope hata kupotea.
target_text_raw: Zamiri ni kwa nafsi sasa kile kyenyi mwili inafanya bila kujuwa, mwenyi anafuata hali ya kizalikio anaitii na haogope hata kupotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois être vraiment spécial.
target_text: Unapashwa kuwa mutu wa dur.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kuwa mutu wa dur.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les garçons ont parlé des jeux vidéo.
target_text: Ba garcons baliongea ju ya ma jeux video.
target_text_raw: Ba garcons baliongea ju ya ma jeux video.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Akira va et revient.
target_text: Akira anaenda na anarudia.
target_text_raw: Akira anaenda na anarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai passé un merveilleux séjour ici.
target_text: Nilipitisha wakati ya mzuri hapa.
target_text_raw: Nilipitisha wakati ya mzuri hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais le prouver.
target_text: Nitaisibitisha.
target_text_raw: Nitaisibitisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette fête est une réception privée.
target_text: Hii fete ni reception ya kipekee.
target_text_raw: Hii fete ni reception ya kipekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne supporte pas la pêche.
target_text: Misiwezake uvuvi wa samaki.
target_text_raw: Misiwezake uvuvi wa samaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les chefs extrémistes espèrent pouvoir détruire cette mosquée un jour avec l'accord tacite du gouvernement.
target_text: Bakubwa benyi msimamo mkali banatumainia kama siku moya bataweza bomola hii mosquée na makubaliano na serkali yenyi iko amo giza.
target_text_raw: Bakubwa benyi msimamo mkali banatumainia kama siku moya bataweza bomola hii mosquée na makubaliano na serkali yenyi iko amo giza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai marre de chercher vos chaussettes à longueur de journée. Apprenez à les ranger !
target_text: Ninacoka na kutafuta socks zako mcana mzima. Ujifunze kubipanga!
target_text_raw: Ninacoka na kutafuta socks zako mcana mzima. Ujifunze kubipanga!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'officier couvert de talismans s'inclina jusqu'à terre.
target_text: Ofisa mwenyi alikuwa anajaa mambo ya ucawi aliinama cini.
target_text_raw: Ofisa mwenyi alikuwa anajaa mambo ya ucawi aliinama cini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hugo s'est retrouvé coincé dans les embouteillages.
target_text: Hugo alijikutana anabana mu embouteillages.
target_text_raw: Hugo alijikutana anabana mu embouteillages.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'accord OK.
target_text: Sawa Ok.
target_text_raw: Sawa Ok.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quoique tu fasse, ne lâche pas la corde.
target_text: Hata ufanye aye, usiacilie lukamba.
target_text_raw: Hata ufanye aye, usiacilie lukamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mademoiselle March m'a donné un dictionnaire anglais.
target_text: Fille March alinipatia kamusi ya kingereza.
target_text_raw: Fille March alinipatia kamusi ya kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voulais l'épouser.
target_text: Nilitaka kumuowa.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka kumuowa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aime toujours arranger les choses.
target_text: Siku zote ninapendaka kupanga bitu.
target_text_raw: Siku zote ninapendaka kupanga bitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a des restes dans le réfrigérateur.
target_text: Kungali byenyi binabakia mu frigo.
target_text_raw: Kungali byenyi binabakia mu frigo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le trou est trop petit. Continuez de creuser !
target_text: Tundu ni ya kidogo sana. Muendeleye kucimba!
target_text_raw: Tundu ni ya kidogo sana. Muendeleye kucimba!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous feriez un très beau couple.
target_text: Mungelifanya ya muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Mungelifanya ya muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Richard Dawkins est athée.
target_text: Richards Dawkins haamini kama Mungu iko.
target_text_raw: Richards Dawkins haamini kama Mungu iko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je souhaite remercier toutes celles qui m'ont aidé à faire ça.
target_text: Nataka niwapigie aksanti bote benyi balinisaidia kufanya hii.
target_text_raw: Nataka niwapigie aksanti bote benyi balinisaidia kufanya hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faut que ça dégage.
target_text: Inaomba itoke.
target_text_raw: Inaomba itoke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous souhaite à tous un joyeux Noël et une bonne année.
target_text: Ninawatakia nyote Noele njema na mwaka mpya mwema.
target_text_raw: Ninawatakia nyote Noele njema na mwaka mpya mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela peut te paraître ridicule, mais les règles sont ainsi.
target_text: Inaweza oneka bya haya,lakini njo kanuni ile.
target_text_raw: Inaweza oneka bya haya,lakini njo kanuni ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous trouvez ce vin bon.
target_text: Munasikia ile divai ni ya mzuri.
target_text_raw: Munasikia ile divai ni ya mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La piste d'atterrissage est quotidiennement nettoyée et contrôlée par une équipe spécialisée.
target_text: Kiwanja ya ndege inatengenezwa kila siku na inacunguzwa na timu ya watalaamu.
target_text_raw: Kiwanja ya ndege inatengenezwa kila siku na inacunguzwa na timu ya watalaamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous serons aux premières loges.
target_text: Tutakuwa ku manyumba za kupanga za kwanza.
target_text_raw: Tutakuwa ku manyumba za kupanga za kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie est assise sur un tronc d'arbre, couvrant ses yeux de ses mains. Pendant ce temps, Théo se cache quelque part dans la densité du sous-bois.
target_text: Maria anaikala ku kipande ya muti anafunika maco yake na mikono yake. Kwa hii wakati, Theo anajifica fasi moya hivu mu miti.
target_text_raw: Maria anaikala ku kipande ya muti anafunika maco yake na mikono yake. Kwa hii wakati, Theo anajifica fasi moya hivu mu miti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais où et avec qui tu as couché la nuit dernière.
target_text: Ninajuwa wapi na nani ulilala busiku ya jana
target_text_raw: Ninajuwa wapi na nani ulilala busiku ya jana
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pleure toujours quand nous nous disons au revoir.
target_text: Ninaliaka kila siku saa yenyi tunalaganaka.
target_text_raw: Ninaliaka kila siku saa yenyi tunalaganaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette traduction n'est pas bien claire.
target_text: Hii utafsiri haiko wazi sana.
target_text_raw: Hii utafsiri haiko wazi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouvrez la grille !
target_text: Fungula lupango!
target_text_raw: Fungula lupango!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les racines de l'arbre ont percé à travers le ciment à différents points le long du trottoir.
target_text: Mizizi ya muti imeingia mu ciment mu fasi tafauti kwa kutembelea kote.
target_text_raw: Mizizi ya muti imeingia mu ciment mu fasi tafauti kwa kutembelea kote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est l'apôtre de Jésus.
target_text: Ni mtume wa Yesu.
target_text_raw: Ni mtume wa Yesu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'équipage se prépare à une sortie dans l'espace.
target_text: Batumishi ya ndani banajitayarisha kwenda angani.
target_text_raw: Batumishi ya ndani banajitayarisha kwenda angani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai marre de manger des fruits de mer.
target_text: Ninacoka na kukula matunda ya bahari.
target_text_raw: Ninacoka na kukula matunda ya bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle consulta un magazine en attendant que son rendez-vous se montre.
target_text: Alifungula gazet imbele saa ya rendez-vous yake ifike.
target_text_raw: Alifungula gazet i(journal) mbele saa ya rendez-vous yake ifike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a amené des chocolats pour chaque enfant.
target_text: Alileta ma chocolats kwa kila mtoto.
target_text_raw: Alileta ma chocolats kwa kila mtoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'êtes pas autorisés à amener des chiens dans ce bâtiment.
target_text: Hamuruhusiwe kuleta imbwa mwa hii nyumba.
target_text_raw: Hamuruhusiwe kuleta imbwa mwa hii nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'art amène le pain.
target_text: Ujuwi inaleta mkate.
target_text_raw: Ujuwi inaleta mkate.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Effectuez des recherches afin de savoir si Nathan a de la parenté à Boston.
target_text: Fanya utafiti uangalie kama Hugo iko na jamaa kule Boston.
target_text_raw: Fanya utafiti (ma recherches) uangalie kama Hugo iko na jamaa (famille) kule Boston.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi tu n'appelles pas les choses par leur nom ?
target_text: Juu ya nini hauitake bitu mu jina yabyo?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini hauitake bitu mu jina yabyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De toute évidence, Timéo n'avait pas de preuve.
target_text: Kwa ukweli yote, Timeo hakukuwa na usibitisho.
target_text_raw: Kwa ukweli yote, Timeo hakukuwa na usibitisho(preuve).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux être certaine que vous êtes celles que vous déclarez être.
target_text: Ninataka nikuwe na uhakika kama muko benyi munatamka kama njo nyiye.
target_text_raw: Ninataka nikuwe na uhakika kama muko benyi munatamka kama njo nyiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pourrai jamais faire ça sans ton aide.
target_text: Singeliweza fanya hii kitu bila msaada yako.
target_text_raw: Singeliweza fanya hii kitu bila msaada yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui est un jour formidable !
target_text: Leo ni siku mzuri!
target_text_raw: Leo ni siku mzuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez mérité une pause.
target_text: Unastahili kupumzika.
target_text_raw: Unastahili kupumzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le moment où la réunion va reprendre est incertain.
target_text: Wakati yenyi reunion inaanza tena haijulikane
target_text_raw: Wakati yenyi reunion inaanza tena haijulikane
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te le dis seulement si tu le gardes pour toi.
target_text: Nitakwambia tu kama utaiweka siri yako we pekee,
target_text_raw: Nitakwambia tu kama utaiweka siri yako we pekee,
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est agent immobilier.
target_text: Anafanya kazi ya kuuza na kuuzisha ma nyumba.
target_text_raw: Anafanya kazi ya kuuza na kuuzisha ma nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a d'énormes balles.
target_text: Iko na masasi/kabumbu za mingi
target_text_raw: Iko na masasi/kabumbu za mingi
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons trouvé les empreintes de pas dans le sable.
target_text: Tulipata halama za hatua za migulu mu mcanga.
target_text_raw: Tulipata halama za hatua za migulu mu mcanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La belle femme est gentille.
target_text: Mwanamuke mrembo ni mwema.
target_text_raw: Mwanamuke mrembo ni mwema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Change de disque !
target_text: Badilisha disk!
target_text_raw: Badilisha disk!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas tant d'argent que vous le pensez.
target_text: Sina makuta za mingi vile saa ginsi uko unawaza.
target_text_raw: Sina makuta za mingi vile saa ginsi uko unawaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous écoutâmes l'échange de tirs.
target_text: Tulisikia milio ya masasi.
target_text_raw: Tulisikia milio ya masasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On meurt de soif, ici.
target_text: Tunakufa na kiu, hapa.
target_text_raw: Tunakufa na kiu, hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir se coucher de bonne heure.
target_text: Itaomba kulala mbele ya wakati.
target_text_raw: Itaomba kulala mbele ya wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez cool.
target_text: Mubakie sawa.
target_text_raw: Mubakie sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Depuis combien d'années ne vous ai-je pas vus ?
target_text: Inakuwa myaka ngapi sibaone?
target_text_raw: Inakuwa myaka ngapi sibaone?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu l'as trouvée.
target_text: Umemupata.
target_text_raw: Umemupata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jack a trois ans de plus que moi.
target_text: Jack iko na myaka tatu kunipita.
target_text_raw: Jack iko na myaka tatu kunipita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a une rose jaune.
target_text: Kuko liuwa ya rose ya jaune.
target_text_raw: Kuko liuwa ya rose ya jaune.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'a pas eu le temps de s'échapper de l'incendie et a trouvé la mort.
target_text: Hakupata wakati ya kukimbia muripuko ya moto na alikufa.
target_text_raw: Hakupata wakati ya kukimbia muripuko ya moto na alikufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Viens te recoucher, chéri.
target_text: Kuya ulale tena ,cheri.
target_text_raw: Kuya ulale tena ,cheri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien malin qui le sait.
target_text: Mwenyi mayele ni yule anayejuwa.
target_text_raw: Mwenyi mayele ni yule anayejuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas. Vous rencontrerez quelqu'un.
target_text: Musiwe na wasi wasi. Mutakutanana na mutu fulani.
target_text_raw: Musiwe na wasi wasi. Mutakutanana na mutu fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle lui a conseillé de revenir sans tarder.
target_text: Mwanamuke alimushauria arudie bila kucelewa.
target_text_raw: Mwanamuke alimushauria arudie bila kucelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'occupe de la note.
target_text: Nitahusika na barua ile.
target_text_raw: Nitahusika na barua ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas à m'inquiéter pour Marie.
target_text: Sina wasi wasi ju ya Maria.
target_text_raw: Sina wasi wasi ju ya Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que si je parlais plus souvent avec un locuteur natif anglais, mon niveau d'anglais s'améliorerait rapidement.
target_text: Ninawaza kama ningelikuwa naongea sana na mutu mwenyi Kingereza ni luga yake ya kuzaliwa, kingereza yangu ingeliboreka haraka.
target_text_raw: Ninawaza kama ningelikuwa naongea sana na mutu mwenyi Kingereza ni luga yake ya kuzaliwa, kingereza yangu ingeliboreka haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parlons bientôt !
target_text: Tunogeye hapa baadaye!
target_text_raw: Tunogeye hapa baadaye!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir, ça va ?
target_text: Jambo , ni sawa?
target_text_raw: Jambo , ni sawa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom fut enchanté.
target_text: Tom alifurahi.
target_text_raw: Tom alifurahi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'assure qu'il s'agit de bien plus que d'argent.
target_text: Ninakwambia kweli kama ni mambo mzuri kuliko makuta.
target_text_raw: Ninakwambia kweli kama ni mambo mzuri kuliko makuta.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont fait semblant de ne pas m'avoir entendue.
target_text: Balifanya saa ginsi habakunisikia.
target_text_raw: Balifanya saa ginsi habakunisikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne ne saura où tu as acheté tes vêtements.
target_text: Hakuna mwenyi atajuwa kwenyi uliuzia manguo zako.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwenyi atajuwa kwenyi uliuzia manguo zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas compliqué.
target_text: Haiko nguvu.
target_text_raw: Haiko nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous connaissez en effet beaucoup de choses, mais vous n'êtes pas apte à les enseigner.
target_text: Unajuwa bitu mingi,lakini hauna uwezo ya kubifundisha.
target_text_raw: Unajuwa bitu mingi,lakini hauna uwezo ya kubifundisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'accepte les termes du contrat si vous baissez le prix.
target_text: Nitaitika ginsi makubaliano inasema kama unapunguza beyi.
target_text_raw: Nitaitika ginsi makubaliano inasema kama unapunguza beyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les images qui suivent ne sont pas faites pour les âmes sensibles.
target_text: Pica zenyi zinafuata haziko za nafsi za tegetege.
target_text_raw: Pica zenyi zinafuata haziko za nafsi za tegetege.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi vous ne lui donnez pas des fleurs?
target_text: Juu ya nini haumupatie maua?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini haumupatie maua?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fais du vélo pour avoir de belles fesses. Mes jambes sont déjà parfaites.
target_text: Ninatembezaka kinga ju nikuwe na matako ya mzuri. Migulu yangu ilisha kuwa mzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Ninatembezaka kinga ju nikuwe na matako ya mzuri. Migulu yangu ilisha kuwa mzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Raphaël dit qu'il a vu un fantôme.
target_text: Raphael anasema aseme aliona kizimu.
target_text_raw: Raphael anasema aseme aliona kizimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'Union Soviétique lança Spoutnik I en dix-neuf-cent-cinquante-sept.
target_text: Muungano wa kirusi ilianzisha Spoutkin I mu mwaka wa elfu moya miya kenda na makumi tano na saba.
target_text_raw: Muungano wa kirusi ilianzisha Spoutkin I mu mwaka wa elfu moya miya kenda na makumi tano na saba(1957).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Moins une coutume traditionnelle est justifiée, plus il est difficile de s'en débarrasser.
target_text: Kwa kawaida wakati mila ya zamani haina maana ya kukuwa, zaidi inakuwa nguvu kuitosha.
target_text_raw: Kwa kawaida wakati mila ya zamani haina maana ya kukuwa, zaidi inakuwa nguvu kuitosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève la bicyclette du trottoir !
target_text: Tosha kinga yako fasi ya kutembelea!
target_text_raw: Tosha kinga yako fasi ya kutembelea!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il dit que tu mens.
target_text: Anasema kama unasema uongo.
target_text_raw: Anasema kama unasema uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas très sympa.
target_text: Haiko mzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Haiko mzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pars dimanche.
target_text: Ninaenda siku ya Mungu.
target_text_raw: Ninaenda siku ya Mungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête d'être aussi attardée, bordel !
target_text: Aca kukuwa mzaifu, fujo!
target_text_raw: Aca kukuwa mzaifu, fujo(kavuyo)!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pardon pour ceux que j'ai blessés, mais je me devais de le dire.
target_text: Pardon ku benyi nilivunja moyo, lakini nilipasha isema.
target_text_raw: Pardon ku benyi nilivunja moyo, lakini nilipasha isema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'avoine est depuis longtemps une nourriture pour les chevaux et les mules.
target_text: Tangu zamani shairi inakuwaka chakula ya farasi na nyundo.
target_text_raw: Tangu zamani shairi inakuwaka chakula ya farasi na nyundo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En descendant du train, il a fait un salto par-dessus sa valise, mais heureusement il n'a rien eu.
target_text: Saa alikuwa anashuka mu train, aliruka kwa gafla yulu ya valise yake,lakini kizuri hakulumia.
target_text_raw: Saa alikuwa anashuka mu train, aliruka kwa gafla yulu ya valise yake,lakini kizuri hakulumia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde veut aller au paradis, mais personne ne veut mourir.
target_text: Kila mutu anata aende mbinguni,lakini hakuna mwenyi anataka kufa.
target_text_raw: Kila mutu anata aende mbinguni,lakini hakuna mwenyi anataka kufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne lance pas de pierres contre eux.
target_text: Sibatupie majiwe.
target_text_raw: Sibatupie majiwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pris la tête de cette mission.
target_text: Nilikamata uongowi ya hii mssion.
target_text_raw: Nilikamata uongowi ya hii mssion.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle prit l'or et lui jeta au nez en lui disant:"Je ne veux pas d'argent volé".
target_text: Alikamata zahabuakaitupa ku mapua yake akisema: “sitaki makuta ya bwizi.”
target_text_raw: Alikamata zahabu(or) akaitupa ku mapua yake akisema: “sitaki makuta ya bwizi.”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La politesse est à l'esprit ce que la grâce est au visage : de la bonté du cœur, elle est la douce image; et c'est la bonté qu'on chérit.
target_text: Adabu ni ya maana ku akili sawa vile neema ni ya maana ku sura: mu wema ya roho,iko na umbo nzuri, ni wemba njo banatapaka.
target_text_raw: Adabu ni ya maana ku akili sawa vile neema ni ya maana ku sura: mu wema ya roho,iko na umbo nzuri, ni wemba njo banatapaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mets-le dedans.
target_text: Tiya ayo ndani.
target_text_raw: Tiya ayo ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les arbres et les rochers vous enseigneront ce que vous ne pourrez apprendre d'aucun maître.
target_text: Miti na mawe itakufundisha byenyi hakuna hata mwalimu yeyote anaweza kufundisha.
target_text_raw: Miti na mawe itakufundisha byenyi hakuna hata mwalimu yeyote anaweza kufundisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Paix aux hommes de bonne volonté !
target_text: Amani kwa watu wenyi mapenzi mema!
target_text_raw: Amani kwa watu wenyi mapenzi mema!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vue depuis le ciel, la rivière ressemblait à un énorme serpent.
target_text: Kwa kuonekana toka angani,mtoni hiyo ilionekana sawa nyoka kubwa.
target_text_raw: Kwa kuonekana toka angani,mtoni hiyo ilionekana sawa nyoka kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom nous a demandés d'être patients.
target_text: Tom alituomba tukuwe wavumilivu.
target_text_raw: Tom alituomba tukuwe wavumilivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est vraiment triste et déplacé.
target_text: Inahuwunisha sana na haiko fasi.
target_text_raw: Inahuwunisha sana na haiko fasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Rapprochez-vous le moins du monde et je vous descends !
target_text: Mwende mbali na watu na nitawashusha!
target_text_raw: Mwende mbali na watu na nitawashusha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce médicament est très efficace pour soigner les souris.
target_text: Hii dawa ni ya mzuri sana kwa kutunza panya.
target_text_raw: Hii dawa ni ya mzuri sana kwa kutunza panya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'actrice répète son texte.
target_text: Mcezaji wa film ao theatre anarudilia maandishi yake.
target_text_raw: Mcezaji wa film ao theatre (actrice) anarudilia maandishi (texte) yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est vraiment exact ?
target_text: Ni kweli kabisa?
target_text_raw: Ni kweli kabisa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet essai finalement n'a pas réussi.
target_text: Kwa mwisho jaribio hili halkufaulu.
target_text_raw: Kwa mwisho jaribio hili halkufaulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'arbre du silence porte les fruits de la paix.
target_text: Mti wa ukimya kuzaa matunda ya amani.
target_text_raw: Mti wa ukimya kuzaa matunda ya amani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le suspense me tue !
target_text: Kungoya sana bila kujuwa byenyi bitafika inaniuwa.
target_text_raw: Kungoya sana bila kujuwa byenyi bitafika inaniuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça fait à peu près 5 miles.
target_text: Inakuwa karibu kilometres 5.
target_text_raw: Inakuwa karibu kilometres 5.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noah a risqué toutes ses affaires.
target_text: Nuhu alihatarisha biashara yake yote.
target_text_raw: Nuhu alihatarisha biashara yake yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'arrêtait toujours au bar après le travail.
target_text: Siku zote kisha kazi alikuwa anasimama ku bar.
target_text_raw: Siku zote kisha kazi alikuwa anasimama ku bar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une pièce comportant de nombreux changements de décors peut constituer une épreuve pour la troupe ou pour le public.
target_text: Mcezo yenyi kuwa na mabadiliko mingi ya mapambo inaweza kuwa jaribu kwa kikundi ca wacezaji ao kwa uma.
target_text_raw: Mcezo yenyi kuwa na mabadiliko mingi ya mapambo inaweza kuwa jaribu kwa kikundi ca wacezaji ao kwa uma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Biologie » est un mot grec qui veut dire « étude des organismes vivants ».
target_text: “Biolojia” ni neno ya kigriki inayo maanisha “utafiti ya viumbe hai.
target_text_raw: “Biolojia” ni neno ya kigriki inayo maanisha “utafiti ya viumbe hai (vinavyo ishi).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathéo feuilleta le magazine qui était posé sur la table du salon.
target_text: Mathéo akafungula gazeti yenyi ilikuwa kuwa ku meza ya salon.
target_text_raw: Mathéo akafungula gazeti yenyi ilikuwa kuwa ku meza ya salon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut passer quelques appels.
target_text: Inaniomba niite.
target_text_raw: Inaniomba niite.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas si tu te rappelles de moi, mais nous nous sommes rencontrées il y a deux ans à Boston.
target_text: Sijuwe kama unanikumbuka, lakini tulikutananaka Boston inapita sasa myaka mbili.
target_text_raw: Sijuwe kama unanikumbuka, lakini tulikutananaka Boston inapita sasa myaka mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'est fait battre aux échecs par le gamin haut comme trois pommes du voisin.
target_text: Alipigwa chess na mtoto mrefu kama pommes tatu kutoka kwa jirani.
target_text_raw: Alipigwa chess na mtoto mrefu kama pommes tatu kutoka kwa jirani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ravie de vous aider.
target_text: Nina furahi kukusaidia.
target_text_raw: Nina furahi kukusaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis née et j'ai grandi ici.
target_text: Nilizaliwa hapa na nikakomalia hapa.
target_text_raw: Nilizaliwa hapa na nikakomalia hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que Thomas soit amoureux de Catherine est un secret de polichinelle.
target_text: Kusema Thomas anapendana na Catherine haiko siri.
target_text_raw: Kusema Thomas anapendana na Catherine haiko siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle avait un itinéraire précis.
target_text: Alikuwa na ratiba.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa na ratiba(itineraire) sahihi(précis).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On voyait les lumières de la ville au loin.
target_text: Tulikuwa tunaona matala za mu ville kwa mbali.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa tunaona matala za mu ville kwa mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un site de paris en ligne laisse les usagers parier sur quelles espèces animales s'éteindront à cause de la fuite de pétrole dans le Golfe du Mexique.
target_text: Mtandao ya ku parier ako inaruhusu watumiaji ku parier kwa aina za wanyama zitatoweka kwa sababu ya kumwagika kwa mafutamu Golfe ya Mexico.
target_text_raw: Mtandao ya ku parier ako inaruhusu watumiaji ku parier kwa aina za wanyama zitatoweka kwa sababu ya kumwagika kwa mafuta(petrole) mu Golfe ya Mexico.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'il repose en paix.
target_text: Apumuzike kwa amani.
target_text_raw: Apumuzike kwa amani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pas d'accès pendant la séance.
target_text: Inakatazwa kuingia saa ya réunion.
target_text_raw: Inakatazwa kuingia saa ya réunion.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous contre-vérifié ces chiffres ?
target_text: Aye! Umecunguza hizi takwimu?
target_text_raw: Aye! Umecunguza (ume verifier) hizi takwimu(ma chiffres)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut y aller carrément.
target_text: Inaomba tu kwendako.
target_text_raw: Inaomba tu kwendako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais vous interroger au sujet d'une voiture que vous avez réparée.
target_text: Nilitaka nikuulize juu ya gri yenyi ulitengeneza.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka nikuulize juu ya gri (voiture) yenyi ulitengeneza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se brossait les dents, nu, dans la salle de bains.
target_text: Alikuwa anasukula meno,alikuwa uci mu chumba ya kunawia.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anasukula meno,alikuwa uci mu chumba ya kunawia (mu salle de bains).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuillez apporter de l'eau plus chaude.
target_text: Tafazali , leta mayi ya moto zaidi.
target_text_raw: Tafazali , leta mayi ya moto zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les policiers examinent leurs sacs.
target_text: Bapolisi biko na controler ma sacs zabo.
target_text_raw: Bapolisi biko na controler ma sacs zabo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerai une couverture en plus.
target_text: Ninataka ingine blangeti moya ya zaidi.
target_text_raw: Ninataka ingine blangeti moya ya zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'oppose à ce que vous alliez seules en Europe.
target_text: Ninakatala wende Ulaya we pekee.
target_text_raw: Ninakatala wende Ulaya we pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les hommes ne vous trouvent sage que lorsqu'on partage ou approuve leur folie.
target_text: Watu wanakuonaka uko na busara wakati unashiriki ao unaitika upumbavu yao.
target_text_raw: Watu wanakuonaka uko na busara (hekima) wakati unashiriki ao unaitika upumbavu yao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Monsieur Johnson insiste sur sa théorie.
target_text: Bwana Johnson anakazia juu ya théorie.
target_text_raw: Bwana Johnson anakazia juu ya théorie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La critique donne des commentaires très négatifs, sauf pour "Boule de Suif".
target_text: Mapitioinaleta maoni mabaya, isipokuwa tu “Boule de Suif”
target_text_raw: Mapitio(critiques) inaleta maoni mabaya, isipokuwa tu “Boule de Suif”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ici, vous cultivez des terres franches et libres, et ne travaillez que pour vous-même, puisque vous ne payez ni redevances, ni impositions.
target_text: Hapa, munalima shamba zenyi ziko wazi na huru, na munajitumikia nyi pekee, juu hamulipe ni ushuru ni mrahaba.
target_text_raw: Hapa, munalima shamba zenyi ziko wazi na huru, na munajitumikia nyi pekee, juu hamulipe ni ushuru ni mrahaba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le mur qui sépare les criminels des non-criminels n'est pas aussi épais qu'on le pense.
target_text: Mstari yenyi inaacanisha wauwaji na wasio wauwaji haiko kidogo sawa vile mutu anaweza waza.
target_text_raw: Mstari yenyi inaacanisha wauwaji na wasio wauwaji haiko kidogo sawa vile mutu anaweza waza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça nous est égal que vous preniez une photo depuis l'extérieur.
target_text: Na siye ni vile, mukamatishie foto inje.
target_text_raw: Na siye ni vile, mukamatishie foto inje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est assis en fauteuil roulant, mais peut lui-même organiser sa vie quotidienne.
target_text: Hata kama anaikala mu kiti ya kutembea, lakini anaweza kupanga maisha yake ye pekee.
target_text_raw: Hata kama anaikala mu kiti ya kutembea, lakini anaweza kupanga maisha yake ye pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'en parlerai à mon retour.
target_text: Nitakwambia juu ya ile saa ninarudia.
target_text_raw: Nitakwambia juu ya ile saa ninarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il semble quelle ne soit pas enchantée par le poste.
target_text: Iko saa hafurahie ile kazi.
target_text_raw: Iko saa hafurahie ile kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois confusément avouer ne pas savoir où diriger mes soupçons.
target_text: Ninapashwa sema wazi kama sijuwe kwenyi ndaweza wazia.
target_text_raw: Ninapashwa sema wazi kama sijuwe kwenyi ndaweza wazia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les coupures de presse sont celles qui cicatrisent le plus vite.
target_text: Bipande bya majalada njo byenyi binaponaka mbio zaidi.
target_text_raw: Bipande bya majalada (ma journaux) njo byenyi binaponaka mbio zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'accusé fut conduit menotté en salle d'audience.
target_text: Mushitakiwa alibebwa na anafungiwa mu chumba ca kusikilizwa.
target_text_raw: Mushitakiwa alibebwa na anafungiwa mu chumba ca kusikilizwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je coupe le papier avec une paire de ciseaux.
target_text: Ninakata kartasi na ciseaux.
target_text_raw: Ninakata kartasi na ciseaux.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aimez-vous à ce point les oiseaux que paternellement vous vous préoccupâtes de tendre ce perchoir à leurs petites pattes ?
target_text: Munapenda ndege mpaka kwa ile kiwango,ndege zenyi mulikwaka munashurulikia sawa baba zao na kuguza migulu yazo ya kidogo?
target_text_raw: Munapenda ndege mpaka kwa ile kiwango,ndege zenyi mulikwaka munashurulikia sawa baba zao na kuguza migulu yazo ya kidogo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le juge l'a condamné à un an de prison.
target_text: Muamuzi alimuhumu kifungo ca mwaka moya mu gereza.
target_text_raw: Muamuzi (juge) alimuhumu kifungo ca mwaka moya mu gereza(prison).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai recueilli le maximum d'éléments dans ce rapport.
target_text: Nilipata bitu ya kutosha mwa hii rapport.
target_text_raw: Nilipata bitu ya kutosha mwa hii rapport.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Choisissez le mot de passe de sorte que vous puissiez facilement vous le rappeler mais qu'il soit néanmoins difficile à deviner.
target_text: Ucagule mot de passe yenyi utaweza kumbuka mbio mbio lakini tena ikuwe yenyi nguvu kuwazia.
target_text_raw: Ucagule mot de passe yenyi utaweza kumbuka mbio mbio lakini tena ikuwe yenyi nguvu kuwazia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est votre domaine d'étude, votre champ d'investigation, votre intérêt principal ?
target_text: Masomo yako ni nini, uwanjwa wako wa utafiti ni nini, nini njo yenyi ina ku interesaka sana?
target_text_raw: Masomo yako ni nini, uwanjwa wako wa utafiti ni nini, nini njo yenyi ina ku interesaka sana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourriez-vous garder l'œil sur ma valise un moment ?
target_text: Unaweza niangalilia valise yangu kwanza?
target_text_raw: Unaweza niangalilia valise yangu kwanza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est retourné à la boutique.
target_text: Alirudia ku boutique.
target_text_raw: Alirudia ku boutique.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le gouvernement a reçu son autorité de l'empereur.
target_text: Serkali ilipata malaka yake ya mfalme.
target_text_raw: Serkali ilipata malaka yake ya mfalme.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voulez-vous que nous essayions de forcer cette porte ?
target_text: Unataka tufungule hii mlangio kwa kinguvu?
target_text_raw: Unataka tufungule hii mlangio kwa kinguvu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mais où est donc restée ma chemise rose ?
target_text: Lakini, ile chemise yangu ya rose ilibakia wapi?
target_text_raw: Lakini, ile chemise yangu ya rose ilibakia wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est devenue blanche.
target_text: Ilishakuwa ya mweupe.
target_text_raw: Ilishakuwa ya mweupe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'est tourné à cent-quatre-vingts degrés.
target_text: Aligeuka ku 180 degrés.
target_text_raw: Aligeuka ku 180 degrés.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une à une, les voitures s’en allaient ; les roues grinçaient sur le sable de la grande allée.
target_text: Moya kwa moya , ma gari zikajiendea, ma pneu zilikuwa zinajisirita ku mcanga ya barabara kubwa.
target_text_raw: Moya kwa moya , ma gari zikajiendea, ma pneu zilikuwa zinajisirita ku mcanga ya barabara kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand je t'embrasse, j'oublie le monde qui nous entoure.
target_text: Wakati ninakukubusu ku midomo, ninasahau dunia yenyi inatuzunguluka.
target_text_raw: Wakati ninakukubusu ku midomo, ninasahau dunia yenyi inatuzunguluka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais sûr de recevoir un bon accueil.
target_text: Balikuwa banataka nikaribisha muzuri.
target_text_raw: Balikuwa banataka nikaribisha muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De nombreuses espèces sont en voie de disparition.
target_text: Aina mingi ya vitu ziko mu njia ya kupotea.
target_text_raw: Aina mingi ya vitu ziko mu njia ya kupotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous commencez à me faire peur.
target_text: Unaanza niogopesha.
target_text_raw: Unaanza niogopesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne voulons pas être les derniers.
target_text: Hatutaki tukuwe ba mwisho.
target_text_raw: Hatutaki tukuwe ba mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plaque de cuisson était toujours chaude après quinze minutes.
target_text: Plaque ya kupigiako ilikuwa moto siku zote kisha dakikakumi na tano.
target_text_raw: Plaque ya kupigiako ilikuwa moto siku zote kisha dakika(minutes) kumi na tano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je employer votre téléphone mobile ?
target_text: Ndaweza tumikisha simu yako ya mkononi?
target_text_raw: Ndaweza tumikisha simu yako ya mkononi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit qu'ils seraient malades.
target_text: Banasema iko saa banagonjwa.
target_text_raw: Banasema iko saa banagonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui, je t'invite à manger.
target_text: Leom nina kualikakukula.
target_text_raw: Leom nina kualika(nina ku inviter) kukula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a essayé de le convaincre de ne pas refuser l'offre.
target_text: Alijikaza kumwambia asikatale ile aliko/kazi/zawadi.
target_text_raw: Alijikaza kumwambia asikatale ile aliko/kazi/zawadi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne saurais vous remercier assez pour ce que vous avez fait pour moi.
target_text: Sijuwe aye njo ndaweza kubapigia aksanti ku byenyi mulinifanyia.
target_text_raw: Sijuwe aye njo ndaweza kubapigia aksanti ku byenyi mulinifanyia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette nouvelle n'est pas digne de foi.
target_text: Hii habari haiko ya kuaminika.
target_text_raw: Hii habari haiko ya kuaminika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas que les adultes, les enfants aussi peuvent acheter des cigarettes aux distributeurs automatiques.
target_text: Haiko tu watu wazima,na batoto nabo banaweza uza tumbako ku ma distributeurs za banques.
target_text_raw: Haiko tu watu wazima,na batoto nabo banaweza uza tumbako ku ma distributeurs za banques.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'attends avec impatience d'aller chasser avec mon père.
target_text: Ninangoya sana twenda na babangu kuwinda.
target_text_raw: Ninangoya sana twenda na babangu kuwinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Prends ça avec humour, Timéo ! » — « L’humour, je m’en balance ! »
target_text: “Kamata hii na kicekesho, Timéo!”-”Kicekesho, ninaifanya:”
target_text_raw: “Kamata hii na kicekesho, Timéo!”-”Kicekesho, ninaifanya:”
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans cette situation critique, il importe de garder bonne contenance.
target_text: Mwa hii hali ya nguvu,ni ya maana kubakia na utulivu.
target_text_raw: Mwa hii hali ya nguvu,ni ya maana kubakia na utulivu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'irais bien, mais j'ai pris froid.
target_text: Nitaenda tu, lakini nimepata mafua.
target_text_raw: Nitaenda tu, lakini nimepata mafua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: M. Brown nous enseigne l'anglais.
target_text: Bwana Brown anatufundisha kingereza.
target_text_raw: Bwana Brown anatufundisha kingereza(Anglais).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu peux me dire ce que tu essaies de faire ?
target_text: Je! Utaweza niambia nini njo uko unajaribu kufanya?
target_text_raw: Je! Utaweza niambia nini njo uko unajaribu kufanya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est née avec une cuillère d'argent dans la bouche.
target_text: Alizaliwa na kijiko ya makuta mu kinywa.
target_text_raw: Alizaliwa na kijiko ya makuta mu kinywa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne n'a émis d'objection.
target_text: Hakuna mwenyi alikatala.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwenyi alikatala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'épicier avait déjà quitté le local quand il a reçu l'autorisation d'y rester.
target_text: Grocer alikuwa alisha enda wakati alipewa ruhusa ya kubakia.
target_text_raw: Grocer alikuwa alisha enda wakati alipewa ruhusa ya kubakia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon cherchait la clé qu'il avait perdue.
target_text: Ule garcon alikuwa anatafuta fungulo yenyi alipoteza.
target_text_raw: Ule garcon alikuwa anatafuta fungulo yenyi alipoteza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au cou, il portait une triple chaîne d'or et sous le bras gauche, sur le poitrail, une courte épée dans un fourreau précieux.
target_text: Ku shingo alikuwa anavala chaine tatu za or, na ku mkono ya kushoto,ku kiuno, kisu ya mfupi ku kifua mumfuko yake ya samani.
target_text_raw: Ku shingo alikuwa anavala chaine tatu za or, na ku mkono ya kushoto,ku kiuno, kisu ya mfupi ku kifua mumfuko yake ya samani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arthur ne pense pas que quelqu'un d'autre voudra venir.
target_text: Arthur hawaze kama kuko mwengine mwenyi ataweza kuya.
target_text_raw: Arthur hawaze kama kuko mwengine mwenyi ataweza kuya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ken collectionne les vieilles pièces.
target_text: Ken anakusanya makuta za vicele za zamani.
target_text_raw: Ken anakusanya makuta za vicele za zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vérité est que, ces derniers jours, je pense écrire un roman pour un magazine féminin.
target_text: Ukweli ni kama, hizi siku , ninawaza kuandika roman ya gazeti la wanawake.
target_text_raw: Ukweli ni kama, hizi siku , ninawaza kuandika roman ya gazeti la wanawake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand est-ce que tu rentres ?
target_text: Utarudia wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Utarudia wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle aime bien sortir avec lui, d'autant plus qu'il commande toujours du champagne.
target_text: Anapenda kutoka naye sana,juu anazoweyaka uza champagne siku zote.
target_text_raw: Anapenda kutoka naye sana,juu anazoweyaka uza champagne siku zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Posez le fusil.
target_text: Weka bunduki.
target_text_raw: Weka bunduki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne cherche pas la bagarre avec toi.
target_text: Sitaki kupigana na weye.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kupigana na weye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aragon est lié au surréalisme.
target_text: Aragon anafungwa na surrealisme
target_text_raw: Aragon anafungwa na surrealisme(anakatala kuona ukweli wa mamabo ginsi ilivyo)
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle prenait Nathan pour un idiot.
target_text: Alimukamata Nathan sawa pumbavu
target_text_raw: Alimukamata Nathan sawa pumbavu
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton idée est complètement différente de la mienne.
target_text: Nia yako ika tafauti na yangu sana kabisa.
target_text_raw: Nia (idée) yako ika tafauti na yangu sana kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les enfants ont suivi le défilé du cirque.
target_text: Watoto walifuata défilé ya mcezo ya cirque.
target_text_raw: Watoto walifuata défilé ya mcezo ya cirque.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le patron nous donna à tous un jour de congé.
target_text: Mkubwa wa kazialitupatia siye bote siku moya ya kupumzika.
target_text_raw: Mkubwa wa kazi(patron) alitupatia siye bote siku moya ya kupumzika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Franz désossa les filets de poisson, puis les rôtit dans du beurre, de l'ail et du jus de citron.
target_text: Franz alitosha mifupa mu samaki kisha akamata minyofu akaikalanga mu beurre, akatia matungulu sumu, na citron.
target_text_raw: Franz alitosha mifupa mu samaki kisha akamata minyofu akaikalanga mu beurre, akatia matungulu sumu, na citron.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le stade de baseball était plein de spectateurs enthousiastes.
target_text: Kiwanja ya mpira ya baseball ilikuwa inayaka watazamaji wenyi furaha.
target_text_raw: Kiwanja ya mpira ya baseball ilikuwa inayaka watazamaji wenyi furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sentis quelqu'un me taper sur l'épaule.
target_text: Nilisikia mutu ananigusa ku libega.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia mutu ananigusa ku libega.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est assez facile une fois qu'on a pigé le truc.
target_text: Ni kwepesi sana mutu akisha sikia kitu.
target_text_raw: Ni kwepesi sana mutu akisha sikia kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'essentiel est sans cesse menacé par l'insignifiant.
target_text: Kila wakati bya maana binavamiwaka na byenyi habina maana.
target_text_raw: Kila wakati bya maana binavamiwaka na byenyi habina maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il arrivait même que mon père nous donne des coups de poing au ventre.
target_text: Ilikuwaka inafikia wakati yenyi baba yetu alikuwa anatupiga mangumi ku tumbu.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwaka inafikia wakati yenyi baba yetu alikuwa anatupiga mangumi ku tumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voyant la vulnérabilité du candidat en recherche d'emploi, la compagnie lui offrit une faible rémunération.
target_text: Wakati kampuni iliona kama alikuwa anatafuta kazi sana, bakamupatia mshahara kidogo.
target_text_raw: Wakati kampuni iliona kama alikuwa anatafuta kazi sana, bakamupatia mshahara kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui voudrait améliorer sa condition devrait examiner son fondement.
target_text: Mwenyi anataka kuboresha hali yake anapashwa cunguza msinji yake.
target_text_raw: Mwenyi anataka kuboresha hali yake anapashwa cunguza msinji yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Patiente quelques minutes, veux-tu ?
target_text: Vumilia minutes kidogo, unataka?
target_text_raw: Vumilia minutes kidogo, unataka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous la trouverez très aimable.
target_text: Mutamuona wakupendeza sana.
target_text_raw: Mutamuona wakupendeza sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La voiture est malheureusement déjà donnée.
target_text: Kibaya balisha pana ile gari.
target_text_raw: Kibaya balisha pana ile gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On devrait aller fêter ça.
target_text: Tulipashwa enda kuisherekea.
target_text_raw: Tulipashwa enda kuisherekea(ku ifeter).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veux-tu réellement que cette information soit rendue publique ?
target_text: Unata kabisa hii habari ijulikane na watu?
target_text_raw: Unata kabisa hii habari ijulikane na watu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis rarement invitée à des fêtes.
target_text: Habazoweke kuni inviter ku ma karamu
target_text_raw: Habazoweke kuni inviter ku ma karamu (ku ma fetes)
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T’es pas cap.
target_text: Hauko capable.
target_text_raw: Hauko capable.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le poisson s'accompagne d'ordinaire de vin blanc.
target_text: Mara mingi samaki inafuatiwaka na divai mweupe.
target_text_raw: Mara mingi samaki inafuatiwaka na divai mweupe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prêtre fit le signe de croix tandis que le cercueil était descendu dans le sol.
target_text: Padiri alifanya halama ya msalaba na ao sandukuilikuwa imeshuka mu udongo.
target_text_raw: Padiri alifanya halama ya msalaba na ao sanduku(cercueil) ilikuwa imeshuka mu udongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Nations Unies dépêchèrent des troupes afin d'intervenir dans le conflit.
target_text: Umoja wa Mataifa ilitumana majeshi kwa haraka kwa kumaliza mzozo.
target_text_raw: Umoja wa Mataifa ilitumana majeshi kwa haraka kwa kumaliza mzozo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être que j'ai besoin d'une nouvelle assistante.
target_text: Labda niko na lazima ya msaidiziwa mpya.
target_text_raw: Labda niko na lazima ya msaidizi(assistante) wa mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux m'éloigner autant que faire se peut d'ici.
target_text: Nitaenda mbali kama ninavyoweza kutoka hapa.
target_text_raw: Nitaenda mbali kama ninavyoweza kutoka hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Anatole n’est pas un génie, mais c’est un honnête et brave garçon, c’est un bon fils.
target_text: Anatoke haiko mtu wa akili mingi sana, lakini garcon mwenyi iko ku mustari na iko na juhudi, ni mtoto mzuri.
target_text_raw: Anatoke haiko mtu wa akili mingi sana, lakini garcon mwenyi iko ku mustari na iko na juhudi, ni mtoto mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vue du sommet est très jolie.
target_text: Kuangalilia yulu ya kilima ni mzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Kuangalilia yulu ya kilima ni mzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons volé non-stop d'Osaka à Los Angeles.
target_text: Tulienda na ndege kutoka Osaka mpaka Los Angeles bila kusimama.
target_text_raw: Tulienda na ndege kutoka Osaka mpaka Los Angeles bila kusimama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un navire pétrolier géant vient d'appareiller.
target_text: Mashua/Meli kubwa ya kubeba carburant inaisha anza safari.
target_text_raw: Mashua/Meli (bateau) kubwa ya kubeba carburant inaisha anza safari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas de démons en ce monde.
target_text: Hakuna ma shetani mwa hii dunia.
target_text_raw: Hakuna ma shetani mwa hii dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je fis taper la lettre par mon secrétaire.
target_text: Niliandikisha barua na secretaire wangu.
target_text_raw: Niliandikisha barua na secretaire wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chien a marqué son territoire.
target_text: Imbwa iliashiria eneo lake.
target_text_raw: Imbwa iliashiria eneo lake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A-t-il un alibi ?
target_text: Uko na kisingizio?
target_text_raw: Uko na kisingizio (motif)?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pensez-vous que cela marchera ?
target_text: Unawaza kama bile bitaendeka?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kama bile bitaendeka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas si vous vous rappelez de moi, mais nous nous sommes rencontrés il y a quelques années à Boston.
target_text: Sijuwe kama unanikumbuka,likini tulikutananaka Boston inapita myaka micace.
target_text_raw: Sijuwe kama unanikumbuka,likini tulikutananaka Boston inapita myaka micace.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où voulez-vous le faire livrer ?
target_text: Unataka kuitumanishia wapi?
target_text_raw: Unataka kuitumanishia wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous étiez blessés.
target_text: Mulikuwa munavunjika/Mulikwazika.
target_text_raw: Mulikuwa munavunjika/Mulikwazika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon supérieur m'a assigné cette tâche difficile.
target_text: Mkubwa wangu wa kazi alinipatia hii kazi ya nguvu.
target_text_raw: Mkubwa wangu wa kazi alinipatia hii kazi ya nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsqu'il a repris ses esprits, il était ligoté à une chaise dans la cave.
target_text: Saa ma esprits zake zilirudia,alikuwa anafungiwa ku kiti ya mu cave.
target_text_raw: Saa ma esprits zake zilirudia,alikuwa anafungiwa ku kiti ya mu cave.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sous le poil gris, il y a aussi un fameux étalon.
target_text: Chini ya turubai ya kijivu pia kuna stallion maarufu.
target_text_raw: Chini ya turubai ya kijivu pia kuna stallion maarufu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a de nombreux rats sur le navire.
target_text: Kuko panya za mingiku ku mashua.
target_text_raw: Kuko panya za mingiku ku mashua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il voulait répéter sa pièce de théâtre dans une des pièces de son appartement.
target_text: Alitaka kurudilia mcezo yake mu chumba moya ya nyumba yake.
target_text_raw: Alitaka kurudilia mcezo yake mu chumba moya ya nyumba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'es pas actuellement armé.
target_text: Kwa saa hii hauna bunduki.
target_text_raw: Kwa saa hii hauna bunduki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet appartement est très beau et grand : quatre pièces, cuisine et salle de bains.
target_text: Hii nyumba ni ya mzuri na ya kabambi sana: chambres ines, mafiga na salle de bains.
target_text_raw: Hii nyumba ni ya mzuri na ya kabambi sana: chambres ines, mafiga na salle de bains.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Officiellement, nous n'autorisons pas cela.
target_text: Kisheria, haturuhusu ile.
target_text_raw: Kisheria, haturuhusu ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'écoute que des musiques difficiles.
target_text: Anafuataka tu muziki ya nguvu.
target_text_raw: Anafuataka tu muziki ya nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous jouons aux échecs sur un plateau de dames.
target_text: Biko banatushinda ku mcezo ya dames.
target_text_raw: Biko banatushinda ku mcezo ya dames.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bientôt les autres compagnons d’Énée arrivent aussi dans le temple, et sont présentés à Didon.
target_text: Happa karibuni barafiki ya Enée batafika nabo mu kanisa, na batabaonyesha kwa Didon.
target_text_raw: Happa karibuni barafiki ya Enée batafika nabo mu kanisa, na batabaonyesha kwa Didon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne considère pas cela suffisant.
target_text: Sione kama ile inatosha.
target_text_raw: Sione kama ile inatosha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est très douée pour s'occuper des enfants.
target_text: Iko na akili ya mingi kwa kucunga watoto.
target_text_raw: Iko na akili ya mingi kwa kucunga watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'êtes pas obligée de mentir.
target_text: Hauko obligé kusema bongo.
target_text_raw: Hauko obligé kusema bongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un musulman qui dit qu'il aime les juifs est un menteur.
target_text: Musulman mwenyi anasema kama anapenda wayahudi ni msema uongo.
target_text_raw: Musulman mwenyi anasema kama anapenda wayahudi ni msema uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enzo s'est enfermé dans sa chambre et a pleuré.
target_text: Enzo alijifungia mu chambre yake na akalia.
target_text_raw: Enzo alijifungia mu chambre yake na akalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous vous approchez de trop près, vous risquez de vous électrocuter.
target_text: Kama munazogelea karibu sana,muta risquer kukamatika na courant.
target_text_raw: Kama munazogelea karibu sana,muta risquer kukamatika na courant.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ces colons croient en un dieu injuste, raciste et colonialiste pour justifier leurs crimes abjects.
target_text: Hawa wakoloni wanaamini mungu asiye na uhaki,mwenyi ubaguzi wa rangi na mkuloni kwa kuficika mauwaji yao ya mabaya.
target_text_raw: Hawa wakoloni wanaamini mungu asiye na uhaki,mwenyi ubaguzi wa rangi na mkuloni kwa kuficika mauwaji yao ya mabaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un accident a stoppé tout le trafic.
target_text: Ajali ilifunga circulation yote.
target_text_raw: Ajali (accident) ilifunga circulation yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles m'ont bien eue.
target_text: Balinipata muzuri.
target_text_raw: Balinipata muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aide-moi à déplacer cette pierre.
target_text: Nisaidie kuzogeza hii lijiwe.
target_text_raw: Nisaidie kuzogeza hii lijiwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mère, désolé de vous causer constamment des soucis.
target_text: Mama, pardon kukuletea soucis saa zote.
target_text_raw: Mama, pardon kukuletea soucis saa zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois obtenir la permission de mes parents pour t'accompagner à la danse.
target_text: Ninaamini ndapata ruhusa ya wazazi wangu ya kukusindikiza kuceza.
target_text_raw: Ninaamini ndapata ruhusa ya wazazi wangu ya kukusindikiza kuceza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouvez me donner du « Monsieur », ça ne changera rien.
target_text: Unaweza niita “Monsieur” haitabadilisha kitu.
target_text_raw: Unaweza niita “Monsieur” (Bwana) haitabadilisha kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La girafe descend à la rivière.
target_text: Girafe inashuka ku mtoni.
target_text_raw: Girafe inashuka ku mtoni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa méthode est bien plus efficace que la nôtre.
target_text: Methode yake ni ya mzuri mbali mbali kushindia yetu.
target_text_raw: Methode yake ni ya mzuri mbali mbali kushindia yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouah ! Quelle grande horloge ! Oui, c'est une horloge comtoise.
target_text: Ndio! Saa ya kiabambi ya kukibambazi! Ndio, ni saa ya saa ya zamani.
target_text_raw: Ndio! Saa ya kiabambi ya kukibambazi! Ndio, ni saa ya saa ya zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons mettre fin au harcèlement sexuel.
target_text: Tunapashwa maliza unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.
target_text_raw: Tunapashwa maliza unyanyasaji wa kijinsia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça a l'air excitant.
target_text: Inafanna ya kufurahisha.
target_text_raw: Inafanna ya kufurahisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où est le guichet d'enregistrement ?
target_text: Wapi kwenyi fasi ya kujiandikisha iko?
target_text_raw: Wapi kwenyi fasi ya kujiandikisha iko?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous vous foutez de moi.
target_text: Hauniangaikie
target_text_raw: Hauniangaikie
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas très original.
target_text: Haiko asili kabisa.
target_text_raw: Haiko asili kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous vous rendez d'ordinaire à l'école à vélo.
target_text: Munaendaka ku masomo kawaida na kinga.
target_text_raw: Munaendaka ku masomo kawaida na kinga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque fois que ce groupe tentait de participer à la session, il échouait malheureusement.
target_text: Kila mara kikundi ilikuwa inajaribu kushiriki kwenyi kikao kibaya ilikuwa inashindwa.
target_text_raw: Kila mara kikundi ilikuwa inajaribu kushiriki kwenyi kikao kibaya ilikuwa inashindwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lavez et coupez le potiron en 4.
target_text: Sukula na ukate malenge sehemu 4.
target_text_raw: Sukula na ukate malenge sehemu 4.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'attrape pas mal à l'estomac en mangeant trop.
target_text: Usipata maumivu ya tumbu kwa kukula mingi mno.
target_text_raw: Usipata maumivu ya tumbu kwa kukula mingi mno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Approchons ceci d'un angle différent.
target_text: Tuangalie hii probleme namna tafauti.
target_text_raw: Tuangalie hii probleme namna tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelqu'un doit sortir la poubelle.
target_text: Mutu moya anapashwa enda mwanga yalala.
target_text_raw: Mutu moya anapashwa enda mwanga yalala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.
