source_text: Bien qu'il habite la porte d'à coté, il ne nous dit même pas bonjour.
target_text: Hata kama anaishi mu mulango ya pembeni, hatuambiake hata jambo.
target_text_raw: Hata kama anaishi mu mulango ya pembeni, hatuambiake hata jambo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il travaille à la Commission.
target_text: Anatumika kwenyi tume.
target_text_raw: Anatumika kwenyi tume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La tribu Zoulou en Afrique du Sud a sa propre langue.
target_text: Kabila la Wazulu Afrika ya kusini iko na luga yake ya pekee.
target_text_raw: Kabila la Wazulu Afrika ya kusini iko na luga yake ya pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à croire que vous ayez fait cela toutes seules.
target_text: Siyaitika hata kama muliweza kubifanya nyiye benyewe.
target_text_raw: Siyaitika hata kama muliweza kubifanya nyiye benyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est dans l'épreuve, c'est dans la souffrance que se forme la sève robuste qui fait un peuple fort.
target_text: Ni mu magumu, mu mateso njo maji ya nguvu inatengenezewaka yenyi itafanya watu wenyi nguvu.
target_text_raw: Ni mu magumu, mu mateso njo maji ya nguvu inatengenezewaka yenyi itafanya watu wenyi nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Goutte après goutte, l'eau peut se transformer en lac.
target_text: Toni moya moya, mayi inaweza geuka bahari.
target_text_raw: Toni moya moya, mayi inaweza geuka bahari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tous ces dégâts sont le résultat de la tempête.
target_text: Hizi dégats zote ni matokeo ya ile mpepeo.
target_text_raw: Hizi dégats zote ni matokeo ya ile mpepeo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une mouche ne rentre pas dans une bouche fermée.
target_text: Inzi haiingiyake mu kinywa ya kufungiwa.
target_text_raw: Inzi haiingiyake mu kinywa ya kufungiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le test s'est avéré négatif.
target_text: Kipimoilitoka négatif.
target_text_raw: Kipimo(Test) ilitoka négatif.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous êtes sûr de ce que vous avancez ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika ba byenyi uko unasema?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika ba byenyi uko unasema?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca ne voulait pas témoigner contre Marie.
target_text: Luca hakupenda kushuhudia juu ya Maria.
target_text_raw: Luca hakupenda kushuhudia juu ya Maria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ah bah ça c'est la meilleure !
target_text: Ah bah, njo ya muzuri kushindia zingine zote.
target_text_raw: Ah bah, njo ya muzuri kushindia zingine zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'obtiens un diplôme supérieur en éducation.
target_text: Ninapata ceti ca/ya yulu mu kyalimu.
target_text_raw: Ninapata ceti (diplome) ca/ya yulu mu kyalimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps était pur et un beau soleil réchauffait l’air après la légère gelée de la nuit.
target_text: Majira/Hewa ilikuwa safina jua nzuri ilikuwa inacamusha hewa kisha baridi cace ya busiku.
target_text_raw: Majira/Hewa ilikuwa safi(ya kutakata) na jua nzuri ilikuwa inacamusha hewa kisha baridi cace ya busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour confectionner ce gâteau, on a besoin de poudre à lever et de beurre non salé.
target_text: Kwa kutengeneza hii keki, tuko na lazima ya bunga ya kuoka na siagi yenyi haina cunvi.
target_text_raw: Kwa kutengeneza hii keki (gateau), tuko na lazima ya bunga ya kuoka na siagi yenyi haina cunvi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je préfère les méchants aux imbéciles. Les méchants, de temps en temps, ça se repose.
target_text: Napendelea watu wabaya kuliko wapumbavu. Wabaya. mara kwa mara, wanapumuzikaka.
target_text_raw: Napendelea watu wabaya kuliko wapumbavu. Wabaya. mara kwa mara, wanapumuzikaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas les numéros de mes chèques.
target_text: Sina ma numeros za ma cheques zangu.
target_text_raw: Sina ma numeros za ma cheques zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai déjà récupéré tout le poids que j'avais perdu l'été dernier.
target_text: Nilisha rudisha kilo yote nilipotezaka mu kipwa yenyi ilipitaka.
target_text_raw: Nilisha rudisha kilo yote nilipotezaka mu kipwa yenyi ilipitaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous buvez du jus de pomme.
target_text: Unakunywa jus ya pomme.
target_text_raw: Unakunywa jus ya pomme.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais apporter de la tarte à ma mère.
target_text: Nitamletea mamangu pai.
target_text_raw: Nitamletea mamangu pai(mkate).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'occupe de ses petites affaires dans son coin.
target_text: Anahusika na mambo yake kidogo mu corner.
target_text_raw: Anahusika na mambo yake kidogo mu corner(mu coin).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comptez !
target_text: Hesabia!
target_text_raw: Hesabia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan a indiqué qu'il était flic.
target_text: Dan alisema kama ni polisi.
target_text_raw: Dan alisema kama ni polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir ! Comment vas-tu ?
target_text: Jambo! Biko aye?
target_text_raw: Jambo! Biko aye?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu voies ma collection de timbres.
target_text: Ninapenda uone ma timbres zangu nilikusanya.
target_text_raw: Ninapenda uone ma timbres zangu nilikusanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un vaisseau sanguin a éclaté dans mon œil.
target_text: Kuko sehemu ya kubeba damu mu lico yenyi ilipasuka ndani.
target_text_raw: Kuko sehemu ya kubeba damu mu lico yenyi ilipasuka ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'enfer est pavé de bonnes intentions.
target_text: Jehenama inayala na nia nzuri.
target_text_raw: Jehenama inayala na nia nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hé, les mecs ! Je pense que j'ai trouvé quelque chose.
target_text: He, ba masta! Ninawaza nimepata quelque chose.
target_text_raw: He, ba masta! Ninawaza nimepata quelque chose.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a hurlé comme une gamine.
target_text: Maria alingoroma sawa mtoto mcanga.
target_text_raw: Maria alingoroma sawa mtoto mcanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ne perdirent pas de temps à emmener l'homme souffrant à un hôpital.
target_text: Hawakupoteza muda ya kumubeba mgonjwa ku hopitali.
target_text_raw: Hawakupoteza muda ya kumubeba mgonjwa ku hopitali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne nous laissons pas dévier à ce point !
target_text: Tusijipoteze mpaka hapa!
target_text_raw: Tusijipoteze mpaka hapa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sue est une étudiante usanienne.
target_text: Sue ni mwanafunzi wa ku cuo kikuu wa Amerika.
target_text_raw: Sue ni mwanafunzi wa ku cuo kikuu wa Amerika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aime se détendre à la maison avec sa famille quand il est en permission de l'Armée de l'Air.
target_text: Anapendaka kubakia ku nyumba na jamaa yake saa yenyi iko mu conge ya Jeshi la Anga.
target_text_raw: Anapendaka kubakia ku nyumba na jamaa yake saa yenyi iko mu conge ya Jeshi la Anga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous le connaissez ?
target_text: Unamujuwa?
target_text_raw: Unamujuwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis prêt pour le combat.
target_text: Niko tayari kupigana.
target_text_raw: Niko tayari kupigana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En regardant ce graphique, on peut très facilement en déduire que nous suivons une croissance exponentielle.
target_text: Tukiangalia hii capo,tunaweza sema bila kudanganyika kama tunafuata kukomala ya ajabu.
target_text_raw: Tukiangalia hii capo,tunaweza sema bila kudanganyika kama tunafuata kukomala ya ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Chaque personne de cette communauté est comme une cellule dans le système immunitaire d'un corps humain sain.
target_text: Kila mutu wa mu hii jamii iko kama vile seli ya kingo mwilini ya mwili yenyi haika ugonjwa.
target_text_raw: Kila mutu wa mu hii jamii iko kama vile seli ya kingo mwilini ya mwili yenyi haika ugonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En espéranto tous les verbes à l'infinitif finissent par i.
target_text: Mu luga ya espéranto matendo zote ninaisha na i.
target_text_raw: Mu luga ya espéranto matendo(ma verbes) zote ninaisha na i.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis me rend dingue.
target_text: Louis ananigeuza duru.
target_text_raw: Louis ananigeuza duru.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant, je voudrais que tu t'imagines une carte de la Grande-Bretagne.
target_text: Sasa, nataka uwaze carte ya Ungereza.
target_text_raw: Sasa, nataka uwaze carte ya Ungereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous recherchons éperdument des preuves de notre propre existence.
target_text: Tuko tunatafuta ma preuves za kukuwa kwetu lakini hatuzipate.
target_text_raw: Tuko tunatafuta ma preuves za kukuwa kwetu lakini hatuzipate.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'était pas très sympa.
target_text: Haikukua mzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Haikukua mzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu pars déjà ?
target_text: Unaenda déjà?
target_text_raw: Unaenda déjà?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça va être le bordel.
target_text: Itakuwa kavuyo.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa kavuyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Zut, la doublure de mon manteau se détache.
target_text: Ha! nguo ya ndani ya koti yangu inatoka.
target_text_raw: Ha! nguo ya ndani ya koti yangu inatoka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pourriez essayer au-delà de la Colline ou de l'autre côté de l'Eau.
target_text: Ungelipima julu ya kilima ao ngambo ingine ya mayi.
target_text_raw: Ungelipima julu ya kilima ao ngambo ingine ya mayi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne me coupe jamais les ongles la nuit.
target_text: Hata siku moya sijikatake makuca busiku.
target_text_raw: Hata siku moya sijikatake makuca busiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trente pages ?! Tu devais écrire une dissertation et non une thèse !
target_text: Page makumi tatu?! Ulishwa andika kitabu ya kidogo hapana kitabu kikubwa sana!
target_text_raw: Page makumi tatu?! Ulishwa andika kitabu ya kidogo (dissertation) hapana kitabu kikubwa sana(thèse)!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous quittons définitivement ce pays.
target_text: Tunatoka mwa hii inchi lote.
target_text_raw: Tunatoka mwa hii inchi lote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tenez votre langue !
target_text: Ucunge ulimi yako!
target_text_raw: Ucunge ulimi yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plusieurs dirigeants de l'entreprise sont en mission pour suivre une conférence.
target_text: Waongozi wengi wa kampuni wako mu mission kwa kufuata conférence.
target_text_raw: Waongozi wengi wa kampuni wako mu mission kwa kufuata conférence.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une remarque homophobe.
target_text: Hii na neno ya kuonyesha cuki zidi ya mwanadamu.
target_text_raw: Hii na neno ya kuonyesha cuki zidi ya mwanadamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celui qui possède aussi peu d'oreille pour les langues que mon frère ferait mieux de ne pas devenir journaliste, interprète ou traducteur.
target_text: Mwenyi anakuwaka naye na masikio kidogo kuhusa luga sawa ndugu yangu ingelikwa mzuri asikuwe mupasha habari, mtafsiri wa maneno yenyi kusemwa ao yenyi kuandikwa.
target_text_raw: Mwenyi anakuwaka naye na masikio kidogo kuhusa luga sawa ndugu yangu ingelikwa mzuri asikuwe mupasha habari, mtafsiri wa maneno yenyi kusemwa ao yenyi kuandikwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les rumeurs étaient vraies.
target_text: Ruma zilikuwa za kweli.
target_text_raw: Ruma (ma rumeurs) zilikuwa za kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu devrais passer plus de temps dehors et moins de temps dedans.
target_text: Unapashwa kuwa unapitisha muda ya mingi zaidi inje na muda kidogo zaidi mu nyumba.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa kuwa unapitisha muda ya mingi zaidi inje na muda kidogo zaidi mu nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les États-Unis utilisent des sociétés de mercenaires pour déstabiliser des pays faibles et petits, mais cette stratégie ne pourra jamais marcher face à un pays comme la Russie.
target_text: Amerika inatumikishaka kampuni za wanyanyasi kwa kukosesha amani inchi zaifu na zidogo, lakini hii strategie haitaendeka hata siku moya zidi ya inchi sawa Urusi.
target_text_raw: Amerika inatumikishaka kampuni za wanyanyasi kwa kukosesha amani inchi zaifu na zidogo, lakini hii strategie haitaendeka hata siku moya zidi ya inchi sawa Urusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma femme était enceinte à l'époque.
target_text: Ile wakati bibi yangu alikuwaka mimba.
target_text_raw: Ile wakati bibi yangu alikuwaka mimba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quiconque excuse toute erreur commise commet une erreur.
target_text: Kila mwenyi anahurumiaka kila kosa anafanya kosa.
target_text_raw: Kila mwenyi anahurumiaka kila kosa anafanya kosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous faut parler sérieusement.
target_text: Inaomba tuongeye sana kabisa.
target_text_raw: Inaomba tuongeye sana kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bravo Taoues !
target_text: Hongera Taoues!
target_text_raw: Hongera (Félicitations) Taoues!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aboule le fric, ou je t'éclate!
target_text: Aboule mwenyi makuta,ao ninakubomola!
target_text_raw: Aboule mwenyi makuta,ao ninakubomola!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Change de disque, c'est ennuyeux !
target_text: Badilisha disk, inauzi!
target_text_raw: Badilisha disk, inauzi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un tas de trucs à faire.
target_text: Niko na bitu bya mingi bya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Niko na bitu bya mingi bya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si une évaluation est prévue le jour où tu es absent, tu seras supposé la faire au cours suivant.
target_text: Kama kuko mashindano yenyi inatayarishiwa siku yenyi hauko, utaifanya siku ya kufuata.
target_text_raw: Kama kuko mashindano yenyi inatayarishiwa siku yenyi hauko, utaifanya siku ya kufuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En principe, pas seulement chez les humains mais aussi chez les animaux, une « parade sexuelle » survient, consciemment ou inconsciemment, à l'égard des individus de sexe opposé.
target_text: Kwa namna ya kawaida,haiko tu kwa wanadamu lakini na kwa wanyama, hamu ya kufanya ngono inakuyaka,kwa utashi ao bila kujuwa,mutu akiona kiumbe ya jinsia ingine.
target_text_raw: Kwa namna ya kawaida,haiko tu kwa wanadamu lakini na kwa wanyama, hamu ya kufanya ngono inakuyaka,kwa utashi ao bila kujuwa,mutu akiona kiumbe ya jinsia ingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux connaître le sens exact de cette peine.
target_text: Siwezi kujuwa maana kamili ya hii malipizi.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kujuwa maana kamili ya hii malipizi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps est un grand maître ; le problème, c'est qu'il tue ses élèves.
target_text: Wakati ni mwalimu mkuu, shida, ni juu inauwaka wanafunzi wake.
target_text_raw: Wakati ni mwalimu mkuu, shida, ni juu inauwaka wanafunzi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On verra.
target_text: Tutaona.
target_text_raw: Tutaona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne partez pas, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Musiende, tafazali.
target_text_raw: Musiende, tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le gardien de troupeaux entra dans le bar.
target_text: Mcungaji wa ufugo akaingia mu bar.
target_text_raw: Mcungaji wa ufugo akaingia mu bar.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Et je veux étudier de nombreuses langues pour comprendre le monde. Actuellement, je prépare une licence de grec classique.
target_text: Na ninataka kujifunza luga za mingi kwa kuelewa dunia. Kwa sasa niko natayarisha licence ya kigreki ya kumasomo!
target_text_raw: Na ninataka kujifunza luga za mingi kwa kuelewa dunia. Kwa sasa niko natayarisha licence ya kigreki ya kumasomo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce gamin ne veut pas me dire son nom.
target_text: Huyu mtoto hataki kuniambia jina yake.
target_text_raw: Huyu mtoto hataki kuniambia jina yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un ramassis de conneries !
target_text: Bucafu ya upumbavu!
target_text_raw: Bucafu ya upumbavu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'es pas spécial.
target_text: Hauko wa ajabu.
target_text_raw: Hauko wa ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête de jouer à des jeux vidéo pendant trois ans.
target_text: Aca kuceza micezo ya ma video muda wa myaka tatu.
target_text_raw: Aca kuceza micezo ya ma video muda wa myaka tatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À chaque fois, je suis restée très peu de temps à Paris. Je le regrette bien.
target_text: Kila mara , nilibakia Paris kwa muda kidogo. Ninairegretter kabisa.
target_text_raw: Kila mara , nilibakia Paris kwa muda kidogo. Ninairegretter kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui ne peut se souvenir de son passé est condamné à le revivre.
target_text: Mutu mwenyi hawezi kumbuka maisha yake ya zamani anapashwa kuiishi tena.
target_text_raw: Mutu mwenyi hawezi kumbuka maisha yake ya zamani anapashwa kuiishi tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Informez-moi aussitôt qu'il revient.
target_text: Uniambie saa anarudia.
target_text_raw: Uniambie saa anarudia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le château a été transformé en un merveilleux musée.
target_text: Baligeuza nyumba mu fasi ya kuwekea vyombo.
target_text_raw: Baligeuza nyumba mu fasi ya kuwekea vyombo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne voulais pas remettre en cause ton autorité.
target_text: Sikukukuwa nataka kushakia mamlaka yako.
target_text_raw: Sikukukuwa nataka kushakia mamlaka yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: «Votre commande ?» «Du jus d'orange.» «Avec glaçons ?» «Oui.» «Merci de votre participation.»
target_text: «Commande yako?» «Jus ya orange.» «na barafu glacons?» «Ndio.» «Aksanti kwa kuhuzuria.»
target_text_raw: «Commande yako?» «Jus ya orange.» «na barafu glacons?» «Ndio.» «Aksanti kwa kuhuzuria.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai oublié que j'étais supposé apporter une bouteille de vin.
target_text: Nilisahau kama nilipashwa leta cupa ya divai.
target_text_raw: Nilisahau kama nilipashwa leta cupa ya divai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux prouver que je peux le faire.
target_text: Nitamusibitisha kama ndaweza ifanya.
target_text_raw: Nitamusibitisha(nataka mu prouver) kama ndaweza ifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a une règle qui fonctionne pour chaque calamité. Que ce soit la peste, la guerre ou la famine ; les riches s'enrichissent et les pauvres s'appauvrissent. Les pauvres y contribuent, même.
target_text: Kuko kanuni yenyi inatumika ku kila shida. Ikuwe ugonjwa ya peste, vita ao njala;watajiri wanatajirika na wamaskini wanakosewa. Wamaskini wanatuma bitu kukuwa vile hata.
target_text_raw: Kuko kanuni yenyi inatumika ku kila shida. Ikuwe ugonjwa ya peste, vita ao njala;watajiri wanatajirika na wamaskini wanakosewa. Wamaskini wanatuma bitu kukuwa vile hata(wanacontribuer kwa ile).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voulez-vous toujours être officier ?
target_text: Unataka kwendela kuwa tu mkubwa wa jeshi?
target_text_raw: Unataka kwendela kuwa tu mkubwa wa jeshi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons des témoins.
target_text: Tuko na washahidi.
target_text_raw: Tuko na washahidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami a retrouvé le collier.
target_text: Sami alipata ile lukamba.
target_text_raw: Sami alipata ile lukamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est devenue infirmière.
target_text: Aliisha kuwa munganga.
target_text_raw: Aliisha kuwa munganga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A-t-il des chances de réussir ?
target_text: Iko na bahati ya kuweza?
target_text_raw: Iko na bahati ya kuweza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais lui offrir soit ces lunettes de soleil bleues en forme de guitare électrique soit ce chapeau rouge.
target_text: Ndamupatia ma lunettes za bleu za jua yenyi iko saa guitare ya courant ao chapeau ya rouge.
target_text_raw: Ndamupatia ma lunettes za bleu za jua yenyi iko saa guitare ya courant ao chapeau ya rouge.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ambiance délétère en aura fait fuir plus d'un.
target_text: Ambulance ya kuhatarisha maisha itakimbiza batu mingi.
target_text_raw: Ambulance ya kuhatarisha maisha itakimbiza batu mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon bureau est au troisième étage de cet immeuble gris de cinq étages.
target_text: Ofisiyangu iko ku étage ya tatu ya hii nyumba ya rangi ya majifu ya étages tano.
target_text_raw: Ofisi (bureau) yangu iko ku étage ya tatu ya hii nyumba ya rangi ya majifu ya étages tano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jules a battu le chien.
target_text: Jules alipiga imbwa.
target_text_raw: Jules alipiga imbwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette dent est lâche.
target_text: Hii lino inagonjwa.
target_text_raw: Hii lino inagonjwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son aide actuelle est Mademoiselle Nokami.
target_text: Msaidizi wake wa hizi masiku ni Mademoiselle Nokami.
target_text_raw: Msaidizi wake wa hizi masiku ni Mademoiselle Nokami.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'air doux du matin était rempli de l'agréable odeur de la forêt.
target_text: Hali nzuri ya hewa ya asubui ilikuwa inayala harufu nzuri ya pori.
target_text_raw: Hali nzuri ya hewa ya asubui ilikuwa inayala harufu nzuri ya pori.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Anna est une petite fille.
target_text: Anna ni binti mdogo.
target_text_raw: Anna ni binti (fille) mdogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux l'épouser.
target_text: Ninataka nimuwe.
target_text_raw: Ninataka nimuwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'avais pas idée que vous saviez jouer au mah-jong.
target_text: Nilikuwa sizani kama una juwa cheza mah-jong.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa sizani kama una juwa cheza mah-jong.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne pouvez-vous pas arranger les choses par le dialogue ?
target_text: Hamuwezi tafuta solution ku shida kupitia maongezi?
target_text_raw: Hamuwezi tafuta solution ku shida kupitia maongezi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gardez la monnaie !
target_text: Muweke makuta!
target_text_raw: Muweke makuta!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La chambre de Lisa a encore besoin d'être nettoyée.
target_text: Chumba ya Laiza iko na lazima ya kukoropewa.
target_text_raw: Chumba (chambre) ya Laiza iko na lazima ya kukoropewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Accommoder les restes, c'est tout un art !
target_text: Kujuwa kutengeneza byenyi binabakia ni ujuzi ya kuenea.
target_text_raw: Kujuwa kutengeneza byenyi binabakia ni ujuzi ya kuenea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était hier matin qu'elles ont vu M. Carter.
target_text: Ilikuwa jana asubui njo baliona Bwana Carter.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa jana asubui njo baliona Bwana Carter.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Emily pleure.
target_text: Emily analia.
target_text_raw: Emily analia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ayant été écrite en grande hâte, cette lettre comporte pas mal de fautes.
target_text: Kwa sababu iliandikwa kwa haraka kubwa, hii barua iko na makosa za mingi.
target_text_raw: Kwa sababu iliandikwa kwa haraka kubwa, hii barua iko na makosa za mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez à manger votre dîner.
target_text: Muendeleye munakula cakula yenu ya mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Muendeleye munakula cakula yenu ya mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous partons d'ici.
target_text: Tunatoka hapa.
target_text_raw: Tunatoka hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand tu verras ce film, je serai mort.
target_text: Wakati utaona ile film ndakufa!
target_text_raw: Wakati utaona ile film ndakufa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai été viré de l'équipe de baseball.
target_text: Balinifukuza mu equipe ya baseball.
target_text_raw: Balinifukuza mu equipe ya baseball.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai remarqué qu'un petit animal gris nous regardait.
target_text: Niliona kama ka nyama ka kidogo ka rangi ya majifu kalikuwa kanatuangalia.
target_text_raw: Niliona kama ka nyama ka kidogo ka rangi ya majifu kalikuwa kanatuangalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un vélo rouille, si tu le laisses sous la pluie.
target_text: Kinga inapata kutu kama unaiaca mu nvula.
target_text_raw: Kinga inapata kutu kama unaiaca mu nvula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te prie de virer tout ton bazar de cette pièce.
target_text: Ninakusihi utoshe ile soko yako yote mwa hii chumba.
target_text_raw: Ninakusihi utoshe ile soko yako yote mwa hii chumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que nous contez-vous là, Richard ?
target_text: Nini njo uko unatuhesabilia pale, Richard?
target_text_raw: Nini njo uko unatuhesabilia pale, Richard?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Passez un bon dimanche !
target_text: Nawatakia siku ya Mungu nzuri!
target_text_raw: Nawatakia siku ya Mungu nzuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai accouché de deux vrais jumeaux.
target_text: Nimezala batoto bawili ba mapasa ya kweli.
target_text_raw: Nimezala batoto bawili ba mapasa ya kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie, c’est pas que des bons moments.
target_text: Maisha,haiko tu wakati ya raha.
target_text_raw: Maisha,haiko tu wakati ya raha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne les dégage pas.
target_text: Sitawafukuza.
target_text_raw: Sitawafukuza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Joyeux anniversaire, la Roumanie !
target_text: Sikukuu njema ya kuzaliwa, La Roumanie!
target_text_raw: Sikukuu njema ya kuzaliwa, La Roumanie!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais gardé de journal.
target_text: Hata siku moya siyawekaka jalada/gazeti.
target_text_raw: Hata siku moya siyawekaka jalada/gazeti(journal).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trouvez les erreurs et corrigez-les !
target_text: Mutafute makosa na muzikosoe!
target_text_raw: Mutafute makosa na muzikosoe(muzicorriger)!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puisque tu es fatiguée, tu devrais te reposer.
target_text: Ginsi unacoka, inakuomba upumuzike.
target_text_raw: Ginsi unacoka, inakuomba upumuzike.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis a demandé à Gabrielle de surveiller les enfants.
target_text: Louis aliomba Gabrielle aangalie batoto.
target_text_raw: Louis aliomba Gabrielle aangalie batoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que cette piste d'atterrissage n'est pas assez longue.
target_text: Ninawaza hii ya kushukiako ndege haiko ya mrefu sana.
target_text_raw: Ninawaza hii ya kushukiako ndege(avion) haiko ya mrefu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aimerais remercier toutes celles qui ont aidé.
target_text: Nilitaka niwapigie aksanti wote wenyi walisaidia.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka niwapigie aksanti wote wenyi walisaidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On se passera facilement de leurs services.
target_text: Tutaacha ma kazi zao bila shida.
target_text_raw: Tutaacha ma kazi (ma services) zao bila shida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une approche purement policière du problème ne permet pas de le résoudre.
target_text: Kwende ku la polisi kama kuko shida haisaidie kuitatua.
target_text_raw: Kwende ku la polisi kama kuko shida(probleme) haisaidie kuitatua(ku iresoudre).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon meilleur ami a couché avec ma petite amie.
target_text: Rafiki yangu wa sana alilala na ka rafiki kangu ka fille.
target_text_raw: Rafiki yangu wa sana alilala na ka rafiki kangu ka fille (ka cherie kangu).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le conflit entre les blancs et les noirs dans la ville s'empira.
target_text: Mgogoro kati ya bazungu na beusi iliendelea kuharibika zaidi mjini.
target_text_raw: Mgogoro(conflit) kati ya bazungu na beusi iliendelea kuharibika zaidi mjini(mu ville).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Disons que vous avez raison.
target_text: Tuseme kama muko na sheria.
target_text_raw: Tuseme kama muko na sheria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande si cette phrase va survivre à la fin du monde.
target_text: Ninajiuliza kama hii msemwa inabakia mpaka mwisho ya dunia.
target_text_raw: Ninajiuliza kama hii msemwa inabakia mpaka mwisho ya dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette traduction n'est pas très claire.
target_text: Hii utafsiri haiko mzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Hii utafsiri haiko mzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tes O ressemblent à des A.
target_text: Ma O zako zinafanana na ma A.
target_text_raw: Ma O zako zinafanana na ma A.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je souffre de maux de ventre.
target_text: Niko naumwa na tumbu/Tuko iko inaniluma.
target_text_raw: Niko naumwa na tumbu/Tuko iko inaniluma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous remercie sincèrement d'avoir répondu à mon appel.
target_text: Ninawapigia kabisa aksanti kuona muliitika uwito yangu.
target_text_raw: Ninawapigia kabisa aksanti kuona muliitika uwito yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un livre d'une puissance visionnaire inouïe.
target_text: Ni kitabu ca nguvu ya maono ya ajabu.
target_text_raw: Ni kitabu ca nguvu ya maono ya ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouvrez la fenêtre s'il vous plait.
target_text: Fungula mlango tafazali.
target_text_raw: Fungula mlango tafazali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le rythme actuel est d'environ un crash aérien toutes les deux semaines, en tenant compte de tous les accidents graves sur tous les types d'avions de transport.
target_text: Rythme ya leo ni yapata ajali ya ndege kila posho mbili, tukikamata akali zote za nguvu za namna zote za ndege za usafirishaji.
target_text_raw: Rythme ya leo ni yapata ajali ya ndege(avion) kila posho mbili, tukikamata akali zote za nguvu za namna zote za ndege za usafirishaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me fait me sentir spéciale.
target_text: Anaaca ninajisikia wa maana!
target_text_raw: Anaaca ninajisikia wa maana (wa dur)!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons tous des points forts différents.
target_text: Siye bote tuko na ngambo nzuri tafauti.
target_text_raw: Siye bote tuko na ngambo nzuri tafauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est assez évident qu'il l'aime.
target_text: Ni ya kweli kabisa anamupenda.
target_text_raw: Ni ya kweli kabisa anamupenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La logique est clairement ton point fort.
target_text: Mawazo yenyi iko ku mstari njo tabia yako nzuri.
target_text_raw: Mawazo yenyi iko ku mstari njo tabia yako nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre enfant nous semble être brillant. Évidemment, il se peut que nous ayons un parti pris.
target_text: Mtoto wetu anatufanania ni wa akili. Ni kweli, inaonekana saa nginsi tuko na ngambo tunapendelea.
target_text_raw: Mtoto wetu anatufanania ni wa akili. Ni kweli, inaonekana saa nginsi tuko na ngambo tunapendelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne revenez pas.
target_text: Usirudie.
target_text_raw: Usirudie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jésus et ses disciples furent invités à ce mariage.
target_text: Yesu na wafuasi wake walikuwa invites kwa ile ndoa.
target_text_raw: Yesu na wafuasi wake walikuwa invites kwa ile ndoa(mariage).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les États-Unis ne pourront jamais attaquer et anéantir de grands pays comme l'Iran ou le Venezuela.
target_text: Amerika haitaweza kushambulia na kubaribisha inchi kubwa sawa vile Iran na Venezuela.
target_text_raw: Amerika haitaweza kushambulia na kubaribisha inchi kubwa sawa vile Iran na Venezuela.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es probablement fatiguée après un vol aussi long.
target_text: Inawezakana unacoka kisha safari ya mrefu vile mu avion.
target_text_raw: Inawezakana unacoka kisha safari ya mrefu vile mu avion.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous faisiez allusion au divorce.
target_text: Ulikuwa ukiongelea kuvunja ndoa.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa ukiongelea kuvunja ndoa(divorce).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que tu pourras profiter de ton temps en Chine.
target_text: Niko nam matumaini kama utafurahia muda yako utapitisha China.
target_text_raw: Niko nam matumaini kama utafurahia muda yako utapitisha China.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous voulons tous des réponses.
target_text: Siye bote tunataka majibu.
target_text_raw: Siye bote tunataka majibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Actuellement, il est au travail, mais il reviendra à sept heures.
target_text: Saa hii, iko mu kazi, lakini atarudia na saa moya.
target_text_raw: Saa hii, iko mu kazi, lakini atarudia na saa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En entendant que notre prof allait se marier, tout le monde voulait participer à son mariage.
target_text: En attendant ginsi prof wetu ataenda lunga,kila mutu alitaka aende ku ndoa yake.
target_text_raw: En attendant ginsi prof wetu ataenda lunga,kila mutu alitaka aende ku ndoa yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Alerte, Mathéo, ouvre les yeux, il se passe quelque chose sur la plage.
target_text: Hange, Mathéo,fungula maco,kuko byenyi biko binapitika ku plage.
target_text_raw: Hange, Mathéo,fungula maco,kuko byenyi biko binapitika ku plage.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Linda va libérer les prisonniers.
target_text: Linda atafungula bafungwa.
target_text_raw: Linda atafungula bafungwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas pris conscience que vous étiez sérieuse.
target_text: Sikujua kama uko serieuse.
target_text_raw: Sikujua kama uko serieuse.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En attendant de trouver une pomme, j'ai mangé ma poire.
target_text: En attendant ginsi ndapata tundanilikula poire yangu.
target_text_raw: En attendant ginsi ndapata tunda(pomme) nilikula poire yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est moi qui ai amené ce livre.
target_text: Miye njo nilileta hii kitabu.
target_text_raw: Miye njo nilileta hii kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'avais pas besoin d'amener Sami ici.
target_text: Haukukuwa na lazima ya kuleta Sami hapa.
target_text_raw: Haukukuwa na lazima ya kuleta Sami hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Amène tes amis.
target_text: Leta barafiki yako.
target_text_raw: Leta barafiki yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le patron a dicté une lettre à la secrétaire.
target_text: Mkubwa wa kazi ali dicter barua kwa secretaire wake.
target_text_raw: Mkubwa wa kazi ali dicter barua kwa secretaire wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous faisons des recherches sur les drones.
target_text: Tunafanyaka utafiti juu ya avions za kuenda bila pilotes.
target_text_raw: Tunafanyaka utafiti juu ya avions za kuenda bila pilotes(ma drones).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-moi comment tu t'appelles.
target_text: Niambie jina yako nani.
target_text_raw: Niambie jina yako nani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je le ferai dès que je pourrai.
target_text: Ndaifanya saa ndaweza.
target_text_raw: Ndaifanya saa ndaweza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai le cœur brisé.
target_text: Niko na roho ya kuvunjika.
target_text_raw: Niko na roho ya kuvunjika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Connais-tu le massage cardiaque ?
target_text: Unajuwa massage ya roho njo nini?
target_text_raw: Unajuwa massage ya roho njo nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sens que tu écriras une pièce formidable.
target_text: Ninajuwa kama utaandika mcezo mzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Ninajuwa kama utaandika mcezo mzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faisons une pause durant 10 minutes.
target_text: Tupumzike dakika10.
target_text_raw: Tupumzike dakika(minutes) 10.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En Chine, on construit une ville écologique modèle entièrement nouvelle.
target_text: China, biko banajenga mjiya kukinga mazingira yenyi ni mfano na ni ya mpya yote.
target_text_raw: China, biko banajenga mji(ville) ya kukinga mazingira yenyi ni mfano na ni ya mpya yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as beau leur faire de la lèche, ils vont te ramollir en te ratatinant le cerveau, voire te briser le cou.
target_text: Ni muzuri uwakoroge, batakuvuruga bakikulumisha kicwa, hata kukuvunja shingo.
target_text_raw: Ni muzuri uwakoroge, batakuvuruga bakikulumisha kicwa, hata kukuvunja shingo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jouer au Go est ma seule distraction.
target_text: Kuceza mcezo ya Go njo yenyi ninapotezakamo wakati.
target_text_raw: Kuceza mcezo ya Go njo yenyi ninapotezakamo wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut reprendre le chemin du travail.
target_text: Inaniomba nirudilie njia ya kwenda ku kazi.
target_text_raw: Inaniomba nirudilie njia ya kwenda ku kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Même si j'utilise mes deux mains, je ne peux pas casser un œuf sans casser le jaune.
target_text: Hata kama ninatumikisha mikono yangu mbili,siwezi vunja liyayi bila kumwanga mayi ya ndani.
target_text_raw: Hata kama ninatumikisha mikono yangu mbili,siwezi vunja liyayi bila kumwanga mayi ya ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons trois gardes de sécurité qui se relaient.
target_text: Tuko walinzi wa usalama watatu wenyi wanagombolana.
target_text_raw: Tuko walinzi wa usalama watatu wenyi wanagombolana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je comprends ce que vous me demandez de faire, mais je ne peux pas faire ça.
target_text: Ninasikia byenyi unanilomba nifanye,lakini siwezi bifanya.
target_text_raw: Ninasikia byenyi unanilomba nifanye,lakini siwezi bifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez deux balles.
target_text: Uko na kabumbu mbili.
target_text_raw: Uko na kabumbu mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous feriez un bon détective privé.
target_text: Ungelipashwaka kuwa polisi wa pekee wa mzuri wakuwindana na ba mwizi na bauwaji.
target_text_raw: Ungelipashwaka kuwa polisi wa pekee wa mzuri wakuwindana na ba mwizi na bauwaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La lecture de ce livre nécessite soit une excellente vue soit une paire de lunettes performante.
target_text: Kusoma hiki kitabu inaomba kuwa na maco ya mzuri sana ao ma lunettes za mzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Kusoma hiki kitabu inaomba kuwa na maco ya mzuri sana ao ma lunettes za mzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus je réfléchis au problème, plus difficile il m’apparut.
target_text: Zaidi niliwaza ku probleme, zaidi ilionekana kuwa nguvu kwangu.
target_text_raw: Zaidi niliwaza ku probleme, zaidi ilionekana kuwa nguvu kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'évolution a bien fait les choses en faisant les hommes soldats. Si c'étaient les femmes, il n'y aurait jamais de quartier et toutes les prisonnières seraient défigurées et auraient les yeux arrachés.
target_text: Maendeleo ilifanya bitu bya mingi bya mzuri ikafanya banaume ba mingi banakuwa basoda. Ingelikuwa banamuke,hakungelikuwa mungini,na banamuke bafungwa bote habangelijulikana na bangelibatosha maco.
target_text_raw: Maendeleo ilifanya bitu bya mingi bya mzuri ikafanya banaume ba mingi banakuwa basoda. Ingelikuwa banamuke,hakungelikuwa mungini,na banamuke bafungwa bote habangelijulikana na bangelibatosha maco.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pensez-vous que le tir fut accidentel ?
target_text: Unawaza kama masasi ilifika bila kujuwa?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kama masasi ilifika bila kujuwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque les gens commencent à faire une comparaison entre eux et d'autres, qui ont rencontré un succès, ceci constitue pour eux un puissant facteur de démotivation.
target_text: Wakati watu wanaanza kujilinganisha na wengine,wenyi waliseza kufaulu mu maisha,ile inaendelea kuwasukuma kutumika sana.
target_text_raw: Wakati watu wanaanza kujilinganisha na wengine,wenyi waliseza kufaulu mu maisha,ile inaendelea kuwasukuma kutumika sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chauffeur de taxi n'est pas aimable.
target_text: Ule chauffeur wa taxi haiko mtu mzuri.
target_text_raw: Ule chauffeur wa taxi haiko mtu mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous vîmes les empreintes d'un ours dans la neige.
target_text: Tuliona halama za bidole ya nyama mu seluji.
target_text_raw: Tuliona halama za bidole ya nyama mu seluji(neige).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la première fois que je contribue à Tatoeba alors je suis un peu nerveuse...veuillez être gentille avec moi.
target_text: Njo mara ya kwanza ninapana mcango kwa Tatoeba na japo ninasirika kidogo...Tafazali ukuwe mzuri na miye.
target_text_raw: Njo mara ya kwanza ninapana mcango kwa Tatoeba na japo ninasirika kidogo...Tafazali ukuwe mzuri na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Écoute-moi, » dit le Démon, en posant sa main sur ma tête.
target_text: «Nisikilize,» Shetani anasema,akitia mkono yake ku kicwa.
target_text_raw: «Nisikilize,» Shetani anasema,akitia mkono yake ku kicwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le figuier est arbre qui pousse dans des pays chauds.
target_text: Mtiti ya matunda zinazoitwa «figues» ni muti yenyi inaota mu inchi za kifukutu.
target_text_raw: Mtiti ya matunda zinazoitwa «figues» ni muti yenyi inaota mu inchi za kifukutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous directement rentrée chez vous hier, après l'école ?
target_text: Kisha masomo jana ulirudia kwenu directement?
target_text_raw: Kisha masomo jana ulirudia kwenu directement?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a que lui pour donner une oie en échange d'un moineau.
target_text: Ni yeye tu njo mwenyi anaweza pana ndegz kubwa pahali ya ndege ndogo.
target_text_raw: Ni yeye tu njo mwenyi anaweza pana ndegz kubwa pahali ya ndege ndogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dès que le résultat sera rendu public, je te le ferai savoir.
target_text: Wakati matokeoitajulikana watu, nitakwambiazo.
target_text_raw: Wakati matokeo (résultat) itajulikana watu, nitakwambiazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu ne vois pas que tu me casses les couilles ?
target_text: Hauone kama uko unaniambia maneno ya kuniuzi?
target_text_raw: Hauone kama uko unaniambia maneno ya kuniuzi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens disent qu'il ne meurt jamais.
target_text: Batu banasema aseme hakufake.
target_text_raw: Batu banasema aseme hakufake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va falloir changer de mode de vie.
target_text: Tutakuwa na lazima ya kubadilisha ginsi ya kuishi.
target_text_raw: Tutakuwa na lazima ya kubadilisha ginsi ya kuishi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne nous sommes pas vus depuis longtemps.
target_text: Inakuwa siku mingi hatuonane.
target_text_raw: Inakuwa siku mingi hatuonane.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je l'ai trouvée au grenier.
target_text: Nilimutuka ku étage ya mwisho.
target_text_raw: Nilimutuka ku étage ya mwisho (ku grenier).
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La thèse est finie à l'exception de la conclusion.
target_text: Ile kitabu iliisha sauf tu conlusion.
target_text_raw: Ile kitabu iliisha sauf tu conlusion.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis a vu Lucienne essayant de s'échapper.
target_text: Yanis aliona Lucienne anajaribu kukimbia.
target_text_raw: Yanis aliona Lucienne anajaribu kukimbia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me lève tous les matins pour aller bosser.
target_text: Ninalamukaka kila asubui juu niende kupiganisha.
target_text_raw: Ninalamukaka kila asubui juu niende kupiganisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malin, cet aspirateur dévore tout : poussières et liquides !
target_text: Mwenyi mayele,hii combo inameza kila kitu: mavumbi na mayi!
target_text_raw: Mwenyi mayele,hii combo inameza kila kitu: mavumbi na mayi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas pour ça.
target_text: Musikuwe na wasi wasi juu ya ile.
target_text_raw: Musikuwe na wasi wasi juu ya ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que ce sont ces lunettes que tu cherches ?
target_text: Est-ce que ni hizi ma lunettes njo uko unatafuta?
target_text_raw: Est-ce que ni hizi ma lunettes njo uko unatafuta?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi tu ne me donnes pas un coup de main ?
target_text: Juu ya nini haunisaidie?
target_text_raw: Juu ya nini haunisaidie?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne n'atteint au succès ou au bonheur en étant forcé de faire ce qu'il répugne naturellement à faire.
target_text: Hakuna mwanyi anafikiaka ku faulu ao kupata raha kama banamukaza kufanya byenyi hapendi kufanya.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwanyi anafikiaka ku faulu ao kupata raha kama banamukaza kufanya byenyi hapendi kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se cache là où l'on ne peut le trouver.
target_text: Anajifica kwenyi habawezi muona.
target_text_raw: Anajifica kwenyi habawezi muona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vais pas m'en inquiéter.
target_text: Sitajiletea soucis juu ya ile.
target_text_raw: Sitajiletea soucis juu ya ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne parlais pas de Jules.
target_text: Sikukuwa naongea juu ya Jules.
target_text_raw: Sikukuwa naongea juu ya Jules.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Parlons franchement !
target_text: Tuongeye bya kweli!
target_text_raw: Tuongeye bya kweli!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurais besoin de faire quelques tests supplémentaires.
target_text: Nitakuwa na lazima ya kufanya vipimozingine.
target_text_raw: Nitakuwa na lazima ya kufanya vipimo(ma tests) zingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Demande-lui, il sera enchanté.
target_text: Umuuliza,atafurahi.
target_text_raw: Umuuliza,atafurahi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te l'assure.
target_text: Ninakuhakikishia.
target_text_raw: Ninakuhakikishia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'en supplie.
target_text: Ninakusihi.
target_text_raw: Ninakusihi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous faisons la tournée de toujours : faire les bars et puis au karaoké.
target_text: Tunafanya muzunguko wa kawaida: tunaenda ku bar na ku karaoké.
target_text_raw: Tunafanya muzunguko wa kawaida: tunaenda ku bar na ku karaoké.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vérifie tous les nœuds desserrés et serre-les fort.
target_text: Angalia fundo zote zenyi zinaregea na uzikaze sana.
target_text_raw: Angalia fundo zote zenyi zinaregea na uzikaze sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas te déranger plus longtemps.
target_text: Sitaki kukuuzi saa mrefu zaidi.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kukuuzi saa mrefu zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça se saura tôt ou tard.
target_text: Itajulikana tu mwisho na mwisho
target_text_raw: Itajulikana tu mwisho na mwisho
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La procédure de vote doit être achevée dans l'intervalle de deux jours consécutifs.
target_text: Ginsi ya kufanya ucaguzi inapashwa maliza mu siku mbili za kufuatana.
target_text_raw: Ginsi ya kufanya ucaguzi inapashwa maliza mu siku mbili za kufuatana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La théorie et la pratique ne vont pas forcément de pair.
target_text: Théorie na pratique haiko lazima biende pamoya.
target_text_raw: Théorie na pratique haiko lazima biende pamoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas de planète B.
target_text: Hakuna sayariB.
target_text_raw: Hakuna sayari (planete) B.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'arabe n'est pas compliqué.
target_text: Miti sio nguvu.
target_text_raw: Miti sio nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mathis ne sait pas si Josephine est morte ou vivante.
target_text: Mathis hajui kama Josephine amekufa au yuko hai.
target_text_raw: Mathis hajui kama Josephine amekufa au yuko hai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Essayons de trouver un remède.
target_text: Tujaribu kupata dawa.
target_text_raw: Tujaribu kupata dawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sacrée baraque !
target_text: Kambi kitakatifu!
target_text_raw: Kambi kitakatifu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toute vérité passe par trois stades. En premier, on la ridiculise. En second, elle reçoit une opposition violente. Troisièmement, on l'accepte comme évidente.
target_text: Ukweli wote hupitia viwango tatu. Kwanza, tumusikise haya. Pili, anapata upinzani nguvu. Tatu, inakubaliwa kama dhahiri.
target_text_raw: Ukweli wote hupitia viwango tatu. Kwanza, tumusikise haya. Pili, anapata upinzani nguvu. Tatu, inakubaliwa kama dhahiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne donnez plus rien à Hugo ! Il a eu sa part.
target_text: Usimpe Hugo kitu chochote tena! Alikuwa na sehemu yake.
target_text_raw: Usimpe Hugo kitu chochote tena! Alikuwa na sehemu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a des rapports difficiles avec sa mère.
target_text: Ana uhusiano mgumu na mama yake.
target_text_raw: Ana uhusiano mgumu na mama yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu serres les fesses et tu t'accroches aux rênes.
target_text: Una bana matako yako na unashikilia hatamu.
target_text_raw: Una bana matako yako na unashikilia hatamu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans ma maison, il y a vraiment un fantôme.
target_text: Katika nyumba yangu, kuna mzuka kweli.
target_text_raw: Katika nyumba yangu, kuna mzuka kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cycliste a monté la colline.
target_text: Baiskeli alipanda kilima.
target_text_raw: Baiskeli alipanda kilima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut débarrasser le grain de l'ivraie.
target_text: Lazima tuondoe magugu kutoka kwa mbegu.
target_text_raw: Lazima tuondoe magugu kutoka kwa mbegu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enlève cette chose de moi !
target_text: Ondoa ile kitu kwangu!
target_text_raw: Ondoa ile kitu kwangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu mens, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Unasema uwongo, sivyo?
target_text_raw: Unasema uwongo, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette maison est en dehors du réseau électrique.
target_text: Nyumba hii iko nje ya gridi ya umeme.
target_text_raw: Nyumba hii iko nje ya gridi ya umeme.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je choisis de prier.
target_text: Ninachagua kuomba.
target_text_raw: Ninachagua kuomba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia fut inquiet de perdre son travail.
target_text: Kylia alikuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kupoteza kazi.
target_text_raw: Kylia alikuwa na wasiwasi juu ya kupoteza kazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La neige fondait, les chevaux galopaient, et de chaque côté du chemin se déroulaient des forêts, des champs et des villages.
target_text: Theluji ilikuwa ikiyeyuka, nywele ilikuwa na shoti, na kila upande wa njia kulikuwa na mapoli, mashamba na vijiji.
target_text_raw: Theluji ilikuwa ikiyeyuka, nywele ilikuwa na shoti, na kila upande wa njia kulikuwa na mapoli, mashamba na vijiji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devrions profiter de cette occasion, tout en sachant bien que cela ne sera pas facile.
target_text: Tunapaswa kuchukua fursa hii, akijua vizuri kwamba itakuwa si rahisi.
target_text_raw: Tunapaswa kuchukua fursa hii, akijua vizuri kwamba itakuwa si rahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est revenue au bout d'une heure.
target_text: Alirudi baada ya saa moja.
target_text_raw: Alirudi baada ya saa moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Heureusement, j'ai la main verte.
target_text: Kwa bahati nzuri, nina mkono wa kijani.
target_text_raw: Kwa bahati nzuri, nina mkono wa kijani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux aller au paradis mais je ne veux pas mourir pour y parvenir !
target_text: Nataka kwenda mbinguni lakini sitaki kufa ili kufika huko!
target_text_raw: Nataka kwenda mbinguni lakini sitaki kufa ili kufika huko!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas intervint pour calmer les esprits.
target_text: Thomas alikuya kutuliza roho.
target_text_raw: Thomas alikuya kutuliza roho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un coup de langue est parfois pire qu'un coup de lance.
target_text: Masemo mubaya wakati mwingine ni mbaya kuliko mkuki.
target_text_raw: Masemo mubaya wakati mwingine ni mbaya kuliko mkuki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que je puisse tenir cette promesse.
target_text: Sidhani kama ninaweza kutimiza ahadi hiyo.
target_text_raw: Sidhani kama ninaweza kutimiza ahadi hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a essayé de me mettre des bâtons dans les roues en disant du mal de moi à tous nos voisins.
target_text: Alijaribu kutia muti ku mangurudumu kwa kusema mabaya juu yangu kwa majirani zetu wote.
target_text_raw: Alijaribu kutia muti ku mangurudumu kwa kusema mabaya juu yangu kwa majirani zetu wote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que l'année vous soit douce, légère, heureuse.
target_text: Mwaka huo uwe mtamu kwako, mwepesi, na furaha.
target_text_raw: Mwaka huo uwe mtamu kwako, mwepesi, na furaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Montez.
target_text: Panda juu.
target_text_raw: Panda juu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au Musée d'Orsay, vous pourrez admirer les œuvres de nombreux peintres : Cézanne, Corot, Klimt, Delacroix, Pissaro, Toulouse-lautrec…
target_text: Kwenye Musée d'Orsay, unaweza kufurahikiya kazi za wachoraji wengi: Cezanne, Corot, Klimt, Delacroix, Pissaro, Toulouselautrec ...
target_text_raw: Kwenye Musée d'Orsay, unaweza kufurahikiya kazi za wachoraji wengi: Cezanne, Corot, Klimt, Delacroix, Pissaro, Toulouselautrec ...
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous aurons toutes faim alors assurez-vous d'apporter suffisamment de nourriture pour tout le monde.
target_text: Sote tutakuwa na njaa hivyo hakikisha unaleta chakula yakuheneya kwa kila mtu.
target_text_raw: Sote tutakuwa na njaa hivyo hakikisha unaleta chakula yakuheneya kwa kila mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gloire à Dieu, au plus haut des cieux, et paix sur la terre aux hommes de bonne volonté.
target_text: Utukufu kwa Mungu mbinguni mbinguni, na amani duniani kwa watu wenye mapenzi mema.
target_text_raw: Utukufu kwa Mungu mbinguni mbinguni, na amani duniani kwa watu wenye mapenzi mema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plainte est à l'étude.
target_text: Malalamiko hayo yana chunguzwa.
target_text_raw: Malalamiko hayo yana chunguzwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il restera ici comme son patron le lui a ordonné.
target_text: Atakaa hapa lakini bosi wake alivyowaambia aikale.
target_text_raw: Atakaa hapa lakini bosi wake alivyowaambia aikale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je conseillais mes patients.
target_text: Nili washauri wagonjwa wangu.
target_text_raw: Nili washauri wagonjwa wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Descends de là !
target_text: Chuka tshini!
target_text_raw: Chuka tshini!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette manière de parler est typique venant de lui.
target_text: Namuna hii ya kuongea ni mfano wake kabisa.
target_text_raw: Namuna hii ya kuongea ni mfano wake kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voudriez-vous que je répète la question ?
target_text: Je! Unapenda nirudiliye ulizo?
target_text_raw: Je! Unapenda nirudiliye ulizo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce serait bien, si les couvertures de protection de nombreux livres non seulement seraient belles mais aussi protégeraient contre le contenu.
target_text: Ingekuwa nzuri, ikiwa vifuniko vya kinga vya vitabu vingi sio tu vinaonekana vizuri lakini pia vina linda dhidi ya yaliyomo.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa nzuri, ikiwa vifuniko vya kinga vya vitabu vingi sio tu vinaonekana vizuri lakini pia vina linda dhidi ya yaliyomo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les avocats débattirent du cas des heures durant.
target_text: Mwanasheria walijadili kesi hiyo kwa masaa.
target_text_raw: Mwanasheria walijadili kesi hiyo kwa masaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui surveille les surveillants ?
target_text: Nani ana fuatilia wasimamizi?
target_text_raw: Nani ana fuatilia wasimamizi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Espérons que nous n'ayons plus à refaire cela.
target_text: Tunatumaini sio lazima tufanye hivi tena.
target_text_raw: Tunatumaini sio lazima tufanye hivi tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le crois-tu honnêtement ?
target_text: Je! Unaamini kwa uaminifu?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaamini kwa uaminifu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fais gaffe !
target_text: Onyo!
target_text_raw: Onyo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai reçu un grand nombre d'appels aujourd'hui.
target_text: Nimepokea simu nyingi leo.
target_text_raw: Nimepokea simu nyingi leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai toujours été un grand fan de Jean Reno.
target_text: Siku zote nimekuwa mpenzi mkubwa wa Jean Reno.
target_text_raw: Siku zote nimekuwa mpenzi mkubwa wa Jean Reno.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai étudié le français, tu te rappelles ?
target_text: Nilisoma Kifaransa, kumbuka?
target_text_raw: Nilisoma Kifaransa, kumbuka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu m'en vois ravie !
target_text: Unaniona nimefurahi!
target_text_raw: Unaniona nimefurahi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il prit Jenny à moitié déshabillée et la porta dans son lit.
target_text: Alimchukua Jenny aliyevua nusu na kumpeleka kitandani kwake.
target_text_raw: Alimchukua Jenny aliyevua nusu na kumpeleka kitandani kwake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cette coutume remonte au douzième siècle.
target_text: Desturi hii imeanza karne ya kumi na mbili.
target_text_raw: Desturi hii imeanza karne ya kumi na mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu déjà réglé la note ?
target_text: Je, umeshalipa bili hiyo?
target_text_raw: Je, umeshalipa bili hiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'accrochait à la barre de fer.
target_text: Alibana baa ya chuma.
target_text_raw: Alibana baa ya chuma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maudites soient les lois hors celles que l'amour a créées !
target_text: Zilaaniwe sheria mbali na zile zilizoundwa na upendo!
target_text_raw: Zilaaniwe sheria mbali na zile zilizoundwa na upendo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel foyer ! L'endroit avait l'air d'une friperie désaffectée. La grande vitrine, dénuée de carreau, était fermée par un volet délabré.
target_text: Nyumba iliyoje! Mahali hapo yalionekana kama duka la kuuza bidhaa ambalo hali kutumika. Dirisha kubwa, lisilokuwa na vigae, lilifungwa na ufunguo iliyochakaa.
target_text_raw: Nyumba iliyoje! Mahali hapo yalionekana kama duka la kuuza bidhaa ambalo hali kutumika. Dirisha kubwa, lisilokuwa na vigae, lilifungwa na ufunguo iliyochakaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'amuse.
target_text: Anacheza.
target_text_raw: Anacheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de fois Anadoluspor est-il devenu champion?
target_text: Anadoluspor amekuwa championi mara ngapi?
target_text_raw: Anadoluspor amekuwa championi mara ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Kama kwamba hasira hii kubwa ilinisafisha na uovu, nikamwacha tumaini, kabla ya usiku huu uliojaa ishara na nyota, nilikuwa nikifungua mwenyewe kwa mara ya kwanza kwa kutokujali kwa ulimwengu.
