source_text: Je ne saurais dire l'importance des dégâts.
target_text: Siwezi kusema kiwango cha uharibifu.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kusema kiwango cha uharibifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Yanis ne veut pas d'un iPad. Il veut un portable qui accepte le Flash.
target_text: Yanis hataki iPad. Anataka kompyuta ndogo inayokubali Flash.
target_text_raw: Yanis hataki iPad. Anataka kompyuta ndogo inayokubali Flash.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le lui donnez pas. Donnez-le-moi.
target_text: Usimpe. Unipatiye.
target_text_raw: Usimpe. Unipatiye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as vu le prix de ce téléphone ! Il coûte la peau des fesses !
target_text: Uliona bei ya simu hii! Inabeyi ya ngozi ya matako!
target_text_raw: Uliona bei ya simu hii! Inabeyi ya ngozi ya matako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dirait que vous venez de voir un fantôme.
target_text: Inaonekana umeona mzuka tu.
target_text_raw: Inaonekana umeona mzuka tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourrais-tu, s'il te plait, débarrasser la table ?
target_text: Tafadhali, unapacha futa meza?
target_text_raw: Tafadhali, unapacha futa meza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'enlève pas tes chaussures !
target_text: Usitoche viatu!
target_text_raw: Usitoche viatu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-moi la vérité, Thomas. Ne me mens pas.
target_text: Niambie ukweli, Thomas. Usinidanganye.
target_text_raw: Niambie ukweli, Thomas. Usinidanganye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les filles aiment les chevaux.
target_text: Wasichana wote wanapenda farasi.
target_text_raw: Wasichana wote wanapenda farasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les hommes sont comme les plantes, qui ne croissent jamais heureusement, si elles ne sont bien cultivées.
target_text: Wanaume ni kama mimea, ambayo haikui kamwe kwa furaha ikiwa haijalimwa vizuri.
target_text_raw: Wanaume ni kama mimea, ambayo haikui kamwe kwa furaha ikiwa haijalimwa vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les baisers sont ce qui est resté de la langue du Paradis.
target_text: Mabusu ndio iliyobaki ya ulimi wa Mbingu.
target_text_raw: Mabusu ndio iliyobaki ya ulimi wa Mbingu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne lance pas de pierre contre vous.
target_text: Sikurushiye majuwe.
target_text_raw: Sikurushiye majuwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me fit parvenir une lettre disant qu'il ne pouvait me voir.
target_text: Alinitumia barua akisema awezi kuniona.
target_text_raw: Alinitumia barua akisema awezi kuniona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que l'année 2018 vous soit douce, légère, et heureuse.
target_text: Mei 2018 iwe tamu, nyepesi, na furaha kwako.
target_text_raw: Mei 2018 iwe tamu, nyepesi, na furaha kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faites-moi savoir les jours pendant lesquels vous pourrez venir.
target_text: Nijulishe siku ambazo unaweza kuja.
target_text_raw: Nijulishe siku ambazo unaweza kuja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes voisins sont des gens de paix et de bonne volonté.
target_text: Majirani zangu ni watu wa amani na mapenzi mema.
target_text_raw: Majirani zangu ni watu wa amani na mapenzi mema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si j'étais un garçon, je pourrais me joindre à l'équipe de baseball.
target_text: Ikiwa ningekuwa mvulana ningeweza kujiunga na timu ya baseball.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa ningekuwa mvulana ningeweza kujiunga na timu ya baseball.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soyez patients !
target_text: Kuwa mvumilivu!
target_text_raw: Kuwa mvumilivu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne bouge pas ou je te descends.
target_text: Usisogee la sivyo nitakupiga risasi chini.
target_text_raw: Usisogee la sivyo nitakupiga risasi chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne répète pas ça !
target_text: Usirudie hivyo!
target_text_raw: Usirudie hivyo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regrette d'avoir passé ma jeunesse à fainéanter.
target_text: Ninajuta kutumia ujana wangu kuzunguka.
target_text_raw: Ninajuta kutumia ujana wangu kuzunguka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je passai quelques appels.
target_text: Nilipiga simu kadhaa.
target_text_raw: Nilipiga simu kadhaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me rappelles ton frère.
target_text: Unanikumbusha ndugu yako.
target_text_raw: Unanikumbusha ndugu yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ravie de vous rencontrer.
target_text: Ninafurahi kukutana nawe.
target_text_raw: Ninafurahi kukutana nawe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie fit semblant de ne rien remarquer.
target_text: Marie alijifanya kuwa haoni chochote.
target_text_raw: Marie alijifanya kuwa haoni chochote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Beaucoup de personnes de la génération de mon grand-père ont grandi dans des fermes.
target_text: Wengi wa kizazi cha babu yangu walikua kwenye mashamba.
target_text_raw: Wengi wa kizazi cha babu yangu walikua kwenye mashamba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voulais te dire une chose depuis longtemps : il faut ranger la cave.
target_text: Nilitaka kukuambia jambo moja kwa muda mrefu: pishi lazima iangaliwe.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka kukuambia jambo moja kwa muda mrefu: pishi lazima iangaliwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le poète ne doit avoir qu'un modèle, la nature ; qu'un guide, la vérité.
target_text: Mshairi lazima awe na mfano mmoja tu, maumbile; mwongozo tu, ukweli.
target_text_raw: Mshairi lazima awe na mfano mmoja tu, maumbile; mwongozo tu, ukweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis certaine que beaucoup de gens seraient d'accord avec vous.
target_text: Nina hakika watu wengi watakubaliana nawe.
target_text_raw: Nina hakika watu wengi watakubaliana nawe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas d'homme raisonnable qui prenne le volant après avoir bu.
target_text: Hakuna mtu mwenye busara anayeendesha gari baada ya kunywa.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mtu mwenye busara anayeendesha gari baada ya kunywa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas est OK maintenant.
target_text: Thomas yuko sawa sasa.
target_text_raw: Thomas yuko sawa sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les lois sont toujours faites par les riches contre les pauvres.
target_text: Siku zote sheria zinatungwa na matajiri dhidi ya maskini.
target_text_raw: Siku zote sheria zinatungwa na matajiri dhidi ya maskini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est des esprits tellement chauds que leurs pensées s’exhalent en fumée et se consument en eux dès le moment qu’elles s’y forment.
target_text: Kuna roho kali sana hivi kwamba mawazo yao hutoka moshi na huliwa ndani yao mara tu wanapoundwa hapo.
target_text_raw: Kuna roho kali sana hivi kwamba mawazo yao hutoka moshi na huliwa ndani yao mara tu wanapoundwa hapo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Écoute les sages conseils de ceux qui ont une grande expérience.
target_text: Sikiliza ushauri wa busara wa wale walio na uzoefu mkubwa.
target_text_raw: Sikiliza ushauri wa busara wa wale walio na uzoefu mkubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'elle les ait affabulés n'est pas plus incohérent que la probabilité qu'elle nous dirait, comme elle l'a fait, qu'elle pouvait réaliser et a réalisé des miracles.
target_text: Kwamba aliwatengeneza sio sawa zaidi kuliko uwezekano wa kutuambia, kama alivyofanya, kwamba angeweza na alifanya miujiza.
target_text_raw: Kwamba aliwatengeneza sio sawa zaidi kuliko uwezekano wa kutuambia, kama alivyofanya, kwamba angeweza na alifanya miujiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'équipe considère que c'est un bon capitaine.
target_text: Timu inamchukulia nahodha mzuri.
target_text_raw: Timu inamchukulia nahodha mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Après avoir été à l'étranger, vous voyez beaucoup de choses différemment.
target_text: Baada ya kuwa nje ya nchi, unaona mambo mengi tofauti.
target_text_raw: Baada ya kuwa nje ya nchi, unaona mambo mengi tofauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan a échoué en tant qu'en agent de Voyage.
target_text: Dan alishindwa kama wakala wa kusafiri.
target_text_raw: Dan alishindwa kama wakala wa kusafiri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous pensez que cela intéresse Enzo?
target_text: Je! Unafikiri hii inampendeza Enzo?
target_text_raw: Je! Unafikiri hii inampendeza Enzo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "Ne m'attends pas." "Je n'allais pas t'attendre."
target_text: «Usinisubiri.» «Singe kuchunga.»
target_text_raw: «Usinisubiri.» «Singe kuchunga.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noah essaye toujours d'être cool.
target_text: Noa kila wakati hujaribu kuwa mutu mzuri.
target_text_raw: Noa kila wakati hujaribu kuwa mutu mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jack ne manque pas de talent musical, au contraire il joue très bien du piano.
target_text: Jack hakosi talanta ya muziki, badala yake anacheza piano vizuri.
target_text_raw: Jack hakosi talanta ya muziki, badala yake anacheza piano vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Viens vite, mon chéri, j'ai besoin de toi !
target_text: Kuya haraka, mpenzi wangu, ninakuhitaji!
target_text_raw: Kuya haraka, mpenzi wangu, ninakuhitaji!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va revenir sous trois heures.
target_text: Atarudi baada ya masaa matatu.
target_text_raw: Atarudi baada ya masaa matatu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon beau-père occupe un poste important.
target_text: Baba semeki wangu wa kambo anashikilia nafasi kubwa.
target_text_raw: Baba semeki wangu wa kambo anashikilia nafasi kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir, comment ça va ?
target_text: Jambo, habari yako?
target_text_raw: Jambo, habari yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a là-bas une rose jaune.
target_text: Kuna rose ya manjano hapo.
target_text_raw: Kuna rose ya manjano hapo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comme ailleurs en Inde, la croissance se produit la plupart du temps plus malgré le gouvernement que grâce à lui.
target_text: Kama mahali pengine nchini India, ukuaji mwingi wa wakati hutokea zaidi licha ya serikali kuliko kwa sababu yake.
target_text_raw: Kama mahali pengine nchini India, ukuaji mwingi wa wakati hutokea zaidi licha ya serikali kuliko kwa sababu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous connaissez mon secret.
target_text: Unajua siri yangu.
target_text_raw: Unajua siri yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Anda i tebɣiḍ ad tṛuḥeḍ azekka?
target_text: Anda i tebɣiḍ ad tṛuḥeḍ azekka?
target_text_raw: Anda i tebɣiḍ ad tṛuḥeḍ azekka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça serait sympa si quelqu'un pouvait revoir ça.
target_text: Itakuwa nzuri ikiwa mtu angekagua hii.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa nzuri ikiwa mtu angekagua hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pars après-demain.
target_text: Ninaondoka kesho kutwa.
target_text_raw: Ninaondoka kesho kutwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regarde ce bordel.
target_text: Angalia fujo hii.
target_text_raw: Angalia fujo hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si je devais aller à l'étranger, je choisirais la France.
target_text: Ikiwa ningepaswa kwenda nje ya nchi, ningechagua Ufaransa.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa ningepaswa kwenda nje ya nchi, ningechagua Ufaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On lui a confié une mission importante.
target_text: Alipewa utume muhimu.
target_text_raw: Alipewa utume muhimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai songé que ça vous ferait rire.
target_text: Nilidhani hiyo itakuchekesha.
target_text_raw: Nilidhani hiyo itakuchekesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Enfile-toi là dedans.
target_text: Ingia ndani.
target_text_raw: Ingia ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia espère que Lucie pourra venir chez lui ce soir.
target_text: Kylia anatarajia Lucie anaweza kuja nyumbani kwake usiku wa leo.
target_text_raw: Kylia anatarajia Lucie anaweza kuja nyumbani kwake usiku wa leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-il exact que tu sais écrire le chinois ?
target_text: Je! Ni sahihi kwamba unaweza kuandika Kichina?
target_text_raw: Je! Ni sahihi kwamba unaweza kuandika Kichina?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fumer tue peu à peu.
target_text: Uvutaji sigara unaua pole pole.
target_text_raw: Uvutaji sigara unaua pole pole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis assis au bar.
target_text: Nilikaa chini kwenye baa.
target_text_raw: Nilikaa chini kwenye baa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Silence, gamin !
target_text: Kimya, mtoto!
target_text_raw: Kimya, mtoto!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est clairement en train de mentir.
target_text: Ni wazi anadanganya.
target_text_raw: Ni wazi anadanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le magazine révéla tous ses sombres secrets.
target_text: Jarida lilifunua siri zake zote za giza.
target_text_raw: Jarida lilifunua siri zake zote za giza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est ainsi que les affaires se traitent dans tous les contes de fées. Lorsque le fils du roi eut réveillé la Belle au bois dormant, il l'épousa séance tenante, sans même aller quérir la permission de ses parents.
target_text: Hivi ndivyo biashara inavyoshughulikiwa katika hadithi zote za hadithi. Wakati mtoto wa mfalme alikuwa ameamsha Uzuri wa Kulala, alimwoa mara moja, bila hata kwenda kutafuta ruhusa kutoka kwa wazazi wake.
target_text_raw: Hivi ndivyo biashara inavyoshughulikiwa katika hadithi zote za hadithi. Wakati mtoto wa mfalme alikuwa ameamsha Uzuri wa Kulala, alimwoa mara moja, bila hata kwenda kutafuta ruhusa kutoka kwa wazazi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas que tu me voies nue.
target_text: Sitaki unione uchi.
target_text_raw: Sitaki unione uchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est certaine de réussir les examens.
target_text: Ana hakika kufaulu mitihani.
target_text_raw: Ana hakika kufaulu mitihani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le tableau de bord de cette voiture est entièrement électronique.
target_text: Kadibodi ya gari hii ni ya elektroniki kabisa.
target_text_raw: Kadibodi ya gari hii ni ya elektroniki kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Timéo finit par se calmer.
target_text: Timéo mwishowe alitulia.
target_text_raw: Timéo mwishowe alitulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment faire pour nous soigner sans délabrer notre santé ?
target_text: Je! Tunawezaje kujitunza bila kuharibu afya zetu?
target_text_raw: Je! Tunawezaje kujitunza bila kuharibu afya zetu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est allée se coucher juste après avoir fini de lire cet essai.
target_text: Alienda kulala mara tu baada ya kumaliza kusoma insha hii.
target_text_raw: Alienda kulala mara tu baada ya kumaliza kusoma insha hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les fruits frais sont bons pour la santé.
target_text: Matunda mapya ni nzuri kwako.
target_text_raw: Matunda mapya ni nzuri kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tokyo est à 5 miles d'ici.
target_text: Tokyo iko maili 5 kutoka hapa.
target_text_raw: Tokyo iko maili 5 kutoka hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai eu cent points à l'épreuve de mathématiques.
target_text: Nilipata alama 100 kwenye mtihani wa hesabu.
target_text_raw: Nilipata alama 100 kwenye mtihani wa hesabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laisse tomber ! C'est trop risqué.
target_text: Achia! Ni hatari sana.
target_text_raw: Achia! Ni hatari sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les animaux, les plantes et les microbes sont tous des êtres vivants.
target_text: Wanyama, mimea na vijidudu vyote ni vitu vilivyo hai.
target_text_raw: Wanyama, mimea na vijidudu vyote ni vitu vilivyo hai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crois que c'est un homme digne de foi.
target_text: Ninaamini ni mtu anayestahili kuaminiwa.
target_text_raw: Ninaamini ni mtu anayestahili kuaminiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Deux verres de jus d'orange s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Glasi mbili za juisi ya machungwa, tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Glasi mbili za juisi ya machungwa, tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le garçon cherchait la clé perdue.
target_text: Mvulana alikuwa akitafuta ufunguo uliopotea.
target_text_raw: Mvulana alikuwa akitafuta ufunguo uliopotea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me réjouis certainement que vous n'ayez pas été blessée.
target_text: Nina hakika nina furaha kuwa hukuumizwa.
target_text_raw: Nina hakika nina furaha kuwa hukuumizwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va sans dire que Thomas est amoureux de Catherine.
target_text: Ni bila kusema kwamba Thomas anapenda na Catherine.
target_text_raw: Ni bila kusema kwamba Thomas anapenda na Catherine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce qu'il a dit était concis et précis.
target_text: Alichosema ni mafupi na kwa uhakika.
target_text_raw: Alichosema ni mafupi na kwa uhakika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un vague souvenir.
target_text: Nina kumbukumbu isiyo wazi.
target_text_raw: Nina kumbukumbu isiyo wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Allemands sont des êtres inférieurs qui ont la chance d’être nos voisins ; nous leur donnerons nos lumières.
target_text: Wajerumani ni viumbe duni ambao wana bahati ya kuwa majirani zetu; tutawapa taa zetu.
target_text_raw: Wajerumani ni viumbe duni ambao wana bahati ya kuwa majirani zetu; tutawapa taa zetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vis et travaille au Mexique.
target_text: Ninaishi na kufanya kazi Mexico.
target_text_raw: Ninaishi na kufanya kazi Mexico.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Repose en paix !
target_text: Pumzika kwa amani!
target_text_raw: Pumzika kwa amani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as additionné tous les chiffres.
target_text: Umeongeza nambari zote.
target_text_raw: Umeongeza nambari zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ignore carrément mon existence.
target_text: Anapuuza kabisa uwepo wangu.
target_text_raw: Anapuuza kabisa uwepo wangu.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Posez le livre sur l'étagère du bas.
target_text: Weka kitabu kwenye rafu ya chini.
target_text_raw: Weka kitabu kwenye rafu ya chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a eu une bagarre ?
target_text: Kulikuwa na vita?
target_text_raw: Kulikuwa na vita?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas être lié à une seule entreprise.
target_text: Sitaki kufungwa kwa kampuni moja tu.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kufungwa kwa kampuni moja tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les images choquantes d'Abou Ghraib étaient destinées à banaliser la torture.
target_text: Picha za kushangaza za Abu Ghraib zilikusudiwa kupunguza mateso.
target_text_raw: Picha za kushangaza za Abu Ghraib zilikusudiwa kupunguza mateso.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'en sommes pas entièrement sûrs.
target_text: Hatuna uhakika kabisa.
target_text_raw: Hatuna uhakika kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'en sortira très bien.
target_text: Atafanya vizuri sana.
target_text_raw: Atafanya vizuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En voyant ces larmes sur ton visage, j'ai l'impression de voir une belle rose ponctuée de gouttelettes de rosée... Tu es belle, Marika.
target_text: Kuona machozi haya usoni mwako, nina maoni ya kuona rose nzuri imechomwa na matone ya umande .. Wewe ni mrembo, Marika.
target_text_raw: Kuona machozi haya usoni mwako, nina maoni ya kuona rose nzuri imechomwa na matone ya umande .. Wewe ni mrembo, Marika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que je lui ai brisé le cœur.
target_text: Nadhani nilivunja moyo wake.
target_text_raw: Nadhani nilivunja moyo wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en tremble encore ! J'ai cru avoir une crise cardiaque.
target_text: Bado natetemeka! Nilidhani nilikuwa na mshtuko wa moyo.
target_text_raw: Bado natetemeka! Nilidhani nilikuwa na mshtuko wa moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma seule distraction est le jeu de go.
target_text: Usumbufu wangu tu ni mchezo wa kwenda.
target_text_raw: Usumbufu wangu tu ni mchezo wa kwenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment puis-je me rendre au stade ?
target_text: Ninawezaje kufika uwanjani?
target_text_raw: Ninawezaje kufika uwanjani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le vieil homme a été renversé et immédiatement emmené à l'hôpital.
target_text: Mzee huyo alikimbiwa na mara moja akapelekwa hospitalini.
target_text_raw: Mzee huyo alikimbiwa na mara moja akapelekwa hospitalini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je réfléchis à démissionner.
target_text: Ninafikiria kujiuzulu.
target_text_raw: Ninafikiria kujiuzulu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils montrent leurs billets de saison au chauffeur d'autobus ou achètent des billets.
target_text: Wanaonyesha tikiti zao za msimu kwa dereva wa basi au kununua tikiti.
target_text_raw: Wanaonyesha tikiti zao za msimu kwa dereva wa basi au kununua tikiti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pleuré sur son épaule.
target_text: Nililia begani mwake.
target_text_raw: Nililia begani mwake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: T'as pigé ?
target_text: Unasadiki?
target_text_raw: Unasadiki?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Leur habitat est menacé par la déforestation.
target_text: Makao yao yanatishiwa na ukataji miti.
target_text_raw: Makao yao yanatishiwa na ukataji miti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le démon détruisit Hiroshima et Nagasaki.
target_text: Pepo aliharibu Hiroshima na Nagasaki.
target_text_raw: Pepo aliharibu Hiroshima na Nagasaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une de mes dents de sagesse pousse.
target_text: Moja ya meno yangu ya hekima yanakua.
target_text_raw: Moja ya meno yangu ya hekima yanakua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je supporte entièrement Mathéo.
target_text: Ninaunga mkono kikamilifu Mathéo.
target_text_raw: Ninaunga mkono kikamilifu Mathéo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La troisième et plus importante idée est la rentrée.
target_text: Wazo la tatu na muhimu zaidi ni kurudi shuleni.
target_text_raw: Wazo la tatu na muhimu zaidi ni kurudi shuleni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelque chose dans cette maison l'a fait s'arrêter et l'examiner de nouveau.
target_text: Kitu ndani ya nyumba hii kilimfanya asimame na kumchunguza tena.
target_text_raw: Kitu ndani ya nyumba hii kilimfanya asimame na kumchunguza tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous lui faites du mal, je vous couperai les couilles.
target_text: Ikiwa utamuumiza, nitakata mipira yako.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa utamuumiza, nitakata mipira yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le foyer national des Palestiniens est la Palestine, et même les Palestiniens ont un droit de retour.
target_text: Nyumba ya kitaifa ya Wapalestina ni Palestina, na hata Wapalestina wana haki ya kurudi.
target_text_raw: Nyumba ya kitaifa ya Wapalestina ni Palestina, na hata Wapalestina wana haki ya kurudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan avait un garage plein de voitures de collection.
target_text: Dan alikuwa na karakana iliyojaa magari ya zabibu.
target_text_raw: Dan alikuwa na karakana iliyojaa magari ya zabibu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est extrêmement patiente.
target_text: Yeye ni mvumilivu sana.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mvumilivu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous trouverez ces articles partout.
target_text: Utapata makala hizi kila mahali.
target_text_raw: Utapata makala hizi kila mahali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est cette mignonne fille avec laquelle je vous ai vues à la galerie commerciale ?
target_text: Huyu msichana mzuri niliyekuona naye kwenye duka ni nani?
target_text_raw: Huyu msichana mzuri niliyekuona naye kwenye duka ni nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La nourriture lourde lui a retourné l'estomac.
target_text: Chakula kizito kiligeuza tumbo lake kichwa chini.
target_text_raw: Chakula kizito kiligeuza tumbo lake kichwa chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui, tu peux fêter tout ce que tu veux.
target_text: Ndio, unaweza kusherehekea chochote unachotaka.
target_text_raw: Ndio, unaweza kusherehekea chochote unachotaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je deviens gros.
target_text: Mi nanenepa.
target_text_raw: Mi nanenepa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voulez-vous réellement que cette information soit rendue publique ?
target_text: Je! Kweli unataka habari hii iwekwe hadharani?
target_text_raw: Je! Kweli unataka habari hii iwekwe hadharani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es notre invitée pour la semaine.
target_text: Wewe ni mgeni wetu kwa wiki.
target_text_raw: Wewe ni mgeni wetu kwa wiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintiens le cap.
target_text: Kaa kozi.
target_text_raw: Kaa kozi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où est parti ton bien-aimé, ô la plus belle des femmes ? Où s'est tourné ton bien-aimé, que nous le cherchions avec toi ?
target_text: Mpendwa wako ameenda wapi, Ee msichana mzuri zaidi? Mpendwa wako amegeukia wapi, kwamba tumtafute pamoja nawe?
target_text_raw: Mpendwa wako ameenda wapi, Ee msichana mzuri zaidi? Mpendwa wako amegeukia wapi, kwamba tumtafute pamoja nawe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma vie est finie !
target_text: Maisha yangu yamekwisha!
target_text_raw: Maisha yangu yamekwisha!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'accompagne des jeunes dans leur insertion professionnelle.
target_text: Ninaunga mkono vijana katika ujumuishaji wao wa kitaalam.
target_text_raw: Ninaunga mkono vijana katika ujumuishaji wao wa kitaalam.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu prêtes de l'argent à Robert, tu peux faire une croix dessus !
target_text: Ikiwa utamkopesha Robert pesa, unaweza kutoa!
target_text_raw: Ikiwa utamkopesha Robert pesa, unaweza kutoa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai trouvé le livre facilement malgré le fait qu'il faisait sombre dans la pièce.
target_text: Nilipata kitabu hicho kwa urahisi licha ya ukweli kwamba kulikuwa na giza ndani ya chumba.
target_text_raw: Nilipata kitabu hicho kwa urahisi licha ya ukweli kwamba kulikuwa na giza ndani ya chumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le général passa les troupes en revue.
target_text: Jenerali huyo alipitia tena vikosi.
target_text_raw: Jenerali huyo alipitia tena vikosi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pensons qu'ils nous connaissent.
target_text: Tunadhani wanatujua.
target_text_raw: Tunadhani wanatujua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si tu cherches Jules, il n'est pas ici.
target_text: Ikiwa unatafuta Jules, hayupo hapa.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa unatafuta Jules, hayupo hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je travaille en tant qu'assistante de M. Eliot.
target_text: Ninafanya kazi kama msaidizi wa Bwana Eliot.
target_text_raw: Ninafanya kazi kama msaidizi wa Bwana Eliot.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Là, tu me donnes une bonne raison pour t'envoyer à l'hôpital.
target_text: Huko, unanipa sababu nzuri ya kukupeleka hospitalini.
target_text_raw: Huko, unanipa sababu nzuri ya kukupeleka hospitalini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voudrais-tu bien éloigner cette chose ?
target_text: Je! Ungependa kuchukua kitu hicho?
target_text_raw: Je! Ungependa kuchukua kitu hicho?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une brave fille.
target_text: Yeye ni msichana mzuri.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni msichana mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allons faire des tests.
target_text: Tutafanya vipimo kadhaa.
target_text_raw: Tutafanya vipimo kadhaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jour où le Royaume-Uni quittera l'Union Européenne, je boirai le meilleur champagne, jusqu'à ce que je ne tienne plus debout.
target_text: Siku ambayo Uingereza itaondoka kwenye Jumuiya ya Ulaya, nitakunywa champagne bora, hadi siwezi kuhimili tena.
target_text_raw: Siku ambayo Uingereza itaondoka kwenye Jumuiya ya Ulaya, nitakunywa champagne bora, hadi siwezi kuhimili tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sais-tu que ton vaisseau spatial stationnait de manière illicite en orbite autour de Saturne ?
target_text: Je! Unajua kwamba chombo chako cha angani kilikuwa kikizunguka isivyo halali katika obiti karibu na Saturn?
target_text_raw: Je! Unajua kwamba chombo chako cha angani kilikuwa kikizunguka isivyo halali katika obiti karibu na Saturn?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être que ce monde est l'Enfer d'une autre planète.
target_text: Labda ulimwengu huu ni Jehanamu ya sayari nyingine.
target_text_raw: Labda ulimwengu huu ni Jehanamu ya sayari nyingine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous supplie de me laisser vivre !
target_text: Ninakuomba uniruhusu niishi!
target_text_raw: Ninakuomba uniruhusu niishi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment se fait-il que les mecs que je veux ne veulent jamais de moi ?
target_text: Inakuaje wavulana ninaowataka hawanitaki kamwe?
target_text_raw: Inakuaje wavulana ninaowataka hawanitaki kamwe?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait taper cette lettre par mon secrétaire.
target_text: Niliandikiwa barua hii na katibu wangu.
target_text_raw: Niliandikiwa barua hii na katibu wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne les vérifie pas.
target_text: Siziangalii.
target_text_raw: Siziangalii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout individu qui séjourne légitimement sur le territoire de la Hongrie dispose du droit à la liberté de mouvement et au libre choix de son lieu de séjour.
target_text: Mtu yeyote ambaye anaishi kihalali katika eneo la Hungary ana haki ya uhuru wa kusafiri na chaguo la bure la makazi yake.
target_text_raw: Mtu yeyote ambaye anaishi kihalali katika eneo la Hungary ana haki ya uhuru wa kusafiri na chaguo la bure la makazi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec un grand pouvoir viennent de grandes responsabilités.
target_text: Kwa nguvu kubwa kuja jukumu kubwa.
target_text_raw: Kwa nguvu kubwa kuja jukumu kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai cherché partout mais je ne trouve pas mon portefeuille.
target_text: Nimetafuta kila mahali lakini siwezi kupata mkoba wangu.
target_text_raw: Nimetafuta kila mahali lakini siwezi kupata mkoba wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'as pas envie d'emmener ta famille au cinéma ?
target_text: Je! Hutaki kupeleka familia yako kwenye sinema?
target_text_raw: Je! Hutaki kupeleka familia yako kwenye sinema?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que je peux vous déranger ?
target_text: Je! Ninaweza kukusumbua?
target_text_raw: Je! Ninaweza kukusumbua?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La procédure de vote doit être achevée endéans deux jours consécutifs.
target_text: Utaratibu wa kupiga kura lazima ukamilike ndani ya siku mbili mfululizo.
target_text_raw: Utaratibu wa kupiga kura lazima ukamilike ndani ya siku mbili mfululizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les fruits d'un pommier sont forcément rouges.
target_text: Matunda ya mti wa pome ni nyekundu.
target_text_raw: Matunda ya mti wa pome ni nyekundu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: "A" est cinq fois plus long que "B".
target_text: «A» ni zaidi ya mara tano kuliko «B».
target_text_raw: «A» ni zaidi ya mara tano kuliko «B».
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami fournit un alibi à la police.
target_text: Sami hutoa alibi kwa polisi.
target_text_raw: Sami hutoa alibi kwa polisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a été enterrée vivante.
target_text: Alizikwa akiwa hai.
target_text_raw: Alizikwa akiwa hai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça ne marchera jamais entre nous.
target_text: Haitawahi kufanya kazi kati yetu.
target_text_raw: Haitawahi kufanya kazi kati yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce fut un combat ardu.
target_text: Ilikuwa vita ya kupanda.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa vita ya kupanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était une sacrée expérience.
target_text: Ilikuwa ni uzoefu kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa ni uzoefu kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me rappelez plus jamais !
target_text: Kamwe usinipigie simu tena!
target_text_raw: Kamwe usinipigie simu tena!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous pouvons le livrer ce soir.
target_text: Tunaweza kuipeleka usiku wa leo.
target_text_raw: Tunaweza kuipeleka usiku wa leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Raphaël est respecté dans la communauté des affaires parce qu'il est toujours juste et honnête dans ses rapports avec les autres.
target_text: Raphaël anaheshimiwa katika jamii ya wafanyabiashara kwa sababu yeye huwa mwadilifu na mwaminifu katika shughuli zake na wengine.
target_text_raw: Raphaël anaheshimiwa katika jamii ya wafanyabiashara kwa sababu yeye huwa mwadilifu na mwaminifu katika shughuli zake na wengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous étiez blessés, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Uliumizwa, sivyo?
target_text_raw: Uliumizwa, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arthur a monté la colline.
target_text: Arthur alitembea juu ya kilima.
target_text_raw: Arthur alitembea juu ya kilima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton chat me rend dingue.
target_text: Paka wako ananiendesha wazimu.
target_text_raw: Paka wako ananiendesha wazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noble dame, dit-il, daignez me permettre d’oser déposer à vos pieds un précieux message de sa grâce, votre illustre époux.
target_text: Alisema mwanamke mzuri, niruhusu nithubutu kuweka miguuni kwako ujumbe wa thamani wa neema yake, mume wako mashuhuri.
target_text_raw: Alisema mwanamke mzuri, niruhusu nithubutu kuweka miguuni kwako ujumbe wa thamani wa neema yake, mume wako mashuhuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La gloire n’est qu’une fausse monnaie contre laquelle nous sacrifions aux autres notre propre bonheur.
target_text: Utukufu ni sarafu bandia tu ambayo tunatoa furaha yetu wenyewe kwa wengine.
target_text_raw: Utukufu ni sarafu bandia tu ambayo tunatoa furaha yetu wenyewe kwa wengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment vous êtes-vous procuré une photo de moi à poil ?
target_text: Umepataje picha yangu uchi?
target_text_raw: Umepataje picha yangu uchi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle voulait des preuves.
target_text: Alitaka uthibitisho.
target_text_raw: Alitaka uthibitisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les rats quittent le navire qui coule.
target_text: Panya wanaacha meli inayozama.
target_text_raw: Panya wanaacha meli inayozama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Afin de conserver l'eau tout au long de l'année, ils creusèrent, en leur pays, un réseau de canaux, long de plusieurs milliers de milles.
target_text: Ili kuhifadhi maji kwa mwaka mzima, walichimba mtandao wa mifereji nchini mwao, wenye urefu wa maili elfu kadhaa.
target_text_raw: Ili kuhifadhi maji kwa mwaka mzima, walichimba mtandao wa mifereji nchini mwao, wenye urefu wa maili elfu kadhaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je promets que je passerai le sol à la serpillère, demain matin.
target_text: Ninaahidi nitapiga sakafu kesho asubuhi.
target_text_raw: Ninaahidi nitapiga sakafu kesho asubuhi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui, vous pourriez avoir raison.
target_text: Ndio, unaweza kuwa sahihi.
target_text_raw: Ndio, unaweza kuwa sahihi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Louis avait l'air inquiet.
target_text: Louis alionekana kuwa na wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Louis alionekana kuwa na wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis armé.
target_text: Nina silaha.
target_text_raw: Nina silaha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devons profiter de l'occasion.
target_text: Lazima tuchukue fursa.
target_text_raw: Lazima tuchukue fursa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est revenue rapidement.
target_text: Alirudi haraka.
target_text_raw: Alirudi haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Cet appartement est très beau et grand : quatre pièces, cuisine et salle de bains. » « Est-il aussi vraiment calme ? »

target_text_raw: Ulimpata wapi? Shuleni au nyumbani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous accorda un entretien.
target_text: Alitupa mahojiano.
target_text_raw: Alitupa mahojiano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela ne vous gêne pas que je remette droites les fleurs de votre corsage qui ont été déplacées par le choc. J'ai peur que vous ne les perdiez.
target_text: Haijalishi ikiwa nitaweka moja kwa moja maua kwenye bodice yako ambayo yamehamishwa na mshtuko. Ninaogopa utawapoteza.
target_text_raw: Haijalishi ikiwa nitaweka moja kwa moja maua kwenye bodice yako ambayo yamehamishwa na mshtuko. Ninaogopa utawapoteza.

source_text: Ce livre t'aidera à écrire de manière efficace.

target_text_raw: Kitabu hiki kitakusaidia kuandika vyema.

source_text: Le corps de Sami a été partiellement brûlé avec de l'essence.
target_text: Mwili wa Sami uliteketezwa kwa sehemu na petroli.
target_text_raw: Mwili wa Sami uliteketezwa kwa sehemu na petroli.

source_text: Le ciel devenait de plus en plus sombre et le vent de plus en plus violent.
target_text: Anga lilikuwa linazidi kuwa nyeusi na giza na upepo ulizidi kuwa mkali.
target_text_raw: Anga lilikuwa linazidi kuwa nyeusi na giza na upepo ulizidi kuwa mkali.

source_text: Demande à un agent de police !

target_text_raw: Uliza afisa wa polisi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a une excellente mémoire, elle se souvient de tout.
target_text: Marie ana kumbukumbu nzuri, anakumbuka kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Marie ana kumbukumbu nzuri, anakumbuka kila kitu.

target_text_raw: Magaidi waliwaachilia mateka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant, regarder dans la rue, les gens qui parlent seuls, ça m’énerve.
target_text: Sasa, kuangalia watu mitaani wakiongea peke yao, hilo hunikasirisha.
target_text_raw: Sasa, kuangalia watu mitaani wakiongea peke yao, hilo hunikasirisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'achèterai tous les vêtements que tu voudras.
target_text: Nitakununulia nguo zote unazotaka.
target_text_raw: Nitakununulia nguo zote unazotaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles ont sauté dans l'eau.
target_text: Waliruka ndani ya maji.
target_text_raw: Waliruka ndani ya maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant que vous avez fini votre travail, vous êtes libre de repartir chez vous.
target_text: Sasa kwa kuwa umemaliza kazi yako, uko huru kwenda nyumbani.
target_text_raw: Sasa kwa kuwa umemaliza kazi yako, uko huru kwenda nyumbani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les hommes trouvent que les femmes seraient souvent très compliquées.
target_text: Wanaume hugundua kuwa wanawake mara nyingi wangekuwa ngumu sana.
target_text_raw: Wanaume hugundua kuwa wanawake mara nyingi wangekuwa ngumu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand il tenta de s'échapper, le bandit tua quatre otages.
target_text: Alipojaribu kutoroka, jambazi huyo aliua mateka wanne.
target_text_raw: Alipojaribu kutoroka, jambazi huyo aliua mateka wanne.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne ferez pas changer Timéo d'avis.
target_text: Hutabadilisha mawazo ya Timéo.
target_text_raw: Hutabadilisha mawazo ya Timéo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment est-ce que je me décide à son propos ? L'engager ?
target_text: Je! Ninaamuaje juu yangu? Kuajiri?
target_text_raw: Je! Ninaamuaje juu yangu? Kuajiri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a eu des intérêts grâce à l'argent qui restait dans le livret de caisse d'épargne.
target_text: Kulikuwa na riba juu ya pesa ambazo zilibaki kwenye kitabu cha benki ya akiba.
target_text_raw: Kulikuwa na riba juu ya pesa ambazo zilibaki kwenye kitabu cha benki ya akiba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le secrétaire demande une promotion.
target_text: Katibu anauliza kupandishwa cheo.
target_text_raw: Katibu anauliza kupandishwa cheo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il fut assez malin pour accepter son conseil.
target_text: Alikuwa mwerevu wa kutosha kuchukua ushauri wake.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa mwerevu wa kutosha kuchukua ushauri wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis sure que notre équipé gagnera.
target_text: Nina hakika timu yetu itashinda.
target_text_raw: Nina hakika timu yetu itashinda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laissez, ne vous inquiétez pas.
target_text: Ondoka, usijali.
target_text_raw: Ondoka, usijali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si nous ne créons pas d'opportunités pour tous, le mécontentement et la division qui ont retardé notre progression ne s'amélioreront que dans les années à venir.
target_text: Ikiwa hatutaunda fursa kwa wote, kutoridhika na mgawanyiko ambao ume rudisha nyuma maendeleo yetu utaboresha tu katika miaka ijayo.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa hatutaunda fursa kwa wote, kutoridhika na mgawanyiko ambao ume rudisha nyuma maendeleo yetu utaboresha tu katika miaka ijayo.

source_text: Manger du foie est-il bon pour toi ?
target_text: Je! Kula ini ni bora kwako?
target_text_raw: Je! Kula ini ni bora kwako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je voulais aider Nathan à comprendre ce que Marie essayait de lui dire.
target_text: Nilitaka kumsaidia Nathan kugundua kile Marie alikuwa anajaribu kumwambia.
target_text_raw: Nilitaka kumsaidia Nathan kugundua kile Marie alikuwa anajaribu kumwambia.

source_text: Dites ce que vous pensez.

target_text_raw: Sema unachofikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sous ton poids, la glace va se rompre.
target_text: Chini ya uzito wako, barafu itavunjika.
target_text_raw: Chini ya uzito wako, barafu itavunjika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crains que tu ne puisses pas faire cela.
target_text: Ninaogopa huwezi kufanya hivi.
target_text_raw: Ninaogopa huwezi kufanya hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aime la vérité, mais pardonne l'erreur.

target_text_raw: Penda ukweli, lakini usamehe makosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Usijifiche.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Mwanadamu anapaswa kuwa na wasiwasi juu yake mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Mwanadamu anapaswa kuwa na wasiwasi juu yake mwenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle me demanda combien de langues je parlais.

target_text_raw: Aliniuliza niliongea lugha ngapi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À notre époque du politiquement correct, être un habile faux-cul est davantage toléré qu'être franc.
target_text: Katika zama zetu za usahihi wa kisiasa, kuwa punda mjanja kunavumiliwa kuliko kuongea.
target_text_raw: Katika zama zetu za usahihi wa kisiasa, kuwa punda mjanja kunavumiliwa kuliko kuongea.

target_text_raw: Tunazungumza mengi.

source_text: L'accusé a assassiné son voisin avec préméditation.
target_text: Mtuhumiwa alimuua jirani yake kwa mpango.
target_text_raw: Mtuhumiwa alimuua jirani yake kwa mpango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Anaandaa sanduku lake kwenda safari.

target_text_raw: Anasafisha kabati lake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Noah et Louise ont rejoint le groupe.
target_text: Noah na Louise walijiunga na kikundi hicho.
target_text_raw: Noah na Louise walijiunga na kikundi hicho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous assure que je vais très bien.
target_text: Ninawahakikishia kuwa mimi ni mzima sana.
target_text_raw: Ninawahakikishia kuwa mimi ni mzima sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a consacré sa vie entière à l'étude de la physique.
target_text: Alijitolea maisha yake yote kwenye masomo ya fizikia.
target_text_raw: Alijitolea maisha yake yote kwenye masomo ya fizikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Je! Unatoka umevaa nguo hizi? Sio baridi!

source_text: Mon passe-temps est la collection de pièces anciennes.

target_text_raw: Minazoweya kupitisha wakati kukusanya sarafu za zamani.

target_text_raw: Binafsi, nadhani uko sawa.

source_text: À la campagne, les couleurs du ciel et du feuillage sont entièrement différentes de celles qu'on voit en ville.

target_text_raw: Vijijini, rangi za anga na majani ni tofauti kabisa na zile zinazoonekana jijini.

target_text_raw: Jack ana paka na kasuku nyumbani kwake.

source_text: C'est impressionnant la taille de sa tête.

target_text_raw: Inavutia saizi ya kichwa chake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Depuis qu'il y a un nouveau chef ici, ça ne rigole plus.

target_text_raw: Kwa kuwa hapa kuna mpishi mpya, haicheki tena.

source_text: Si tu changeais ta coupe de cheveux, tu pourrais paraître dix ans plus jeune.

target_text_raw: Ikiwa umebadilisha mtindo wako wa nywele, unaweza kuonekana mdogo kwa miaka kumi.

target_text_raw: Atajua siri hii mapema au baadaye.

source_text: Spoutnik fut lancé le quatre octobre mille-neuf-cent-cinquante-sept.

target_text_raw: Sputnik ilizinduliwa mnamo nne wa Oktoba kumi na tisa na hamsini na saba.

target_text_raw: Ni sawa, ni jihadi ya media tu: wanapunguza tu watu wasio na hatia.

target_text_raw: «Je! Ninaweza kukuhudumia?» «Ndio, tafadhali.»

target_text_raw: Marafiki zangu, ni wakati wa mimi kwenda.

target_text: Anahisi kutokuwa na usalama sana juu ya Mfaransa wake, licha ya madai yake kuwa mzungumzaji wa Kifaransa asilia, hivi kwamba kila wakati anapaswa kuandika ufafanuzi mgumu kidogo, anafanya kwa Kiingereza.

target_text_raw: Ninauza nguo mkondoni.

source_text: Combien de comtés y a-t-il en Floride ?
target_text: Kuna kata ngapi huko Florida?
target_text_raw: Kuna kata ngapi huko Florida?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Deux têtes valent mieux qu'une.

target_text_raw: Vichwa viwili ni bora kuliko moja.

source_text: " Dieux paternels ! dit-il, c'en est fait, je me rends ; / protégez ma famille, et sauvez mes enfants ! / J'accepte avec transport ce présage céleste. / Dieux puissants ! d'Ilion vous sauverez le reste. / Viens, mon fils, je te suis. "
target_text: «Baba miungu!» Alisema, «imekwisha, ninajisalimisha; / linda familia yangu, na kuokoa watoto wangu! / Ninakubali ishara hii ya mbinguni na usafiri. / Miungu wenye nguvu! Kutoka kwa Ilion utaokoa iliyobaki. / Njoo, mwanangu, nakufuata.»

source_text: Le mariage est une communauté composée d'un maître, d'une maîtresse et de deux esclaves, ce qui fait en tout deux personnes.
target_text: Ndoa ni jamii inayoundwa na bwana, bibi na watumwa wawili, ambayo kwa jumla hufanya watu wawili.
