source_text: Allez, raboule le fric.
target_text: Haya, zungusha pesa.
target_text_raw: Haya, zungusha pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On dit qu'il a des tas de vielles monnaies.
target_text: Wanasema ana sarafu nyingi za zamani.
target_text_raw: Wanasema ana sarafu nyingi za zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas sûre de son sexe.
target_text: Sina hakika ya jinsia yake.
target_text_raw: Sina hakika ya jinsia yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel a l'air sympa.
target_text: Gabriel anaonekana mzuri.
target_text_raw: Gabriel anaonekana mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La semaine prochaine, je pars en vacances.
target_text: Wiki ijayo ninaenda likizo.
target_text_raw: Wiki ijayo ninaenda likizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quoi pensait-elle, bordel ?
target_text: Je! Alikuwa akifikiria nini?
target_text_raw: Je! Alikuwa akifikiria nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui oui, on verra !
target_text: Ndio ndio, tutaona!
target_text_raw: Ndio ndio, tutaona!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Venez et apprenez, - partez et enseignez!
target_text: Njoo ujifunze, - nenda ukafundishe!
target_text_raw: Njoo ujifunze, - nenda ukafundishe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: André sentit un moment que son intervention frisait le ridicule, la chose qu’il craignait le plus au monde.
target_text: Andre alihisi kwa muda kwamba uingiliaji wake ulipakana na kejeli, jambo ambalo aliogopa sana ulimwenguni.
target_text_raw: Andre alihisi kwa muda kwamba uingiliaji wake ulipakana na kejeli, jambo ambalo aliogopa sana ulimwenguni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je savais que je devais le faire.
target_text: Nilijua lazima nifanye.
target_text_raw: Nilijua lazima nifanye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une mission pour vous.
target_text: Nina dhamira kwako.
target_text_raw: Nina dhamira kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qu'il raconte comme conneries encore ?
target_text: Anasema nini tena?
target_text_raw: Anasema nini tena?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande comment ça ferait d'être une femme.
target_text: Nashangaa itakuwaje kuwa mwanamke.
target_text_raw: Nashangaa itakuwaje kuwa mwanamke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui les fait, et qu'y a-t'il dedans ?
target_text: Ni nani anayewafanya, na ni nini ndani yao?
target_text_raw: Ni nani anayewafanya, na ni nini ndani yao?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle ne pourra pas venir demain.
target_text: Hataweza kuja kesho.
target_text_raw: Hataweza kuja kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est dotée d'un talent spécial.
target_text: Ana talanta maalum.
target_text_raw: Ana talanta maalum.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai une vidéo sur Youtube.
target_text: Nina video kwenye Youtube.
target_text_raw: Nina video kwenye Youtube.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Paul est allé chercher Paul, et voilà que lui non plus ne revient pas.
target_text: Paulo alienda kumchukua Paulo, naye hakurudi pia.
target_text_raw: Paulo alienda kumchukua Paulo, naye hakurudi pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oui. C'est exact.
target_text: Ndio. Hiyo ni sawa.
target_text_raw: Ndio. Hiyo ni sawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vapoter tue.
target_text: Kuvuta sigara ya power inaua.
target_text_raw: Kuvuta sigara ya power inaua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le bar Zailaiba embauche des serveurs ; es-tu intéressé ?
target_text: Zailaiba huajiri wahudumu; una nia?
target_text_raw: Zailaiba huajiri wahudumu; una nia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il croit pouvoir le prouver.
target_text: Anadhani anaweza kudhibitisha.
target_text_raw: Anadhani anaweza kudhibitisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le gamin a bondi hors du lit.
target_text: Mtoto akaruka kutoka kitandani.
target_text_raw: Mtoto akaruka kutoka kitandani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En répondant à ma question, il fit preuve de remarquables capacités mémorielles.
target_text: Katika kujibu swali langu, alionyesha uwezo mzuri wa kumbukumbu.
target_text_raw: Katika kujibu swali langu, alionyesha uwezo mzuri wa kumbukumbu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut remettre les perroquets sur les bonnes épaules.
target_text: Lazima tuwarudishe kasuku kwenye mabega ya kulia.
target_text_raw: Lazima tuwarudishe kasuku kwenye mabega ya kulia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vous laisserai pas détruire ça.
target_text: Sitakuruhusu uharibu hii.
target_text_raw: Sitakuruhusu uharibu hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est tombé malade puis il a retrouvé sa santé.
target_text: Aliugua kisha akapona afya yake.
target_text_raw: Aliugua kisha akapona afya yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois te rappeler à ta promesse.
target_text: Lazima nikukumbushe ahadi yako.
target_text_raw: Lazima nikukumbushe ahadi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas m'offrir de longues vacances.
target_text: Siwezi kumudu likizo ndefu.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kumudu likizo ndefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne demande pas que ce qui arrive arrive comme tu veux. Mais veuille que les choses arrivent comme elles arrivent, et tu seras heureux.
target_text: Usiulize kile kinachotokea kutokea kama unavyotaka. Lakini tafadhali ruhusu mambo yatendeke kama yanavyotokea, na utafurahi.
target_text_raw: Usiulize kile kinachotokea kutokea kama unavyotaka. Lakini tafadhali ruhusu mambo yatendeke kama yanavyotokea, na utafurahi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis un lâche.
target_text: Mimi ni mwoga.
target_text_raw: Mimi ni mwoga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Êtes-vous Mademoiselle Neusa ?
target_text: Je! Wewe ni Mademoiselle Neusa?
target_text_raw: Je! Wewe ni Mademoiselle Neusa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veux-tu m'épouser ?
target_text: Je! Ungenioa?
target_text_raw: Je! Ungenioa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour ne rien arranger, il se mit à neiger.
target_text: Kibaya zaidi, ilianza theluji.
target_text_raw: Kibaya zaidi, ilianza theluji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On aura à manger toute la semaine avec les restes.
target_text: Tutalazimika kula wiki nzima na mabaki.
target_text_raw: Tutalazimika kula wiki nzima na mabaki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Au cas où tu trouves l'homme, tiens-moi-en, s'il te plait, immédiatement informé.
target_text: Ikiwa utapata mtu huyo, tafadhali nijulishe mara moja.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa utapata mtu huyo, tafadhali nijulishe mara moja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez de bouger.
target_text: Endelea kusonga.
target_text_raw: Endelea kusonga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle vous regardait sans cesse. N'avez-vous pas remarqué ?
target_text: Alikuwa akikutazama kila wakati. Je! Haujaona?
target_text_raw: Alikuwa akikutazama kila wakati. Je! Haujaona?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le couple heureux qui se reconnaît dans l’amour défie l’univers et le temps ; il se suffit, il réalise l’absolu.
target_text: Wanandoa wenye furaha ambao wanajitambua kwa upendo wanapinga ulimwengu na wakati; inatosha, inatambua kabisa.
target_text_raw: Wanandoa wenye furaha ambao wanajitambua kwa upendo wanapinga ulimwengu na wakati; inatosha, inatambua kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aujourd'hui le soleil dégage une chaleur plus printanière.
target_text: Leo jua hutoa joto zaidi la chemchemi.
target_text_raw: Leo jua hutoa joto zaidi la chemchemi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonne année, joyeux Yennayer.
target_text: Heri ya Mwaka Mpya, heri Yennayer.
target_text_raw: Heri ya Mwaka Mpya, heri Yennayer.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous trouvez mon livre, veuillez me l'envoyer.
target_text: Ukipata kitabu changu, tafadhali nitumie.
target_text_raw: Ukipata kitabu changu, tafadhali nitumie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La piste d'atterrissage n'avait pas encore d'éclairage.
target_text: Uwanja wa ndege bado haukuwa na taa.
target_text_raw: Uwanja wa ndege bado haukuwa na taa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez un autre couvert pour notre invité, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Weka mpangilio wa mahali pengine kwa mgeni wetu, tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Weka mpangilio wa mahali pengine kwa mgeni wetu, tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À quelle heure t'es-tu couché hier ?
target_text: Ulienda kulala saa ngapi jana?
target_text_raw: Ulienda kulala saa ngapi jana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous disons qu'il y a un homme sur la Lune mais personne n'y croit vraiment.
target_text: Tunasema kuna mtu kwenye Mwezi lakini hakuna mtu anayemwamini kweli.
target_text_raw: Tunasema kuna mtu kwenye Mwezi lakini hakuna mtu anayemwamini kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les gens sont prêts à mourir pour n'importe quelle idée du moment qu'elle n'est pas tout à fait claire pour eux.
target_text: Watu wako tayari kufa kwa wazo lolote maadamu halieleweki kwao kabisa.
target_text_raw: Watu wako tayari kufa kwa wazo lolote maadamu halieleweki kwao kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne me remercie pas, remercie Gabriel !
target_text: Usinishukuru, asante Gabriel!
target_text_raw: Usinishukuru, asante Gabriel!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouvrez les portes !
target_text: Fungua milango!
target_text_raw: Fungua milango!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas supporter de voir ces types.
target_text: Siwezi kuvumilia kuwaona hawa watu.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kuvumilia kuwaona hawa watu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Évidemment, j'étais très choqué.
target_text: Kwa wazi, nilishtuka sana.
target_text_raw: Kwa wazi, nilishtuka sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jésus et ses disciples ont été conviés à ces noces.
target_text: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walialikwa kwenye harusi hii.
target_text_raw: Yesu na wanafunzi wake walialikwa kwenye harusi hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu pourras me rapporter quelques oranges du supermarché, quand tu t'y rendras ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza kuniletea machungwa kutoka dukani wakati ukifika?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza kuniletea machungwa kutoka dukani wakati ukifika?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'en ai marre de voir vos visages.
target_text: Ninaugua kuona sura zako.
target_text_raw: Ninaugua kuona sura zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faisait les cent pas sur le quai en attendant le train.
target_text: Alikuwa akitembea jukwaani wakati akingojea gari moshi.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa akitembea jukwaani wakati akingojea gari moshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qui t'a amené ici ?
target_text: Nini kilikuleta hapa?
target_text_raw: Nini kilikuleta hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je compte sur toi pour amener la boisson.
target_text: Ninategemea wewe kuleta kinywaji.
target_text_raw: Ninategemea wewe kuleta kinywaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'amène chez Timéo.
target_text: Nitakupeleka Timo.
target_text_raw: Nitakupeleka Timo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de temps avez-vous consacré à effectuer des recherches avant de commencer à écrire ?
target_text: Ulitumia muda gani kufanya utafiti kabla ya kuanza kuandika?
target_text_raw: Ulitumia muda gani kufanya utafiti kabla ya kuanza kuandika?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux que tu appelles chez toi, maintenant.
target_text: Nataka upigie simu nyumbani sasa.
target_text_raw: Nataka upigie simu nyumbani sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Son passe-temps était de collectionner les pièces de monnaie anciennes.
target_text: Alizoweyaka kukusanya sarafu za zamani.
target_text_raw: Alizoweyaka kukusanya sarafu za zamani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pourrai plus jamais vous faire confiance.
target_text: Sitaweza kukuamini tena.
target_text_raw: Sitaweza kukuamini tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens d’avoir une idée formidable.
target_text: Nilikuwa na wazo nzuri tu.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa na wazo nzuri tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Faisons une pause pour boire du thé.
target_text: Wacha tuchukue mapumziko ya chai.
target_text_raw: Wacha tuchukue mapumziko ya chai.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas me permettre d'acheter un si bon appareil photo que le vôtre.
target_text: Siwezi kumudu kununua kamera nzuri kama yako.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kumudu kununua kamera nzuri kama yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le cou dressé, levant une crête sanglante, / de leur tête orgueilleuse ils dominent les eaux ; / le reste au loin se traîne en immenses anneaux.
target_text: Kwa shingo zao zilizosimama, wakiinua mwili wa damu, / na vichwa vyao vya kiburi wanatawala maji; / wengine kwa umbali hutambaa kwa pete kubwa.
target_text_raw: Kwa shingo zao zilizosimama, wakiinua mwili wa damu, / na vichwa vyao vya kiburi wanatawala maji; / wengine kwa umbali hutambaa kwa pete kubwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle va reprendre l'affaire de son père.
target_text: Atachukua biashara ya baba yake.
target_text_raw: Atachukua biashara ya baba yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux des gardes postés ici et je les veux maintenant !
target_text: Ninataka walinzi waliowekwa hapa na ninawataka sasa!
target_text_raw: Ninataka walinzi waliowekwa hapa na ninawataka sasa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Je vous en prie, je ne vous demande jamais rien. » « C'est faux. Vous me demandez tout le temps des trucs. »
target_text: «Tafadhali, sikuwahi kukuuliza chochote.» «Ni makosa. Unaniuliza vitu kila wakati.»
target_text_raw: «Tafadhali, sikuwahi kukuuliza chochote.» «Ni makosa. Unaniuliza vitu kila wakati.»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les pistolets d'or ne protègent pas des balles.
target_text: Bastola za dhahabu hazilindi kutoka kwa risasi.
target_text_raw: Bastola za dhahabu hazilindi kutoka kwa risasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'amour est un événement mondial privé.
target_text: Upendo ni tukio la kibinafsi la ulimwengu.
target_text_raw: Upendo ni tukio la kibinafsi la ulimwengu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On doit mettre le nez de cet enquêteur dessus, sans quoi il ne remarquerait même pas les empreintes.
target_text: Lazima tuweke pua ya mchunguzi huyo juu yake ama sivyo hatagundua alama za vidole.
target_text_raw: Lazima tuweke pua ya mchunguzi huyo juu yake ama sivyo hatagundua alama za vidole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi êtes-vous si gentille avec moi ?
target_text: Kwa nini wewe ni mzuri kwangu?
target_text_raw: Kwa nini wewe ni mzuri kwangu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque même les forces manquent, la volonté est d'autant plus louable.
target_text: Wakati hata nguvu inapokosekana, mapenzi yanapongezwa zaidi.
target_text_raw: Wakati hata nguvu inapokosekana, mapenzi yanapongezwa zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Échange.
target_text: Kubadilishana.
target_text_raw: Kubadilishana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa réponse est tout sauf parfaite.
target_text: Jibu lake ni kamili.
target_text_raw: Jibu lake ni kamili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se meurt.
target_text: Anakufa.
target_text_raw: Anakufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si la délégation est en retard, il va falloir modifier le programme.
target_text: Ikiwa ujumbe umechelewa, programu hiyo itabidi ibadilishwe.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa ujumbe umechelewa, programu hiyo itabidi ibadilishwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est ce mignon garçon avec lequel je vous ai vus hier ?
target_text: Huyu kijana mzuri niliyekuona nae ni nani jana?
target_text_raw: Huyu kijana mzuri niliyekuona nae ni nani jana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De l'albumine a déjà été trouvée dans mon urine.
target_text: Albamu tayari imepatikana katika mkojo wangu.
target_text_raw: Albamu tayari imepatikana katika mkojo wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La complexité est souvent un moyen de prétendre à la sophistication ou d'échapper à des vérités simples.
target_text: Utata mara nyingi ni njia ya kudai ustadi au kuepuka ukweli rahisi.
target_text_raw: Utata mara nyingi ni njia ya kudai ustadi au kuepuka ukweli rahisi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous ne semblez pas si malin.
target_text: Hausikii mwenye busara sana.
target_text_raw: Hausikii mwenye busara sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas pour l'enfant !
target_text: Usijali kuhusu mtoto!
target_text_raw: Usijali kuhusu mtoto!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À l’extérieur du Tibet, la situation est différente.
target_text: Nje ya Tibet, hali ni tofauti.
target_text_raw: Nje ya Tibet, hali ni tofauti.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À l'extérieur, des murs plats sans structure régulière et sans ornementation enceignent les temples.
target_text: Nje, kuta za gorofa bila muundo wa kawaida na bila mapambo huzunguka mahekalu.
target_text_raw: Nje, kuta za gorofa bila muundo wa kawaida na bila mapambo huzunguka mahekalu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où se cache Hugo ?
target_text: Hugo amejificha wapi?
target_text_raw: Hugo amejificha wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Maintenant que je suis ici, tu n'as pas à t'inquiéter.
target_text: Sasa kwa kuwa niko hapa haifai kuwa na wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Sasa kwa kuwa niko hapa haifai kuwa na wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parlais de toi.
target_text: Nilikuwa nazungumza juu yako.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nazungumza juu yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne parlons pas de ça devant les enfants.
target_text: Wacha tuzungumze juu ya hili mbele ya watoto.
target_text_raw: Wacha tuzungumze juu ya hili mbele ya watoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le jour suivant, à l'heure du souper, je fus présenté à son époux.

target_text_raw: Siku iliyofuata, wakati wa chakula cha jioni, nilijulishwa kwa mumewe.

source_text: Perds donc l'habitude de te ronger les ongles !

target_text_raw: Kwa hivyo poteza tabia ya kuuma kucha!

target_text_raw: Apana kuatchanisha! Ndivyo ilivyo matako changu.

source_text: Tu as l'air d'avoir vu un fantôme.

target_text_raw: Unaonekana kama umeona mzuka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le typhon n'a heureusement fait aucun dégât.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux me rendre au paradis, mais je ne veux pas mourir pour y parvenir !

target_text_raw: Nataka kwenda Mbinguni, lakini sitaki kufa ili kufika huko!

source_text: Reconnaissant sa responsabilité écologique, le constructeur automobile lance la fabrication de radeaux en série.
target_text: Kutambua jukumu lake la kiikolojia, mtengenezaji wa gari anazindua utengenezaji wa raft mfululizo.

target_text_raw: Inakwenda bila kusema, lakini bado ni bora kusema.

target_text_raw: Samaki kama carpe au truite wanaishi katika maji safi.

target_text_raw: Maadamu uko kimya, utaweza kukaa kwenye chumba hiki.

target_text_raw: Shuka tu jukwaani!

target_text_raw: Usirudie hilo kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je regrette d'avoir fainéanté toute ma jeunesse.

target_text_raw: Ninajuta kuwa wavivu ujana wangu wote.

target_text: Kwenye sebule ya wawindaji ilining'inia nyara nyingi za kulungu, kwa hivyo Mandy mdogo, na tatoo yake mpya katika sura ya antlers, hakuweza kulala usiku kucha.

target_text_raw: «Kesho tutakuwa wangapi?» «Kesho tutakuwa Jumanne Oktoba 24.»

source_text: En raison d'un grand nombre d'appels, nous vous prions de bien vouloir patienter.

target_text_raw: Kwa sababu ya idadi kubwa ya simu, tunakuuliza uwe mvumilivu.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Ninakushauri ujifanye kulala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Mwana wao amekua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec les progrès de la médecine, de plus en plus de gens peuvent espérer un jour être centenaires.

target_text_raw: Pamoja na maendeleo ya dawa, watu zaidi na zaidi wanaweza kutumaini siku moja kuwa na umri wa miaka 100.

source_text: Deux couples de petites mésanges à ventre jaune visitent quotidiennement mon jardin.

target_text_raw: Walikuwa wamehoji makumi ya mashahidi bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es fatiguée, ce matin. Tu n'as pas suffisamment dormi la nuit dernière ?

target_text_raw: Umechoka asubuhi ya leo. Je! Haukupata usingizi wa kutosha jana usiku?

target_text: Utawala huko Ufaransa katika karne ya 17 haukuwa tu ufalme, lakini ufalme kamili, ambapo nguvu tatu za serikali, mtendaji, sheria na mahakama, zilijikita mikononi mwa mtu mmoja, mfalme.

source_text: Adressant donc sa voix à l'aîné des Amours : / " O toi, l'honneur, l'appui, le charme de mes jours, / enfant vainqueur des dieux, souverain de la terre, / de que la flèche insulte aux flèches du tonnerre. "
target_text: Akielekeza sauti yake kwa mkubwa wa Wapenzi: / «Ewe, heshima, msaada, haiba ya siku zangu, / mshindi wa watoto wa miungu, mfalme wa ulimwengu, / ambaye mshale unamtukana mishale ya radi.»

source_text: Cet établissement souffre d'une réputation calamiteuse.
target_text: Uanzishwaji huu unakabiliwa na sifa mbaya.
target_text_raw: Uanzishwaji huu unakabiliwa na sifa mbaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le Secrétaire Général fait une ultime tentative de négociation de traité de paix entre les deux factions en guerre.
target_text: Katibu Mkuu anafanya jaribio la mwisho la kujadili mkataba wa amani kati ya pande hizo mbili zinazopigana.
target_text_raw: Katibu Mkuu anafanya jaribio la mwisho la kujadili mkataba wa amani kati ya pande hizo mbili zinazopigana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il regardait de belles images.
target_text: Alikuwa akiangalia picha nzuri.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa akiangalia picha nzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jules m'a brisé le cœur.
target_text: Jules alivunja moyo wangu.
target_text_raw: Jules alivunja moyo wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va avoir une attaque cardiaque.
target_text: Atapata mshtuko wa moyo.
target_text_raw: Atapata mshtuko wa moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis allé à l'université seulement pour revoir mon ancien prof de français.
target_text: Nilikwenda chuo kikuu ili tu kumwona tena mwalimu wangu wa zamani wa Kifaransa.
target_text_raw: Nilikwenda chuo kikuu ili tu kumwona tena mwalimu wangu wa zamani wa Kifaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut casser la noix pour en obtenir la nourriture.
target_text: Unapaswa kupasua nati ili kupata chakula.
target_text_raw: Unapaswa kupasua nati ili kupata chakula.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sami a été emmené à l'hôpital et ça n'a pas l'air bon.
target_text: Sami alipelekwa hospitalini na haionekani vizuri.
target_text_raw: Sami alipelekwa hospitalini na haionekani vizuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je réfléchis à faire un beau voyage à l'étranger.
target_text: Ninafikiria kuwa na safari nzuri nje ya nchi.
target_text_raw: Ninafikiria kuwa na safari nzuri nje ya nchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un chauffeur dormait dans la voiture.
target_text: Dereva alikuwa amelala ndani ya gari.
target_text_raw: Dereva alikuwa amelala ndani ya gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce grand corps puissant ne demandait qu'à ne rien faire, qu'à se vautrer dans une oisiveté et un assouvissement de toutes les heures.
target_text: Mwili huu mkubwa, wenye nguvu uliuliza tu usifanye chochote, kujigugumia kwa uvivu na kuridhika kila saa.
target_text_raw: Mwili huu mkubwa, wenye nguvu uliuliza tu usifanye chochote, kujigugumia kwa uvivu na kuridhika kila saa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel est le capitaine de cette équipe de baseball.
target_text: Gabriel ndiye nahodha wa timu hii ya baseball.
target_text_raw: Gabriel ndiye nahodha wa timu hii ya baseball.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le démon se saisit de ma sœur et la jeta dans un puits sans fond, avec un ricanement.
target_text: Yule pepo alimshika dada yangu na kumtupa kwenye shimo lisilo na mwisho, kwa kejeli.
target_text_raw: Yule pepo alimshika dada yangu na kumtupa kwenye shimo lisilo na mwisho, kwa kejeli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'argent ne pousse pas dans les arbres, tu sais.
target_text: Pesa hazitokake kwenye miti, unajua.
target_text_raw: Pesa hazitokake kwenye miti, unajua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es rentrée de Chine, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Umerudi kutoka China, sivyo?
target_text_raw: Umerudi kutoka China, sivyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me casses les couilles.
target_text: Unavunja mipira yangu.
target_text_raw: Unavunja mipira yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous voyez la famille Popescu, s'il vous plaît, donnez-lui le bonjour de ma part.
target_text: Ukiona familia ya Popescu, tafadhali wape hodi kwangu.
target_text_raw: Ukiona familia ya Popescu, tafadhali wape hodi kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne deviens pas gros.
target_text: Apana kunenepa.
target_text_raw: Apana kunenepa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est moi qui ai tourné autour du pot.
target_text: Ni mimi ambaye nilizunguka msituni.
target_text_raw: Ni mimi ambaye nilizunguka msituni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un agent secret infiltra l'organisation.
target_text: Wakala wa siri alijipenyeza kwenye shirika.
target_text_raw: Wakala wa siri alijipenyeza kwenye shirika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La guerre n'est pas finie.
target_text: Vita haijaisha.
target_text_raw: Vita haijaisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu cherches un appartement.
target_text: Unatafuta nyumba.
target_text_raw: Unatafuta nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu me donnes la clé?
target_text: Je! Utanipa ufunguo?
target_text_raw: Je! Utanipa ufunguo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne comprends vraiment pas pourquoi vous pensez que c'est une bonne idée.
target_text: Sielewi kwa nini unafikiria hili ni wazo zuri.
target_text_raw: Sielewi kwa nini unafikiria hili ni wazo zuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai fait ma valise, et j'ai préparé mon déménagement.
target_text: Nilipakia sanduku langu, na nikaandaa hoja yangu.
target_text_raw: Nilipakia sanduku langu, na nikaandaa hoja yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous faites pas de soucis !
target_text: Usijali!
target_text_raw: Usijali!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour voir la vraie bonne fin, il faut battre Dracula en ayant équipé les bons objets.
target_text: Ili kuona mwisho mzuri, lazima umpige Dracula kwa kuwa na vifaa vyenye vitu sahihi.
target_text_raw: Ili kuona mwisho mzuri, lazima umpige Dracula kwa kuwa na vifaa vyenye vitu sahihi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ont protesté contre les tests nucléaires fortement et avec insistance.
target_text: Walipinga majaribio ya nyuklia kwa nguvu na kwa msisitizo.
target_text_raw: Walipinga majaribio ya nyuklia kwa nguvu na kwa msisitizo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui a dit que je n'allais pas t'aider?
target_text: Nani Kasema Sitakusaidia?
target_text_raw: Nani Kasema Sitakusaidia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était cool.
target_text: Ilikuwa poa.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa poa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que suis-je supposé faire d'eux ?
target_text: Je! Ninafaa kufanya nini nao?
target_text_raw: Je! Ninafaa kufanya nini nao?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Aidez-moi, je vous en supplie.
target_text: Nisaidie, nakuomba.
target_text_raw: Nisaidie, nakuomba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vérifie la réponse correcte, je te prie.
target_text: Angalia jibu sahihi, tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Angalia jibu sahihi, tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jack a décidé d'annuler sa réservation.
target_text: Jack aliamua kughairi uhifadhi wake.
target_text_raw: Jack aliamua kughairi uhifadhi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'avais pas l'intention de vous déranger.
target_text: Sikukusudia kukusumbua.
target_text_raw: Sikukusudia kukusumbua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Gabriel vote toujours pour l'opposition.
target_text: Gabriel bado anapigia kura upinzani.
target_text_raw: Gabriel bado anapigia kura upinzani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voir des gens qui vous ressemblent, c'est forcément rassurant.
target_text: Kuona watu ambao wako kama wewe ni lazima kutia moyo.
target_text_raw: Kuona watu ambao wako kama wewe ni lazima kutia moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il y a assez de A, mais B est insuffisant.
target_text: Kuna A ya kutosha, lakini B haitoshi.
target_text_raw: Kuna A ya kutosha, lakini B haitoshi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jamais tu ne m'auras vivante !
target_text: Hautakuwa nami kamwe!
target_text_raw: Hautakuwa nami kamwe!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les riches sont différents de vous et moi.
target_text: Matajiri ni tofauti na mimi na wewe.
target_text_raw: Matajiri ni tofauti na mimi na wewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dépêche-toi donc, sacrée flemme !
target_text: Haraka, wavivu jamani!
target_text_raw: Haraka, wavivu jamani!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une fausse couche est une expérience à vous briser le cœur.
target_text: Kuharibika kwa mimba ni uzoefu wa kuumiza moyo.
target_text_raw: Kuharibika kwa mimba ni uzoefu wa kuumiza moyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis à Théo que je vais revenir.
target_text: Mwambie Theo nitarudi.
target_text_raw: Mwambie Theo nitarudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avez-vous eu des rapports avec cette femme ?
target_text: Umeshafanya mapenzi na mwanamke huyu?
target_text_raw: Umeshafanya mapenzi na mwanamke huyu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les Palestiniens ont un foyer national et il s'appelle la Palestine.
target_text: Wapalestina wana nyumba ya kitaifa na inaitwa Palestina.
target_text_raw: Wapalestina wana nyumba ya kitaifa na inaitwa Palestina.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne m'occupe pas très bien de mes enfants.
target_text: Siwajali vizuri watoto wangu.
target_text_raw: Siwajali vizuri watoto wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soleil était déjà assez haut monté sur l'horizon qu'on n'avait fait que deux lieues, des lieues de pays, il est vrai, aussi longues qu'un jour sans pain.
target_text: Jua lilikuwa tayari limejaa juu kabisa kwamba tulikuwa tumesafiri ligi mbili tu, ligi za nchi, ni kweli, kwa muda mrefu kama siku bila mkate.
target_text_raw: Jua lilikuwa tayari limejaa juu kabisa kwamba tulikuwa tumesafiri ligi mbili tu, ligi za nchi, ni kweli, kwa muda mrefu kama siku bila mkate.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est une honte de ne pas tenir votre promesse.
target_text: Ni aibu kutotimiza ahadi yako.
target_text_raw: Ni aibu kutotimiza ahadi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment utiliser un routeur pour limiter le débit réseau ?
target_text: Jinsi ya kutumia routeur kupunguza kasi ya mtandao?
target_text_raw: Jinsi ya kutumia routeur kupunguza kasi ya mtandao?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonsoir !
target_text: Jambo!
target_text_raw: Jambo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Choisis celui que tu préfères.
target_text: Chagua unayopendelea.
target_text_raw: Chagua unayopendelea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dois-je plutôt faire une tarte à la crème ou bien un quatre-quarts ?
target_text: Je! napaswa kutengeneza keki ya custard badala yake au keki ya pauni?
target_text_raw: Je! napaswa kutengeneza keki ya custard badala yake au keki ya pauni?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi Tom est-il inquiet ? Sa mère est malade ?
target_text: Kwa nini Tom ana wasiwasi? Je! Mama yake ni mgonjwa?
target_text_raw: Kwa nini Tom ana wasiwasi? Je! Mama yake ni mgonjwa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois profiter de cette occasion.
target_text: Lazima uchukue fursa hii.
target_text_raw: Lazima uchukue fursa hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis revenue ici.
target_text: Nimerudi hapa.
target_text_raw: Nimerudi hapa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Montez le cheval.
target_text: Panda farasi.
target_text_raw: Panda farasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles ont toutes déménagé ailleurs.
target_text: Wote walihamia mahali pengine.
target_text_raw: Wote walihamia mahali pengine.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'aurai été aimée.
target_text: Nitakuwa nimependwa.
target_text_raw: Nitakuwa nimependwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ici, attrape !
target_text: Hapa, kukamata!
target_text_raw: Hapa, kukamata!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous me connaissez à peine.
target_text: Hauwezi kunijua.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi kunijua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les politiciens ne voient pas les choses sous cet angle.
target_text: Wanasiasa hawaoni hivyo.
target_text_raw: Wanasiasa hawaoni hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il continue à vous menacer, portez plainte.
target_text: Ikiwa anaendelea kukutishia, fungua malalamiko.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa anaendelea kukutishia, fungua malalamiko.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui a un professeur venant du Royaume-Uni ?
target_text: Nani ana mwalimu kutoka Uingereza?
target_text_raw: Nani ana mwalimu kutoka Uingereza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était très sympa de ta part de lui prêter de l'argent.
target_text: Ilikuwa nzuri sana kwako kumkopesha pesa.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa nzuri sana kwako kumkopesha pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pars demain.
target_text: Naondoka kesho.
target_text_raw: Naondoka kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était un bordel dans le grand magasin.
target_text: Ilikuwa fujo katika duka la idara.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa fujo katika duka la idara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les avocats de la défense ont fait appel à leur clémence.
target_text: Mawakili wa utetezi walikata rufaa kwa unyenyekevu wao.
target_text_raw: Mawakili wa utetezi walikata rufaa kwa unyenyekevu wao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Surveille tes paroles !
target_text: Angalia maneno yako!
target_text_raw: Angalia maneno yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je devais contenir ma colère devant lui.
target_text: Ilibidi nizuia hasira yangu mbele yake.
target_text_raw: Ilibidi nizuia hasira yangu mbele yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais te le refaire.
target_text: Nitafanya tena kwa ajili yako.
target_text_raw: Nitafanya tena kwa ajili yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'en ai honnêtement aucune idée.
target_text: Kwa kweli sina wazo.
target_text_raw: Kwa kweli sina wazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pas fait gaffe.
target_text: Sikuangalia.
target_text_raw: Sikuangalia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il crut à la superstition voulant que les Chrétiens aient de l'aversion pour l'étude.
target_text: Aliamini katika ushirikina kwamba Wakristo hawapendi kusoma.
target_text_raw: Aliamini katika ushirikina kwamba Wakristo hawapendi kusoma.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi as-tu accepté cette mission ?
target_text: Kwa nini ulikubali utume huu?
target_text_raw: Kwa nini ulikubali utume huu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas un grand fan de tout ce qui est cuisine asiatique.
target_text: Yeye sio shabiki mkubwa wa vyakula vyote vya Kiasia.
target_text_raw: Yeye sio shabiki mkubwa wa vyakula vyote vya Kiasia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À mon retour, Jenny, je te meublerai ta chambre, et d’une manière soignée.
target_text: Nikirudi, Jenny, nitatoa chumba chako, na kwa nadhifu.
target_text_raw: Nikirudi, Jenny, nitatoa chumba chako, na kwa nadhifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que Ethan ne ferait jamais cela.
target_text: Nadhani Ethan hatafanya hivyo kamwe.
target_text_raw: Nadhani Ethan hatafanya hivyo kamwe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Remonte ta manche droite.
target_text: Pindisha mkono ya nguo yako kwenye mkono ya kiume.
target_text_raw: Pindisha mkono ya nguo yako kwenye mkono ya kiume.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pense à le faire la semaine prochaine, comme ça c'est réglé.
target_text: Fikiria juu ya kuifanya wiki ijayo, hiyo imetunzwa.
target_text_raw: Fikiria juu ya kuifanya wiki ijayo, hiyo imetunzwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a les pieds en dedans.
target_text: Ana miguu ndani.
target_text_raw: Ana miguu ndani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lorsque la pauvreté passe la porte, l'amour se barre par la fenêtre.
target_text: Wakati umasikini unakuja kupitia mlango, mapenzi hutoka dirishani.
target_text_raw: Wakati umasikini unakuja kupitia mlango, mapenzi hutoka dirishani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Advienne que pourra.
target_text: Njoo iweje.
target_text_raw: Njoo iweje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je m'amuse comme un fou.
target_text: Ninafurahi kama wazimu.
target_text_raw: Ninafurahi kama wazimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mieux vaut ramer et continuer son petit bonhomme de chemin que de se faire mener en bateau !
target_text: Ni bora kupiga makasia na kuendelea kuliko kuchukuliwa kwa mashua!
target_text_raw: Ni bora kupiga makasia na kuendelea kuliko kuchukuliwa kwa mashua!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On attendait du champion de l'année dernière qu'il remportât Wimbledon.
target_text: Bingwa wa mwaka jana alitarajiwa kushinda Wimbledon.
target_text_raw: Bingwa wa mwaka jana alitarajiwa kushinda Wimbledon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas que tu le lui racontes.
target_text: Sitaki umwambie.
target_text_raw: Sitaki umwambie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment peut-on prétendre qu'un pays est démocratique s'il est, en même temps, raciste, colonialiste, commet d'horribles crimes de guerres et construit des murs de séparation d'un autre âge ?
target_text: Je! Tunawezaje kudai kuwa nchi ni ya kidemokrasia ikiwa wakati huo huo ni wa kibaguzi, mkoloni, anafanya uhalifu wa kutisha wa vita na kujenga kuta za kujitenga na enzi nyingine?
target_text_raw: Je! Tunawezaje kudai kuwa nchi ni ya kidemokrasia ikiwa wakati huo huo ni wa kibaguzi, mkoloni, anafanya uhalifu wa kutisha wa vita na kujenga kuta za kujitenga na enzi nyingine?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne m'oblige pas à recommencer.
target_text: Usinifanye nianze tena.
target_text_raw: Usinifanye nianze tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'exact opposé est vrai.
target_text: Kinyume kabisa ni kweli.
target_text_raw: Kinyume kabisa ni kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « Trop d'impôt tue l'impôt. »
target_text: «Ushuru mwingi huua ushuru.»
target_text_raw: «Ushuru mwingi huua ushuru.»

source_text: Aucun entraînement ne peut nous préparer à cela.

target_text_raw: Hii ndio baa ambayo nilikunywa bia yangu ya kwanza.

source_text: À l'époque soviétique, il était normal qu'un simple ingénieur soit peu payé.

target_text_raw: Katika nyakati za Soviet, ilikuwa kawaida kwa mhandisi rahisi kulipwa kidogo.

source_text: Que quelqu'un ose admettre que ces vuvuzelas ruinent le tournoi.
target_text: Mtu anathubutu kukubali kuwa hizi vuvuzela zinaharibu mashindano.
target_text_raw: Mtu anathubutu kukubali kuwa hizi vuvuzela zinaharibu mashindano.

target_text_raw: Pakia nyenzo zako!

target_text_raw: Kupitia dirisha utaona bustani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était la réaction en chaîne la plus impressionnante que j'ai vue jusqu'à présent.
target_text: Ilikuwa athari ya kuvutia zaidi ya mnyororo ambayo nimeona hadi sasa.
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa athari ya kuvutia zaidi ya mnyororo ambayo nimeona hadi sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Laura, wewe ni mwalimu?
target_text_raw: Laura, wewe ni mwalimu?

target_text_raw: Enzo ni mtoto dhaifu.

target_text_raw: Usijali!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux que conseiller à tout le monde de prendre trois jours pour apprendre le toki pona.

target_text_raw: Ninaweza tu kushauri kila mtu kuchukua siku tatu kujifunza Toki Pona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Yule mzee alionekana kuonyesha hekima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien que le hérisson, la taupe, la loutre, le lapin et l'opossum ressemblent aux rongeurs, ils n'en font pas partie.
target_text: Ata ivyo hérisson, taupe, loutre, sungura, na opossum zinaonekana kama panya, sio panya.
target_text_raw: Ata ivyo hérisson, taupe, loutre, sungura, na opossum zinaonekana kama panya, sio panya.

target_text: Wengine hawakujua jinsi ya kupigana.
target_text_raw: Wengine hawakujua jinsi ya kupigana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Change le drapeau, s'il te plait.

target_text_raw: Badilisha bendera, tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je reviendrai aussitôt que je peux.

target_text_raw: Nitarudi haraka iwezekanavyo.

target_text_raw: Layla ni mjane mwenye huzuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La mère oiseau a ramené des vers pour ses oisillons.

target_text_raw: Mama ndege alileta minyoo kwa watoto vyake.

source_text: Nous avons quitté la station, puis marché le long de la rue, jusqu'à arriver dans un petit hôtel que Sam connaissait.
target_text: Tuliondoka kituoni, kisha tukatembea barabarani, hadi tukafika kwenye hoteli ndogo ambayo Sam alikuwa akijua.
target_text_raw: Tuliondoka kituoni, kisha tukatembea barabarani, hadi tukafika kwenye hoteli ndogo ambayo Sam alikuwa akijua.

target_text_raw: Najua unajisikia upweke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas vu la bouche d'incendie.

target_text_raw: Sikuona bomba la moto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Théo est l'ex de Lucienne.

target_text_raw: Théo ni wa zamani wa Lucienne.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'étais curieux.
target_text: Nilikuwa na hamu ya kujua.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa na hamu ya kujua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère qu'aucun d'entre eux n'a été impliqué dans cet accident de la circulation.
target_text: Natumaini hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyehusika katika ajali hii ya trafiki.
target_text_raw: Natumaini hakuna hata mmoja wao aliyehusika katika ajali hii ya trafiki.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est facile de dire l'âge d'un enfant uniquement en regardant sa dentition.
target_text: Ni rahisi kusema umri wa mtoto kwa kuangalia meno yao tu.
target_text_raw: Ni rahisi kusema umri wa mtoto kwa kuangalia meno yao tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne m'oblige pas à répéter sans cesse la même chose!
target_text: Usinifanye nirudie kitu kimoja tena na tena!
target_text_raw: Usinifanye nirudie kitu kimoja tena na tena!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Veuille me pardonner !

target_text_raw: Tafadhali naomba unisamehe!

source_text: Mon copain aime traîner au lit.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est rare de trouver quelqu'un ayant autant d’âpreté.

target_text_raw: Ni nadra kupata mtu mwenye uchungu kama huo.

source_text: Amis, rassemblez vos dernières forces ! Nous allons réussir.
target_text: Marafiki, kukusanya nguvu zako za mwisho! Tutafanikiwa.
target_text_raw: Marafiki, kukusanya nguvu zako za mwisho! Tutafanikiwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme saute par-dessus le ruisseau.

target_text_raw: Mtu huyo anaruka juu ya kijito.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment se prononce ton prénom ?
target_text: Je! Unatamkaje jina lako la kwanza?
target_text_raw: Je! Unatamkaje jina lako la kwanza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Nilijaribu bure kujaribu.
target_text_raw: Nilijaribu bure kujaribu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle doit avoir une liaison avec son chef.

target_text_raw: Lazima awe ana uhusiano wa kimapenzi na bosi wake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Labda unaweza kuchukua nafasi ya maneno kadhaa ya Kijerumani na sawa na Kiingereza katika udaktari wako, ili tusijue kuwa hii ni wizi.

notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text: Wakati wowote dhuluma inapojitahidi kuwasilisha umati wa watu kwa mapenzi ya moja ya sehemu zake, inahesabu kati ya njia zake ubaguzi na ujinga wa wahasiriwa wake.

target_text_raw: Mathéo na Marthe wanajadili watakachofanya kwa Siku ya Wapendanao.
