target_text_raw: Je! Ninaweza kukununulia kinywaji?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les débiteurs sont des gens qui n'arrivent pas à rembourser l'argent qu'ils doivent à quelqu'un.
target_text: Wadaiwa ni watu ambao hawawezi kulipa pesa wanazodaiwa na mtu.
target_text_raw: Wadaiwa ni watu ambao hawawezi kulipa pesa wanazodaiwa na mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne sois pas lâche !
target_text: Usiwe mwoga!
target_text_raw: Usiwe mwoga!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bonjour, Mademoiselle, comment vas-tu ?
target_text: Jambo, bibi, habari yako?
target_text_raw: Jambo, bibi, habari yako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne vais pas vous épouser.
target_text: Sitakuoa.
target_text_raw: Sitakuoa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça va s'arranger.
target_text: Itakuwa bora.
target_text_raw: Itakuwa bora.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je souhaite que tu restes.
target_text: Natamani ungekaa.
target_text_raw: Natamani ungekaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Continuez à grimper.
target_text: Endelea kupanda.
target_text_raw: Endelea kupanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il te regardait sans cesse. N'as-tu pas remarqué ?
target_text: Alikuwa akikutazama kila wakati. Je! Haujaona?
target_text_raw: Alikuwa akikutazama kila wakati. Je! Haujaona?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Petit à petit, le ciel se dégage.
target_text: Kidogo kidogo, anga linaangaza.
target_text_raw: Kidogo kidogo, anga linaangaza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Joyeux anniversaire!
target_text: Heri ya Siku ya Kuzaliwa!
target_text_raw: Heri ya Siku ya Kuzaliwa!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Trouvez Jules.
target_text: Mtafute Jules.
target_text_raw: Mtafute Jules.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La construction de la piste d'atterrissage est achevée, mais cette dernière n'a pas encore été équipée.
target_text: Ujenzi wa uwanja wa ndege umekamilika, lakini bado haujapewa vifaa.
target_text_raw: Ujenzi wa uwanja wa ndege umekamilika, lakini bado haujapewa vifaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sysko traîne dans des bars secrets la nuit.
target_text: Sysko hutegemea baa za siri usiku.
target_text_raw: Sysko hutegemea baa za siri usiku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mettez la robe dans la boîte après le mariage.
target_text: Weka mavazi kwenye sanduku baada ya harusi.
target_text_raw: Weka mavazi kwenye sanduku baada ya harusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'arbre s'est couché.
target_text: Mti huo umelala chini.
target_text_raw: Mti huo umelala chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'en disons plus rien !
target_text: Tusiseme kitu zaidi!
target_text_raw: Tusiseme kitu zaidi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'eau qui coule de la fontaine est claire.
target_text: Maji yanayotiririka kutoka kwenye chemchemi ni wazi.
target_text_raw: Maji yanayotiririka kutoka kwenye chemchemi ni wazi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Remercie Dieu.
target_text: Asante Mungu.
target_text_raw: Asante Mungu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'ouvrez pas encore le cadeau !
target_text: Usifungue zawadi bado!
target_text_raw: Usifungue zawadi bado!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle sait faire plus de cent types de pain.
target_text: Anajua kuoka zaidi ya aina mia ya mkate.
target_text_raw: Anajua kuoka zaidi ya aina mia ya mkate.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si Luca avait suivi les conseils de son médecin, il ne serait peut-être pas décédé.
target_text: Ikiwa Luca angefuata ushauri wa daktari wake, labda asingekufa.
target_text_raw: Ikiwa Luca angefuata ushauri wa daktari wake, labda asingekufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Évidemment, le théorème est vrai pour les ensembles finis.
target_text: Kwa wazi, nadharia ni kweli kwa seti zenye mwisho.
target_text_raw: Kwa wazi, nadharia ni kweli kwa seti zenye mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Alors Jésus arrive de la Galilée au Jourdain, vers Jean, pour être baptisé par lui.
target_text: Kisha Yesu anakuja kutoka Galilaya mpaka Yordani, kwa Yohane, kubatizwa naye.
target_text_raw: Kisha Yesu anakuja kutoka Galilaya mpaka Yordani, kwa Yohane, kubatizwa naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fais-moi savoir les jours pendant lesquels tu pourras venir.
target_text: Nijulishe siku ambazo unaweza kuja.
target_text_raw: Nijulishe siku ambazo unaweza kuja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui est-ce qui se marre ?
target_text: Nani anacheka?
target_text_raw: Nani anacheka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jour après jour, le chien était assis en attendant son maître face à la station.
target_text: Siku baada ya siku, mbwa aliketi akimsubiri bwana wake mbele ya kituo.
target_text_raw: Siku baada ya siku, mbwa aliketi akimsubiri bwana wake mbele ya kituo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le prisonnier fut amené devant un juge.
target_text: Mfungwa huyo alifikishwa mbele ya hakimu.
target_text_raw: Mfungwa huyo alifikishwa mbele ya hakimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais amener ma sœur à la fête.
target_text: Nitamleta dada yangu kwenye sherehe.
target_text_raw: Nitamleta dada yangu kwenye sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n’amène personne.
target_text: Sileti mtu yeyote.
target_text_raw: Sileti mtu yeyote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as besoin de faire plus de recherches.
target_text: Unahitaji kufanya utafiti zaidi.
target_text_raw: Unahitaji kufanya utafiti zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que tu t'appelles Gabriel ?
target_text: Je! Jina lako ni Gabriel?
target_text_raw: Je! Jina lako ni Gabriel?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Luca a une grande jarre pleine de pièces de monnaie.
target_text: Luca ana jarida kubwa lililojaa sarafu.
target_text_raw: Luca ana jarida kubwa lililojaa sarafu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas si je pourrai aller à la fête.
target_text: Sijui ikiwa nitaweza kwenda kwenye sherehe.
target_text_raw: Sijui ikiwa nitaweza kwenda kwenye sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma vie est formidable !
target_text: Maisha yangu ni mazuri!
target_text_raw: Maisha yangu ni mazuri!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laisse-moi prendre une petite pause.
target_text: Ngoja nipumzike kidogo.
target_text_raw: Ngoja nipumzike kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dépêchons-nous : on entend déjà les premières explosions du feu d'artifice !
target_text: Wacha tuharakishe: tayari tunaweza kusikia milipuko ya kwanza ya fataki!
target_text_raw: Wacha tuharakishe: tayari tunaweza kusikia milipuko ya kwanza ya fataki!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous allons reprendre l'affaire de notre père.
target_text: Tunachukua biashara ya baba yetu.
target_text_raw: Tunachukua biashara ya baba yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Celle-là, tu la gardes !
target_text: Huyu, unaiweka!
target_text_raw: Huyu, unaiweka!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne demandez pas d'argent.
target_text: Usiulize pesa.
target_text_raw: Usiulize pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai entendu que l'on peut tuer les loups-garous en leur tirant dessus avec des balles en argent.
target_text: Nilisikia kwamba unaweza kuua mbwa mwitu kwa kuwapiga risasi za fedha.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia kwamba unaweza kuua mbwa mwitu kwa kuwapiga risasi za fedha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un détective privé. Il nous a filé toute la soirée.
target_text: Yeye ni mpelelezi wa kibinafsi. Amekuwa akitukimbiza jioni yote.
target_text_raw: Yeye ni mpelelezi wa kibinafsi. Amekuwa akitukimbiza jioni yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On arrive juste à saisir ses empreintes.
target_text: Tunaweza tu kunyakua alama za vidole vyake.
target_text_raw: Tunaweza tu kunyakua alama za vidole vyake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cesse d'être aussi gentille avec moi !
target_text: Acha kuwa mzuri kwangu!
target_text_raw: Acha kuwa mzuri kwangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle entretient un échange régulier de lettres avec sa correspondante en Australie.
target_text: Anaendelea kubadilishana barua mara kwa mara na mwandishi wake huko Australia.
target_text_raw: Anaendelea kubadilishana barua mara kwa mara na mwandishi wake huko Australia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta réponse est tout sauf parfaite.
target_text: Jibu lako sio kamili.
target_text_raw: Jibu lako sio kamili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pire des maladies c'est la vie, parce que dans 100 % des cas on en meurt.
target_text: Ugonjwa mbaya zaidi ni maisha, kwa sababu katika kesi 100% tunakufa nayo.
target_text_raw: Ugonjwa mbaya zaidi ni maisha, kwa sababu katika kesi 100% tunakufa nayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va me falloir y réfléchir.
target_text: Itabidi nifikirie juu yake.
target_text_raw: Itabidi nifikirie juu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier, j'ai discuté trois heures avec mon copain. C'est que ça fait une semaine qu'on ne s'est pas vus.
target_text: Jana nilikuwa na mazungumzo ya saa tatu na mpenzi wangu. Imekuwa wiki moja tangu tuone mwisho.
target_text_raw: Jana nilikuwa na mazungumzo ya saa tatu na mpenzi wangu. Imekuwa wiki moja tangu tuone mwisho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis trouvée à court d'argent.
target_text: Nilijikuta nimefungwa kamba ya pesa.
target_text_raw: Nilijikuta nimefungwa kamba ya pesa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il me faut m'échapper de cet endroit.
target_text: Lazima nimtokee hii pali.
target_text_raw: Lazima nimtokee hii pali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon chat est vraiment malin.
target_text: Paka wangu ni mwerevu kweli.
target_text_raw: Paka wangu ni mwerevu kweli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les autorités ont signifié une fin de non recevoir au requérant dans des termes secs.
target_text: Mamlaka yamempa mwombaji mwisho wa kutokubali katika suala kavu.
target_text_raw: Mamlaka yamempa mwombaji mwisho wa kutokubali katika suala kavu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne vous inquiétez pas comme ça.
target_text: Usijali kama hiyo.
target_text_raw: Usijali kama hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se cache dans la penderie.
target_text: Amejificha chooni.
target_text_raw: Amejificha chooni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête de t'inquiéter.
target_text: Acha wasiwasi.
target_text_raw: Acha wasiwasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec qui est-ce que tu parlais ?
target_text: Ulikuwa unazungumza na nani?
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa unazungumza na nani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous parlons vite.
target_text: Tunazungumza haraka.
target_text_raw: Tunazungumza haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je t'assure qu'il ne l'a pas fait exprès.
target_text: Ninawahakikishia hakufanya kwa makusudi.
target_text_raw: Ninawahakikishia hakufanya kwa makusudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les leçons et les devoirs sont toujours à faire pour le cours suivant.
target_text: Masomo na kazi za nyumbani bado zinapaswa kufanywa kwa darasa linalofuata.
target_text_raw: Masomo na kazi za nyumbani bado zinapaswa kufanywa kwa darasa linalofuata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne t'inquiète pas. Elle ne saura rien.
target_text: Usijali. Yeye hatajua kitu.
target_text_raw: Usijali. Yeye hatajua kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je peux encore tellement manger dans le cadre du régime, car je ne perds pas de poids.
target_text: Bado ninaweza kula sana kwenye lishe kwa sababu sipunguzi uzito.
target_text_raw: Bado ninaweza kula sana kwenye lishe kwa sababu sipunguzi uzito.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce problème est trop compliqué à résoudre pour moi.
target_text: Shida hii ni ngumu sana kwangu kutatua.
target_text_raw: Shida hii ni ngumu sana kwangu kutatua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne donnez plus rien à cet homme !
target_text: Usimpe mtu huyu chochote zaidi!
target_text_raw: Usimpe mtu huyu chochote zaidi!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bouge tes fesses et vas-y !
target_text: Sogeza kitako chako na uende!
target_text_raw: Sogeza kitako chako na uende!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense avoir vu un fantôme dans les bois.
target_text: Nadhani niliona mzuka msituni.
target_text_raw: Nadhani niliona mzuka msituni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si on tombe à l'eau, il faut se débarrasser de tous ses vêtements mouillés.
target_text: Ukianguka ndani ya maji, toa nguo zako zote zenye mvua.
target_text_raw: Ukianguka ndani ya maji, toa nguo zako zote zenye mvua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'enlève pas leurs chaussures.
target_text: Siwatoche viatu vyao.
target_text_raw: Siwatoche viatu vyao.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que tu mens.
target_text: Nadhani unasema uwongo.
target_text_raw: Nadhani unasema uwongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous avez abreuvé vos chevaux.
target_text: Umewanywesha farasi zako.
target_text_raw: Umewanywesha farasi zako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Heureusement que vous l'avez.
target_text: Bahati unayo.
target_text_raw: Bahati unayo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce que le paradis pour vous ?
target_text: Je! Paradiso ni nini kwako?
target_text_raw: Je! Paradiso ni nini kwako?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne lance de pierres contre personne.
target_text: Situpii mtu mawe.
target_text_raw: Situpii mtu mawe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne comprends vraiment pas ce qu'elle veut dire en disant ça.
target_text: Sielewi anachomaanisha kwa kusema hivyo.
target_text_raw: Sielewi anachomaanisha kwa kusema hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta voix est plus douce pour moi que le chant même des jeunes oiseaux.
target_text: Sauti yako ni tamu kwangu kuliko hata wimbo wa ndege wachanga.
target_text_raw: Sauti yako ni tamu kwangu kuliko hata wimbo wa ndege wachanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que vous pourrez vous occuper de mon chien ce printemps ?
target_text: Je! Unaweza kumtunza mbwa wangu hii chemchemi?
target_text_raw: Je! Unaweza kumtunza mbwa wangu hii chemchemi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il incitait un jeune homme innocent à se joindre à lui dans son affaire douteuse.
target_text: Alikuwa akimsihi kijana asiye na hatia ajiunge naye katika shughuli yake ya kutiliwa shaka.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa akimsihi kijana asiye na hatia ajiunge naye katika shughuli yake ya kutiliwa shaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soyons patients !
target_text: Tuwe wavumilivu!
target_text_raw: Tuwe wavumilivu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Descends de ma voiture.
target_text: Toka kwenye gari langu.
target_text_raw: Toka kwenye gari langu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les carottes sont cuites, je répète, les carottes sont cuites.
target_text: Karoti hupikwa, narudia, karoti hupikwa.
target_text_raw: Karoti hupikwa, narudia, karoti hupikwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Malgré nos appels, la lumière reste sourde.
target_text: Licha ya wito wetu, mwanga unabaki kiziwi.
target_text_raw: Licha ya wito wetu, mwanga unabaki kiziwi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis ravie que tu aies mis cela sur la table.
target_text: Nimefurahi kuweka hii mezani.
target_text_raw: Nimefurahi kuweka hii mezani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu pourrais au moins faire semblant de t'intéresser à ce que je dis !
target_text: Unaweza angalau kujifanya unajali kile ninachosema!
target_text_raw: Unaweza angalau kujifanya unajali kile ninachosema!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Où as-tu grandi en Australie ?
target_text: Uliguwa wapi Australia?
target_text_raw: Uliguwa wapi Australia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les lois étaient très difficiles à appliquer.
target_text: Sheria zilikuwa nguvu sana kuiechimiya.
target_text_raw: Sheria zilikuwa nguvu sana kuiechimiya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toutes les personnes, avec lesquelles vous avez eu des relations sexuelles, doivent se faire soigner.
target_text: Kila mtu uliyefanya ngono na anahitaji matibabu.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu uliyefanya ngono na anahitaji matibabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se peut que j'en fasse à nouveau l'essai.
target_text: Naweza kujaribu tena.
target_text_raw: Naweza kujaribu tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'arbre qui ne donne pas de bons fruits, on l'abat.
target_text: Mti ambao haizai matunda mazuri hukatwa.
target_text_raw: Mti ambao haizai matunda mazuri hukatwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La maison la plus proche d'ici est à deux miles.
target_text: Nyumba ya karibu kutoka hapa iko maili mbili mbali.
target_text_raw: Nyumba ya karibu kutoka hapa iko maili mbili mbali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela aurait été risqué de faire cela.
target_text: Ingekuwa hatari kufanya hivyo.
target_text_raw: Ingekuwa hatari kufanya hivyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as remporté l'épreuve de forces.
target_text: Umeshinda mashindano.
target_text_raw: Umeshinda mashindano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sont-ils tous vivants ?
target_text: Je! Wote wako hai?
target_text_raw: Je! Wote wako hai?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a descendu quelques verres.
target_text: Tulikuwa na vinywaji vichache chini.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa na vinywaji vichache chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me réjouis que vous n'ayez pas été blessée.
target_text: Nafurahi haukuumizwa.
target_text_raw: Nafurahi haukuumizwa.

target_text_raw: Tulisafiri mu inchi yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On m'a proposé le choix entre un thé et un café.
target_text: Baliniambia nichaguwe kati ya chai na kahawa.
target_text_raw: Baliniambia nichaguwe kati ya chai na kahawa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Thomas a une photo de sa famille sur son bureau.
target_text: Thomas iko na picha ya familia yake mu ofisi yake.
target_text_raw: Thomas iko na picha ya familia yake mu ofisi yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On se fait à tout.
target_text: Tunazoweya kila kitu.
target_text_raw: Tunazoweya kila kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que quiconque me comprenne réellement.
target_text: Sijui kama kuko mutu mwenye ananielewe kabisa.
target_text_raw: Sijui kama kuko mutu mwenye ananielewe kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je commence à comprendre.
target_text: Minaanza elewa.
target_text_raw: Minaanza elewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as entendu un bruit derrière toi.
target_text: Ulisikia fujo nyuma yako.
target_text_raw: Ulisikia fujo nyuma yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as commis cette erreur exprès, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Ulifanya ile kosa kwa utashi, si vile?
target_text_raw: Ulifanya ile kosa kwa utashi, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi as-tu pleuré ?
target_text: Sababu gani ulilia?
target_text_raw: Sababu gani ulilia?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avions nos raisons.
target_text: Tulikuwa na sababu zetu.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa na sababu zetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois appeler Tom immédiatement.
target_text: Unapashwa ita Tom sasa hivi.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa ita Tom sasa hivi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est déjà l'été.
target_text: Ni kipwa déjà.
target_text_raw: Ni kipwa déjà.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce n'est pas du chiqué.
target_text: Haiko ya kujisifia.
target_text_raw: Haiko ya kujisifia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ne m'a pas payé autant qu'il l'a promis.
target_text: Tom hakunilipa sawa vile alini ahidia.
target_text_raw: Tom hakunilipa sawa vile alini ahidia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils ne peuvent me voir.
target_text: Habawezi niona.
target_text_raw: Habawezi niona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Profitez de la soirée au bal.
target_text: Mupitishe mangaribi njema ya sherehe.
target_text_raw: Mupitishe mangaribi njema ya sherehe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Des monnaies antiques furent trouvées à l'intérieur de la mystérieuse tombe.
target_text: Franga za zamani zilipatikana ndani ya ile kaburi ya ajabu.
target_text_raw: Franga za zamani zilipatikana ndani ya ile kaburi ya ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père m'a emmené au cinéma hier soir.
target_text: Baba alinibeba ku ciné jana mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Baba alinibeba ku ciné jana mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous pouvez choisir le livre que vous aimez.
target_text: Unaweza chagua kitabu kyenyi unapenda.
target_text_raw: Unaweza chagua kitabu kyenyi unapenda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es un bon étudiant.
target_text: Uko mwanafuzi mzuri.
target_text_raw: Uko mwanafuzi mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien en as-tu eu ?
target_text: Ulipata ngapi?
target_text_raw: Ulipata ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez en ligne, s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Bakia kwenye mustari tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Bakia kwenye mustari tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous partons maintenant.
target_text: Tunaenda sasa.
target_text_raw: Tunaenda sasa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons pas encore planifié nos vacances.
target_text: Hatujapanga mapumuziko yetu.
target_text_raw: Hatujapanga mapumuziko yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le soleil, ça fait toute la différence.
target_text: Jua, inafanya tofauti yote.
target_text_raw: Jua, inafanya tofauti yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Comment faisons-nous cela ?
target_text: Tunaweza fanya ile namna gani?
target_text_raw: Tunaweza fanya ile namna gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu dois remettre les rapports lundi.
target_text: Unapashwa pana ripoti siku ya kwanza.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa pana ripoti siku ya kwanza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu te soucies de Tom.
target_text: Minajua kama unaangaikIa Tom.
target_text_raw: Minajua kama unaangaikIa Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ferais pareil.
target_text: Nitafanya vile vile.
target_text_raw: Nitafanya vile vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se lassa bientôt.
target_text: Alichoka hivi karibuni.
target_text_raw: Alichoka hivi karibuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faut que tu essaies ça.
target_text: Unapashwa pima hii.
target_text_raw: Unapashwa pima hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me suis descendu à son niveau.
target_text: Nilijishusha mpaka ku hali yake.
target_text_raw: Nilijishusha mpaka ku hali yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aime les jeux de hasard.
target_text: Anapenda michezo ya bahati.
target_text_raw: Anapenda michezo ya bahati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle m'a menti.
target_text: Alinidanganya.
target_text_raw: Alinidanganya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous l'avons élu maire.
target_text: Tulimuchagua kuwa meya.
target_text_raw: Tulimuchagua kuwa meya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons presque fini pour aujourd'hui.
target_text: Tunakaribia maliza kwa siku ya leo.
target_text_raw: Tunakaribia maliza kwa siku ya leo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis devenu ami avec Tom.
target_text: Niligeuka rafiki ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Niligeuka rafiki ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'êtes jamais allé à Paris ?
target_text: Hamujawai kwenda Paris?
target_text_raw: Hamujawai kwenda Paris?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand la fête a-t-elle lieu ?
target_text: Sherehe ilikuwa wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Sherehe ilikuwa wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois déjeuner avec lui.
target_text: Ninapashwa kula chakula ya mchana pamoja naye.
target_text_raw: Ninapashwa kula chakula ya mchana pamoja naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je préfère l'anglais.
target_text: Minapendelea Kingereza.
target_text_raw: Minapendelea Kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il s'inquiète pour les résultats de l'examen.
target_text: Iko na wasiwasi juu ya matokeo ya mashindano.
target_text_raw: Iko na wasiwasi juu ya matokeo ya mashindano.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est fière d'être belle.
target_text: Anajivunia kuwa murembo.
target_text_raw: Anajivunia kuwa murembo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Père lisait souvent des romans policiers pendant son temps libre.
target_text: Baba alikuwa nazowea soma bitabu ya hadisi za kipolisi wakati alikuwa hana kazi ya kufanya.
target_text_raw: Baba alikuwa nazowea soma bitabu ya hadisi za kipolisi wakati alikuwa hana kazi ya kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sers-toi une boisson !
target_text: Ujisaidie na kinywaji.
target_text_raw: Ujisaidie na kinywaji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est arrivé ce matin pour vous.
target_text: Imefika hii asubui ju yako.
target_text_raw: Imefika hii asubui ju yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La serviette ne fut pas du tout utile.
target_text: Kipanguza haikukuwa ya lazima.
target_text_raw: Kipanguza haikukuwa ya lazima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est mieux que le film.
target_text: Ni vema zaidi ya film.
target_text_raw: Ni vema zaidi ya film.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils vous aideront à vous réchauffer.
target_text: Watakusaidia kupata kifukutu.
target_text_raw: Watakusaidia kupata kifukutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cela peut avoir de sérieuses conséquences.
target_text: Ile inaweza kuwa na matokeo ya nguvu sana.
target_text_raw: Ile inaweza kuwa na matokeo ya nguvu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je préférerais vraiment ne pas savoir.
target_text: Ningependa nisijuwe kabisa.
target_text_raw: Ningependa nisijuwe kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui commande ici ?
target_text: Ni nani anaongoza hapa?
target_text_raw: Ni nani anaongoza hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as un téléphone chez toi.
target_text: Uko na telefone kwako.
target_text_raw: Uko na telefone kwako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'imagine que non.
target_text: Minawaza kama hapana.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama hapana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il se met parfois en colère pour rien.
target_text: Kuko saa anasirikiaka bure.
target_text_raw: Kuko saa anasirikiaka bure.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ça n'a pas été fait auparavant.
target_text: Mbele haikufanyikaka .
target_text_raw: Mbele haikufanyikaka .
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie se défendait.
target_text: Marie alikuwa anajiteteya.
target_text_raw: Marie alikuwa anajiteteya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu te dépêchais.
target_text: Ulikuwa unafanya mbio.
target_text_raw: Ulikuwa unafanya mbio.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce soir, mangeons dehors.
target_text: Hii magaribi tukulie inje.
target_text_raw: Hii magaribi tukulie inje.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan a été profondément troublé par la mort de Linda.
target_text: Kukufa ya Linda ili troubler Dan sana.
target_text_raw: Kukufa ya Linda ili troubler Dan sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu voulais me parler de liberté ?
target_text: Ulitaka kuniambia juu ya uhuru?
target_text_raw: Ulitaka kuniambia juu ya uhuru?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes des hommes occupés.
target_text: Siye ni wanaume wenye wako na kazi mingi.
target_text_raw: Siye ni wanaume wenye wako na kazi mingi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as craqué pour lui, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Ulimutupia kicwa, si vile?
target_text_raw: Ulimutupia kicwa, si vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ta femme te manque-t-elle ?
target_text: Bibi yako unamkumbuka?
target_text_raw: Bibi yako unamkumbuka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un livre espagnol.
target_text: Ni kitabu cha Uhispania.
target_text_raw: Ni kitabu cha Uhispania.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est mal de dire un mensonge.
target_text: Ni mubaya kusema uongo.
target_text_raw: Ni mubaya kusema uongo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand avez-vous commencé à apprendre l'anglais ?
target_text: Ulianza kujifunza kingereza wakati gani?
target_text_raw: Ulianza kujifunza kingereza wakati gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a acheté un appareil photo comme le tien.
target_text: Tom aliuza appareil foto ya kufanana na yako.
target_text_raw: Tom aliuza appareil foto ya kufanana na yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Notre ville n'a pas encore l'eau courante.

target_text_raw: Muji yetu haiyakuwa na maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne ronge pas tes ongles.

target_text_raw: Usikule makucha yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle arriva en courant, les yeux brillants.
target_text: Alikuya iko anakimbia, maco yake inaangara.
target_text_raw: Alikuya iko anakimbia, maco yake inaangara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom sera heureux de te revoir.

target_text_raw: Tom atafurahi kukuona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je te donnerai tout ce que tu veux.

target_text_raw: Nitakupatia byote byenyi unataka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai manqué mon train.

target_text_raw: Gari moshi iliniacha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai acheté ces fleurs pour toi.

target_text_raw: Nilikuuzia mauwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle est aussi vieille que la grand-mère du diable.
target_text: Naye ni mzee sawa na tate yake na shetani.
target_text_raw: Naye ni mzee sawa na tate yake na shetani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis de ton avis.
target_text: Minakuunga mukono.
target_text_raw: Minakuunga mukono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Moi non plus.
target_text: Na miye pia.
target_text_raw: Na miye pia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu déjà embrassé une autre nana ?
target_text: Ulishaka busu mwengine binti?
target_text_raw: Ulishaka busu mwengine binti?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'homme était trop gros pour se déplacer par lui-même.
target_text: Mwanaume alikuwa mnene mno hangeweza jibeba mwenyewe.
target_text_raw: Mwanaume alikuwa mnene mno hangeweza jibeba mwenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ma sœur est un génie !
target_text: Dada yangu ni wa akili sana!
target_text_raw: Dada yangu ni wa akili sana!

source_text: Nous nous approchâmes chaque jour.

target_text_raw: Tulienda tunasogeleana siku kwa siku.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il prit un stylo dans sa main.
target_text: Akakamata kalamu mu mikono yake.
target_text_raw: Akakamata kalamu mu mikono yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Mwenye anasema A anapashwa pia sema B.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce bus va-t-il à la gare ?
target_text: Iyi bus iko inaenda ku parking?
target_text_raw: Iyi bus iko inaenda ku parking?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne le saviez-vous pas ?

target_text_raw: Ulikuwa haujuwi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dieu l'a créé.

target_text_raw: Mungu alimuumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vengeance est un plat qui se mange froid.

target_text_raw: Kisasi ni chakula yenye kukuliwa ingali baridi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous me gênez.
target_text: Munaniuzi.
target_text_raw: Munaniuzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est parti.
target_text: Alienda.
target_text_raw: Alienda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Du poisson s'il vous plaît.
target_text: Samaki tafadhali.
target_text_raw: Samaki tafadhali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils sont nés à un mois d'intervalle en 1970.
target_text: Walizaliwa wanapishana mwezi moja munamo mwaka 1970.
target_text_raw: Walizaliwa wanapishana mwezi moja munamo mwaka 1970.

source_text: Nous ne sommes pas perdus.

target_text_raw: Hatupotei.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne sais pas le distinguer de son frère.
target_text: Sijuwi kumutafautisha na ndugu yake.
target_text_raw: Sijuwi kumutafautisha na ndugu yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Ninajiendea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a trop parlé de ce mariage.

target_text_raw: Tulisema mingi kuhusu ndoa hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je lui demanderai demain.

target_text_raw: Nitamuuliza kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Père est allé à la pêche.
target_text: Baba alienda kuloa.
target_text_raw: Baba alienda kuloa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En es-tu sûr ?
target_text: Uko na uhakika?
target_text_raw: Uko na uhakika?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'attachai mon chien à un arbre dans le jardin.
target_text: Nilikuwa nafunga imbwa yangu ku mti ndani ya bustani.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa nafunga imbwa yangu ku mti ndani ya bustani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que j'étais en train de mourir.
target_text: Niliwaza nilikuwa ninakufa.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza nilikuwa ninakufa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a pas de limites à l'univers.

target_text_raw: Hakuna mipaka kwa ulimwengu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ferais mieux d'y aller, moi aussi.
target_text: Nitafanya yote inayowezekana niende kule na miye.
target_text_raw: Nitafanya yote inayowezekana niende kule na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce bureau est différent de celui que j'ai commandé.
target_text: Iyi offisi inapishana na yenye niliomba.
target_text_raw: Iyi offisi inapishana na yenye niliomba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est à l'étranger.
target_text: Iko inje ya inchi.
target_text_raw: Iko inje ya inchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'éducation est importante.
target_text: Masomo ni ya lazima.
target_text_raw: Masomo ni ya lazima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.
