source_text: La femme s'est levée de la chaise. Et elle a jeté un coup d’œil à la porte.
target_text: Mwanamke akasimama ku mu kiti. Na akachungulia ku mlango.
target_text_raw: Mwanamke akasimama ku mu kiti. Na akachungulia ku mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ferai du beurre de cacahuètes.
target_text: Nitafanya buyi ya kalanga.
target_text_raw: Nitafanya buyi ya kalanga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a dit qu'il n'avait pas faim.
target_text: Tom alisema hana njala.
target_text_raw: Tom alisema hana njala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous réparerons ceci.
target_text: Tutatengeneza hii.
target_text_raw: Tutatengeneza hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On ne peut pas être à deux endroits en même temps.
target_text: Hauwezi kuwa fasi mbili kwa limoya.
target_text_raw: Hauwezi kuwa fasi mbili kwa limoya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle était sur le point de l'appeler lorsqu'il entra par la porte.
target_text: Alikuwa anataka muita saa aliingia mu mlango.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anataka muita saa aliingia mu mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle est ta couleur de cheveux naturelle ?
target_text: Rangi ya nywele za asili ni gani?
target_text_raw: Rangi ya nywele za asili ni gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande si Tom sait ce que Mary a fait.
target_text: Niko najiuliza kama Tom anajuwa byenyi Mary alifanya.
target_text_raw: Niko najiuliza kama Tom anajuwa byenyi Mary alifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas du tout intéressé.
target_text: Hainiangalie sana.
target_text_raw: Hainiangalie sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il tient un journal en anglais.
target_text: Anakama gazeti ya kingereza mu mkono.
target_text_raw: Anakama gazeti ya kingereza mu mkono.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Une douzaine d'arbres environ furent bientôt plantés.
target_text: Karibu miti kumi na mbili ilipandwa hapa siku zilizopita.
target_text_raw: Karibu miti kumi na mbili ilipandwa hapa siku zilizopita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout le monde le faisait.
target_text: Kila mtu alikuwa anaifanya.
target_text_raw: Kila mtu alikuwa anaifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis pas déçu.
target_text: Siyakata tamaa.
target_text_raw: Siyakata tamaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Arrête de te la raconter ! Tu n'aurais pas les moyens d'acheter une maison pareille.
target_text: Achana na kuikumbuka! Hauwezi pata namna ya kuuza nyumba ya vile.
target_text_raw: Achana na kuikumbuka! Hauwezi pata namna ya kuuza nyumba ya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que des enfants devraient boire de la bière.
target_text: Siwaze kama watoto wanapashwa kunywa pombe.
target_text_raw: Siwaze kama watoto wanapashwa kunywa pombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'as-tu l'intention de faire ?
target_text: Nini njo unataka fanya?
target_text_raw: Nini njo unataka fanya?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce que ça en valait la peine?
target_text: Ilikuwa ya maana?
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa ya maana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis chez une amie.
target_text: Niko kwa rafiki yangu.
target_text_raw: Niko kwa rafiki yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un jour, tu le regretteras.
target_text: Siku moja utajuta kuhusu hiyo.
target_text_raw: Siku moja utajuta kuhusu hiyo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu es très timide.
target_text: Uko kimia sana.
target_text_raw: Uko kimia sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'en sommes pas fiers.
target_text: Hatujivunie ile.
target_text_raw: Hatujivunie ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ne perdras-tu pas la raison ?
target_text: Hautapoteza akili ?
target_text_raw: Hautapoteza akili ?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas faire ça.
target_text: Siwezi fanya vile.
target_text_raw: Siwezi fanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai besoin de ça.
target_text: Niko na lazima nayo..
target_text_raw: Niko na lazima nayo..
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il va peut-être neiger ce soir.
target_text: Labda kuta kuwa neige itamwangika leo mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Labda kuta kuwa neige itamwangika leo mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De combien de temps disposes-tu pour déjeuner ?
target_text: Uko na muda gani kwa kukula chakula cha mchana?
target_text_raw: Uko na muda gani kwa kukula chakula cha mchana?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est tout ce que nous pouvons faire pour le moment.
target_text: Njo yote hii yenyi tunaweza fanya kwa saa hii.
target_text_raw: Njo yote hii yenyi tunaweza fanya kwa saa hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: As-tu jamais trouvé réponse à cette question ?
target_text: Ulishaka pata jibu ya hii ulizo?
target_text_raw: Ulishaka pata jibu ya hii ulizo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mes amis m'ont invité à dîner.
target_text: Warafiki wangu walinialika kwenda kula chakula ya mangaribi.
target_text_raw: Warafiki wangu walinialika kwenda kula chakula ya mangaribi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Restez calme !
target_text: Bakia kimia!
target_text_raw: Bakia kimia!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Reprenons un peu notre souffle !
target_text: Tuvute hewa kidogo kidogo!
target_text_raw: Tuvute hewa kidogo kidogo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que Tom croit tout ce que Marie lui dit.
target_text: Minawaza Tom anasadikiaka kila kitu yenye Marie anamwambia.
target_text_raw: Minawaza Tom anasadikiaka kila kitu yenye Marie anamwambia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous laissai une note.
target_text: Nilikuachia barua.
target_text_raw: Nilikuachia barua.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ton arme est-elle chargée ?
target_text: Bunduki yako iko charger?
target_text_raw: Bunduki yako iko charger?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle se tint près de lui.
target_text: Akasimama pembeni yake.
target_text_raw: Akasimama pembeni yake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai pensé que tu serais intéressé par cela.
target_text: Niliwaza utakua interessé na ile.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza utakua interessé na ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous nous embrassâmes.
target_text: Tukapeana busu.
target_text_raw: Tukapeana busu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dis-moi, dis-moi !
target_text: Niambie, Niambie !
target_text_raw: Niambie, Niambie !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'où venez-vous au Canada ?
target_text: Munatokeya wapi Canada?
target_text_raw: Munatokeya wapi Canada?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Avec toi, c'est l'été toute l'année.
target_text: Na wewe, ni kifukutu mwaka mzima.
target_text_raw: Na wewe, ni kifukutu mwaka mzima.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux changer le monde.
target_text: Nitageuza dunia.
target_text_raw: Nitageuza dunia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il essaie de se débarrasser des fourmis.
target_text: Anajaribu kujitoshako siyafu.
target_text_raw: Anajaribu kujitoshako siyafu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le poison s'est répandu dans tout le corps.
target_text: Sumu iliingiya ndani ya mwili yote.
target_text_raw: Sumu iliingiya ndani ya mwili yote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai peut-être heurté ses sentiments.
target_text: Labda nilivunja sentiments zake.
target_text_raw: Labda nilivunja sentiments zake.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne comprends pas pourquoi tu ne veux pas faire ça.
target_text: Misielewi ju ya nini haupendi fanya vile.
target_text_raw: Misielewi ju ya nini haupendi fanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je crains de ne pas avoir d'expérience.
target_text: Niko na wasiwasi ya kustokuwa na uzoefu.
target_text_raw: Niko na wasiwasi ya kustokuwa na uzoefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fais juste ce que je dis !
target_text: Fanya tu byenyi ninasema.
target_text_raw: Fanya tu byenyi ninasema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom doit être puni pour ce qu'il a fait.
target_text: Tom anapashwa pata malipizi ju ya byenyi alifanya.
target_text_raw: Tom anapashwa pata malipizi ju ya byenyi alifanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne crois pas que Tom ait fait ses devoirs lui-même.
target_text: Siamini kama Tom alifanya devoirs zake yepeke.
target_text_raw: Siamini kama Tom alifanya devoirs zake yepeke.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a montré à Marie la photo.
target_text: Tom alionesha Marie ile picha.
target_text_raw: Tom alionesha Marie ile picha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom ferait n'importe quoi pour attirer l'attention de Marie.
target_text: Tom anaweza fanya kila kitu kyenyi kinawezekana kusudi Marie amusikie.
target_text_raw: Tom anaweza fanya kila kitu kyenyi kinawezekana kusudi Marie amusikie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Personne ne se soucie de moi.
target_text: Hakuna mwenyi ananiangaikia.
target_text_raw: Hakuna mwenyi ananiangaikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les animaux ne sont pas des jouets !
target_text: Wanyama haiko vitu vya kucheza navyo! Nyama haziko ma jouets!
target_text_raw: Wanyama haiko vitu vya kucheza navyo! Nyama haziko ma jouets!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père a arrêté de fumer récemment.
target_text: Baba aliacha kuuta siku zilizo pita.
target_text_raw: Baba aliacha kuuta siku zilizo pita.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux simplement que les gens m'aiment.
target_text: Nataka tu watu wanipende.
target_text_raw: Nataka tu watu wanipende.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La fille s'efforçait de retenir ses larmes.
target_text: Binti alijikaza asilie.
target_text_raw: Binti alijikaza asilie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Laissez-moi vérifier le manuel.
target_text: Acha nichunguze kitabu.
target_text_raw: Acha nichunguze kitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Cet incendie de forêt a une origine naturelle.
target_text: Hii moto ya msitu ilisababishwa na jambo ya kawaida.
target_text_raw: Hii moto ya msitu ilisababishwa na jambo ya kawaida.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom va le faire à temps.
target_text: Tom ataifanya kwa wakati.
target_text_raw: Tom ataifanya kwa wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a demandé un conseil à Maria.
target_text: Tom aliomba shauri kwa Marie.
target_text_raw: Tom aliomba shauri kwa Marie.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que Tom est à moitié endormi.
target_text: Najua Tom amelala nusu.
target_text_raw: Najua Tom amelala nusu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pense pas que ce soit le meilleur moment pour parler à Tom.
target_text: Siwazie kama ni wakati ya mzuri ya kuongelesha Tom.
target_text_raw: Siwazie kama ni wakati ya mzuri ya kuongelesha Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si elle avait été en vie, ma mère m'aurait aidé à ce moment-là.
target_text: Mamangu angelikuwa angali anaishi, kama angelinisaidia kwa wakati ile.
target_text_raw: Mamangu angelikuwa angali anaishi, kama angelinisaidia kwa wakati ile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La police enquête sur les causes de l'accident.
target_text: Polisi wanachunguza sababu za ile ajali.
target_text_raw: Polisi wanachunguza sababu za ile ajali.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ce garçon a un corps fort et sain.
target_text: Kijana huyu ana mwili wa nguvu na ana afia.
target_text_raw: Kijana huyu ana mwili wa nguvu na ana afia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le studio est très petit, sans lieu où se cacher.
target_text: Studio ni ya kidogo sana, hakuna fasi ya kujificha.
target_text_raw: Studio ni ya kidogo sana, hakuna fasi ya kujificha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pensais que tu voudrais peut-être savoir.
target_text: Niliwaza labda ulitaka kujuwa.
target_text_raw: Niliwaza labda ulitaka kujuwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Soyez vu par moi !
target_text: Nibaone!
target_text_raw: Nibaone!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom sortit un crayon.
target_text: Tom akatosha crayon.
target_text_raw: Tom akatosha crayon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les personnes âgées ont besoin de vivre pour quelqu'un.
target_text: Wazee wanahitaji kuishi sababu ya mtu.
target_text_raw: Wazee wanahitaji kuishi sababu ya mtu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quelle est le sens de cela ?
target_text: Ile inamaanisha nini?
target_text_raw: Ile inamaanisha nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le temps est vraiment mauvais.
target_text: Wakati iko mbaya kabisa.
target_text_raw: Wakati iko mbaya kabisa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis très intéressé d'entendre ce que tu as à dire.
target_text: Ninapeda nisikie nini yenyi unataka sema.
target_text_raw: Ninapeda nisikie nini yenyi unataka sema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Croyez-vous vraiment nécessaire de faire cela ?
target_text: Unawaza kabisa ni lazima kufanya vile?
target_text_raw: Unawaza kabisa ni lazima kufanya vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils se nourrissent surtout de lait.
target_text: Wanakulaka maziwa sana sana.
target_text_raw: Wanakulaka maziwa sana sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne suis qu'un garçon qui fait des erreurs.
target_text: Niko tu kijana mwenyi anafanyaka tu makosa.
target_text_raw: Niko tu kijana mwenyi anafanyaka tu makosa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il changea d'avis.
target_text: Akabadilisha mawazo.
target_text_raw: Akabadilisha mawazo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peux-tu m'indiquer la bonne direction ?
target_text: Unaweza nionesha njia ya mzuri?
target_text_raw: Unaweza nionesha njia ya mzuri?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom est tombé dans l'eau.
target_text: Tom aliangukia ndani ya maji.
target_text_raw: Tom aliangukia ndani ya maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu sais que Tom aime la bière.
target_text: Unajuwa kama Tom anapendaka pombe.
target_text_raw: Unajuwa kama Tom anapendaka pombe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes sérieux.
target_text: Tunakuwaka serieux.
target_text_raw: Tunakuwaka serieux.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je bois.
target_text: Ninakunywaka.
target_text_raw: Ninakunywaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne veux pas être votre secret.
target_text: Sitaki kukuwekea siri.
target_text_raw: Sitaki kukuwekea siri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous avons une bonne nouvelle.
target_text: Tuka na habari ya mzuri.
target_text_raw: Tuka na habari ya mzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il viendra bientôt.
target_text: Atakuja hivi karibuni.
target_text_raw: Atakuja hivi karibuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Plus de recherches sont nécessaires.
target_text: Utafiti ya zaidi inahitajika.
target_text_raw: Utafiti ya zaidi inahitajika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai entendu ça.
target_text: Nilisikia vile.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne pouvais rien y faire.
target_text: Hakuna kyenyi ningeliweza kufanya.
target_text_raw: Hakuna kyenyi ningeliweza kufanya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi ne nous glissons-nous pas à nouveau à l'intérieur ?
target_text: Kwa nini hatuingiye tena ndani?
target_text_raw: Kwa nini hatuingiye tena ndani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom se donne beaucoup de mal.
target_text: Tom anajisumbua sana.
target_text_raw: Tom anajisumbua sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle parle anglais.
target_text: Anaongea kingereza.
target_text_raw: Anaongea kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vues d'avion, les petites collines paraissent plates.
target_text: Ukiangalilia kutokea mu avion, milima ya kidogo inaonekanaka plat.
target_text_raw: Ukiangalilia kutokea mu avion, milima ya kidogo inaonekanaka plat.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous tentons de réduire les dépenses.
target_text: Tunajaribu kupunguza garama.
target_text_raw: Tunajaribu kupunguza garama.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu as dit qu'il y avait urgence.
target_text: Ulisema kuko urgence.
target_text_raw: Ulisema kuko urgence.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Est-ce vraiment possible ?
target_text: Inawezekana kweli?
target_text_raw: Inawezekana kweli?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a été surpris par ce qu'il a vu.
target_text: Tom alishangazwa na byenye aliona.
target_text_raw: Tom alishangazwa na byenye aliona.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu veux bien me passer le sel, s'il te plaît?
target_text: Tafadhali, unaweza nipokeza chumvi?
target_text_raw: Tafadhali, unaweza nipokeza chumvi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En grandissant, il apprit à mettre les choses en perspective.
target_text: Alipokuwa anakomala, alijifunza kukuwa na matumaini ku mambo ya kesho.
target_text_raw: Alipokuwa anakomala, alijifunza kukuwa na matumaini ku mambo ya kesho.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous n'avez à l'évidence pas le temps.
target_text: Ni wazi hamuna wakati.
target_text_raw: Ni wazi hamuna wakati.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'opéra commence à sept heures.
target_text: Opera itaanza na saa moya.
target_text_raw: Opera itaanza na saa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous ne pouvons pas continuer à nous abuser.
target_text: Hatuwezi endelea tunakwazana.
target_text_raw: Hatuwezi endelea tunakwazana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est un risque que tu dois simplement prendre.
target_text: Ni hatari yenyi ni lazima uichukue.
target_text_raw: Ni hatari yenyi ni lazima uichukue.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est étrange à dire, mais il ne connaissait pas la nouvelle.
target_text: Inashangaza kusema, lakini hakukwa anajuwa ile habari.
target_text_raw: Inashangaza kusema, lakini hakukwa anajuwa ile habari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom fut promu gérant.
target_text: Tom alipandishwa cheo ya kuwa gérant.
target_text_raw: Tom alipandishwa cheo ya kuwa gérant.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Lire des livres est une de mes habitudes.
target_text: Kusoma vitabu ni moja ya tabia zangu.
target_text_raw: Kusoma vitabu ni moja ya tabia zangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a coupé la pomme en deux.
target_text: Tom alikata pome vipande mbili.
target_text_raw: Tom alikata pome vipande mbili.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le fait est qu'ils sont trop jeunes.
target_text: Shida ni juu bangali vijana.
target_text_raw: Shida ni juu bangali vijana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il a dû y aller.
target_text: Ilimubidi aende kule.
target_text_raw: Ilimubidi aende kule.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qui frappe à la porte?
target_text: Nani njo anapiga hodi ku mulango?
target_text_raw: Nani njo anapiga hodi ku mulango?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom n'a pas suffisamment d'argent pour acheter une voiture.
target_text: Tom hana franga ya kutosha kwa kusema auze gari.
target_text_raw: Tom hana franga ya kutosha kwa kusema auze gari.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me demande si je peux faire ça.
target_text: Najiuliza kama ndaweza fanya vile.
target_text_raw: Najiuliza kama ndaweza fanya vile.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom m'a demandé comment se rendre à la poste.
target_text: Tom aliniuliza namna gani mtu ataweza fika ku poste.
target_text_raw: Tom aliniuliza namna gani mtu ataweza fika ku poste.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous espérions que quelque chose d'intéressant surviendrait.
target_text: Tulikuwa na matumaini kama kitu ca maana kitatokea.
target_text_raw: Tulikuwa na matumaini kama kitu ca maana kitatokea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est pas facile de maîtriser l'anglais.
target_text: Siyo rahisi kujua kingereza.
target_text_raw: Siyo rahisi kujua kingereza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voudriez-vous me porter ceci au premier étage ?
target_text: Unaweza kunipelekea hii ku etage ya kwanza?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kunipelekea hii ku etage ya kwanza?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La valeur des livres était telle qu'on en prenait le plus grand soin.
target_text: Samani ya vitabu ilikuwa gisi tulikuwa nazichunga muzuri sana.
target_text_raw: Samani ya vitabu ilikuwa gisi tulikuwa nazichunga muzuri sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'y a que cinq-cent-quatorze personnes qui soient allées dans l'espace.
target_text: Kuko watu mia tano na kumi na ine waliyo enda angani.
target_text_raw: Kuko watu mia tano na kumi na ine waliyo enda angani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien de temps faut-il d'ici à la gare ?
target_text: Hapa na ku parking ni muda wa saa ngapi?
target_text_raw: Hapa na ku parking ni muda wa saa ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il avait dit qu'il m'écrirait, mais il n'en fut rien.
target_text: Alisemaka ataweza niandikiya lakini hakufanya kitu.
target_text_raw: Alisemaka ataweza niandikiya lakini hakufanya kitu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom et Marie n'ont pas été particulièrement gentils avec moi.
target_text: Tom na Marie hawakuwa watu wanzuri kwangu.
target_text_raw: Tom na Marie hawakuwa watu wanzuri kwangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien qu'il soit jeune, il est très prudent.
target_text: Hata kama angali kijana, iko makini sana.
target_text_raw: Hata kama angali kijana, iko makini sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Voulez-vous contrôler les pneus ?
target_text: Unaweza kuchunguza ma pine?
target_text_raw: Unaweza kuchunguza ma pine?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu n'aimes pas le chien de Tom.
target_text: Haupendake imbwa ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Haupendake imbwa ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas du tout peur des chiens.
target_text: Sina kabisa woga wa imbwa.
target_text_raw: Sina kabisa woga wa imbwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je devais rencontrer quelqu'un pour des affaires.
target_text: Nalipashwa kutana na mtu kwa ajili ya biashara.
target_text_raw: Nalipashwa kutana na mtu kwa ajili ya biashara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel âge a ce livre?
target_text: Hiki kitabu kina miaka ngapi?
target_text_raw: Hiki kitabu kina miaka ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La plupart des gens aiment regarder la telé.
target_text: Watu wengi wanapendaka kuangalia télé.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wanapendaka kuangalia télé.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous sommes pauvres, mais heureux.
target_text: Sisi tuko ba masikini, lakini tuko na raha.
target_text_raw: Sisi tuko ba masikini, lakini tuko na raha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je parle anglais, et toi, quelle langue parles-tu ?
target_text: Minaongea Kingereza, na weye, unaongea luga gani?
target_text_raw: Minaongea Kingereza, na weye, unaongea luga gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel sorte de jeu est-ce ?
target_text: Iyi ni mchezo gani?
target_text_raw: Iyi ni mchezo gani?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon père travaille dans une usine.
target_text: Baba anatumikaka mu kiwanda.
target_text_raw: Baba anatumikaka mu kiwanda.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il aime lire des livres.
target_text: Anapendaka soma bitabu.
target_text_raw: Anapendaka soma bitabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie n'est pas figée.
target_text: Maisha inakuwaka na milima na mabonde.
target_text_raw: Maisha inakuwaka na milima na mabonde.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il posa le livre sur la table.
target_text: Akatia kitabu ku meza.
target_text_raw: Akatia kitabu ku meza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bien qu'il ne fût qu'un enfant, il était très courageux.
target_text: Hata kama alikuwa mtoto, alikuwa na juhudi.
target_text_raw: Hata kama alikuwa mtoto, alikuwa na juhudi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Regarde ces nuages noirs.
target_text: Angalia ile mawingu ya mweusi.
target_text_raw: Angalia ile mawingu ya mweusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pourquoi les hommes ne sont-ils jamais heureux ? Parce qu'ils veulent toujours l'impossible.
target_text: Sababu gani wanaume hawakuwake na raha? Kwa sababu kila wakati wanatafuta visivyo wezekana.
target_text_raw: Sababu gani wanaume hawakuwake na raha? Kwa sababu kila wakati wanatafuta visivyo wezekana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On est ici, à l'office de tourisme. Vous voyez ?
target_text: Tuko hapa ku bureau yenyi inausika na ba touristes. Unaona?
target_text_raw: Tuko hapa ku bureau yenyi inausika na ba touristes. Unaona?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il est revenu du Canada.
target_text: Anatokeya Canada.
target_text_raw: Anatokeya Canada.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ils sont en salle des professeurs.
target_text: Wako mu salle ya walimu.
target_text_raw: Wako mu salle ya walimu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous y allons seuls.
target_text: Tunapaenda sisi wenyewe.
target_text_raw: Tunapaenda sisi wenyewe.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mon front brûlait de fièvre.
target_text: Sura yangu inalungula na homa.
target_text_raw: Sura yangu inalungula na homa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dan a été vu pour la dernière fois avec un jean bleu et une veste en cuir noir.
target_text: Dan alionekana kwa mara ya mwisho na Jean ya rangi ya bleu na koti ya ngozi ya mweusi.
target_text_raw: Dan alionekana kwa mara ya mwisho na Jean ya rangi ya bleu na koti ya ngozi ya mweusi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle vivait la porte à côté de chez nous.
target_text: Alikuwa naishi mu mulango ya pembeni ya kwetu.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa naishi mu mulango ya pembeni ya kwetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sa mère a frappé à la porte.
target_text: Mama yake aligonga ku mlango.
target_text_raw: Mama yake aligonga ku mlango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne peux pas l'abandonner.
target_text: Siwezi kumuachilia.
target_text_raw: Siwezi kumuachilia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous n'avons aucune raison d'avoir honte.
target_text: Hatuna hata sababu moya ya kusikia haya.
target_text_raw: Hatuna hata sababu moya ya kusikia haya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: À sept heures je serai de nouveau là.
target_text: Na saa moya nitakuwa tena pale.
target_text_raw: Na saa moya nitakuwa tena pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle n'est plus seule maintenant.
target_text: Haiko yeye peke tena.
target_text_raw: Haiko yeye peke tena.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous tînmes parole.
target_text: Tukakamata kauli.
target_text_raw: Tukakamata kauli.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Qu'est-ce qui se passe, ici ?
target_text: Nini njo iko napitikana hapa?
target_text_raw: Nini njo iko napitikana hapa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'as-tu fait toi-même ?
target_text: Uliifanya wepeke?
target_text_raw: Uliifanya wepeke?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est la vie.
target_text: Ni maisha.
target_text_raw: Ni maisha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Oh ! c'est trop mignon !
target_text: Oh, ni muzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Oh, ni muzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai pas envie de rentrer à la maison!
target_text: Sina hata haja yakurudia ku nyumba.
target_text_raw: Sina hata haja yakurudia ku nyumba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je ne savais pas que Tom dormait.
target_text: Nilikuwa sijuwe kama Tom alikuwa analala.
target_text_raw: Nilikuwa sijuwe kama Tom alikuwa analala.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: De quoi avez-vous peur ?
target_text: Unaogopa nini?
target_text_raw: Unaogopa nini?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Dans cette boîte, je me sentais comme un poisson hors de l'eau.
target_text: Ndani ya hiyo sanduku, nilikuwa na jisikia savile samaki inje ya maji.
target_text_raw: Ndani ya hiyo sanduku, nilikuwa na jisikia savile samaki inje ya maji.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que Tom est blessé.
target_text: Nawaza Tom analumia.
target_text_raw: Nawaza Tom analumia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La vie est dure pour tout le monde.
target_text: Maisha iko magumu kwa kila mutu.
target_text_raw: Maisha iko magumu kwa kila mutu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai peur des ours.
target_text: Nina woga ya nyama za pori.
target_text_raw: Nina woga ya nyama za pori.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle a remporté le premier prix de la course.
target_text: Alishinda mcezo ya kwanza ya kukimbia.
target_text_raw: Alishinda mcezo ya kwanza ya kukimbia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai du travail par-dessus la tête.
target_text: Niko na kazi ya mingi sana.
target_text_raw: Niko na kazi ya mingi sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: N'as-tu pas une réunion ?
target_text: Hauna mkutano?
target_text_raw: Hauna mkutano?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Monte le son de la musique !
target_text: Pandisha sauti ya muziki!
target_text_raw: Pandisha sauti ya muziki!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu vas manquer le train si tu ne te dépêches pas.
target_text: Utakosa gari la moshi kama haufanyi haraka.
target_text_raw: Utakosa gari la moshi kama haufanyi haraka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Non, ça ne me plait pas tant que ça.
target_text: Hapana, hainifurahishe mpaka kwa ile niveau.
target_text_raw: Hapana, hainifurahishe mpaka kwa ile niveau.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Peut-être a-t-il manqué le train.
target_text: Labda alikosa train.
target_text_raw: Labda alikosa train.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Puis-je savoir où vous travaillez ?
target_text: Naweza kujuwa unatumikaka wapi?
target_text_raw: Naweza kujuwa unatumikaka wapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les progrès de l'homme sont sans limites.
target_text: Maendeleo ya mwanadamu haina mipaka.
target_text_raw: Maendeleo ya mwanadamu haina mipaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vous demande pardon. Je ne pense pas que cela soit votre siège.
target_text: Nakuomba musamaha. Sizani kama ile ni fasi yako.
target_text_raw: Nakuomba musamaha. Sizani kama ile ni fasi yako.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom aurait dû manger plus.
target_text: Tom angelipashwa kula mingi zaidi.
target_text_raw: Tom angelipashwa kula mingi zaidi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'est de la faute de Tom.
target_text: Ile ni kosa ya Tom.
target_text_raw: Ile ni kosa ya Tom.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous mangeâmes des fruits frais après le déjeuner.
target_text: Kisha cakula ca mcana, tulikula matunda yenyi walikuwa wanamaliza cuma pale pale.
target_text_raw: Kisha cakula ca mcana, tulikula matunda yenyi walikuwa wanamaliza cuma pale pale.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il n'est rien d'autre qu'un enfant.
target_text: Yeye haiko kitu ingine isipokuwa mtoto tu.
target_text_raw: Yeye haiko kitu ingine isipokuwa mtoto tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Mets de l'eau dans ton vin.
target_text: Tulizana kidogo.
target_text_raw: Tulizana kidogo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: C'était pour rire ?
target_text: Ilikuwa kwa kuchekesha tu?
target_text_raw: Ilikuwa kwa kuchekesha tu?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je veux fonder une famille.
target_text: Nataka kujenga jamaa.
target_text_raw: Nataka kujenga jamaa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quel est ton restaurant de fast food préféré?
target_text: Ni restaurant gani ya chakula cha mbio mbio unapendaka?
target_text_raw: Ni restaurant gani ya chakula cha mbio mbio unapendaka?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un café, ça te dirait ?
target_text: Ungependa kutumia kahawa?
target_text_raw: Ungependa kutumia kahawa?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je viens juste d'apprendre que mon hôtel favori a fait faillite.
target_text: Minapata habari kama hoteli yangu napendaka walihomba.
target_text_raw: Minapata habari kama hoteli yangu napendaka walihomba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Un jour tu comprendras.
target_text: Siku moja utaelewa.
target_text_raw: Siku moja utaelewa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me rappelle l'avoir rencontrée quelque part.
target_text: Nakumbuka kama kuko kwenye nilishaka kutanana naye.
target_text_raw: Nakumbuka kama kuko kwenye nilishaka kutanana naye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Reste hors de ma vue !
target_text: Potea mu macho yangu!
target_text_raw: Potea mu macho yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Combien y a-t-il de sortes ?
target_text: Kuna aina ngapi?
target_text_raw: Kuna aina ngapi?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai dansé.
target_text: Nilicheza.
target_text_raw: Nilicheza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il a eu dix sur dix à l'examen, c'est parce qu'il a triché.
target_text: Kama alipata kumi juya kumi ku mashindano, ni sababu aliiba.
target_text_raw: Kama alipata kumi juya kumi ku mashindano, ni sababu aliiba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tom a gardé son chapeau sur la tête.
target_text: Tom aliweka kofia yake ku kichwa.
target_text_raw: Tom aliweka kofia yake ku kichwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'ai jamais dit cela à personne auparavant.
target_text: Siyaambiaka hata mutu moya vile mbele.
target_text_raw: Siyaambiaka hata mutu moya vile mbele.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La pire amie et ennemie n'est nulle autre que la mort.
target_text: Rafiki na adui wa kutisha siyo mwengine isipokuwa kifo.
target_text_raw: Rafiki na adui wa kutisha siyo mwengine isipokuwa kifo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Femme au volant, mort au tournant.
target_text: Mwanamuke akitembeza gari, ajali inatokeaka.
target_text_raw: Mwanamuke akitembeza gari, ajali inatokeaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: « J'ai rêvé de toi, hier. » « Sérieux ? Et je faisais quoi ? »
target_text: «Nilikulota jana.» «Kweli? Na nilikuwa nafanya nini?»
target_text_raw: «Nilikulota jana.» «Kweli? Na nilikuwa nafanya nini?»
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Fermez la trappe.
target_text: Funga mulango.
target_text_raw: Funga mulango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tu aimerais ça.
target_text: Unaweza penda vile?
target_text_raw: Unaweza penda vile?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je n'arrive pas à croire que nous ayons finalement terminé le projet.
target_text: Sija sadikia kama tumemaliza mpango.
target_text_raw: Sija sadikia kama tumemaliza mpango.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: La campagne a été une réussite et il a gagné les élections.
target_text: Kampeni ilikuwa ushindi na alishinda uchaguzi.
target_text_raw: Kampeni ilikuwa ushindi na alishinda uchaguzi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je dois m'occuper de quelque chose.
target_text: Napashwa kujihusisha na kitu fulani.
target_text_raw: Napashwa kujihusisha na kitu fulani.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je pense que sa proposition mérite réflexion.
target_text: Minawaza kama pendekezo yake inaomba kuifikiria.
target_text_raw: Minawaza kama pendekezo yake inaomba kuifikiria.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je vais corriger ceci.
target_text: Nitakosowa hii.
target_text_raw: Nitakosowa hii.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous vivons à proximité de la grande bibliothèque.

target_text: Ni mujuzi sana wa kweli wa Marekani: kwamba Marekani iweze kubadilika. Muungano wetu unaweza kujiboresha. Kile ambacho tufanya mpaka sasa kinatupa matumaini ya kuhusu kile ambacho tunaweza na tunapashwa fanya kesho.

target_text_raw: Je! Umecheza Hadisi ya Zelda?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les premiers arrivés auront les meilleures places.
target_text: Wale wenyi watafika wa kwanza watapewa fasi zizuri kuliko zote.
target_text_raw: Wale wenyi watafika wa kwanza watapewa fasi zizuri kuliko zote.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je suis si fatigué de tes commentaires arrogants que, maintenant, je ne lis presque rien de ce que tu écris afin d'éviter de tomber sur l'une de tes conneries hautaines.
target_text: Nimechoka sana na ma commentaires zako za majivuno kwamba, hivi sasa, sikusoma hata kitu moya mu byenyi uliandika ju sitaki nianguke mwa ile ma blagues zako zenyi hazina maana na za kiburi tu.
target_text_raw: Nimechoka sana na ma commentaires zako za majivuno kwamba, hivi sasa, sikusoma hata kitu moya mu byenyi uliandika ju sitaki nianguke mwa ile ma blagues zako zenyi hazina maana na za kiburi tu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ok, je suis content que tu puisses venir.
target_text: Sawa, ninafurahi kuona utaweza fika.
target_text_raw: Sawa, ninafurahi kuona utaweza fika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Toute personne accusée d'un acte délictueux est présumée innocente jusqu'à ce que sa culpabilité ait été légalement établie au cours d'un procès public où toutes les garanties nécessaires à sa défense lui auront été assurées.
target_text: Mtu yeyote anaye shtakiwa kwa kosa inayo stahili kuazibiwa anaonekana kama vile hana kosa mpaka ihakikishwe kuwa na kosa kulingana na sheria katika kesi inayo fanyika mbele ya watu wote ambapo anapewa haki ya kupewa watetezi wote wanao faa kwa ajili ya kumutetea.
target_text_raw: Mtu yeyote anaye shtakiwa kwa kosa inayo stahili kuazibiwa anaonekana kama vile hana kosa mpaka ihakikishwe kuwa na kosa kulingana na sheria katika kesi inayo fanyika mbele ya watu wote ambapo anapewa haki ya kupewa watetezi wote wanao faa kwa ajili ya kumutetea.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai contemplé son déhanché tzigane et me suis demandé l'intérêt d'adorer la sainte vierge.
target_text: Nilitafakari juu ya kiuno yake ya gypsy na nikajiuliza nia ya kumwabudu yule bikira mtakatifu.
target_text_raw: Nilitafakari juu ya kiuno yake ya gypsy na nikajiuliza nia ya kumwabudu yule bikira mtakatifu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les parents voient la nouvelle génération comme une génération très éloignée de la réalité et occupée à poursuivre des rêves irréalisables.
target_text: Bazazi banaona batu ba siku hizi sawa vile biko mbali sana na ukweli na biko occupés sana kufuatilia ndoto zenyi haziwezi timilika.
target_text_raw: Bazazi banaona batu ba siku hizi sawa vile biko mbali sana na ukweli na biko occupés sana kufuatilia ndoto zenyi haziwezi timilika.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Buvez tout de suite votre verre de jus de tomate!
target_text: Ukunywe sasa hivi verre yako ya jus ya tomate!
target_text_raw: Ukunywe sasa hivi verre yako ya jus ya tomate!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: A force de rouler sa bosse, on en voit du paysage !
target_text: Mtu akizowea ulemavu wake anaanzaka iona kama ni ya muzuri.
target_text_raw: Mtu akizowea ulemavu wake anaanzaka iona kama ni ya muzuri.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quoi ? Alex, c'était une fille ? J'ai toujours cru que c'était un garçon.
target_text: Nini? Alex, ni binti? Nilikuwaka nawaza kama alikuwa garcon.
target_text_raw: Nini? Alex, ni binti? Nilikuwaka nawaza kama alikuwa garcon.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'ailleurs un procès, mais c'est très amusant.
target_text: Kwanza ni proces, lakini ya kucekesha sana.
target_text_raw: Kwanza ni proces, lakini ya kucekesha sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous devrions consacrer notre temps à créer du contenu pour notre site web plutôt que de gâcher du temps à nous préoccuper de détails esthétiques mineurs.
target_text: Tulipashwa kamata wakati tukitengeneza tuvuti yetu pahali ya kupitisha wakati ya kufuatilia bitu ya mapambo isiyo na maana.
target_text_raw: Tulipashwa kamata wakati tukitengeneza tuvuti yetu pahali ya kupitisha wakati ya kufuatilia bitu ya mapambo isiyo na maana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le président Ho Chi Minh a bourlingué durant trente années à travers le monde pour chercher la voie au salut national.
target_text: Raisi Ho Chi Minh alitembea dunia muzima miaka makumi tatu kwa ajili kutafuta namna ya kuleta kimya ndani ya inchi.
target_text_raw: Raisi Ho Chi Minh alitembea dunia muzima miaka makumi tatu kwa ajili kutafuta namna ya kuleta kimya ndani ya inchi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Danny n'a pas le sens du beau.
target_text: Danny hana hamu ya buyana.
target_text_raw: Danny hana hamu ya buyana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: On a cru que le choléra a définitivement disparu, mis il revient de plus belle.
target_text: Tulizani kama cholera ilishaka lote, lakini inarudia tena na nguvu.
target_text_raw: Tulizani kama cholera ilishaka lote, lakini inarudia tena na nguvu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Tout ce que tu as à faire c'est t'asseoir là et répondre aux questions du médecin.
target_text: Kitu moja ya kufanya ni kuikala pale na kujibia ku maulizo ya muganga.
target_text_raw: Kitu moja ya kufanya ni kuikala pale na kujibia ku maulizo ya muganga.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Durant le sommeil, le cerveau traite préalablement les informations acquises et les transforme en mémoire de longue durée. Un temps de sommeil court peut déjà contribuer à l'amélioration d'une capacité nouvellement apprise.
target_text: Mu busingizi, inawezekana ubongo inachambua habari zenye ilipata na kuzigeuza kuwa kumbukumbu ya muda mrefu. Muda ya busingisi ya muda mfupi inaweza boresha akili ya vitu mupya byenye mtu alijifunza.
target_text_raw: Mu busingizi, inawezekana ubongo inachambua habari zenye ilipata na kuzigeuza kuwa kumbukumbu ya muda mrefu. Muda ya busingisi ya muda mfupi inaweza boresha akili ya vitu mupya byenye mtu alijifunza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jason, qui était en charge du projet, a été renvoyé pour cause de corruption.
target_text: Jason, mwenyi alikuwa msimamizi wa mradi, amefukuzwa sababu ya rushwa.
target_text_raw: Jason, mwenyi alikuwa msimamizi wa mradi, amefukuzwa sababu ya rushwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elles disent toutes qu'elles ne veulent pas qu'on ne s'intéresse à elles que pour leur physique, mais passent toutes les trois-quarts de leur temps à s'en occuper.
target_text: Wote wanasema hawataki watu wawapende juu ya umbo yao tu, lakini wanapitisha karibu wakati yao yote wanajitengeneza sura.
target_text_raw: Wote wanasema hawataki watu wawapende juu ya umbo yao tu, lakini wanapitisha karibu wakati yao yote wanajitengeneza sura.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le chat est enfermé dans le placard. Peux-tu le laisser sortir ?
target_text: Pusi inafungiwa mu nyumba yake. Unaweza iacha iende inje?
target_text_raw: Pusi inafungiwa mu nyumba yake. Unaweza iacha iende inje?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai remarqué que j'avais grandi lorsque j'ai commencé à suivre les conseils de mes parents.
target_text: Niliona kama nilisha komala wakati nilianza fuata mashauri ya wazazi wangu.
target_text_raw: Niliona kama nilisha komala wakati nilianza fuata mashauri ya wazazi wangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Bref, vous auriez dû accepter cette responsabilité.
target_text: Kwa kifupi, ulipashwa itika ile majukumu.
target_text_raw: Kwa kifupi, ulipashwa itika ile majukumu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Marie a disparu sans laisser de traces. Peut-être a-t-elle été enlevée.
target_text: Marie alipotea bila hata kuaca traces. Labda alitekwa nyara.
target_text_raw: Marie alipotea bila hata kuaca traces. Labda alitekwa nyara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Sur une fiche de paie est indiqué : Le salaire brut et le salaire net.
target_text: Ku fiche ya mushahara kunaandikwa: Mushahara bila kodi na mushara kisha kodi.
target_text_raw: Ku fiche ya mushahara kunaandikwa: Mushahara bila kodi na mushara kisha kodi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hé ! Je ne m'attendais pas à te rencontrer ici ! Le monde est petit, n'est-ce pas ?
target_text: Hee! Sikukuwa nawazia kama ndakukuta hapa! Dunia iko kidogo, si ndiyo?
target_text_raw: Hee! Sikukuwa nawazia kama ndakukuta hapa! Dunia iko kidogo, si ndiyo?
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Attendez à la gare, je viendrai vous chercher.
target_text: Mungoye pale ku gare, ndakuya bakamata.
target_text_raw: Mungoye pale ku gare, ndakuya bakamata.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère qu'il ne nous arrivera rien de grave.
target_text: Nina matumaini kama hakuna bya grave byenyi bitatufikia.
target_text_raw: Nina matumaini kama hakuna bya grave byenyi bitatufikia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand le sage montre la lune, l'imbécile regarde le doigt.
target_text: Wakati mwenyi busara anaonyesha mbaramwezi,mpumbavu anaangalia kidole.
target_text_raw: Wakati mwenyi busara anaonyesha mbaramwezi,mpumbavu anaangalia kidole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Ouais, j'ai un nouveau boulot mais il n'a rien d'extraordinaire.
target_text: Ndio, niko ba kazi ya mpya lakini haina bya ajabu.
target_text_raw: Ndio, niko ba kazi ya mpya lakini haina bya ajabu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand vous vous tenez si proche de la mort, sachant qu'elle ne vous touchera pas, vous sentez quelque chose de spécial !
target_text: Wakati unakaribia sana kifo, ukijuwa haitakugusa, unasikia kitu yenyi iko special !
target_text_raw: Wakati unakaribia sana kifo, ukijuwa haitakugusa, unasikia kitu yenyi iko special !
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jamais je ne pourrai oublier cet horrible épisode de mon enfance.
target_text: Hakuna siku ndasahau ile kipindi ya boga ya mu butoto yangu.
target_text_raw: Hakuna siku ndasahau ile kipindi ya boga ya mu butoto yangu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Jim regarda à droite et à gauche avant de traverser la rue.
target_text: Jim aliangalia kuume na kushoto mbele ya kuvuka barabara.
target_text_raw: Jim aliangalia kuume na kushoto mbele ya kuvuka barabara.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Nous parlons trop vite pour les étrangers qui viennent en France.
target_text: Tunazungumza haraka sana kwa wageni wenye wanatokea Ufaransa.
target_text_raw: Tunazungumza haraka sana kwa wageni wenye wanatokea Ufaransa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Eh ! Tu as oublié ton baiser. Désolé, tes clés !
target_text: Hee! Ulisahau bizu yako? Samahani, fungulo zako!
target_text_raw: Hee! Ulisahau bizu yako? Samahani, fungulo zako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'ai un but, une tâche, disons le mot, une passion. Le métier d'écrire en est une violente et presque indestructible.
target_text: Niko na lengo, kazi, tuseme neno, ninashikilia sana. Kazi ya uandishi ni ya nguvu sana na inakaribia kuwa ya kuangamiza.
target_text_raw: Niko na lengo, kazi, tuseme neno, ninashikilia sana. Kazi ya uandishi ni ya nguvu sana na inakaribia kuwa ya kuangamiza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il ne faut pas se fier aux choses qui ne peuvent pas arriver, car c'est justement celles-là qui arrivent.
target_text: Haifai kutumainia bitu byenyi habiwezi fika, juu na njo binafikaka.
target_text_raw: Haifai kutumainia bitu byenyi habiwezi fika, juu na njo binafikaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Stop, attendez !
target_text: Stop, mungoye!
target_text_raw: Stop, mungoye!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le professeur a commandé quelques nouveaux livres de New York.
target_text: Mwalimu alilomba bitabu bya mupya kutoka New York.
target_text_raw: Mwalimu alilomba bitabu bya mupya kutoka New York.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'occasion de sauver des vies sera bientôt perdue.
target_text: Bahati nzuri ya kuokowa maisha itapotea hapa karibuni.
target_text_raw: Bahati nzuri ya kuokowa maisha itapotea hapa karibuni.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Elle était assise au bar, descendant les verres de whisky les uns à la suite des autres.
target_text: Alikuwa anaikala ku bar, alikuwa akimeza ma verres za whisky moya kwa moya.
target_text_raw: Alikuwa anaikala ku bar, alikuwa akimeza ma verres za whisky moya kwa moya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je sais que tu penses avoir compris ce que tu pensais que j'avais dit, mais je ne suis pas sûr que tu as réalisé que ce que tu as entendu n'est pas ce que je voulais dire.
target_text: Minajua kama unazani ulisikia byenye ulikuwa nawaza nilisemaka, lakini sina uhakika kama ulielewa kama byenye ulisikia haiko njo byenye nilitaka sema.
target_text_raw: Minajua kama unazani ulisikia byenye ulikuwa nawaza nilisemaka, lakini sina uhakika kama ulielewa kama byenye ulisikia haiko njo byenye nilitaka sema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D'abord ce Latium, cette terre fatale, / tu les crois séparés par un court intervalle ; / mais la mer, devant toi s'agrandissant toujours, / de ta longue carrière allongera le cours.
target_text: Kwanza Latium, iyi udongo ya hatari, / unazani kama inagabulika na intervalle ya mufupi, / lakini bahari, mbele yako inaongezeka kila mara, / kwa kazi yako murefu mutoni itaongezeka burefu.
target_text_raw: Kwanza Latium, iyi udongo ya hatari, / unazani kama inagabulika na intervalle ya mufupi, / lakini bahari, mbele yako inaongezeka kila mara, / kwa kazi yako murefu mutoni itaongezeka burefu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: En continuant à massacrer des populations civiles malgré une dénonciation internationale généralisée, cet État raciste et colonialiste voudrait banaliser le fait de tuer des populations civiles en grand nombre.
target_text: Kuendelea kuuawa raia hata kama umoja wa mataifa inalaumu kwa ujumla, ile serkali ya kibaguzi ya rangi na ukoloni haijiuzi kutokana na mauwaji ya hesabu kubwa ya raia.
target_text_raw: Kuendelea kuuawa raia hata kama umoja wa mataifa inalaumu kwa ujumla, ile serkali ya kibaguzi ya rangi na ukoloni haijiuzi kutokana na mauwaji ya hesabu kubwa ya raia.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: D’aucun dira que le numéro treize porte malchance.
target_text: Watu wengi wanasema kama numba 13 ni ya bahati mubaya.
target_text_raw: Watu wengi wanasema kama numba 13 ni ya bahati mubaya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le moindre mot de critique la rend nerveuse.
target_text: Neno tu kidogo ya kumu critiquer inamusirikishaka.
target_text_raw: Neno tu kidogo ya kumu critiquer inamusirikishaka.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'avais senti une pression sur mon épaule et je m'étais retourné.
target_text: Nilisikia libega yangu inaluma nikajigeuza.
target_text_raw: Nilisikia libega yangu inaluma nikajigeuza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Brian a acheté du rouge à lèvres pour Kate.
target_text: Brian aliuzia Kate rouge à levres.
target_text_raw: Brian aliuzia Kate rouge à levres.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'ail dégage une odeur forte.
target_text: Litungulu sumu inatosha harufu ya nguvu sana.
target_text_raw: Litungulu sumu inatosha harufu ya nguvu sana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il nous a fallu adapter nos vies aux nouvelles circonstances.
target_text: Ilitulomba tu adapter maisha yetu ku situations za mpya.
target_text_raw: Ilitulomba tu adapter maisha yetu ku situations za mpya.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si on remonte la poupée avec la clé sur le côté de son torse, elle fera des cercles avec ses bras et avancera en faisant des culbutes.
target_text: Kama unatia fungulo mu poupée kwenye upande ya kifua yaje, itafanya miviringo na mikono yake na itapiga ma culbutes.
target_text_raw: Kama unatia fungulo mu poupée kwenye upande ya kifua yaje, itafanya miviringo na mikono yake na itapiga ma culbutes.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je serais ravie si vous pouviez vous joindre à nous pour déjeuner.
target_text: Ndafurahi kama munakuya tukule pamoya cakula ya mcana.
target_text_raw: Ndafurahi kama munakuya tukule pamoya cakula ya mcana.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si vous trouvez une erreur, merci de laisser un commentaire.
target_text: Kama munapata kosa, musikose kusema.
target_text_raw: Kama munapata kosa, musikose kusema.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Que des idées stupides ne te viennent pas à l'esprit !
target_text: Mawazo mabaya isikuye mu akili yako!
target_text_raw: Mawazo mabaya isikuye mu akili yako!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le nouvel album de « Take That », c'est de la balle !
target_text: Album ya mupya ya «Take that», ni ya muzuri sana!
target_text_raw: Album ya mupya ya «Take that», ni ya muzuri sana!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le passé est un œuf cassé, l’avenir est un œuf couvé.
target_text: Wakati iliyo pita ni liyayi yenyi kulamuka,maisha ya kesho ni liyayi yenyi iko amo kitoto.
target_text_raw: Wakati iliyo pita ni liyayi yenyi kulamuka,maisha ya kesho ni liyayi yenyi iko amo kitoto.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je me rends compte que je ne suis peut-être pas l'homme le plus séduisant du monde mais j'espère quand même que tu envisageras de sortir avec moi.
target_text: Ninaona kama labda siko mwanaume mwenyi kuvutia kuliko wengine wote duniani lakini ninatumaini kama utapenda kutoka na miye.
target_text_raw: Ninaona kama labda siko mwanaume mwenyi kuvutia kuliko wengine wote duniani lakini ninatumaini kama utapenda kutoka na miye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Les téléspectateurs ne voient que ce que la caméra montre.
target_text: Watazamaji wanaonaka tu byenyi camera inaonyesha.
target_text_raw: Watazamaji wanaonaka tu byenyi camera inaonyesha.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Je refuse de répondre à une question aussi stupide.
target_text: Minakatala kujibia ulizo ya upumbavu kama iyi.
target_text_raw: Minakatala kujibia ulizo ya upumbavu kama iyi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Il faisait sombre, la Lune brillait d'une lumière claire, la neige reposait sur la campagne verte, tandis qu'une voiture, lente comme la vitesse de l'éclair avançait autour du coin circulaire.
target_text: Giza ilikuwa,mbara mwezi ilikuwa inaanzaka na mwangaza Mauro,neige ilikuwa,kisha gari,ilikuya pole pole na vitesse saa ya radi,ikaendelea mu coin ya kiviringo.
target_text_raw: Giza ilikuwa,mbara mwezi ilikuwa inaanzaka na mwangaza Mauro,neige ilikuwa,kisha gari,ilikuya pole pole na vitesse saa ya radi,ikaendelea mu coin ya kiviringo.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Kylia a refusé que j'appelle une ambulance alors je l'ai amené à l'hôpital par moi-même.
target_text: Kylia alikatala niite ambulance na njo nimemubeba ku hopital mi pekee.
target_text_raw: Kylia alikatala niite ambulance na njo nimemubeba ku hopital mi pekee.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Quand je suis rentré à la maison, j'ai trouvé bizarre que la porte fût ouverte.
target_text: Saa nilirudia ku nyumba, nilishangala kuona mlango inafunguliwa.
target_text_raw: Saa nilirudia ku nyumba, nilishangala kuona mlango inafunguliwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si l'on devait nommer les pays d'après les mots qu'on y entend d'abord, l'Angleterre s'appellerait “damn it”.

source_text: Il n'arrive rien de neuf. Ce sont toujours les mêmes vieilles histoires qui arrivent à de nouvelles gens.

target_text: Iko na kiburi sana. Minakulapia kama ingekuwa hayazaliwaka tena, angekuwa mikrobe yenye inaweza ishi hata mu hewa.

target_text: Na kwa hivyo, mu ile hali, aca nikwambie, kwa ukweli na waziwazi ginsi ndaeza weza, juu ya shida fulani fulani, inatuomba tu tuungane mkono kwa kuzipiganisha.

source_text: Faites bien attention à mettre le bon objet avant de m'envoyer votre e-mail, autrement il finira dans le dossier "pourriel".
target_text: Kuwa mwangalifu kuweka bidhaa sahihi kabla ya kunitumia barua pepe yako, vinginevyo itaishia kwenye folda ya "barua taka".

target_text_raw: Ikiwa ni ya haraka, je! Ninaweza kumutumia ujumbe kwenye téléavertisseur ...?

target_text_raw: Afisa wa polisi alionyesha kuwa inaonekana sawa kilonda ya bunduki la makusudi kwa kichwa.

source_text: De belles paroles, une belle mélodie. La chanson est tout de suite devenue ma préférée.
target_text: Maneno mazuri, wimbo muzuri. Wimbo uligeuka mara moja yenyi minapenda sana.
target_text_raw: Maneno mazuri, wimbo muzuri. Wimbo uligeuka mara moja yenyi minapenda sana.

source_text: Mon père ordonne alors de repasser les flots, / d'aller interroger les trépieds de Délos, / d'apprendre dans quels lieux doivent finir nos peines, / nos travaux renaissants, nos courses incertaines.
target_text: Kwa hivyo baba yangu anaamuru kuvuka mawimbi tena, / kwenda kuswali safari za Delos, / kujifunza katika sehemu ambazo huzuni zetu lazima zimalizike, / kazi zetu mupya, mashuguli zetu zenye hazina uhakika.

source_text: Pour les personnes qui comprennent quelque chose à propos de l'art, il n'y a pas besoin de mots. On dit "Hm!" "Ha!" ou "Ho!", et avec cela tout est exprimé.
target_text: Kwa watu ambao wanaelewa kitu juu ya sanaa, hakuna lazima ya maneno. Bana semaka “Hm!” “Ha!”au "Ho!", na kwa iyo kila kitu kimesha elezwa.
target_text_raw: Kwa watu ambao wanaelewa kitu juu ya sanaa, hakuna lazima ya maneno. Bana semaka “Hm!” “Ha!”au "Ho!", na kwa iyo kila kitu kimesha elezwa.

source_text: J'ai aimé, j'aime, j'aimerai l'idée de Tatoeba.

target_text_raw: Nilipenda, napenda, nitaipenda wazo ya Tatoeba.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Si c'est pas cassé, faut pas chercher à le faire réparer.

target_text_raw: Ikiwa haijavunjika, usijaribu kuitengeneza.

source_text: Il espère revenir l'an prochain.

target_text_raw: Ana tumainia kurudi mwaka yenye inakuja.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pitié est morte, amour est enterré.

target_text_raw: Huruma imekufa, upendo umezikwa.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: S'il te plaît, s'il te plaît, continue de chanter faux !

target_text_raw: Tafadhali, tafadhali endelea kuimba nje ya wimbo!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le commandant de l'unité a donné l'ordre de déposer les armes.

target_text_raw: Mukubwa wa kikosi alitoa amri ya kuweka silaa chini.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Pour quelqu'un qui est censé être expert, vous ne semblez pas en savoir long.
target_text: Kwa mutu anayetakiwa kuwa mutaalamu, hauonekani unajua mengi.
target_text_raw: Kwa mutu anayetakiwa kuwa mutaalamu, hauonekani unajua mengi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Le joyeux Ned se proposait de revenir le lendemain à cette île enchantée, qu'il voulait dépeupler de tous ses quadrupèdes comestibles.
target_text: Ned ya kupendekezwa ilipendekeza kurudi siku iliyofuata kwenye kisiwa hiki kilichowezeshwa, ambacho alitaka kutoa quadrupèdes comestibles huko.
target_text_raw: Ned ya kupendekezwa ilipendekeza kurudi siku iliyofuata kwenye kisiwa hiki kilichowezeshwa, ambacho alitaka kutoa quadrupèdes comestibles huko.

source_text: Ne soyez pas méchant, s’écria Anna Pavlovna en le menaçant du doigt.

target_text_raw: Usiwe mukali, alilia Anna Pavlovna, akimtishia kwa kidole.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Hier, Jules a été blessé dans un accident de moto, donc il ne pourra pas participer au cours de gym pour le moment.
target_text: Jules alijeruliwa jana kwenye ajali ya pikipiki, kwa hivyo hataweza kushiriki darasa la mazoezi kwa sasa.
target_text_raw: Jules alijeruliwa jana kwenye ajali ya pikipiki, kwa hivyo hataweza kushiriki darasa la mazoezi kwa sasa.

source_text: Tu parles en premier; je parlerai ensuite.

target_text_raw: Utaongea kwanza, miye nitaongea baadaye.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: J'espère que vous serez des nôtres.
target_text: Natumai utakuwa pamoja nasi.
target_text_raw: Natumai utakuwa pamoja nasi.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Selon mes dispositions en ce temps-là le contenu de ce livre devait être formé par des données, qui seraient pour la présentation des choses spirituelles, des informations cohérentes pour les pensées utilisées dans le domaine des sciences naturelles.
target_text: Kulingana na mpangilio wangu wakati huo yaliyomo katika kitabu hiki yangeundwa na data, ambayo itakuwa ya uwasilishaji wa mambo ya kiroho, habari madhubuti kwa mawazo yanayotumiwa katika uwanja wa sayansi asilia.
target_text_raw: Kulingana na mpangilio wangu wakati huo yaliyomo katika kitabu hiki yangeundwa na data, ambayo itakuwa ya uwasilishaji wa mambo ya kiroho, habari madhubuti kwa mawazo yanayotumiwa katika uwanja wa sayansi asilia.

source_text: La chirurgie laser peut corriger certains problèmes de la vision.

target_text_raw: Upasuaji wa laser unaweza kusahihisha shida fulani za kuona.

source_text: Eh ben mon cochon !

target_text_raw: Sawa nguruwe yangu!
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: L'opinion publique joue un rôle important dans le domaine politique.
target_text: Maoni ya watu iko na umuhimu mukubwa kwenye uwanja wa siasa.
target_text_raw: Maoni ya watu iko na umuhimu mukubwa kwenye uwanja wa siasa.

source_text: Amiral, un vaisseau non identifié s'approche de notre position.

target_text_raw: Amiral, Boti fulani isiyo julikana inakaribia eneo yetu.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

target_text_raw: Ningeenda kutoa mwezi kama unge niuliza.
notes: CLEAR Global source accepted as supplied; validated by a Congo Swahili speaker.

source_text: Vous devriez lui présenter des excuses pour être arrivés en retard.

target_text_raw: Ungeli muomba musamaha kwa kuchelewa.

source_text: Au secours ! au secours ! Arrière, sacrilège ! infâme ! maudit !

target_text_raw: Munisaidie! Munisaidie! Nyuma, kitendo mubaya! kibaya ! ulaaniwe!

source_text: Tu laisses toujours la fenêtre ouverte lorsque tu dors.

target_text_raw: Una achaka dirisha wazi kila wakati ukilala.

source_text: Has your appetite changed?

source_text: Tu dois fermer la porte quand tu vas aux toilettes, hein ?

target_text_raw: Ukuwe unafunge mulango wakati unaenda ku choo, huh?

target_text_raw: Vipi tuki cheza muchezo waku tupiana kabumbu?" - "Ndio, kwa nini apana?

target_text_raw: Anapenda kimaneno lakini sio kimatendo. (Upendo wa kuku yenye haina liziba!)

target_text_raw: Nili pitisha mashine ya kuosha ku ma chumba yote masaa yote ya asubui.

target_text_raw: Tutafika Akita saa ngapi ikiwa tunachukua treni ya 9:30 asubuhi?

target_text_raw: Kitabu «Minakuomba haki ya kufa» inasimulia tukio ya kusikitisha ya kifo cha Vincent Humbert.

source_text: Si vous voulez que ça se passe bien entre nous, il va falloir jouer cartes sur table et ne pas nous mentir comme la dernière fois.
target_text: Ikiwa unataka iende vizuri kati yetu, italazimika ku ongea ukweli na sio kutudanganya kama ile mara ingine iliyo pita.

source_text: Avez-vous déjà fait l'expérience de quelque chose de vraiment étrange et que vous ne pouvez pas vraiment expliquer, mais qui, lorsque vous y pensez vraiment sans l'ignorer, vous fait finalement très peur ?
target_text: Je! Umewahi kuona kitu cha kushangaza sana ambacho huwezi kuelezea, lakini ambayo wakati unafikiria juu yake bila kupuuza hatimaye kinakutisha?

target_text_raw: Anza mara moja sai, au utachelewa.

source_text: Georgette pense qu'Oliver passe trop de temps sur les jeux vidéos.

target_text_raw: Georgette anafikiria kama Oliver anatumiaka wakati mingi ku michezo ya video.

source_text: Il savait qu'ils n'allaient pas lui faire de fleur, que ça allait être sa fête.

target_text_raw: Alijua hawata mupatia maua, ingekuwa siku kuu yake.

source_text: Le diable se cache dans les détails, ainsi que vous le savez tous.

target_text_raw: Shetani ana jifichaka mu maelezo ya kindani, kama vile nyie bote munajua.

source_text: Vous m'arrêtez pour violence domestique? Franchement, les mecs!

target_text_raw: Je! Unanikamata kwa dhuluma ya nyumbani? Kwa ukweli, ma rafiki zangu!
